column1: Engineers had clearly intended for the BSN-3K to engage its enemies at short to medium ranges. The primary weapon on the 'Mech is a MRM-20 launcher, backed up by a pair of ER Medium Lasers and two highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. While the 'Mech is vulnerable to long-range attacks, when engaged in close quarters the Bishamon is an extremely dangerous 'Mech to face. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 工程师们显然打算让BSN-3K在短到中距离上与敌人交战。该机甲的主武器是一具MRM-20发射器，辅以两门增程中型激光和两门高精度中型脉冲激光。虽然该机甲易受远程攻击压制，但在近距离交战中，毗沙门天是极为危险的对手。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Heavy Scout Quad
column2: 重型火箭 Scout Quad

column1: The Bishamon is a quad BattleMech designed by Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited, which uses a mix of advanced construction techniques and advanced weapons systems to both save weight and make it as effective as possible on the battlefield. Officials had approached Nimakachi Fusion after the success of the Venom to build a larger design with newer technologies that had been introduced at the time. Nimakachi engineers originally intended for the Bishamon to have jump jets, however with a heavier weapons load the tradeoffs were enough to satisfy DCMS officials. Intended as a heavy scout, the Bishamon is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 315 XL engine that gives it a ground speed of 118.8 km/h. While the Bishamon's high ground speed makes it a hard target to hit, the 'Mech carries 10.5 tons of Nimakachi Type 3 armor that provides adequate protection for the 'Mech's size. The Bishamon also has an extremely stable frame due to its quadrupedal chassis, at the expense of space available for weapons and equipment.
column2: Bishamon 是由 Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited 设计的四足战斗机甲，它结合了先进的建造工艺与先进的武器系统，既节省重量，又尽可能提升战场效能。在 Venom 取得成功后，官方曾找上 Nimakachi Fusion，希望以当时新推出的技术打造一款更大的设计。Nimakachi 的工程师原本打算为 Bishamon 配备跳跃推进器，但由于武器载荷更重，权衡取舍的结果足以让 DCMS 官员满意。Bishamon 定位为重型侦察机甲，采用轻量化的内骨架底盘，由一台 315 XL 引擎驱动，地面速度可达 118.8 km/h。Bishamon 的高地面速度使其成为难以命中的目标，同时该机甲披挂 10.5 吨 Nimakachi Type 3 装甲，为其体量提供了足够的防护。得益于四足底盘，Bishamon 的框架极其稳定，代价则是可用于武器和装备的空间减少。

column1: The 4K variant of the Bishamon is intended to command a C3 lance. In order to accomplish this, the 'Mech has had the MRM-20 launcher downgraded to an MRM-10 launcher, and replaces its two ER medium lasers with two ER small lasers. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 毗沙门的 4K 变型旨在指挥一个 C3 小队。为此，这台机甲的 MRM-20 发射器被降级为 MRM-10 发射器，两门增程中型激光也换成了两门增程小型激光。 特性：先进光学系统 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Black Hawk-KU
column2: 黑鹰-KU

column1: Formerly known as the Bulldog variant, this configuration is a field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog. It utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. A mix of arm-mounted short and long range weapons, this configuration mounts two Clan-tech ER Large Lasers mounted in the right, with two Clan Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left. Carrying a ton of reloads of each Streak Missile Launcher, a C3 Slave unit allows further enhances its abilities. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这一构型原称斗牛犬改型，是在斗牛犬行动期间开发的战场升级方案。它利用缴获的Smoke Jaguar部族武器，帮助增强后续几波攻势中的SLDF部队。这一构型混合了臂挂式近程与远程武器，右侧装有两门部族科技增程大型激光，左侧则装有两具部族连发SRM-6发射器。每具连发导弹发射器都携带一吨再装填弹药，而一个C3从属单元则进一步增强了它的能力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 km/h.
column2: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为能复制黑鹰，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族原版重十吨。它基于六十吨底盘建造，由一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

column1: This variant carries seven medium lasers in each arm and a C3 Slave next to the cockpit. To keep the BHKU-OX cool, it carries an experimental Coolant Pod in the left and right torsos. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变型在每条手臂各携带七门中型激光，驾驶舱旁装有一台 C3 从属计算机。为给 BHKU-OX 降温，它还在左右躯干各携带一个实验性冷却剂罐。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Black Lanner
column2: 黑猎隼

column1: This dedicated fire-support model uses a pair of LRM-20s, though they can only call upon three tons of ammunition. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这款专职火力支援型号使用一对LRM-20，但只能依靠三吨弹药。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Fire Support & Skirmisher
column2: 火力支援与散兵

column1: This dedicated fire-support model uses a pair of LRM-20s, though they can only call upon three tons of ammunition.
column2: 这一专用火力支援型号使用两具LRM-20，不过它们只能调用三吨弹药。

column1: The Black Lanner 'Bellonarius' is a custom designed 'Mech, carrying a Streak SRM-4 in each side torso, supported by three machine guns in each arm, a heavy medium laser in the left torso, and a heavy small laser in the head. Two tons of Streak ammunition and four tons of machine gun reloads give the Bellonarius reasonable field endurance. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 黑隼"贝罗纳里乌斯"是一台定制设计的机甲，两侧躯干各装有一具连发SRM-4，每只手臂另有三挺机枪，左躯干装有一具重型中型激光，头部则装有一具重型小型激光。两吨连发导弹弹药与四吨机枪备弹让"贝罗纳里乌斯"拥有相当不错的战场续航能力。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Newly developed by Clan Jade Falcon for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere, the Black Lanner is a fast medium OmniMech that can take on a variety of roles. Intended as a front-line 'Mech, the Black Lanner makes use of all weight-saving technology available to the Clan Jade Falcon scientists who designed it, including an XL engine, endo steel, and eight tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Black Lanner also includes a MASC system on the base chassis that enables it to run up to 151 km/h in bursts, allowing it to outrun many 'Mechs half its size. The design sacrifices pod space for that speed however, with an engine almost half the Black Lanner's weight leaving a mere 13 tons for offensive weaponry.
column2: 黑猎隼由翡翠隼氏族为入侵内天体而新近开发，是一款能承担多种角色的快速中型全能机甲。作为一线机甲，黑猎隼用上了设计它的翡翠隼科学家所能获得的一切减重技术，包括 XL 引擎、内骨骼和八吨铁纤维装甲。黑猎隼的基础底盘还装有 MASC 系统，使其能在爆发中跑至 151 公里/小时，足以甩开许多体型只有它一半的机甲。不过该设计为速度牺牲了吊舱空间——引擎几乎占去黑猎隼一半重量，只留下 13 吨用于攻击武器。

column1: The Black Lanner's F2 loadout is currently only used with the Jade Falcon Clan. It is a general-purpose design, intended to take on recon patrols and disrupt supply lines on an intermittent basis. The choice of weapons suggests a need to minimize the burden on the Jade Falcon support and technical training pipelines. Unfortunately, while it is capable of many routine assignments, the F2 will do none of them well. It is presumed the Jade Falcons will exercise caution, fielding this configuration only when they are sure there are no massed formations of Battlemechs in the target area. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 黑兰纳的F2配置目前仅供翡翠猎鹰部族使用。这是一种通用设计，用于执行侦察巡逻，并间歇性地破坏补给线。其武器选择表明，该设计有意将对翡翠猎鹰后勤与技术人员培养体系的负担降到最低。遗憾的是，尽管F2能胜任许多常规任务，却没有一项能做得很好。可以推测，翡翠猎鹰使用时也会相当谨慎，只有在确信目标区域内没有大规模战斗机甲编队时，才会投入这一配置。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The ability to close quickly on large, slow-moving Assault 'Mechs, combined with the potential to kill such foes with a single headshot, makes it abundantly clear the Black Lanner G2 configuration is intended for brutal sledgehammer operations. Deployed in pure Stars, the G2 can quickly gain the upper hand and go on to dominate the battlefield, moving about at will. Jade Falcon Commanders who make proper use of this threat can force an opponent into defensive strategies which will ultimately lead to defeat. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 能迅速逼近庞大而行动迟缓的突击机甲，再加上一记爆头即可击杀这类敌人的潜力，充分说明黑鹞G2配置是为残酷的“大锤”作战而设。以纯星队部署时，G2能迅速占据上风并进而主宰战场，随心所欲地机动。善用这一威胁的玉猫指挥官可以迫使对手转入防御策略，最终走向失败。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The H configuration mounts four additional double heat sinks to combat the heat that the heavy large laser and pair of medium pulse lasers build; it also has an ECM suite. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: H构型额外加装了四具双散热器，以应对重型大型激光与两门中型脉冲激光产生的热量；它还配备了一套电子对抗套件。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The S loadout is a hunter-killer designed primarily to take out enemy support 'Mechs. It can easily deal with enemy recon patrols, rapidly bypass front lines and bring the fight to softer targets in the rear or close in quickly on large, slow-moving ‘missile boats’ and artillery support vehicles - all depending on the current needs. Seventy-two percent of the weapons systems are energy-based, giving the Lanner S respectable battlefield endurance. This, combined with its impressive mobility, translates to chaos and carnage when it reaches the back field Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: S配置是一种猎杀者构型，主要用于清除敌方的支援机甲。它能轻松应对敌方侦察巡逻队，迅速绕过前线，把战斗带到后方更脆弱的目标身上，或快速逼近庞大迟缓的“导弹艇”与炮击支援车辆——一切视当下需要而定。其武器系统有百分之七十二为能量武器，让Lanner S拥有相当不错的战场续航力。再加上其出色的机动性，这意味着当它突入后方时，带来的便是混乱与屠杀。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Black Python
column2: 黑蟒

column1: This variant was introduced by Clan Steel Viper. It replaces the traditional weaponry with a pair of ER PPCs, a Gauss rifle, and two Machine Guns. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 该变型由钢蝰蛇部族推出，它以2门增程粒子炮、1门高斯步枪和2挺机枪取代了传统武器。\n<特性：改进瞄准（近程）\n<投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: The Black Python is similar in many ways to the Warhammer and Marauder BattleMechs. Though it is faster than those heavies, it has a similar weapons load-out with comparable damage, albeit with much more accurate damage potential. In order to achieve this, this expensive second-line 'Mech avails itself of all weight saving technologies that were at the disposal of the Clans, including an XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 黑蟒在许多方面与战锤和掠夺者战斗机甲相似。虽然比这两款重型机甲更快，但它的武器配置与伤害相当，只是伤害潜力更为精准。为实现这一点，这款昂贵的二线机甲使用了氏族可用的一切减重技术，包括 XL 引擎、内骨骼框架和十一吨铁纤维装甲。

column1: The 7R carries a Light Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, allowing the 'mech to engage an enemy at up to seven hundred and fifty meters. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 that can fire at twice the rate of a standard autocannon. For medium to short ranges, the Black Watch has a MRM-40 launcher. The Black Watch has received some criticism due to its heavy reliance on ammunition based weapons. To make the most of them, the Black Watch carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to share targeting data with friendly units through a C3 network. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 7R的主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪，使机甲能够在最远七百五十米的距离上交战。它的补充火力是一门超级自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。在中近距离上，Black Watch配备一具MRM-40发射器。由于过度依赖弹药类武器，Black Watch也招致了一些批评。为充分发挥这些武器的效能，Black Watch搭载了C3从属单元，可通过C3网络与友军单位共享瞄准数据。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: Black Watch
column2: 黑色守望

column1: Built with the intention of showing solidarity in the spirit of the new Star League, the Black Watch is the culmination of the efforts of Cosara Weaponries, the Northwind Highlanders, and Captain Neil Campbell of the Royal Black Watch. The Black Watch is built on the same chassis as the classic Crockett which served with distinction in the old Star League Defense Force. The 'Mech is powered by the rugged and durable Strand 255 fusion engine, giving the Black Watch a top speed of 54.0 km/h. For added mobility, the Black Watch has three Rawlings 54 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters. The Black Watch has ten double heat sinks that are more than adequate for the needs of the 'mech and has fifteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions.
column2: 为在新星盟的精神下展现团结而建造，黑卫是科萨拉兵工、北风高地团以及皇家黑卫的尼尔·坎贝尔上尉共同努力的结晶。黑卫建立在与经典克罗基特相同的底盘上——后者曾在旧星盟防卫部队中服役并功勋卓著。该机甲由坚固耐用的斯特兰德255聚变引擎驱动，使黑卫的最高速度达到54.0公里/小时。为增强机动性，黑卫装有三个罗林斯54跳跃推进器，可让机甲跳跃至多九十米。黑卫有十具双重散热器，完全足以满足该机甲的需求，并披挂十五吨瓦利安特·拉梅洛装甲，配以CASE以保护自身免受弹药爆炸之害。

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. The 1B is a typical example of a battlefield refit, swapping the autocannons and arm-mounted medium lasers for two LRM-15 launchers and three tons of reloads between them. In addition, two jumpjets and one ton of armor were removed. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 就吨位而言，二十一点（Blackjack）1 系列都是扎实而全面的机甲。1B 型是战场改装的典型例子：它把自动炮和臂装中型激光换成两具 LRM-15 发射器，并为其配备三吨备用弹药。此外，还拆除了两具跳跃推进器和一吨装甲。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. The 1B is a typical example of a battlefield refit, swapping the autocannons and arm-mounted medium lasers for two LRM-15 launchers and three tons of reloads between them. In addition, two jumpjets and one ton of armor were removed.
column2: 黑杰克1就其吨位而言是扎实、均衡的机甲。1B是战地改装的典型例子：把自动炮和臂装中型激光器换成两具LRM-15发射器，合计三吨备用弹。此外，还拆掉了两个跳跃推进器和一吨装甲。

column1: A common refit of the standard BJ-2, the BJ-2t replaces the streak launchers with standard SRM-2 launchers. This frees up the space for another ton of ammunition, as well allows the addition of C.A.S.E. protection in both side torsos to lower the impact of internal ammo explosions. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: BJ-2t 是标准 BJ-2 的常见改装，它用标准 SRM-2 发射器取代连发发射器。这腾出了空间以增加一吨弹药，同时还得以在两侧躯干加装 C.A.S.E. 防护，以减轻内部弹药爆炸造成的冲击。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
column2: BJ-2 由联邦太阳系于 3052 年推出，是黑杰克的新量产型号，基于早期实验设计。它将自动炮换成两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，并移除中型激光，换成四具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2 发射器，左右躯干各两具。发射器的一吨弹药存于左侧躯干，标准散热器则升级为双倍散热器。

column1: Michael Ubodo's Arrow is armed with a trio of Machine Guns in each arm supplied with two tons of ammo, supported by a Medium Laser in side torso and a Large Pulse Laser mounted in the center torso. Mounting a 235 standard engine, its varation of the Arrow is clad in Ferro-Fibrous armor on an Endo Steel frame, carrying eleven Double Heat Sinks and just two Jump Jets. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 迈克尔·乌博多的箭在每只手臂上装三挺机枪（配两吨弹药），侧躯干一门中型激光、中央躯干一门大型脉冲激光辅助。它采用235标准引擎，该变型的箭披挂铁纤维装甲、建在内骨架框架上，带十一个双散热器和仅两具跳跃推进器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Michael Ubodo's Arrow is armed with a trio of Machine Guns in each arm supplied with two tons of ammo, supported by a Medium Laser in side torso and a Large Pulse Laser mounted in the center torso. Mounting a 235 standard engine, its variation of the Arrow is clad in Ferro-Fibrous armor on an Endo Steel frame, carrying eleven Double Heat Sinks and just two Jump Jets.
column2: 迈克尔·乌博多的箭在双臂各装三挺机枪、配两吨弹药，由侧躯干的一门中型激光器和中央躯干的一门大型脉冲激光器支援。它装一具235标准引擎，其箭的变体以内层钢框架上的铁纤装甲披挂，携带十一具双重散热器和仅两个跳跃推进器。

column1: Given to Ross McKinnon upon his father's retirement in 3051, the family 'Mech continued to be upgraded with the latest technology. By the FedCom Civil War the right arm and torso weaponry of Ross's 'Mech was upgraded to extended range models, with the triple strength myomers and hatchet retained. The use of production grade ferro-fibrous and double heat sinks, along with downgrading the large lasers to medium pulse lasers and the left arm medium for an ER Small Laser, freed up enough weight for a Targeting Computer to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 这台家族机甲在 3051 年其父退役时传给了罗斯·麦金农，此后不断以最新科技进行升级。到联邦共和国内战时期，罗斯机甲的右臂和躯干武器已升级为增程型号，三倍强度肌纤维和战斧则予以保留。量产级铁纤维和双散热器的使用，加上将大型激光降级为中型脉冲激光、把左臂中型激光换成增程小型激光，腾出了足够的重量来加装一台瞄准计算机。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Black Knight
column2: 黑骑士

column1: Brawler & Ranged Assault
column2: 缠斗者与远程突击

column1: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.
column2: 黑骑士既被设计为前线战斗单位，也被设计为星盟防卫军连级与营级的指挥战斗机甲。其先进通讯设备使黑骑士能轻易同时协调一整连机甲，并能轻松接通整个上级团的指挥频率并与轨道支援卫星联络。先进的建造材料赋予黑骑士轻而坚固的底盘，能以更小的重量携带更多武器与装甲。考虑到它所携带火力的类型与数量，黑骑士面临的唯一问题是散热管理。

column1: Downgraded during the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, the personal 'Mech of the McKinnon family was selected to receive among the first experimental weapons developed from the Helm Memory Core by the New Avalon Institute of Science, thanks to the exploits of Fox's Teeth commander Ian McKinnon. When piloted by Ian during the War of 3039, the 'Mech was clad in prototype ferro-fibrous armor and the standard heat sinks outside the engine were replaced with corrosive 3039-era double heat sinks. These weight savings, along with the removal of the head-mounted small laser, allowed the 'Mech to carry a Hatchet whose damage was boosted by the addition of Triple Strength Myomer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 麦金农（McKinnon）家族的座机在继承战争时期的技术衰退中遭到降级，但凭借“狐牙”（Fox's Teeth）指挥官伊恩·麦金农的战绩，它被选中，成为新阿瓦隆科学研究所依据地狱核心（Helm Memory Core）研发的首批实验性武器之一的搭载平台。3039 年战争期间由伊恩驾驶时，这台机甲披挂原型铁纤维装甲，引擎之外的标准散热器则被替换为 3039 年代那批具有腐蚀性的双散热器。这些减重措施，再加上拆除头部安装的小型激光，使该机甲得以携带一把战斧，其伤害因加装三重强度人造肌而进一步提升。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: The Black Knight BL-6-KNT-K is a full conversion of the classic Black Knight to use Clan technology. Originally designed and ordered by Kell's Hounds, it can lately also sometimes be seen with other mercenary forces. The full energy weapons loadout combines an ER PPC with a Large Pulse Laser and an ER Large Laser as the main damage dealers, four ER Medium Lasers are available as secondary firepower. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 黑骑士BL-6-KNT-K是把经典黑骑士全面改装为部族技术的版本。它最初由凯尔猎犬设计并订购，近来有时也能在其他雇佣兵部队中见到。这套全能量武器载荷以一门增程粒子炮、一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程大型激光为主要伤害来源，四门增程中型激光则作为次要火力。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: A mysterious variant sighted in 3057 on an uninhabited world in the Spinward Periphery near Antallos, the so-called BL-6-RR swaps out the standard medium lasers and PPC of the BL-6-KNT for more deadly Clan ER medium lasers and an ER PPC. The lighter particle cannon allows an additional single heat sink to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 这台被称为 BL-6-RR 的神秘变型于 3057 年在安塔洛斯（Antallos）附近的顺旋臂外围地区一颗无人星球上现身。它把 BL-6-KNT 的标准中型激光和粒子炮换成了更致命的部族增程中型激光与增程粒子炮。更轻的粒子炮还让它可以额外加装一台单散热器。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Introduced in 3040, this variant retains the side torso–mounted large lasers and right arm medium laser, replacing the PPC with another large laser and upgrading the head-mounted small laser to another medium. The weight saved allows the BL-7-KNT-P to carry a heavy longsword in its left arm. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是3040年推出的变型，保留侧躯干大型激光和右臂中型激光，以另一门大型激光取代粒子炮，并把头部小型激光升级为另一门中型激光。省下的重量让BL-7-KNT-P左手能握一把重型长剑。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An updated version of the classic BL-7-KNT using modern Ferro-Fibrous armor and double heat sinks. The saved weight allows the 'Mech to mount an Beagle Active Probe and considerably more armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是对经典BL-7-KNT的更新版本，采用现代铁纤维装甲与双散热器。省下的重量让机甲得以装设一台比格犬主动探测器和多得多的装甲。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The BL-8W-KNT is a further enhancement of the 7W, replacing its active probe with two more double heat sinks to address the subpar cooling. The design is otherwise the same. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: BL-8W-KNT是7W的进一步强化型，它用两台额外的双散热器取代了主动探测器，以解决散热不佳的问题。除此之外设计保持不变。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: This variant is based on Ian McKinnon's Black Knight. The only difference is the Hatchet being replaced by an Autocannon/5 and SRM-2. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 该变型以伊恩·麦金农的黑骑士为基础，唯一的区别是战斧被替换为一门 AC/5 自动炮和一具 SRM-2。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: The Bloedhond BLH-6D carries several lasers, utilizing its high speed and small size to repeatedly flank and hit an enemy in less protected locations. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 血犬BLH-6D装有多门激光，凭借其高速度与小体型反复包抄并打击敌人防护较弱的部位。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

column2: 超轻型侧翼手

column1: The Bloedhond is a 15-ton ultralight 'Mech. Due to its small size the 'Mech is quite cheap to acquire and easy to pilot, and as a result is used mainly by remote periphery garrisons and pirate bands.
column2: 血犬是一台15吨超轻型机甲。由于体型小，它采购便宜、易于驾驶，因此主要被偏远的外围驻防部队与海盗团伙使用。

column1: The Bloedhond BLH-7D replaces the medium pulse laser of the 6D with two standard medium lasers. Otherwise the 'Mech configuration is the same as -6D. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 血犬BLH-7D以两门标准中型激光取代6D的中型脉冲激光，其余配置与-6D相同。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Blood Asp
column2: 血复

column1: The Alpha loadout has a single weapon, an ER PPC mounted in the left arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Alpha载荷只有一件武器：左臂安装的一门增程粒子炮。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Blood Ferret
column2: 血貂

column1: Not much is known about the creation of the Blood Ferret, but somehow this little scout has spread through the clans.
column2: 关于血貂的诞生所知甚少，但这款小侦察机甲不知怎地在各氏族中传开了。

column1: The B configuration of the Blood Ferret mounts three ATM-3 launchers. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso works as backup firepower. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Blood Ferret 的 B 配置装有三具 ATM-3 发射器。中央躯干的一门增程小型激光充当备用火力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The C configuration is all energy based; two ER Medium Lasers in each Side Torso together with two ER Small Lasers in each arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C配置为全能量配置：每侧躯干各装两具增程中型激光，每只手臂各装两具增程小型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration of the Blood Ferret combines three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single Small Pulse Laser and a TAG. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 血貂的主配置把三具连发SRM-2发射器与一门小型脉冲激光和一具TAG结合起来。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Blood Kite does not use advanced electronic targeting systems or expensive weaponry. For long range, it mounts a trio of ER Large Lasers and three LRM-15 launchers. The missile launchers each contain enough ammunition for protracted engagements, though the twenty-one double heat sinks preclude continuous fire of all six weapons. At short range, three SRM-4 launchers give the 'Mech the ability to score critical damage against exposed components. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 血鸢不使用先进的电子瞄准系统或昂贵武器。远程方面它装三门增程大型激光和三具LRM-15发射器；每具导弹发射器都带足弹药以支持持久交战，不过二十一个双散热器不足以支撑全部六件武器持续开火。近程方面，三具SRM-4发射器让该机甲能对已暴露的部件造成致命伤害。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Blood Kite
column2: 血鸢

column1: The Blood Kite is a BattleMech that was designed on the orders of Clan Blood Spirit Khan Ceana Boques following the deployment of the OmniMech by Clan Coyote in 2854. Because Khan Boques expected the Trials for the OmniMech technology to escalate to the point that her small Clan's touman would not be able to compete, she ordered her scientist caste to rethink the way they designed 'Mechs. Boques dictated that this design philosophy was to conform to four points that seem like they would be common sense: be as cheap as is reasonable, have a reasonable chance of surviving an engagement, sustain a steady barrage, and be as efficient as possible. In fact, many prior designs created by the Clan's scientists violated many or all of these principles. The cream of this crop was the Blood Kite, which debuted in the early part of the thirtieth century. The Blood Kite eschews the use of expensive technology and weapons, only making use of an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. It contains as much standard armor as the engineers could fit onto the eighty-five ton frame, as well as jump jets that propel it up to ninety meters at a time.
column2: 血鸢是一种战斗机甲，在郊狼氏族于2854年部署全方位机甲之后，由血灵氏族可汗西娜·博克斯下令设计。因为博克斯可汗预计围绕全方位机甲技术的试炼会升级到她这个小氏族的图曼无法竞争的程度，她命令她的科学家种姓重新思考设计机甲的方式。博克斯规定这套设计哲学要符合四条看来像是常识的要点：尽可能便宜合理、有合理的机会在交战中存活、能持续稳定火力输出，以及尽可能高效。事实上，该氏族科学家此前创造的许多设计违反其中多条甚至全部原则。这批成果中的精华就是血鸢，它在三十世纪初首次亮相。血鸢避免使用昂贵的技术与武器，只采用内层钢内部结构来减重。它装了工程师能塞上八十五吨框架的最大量标准装甲，还配了能一次推进九十米的跳跃推进器。

column1: The 10D variant of the Bombardier is a refit performed by Earthwerks Incorporated during the Succession Wars as many advanced components became lostech; while Wakazashi were content not to manufacture any more Bombardiers, the company was prepared to license Earthwerks to produce parts for existing 'Mechs, resulting in the 10D refit. While the Delphinius and Arrowlight launchers were swapped out for low-tech Doombud and Hovertech models, the AMS system was completely replaced with a Machine Gun. Perhaps the biggest difference was the replacement of VOX 325 XL engine with the smaller Magna 260, giving the design a top speed of 64.8 km/h and cruising speed of 43 km/h. In addition, the CASE that protected the vulnerable ammunition stores has been removed from the design, while the armor protection itself has not changed. As a part of the refit performed by Earthwerks in their Calloway VI plant the communications system was replaced with the Neil 5000 system and the targeting and tracking system was replaced with the RCA Instatrac Mark XII system. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 轰炸机的10D变型是Earthwerks Incorporated在继承战争期间进行的改装，当时许多先进部件已成为失落科技；Wakazashi满足于不再生产轰炸机，但愿意授权Earthwerks为现有机甲生产零件，10D改装因此诞生。Delphinius和Arrowlight发射器被换成低技术的Doombud和Hovertech型号，而AMS系统则被一挺机枪彻底取代。或许最大的变化是用更小的Magna 260替换了VOX 325 XL引擎，使该设计的最高时速为64.8 km/h、巡航速度为43 km/h。此外，用于保护脆弱弹药库的CASE已被从设计中移除，装甲防护本身则没有变化。作为Earthwerks在其卡洛威VI工厂进行改装的一部分，通讯系统被更换为Neil 5000系统，瞄准与跟踪系统则更换为RCA Instatrac Mark XII系统。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Heavy Support
column2: 重型支援

In addition, the CASE that protected the vulnerable ammunition stores has been removed from the design, while the armor protection itself has not changed. As a part of the refit performed by Earthwerks in their Calloway VI plant the communications system was replaced with the Neil 5000 system and the targeting and tracking system was replaced with the RCA Instatrac Mark XII system.
column2: 轰击手的10D变型是地球工厂公司在继承战争期间进行的改装，当时许多先进部件已成失落科技；和泉虽然满足于不再制造任何轰击手，却愿意授权地球工厂为现有机甲生产部件，于是有了10D改装。德尔菲尼乌斯与箭光发射器换成低技术的杜姆巴德与霍弗泰克型号，反导弹系统则被一挺机枪完全取代。或许最大的差别是用较小的马格纳260取代VOX 325 XL引擎，使该设计的最高速度为64.8公里/小时、巡航速度43公里/小时。此外，保护脆弱弹药库的CASE被拆掉，而装甲防护本身没有变化。作为地球工厂在其卡洛韦VI工厂所做改装的一部分，通讯系统换成了尼尔5000，瞄准追踪系统换成了RCA因斯塔特拉克Mark XII。

column1: Continuing the trend toward specialized BattleMechs, the Bombardier was proposed to the Star League in 2735 by Wakazashi Enterprises as an "artillery 'Mech." The concept behind the design was to make a BattleMech that could replace less-mobile artillery vehicles, which might fall behind in an advance or be destroyed by counter-battery fire. It would be well-protected with twelve and a half tons of armor and use specialized missile racks which could carry diverse types of advanced missiles. Over years of testing and field exercises the Bombardier proved itself extremely effective at fulfilling the long-range fire support role, easily surpassing its vehicular counterparts and even inspiring talks of disbanding the SLDF's artillery arm once enough Bombardiers were operational. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 在机甲专用化的潮流之中，Wakazashi 企业于 2735 年向星际联盟提出轰炸机的方案——一款“炮击机甲”。这一设计的理念是打造一种能够取代机动性较差的炮击车辆的战斗机甲，因为那些车辆在推进时可能掉队，或被反炮兵火力摧毁。它将拥有十二吨半装甲的优异防护，并使用可携带多种先进导弹的特制导弹发射架。经过多年的测试与野外演习，轰炸机在远程火力支援任务中证明自己极为高效，轻松超越了同类车辆，甚至引发了解散 SLDF 炮兵部队的讨论——只要足够数量的轰炸机投入服役。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Continuing the trend toward specialized BattleMechs, the Bombardier was proposed to the Star League in 2735 by Wakazashi Enterprises as an \"artillery 'Mech.\" The concept behind the design was to make a BattleMech that could replace less-mobile artillery vehicles, which might fall behind in an advance or be destroyed by counter-battery fire. It would be well-protected with twelve and a half tons of armor and use specialized missile racks which could carry diverse types of advanced missiles. Over years of testing and field exercises the Bombardier proved itself extremely effective at fulfilling the long-range fire support role, easily surpassing its vehicular counterparts and even inspiring talks of disbanding the SLDF's artillery arm once enough Bombardiers were operational.
column2: 延续专用战斗机甲的趋势，轰击者由若狭企业于2735年作为"炮兵机甲"提交给星盟。该设计背后的构想是造出一种能替代机动性较差火炮车辆的战斗机甲，后者可能在推进中掉队或被反炮兵火力摧毁。它将以十二吨半装甲获得良好防护，并使用能携带多种先进导弹的特制导弹架。经过多年测试与实地演习，轰击者被证明在执行远程火力支援角色上极为有效，轻松超越其车辆同类，甚至引发了在足够多轰击者投入运作后解散SLDF炮兵部队的讨论。

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Bombardier BMB-12D-EC was an upgrade of the BMB-12D that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Bombardier BMB-12D-EC 是源自克朗代克行动时期的早期部族机甲，它是对 BMB-12D 的升级，将武器替换为早期部族型号。随着现代部族规格武器投入生产，它最终停产并被人们遗忘。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Bombardier BMB-12D-EC was an upgrade of the BMB-12D that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，轰击者BMB-12D-EC是BMB-12D的升级版，把武器换成了早期氏族变体。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。

column1: The Bowman utilizes an XL engine to maintain its rapid pace, as well an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. An ECM Suite protects it from some forms of electronic warfare, while twelve and a half tons of armor protect it from weapons fire. The primary armament on the Bowman is a Class 16 Arrow IV Artillery launcher. Enough ammunition is included to allow for various types to be utilized. Though the original design incorporated two artillery pieces, the modern version accedes to modern demands by utilizing a LRM-20, though it has a limited amount of ammunition. Three ER Medium Lasers are meant for anti-vehicle use, while two Anti-Personnel Pods on each leg keep conventional infantry at bay. Fourteen double heat sinks keep heat levels down for the most part. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 弓手利用XL引擎保持其迅捷节奏，并采用内骨架内部结构减轻重量。一套电子对抗套件保护它免受某些形式的电子战，十二吨半装甲则抵御武器火力。弓手的主要武器是一门16型箭IV火炮发射器，配足量弹药以使用多种弹种。虽然原设计整合了两门火炮，现代版本顺应需求改用一具LRM-20，尽管弹药量有限。三门增程中型激光用于反车辆，每条腿两具反人员舱则把常规步兵挡在外面。十四个双散热器大体上压住了热量水平。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: The Bowman first saw production in 2960 as Clan Hell's Horses started a crash program to build defensive BattleMechs following the fall of Tokasha MechWorks to Clan Ghost Bear in 2921. Now a rare sight on the battlefield, the Bowman began its life as an artillery platform mounting a pair of Arrow IV artillery systems. However, this configuration never met with success, due mostly to Clan biases against indirect warfare. Therefore, the Bowman was modified to its present \"standard\" configuration in 2973. Still unpopular with Clan warriors, the Bowman is primarily utilized by Clan Hell's Horses.
column2: 弓手于2960年首次投产，当时地狱马部族在2921年托卡沙机甲厂落入鬼熊部族之后，启动了一项紧急计划来建造防御型战斗机甲。如今战场上已难得一见；弓手最初是作为搭载两套箭IV火炮系统的火炮平台而生。然而这一配置从未成功，主要因为部族对间接作战的偏见。因此弓手在2973年被改为如今的“标准”配置。弓手在部族战士中仍不受欢迎，主要由地狱马部族使用。

column1: This variant abandons any hope of the Bowman being an ArtilleryMech. The remaining artillery is replaced with a second LRM-20 launcher, three additional tons of ammunition, and an ER Large Laser. More heat sinks are added to keep the heat in check. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这个变型彻底放弃了让弓手充当火炮机甲的可能：剩余的火炮被替换为第2具LRM-20发射器、3吨额外弹药和1门增程大型激光，并加装更多散热器以控制热量。 <特性：稳定 <投放费用倍率：1.16 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂上段

column1: This is the original Bowman configuration introduced in 2923, carrying a pair of Arrow IV missile artillery systems. Its only other defense are a pair of A-Pods in each leg. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这是 Bowman 于 2923 年推出的原始配置，携带两套 Arrow IV 导弹炮击系统。它仅有的其他防御手段是每条腿上的两具 A-Pod。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂上部

column1: Designed primarily for short range combat, the Buccaneer carries a single ER large laser to give it some striking capability at long ranges. With the elevation of physical combat to an art in the Inner Sphere, the Buccaneer's most fearsome weapon is its four ton hatchet, supported at medium to close ranges by four medium lasers, a highly accurate medium pulse laser, and a SRM-6 with an Artemis IV guidance system for increased missile accuracy. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 海盗主要设计用于近程战斗，却带有一门增程大型激光，使它在远距离上也具备一定的打击能力。随着肉搏战在内层星域被提升为一门艺术，海盗最令人畏惧的武器是它那把四吨重的战斧；中近距离则由四门中型激光、一门高精度中型脉冲激光和一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV制导系统的SRM-6支援，以提高导弹精度。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Buccaneer is a product of the Word of Blake's voracious appetite for military equipment in its first few years, as the order had far more MechWarriors than they had 'Mechs. The Buccaneer was originally designed to be used by ComStar, but had not begun production. When the schism that created the Word of Blake occurred, the design was modified to accommodate equipment available to the Word of Blake in their temporary home of the Free Worlds League. The Buccaneer is built with a lightweight VOX 330 XL engine giving the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. It also carries an impressive ten tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the maximum amount of protection the chassis can carry, and mounts 10 double heat sinks as standard.
column2: 海盗是布雷克之言在其最初几年对军事装备贪婪渴求的产物，因为该教团的机师远比机甲多。海盗原本是为康星设计使用，但尚未投产。当导致布雷克之言诞生的分裂发生时，该设计被修改，以适应布雷克之言在其临时家园自由世界联盟所能获得的装备。海盗采用一台轻量的VOX 330 XL引擎，使该机甲最高速度达到97.2公里/小时。它还携带令人印象深刻的十吨铁纤装甲，是该底盘能承载的最大防护量，并标配10具双重散热器。

column1: A derivative variant of the old Bushwacker prototypes, the High Roller uses an XL275 engine and Endo-Steel structure to field an AC/10, LRM-5, three Medium Lasers, and a pair of Machine Guns. While it's enhancements increase the damage output of these weapons, it still suffers from the prototype models' electronic systems, especially in its TTS and FCS. This means that while powerful, the High Roller requires an above-average warrior to land a hit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为早期 Bushwacker 原型机的衍生变型，High Roller 采用 XL275 引擎和内骨架结构，得以装备一门 AC/10、一具 LRM-5、三具中型激光和两挺机枪。虽然它的改进提升了这些武器的伤害输出，但它仍然受累于原型型号的电子系统，尤其是其 TTS 和 FCS。这意味着 High Roller 虽然威力强大，却需要一位水准高于常人的战士才能命中目标。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A Kell Hounds refit, the -3KH carries all Clan weapons. The mercenary outfit kept most of the 'Mech the same, but did manage to squeeze in a C3 Slave unit in the head. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 凯尔猎犬的改装版，-3KH搭载的全是部族武器。这支雇佣兵部队让机甲的大部分保持原样，但设法在头部塞进了一台C3从属单元。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.Though never attracting great sales, the Caesar would prove to be relatively popular in the Capellan March, among Lyran units on the Clan front, and with both FedCom-employed mercenaries and the Com Guards.Though never attracting great sales, the Caesar would prove to be relatively popular in the Capellan March, among Lyran units on the Clan front, and with both FedCom-employed mercenaries and the Com Guards.
column2: 凯撒最初是甲胄的逆向工程版本，但成品设计本身出人意料地证明是一种高质量设计。虽然从未取得亮眼销量，凯撒在卡佩兰边区、氏族前线的莱兰部队中，以及在联邦共同体雇佣的雇佣兵和康卫队中都相当受欢迎。

column1: The personal 'Mech of Marcus GioAvanti, commander of Avanti's Angels, all of Archangel's weapons are upgraded to Clantech equivalents with the right arm medium pulse laser moved to the left arm and an extra Clan medium pulse laser added to the center torso. The resulted weight and space saved allowed the mounting of an extra double heat sink as well as additional armor. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 这是阿万蒂之天使指挥官马库斯·乔阿万蒂的私人机甲，大天使的所有武器都升级为部族同类，右臂的中型脉冲激光移到左臂，中央躯干再加一门部族中型脉冲激光。由此节省的重量与空间让它得以多装一个双散热器以及额外装甲。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12

The resulted weight and space saved allowed the mounting of an extra double heat sink as well as additional armor.
column2: 这是阿万蒂之天使指挥官马库斯·乔阿万蒂的私人机甲，大天使的所有武器都升级为部族同类，右臂的中型脉冲激光移到左臂，中央躯干再加一门部族中型脉冲激光。由此节省的重量与空间让它得以多装一个双散热器以及额外装甲。

column1: The energy weapons on the Canis are four arm-mounted Series 7Ja ER Large Lasers. While these pack a powerful, long-range punch, they often overload the design's sixteen double heat sinks. For medium-range support, the Canis utilizes a pair of torso-mounted Type 9 Ultra Autocannon/10s, though it only carries enough ammunition for approximately a minute and a half of sustained firing. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Canis 的能量武器是四门安装在手臂上的 Series 7Ja 增程大型激光。它们虽然拥有强大的远程打击力，却常常让该设计配备的十六具双散热器不堪重负。中距离支援方面，Canis 使用两门安装在躯干上的 Type 9 超级自动炮/10，不过其携带的弹药仅够持续射击约一分半钟。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Paying tribute to other highly successful Clan Wolf designs, the Blood Reaper is a symbolic and straightforward second-line BattleMech in heavy use in the post-Jihad Clan Wolf touman. Seeking to standardize his forces and weed out non-Wolf designs, Khan Vlad Ward ordered his scientists to develop a rugged yet symbolic 'Mech for warriors of Clan Wolf to rally around. A standard BattleMech in the mold of the successful Tundra Wolf, the Blood Reaper first entered service in 3079 and went on to form a large part of the Wolves' post-Jihad touman. Khan Ward overcame the stigma of a second-line machine with classic Clan posturing; by insisting that warriors truly worthy of the spirit of the Wolf would win even while being hobbled by such a design.
column2: 向其他极为成功的狼族设计致敬，血收割者是战后圣战中狼族图曼里大量使用的一种象征性、直截了当的二等战斗机甲。可汗弗拉德·沃德为求标准化其部队、淘汰非狼族设计，命令他的科学家研发一种粗犷却具象征意义的机甲，供狼族战士凝聚于其周围。作为成功机型冻原狼式的标准战斗机甲，血收割者于3079年首次服役，此后构成战后狼族图曼的一大部分。沃德可汗以经典的氏族姿态克服了二等机甲的污名：他坚称真正配得上狼之精神的战士，即便被这种设计拖着后腿也能取胜。

column1: The Cataphract Hero 'Mech, Grigori Kovalenko's custom Cataphract 'Ilya Muromets', Identification Number CTF2X0042A-1013, is armed with an AC/5 in each arm, supported by a right arm Small Laser, a Medium Laser in each side torso and a right torso mounted AC/10. Such a heavy autocannon loadout is made possible through the use of 280-rated XL engine, while three tons of AC/5 rounds and two of AC/10 reloads keep those cannons firing. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Cataphract 英雄机甲——格里戈里·科瓦连科的定制型 Cataphract“Ilya Muromets”，识别编号 CTF2X0042A-1013——两条手臂各装备一门 AC/5，并有右臂一门小型激光、两侧躯干各一门中型激光以及右躯干的 AC/10 提供支援。如此沉重的自动炮配置之所以能够实现，得益于 280 级 XL 引擎的使用；三吨 AC/5 炮弹和两吨 AC/10 弹药则保证了这些火炮的持续射击。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Cataphract Hero 'Mech, Grigori Kovalenko's custom Cataphract 'Ilya Muromets', Identification Number CTF2X0042A-1013, is armed with an AC/5 in each arm, supported by a right arm Small Laser, a Medium Laser in each side torso and a right torso mounted AC/10. Such a heavy autocannon loadout is made possible through the use of 280-rated XL engine, while three tons of AC/5 rounds and two of AC/10 reloads keep those cannons firing.
column2: 这台甲胄英雄机甲，格里戈里·科瓦连科的定制甲胄"伊利亚·穆罗梅茨"，识别号CTF2X0042A-1013，双臂各装一门AC/5，由右臂一门小型激光器支援，两侧躯干各一门中型激光器，右躯干另装一门AC/10。如此沉重的自动炮载荷之所以可行，要归功于280级XL引擎，而三吨AC/5炮弹和两吨AC/10备用弹让这些炮持续开火。

column2: 这是切斯特顿预备役机甲战士珍妮·坦普尔顿的私人座机。这款弹射器C1的定制变型，其 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The personal ride of MechWarrior Jenny Templeton of the Chesterton Reserves. This custom variant of the Catapult C1, the Butterbee, replaces the standard arm-mounted LRM-15s with two SRM-6 missile launchers in each arm, giving it deadly close combat capability.
column2: 这是切斯特顿预备役机甲战士珍妮·坦普尔顿的私人座机。这款弹射器C1的定制变型黄油蜂以每只手臂两具SRM-6导弹发射器取代标准臂载LRM-15，赋予它致命的近战能力。

column1: A field refit given popularity after repeated sightings in combat piloted by MechWarrior Leigh Voss, the CLPT-Jester typically begins life as a refit kit for a CPLT-K2 or similar variant. Stripping out the PPCs, the Jester manages to run enough power couplings to cram a laser into each arm, each side torso, and two in the center torso, with additional fittings for support weapons if available. It also mounts an AMS system and advanced TTS systems, allowing for lethally accurate fire even beyond traditional weapon ranges. The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: A field refit given popularity after repeated sightings in combat piloted by MechWarrior Leigh Voss, the CLPT-Jester typically begins life as a refit kit for a CPLT-K2 or similar variant. Stripping out the PPCs, the Jester manages to run enough power couplings to cram a laser into each arm, each side torso, and two in the center torso, with additional fittings for support weapons if available. It also mounts an AMS system and advanced TTS systems, allowing for lethally accurate fire even beyond traditional weapon ranges. The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated.

column1: The Cavalier is a battle armor suit built in response to sagging morale in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth, due in large part to the secession of the Lyran state from the Federated Commonwealth. Although originally heavily based on the Inner Sphere Standard, the redesign turned out to be more than cosmetic: the redistribution of armor plating had increased leg protection at the expense of upper body protection. While there were some misgivings, in the final analysis it was discovered these alterations also gave superior dexterity to the trooper compared to that of the Standard. Reluctantly the officers in charge agreed that the benefits outweighed the drawbacks and approved mass production of the suit, which started in June of that same year. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 骑士战斗装甲服是为应对联邦联邦武装部队士气低落而建造的，这在很大程度上源于莱兰邦从联邦联邦中脱离。虽然它在最初很大程度上以"内天体标准型"为基础，但这次重新设计远不止外观改动：装甲板的重新分配以牺牲上半身防护为代价增强了腿部防护。尽管当时存有疑虑，但最终分析发现这些改动还使士兵的灵活性优于标准型。主管军官们不情愿地承认利大于弊，批准了该装甲服量产，并于同年六月开始。 特质：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

column1: While not mounting any defensive weaponry, the Celerity CLR-02-X-D's head is equipped with a Drone Remote Control System and carries a C3i module. column2: 超轻型全方位机甲迅捷最初是康星在图卡伊德战役之后不久，尝试打造一种可消耗的无人机侦察战斗机甲。这台"机甲"建在内层钢框架上，由一台巨大的240级XXL聚变引擎驱动，笨重的引擎让这具兽形无人机能高速冲刺，再加上MASC，使它齐身现存最快的地面单位之列。

column1: Designed to compete with 'Mechs like the Atlas and King Crab, the Cerberus is a 'Mech designed around speed and firepower. The Cerberus uses a massive GM 380 XL engine to propel it to a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is also armored with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous armor, which provides more protection per ton than standard armor. The large amount of free weight on the 'Mech, almost half of its mass, is dedicated to its weapons systems, which are designed to do as much damage to an enemy at as great a distance as possible.
column2: Cerberus 是为与 Atlas、King Crab 这类机甲一较高下而设计的机甲，以速度与火力为核心。它采用一台巨大的 GM 380 XL引擎，将其推进至 64.8 km/h 的最高速度。该机甲还披挂十一吨重型铁纤维装甲，每吨提供的防护优于标准装甲。机甲上充裕的富余重量几乎占其质量的一半，全部投入武器系统，而这些武器旨在尽可能远的距离上对敌人造成尽可能大的伤害。

column2: 地狱犬的主武器是两门格里扎德200型高斯步枪，每门都能在远距离上剥掉敌人一吨装甲。若敌人真的逼近近距，地狱犬也已做好准备：它带四门布兰肯堡中型脉冲激光和两挺后向斯佩里-勃朗宁机枪。此外，为加强对导弹攻击的防御，地狱犬还带一套麦克阿瑟反导弹系统。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Cestus 6X was produced for the SLDF in 2603. Considered a failure due to abysmal heat sinking on an energy-exclusive loadout, the Cestus design would eventually see an overhaul into the 6Y, albeit half a century later. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Cestus 6X于2603年为SLDF生产。由于全能量载荷的散热能力糟糕透顶而被视为失败之作，Cestus设计最终在半个世纪后被彻底翻新为6Y。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: General Motors
column2: 通用汽车

column1: Whoever designed this thing apparently never got the memo that energy weapons generate heat. I wouldn't recommend firing more than a single weapon at a time on this thing, Boss. Not unless you want to fry your pilots.
column2: 不管是谁设计的这东西，显然从没收到"能量武器会产生热量"这条备忘录。我不建议在这玩意儿上同时发射超过一件武器，老大。除非你想把飞行员烤熟。

column1: Designed for the SLDF in 2766, the Cestus production was plagued with delays and setbacks. The 6Y is considered a design correction over the original 6X, which ran notoriously hot, by replacing some of the energy weapons with ballistics. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Cestus于2766年为SLDF设计，其生产却饱受延误与挫折。6Y被认为是对原始6X的设计修正——后者以过热问题臭名昭著——做法是用实弹武器替换了部分能量武器。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Cestus moves at a slower clip than most 65-tonners, but it puts that extra tonnage where it counts. More armor and an arsenal that's threatening at all ranges make it a solid choice.
column2: Cestus的移动比大多数65吨机甲更慢，但它把额外的吨位用在了关键处。更多的装甲与一套在任何射程上都有威胁的武库，使它成为一个扎实的选择。

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit performed by Clan Fire Mandrill. While the original loadout remains identical to the base Cestus 6Y, the 6Y-EC benefits from the early fruits of Clan weapons research. Despite proving to be a success, the redesigned Cestus was overshadowed by further advancements in Clan technology and by 3020 was all but forgotten. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是火沸沸部族进行的部族技术改装。虽然原始配置与基础Cestus 6Y完全相同，但6Y-EC得益于部族武器研究的早期成果。尽管被证明是成功的，重新设计的Cestus仍被部族技术的进一步进步所掩盖，到3020年已几乎被遗忘。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Clan Fire Mandrill
column2: 氏族火沸沸

column1: Interesting. Very interesting. So, what we've got here looks to be a sort of middle ground between the technology that the SLDF left with, and the technology that they came back with. This thing is like a peek into the history of Clan weapons tech, Boss.
column2: 有意思。非常有意思。那么我们这里拿到的，看起来是SLDF离开时所带技术与他们归来时所带技术之间的某种中间形态。这东西就像一窥氏族武器技术史，老大。

column1: Created for the Federated Commonwealth during the Clan Invasion, the 6Z variant of the Cestus returns to the original energy-exclusive loadout of the BattleMech, this time with better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 6Z 变型是部族入侵期间为联邦共和国打造的，Cestus 借此回归了该战斗机甲最初的全能量武器配置，而这一次散热更为出色。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The 6Z runs hot, but it's a massive improvement over the original 6X. As long as you don't have Mechjocks firing weapons at targets beyond their ranges, the heat should be manageable.
column2: 6Z跑起来很热，但相比原来的6X是巨大的改进。只要别让机师朝超出射程的目标开火，热量应该可控。

column1: The 5C is a weird one, no official creator exists in the records of the design but the 'Mech was produced at several factories at one point of time. A slight rebuild of the classic TRC-4B, the variant does not introduce any major changes except moving the internals around. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 5C 是一个古怪的型号：设计档案中查不到任何官方设计者，但该机甲曾一度在多家工厂同时生产。它是对经典 TRC-4B 的小幅重构，除了调整内部构件的布局之外，并没有引入任何重大改动。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Chameleon carried a basic arsenal that allowed a MechWarrior-in-training to learn the skill of heat management. The 'Mech's reliable low-tech arsenal had proven effective when forced into combat. The primary weapon was a Cyclops Eye Large Laser. This was backed up by two Intek Medium Lasers and a trio of Defiance B3S Small Lasers. To make the threat of overheating more real to the new MechWarrior, the 'Mech carried two Scatter Gun Light Machine Guns that can be used for anti-infantry training.
column2: 变色龙携带基础武器库，让受训中的机甲战士学习散热管理技巧。机甲可靠的低技术武器库在被拖入战斗时证明有效。主武器是一门"独眼巨人眼"大型激光。它由两门英泰克中型激光和三门"迪法恩斯 B3S"小型激光支援。为使过热威胁对新手机甲战士更真实，机甲携带两挺"散射枪"轻型机枪，可用于反步兵训练。

column1: A Clan refurbished version of the TRC-4B, replacing its internals with Clan versions but keeping all weapon systems from the original 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是 TRC-4B 的部族翻新型，其内部构件全部换为部族版本，但保留了原机甲的全部武器系统。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: (also referred to as the CHM-3 Chameleon Training Scout) A formerly common but now obscure training 'Mech, the TRC-4B was armed with one Large Laser, two Medium Lasers, four Small Lasers and two Machine Guns. With only 10 normal heat sinks this 'Mech was quite prone to overheating.
column2: （又称 CHM-3 变色龙训练侦察型）TRC-4B 曾是常见而如今鲜为人知的训练机甲，装备一门大型激光、两门中型激光、四门小型激光和两挺机枪。由于只有 10 台普通散热器，这台机甲极易过热。

column1: The personal 'Mech of Force Commander Pasi Irin assigned to the First Free Worlds Legionnaires, this custom variant replaces the SRM-6 w/Artemis IV with a pair of Streak SRM-2 and additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是配属第一自由世界军团的部队指挥官 Pasi Irin 的专属机甲。这款定制改型用一对连发 SRM-2 和额外装甲取代了带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 SRM-6。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Heavy Recon and Striker
column2: 重型侦察与打击

column1: The personal 'Mech of Force Commander Pasi Irin assigned to the First Free Worlds Legionnaires, this custom variant replaces the SRM-6 w/Artemis IV with a pair of Streak SRM-2 and additional armor.
column2: 这是配属第一自由世界步兵团的部队指挥官帕西·伊林的私人机甲，这一定制改型把带阿尔忒弥斯IV的SRM-6换成两具连发SRM-2，并增加装甲。

column1: One of the so-called "Clanbuster" variants developed in 3052 by ComStar in the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, this variant is a major upgrade that replaces the standard fusion engine with a lighter but more vulnerable 300-rated ExtraLight engine, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and two Large Lasers, surplus from the Clanbuster upgrade of the Wyvern, have been added to the 'Mech's unoccupied arms. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是通讯之星在Tukayyid战役前夕于3052年研发的所谓“部族克星”变型之一。该变型是一次重大升级：标准聚变引擎被替换为更轻但更脆弱的300级超轻型引擎，散热器升级为双散热器，并将Wyvern部族克星升级中富余的两门大型激光加装到机甲空置的双臂上。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: One of the so-called \"Clanbuster\" variants developed in 3052 by ComStar in the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, this variant is a major upgrade that replaces the standard fusion engine with a lighter but more vulnerable 300-rated ExtraLight engine, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and two Large Lasers, surplus from the Clanbuster upgrade of the Wyvern, have been added to the 'Mech's unoccupied arms.
column2: 这是3052年图卡伊迪战役前夕由通讯之星研制的所谓“部族克星”变型之一。它是一次重大升级：以更轻但更脆弱的300额定超轻型引擎取代标准聚变引擎，散热器升级为双散热器，并在机甲空置的手臂上加装两门大型激光——它们来自飞龙的部族克星升级项目余料。

column1: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 3P是Champion最新的变型，于3061年推出。该机甲的武库已按现代标准全面升级，原有武器被尽数拆除。取而代之的是，这一版本的Champion搭载四门增程中型激光，每臂各一门。一门Ultra自动炮/10替换了LB-X自动炮，SRM-6则被改进型Narc导弹信标取代。此外，3N所使用的超轻型引擎得以保留，并增设了一台改进型C3计算机，使Champion能够作为6单位C3网络的一环运作。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network.
column2: 3P是冠军的最新改型，于3061年推出。该机甲的武库已完全按现代标准升级，所有武器都被彻底替换。取而代之的是，这一版冠军携带四门增程中型激光器，每臂一门。一门超速自动炮/10取代LB-X自动炮，SRM-6则换成一具改进型Narc导弹信标。此外，3N使用的超轻型引擎被保留，并加装一台改进型C3计算机，让冠军能作为6单位C3网络的一部分运作。

column1: An upgraded Champion with Clantech, the Champion C is simply an updated Champion 1N2. Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 冠军 C（Champion C）是采用部族科技升级的冠军，实质上就是更新版的冠军 1N2。它于 2867 年建造，使用 XL 引擎，节省下来的重量用于加装 5 具跳跃推进器，使该机甲一次最多可跳跃 150 米。中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并新增了两门增程中型激光。小型激光也升级为小型脉冲激光。其余武器均升级至部族标准，剩余的吨位则用于增加装甲。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: An upgraded Champion with Clantech, the Champion C is simply an updated Champion 1N2. Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor.
column2: 冠军C是用部族技术升级的冠军式，本质上就是更新版的冠军1N2。它制造于2867年，采用XL引擎，节省下来的重量用于加装5个跳跃推进器，使机甲一次可跳跃至多150米。中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并新增两门增程中型激光。小型激光也升级为小型脉冲激光。其余武器均升级至部族标准，剩余吨位则用于增加装甲。

column1: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger CGR-C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为3K的升级型，Charger CGR-C经过改装以搭载C3从属单元，使其能够与本单位内其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为了加装该从属单元，设计上不得不移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的重量则用于为LRM发射器增加额外弹药。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger CGR-C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
column2: 作为3K的升级版，冲锋者CGR-C经过改装以携带一套C3从属系统，使它能与本单位其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为了加装从属系统，必须从设计中拆除一门中型脉冲激光器。剩余的重量则用于为LRM发射器增加弹药。

column1: A simple refit of the -1A1, replacing three of the Small Lasers and some of the armor for a Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 对-1A1的简易改装：拆除三具小型激光和部分装甲，换装一具中型激光和一个C3从属单元。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Heavy Scout & Harasser
column2: 重型侦察与骚扰

column1: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.
column2: 由于冲锋者的设计者想阻止任何让机甲陷入危险的活动，威尔斯科技的工程师为冲锋者装备了五门玛格纳 Mk I 小型激光，装在臂部、躯干和头部。这让机甲火力严重不足，因此可以说它最有力的武器是拳头；若冲锋者能拉近距离进入肉搏，它完全有能力把其他机甲——尤其是轻型机甲——砸成碎片。

column1: An attempt to make the early Charger models more successful by downgrading the 400 engine to a 320 core. The freed up weight allows both considerably more armor as a much different weapons mix of weapons - a Large Laser, a PPC and three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 通过将400引擎降级为320核心，试图让早期型的Charger型号获得更好的表现。省下的重量既带来了大幅增加的装甲，也带来了截然不同的武器组合——一门大型激光、一门粒子炮和三门中型激光。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: A melee-focused variation of the CGR-1A5 model introduced in 3028, the 1P5 retains the lasers and SRM racks but downgrades the AC/20 for an much smaller AC/5 to free up the weight for an assault Battle Axe carried in the right arm. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 1P5是3028年推出的CGR-1A5型号的近战向变体，它保留了激光与SRM发射槽，但把AC/20降级为小得多的AC/5，以腾出重量在右臂携带一把突击型战斧。 特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: A very unusual total refit of the Charger, it's origins uncertain but likely some blackshop in the periphery as it is only used by pirates and other unsavory groups. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这是对 Charger 一次极为罕见的大改，来历不明，很可能出自外围地区的某家黑作坊，因为只有海盗和其他不三不四的团体才使用它。 特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Terry Ford's "Number Seven" is built around an 320-rated standard engine, the slower engine allows it to retain the 'Mech's ten tons of armor and head mounted small laser while freeing up weight to carry a Large Laser in each side torso supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and the right torso. Twenty-five single heat sinks and four jump jets ensure Number Seven surprising mobility and endurance in battle. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 特里·福特的“七号”围绕额定 320 的标准引擎打造。较慢的引擎使它得以保留机甲原有的十吨装甲和头部安装的小型激光，同时腾出重量，在两侧躯干各装一门大型激光，并由每条手臂和右躯干各一门中型激光提供支援。二十五个单散热器和四具跳跃推进器，使“七号”在战斗中拥有出人意料的机动性与续航能力。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: Support & Skirmisher
column2: 支援与游骑

column1: Terry Ford's \"Number Seven\" is built around an 320-rated standard engine, the slower engine allows it to retain the 'Mech's ten tons of armor and head mounted small laser while freeing up weight to carry a Large Laser in each side torso supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and the right torso. Twenty-five single heat sinks and four jump jets ensure Number Seven surprising mobility and endurance in battle.
column2: 特里·福特的“七号”围绕一台320额定标准引擎建造。较慢的引擎让它得以保留机甲的十吨装甲和头部小型激光，同时腾出重量在两侧躯干各装一门大型激光，并由每只手臂和右躯干的中型激光支援。二十五个单散热器和四具跳跃推进器确保“七号”在战斗中拥有惊人的机动性与持续力。

column1: Punch Bot started as an standard CGR-1A1 of a lance sized merc unit with limited funds available. The first pilot repeatedly threw his 'Mech first into every tough situation hoping to to be able to collect the insurance on the Charger, but the 'Mech just wouldn't die. Eventually the unit realized they could save over 10 tons by replacing the LTV 400 Engine with a GM 380 out of a salvaged Banshee. The then dropped 5 of those tons of the 'Mech's overall weight to keep the same top speed. The extra tonnage allowed them to embrace Punch Bot's usual tactics by mounting Jump Jets, a ton and a half extra armor and upgraded arm actuators. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 拳击机器人起初是一个经费有限的排级雇佣兵单位的一台标准CGR-1A1。首位飞行员反复把机甲第一个扔进每个险境，指望能靠冲锋者拿到保险金，可这台机甲就是死不了。最终该部队意识到，用一台从废弃女妖上拆下的GM 380替换LTV 400引擎，能省下十吨以上。他们随后又削掉其中5吨总重量以保持同样的最高速度。多出的吨位让他们得以拥抱拳击机器人的惯用战术：装跳跃推进器、一吨半额外装甲，并升级手臂驱动器。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: An interesting departure from standard 'Mech design, deciding to use the Chargers speed and dedicate it to beating heavy and assault 'Mechs into scrap with it's fists.
column2: 这是对标准机甲设计一次有趣的偏离——决定利用冲锋者的速度，把它专门用于用拳头把重型与突击机甲砸成废铁。

column1: The 2G is a Clan conversion of the Cicada, although its purpose is unknown it does allow the 'Mech to perform better and fit more advanced electronic warfare components. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 2G是蝉式机甲经部族技术改造而成的型号。尽管其用途不明，但它确实让这台机甲性能更佳，并能容纳更先进的电子战部件。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated Fusion Core, the Cicada 2A is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers and a Small Laser.
column2: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。蝉2A由一台320额定聚变核心驱动，装有两门中型激光和一门小型激光。

Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the prototype Cicada X5 is armed with quad Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-2’s. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。原型蝉X5由一台320额定XL引擎驱动，装四门中型激光和两具SRM-2。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the prototype Cicada X5 is armed with quad Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-2’s.
column2: 蝉于2740年推出，这种40吨机甲是作为蝗虫的竞争者而研发的。武装略好、速度相当，蝉更厚的装甲与更强的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉X5原型由一具320级XL引擎驱动，武装为四门中型激光器和两具SRM-2。

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This custom model exchanges the Autocannon/5 with a Large Laser and four Heat Sinks. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Clint 最初是作为廉价侦察单位设计的，却具备武装精良的低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这方面它表现相当出色。其最高速度为 97.2 km/h，跳跃距离达一百八十米，能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中灵活机动。这款定制型号用一门大型激光和四具散热器换掉了自动炮/5。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This custom model exchanges the Autocannon/5 with a Large Laser and four Heat Sinks.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为一种廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好、低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这点上它表现出色。凭借97.2公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中机动。这台定制型号把自动炮/5换成了一门大型激光器和四具散热器。

column1: A battlefield refit of the CLNT-2-3T, replacing one of the medium lasers for a small laser and CASE protection to the autocannon ammunition. Two jump jets are also removed to enable the use of a C3 Slave unit. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是 CLNT-2-3T 的战场改装：将其中一门中型激光换为小型激光，并为自动炮弹药加装 CASE 防护。此外还拆除了两具跳跃推进器，以便使用 C3 从属单元。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column2: 狙击手与轻型缠斗者

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3T equipped with one Autocannon/5 with one ton of ammunition. As secondary weapons, the Clint carries two Martell Medium Lasers. This well-balanced mix of weapons when combined with the Clint's above-average maneuverability for its size make the Clint a highly effective multi-role BattleMech.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。克林特 2-3T 装备一门自动炮/5，配一吨弹药。作为次要武器，克林特携带两门马特尔中型激光。这种均衡的武器搭配结合克林特同尺寸中高于平均的机动性，使克林特成为极为高效的多用途战斗机甲。

column1: A full conversion of the standard Clint to Clan tech, used by the famous elite mercenary unit the Gray Death Legion. By using both Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo-Steel chassis the design manages to fit an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, making the 40 ton 'Mech capable to deliver an unexpectedly heavy strike. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是将标准型克林特全面改装为部族科技的产物，由著名精锐雇佣兵部队灰死军团使用。通过同时采用铁纤维装甲与内骨架底盘，该设计成功装下了一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，让这台40吨机甲能够打出出人意料的沉重一击。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. Produced by the Taurian Concordat at the outbreak of the Jihad, the 3-3T modifies the original 2-3T. It adds Ferro-Fibrous armor to the design and swaps out the AC/5 with a Light AC/5, presumably supplied to them by the Word of Blake. This lighter weapon makes room for the inclusion of CASE and two tons of ammunition, ensuring it is able to carry various types of munitions.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为一种廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好、低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这点上它表现出色。凭借97.2公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中机动。由陶里安协约国在圣战爆发时生产，3-3T改装自原本的2-3T。它为该设计增加了铁纤装甲，并把AC/5换成轻型AC/5——想必是布雷克之言提供给他们的。这件更轻的武器为加装CASE和两吨弹药腾出了空间，确保它能携带多种弹药。

column1: A mercenary refit of the Clint CLNT-3-3T using acquired clan tech. Mounting an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, made possibly by use of both Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel structure, making it considerably better armed than its base variant. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是雇佣兵利用取得的部族技术对克林特CLNT-3-3T的改装。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，靠铁纤维装甲与内骨架结构才得以实现，武装明显优于基础变型。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Clint IIC
column2: 克林特 IIC

column1: The CRH-2B distinguishes itself through an unusual density of reinforced components, including an armored cockpit, armored engine shielding, a defensive-rated gyro, and reinforced leg and arm actuators that resist crippling damage. Ferro-Fibrous armor plating keeps weight manageable despite this added bulk, while internal spall liners reduce the risk of catastrophic crew or component loss from penetrating hits. Armed with twin PPCs and three Medium Lasers, and fitted with assault-class jump jets for repositioning, the CRH-2B remains a stubbornly difficult mech to put down for good. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: CRH-2B的独特之处在于强化部件密度异常之高：装甲座舱、装甲引擎屏蔽、防御级陀螺仪，以及能抵抗致残伤害的加固腿部与手臂驱动器。尽管增加了这些体积，铁纤维装甲板仍让重量保持可控，而内部崩落衬层则降低了穿透命中导致乘员或部件灾难性损失的风险。CRH-2B装双粒子炮与三门中型激光，并配突击级跳跃推进器用于重新站位，是一台顽固得难以彻底击倒的机甲。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: Defensive Juggernaut
column2: 防御型主宰者

column1: Designed in the waning years of the Star League to bolster SLDF garrisons amid mounting civil unrest, the Cockroach prioritized survivability above all else, trading offensive punch for unmatched resilience under fire. Following the Amaris Civil War, production blueprints scattered across the Inner Sphere, picked up intermittently by various manufacturers ever since. Now an uncommon but unsurprising sight in garrison forces of nearly every major faction, with scattered units even reaching Periphery militias.
column2: 蟑螂在星盟末期设计，用于在内乱加剧之际强化星盟防卫军驻军，它把生存性置于一切之上，以牺牲进攻打击力换取无与伦比的抗打击能力。阿马里斯内战之后，其生产蓝图散落内天体各地，此后被各家制造商断断续续地拾起。如今它几乎在每个主要势力的驻军中都能见到——虽不常见却也并不令人意外，零星机体甚至流入外围区民兵手中。

column1: The CRH-2Br is a common field refit of the original CRH-2B, replacing its single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout. This simple upgrade allows the Cockroach's twin PPCs to fire more frequently without risking shutdown, meaningfully improving sustained combat performance while leaving the chassis's signature armor, reinforced actuators, and defensive systems entirely untouched. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CRH-2Br是CRH-2B常见的野战改装，把单散热器全面换成双散热器。这项简单升级让蟑螂的双粒子炮能更频繁地射击而不必担心停机，显著改善持续战斗表现，同时完全不动其标志性装甲、加固驱动器和防御系统。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: The CRH-4H represents a significant rework of the original CRH-2B, upgrading its twin PPCs to ER PPCs for greater range and replacing single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout to support them. A Guardian ECM Suite has been added for electronic protection, and Reinforced Internal Structure further bolsters the chassis's already formidable durability. These additions come at a slight cost to armor coverage, though the CRH-4H remains every bit as difficult to bring down as its predecessor. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CRH-4H 是对原始 CRH-2B 的一次重大改造：将成对的粒子炮升级为增程粒子炮以获得更大射程，并全面以双散热器替换单散热器来支撑它们。它还加装了 Guardian 电子对抗套件以提供电子防护，而强化内部结构则进一步增强了机体本就强悍的耐用性。这些改动以略微削减装甲覆盖为代价，不过 CRH-4H 依旧如前代一样难以被击倒。 特性：强化结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: The CRH-4H2 builds directly on the CRH-4H, upgrading all three Medium Lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers and adding a fourth in the center torso for substantially improved close-range accuracy and output. An Advanced Targeting Computer and additional energy and heat tracking systems further sharpen its weapons' effectiveness, supported by extra heat sinks in both arms. To accommodate this expanded and refined arsenal, the CRH-4H2 sacrifices its jump jets entirely — a trade-off that grounds the design but leaves its renowned armor and defensive systems fully intact. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CRH-4H2直接以CRH-4H为基础，把三门中型激光全部升级为中型脉冲激光，并在中央躯干加装第四门，近距精度与输出显著提升。一台先进瞄准计算机与额外的能量和热量追踪系统进一步强化了武器效能，双臂还加了额外散热器。为容纳这套扩充且精炼的武器，CRH-4H2完全牺牲了跳跃推进器——这一取舍让该设计失去了跳跃能力，但其著名的装甲与防御系统完好无损。 特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: The original Colossus design, introduced in 3053, carried a standard AC/20, and a Large Pulse Laser teamed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Like the updated version, this prototype could jump 90 meters. The armor protection remained the same, but it carried three Coolant Pods in the right and left torsos instead of the shields that would later appear on the CLS-4S. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 最初的巨像设计于3053年推出，带一门标准AC/20，每只手臂则有一门大型脉冲激光配一门中型脉冲激光。与更新版本一样，此原型可跳跃90米。装甲防护保持不变，但它在左右躯干装了三个冷却剂罐，而非后来出现在CLS-4S上的护盾。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Colossus was one of the first 'Mechs to use X-Pulse Lasers. Bethel Labs, the developers of the X-Pulse technology, wanted a demonstrator for their new technology. Omnitech Industries brushed off their Colossus design and the rest is history. Using a standard engine, Endo Steel chassis, and armor, the Colossus can take enormous amounts of damage. Though not a particularly fast 'Mech, it does move at the same rate as the Atlas and other assault 'Mechs. In addition it has a 90 meter jump capability which can maneuver it out of trouble.
column2: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，巨像是首批使用X脉冲激光器的机甲之一。X脉冲技术的开发者贝塞尔实验室想为他们的新技术做一个展示机。全能科技工业翻出他们的巨像设计，余下的就成了历史。它采用标准引擎、内层钢底盘和装甲，能承受巨量伤害。虽然不算特别快，它的移动速度与阿特拉斯及其他突击机甲相当。此外它还有90米的跳跃能力，可以机动脱离麻烦。

column1: The 2A is an unofficial refit of the 2D, adding one and a half ton of armor and switching from single to double heat sinks. The SRM-6 launcher is converted to a hand-mounted SRM-4, and the Medium Laser moved to a side torso. The 'Mech also adds protection against internal ammunition explosions in form of a C.A.S.E. system. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 2A是对2D的非官方改装，增加了一吨半装甲，并将单散热器换成双散热器。SRM-6发射器被改为手持式SRM-4，中型激光则移至侧躯干。该机甲还以C.A.S.E.系统的形式增添了针对内部弹药爆炸的防护。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The 2A is an unofficial refit of the 2D, adding one and a half ton of armor and switching from single to double heat sinks. The SRM-6 launcher is converted to a hand-mounted SRM-4, and the Medium Laser moved to a side torso. The 'Mech also adds protection against internal ammunition explosions in form of a C.A.S.E. system.
column2: 2A是2D的非官方改装，增加一吨半装甲，并把单重散热器改为双重散热器。SRM-6发射器被改为手持式SRM-4，中型激光器移到侧躯干。该机甲还以C.A.S.E.系统的形式增加了对内部弹药爆炸的防护。

column1: A refit of the 2D chassis removing all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 2D 底盘的改装型，拆除了全部导弹，改为加装三具中型激光和六具小型激光，并额外增加一吨装甲。 特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: When the say Inferno, no one realized they were referring to the temperature inside the cockpit.  I suggest removing some of the lasers and adding a heat sink or two.
column2: 当人们说"燃烧弹"时，没人意识到他们指的是驾驶舱内的温度。我建议移除一些激光，加一两台散热器。

column1: A variant of the -2D that drops the Medium Laser to replace it with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 这是-2D的变型，拆掉中型激光，换成一台C3从机。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A variant of the -2D that drops the Medium Laser to replace it with a C3 slave unit.
column2: 这是-2D的一个改型，拆掉中型激光器，换上一套C3从属系统。

column1: A battlefield refit of the 2D, the 2J mounts 6 jump jets and replaces the SRM-6 with a SRM-4 launcher. The 'Mech further uses double heat sinks to support the increased heat build up from the jump jets. To be able to carry the weight of the jump jets, the 2J uses an XL engine core and Ferro-Fibrous armor. This does however mean that an extra ton of armor and a C.A.S.E. system can be added. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 2J 是 2D 的战地改装型，安装了 6 台跳跃推进器，并以 SRM-4 发射器取代 SRM-6。该机甲还采用双散热器，以应对跳跃推进器带来的额外热量积聚。为了承受跳跃推进器的重量，2J 使用 XL 引擎核心和铁纤维装甲，不过这也意味着还能额外增加一吨装甲并加装 C.A.S.E. 系统。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A battlefield refit of the 2D, the 2J mounts 6 jump jets and replaces the SRM-6 with a SRM-4 launcher. The 'Mech further uses double heat sinks to support the increased heat build up from the jump jets. To be able to carry the weight of the jump jets, the 2J uses an XL engine core and Ferro-Fibrous armor. This does however mean that an extra ton of armor and a C.A.S.E. system can be added.
column2: 作为2D的战地改装，2J装6个跳跃推进器，并把SRM-6换成SRM-4发射器。该机甲还使用双重散热器以应对跳跃推进器带来的额外积热。为承载跳跃推进器的重量，2J采用XL引擎核心和铁纤装甲。不过这确实意味着可以加装额外一吨装甲和一套C.A.S.E.系统。

column1: Another common refit of the COM-2D is the 2P, which adds a Large Laser at the cost of only keeping a downgraded SRM-2 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96

column1: Another common refit of the COM-2D is the 2P, which adds a Large Laser at the cost of only keeping a downgraded SRM-2 launcher.
column2: COM-2D另一个常见的改装是2P，它以只保留降级版SRM-2发射器为代价，加装了一门大型激光器。

column1: Five tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, an XL engine, double heat sinks, C.A.S.E. system and an extra Medium laser makes the 2W quite a refit of the 2D. To make it even more interesting the SRM-6 has been replaced by a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 五吨铁纤维装甲、一台XL引擎、双散热器、C.A.S.E.系统和一门额外中型激光，使2W成为对2D相当彻底的改装。更有意思的是，SRM-6被换成了连发SRM-4发射器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column2: 五吨铁纤装甲、一具XL引擎、双重散热器、C.A.S.E.系统和一门额外中型激光器，使2W成为对2D相当大的一次改装。为了更有意思，SRM-6被换成了连发SRM-4发射器。

column1: The 3H2 mounts a Large Laser and a Small Laser, protected by 5.5 tons of armor. This makes it more durable than a 2D, allowing it to remain scouting for a longer time on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
