column1: The 3H2 mounts a Large Laser and a Small Laser, protected by 5.5 tons of armor. This makes it more durable than a 2D, allowing it to remain scouting for a longer time on the battlefield.
column2: 3H2装有一门大型激光和一门小型激光，由5.5吨装甲保护。这使它比2D更耐久，能在战场上保持更久的侦察状态。

column1: The best armored of the of the -7 series, the -7A still manages to fit a total of 200 C.A.S.E. protected SRM missiles for its two SRM-4 launchers. A single Medium Laser in the Left Arm is the only other weapon of the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: -7A是-7系列中装甲最厚的一款，却仍能为其两具SRM-4发射器携带总计200枚受C.A.S.E.保护的SRM导弹。左臂的一门中型激光是该变型唯一的其他武器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: Long the darling of the Lyran Commonwealth's scouting formations, the Commando has enjoyed vast success over its seven centuries of service. Once exclusively Lyran, the Succession Wars spread the capable little 'Mech to various mercenary companies, where a score of variants commonly called the -7 series emerged. Thrifty mercenaries often swap missile racks for energy independence, and the Commando is a common sight in Mech-it-Lube franchise refit bays.
column2: 作为莱兰联邦侦察编队长期的心头好，突击队员在其七个世纪服役中取得了巨大成功。它曾为莱兰独有，继承战争把这款能干的小机甲传播到各家佣兵部队，并涌现出被称为"-7 系列"的众多变体。节俭的佣兵常用导弹挂架换取能量武器的后勤独立性，因此突击队员在"Mech-it-Lube"连锁改装店里随处可见。

column1: Similar to the -7A in weapons loadout with two SRM-4 launchers and a Medium Laser, the -7J mounts five jump jets instead of the extra armor and ammunition of the -7A. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: -7J的武器配置与-7A相似，同为2具SRM-4发射器和1门中型激光，但它用5具跳跃推进器替代了-7A上额外的装甲与弹药。\n<特性：狭小/低矮外形\n<投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The -7W reaches for longevity with extra ammo and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Task Force Serpent used these variants to great effect on Huntress, prompting Coventry Metal Works to dedicate factory space to producing official re-creations. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: -7W以额外弹药和一具连发SRM-2发射器追求持久力。蛇特遣队在享特雷斯上大量使用这些变型并效果卓著，促使考文垂金属厂专门腾出厂房生产官方复刻版。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A 4th Succession war variant that saw limited production, the 7X variant exchanges the SRM-4 for an additional 2 medium lasers but is otherwise identical to the standard Commando. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 7X是第四次继承战争时期产量有限的变型，以额外2门中型激光取代SRM-4，其余与标准突击兵完全相同。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A 4th Succession war variant that saw limited production, the 7X variant exchanges the SRM-4 for an additional 2 medium lasers but is otherwise identical to the standard Commando.
column2: 这是第四次继承战争中产量有限的改型，7X把SRM-4换成额外两门中型激光器，其余与标准突击队员完全相同。

column1: The COM-7Y swaps the -2D's SRM-4 for two more medium lasers and another ton of armor in an attempt to improve the Commando's longevity on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: COM-7Y以两门额外中型激光和另一吨装甲取代-2D的SRM-4，意在提升突击兵在战场上的存续力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The -7Y2 is more than just a sub-variant of the -7Y, it has become so famous and beloved it earned its own nickname of the 'Blazing Inferno'. It sacrifices the SRM launchers, but instead adds 6 small lasers. The only downside of the variant is its quite bad cooling capabilities considering all its weapons. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: -7Y2 不只是 -7Y 的子改型，它已经太过出名、太受欢迎，以至于获得了自己的绰号“炽烈地狱”。它舍弃了 SRM 发射器，改为加装 6 门小型激光。该改型唯一的缺点在于，考虑到它的全部武器，其散热能力相当糟糕。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The recovery of Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment technology saw the emergence of a new more durable variant of the Commando, the -7Z. To fit the C.A.S.E. system the variant drops one of the -7Y's Medium Lasers, but also adds a bit more armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 随着细胞式弹药储存设备技术的重获，Commando出现了一种更耐用的新型改款——7Z。为了容纳C.A.S.E.系统，该改型舍弃了7Y的一门中型激光，但也增加了一些装甲。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A sub-variant of the -7Z, the Commando COM-7Z2 downgrades the two Medium Lasers to Small Lasers to be able to fit a Beagle Active Probe. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Commando COM-7Z2是7Z的子改型，将两门中型激光降级为小型激光，以便装下一具Beagle主动探测器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Built on an Endo Steel chassis, the 9D combines a 200 XL engine with 5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. A ton of streak ammunition and an Beagle Active Probe finishes the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 9D 以内骨架底盘打造，整合了 200 XL 引擎、5 吨铁纤维装甲、两门中型激光和一部连发 SRM-6 发射器。一吨连发弹药和一部 Beagle 主动探测器构成了这套设计的收尾。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Built on an Endo Steel chassis, the 9D combines a 200 XL engine with 5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. A ton of streak ammunition and an Beagle Active Probe finishes the design.
column2: 9D建在内层钢底盘上，把一具200 XL引擎与5吨铁纤装甲、两门中型激光器和一具连发SRM-6发射器结合起来。一吨连发弹药和一个比格犬主动探测器补全该设计。

column1: A refresh of the 9D, the 9DA replaces the Medium Lasers with Small Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 9DA是9D的改良型，用小型脉冲激光替换了中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column2: 作为9D的更新版，9DA把中型激光器换成小型脉冲激光器。

column1: The Commando R2D2, except for having a very strange designation, is a pretty standard looking refit of the 2D replacing the Medium Laser with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 突击兵R2D2除了有个非常奇怪的编号之外，就是对2D相当标准的改装，以一台C3从机取代中型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the "Death's Knell"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 第22斯凯游骑兵上尉博诺·杜根梅尔驾驶的一台独特突击兵“丧钟”，装上了回收的失落科技。它以额外3门中型激光取代标准SRM挂架，使这台TDK的引擎得以换装175核心。双散热器的加入让机甲保持舒适的温度，另加半吨装甲为该设计收尾。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

column2: 这是第22斯凯游骑兵的博诺·杜根梅尔上尉驾驶的一台独特突击队员，名为"丧钟"；它以回收的失传科技改装。把标准SRM架换成额外3门中型激光器，使TDK的引擎得以改配175核心。加入双重散热器让该机甲保持舒适凉爽。另加半吨装甲补全设计。

A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 幻术师作为狼獾的后继型号而设计，是部族二线编队中得见的50吨机甲。它由一台300额定聚变核心驱动，幻术师CJR-7装6具跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光和2具LRM-5构成CJR-7武器的大部分，另有一对增程中型激光用于近战。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat.
column2: 作为狼獾的后继者而设计，咒术师是一种出现在氏族二线编队中的50吨机甲。咒术师CJR-7由一具300级聚变核心驱动，装6个跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光器和2具LRM-5构成CJR-7的主要武器，另有一对增程中型激光器用于近战。

column1: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 科罗娜是星蝰部族在决定哪些部族参与“复兴行动”的试炼之后所创造的战斗装甲设计。其构想是围绕一件能从远处威胁机甲的武器来打造这套战斗服。安装如此沉重的武器所需的重量，导致装甲减少百分之二十并取消了跳跃背包，尽管整体重量增加了百分之五十。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可进行近战，无法发动蜂群攻击。

column1: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass.
column2: 日冕是星蝰氏族在确定哪些氏族参加复兴行动的试炼之后创造的战斗装甲设计。其理念是围绕一件能从远距离威胁机甲的武器来打造整套战斗服。为承载如此重型的武器所需的质量，导致装甲减少了百分之二十并拆除了跳跃背包，尽管整体质量增加了百分之五十。

column1: Jake Kalmar's infamous Ravager was built around a 285-rated XL Engine to save weight to carry eighteen tons of armor and fifteen double heat sinks. Offensively the Ravager is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the left arm and a Ultra AC/5 in the right torso, supported by a center torso mounted Large Pulse Laser, a standard Large Laser in the left torso and right arm, rounded out by a Medium Laser in the head and each arm. Two tons each of Gauss and UAC reloads gave it good endurance. The 'Mech was salvaged by Chloe's Cavaliers after they tracked Kalmar to Sigurd in 3037 and killed him there. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 杰克·卡尔马（Jake Kalmar）那台臭名昭著的“揉躏者”（Ravager）以额定 285 的 XL 引擎为核心，从而省下重量来携带十八吨装甲和十五台双散热器。在攻击方面，揉躏者的左臂装有一门高斯步枪，右躯干装有一门超速 AC/5，并由中央躯干的大型脉冲激光、左躯干与右臂的标准大型激光提供支援，头部与每条手臂各一门中型激光则补齐了配置。高斯弹药与 UAC 弹药各两吨，使它具备良好的持续作战能力。3037 年，克洛伊骑兵团（Chloe's Cavaliers）追踪卡尔马至西格德（Sigurd）并将其击毙后，回收了这台机甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column2: 重型拼装机甲

column1: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works.
column2: 老板，这玩意儿到底是什么？我不怕挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗死亡陷阱。它不知怎么就能用，但我完全说不出它为什么、以及怎么能用。

column1: The Corvis 1 is built on a Model MH-24 endo steel chassis, protected by seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor; a good thing since it is so slow. This low speed is due to the 160-rated fusion engine that powers the 'Mech. Thankfully this low speed is augmented by four jump jets, giving the Corvis a jump range of 120 meters. The main gun of the Corvis is its UAC/10, backed up by a pair of medium pulse lasers. These guns enable the Corvis to operate effectively in medium to short ranges. Between the generous supply of autocannon ammunition and 10 double heat sinks that keep the 'Mech chilled, the Corvis can operate without resupply for a respectable amount of time. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Corvis 1 以 Model MH-24 内骨架机体建造，由七吨铁纤维装甲保护；鉴于它的速度如此之慢，这倒是件好事。低速源于为机甲提供动力的 160 级聚变引擎。所幸四具跳跃推进器弥补了这一缺陷，使 Corvis 拥有 120 米的跳跃距离。Corvis 的主炮是 UAC/10，辅以两门中型脉冲激光。这些武器让 Corvis 在中近距离都能有效作战。凭借充裕的自动炮弹药和 10 具让机甲保持凉爽的双散热器，Corvis 能够在相当长的时间内无需补给持续作战。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The Corvis was one of the predecessors to the OmniMech, utilizing the same semi-modular ports as the Star League Mercury BattleMech. Clan technicians eventually expanded upon this design to create the Stormcrow, and with the development of that front-line OmniMech, all of the Clans save the Horses lost interest in the Corvis, which was often derided as too slow for its weight class. In fact, the Corvis' only saving grace is its use of jump jets, because they allow the medium-range 'Mech to be useful when on restricting terrain, such as urban environments. The Corvis was often deployed as support for conventional troops, such as combat vehicles and infantry, so it only seems natural that the Horses would want to keep producing it.
column2: 科维斯是全方位机甲的前身之一，使用了与星盟水星战斗机甲相同的半模块化接口。氏族技师最终在这一设计上扩展创造出暴风鸦，而随着那台前线全方位机甲的研发，除地狱马之外的所有氏族都对科维斯失去了兴趣，它常被嘲笑为对其重量级而言太慢。事实上，科维斯唯一可取之处就是它对跳跃推进器的使用，因为它们让这台中型机甲在受限制的地形（如城市环境）中仍有用处。科维斯常被部署为常规部队（如战斗车辆与步兵）的支援，所以地狱马想继续生产它似乎也很自然。

column1: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: COU-A专注间接火力支援，装备两具由阿尔忒弥斯IV制导的LRM-20。若机师获得直视射界，还可依靠两具增程中型激光和一具备用的小型脉冲激光。总体而言，这让它在极小的机体中汇聚了相当可观的火力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. column1: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 美洲狮-B 是典型的部族直射火力支援/狙击配置。两门增程粒子炮加上一门作为备份的增程中型激光，构成相当可观的打击力。额外的六个双散热器让 COU-B 运行得相当凉爽，能够长时间持续倾泻火力。 特性：先进光学系统 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A custom Cougar configuration, the Blood Adder is armed with a pair of ATM-9’s. A pair of torso mounted HMG’s back the ATM’s up at closer ranges while a head mounted AMS enhances the configurations defensive capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为美洲狮的定制配置，血蝰蛇装有一对ATM-9。两挺躯干机枪在较近距离为ATM提供后手，头部一套反导弹系统则增强该配置的防御能力。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 远程与中程武器的混装使美洲狮-C变型相当独特。就一台仅35吨的机甲而言，高斯步枪是绝对可怕的主武器系统，就连后备武器也足以在敌人心中种下恐惧：5门ERML让COU-C即便在高斯弹药耗尽后仍能保持活跃与危险。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 美洲狮-D变型的设计构想是兼具优秀近距防御的狙击手：远程依靠一门ERLL和一门超级自动炮/10，近程则用双联SRM4发射器。COU-D也许不算快，但如果它撕开装甲后逼近，这些近程导弹的收割能力极强。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This configuration was introduced during the 3060s. It was equipped with four Jump Jets and an ECM suite. This variant is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/5 and a trio of Heavy Medium Lasers for when any opponent tries to close range. It also has three additional double heat sinks to deal with heat the trio of heavy lasers produce. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 此配置于3060年代推出，配备四具跳跃推进器和一套电子对抗套件。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门重型中型激光，以应对任何试图逼近的对手，另有三个额外双散热器处理三门重型激光产生的热量。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A configuration focused on medium and short distance engagements, can do a fair amount of damage if used properly.
column2: 这是一个专注中近距离交战的配置，使用得当能造成相当可观的伤害。

column1: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Cougar 的 Huntress 配置十分罕见，它的定位是猎杀侦察兵的“重击手”，大部分性能都转移到了先进电子设备上，并具备侦测乃至一击摧毁隐身单位的能力。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The MCA's purpose is long rage attacks, carrying a LRM-15 and a Large Pulse Laser. For defensive purposes it mounts an Anti Missile System and to deal with infantry attacks the MCA also mounts a Flamer. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的主配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。MCA的用途是远程打击，带一具LRM-15和一门大型脉冲激光。为自卫它装有一套反导弹系统，为应对步兵袭击还装有一具火焰喷射器。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The addition of six jump jets makes the MCJ one of the most mobile configurations of the Cougar, at the cost of only being able to mount a single LRM-15 launcher and a Large Pulse Laser for combat, with a chest mounted Flamer for defensive purposes. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是Cougar的MC定制系列中的另一款构型，以升级的210 XL引擎取代原来的175 XL引擎。六具跳跃推进器的加入使MCJ成为Cougar中机动性最强的构型之一，代价是作战时只能装备一具LRM-15发射器与一门大型脉冲激光，并在胸部装一具火焰喷射器用于自卫。 特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. Mounting four LRM-5 launchers and double Large Pulse Lasers, the damage profile is higher than expected. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的又一配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。它装四具LRM-5发射器和双联大型脉冲激光，伤害曲线高于预期。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 可汗玛尔特·普赖德决定升级其部族列装的机甲。与其耗费宝贵资源从头设计一款新的全向机甲，她指示科学家改进现有设计。科学家们选择改造的是蝰蛇。虽然两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢、武装更好。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The A configuration was introduced during a conflict against Clan Cloud Cobra. Seven Jump Jets gave the Coyotl A much greater maneuverability, while the long range weapons were traded for a Large Pulse Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and an additional Streak SRM-4 launcher. This version also dropped the Medium Pulse Laser of the original. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Coyotl 拥有作为首款全向机甲的荣耀。它由郊狼部族在海洋狐部族的协助下开发，于 2854 年首次投入战场。通过采用 XL 引擎和内骨架机体，科学家们得以打造出一具能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，Coyotl 的高地面速度使其能够迅速从战场一处奔赴另一处，为队友提供支援。A 配置是在与云眼镜蛇部族的冲突中推出的。七具跳跃推进器大幅提升了 Coyotl A 的机动性，远程武器则被换成了一门大型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一具额外的连发 SRM-4 发射器。该版本还去掉了原型的中型脉冲激光。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This is the first of them all. The Grandfather that paved the path for the Omni revolution. Too bad it isn't that great a 'Mech compared to later designs. But at least it has historical value.
column2: 这是它们中的第一款，是为全向机甲革命铺平道路的鼻祖。可惜与后来的设计相比，它算不上出色的机甲。但至少它有历史价值。

column1: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-0 is a downgrade resulting from the Succession War’s decline in technology and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of Large Lasers and an AC/10 form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with paired SRM-6's Lasers and Small Lasers surprising opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Crockett是星际联盟时代的训练机甲，于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混合了多种武器类型并配备双散热器，后来更作为指挥机甲与突击机甲在前线服役。CRK-5003-0是继承战争导致科技衰退后产生的降级版本，配备一具255级引擎与三具跳跃推进器。两门大型激光与一门AC/10构成这台机甲的主要武器，而配对的SRM-6、激光与小型激光则能在近距离让对手措手不及。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为星际联盟时期的训练机甲，克罗基特于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混装多种武器并配双散热器，后来还作为指挥机甲与突击机甲投入一线服役。CRK-5003-1b是SLDF皇家团使用的升级型号，配备一台255额定引擎、内骨架结构和三具跳跃推进器。两门增程大型激光和一门高斯步枪构成机甲武器的绝大部分，另有2门中型激光和4门中型脉冲激光在近距给对手一个惊喜。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-1b is an upgrade model used by the SLDF Royal regiments and features a 255-rated engine alongside an Endo Steel skeleton and a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of ER Large Lasers and a Gauss Rifle form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with 2 Medium Lasers and 4 Medium Pulses surprise opponents at close range.
column2: 作为星盟时代的教练机甲，克罗基特于2735年推出。作为一台85吨机甲，混合使用多种武器类型并配双重散热器，克罗基特后来作为指挥机甲与突击机甲执行前线任务。CRK-5003-1b是SLDF皇家团使用的升级型号，采用一具255级引擎、内层钢骨架和三个跳跃推进器。两门增程大型激光器和一门磁轨炮构成该机甲武器的主体，另有2门中型激光器和4门中型脉冲激光器在近距离给对手一个惊喜。

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X2M is a militarized crosscut on the cheap, with only minor modifications to the base industrial model. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72
column2: 横切是受欢迎的伐木机甲类型，以在林地作业高效、称霸商业林业而受赞誉。X2M是一款低成本的军用化横切，仅对基础工业型号做了少量改动。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.72

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X2M is a militarized crosscut on the cheap, with only minor modifications to the base industrial model.
column2: 克罗斯卡特是一种广受欢迎的伐木机甲，以林地作业效率高、称霸商业林业而著称。X2M是廉价的军用化克罗斯卡特，只对基础工业型号做了轻微改动。

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X4X is the dual-chainsaw version (not to be confused with the dual-saw version, which is different). It's particularly popular in forestry with dense tree coverage. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72
column2: 横切是受欢迎的伐木机甲类型，以在林地作业高效、称霸商业林业而受赞誉。X4X是双链锯版本（不要与双锯版本混淆，那是不一样的东西）。它在树冠茂密的林区尤其受欢迎。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.72

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X4X is the dual-chainsaw version (not to be confused with the dual-saw version, which is different). It's particularly popular in forestry with dense tree coverage.
column2: 克罗斯卡特是一种广受欢迎的伐木机甲，以林地作业效率高、称霸商业林业而著称。X4X是双链锯版本（别与双锯版本混淆，那是另一种）。它在林木茂密的地带尤其受欢迎。

column1: Used by 'Crusading Crael', the reigning champion of the DeathRain Arena in Port Krin on Antallos in 3057, this heavily modified Crusader had huge spikes protruding from its chest and shoulders; the latter served to conceal missile launchers and fall off as soon as the shoulder-mounted SRMs were fired for the first time. The shoulder-mounted LRM-15 launchers of the original were replaced with two more SRM-6 racks (mounted in the side torso sections) to boost short-range firepower over the LRM's long range that was less useful in arena combat, and maximized the infighter capabilities by installing Claws on each arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台机甲由“十字军克雷尔”使用——他是3057年安塔洛斯克林港“死亡雨竞技场”的卫冕冠军。这台大幅改装的十字军胸口与肩部伸出巨大尖刺；肩部那些还用来隐藏导弹发射器，在肩载SRM首次发射后便会脱落。原本的肩载LRM-15发射器被换成另外两组SRM-6挂架（装在侧躯干），以在竞技场战斗中用处不大的LRM远程火力换取更强的近程火力，并给每只手臂装上爪，最大限度发挥近身近战能力。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: Don't get close to this one. Ever. Or it will turn your 'Mech to scrap before you can say the word <i>Honorificabilitudinitatibus<i> out loud.
column2: 永远别靠近这一个。绝不。否则在你把<i>Honorificabilitudinitatibus<i>大声念完之前，它就会把你的机甲变成废铁。

column1: A refit of the -3R that replaces the Machine Guns with a C3 slave unit and CASE protection to improve battlefield performance against other Mechs and Vehicles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这是 -3R 的改装型，以一套 C3 从机和 CASE 防护替换了机枪，以提升在战场上对付其他机甲和车辆的表现。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Heavy Skirmisher & Brawler
column2: 重型散兵与缠斗者

column1: Another of those refits which don't really change that much of the how the 'Mech performs. But I guess if you care about surviving, having CASE can be a good thing.
column2: 这又是一次其实没怎么改变机甲表现的改装。不过我想，如果你在乎活命，有CASE总是好事。

column1: Custom refit of the Crusader CRD-3R used by the mercenary band Wolf's Dragoons. The main features are the replacement of all the weapons with Clan tech versions and the use of a Clan XL engine core, combined with four JumpJets and an Artemis IV system. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是雇佣兵部队沃尔夫龙骑兵所使用的 Crusader CRD-3R 定制改装版。主要特点是将全部武器换成部族科技型号，并采用部族 XL 引擎核心，同时配备四台跳跃推进器和一套 Artemis IV 系统。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: This, and the other Wolf's Dragoons refits of the stock Crusader, are such huge improvements that they can't be compared on any level except sharing the chassis name and structure.
column2: 这一台，以及狼族龙骑兵对现有十字军的其他改装，改进之大使它们在任何层面都无法比较，除了共用底盘名称与结构。

column1: One of several custom designs used by the famous mercenary company Wolf's Dragoons. Based off the -3R but heavily improved with Clan tech, the design uses a 360 XL Clan Engine core to be able to fit better weapons, a C3 slave unit, jumpjets and better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是著名雇佣兵公司沃尔夫龙骑兵所使用的数款定制设计之一。它以-3R为基础，但用部族科技大幅改良，采用额定360的部族XL引擎核心，从而能装下更好的武器、一套C3从属单元、跳跃推进器以及更强的散热系统。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: So, see it like this, Boss. Take a normal Crusader CRD-3R, but replace half of the weapons with Clan Tech, add Jump Jets and improve its battlefield performance a lot. That is what these beasts are.
column2: 你看，老大。拿一台普通的十字军CRD-3R，把一半武器换成氏族科技，装上跳跃推进器，并大幅提升其战场表现。这些猛兽就是这样。

column1: A Star League-tech retrofit of the classic CRD-3R developed by Bander BattleMechs for the mercenary market in 3054, the 4BR switches to double heat sinks and replaces the SRM-6 launchers with a pair of Streak SRM-2s. The weight saved allows an extra ton of LRM reloads for each launcher to be carried, protected by the addition of CASE in each torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 4BR 是 Bander BattleMechs 于 3054 年为雇佣兵市场开发的、经典 CRD-3R 的星际联盟技术改装型。它换装双散热器，并以两具连发 SRM-2 取代 SRM-6 发射器。节省下来的重量使每具发射器都能多携带一吨 LRM 备用弹药，并由各躯干新增的 CASE 提供保护。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An all-round upgrade for the 'Mech, most of the improvements are aimed to improve the survivability and length of useful deployment.
column2: 对该机甲的全方位升级，大部分改进都旨在提升生存能力与有效部署时长。

column1: The -4Db was an initial alternative upgrade route from the -3R before -4D design was fully finished. However, due the use of Artemis IV FCS, Streak SRM-4s rather than Streak SRM-2s and Endo Steel structure made the design far too expensive for the intended market. Only a few units were ever produced. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: -4Db是-4D设计完全定型之前，-3R的一条早期替代升级路线。然而，由于采用阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统、连发SRM-4而非连发SRM-2以及内骨架结构，该设计对目标市场而言过于昂贵，只生产了少数几台。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Probably a better 'Mech than the final -4D, but I see why it would be a problem for smaller mercenary outfits to afford both the initial purchase and the continued maintenance of this version.
column2: 大概是台比最终-4D更好的机甲，但我明白为什么较小的雇佣兵部队会既负担不起初次购买、又负担不起这一版本持续的维护费用。

column1: A Capellan Confederation specific variant, similar to the CRD-4D except for a slightly different paintjob. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 卡佩兰联邦专属的变型，与CRD-4D相似，只是涂装略有不同。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: It's a -4D, nothing special.
column2: 它就是个-4D，没什么特别的。

column1: A production-model upgrade of the Crusader utilizing Star League equipment, the 5S was built by TharHes industries on Tharkad for FedCom forces starting in 3049. It varies little from the 3R model, instead removing the machine guns to make room for double heat sinks, CASE to protect the missile reloads, and the addition of a Flamer in the right arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 5S是Crusader采用星际联盟装备的量产升级型，自3049年起由Tharkad上的TharHes工业为联邦共和国部队制造。它与3R型差别不大，只是拆除了机枪以腾出空间安装双散热器、保护导弹弹药的CASE，并在右臂增设了一门火焰喷射器。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Trading the two machine guns for better cooling and CASE just sounds like a no-brainer deal. Who would keep a -3R when there is this to replace it? Well, the poor mercenary outfits, I guess. Unlike us. So let's use this!
column2: 用两挺机枪换成更好的散热与CASE，听起来是个不用过脑子的交易。既然有这东西可以替换，谁还会留着-3R？嗯，我想是那些穷雇佣兵部队吧。不像我们。所以用上这个吧！

column1: A Kallon variant with a top speed of 86 km/h thanks to an XL engine. Each arm carries six medium lasers and the leg mounted weapons are a flamer in each hip mount. Seventeen double heat sinks struggle to keep things cool, but twelve and a half tons of armor protect the 'Mech. A C3 slave unit is mounted in the head, allowing this Crusader to share targeting data. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Kallon 出品的变型，凭借 XL 引擎最高速度可达 86 km/h。每只手臂搭载六具中型激光，腿部武器则是每个髋部安装座内的一具火焰喷射器。十七具双散热器勉力维持散热，十二点五吨装甲则为该机甲提供防护。头部装有一具 C3 从属单元，使这具 Crusader 能够共享瞄准数据。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multirole design. This reliable workhorse of the SLDF, while not excelling in any one job, was quite capable of accomplishing just about any mission, whether it be close assault, anti-aircraft, counterinsurgency, or even reconnaissance. Its versatility and large number of manufacturers ensured the Crusader its place as one of the most common heavy 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 十字军最初是作为星盟防卫部队的近战战斗机甲设计的，但很快证明自己是一种适应性极强的多用途设计。这台SLDF可靠的主力机型虽然在任何单一领域都不算顶尖，却几乎能胜任任何任务——无论是近距突击、防空、反叛乱，还是侦察。它的多用途性与众多的制造商共同确保了十字军在内天体最常见重型机甲中的地位。

column1: The Cudgel 1B was the first of a handful of BattleMechs designed off of the Charger chassis by Solarian manufacturer Innovative Design Concepts. By mounting all weaponry in the torsos, IDC found that MechWarriors were able to make melee strikes without sacrificing any firepower. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 短棍1B是索拉里斯制造商创新设计概念公司基于冲锋者底盘设计的少数战斗机甲中的第一款。通过把所有武器装进躯干，IDC发现机甲战士能在不牺牲任何火力的情况下进行近战打击。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: The Cudgel 1B was the first of a handful of BattleMechs designed off of the Charger chassis by Solarian manufacturer Innovative Design Concepts. By mounting all weaponry in the torsos, IDC found that MechWarriors were able to make melee strikes without sacrificing any firepower.
column2: 棍棒1B是索拉里斯制造商创新设计理念公司基于冲锋者底盘设计的少数战斗机甲中的第一款。通过把所有武器都装进躯干，IDC发现机师能在不牺牲任何火力的前提下进行近战打击。

column1: The original flagship model, the Cyclone A1 began mass-manufacture in 2631 and proved to be the most expensive variant until the 3060s. Sporting a Magna 210XL Fusion engine, the Cyclone A1 can reach and maintain speeds up to 118km/h. Sold as a Scout Mech, the A1 features both a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe which leaves just enough space for its light weapons payload consisting of a pair of Longfire V LRM 5s in the arms and a pair of Magna Mk II Medium Lasers in the side torsos. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为最初的旗舰型号，Cyclone A1 于 2631 年开始量产，并在此后直到 3060 年代一直是价格最高的改型。它搭载 Magna 210XL 聚变引擎，最高可达到并维持 118km/h 的速度。作为侦察机甲发售的 A1 同时配备守卫者电子对抗套件和鱼鹰主动探测器，留下的空间恰好够装它那套轻量武器：双臂各一具 Longfire V LRM 5，两侧躯干各一门 Magna Mk II 中型激光。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Armored Scout
column2: 重装甲侦察

column1: This thing really lives up to it's name, Boss; it's pretty quick and surprisingly hard to stop for its size. The tech specs claims it tops out around 118km/h and when you combine that with the ECM Suite, you can quickly get into and out of trouble.
column2: 这东西真配得上它的名字，老大；它相当快，而且就其体型而言出奇地难以拦住。技术规格称它最高约118公里/小时，再把ECM套件结合起来，你就能迅速进出麻烦。

column1: A downgrade of the original A1 variant, the Cyclone A3 was produced throughout the Amaris Civil War and all four Succession Wars. Replacing the 210XL Fusion engine with an ultra-reliable Magna 150 Fusion engine made the A3 cost half as much as the A1 variant. While the A3 retains the Magna MkII Medium Lasers and Longfire V LRM 5s, the ECM Suite and Active Probe are replaced by a pair of Sperry Browning Machine Guns and a Zippo Flamer. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Cyclone A3 是原 A1 变型的降级版，其生产贯穿了阿马里斯内战与全部四次继承战争。它用极为可靠的 Magna 150 聚变引擎替换了 210XL 聚变引擎，使 A3 的成本只有 A1 变型的一半。A3 保留了 Magna MkII 中型激光与 Longfire V LRM 5，但 ECM 套件和主动探测器被一对 Sperry Browning 机枪和一具 Zippo 火焰喷射器所取代。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The A3 variant is a Succession Wars downgrade of the Cyclone A1. It is not fancy by any means.  I remember my old pappy had a saying about the thing: you pays your monies, you gets your picks. Whatever that means.
column2: A3改型是继承战争期间对旋风A1的降级版。它绝对不算花哨。我记得我老爹对这玩意儿有句说法：你付了你的钱，你拿到你的货。管它什么意思。

column1: The Cyclone A3P refit became popular in the late 2960s and became the primary variant produced, under license, by Luthien Armor Works in the Draconis Combine until the design was retired in the 3060s. The A3P retains the Magna 150 Fusion engine and Magna Mk II Medium lasers of the A3 but replaces the remainder of the weapons payload for a Magna Hellstar PPC and an extra heat sink. The Luthien production runs of the A3P variant were the first Cyclones to feature lower arm and hand actuators. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 旋风A3P改装在2960年代后期流行起来，并成为龙脉联合体内卢西恩装甲厂授权生产的主力变型，直到该设计在3060年代退役。A3P保留了A3的马格纳150聚变引擎和马格纳Mk II中型激光，其余武器则换成一门马格纳地狱星粒子炮和一个额外散热器。卢西恩生产的A3P变型是首批配备下臂与手部驱动器的旋风。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Hey, this is one of those Kuritan Cyclones! The refit to drop the LRMs for a PPC was so popular that the Luthien factory switched over to producing only this variant. Just be careful, boss, it runs damn hot.
column2: 嘿，这是一台库瑞塔旋风！为装粒子炮而拆掉LRM的改装太受欢迎，卢西恩工厂索性转产只造这个变型。不过小心点，老板，它热得要命。

column1: After the discovery of the Helm Memory Core and the development of several additional key technologies, Magna Metals Inc. revisited the Cyclone design in 3058. The B2 variant features an Endo-Steel chassis paired with a 180L Fusion Engine to make room for a pair of experimental Hellcat Class 5 Thunderbolt 5 launchers with a ton of ammunition each and a pair of Magna Mk VI ER Medium Lasers. Further differences from the previous A3 variant come in the form of Double Heat Sinks, lower arm and hand actuators, and the reintroduction of the Guardian ECM Suite. The Cyclone B2 found only a tepid response from military buyers as the Thunderbolt missiles are susceptible to being rendered ineffectual by Anti-Missile Systems. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 在地狱记忆核心被发现并发展出若干关键附加技术之后，马格纳金属公司于3058年重新审视了旋风设计。B2变型采用内骨架底盘配一台180L聚变引擎，为两具实验型地狱猫5级雷神之锤5发射器（各配一吨弹药）和两门马格纳Mk VI增程中型激光腾出空间。相较此前的A3变型，它还有双散热器、下臂与手部驱动器，以及重新引入的守护者电子对抗套件。旋风B2在军方买家中反响平平，因为雷神之锤导弹容易被反导弹系统化为无效。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Well, you don't see a lot of Thunderbolt Missile systems outside of the Solaris arenas for a reason, boss. The two Thunderbolt 5s on this thing hit pretty hard but any AMS systems in the area are going to give you headaches.
column2: 嗯，你在索拉里斯竞技场之外看不到多少雷霆导弹系统，是有原因的，老大。这东西上的两具雷霆5打得确实狠，但这一带任何AMS系统都会让你头疼。

column1: After the lack-luster reaction to the Cyclone B2 in most markets, Magna Metals Inc., in collaboration with Hollis Incorporated, developed the C1 variant. The Cyclone C1 is built around the same Magna 210XL engine of the A1 variant. Using the same Endo-Steel chassis of the B2, the C1 replaces the weapons payload of the B2 with a Magna Firestar ER PPC, a pair of Magna Mk VI ER Medium Lasers, a Guardian ECM Suite, and an additional Double Heat Sink. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 在 Cyclone B2 于大多数市场反响平平之后，Magna Metals 公司与霍利斯公司合作开发了 C1 改型。Cyclone C1 围绕与 A1 改型相同的 Magna 210XL 引擎打造。它沿用 B2 的内骨架底盘，把 B2 的武器配置换成了一门 Magna Firestar 增程粒子炮、一对 Magna Mk VI 增程中型激光、一具守卫者电子对抗套件和一台额外的双散热器。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Hit-and-Run Sniper
column2: 打了就跑的狙击手

column1: The Cyclone C1 is a mobile direct-fire support platform. A top speed of 118km/h and a Guardian ECM suite make this thing a ghost at longer ranges.
column2: 旋风C1是一种机动的直射火力支援平台。118公里/小时的最高速度和一套守卫者ECM让这东西在远距离上如同幽灵。

column1: The original Daedalus carried a large pulse laser, machine gun, small laser, SRM-6, and a pair of SRM-4 missile launchers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 最初的 Daedalus 搭载一门大型脉冲激光、一挺机枪、一门小型激光、一具 SRM-6，以及两组 SRM-4 导弹发射器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The Daedalus is a Solaris VII BattleMech, which was developed from an original Phoenix Hawk PXH-1 in the middle of the thirty-first century. Innovative Design Concepts took the original Phoenix Hawk design and updated it with several missile racks and the newly rediscovered large pulse laser, while utilizing speed to keep the design maneuvering out of tight situations.
column2: 代达罗斯是一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，于三十一世纪中叶从原有的凤凰鹰PXH-1发展而来。创新设计理念公司取来原本的凤凰鹰设计，用若干导弹架和新近重新发现的大型脉冲激光器对其升级，同时利用速度让该设计脱离险境。

column1: The original Dagoth design was meant to be a competitor to Defiance's Berserker but never made it to full production. However, the original design did see a few prototypes dubbed the Dagoth DG-UR-1. A 380XL engine with supercharger strains to move the over 30 tons of Hardened armor at reasonable speeds to bring the sword and Snub-Nose PPC into range. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 最初的达戈斯设计意在成为挑战公司狂战士的竞争者，却从未进入量产。不过该原始设计确实造出了几台被称为达戈斯DG-UR-1的原型。一台380XL引擎配增压器，勉力推动超过30吨的硬化装甲以尚可的速度移动，把长剑和短鼻粒子炮带入射程。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: Vining Engineering and Salvage Team
column2: 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队

column1: What a grand and intoxicating innocence! I, uh, I'm not sure what came over me boss. This is THE Dagoth Ur of Solaris fame.
column2: 多么宏大而令人沉醉的纯真！我，呃，我不知道自己刚才是怎么了老板。这位可是索拉里斯赫赫有名的达戈斯·乌尔。

column1: The DAI-01 is built around long-range firepower. The primary weapon the 'Mech carries is a ER PPC backed up by a pair of Ultra autocannon/5s. This combination of weapons gives the Daikyu a devastating long-range punch. The 'Mech also carries a LRM-5 launcher, giving it limited indirect fire support capabilities. For close combat, the Daikyu carries a single medium laser. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: DAI-01 以远程火力为核心。该机甲的主武器是一具增程粒子炮，辅以两门超级自动炮/5。这一武器组合赋予 Daikyu 毁灭性的远程打击力。该机甲还搭载一具 LRM-5 发射器，具备有限的间接火力支援能力。近距离作战方面，Daikyu 装有一具中型激光。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Named for the ancient Japanese longbow and first produced in 3055, the Daikyu is armed to strike an enemy with a powerful blow at long range and, as such, is poorly armed for short-range combat. The Daikyu attempts to dictate the range at which it engages with its top speed of 86.4 km/h, which allows the Daikyu to keep up with most medium and heavy 'Mechs and makes it capable of outpacing most assault 'Mechs. The Daikyu is also well protected with twelve tons of armor and CASE to protect against ammunition explosions.
column2: 大弓以日本古长弓命名，于3055年首次生产。它被武装为在远距离对敌人打出强力一击，因此近距战斗武装薄弱。大弓试图用86.4公里/小时的最高速度主导交战距离，这使它跟得上大多数中型与重型机甲，并能超过大多数突击机甲。大弓防护也好，有十二吨装甲和CASE防止弹药爆炸。

column1: A variant made to address concerns of a lack of short-range firepower, the 02 variant was built soon after Operation Bulldog. The 'Mech carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in place of the two Ultra autocannon/5s. Additionally, for close combat, the 02 variant of the Daikyu has two ER medium lasers. It is also outfitted with a C3 slave unit to share targeting information with other friendly units. It also has the addition of jump jets, giving it a jumping capacity of 150 meters. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 02改型是为解决近距离火力不足的担忧而打造，在斗牛犬行动结束后不久便投入生产。这台机甲以两具连发SRM-6发射器取代了两门Ultra自动炮/5。此外，为应付近战，Daikyu的02改型还装有两门增程中型激光。它还配备了C3从属单元，可与其他友军单位共享瞄准信息。它还加装了跳跃推进器，使其跳跃能力达到150米。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The original prototype Defiance produced on Hesperus II, this version was powered by an 300 XL engine and used an experimental compact gyro, which freed up space to mount a second SRM-6 rack in the center torso. As extended-range versions of medium and small lasers were not yet available to the Federated Commonwealth, it carried two pairs of small and medium pulse lasers instead, the increased weight devoted to weapons limiting the armor to twelve tons. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是挑战公司在赫斯佩鲁斯II生产的原始原型，由一台300 XL引擎驱动并使用实验型紧凑陀螺仪，从而腾出空间在中央躯干加装第二具SRM-6挂架。由于当时联邦共和国还无法获得中型与小型激光的增程版本，它改为带两对小型与中型脉冲激光；投入武器的重量增加，使装甲被限制在十二吨。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Described as a \"Warhammer on steroids\", the Defiance is visually similar to the original WHM-6R and carries a similar weapons array. Where it differs from the classic design is in the use of digitigrade instead of humanoid legs, and modern construction components such as an endo steel skeleton, light fusion engine, and triple strength myomers. Due in part to the high heat levels required by its specialized myomers, as well as weight constraints, the Defiance carries only twelve double heat sinks, forcing it to rely upon volley fire to avoid shutdown, much like the design upon which it was based.
column2: 被描述为"吃了兴奋剂的重锤"，反抗在外观上与原始WHM-6R相似，武器阵列也相近。它与经典设计的不同之处在于采用了趾行式而非人形腿部，以及内层钢骨架、轻型聚变引擎和三倍强度肌纤维等现代建造组件。部分由于其特化肌纤维所需的高热量水平以及重量限制，反抗只带十二具双重散热器，迫使它依靠轮番齐射来避免停机，这很像它所基于的那个设计。

column1: The customized 'Mech of fierce Azami warrior Ukla Mauck, Mauck stripped the missile launchers from his 'Mech and replaced them with a trio of MRM-10s. The further addition of Triple Strength Myomer makes Mauck's nearly 200-year-old Dervish a terror in close-range combat. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是凶悍的阿扎米战士乌克拉·毛克的定制机甲。毛克拆掉机甲上的导弹发射器，换成三具MRM-10，并进一步加装三倍强度人造肌，使这台近两百年历史的苦行僧在近距战斗中成为恐怖的存在。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.
column2: 苦行僧以两具联邦 10 发 LRM 发射器为主武器。这些导弹发射器为苦行僧提供了向友军提供火力支援所需的远程能力，且安全嵌入躯干内，不像其他机甲那样外露。每具发射器一吨弹药，除最持久的战斗外足以支撑。近战方面，苦行僧携带两具联邦 2 发 SRM 发射器和两门 ChisComp 39 中型激光。SRM 发射器完全内嵌于前臂，可迅速瞄准，各由一吨弹药供弹。激光位于发射器正上方，确保机甲在导弹耗尽后仍能作战。苦行僧能跳 150 米，并由七吨半装甲保护。

column1: The DV-6MRU - or Minor Resilience Upgrade - was an upgrade program provided for a while for the original DV-6M, replacing one of the Medium Lasers with a C3 slave unit and C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: DV-6MRU——“小型韧性升级”——曾为原版DV-6M提供过一段时间的升级，以一台C3从机替换其中一门中型激光，并为弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 7S is in practice a 6M with one of the medium lasers exchanged for two small ones and some relocation of the 'Mechs components and weapons. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 7S实际上就是一台6M，把其中一门中型激光换成两门小型激光，并对机甲的部件与武器做了些位置调整。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Frenzy is built around an 275-rated extralight engine and an endo steel frame, carrying an SRM-4 in each arm in support of LRM-20 in each side torso. Clad in seven and half tons of standard armor and fitted with five jump jets and ten double heat sinks, the Frenzy carries two tons each of LRM and SRM missile reloads. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Frenzy 以 275 级超轻型引擎和内骨架框架打造，每条手臂各携带一具 SRM-4，用以辅助两侧躯干中的 LRM-20。它披挂七吨半标准装甲，配备五具跳跃推进器和十具双散热器，并携带 LRM 与 SRM 导弹各两吨备用弹药。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: This 'Frenzy' packs a lot of firepower for a medium 'Mech, with AMS-resistant LRM-20 Delta racks and eight SRM tubes for close combat. The usual medium lasers have been removed, though, so it's dead weight if it runs out of missiles.
column2: 这台"狂热"对中型机甲而言火力相当充沛，装有抗AMS的LRM-20德尔塔挂架和八具SRM发射管用于近战。不过通常的中型激光器被拆掉了，所以一旦导弹打光，它就是死重。

column1: Dervish IIC
column2: 苦行僧 IIC

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated engine, the Devastator DVS-1D carries a pair of AC/10’s, with 2 Large Lasers and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18 tons of armor and 15 heat sinks round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Devastator是星际联盟时代为修正初代Titan的缺陷而设计的机甲，3023年被联邦太阳国重新发现。DVS-1D由额定300的引擎驱动，装备两门AC/10，副武器为2门大型激光和4门中型激光。18吨装甲和15台散热器补全了整体设计。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated engine, the Devastator DVS-1D carries a pair of AC/10’s, with 2 Large Lasers and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18 tons of armor and 15 heat sinks round out the design.
column2: 毁灭者（Devastator）是一台星际联盟时代的机甲，旨在修正原版泰坦（Titan）的缺陷，于 3023 年被联邦太阳国重新发现。DVS-1D 型毁灭者由一台额定 300 的引擎驱动，装有两门 AC/10，并以 2 门大型激光和 4 门中型激光作为次要武器。18 吨装甲和 15 台散热器则完善了整体设计。

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-2 carries a pair of Gauss Rifles, with 2 PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 毁灭者是星际联盟时代为修正原始泰坦的缺陷而设计的机甲，3023年被联邦太阳国重新发现。由一具额定300的XL引擎驱动，毁灭者DVS-2装有两门高斯步枪，并以2门粒子炮与4门中型激光作为次要武器。18.5吨装甲与14具双散热器构成了该设计的其余部分。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-2 carries a pair of Gauss Rifles, with 2 PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design.
column2: 作为一种为修正初代泰坦缺陷而设计的星盟时代机甲，毁灭者在3023年被联邦太阳重新发现。毁灭者DVS-2由一具300级XL引擎驱动，携带两门磁轨炮，另有2门PPC和4门中型激光器作为次要武器。18.5吨装甲和14具双重散热器补全了该设计。

column1: Several Devastators were hand-built by Clan technicians for Operation Klondike. These used Improved Gauss Rifles and carried two more tons of Gauss ammunition (four tons total). Later Clan Wolverine would overhaul the weapons completely, leaving the Improved Gauss Rifles in place (adding CASE to the arms for protection), but trading the PPCs for Enhanced ER PPCs and the medium lasers for ER medium lasers. To handle the massive heat load, twenty Clan-spec double heat sinks were installed. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 为“克朗代克行动”，部族技术员手工组装了数台Devastator。它们采用改进型高斯步枪，并多携带两吨高斯弹药（共计四吨）。后来狼獾部族将武器彻底翻修：保留改进型高斯步枪（为双臂加装CASE作为防护），但把粒子炮换成增强型增程粒子炮，把中型激光换成增程中型激光。为应对庞大的热量负荷，还安装了二十台部族规格的双散热器。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-3S carries a pair of Gauss Rifles and 2 PPC’s. A Medium laser and a Small Laser round out the Mechs weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 揉躏者是星际联盟时期为纠正原版泰坦缺陷而设计的机甲，3023年由联邦太阳国重新发现。揉躏者DVS-3S由一台300额定XL引擎驱动，装有一对高斯步枪和2门粒子炮，另有一门中型激光和一门小型激光补全武器。18.5吨装甲和14个双散热器为该设计收尾。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-3S carries a pair of Gauss Rifles and 2 PPC’s. A Medium laser and a Small Laser round out the Mechs weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design.
column2: 作为一种为修正初代泰坦缺陷而设计的星盟时代机甲，毁灭者在3023年被联邦太阳重新发现。毁灭者DVS-3S由一具300级XL引擎驱动，携带两门磁轨炮和2门PPC。一门中型激光器和一门小型激光器补全该机甲的武器。18.5吨装甲和14具双重散热器补全了该设计。

column1: A Snow Raven variation on the original Howler chassis, the 30 ton Devil entered service in 2911. Gaining 10 tons over it’s predecessor, it is powered by a 300-rated XL Engine; enabling it to accelerate to higher speeds then the Baboon. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel provide the free weight for an ER PPC and a Targeting Computer. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 魔鬼（Devil）是雪鸦部族在原版嗥叫者（Howler）底盘基础上推出的变体，重 30 吨，于 2911 年服役。它比前代增重 10 吨，由一台额定 300 的 XL 引擎驱动，可加速到比沸沸（Baboon）更高的速度。铁纤维装甲与内骨架的组合省下了足够的重量，用于安装一门增程粒子炮和一台瞄准计算机。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: A Snow Raven variation on the original Howler chassis, the 30 ton Devil entered service in 2911. Gaining 10 tons over it’s predecessor, it is powered by a 300-rated XL Engine; enabling it to accelerate to higher speeds then the Baboon. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel provide the free weight for an ER PPC and a Targeting Computer.
column2: 作为雪鸦对原版嚎叫者底盘的一种变体，30吨的恶魔于2911年服役。它比前身重了10吨，由一具300级XL引擎驱动，能加速到比沸沸更高的速度。铁纤装甲与内层钢的组合为一门增程PPC和一台瞄准计算机提供自由重量。

column1: The loadout on this Dire Wolf more closely resembles that of a short-range strike vehicle, carrying devastating damage potential but very limited ammunition. Capable of launching a ton and a half of mortar ammunition at once, it presents a lethal threat until its ammo runs dry. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这套Dire Wolf的配置更像是一台近程突击车辆，拥有毁灭性的伤害潜力，但弹药极为有限。它能一次性发射一吨半的迫击炮弹药，在弹药耗尽之前都是致命的威胁。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远距 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Dire Wolf
column2: 恐狼

column1: A Clan Omnimech, stuffed to the gills with Clan Technology... but only enough ammo for the shortest of engagements. No self-respecting clanner would be caught dead in this thing, Boss.
column2: 一台氏族全方位机甲，塞满了氏族科技……但弹药只够打最短暂的一场交战。任何有自尊的氏族人都不会被人撞见坐在这种玩意儿里，老大。

column1: The C2 configuration of the Dire Wolf brings a combination of energy and ballistic weapons. Two Ultra AC/2, two LBX AC/2 and three Large Pulse Lasers are the main damage dealers, while two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser can provide extra defensive capabilities if needed. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 恐狼C2配置带来能量与弹道武器的组合。两门超级AC/2、两门LBX AC/2和四门大型脉冲激光是主要伤害来源，而两门中型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光可在需要时提供额外防御能力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
column2: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。它重达惊人的一百吨，由 300 XL 引擎驱动，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅 54 公里/小时。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但凭借五十吨半的自由吊舱空间搭载武器与装备，拥有更强的火力潜力。正因如此，德拉科尼斯联合体的黑道将其命名为"大师"（伪日语"伟大的死亡"），而这名字一次又一次被证明冷酷地精准。

column1: The OmniMech configuration designated D2 for the Dire Wolf carries on of the scariest weapons on the battlefield, an Ultra AC/20. But even if the large autocannon misses, the loadout still has two ER PPC, one Large Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers as followup damage. The largest drawback of the D2 is the fact that even with 24 Double heat sinks, the cooling is seldom enough for repeated full alpha strikes. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Dire Wolf 代号 D2 的全向机甲配置搭载了战场上最令人胆寒的武器之一——一门 Ultra AC/20。但即便这门大型自动炮打空，这套配置仍有两门增程粒子炮、一门大型脉冲激光、四门增程中型激光和两门中型脉冲激光作为后续伤害。D2 最大的缺陷在于：即便拥有 24 具双散热器，其散热能力也很少足以支撑反复的全力齐射。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

column1: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 恐狼是部族入侵初期在整个内层星域中令人闻风丧胆的全向机甲之一，而这份恐惧并非空穴来风。恐狼重达惊人的一百吨，由一台300 XL引擎提供动力，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅为54 km/h。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但潜在火力更强，拥有五十五吨半的自由舱位空间用于搭载武器与装备。正是这些特质，让龙脉联合体的黑社会给它取了“大师”这个名字（Daishi，伪日语中的“伟大之死”）——而事实证明，这个名字一次又一次地准确得令人胆寒。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This Direwolf Commander is a piece of work by a nutcase clanner and I have seen many weird stuff. The madman or whoever designed this, must have been clearly out of his mind. Sacrificing everything for pure firepower this mech mounts 11 clan ERPPCs, that will instantly shut down your mech, if you try to alpha strike as well bringing lot of pain to the target. If the mech doesn't get destroyed while being shutdown it will definitely blow up by all the excess heat by firing all those PPCs.
column2: 这个恐狼指挥官是某个疯子氏族人的作品，而我见过许多怪东西。那个疯子——或者说设计这东西的人——脑子里肯定完全不清楚。为纯粹火力牺牲一切，这台机甲装了11门氏族增程PPC，如果你试图全弹齐射，它会瞬间让你的机甲停机，同时给目标带来巨量痛苦。如果机甲在停机期间没被摧毁，那它肯定会因为发射那些PPC产生的过量热量而炸掉。

column1: The E2 loadout is all energy-based except for its two AMS. Two Large Pulse Lasers and six Medium ones provide a scary amount of damage potential when paired with the advanced targeting computer mounted in the left torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E2 配装除两具 AMS 外全部为能量武器。两门大型脉冲激光与六门中型脉冲激光，在左躯干先进的瞄准计算机配合下，具备惊人的伤害潜力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Dire Wolf F2 is configured for close quarters combat with its six Stream SRM-6 and 6 Medium Pulse Lasers. The loadout still manages to fit two ER Large Laser to use while closing to closer range, and a leg mounted A-Pod provides defense against infantry attacks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Dire Wolf F2 的配置专为近距离近战而设，搭载六具连发 SRM-6 和 6 门中型脉冲激光。这套配置还设法装下了两门大型增程激光，供逼近目标的途中开火；腿部安装的 A-Pod 则用来防御步兵攻击。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Dire Wolf F3 configuration is presently used mostly with front line regiments and a few reserves. Most other Clans are restricting their 'rookie-resistant' designs to reserve units only. However, Clan Diamond Shark seems determined to correct their past conservative strategy by swinging wildly in the opposite direction, dropping the new design right on the front lines. Some rumours claim this is due to the clan lacking the resources to conduct a full field test of the Dire Wolf F2 before committing it to combat. Only time will tell. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Dire Wolf F3配置目前主要配属一线团和少数预备队。其他多数部族都将这类“对新手友好”的设计仅限于预备部队使用。然而，钻石鲨部族似乎决心以向相反方向猛烈摆动来纠正其过去保守的策略，将这款新设计直接放到前线上。有传言称，这是因为该部族缺乏资源，无法在将Dire Wolf F2投入战斗之前进行完整的实地测试。只有时间才能给出答案。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Part of the Dire Wolf Forward program, the F/C loadout replaces the one-shot SRM from the standard C configuration with a Streak SRM-4. To free the weight capacity for this change, one heat sink had to be removed. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为恐狼前瞻计划的一部分，F/C载荷以具连发SRM-4取代标准C配置中的一次性SRM。为腾出重量完成这一改动，不得不拆掉一个散热器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The second configuration of the Dire Wolf Forward program, the F/C2 replaces the SRM launcher with a NARC Launcher. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为恐狼“前锋”计划的第二种配置，F/C2 以 NARC 发射器替换了 SRM 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A customized variant of the Dire Wolf. Piloted by Jin Mehta, the Ultraviolet uses a quartet of Ultra Autocannon/2s, two in each arm, supported with two tons of ammo. Both side torsos utilize an ER PPC, supported by a Medium Pulse Laser. Finally, the center torso sports an LRM 10 with a ton of ammo. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 恐狼的定制变型。由金·梅塔驾驶的“紫外线”装备四门 Ultra 自动炮/2，每臂两门，配两吨弹药。两个侧躯干各使用一部 增程粒子炮，并由一门中型脉冲激光支援。最后，中央躯干装有一部 LRM 10 和一吨弹药。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The 'Götterfunken', translating to 'Divine Spark' in common parlance, was the personal Dire Wolf of Hohiro Kurita. The 'Mech was one of the very first produced by Wolf's Dragoons and was a personal gift from Jamie Wolf to Hohiro, amazing the latter with its vastly superior performance compared the common Inner Sphere 'Mechs he had piloted so far. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: “神之火花”（俗语中意为“神圣火花”）是库瑞塔宏广的私人恐狼。该机甲是狼之龙骑兵最早生产的机甲之一，由海梅·沃尔夫作为私人礼物赠予宏广；与其此前驾驶的普通内层星域机甲相比，它优越得多的性能令宏广惊叹。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Hihiro Kurita created fully personal loadout for his Dire Wolf, combining the large damage potentional of a Gauss Rifle and an ER PPC with three Large Pulse Lasers. As the 'Mech was part of the very first prototype run of Dire Wolfs produced by the Wolf's Dragoons, its electronics are considerably stronger than that of the standard mass-produced ones.
column2: 库瑞塔宏广为他的恐狼打造了完全私人的载荷：把高斯步枪与增程粒子炮的巨大伤害潜力与三门大型脉冲激光结合起来。由于该机甲属于狼之龙骑兵生产的最初一批恐狼原型，其电子设备比标准量产型号强得多。

column1: The 'Götterfunken', translating to 'Divine Spark' in common parlance, was the personal Dire Wolf of Hohiro Kurita. The 'Mech was one of the very first produced by Wolf's Dragoons and was a personal gift from Jamie Wolf to Hohiro, amazing the latter with its vastly superior performance compared the common Inner Sphere 'Mechs he had piloted so far.
column2: 神之火花（通俗译作Götterfunken）是栗田弘人的私人恐狼。这台机甲是狼族龙骑兵最早生产的一批之一，是杰米·沃夫送给弘人的私人礼物，其远超他此前驾驶过的常见内天体机甲的优越性能令后者大为惊叹。

column1: The Hohiro configuration of the Dire Wolf is used by Hohiro Kurita and has a mixed long and short range weapons profile. For long range hitting power, an ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle provide overwhelming punch. To engage enemies at long to medium ranges, three Large Pulse Lasers are carried. One ER Small Laser and one Streak SRM-6 round out this configuration with some short range punch. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 恐狼的宏广配置由库瑞塔宏广使用，兼具远程与近程武器。远程打击方面，一门增程粒子炮和一门高斯步枪提供压倒性重拳；中远程交战则有三门大型脉冲激光。一门增程小型激光和一具连发SRM-6为该配置补上近程打击力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so.
column2: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。

column1: The 'Lone Wolf 2' is inspired by the original Lone Wolf loadout used by Phelan Wolf at his Trial of Position. Downgrading the LRM launchers to only 10 tubes each and removing their Artemis IV FCS, combined with replacing the SRM-6 with an SRM-4 one-shot, allowed adding 5 more heat sinks, greatly improving the heat handling of the 'Mech. Enough weight capacity remained to increase the amount of LB-X ammunition, which could run dry sometimes in the original design. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: “Lone Wolf 2”的灵感来自 Phelan Wolf 在其定位试炼中所使用的原始 Lone Wolf 配置。将 LRM 发射器降级为每具仅 10 管并拆除其 Artemis IV 火控系统，再加上用一次性 SRM-4 替换 SRM-6，使得该机得以加装 5 具散热器，大幅改善了热量管理。剩余的重量容量还足以增加 LB-X 弹药数量——在原设计中这些弹药有时会打光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

column1: The preferred configuration of Archon-Prince Victor Ian Steiner-Davion, the Prometheus configuration carries a blistering array of weapons that increases its damage potential as it closes range. The primary long range weapons are a pair of ER Large Lasers supported by three Large Pulse Lasers. For close combat, an Ultra Autocannon/20 and an SRM-6 launcher are carried. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为大公-亲王维克托·伊恩·斯坦纳-戴维安的首选配置，Prometheus 配置搭载了一套凶猛无比的武器，随着交战距离拉近，其伤害潜力也不断攀升。主要远程武器是两门增程大型激光，并由三门大型脉冲激光提供支援。近战方面，则配备了一门超级自动炮/20 和一部 SRM-6 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The personal 'Mech of the Khan of Clan Blood Spirit, William 'Northwind' Campbell, formally named 'Sanguine Essence'. Each arm of the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and one Extended Range Large Laser. These trios of energy weapons gives the 'Mech great close combat hitters as well as a long reach with good punch. A Gauss rifle is installed in the right torso, which, combined with the hitting power of the ERLLs, provides excellent long-range power. Sixteen shots of ammo is split into two bins, one in the right torso and one in the left. The offensive weapons are rounded out with a torso-mounted Extended Range Small Laser. The Sanguine Essence is also outfitted with a highly advanced battlefield electronics, both en ECM suite in the head and an advanced Clan targeting computer in the left torso. The most surprising feature of the 'Mech, though, are the three installed jump jets providing unexpected mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是血灵氏族可汗威廉·“北风”·坎贝尔的私人机甲，正式命名为“Sanguine Essence”。机甲每条手臂各装有两门中型脉冲激光和一门增程大型激光。这三组能量武器使该机甲既拥有强悍的近战打击手段，又具备射程远、威力足的远程火力。右躯干内装有一门高斯步枪，与增程大型激光的打击力相结合，提供了极佳的远程威力。十六发弹药分装在两个弹药箱中，一个位于右躯干，一个位于左侧。躯干上的一门增程小型激光进一步完善了进攻武器。Sanguine Essence 还配备了极为先进的战场电子设备：头部的 ECM 套件与左躯干内先进的部族瞄准计算机。不过这台机甲最令人惊奇之处，是它所安装的三台跳跃推进器所带来的出乎意料的机动性。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: So far Dire Wolf W2 has only been seen in use inside Crusader Clan Wolf and only in the hands of a few bloodnamed warriors. Speculation surrounds this variant and its deployment, and so far it seems the Widowmaker program has only limited support inside the Clan itself. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 迄今为止，恐狼W2只见于十字军狼部族内部使用，且仅在少数有血名的战士手中。围绕此变型及其部署有诸多猜测，而到目前为止，“寡妇制造者”计划在部族内部似乎只获得有限支持。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A custom loadout for the Dire Wolf used by the Wolf's Dragoons, the infamous mercenary outfit. A Gauss Rifle and two ER PPC provides pinpoint long range damage, while two Medium Pulse Lasers add extra firepower at closer ranges. A single ER Small Laser and two AMS provides considerable defensive strength, and a C3 Slave unit makes sure the unit is constantly sharing its targeting information. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是狼之龙骑兵团——那支声名狼藉的雇佣兵部队——所使用的恐狼定制配置。一门高斯步枪和两门增程粒子炮提供精确的远程打击，而两门中型脉冲激光则增强近距离火力。一门增程小型激光和两套AMS提供了相当可观的防御能力，一具C3辅助单元则确保该机持续共享其瞄准信息。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The preferred configuration of the Black Widow Natasha Kerensky, the Widowmaker can do a great deal of damage at any range. For long range combat, an ER PPC backed up by a Large Pulse Laser mounted in each arm. For close combat, the Widowmaker carries three ER Medium Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and an Ultra Autocannon/20. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 黑寡妇娜塔莎·克伦斯基偏爱的配置，“寡妇制造者”能在任何距离上造成巨大伤害。远程作战时，它以一门 增程粒子炮为主，并在每只手臂各配一门大型脉冲激光。近距离作战时，“寡妇制造者”携带三门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一门 Ultra 自动炮/20。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The configuration of Dire Wolf piloted by Natasha Kerensky at her Trial of Position to test out as a MechWarrior. For long range combat, the ER PPCs are replaced by shoulder-mounted twin LRM-20 launchers with 24 racks, first half being Swarm LRMs and backed up by a Large Pulse Laser mounted in each arm. For close combat, the left torso carries three ER Medium Lasers in triangular configuration in the chest and the stubby LB-X AC/20 with 10 cluster rounds underslung on the right torso. For when things gets dicey, a 'fire and forget' SRM-6 one-shot launcher above cockpit, just aft of the hatch and only 20 double strength heat sinks. This configuration was created just for her Trial of Position and seldom used again. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是娜塔莎·克伦斯基在晋升试炼中为考核机甲战士资格所驾驶的恐狼配置。远程作战方面，增程粒子炮被换成肩载双联LRM-20发射器（共24联），前半为蜂群LRM，并由装在双臂的大型脉冲激光支援；近战时，左躯干以三角布局在胸前装三门增程中型激光，右躯干下方则悬挂那门短粗的LB-X AC/20（配10发集束弹）；万一情况棘手，座舱上方、舱门后方还有一具“发射后不管”的一次性SRM-6发射器，而双倍强度散热器仅有20个。这一配置专为她的晋升试炼而造，此后很少再用。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A loadout of the Dire Wolf normally only used for Batchalls between clans. A large combination of weapons allows for handling of most situations that can arise, but without providing the resilience for extended engagements. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是恐狼（Dire Wolf）的一套配置，通常只用于部族之间的“议战”（Batchall）。大量的武器组合足以应对大多数可能出现的情况，但无法提供长时间交战所需的持久力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远距 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Dragon DRG-1ALAG is a custom variant developer for the Amphigean Light Assault Group mercenary forced during the long contract to the DCMS. The variant replaces the LRM-10 launcher with a much shorter range SRM-4 and a Flamer, but this in turn allows upgrading the AC/5 to an AC/10. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Dragon DRG-1ALAG 是雇佣兵部队 Amphigean Light Assault Group 在与 DCMS 长期签约期间自行开发的定制变型。该变型用射程短得多的 SRM-4 和一门火焰喷射器取代了 LRM-10 发射器，而这反过来又使其得以把 AC/5 升级为 AC/10。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Dragon is a heavy BattleMech originally designed in a bid to replace the Shadow Hawk. A close assault 'Mech, its versatile design allows it to be used in both offensive and defensive operations. It boasts above-average firepower and plenty of ammunition for extended combat, while having a high top speed for a heavy 'Mech. Armor coverage for the Dragon is thick around the torso, and especially the rear, for when it is surrounded by opponents, while the squat design gives it a smaller profile and makes it harder to knock over. The Dragon's only major problem is it requires frequent maintenance and/or overhaul of its hip actuator
column2: 龙是一种重型战斗机甲，最初为取代暗影鹰而设计。作为近距离突击机甲，它多用途的设计使其既能用于进攻作战，也能用于防御作战。它拥有高于平均水准的火力和充足的弹药，适合持久战，同时作为重型机甲拥有很高的最高速度。龙的躯干部位装甲厚实，后方尤其如此，以应对被敌人包围的情况；低矮的外形也让它的轮廓更小，更难被击倒。龙唯一的主要问题是需要频繁维护和/或大修髋部驱动器。

column1: The Dragon DRG-2ALAG drops the flamer of the DRG-1ALAG to instead fit another ton of ammunition for the Autocannon/10. Otherwise the designs are identical. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 龙DRG-2ALAG拆掉DRG-1ALAG的火焰喷射器，改为多带一吨自动炮/10弹药，其余设计完全相同。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: This Custom Dragon was piloted by Warlord Syovo Yorioshi from 25th May to 26th September 3025 during the Battle of Galtor III. Only the left-arm mounted Medium Laser remains, with Large Laser in the right arm and an SRM4 and Flamer mounted in the Center. A Small Laser was also installed next to the Cockpit, with an additional 5 Heat Sinks and 3 more tons of armor. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台定制 Dragon 由军阀 Syovo Yorioshi 在 3025 年 5 月 25 日至 9 月 26 日的高尔特三世战役期间驾驶。它只保留左臂的中型激光，右臂装大型激光，中央则装 SRM4 与火焰喷射器。座舱旁还加装了一门小型激光，并额外增加 5 具散热器与 3 吨装甲。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: If you thought the Dragon 1N and 1C were fast, rugged Heavy 'Mechs, this one-of-a-kind and quite unusual refit for a Dragon took it to the next level.
column2: 如果你觉得龙1N和1C是快速、粗犷的重型机甲，那么这台独一无二、对龙来说相当不寻常的改装把它推到了另一个层次。

column1: The DRG-5ALAG is the Amphigean Light Assault Group's take on improving the previous Dragon DRG-1ALAG with the updates introduced by the DRG-5N for their purposes. By replacing the AC/10 with a Gauss Rifle they found it considerably more useful due its increased range, while also allowing for more colling and two more lasers. The success of this variant eventually led to parts of the DRG-7N design. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: DRG-5ALAG是两栖轻突击集团对改进前代龙DRG-1ALAG的理解，把DRG-5N引入的更新按自身需要加以应用。以一门高斯步枪取代AC/10后，他们发现由于射程提升，该机甲实用得多，同时也腾出空间用于更多冷却和另外两门激光。此变型的成功最终促成了DRG-7N设计的一部分。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A 28th century design that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech designed for brawling. The DRG-3F is armed with a Gauss Rifle and an LB-10X, with a Large Laser and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton provide the weight need for the heavy payload, while CASE and Guardian ECM add to the designs survivability. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 龙火是28世纪的设计，于3058年首次投产，是75吨的近战机甲。DRG-3F装有一门高斯步枪和一门LB-10X，次要武器为一门大型激光和一对中型脉冲激光。一台300额定XL引擎与内骨架结构提供了这套重载荷所需的重量，CASE与守护者电子对抗套件则提升该设计的生存性。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Dragoon AEM-01 is armed with only a few, but powerful, weapons in the 'Mech's arms. The main damage is provided by a pair of LB 10-X Autocannons with a long-reaching ER PPC as backup. Powered by a 280-rated XL Fusion Engines, the 'Mech is able to achieve a modest pace of 64 km/h. Its defenses include a Guardian ECM Suite, while its hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 龙骑兵AEM-01只在机甲手臂上装少数但强力的武器：主要伤害来自一对LB 10-X自动炮，以一门远程增程粒子炮作为后手。它由一台280额定XL聚变引擎驱动，能达到64公里/小时的不快速度。防御方面有一套守护者电子对抗套件，车体由11.5吨铁纤维装甲保护。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The brainchild of Stefan Amaris, the Dragoon BattleMech was envisioned as part of Amaris's ambitious plan to create a family of 'modular' multi-mission combat units for his Amaris Empire Armed Forces. In the year following the Amaris Coup, now-Emperor Amaris would have a means to make his dream into reality, and he began swiftly issuing contracts which would lead to the creation of the Dragoon. Originally built by Krupp Stellar Technologies Inc., the Dragoon was designed with a similar modular subsystem akin to the Mercury. With this system, the 'Mech's maintenance loads would be eased. Its modular nature would allow repair depots and factories to be able to reconfigure the design's weapons systems and its power plant for any needed mission-specific specs.
column2: 龙骑兵机甲是斯特凡·阿马里斯的心血结晶，被他设想为一项宏大计划的一部分——为其阿马里斯帝国武装部队打造一系列"模块化"多任务战斗单位。在阿马里斯政变之后的一年里，已成为皇帝的阿马里斯得以将梦想变为现实，他迅速签发了一系列合同，最终促成了龙骑兵的诞生。龙骑兵最初由克虏伯星际技术公司制造，其设计采用了与"水星"类似的模块化子系统。凭借这套系统，机甲的维护负担得以减轻。其模块化特性使维修站和工厂能够为任何特定任务需求重新配置该设计的武器系统与动力装置。

column1: Designed as a short-ranged fighter, the -02 is armed with a single ER PPC, the remaining weapons space is filled by five medium lasers, a small pulse laser, and an AC/20. At the price of dropping its jump jets, the 'Mech's engine has been upgraded to an XL 350 to allow the 'Mech to close in quicker than the original model. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -02被设计为近程战斗机，装一门单独的增程粒子炮，其余武器空间则由五门中型激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一门AC/20填满。以放弃跳跃推进器为代价，该机甲的引擎升级为XL 350，使其能比原型更快地逼近。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed as a long-range fire support unit, the Dragoon -03 retains the same engine specifications of the Dragoon -01 model. Its principal weaponry includes 3 Artemis IV FCS-guided 15-tubed LRM Launchers with 2 tons of CASE-protected ammunition. Backup weapons include a single medium laser, with a duo of medium and small pulse lasers for close-in defense. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Dragoon -03被设计为远程火力支援单位，保留了Dragoon -01型相同的引擎规格。其主要武器包括3具由Artemis IV火控系统制导的15管LRM发射器，配2吨受CASE保护的弹药。副武器包括一门中型激光，以及中型和小型脉冲激光各一对，用于近距防御。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Based on a weapon-stripped -01 model, -04's long-ranged weapons come in the form of a single Gauss rifle and an ER PPC. Its short-ranged weapons include four SRM 4s and a pair of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -04 以拆除武器的 -01 型为基础，其远程武器为一门高斯步枪和一门增程粒子炮；近程武器包括四具 SRM 4 和两门中型激光。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The first Ice Hellion mech to be built entirely of Clan tech, the 30 ton Drift Shag entered production in the early Golden Age. A conversion of the older Falcon BattleMech, the Drift Shag is built around a 210-rated XL Engine and armed with an ER Large Laser. A quartet of ER Small Lasers and a Medium Pulse Laser support the ER Large at close range. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这是冰地狱狮首款完全由部族技术打造的机甲，30吨的漂白鸬鹚在黄金时代早期投产。它是较旧猎鹰战斗机甲的改造版，围绕一台210额定XL引擎建造，装有一门增程大型激光；四门增程小型激光和一门中型脉冲激光在近距支援这门增程大型激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

For close-range engagements, the 'Mech has two medium lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

column1: Based on an old Star League design called the Sling, the Duan Gung likely shares its roots with the Koshi OmniMech, as the Sling shared many characteristics with both designs, and it is believed that the Sling was easily upgraded with OmniMech technology. The Duan Gung is a competent light fire support 'Mech, with a ground speed of 119 km/h and the ability to jump up to 180 meters, it is capable of keeping up with most other light 'Mechs. To save weight and allow the Duan Gung to carry as heavy an arsenal as possible, the 'Mech is built on a endo steel chassis and is powered by an 175 XL engine that weighs half as much as its standard fusion counterpart. To handle the heat from its weapons, the Duan Gung has 10 double heat sinks, which are more than adequate for the 'Mech's needs. Finally, for protection from enemy fire, the Duan Gung carries four tons of armor, providing more than enough protection for the 'Mech's intended role.
column2: 段弓基于一种名为投石的旧星盟设计，很可能与越志全方位机甲同源，因为投石与这两种设计都有许多共同特征，据信投石能轻松地以全方位机甲技术升级。段弓是一台称职的轻型火力支援机甲，地面速度119公里/小时，可跳跃至多180米，能跟上大多数其他轻型机甲。为节省重量并让段弓尽可能携带更重的武库，该机甲建在内层钢底盘上，由一台175 XL引擎驱动，重量只有标准聚变对应型号的一半。为处理武器热量，段弓有10具双重散热器，完全足以满足该机甲的需求。最后，为抵御敌方火力，段弓携带四吨装甲，为该机甲的预期角色提供了绰绰有余的防护。

column1: Produced in 3058 by Curtiss Militech, the Eagle is an effort to create a balanced mix of speed and firepower on a 25-ton chassis. The 1M sports an ER large laser and an ER small laser, along with an anti-missile system. Five jump jets allow it to maintain decent mobility, but its overland speed is lacking compared to similarly weighted BattleMechs. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
