column1: The primitive Eisenfaust EFT-2 model was intended to carry the AC/10 into a siege or defensive engagement. This simple design mandate was quickly warped into an entirely different machine. For close work the 'Mech carried two medium lasers while a large laser provided long range and ammunition free firepower. The Coventry Defense Conglomerate was unable to overcome the inherent limitations of primitive technology however, resulting in a thinly armored and clumsy 'Mech that could only reach a top speed of 32 km/h. The single ton of ammunition provided to the Eisenfaust's main weapon didn't help. The CDC only produced one prototype unit for the LCAF. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83
column2: 原始型的Eisenfaust EFT-2原本打算把AC/10带入攻城或防御作战。但这项简单的设计要求很快被扭曲成了一台完全不同的机器。近战方面，这台机甲装有两门中型激光，而一门大型激光则提供无需弹药的远程火力。然而Coventry Defense Conglomerate无法克服原始技术的固有局限，最终造出一台装甲单薄、动作笨拙、最高时速仅32 km/h的机甲。而Eisenfaust主武器只配一吨弹药的配置也帮不上忙。CDC只为LCAF生产了一台原型机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.83

column1: The Eisenfaust was originally designed shortly after the Lyran Commonwealth began building 'Mechs. Based on their experience with the Commando and Ymir, the LCAF tried to build a medium class \"siege engine\" 'Mech. Though the trials looked promising, the battlefield performance of the early Eisenfaust was poor and the design was canceled. After the recovery of lostech and advanced SLDF technologies, Defiance Industries looked at the early Eisenfaust design again. The updated Eisenfaust entered production after simulations showed it could be an effective battlefield unit if equipped with updated technologies. In fact the Eisenfaust was one of the first designs to enter production after the start of the Jihad
column2: 艾森福斯特最初是在莱兰联邦开始建造机甲后不久设计的。基于在突击兵和伊米尔上的经验，莱兰联邦武装部队（LCAF）试图打造一款中型“攻城引擎”机甲。虽然试验看起来很有希望，但早期艾森福斯特的战场表现很差，该设计因此被取消。在失落科技与先进SLDF技术被重新发现之后，Defiance Industries重新审视了早期艾森福斯特的设计。模拟显示，若装备更新的技术，它可以成为一款有效的战场单位，于是更新后的艾森福斯特投入了生产。事实上，艾森福斯特是圣战开始后最早投产的设计之一。

column1: This Eisenfaust model was the original prototype developed in 2515. Though several were produced, Defiance Industries only used them to test weapons and equipment configurations for the EFT-7X. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 这款铁拳是2515年研制的原始原型机。尽管生产了数台，迪法恩斯工业只将它们用于为EFT-7X测试武器与装备配置。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 作为衡量一切战斗装甲的标准，元素战斗装甲于 2868 年由狼氏族在与新星猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，让一小队操作员能击倒大型机甲并全身而退。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这套装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨大的元素战士量身定制，只有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。 特质：标准部件 投放费用倍率：0.93 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

column1: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
column2: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

column1: This variant was created by Clan Wolf in 3050 to carry out decapitation strikes against Inner Sphere command personnel during the Clan Invasion. It removes the missile launcher to include an additional Power Pack, Heat and Improved Sensors, a Remote Sensor Dispenser, and a pair of extra Fuel Tanks for its jump jets, while mounting a fixed anti-personnel Machine Gun in addition to the anti-personnel weapon mount. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 该变型由狼族部族于3050年创造，用于在部族入侵期间对内层星域的指挥人员实施斩首打击。它移除导弹发射器，以加装额外的动力包、热感应器与改进传感器、1具遥控传感器撒布器，以及2只为其跳跃推进器准备的额外燃料箱，同时在反步兵武器挂架之外固定安装1挺反步兵机枪。 <特性：标准零件 <投放费用倍率：0.93 <可搭载全向单位，可近战，可攀爬攻击。

column1: This variant was created by Clan Wolf in 3050 to carry out decapitation strikes against Inner Sphere command personnel during the Clan Invasion. It removes the missile launcher to include an additional Power Pack, Heat and Improved Sensors, a Remote Sensor Dispenser, and a pair of extra Fuel Tanks for its jump jets, while mounting a fixed anti-personnel Machine Gun in addition to the anti-personnel weapon mount.
column2: 这一改型由狼族在3050年创造，用于在氏族入侵期间对内天体指挥人员实施斩首打击。它拆掉导弹发射器，换成额外动力包、散热与改进型传感器、一具遥控传感器投放器，以及为其跳跃推进器准备的一对额外燃料箱，同时除反人员武器挂点外还固定安装一挺反人员机枪。

column1: A unique variant of the Emperor which was discovered in a Brian Cache by Clan Goliath Scorpion MechWarrior Nerran. The Clan warrior restored the ancient 'Mech by refitting the right arm's LB 10-X Autocannons with Clan produced Gauss Rifle and placed a Star League tech ER PPC in the right torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是皇帝的一个独特变型，由部族歌利亚蝎的机甲战士尼兰在一处布莱恩库中发现。这位部族战士让这台古老机甲重获新生：将右臂的LB 10-X自动炮改装为部族生产的高斯步枪，并在右躯干装上一门星际联盟科技的增程粒子炮。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Juggernaut & Heavy Cavalry
column2: 主宰者与重型骑兵

column1: A unique variant of the Emperor which was discovered in a Brian Cache by Clan Goliath Scorpion MechWarrior Nerran. The Clan warrior restored the ancient 'Mech by refitting the right arm's LB 10-X Autocannons with Clan produced Gauss Rifle and placed a Star League tech ER PPC in the right torso.
column2: 皇帝的一种独特改型，由蝎狮氏族机师内兰在一处布莱恩储藏库中发现。这位氏族战士通过把右臂的LB 10-X自动炮换成氏族制造的磁轨炮、并在右躯干装上一门星盟科技的增程PPC，修复了这台古老的机甲。

column1: Carries Clan-spec ER large lasers, an LB 10-X and LB 5-X, supported by a prototype Streak SRM-4. Used extensively by Clan Star Adder before getting replaced by various Highlander variants. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 搭载部族规格的增程大型激光、一门 LB 10-X 和一门 LB 5-X，并由一具原型连发 SRM-4 提供支援。星蝰部族曾大量使用，后来被各种 Highlander 变型取代。 特性：改进冷却护套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
column2: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。2612 年，星团公司推出升级版皇帝 EMP-6A，专为星盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家供应。皇帝一直持续生产，直到第二次继承战争中马里克部队用核武器摧毁了星团公司在子华星的工厂。皇帝的生产于 3057 年与传奇的高地人一同恢复。

column1: Using a mixture of newly developed or prototype weapons paired with older SLDF surplus, the Emperor EC was produced by the Star Adders before being supplanted by the development of the Highlander IIC. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 皇帝EC混合使用新研制的武器或原型武器与较旧的星际联盟防卫军剩余装备，由星蝰部族生产，后来随着高地人IIC的研制而被取代。 特性：改进冷却套件（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Using a mixture of newly developed or prototype weapons paired with older SLDF surplus, the Emperor EC was produced by the Star Adders before being supplanted by the development of the Highlander IIC.
column2: 皇帝EC把新研发或原型的武器与较老的SLDF剩余装备混合使用，由星蝰氏族生产，后来被高地人IIC的研发所取代。

column1: Created during the Golden Age by Clan Mongoose, the Enfield END-6J-EC incorporates newly developed technology into the original END-6J design. Powered by a 250-rated Fusion Core, the Enfield END-6J-EC is armed with an Improved Large Laser and a prototype UAC/10, with a Medium Laser filling the remaining tonnage. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 恩菲尔德END-6J-EC由猫鼬部族在黄金时代打造，把新开发的技术融入原END-6J设计。它由一台250额定聚变核心驱动，装有一门改进型大型激光和一原型UAC/10，余下吨位则由一门中型激光填补。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Created during the Golden Age by Clan Mongoose, the Enfield END-6J-EC incorporates newly developed technology into the original END-6J design. Powered by a 250-rated Fusion Core, the Enfield END-6J-EC is armed with an Improved Large Laser and a prototype UAC/10, with a Medium Laser filling the remaining tonnage.
column2: 恩菲尔德END-6J-EC由獴氏族在黄金时代创造，把新研发的技术融入原本的END-6J设计。恩菲尔德END-6J-EC由一具250级聚变核心驱动，武装为一门改进型大型激光器和一门原型UAC/10，其余吨位装有一门中型激光器。

column1: An attempted modernization of the Enforcer that never was mass produced, the -4D carries a ER PPC and a LB 10-X Autocannon, with a Guardian ECM for sensor protection. With the launch of the Enforcer III this variant was quickly forgotten. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是对执行者的一次现代化尝试，但从未量产。该型号搭载1门增程粒子炮和1门LB 10-X自动炮，并配1具守护者电子对抗套件保护传感器。随着执行者III的推出，这一变型很快就被遗忘了。 <特性：改进冷却套（自动炮） <投放费用倍率：1.04 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

column1: A considerable upgrade over the stock -4R, however the extra 1.2 million C-Bills cost while still carrying the 'Enforcer ENF-4' name meant this 'Mech would never sell so the idea was scrapped after just a single small production run.
column2: 相比原版-4R是相当大的升级，但多出120万C币的成本，却又仍挂着"执法者ENF-4"的名字，意味着这台机甲永远卖不动，所以这个想法在仅仅一个小批量生产后就废弃了。

column1: A Kell Hound's custom upgrade, replacing most of the internals and equipment with Clan tech. Sporting Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor allows a better protection for only 8 ton weight. With the improved cooling of using Clan Double Heat Sinks, the -4KH can mount a Large Pulse Laser together with the Ultra AC/10 and an ER Small Laser for anti-infantry protection. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是凯尔猎犬的定制升级，把大部分内部结构与设备换成部族技术。采用部族铁纤维装甲，仅八吨重量便获得更好的防护。凭借部族双散热器带来的冷却改善，-4KH能装一门大型脉冲激光，外加超级AC/10，以及一门增程小型激光用于反步兵防护。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: So much is changed on this 'Mech that it should really be considered a totally different one rather than just an Enforcer refit. But I guess the chassis structure is one of the few things not replaced, so that makes it still an Enforcer in theory.
column2: 这台机甲改动太多，真该把它当成一台完全不同的机甲，而不只是执法者的改装。不过我想底盘结构是少数没被替换的东西之一，所以理论上它还算是个执法者。

column1: Only retaining the 4R's torso mounted Small Laser, the 4P instead mounts an AC/20 in the right arm and a pair of Medium Lasers in the left arm. Carrying three tons of autocannon ammunition and eleven Double Heat Sinks, the 4P is powered by 250-rated standard engine, saving weight through the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo-Steel internal structure. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 4P只保留4R躯干上的小型激光，右臂改装一门AC/20，左臂一对中型激光。它带三吨自动炮弹药和十一个双散热器，由一台250额定标准引擎驱动，并借助铁纤维装甲与内骨架内部结构减轻重量。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: An AC/10 and a Small Laser, or an AC/20... I know which variant I would choose.
column2: 一门AC/10加一门小型激光器，还是一门AC/20……我知道我会选哪个改型。

column1: The personal 'Mech of Fox's Teeth member Daniel Waylen, after his unit was selected to receive among the first experimental weapons developed from the Helm Memory Core by the New Avalon Institute of Science in the lead-up to the War of 3039, his Enforcer was chosen as the test bed for an experimental NAIS Mk. I Gauss Rifle prototype. To free up the mass required for this weapon and two tons of reloads, the NAIS engineers adopted the laser armament from the original design, mounting a pair of ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers in the left arm in place of the large laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是“狐牙”成员丹尼尔·韦伦的专属机甲。在 3039 年战争前夕，新阿瓦隆科学院利用地狱核心开发出首批实验性武器，韦伦所在的部队被选中接收其中一部分，他的 Enforcer 也被选为实验型 NAIS Mk. I 高斯步枪原型的测试平台。为腾出这门武器以及两吨弹药所需的重量，NAIS 工程师沿用了原始设计的激光武器配置，在左臂以两门 ChisComp 39 中型激光取代大型激光。 特性：精准武器（高斯） 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: Wow, this is an old one you found. Not really a lot of use for this one anymore, those old prototype gausses are not as good as modern ones and have serious issues with reliability.
column2: 哇，你找到的这件可真够老的。这东西现在没什么用了——那些旧原型高斯炮不如现代的，可靠性也有严重问题。

column1: A battlefield refit of the -4R upgrading the cooling to double heat sinks, a change that allows dropping two external heat sinks and still improve the overall cooling performance. The saved weight is used for a second Small Laser, a C3 unit and a CASE system for the AC/10 ammunition. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是-4R的野战改装，把冷却升级为双散热器；这一改动使它可以拆掉两个外部散热器而仍然改善整体散热表现。省下的重量用于加装第二门小型激光、一台C3单元，以及为AC/10弹药加装CASE系统。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The switch to doubles makes sense, the -4R does struggle a bit with the heat. Most of the time the pilot won't be using the small lasers anyway, so it should be an overall gain in performance.
column2: 换成双重散热器是合理的，-4R在热量上确实有点吃力。多数时候飞行员根本不会用小型激光器，所以总体应该是性能上的增益。

column1: The -4R-WDR is a custom refit of the stock variant by the mercenary outfit the Wolf's Dragoons, improving the 'Mech considerably by using Clan tech. Using a 200 XL engine allows extra free weight, used to improve the cooling and a mounting C3 unit. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: -4R-WDR是雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵对现成变型的定制改装，使用部族技术大幅改进该机甲。采用200 XL引擎腾出额外自由重量，用于改善冷却并加装一台C3单元。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Another of those mercenary variants that practically change the whole 'Mech. All this Clan tech makes the 'Mech a lot more attractive to bring to the battlefield.
column2: 又是那种几乎改头换面的雇佣兵改型。这些氏族科技让这台机甲在战场上的吸引力大增。

column1: While the body of his 'Mech was factory refitted to the 5D standard after the initial Clan Invasion, Waylen adopted a more modern version of its War of '39 weapons loadout, carrying a now refined Gauss Rifle, two ER Medium Lasers in the left arm and a single torso mounted ER Small Laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 在部族入侵初期，他的机甲机体被厂方改装到5D标准，但韦伦采用了其“39年战争”武器载荷的更现代版本：一门经过改进的高斯步枪、左臂两门增程中型激光，以及躯干上一门单独的增程小型激光。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: This is the result of Daniel Waylen's first gauss prototype Mech, the final Gauss rifle now used rather than the prototype version of the earlier variant.
column2: 这是丹尼尔·韦伦第一台高斯原型机的成果——如今使用的是最终版高斯步枪，而非那个早期变型的原型版本。

column1: An alternate loadout to the -5D, the -5DR exchanges the ER Large Laser for an ER PPC, dropping the Ferro-Fibrous armor but instead using an Endo Steel structure and finally switches to double heat sinks. These changes further allows the addition of an Beagle active probe. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是-5D的另一种载荷，-5DR以一门增程粒子炮取代增程大型激光，放弃铁纤维装甲而改用内骨架结构，并最终改用双散热器。这些改动还进一步允许加装一台比格犬主动探测器。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: I would call this an upgrade rather than an alternative variant, the extra cooling just makes it generally better. I guess the increased cost is the downside that caused this variant to be less common.
column2: 我会把这称为升级而非替代改型，额外的散热只是让它普遍更好。我猜增加的成本就是导致这一改型不那么常见的缺点。

column1: The -5P is an uncommon variant mounting twin Ultra AC/5s at the cost of less armor and only 2 Jump Jets. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: -5P是一种少见变型，装双联超级AC/5，代价是装甲更薄且只有2具跳跃推进器。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The trade-off to mount two UAC/5 is not worth it on my opinion, Boss. What use is big guns if you're dead?
column2: 在我看来，为装两门UAC/5付出的代价并不值得，老大。人都死了，大炮有什么用？

column1: The Enforcer 7S is an NAIS prototype carrying a mostly functional Gauss rifle prototype. This one seems to be stolen. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Enforcer 7S 是 NAIS 的原型机，搭载一门基本可用的高斯步枪原型。这一台似乎是偷来的。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: The Enforcer 7S is an NAIS prototype carrying a mostly functional Gauss rifle prototype. This one seems to be stolen.
column2: 执法者7S是一台携带大致可用的磁轨炮原型的NAIS原型机。这一台似乎是被偷来的。

column1: The 'Ghillie' is built for Davion's NAIS' Team Banzai, named after the camouflage suits often worn by snipers. It carries an Improved Gauss Rifle and Electronics to be formidable Skirmisher and Scout. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: “吉利服”（Ghillie）是为 Davion 的 NAIS 下属 Banzai 小队打造的，名字取自狙击手常穿着的伪装服。它搭载改进型高斯步枪与电子设备，因而成为强悍的游击与侦察机甲。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: The 'Ghillie' is built for Davion's NAIS' Team Banzai, named after the camouflage suits often worn by snipers. It carries an Improved Gauss Rifle and Electronics to be formidable Skirmisher and Scout.
column2: 伪装服是为达维昂的NAIS班宰小队打造的，以狙击手常穿的伪装服命名。它携带一门改进型磁轨炮和电子设备，是令人生畏的游击手与侦察兵。

column1: A research variant of the Enforcer by the New Avalon Institute of Science for Worst Case, a scenario created to deal with any situation by using the latest and greatest technology. The result was not as great as hoped, as the ENF-NAIS-WC never got far beyond prototype stage. Lessons learned during its design were however used for later models and their improvements. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是新阿瓦隆科学研究所为“最坏情况”项目打造的研究型 Enforcer 变型——该项目旨在运用最新、最强的技术应对任何局面。结果并未达到预期，ENF-NAIS-WC 始终没能走出原型阶段。不过，其设计过程中获得的经验被用于后续型号及其改进。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: These research variants never go far, they just have too many inherent flaws by being built by researchers with little to no understanding of real battlefield needs.
column2: 这些研究改型从来走不远，它们天生缺陷太多，因为造它们的研究人员对真正的战场需求几乎一无所知。

column1: The aging Enforcer was commissioned to be redesigned by then First Prince Victor Steiner-Davion in an effort to rebuild his image within the sundered Federated Commonwealth. The resulting Enforcer III is built on a Endo Steel chassis, with further weight savings achieved through the use of a 250 XL Engine. Five jump jets grants a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters. The Enforcer III is armored with ten tons of standard armor that gives it good armor protection for its size. The Enforcer III carries as its primary weapon a UAC/10, backed up by an ER Large Laser and an ER Small Laser. This balanced mix of weapons makes the Enforcer III a powerful medium 'Mech. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 为在分裂的联邦共和国中重塑形象，时任第一王子维克托·施泰纳-达维昂下令对老旧的 Enforcer 进行重新设计。由此诞生的 Enforcer III 采用内骨架机体，并通过换装 250 XL 引擎进一步减轻重量。五具跳跃推进器赋予其一百五十米的跳跃能力。Enforcer III 披挂十吨标准装甲，就体型而言防护相当出色。它的主武器是一门 UAC/10，辅以一门大型增程激光和一门小型增程激光。这种均衡的武器搭配使 Enforcer III 成为一具强大的中型机甲。 特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: Enforcer III
column2: 执法者 III

column1: Fire Support & Sniper
column2: 火力支援与狙击

column1: The original Enforcer wasn't cutting it anymore. I guess the Steiner-Davions tried to fix the design rather than create a new one from scratch. And that can be seen, it still is not a fully modernized 'Mech.
column2: 原来的执法者已经不够用了。我猜施泰纳-达维昂是试着修补这个设计，而不是从头造个新的。这看得出来，它仍然不是一台完全现代化的机甲。

column1: The Epimetheus was equipped with Clan armor and weaponry. As the cockpit was moved to the torso, extra space was available in the 'Mech's head. This space was filled by an Ultra AC/10. Each arm mounted an ER Large Laser and Medium Pulse Laser. All the weapons were tied into a Clan Targeting Computer that made the weapons extraordinarily accurate. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 厄庇墨透斯配备了部族装甲与武器。由于驾驶舱被移至躯干，机甲头部因此空出了额外空间，而这部分空间由一门超级AC/10填补。每只手臂各安装一门增程大型激光和一门中型脉冲激光。所有武器都接入一台部族瞄准计算机，使其精准度异常出众。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.22

column1: Clan BattleMech
column2: 氏族战斗机甲

column1: The Epimetheus was designed by the same team that created the Prometheus BattleMech. The team was trying to design a 'Mech for the Inner Sphere with the latest Clan technologies. The 'Mech uses Clan produced ferro-fibrous armor, Endo Steel skeleton, and 400-rated XL engine. After Professor Burke Kale plundered the Dark Mirage research facility, NAIS investigators discovered that he had taken the half-completed 'Mech with him to Solaris.
column2: 厄庇墨透斯由打造普罗米修斯战斗机甲的同一团队设计。该团队试图为内层星域设计一台采用部族最新技术的机甲。这台机甲使用部族生产的铁纤维装甲、内骨架结构和 400 级 XL 引擎。在 Burke Kale 教授洗劫暗影辰景研究设施之后，NAIS 的调查人员发现他把这台尚未完成的机甲一起带去了索拉里斯。

column1: A slightly modified version for Solaris 7 arenas. It removes the torso mounted cockpit to fit one more heat sink. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 为 Solaris 7 竞技场稍作修改的版本。它拆除了躯干座舱，以便多装一具散热器。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.22

column1: The 3BK is a refurbished version of older Excalibur B2 models mainly sold to the periphery states. It drops the AMS for a C3 slave and some more armor. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 3BK是较旧的神剑B2型号的翻新版本，主要卖给外围国家。它拆掉反导弹系统，换装一台C3从机和更多装甲。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Skobel MechWorks
column2: 斯科贝尔机甲工厂

column1: The B1 comes with few weapons, sure, but those weapons pack a punch at longer ranges.
column2: B1 的武器确实不多，但这些武器在较远距离上很有杀伤力。

column1: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The B1 was the first model of Excalibur to be produced and served as a solid basis for all models to follow. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 神剑战斗机甲的设计意在融合射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当可观。它的名字来自右下臂驱动器独特的外观——让人想起中世纪地球的剑。B1是神剑首款量产型号，为此后所有型号奠定了坚实基础。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The B2 is the standard model of Excalibur adopted by the SLDF in 2620, serving well during Operation Smother and the Amaris Civil War. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 神剑战斗机甲的设计意在融合射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当可观。它的名字来自右下臂驱动器独特的外观——让人想起中世纪地球的剑。B2是SLDF于2620年采用的神剑标准型号，在“窒息行动”与阿马里斯内战期间表现良好。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Yankee Weapons Systems
column2: 扬基武器系统

column1: The Excalibur B2 is light on its feet, but also light just about everywhere else. Low amounts of armour, low amounts of weaponry, you name it. It served well back in the day as a sniper, but it'll need support if you send it out as-is, Boss.
column2: 神剑B2脚下轻快，但其他地方也都轻。装甲少、武器少，什么都少。它当年当狙击手表现不错，但要是你原封不动把它派出去，它需要支援，老大。

column1: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The B2b model was utilised by the Star League's Royal Divisions and boasted more advanced components over the stock B2. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 神剑战斗机甲的设计意在融合射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当可观。它的名字来自右下臂驱动器独特的外观——让人想起中世纪地球的剑。B2b型号由星际联盟皇家师使用，相较标准B2配备了更先进的部件。 特性：破甲射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Excalibur B2b is light on its feet, but also light just about everywhere else. Low amounts of armour, low amounts of weaponry, you name it. It served well back in the day as a sniper, but it'll need support if you send it out as-is, Boss.
column2: 神剑B2b脚下很轻，但其他各个方面也都很轻：装甲少、武器少，样样如此。它当年当狙击手时表现不错，但老板，如果你就这么派它出去，它需要支援。

column1: A Clan-tech overhaul of the original SLDF Royal Excalibur B2b. The B2b-EC enjoys the early fruits of Clan weapons research, but otherwise retains the original Spheroid technology. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是对原SLDF皇家Excalibur B2b进行的部族技术全面翻修。B2b-EC享受到了部族武器研究的早期成果，其余部分则保留了原本的内层星域技术。 特性：穿透射击 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Clan Wolf
column2: 氏族狼

column1: Looks like we got ourselves a Clan prototype 'Mech, Boss. I've always found it fascinating how 'Mechs like these give us a glimpse into the evolution of the Clans' technologies.
column2: 看来我们弄到了一台部族原型机甲，老板。我一直觉得这类机甲很有意思，它们让我们得以一窥部族技术的演化。

column1: The Excalibur BattleMech was designed to blend range and mobility, boasting an impressive top speed for its tonnage. The name comes from the unique appearance of its lower right arm actuator, reminiscent of a medieval Terran sword. The C1 is a later model of the Excalibur produced during the Clan Invasion Era. The redesign aimed to address the notorious lack of armor present on the B2. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Excalibur 战斗机甲的设计旨在兼顾射程与机动性，就其吨位而言最高速度相当惊人。其名称源自它右臂下部驱动器独特的外观，形似中世纪地球的剑。C1 是部族入侵时代生产的较晚型号的 Excalibur，这次重新设计旨在解决 B2 上臭名昭著的装甲不足问题。 特性：穿透射击 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Excalibur C1 is a pretty solid improvement on the original B2, if you ask me, Boss. More armour, modern heat sinks, and an extra laser, to boot. Don't get me wrong, though, she's still no Atlas when it comes to taking punishment.
column2: 神剑C1相对原版B2是相当扎实的改进，要我说的话，老大。更多装甲、现代化散热器，外加一门额外激光器。不过别误会，说到挨揍，她还是比不了阿特拉斯。

column1: A customized variant of the Executioner supposedly piloted by Gorman Bekker, the Cherbi carries a massive Ultra AC/20 in its right arm, supported by a trio of ER Small Lasers in the left arm and a Streak SRM-6 rack in the left torso. A single LRM-20 launcher int he right torso provides some ranged firepower, with Cherbi carrying two tons each of Ultra Autocannon and Long Range Missile reloads with a single ton for the ammo-efficient Streak Missile Launcher. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 据称由戈尔曼·贝克尔驾驶的刽子手定制变型，“切尔比”在右臂装有一门巨型 Ultra AC/20，左臂以三门 ER 小型激光支援，左躯干则有一组连发 SRM-6。右躯干的一部 LRM-20 发射器提供了一定的远程火力；“切尔比”为 Ultra 自动炮和远程导弹各携带两吨再装填弹药，而弹药效率极高的连发导弹发射器只用一吨。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Capable of reaching speeds of 87 km/h with it's MASC activated, the Executioner is a fast 95 ton Clan OmniMech. Powered by a 380-rated XL Engine, the Executioner has 26.5 tons of pod space. The MASC and 4 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis.
column2: 启用 MASC 后速度可达 87 公里/小时，行刑者是一台快速的 95 吨氏族全能机甲。由一台 380 额定 XL 引擎驱动，拥有 26.5 吨吊舱空间。MASC 与 4 个跳跃推进器硬接在底盘上。

column1: Using recently developed heavy laser technology, the Executioner H specializes in close combat, and mounts a Heavy Large Laser for prodigious medium-range firepower. Complementing the laser is a devastatingly powerful Ultra Autocannon/20. Supporting this heavy firepower is a pair of ER Medium Lasers and a Flamer, which is very effective against infantry, and is also a powerful tactical weapon. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Executioner H 运用新近研发的重型激光技术，专精于近距离战斗，搭载一具重型大型激光，可提供惊人的中距离火力。与之相配的是一门威力骇人的超级自动炮/20。为这一重型火力提供支援的是两具增程中型激光和一具火焰喷射器；后者对步兵极为有效，同时也是一种强力战术武器。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The N configuration of the Executioner was an attempt to make the 'Mech less ammunition reliant. However, instead it created major issues with heat management and the practically all energy loadout never got produced in any larger batches. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 行刑者的N配置试图让该机甲减少对弹药的依赖，结果却在热量管理上造成了重大问题，这套几乎全能量的载荷从未大批量生产。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Capable of reaching speeds of 87 km/h with it's MASC activated, the Executioner is a fast 95 ton Clan OmniMech. Powered by a 380-rated XL Engine, the Executioner has 26.5 tons of pod space. The MASC and 4 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis. The Executioner EXE-Prime is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a Gauss Rifle. A pair of Machine Guns fill the remaining pod space.
column2: 启用 MASC 后速度可达 87 公里/小时，行刑者是一台快速的 95 吨氏族全能机甲。由一台 380 额定 XL 引擎驱动，拥有 26.5 吨吊舱空间。MASC 与 4 个跳跃推进器硬接在底盘上。行刑者 EXE-主型号装备一对 ER 大型激光和一具高斯步枪，两挺机枪填满剩余吊舱空间。

column1: A Missile Boat version of the Executioner, the O carries two side torso mounted ATM 12 launchers combined with an assortment of lasers - the largest which is a Large Pulse Laser. Four tons of various ATM ammunition allows the loadout some further flexibility. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: O是Executioner的导弹平台版本，两侧躯干各装一具ATM 12发射器，并搭配多种激光，其中最大的是大型脉冲激光。四吨各式ATM弹药为这套配置提供了更多灵活性。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Q configuration has a slight focus on more survivability, in the way of an Anti-Missile System and an ECM Suite. Besides this the 'Mech also carries a four ton Targeting Computer to support the two Large and four Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Q 配置略微侧重提升生存能力，为此加装了反导弹系统和一套电子对抗套件。除此之外，该机甲还搭载了一台四吨重的瞄准计算机，用于辅助两门大型脉冲激光和四门中型脉冲激光。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: An unofficial configuration mostly used by Mercenary bands that somehow managed to aquire the 'Mech. The weapons consist of a Light Gauss Rifle, two ER Large Lasers and one LRM10 launcher, and a C3 slave unit rounds out the build. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 一种非官方配置，主要被那些不知用什么办法弄到这台机甲的雇佣兵团使用。武器包括一门轻型高斯步枪、两门增程大型激光和一具LRM10发射器，另有一台C3从属单元补全整套配置。 特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A command configuration of the Executioner, combining a C3 Master system with advanced ECM and Sensors. The 'Mech still manages to fit a combination of ER and Pulse Lasers to defend itself, or even help with the actual battle in times of crisis. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是行刑者的指挥配置，把C3主机系统与先进电子对抗和传感器结合。该机甲仍设法装下增程与脉冲激光的组合用于自卫，危机时刻甚至能直接参与战斗。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Battle of Tukayyid 'temporary configuration' that became a standard variant, the TC is an energy boat with limited recon capabilities. The right arm carries the customary pair of energy weapons, in this case Large Pulse Lasers. The left arm carries an ER PPC, an ER Small Laser, and an additional heat sink. Two more ER Small Lasers are mounted in the right torso. The right torso also carries an additional heat sink and an Active Probe that allows the TC to detect hidden enemy units. Drastically increasing the lethality of the TC, a Targeting Computer in the left torso helps ensure the 'Mech hits what it shoots at. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: TC 是图卡伊德战役中的“临时配置”，后来成了标准变型；它是一台能量武器平台，具备有限的侦察能力。右臂装有一贯成对配置的能量武器，此处为大型脉冲激光。左臂装有一门 ER PPC、一门增程小型激光和一个额外的散热器。右躯干另装有两门增程小型激光。右躯干还带有一个额外的散热器和一个主动探测器，使 TC 能侦测隐藏的敌方单位。左躯干中的瞄准计算机大幅提升了 TC 的致命性，帮助机甲确保打中它瞄准的目标。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A configuration almost fully focused on ballistic weapons, the Executioner-B A brings a LB 10-X and an Ultra AC/10 in each arm. Two ER Small Lasers provide some improved anti-infantry defense. Although the heavy focus on ballistic reduces the flexibility of the design, this configuration still is amongst the more favored as it actually has excessive cooling capacity. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这一配置几乎完全专注于弹道武器，Executioner-B A 每臂各带一门 LB 10-X 和一门 Ultra AC/10。两门增程小型激光提供了一定的反步兵防御能力。尽管对弹道武器的重度偏重降低了这一设计的灵活性，但它仍是较受欢迎的配置之一，因为它的散热能力实际上相当过剩。 特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Executioner-B is actually the First generation Executioner, which was used for its Trials. The name was retroactively changed as the actual and improved Executioners went into full production. Suffering from constant heat issues and very high energy consumption made for an exceptionally sluggish OmniMech.
column2: 行刑者-B 实际上是第一代行刑者，用于其试炼。随着真正改进后的行刑者进入全面量产，这个名字才被追认更改。持续的热量问题与极高的能耗使这台全能机甲异常迟钝。

column1: The B configuration of the Executioner-B mounts a Gauss Rifle in each arm as well as two ER Large Lasers for long range engagements. Four Medium Pulse Lasers provide extra damage at closer ranges. Even with 18 double heat sinks the 'Mech still suffers from easy overheating due to the many energy weapons. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 行刑者-B 的 B 型配置在每条手臂上各装一门高斯步枪，另有两门增程大型激光用于远距离交战。四门中型脉冲激光在更近的距离上提供额外伤害。即使有18个双散热器，由于能量武器众多，这台机甲依然很容易过热。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Executioner-B is actually the First generation Executioner, which was used for its Trials. The name was retroactivly changed as the actual and improved Executioners went into full production. Suffering from constant heat issues and very high energy consumption made for an execptionally sluggish OmniMech.
column2: 行刑者-B实际上是第一代行刑者，曾用于其试炼。随着真正改进后的行刑者全面投产，这个名字被追改过来。它受困于持续的热量问题与极高的能耗，是一台异常迟钝的全向机甲。

column1: The C configuration is focused at long-range assaults with its four ER PPC and two Ultra AC/5. To help with protection at close range, two SRM-2 launchers were added, but they seldom see much use in practice due to the far too weak cooling capabilities of the 'Mech. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C 型配置以四门增程粒子炮和两门 Ultra AC/5 专注于远程强攻。为增强近距离自卫能力，加装了两具 SRM-2 发射器，但由于该机甲散热能力实在过弱，实战中它们很少派上用场。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration of the Executioner-B mounts an Ultra AC/20 in the left arm, two Large Pulse Lasers in the right, and one ER PPC and two Ultra AC/2 in the side torsos. All together this makes for a formidable weapons loadout, but as the cooling is insufficient for repeated alpha strikes the 'Mech seldom reaches its maximum damage potential as listed on paper. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 行刑者-B的主配置左臂装一门超级AC/20，右臂两门大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各一门增程粒子炮和两门超级AC/2。合起来是一套强悍的武器配置，但由于冷却不足以支持反复的全力齐射，该机甲很少能达到纸面所列的最大伤害潜力。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The personal 'Mech of Vlad Ward before he achieved fame and rose to the title of Khan, a customized version of the B loadout of the Executioner-B. Keeping the same weaponry, but adding some advanced systems and sensors to improved battlefield performance. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是弗拉德·沃德成名并升任可汗之前的私人机甲，是行刑者-B的B挂载的定制版本。它保留相同武器，但加装了一些先进系统与传感器以提升战场表现。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Succession Wars era downgrade of the original EXT-4D model, the Exterminator 4A model was created in 3007 by Kallon Industries as a potential replacement for their Wolverine line. While packing nearly the same weapons array as the original 4D, engineers were forced to substitute the AMS for a conventional Machine Gun and downgrade the engine to a smaller 325-rated model. Lacking the advanced stealth systems and high speed of its progenitor model, the design was considered a failure and only 25 models were constructed. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 灭虫者（Exterminator）4A 型是原版 EXT-4D 在继承战争时期的降级版本，由 Kallon 工业公司于 3007 年打造，意在作为其狼獾（Wolverine）生产线的潜在替代品。虽然武器配置与原版 4D 几乎相同，但工程师们被迫将反导弹系统换成一挺常规机枪，并将引擎降级为较小的额定 325 型号。由于缺少原型机所具备的先进隐形系统与高速度，该设计被认为是一次失败，仅建造了 25 台。 特性：迅捷 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: A Succession Wars era downgrade of the original EXT-4D model, the Exterminator 4A model was created in 3007 by Kallon Industries as a potential replacement for their Wolverine line. While packing nearly the same weapons array as the original 4D, engineers were forced to substitute the AMS for a conventional Machine Gun and downgrade the engine to a smaller 325-rated model. Lacking the advanced stealth systems and high speed of its progenitor model, the design was considered a failure and only 25 models were constructed.
column2: 作为原始 EXT-4D 型号在继承战争时期的降级版本，灭虫者 4A 于 3007 年由 Kallon Industries 研制，意在取代自家的狼獾系列。虽然武器配置与原始 4D 几乎相同，工程师却不得不把 AMS 换成一门常规机枪，并将引擎降级为额定 325 的较小型号。由于缺少原型机上的先进隐身系统与高速度，该设计被认为是一次失败，仅建造了 25 台。

column1: A variant of the EXT-4D, the Exterminator EXT-4C incorporates a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. Entering production at the same time as the EXT-4D, the 4C is otherwise unchanged from its parent design. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 作为EXT-4D的变型，灭绝者EXT-4C整合了1面变色龙光偏振护盾。它与EXT-4D同时投产，除此之外与母型设计没有任何差别。\n<特性：灵活\n<投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: A variant of the EXT-4D, the Exterminator EXT-4C incorporates a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. Entering production at the same time as the EXT-4D, the 4C is otherwise unchanged from its parent design.
column2: 作为EXT-4D的变型，灭绝者EXT-4C整合了一面变色龙光偏振护盾。它与EXT-4D同时投产，除此之外与母设计没有差别。

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Exterminator EXT-4Db-EC was an upgrade of the EXT-4Db that replaced the Medium Lasers with prototype ER Mediums. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 作为一款可追溯到“克朗代克行动”时代的早期部族机甲，Exterminator EXT-4Db-EC 是 EXT-4Db 的升级型，用原型增程中型激光替换了中型激光。随着现代部族规格武器投入生产，它被停产并逐渐被人遗忘。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Exterminator EXT-4Db-EC was an upgrade of the EXT-4Db that replaced the Medium Lasers with prototype ER Mediums. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，灭绝者EXT-4Db-EC是EXT-4Db的升级版，把中型激光器换成了原型增程中型激光器。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。

column1: A unique Exterminator variant refitted as specifically as a dueling Mech, the EXT-4DX was piloted by Lieutenant Caine Barclay of the SLDF's Forty-First Assault Battalion. Designed for close range combat, the 4DX mounts 6 Medium Pulse Lasers and a headmounted AMS. To fit the battery of Lasers, engineers replaced the 390-rated XL Engine with a smaller 325-rated model. Offsetting the slower speed is a Supercharger paired with MASC; allowing the 4DX to theoretically outrun a Locust. Laser Insulators are attached to each MPL, reducing the heat load to managable levels. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 作为一款被专门改装成决斗机甲的独特灭绝者变型，EXT-4DX由SLDF第四十一突击营的凯恩·巴克利中尉驾驶。为近距离战斗而设计，4DX装有6门中型脉冲激光以及一具安装在头部的AMS。为容纳这批激光，工程师把390级XL引擎换成更小的325级型号。为弥补速度下降，该机配备了一台超级增压器并与MASC搭配，理论上能让4DX跑得比蝗虫式还快。每门中型脉冲激光都装有激光绝缘器，将热量负荷降至可控水平。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: A unique Exterminator variant refitted as specifically as a dueling Mech, the EXT-4DX was piloted by Lieutenant Caine Barclay of the SLDF's Forty-First Assault Battalion. Designed for close range combat, the 4DX mounts 6 Medium Pulse Lasers and a headmounted AMS. To fit the battery of Lasers, engineers replaced the 390-rated XL Engine with a smaller 325-rated model. Offsetting the slower speed is a Supercharger paired with MASC; allowing the 4DX to theoretically outrun a Locust. Laser Insulators are attached to each MPL, reducing the heat load to managable levels.
column2: 这是一种独特的灭绝者改型，被专门改装为决斗机甲，EXT-4DX由SLDF第四十一突击营的凯恩·巴克利中尉驾驶。4DX为近距离战斗而设计，装6门中型脉冲激光器和一具头部AMS。为容纳这一整排激光器，工程师把390级XL引擎换成了更小的325级型号。为弥补较慢的速度，配上了增压器与MASC；理论上这让4DX能跑赢一台蝗虫。每门中型脉冲激光器都附有激光绝缘器，把热量负担降到可控水平。

column1: Introduced in 3060, the Exterminator EXT-5E is a modernisation of the 4D model built for Comstar and the Word of Blake. A 390-rated Xl Engine and Endo Steel allow the designers to mount an iNarc and 4 ER Medium Lasers. The Jump Jets were removed to make space for C3i and MASC fitted to compensate for the loss of agility. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 灭绝者EXT-5E于3060年推出，是为通讯之星与布莱克之词建造的4D型号的现代化版本。一台390额定XL引擎与内骨架让设计者得以装设一具iNarc和4门增程中型激光。跳跃推进器被拆除以腾出空间给C3i，并加装MASC以补偿损失的灵活性。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Introduced in 3060, the Exterminator EXT-5E is a modernisation of the 4D model built for Comstar and the Word of Blake. A 390-rated Xl Engine and Endo Steel allow the designers to mount an iNarc and 4 ER Medium Lasers. The Jump Jets were removed to make space for C3i and MASC  fitted to compensate for the loss of agility.
column2: 灭绝者EXT-5E于3060年推出，是为康星与布雷克之言建造的4D型号的现代化版本。一具390级XL引擎与内层钢让设计师得以装上一具iNarc和4门增程中型激光器。跳跃推进器被拆除以腾出空间装C3i和MASC——后者用以补偿失去的灵活性。

column1: A IIC version of the Exterminator used by the Clans that invaded the Inner Sphere. Rebuilt almost from scratch the design is fully Clan technology based, mounting six ER Medium Lasers and an LRM-10 with attached Artemis IV FCS. Two Anti-Missile Systems provide self-defense. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 入侵内层星域的部族所使用的 Exterminator 的 IIC 版本。该设计几乎从零重造，全面基于部族科技，装有六门增程中型激光和一具带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统的 LRM-10。两套反导弹系统提供自卫能力。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Exterminator IIC
column2: 灭绝者 IIC

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4Nb-Saho is armed with a Medium Laser and a Large Pulse Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Falcon 是在统一战争之后为 SLDF 设计的，既是侦察机甲的猎手，也是一款反步兵机甲。Falcon 是 30 吨的轻型机甲，由一台 180 级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4Nb-Saho 装备一门中型激光和一门大型脉冲激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4Nb-Saho is armed with a Medium Laser and a Large Pulse Laser.
column2: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。猎鹰FLC-4Nb-Saho武装为一门中型激光器和一门大型脉冲激光器。

column1: The Falcon FLC-5P2 mounts a Large Laser in the left arm and two ER Medium Lasers in the right. A Single head-mounted Small Laser act as backup. The 'Mech carries six jump jets for increased mobility. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: Falcon FLC-5P2 在左臂搭载一具大型激光，右臂搭载两具增程中型激光。头部安装的一具小型激光作为备用武器。该机甲配备六具跳跃推进器以提升机动性。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core.
column2: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。

column1: A rebuild of the Falcon by the Wolf's Dragoons, utilizing Clan technology to much improve its systems. Two ER Medium Lasers and one Medium Pulse Lasers are connected through a small Targeting Computer to provide some basic firepower, but the 'Mechs main purpose is utilizing its TAG and C3 slave to scout out enemy foes for artillery strikes and indirect fire. To stay hidden the design carries a Guardian ECM, and an AMS protects it in case it is engaged. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是沃尔夫龙骑兵对猎鹰的重新建造，利用部族科技大幅改进了它的各项系统。两门增程中型激光与一门中型脉冲激光通过一台小型瞄准计算机联动，提供基本的火力；但这台机甲的主要用途是凭借TAG与C3从属单元侦察敌情，为炮火打击和间接射击标定目标。为保持隐蔽，该设计搭载了守护者电子对抗套件，并配备AMS以便在遭遇交战时保护自身。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-5P is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser and a pair of ER Medium Lasers. A Targeting Computer enhances the Laser’s accuracy while the inclusion of MASC boosts the Falcon’s speed.
column2: 猎鹰于统一战争之后为SLDF设计，是一款猎杀侦察机甲的机甲，也是反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一台180额定聚变核心驱动。猎鹰FLC-5P装有一门中型脉冲激光和一对增程中型激光。一台瞄准计算机提升激光精度，MASC的加入则提升了猎鹰的速度。

column1: The Falcon Hawk 9K is armed with an ER PPC as its primary weapon, which allows engage targets at up to 690 meters. For close range combat the 'Mech carries two medium pulse lasers and a small pulse laser. In the event that an enemy is able to circle into its rear arc, the Falcon Hawk is prepared with a medium laser to defend its rear armor. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Falcon Hawk 9K以一门增程粒子炮为主武器，可在最远690米外交战。近距近战方面，机甲搭载两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光。若敌人绕入其后方弧区，Falcon Hawk也备有一门中型激光来保护后部装甲。 特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Falcon Hawk
column2: 隼鹰

column1: The Falcon Hawk has what is probably the longest development time of any 'Mech in history. Originally engineered and designed in 2794, the rapid loss of technology during the Succession Wars delayed its production until 3057, and even then only thanks to the recovery of a Star League memory core on Helm by the Gray Death Legion. The Falcon Hawk is powered by an 175 XL engine that provides a top speed of 86.4 km/h, making it relatively slow for its weight class. This is done so the Falcon Hawk could carry the weapons needed for its role as a long-range sniper. The 'Mech carries seven tons of armor to protect it from return fire.
column2: 隼鹰的开发周期很可能是所有机甲中最长的。它最初于 2794 年完成工程设计与规划，但继承战争期间技术的迅速流失使它的生产一直推迟到 3057 年，而且这还要归功于灰死军团在地狱星上找回了一份星际联盟记忆核心。隼鹰由一台 175 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度为 86.4 km/h，在同级重量中相对偏慢。这样设计是为了让隼鹰能携带其远程狙击手角色所需的武器。这台机甲带有七吨装甲，用以抵御敌人的还击。

column1: The discontinued 9K1A variant of the Falcon Hawk reduces its long-range capabilities, but increases the raw firepower available. The ER PPC has been removed as well as the two medium pulse lasers. These have been replaced with an ER large laser, a standard large laser, and a medium laser; the original medium laser was retained. This weapons configuration provides the Falcon Hawk with a capable medium to long-range arsenal. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Falcon Hawk 已停产的 9K1A 变型削弱了远程能力，却提高了可用火力。它拆除了增程粒子炮以及两门中型脉冲激光，代之以一门增程大型激光、一门标准大型激光和一门中型激光，原有的那门中型激光则予以保留。这一武器配置为 Falcon Hawk 提供了堪用的中远距离武器库。 特性：配重均衡 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Falconer FLC-8R carries a weapons mix that attempts to negate the range advantage of the weapons used by the Clans. The primary weapon on the 'Mech is a Gauss rifle, which is capable of stripping a ton of armor off an enemy unit at extreme ranges. It is backed up by an ER PPC, having a similar range profile to the Gauss Rifle and doing about a third less damage, but not dependent upon ammunition. Finally, the Falconer carries four medium lasers to give it a powerful close range punch. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 隼人FLC-8R的武器组合试图抵消部族武器的射程优势。该机甲的主武器是一门高斯步枪，能在极远距离上剥掉敌方单位一吨装甲。它由一门增程粒子炮支援——射程表现与高斯步枪相近，伤害约少三分之一，却不依赖弹药。最后，隼人带四门中型激光，赋予它强力的近程重拳。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Falconer was designed at the order of Hanse Davion to create a 'Mech that could tame the Jade Falcons and defeat a Clan OmniMech in one-on-one combat. The Falconer is powered by a 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. This speed is enhanced with greater mobility by fiv jump jets that allow the Falconer to jump the considerable distance of one hundred and fifty meters. The Falconer also saves weight to carry as many weapons as possible by using a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and carries eleven and a half tons of armor plating, which gives the Falconer a respectable amount of armor protection.
column2: 隼人奉汉斯·戴维恩之命设计，目标是一款能驯服玉猫、并在一对一近战中击败部族全向机甲的机甲。隼人由一台375 XL引擎驱动，最高速度86.4公里/小时；五具跳跃推进器进一步提升了它的机动性，使它可跳跃相当可观的一百五十米。隼人还通过采用轻量内骨架底盘省下重量以尽可能多带武器，并披挂十一吨半装甲板，为它提供了可观的装甲防护。

column1: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: 芬里尔以日耳曼神话中的魔狼命名，它与其说是传统战斗服，不如说是一座机动火力支援平台。操控这套装甲的士兵坐在狭窄的"驾驶舱"里，像驾驶一台小型步行坦克那样操纵芬里尔。装甲上那座可配置的单一炮塔能接受多种武器配置，而芬里尔结实有力的腿部能让它跑得远比史莱格快。 特质：精准 投放费用倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可蜂群攻击。

column1: The Fire Falcon was created in the early-3050s, apparently as a replacement for the Mist Lynx; it is faster, has more front-facing armor, and more pod space, though it lacks the jump jets of that earlier 'Mech. It makes use of weight-saving materials in the form of an XL engine, an endo steel internal structure, and four tons of ferro-fibrous armor.
column2: 火隼于 3050 年代初被制造，显然是为了取代雾豹；它更快、前向装甲更多、吊舱空间更大，但缺少前者的跳跃推进器。它采用了减重材料：XL 引擎、内骨骼内部结构和四吨铁纤维装甲。

column1: The B loadout is a long-range configuration that makes use of a pair of ER large lasers guided by a targeting computer. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: Designed for scouting and work against infantry, the C uses an active probe to find hidden targets. To use against those targets, it carries one medium pulse laser, one small pulse laser, one ER small laser, and a pair of SRM-6s. Against soft targets, four machine guns provide ample infantry killing power. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C配置为侦察和对付步兵而设计，用一台主动探测器寻找隐藏目标；为打击这些目标，它带一门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光、一门增程小型激光和两具SRM-6。对付软目标时，四挺机枪提供充足的步兵杀伤力。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A spotter, the D carries TAG and a Narc missile beacon. If it gets caught in combat, it can use a pair of SRM-4s and one ER medium laser. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D 配置担任观察手，携带 TAG 和 NARC 导弹信标。如果被迫卷入战斗，它可以使用两具 SRM-4 和一门增程中型激光。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column2: Fire Falcon 的主配置最擅长中近距离作战，在那里它能发挥出一对连发 SRM-4 发射器、一门中型脉冲激光、两门增程中型激光和两门增程小型激光的火力。虽然这样的齐射对一台如此体型的机甲而言相当强悍，但 10 具双散热器大体上足以让该设计保持冷却。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

Heavy anti-infantry focused version, mounting a machine gun array in each arm and dual machine guns in each torso, with an auxiliary rear facing machine gun mounted in the head. Two Small Pulse lasers provide some ammo-independent weaponry. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这是“复兴行动”之后为推进部族轻型机甲能力而造的四款原型变型之一。它从未进入全面量产，但试车足够多，至今仍有若干存世。这是偏重反步兵的重型版本：每只手臂装一组机枪阵列，两侧躯干各装双联机枪，头部另有一挺辅助的后向机枪；两门小型脉冲激光提供一些不依赖弹药的武器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这是在 REVIVAL 行动之后为推进部族轻型机甲能力而创造的四种原型变型之一。它从未进入全面量产，但接受过实战测试的数量足以让其中一些留存至今。该机共装备九门增程小型激光，并由一台能量瞄准计算机进一步强化。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A heavily modified variant of the Fire Moth, normally only used for batchalls. Five independent SRM-2 launchers are mounted in the 'Mech's right arm, a single heavy medium laser in the left, and each torso sports a ER small laser. An energy targeting computer provides extra support the lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Fire Moth经过大幅改装的变型，通常只用于Batchall。五具独立的SRM-2发射器安装在机甲右臂，左臂则是一具重型中型激光，每个躯干各带一门增程小型激光。一台能量瞄准计算机为激光提供额外支持。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: As a quad design, the Fire Scorpion 1 lacks the amount of internal space that bipedal designs have, so its creators opted for two heavy guns; a LB 10-X Autocannon and an Ultra Autocannon/10. Each of these is fed by three tons of ammunition, giving the quad 'Mech enough shots to finish most Trials. To defend against unarmored infantry, the Fire Scorpion carries an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 作为四足设计，Fire Scorpion 1 的内部空间不如双足机甲充裕，因此设计者选择了两门重型火炮：一门 LB 10-X 自动炮和一门 Ultra 自动炮/10。两者各由三吨弹药供弹，让这台四足机甲拥有足以打完大多数试炼的弹药量。为防御无装甲步兵，Fire Scorpion 在每条腿上都装有一具反人员荚舱。 特性：头罩 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: The Fire Scorpion is a quadrupedal BattleMech designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists to be a totem 'Mech. It is visually similar to a scorpion, complete with a \"tail\" rising up from the rear of the BattleMech. The claw-like elements near the cockpit are actually armored guards, placed on either side of the head to keep ground troops from sniping at the cockpit. Scientists who designed it apparently believed in a quantity over quality approach, as the Fire Scorpion is rugged, cheap and primarily fielded by second-line forces that defend cities, the role in which it excels.
column2: 火蝎是歌利亚蝎部族的科学家设计的一款四足战斗机甲，意为图腾机甲。它外形酷似蝎子，机甲尾部还扬起一条“尾巴”。座舱附近的爪状部件其实是装甲护板，分列头部两侧，防止地面部队狙击座舱。设计它的科学家显然信奉数量胜于质量的思路：火蝎坚固、廉价，主要配属给守卫城市的二线部队，而它在这一角色上表现出色。

column1: The Fire Scorpion 2, which was introduced 3060 at the prompting of a Star Commander Temujin of the Twentieth Scorpion Cuirassiers, removes the weaponry of the base chassis and replaces it with a massive Ultra Autocannon/20, two LRM-10s, and four Machine Guns. This variants continues to excel in urban combat, especially against conventional infantry thanks to its anti-personnel Machine Guns. The inclusion of an Active Probe helps the MechWarrior locate hidden enemies. As with the base variant, ample ammunition ensures that the Fire Scorpion 2 rarely has to withdraw from a battlefield because of reduced ammo stores. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 火蝎2型于3060年应第二十蝎子胸甲骑兵团之星指挥官铁木真的要求而推出，它移除了基础底盘的武器，换上巨大的超级自动炮/20、两具LRM-10以及四挺机枪。该变型在城市作战中依旧表现卓越，尤其凭借其反人员机枪对付常规步兵。加装的主动探测器有助于机甲战士发现隐藏的敌人。与基础变型一样，充足的弹药让火蝎2型极少因弹药不足而被迫撤出战场。 特性：防护罩 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: First built in 2679, the standard Star League Defense Force model, the 3A utilizes an XL engine, double heat sinks, and Ferro-Fibrous armor to reduce weight. A battery of four Small Lasers, three Medium Lasers, and an LRM-5 provide significant offensive capabilities for a recon 'Mech. Target Acquisition Gear enhances its ability to spot for artillery, while CASE protects from ammunition explosion. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 标准星际联盟国防军型号于2679年首次建造，3A利用XL引擎、双散热器和铁纤维装甲减轻重量。四门小型激光、三门中型激光和一具LRM-5的武器组为侦察机甲提供了可观的进攻能力。目标捕获装置增强了它为炮兵观测的能力，CASE则防护弹药爆炸。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: As a scout 'Mech, the Firefly gives average performance with its energy weapon-heavy arsenal and is useful in both a recon and in a guerrilla fighter role.
column2: 作为侦察机甲，萤火虫凭借其偏能量武器的配置表现平平，但在侦察与游击作战中都颇为有用。

column1: A Pentagon Powers variant of the FFL-3SLE that removes the CASE and ECM in order to upgrade the missile rack to an LRM-10. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是五角势力对FFL-3SLE的变型，拆除了CASE和电子对抗套件，以便把导弹架升级为LRM-10。 <特性：改进传感器 <投放费用倍率：0.97 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂上段，右臂上段

column1: Another refit of the FFL-3SLE, this time simply using standard armor plating instead of the advanced Ferro-Fibrous composites. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是FFL-3SLE的又一次改装，这次只是改用标准装甲板，而不再使用先进的铁纤维复合材料。 <特性：改进传感器 <投放费用倍率：0.97 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂上段，右臂上段

column1: This variation on the -3SLE removes both the Ferro-Fibrous armor and the ECM system, instead upgrading the LRM rack with an Artemis IV fire-control system. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一 -3SLE 的变体取消了铁纤维装甲和电子对抗系统，转而用 Artemis IV 火控系统升级 LRM 发射器。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A basic variant of the Firefly that accompanied the Dragoons to the Inner Sphere, the 4A carries a similar weapons payload to the 4B model, although it keeps the small laser battery of the -3A instead of the anti-missile system. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是随龙骑兵一同来到内层星域的萤火虫基础变型。4A的武器载荷与4B型相近，但它保留了-3A的小型激光阵列，而没有采用反导弹系统。 <特性：改进传感器 <投放费用倍率：0.97 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂上段，右臂上段

column1: The main variant reintroducing the thought extinct 'Mech to the Inner Sphere by Wolf's Dragoons in 3005. The -4B only carries three Medium Lasers and an LRM-5 launcher as its main weaponry, unlike the original SLDF models and their direct descendents. However, the design does add an Anti-Missile System to the left arm. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一主要变型由狼之龙骑兵于3005年将这台被认为已经灭绝的机甲重新带回内层星域。-4B仅以三门中型激光与一具LRM-5发射器作为主要武器，与最初的SLDF型号及其直系后裔不同。不过，该设计确实在左臂加装了反导弹系统。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: As a scout 'Mech, the Firefly gives average performance with its energy weapon-heavy arsenal and is useful in both a recon and in a guerrilla fighter role. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为侦察机甲，Firefly 以能量武器为主的武器库使其表现中规中矩，在侦察和游击作战中都能派上用场。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The -7A is a strange rebuild of the Firefly. It's origins are unknown, but as it carries a mix of Clan and Inner Sphere tech, it is thought to be the result of mercenary outfits upgrading other versions with battlefield loot. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -7A是对萤火虫的一次奇怪重建。其来历不明，但由于它混装部族与内层星域技术，一般认为是雇佣兵部队用战场缴获品升级其他版本的结果。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This is a Clan variant of the Firefly that has been upgraded with all Clan technology and is mainly used by the Clans. The Firefly C is built on an Endo Steel chassis and is armed with four ER Small Lasers, three Medium Pulse Lasers, and an SRM-2 launcher. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是Firefly的部族变型，已用全套部族科技升级，主要由部族使用。Firefly C建造在内骨架底盘上，装备四门增程小型激光、三门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-2发射器。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上
