column1: Utilized in the final duel between Philip Capet's Capellan Mafia and Justin Allard on Solaris VII, the Firestorm features twin machine guns in its arms, a medium laser in each side torso, and retains the center torso mounted twin flamers. The Firestorm carries two tons of machine gun ammunition.
column2: 在菲利普·卡佩的卡佩兰黑手党与贾斯汀·阿拉德于索拉里斯VII的最终决斗中使用，火暴双臂装成对机枪，两侧躯干各一门中型激光器，并保留中央躯干成对的火焰喷射器。火暴携带两吨机枪弹药。

column1: The FS9-HB combines two Light Binary Lasers with four Flamers in an attempt to incorporate the rare blazer technology to improve the Firestarter's anti-Mech strength while still keeping its short range strengths. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: FS9-HB将两门轻型二元激光与四具火焰喷射器结合起来，试图借助稀有的二元激光技术提升纵火者的反机甲能力，同时保留其近距离优势。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage. Carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces. The FS9-H also makes a decent light 'Mech hunter-killer.
column2: 火焰使者就其吨位而言是危险的机甲。以火焰喷射器精心把握时机的攻击能让任何机甲停机，使其暴露在你其他部队的打击之下。FS9-H 也是出色的轻型机甲猎杀者。

column1: A battlefield refit of the FS9-H, adding a C3 slave unit at the cost of one of the Medium Lasers. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是FS9-H的野战改装，以其中一门中型激光为代价加装一台C3从机。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: One of the more common 'Mechs during large parts of the Succession Wars, the Firestarter is built for one purpose alone - to overheat enemies and then overwhelm them. Later models also started seeing use as a capable scout, showing the versatility of the base design.
column2: 火焰使者是继承战争大部分时期较常见的机甲之一，它只为一个目的而造——让敌人过热，然后将其压倒。后来的型号也开始被用作能干的侦察机甲，显示出基础设计的多用途性。

column1: A custom refit of the Firestarter originally used by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds, using a mix of captured clan technology and standard Inner Sphere tech. Since the variants introduction a number of the 'Mechs have been sold to other mercenary outfits. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬最初使用的纵火者定制改装，混用缴获的部族技术与标准内层星域技术。自该变型推出以来，已有若干台被卖给其他雇佣兵部队。 特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The FS9-MA is a periphery variant that has mostly a pretty standard Firestarter loadout with four flamers, but with the exception of a SRM-4 launcher with an attached Artemis IV FCS. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: FS9-MA 是一款外围地区变型，其配置大体上是标准的纵火者（Firestarter）装备——四具火焰喷射器——唯一的例外是一具附带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The FS9-MJ is a periphery variant that throws away most pretenses of durability to fit more weapons. A total of 6 Flamers, makes the variant a dangerous foe once it gets in range, and further even a SRM-6 launcher with an attached Artemis IV FCS for some extra punch. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: FS9-MJ 是一种外围地区变型，它几乎完全放弃了耐用性这一门面，以容纳更多武器。总共 6 门火焰喷射器使该变型一旦进入射程便成为危险的对手，此外还装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器，以增添几分额外的冲击力。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The FS9-MW is a periphery variant with an unusual loadout for the Firestarter. Not a single flamer is mounted, but instead a PPC, medium laser and a SRM-4 launcher with an Artemis IV FCS. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: FS9-MW 是一种外围地区变型，其武器配置对 Firestarter 而言颇为罕见。它一门火焰喷射器都没有装，取而代之的是一门粒子炮、一门中型激光，以及一具配备 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Piloted by William 'Pyro' Peterson of Banson's Raiders, this customized Firestarter manages to fit six Flamers and an ER Medium Laser, while still retaining most of its armor. It further carries some advanced cockpit components, further improving the design. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台定制版Firestarter由班森劫掠者部队的威廉·“纵火狂”·彼得森驾驶，在保留大部分装甲的同时，成功装下了六具火焰喷射器和一门增程中型激光。它还配备了若干先进驾驶舱组件，进一步提升了整机性能。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The original Flashfire lacks the FLS-P5's jump jets, and mounts two flamers and a medium pulse laser in each arm, as well as dual SRM-6 launchers on the right shoulder. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 原版“闪火”（Flashfire）没有 FLS-P5 的跳跃推进器，每条手臂各装有两具火焰喷射器和一门中型脉冲激光，右肩还装有一对 SRM-6 发射器。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Flashfire uses the varying payloads of the fluid guns to affect its enemies. The endo steel chassis and XL engine free up large amounts of weight, allowing the engineers to mount a variety of weapons. More importantly, it allows the Flashfire to carry jump jets that can easily carry the 'Mech 120 meters, very useful when a pilot wants to get behind an enemy to attack the weak rear armor.
column2: 闪火是一台索拉里斯 VII 战斗机甲，它利用流体炮不同的弹药来影响敌人。内骨架底盘和 XL 引擎腾出了大量重量，让工程师得以安装多种武器。更重要的是，它让闪火能携带跳跃推进器，轻松将机甲送过 120 米，这在飞行员想绕到敌人背后攻击薄弱的后部装甲时非常有用。

column1: The Flashfire P3 is quite similar to the P4, just applying a slightly different layout. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Flashfire P3 与 P4 相当相似，只是采用了略有不同的布局。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: This is a retrofit of the FLS-P2, and upgrades the weapons to that of the FLS-P5. It trades in one SRM-6 launcher for false ports and jump jets. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是FLS-P2的改装型，将武器升级到FLS-P5的水平。它用一具SRM-6发射器换来了假炮口与跳跃推进器。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A far cry from the fast and deadly 8K Flashman, the 7K model is a downgraded version that was produced by Defiance Industries in 2796 after the destruction of the Renault-Prime factories, using a blueprint that was acquired prior to the factory's destruction. The advanced extralight engine was no longer being produced though, and with a standard Vlar 300 the design now has a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. In addition, the center torso Large Laser, the AMS and the advanced targeting-tracking system were also removed and the double heat sinks replaced with standard single versions. The design now instead only carries two arm-mounted Large Lasers and five Medium Lasers. Surprisingly, the armor protection has not been sacrificed in any way, which has resulted in the 7K being more durable than the SLDF version due to its lack of an XL engine. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 与迅捷致命的8K型闪电相比，7K型是一台降级版本，由迪法恩斯工业于2796年在雷诺-普莱姆工厂被摧毁后、依据工厂毁灭前取得的图纸生产。然而先进的特轻引擎已不再生产，改用标准Vlar 300后，该设计的最高时速只剩64.8 km/h。此外，中央躯干的大型激光、反导弹系统以及先进的瞄准跟踪系统也一并被拆除，双散热器则换成标准单散热器。现在它只携带2门装在手臂上的大型激光和5门中型激光。令人意外的是，装甲防护丝毫没有缩水，这使得7K由于没有XL引擎，反而比星际联盟防卫军版本更耐打。 <特性：坚固 <投放费用倍率：1.09 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

column1: Boss, just sell this one. Its much lower heat sinking capacity, worse weaponry and slower speed compared with the base version just removes about everything that makes the standard Flashman useful.
column2: 老板，这台就卖掉吧。比起基础型号，它的散热能力低得多，武器更差，速度也更慢，几乎把标准型 Flashman 所有值得一提的优点都抹掉了。

column1: The Flashman is an underrated heavy 'Mech, commonly called a "flashbulb" by MechWarriors for its heavy-energy configuration. The Flashman, which was first introduced in 2701, is a 'Mech that is capable of engaging an enemy for extended periods of time with little re-supply. The primary weapons on the Flashman FLS-8K are three Large Lasers mounted in the right arm, left arm, and center torso. These are backed up by five Medium Lasers, two mounted in either arm coaxial to the large lasers, two in the left torso and one in the right. The Flashman also carries an Anti-Missile System with one ton of ammo in the right torso to defend against missile attacks, and a Flamer in the head, to deter infantry attacks. The use of a Faust/Shinji AT/TS targeting-tracking system gives the Flashman a level of accuracy few can match, while fifteen double heat sinks give it an effective heat management system. The 'Mech is also notable for using an extralight engine which makes it fast for its size, though not at the expense of protection thanks to thirteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 闪光侠是一款被低估的重型机甲，机甲战士常因它厚重的能量配置而称之为“闪光灯泡”。闪光侠于2701年首次推出，能长时间交战而几乎无需补给。FLS-8K的主武器是分别装在右臂、左臂和中央躯干的三门大型激光，辅以五门中型激光——两侧手臂各两门与大型激光同轴，左躯干两门、右躯干一门。闪光侠还在右躯干带一套反导弹系统（配一吨弹药）以防御导弹攻击，头部一具火焰喷射器以遏制步兵袭击。福斯特/真嗣AT/TS瞄准追踪系统的使用让闪光侠拥有少有人能及的精度，而十五个双散热器则构成了有效的热量管理系统。该机甲还以采用超轻型引擎著称，使它在同尺寸中速度很快，而十三吨半装甲确保这并未牺牲防护。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The base variant of the Flashman is better than its reputation makes you think, the combination of all those lasers with so many heat sinks means it can keep dishing out serious damage when most other 'Mechs will have to vent heat.
column2: 闪光人的基础改型比它的名声所暗示的更好，那么多激光器配上那么多散热器的组合，意味着在大多数其他机甲不得不排热时，它仍能持续输出沉重伤害。

column1: The personal 'Mech of David Kalasa, the Founding Khan of Clan Sea Fox, later renamed to Clan Diamond Shark. He was killed piloting it during Operation KLONDIKE, and while his 'Mech was recovered afterwards it somehow got "misplaced" during transport back from the battlefield. The 'Mech was heavily converted to use Clan tech, being able to convert all the lasers to Extended Range variants and still improve the cooling capabilities. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 海狐部族（后更名为钻石鲨部族）创始可汗大卫·卡拉萨的个人机甲。他在“克朗代克行动”中驾驶该机阵亡，机甲随后虽被回收，却在从战场运回的途中不知怎么地“弄丢”了。这台机甲经过大幅改装以使用部族技术，能够把所有激光都换成增程型号，同时还提升了散热能力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Amazing! This is the long lost personal 'Mech of one of the Clan Khans, even if we find no use for it I am sure it could be sold back for a profit...
column2: 太惊人了！这是某位氏族可汗失落已久的私人机甲，即便我们找不到用处，我相信也能卖出去赚一笔……

column1: A mercenary upgrade of the -8K, like many other similar upgrades the easier parts have been upgraded with 'aquired' clan tech. In the case of the -8KH, it is very reminisicent of the later introduced official variant -10E, which rumours says was heavily influenced by this design. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是雇佣兵对-8K的升级，与许多类似升级一样，较容易的部件都以“取得”的部族技术替换。就-8KH而言，它与后来推出的官方变型-10E极为相似；有传闻称后者深受这套设计影响。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The 9C, a complete overhaul of the Flashman produced by Defiance Industries for ComStar in 3061, carries three ER Large Lasers, four Medium Pulse Lasers, a single Medium Laser, and an Improved C3 computer. In order to accomplish this, the armor on the design has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous and the 'Mech now has an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 9C是Defiance Industries于3061年为通讯之星生产的闪电人全面翻新版，装有三门增程大型激光、四门中型脉冲激光、一门中型激光以及一台改进型C3计算机。为实现这一配置，该设计的装甲升级为铁纤维，机甲也改用内骨架底盘。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: A good upgrade to a good mech for its role, making it even better with stronger weaponry and a C3 unit. I bet many mercenary outfits would love to have one or two of these in their bays if it wasn't for the increased costs.
column2: 对本就胜任其定位的良机而言，这是一次不错的升级：更强的武器加上一套C3单元，让它更加出色。我敢说，要不是成本上涨，许多雇佣兵部队都会乐意在机库里备上一两台。

column1: Created during the Golden Century by Clan Sea Fox, the CS-1 Fox had few equals. The 50-ton Mech was powered by a 300-rated cXL engine, that propelled the Mech to speeds of 97 km/h. Protected by 10 tons of armor, the CS-1 Fox was armed with a pair of Improved LRM-15’s. At closer ranges, a trio of Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-2’s and a pair of Machine Guns provided additional firepower. Production of the Fox mysteriously stopped partway through the Golden Century as the Mech was dropped from use in the Sea Fox Touman. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: CS-1 Fox 由海狐部族在黄金世纪打造，当年几乎无人能与之匹敌。这台 50 吨机甲由 300 额定的 cXL 引擎驱动，最高速度可达 97 km/h。CS-1 Fox 由 10 吨装甲护体，武装为两具改进型 LRM-15。在更近的距离上，三门中型激光、两组连发 SRM-2 与两挺机枪提供额外火力。Fox 的生产在黄金世纪中途神秘中止，该机甲也随之从海狐部族的 Touman（战斗序列）中被除名。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: Created during the Golden Century by Clan Sea Fox, the CS-1 Fox had few equals. The 50-ton Mech was powered by a 300-rated cXL engine, that propelled the Mech to speeds of 97 km/h. Protected by 10 tons of armor, the CS-1 Fox was armed with a pair of Improved LRM-15’s. At closer ranges, a trio of Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-2’s and a pair of Machine Guns provided additional firepower. Production of the Fox mysteriously stopped partway through the Golden Century as the Mech was dropped from use in the Sea Fox Touman.
column2: 由海狐氏族在黄金世纪创造，CS-1狐几乎没有对手。这种50吨机甲由一具300级cXL引擎驱动，推动机甲达到97公里/小时的速度。CS-1狐由10吨装甲保护，武装为两具改进型LRM-15。在更近距离，三兄弟中型激光器、两具连发SRM-2和两挺机枪提供额外火力。狐的生产在黄金世纪中途神秘停止，该机甲被从海狐图曼中撤出使用。

column1: Created during the Golden Century by Clan Sea Fox, the CS-2 Fox had few equals. The 50-ton Mech was powered by a 300-rated cXL engine, that propelled the Mech to speeds of 97 km/h. Protected by 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the CS-2 Fox was armed with a pair of LRM-15’s and an ER Large Laser. At closer ranges, a pair of ER Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-2’s and a pair of Machine Guns provided additional firepower. Production of the Fox mysteriously stopped partway through the Golden Century as the Mech was dropped from use in the Sea Fox Touman. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 海狐部族在黄金世纪打造的CS-2狐狸几乎没有对手。这台50吨机甲由一台300额定cXL引擎驱动，速度可达97公里/小时；披挂10吨铁纤维装甲，CS-2狐狸装有一对LRM-15和一门增程大型激光。更近的距离上，两门增程中型激光、两具连发SRM-2和两挺机枪提供额外火力。狐狸的生产在黄金世纪中期神秘中断，该机甲也随之从海狐部队中撤出。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Created during the Golden Century by Clan Sea Fox, the CS-2 Fox had few equals. The 50-ton Mech was powered by a 300-rated cXL engine, that propelled the Mech to speeds of 97 km/h. Protected by 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the CS-2 Fox was armed with a pair of LRM-15’s and an ER Large Laser. At closer ranges, a pair of ER Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-2’s and a pair of Machine Guns provided additional firepower. Production of the Fox mysteriously stopped partway through the Golden Century as the Mech was dropped from use in the Sea Fox Touman.
column2: 由海狐氏族在黄金世纪创造，CS-2狐几乎没有对手。这种50吨机甲由一具300级cXL引擎驱动，推动机甲达到97公里/小时的速度。CS-2狐由10吨铁纤装甲保护，武装为两具LRM-15和一门增程大型激光器。在更近距离，两门增程中型激光器、两具连发SRM-2和两挺机枪提供额外火力。狐的生产在黄金世纪中途神秘停止，该机甲被从海狐图曼中撤出使用。

column1: The Foxfire FXR-4R was designed around its Center Torso mounted flamer, the original purpose of even creating the ultralight BattleMech. A small laser mounted in the head provides some secondary fire for self-defense, but the 'Mechs very high movement speed is by far its best defense. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 狐火FXR-4R是围绕安装于中央躯干的火焰喷射器设计的，而这也正是当初打造这台超轻型战斗机甲的本意。头部安装的一门小型激光提供些许自卫火力，但这台机甲极高的移动速度才是它最好的防御。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Foxfire is the brainchild of Karl von der Burg, a senior engineer with Defiance Industries. Inspired by flamethrower tanks used during the Second World War on Terra his goal became to create a highly mobile armored platform to deliver devastating overheating attacks on other 'Mechs. When first fielded, battlefield commanders were not sure of the role for such a 'Mech, which meant the Foxfire was usually put to use as a very mobile scout unit. However, once the strength of specialized incendiary lances was realized, the 'Mech quickly became a great success and quite a fearful target. As more modern cooling technology is being discovered, the heat from a few flamers do not pose such a large threat anymore and the Foxfire once again started falling back to its old scouting role.
column2: 狐火是挑战工业资深工程师卡尔·冯·德·伯格的创意。受地球第二次世界大战中火焰喷射坦克的启发，他的目标是造出一套高度机动的装甲平台，对其他机甲实施毁灭性的过热攻击。首次投入战场时，战场指挥官并不确定这种机甲的定位，因此狐火通常被当作非常机动的侦察单位使用。然而当专业化燃烧小队的威力被认识到之后，该机甲迅速大获成功，也成为相当可怕的目标。随着更现代的冷却技术不断被发现，几具火焰喷射器产生的热量已不再构成那么大威胁，狐火又一次退回了它旧的侦察角色。

column1: The 1A4 is the originally produced version of the Freedom, establishing the chassis line as long range missile boats. A total of four 15-tubed LRM launchers provide adequate fire power for both direct and indirect suppressive fire. Two Medium and one ER Large Laser are available as secondary firepower, although the cooling is insufficient to handle repeated use of the energy weapons. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 1A4 是自由（Freedom）最初量产的型号，确立了该底盘系列作为远程导弹火力平台的定位。总计四具 15 管 LRM 发射器提供了充足的火力，可执行直接与间接压制射击。两门中型激光和一门增程大型激光作为次要火力，不过其散热能力不足以支撑能量武器的反复使用。 特性：改进冷却套 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Juggernaut Missile Boat
column2: 主宰者导弹平台

column1: The Freedom is one of the heaviest missile boats designed during the Star League era. Although weighing in at 90 tons, the 'Mech is both lightly armored and not very mobile. It is therefore a clear second line 'Mech that has to be protected from flankers or direct frontal alpha strikes. The chassis was produced in a number of variants, all of them a common sight throughout the Inner Sphere.
column2: 自由是星盟时代设计的最重导弹平台之一。虽然重达 90 吨，这台机甲装甲轻薄、机动性差。因此它显然是二线机甲，必须防止被侧翼包抄或正面齐射直击。该底盘有若干变体，在内天体各地都很常见。

column1: The 1A5 is fully focused on its four LRM-20 launchers. The lack of any secondary weapons means the 'Mech is quite vulnerable to short range or flanking attacks, increasing the need for protection by other forces even further. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 1A5完全专注其四具LRM-20发射器。缺乏任何次要武器，意味着该机甲极易受到近程或侧翼攻击，因而更加依赖其他部队的保护。 特性：改进冷却套 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The 2B was considered the first of the second generation refresh of the Freedom chassis. In practice the changes are not very large beyond an updated weapons loadout, five LRM-10 launchers and one Large and one Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 2B 被认为是自由（Freedom）底盘第二代改进型的首款。实际上，除了更新的武器配置——五具 LRM-10 发射器以及一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光——之外，改动并不算大。 特性：改进冷却套 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Although marked as a simple refit of the 2B, the 2Br is in fact a considerably larger update to the design. By adding Artemis IV to its six LRM-10 launchers, the direct fire capabilities are much higher. Two Medium Pulse Lasers, one in each arm, are mounted as secondary and defensive firepower. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 虽然标注为2B的简单改装，2Br实际上是对该设计相当大幅度的更新。通过为其六具LRM-10发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV，直射能力大幅提高。两门中型脉冲激光（每臂一门）作为次要与防御火力。 特性：改进冷却套 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The 2F is the only variant using Ferro-Fibrous armor to save further weight. The extra tonnage is used to create a more flexible weapons profile to handle the increasing need for more tactical use of its ammunition. A combination of two LRM-20, two LRM-15 and two LRM-5 serve as the main weapons, while a single AC/2 provide further long range direct fire harassment capabilities. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 2F是唯一采用铁纤维装甲以进一步节省重量的变型。多出的吨位被用于打造更灵活的武器配置，以应对对其弹药战术运用日益增长的需求。两具LRM-20、两具LRM-15和两具LRM-5的组合构成主武器，而一门AC/2则提供额外的远程直射骚扰能力。 特性：改进冷却套 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The weapons payload on the Gallowglas is an all energy arsenal. The primary long-range weapon is a Tiegart Magnum ER PPC, which provides a powerful long-range punch. For intermediate ranges, the 'Mech carries two Sunglow Large Lasers. Finally, for short-range protection, the 'Mech has two Magna Quasar Medium Pulse Lasers and a Magna Starglow Small Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Gallowglas的武器载荷是全能量武库。主要远程武器是一门Tiegart Magnum增程粒子炮，提供强大的远程打击力。中距离上，机甲搭载两门Sunglow大型激光。最后，近距防护方面，机甲有两门Magna Quasar中型脉冲激光和一门Magna Starglow小型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Gallowglas was designed to counter the threat of the Clans. The 'Mech is produced by Blackwell Heavy Industries on Outreach and is built to be effective from its longest range to point-blank range. The 'Mech is built using an Endo Steel chassis to save weight and a 280 fusion engine for its durability. The Gallowglas is protected by a respectable twelve tons of armor, and the 'Mech uses eighteen double heat sinks to handle its heavy heat load.
column2: 绞刑台为应对氏族威胁而设计，由"外联"星上的布莱克韦尔重工生产，从最远射程到抵近射击都能有效作战。它采用内骨骼底盘减重，并选用 280 聚变引擎以其耐用性。绞刑台由可观的十二吨装甲保护，并使用十八台双倍散热器处理沉重的热负荷。

column1: The 2GLS variant of the Gallowglas is modified to increase its long-range effectiveness. This is done by removing the ER PPC, a Medium Pulse Laser, the Small Laser, as well as eight double heat sinks and replacing them with a Blackwell Fury Gauss rifle and two tons of CASE-protected ammunition. This modification greatly reduces the 'Mechs heat load and gives it a greater damage potential at long range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 绞刑吏的2GLS变型为增强远程效能而改装：拆掉增程粒子炮、一门中型脉冲激光、小型激光以及八个双散热器，换成一门布莱克威尔狂怒高斯步枪和两吨CASE防护弹药。这一改装大幅降低机甲的热负荷，并在远距离上赋予它更强的伤害潜力。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A variant of the Gallowglas available only to Wolf's Dragoons, the Gallowglas WD is built using all Clan technologies. The 'Mech carries an ER PPC as its primary weapon, and two ER Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers for close range combat; three double heat sinks are removed. The WD variant uses the weight savings to increase its engine size, allowing for a maximum speed of 86.4 km/h, making the WD a highly maneuverable and effective 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Gallowglas WD 是狼之龙骑兵专属的 Gallowglas 变型，完全采用部族技术打造。该机甲以一门增程粒子炮为主力武器，近距离作战则依靠两门增程中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光；同时拆除了三个双散热器。WD 变型利用减重带来的余裕增大了引擎，使其最高速度达到 86.4 km/h，令 WD 成为一款机动性极强、作战效率极高的机甲。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A special version of the Gallowglas for the Wold's Dragoons using all Clan technology. An ER PPC and two ER Large Lasers are the main damage dealers, while two Medium Pulse Laser and two ER Medium Lasers provbide secondary fire. Finally, two Small Pulse and one ER Small Laser provide short range defense. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是Gallowglas为狼龙骑兵团打造的特殊版本，全部采用部族科技。一门增程粒子炮和两门增程大型激光是主要的伤害来源，而两门中型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光提供次级火力。最后，两门小型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光负责近距防御。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Star Colonel Conal Ward used a custom configuration when he was commanding the 31st Wolf Solahma. Mounting a pair of ER PPCs in the right arm and a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left torso, the Gargoyle Conal could fight comfortably at long and short range. Each leg mounted a single A-Pod, and the center torso held an ECM Suite and a Light TAG unit for artillery spotting. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 星上校科纳尔·沃德在指挥第31狼族索拉马时使用一套定制配置。它在右臂装一对增程粒子炮，左躯干装一对连发SRM-6发射器，使石像鬼科纳尔能从容应对远近两种距离。每条腿各装一具A-Pod，中央躯干装有电子对抗套件和一具用于炮火观测的轻型TAG。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Fast Assault
column2: 快速突击

column1: The Gargoyle is an extremely fast assault OmniMech developed with the Timber Wolf as replacements for the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech. The Gargoyle is therefore commonly seen among Clan Wolf, and was a featured assault OmniMech during the Clan Invasion. The Gargoyle earned the code name Man O' War from the Inner Sphere forces because of its effectiveness. This dependable design eventually spread throughout the Clans, and can be seen with any of their Galaxies now.
column2: 石像鬼是一款极快的突击全能机甲，与木材狼一同开发以取代第一代"林中人"全能机甲。因此石像鬼在狼氏族中很常见，也是氏族入侵期间的标志性突击全能机甲。它的高效使内天体部队给了它"战舰"的代号。这款可靠的设计最终传遍各氏族，如今在任何星系都能见到。

column1: A loadout for engagements at medium to long ranges, the D2 mounts two LRM-20 and three ER Large Lasers. Three tons of LRM ammunition ensures enough salvos can be fired for most battles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为中远程交战载荷，D2装两具LRM-20和三门增程大型激光。三吨LRM弹药确保大多数战斗都能打出足够次数的齐射。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The E2 configuration combines the high damage output of an Ultra AC/10 with several ER Lasers. A Streak SRM-6, mounted in the right arm, provides some extra punch when needed. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E2 配置将 Ultra AC/10 的高伤害输出与多门增程激光结合起来。右臂搭载的一组连发 SRM-6 可在需要时提供额外的打击力。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Gargoyle F2 is a full energy configuration. Three Large Pulse Lasers, two in the right arm and one in the left, serve as the main sources of damage, while three ER Medium Lasers in the Left Torso provide secondary damage capacity. A single ER Small Laser in the right torso allows dealing with infantry at very close ranges. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Gargoyle F2 是全能量配置。三门大型脉冲激光（右臂两门、左臂一门）是主要的伤害来源，左躯干的三门增程中型激光则提供次级伤害能力。右躯干的一门增程小型激光使其能够在极近距离上对付步兵。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The G2 loadout is mainly for close range fighting, with its massive LBX AC/20 in the right arm. The left arm contains three ER Medium Lasers, and another five ER Small Lasers are mounted in the left torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: G2配置主要用于近距离作战，右臂装有一门巨型LBX AC/20。左臂装有三门增程中型激光，左躯干另装有五门增程小型激光。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This configuration of the Gargoyle was created for anti-squad and infantry fighting, but can also be successful against light 'Mechs or Vehicles. Four Medium Pulse Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers provide accurate daamge, while a Flamer and Stream SRM-6 can provide more damage as needed. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 石像鬼的这一配置专为反班组与步兵作战而设计，但在对付轻型机甲或车辆时同样能奏效。四门中型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光提供精准的伤害，而一具火焰喷射器和一具Stream SRM-6则可在需要时补充更多伤害。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A customized variant of the Gargoyle allegedly piloted by Ulric Kerensky, the Kin Wolf uses an LB 2-X Autocannon in its left and right arms. In the left torso, a pair of Streak SRM-4s . A Streak SRM-6s and an AMS with one ton of AMS ammo is carried in the right torso. Both torsos carry a ton of LB-X and Streak ammo. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 亲族狼（Kin Wolf）是石像鬼（Gargoyle）的定制变型，据称由乌尔里克·克伦斯基（Ulric Kerensky）驾驶，其左右手臂各装有一门 LB 2-X 自动炮。左躯干内装有一对连发 SRM-4。右躯干则装有一具连发 SRM-6 和一套 AMS，并配有一吨 AMS 弹药。两侧躯干各携带一吨 LB-X 与连发弹药。 特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Also an effective all around 'Mech, the A configuration ups the firepower with two ER PPCs as its primary long-range weapons. These are supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate range engagements and a Medium Pulse Laser, ER Medium Laser, and ER Small Laser for close combat.
column2: A 配置同样是全能有效的机甲，以两门 ER PPC 为远程主武器提升火力。中距离交战由一门大型脉冲激光支援，近战则由一门中型脉冲激光、一门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光负责。

column1: The Primary Gargoyle configuration is capable of engaging enemies at a variety of ranges. For long range encounters, the Gargoyle has two LB 5-X Autocannon that are capable of firing both solid rounds and cluster ammunition, making the 'Mech effective against aircraft and vehicles. For short ranges, the 'Mech has two SRM-6 launchers and a single ER Small Laser which provide adequate close in protection. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Gargoyle 的 Prime 配置能够在多种距离上与敌人交战。远程交战时，Gargoyle 装有两门 LB 5-X 自动炮，可发射实心弹和集束弹药，使该机甲在对付飞机和车辆时十分有效。近距离方面，该机甲装有两具 SRM-6 发射器和一门增程小型激光，可提供足够的近身自卫能力。 特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Primary Gargoyle configuration is capable of engaging enemies at a variety of ranges. For long range encounters, the Gargoyle has two LB 5-X Autocannon that are capable of firing both solid rounds and cluster ammunition, making the 'Mech effective against aircraft and vehicles. For short ranges, the 'Mech has two SRM-6 launchers and a single ER Small Laser which provide adequate close in protection.
column2: 石像鬼的主配置能在多种距离上接敌。远程交战时，它有两门 LB 5-X 自动炮，可发射实心弹与集束弹，对飞行器与车辆都很有效。近距离则有两具 SRM-6 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光，提供足够的近身防护。

column1: The Garm is capable of providing both direct and indirect fire support. For direct fire support, the Garm has a LB-X AC/5, capable of firing both standard and cluster ammunition. A LRM-10 launcher provides the Garm with added long-range combat capabilities and allows indirect fire support. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 加尔姆能够同时提供直接与间接火力支援。直接火力方面，它装有1门LB-X自动炮/5，可发射标准弹和集束弹；1具LRM-10发射器则赋予加尔姆额外的远程作战能力，并使其能够进行间接射击支援。\n<特性：扩展躯干旋转\n<投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Garm is designed to operate as part of a fire support lance, providing long-range direct fire for other units, and as such, the Garm competes directly with the Valkyrie BattleMech. To make the Garm capable of carrying the weapons needed to carry out its intended mission, it is built on an endo steel chassis that weighs half as much as a standard chassis, while an 175 fusion engine allows it a maximum speed of 86.4 km/h. The mobility enjoyed by the Garm is enhanced with five Rawlings 80-beta jump jets that make the 'Mech capable of jumping up to 150 meters. The Garm does have relatively light armor for a 'Mech of its size, with only three and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor; this is because the Garm depends on its ability to engage an enemy at long range rather than closing to short ranges.
column2: 加尔姆被设计为火力支援小队的成员，为其他单位提供远程直射火力，因此它与女武神战斗机甲直接竞争。为使加尔姆能携带执行预期任务所需的武器，它建在重量只有标准底盘一半的内骨架底盘上，而一台175聚变引擎让它最高可达86.4公里/小时。加尔姆享有的机动性还由五具罗林斯80-β跳跃推进器增强，使机甲可跳跃至多150米。就体型而言，加尔姆的装甲相对轻薄，只有三吨半铁纤维；这是因为加尔姆依赖在远距离上交战，而非逼近到近程。

column1: The 01B variant of the Garm is built to operate independently of supply lines and increases its long-range indirect fire capabilities. To do this, the Garm removes the heavy LB-X AC/5 and replaces it with an ER large laser. The 'Mech also adds an Artemis IV fire control system to increase the accuracy of its LRM-10 launcher. Finally, the 'Mech adds two single heat sinks and an additional ton of armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 加尔姆的 01B 变型专为脱离补给线独立作战而设计，并强化了远程间接火力。为此，加尔姆拆掉了沉重的 LB-X AC/5，换装一门 ER 大型激光。该机甲还加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，以提高 LRM-10 发射器的精度。最后，它还增加了两台单散热器和一吨装甲。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A simple refit of the GLD-3R, dropping on of the Jump Jets to add more armor. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这是GLD-3R的简单改装，拆掉其中一具跳跃推进器以增加装甲。 特性：机罩 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The original Gladiator used primitive technologies, so it only had a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. In addition, it could only manage a top speed around 64 km/h. It was protected by sixteen and a half tons of Primitive Armor. The GLD-1R went out of production by 2488. During the Jihad, several companies began producing this primitive design of Gladiator as a part of the appearance of RetroTech on the battlefield, driven by the need for war materiel; companies which produced the primitive Gladiator during this era included Rastaban Agricultural Products, Metals of the Earth and Sword of the Prophet Enterprises although many of these manufacturing lines had closed down by 3079.
column2: 原版角斗士使用原始技术，因此只有一门大型激光和两门中型激光。此外它最高速度仅约 64 公里/小时。它由十六吨半原始装甲保护。GLD-1R 于 2488 年停产。圣战期间，随着"复古技术"在战场上出现，若干公司出于战争物资需求开始生产这一原始设计的角斗士；此时期生产原始角斗士的公司包括拉斯塔班农产品、大地金属和先知之剑企业，不过其中许多生产线到 3079 年已关闭。

column1: Descended from the Star League era Galahad, the Glass Spider is a second line Clan Battlemech specializing in anti aircraft and direct fire support duties. A 60-ton mech, the Glass Spider is powered by a 240-rated Fusion Engine and relies on a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel skeleton. A pair of Gauss Rifles form the mechs only weapons and are supplied by 5 tons of ammo. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: The Gnome battle armor was created by Clan Hell's Horses in response to Inner Sphere responses to the ubiquitous Elemental battle armor. Since its introduction the Gnome has been eclipsed in size by other assault-weight suits but still serves as the mainstay in most Hell's Horses' front-line Clusters and found its way into the toumans of other Clans through various Trials. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 朱儒战斗装甲由地狱马部族研制，用于回应内层星域对无处不在的元素战斗装甲的应对措施。自问世以来，朱儒在体型上已被其他突击级装甲超越，但它仍是地狱马部族大多数一线集群的主力装备，并通过各种试炼流入其他部族的军队。 特性：装甲强化 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可近战，无法攀附攻击。

Since its introduction the Gnome has been eclipsed in size by other assault-weight suits but still serves as the mainstay in most Hell's Horses' front-line Clusters and found its way into the toumans of other Clans through various Trials.
column2: 地精战斗装甲由地狱马氏族创造，以回应内天体对无处不在的元素战斗装甲的应对。自推出以来，地精在尺寸上已被其他突击重量级战斗服超越，但它仍是大多数地狱马前线集群的骨干，并通过各种试炼流入其他氏族的图曼。

column1: The -1A manages to squeeze in a AC/20 in the right torso while still keeping the two LRM-10 launchers, only removing the Machine Guns and PPC. To save weight the design however drops all the extra heatsinks, leaving the 'Mech more at risk of overheating. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: -1A设法在右躯干塞入了一门AC/20，同时仍保留两具LRM-10发射器，只拆除了机枪与粒子炮。然而为节省重量，该设计舍弃了所有额外散热器，使这台机甲更容易过热。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: An 80-ton Quad Mech, the Goliath entered production in 2652. Partially based on data from the earlier Scorpion Quad Mech, the Goliath carries a heavier payload of weapons and armor, intended to boost its effectiveness on the battlefield. Powered by a 320-rated Fusion Core, the Goliath GOL-1H is armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-10’s. A pair of Machine Guns provide closer ranged firepower.
column2: 作为一款 80 吨四足机甲，歌利亚于 2652 年投产。它部分基于早期四足机甲蝎式的数据，携带更重的武器与装甲载荷，意在提升战场效能。GOL-1H 歌利亚由一台 320 额定聚变核心驱动，装备一门 PPC 和一对 LRM-10。两挺机枪提供更近距离的火力。

column1: A short range version of the Goliath, the 1C mounts two SRM-6 launchers and an AC/10, with one medium and two small lasers as support. The variant is surprisingly effective at dealing with infantry and battle armor squads. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 作为 Goliath 的近距离版本，1C 装有两具 SRM-6 发射器和一门 AC/10，另有一门中型激光和两门小型激光作为辅助。该变型在对付步兵和战斗装甲小队时效果出奇地好。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: The Goliath GOL-1E has two main weapons, a Large Laser and an Autocannon AC/10. Two SRM-4 launchers are mounted in the Left Torso for close quarters engagements. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 歌利亚GOL-1E有两件主要武器：一具大型激光和一门自动炮AC/10。左躯干装有两具SRM-4发射器，用于近身交战。 特性：多履带 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: An 80-ton Quad Mech, the Goliath entered production in 2652. Partially based on data from the earlier Scorpion Quad Mech, the Goliath carries a heavier payload of weapons and armor, intended to boost its effectiveness on the battlefield. Powered by a 320-rated Fusion Core, the Goliath GOL-1H is armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-10’s. A pair of Machine Guns provide closer ranged firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 歌利亚（Goliath）是一台 80 吨四足机甲，于 2652 年投产。它部分基于早期四足机甲蝎子（Scorpion）的数据，可搭载更重的武器与装甲配置，旨在提升战场效能。GOL-1H 型歌利亚由一台额定 320 的聚变核心驱动，装备一门粒子炮和两具 LRM-10，另有两挺机枪提供较近距离的火力。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: A battlefield refit of the Goliath, with the aim of improving its long range combat capabilities and durability. The LRM-10 launchers are now supported by Artemis IV attachments, both sides torsos are protected by C.A.S.E. and the cockpit has been armored to improve MechWarrior survivability. A C3 slave unit is also mounted in the Center Torso to improve squad efficiency and the cooling system has been upgraded to use double heat sinks. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这是歌利亚（Goliath）的战场改装，旨在提升其远程作战能力与耐用性。LRM-10 发射器现在配有 Artemis IV 附件，两侧躯干由 C.A.S.E. 保护，座舱也加装了装甲以提升机甲战士的生存能力。中央躯干还装有一台 C3 从属单元以提升小队作战效率，冷却系统则升级为使用双散热器。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: An 80-ton Quad Mech, the Goliath entered production in 2652. Partially based on data from the earlier Scorpion Quad Mech, the Goliath carries a heavier payload of weapons and armor, intended to boost it's effectiveness on the battlefield.
column2: 作为一台80吨四肢机甲，歌利亚于2652年投产。它部分基于更早的蝎式四肢机甲的数据，携带更重的武器与装甲载荷，意在提升其战场效能。

column1: A refresh of the -1H, this variant upgrades the weapons to use LRM-15 launchers and an ER PPC. A Guardian ECM suite and three Medium Pulse Lasers are also added to the design. A switch to double heat sinks, dropping the Machine Guns and use of an XL engine allows all the changes, and still allows increasing the armoring to 17.5 tons. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这一变型是对 -1H 的翻新，武器升级为 LRM-15 发射器和一门 ER PPC。设计上还增加了守卫者电子对抗套件和三门中型脉冲激光。改用双散热器、拆除机枪以及采用 XL 引擎使这些改动成为可能，并且还让装甲得以增加到 17.5 吨。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: The COL-3J combines an LRM-20 launcher with a Gauss Rifle for long range damage, and two Streak SRM-4 launchers for short range engagements. Two ER Medium Laser provide extra firepower as needed. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: COL-3J 将一部 LRM-20 发射器与一门高斯步枪结合以提供远程伤害，另配两部连发 SRM-4 发射器用于近距离交战。两门 ER 中型激光可在需要时补充火力。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: The COL-3J combines an LRM-20 launcher with a Gauss Rifle for long range damage, and two Streak SRM-4 launchers for short range engagements. Two ER Medium Laser provide extra firepower as needed.
column2: COL-3J把一具LRM-20发射器与一门磁轨炮结合用于远程伤害，另有两具连发SRM-4发射器用于近距离交战。两门增程中型激光器在需要时提供额外火力。

column1: The 3M is a 3047 upgrade of the Goliath that uses Star League technology. The 'Mech has had a 320 XL Engine installed to reduce the engine's weight by half. The 'Mech retains the LRM launchers and Machine Guns of the 1H model. The 'Mech replaces the PPC with a Gauss Rifle which gives the Goliath devastating long-range firepower. The 'Mech still suffers from its close combat deficiencies but with its updated arsenal most 'Mechs are hard pressed to close to short range. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 3M是歌利亚于3047年采用星际联盟技术的升级型。该机甲安装了320 XL引擎，使引擎重量减半。它保留了1H型号的LRM发射器和机枪。粒子炮被换成一门高斯步枪，为歌利亚带来毁灭性的远程火力。该机甲近距离战斗的短板依旧存在，但凭借更新后的武器库，大多数机甲都难以逼近到短程。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: An alterate variant to the 3M, using Small Pulse Lasers instead of the Machine Guns. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这是3M的另一种变型，以小型脉冲激光取代了机枪。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. With a standard LRM-10 launcher and one ton of ammunition, the Gorgon can provide almost as much firepower as a Valkyrie. For close in work, the Gorgon mounts an ER Micro Laser. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: 戈耳工是一款重型火力支援单位，常作为原生机甲点的支柱。凭借一具标准LRM-10发射器和一吨弹药，戈耳工能提供几乎与女武神相当的火力；近战方面，它装一门增程微型激光。 特性：标准部件 投放费用倍率：0.978

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. With a standard LRM-10 launcher and one ton of ammunition, the Gorgon can provide almost as much firepower as a Valkyrie. For close in work, the Gorgon mounts an ER Micro Laser.
column2: 戈耳工是一种重型火力支援单位，常作为原型机甲小队的核心。凭借一具标准LRM-10发射器和一吨弹药，戈耳工能提供几乎与瓦尔基里相当的火力。近距离作战时，戈耳工装有一门增程微型激光器。

column1: The first production model of the Grand Crusder. A 240 XL engine propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 54.0 km/h, while still leaving enough weight capacity for a balanced design. The Grand Crusader is protected by 15.5 tons of armor and, to handle the 'Mech's heat burden, the Grand Crusader carries 10 double heat sinks. The Grand Crusader is well-armed to engage an enemy at medium to long ranges. The primary long-range weapons are a pair of LRM-20 launchers fed from a combined six ton of ammunition, mated with an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy. For medium range combat, the Grand Crusader has two Large Pulse Lasers and, for close range combat, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers. For added protection against missile attacks, the Grand Crusader carries an AMS, mounted on a pivot point on top of the cockpit. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Grand Crusader 的首款量产型号。一台 240 XL 引擎推动机甲达到 54.0 km/h 的最高速度，同时仍留有足够的重量余量以实现均衡设计。Grand Crusader 由 15.5 吨装甲保护，为应对机甲的热负荷，它搭载了 10 个双散热器。Grand Crusader 武装精良，适合在中远距离与敌人交战。主要远程武器是两部 LRM-20 发射器，由共六吨弹药供弹，并搭配阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统以提高导弹精度。中距离作战时，Grand Crusader 有两门大型脉冲激光；近距离作战时，则有两门中型脉冲激光。为进一步抵御导弹攻击，Grand Crusader 还在座舱顶部的一个旋转基座上安装了一套 AMS。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Grand Crusader
column2: 大十字军

column1: The Grand Crusader has a massive barrel-chested profile that harkens back to designs like the Awesome or Mackie and lending it an almost steam-age appearance, reinforced by the large smoke-stack style sensor pylons rising from its back. Built to maximize its available space for weapons and equipment, the Grand Crusader uses a weight saving Endo Steel chassis and XL engine. A common misconception is that the model is named after the Crusader 'Mech, but this is not the case. The name is instead taken from a revered blakeist quote.
column2: 大十字军拥有宽厚胸膛般的庞大轮廓，令人想起神奇或麦基等设计，赋予它近乎蒸汽时代的外观，背上升起的大烟囱式传感器塔更强化了这一印象。它被建成以最大化可用武器与装备空间，采用减重的内骨骼底盘与 XL 引擎。一个常见误解是它以大十字军机甲命名，事实并非如此——名字取自一句受人尊崇的布雷克派语录。

column1: The -01-U production variant retains larger 320 XL engine of the -01-X prototype, but keeps the pulse lasers from the -01. This meant that over 5 tons of the armoring of the 'Mech had to be removed, and as a result this variant never saw any larger success and was only produced in limited numbers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -01-U 量产变型保留了 -01-X 原型机较大的 320 XL 引擎，同时沿用 -01 的脉冲激光。这意味着机甲的装甲必须削减超过 5 吨，因此该变型从未取得太大成功，仅小批量生产。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A prototype based of the -01 model with some experimental upgrades. Two shoulder mounted turrets containing the Artemis IV enabled LRM-20 launchers and an upgraded 320 XL engine were the key highlights of the prototype. However, it's energy weaponry had to be reduced to only one ER Large Laser and five normal Medium Lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是以-01型号为基础、带若干实验性升级的原型机。原型的两大亮点是两座肩载炮塔（内含带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20发射器）和一台升级的320 XL引擎。但其能量武器不得不削减为一门增程大型激光和五门标准中型激光。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: One of two subvariants of the -02 line of the Grand Crusader, based of the -01-X prototype. The -02 kept the original 240XL engine from the -01 over the upgraded 320XL engine of the prototype, and dropped the shoulder turrets as they were causing reliability concerns. These changes allows the addition of two LRM5 launchers to the Mech's arms instead of the Medium Lasers. The two Large Pulse Lasers and the two LRM-20 launchers were kept untouched from the -01 model. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是大十字军-02系列两个子变型之一，基于-01-X原型。-02保留了-01原装的240XL引擎，而非原型升级的320XL引擎，并因可靠性顾虑拆掉了肩载炮塔。这些改动使它能在机甲手臂上装两具LRM5发射器取代中型激光。两门大型脉冲激光和两具LRM-20发射器则从-01型号原封不动地保留下来。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: One of two subvariants of the -02 line of the Grand Crusader based on the -01-X prototype. The -02-B retained the larger engine of the prototype, but like the other production models based of it dropped the shoulder turrets. The design switched to two ER Large Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers as the energy weapons, while keeping the -01's Anti Missile System. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是大十字军-02系列两个子变型之一，以-01-X原型为基础。-02-B保留了原型更大的引擎，但与基于它的其他量产型号一样拆掉了肩载炮塔。该设计改用两门增程大型激光和两门中型脉冲激光作为能量武器，同时保留-01的反导弹系统。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The -02-W is a battlefield refit if the -02-B often used by experienced Grand Crusader pilots. With just a small adjustment to the chassis, the Medium Pulse Lasers were able to be moved into the side torsos, thus making the loss of an arm less crippling. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -02-W 是 -02-B 的战地改装型，常由经验丰富的 Grand Crusader 机师使用。只需对骨架略作调整，中型脉冲激光便能移入侧躯干，从而使失去一条手臂不再那么致命。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This first generation Grand Dragon was customized by Team Banzai MechWarrior Douglas Running-Elk. Not keen on high temperatures, Douglas refitted his captured Grand Dragon to run with cooler weapons. He had the 'Mech's PPC removed for a Class 5 Autocannon with one ton of ammunition. He then downgraded its LRM Launcher to a 5 Rack with single ton of ammunition. He removed all the forward medium lasers and replaced them with a single 6-tubed Short Range Missile Launcher. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是第一代大龙式，由班载小队的机甲战士道格拉斯·奔鹿定制。道格拉斯不喜欢高温，因此将自己缴获的大龙式改装为使用温度更低的武器。他拆除了机甲的粒子炮，换成一门5级自动炮并配一吨弹药。随后把LRM发射器降级为5联装，备弹一吨。他还拆除了所有前向中型激光，代之以一具6管短程火箭发射器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: Grand Dragon
column2: 大龙

column1: Now this one here is interesting. A custom 'Grand Dragon' nearly remade back into a 1N. The pilot was Professor Douglas Running-Elk who was both a MechWarrior and a Scholar. Interesting combination wouldn't you say?
column2: 这一个挺有意思。一台定制的"巨龙"几乎被改回了1N。飞行员是道格拉斯·奔鹿教授，他既是机师又是学者。挺有趣的组合，你不觉得吗？

column1: Sorenson's Sabres member Emory Wilk's Dragon was among the earliest new-tech "Grand" upgrades in the lead-up to the War of 3039. It was rebuilt with less refined bulkier Endo Steel chassis and 3039 era double strength heat sinks, retaining only the medium laser and carrying a prototype ER Large Laser and LRM-15 with two tons of reloads as its main weapons. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 索伦森之剑成员埃默里·威尔的龙，是3039年战争前夕最早的一批新技术的“巨龙”升级机之一。它用较粗糙、更臃肿的内骨架底盘和3039年时期的双倍强度散热器重建，只保留中型激光，主武器则是一原型增程大型激光和一具带两吨再装填弹药的LRM-15。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Grand Dragon is the successful follow-up to the Dragon BattleMech. Just like the Dragon, the Grand Dragon quickly became a favorite in the DCMS, with nearly every line unit fielding a company of either design. Production of the Grand Dragon continued unabated until the Jihad, when the Word of Blake devastated LAW's factories in 3068. It took two years for LAW to get new Grand Dragon factories up and running, the first on Nykvarn followed by Abiy Adi and Savinsville, and ensure the continued use of the 'Mech in years to come.
column2: Grand Dragon 是 Dragon 战斗机甲的成功后继型号。与 Dragon 一样，Grand Dragon 迅速成为龙脉联合体军队中的宠儿，几乎每个一线单位都编有一个连的这两款设计中的一款。Grand Dragon 的生产一直持续到圣战爆发——3068 年，布莱克之词摧毁了卢西恩装甲工厂的厂房。卢西恩装甲工厂花了两年时间才让新的 Grand Dragon 工厂恢复运转，第一家位于 Nykvarn，随后是 Abiy Adi 和 Savinsville，从而确保这款机甲在未来继续服役。

column1: A Grand Dragon variant introduced in 3050, mainly for use by commanding officers. It has dropped the rearward-firing medium laser in the left torso section to free up tonnage for a Command Console. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是3050年推出的巨龙变型，主要供指挥官使用。它拆掉左躯干的后向中型激光，以腾出吨位安装指挥控制台。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A command variant of the Grand Dragon DRG-5K, dropping one medium laser to fit a Command Console cockpit. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是巨龙DRG-5K的指挥变型，拆掉一门中型激光以装入指挥控制台座舱。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The DGR-5K Grand Dragon introduced in 3050 incorporates a number of lostech improvements over the original DRG-1G.Mounted in its right arm is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. The ER PPC is backed up by a LRM-10 in the center torso, which gives the 'Mech an impressive and formidable long-range striking capability. The launcher is fed by a two-ton reload bin in the left torso protected by CASE. If an enemy 'Mech gets into close ranges, the Grand Dragon carries three Victory 23R Medium Lasers for defense, one in the left arm and two split between the rear-facing left and right torso. Protected by ten tons of armor, the Grand Dragon uses thirteen double heat sinks for excellent heat management and uses a 16.5 ton Hermes 360 XL engine to achieve a moderate cruising speed of 64 km/h.
column2: 3050 年推出的 DGR-5K 大龙在原版 DRG-1G 基础上融入了多项失传技术改进。右臂装一门"主之光 2"ER PPC。这门 ER PPC 由中央躯干一具 LRM-10 支援，为机甲带来惊人而强劲的远程打击能力。发射器由左躯干一个受 C.A.S.E. 保护的两吨弹药箱供弹。若敌方机甲逼近，大龙携带三门"胜利 23R"中型激光用于防御，一门在左臂，两门分置于后向左、右躯干。由十吨装甲保护，大龙使用十三台双倍散热器实现出色的散热管理，并采用一台 16.5 吨的赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎达到 64 公里/小时的中等巡航速度。

column1: Designed by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, the Grand Titan was conceived to take on and defeat any opponent. Built around a 400-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel chassis, the Grand Titan has 18 tons of armor. The Grand Titan carries a large arsenal of weapons that allow it to work best at short to medium range. The longest-range weapon carried is an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-15 with 2 SRM-6's for closer range engagements. Two Large Pulse Lasers, two Medium Pulse Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers provide additional mid to short range firepower. An AMS system provides a degree of protection from missiles. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: Grand Titan 由 Vining Engineering and Salvage Team 设计，构想是能够迎战并击败任何对手。它以 400 额定的 XL引擎与内骨架底盘为基础，拥有 18 吨装甲。Grand Titan 搭载庞大的武器库，使其在中近距离表现最佳。射程最远的武器是一门带 Artemis IV 增强的 LRM-15，另有两具 SRM-6 用于更近距离的交战。两门大型脉冲激光、两门中型脉冲激光与两门小型脉冲激光提供额外的中近距离火力。AMS 系统则提供一定程度的导弹防护。 特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The N11M model of the Grand Titan is a major modification of the design. The 'Mech carries as its primary long-range weapons a Light Gauss Rifle and an ER PPC which gives the 'Mech powerful long-range reach. The 'Mech has for short-range combat four Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. It is also protected by a Guardian ECM Suite. This upgrade brings the Grand Titan to modern standards and makes it as powerful on the battlefield now as it was when it was first released. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: Grand Titan 的 N11M 型号是该设计的重大改进版本。该机甲以一门轻型高斯步枪和一门增程粒子炮作为主要的远程武器，赋予它强大的远程打击范围。近程作战方面，它有四门中型脉冲激光和两具连发 SRM-4 发射器。它还受一具守护者电子对抗套件保护。这次升级使 Grand Titan 达到现代标准，让它在今日战场上的威力与首次问世时同样强大。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Grand Titan T-IT-N11M2 is despite its name not related to the -N11M version, instead it was a parallel design project. Two LBX AC/10 act as the main weapons, while a LRM-10 and seven lasers of various sizes and types provide more firepower as needed. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 大泰坦T-IT-N11M2虽然名字相近，却与-N11M版本并无关联，而是一个并行设计项目。两门LBX AC/10作为主武器，一具LRM-10和七门各种规格与类型的激光按需提供更多火力。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: A battlefield refit of the GHR-5H, replacing two heat sinks with a small laser, a C3 Slave unit and C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 蚱猛 GHR-5H 的战场改装版，用一门小型激光、一套 C3 从属单元和为弹药加装的 C.A.S.E. 防护换掉了两台散热器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.08

column2: 重型散兵与骑兵

column1: Don't be fooled by its whimsical name, the Grasshopper is a killer that specializes in hunting down light and medium 'Mechs. Its superb jump ability and good armor allow it to get behind foes easily to bring its all-Energy weapons to bear.
column2: 别被它古怪的名字骗了，蚱猛是个专精猎杀轻中型机甲的杀手。其卓越的跳跃能力与良好的装甲使它轻易绕到敌后，倾泻全能量武器。

column1: A rare version of the Grasshopper mainly seen with various mercenary outfits. Two ER Large Lasers, four Medium Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers provide significant damage capabilities, with a Stream SRM-4 as backup for close range engagements. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是蚱猛的罕见版本，主要见于各类雇佣兵部队。两门增程大型激光、四门中型激光和两门中型脉冲激光提供可观的伤害能力，另有一具溪流SRM-4作为近距交战的后手。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The 5KH is a Clan tech refit originally fielded by the Kell Hounds. Its weapons loadout consist of an ER Large Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-6 launchers. An Anti-Missile System helps protect the 'Mech. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 5KH是最初由凯尔猎犬投入使用的部族技术改装。它的武器包括一门增程大型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和两具连发SRM-6发射器，一套反导弹系统帮助保护机甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: An upgrade package incorporating Helm core technology, the Grasshopper 5P is armed with 2 Medium Lasers, 2 Medium pulse Lasers and 2 PPCs with Double Heat Sinks installed to handle the increased heat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5P是采用地狱核心技术的一套升级方案，装备2门中型激光、2门中型脉冲激光和2门粒子炮，并安装了双散热器以应对增加的热量。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: An upgrade package incorporating Helm core technology, the Grasshopper 5P is armed with 2 Medium Lasers, 2 Medium pulse Lasers and 2 PPCs with Double Heat Sinks installed to handle the increased heat.
column2: 作为纳入地狱核心技术的升级包，蚱猛5P装有2门中型激光、2门中型脉冲激光和2门粒子炮，并安装双散热器以应对增加的热量。

column1: The Grasshopper GHR-5S upgrades the cooling to use double heat sinks, allowing the Large Laser to be exchanged for an Extended Range version. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 蚱猛GHR-5S把冷却升级为双散热器，从而把大型激光换成增程版本。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: First observed in the Periphery, the Grasshopper 6H is a refit of the standard 5H that improves the Grasshoppers utility as a scout/skirmisher. A relatively simple refit, the 6H removes 7 heat sinks and replaces the rest with double strength models. A second Large Laser is mounted in the Right Arm and the standard ammunition bay is swapped for a CASE protected one. The remaining weight is dedicated to a rare Beagle Active Probe, improving the Grasshoppers scouting capabilities in urban environments. Since being observed in the Periphery, this refit has spread throughout the Inner Sphere, with every House possessing at least 1 unit. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 6H最初在外围地区被发现，是标准型5H的改装版，提升了Grasshopper作为侦察/游击机甲的实用性。这是一次相对简单的改装：6H拆掉了7具散热器，其余全部换成双倍强度的型号。右臂加装第二门大型激光，标准弹药舱则换成受CASE保护的款式。剩余重量用于加装一具罕见的Beagle主动探测器，提升Grasshopper在城市环境中的侦察能力。自在外围地区被发现以来，这项改装已传遍整个内层星域，每个大家族都至少拥有1台。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: First observed in the Periphery, the Grasshopper 6H is a refit of the standard 5H that improves the Grasshoppers utility as a scout/skirmisher. A relatively simple refit, the 6H removes 7 heat sinks and replaces the rest with double strength models. A second Large Laser is mounted in the Right Arm and the standard ammunition bay is swapped for a CASE protected one. The remaining weight is dedicated to a rare Beagle Active Probe, improving the Grasshoppers scouting capabilities in urban environments. Since being observed in the Periphery, this refit has spread throughout the Inner Sphere, with every House possessing at least 1 unit.
column2: 首次在外缘被发现，蚱猛6H是标准5H的改装，提升了蚱猛作为侦察/游击手的实用性。这是一次相对简单的改装，6H拆掉7具散热器，其余换成双倍强度型号。右臂加装第二门大型激光器，标准弹药舱换成CASE保护型。剩余重量用于一个稀有的比格犬主动探测器，提升蚱猛在城市环境中的侦察能力。由于在外缘被发现，这一改装已遍布内天体，每个家族都至少有一台。

column1: The customized Grasshopper used by 3rd Davion Guards Hauptmann Reynolds Allen when he commanded the Allen's Animals raiding company during Operation Bird Dog. To help him hold out against Clan Smoke Jaguar forces on Luzerne, this 'Mech's standard weapons were replaced with a trio of Clan-Tech ER large lasers mounted in the head and center torso supported by a Clan ER Medium Laser mounted in each arm and side torso. The remaining free weight was devoted to IS-grade double heat sinks. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 这是第3戴维恩卫队上尉雷诺兹·艾伦在“猎鸟犬行动”期间指挥“艾伦的动物”袭掠连时使用的定制蚱猛。为帮助他在卢泽恩对抗烟虎部族部队，该机甲的武器被换成三门部族技术增程大型激光（装在头部与中央躯干），并由每只手臂与每侧躯干上的一门部族增程中型激光支援。剩余重量则全部用于内层星域级双散热器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: The customized Grasshopper used by 3rd Davion Guards Hauptmann Reynolds Allen when he commanded the Allen's Animals raiding company during Operation Bird Dog. To help him hold out against Clan Smoke Jaguar forces on Luzerne, this 'Mech's standard weapons were replaced with a trio of Clan-Tech ER large lasers mounted in the head and center torso supported by a Clan ER Medium Laser mounted in each arm and side torso. The remaining free weight was devoted to IS-grade double heat sinks.
column2: 这是达维昂第三卫队的上尉雷诺兹·艾伦在"鸟犬行动"期间指挥艾伦动物突袭连时使用的定制蚱猛。为帮助他在卢泽恩对抗烟虎氏族部队，这台机甲的标准武器被替换为三门装在头部与中央躯干的氏族科技增程大型激光器，由装在双臂与两侧躯干各一门的氏族增程中型激光器支援。剩余的自由重量全部用于内天体级的双重散热器。

column1: Although called the Grasshopper II, this variant is just a modified Grasshopper used by certain mercenaries. It mounts a Large Pulser Laser and an ER Large Laser as the main damage weapons, with four Medium and two Small Lasers providing extra damage as needed. What makes the 'Mech stand out from other Grasshoppers is its large hatchet carried in the left hand. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 虽然被称作蚱猛II，此变型其实只是某些雇佣兵使用的改装蚱猛。它装一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程大型激光作为主要伤害武器，四门中型和两门小型激光按需提供额外伤害。让该机甲区别于其他蚱猛的，是它左手携带的那把大战斧。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

column2: 蚂蚱II

column1: Though Gray Death Scout armor has no integral weapons, its Armored Gloves allow soldiers to wield standard small arms and perform other functions as normal. While this does not allow for very much damage potential against hardened targets, a scout squad can be a serious threat to unarmored infantry. The armored gloves, in combination with the suit's strength enhancements, allows the trooper to ride on OmniMechs via their handholds or perform anti-'Mech attacks. That the trooper's natural dexterity is otherwise unaffected by the suit is an added bonus for placing Satchel Charges in exposed 'Mech joints. Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 尽管灰死侦察装甲没有内置武器，其装甲手套却让士兵能像平常一样使用标准轻型枪械并执行其他动作。虽然面对坚固目标时谈不上有多大杀伤潜力，但一支侦察小队对无装甲步兵而言仍是严重威胁。装甲手套结合装甲服的力量增幅，使士兵能抓着把手搭乘全向机甲，或发动反机甲攻击。而士兵天生的灵巧度不受装甲服影响，这一点对于把炸药包塞进机甲外露的关节处更是额外的好处。 <特性：情报收集者 <投放费用倍率：0.886 <可搭载全向单位，可近战，可攀爬攻击。

column2: 灰死侦察型

column1: Gray Death Scout is a radical take on battle armor, almost taking the \"battle\" out of battle armor. When the New Avalon Institute of Science sent prototypes of its Inner Sphere Standard to the Gray Death Legion, the mercenaries were duly impressed with many of its features. They also had a number of criticisms, sending a long list of improvements back to NAIS while Legion technicians went about with their own tinkering. By late 3051 the Legion had created two distinct suits from the original prototype: a Gray Death Standard similar in form and function of the Inner Sphere Standard, and a light \"scout armor\" suit. By stripping off more than half of the prototype's armor and its integrated weaponry, the technicians were able to improve the Scout's jumping and sensor capabilities, creating a suit suitable for deep reconnaissance missions.
column2: 灰死侦察型是对战斗装甲的一次激进演绎，几乎把战斗装甲中的"战斗"二字去掉了。当新阿瓦隆科学院把其内天体标准型的原型送到灰死军团时，这些雇佣兵对其许多特性印象深刻。他们同时也提出了不少批评，把一长串改进清单送回NAIS，而军团的技师们则自行鼓捣起来。到3051年末，军团已从原型发展出两种截然不同的战斗服：一种在形态与功能上类似内天体标准型的灰死标准型，以及一种轻型"侦察装甲"服。通过剥除原型超过一半的装甲与整合武器，技师们得以提升侦察型的跳跃与传感器能力，造出一套适合纵深侦察任务的战斗服。

column1: The Gray Death Standard battle armor was developed by the technicians of the Gray Death Legion after the New Avalon Institute of Science sent them prototype battle armor suits, the progenitors of what eventually became the Inner Sphere Standard, for field testing. Using what was learned from these tests, the Legion decided to remove the suits' jump jets to make room for dedicated anti-infantry firepower, superior sensor systems, and reinforced myomer bundles to improve ground speed. While losing the ability to leap over obstacles, these changes made the suit easier to maintain and cheaper to build than the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

column1: The Gray Death Standard battle armor was developed by the technicians of the Gray Death Legion after the New Avalon Institute of Science sent them prototype battle armor suits, the progenitors of what eventually became the Inner Sphere Standard, for field testing. Using what was learned from these tests, the Legion decided to remove the suits' jump jets to make room for dedicated anti-infantry firepower, superior sensor systems, and reinforced myomer bundles to improve ground speed. While losing the ability to leap over obstacles, these changes made the suit easier to maintain and cheaper to build than the Inner Sphere Standard.

column1: As an early Clan design, the Great Wyrm utilizes less advanced technology compared to later Clan 'Mechs. As such, it is built on a standard chassis, powered by a 225 fusion engine, and is protected by seven tons of armor. A max speed of 86.4 km/h was respectable, and the heat generated was kept under control by the base 10 double heat sinks. The Great Wyrm mounts weaponry that covers all ranges, giving it good engagement flexibility. For long-ranges it makes use of a LRM-10 and a pair of UAC/2s, and uses its speed to stay out of the range of most enemies' guns while peppering them with these. If any enemy manages to close, or if the one ton of ammunition for those weapons is expended, the Great Wyrm also mounts a pair of ER medium lasers and ER small lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 作为早期的部族设计，Great Wyrm 所采用的技术不如后来的部族机甲先进。因此它采用标准底盘建造，由一台 225 聚变引擎驱动，并以七吨装甲防护。86.4 km/h 的最高速度在当时称得上可观，而基础配备的 10 具双散热器足以控制产生的热量。Great Wyrm 的武器覆盖了所有距离段，赋予它良好的交战灵活性。远程方面，它使用一具 LRM-10 和两门 UAC/2，并利用速度保持在大多数敌人武器的射程之外，同时不断用这些武器骚扰对手。若有敌人成功逼近，或者这些武器的一吨弹药耗尽，Great Wyrm 还搭载了两具增程中型激光与增程小型激光。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：右上臂

column1: The Great Wyrm was one of the first unique Clan BattleMechs ever developed. Clan Mongoose scientists used the specifications for the Dragon as the basis for their new creation, and were able to update it to their liking in a little more than a year. Not only was it designed to Clan specifications, but the Mongoose creators reduced the Dragon's weight by 15 tons. The Great Wyrm first saw action in 2844 against Clan Star Adder, and soon found its way into the touman of every Clan. With the development of the OmniMech, however, the Great Wyrm was reduced to a solahma unit and production finally ceased in 2872.
column2: 巨蛇是有史以来最早开发的部族独有机甲之一。猫鼬部族的科学家以巨龙的规格作为新造物的基础，并在一年多的时间里按自己的喜好完成更新。它不仅按部族规格设计，猫鼬的创造者还把它比巨龙减重15吨。巨蛇于2844年首次对星蝰部族作战，随后很快进入每个部族的部队。然而随着全向机甲的出现，巨蛇被降为索拉马单位，并最终于2872年停产。

column1: The Grendel features a powerful 315-rated engine, enabling it to move at a fleet 119 km/h, and enough jump jets fixed on the chassis to propel it up to 210 meters at a leap. The Sharks spared no expense in weight-saving materials, making use of an XL Engine, Endo Steel structure, and seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The incredible speed of the Grendel is not terribly helpful in most zellbrigen duels, but it is effective in large-scale actions. The primary configuration uses an ER Large Laser at long range, but really excels at closer ranges. It mounts three ER Medium Lasers that can be devastating to light 'Mechs and a Streak SRM-6 that exploits any holes the lasers make. An ER Small Laser that is effective at point-blank range seems an afterthought. This design is best using its large laser to soften up an opponent, then dash closer in a flurry of lasers and missiles. Two extra double heat sinks help to keep the design mostly cool. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 格伦德尔配备一台强劲的315额定引擎，能跑到119公里/小时的舰队速度；底盘上还固定了足够的跳跃推进器，一次跃升可达210米。鲨鱼部族在减重材料上不惜工本，用上了XL引擎、内骨架结构和七吨半铁纤维装甲。格伦德尔惊人的速度在大多数zellbrigen决斗中帮助不大，但在大规模行动中相当有效。主配置在远距离使用一门增程大型激光，但真正擅长的是更近的距离：它装三门增程中型激光，对轻型机甲极具毁灭性，另有一具连发SRM-6，利用激光打出的破口。一门在零距离上有效的增程小型激光则像是事后添补。这套设计最好的用法是先用大型激光削弱对手，然后迅速逼近，以一连串激光与导弹收尾。两个额外双散热器帮助该设计大体保持凉爽。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Designed after the personal ‘Mech of Elle Bennett of the 5th Donegal Guards, the GRF-1E 'Sparky' is a radical departure from standard Griffin design ethos. In place of its typical missile rack, the 1E features enough power couplings to mount a cluster of Medium Lasers - five of them, in fact - alongside the typical PPC. In a curious design decision, the engineers behind the Sparky opted for an innovative radiator pattern instead of more sophisticated heat sinks, likely as a cost-saving experiment. While this does give the 'Mech above-average heat dissipation, it's provided complement of standard heat sinks is still woefully inadequate for such a high heat load. This means that, while powerful, this 'Mech needs an equally disciplined pilot to avoid cooking alive. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: GRF-1E“闪电”以第5多尼戈尔卫队埃勒·班尼特的私人机甲为蓝本设计，是对标准狮鹫设计理念的一次激进背离。1E以其典型的导弹挂架位置，改装了足够的动力接头来装一组中型激光——实际上是五门——外加标准粒子炮。一个令人费解的设计决定是，闪电背后的工程师选择了一种创新的散热片布置，而非更精密的散热器，很可能是出于省钱的实验。虽然这确实赋予机甲高于平均的散热能力，但它配装的标准散热器对如此高的热负荷仍远远不够。这意味着它虽然强力，却需要同样自律的飞行员才能避免被活活烤熟。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07
