column1: One of the Vining Engineering and Salvage Team’s more curious creations, the Ion Raptor is a hand built marque of battlemechs built with salvaged mech chassis's from the Clan front lines. First debuting in 3053, the original Ion Raptor was built from the remains of a Masakari and a Crab. Built specifically for the Solaris Arenas, less than a dozen Ion Raptors are known to exist, though speculation is rife that VEST intends to sell the design to a major manufacturer in the near future. The ION-2R is the standard model offered by VEST and the most well known one. 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and 4 Streak-4’s form the bulk of the Mechs armament, with a pair of Large Lasers providing a ranged punch. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为维宁工程与打捞队较为奇特的造物之一，离子猛禽是手工打造的机甲品牌，使用从部族前线缴获的机甲底盘。首台离子猛禽于3053年首次亮相，由一架正餐和一只蟹的残骸拼装而成。它专为索拉里斯竞技场而造，已知存世不足十二台，不过盛传VEST打算在不久的将来把该设计卖给一家大型厂商。ION-2R是VEST提供的标准型号，也是最知名的一款。4门中型脉冲激光和4具连发-4构成机甲武器的绝大部分，另有一对大型激光提供远程打击力。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The A configuration of the Iron Cheetah mounts two Large Pulse Lasers and one Ultra AC/20 as the main weapons. Two Streak SRM-6 launchers provide some extra close quarters damage potential. To defend against infantry, the 'Mech also carries six machine guns. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: The ultimate creation by the Smoke Jaguars, they luckily never had the chance to mass produce this beast before they got crushed during Operation Bulldog.

column1: Mounting two Large and six Medium Pulse Lasers and a targetting computer optimizing their output makes the B configuration of the Iron Cheetah quite lethal. Four Jump Jets have also been added for better flanking and mobility. However, it struggles to vent all the generated heat in warmer biomes, making its usefulness situational. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 装有两门大型脉冲激光和六门中型脉冲激光，再加上一台优化其输出的瞄准计算机，使 Iron Cheetah 的 B 配置相当致命。它还加装了四具跳跃推进器，以便更好地实施侧翼包抄和机动。不过在较炎热的环境中，它难以排散产生的全部热量，使其用处受限。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The C configuration mounts four Extended Range Large Lasers and four Medium Pulse Lasers. Combined with a LRM-15 launcher, there is great damage potential even at longer ranges. Two Streak SRM 2 launchers add some extra punch in close quarters. Even with 24 double heat sinks, the generated heat is almost half again over the cooling capacity, so pilots have to be careful with their weapons usage. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C配置装四门增程大型激光和四门中型脉冲激光，配合一具LRM-15发射器，即便在较远距离上也有巨大伤害潜力。两具连发SRM 2发射器在近距提供额外打击力。即便有24个双散热器，产生的热量仍几乎超出冷却能力一半，因此飞行员必须谨慎使用武器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The D configuration uses a combination of four ER Lasers, one Gauss Rifle and an Ultra Autocannon/20. An ECM suite is also added in the Center Torso. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D 配置结合使用了四门增程激光、一门高斯步枪与一门 Ultra AC/20。中央躯干还加装了一套电子对抗套件。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The E configuration combines the two base ER PPC with one Large and one Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. A center mounted ER Small Laser for anti-infantry and a ECM suite completes the loadout. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E 配置在两门基础增程粒子炮的基础上，为每条手臂各加装一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光。中央安装的一门反步兵用增程小型激光，以及一套电子对抗套件，构成了完整的配置。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Iron Cheetah's F configuration is based from the B loadout, but adds another Large Pulse Laser instead of the jump jets. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 铁猎豹的F配置以B载荷为基础，但以另一门大型脉冲激光取代跳跃推进器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The last OmniMech created by Clan Smoke Jaguar, the Iron Cheetah is the pinnacle of their OmniMech design line. Building upon the success of the Dire Wolf, the clan engineers created a brutal and efficient killer. By using an Endo Steel chassis, a 400 XL engine and 16 ton of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the largest weakness of the Dire Wolf - its slow speed - was corrected, yet still leaving an impressive 39.5 tons of free pod space. The Prime configuration uses this space to mount two ER PPC, two Medium Pulse Lasers, one Gauss Rifle and an Artemis IV-enabled LRM15. For close range defense it also carries an ER small laser and an AMS system. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 铁猎豹是烟虎部族打造的最后一款全向机甲，也是其全向机甲设计路线的巅峰。在恐狼的成功基础上，部族工程师造出了一头残酷而高效的杀手。通过采用内骨架底盘、一台400 XL引擎和16吨铁纤维装甲，恐狼最大的弱点——速度迟缓——得到纠正，同时还留出惊人的39.5吨自由挂载空间。主配置用这些空间装了两门增程粒子炮、两门中型脉冲激光、一门高斯步枪和一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM15；近程防御另有一门增程小型激光和一套反导弹系统。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Jackal JA-KL-1532 was armed with a simple but effective arsenal. The primary weapon carried by the 'Mech is an ER PPC, which allowed the Jackal to damage a target at just under 700 meters, while a Streak SRM-2 missile launcher provided close combat power. An anti-missile system was mounted on the 'Mech's head for missile defense; each system carried a ton of ammunition. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 豺狼JA-KL-1532的武器简单却有效：主武器是一门增程粒子炮，使豺狼能在略低于700米的距离上伤害目标；一具连发SRM-2导弹发射器提供近战火力。机甲头部装有一套反导弹系统用于导弹防御，每套系统各带一吨弹药。 特性：改进冷却套 - 粒子炮 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Developed by the Solaris VII-based Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, the Jackal was designed to give as equal of a performance as possible to a Clan 'Mech of equal weight. While intended for the battlefield rather than the arenas, the prototype's stellar run on Solaris attracted the attention of number of 'Mech manufacturers, most notably Earthwerks Incorporated of Keystone. While Earthwerks ultimately secured the main production rights to the design, VEST was allowed to maintain limited garage level production as well.
column2: 由总部设在索拉里斯VII的维宁工程与打捞队研制，豺狼的设计目标是尽可能达到与同重量部族机甲相当的性能。虽然它是为战场而非竞技场而造，原型机在索拉里斯的出色表现仍吸引了一批机甲厂商的注意，其中最著名的是基斯通的地球工厂公司。虽然地球工厂最终取得该设计的主要生产权，VEST仍获准保留有限的车库级生产。

column1: The JA-KL-1540 is able to mount an extra Medium Laser over the JA-KL-1532 by switching to double heat sinks, thus reducing the total need by one sink. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: JA-KL-1540通过改用双散热器，比JA-KL-1532多装一门中型激光，因为总散热器需求减少了一个。 特性：改进冷却套 - 粒子炮 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Conceived as a long-range infantry support Mech, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass produced without regard for its design flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor armor; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the design. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-8T to carry an AC/2 and a Streak SRM-2, both with a single ton of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为一款远程步兵支援机甲，命运多舛的兔耳袋狸在阿马里斯政变前数周才进入原型阶段。它不顾设计缺陷而被量产，这25吨机体受困于贫弱的火力与糟糕的装甲，因此名声不佳并最终灭绝。兔耳袋狸由一台150额定聚变引擎驱动，带3.5吨铁纤维装甲，最高速度97公里/小时。内骨架结构使兔耳袋狸JKR-8T得以携带一门AC/2和一具连发SRM-2，两者各配一吨弹药。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 4.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-9R to carry a Large Laser and a Streak SRM-2 with a single ton of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为一款远程步兵支援机甲，命运多舛的兔耳袋狸在阿马里斯政变前数周才进入原型阶段。它不顾设计缺陷而被量产，这25吨机体受困于贫弱的火力与糟糕的装甲，因此名声不佳并最终灭绝。兔耳袋狸由一台150额定聚变引擎驱动，带4.5吨铁纤维装甲，最高速度97公里/小时。内骨架结构使兔耳袋狸JKR-9R得以携带一门大型激光和一具连发SRM-2（配一吨弹药）。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Conceived as a long-range infantry support Mech, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass produced without regard for its design flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor armor; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the design. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 4.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-9R to carry a Large Laser and a Streak SRM-2 with a single ton of ammo.
column2: 作为远程步兵支援机甲而构想，命运多舛的豺兔在阿马里斯政变前几周才进入原型测试。25吨的豺兔在无视设计缺陷的情况下量产，火力贫血、装甲糟糕，结果名声不佳，该设计最终灭绝。豺兔由一具150级聚变引擎驱动，携带4.5吨铁纤装甲，最高速度97公里/小时。内层钢骨架让豺兔JKR-9R能携带一门大型激光器和一具连发SRM-2配一吨弹药。

column1: The JagerMech IIC carries a LB-X AC/5 and an Ultra AC/2 in each arm, with enough ammunition to keep the weapons firing for longer engagements. Two ER Medium Lasers act as close range secondary weapons and four Jump Jets allow the 'Mech to reposition easily. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 猎手IIC每只手臂装一门LB-X AC/5和一门超级AC/2，弹药充足，可在较长交战中持续射击。两门增程中型激光作为近程次要武器，四具跳跃推进器让机甲能轻松重新站位。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: JagerMech IIC
column2: 猎手机甲 IIC

column1: As the SLDF left the Inner Sphere during Operation EXODUS, only a limited number of JagerMech were brought with them due to it only being produced for a few years. As time passed and the now Clans started perfecting their technological advances, they created a rebuilt and greatly improved JagerMech. Once the 'Mech was seen by Inner Sphere forces it was given the IIC designation as many other Clan rebuilds of already known chassis.
column2: 由于SLDF在“大逃亡行动”中离开内层星域时，猎手机甲只生产了几年，因此被带走的数量有限。随着时间推移，如今的部族开始完善其技术进步，他们造出了一款重建并大幅改进的猎手机甲。当这款机甲被内层星域部队看到后，便像许多其他已知底盘的重建版一样被冠以IIC编号。

column1: One of two 100 ton IIC variant created by the cleans mounts four Gauss Rifles with 16 tons of ammunition, and nothing else. This leaves the 'Mech very vulnerable if engaged directly, and was considered a colossal failure. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是“洁净派”打造的两款100吨IIC变型之一，装四门高斯步枪与16吨弹药，别无他物。这使该机甲在正面交战中极为脆弱，被视为一次彻底失败。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: As 70 ton JagerMechs started appearing, the Clans took an interest and created two offshoot upgraded versions. Although designated as IIC, the designs in reality probably does not warrant the moniker as the result was a 100 ton largely rebuilt version that just kept a somewhat similar appearance of the Inner Sphere variants.
column2: 随着70吨的猎兵机甲陆续出现，部族也产生了兴趣，并衍生出两种升级版本。虽然被冠以IIC的名号，这些设计其实未必当得起这个称呼——最终产物是一台100吨、几乎彻底重制的机甲，只是外观上还保留了内层星域变型的几分相似。

column1: JagerMech IIC JM6-IIC V2-UK
column2: 猎手机甲IIC JM6-IIC V2-UK

column1: The second 100 ton IIC variant created by the Clans drops four ton of Gauss ammunition for two Medium Pulse Lasers to add some self-protection. This minor change did not change the fact that the whole project was seen as a huge failure, and was quietly cancelled not long after. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是部族打造的第二款 100 吨 IIC 变型，它削减了四吨高斯弹药，换来两门中型脉冲激光以增强自卫能力。这一细微改动并未改变整个项目被视为巨大失败的事实，不久后它便被悄然取消。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The primary weapons the JagerMech III JM6-D3 carries, for long-range combat, are two Ultra Autocannon/2s that are capable of hitting with light damage out to seven hundred and fifty meters. For intermediate ranges, in spite of the state-of-the-art construction techniques used on the 'Mech, the JagerMech III relies on two PPCs backed up by two Medium Lasers for close combat. The -D3 carries armor in line with its role as a long-range 'Mech, with only nine and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Finally, to dissipate waste heat, the 'Mech has twelve double heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JagerMech III JM6-D3 用于远程交战的主要武器是两门 Ultra 自动炮/2，能够以轻微伤害打到七百五十米之外。在中距离上，尽管这台机甲采用了最先进的建造工艺，JagerMech III 仍依靠两门粒子炮，并以两门中型激光支援近战。作为一台远程机甲，-D3 的装甲也与其定位相符，仅有九点五吨铁纤维装甲。最后，为散发废热，该机甲装有十二台双散热器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: JagerMech III
column2: 猎手机甲 III

column1: As part of First Prince Victor Steiner-Davion's attempt to rebuild national pride in the Federated Commonwealth, the JagerMech underwent a redesign and was christened the JagerMech III and introduced in 3058. The JagerMech III is built along a similar philosophy as the original: keeping an enemy at range. To make this new JagerMech III fit into the mobile warfare doctrine embraced by the AFFC, the 'Mech is powered by a massive 325 XL engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h while weighing half as much as a standard fusion engine. To save even more weight, the JagerMech III is built on an endo steel chassis. The design has suffered some criticism for its lack of CASE to protect its ammunition, especially given the amount of advanced technology onboard.
column2: 作为第一亲王维克托·施泰纳-达维昂重建联邦共同体民族自豪感努力的一部分，猎手经过重新设计，被命名为猎手III，并于3058年推出。猎手III遵循与原版相似的哲学：让敌人保持距离。为使这台新猎手III契合AFFC所推崇的机动作战学说，该机甲由一具巨大的325 XL引擎驱动，使其最高速度达86.4公里/小时，而重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半。为再省重量，猎手III建在内层钢底盘上。该设计因缺乏CASE保护其弹药而受到一些批评，尤其考虑到舰上搭载的先进技术数量。

column1: A variant of uncertain origins, but likely on one of the Gamesworlds despites the unsuitability of the chassis for arena combat. Four LRM-5 launchers allow causing some light damage before its SRM and Medium Lasers are in range. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一变型来历不明，但很可能出自某个竞技世界，尽管该底盘并不适合竞技场战斗。四具 LRM-5 发射器让它在 SRM 和中型激光进入射程之前，就能先造成一些轻微伤害。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The JagerMech was designed as an anti-aircraft platform and long-range fire support unit intended to correct several perceived faults of the original Rifleman. Kallon Industries went about reviewing the battlefield performance of the Rifleman and identified three critical flaws: it ran too hot, it was too lightly armored, and it didn't carry enough ammunition. Kallon's engineers built the JagerMech with these issues in mind and while they managed to address the heat and ammunition problems they were unable to increase its armoring despite the larger chassis. In the end the company saw this as less of an issue since, as they noted, the JagerMech is a second-line 'Mech whose long-ranged autocannons allow it to engage many enemies without suffering return fire.
column2: 猎手机甲被设计为防空平台与远程火力支援单位，意在纠正原版步枪手的若干已知缺陷。卡隆工业在审查步枪手的战场表现后找出三个关键缺陷：过热、装甲过薄、弹药携带不足。卡隆的工程师在建造猎手机甲时考虑到了这些问题，虽然他们成功解决了过热与弹药问题，却未能即便在更大底盘上增强其装甲。最终公司认为这不成大问题，因为他们指出猎手机甲是一款二线机甲，其远程自动炮使它能在不受还击的情况下与众多敌人交战。

column1: The DD was the first variant incorporating technology recovered from the Gray Death Memory Core. The DD replaces the standard engine with an XL model and converts the armor to ferro-fibrous, adding an additional half-ton. The Mydron Medium Autocannons are replaced by General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannons, and the Magna standard lasers are replaced with Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Lasers. CASE is mounted in both side torsos to protect the ammunition, with the AC/2 ammunition doubled and moved into these side torsos to take advantage of this. The original design's single heat sinks are retained. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: DD是首个纳入灰死记忆核心所回收技术的变型。DD把标准引擎换成XL型号，装甲改为铁纤维并增加半吨。迈德隆中型自动炮换成通用汽车新星-5超级自动炮，马格纳标准激光换成苏特尔精密线中型脉冲激光。两侧躯干都装了CASE保护弹药，AC/2弹药翻倍并移入这些侧躯干以利用这一保护。原型设计的单散热器被保留。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Sniper & Direct-Fire Support
column2: 狙击手与直射火力支援

column1: This field refit was the result of inspired technicians working on JagerMechs undergoing major overhauls. Introduced in 3054 it replaces the autocannons with two Gauss Rifles and six tons of ammunition. In order to accommodate this change, the lasers were swapped out for ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这项战场改装是技师们在为JagerMech进行大修时灵光一现的成果。它于3054年推出，以两具高斯步枪与六吨弹药取代了自动炮。为配合这一改动，激光也换成了增程中型激光。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The DDa is a Jihad-era refit first spotted in 3070. A hybrid of the JM6-D and JM6-DD, it uses the chassis, engine, CASE-protected ammunition bays, and armor of the JM6-DD with a weapons complement similar to the JM6-D. The standard Autocannon/5 and Light AC/2s have similar range characteristics, and can use special munitions. The autocannon and twin medium lasers are also tied into an advanced Targeting Computer. As the weapons are comparatively cool, ten single heat sinks are used to dissipate heat buildup
column2: DDa是圣战时期的改装，于3070年首次被发现。它是JM6-D与JM6-DD的混合体：沿用JM6-DD的底盘、引擎、CASE防护弹药舱与装甲，武器配置则类似JM6-D。标准AC/5与轻型AC/2射程特性相近，且可使用特种弹药。自动炮与双联中型激光也接入一台先进瞄准计算机。由于这些武器相对低温，使用十个单散热器散发积累的热量

column1: An obvious update to the DG field refit introduced in 3058. It replaces the standard medium lasers with ER medium lasers thus justifying the upgrade of the heat sinks to double-strength models. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是对 3058 年推出的 DG 野战改装的明显更新。它以增程中型激光取代标准中型激光，从而为将散热器升级为双倍强度型号提供了充分理由。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The JagerMech Firebrand swaps the signature AC/5s for PPCs and extra heatsinks, giving it reliable long range damage. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JagerMech Firebrand 将标志性的 AC/5 换成粒子炮与额外的散热器，从而获得稳定的远程伤害能力。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The JagerMech Firebrand swaps the signature AC/5s for PPCs and extra heatsinks, giving it reliable long range damage.
column2: 猎手布兰德把招牌的AC/5换成PPC和额外散热器，赋予它可靠的远程伤害。

column1: A battlefield refit of the JM6-S, the -SR trades the two Medium Lasers for a C3 slave unit and C.A.S.E. protection for the autocannon ammunition. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -SR是JM6-S的野战改装，以一台C3从机和自动炮弹药的C.A.S.E.防护取代两门中型激光。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed by the famous 'Tricky Dick', this custom variant has the attached design notes of: When you think of 'bad' 'Mechs, the JagerMech has to be one that comes to mind. By adding an XL engine with double heat sinks and Endo Steel, we were able to save enough weight that we could remove the two Ultra Autocannon/5's, and replace them with ER PPCs! As usual, maximum armor is a must, and the 'Mech can fire its long range suite of weapons with no heat buildup. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是著名“狡猾迪克”设计的定制变型，附带的说明是：说到“糟糕”的机甲，猎手机甲必然是其中一个。通过加入带双散热器的XL引擎和内骨架，我们得以省下足够重量，拆掉两门超级AC/5，换成增程粒子炮！照例，最大装甲是必须的，而该机甲能发射其远程武器组合而不产生热量积累。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A mercenary refit of the classical JagerMech, replacing all weapons with a Light Gauss Rifle in each arm and three Medium Lasers for closer ranges. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JagerMech 的雇佣兵改装版，将所有武器替换为每侧手臂各一门轻型高斯步枪，以及三门用于较近距离的中型激光。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: JagerMech MC-A
column2: 猎手机甲 MC-A

column1: The 70 ton JM7-A slightly modifies the JM7-D to create a cheaper variant. Keeping the Ultra AC/5 and one of the ER Large Lasers, but replacing the remaining weapons with just two Medium Lasers allows the 'Mech to drop its cost by over 3 million c-bills. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 70 吨的 JM7-A 在 JM7-D 基础上稍作改动，打造出更廉价的变型。它保留超级 AC/5 和一具增程大型激光，其余武器则仅以两具中型激光替代，使该机甲的成本降低了 300 多万 C 币。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The JagerMech was designed as an anti-aircraft platform and long-range fire support unit intended to correct several perceived faults of the original Rifleman. After the FedCom Civil War further development of the JagerMech split along three different lines. The first were simple field refits of the original JM6-DD, such as the H and DG models. The second was a complete overhaul as part of Victor Steiner-Davion's 'Redesign for Davion Pride' program, resulting in the JagerMech III. The third was the creation of a divergent line, the JM7 series, built on a slightly heavier chassis massing 70 instead of 65 tons that was nevertheless not considered enough of a change to change the chassis name.
column2: 猎手机甲最初被设计为防空平台与远程火力支援单位，目的是纠正原版步枪兵被认为存在的若干缺陷。联邦共和内战之后，猎手机甲的后继发展分化为三条不同路线。第一条是对原版JM6-DD进行简单的野战改装，例如H型和DG型。第二条是作为维克多·施泰纳-戴维恩"戴维恩荣耀重新设计"计划的一部分进行的全面翻新，成果便是猎手机甲III。第三条则衍生出另一条支线——JM7系列，它采用略重的底盘，重量为70吨而非65吨，但由于改动幅度不足以更换底盘名称。

column1: The first of the heavier JM7 JagerMech variants introduced in 3057, the D variant adds five tons of overall weight to the JM6-DD, four and one-half of which go directly to increased ferro-fibrous armor. The Autocannon/2s are replaced with ER Large Lasers. The weight savings from this swap allows the design to mount thirteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为3057年推出的更重型JM7猎手机甲变型中的第一款，D型在JM6-DD的基础上增加了五吨总重量，其中四吨半直接用于加强铁纤维装甲。自动炮/2被换成增程大型激光。这次替换所节省的重量使该设计得以安装十三具双散热器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The JM7-J mounts four Jump Jets as an attempt to make it more mobile. Fitting two Ultra AC/5 and an ER Large Laser, the 'Mech is capable of some good damage if able to flank its enemies while jumping. Two Medium Lasers and CASE protection for the UAC ammunition round out the design. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JM7-J 搭载四台跳跃推进器，试图让机甲更加机动。它装有两门 Ultra AC/5 和一门增程大型激光，只要能在跳跃中绕到敌人侧翼，就能打出相当可观的伤害。两门中型激光以及为 UAC 弹药提供的 CASE 保护完善了整个设计。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Introduced in 3059 the JM7-W combines two imposing Ultra AC/5 with a Large Pulse Laser and an ER Large Laser. Not much else of the design is changed from the earlier JM7 designs. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JM7-W于3059年推出，将两门气势逼人的Ultra AC/5与一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程大型激光结合在一起。与早先的JM7型号相比，该设计没有太多其他改动。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: An illegally manufactured JagerMech variant from somewhere in the Periphery, the JM8-HK uses cheaper and more commonly available equipment than many of the other more recent variants. Two ER PPC and two AC/2 serve as the main damage dealers, with two Medium Lasers for close range. A C3 Slave unit was added to improved battlefield coordination within its lance. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一种在外围地区某处非法制造的 JagerMech 变型。相比许多更新的变型，JM8-HK 采用了更廉价、更常见的装备。两具增程粒子炮和两门 AC/2 承担主要输出，另有两具中型激光负责近距离作战。它还加装了一具 C3 从属单元，以改善其小队内的战场协同。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A Kell Hounds custom variant, replacing much of the 'Mech with Clan grade technologies. Two Ultra AC/5, two ER Large Laser and two Small Pulse Lasers, all of Clan tech base, and a C3 slave marks the key upgrades. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 凯尔猎犬的定制变型，将机甲的大部分替换为部族级科技。两门Ultra AC/5、两门增程大型激光和两门小型脉冲激光，均属部族科技基础，再加上一台C3从属单元，构成了其核心升级。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Jenner IIC
column2: 詹纳 IIC

column1: A mercenary refit of the JR7-D which allows adding two extra Medium Lasers and a C3 slave unit by switching to Double Heat Sinks and dropping the SRM-4 launcher. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 JR7-D 的雇佣兵改装型，通过换装双散热器并拆除 SRM-4 发射器，得以额外加装两门中型激光和一具 C3 从属单元。 特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Fast Striker Cavalry
column2: 快速打击骑兵

column1: The switch to Double Heat Sinks does wonders, even with more lasers it still runs cooler! It might still overheat if you keep firing them constantly, but at least it takes more than one salvo now.
column2: 换成双重散热器效果奇佳，即便多了激光器，它跑起来还是更凉！如果你不停开火可能还是会过热，但至少现在扛得住不止一轮齐射了。

column1: Piloted by Tai-i Miki Smith of the 2nd Galedon Regulars during the 3039 battle of Vega. It drops all jump jets for 2 Medium Lasers in the torsos and an additional half ton of armor, maxing it out. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 3039年维加战役期间，由第二加勒登常规团的大尉米基·史密斯驾驶。它拆除了全部跳跃推进器，在躯干上加装两门中型激光并增加额外半吨装甲，使装甲达到满载。 特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: Removing the Jump Jets sort of defeat the main purpose of a Jenner, but maybe their needs were different.
column2: 拆掉跳跃推进器多少毁了詹纳的主要用途，但也许他们的需求不同。

column1: Known as Cat among the MechWarriors of Sorenson's Sabres, the personal 'Mech of Grace Shiro has been extensively modified over the years to aid her role as the unit's spotter. Originally trading two Medium Lasers for extra armor, in the lead-up to the War of 3039 her 'Mech was outfitted a less-refined experimental Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing the SRM launcher to be replaced with an advanced Octagon Missile Magnet Narc Missile Beacon with three tons of Homing Pods. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 在索伦森之刀（Sorenson's Sabres）的机甲战士中间，格蕾丝·白（Grace Shiro）的座机被称为“猫”，多年来为配合她作为部队观察员的角色而经过了大幅改装。它最初以两门中型激光换取额外装甲；而在 3039 年战争前夕，她的机甲又换装了工艺较粗糙的实验性内骨架底盘和铁纤维装甲，使 SRM 发射器得以替换为一具先进的“八角导弹磁铁”Narc 导弹信标，并配有三吨寻的弹舱。 特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Known as Cat among the MechWarriors of Sorenson's Sabres, the personal 'Mech of Grace Shiro has been extensively modified over the years to aid her role as the unit's spotter. Originally trading two Medium Lasers for extra armor, in the lead-up to the War of 3039 her 'Mech was outfitted a less-refined experimental Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing the SRM launcher to be replaced with an advanced Octagon Missile Magnet Narc Missile Beacon with three tons of Homing Pods.
column2: 在索伦森军刀的机师中被称为"猫"，格蕾丝·白的私人机甲多年来经过大幅改装，以协助她担任该部队标定者的角色。它最初以两门中型激光器换取额外装甲，而在3039年战争前夕，她的机甲被装上了较粗糙的实验性内层钢底盘与铁纤装甲，使SRM发射器得以换成一套先进的八角导弹磁铁Narc导弹信标，配三吨寻的吊舱。

column1: A customized Jenner for Chu-i Samuli Rinne of the DCMS. The 'Mech's engine was upgraded with a 245-rated XL Engine and 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor. By removing the standard SRM launcher, DCMS techs freed enough room to add CASE and a single LRM-15 with two tons of ammunition. Rinne's Jenner keeps the standard complement of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是为DCMS的Samuli Rinne中尉定制的Jenner。这台机甲的引擎升级为一具245级XL引擎，并配3.5吨铁纤维装甲。DCMS的技师拆除了标准SRM发射器，从而腾出足够空间加装CASE以及一具带两吨弹药的LRM-15。Rinne的Jenner保留了标准配置的中型激光。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A customized Jenner for Chu-i Samuli Rinne of the DCMS. The 'Mech's engine was upgraded with a 245-rated XL Engine and 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor. By removing the standard SRM launcher, DCMS techs freed enough room to add CASE and a single LRM-15 with two tons of ammunition. Rinne's Jenner keeps the standard complement of Medium Lasers.
column2: 这是为DCMS中尉萨穆利·林内定制的迅捷。该机甲的引擎升级为245额定XL引擎，并加装3.5吨铁纤维装甲。通过拆掉标准SRM发射器，DCMS技师腾出足够空间加装CASE和一具LRM-15（配两吨弹药）。林内的迅捷保留了标准的中型激光配置。

column1: A full Clan tech refit by the Kell Houds, doubling it's available tonnage for weapons by the combination of Endo Steel, Ferro-Fibrous armor and an XL engine. As a result the JR7-KH can mount 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and a Streak SRM-4, while still having space for an Active Probe, ECM and C3 slave unit to strengthen the battlefield presence. Even with all this enough free weight remains to increase the armoring by half a ton. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是凯尔猎犬进行的完全部族技术改装，通过内骨架、铁纤维装甲与XL引擎的组合，使可用武器吨位翻倍。因此JR7-KH能装4门中型脉冲激光和一具连发SRM-4，同时仍有空间装主动探测器、电子对抗套件和C3从机以强化战场存在感。即便这样，仍余下足够自由重量把装甲增加半吨。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This is pushing the Jenner design pretty much as far as it can get. Unless you attach a Railgun to it. Now that would be fun, imagine watching it flying backwards as it fires...
column2: 这把詹纳设计推到了几乎是它能达到的极限。除非你给它接上一门磁轨炮。那才有意思，想象一下它开火时往后飞的画面……

column1: A pirate version of the Jenner, using as light components as possible to fit twin Streak SRM-2 launchers, a single Streak SRM-6 and 7 tons of armor. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是珍纳的海盗改装版，尽可能采用轻量部件，以装下2具连发SRM-2发射器、1具连发SRM-6和7吨装甲。 <特性：改进生命维持系统 <投放费用倍率：0.98 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂上段，右臂上段

column1: Typically pirate stupidness. What will you do in this 'Mech once you are out of missiles? Spit at the enemy? Oh, and why is it named JR8 instead of JR7 you ask? Why, 'obviously 8 is larger than 7 so this is the bestest variant' the claim goes. Pirates, bah.
column2: 典型的傻瓜海盗作风。等你导弹打光了，你要用这台机甲干什么？朝敌人吐口水？哦，你问为什么叫JR8而不是JR7？当然是因为"8比7大，所以这是最强的改型"，他们这么说。海盗，呸。

column1: Not much is known of this pirate variant, a few have been spotted in recent raids around the Periphery and they seem to mostly be a random assortment of equipment thrown together. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 关于这一海盗变型所知不多。在近期围绕外围地区的袭掠中曾发现过几台，它们似乎大多是把各种装备随意凑在一起的产物。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: My guess is they build them of whatever parts they could steal and loot from battles. The parts always seem to be from different brands on different 'Mechs of the variant.
column2: 我猜他们是用能从战斗中偷抢来的任何零件拼出来的。同一种改型的每一台机甲上，零件似乎都来自不同品牌。

column1: The Jinggau is built on a lightweight Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a VOX 325 XL engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h. To increase its mobility, the Jinggau has five Hellespont Leaper jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection, the Jinggau carries eleven and a half tons of armor that protects the 'Mech from enemy fire. To dissipate the waste heat produced by the Jinggau's weapons and jump jets, the 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks that are more than adequate. Overall, with its high ground speed, superior mobility, armor, and firepower the Jinggau is a 'Mech more than capable of handling most enemies on today's battlefield. The primary weapon on the Jinggau is a powerful Zhi-tong-yao Gauss Rifle that gives the 'Mech a maximum striking distance of up to six hundred and sixty meters which allows the Jinggau the opportunity to draw the first blood on the battlefield. For close combat, the Jinggau has a set of four Diverse Optics Type ER Medium Lasers and a single, highly accurate, Raker-IV Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 荆柯建在轻量战车II型内骨架底盘上，由一台VOX 325 XL引擎驱动，最高速度86.4公里/小时。为提升机动性，荆柯装五具赫勒斯庞特跳跃者跳跃推进器，可跳跃至多一百五十米。防护方面，荆柯带十一吨半装甲抵御敌方火力。为散发武器与跳跃推进器产生的废热，该机甲有十三个双散热器，绰绰有余。总体而言，凭借高地面速度、出色的机动性、装甲与火力，荆柯足以应付当今战场上的大多数敌人。荆柯的主武器是一门强力的紫铜窑高斯步枪，最大打击距离可达六百六十米，让荆柯有机会在战场上先行见血。近战时，荆柯有4门Diverse Optics型增程中型激光和一门高精度的雷克-IV中型脉冲激光。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This is one hell of a 'Mech for its weight. It can jump around the battlefield and constantly flank with very accurate high-penetration shots.
column2: 就其重量而言这是台了不得的机甲。它能在战场上跳来跳去，不断用非常精准的高穿透射击进行侧击。

column1: Classified Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 机密 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Junior JNR-7P remains among the best-armed 'Mechs in its weight class, sporting a reliable combination of a medium laser in the center torso and a small laser in each side torso. Two tons of armor provides minimal protection. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 少年JNR-7P仍是同重量级中武装最好的机甲之一，拥有可靠的组合：中央躯干一门中型激光，两侧躯干各一门小型激光。两吨装甲提供最低限度的防护。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Ultralight Scout
column2: 超轻型侦察

column1: One of the first ultralight BattleMechs ever built, the Junior was designed by the Federated Suns in the twenty-fifth century and remains in use with backwater garrisons, third-line units, and some mercenary units.
column2: 作为有史以来最早建造的超轻型战斗机甲之一，初级型由联邦太阳在二十五世纪设计，至今仍在偏远驻军、三线单位和一些雇佣兵部队中使用。

column1: The Kage (translating to "shadow" in japanese) light battle armor was one of the first battle armor designs produced by the Draconis Combine after the Truce of Tukayyid. Built for reconnaissance and battlefield infiltration, development of the Kage was a joint operation between Internal Security Force scientists and Draconis Elite Strike Team advisers. Indeed the Kage was meant to provide an alternative to the much-respected DEST Infiltration Suit for missions in which DEST teams could expect heavy opposition, and since production started in 3056 the battle armor has virtually replaced the older Sneak Suit. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 影（日文中意为"影"）轻型战斗装甲是德拉科尼斯联合体在图卡伊德停战协定后最早生产的战斗装甲设计之一。它专为侦察与战场渗透而建，由内务安全部队的科学家与德拉科尼斯精锐打击小队顾问联合开发。事实上，影意在为备受尊崇的 DEST 渗透服提供替代方案，用于 DEST 小队可能遭遇强敌的任务；自 3056 年投产以来，这套战斗装甲几乎完全取代了较老的"潜行服"。 特质：伏击者 投放费用倍率：0.886 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

column1: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Kanazuchi 在日语中意为“锤子”，是龙脉联合体的战斗装甲设计，也是该势力所推出过的最重型战斗装甲之一。 特性：装甲强化 投放费用倍率：0.896 只能通过内部舱室运输，可以近战，无法攀附。

column1: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm.
column2: 金锤（日语"锤子"）是德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计，是该势力出品中最重的一种。

column1: A highly unusual version, the 50003-2OS is only found amongst mercenaries and in the periphery. No official sales was ever recorded of the variant, which makes it likely an unlicensed reproduction. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是极为罕见的版本，50003-2OS只出现在雇佣兵与外围地区。该变型从未有过任何官方销售记录，因而很可能是一次未获授权的仿制。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Katana began its existence when the Draconis Combine was given several downgraded Crockett BattleMechs by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. Independence Weaponry reverse-engineered the weapons so they could produce copies at a nearby facility and closely examined the Crocketts for several months. After making minor modifications these 'Mechs were renamed Katanas and used to replace Chargers in several DCMS units. The Katana quickly become a mainstay in many of the heavier mobile line units, especially after the invention of the C3 Computer. The Katana still shares many of the same features as the Crockett, right down to the serial number.
column2: 武士刀源于康星作为"玫瑰花蕾"行动的一部分把若干降级版克罗基特战斗机甲交给德拉科尼斯联合体。独立兵器公司对武器进行逆向工程以便在附近工厂生产复制品，并仔细检查了这些克罗基特数月。做了一些小改动后，这些机甲被改名为武士刀，用于替换若干 DCMS 单位中的冲锋者。武士刀很快成为许多较重型机动一线单位的主力，尤其在 C3 计算机发明之后。它至今与克罗基特共享许多相同特征，连序列号都一样。

column1: In the CRK-5003-2's left torso is a LB-X Autocannon/10 which draws from a two-ton ammo bin in the right torso. A pair of Large Lasers split between both arms take the place of the extended-range versions found in the Crockett. For close-range combat the CRK-5003-2 carries two SRM-6s in either side torso, with two tons of reloads concentrated in the right side, and for point blank defense the 'Mech carries two Small Lasers mounted co-axially with the large lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: CRK-5003-2的左躯干内是一门LB-X自动炮/10，由右躯干一个两吨弹药舱供弹。两门大型激光分装在双臂，取代了克罗基特上的增程版本。近距交战时，CRK-5003-2两侧躯干各装两具SRM-6，两吨再装填弹药集中在右侧；零距离防御则由两门与大型激光同轴安装的小型激光负责。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The CRK-5003-2OS is the personal BattleMech of Warlord Oruko Saki. It has a configuration very close to the standard CRK-5003-2 with only a few upgrades. The 'Mech's primary weapons systems remain the same: two Large Lasers backed up by a single LB 10-X Autocannon. The 'Mech also retains the two standard Short Range Missile racks. A secondary system of small lasers rounds out the 'Mech's offensive powers, mounted one in each arm and one in the rear torso. One of the few upgrades to Saki's Katana comes in the form of C.A.S.E. installed into the 'Mech's right torso. The other upgrade comes in the form of fifteen high-efficiency heat sinks replacing the CRK-5003-2's normal twenty heat sinks. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: CRK-5003-2OS是军阀奥鲁科·萨基的专属战斗机甲。它的配置与标准型CRK-5003-2非常接近，只有少数几处升级。机甲的主武器系统保持不变：两门大型激光，辅以一门LB 10-X自动炮。该机甲同样保留了原有的两具标准短程火箭发射巢。一套小型激光的次要系统补全了机甲的攻击火力，每只手臂各装一门，后躯干装一门。萨基的武士刀少数升级之一，是在机甲右躯干加装了C.A.S.E.；另一项升级则是用十五个高效散热器替换了CRK-5003-2原有的二十个散热器。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A simple variant of the Katana introduced in 3057, the 5003-C variant is a modification intended to carry a C3 Slave unit into battle. In order to achieve this, the 'Mech has removed both of the small lasers from the chassis, freeing up the needed room for the slave unit and allowing the Katana to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: The King Crab's primary weapons are two massive Autocannon/20s, among the most powerful BattleMech weapons ever created. Each arm carries one of these massive weapons, and they are fed by two tons of ammo split between the side torsos. The firepower of these weapons is enough to destroy a medium 'Mech in one salvo. To protect the autocannons in combat, engineers designed the King Crab with simple hand actuators. In appearance and movement, the actuators are very similar to pincers or claws found on real crabs, a contributing factor to the 'Mech's name. To back up the autocannons, and provide some long-range capabilities, the King Crab carries a LRM-15 launcher, mounted in the left torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the same location, and a Large Laser in the right torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 帝王蟹的主武器是两门庞大的自动炮/20，这是有史以来最强大的战斗机甲武器之一。每只手臂各携一门这种巨炮，由分装在两侧躯干的两吨弹药供弹。这些武器的火力足以一次齐射摧毁一台中型机甲。为在战斗中保护自动炮，工程师为帝王蟹设计了简单的手部驱动器：外观与动作都极像真螃蟹的钳或爪，这也是该机甲得名的一个原因。为给自动炮提供后手及一定远程能力，帝王蟹带一具LRM-15发射器（装在左躯干，配同位置一吨再装填弹药）和右躯干一门大型激光。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: One of the earliest second generation OmniMech designs, the Kingfisher debuted in 2887 and is reputed to have influenced all subsequent Clan Assault OmniMech designs. A 90-ton mech powered by a 360-rated Fusion Engine, the Kingfisher has 24 tons of podspace provided by a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel skeleton. The Kingfisher Prime is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a LRM-10. At closer ranges, the Prime can bring to bear a Streak SRM-6, an ER Small Laser and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 作为最早的第二代全方位机甲设计之一，翠鸟于2887年首次亮相，据称影响了此后所有氏族突击全方位机甲的设计。作为由一具360级聚变引擎驱动的90吨机甲，翠鸟凭借铁纤装甲与内层钢骨架的组合获得24吨吊舱空间。翠鸟主配置武装为两门大型脉冲激光器和一具LRM-10。在更近距离，主配置能祭出一具连发SRM-6、一门增程小型激光器和两门中型脉冲激光器。

column1: A simple refit of the standard Kintaro KTO-19 that moves one of the Medium Lasers to the opposite arm for MechWarriors that prefer the more balanced weapon distribution. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是标准 Kintaro KTO-19 的简单改装，将其中一门中型激光移到对侧手臂，以迎合偏爱更均衡武器分布的机甲战士。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Kintaro 19 is a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of Narc supported close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
column2: 金太郎 19 是一头猛兽。它以自身体型而言速度很快，装备厚重装甲，凭借几乎多到荒谬的 Narc 辅助近程武器，真能把大多数其他机甲撕成碎片。不过它比地狱的桑拿房还烫。

column1: The Kiso was created as a "command" construction vehicle for large planetary construction projects in the Draconis Combine. This particular Kiso, however, was destined for greater things when modifications by mercenary company "Harkness' Horde" elevated it to something resembling a 100-ton Assault 'Mech. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93
column2: Kiso最初是作为龙脉联合体大型行星建设工程的“指挥”施工车辆而制造的。然而，这辆特别的Kiso注定肩负更重大的使命——经过雇佣兵连队“哈克尼斯之群”的改装，它被提升到接近100吨突击机甲的水平。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.93

column1: I can't decide if I love this thing or if I hate it, Boss. On the one hand, \"wow, cool quad 'mech,\" and on the other hand, \"why in God's name would you do this?\"

column1: Originally developed by Luthien Armor Works as a cheap but durable garrison unit, the Kumazemi entered production after a brief test period showing promising results. Its name, meaning \"bear cicada\", is a nod to both its imposing bulk and to some borrowed design elements from the venerable Cicada chassis. Initially fielded exclusively within Combine garrison units, limited export agreements have made the Kumazemi an increasingly more common sight among both Inner Sphere and Periphery garrisons, as well as the occasional mercenary command.
column2: 熊蝉最初由鲁西恩装甲工厂开发为一款廉价而耐用的驻防单位，经过短暂测试显示前景良好后投产。它的名字意为"熊蝉"，既致敬其厚重体量，也暗指它从经典蝉底盘借鉴的部分设计元素。最初仅在联合体驻防部队内使用，限定出口协议使熊蝉在内天体与外围区驻军中越来越常见，偶尔也出现在佣兵部队中。

column1: The KUZ-C3 refines the original Kumazemi's loadout with a trio of practical upgrades. The head-mounted Machine Gun has been replaced with a Small Laser for ammunition independent close defense, an SRM-6 has been added to the left torso for additional short range punch, and single heat sinks have given way to double heat sinks throughout. Together, these changes allow the KUZ-C3 to sustain heavier fire from its AC/20 and LRM-15 while adding a meaningful close-combat option its predecessor lacked. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: KUZ-C3以三项务实的升级完善了原版熊爪的配置：头部的机枪换成小型激光，以实现不依赖弹药的近距防御；左躯干加装一具SRM-6，增强近程打击力；单散热器全面改为双散热器。这些改动合在一起，让KUZ-C3能维持AC/20与LRM-15的更重火力，并补上了前型号所欠缺的、有实际意义的近战选项。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The KUZ-D5 represents a large rework of the original Kumazemi. Endo Steel internal structure frees enough tonnage to replace the head-mounted Machine Gun with an ER Large Laser and add a centrally-mounted SRM-4, while Artemis IV fire control systems on both the LRM-15 and new SRM-4 dramatically improve missile accuracy. Double heat sinks support this expanded arsenal, though the added equipment comes at the cost of reduced armor coverage compared to earlier variants, a trade the KUZ-D5 makes in pursuit of substantially greater firepower. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: KUZ-D5是对原版熊爪的大幅重做。内骨架内部结构腾出足够吨位，把头部机枪换成增程大型激光并加装一具中央SRM-4；同时LRM-15与新SRM-4都加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，导弹精度大幅提升。双散热器支撑这套扩充的武器，但新增设备也以比早期变型更少的装甲覆盖为代价——KUZ-D5为追求显著更强的火力作出了这一取舍。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The KUZ-D7 builds on the KUZ-D5 by trading its SRM-4 and ER Large Laser for an ER PPC and a pair of additional ER Medium Lasers, giving it three ER Medium Lasers in total alongside its AC/20, Artemis-guided LRM-15, and new ER PPC. A Guardian ECM Suite has also been added for electronic protection. To accommodate these changes, the KUZ-D7 switches to Light Ferro-Fibrous armor and carries a reduced LRM ammunition reserve, though it retains the Endo Steel structure and double heat sinks introduced on the KUZ-D5. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: KUZ-D7 在 KUZ-D5 的基础上发展而来，用一门 增程粒子炮和一对额外的 ER 中型激光换掉了原有的 SRM-4 与 ER 大型激光，使其在 AC/20、Artemis 制导的 LRM-15 以及新增的 增程粒子炮之外，总共拥有三门 ER 中型激光。同时还加装了一套 Guardian 电子对抗套件以提供电子防护。为适应这些改动，KUZ-D7 改用轻型铁纤维装甲，并缩减了 LRM 弹药储备，但仍保留了 KUZ-D5 上引入的内骨架结构与双散热器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The KUZ-F2 represents an alternate development path from the original KUZ-C2, retaining its LRM-15 but replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle for comparable hitting power without the heat penalty. The head-mounted Machine Gun gives way to an ER Large Laser, while the paired Medium Lasers are replaced by a Large Pulse Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser for greater precision at range. Endo Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor, along with double heat sinks, round out this substantial overhaul of the chassis's original design. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: KUZ-F2 代表着与原版 KUZ-C2 不同的一条发展路线：它保留了 LRM-15，却以高斯步枪取代 AC/20，在获得相当打击力的同时免去了热量上的负担。头部机枪让位于一门增程大型激光，而成对的中型激光则被一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光取代，以便在远距离上更加精准。内骨架结构与铁纤维装甲，再加上双散热器，共同构成了对这款底盘原始设计的重大改造。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The -01 is the earliest known model of the Kyudo. Built using primitive components, it carries a single LRM-10 and Large Laser, with enough single heat sinks to keep it relatively cool. The -01 was fielded primarily by the Terran Hegemony during the Reunification War, but eventually went extinct during the Amaris Civil War. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.81 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: -01 是已知最早的弓道型号。它使用原始部件建造，装备一部 LRM-10 和一门大型激光，单散热器数量足以让它保持相对凉爽。-01 在统一战争期间主要由地球霸权使用，但最终在阿马里斯内战期间绝迹。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.81 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column2: 马丁森军械

column1: The Kyudo is a pretty old support 'Mech. And this is a pretty old Kyudo. We can pretty her up, but it'll take some work.
column2: 弓道是一台相当老旧的支援机甲。而这是一台相当老旧的弓道。我们可以把它打扮漂亮，但需要花些功夫。

column1: The Kyudo was introduced by Martinson Armaments in 2625 and purchased by the Terran Hegemony with intent to support the Mackie. Topping out at 86 km/h, the Kyudo carries a single LRM-20 with Artemis IV guidance, and an ER Large Laser for direct fire support. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Kyudo 由 Martinson Armaments 于 2625 年推出，被地球霸权采购，意在支援 Mackie。其最高速度为 86 km/h，搭载一具配 Artemis IV 制导的 LRM-20，以及一门用于直射火力支援的增程大型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: The Kyudo is a pretty old support 'Mech. It's only got the two weapons, sure, but considering the weight class, it's not terrible firepower.
column2: 弓道是一台相当老旧的支援机甲。它确实只有两件武器，但考虑到其重量级，火力并不算差。

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-01 is armed with a pair of Large Lasers, a Medium Laser and a PPC. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 兰斯洛特（Lancelot）源自星际联盟防卫军，是一台 60 吨机甲，设计目标是在跟上中型机甲步伐的同时，为战斗带来重型机甲的火力与生存能力。它以一台额定 360 的 XL 引擎为核心，LNC25-01 型兰斯洛特装备了两门大型激光、一门中型激光和一门粒子炮。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-01 is armed with a pair of Large Lasers, a Medium Laser and a PPC.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星际联盟国防军，是一款60吨机甲，设计用于跟上中型机甲的节奏，同时把重型机甲的火力与生存性带入交战。它围绕一台360额定XL引擎建造，兰斯洛特LNC25-01装有两门大型激光、一门中型激光和一门粒子炮。

column1: A battlefield refit of the LNC25-01, adding Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor. The freed up weight is used to increase the armoring and add three more double heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是LNC25-01的战场改装，加装内骨架与铁纤维装甲。省下来的重量用于加强装甲，并增加三个双散热器。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This Lancelot variant removes the PPC and Large Lasers of the standard model and replaces them all with ER Large Lasers. Ferro-Fibrous armor provides increased protection, while the remaining tonnage has been devoted to extra double heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一 Lancelot 变型拆除了标准型号的粒子炮与大型激光，全部换成增程大型激光。铁纤维装甲提供了更强的防护，而剩余的吨位则全部用于加装额外的双散热器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-01sl is armed with a trio of ER Large Lasers and a Medium Laser.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星盟防卫部队，是一种60吨机甲，设计为在跟上中型机甲节奏的同时，为战斗带来重型机甲的火力与生存力。兰斯洛特LNC25-01sl围绕一具360级XL引擎建造，武装为三兄弟增程大型激光器和一门中型激光器。

column1: This prototype Lancelot variant was produced by Krupp prior to Amaris' seizure of Terra. An upgrade of the LNC25-01, it uses an Endo-Steel chassis and Ferro-fibrous armor. The weapons array is same, except the large lasers are Extended Range Type and four jump jets are added for mobility. Early field tests revealed that the inclusion of jump jets did little to improve the design, with most pilots requesting either more armoring or more heat sinks instead. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这款Lancelot原型变型由Krupp在阿马里斯夺取地球之前生产。它是LNC25-01的升级版，采用内骨架底盘和铁纤维装甲。武器阵列相同，只是大型激光改为增程型号，并加装四台跳跃推进器以提升机动性。早期实地测试表明，加装跳跃推进器对设计的改进微乎其微，多数机师反而要求增加装甲或散热器。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-01X is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a PPC.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星盟防卫部队，是一种60吨机甲，设计为在跟上中型机甲节奏的同时，为战斗带来重型机甲的火力与生存力。兰斯洛特LNC25-01X围绕一具360级XL引擎建造，武装为两门增程大型激光器和一门PPC。

column1: The Lancelot did not survive the loss of Star League technology as well as most of its older cousins. Manufactured by Luthien Armor Works from their huge plant on Luthien, the 02 retained the same weapons array though with different models: a Lord's Light PPC, two Sunglow Heavy Lasers, and a Victory 23R Medium Laser. This came at the expense however of a smaller Pitban 240 fusion engine and nineteen single heat sinks. With a new maximum speed of only 64.8 km/h the thin-skinned Lancelot made for an easy target for other 'Mechs of its weight class, and the less efficient heat dissipation system made it unable to unleash its full firepower safely and consistently; firing both large lasers and the PPC at the same time now entailed risking a shutdown from overheating. LAW also had to replace the Krupp electronics used in the Star League variants, installing a Sipher KIT-4 communications system and a Hawkeye B3 targeting and tracking system. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 在星际联盟科技失传的过程中，Lancelot的境遇不如它大多数更古老的表亲。02型由Luthien Armor Works在其位于Luthien的巨型工厂生产，保留了相同的武器阵列，只是型号不同：一门Lord's Light粒子炮、两门Sunglow重型激光和一门Victory 23R中型激光。但代价是换装了更小的Pitban 240聚变引擎和十九台单散热器。新的最高速度仅为64.8 km/h，这身薄皮的Lancelot因而成了同重量级机甲眼中易得的目标；而降效的散热系统也使它无法安全而持续地释放全部火力——如今同时发射两门大型激光和粒子炮，就意味着要冒着过热停机的风险。LAW还不得不替换星际联盟变型所用的Krupp电子设备，改而安装Sipher KIT-4通讯系统和Hawkeye B3瞄准与追踪系统。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 240-rated Fusion Core, the Lancelot LNC25-01X is armed with a pair of Large Lasers, a Medium Laser and a PPC.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星盟防卫部队，是一种60吨机甲，设计为在跟上中型机甲节奏的同时，为战斗带来重型机甲的火力与生存力。兰斯洛特LNC25-01X围绕一具240级聚变核心建造，武装为两门大型激光器、一门中型激光器和一门PPC。

column1: A field refit of the 01 model owing to a lack of proper spare parts, this variant swaps out the large lasers and extra heat sinks for a pair of rugged Autocannon/5s. It is made tougher with the inclusion of additional armor, though the extra protection comes at the cost of a reduction in speed to a maximum of 85 km/h. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 由于缺少合适备件，这是01型号的野战改装：以一对坚固的AC/5取代大型激光和额外散热器。它通过加入额外装甲变得更坚韧，但这份额外防护的代价是速度降到最高85公里/小时。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 300-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-03 is armed with a pair of AC/5’s, a Medium Laser and a PPC.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星际联盟国防军，是一款60吨机甲，设计用于跟上中型机甲的节奏，同时把重型机甲的火力与生存性带入交战。它围绕一台300额定XL引擎建造，兰斯洛特LNC25-03装有两门AC/5、一门中型激光和一门粒子炮。

column1: This variant of the Lancelot is a completely upgraded version, built to utilize the improved C3 computer in use by ComStar and the Word of Blake. In addition to using an Endo-Steel chassis and added a half-ton of armor, the particle cannon and large lasers were upgraded to Extended Range models. In order to make room for these sweeping changes the medium laser was removed. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是兰斯洛特的完全升级版本，为利用通讯之星与布莱克之词所用的改进型C3计算机而造。除采用内骨架底盘并增加半吨装甲外，粒子炮和大型激光都升级为增程型号。为给这些全面改动腾出空间，拆掉了中型激光。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-04 is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and an ER PPC.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星际联盟国防军，是一款60吨机甲，设计用于跟上中型机甲的节奏，同时把重型机甲的火力与生存性带入交战。它围绕一台360额定XL引擎建造，兰斯洛特LNC25-04装有一对增程大型激光和一门增程粒子炮。

column1: The 25-05 is a curious variant of the traditionally energy-based Lancelot primarily aimed at fighting conventional forces. The medium laser and two heat sinks have been replaced with four Machine Guns and a full ton of ammunition. The armor has not been upgraded, and the 25-05 Lancelot has the same speed profile as the older 25-01 model. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 25-05 是一向以能量武器为主的 Lancelot 的一个奇特变型，主要针对常规部队作战。中型激光和两具散热器被四挺机枪以及整整一吨弹药所取代。装甲并未升级，25-05 Lancelot 的速度特性与更早的 25-01 型号相同。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-05 is armed with a pair of Large Lasers, a PPC and pair of Machine Guns.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星际联盟国防军，是一款60吨机甲，设计用于跟上中型机甲的节奏，同时把重型机甲的火力与生存性带入交战。它围绕一台360额定XL引擎建造，兰斯洛特LNC25-05装有两门大型激光、一门粒子炮和一对机枪。

column1: Introduced by Kindraa Smythe-Jewel, the all-Clan tech Lancelot C carried three Kolibri Delta Series Large Pulse Lasers into battle as a light 'Mech hunter. Sixteen double heat sinks and nine and a half tons of armor protected the Lancelot C. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 由金德拉·斯迈思-朱厄尔推出、全用部族技术的兰斯洛特C，以三门蜂鸟德尔塔系列大型脉冲激光参战，担任轻型机甲猎手。十六个双散热器和九吨半装甲保护着兰斯洛特C。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Redesigned specifically to hunt Light mechs, the Lancelot C was a Clan adaption of the SLDF Lancelot designed by Clan Fire Mandrill. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-C is armed with a trio of Large Pulse Lasers.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星盟防卫部队，是一种60吨机甲，设计为在跟上中型机甲节奏的同时，为战斗带来重型机甲的火力与生存力。兰斯洛特C是火沸氏族对SLDF兰斯洛特的氏族改造版，专为猎杀轻型机甲而重新设计。兰斯洛特LNC25-C围绕一具360级XL引擎建造，武装为三兄弟大型脉冲激光器。

column1: This variant of the Lancelot C entered service twenty five years after the original. Similar to the original Lancelot, each arm carries an ER Large Laser while an ER PPC is mounted in the right torso. To fight infantry or create smoke, a pair of Flamers is in the center torso. Seventeen heat sinks offset the heat generated by these weapons. The Lancelot C 2 can also sprint at 120 km/h thanks to a MASC system. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一Lancelot C变型在原版服役二十五年后入役。与原版Lancelot相似，每条手臂各搭载一门增程大型激光，右躯干则安装一门增程粒子炮。为对付步兵或制造烟雾，中央躯干装有两门火焰喷射器。十七台散热器可抵消这些武器产生的热量。得益于MASC系统，Lancelot C 2还能以120 km/h的速度冲刺。 特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Originating with the Star League Defense Force, the Lancelot is a 60-ton mech designed to keep pace with medium mechs while bringing the firepower and survivability of a heavy mech to an engagement. Redesigned specifically to hunt Light mechs, the Lancelot C was a Clan adaption of the SLDF Lancelot designed by Clan Fire Mandrill. Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-C2 is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and an ER PPC. MASC and a pair of Flamers round out the design.
column2: 兰斯洛特源自星盟防卫部队，是一种60吨机甲，设计为在跟上中型机甲节奏的同时，为战斗带来重型机甲的火力与生存力。兰斯洛特C是火沸氏族对SLDF兰斯洛特的氏族改造版，专为猎杀轻型机甲而重新设计。兰斯洛特LNC25-C2围绕一具360级XL引擎建造，武装为两门增程大型激光器和一门增程PPC。MASC与两具火焰喷射器补全了该设计。

column1: Trading the Hermes II's AC/5, medium laser and flamer for missile racks and an upgraded laser, the Liberator offered a harder punch. Carrying an LRM-5 in each arm as primary weapons supported by a center torso mounted large laser, an SRM-2 rack fitted to the 'Mech's left torso provided close-range backup. A single ton of LRM and SRM reloads gave the design reasonable endurance in the field, with designers determining on paper that volley fire alternating between the missile launchers with the laser to easily manage the 'Mech's heat load. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 解放者以导弹挂架和升级激光取代赫尔墨斯II的AC/5、中型激光和火焰喷射器，打击力更强。每只手臂各有一具LRM-5作为主武器，中央躯干一门大型激光支援，左躯干一具SRM-2提供近距后手。一吨LRM与SRM再装填弹药让该设计具备不错的战场持续力；设计者在纸面上判定，在导弹发射器与激光之间交替齐射可以轻松控制机甲的热负荷。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: While intended to serve as more a line-trooper than IrTech's mediocre Hermes II, the Liberator maintains a similar ground speed as the IrTech design, mounting six and half tons of armor, just one ton less than the Hermes II to carry a heavier weapons loadout. Despite easily outperforming the Hermes II, the Liberator was doomed by a severe flaw in its revolutionary torso design which resulted in the complete failure of the production model's cooling system, missed in the hand-built prototypes due to different manufacturing techniques.
column2: 虽然本意是充当战列步兵而非IR科技那平庸的赫尔墨斯II，解放者却保持着与IR科技设计相近的地面速度，装六吨半装甲——仅比赫尔墨斯II少一吨——以携带更重的武器载荷。尽管轻松胜过赫尔墨斯II，解放者却被其革命性躯干设计中的一个严重缺陷判了死刑：该缺陷导致量产型号冷却系统彻底失效，而手工制造的原型因制造工艺不同而未曾发现。

column1: A full missile configuration, the A loadout mounts six LRM-15 launchers, all of them with an attached Artemis IV FCS. Eight tons of artemis ammunition ensures the 'Mech can keep firing during longer engagements. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: A配置是全导弹配置，搭载六具LRM-15发射器，全部配有阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。八个吨位的阿尔忒弥斯弹药确保这台机甲在较长时间的交战中能够持续开火。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Created by Clan Coyote just after the clan invasion of the inner sphere was started, the 65 ton Liberator OmniMech soon spread through the clans that remained on the home worlds.
column2: 解放者由郊狼氏族在内天体入侵刚开始后创造，这款 65 吨全能机甲很快在留守母星的各氏族中传开。

column1: The Bravo configuration of the Liberator mounts a LBX AC/10 and a large pulse laser in each arm, leading to a substantial damage potential. However, the LBX ammunition is limited to only a few tons, which means the 'Mech relies on either resupply or only short engagements. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 解放者的 B 型配置在每条手臂上各装一门 LBX AC/10 和一门大型脉冲激光，伤害潜力相当可观。然而 LBX 弹药仅有寥寥数吨，这意味着这台机甲要么依赖补给，要么只能进行短促交战。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The C configuration mounts a massive Ultra AC/20 in the right arm, combined with a Large Pulser Laser in the left. Three Medium Pulse Lasers in the left torso help at medium ranges, while two Stream SRM-6 launchers can provide extra punch at close range. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C 配置在右臂装有一门巨型 Ultra AC/20，左臂则配有一门大型脉冲激光。左躯干的三门中型脉冲激光在中距离上提供协助，而两具连发 SRM-6 发射器可在近距离带来额外的打击力。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

column1: The D loadout is an unusual ones, as it combines a long range weapon like the Gauss Rifle, with short range ones like its five SRM-6 launchers. The loadout also mounts a LRM-20 and Narc launcher. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D 配置相当独特，它把高斯步枪这样的远程武器与五具 SRM-6 发射器这类近程武器结合在一起。该配置还装有一具 LRM-20 和 Narc 发射器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration mounts two ER PPC in the Left Arm and an Ultra AC/10 in the Right Arm. Three Medium Pulse Lasers were mounted in the Left Torso, and a single ER Small Laser in the Head. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 主配置在左臂装两门增程粒子炮，右臂装一门超级AC/10；左躯干装三门中型脉冲激光，头部一门单独的增程小型激光。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The A2 mounts an SRM-6 in each side torso, with a ton of CASE protected ammunition, and a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. A single Small Laser is also mounted in the Mech's head. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: A2在两侧躯干各装一具SRM-6（配一吨CASE防护弹药），每只手臂一门中型脉冲激光，头部另有一门小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Liberty was primarily designed as a 45 ton Brawler, focused on SRMs and lasers. Thanks to its above average mobility, it can also serve as a flanker or heavy scout as needed.
column2: 自由主要被设计为一台 45 吨近战机，侧重 SRM 与激光。得益于高于平均的机动性，必要时它也能充当侧翼手或重型侦察。

column1: The A5 is quite similar to the original A2, but replaces the standard SRM launchers with four Streak SRM-2. The use of Streak launchers allows preserving the ammunition better during long engagements, but does decrease the total firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: A5与原始A2相当相似，但以四具连发SRM-2取代标准SRM发射器。使用连发发射器能在长时间交战中更好地保存弹药，但总体火力有所下降。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: By replacing the Medium Pulse Lasers of the A2 with two LRM-10 launchers, the D4 achieves indirect fire capabilities. The SRM launchers had to be downgraded to SRM-4 to fit the larger LRMs, but the Small Laser has instead been upgraded to a Small Pulse Laser. The CASE protection was also removed and the fusion core is of a smaller 225 rated capacity. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 以两具LRM-10发射器取代A2的中型脉冲激光，D4获得间接火力能力。为容纳更大的LRM，SRM发射器不得不降级为SRM-4，但小型激光反而升级为小型脉冲激光。CASE防护也被拆掉，聚变核心容量则缩小为225额定。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The last design of the Liberty line, the E12 adds electronic warfare systems to the design by a Guardian ECM mounted in the center torso. Its weapons consist of four SRM-4 and two Medium Lasers. As with the A models, the ammunition for the SRM launchers is C.A.S.E. protected. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: E12是Liberty系列的最后一款设计，它通过在中央躯干安装守护者电子对抗套件，为该设计增添了电子战系统。其武器包括四具SRM-4和两门中型激光。与A型一样，SRM发射器的弹药受到C.A.S.E.保护。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-C is armed with a UAC/5 and an ER Large Laser. 4 ER Medium Lasers, 2 Machine Guns and a Flamer make up the rest of the Omni’s weapons. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 65吨的Linebacker是为取代Timber Wolf而设计的，于3052年投产。它以额定390的XL引擎为核心，较快的速度使其在运动战中能跟上更轻的星队同伴，而这正是Timber Wolf难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内骨架的结合让这台全向机甲拥有17.5吨的自由挂载空间。Linebacker LBK-C装备一门UAC/5和一门增程大型激光，其余武器包括4门增程中型激光、2挺机枪和一具火焰喷射器。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A loadout specifically created for battle challenges, the X configuration mounts a total of ten ER Medium Lasers, five in each arm. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: X 配置是专为战斗挑战打造的武器配置，共安装十门增程中型激光，每条手臂五门。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column2: 装载之王

column1: At long range, the Lobo makes use of its ER large laser. As it closes, it can makes use of paired ATM-6s, paired heavy medium lasers and a heavy small laser. The meager 10 double heat sinks allotted to the design cannot hope to keep it cool, so MechWarriors have resorted to running the heat up to the red, then disengaging to cool off. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 在远距离上，洛博使用它的增程大型激光。随着距离拉近，它可以动用成对的 ATM-6、成对的重型中型激光以及一门重型小型激光。该设计仅分配到区区10个双散热器，根本无法让它保持凉爽，因此机甲战士只好把热量逼到红区，再脱离战斗降温。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Lobo was originally conceived as an inexpensive companion to the Timber Wolf. Khan Vladimir Ward's Clan Wolf was never fond of the Linebacker, the brain child of Khans Natasha Kerensky and Phelan Ward, so Khan Ward directed his scientists to design something smaller. Despite that, Ward was not happy with his options until Clan Coyote developed the Advanced Tactical Missile launcher, which Ward quickly secured the technology and had it incorporated into the Lobo. With that inclusion, the 'Mech ceased to be cheap, however, as the inclusion of endo steel and an extralight engine was necessary to free up space for the desired launchers. Able to out-pace the Timber Wolf, the Lobo is more in line with Clan Wolf's shift to faster, hard-hitting 'Mechs.
column2: 狼獾原本被构想为铁木狼的廉价伙伴。可汗弗拉基米尔·沃德的狼族一直不喜欢由可汗娜塔莎·克伦斯基和费兰·沃德设计的后卫，于是沃德可汗指示他的科学家设计一种更小的东西。即便如此，沃德对自己的选择仍不满意，直到郊狼氏族研发出高级战术导弹发射器，沃德迅速取得该技术并将其整合进狼獾。有了这项整合，这台机甲就不再廉价了，因为必须采用内层钢与超轻型引擎才能为所需的发射器腾出空间。狼獾能比铁木狼跑得更快，更符合狼族转向更快速、更重打击机甲的潮流。

column2: 蝗虫 IIC

column1: A Jade Falcon designed Locust IIC, as they tried to speed up production with simpler 'Mechs to recover after the losses during the failed Operation REVIVAL. Using Clan-grade Endo Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor, enough weight was freed to mount two Streak SRM-2 launchers and two ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是玉鹰部族设计的蝗虫IIC——在“复兴行动”失败、损失惨重之后，他们试图用更简单的机甲加快生产、恢复元气。该机甲采用部族级内骨架结构和铁纤维装甲，腾出的重量足以安装2具连发SRM-2发射器和2门增程中型激光。 <特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.04 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂上段，右臂上段

column1: Locusts are so light that it is hard finding a use for them in most deployments. Having less weapons than many other clan Locusts means this variants also poses little threat to larger 'Mechs.
column2: 蝗虫太轻了，在大多数部署中很难为它们找到用处。比许多其他氏族蝗虫携带更少的武器，意味着这种改型对更大的机甲也几乎构不成威胁。

column1: A total refit of the Locust by the infamous mercenary outfit Gray Death Legion. Trying to mimic the Locust IICs they have used large amounts of Clan tech on the base chassis, creating a fast moving 'Mech with the goal to flank other lights and quickly punch through their weakspots. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是臭名昭著的雇佣兵部队灰死军团对蝗虫的全面改装。他们试图模仿蝗虫IIC，在基础底盘上大量使用部族技术，造出一台高速机甲，目标是绕到其他轻型机甲侧翼并迅速击穿其弱点。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Light Fire Support
column2: 轻型火力支援

column1: Typical high-end Merc refit, take an Inner Sphere chassis and stick all the random Clan tech you have acquired over time in it. Usually enough to do the job it was intended for, just like in this case.
column2: 典型的高端雇佣兵改装：拿一副内天体底盘，把你这段时间弄到的各种氏族科技全塞进去。通常足够干它该干的活，就像这次一样。

column1: Like other major mercenary outfits, the Kell Hounds commonly refit their 'Mechs to suit their needs more by using Clan tech as it is usually better performing. The LCT-1KH is one of these designs, combining Endo Steel, Ferro-Fibrous and an XL engine, all in Clan spec, to reduce enough weight that the 'Mech can fit more weaponry. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 与其他主要雇佣兵部队一样，凯尔猎犬常用部族技术改装自己的机甲以适应需要，因为部族技术通常表现更好。LCT-1KH就是这类设计之一：它把内骨架、铁纤维和一台XL引擎（全为部族规格）结合起来，减掉足够重量以容纳更多武器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This variant is mostly aimed at dealing with infantry and similar low armor units, as it carries several Heavy Machine guns.
column2: 这一改型主要针对步兵和类似低装甲单位，因为它携带若干重型机枪。

column1: The LCT-1L Locust was an attempt to allow the 'Mech to operate at even higher speeds by adding Triple Strength Myomer to the design. Introduced in 3030 the weapons are identical to those on the LCT-1V as it was a test-bed for the technology by Bergan Industries' Ares plant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: LCT-1L蝗虫试图通过为该设计加入三倍强度人造肌，让机甲能以更高速度行动。它于3030年推出，作为伯根工业阿里斯工厂的技术试验平台，武器与LCT-1V完全相同。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The LCT-1L Locust was an attempt to allow the 'Mech to operate at even higher speeds by adding Triple Strength Myomer to the design. Introduced in 3030 the weapons are identical to those on the LCT-1V as it was a test-bed for the technology by Bergan Industries' Ares plant.
column2: LCT-1L蝗虫是一次尝试，通过在该设计上加入三倍强度肌纤维，让机甲能以更高速度运作。它于3030年推出，武器与LCT-1V完全相同，因为它是贝根工业阿瑞斯工厂对该技术的试验台。

column1: Piloted by the mercenary Jostein Mouwen, the Locust 1VM is a Mech with a bloody legend. Deployed among the Rim Worlds occupation forces on Terra, the 1VM has seen combat against numerous resistance groups and SLDF survivors. Originally a standard model LCT-1V, Mouwen has used a combination of looted equipment and battlefield salvage to upgrade his LCT-1V into a murderous Infantry hunter. Retaining the standard armor and heat sinks of the 1V model, Mouwen incorporated an XL Engine and a pair of Small Pulse Lasers taken from a downed LCT-1VB. The left over free weight is devoted to a third Machine Gun and a TAG. A Supercharger allows the mercenary to outrun real opponents. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 由雇佣兵约斯泰因·穆文驾驶，蝗虫1VM是一台沾满鲜血传说的机甲。它被部署在地球上的边境世界占领军中，曾与众多抵抗组织及SLDF幸存者交战。1VM原本是标准型号LCT-1V，穆文用缴获装备与战场残骸把座机改造成凶残的步兵猎手。他保留1V的标准装甲与散热器，换装一台XL引擎和从一架坠毁的LCT-1VB上取来的两门小型脉冲激光；剩余自由重量用于第三挺机枪和一具TAG。增压器让这名雇佣兵能跑赢真正的对手。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A refit of the 1V that replaces the two Machine Guns with one more Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是对1V的改装，以一门额外中型激光和一台C3从机取代两挺机枪。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Machine Guns are not very useful in engagements where there are no infantry, so it is common to remove them like with this refit.
column2: 在没有步兵的交战中机枪没什么用，所以像这次改装一样把它们拆掉很常见。

column1: A custom refit by the scrap refitters MechPros, most sold to mercenaries and less lawful areas, as the way the company acquired its inventory was questionable at best. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是废料改装商MechPros的定制改装，大部分卖给了雇佣兵和不太守法的地区，毕竟这家公司获取库存的方式本身就很有问题。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Is that a smudge of bludge in the cockpit? And does that look like machine gun bullet hole to you? This 'Mech is obviously looted from some battlefield and patched together...
column2: 座舱里那抹东西是血污吗？还有那个看着像机枪弹孔吧？这台机甲显然是从某个战场抢来拼凑的……

column1: Developed by Majesty Metals in 3056 to produce an upgraded Locust model for the MAF, the Locust 3P is based on the original LCT-1V and swaps the Machine Guns for Small Lasers. The Medium Laser is upgraded to a Pulse model and armor protection increased through the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Locust 3P由Majesty Metals公司于3056年为MAF研发，旨在提供一款升级版Locust。它以最初的LCT-1V为基础，将机枪换成小型激光。中型激光升级为脉冲型号，并通过采用铁纤维装甲提高防护能力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Developed by Majesty Metals in 3056 to produce an upgraded Locust model for the MAF, the Locust 3P is based on the original LCT-1V and swaps the Machine Guns for Small Lasers. The Medium Laser is upgraded to a Pulse model and armor protection increased through the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 3056年由至尊金属为MAF生产升级版蝗虫型号而研发，蝗虫3P以最初的LCT-1V为基础，把机枪换成小型激光器。中型激光器升级为脉冲型号，装甲防护则通过采用铁纤装甲而提升。

column1: Based on the earlier 3P model, the Locust 3T is produced by Pinard Protectorates. Introduced in 3059, the LCT-3T is a near clone of the 3P with identical levels of armor protection. Pinards engineers chose to swap the Medium Pulse Laser and 2 Small Lasers for a trio of Medium lasers for increased firepower. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Locust 3T以较早的3P型为基础，由Pinard Protectorates生产。LCT-3T于3059年推出，几乎是3P的翻版，装甲防护水平完全相同。Pinard的工程师选择把中型脉冲激光与2门小型激光换成三门中型激光，以获得更强的火力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Based on the earlier 3P model, the Locust 3T is produced by Pinard Protectorates. Introduced in 3059, the LCT-3T is a near clone of the 3P with identical levels of armor protection. Pinards engineers chose to swap the Medium Pulse Laser and 2 Small Lasers for a trio of Medium lasers for increased firepower.
column2: 基于更早的3P型号，蝗虫3T由皮纳德保护国生产。LCT-3T于3059年推出，几乎是3P的翻版，装甲防护水平完全相同。皮纳德的工程师选择把中型脉冲激光器和2门小型激光器换成三兄弟中型激光器，以提升火力。

column1: An anti-infantry variant of the Locust, the 4M mounts eight Small and one Medium Laser. To deal with the heat, the cooling uses double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Locust 的反步兵改型，4M 装备八门小型激光和一门中型激光。为解决散热问题，其冷却系统采用了双散热器。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Not a lot of use of this one, as we tend to not run into Infantry that much. Let's just refit it, Boss.
column2: 这东西用处不大，我们很少遇上步兵。老板，我们就把它改装一下吧。

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic Locust and intended for second-line and solahma troops, the Locust C replaced each of the arm-mounted Machine Guns with a Clan ER Small Laser which frees up the weight to replace the center Medium Laser with a Clan-grade Medium Pulse Laser but leaves the structural components of the LCT-1V unaltered. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Locust C 是对经典 Locust 的部族技术改装，面向二线部队与 solahma（苏拉赫马）部队。它以一门部族增程小型激光取代了每侧手臂上的机枪，由此腾出吨位，把中央的中型激光换成部族级中型脉冲激光，但 LCT-1V 的结构部件保持不变。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: Not the best Clan retrofit of the Locust, but still better than a base Inner Sphere one.
column2: 这不是蝗虫最好的氏族改装版，但仍优于内天体的基础型号。

column1: The Pirate's Bane is a light mech hunter killer built to keep the periphery pirates at bay. Keep moving and their teeth will be held at bay. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 海盗克星是专为牵制外围海盗而造的轻型机甲猎杀者。保持移动，他们的獠牙就无从下口。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上
