column1: The personal mech of Vladimir Ward. A modified Prime variant, this version has swapped the medium pulse laser for twin Extended Range mediums, one in each side torso.
column2: 弗拉基米尔·沃德的私人机甲。这是主配置的改装版，把中型脉冲激光器换成了两门增程中型激光器，左右躯干各一门。

column1: A customized variant of the Timber Wolf rumored to be piloted by Vlad Ward, the Warrant uses an LB 5-X Autocannon in its left arm, with one ton of ammo. The right arm uses an ER Medium Laser and ER Large Laser. Each side torso carried an LRM-20 with one ton of ammo. The left torso supported a Medium Pulse Laser, while the right torso carries an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是 Timber Wolf 的一种定制变型，据传由 Vlad Ward 驾驶。Warrant 的左臂装有一门 LB 5-X 自动炮，配一吨弹药；右臂装有增程中型激光和增程大型激光。每个侧躯干各承载一具 LRM-20 和一吨弹药。左躯干辅以一门中型脉冲激光，右躯干则装有一门增程小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中级 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A anti-infantry loadout used by the Wolf's Dragoons, the fabled mercenary company. The quite unique configuration mounts eight Machine Guns, ten Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Large Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是传说中的雇佣兵部队“狼之龙骑兵”（Wolf's Dragoons）所使用的反步兵配置。这套相当独特的配置装有八挺机枪、十具连发 SRM-2 发射器和两门大型脉冲激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

column1: A loadout used by the Wolf's Dragoons, combining an Inner Sphere Light Gauss Rifle with two ER Large Lasers and four LRM-5 launchers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是狼之龙骑兵使用的一套配置，将一门内层星域轻型高斯步枪与两门增程大型激光以及四具 LRM-5 发射器结合在一起。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This Wolf's Dragoons configuration of the Timber Wolf mounts only two ER PPC as its damage dealers. Instead it focuses on a support role with a C3 Master and advanced EWS equipment. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 狼之龙骑兵的这款森林狼配置只装两门 增程粒子炮作为输出手段，而是把重心放在支援角色上，配备一套 C3 主控单元与先进的 EWS 设备。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Designed in 2787, the Titan was a prototype assault mech that never reached full-scale production. The 1A carried two PPCs, six Medium Lasers, four SRM-4s, and an SRM-6. 22 Single Heatsinks manage the heat load. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 泰坦于2787年设计，是一款始终未能进入量产的原型突击机甲。1A型配备两门粒子炮、六具中型激光、四具SRM-4和一具SRM-6，由22具单散热器负责散热。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: Designed in 2787, the Titan was a prototype assault mech that never reached full-scale production. The 1A carried two PPCs, six Medium Lasers, four SRM-4s, and an SRM-6. 22 Single Heatsinks manage the heat load.
column2: 泰坦于 2787 年设计，是一款从未进入全面量产的突击机甲原型。1A 装备两门 PPC、六门中型激光、四具 SRM-4 和一具 SRM-6。22 台单散热器负责处理热负荷。

column1: The -1AD is a major refit from the -1A, replacing most of the weapons with more powerful versions. The medium lasers were upgraded to pulse versions and the three PPCs replaced by two ER PPCs. The SRM-launchers were kept the same, but their ammunition are now protected by C.A.S.E. The 'Mech was also upgraded to double heat sinks, improving its cooling even though it has one less sink than the original variant. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: -1AD是对-1A的大幅改装，把大部分武器换成更强力的版本：中型激光升级为脉冲型，三门粒子炮换成两门增程粒子炮；SRM发射器保持不变，但其弹药现在由C.A.S.E.保护。该机甲还升级为双散热器，尽管比原变型少一个散热器，冷却仍然更好。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Titan TI-1D is a further upgrade of the -1AD, but a quite costly one as it replaces the standard engine core with an extra light one. The freed space is used to add one more pulse laser, convert the SRM-6 to two SRM-4s and also add an active probe and one more heat sink. One ton of SRM ammunition is however dropped, leaving the 'Mech with only 200 missiles total. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 泰坦 TI-1D 是 -1AD 的进一步升级，但代价相当高昂，因为它把标准引擎核心换成了特轻引擎。腾出的空间用来加装一门脉冲激光、把 SRM-6 换成两门 SRM-4，并增加一个主动探测器和一台散热器。不过它削减了一吨 SRM 弹药，使该机甲总共只剩下 200 枚导弹。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The only difference between the -1D and -2D is the removal of the Beagle Active Probe, the 'Mech instead mounts a Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: -1D 与 -2D 之间唯一的区别是拆除了 Beagle 主动探测器，机甲改为装设一套 Guardian 电子对抗套件。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Tornado 是通讯之星于二十九世纪末期打造的轻型动力装甲，旨在为其特种部队提供额外防护。Tornado 以 SLDF 的 Nighthawk 装甲为基础——通讯之星当时虽已获得数套，却无法自行生产。它整合了隐形装甲与自适应伪装系统，可模拟伪装/红外/电子对抗潜行服的综合效果，使 Tornado 难以被任何类型的传感器发现。其装甲防护也足以挡下轻武器火力，甚至能抵御火焰喷射器这类重型武器的伤害，保护穿戴者。 特性：动力装甲 投放费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向装备，可进行近战，可实施蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer.
column2: 龙卷风是一种轻型动力装甲，由通讯之星在二十九世纪后期打造，为其特种部队提供额外防护。龙卷风以星际联盟国防军的夜鹰装甲为基础，而通讯之星当时虽已获得数套，却无力自行生产。它整合了隐身装甲和自适应伪装系统，效果相当于伪装/红外/ECM 潜行套件的组合，能让龙卷风躲开各类传感器的探测。这套装甲也足以挡下轻武器火力，甚至连火焰喷射器这样的重武器也无法伤到穿戴者。

column1: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 龙卷风是由通讯之星于二十九世纪晚期研制的动力装甲（轻型）套装，为他们的特种部队提供额外防护。龙卷风以星际联盟国防军的夜鹰套装为基础——尽管通讯之星已获得若干套，当时却无法自行生产。它整合了隐形装甲与自适应伪装系统，可模拟伪装/红外/电子对抗潜行服组合的效果，让龙卷风能对所有类型的传感器隐身。这套装甲也足以挡下轻武器火力，甚至能挡住火焰喷射器这样的重型武器，使穿着者不受伤害。 特性：动力装甲 投放费用倍率：0.8848 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

column1: The original prototype of the Toro, the A-1 was based of the primitive Firebee developed by the Cappellan Confederation. It had two SRM-2s which shared a ton of ammunition and a Large Laser. Though it could only manage 64 km/h, the A-1 had more armor protection than the Firebee, with ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor protecting the mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.78 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Toro 的最初原型 A-1 以卡佩兰联邦开发的原始型 Firebee 为基础。它装有两具共用一吨弹药的 SRM-2 和一门大型激光。虽然最高只能跑到 64 km/h，但 A-1 的装甲防护优于 Firebee，十吨半的原始装甲保护着这台机甲。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.78 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The original prototype of the Toro, the A-1 was based of the primitive Firebee developed by the Cappellan Confederation. It had two SRM-2s which shared a ton of ammunition and a Large Laser. Though it could only manage 64 km/h, the A-1 had more armor protection than the Firebee, with ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor protecting the mech.
column2: 作为公牛的最初原型，A-1基于卡佩兰联邦研发的原始火蜂。它装有两具共分享一吨弹药的SRM-2和一门大型激光器。虽然最高只能跑64公里/小时，A-1的装甲防护比火蜂更多，以十吨半原始装甲保护机甲。

column1: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech. Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 托罗于2546年生产，是金牛座协约的第一款战斗机甲设计。它以缴获的萤火虫为基础，是一款远程支援机甲，装有一门粒子炮和一对LRM-5，带两吨弹药和10个单散热器。最后一座托罗工厂于2598年被入侵的星际联盟部队拆毁，生产直到布莱克之词圣战才恢复。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech.  Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad.
column2: 托罗于2546年生产，是金牛座协约的第一款战斗机甲设计。它以缴获的萤火虫为基础，是一款远程支援机甲，装有一门粒子炮和一对LRM-5，带两吨弹药和10个单散热器。最后一座托罗工厂于2598年被入侵的星际联盟部队拆毁，生产直到布莱克之词圣战才恢复。

column1: The Trebuchet IIC 1 carries two LRM-20 launchers and three Medium Pulse Lasers. The LRM launchers are improved by the addition of Artemis IV FCS, and have a total of 5 tons of Artemis ammunition available. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Trebuchet IIC 1 搭载两组 LRM-20 发射器与三门中型脉冲激光。LRM 发射器因加装 Artemis IV 火控系统而性能提升，并有总计 5 吨的 Artemis 弹药可供使用。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: Trebuchet IIC
column2: 投石机 IIC

column1: The Trebuchet IIC is a like other IIC series a full Clan conversion of the original 'Mech design. The use of an extral ight engine, Endo Steel chassis and ferro-fibrous armor leaves plenty of space for weapons, making the 'Mech considerably more dangerous than the Inner Sphere versions.
column2: 与其他 IIC 系列一样，投石机 IIC 是原设计的完全氏族化改造。超轻型引擎、内骨骼底盘与铁纤维装甲的结合为武器留出充裕空间，使这台机甲远比内天体版本危险。

column1: The IIC 2 uses an LRM-20 with Artemis FCS for long range engagements, adding three ER Medium Lasers as the 'Mech closes in on its enemies. For close range fighting the IIC 2 also mounts a Streak SRM-6. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: IIC 2在远程交战时使用一具带阿尔忒弥斯火控系统的LRM-20，并在逼近敌人时加入三门增程中型激光。近距战斗中，IIC 2还装有一具连发SRM-6。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Trebuchet IIC 3 focuses on long range, high impact weapons. It mounts an Ultra AC/10 in the left arm and an ER PPC in the right torso. A Streak SRM-6 in the right arm can provide some extra punch at closer ranges. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 投石机 IIC 3（Trebuchet IIC 3）专注于远程高威力武器。它的左臂装有一门超速 AC/10，右躯干装有一门增程粒子炮。右臂的连发 SRM-6 则能在较近距离提供额外的打击力。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The IIC 4 drops the ferro-fibrous armor of the earlier IIC variants in an attempt to ease its maintenance needs. The main armament are two LRM-20 launchers with attached Artemis IV FCS and six ton of ammunition. Three ER Medium Laser and one ER Small Laser can help with dealing extra damage or self-defense. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: IIC 4舍弃了早期IIC变型的铁纤维装甲，以减轻维护负担。主要武器为两具LRM-20发射器，配属阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统和六吨弹药。三门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光可提供额外伤害或用于自卫。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Trebuchet TBT-5K is a custom variant originally fielded by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds. The variant uses only Clan-grade specification weapons; two LRM-15 with attached Artemis IV and three ER Medium Lasers. The 'Mech also upgrades the heat sinks to Clan specification and adds a C3 Slave computer mounted in the head. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 投石机TBT-5K是最初由雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬投入使用的定制变型。该变型只用部族规格武器：两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15和三门增程中型激光。它还把散热器升级为部族规格，并在头部加装一台C3从机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The Trebuchet (also jovially referred to as the Trenchbucket) is a mainline medium weight BattleMech considered to be a fine blend of long- and short-range fire support for a unit of its size. Unlike many other pre-Clan 'Mechs, the Trebuchet was designed from the beginning to work as part of a lance instead of functioning as a stand-alone model.
column2: 投石机（也被戏称为"战壕桶"）是一款主力中型战斗机甲，被认为是其尺寸单位中远程与近程火力支援的优良组合。与许多氏族入侵前的机甲不同，投石机从一开始就被设计为小队的一部分，而非独立运作的型号。

column1: The -.5NR is a battlfield refit of the -5N, dropping one Medium Laser for a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: -.5NR是-5N的野战改装，拆掉一门中型激光换装一台C3从机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Introduced in 3025, the -5P retains the dual right arm medium lasers, but otherwise alters the remaining loadout, downgrading the LRM racks to LRM-10s and moving the left arm launcher to the left torso, also shifting the left arm medium laser to the center torso. The weight reduction is needed to carry a medium mace in the left arm with specialized arm actuators to improve its performance. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: -5P于3025年推出，保留了右臂的两门中型激光，但其余装备全部改动：LRM发射架降级为LRM-10，左臂发射器移到左躯干，左臂的中型激光也移到中央躯干。这些减重是为了在左臂挂载一柄中型钉锤，并配以专用手臂驱动器以提升其性能。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A refit of the -7M, removing the Narc laucher to instead add Artemis IV FCS for the LRM-15 launchers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 对-7M的改装：拆除Narc发射器，改为给LRM-15发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The -7KR is an upgrade kit for the -7K, greatly updating its equipment. The PPC is replaced by an ER PPC and the AC/5 by an Ultra AC/5. The SRM-2 is dropped, to instead add a Small Laser. C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition and a C3 Slave computer are also added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: -7KR 是 -7K 的升级套件，对其装备进行了大幅更新。粒子炮被替换为增程粒子炮，AC/5 被替换为 Ultra AC/5。SRM-2 被拆除，改为加装一门小型激光。此外还增加了弹药 C.A.S.E. 防护和一台 C3 从机计算机。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: A -8KL, or -8K 'Long', regears the standard -8K for longer range engagements by replacing all the lasers with a single ER Large Laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Right Upper
column2: -8KL，又称 -8K“远程型”，为标准 -8K 重新配置了装备以适应更远距离的交战：它把所有激光替换为一门增程大型激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下、右上

column1: Named after the largest trebuchet ever built in primitive Terra, the Warwolf packs heavy close range weaponry in the form of paired SRMs, streaks, and pulse lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 战争之狼以原始地球上建造过的最大投石机命名，装有一整套重型近程武器：成对的SRM、连发导弹与脉冲激光。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Named after the largest trebuchet ever built in primitive Terra, the Warwolf packs heavy close range weaponry in the form of paired SRMs, streaks, and pulse lasers.
column2: 战狼以原始类地上有史以来建造过的最大投石机命名，它搭载重型近距离武器：成对的SRM、连发SRM和脉冲激光器。

column1: The Trooper delivers a lot of bang for the buck, as it's large AC/5 autocannon and three Medium Lasers are a respectable weaponry for a 'Mech of its size. The 'Mech still manages to fit an SRM-4 for short range damage bursts. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 步兵性价比极高：它那门大型AC/5自动炮和三门中型激光对如此尺寸的机甲而言是相当不错的武器，而且还设法装下了一具SRM-4用于近程伤害爆发。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Trooper is a cheap Shadow Hawk knock-off BattleMech introduced by Taurian Concordat's Vandenberg Mechanized Industries for sale to other periphery states. Its frame and weapons are all easily maintained or replaced, making the 'Mech considerably cheaper for remote garrisons or militaries with very limited budgets.
column2: 士兵是陶里安协约国的范登堡机械化工业推出的一款廉价影子鹰仿制战斗机甲，用于向其他外缘国家出售。它的框架与武器都易于维护或替换，使该机甲对偏远驻军或预算极有限的军队来说便宜得多。

column1: The Alpha configuration of the Trooper OmniMech drops the LRM-15 launcher to instead add a five jump jets and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 步兵全向机甲的Alpha配置拆掉LRM-15发射器，改为加装五具跳跃推进器和一门增程小型激光。 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A 60-ton Clan OmniMech, the Trooper was designed by Clan Star Adder as a larger compliment to the Adder. Using weight saving technologies as Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel chassis together with a 300 XL engine over 10 tons of pod space are freed for weapons.
column2: 士兵是一台 60 吨的部族全向机甲，由星蝰蛇部族设计，作为蝰蛇的放大补充型号。它采用铁纤维装甲和内骨架底盘等减重技术，再配上 300 XL 引擎，腾出了超过 10 吨的吊舱空间用于安装武器。

column1: The H loadout is focused on close to medium range fights, mounting a massive Ultra AC/20 and a Heavy Large Laser as the main damage dealers. A Heavy Medium Laser provides some extra cover if needed, while an AMS will intercept any incoming missiles. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: H载荷专注中近距离战斗，装一门庞大的超级AC/20和一门重型大型激光作为主要伤害来源，另有一门重型中型激光在需要时提供额外掩护，一套反导弹系统则拦截来袭导弹。 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration of the Trooper uses an Ultra AC/10 in each arm as the main sources of damage, while two ER Medium Lasers and a LRM-15 launcher can be called on as needed. Four tons of autocannon ammunition and two tons of LRM missiles ensures the 'Mech can stand its ground without haveing to re-arm very often. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 士兵的默认配置在每条手臂上各装一门超级AC/10作为主要伤害来源，另有两门增程中型激光与一具LRM-15发射器可按需调用。四吨自动炮弹药与两吨LRM导弹，让这台机甲无需频繁补充弹药就能守住阵地。 特性：精准武器（自动炮） 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The TS-P1's weaponry isn't very impressive, but is adequate for a 40-ton 'Mech. Two Medium Lasers and a Stream SRM-2 deal most of the external damage, while two Machine Guns can shred an opponents internals once the armor is breached. Six jump jets improves the mobility enough to compensate for its 240 standard fusion core. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: TS-P1 的武器配置谈不上惊艳，但对一具 40 吨的机甲而言已算够用。两门中型激光和一具连发 SRM-2 造成大部分外部伤害，而两挺机枪能在敌方装甲被击穿后撕碎其内部结构。六具跳跃推进器带来的机动性足以弥补 240 标准聚变核心的不足。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Tsunami was originally a workhorse 'Mech that could hold its own on the battlefield as well as in the arenas. It wasn't flashy, it just got the job done.
column2: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，海啸最初是一种在战场上和竞技场里都能站稳脚跟的主力机甲。它并不花哨，只是把事情办成。

column1: The Tsunami relies on its 400 XL fusion engine combined with a MASC to reach speeds such that it will surprise its enemies, enabling a flanking maneuver. Once the 'Mech is positioned for a strike, its ER PPC and five Medium Pulse Lasers can easily chew through any side or rear armor. The cooling is handled by 11 double heat sinks. Quirk: Integrated Adv. AMS Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Tsunami依靠其400 XL聚变引擎与MASC的配合，达到足以令敌人措手不及的速度，从而实现侧翼包抄。一旦机甲占好攻击位置，它的增程粒子炮和五门中型脉冲激光便能轻易撕开任何侧面或后方装甲。散热由11台双散热器负责。 特性：集成先进反导弹系统 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: The Tsunami is a 80-ton off-brand 'Mech produced by Defiance Industries using their overstock of Zeus-X chassis using cheaper components. The resulting 'Mech is not the most reliable, but is still considered decent as a secondary line unit or part of a base garrison.
column2: 海啸是反抗工业公司利用其宙斯-X底盘过剩库存、采用更廉价部件生产的80吨杂牌机甲。成品不是最可靠的，但作为二线单位或基地驻防的一部分仍算不错。

column1: Envirosealed unarmored exoskeleton. Clearly unsuitable for combat, but desperate times call for desperate measures, and people had attempted to swarm mechs in exoskeletons with laser cutters and industrial drills. Quirk: Exoskeleton Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 环境密封的无装甲外骨骼。显然不适合战斗，但非常时期需用非常手段，人们曾试图用装有激光切割器和工业钻头的外骨骼蜂拥攀附机甲。 特性：外骨骼 投放费用倍率：0.8832 可安装全向单位，可进行近战，可蜂拥攀附。

column1: Tunnel Rat
column2: 坑道鼠

column1: Boss, your are not going to send our guys out in this, right? Right?! Boss?!!
column2: 老大，你不会真让咱们的人坐着这个出去吧？是吧？！老大？！！

column1: Designed for fighting Inner Sphere forces, the Turkina C is optimised for Urban combat. An LB-X Autocannon/20 and twin Large Pulse Lasers can open up holes in enemy 'Mechs, while the Streak SRM-6 and paired Medium Pulse Lasers exploit them. Paired Anti-Personnel Pods, Machine Guns, and Flamers discourage conventional forces from closing. An Active Probe finds most hidden units, ensuring the MechWarrior is rarely surprised. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Turkina C 为对抗内层星域部队而设计，并针对城市战进行了优化。一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 与双联大型脉冲激光能在敌方机甲上撕开缺口，连发 SRM-6 和两门中型脉冲激光则趁机扩大战果。成对的反人员吊舱、机枪和火焰喷射器可阻止常规部队靠近。一具主动探测器能发现大多数隐蔽单位，使机甲战士极少遭遇突袭。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Designed for fighting Inner Sphere forces, the Turkina C is optimised for Urban combat. An LB-X Autocannon/20 and twin Large Pulse Lasers can open up holes in enemy 'Mechs, while the Streak SRM-6 and paired Medium Pulse Lasers exploit them. Paired Anti-Personnel Pods, Machine Guns, and Flamers discourage conventional forces from closing. An Active Probe finds most hidden units, ensuring the MechWarrior is rarely surprised.
column2: 为对抗内天体部队而设计，突厥娜C为城市战优化。一门LB-X自动炮/20和两门大型脉冲激光器能在敌方机甲上开洞，而连发SRM-6和成对的中型脉冲激光器则加以利用。成对的反人员吊舱、机枪和火焰喷射器阻止常规部队靠近。一个主动探测器能找出大多数隐蔽单位，确保机师极少被突袭。

column1: The Turkina D is armed with 4 ATM 12s. Ten tons of ammunition allow it to make use of the flexibility of Advanced Tactical Missile technology. A pair of ER Medium Lasers provide backup. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Turkina D 装备 4 具 ATM 12。十吨弹药使它得以充分发挥先进战术导弹技术的灵活性。一对增程中型激光则作为辅助火力。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Turkina D is armed with 4 ATM 12s. Ten tons of ammunition allow it to make use of the flexibility of Advanced Tactical Missile technology. A pair of ER Medium Lasers provide backup.
column2: 突厥娜D武装为4具ATM 12。十吨弹药让它能充分利用高级战术导弹技术的灵活性。一对增程中型激光器提供后援。

column1: Each arm of this Turkina configuration carries an ER Large Laser, LB 2-X, and an LB 5-X, plus a ton of ammunition for each autocannon. These are supplemented by an LRM-5 in each side torso and a center torso mounted Medium Pulse Laser. Sixteen double heat sinks are carried as well. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该 Turkina 配置的每条手臂各装一门增程大型激光、一门 LB 2-X 和一门 LB 5-X，并为每门自动炮配备一吨弹药。此外，每个侧躯干各有一具 LRM-5，中央躯干装有一门中型脉冲激光，另配备十六具双散热器。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
column2: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠猎鹰，它在翡翠猎鹰氏族早期激励了其领袖。

column1: The MC/A loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/A combines four LBX, two of them being AC/10 and two AC/2, together with two ER Large Lasers as the main damage dealers. A Medium Pulse Laser and LRM-5 can be used if some extra punch is needed. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: MC/A载荷是“大师之作”项目的产物，该项目试图让最优秀的战士打造他们理想的配置。MC/A把四门LBX——其中两门AC/10、两门AC/2——与两门增程大型激光组合为主要伤害来源，需要额外打击力时还可动用一门中型脉冲激光和一具LRM-5。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The MC/J loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/J is very similar to the MC/A, as it keeps the weapons the same: two LBX AC/10, two LBX AC/2, two ER Large Lasers, one Medium Pulse Laser and one LRM-5. But by dropping some armor and converting the chassis to Endo Steel, the space for three Jump Jets were freed. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: MC/J 配置是“大师之作”项目的产物，该项目旨在让最优秀的战士打造自己理想的配置。MC/J 与 MC/A 非常相似，武器完全相同：两门 LBX AC/10、两门 LBX AC/2、两门增程大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具 LRM-5。但通过削减部分装甲并将底盘改为内骨架，它腾出了安装三个跳跃推进器的空间。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The MC/W loadout was created as part of the 'Master Creation' project, an attempt to have the best warriors create their ideal configurations. The MC/W replaces the two LBX AC/2 from the /A and /J with two Ultra AC/2 and the ER Large Lasers with ER PPC. The rest of the configuration is kept very similar. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: MC/W配置是"大师创造"计划的产物，该计划旨在让最优秀的战士打造自己理想的配置。MC/W把/A与/J配置上的两门LBX AC/2换成两门超级自动炮AC/2，并把增程大型激光换成增程粒子炮，其余配置则大致保持不变。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The X-B configuration is generally only used during batchalls, and is therefore very rare to ever been seen outside Clan occupied territory. It mounts twin Ultra AC/20 for impressive close range firepower, together with two ER Large Lasers for hitting targets further away. Finally it also has one SRM-4 and one LRM-5 missile launcher. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: X-B 配置通常只在竞价决斗中使用，因此在部族占领区之外极难得见。它装有两门 Ultra AC/20，近距离火力惊人，并配有两门增程大型激光用于打击更远处的目标。最后，它还装有一具 SRM-4 和一具 LRM-5 导弹发射器。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Undine battle armor was created by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a combat upgrade to the original "water elementals," the underwater exoskeletons that inspired Clan Wolf's Elemental battle armor. This Undine version replaces the UMU with standard Elementals JJs, while retaining its signature LRM/T launcher. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Undine 战斗装甲由歌利亚蝎族打造，是对最初“水元素”的作战升级——正是那些水下外骨骼启发了狼族的元素战斗装甲。这一 Undine 版本以标准的元素跳跃推进器取代了 UMU，同时保留了其标志性的 LRM/T 发射器。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.93 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可攀附攻击。

column1: The Undine battle armor was created by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a combat upgrade to the original \"water elementals,\" the underwater exoskeletons that inspired Clan Wolf's Elemental battle armor.
column2: 温蒂妮战斗装甲由蝎狮氏族创造，作为对原版"水元素"的作战升级——那些水下外骨骼正是狼族元素战斗装甲的灵感来源。

column1: UrbanMech IIC
column2: 都市机甲 IIC

column1: Complete with a light bar, the K-9 is an UrbanMech refitted for use by a planetary police department. The standard variant's AC/10 is swapped for a UAC/5 and the left arm small laser is updated to a large laser, with two small lasers mounted in the center torso. While its ground speed remains unchanged, the K-9's heavier weapons loadout is made possible through the use of an endo steel chassis and mounting 10 double heat sinks. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: K-9 配有警灯条，是由城市机甲改装、供行星警察部门使用的机型。标准型号的 AC/10 被换成 UAC/5，左臂的小型激光升级为大型激光，中央躯干则安装了两门小型激光。虽然地面速度保持不变，但 K-9 之所以能搭载更重的武器配置，得益于采用内骨架底盘并安装10个双散热器。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Heavy Defender
column2: 重型防御者

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
column2: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

column1: The UM-R100 'SuburbanMech' adapts the traditional UrbanMech R60 into an energy weapon platform for higher performance. Because its weapons aren't limited by ammunition concerns, the R100 is better-suited to longer engagements. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: UM-R100“郊区机甲”把传统的垃圾佬R60改造成性能更高的能量武器平台。由于武器不受弹药限制，R100更适合较长时间的交战。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This is an UrbanMech variant I've never even heard of before. It's got the same armor as a standard R60, but this R100 is armed entirely with energy weapons, including an ER PPC for long-range power. I'm not sure why nobody thought of this sooner.
column2: 这是一种我连听都没听过的城市机甲改型。它的装甲与标准R60相同，但这台R100完全以能量武器武装，包括一门用于远程威力的增程PPC。我不明白为什么没人早点想到这个。

column1: This is the customized Urbie of Dennis Franken, famed leader of mercenary outfit Franken's Frankers, with a Large Laser in the left arm and a PPC in the right, and 12 heat sinks for cooling. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是雇佣兵部队“弗兰肯的弗兰克们”著名首领丹尼斯·弗兰肯的定制垃圾佬，左臂一门大型激光，右臂一门粒子炮，另有12个散热器降温。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。 特质：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Desperate to find any proper use of their UrbanMechs, two Improved AC/2 replaced the single AC/10 on the UM-R60-CE. The small Laser was further replaced by an Improved Large Laser, at the cost of dropping one no longer needed Heat Sink and half a ton of armor. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 为了给手中的 UrbanMech 找到像样的用途，UM-R60-CE 上的单门 AC/10 被两门改进型 AC/2 取代。小型激光也被改进型大型激光替换，代价是拆掉一具不再需要的散热器以及半吨装甲。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The R60R upgrade kit removes the Small Laser and one heat sink from the R60 to instead fit C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition and a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: R60R 升级套件拆除了 R60 的小型激光和一具散热器，改为安装弹药的 C.A.S.E. 防护以及一台 C3 从属计算机。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The Street Cleaner is an UrbanMech utilized by a member of Philip Capet's Solaris VII stable Capellan Mafia. The 'Street Cleaner' is very similar to the standard UrbanMech, featuring an AC/10, supported by a small laser and jump jets. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 街头清道夫是菲利普·卡佩在索拉里斯VII的卡佩兰黑手党战团成员所使用的都市机甲。它与标准型都市机甲极为相似，装备一门AC/10，并辅以一门小型激光和跳跃推进器。 特性：360°躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Ursus 1 is a flexible defender that mounts a variety of weapons to engage enemies at all ranges. Its weakness is in its lack of long-range capability, though the ER Large Laser and LRM-10 are respectable for a 'Mech its size. For closer work, it uses two ER Medium Lasers, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a SRM-6 launcher. This blistering hail of weapons fire is generally effective for an Inner Sphere heavy 'Mech, so the Ursus compares favorably to the designs that it is expected to stand up against. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 乌尔苏斯1是一款灵活的防御型机甲，装备多种武器，可在各距离上与敌人交战。它的弱点在于缺乏远程能力，不过就其体型而言，增程大型激光和LRM-10已算相当不错。近距离作战时，它使用两门增程中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-6发射器。这阵炽热的火力风暴对内层星域的重型机甲而言通常相当有效，因此乌尔苏斯与预期要对抗的那些设计相比毫不逊色。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The Ursus is a fusion between Clan and Inner Sphere technologies. The first Clan BattleMech designed and manufactured entirely and exclusively in the Inner Sphere, the Ursus uses Inner Sphere technology that has not been surpassed by that of the Clans where possible to maximize the efficiency of the factories Clan Ghost Bear captured during the Clan invasion. The rest of the parts are imported from Clan space. Though it took over seven years, Ghost Bear technicians made the Clan and Inner Sphere parts work together to create this second-line 'Mech.
column2: 乌尔苏斯是氏族与内天体技术的融合体。作为第一台完全且仅在内天体设计并制造的氏族战斗机甲，乌尔苏斯尽可能采用尚未被氏族超越的内天体技术，以最大化幽灵熊氏族在氏族入侵中夺取的工厂的效率。其余部件则从氏族空间进口。尽管花了七年多时间，幽灵熊的技师们还是让氏族与内天体的部件协同工作，造出了这台二线机甲。

column1: Valkyrie II
column2: 瓦尔基里 II

column1: A nice heavily armored scout, not too bad. Probably best to keep it at range however, out of harm's range. But an easy mech to find parts for and keep running. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 一台装甲厚重、表现不错的侦察机体，相当不赖。不过最好还是让它保持在远处，远离危险范围。它也是一台容易找到零件、便于维持运转的机甲。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Valkyrie LAM
column2: 瓦尔基里 LAM

column1: A nice heavily armored scout, not too bad.  Probably best to keep it at range however, out of harm's range.  But an easy mech to find parts for and keep running.
column2: 一台不错的重装甲侦察机甲，相当可以。不过最好让它保持距离，待在伤害范围之外。但它的部件容易找到，也易于维持运转。

column1: The -Q1 is an upgrade kit for the -QA, upgrading the Medium Laser to an Extended Range version and adds Artemis IV capabilities to the LRM-10 launcher. One extra ton of LRM missiles are added, as well as C.A.S.E. protection for all of the ammunition. This was all possible by switching to double heat sinks - allowing the 'Mech to drop one sink - and upgrading the chassis to use Endo Steel. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: -Q1是-QA的升级套件，把中型激光升级为增程版本，并为LRM-10发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV能力。它还增加一吨LRM导弹，并为所有弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。这一切都通过改用双散热器（使机甲得以拆掉一个散热器）并把底盘升级为内骨架而实现。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A nice heavily armored scout, not too bad. Probably best to keep it at range however, out of harm's range. But an easy mech to find parts for and keep running. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 一台装甲厚重的侦察机甲，还不错。不过最好还是让它保持距离，别待在危险范围内。但它的零件好找，也容易维持运转。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: A battlefield refit of the VLK-QA, the -QAR switches to use ten double heat sinks, allowing the addition of a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: QAR是VLK-QA的战场改装型，改用十具双散热器，从而得以加装一台C3从属计算机。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The QD Valkyrie is a major overhaul of the design debuting in 3049. The chassis has been re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction and the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous with CASE. This allowed the variant to update the laser to a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser and add an Artemis IV fire control system to the Devastator LRM-10. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: QD 女武神是该设计于 3049 年首次亮相的重大改进版本。底盘经过重新设计，改用内骨架结构，装甲也升级为带 CASE 的铁纤维。这让该变型得以把激光换成 Sutel Precision Line 中型脉冲激光，并为 Devastator LRM-10 加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The QF model of the Valkyrie trades in the medium laser for a flamer, which allows the 'Mech to work in an incendiary role and also acts as an excellent deterrent to infantry attacks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Valkyrie 的 QF 型号用火焰喷射器换掉了中型激光，使该机甲能够执行纵火任务，同时对步兵的进攻也是极佳的威慑。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: A custom Clan technology conversion of the Valkyrie, the -QK was originally fielded by the Kell Hounds mercenary band. It provides three ER Medium Lasers in the right arm and one LRM with Artemis IV in the left arm. In the head a C3 Slave computer is mounted. The engine is a 150 XL core and the armor has been upgraded to ferro-fibrous. The 'Mech uses ten double heat sinks to handle the produced heat. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: -QK 变型是对 Valkyrie 进行部族技术改装的定制机，最初由凯尔猎犬雇佣兵团使用。它在右臂装有三门中型增程激光，左臂装有一具配备 Artemis IV 的 LRM。头部安装了一台 C3 从属计算机。引擎为 150 XL 核心，装甲已升级为铁纤维。该机甲使用十具双散热器来处理产生的热量。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The Vanguard mounts an LB 5-X AC in each side torso alongside a left-torso mounted ER PPC, for close range support a trio of Streak SRM-4 are carried in the arms. Two tons each of LBX and Streak ammunition provide good field endurance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Vanguard在每个侧躯干各装备一门LB 5-X AC，左躯干另装有一门增程粒子炮；近距离火力支援则由双臂上的三具连发SRM-4负责。LBX弹药与连发弹药各两吨，赋予它出色的战场持续作战能力。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Skirmisher & Direct Fire Support
column2: 游击与直射火力支援

column1: The Vanguard mounts an LB 5-X AC in each side torso alongside a left-torso mounted ER PPC, for close range support a trio of Streak SRM-4 are carried in the arms. Two tons each of LBX and Streak ammunition provide good field endurance.
column2: 先锋在两侧躯干各装一门LB 5-X AC，另有左躯干的一门增程PPC，近距离支援则用装在双臂的三具连发SRM-4。LBX与连发弹药各两吨提供了良好的战场续航力。

column1: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 蒸汽鹰采用杂而近距的武器载荷：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连发SRM-2和三门中型脉冲激光分装两侧躯干，左臂一个手枪形外壳内则有三挺机枪。加装一台瞄准计算机后，只要能把武器带入射程，其火力就更为致命。十一个双散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连发导弹弹药对一般的部族试炼而言绰绰有余。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Vapor Eagle
column2: 蒸汽鹰

column1: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
column2: 蒸汽鹰拥有杂糅而偏近程的武器配置：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连续 SRM-2 和三门中型脉冲激光分列两侧躯干，左臂手枪形护罩内还有三挺机枪收尾。加装瞄准计算机后，只要武器能进入射程，其火力更为致命。十一台双倍散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连续导弹弹药，对一般的氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

column1: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 蒸汽鹰的这一变型拆掉两门中型脉冲激光、两具连发导弹巢和大型脉冲激光，以及机甲的一个双散热器，换来一门超级AC/10。该武器以类似古老影子鹰的越肩布置安装，射速是标准自动炮/10的两倍，并带足量弹药可连续以最高射速射击一分半以上。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.
column2: 此蒸汽鹰变体移除两门中型脉冲激光、两具连续导弹荚舱、大型脉冲激光以及一台双倍散热器，换成一门超速自动炮/10。该武器以如同古老的影鹰那样的过肩方式安装，射速是标准自动炮/10 的两倍，并携带足以以最高射速连续射击一分半钟以上的弹药。

column1: This variant carries three Machine Guns in the left arm, three Medium Pulse Lasers in the right arm, supported by a Machine Gun in the left torso and a Medium Pulse Laser in the right torso. It also retains the Targeting Computer. Long range fire is provided by an LRM-20 with an Artemis IV FCS. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 此变型左臂装三挺机枪，右臂三门中型脉冲激光，左躯干一挺机枪和右躯干一门中型脉冲激光支援，并保留瞄准计算机。远程火力由一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-20提供。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: First appearing in the Inner Sphere with the arrival of Clan Steel Viper, ComStar operatives were baffled by the intended purpose of the close-combat second-line garrison BattleMech they named the Goshawk for its unusual birdlike design. It wasn't until Clan culture became more understood that Inner Sphere observers figured out what the Clans called the Vapor Eagle was designed as a duelist for the one-on-one fights that are so prevalent in Clan society.
column2: 它随着钢蛇部族的到来首次出现在内层星域，通讯之星的特工起初对这台被命名为“苍鹰”的近战二线驻防战斗机甲的用途感到困惑——因为它外形奇特如鸟。直到部族文化被更多人了解之后，内层星域的观察者才弄明白：部族称之为蒸汽鹰的这款机甲，是为部族社会中极为常见的一对一决斗而设计的决斗者。

column1: This version keeps the arm weapons and targeting computer of the base model, but in place of the Large Pulse Laser are an Ultra AC/2 in each side torso with a ton of ammunition for each cannon. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 此版本保留了基础型的臂部武器与瞄准计算机，但以两侧躯干各一门Ultra AC/2取代了大型脉冲激光，并为每门自动炮配备一吨弹药。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: A customized variant of the Vapor Eagle. The Rival carries 3 Heavy Machine Guns in its left arm, while a single ER PPC is mounted in the right arm. An ATM 9s and three ton of ATM ammo is in the right torso mounted with MASC. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是雾鹰的定制变型。“对手”在左臂装有3挺重型机枪，右臂则挂载1门增程粒子炮；右躯干内装1具ATM 9与3吨ATM弹药，并与MASC一同安装。\n<特性：空降突击\n<投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: A customized variant of the Vapor Eagle. The Rival carries 3 Heavy Machine Guns in its left arm, while a single ER PPC is mounted in the right arm. An ATM 9s and three ton of ATM ammo is in the right torso mounted with MASC.
column2: 汽鹰的定制改型。对手在左臂携带3挺重型机枪，右臂则装有一门增程PPC。右躯干装有一具ATM 9和三吨ATM弹药，并配有MASC。

column1: The SDR-10K of the Venom is similar in armament to the -9K, but upgrades to use an Endo Steel chassis and double heat sinks. The saved space is used to almost double the amount of armor mounted on the 'Mech. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Venom的SDR-10K在武器配置上与-9K相似，但升级为使用内骨架底盘和双散热器。节省下来的空间用于将机甲搭载的装甲量几乎提高一倍。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The company, which at the time was producing only the Spider, was forced to comply with an order by the Coordinator himself that 'Mech manufacturers make up for the losses suffered by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
column2: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。该公司当时只生产蜘蛛，被迫服从协调官本人的命令：机甲制造商必须弥补德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队遭受的损失。

column1: The 9KA variant of the Venom is a simple modification that intends to increase the 'Mech's protection at the cost of firepower. Introduced in 3056, it does this by removing one of the medium pulse lasers and replacing it with an additional two tons of armor, increasing the total armor protection to five and a half tons. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 毒液9KA是一种简单的改型，意在牺牲火力以提升机甲防护。它于3056年问世，做法是拆除一门中型脉冲激光，代之以额外两吨装甲，使总装甲防护提升到五吨半。 特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The 9KB variant of the Venom is intended to increase both the 'Mech's protection and its anti-infantry capabilities. This is done by removing one of the medium pulse lasers and two jumps jets and replacing them with a single machine gun with a half ton of ammunition and a heat sink. The remaining ton has been used to increase the 'Mech's armor. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Venom 的 9KB 变型旨在同时提升机甲的防护能力与反步兵能力。为此拆除了一门中型脉冲激光和两台跳跃推进器，换成一挺机枪（配半吨弹药）和一台散热器。余下的一吨则用于增加机甲装甲。 特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The personal command 'Mech of General Rudolph Chapman, this 80 ton Victor is a heavily modified machine. Provided with some of the latest technology by NAIS, it is a walking testbed of the new and recovered technologies emerging from the Inner Sphere's intellectual hub Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是鲁道夫·查普曼将军的专属指挥机甲。这台 80 吨的 Victor 经过大幅改装，由 NAIS 提供了一部分最新技术，堪称内层星域学术中枢不断涌现的新技术与复原技术的行走试验台。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Heavy Cavalry
column2: 重型骑兵

column1: It seems General Chapman liked the looks of the Victor but nothing else. Almost everything has been changed on this 'Mech with prototype technology.
column2: 看来查普曼将军只喜欢胜利者的外观，别的都不满意。这台机甲上几乎所有东西都用原型技术换过了。

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of SLDF VTR-9B Victors intended for second-line and solahma troops, this variant swaps the large bore autocannon for a Gauss Rifle, the SRM rack for an advanced Streak SRM-4 and standard Medium Lasers for paired ER Medium Lasers. Unlike the similarly armed 9D and 9K variants, lighter Clan weaponry allows this swap without the need to utilize an Endo Steel chassis and still leaves the refit two ton under weight. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这一变型是为二线与索拉赫马部队准备的SLDF VTR-9B维克托的部族技术改装版，它把大口径自动炮换成高斯步枪、把SRM发射巢换成先进的连发SRM-4，并把标准中型激光换成成对的增程中型激光。与武装相似的9D和9K变型不同，更轻的部族武器使这次更换无需采用内骨架底盘，而且还让改装后仍有两吨的重量余量。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: This clan-tech upgrade of the stock 9B variant makes it a lot more lethal, this one is a mech to look out for in the battlefield unlike the normal variants. Can I have this one, Boss?
column2: 这一对原装9B变型的部族技术升级让它致命得多；与常规变型不同，这台机甲在战场上是需要提防的存在。老板，这台能给我吗？

column1: This custom Victor was used by SLDF Major General Carlos Kataga. It upgrades the engine to a 320 XL, and the Chassis to Endo Steel. This allowed for a 30% increase in overall armor, which was rebalanced towards the front. The AC/20 was upgraded to a Gauss Rifle and the two Medium Lasers and SRM 4 were replaced with Large Pulse Lasers, two Medium Lasers, and a Beagle Active Probe. The heat sinks were upgraded to double strength. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这台定制 Victor 由 SLDF 少将卡洛斯·卡塔加使用。它将引擎升级为 320 XL，底盘升级为内骨架，这使整体装甲增加了 30%，并被重新平衡至正面。AC/20 升级为高斯步枪，两门中型激光和 SRM 4 则被替换为大型脉冲激光、两门中型激光和一部 Beagle 主动探测器。散热器也升级为双倍散热能力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Standing at 14 meters tall, the Victor approaches the concept of support in an unorthodox way for a 'Mech of its weight class. While only possessing a ground speed of 64.8 km/h, the Victor achieves a high degree of mobility instead through the use of four jump jets, allowing it to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. A Victor can therefore \"support\" friendly units by jumping directly into the fray and bringing its deadly close range arsenal to bear, an ability which can surprise inexperienced MechWarriors and prove advantageous in mountainous terrain.
column2: 维克多高 14 米，对同重量级机甲而言它以一种非正统的方式诠释支援概念。虽然地面速度只有 64.8 公里/小时，维克多却通过四个跳跃推进器获得高度机动性，可跳起至一百二十米。因此维克多可以"支援"友军单位——直接跃入战团，动用其致命的近程武器库；这种能力能让缺乏经验的机甲战士吃惊，并在山地地形中占据优势。

column1: The custom Victor used by Tai-sho Li Dok To, this variant removed all the standard weapons and replaced them with a single LRM-15 mounted in the left torso and ten Medium Lasers carried in the 'Mech's right arm, greatly reducing ammo dependency. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是大将 Li Dok To 使用的定制 Victor，该变型拆除了全部标准武器，代之以左躯干的一具 LRM-15 与机甲右臂上的十门中型激光，大幅降低了对弹药的依赖。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The custom Victor used by Tai-sho Li Dok To, this variant removed all the standard weapons and replaced them with a single LRM-15 mounted in the left torso and ten Medium Lasers carried in the 'Mech's right arm, greatly reducing ammo dependency. Armor and movement profiles remained unchanged, but it carried a total of nineteen heat sinks to help deal with extra heat from the lasers.
column2: 这是大将李德道使用的定制胜利者，该改型拆除了全部标准武器，换成一具装在左躯干的LRM-15和十门装在机甲右臂的中型激光器，大幅降低了对弹药的依赖。装甲与移动性能保持不变，但它总共携带了十九具散热器，以应对激光器带来的额外热量。

column1: The Rocky is a customized Victor VTR-9B, used by the leader of the Pirate band 'The Johnsons'. It replaces the stock AC/20 and SRM-4 with a PPC, two SRM-6 and two more medium lasers. The 'Mech also has increased armor and cooling compared to the original. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Rocky 是一台经过改装的 Victor VTR-9B，为海盗团伙“约翰逊帮”的首领所用。它以一门粒子炮、两具 SRM-6 和两门额外的中型激光取代了原有的 AC/20 和 SRM-4。与原型相比，该机甲的装甲与散热能力都有所提升。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Used by the 5th Benjamin Regulars commander on Royal during the War of Davion Succession, this Victor-9B variant removes the AC/20 and replaces it with an AC/10 and two more tons of ammo. The Medium Lasers have been removed and replaced with three Medium Pulse Lasers. The Victor variant is equipped with ten Double Heat sinks, and the remaining tonnage has been devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 在戴维恩继承战争期间的罗亚尔之战中，这台Victor-9B变型由第五本杰明常规团的指挥官使用。它拆除了AC/20，换装一门AC/10和额外两吨弹药。中型激光被拆除，替换为三门中型脉冲激光。该维克托变型配备十台双散热器，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂上部

column1: Used by the 5th Benjamin Regulars commander on Royal during the War of Davion Succession, this Victor-9B variant removes the AC/20 and replaces it with an AC/10 and two more tons of ammo. The Medium Lasers have been removed and replaced with three Medium Pulse Lasers. The Victor variant is equipped with ten Double Heat sinks, and the remaining tonnage has been devoted to additional armor.
column2: 由第五本杰明正规军在达维昂继承战争期间的皇家驻军指挥官使用，这一胜利者-9B改型拆掉AC/20，换成一门AC/10和额外两吨弹药。中型激光器被拆除，换成三门中型脉冲激光器。该胜利者改型装有十具双重散热器，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲。

column1: The Victor VTR-9B-CE replaces the AC/20 with a Clan Early LBX/20 and 4 tons of ammunition, and the SRM-4 launcher with an Improved SRM-6. Everything else is kept the same as on the original Victor VTR-9B. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 维克多 VTR-9B-CE 以一门部族早期型 LBX/20 和 4 吨弹药替换了 AC/20，并以一具改进型 SRM-6 替换了 SRM-4 发射器。其余部分与原版维克多 VTR-9B 保持一致。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: An alternative version of the standard VTR-9B, replacing 5 heat sinks with 2 more Medium Lasers, CASE in the torsos and a C3 slave system. Its intended use is in low risk environments with high cooling capacity or where cooling trucks are available. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这是标准VTR-9B的另一种版本，以2门额外中型激光、躯干内的CASE和一套C3从机系统取代5个散热器。它的预期用途是在冷却能力充足或可调用冷却车的低风险环境中作战。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: An alternative version of the standard VTR-9B, replacing 5 heat sinks with 2 more Medium Lasers, CASE in the torsos and a C3 slave system. Its intended use is in low risk environments with high cooling capacity or where cooling trucks are available.
column2: 这是标准VTR-9B的替代版本，用2门额外中型激光器替换5具散热器，躯干加装CASE，并加装一套C3从属系统。它的预期用途是在风险低、散热能力高，或可调用冷却车的环境中作战。

column1: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9D replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9D is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 9D是一次采用星际联盟技术的升级，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮/20，能在远得多的距离上造成严重伤害。该机甲还带两门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-4发射器用于近战。为实现这些改动，9D建在内骨架底盘上；省下的重量还让它多带一吨装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Heavy Cavalry & Skirmisher
column2: 重骑兵与游骑

column1: The VTR-9D incorporates several Lostech technologies, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, the Medium Lasers with Medium Pulse Lasers, and adding CASE, all on an Endo-Steel frame.
column2: VTR-9D融合了若干失传科技，把AC/20换成磁轨炮，把中型激光器换成中型脉冲激光器，并加装CASE，全部构建在内层钢框架上。

column1: A further upgrade, the VTR-9D-2 replaces the Gauss Rifle of the VTR-9D with a LB 20-X AC and the SRM4 with its Streak equivalent. To be able to accommodate the increased weight, the 15 single heat sinks have been replaced by 10 double. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: VTR-9D-2 是进一步升级的型号，以一门 LB 20-X 自动炮取代了 VTR-9D 的高斯步枪，并将 SRM4 更换为其连发型号。为承受增加的重量，15 具单散热器已被 10 具双散热器取代。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: A further upgrade, the VTR-9D-2 replaces the Gauss Rifle of the VTR-9D with a LB 20-X AC and the SRM4 with its Streak equivalent. To be able to accommodate the increased weight, the 15 single heat sinks have been replaced by 10 double.
column2: 作为进一步升级，VTR-9D-2以一门LB 20-X自动炮取代VTR-9D的高斯步枪，并以连发型号取代SRM4。为容纳增加的重量，15个单散热器被换成10个双散热器。

column1: The VTR-9Db replaces the three external heat sinks of the VTR-9D with two small lasers and extra medium pulse laser, increasing its medium to close range arsenal. The increased heat and reduced cooling capacity is addressed by converting the 'Mech to use double heat sinks. A bit more added armor and the removal of the CASE in the right torso finishes up the design changes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: VTR-9Db 以两门小型激光和一门额外的中型脉冲激光，取代了 VTR-9D 的三具外置散热器，增强了其中近距离火力。为应对增加的热量与降低的散热能力，该机甲改用双散热器。再稍加一点装甲，并拆除右躯干的 CASE，设计改动便告完成。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: The VTR-9Db replaces the three external heat sinks of the VTR-9D with two small lasers and extra medium pulse laser, increasing its medium to close range arsenal. The increased heat and reduced cooling capacity is addressed by converting the 'Mech to use double heat sinks. A bit more added armor and the removal of the CASE in the right torso finishes up the design changes.
column2: VTR-9Db把VTR-9D的三具外置散热器换成两门小型激光器和一门额外中型脉冲激光器，增强了它的中近距离武库。增加的热量与降低的散热能力通过把机甲改用双重散热器来解决。再增加一点装甲，并拆除右躯干的CASE，设计改动就完成了。

column1: The -9G is a conversion of the traditional Victor to use Clan grade equipment, with even the armor switched to use the more weight efficient Clan Ferro-Fibrous. Its weapons have been replaced by a Gauss Rifle, two Medium Pulse Lasers and a Stream SRM-4. Three tons of Gauss ammunition and one ton of Streak SRM missiles are available. The 'Mech also carries a targeting computer, further enhancing the performance of its weapons. The -9G was originally created by and mostly seen with the Grey Death Legion mercenaries. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: -9G是将传统维克托改装为使用部族级装备的型号，连装甲也换成了重量效率更高的部族铁纤维。它的武器被替换为一门高斯步枪、两门中型脉冲激光和一具Stream SRM-4。它可携带三个吨位的高斯弹药和一个吨位的连发SRM导弹。该机甲还搭载了一台瞄准计算机，进一步提升其武器性能。-9G最初由灰死军团雇佣兵打造，也主要出现在他们手中。 特性：坚固耐用 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The -9P variant drops the VTR-9B's AC/20 and one medium laser for an AC/10 and larger SRM-6 rack while freeing up the weight to carry a massive assault claymore in its left arm. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 9P改型舍弃了VTR-9B的AC/20和一门中型激光，换成一门AC/10与更大的SRM-6发射槽，同时腾出重量，在左臂携带一把巨大的突击型阔剑。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: The Victor VTR-9RC fits an ER PPC, two Large and three Medium Pulse Lasers by using a weight saving 320 XL engine. A Guardian ECM is also mounted in the right torso. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Victor VTR-9RC 通过采用减重的 320 XL 引擎，得以装下一具增程粒子炮、两具大型激光和三具中型脉冲激光。右躯干还搭载了一具 Guardian 电子对抗套件。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The VTR-9SI is a prototype design, first piloted by Col. Alexander Knight. A combination of the 9K Endo-Steel structure with the 9S AC/20, replacing the SRM-launcher with even more lasers. The addition of a Guardian ECM system and Triple-Strength Myomer further enhanced the combat capabilities. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: VTR-9SI是一款原型设计，首度由Alexander Knight上校驾驶。它结合了9K的内骨架结构与9S的AC/20，并以更多激光取代了SRM发射器。Guardian电子对抗系统与三倍强度肌纤维的加入进一步提升了作战能力。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: Hm, I am not quite sure what the purpose of this prototype was. It doesn't seem that large an improvement over the earlier models and some of the later models fulfill their role better. But a 'Mech is a 'Mech, Boss, we can always find a use for it.
column2: 嗯，我不太确定这个原型的目的是什么。它似乎并不比早期型号有多大改进，而某些后期型号更好地履行了它们的角色。但机甲就是机甲，老大，我们总能给它找到用处。

column1: Piloted by Henrik Cole and his grandfather, who attempted to overthrow the then head of House Cole but failed and was forced to flee quickly. Basilisk was built upon an XL engine and is armed with two medium lasers in the left arm, three Streak SRM-2s in the left torso (with two tons of reloads), two LB 10-X AC mounted in the right arm (with two tons of reloads), and a Guardian ECM mounted in the right torso. The 'Mech is equipped with three jump jets, one in each leg along with one in the center torso. Thirteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cold. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 由享里克·科尔与其祖父驾驶；祖父曾试图推翻当时的科尔家族首领，但失败并被迫迅速逃亡。蛇怪建在一台XL引擎之上，左臂装两门中型激光，左躯干三具连发SRM-2（配两吨再装填弹药），右臂两门LB 10-X自动炮（配两吨再装填弹药），右躯干一套守护者电子对抗套件。该机甲配有三具跳跃推进器——每条腿各一具，中央躯干一具。十三个双散热器让机甲保持低温。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Based on the 9K variant, the VTR-C was built to incorporate a C3 slave unit, allowing the 'Mech to work as part of a C3 lance. In order to do this, a heat sink was removed. Otherwise, this variant of the Victor is identical to the 9K model. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: VTR-C 以 9K 改型为基础，加入了一台 C3 从属单元，使该机甲能够作为 C3 小队的一员协同作战。为此拆除了一台散热器。除此之外，这款 Victor 改型与 9K 型号完全相同。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Not much to see here, boss. Just a slightly different variant of the 9K with a C3 slave unit.
column2: 这里没什么可看的，老大。只是9K的一个稍有不同的改型，加了套C3从属系统。

column1: The 'Dragon Slayer' mounts a 330-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel and Double Heat Sinks to support a weapons array consisting of a Gauss Rifle and PPC in its right and left arms respectively and twin Medium Pulse Lasers in the right torso and SRM-6 in the left. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: “屠龙者”搭载 330 额定的 XL引擎、内骨架与双散热器，以支撑其武器阵列：右臂高斯步枪、左臂粒子炮，右躯干双联中型脉冲激光，左躯干 SRM-6。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂上部

column1: I don't know, Boss. This 'Mech is so heavily modified most of the internals remind nothing of a standard Victor. There's also something about 'NEED MORE MECH CREDITS' scribbeled all over the inside of the cockpit.
column2: 我不知道，老大。这台机甲改动太大了，大部分内部结构已经让人联想不到标准胜利者。座舱内侧还到处涂着'需要更多机甲信用点'之类的潦草字迹。

column1: The Viking began production shortly after the Beowulf in a joint effort by the Free Rasalhague Republic and ComStar. The 'Mech is intended to take over in the role that has been traditionally filled by the Bombardier. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 维京在贝奥武夫之后不久由自由拉萨尔哈格共和国与康星联合投产。这台机甲意在接替传统上由轰炸机担任的角色。 特质：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.16 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Viking has a singular mission of long-range missile fire support. To do this, the Viking carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers and two Shigunga LRM-20 launchers, all of which are linked to an Artemis IV fire control system.
column2: 维京有一个明确的任务：远程导弹火力支援。为此，维京携带两具"紫郡"LRM-15 发射器和两具"紫郡"LRM-20 发射器，全部联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统。

column1: Classified Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 机密 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A mercenary refit of the -1R, replacing all weapons with acquired clan technology. Rumours originally place the redesign with the Kell Hounds, but the variant can be find with all sorts of mercenary outfits by now. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是雇佣兵对-1R的改装，以取得的部族技术替换全部武器。最初的传闻把这套重新设计归于凯尔猎犬，但如今各种雇佣兵部队都能见到该变型。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Fire Support & Brawler
column2: 火力支援与缠斗者

column1: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was originally built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.
column2: 维护者是卡佩兰邦联最知名的战斗机甲之一。它作为 CCAF 的主力机于 2826 年——第一次与第二次继承战争之间——建成，以最大化邦联幸存的产能、并尽可能承担更多角色。由委员会设计的"样样通"特性意味着它在任何单一角色上都不出众，却都能胜任。由于几乎所有部件都在卡佩拉生产，维护者还造价低廉、易于量产，且因备件充足而修理迅速。

column1: The 1P retains the left-torso LRM-5 and head-mounted medium laser, dropping the small laser and PPC for a large laser in the right arm and a medium hatchet in the left. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 1P 保留了左躯干的 LRM-5 和头部的中型激光，去掉小型激光和 PPC，在右臂换装大型激光，左臂则加装一把中型战斧。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them all adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.
column2: 辩护者是卡佩兰联邦最知名的战斗机甲之一。这台CCAF的主力于2826年第一次与第二次继承战争之间建造，意在最大化联邦残余生产能力的效能，并尽可能承担更多角色。它由委员会设计，其“万金油”性质意味着它在任何单一角色上都不突出，却能把所有角色都完成得足够好。辩护者几乎所有部件都在卡佩拉生产，因而廉价、易于量产，并有充足备件可快速维修。

column1: The personal Vindicator of MechWarrior Michael Jones and his father before him, St. Ives Blue is easily recognizable for the large silver trumpet painted on its chest and its replacement of the PPC with a Large Laser and LRM-5 with an LRM-10 rack. After his unit seceded to the St. Ives Compact in the wake of the Fourth Succession War the newly formed St. Ives Military Command would ultimately use Jones' altered weapons array as the basis for the VND-1SIC variant. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: St. Ives Blue 是机甲战士迈克尔·琼斯及其父亲的专属 Vindicator，它极易辨认——胸口绘有一支巨大的银色小号，并以大型激光取代了粒子炮、以 LRM-10 发射架取代了 LRM-5。在第四次继承战争之后，琼斯所在部队脱离出去并加入圣艾夫斯协约，新成立的圣艾夫斯军事指挥部最终以琼斯改动过的武器配置为基础，开发出了 VND-1SIC 变型机。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Made in 3020, this customized Vindicator used by Major Choung Vong, in the Third Succession War, moved the head-mounted medium laser to the right arm, simply making the cockpit roomier for its brutally effective, but rather rotund pilot. It is by all accounts the same as the original 1R, retaining all its capabilities. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这台定制版Vindicator制造于3020年，由第三次继承战争中的周翁少校使用。它将头部的激光移至右臂，只是为了让驾驶舱更宽敞一些，好容纳这位作战凶狠高效、却身形圆胖的飞行员。除此之外，它与最初的1R完全相同，保留了全部性能。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Made in 3020, this customized Vindicator used by Major Choung Vong in the Third Succession War moved the head-mounted medium laser to the right arm, simply making the cockpit roomier for its brutally effective, but rather rotund pilot. It is by all accounts the same as the original 1R, retaining all its capabilities.
column2: 这台定制维护者制造于3020年，第三次继承战争期间由少校琼·冯使用，它把头部的中型激光器移到了右臂，纯粹是为了给这位残暴高效、但相当圆胖的飞行员腾出更宽敞的座舱。据各方面所述，它与原版1R完全相同，保留了全部能力。

column1: A battlefield refit of the -1R, reducing its weaponry to just the PPC and LRM-5 launcher to be able to fit C.A.S.E. protection and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是-1R的野战改装：把武器削减到仅剩粒子炮和LRM-5发射器，以便装下C.A.S.E.防护和一台C3从机。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A Clan refit of the Vindicator, replacing its Inner Sphere inferior weapons with three ER Medium Lasers, one ER PPC and one Medium Pulse Laser. In typical Clan fashion, the -2C does suffer from insufficient cooling. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是辩护者的部族改装，以内层星域劣等武器换取三门增程中型激光、一门增程粒子炮和一门中型脉冲激光。以典型的部族风格，-2C确实受困于冷却不足。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A rebuild of the -1R with more powerful technology, the Vindicator VND-2R replaces the PPC with an Extended Range version and upgrades the LRM launcher to 15 Artemis IV-enabled tubes. To free the needed weight capacity for the upgrades the chassis uses a Endo Steel structure, the armor to Ferro-Fibrous and the small laser was dropped. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 作为 -1R 采用更强大技术的重建版本，Vindicator VND-2R 以增程型取代了粒子炮，并将 LRM 发射器升级为 15 管、带 Artemis IV 的型号。为腾出升级所需的重量，机体改用内骨架结构，装甲换成铁纤维，同时取消了小型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: An uncommon refit, the Vindicator 2V is often seen in the hands of Mercenaries who lack the ability to replace or repair the expensive PPC. Powered by the standard 180 engine, the Vindicator 2V swaps the PPC for an AC/5 with 2 tons of ammo. The removal of 5 heat sinks, allows a second Medium Laser to be mounted alongside an extra ton of armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 作为一种不常见的改装，复仇者2V常出现在无力更换或修理昂贵粒子炮的雇佣兵手中。该机由标准180引擎驱动，把粒子炮换成一门AC/5并配2吨弹药。拆除5台散热器后，得以加装第二门中型激光以及额外一吨装甲。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: An uncommon refit, the Vindicator 2V is often seen in the hands of Mercenaries who lack the ability to replace or repair the expensive PPC. Powered by the standard 180 engine, the Vindicator 2V swaps the PPC for an AC/5 with 2 tons of ammo. The removal of 5 heat sinks, allows a second Medium Laser to be mounted alongside an extra ton of armor.
column2: 作为一种不常见的改装，维护者2V常见于无力更换或维修昂贵PPC的雇佣兵手中。维护者2V以标准的180引擎驱动，把PPC换成一门AC/5配2吨弹药。拆掉5具散热器后，得以在额外一吨装甲之外再装第二门中型激光器。

column1: An uncommon refit, the Vindicator 2X is often seen in the hands of Mercenaries who lack the ability to replace or repair the expensive PPC. Powered by the standard 180 engine, the Vindicator 2X swaps the PPC for an AC/10 with a single ton of ammo. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 作为一种不常见的改装型号，Vindicator 2X 常出现在无力更换或维修昂贵粒子炮的雇佣兵手中。该机由标准 180 引擎驱动，用一门 AC/10 搭配一吨弹药取代了粒子炮。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column2: 作为一种不常见的改装，维护者2X常见于无力更换或维修昂贵PPC的雇佣兵手中。维护者2X以标准的180引擎驱动，把PPC换成一门AC/10配一吨弹药。

column1: The 5L variant is a more basic upgrade than the 4L and represents Ceres' attempt to produce a close-combat 'Mech superior to the FS9-0 Firestarter. Introduced in 3060 the 5L uses a standard engine, armor, and structure. The changes and advancements come in the weapons and the addition of a TSM system. The 'Mech's new weapons include an ER PPC, two ER medium lasers, two medium pulse lasers, a single Small Pulse Laser, and a small laser. This varied mix of energy weapons allows the MechWarrior piloting the 'Mech to balance their heat load to keep the TSM working at its optimum efficiency. In so doing, the Vindicator can deal a fair amount of damage with its Sword. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 5L变型是比4L更基础的升级方案，代表了Ceres试图打造一款优于FS9-0 Firestarter的近战机甲。5L于3060年推出，采用标准引擎、装甲与结构。变化与进步体现在武器上，并加装了TSM系统。机甲的新武器包括一门增程粒子炮、两门增程中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。这种多样化的能量武器组合让驾驶机甲的机甲战士能够平衡热负荷，使TSM始终以最佳效率运作。如此一来，Vindicator便能以其佩剑造成相当可观的伤害。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Duncan Fisher once said the Butcher was the natural product of Solaris' sweaty and testosterone driven battles. Forged in the heat of battle and adorned with the remains of other Gladiator's Mechs. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 邓肯·费雪曾说，屠夫是索拉里斯那些汗水与高同驱动之战斗的自然产物——在战火中锻造，并以其他角斗士机甲的残骸为装饰。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Duncan fisher once said, the Butcher was the natural product of Solaris' sweaty and testosterone driven battles. Forged in the heat of battle and adorned with the remains of other Gladiator's Mechs.
column2: 邓肯·费舍尔曾说，屠夫是索拉里斯那些汗水淋漓、高同驱动的战斗的自然产物。在战场的热度中锻造，并以其他角斗士机甲的残骸为饰。

column1: For similar reasons of its suboptimal but extensive armor layout, its brute-force primary armament of a pair of binary laser cannons was thermally inefficient but could be produced inhouse, whereas the originally planned ER PPCs were already growing scarce. The rest of the layout, three Medium Pulse Lasers, were still readily available in large quantities when originally designed. A 280 XL engine and four Jump Jets ensured that the 'Mech was mobile enough to quickly adapt on the battlefield, further helped by its extra strong communications suite. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 同样由于其欠佳但覆盖面广的装甲布局，它那套粗暴的双联激光炮主武器在热能上并不高效，却能自行生产——而原本计划的增程粒子炮当时已日渐稀缺。布局的其余部分，三门中型脉冲激光，在设计之初仍能大量获得。一台280 XL引擎和四具跳跃推进器确保该机甲足够机动，能在战场上迅速应变，其格外强大的通讯套件更助一臂之力。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The attrition of the First Succession War made commanders desperate for every BattleMech they could lay hands on. The horrific devastation of three decades of unremitting war drove the Free Worlds League Military in 2828 to issue a tender for a low-maintenance heavy 'Mech that could be manufactured quickly. The winner was the Viper by Kallon Industries. Their design chassis was slightly upsized from the Crusader, a rugged, proven 'Mech that enjoyed a good reputation amongst FWLM technicians. The scaleup was a bit crude, wasting weight on larger, hastily designed armor baffles that give it a ponderous look but provide impressive protection.
column2: 第一次继承战争的消耗，让指挥官们极度渴求任何能到手的战斗机甲。三十年不间断战争带来的惨重破坏，促使自由世界联盟军队在 2828 年发出招标，寻求一款易于维护、可快速量产的重型机甲。中标者是 Kallon Industries 的 Viper。其设计骨架是在 Crusader 的基础上略微放大的，后者是一款坚固可靠、久经考验的机甲，在自由世界联盟军队的技术人员中口碑颇佳。这次放大处理略显粗糙，重量被浪费在仓促设计的、更大型的装甲隔板上，使该机看上去笨重，却带来了令人印象深刻的防护能力。

column1: As the wars continued after the fall of the Star League, it became harder and harder to find the components to keep building the Viper. Eventually the Kallon Industries had to accept that it had no choice but start downgrading the design, eventually landing on the VP-5, an improvised Third Succession War-era downgrade with only standard components and lasers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 星际联盟覆亡之后战事绵延不绝，要继续建造毒蛇所需的部件越来越难找到。最终卡隆工业不得不承认别无选择，只能开始对该设计进行降级，最后推出了VP-5——一款为第三次继承战争时期临时拼凑的降级型号，仅使用标准部件与激光。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: The Viper's main weapon is a massive LBX AC/10 in the right torso, with two tons of ammunition in the right torso. A Streak SRM-2 and Small Laser are available to deal with any enemies too close for the large autocannon. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Viper 的主武器是右躯干内的一门巨型 LBX AC/10，右躯干内备有两吨弹药。对于距离过近、大型自动炮无从应对的敌人，则可使用一具连发 SRM-2 和一门小型激光。 特性：改进干扰器 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Viper is a 35 ton BattleMech designed just before the Clan invasion started. When faced up against the much superior Clan 'Mechs, the Viper just didn't survive long enough to make it worth the cost due to its relatively slow speed for a 'Mech its size. As a result they design stayed mostly unknown, and only one production run was ever done. Most of the 'Mechs were sold to various Mercenary forces, where some are still found.
column2: 毒蛇是一种35吨战斗机甲，就在氏族入侵开始前设计。面对远远优越的氏族机甲时，毒蛇因其相对于自身尺寸较为缓慢的速度，根本活不够久以证明其成本值得，因此该设计大多无人知晓，只进行过一次量产。大部分机甲卖给了各路雇佣兵部队，其中一些至今仍能见到。

column1: The E2 loadout mounts two Medium Pulse Lasers in the left arm together with three Small Pulse Lasers in the right. One ER Medium and one ER small laser act as secondary firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E2挂载在左臂装两门中型脉冲激光，右臂三门小型脉冲激光，另有一门增程中型和一门增程小型激光作为次要火力。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Introduced in 2940, the Viper is a 40-ton OmniMech that emphasizes speed and armor, with only 8.5 tons of podspace available for weapons. A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper Prime is armed with an SRM-6 and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. A pair of Machine Guns and an AMS fill the remaining podspace. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03.
column2: 蝰蛇于 2940 年推出，是一款 40 吨全能机甲，强调速度与装甲，仅有 8.5 吨吊舱空间可用于武器。蝰蛇由一台 320 额定 XL 引擎驱动，底盘硬接了 8 个跳跃推进器，进一步提升机动性。蝰蛇主型号装备一具 SRM-6 和一对中型脉冲激光。两挺机枪和一套 AMS 填满剩余吊舱空间。投放费用倍率：1.03。

column1: The F2 configuration of the Viper is focused on medium to close range engagements. Two ER Medium Laser provide longer range cover, while four SRM-4 and an ER Small Laser are used once the 'Mech has closed in on its enemies. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Viper 的 F2 配置侧重于中近距离交战。两门增程中型激光提供较远距离的火力掩护，而四具 SRM-4 和一门增程小型激光则在机甲逼近敌人后投入使用。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Introduced in 2940, the Viper is a 40-ton OmniMech that emphasizes speed and armor, with only 8.5 tons of podspace available for weapons. A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper M-R (Medusa) is armed with a 6 ER Small Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. An AMS is mounted to counter incoming missiles. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 毒蛇于2940年推出，是一款40吨的全向机甲，强调速度与装甲，仅有8.5吨吊舱空间可用于武器。320级XL引擎为毒蛇提供动力，8具跳跃推进器则直接集成在机身上，进一步提升机动性。毒蛇M-R（美杜莎）装备6具增程小型激光和一具连发SRM-6，并装有AMS以拦截来袭导弹。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Introduced in 2940, the Viper is a 40-ton OmniMech that emphasizes speed and armor, with only 8.5 tons of podspace available for weapons. A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper M-R (Medusa) is armed with a 6 ER Small Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. An AMS is mounted to counter incoming missiles. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03.
column2: 毒蛇于2940年推出，是一种40吨全方位机甲，强调速度与装甲，仅有8.5吨吊舱空间可供武器使用。一具320级XL引擎为毒蛇提供动力，8个跳跃推进器固接在底盘上，进一步提升机动性。毒蛇M-R（美杜莎）武装为6门增程小型激光器和一具连发SRM-6。它还装有一套AMS以对抗来袭导弹。投放成本倍率：1.03。

column1: A further adaption of the J configuration, the S loadout keeps the three ATM-3 launchers but exchanges the Micro Lasers with a single ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: S 配置是 J 配置的进一步改良，保留了三具 ATM-3 发射器，但把微型激光换成了一门增程中型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column2: W载荷极度偏重极近距离交战，装四具SRM-4发射器和两门增程中型激光。若需要额外防御，还可用头部一门增程小型激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: As the fight for the Inner Sphere started with the Clans' invasion, over time a number of Vipers were captured or recovered. A most of them very heavily damaged and no reliable supplies of replacements exist, the 'Mechs were quickly converted to use Inner Sphere weapons in form of a LB 10-X Autocannon and three Streak SRM-2 launchers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 随着部族入侵拉开内层星域战事的序幕，日积月累有不少Viper被缴获或回收。由于其中大多受损严重，且没有可靠的替换零件来源，这些机甲很快被改装为使用内层星域武器，即一门LB 10-X自动炮和三具连发SRM-2发射器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: An early Clan mech introduced by the Nova Cats, the Vision Quest was the first Clan mech to mount the new ER Large Lasers. A 60-ton mech with a 300-rated XL Engine, the Vision Quest VQ-1 carries a UAC/20, alongside a pair of ER Large Lasers and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Vision Quest 是新星猫部族推出的早期部族机甲，也是第一台搭载新型增程大型激光的部族机甲。这台 60 吨机甲由一台 300 级 XL 引擎驱动；Vision Quest VQ-1 携有一门 UAC/20，以及一对增程大型激光和三门中型脉冲激光。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column2: 作为新猫氏族推出的一种早期氏族机甲，幻象探求是首台安装新型增程大型激光器的氏族机甲。作为装有一具300级XL引擎的60吨机甲，幻象探求VQ-1携带一门UAC/20，另有两门增程大型激光器和三兄弟中型脉冲激光器。

column1: An early Clan mech introduced by the Nova Cats, the Vision Quest was the first Clan mech to mount the new ER Large Lasers. column1: The Wakazashi uses a Gauss rifle and an ER PPC to provide long range firepower. An opponent who closes with the Wakazashi, hoping to get under the minimum range of these weapons, is in for a rude shock: a massive AC/20 and a pair of ER Medium Lasers are used in order to deter any opponent that would close in. With three tons of ammunition for the Gauss Rifle and Autocannon, the Wakazashi is able to inflict large amounts of damage on a multitude of enemy forces. Quirk: Missile Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 胁差以一门高斯步枪和一门增程粒子炮提供远程火力。若对手为了钻到这些武器的最小射程内而逼近，就会迎来一个措手不及的惊喜：一门庞大的AC/20和两门增程中型激光专门用来震慑任何想靠近的敌人。凭借高斯步枪与自动炮共三吨弹药，胁差能对大量敌军造成巨大伤害。 特性：导弹干扰器 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Designed during the early years of the Golden Century, the Wakazashi (the sister sword of the katana) allowed Clan Jade Falcon the time to rebuild their then weakened touman. Never intended as a long-term production design, the durable Wakazashi was relatively easy to build but was difficult to repair or modify. Subsequently, the Wakazashi's reputation suffered with the appearance of the OmniMech. When the Falcon's fortunes improved in the early thirtieth century, Wakazashi production was shut down in favor of other designs.
column2: 若狭（武士刀的姊妹刀）在黄金世纪早期被设计出来，让翡翠猎鹰氏族有时间重建当时被削弱的图曼。它从未被打算作为长期生产型号，耐用的若狭相对容易建造，但难以维修或改装。随后，随着全方位机甲的出现，若狭的名声受损。当三十世纪初猎鹰的运势好转时，若狭的生产被关停，转而生产其他设计。

column1: The War Dog carries the long ranged and capable Gauss rifle as its primary weapon. It is backed up at short to medium ranges by a highly accurate Large Pulse Laser. For close combat situations, the 'Mech is armed with two Medium Pulse Lasers, a Small Pulse Laser, and two Streak SRM-2 One Shot Packs. For added defense against missile attacks, the 'Mech carries a anti-missile system. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 战犬（War Dog）以射程远、性能可靠的高斯步枪作为主武器，并在中近距离由一门极为精准的大型脉冲激光提供支援。在近身战斗的情况下，这台机甲装备了两门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光以及两具连发 SRM-2 单发弹包。为加强对导弹攻击的防御，该机甲还装有一套反导弹系统。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The War Dog is a 'Mech that was originally designed by the Star League for use by the SLDF and was thought to be lost to time. Plans for the War Dog were rediscovered by Snord's Irregulars and were turned over to the Blackwell Corporation. The War Dog has since become a powerful and respected force on the modern battlefield.
column2: War Dog 最初由星际联盟设计供 SLDF 使用，曾被认为已随时光湮没。War Dog 的图纸被斯诺德游骑兵重新发现，并移交给了布莱克威尔公司。此后，War Dog 成为现代战场上一股强大而受人敬重的力量。

column1: A full clan conversion of the War Dog, used by the mercenary outfit the Wolf's Dragoons. Although all weapons were upgraded to Clan specification, the 'Mech keeps the same weapon configuration as the original -02FC, except for replacing the one-shot streak launchers with Streak SRM-6 ones. A C3 Slave computer was also added, a common occurance for Wolf's Dragoons rebuilds. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是战犬的完全部族化改装，由雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵使用。所有武器虽已按部族规格升级，机甲却仍保持与原版-02FC相同的武器配置，只是把一次性连发发射器换成了连发SRM-6。此外还加装了1台C3从属计算机——这在狼之龙骑兵的重建机甲中十分常见。 <特性：精准武器（高斯） <投放费用倍率：1.17 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

column1: Jade Falcon commanders were shocked to find themselves suffering losses from an unknown LAM that resembled a small Warhammer. Insulted that the Inner-Sphere forces disgraced the Warhammer lineage with a half-baked LAM, and being a bit more open minded on units, Jade Falcon scientists went to work, producing a 70t version loaded with Clan tech. Fielding the same powerful combo of twin ER PPCs, as well as a pair of Arrow Anti-Air missiles, these Warhammer LAMs provide withering fire on ground targets, and are able to defend themselves from modest aerospace defenses. Coupled with the improved maneuverability of a LAM, these units are finding themselves to be the backbone of quick-response anti-militia garrisons across Jade Falcon territory. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 翡翠猎鹰的指挥官们震惊地发现，己方竟因一架外形酷似小型 Warhammer 的未知 LAM 而蒙受伤亡。内层星域势力用一架半吊子的 LAM 玷污了 Warhammer 的血统，这让翡翠猎鹰的科学家们感到受辱；加上他们对各种单位的态度更为开放，于是着手研发，造出了一款满载部族科技的 70 吨型号。这些 Warhammer LAM 配备了同样强大的双增程粒子炮组合以及两枚箭式防空导弹，能对地面目标倾泻凶猛火力，同时也有能力抵御中等程度的航空航天防御力量。凭借 LAM 更出色的机动性，这些单位正逐渐成为翡翠猎鹰领地内各快速反应反民兵驻防部队的中坚力量。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下
