column1: Adder
column2: 蝰蛇

column1: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
column2: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程火力支援——40 个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光和标准火焰喷射器。

column1: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range support fire power in form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers.
column2: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程支援火力——40 个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光。

column1: Adder ADR-B
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-B

column1: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERMLs. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from.
column2: 每次看到 Adder-B，你都会忍不住想知道氏族是怎么把那么多火力塞进区区 35 吨底盘的。凭借一门极其精准的大型脉冲激光，这套中远程配置能软化敌方装甲，然后在中距离以强力 LB-X AC/5 予以了结，另有两门 ER 中型激光支援。永远不要低估一台 ADR-B 的实力，那可能是个你无法挽回的错误。

column1: Adder ADR-C
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-C

column1: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament... And also an additional launcher for a NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
column2: 作为一款搭载略轻武装的远程轰炸变体，Adder-C"仅仅"以两具 LRM-15 发射器为主武器……另外还多装了一具发射 NARC 自导信标的发射器。只要有那玩意儿粘在你船壳上，你无处可藏。用于近距近战并作为不依赖弹药的备用武器，一门中型脉冲激光足以彻底毁掉那些以为这台 LRM 支援机甲是个软柿子的伏击者的好日子。

column1: Adder ADR-D
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-D

column1: Sticking to the general theme for this rather slow 35 tonner, the Adder-D fields a mid to long range setup in form of an ER Large Laser and an Ultra Autocannon/5. The ADR-D will try to keep its distance and open up components from a safe distance before it moves in to finish the job with a set of Streak SRM2s.
column2: 秉持这款相当缓慢的 35 吨机体的总体主题，Adder-D 以一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/5 构成中远程配置。ADR-D 会尽量保持距离，在安全距离上打开对手的部件孔洞，然后推进以一组连续 SRM2 收尾。

column1: Adder ADR-PRIME
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-原装型

column1: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations. The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy. It also sports a flamer.
column2: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC 武器，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击。它还配有一具火焰喷射器。

column1: Albatross
column2: 信天翁

column1: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
column2: 信天翁由自由世界联盟于 3053 年设计，着眼点是与当时正在推进的氏族可能发生的未来冲突。机甲采用一台赫尔墨斯 380 XL 引擎建造，以最小化重量并为武器载荷最大化可用吨位。信天翁还使用多种武器，力图使机甲在任何距离上都有效。机甲机动性中等，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，并使用双倍散热器以获得更强的散热能力。

column1: Juggernaut
column2: 主宰者

column1: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.
column2: 信天翁不专精于某一角色，更像是一款主力设计。机甲携带一具"伊里安兵器工厂 V7"LRM-15 发射器，赋予它远程与间接火力支援能力。它由一门"东方 O 型"LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光支援，为机甲提供强大的远程打击力。机甲携带一门"特罗内尔 PPL-20"大型脉冲激光，使机甲能在中远程范围边缘交战。最后，近战方面，机甲有一具"伊里安兵器工厂 60 毫米"SRM-6 和两门"伊里安兵器工厂超级 6"中型激光。

column1: Annihilator
column2: 歼灭者

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年被开发为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，作为流亡星盟军事实力的象征而建造。-1A 装备四门自动炮/10 和四门中型激光。虽然精度不如原版-2A，1A 仍是破坏力惊人、危险至极的机甲，没有哪个机甲战士愿意与它交战。

column1: Juggernaut & Siege Mech
column2: 重装与攻城机甲

column1: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
column2: 歼灭者仍是令人生畏的强大设计，原版歼灭者-1A 携带大量强力自动炮，而-1E 则选择全能量武器配置。四门粒子投射炮赋予歼灭者-1E 残暴而惊人的打击力，而-1A 的中型激光被保留用于近身防护，同时装甲防护略有提升以缓解敌方还击。

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年开发，作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，它的建造是流亡星盟与新生的氏族双方军事实力的象征。

column1: Mechazilla
column2: 机甲斯拉

column1: Clan Mechazilla
column2: 氏族机甲斯拉

column1: Apollo
column2: 阿波罗

column1: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
column2: 阿波罗被设计为远程火力支援战斗机甲。为此它搭载的引擎仅能提供 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度和十一吨半装甲。随后它装备了巨型导弹发射器，可将毁灭倾泻到敌人头上。虽然阿波罗的速度低于中型机甲平均水平，但只要运用得当，它便无需惧怕敌方火力；它完全能停留在战场边缘，倾泻压制性 LRM 火力。

column1: Archer
column2: 弓箭手

column1: The 2K Archer was a modification built for House Kurita in 2856, designed to increase its direct firepower capability and give it more staying power on the battlefield once it had run out of ammunition
column2: 2K 弓箭手是 2856 年为库瑞塔家族建造的改装型，旨在提升其直射火力，并在弹药耗尽后仍能在战场上坚持更久

column1: The Archer is a one the best known fire support 'Mechs and can still put up a good fight closer ranges.
column2: 弓箭手是最著名的火力支援机甲之一，在近距离也能打出漂亮的一仗。

column1: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
column2: 作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援

column1: The 2Rb variant of the Archer was built for SLDF Royal units starting in 2752. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support.
column2: 弓箭手 2Rb 变体自 2752 年起为星盟防卫军皇家单位建造。作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。

column1: A another modification made to allow the Archer to defend itself more easily against an enemy that managed to close range with it. Built for House Steiner in 2915
column2: 这是另一项改装，使弓箭手能更轻易地抵御设法逼近的敌人。2915 年为施泰纳家族建造

column1: Carrying a pair of SRM-4s in place of two medium lasers, this was the trademark variant used by the Wolf's Dragoons, which they produced in the assembly plant aboard their space station Hephaestos until its destruction in 3028. It was once stated by Jaime Wolf that all of the Dragoons' Archers were of this variant.
column2: 此变体以两具 SRM-4 取代两门中型激光，是狼之龙骑兵的标志性变体，他们在空间站"赫菲斯托斯"上的装配厂生产，直到 3028 年该站被毁。海梅·沃尔夫曾表示，龙骑兵所有的弓箭手都是这一变体。

column1: Heavy Artillery and Fire Support
column2: 重型火炮与火力支援

column1: The 4M variant of the Archer was built using rediscovered Star League technology. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
column2: 弓箭手 4M 变体使用重新发现的星盟技术建造。作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the standard Star League Defense Force ARC-2R Archer and intended for second-line and solahma troops.
column2: 这是对标准星盟防卫军 ARC-2R 弓箭手的氏族技术改装，供二线部队与"索拉赫马"部队使用。

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Arctic Cheetah was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族极地猎豹长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

column1: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
column2: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

column1: Striker
column2: 攻击手

column1: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
column2: 北极狐主配置意在远距离磨掉敌人装甲，然后逼近收尾。为此，北极狐携带一门 ER PPC，能在六百九十米外命中目标。近战方面，两门中型激光构成主要打击力，而两具 SRM-4 发射器搜寻敌人装甲上的弱点。

column1: Arctic fox
column2: 北极狐

column1: The A configuration is intended for short range engagements and carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and three Small Pulse Lasers. Six jump jets have been added in order to increase mobility.
column2: A 配置用于近程交战，携带四门中型脉冲激光和三门小型脉冲激光。为提升机动性加装了六个跳跃推进器。

column1: Useful in anti-aircraft and in vehicle hunting roles, the B configuration has an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a Medium Laser. This configuration is highly flexible in its roles but also severely handicapped by its reliance on a ballistic weapon.
column2: B 配置适用于防空与猎杀车辆角色，以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器。它由一门中型激光支援。此配置在角色上高度灵活，但也因依赖实弹武器而严重受限。

column1: Another sniper and cleanup 'Mech rolled into one, the C configuration mounts an ER PPC as its primary weapon, giving it superb long range firepower. This is matched up with a Large Pulse Laser, which has a much shorter range but is extremely accurate.
column2: C 配置把狙击手与清道夫合二为一，以一门 ER PPC 为主武器，赋予它卓越的远程火力。与之搭配的是一门大型脉冲激光，射程短得多但极其精准。

column1: A dedicated fire support configuration, the D configuration carries two LRM-10 missile launchers linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy.
column2: D 配置是专职火力支援配置，携带两具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 导弹发射器以提升导弹精度。

column1: Assassin
column2: 刺客

column1: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
column2: ASN-101 保留了 ASN-21 的最高速度与基础导弹武器配置，是联邦太阳稀有的变体，它削减两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以装载三门小型激光，使 ASN-101 相比其前身具备强得多的近身打击力。

column1: Flanker and Assassin
column2: 侧翼与刺客

column1: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
column2: 刺客的设计目标是抗衡黄蜂与毒刺等轻型侦察机甲，但它的重量翻倍、速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力强得多。

column1: Hunter-Killer & Ambusher
column2: 猎杀者 & 伏击者

column1: Assassins are a rare mech nowadays with good firepower and armor with great speed and jumping range.  Makes are really good scout mech killer if you ask me. Dangerous to get jumped by one of these from behind no matter your size.
column2: 刺客如今是稀有机甲，火力与装甲都不错，速度与跳跃距离出色。要我说，它们是极好的侦察机甲杀手。无论你体型如何，被这东西从背后跳上来都很危险。

column1: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles.
column2: 刺客的-23 变体是使用失落科技的原版升级型；最初被视为标准化的野战改装，3067 年由赫勒斯庞特机甲厂开始新的生产。SRM-2 被移除以把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并为 LRM-5 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。在 CCAF、TDF 和 MAF 中，它主要被用作重建残破部队的廉价手段，多在生疏与预备编队中服役。卡佩兰人尤其把-23 用作追击与打击小队的火力支援单位，不过 Artemis 弹药短缺意味着许多只能使用布雷导弹。

column1: This variant of the Atlas II exchanges both ER Large Lasers and its LB 10-X for a Kinslaughter ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle while removing only one double heat sink
column2: 此阿特拉斯 II 变体将两门 ER 大型激光和 LB 10-X 换成一门"屠亲"ER PPC 和一门高斯步枪，仅移除一台双倍散热器

column1: Atlas
column2: 大力神

column1: The Atlas A is the first try to be the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
column2: 阿特拉斯 A 是成为战场之王的最初尝试，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

column1: The Atlas A is the king of short range engagements, capable of bringing a dizzying amount of short range missiles to bear on targets at close range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
column2: 阿特拉斯 A 是近程交战之王，能在近距离向目标倾泻令人目眩的大量短程火箭。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

column1: Built in 2776, this Atlas variant is the largest 'Mech equipped with a Command Console. To free up the weight required to fit this device, the AS7-D-DC removes one ton of LRM ammunition and the paired rear firing lasers. Effective at Close and Long Range Fire Support. Recommended for use by Experienced Tactical Commanders. Extremely Rare and largely Extinct.
column2: 这款阿特拉斯变体于 2776 年建造，是装备指挥控制台的最大机甲。为腾出安装该装置所需的重量，AS7-D-DC 移除一吨 LRM 弹药和成对的后向激光。在近程与远程火力支援上都很有效。推荐由经验丰富的战术指挥官使用。极为稀有且基本绝迹。

column1: Command 'Mech, Juggernaut & Close Assault
column2: 指挥机甲、重装 & 近身突击

column1: I've heard of these older refits and thankfully our Battalion never faced one. Facing a single Pilot in an Atlas is one thing, but going up against two pilots in one of these is something else altogether; an experienced Commander and MechWarrior is a force to be reckoned with. Its no wonder they were targeted so heavily targeted during the Early Succession Wars. The loss of ammo and medium lasers makes this design no less deadly.
column2: 我听说过这些较早的改装，所幸我们营从未遇到过。面对一台阿特拉斯里的单个飞行员是一回事，但面对这种机甲里的两名飞行员就完全是另一回事了；一位经验丰富的指挥官兼机甲战士是股不容小觑的力量。难怪他们在继承战争早期成为重点打击目标。损失弹药和中型激光并没有让这个设计变得不那么致命。

column1: Known as the 'Atlas II,' the D-HT model carries more Energy weaponry and usually a lighter, more flexible Autocannon. It still has unbelievable protection and the same crushing Melee ability as other Atlas models.
column2: D-HT 型号被称为"阿特拉斯 II"，携带更多能量武器，通常配一门更轻便灵活点的自动炮。它仍拥有难以置信的防护，以及其他阿特拉斯型号同样摧枯拉朽的近战能力。

column1: The Atlas D is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
column2: 阿特拉斯 D 是战场之王，能在任何距离向目标施加令人眼花缭乱的武器阵列。它还以通常装备最大可能的装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头巨兽的短暂接触中幸存。

column1: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
column2: K 型是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级，采用一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎建造。左躯干携带一具"紫郡"LRM-20 与两吨弹药，机甲以远程战斗重新武装：用一门"帝皇龙焰"高斯步枪取代自动炮，右臂携带两吨高斯弹，并由分置双肩的两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光支援。这一武器配置使 AS7-K 能让敌人保持在远处，不过继续使用二十台单散热器意味着若两门激光反复开火会迅速积热。近程防御方面，K 型在左臂携带两门"胜利心跳"中型脉冲激光和一套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统。为完善 AS7-K 的防御，两侧躯干加装了 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

column1: Juggernaut & Mid/Longe Assault
column2: 重装与中远程突击

column1: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology. The 'Mechs 300 XL engine makes room for two ER Large -, two Medium Pulse Lasers and an AMS, and the AC-20 was swapped for a huge Gauss Rifle. But due to it's twenty -just- single heat sinks, you have to keep an eye your heat buildup.
column2: 这是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级。机甲的 300 XL 引擎为两门 ER 大型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一套 AMS 腾出空间，AC-20 则换成一门巨型高斯步枪。但由于它那"仅仅"二十台单散热器，你必须留意积热。

column1: A Succession Wars era attempt at recreating the Atlas II's loadout, the AS7-RS downgrades the AutoCannon, LRMs and SRMs while trading out the Medium Lasers for a pair of arm mounted Large Lasers.
column2: AS7-RS 是继承战争时代重现阿特拉斯 II 配置的尝试，它降级了自动炮、LRM 和 SRM，并把中型激光换成两门臂载大型激光。

column1: Avatar
column2: 化身

column1: The first of the Inner Sphere OmniMechs to be conceptualized and one of the last to reach production by the Draconis Combine, the Avatar's design is based on captured Vulture OmniMechs.
column2: 化身是内天体最早被构想、也是联合体最后投产的全能机甲之一，其设计基于缴获的秃鹫全能机甲。

column1: Brawler & Firesupport
column2: 近战与火力支援

column1: Focused on close combat, the A configuration carries an ER Large Laser as its only long range weapon. Mounting a pair of SRM-6 launchers, an Autocannon/20 and the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis, the Avatar A is a fearsome opponent with devastating close range punch.
column2: A 配置聚焦近战，以一门 ER 大型激光作为唯一的远程武器。它装有一对 SRM-6 发射器、一门自动炮/20，以及基础底盘上的两门中型激光，降世神 A 是个可怕的对手，拥有毁灭性的近程打击力。

column1: Brawler
column2: 缠斗者

column1: Now, this is solid Avatar configuration! An AC20 and pair of SRMs to blast away at the enemy. Just don't run out of ammo, boss.
column2: 这才是扎实的降世神配置！一门 AC20 和一对 SRM 轰击敌人。别把弹药打光就行，老大。

column1: A fire support variant, the B configuration carries two LRM-15 racks and two LRM-10 racks. These are all mated to an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The only short range weaponry on the B configuration consists wholly of the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis.
column2: B 配置是一款火力支援变体，携带两具 LRM-15 挂架和两具 LRM-10 挂架，全部配以 Artemis IV 火控系统。B 配置唯一的近程武器完全由底盘上安装的两门中型激光构成。

column1: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
column2: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。

column1: Command & Fire Support
column2: 指挥 & 支援

column1: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
column2: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。

column1: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
column2: D 配置意在担任狙击手。主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。中近距离战斗方面，降世神 D 除两门固定中型激光外，还有两具 MRM-20 发射器和一对 ER 中型激光。最后，D 配置装有一台 C3 从属单元，使它能在 C3 小队中作战。

column1: Sniper
column2: 狙击手

column1: A dedicated 'Mech killer, the Avatar G carries a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition in each arm.
column2: 降世神 G 是专职机甲杀手，每臂各携带一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。

column1: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Mounting a mix of Combine and Clan-tech, this config carries an MRM-40 supported by a Clan Gauss Rifle, ER Large Laser and Streak SRM-4.
column2: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。它混装联合体与氏族科技，携带一具 MRM-40，辅以一门氏族高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具连续 SRM-4。

column1: Awesome
column2: 可畏

column1: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
column2: 一台真正配得上名字的机甲！神奇 8Q 装备三门的可怕 PPC，能在极短时间内摧毁、击倒或瘫痪任何目标。它笨拙不灵，却也能轻易扛下大量来袭火力。

column1: The AWS-8R replaces the more expensive PPCs with a Large Laser and paired LRM-15s.  While this variant can still dish out a similar amount of damage, it suffers from its dependency on a limited supply of ammunition.
column2: AWS-8R 以一门大型激光和成对的 LRM-15 取代更昂贵的 PPC。虽然此变体仍能造成相近的伤害，却因依赖有限的弹药储备而吃亏。

column1: The main benefit of this variant is its ability to lob indirect fire.  Otherwise this is a case where I prefer the original recipe.
column2: 这一变体的主要优势是能投掷间接火力。除此之外，这情况我更偏好原配方。

column1: The Awesome 8T is a superb fire support 'Mech, though its heavy armor is a bit wasted in that role. It can still put up a good fight at medium ranges, and it can crush smaller units outright with Melee attacks.
column2: 卓越 8T 是一款出色的火力支援机甲，尽管其厚重装甲在这个角色上略显浪费。它在中距离仍能打出漂亮的一仗，也能用近战攻击直接碾碎较小单位。

column1: Seeking to address the issues with the 8R model, the AWS-8V is a blend of the 8R and 8Q.  This allows a pilot to provide indirect fire support, while still being a potent combatant with its PPC and Large Laser.
column2: 为解决 8R 型号存在的问题，AWS-8V 融合了 8R 与 8Q。这使飞行员既能提供间接火力支援，又能凭借其 PPC 和大型激光成为强悍的战斗者。

column1: The best of both worlds, with LRMs and the PPC - Large Laser combo you have a versatile fire support platform.
column2: 两全其美，凭借 LRM 和 PPC-大型激光的组合，你得到了一款多用途火力支援平台。

column1: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
column2: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。机甲围绕一台 320 赫尔墨斯 XL 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。散热器升级为双倍散热器，使此变体得以重新装备三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC。这些 ER PPC 由两具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 支援（分置左臂与中央躯干，由左腿一吨再装填供弹）、中央躯干一门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，以及取代头部小型激光的"多元光学 10 型"小型脉冲激光。

column1: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. Twenty double Heatsinks keeping it cool while firing the three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs constantly, and with it's 320 XL engine it is faster and allows in addition a variety of backup weapons, but makes the 'Mech also more fragile.
column2: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。二十台双倍散热器让它在持续发射三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 时保持低温；凭借 320 XL 引擎它更快，还允许加装多种备用武器，但也使机甲更脆弱。

column1: Bane Prime
column2: 灾祸 原装型

column1: Bane
column2: 灾祸

column1: Clan Fire Support
column2: 氏族火力支援

column1: Banshee
column2: 报丧女妖

column1: The original design first produced in 2445, this Banshee variant carries the PPC, Autocannon/5, and Small Laser of the later 3E, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers.
column2: 此女妖变体源于 2445 年首次生产的原始设计，携带后来 3E 型的 PPC、自动炮/5 和小型激光，以及两门中型激光。

column1: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
column2: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。

column1: The Banshee 3M mounts respectable weaponry with better-than-average speed and armor. This comes at the cost of very poor heat management. It's good at hunting lighter units, especially if it can close to Melee range.
column2: 女妖 3M 装备可观的武器，速度与装甲优于平均。代价是散热管理极差。它擅长猎杀轻型单位，尤其当它能逼近至近战距离时。

column1: The Banshee 3MC was a special design of the Magistracy of Canopus. It replaced the autocannon with a bigger one. To make room for it, most of the original heatsinks had to go.
column2: 女妖 3MC 是卡诺普斯法域的特殊设计。它用一门更大的自动炮替换原有自动炮。为腾出空间，大部分原有散热器不得不被舍弃。

column1: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units. To address this design flaw, the Magistracy of Canopus exchanged the autocannon with a bigger one, at the expense of heat management in the MC variant.
column2: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。为解决这一设计缺陷，卡诺普斯法域在 MC 变体中用一门更大的自动炮替换了原有自动炮，代价是散热管理。

column1: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
column2: 女妖 3Q 变体缺乏前代的长距离能力，它以一门 AC20 和足以支撑持久战的弹药取代了 AC10 与 PPC。

column1: Heavy Brawler & Juggernaut
column2: 重型近战与重装

column1: A very recent variant, the 3S downgrades the engine size making the Banshee slower, but more than makes up for this by more than doubling its firepower.
column2: 3S 是极新的变体，它降级引擎尺寸使女妖更慢，但以超过两倍的火力远远弥补了这一点。

column1: This is some new Steiner variant, and those techs at Defiance Industries really made it a monster.  While not as fast as the original, this damage output on this 'Mech would make an Atlas jealous.
column2: 这是某种新的施泰纳变体，迪法恩斯工业的那些技师真把它做成了怪物。虽然不如原版快，但这台机甲的伤害输出会让阿特拉斯嫉妒。

column1: BattleAxe
column2: 战斧

column1: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
column2: 这台机甲的最初量产变体 BKX-7K 采用两门巨型多纳尔粒子投射炮，它们在当时相对较新。为支援这两门巨炮，它还装有两具联邦 5 发 LRM-5 发射器，共分一吨弹药，以及一具"鱼叉-6"SRM-6，使它在任何距离上都有可用的武器。

column1: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch.
column2: 失败的原型机，但威力惊人。

column1: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.\n
column2: 随着战斧的继任者"锤手"问世，再没有官方变体出现过。然而许多机甲战士——尤其是那些始终没学会如何驾驭空中跳跃的战斧的人——让技师拆下反复无常的跳跃推进器，在每侧躯干各装一具 LRM 5，称之为"不摔机"版本，或简称 7NC。\n

column1: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch. But be careful with ammo you will run dry fast.
column2: 失败的原型机，但打击力惊人。不过要小心弹药，你会很快打空。

column1: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
column2: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。

column1: The Battle Hawk is armed with a powerful short-range arsenal. The primary weaponry is a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers, which provides the Battle Hawk with a blistering short-range laser arsenal. The 'Mech is also armed with a Hovertec Streak SRM-2 which allows the 'Mech to attempt to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also armed with a McArthur Anti-Missile System which provides the Battle Hawk with a degree of protection from missile attacks.
column2: 战鹰装备强大的近程武器库。主武器为三门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，为战鹰提供炽烈的近程激光武器库。机甲还装备一具"气垫"连续 SRM-2，使机甲能尝试搜寻敌方装甲上的弱点。机甲另装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统，为战鹰提供一定程度的导弹攻击防护。

column1: BattleMaster
column2: 战斗大师

column1: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.
column2: 这是战斗大师 1DC 指挥型的升级改装，携带先进技术与硬化装甲，以尽可能长时间留在战斗中。

column1: Command 'Mech, Heavy Brawler, & Close Assault
column2: 指挥机甲、重型近战 & 近身突击

column1: More of a refit than a production variant, the SRM-6 and two Medium Lasers are removed so that six Heat Sinks and an extra ton of armor could be added.  Making the BLR-1D a formitable opponent.
column2: 它更像是一次改装而非量产变体：SRM-6 与两门中型激光被移除，以便加装六台散热器和一吨额外装甲，使 BLR-1D 成为令人敬畏的对手。

column1: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.
column2: 2855 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——战将是联邦太阳系首选安装指挥控制台的机甲之一。标准改装通常在 BLR-1G 上安装指挥控制台，移除一台散热器和两门后向中型激光。

column1: Thankfully I never faced one of these during my stint with the Second St. Ives Lancers on Kittery. The Fedrats, after all, preferred installing Command Consoles on the BattleMaster, but from my understanding these were relegated to training duties by the late Third Succession War. The loss of only one heat sink and two Medium Lasers is not too bad for a trade-off.
column2: 幸好我在基特里随第二圣艾夫斯枪骑兵服役期间从未遇到过这种机甲。毕竟联邦鼠更喜欢把指挥控制台装在战将上，但据我了解，这些到第三次继承战争后期已被降级用于训练任务。只损失一台散热器和两门中型激光，这样的代价不算太糟。

column1: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
column2: 战斗大师 1G 多才多艺而强大，是现存最知名的战斗机甲之一。它通常装备多样化的能量武器阵列，能在任何距离接敌，打击力很强。

column1: A new variant produced for the Lyran Commonwealth by Red Devil industries which changes its mission profile to be more of a support 'Mech, removing its PPC and SRM-6 and replacing them with an LRM-15, LRM-5 and a pair of SRM-2s.
column2: 这是红魔工业为莱兰联邦生产的新变体，其任务定位更偏支援机甲，移除 PPC 和 SRM-6，换成一套 LRM-15、LRM-5 和两具 SRM-2。

column1: Blackhawk BHKU-O
column2: 黑鹰 BHKU-O

column1: Blackhawk
column2: 黑鹰

column1: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
column2: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

column1: Blackjack
column2: 海盗旗

column1: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armour as best as it can.
column2: 黑杰克 0 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版，将两门 AC 换成中型步枪，并尽可能最大化装甲。

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. They typically mount Jump Jets, which give them an extra edge by repositioning quickly to keep a direct line of fire for their Autocannons.
column2: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。它们通常装备跳跃推进器，能迅速重新定位以保持自动炮的直射视野，从而获得额外优势。

column1: A recent Federated Suns variant, the BJ-1DB replaces the AutoCannon with Large Lasers.  In order to assist with the added heat, it also drops some armor and the torso mounted lasers to make room for more Heat Sinks.
column2: BJ-1DB 是联邦太阳系新近变体，将自动炮换成大型激光。为帮助应对增加的热量，它还削减了一些装甲和躯干激光，为更多散热器腾出空间。

column1: Sacrificing the Jump Jets, the BJ-1DC adds a Small Laser in each side torso and a Heat Sink to help ease the extra burden.
column2: BJ-1DC 牺牲跳跃推进器，在两侧躯干各加一门小型激光，并加一台散热器以缓解额外负担。

column1: In The Periphery Maintaining Mechs Tends To Be A Problem, As A Result The 1P Was Designed Generally As A Downgrade From The Os, But Much Cheaper To Maintain And Repair, Pilots Often Complain About The Structure 'Making Strange Noises', These Remarks Were Usually Ignored.
column2: 在外围区，维护机甲往往是个难题。因此 1P 大体上是 O 型的降级版，但维护和修理便宜得多。飞行员常抱怨其结构"发出奇怪的响声"，这些说法通常被无视。

column1: Well Isnt This Just a Bucket of bolts, Look At These Weapons, If You Can Call Them That,The Lasers Are Out Of Alignment And The 'Rifles' Are Dented, They Even Took The Fusion Core Out! Barbarians.. At Least It's Cheap To Replace, Not Sure Why You'd Want To.. Commander
column2: 好啊，这不就是一堆破铜烂铁吗？看看这些武器，如果还能叫武器的话——激光全都没校准，"步枪"上全是凹痕，他们居然连聚变核心都拆走了！野蛮人……至少替换起来便宜，不过我不确定你为什么会想替换它……指挥官

column1: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
column2: 这款早期黑杰克原型为该机甲开辟了一条完全不同的道路。BJ-1X 聚焦近程武器，配备四具火焰喷射器和四门中型激光。它还更注重速度而非跳跃机动，增大引擎尺寸并移除跳跃推进器。

column1: Brawler & Disabler
column2: 近战与瘫痪

column1: In the 3030s, the St. Ives Compact experimented with recovered technology on some of their Blackjacks. One prototype that showed great promise replace the autocannon and one heat sink with a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs. Three of the remaining heat sinks were replaced with experimental “freezer” double efficiency units.\n
column2: 在 3030 年代，圣艾夫斯共同体在他们的一些黑杰克上试验了找回的技术。一个前景看好的原型以一对"塞雷斯兵器粉碎者"PPC 取代自动炮和一台散热器。剩余散热器中有三台被换成实验性的"冷冻机"双倍效率装置。\n

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. This prototype tends to run hot even with the experimental "freezer" double heat sinks.
column2: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。这台原型机即便装上了实验性的"冷冻机"双倍散热器，也容易过热。

column1: The Blackjack 3T replaces the standard AC/2s with Large Laser, providing greater punch at the cost of some Heat and carries a large collection of Machine guns and 2 Small Lasers.
column2: 黑杰克 3T 以大型激光取代标准 AC/2，以一些热量为代价换取更强的打击力，并携带一大批机枪和 2 门小型激光。

column1: The Blackjack 5 is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
column2: 黑杰克 5 是一款颇为不寻常的改装型，以两门迫击炮取代自动炮，以提供间接火力支援并配备 AMS 防护。

column1: The Blackjack G, unlike the average variant, carries twin Ultra AC/10s. This variant also features an advanced targeting computer, an ultra-light gyro, and a supercharger.
column2: 黑杰克 G 与一般变体不同，携带双联超速 AC/10。此变体还配备先进瞄准计算机、超轻型陀螺仪和增压器。

column1: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
column2: 作为黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，黑杰克全能机甲是一款强劲且适应性强的中量级主力。与火焰使者全能机甲相似，全能版黑杰克的诞生源于氏族入侵初期联合体的技术交换计划——谷神星金属工业的圣艾夫斯契约分部向卢西恩装甲工厂提供了规格与许可，以制造这款评价不佳的黑杰克。

column1: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack. Even though it received the upgraded and more effective BJ-2 version, LAW manufactured only a few examples before reworking and retooling the line to manufacture an OmniMech version.
column2: 黑杰克全能机甲是黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，是一款强大而适应性强的中型主力机。与火焰使者全能机甲很像，全能黑杰克的起源来自联合体在氏族入侵初期的技术交换计划——塞雷斯金属工业的圣艾夫斯共同体分部向鲁西恩装甲工厂提供规格与许可，以生产这款评价不佳的黑杰克。尽管它获得了升级且更有效的 BJ-2 版本，LAW 只制造了少数几台，随后就改造并重新装备生产线以制造全能机甲版本。

column1: Here We Have the OA Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With LRM Launchers For Some Long Range Support.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OA 变体。此配置以 LRM 发射器取代 UAC/5，提供一些远程支援。

column1: Here We Have the OB Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Guass Rifle And A LRM10 Including An Artemis IV FCS.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OB 变体。此配置以一具高斯步枪和一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM10 取代 UAC/5。

column1: Here We Have the OC Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With LBX AC10's.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OC 变体。此配置以 LBX AC10 取代 UAC/5。

column1: Here We Have the OD Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A PPC And A 'Few' Lasers, As A Result 3 Extra Heatsinks Were Added To Compensate
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OD 变体。此配置以一门 PPC 和"少数"激光取代 UAC/5，因此额外加装了 3 台散热器作为补偿

column1: Here We Have the OE Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Light Guass Rifle,LRM10 and Two ER Lasers For Long Range Support
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OE 变体。此配置以一门轻型高斯步枪、LRM10 和两门 ER 激光取代 UAC/5，用于远程支援

column1: Here We Have the OF Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Bigger UAC/10 Two More Double Heatskinks, ER Lasers And Finally ER PPC
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OF 变体。此配置以更大的 UAC/10、两门额外双倍散热器、ER 激光以及最后的 ER PPC 取代 UAC/5

column1: Here We Have the OR Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Gauss Rifle, Maybe A Few Pulse Lasers.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OR 变体。此配置以一具高斯步枪，也许还有几门脉冲激光，取代 UAC/5。

column1: The Black Knight 6-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damageÔÇª just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
column2: 黑骑士 6-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。

column1: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better. Mostly thanks to its Double Heat Sinks.
column2: 黑骑士 6B 是我们今天所熟知的标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟祖先，打击更狠、散热更好。6 型能做到的一切，它都做得更好。这主要归功于它的双倍散热器。

column1: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
column2: 这是自由世界联盟的变体，BL-7-KNT-L 将较稀有的 PPC 换成第三门大型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

column1: The Black Knight 7-KNT-L still dishes out almost as much firepower as its namesake, perhaps more, since it can keep firing longer with the combination of the extra heat sinks and the removal of the PPC.
column2: 黑骑士 7-KNT-L 输出的火力几乎与其同名型号相当，也许更多，因为凭借额外散热器和移除 PPC，它能持续开火更久。

column1: The Black Knight 7-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damageÔÇª just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
column2: 黑骑士 7-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。

column1: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
column2: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

column1: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
column2: 黑骑士 9-KNT 实质上是 6 型的失落科技升级版，将其大部分标准激光换成脉冲版本，标准 PPC 换成 ER 版本。该变体还配备双倍散热器以应对这些武器产生的额外热量。

column1: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 黑猎隼 A 配置为电子战与侦察。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位，ECM 套件反制敌方电子设备，TAG 指示激光为制导炮击标记目标。进攻方面，它可调用一门 ER PPC 和一对中型脉冲激光。

column1: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 黑猎隼 A 为电子战与侦察而配置。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位、ECM 套件对抗敌方电子设备、TAG 侦察激光为寻的炮弹标记目标。攻击方面，它能依靠一门 ER PPC 和两门中型脉冲激光。

column1: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
column2: C 型是近距支援变体，装备六门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6。它还使用三台额外双倍散热器以帮助控制热量水平。

column1: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
column2: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

column1: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
column2: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

column1: Blitzkrieg
column2: 闪电战

column1: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
column2: 闪电战之名取自意为"闪电战争"的术语，而它完全配得上这个名字。它建立在轻量化的考文垂 BTZ-VII 内骨骼底盘上，由一台玛格纳 350 XL 引擎驱动——重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半，同时赋予机甲 118.8 公里/小时的最高速度。

column1: Fast Raider
column2: 快速袭击者

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the bloodasp was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 血复于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the bloodasp was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere..
column2: 血复于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。.

column1: Bombard
column2: 轰击

column1: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
column2: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。

column1: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
column2: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。

column1: Brigand
column2: 强盗

column1: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
column2: 强盗是一台备受争议的战斗机甲，因为它是首款由海盗团伙生产的机甲。它由一家名为"复仇公司"的企业制造，该企业由避风港星团的海盗与"死亡女士"特雷瓦琳经营。强盗代表着前所未有的威胁，因为尽管它由海盗建造，却使用了先进的建造技术和武器。

column1: Freebooter Scout
column2: 掠夺者侦察

column1: Bushwacker
column2: 丛林猎手

column1: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
column2: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。

column1: Guerilla Prototype
column2: 游击原型

column1: Caesar
column2: 凯撒

column1: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.
column2: 它最初是铁甲舰的逆向工程版本，而最终的成品令人惊讶地被证明本身就是一个高质量设计。

column1: Cataphract
column2: 重装骑兵

column1: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
column2: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。

column1: The 2X replaces the PPC with a heavy laser, while the arm-mounted medium lasers are removed in favor of a SRM-4.  This reduction in heat load also allows for the removal of 2 heat sinks and adding armor in their stead.
column2: 2X 将 PPC 换成重型激光，同时移除臂载中型激光，改为一具 SRM-4。热负荷的降低还允许移除 2 台散热器，并以装甲取而代之。

column1: The CTF-4X is the latest variant of this prototype 'Mech.  The 4X downgrades the Engine, making for a slower ride, but adds more long range firepower with two Autocannon 5s, a Large Laser and LRM5.
column2: CTF-4X 是这款原型机甲的最新变体。4X 降级了引擎，使它跑得更慢，但以两门自动炮 5、一门大型激光和一具 LRM5 增加了更多远程火力。

column1: Honestly Commander, I've never even heard of this thing.  Have to hand it to the Capellans though, these FrankenMechs are nothing if not interesting.
column2: 老实说指挥官，我连听都没听过这东西。不过得佩服卡佩兰人，这些"科学怪机"真是有趣得很。

column1: Catapult
column2: 弩炮

column1: The Catapult A1 was designed as a true support role model.  The CPLT-A1 removes all 4 Medium Lasers in favor of additional LRM ammunition and armor.
column2: 弹射器 A1 被设计为真正的支援型型号。CPLT-A1 移除全部 4 门中型激光，换成额外的 LRM 弹药和装甲。

column1: Heavy Fire Support
column2: 重型火力支援

column1: The A1 model is going to need that extra armor if another 'Mech gets close in, as it doesn't have any real close in defenses.  On the brighter side, you aren't likely to run out of ammo.
column2: A1 型号若有其他机甲贴近就需要那层额外装甲，因为它没有任何真正的近战防御。好的一面是，你不太可能打光弹药。

column1: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
column2: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。

column1: The Royal Catapult, the -C1b was designed to fill the same role as the normal -C1 but better. Thanks to Ferro-Fibrous armor it sports better protection, and thanks to double heat sinks it can jump and fire all day long without problems.
column2: 皇家弹射器-C1b 的设计目标是执行与普通-C1 相同的角色，但做得更好。得益于铁纤维装甲，它拥有更好的防护；得益于双倍散热器，它可以整天跳跃开火而毫无问题。

column1: The CPLT-C4 is an explosive addition to any outfit's arsenal.  Trading out the stock LRM-15s, Medium Lasers and extra Heat Sinks for LRM-20s and Small Lasers - along with 2 extra tons of ammo, the C4 gives the Catapult impressive long range firepower.
column2: CPLT-C4 是任何部队武器库中的爆炸性补充。它把标准 LRM-15、中型激光和额外散热器换成 LRM-20 与小型激光——外加 2 吨额外弹药，C4 赋予弹射器令人印象深刻的远程火力。

column1: If you can't find yourself an Archer, this is the next best thing.  While not as potent close in as the standard C1 model, the C4 can still hold its own in a brawl against a lighter opponent.
column2: 如果你找不到弓箭手，这就是次优选择。虽然近战不如标准 C1 型号强悍，C4 在对抗较轻的对手时仍能立足。

column1: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
column2: 弹射器 K2 是一次跳出常规的重新设计，以更强的直射 PPC 取代间接火力能力。不过它通常不装跳跃推进器，因此在运用上稍有局限。

column1: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor. .
column2: K2K 型号是 K2 弹射器的升级，把引擎换成超轻型。双联 PPC 也升级为 ER PPC。机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光用于近程火力。为处理升级带来的额外热量，机甲使用 20 台双倍散热器。最后，K2K 型号携带十三吨半装甲。

column1: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor.
column2: K2K 型号是 K2 弹射器的升级，把引擎换成超轻型。双联 PPC 也升级为 ER PPC。机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光用于近程火力。为处理升级带来的额外热量，机甲使用 20 台双倍散热器。最后，K2K 型号携带十三吨半装甲。

column1: Though this design never reached full production, it was prototyped during the War of 3039. It upgrades the PPCs of the K2 to ER PPCs.
column2: 该设计从未进入量产，但在 3039 年战争期间被作成原型。它将 K2 的 PPC 升级为 ER PPC。

column1: Another Kuritan variant, the -K5 goes back to its roots by carrying two MRM-30 launchers as its primary weapon.
column2: 又一款库瑞塔变体，-K5 回归本源，以两具 MRM-30 发射器为主武器。

column1: CattleMaster
column2: 牧牛人

column1: Bessie
column2: 贝西

column1: Centurion
column2: 百夫长

column1: A primitive downgrade of the Centurion-9A commonly found among LowTech States and Bandits.
column2: 这是百夫长-9A 的原始降级版，在低技术国家和匪帮中很常见。

column1: Brawler & General Assault
column2: 缠斗者 & 普通突击

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
column2: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离交战，其伤害曲线随接近目标而上升。

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A2 models come with a UAC/10 and usually carry Hotloaded LRMs.
column2: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A2 型号配备一门 UAC/10，通常携带热装 LRM。

column1: A somewhat radical departure from the stock Centurion, the CN9-AH Variant trades out the stock AC10 and Medium Lasers for a single AC20.  While this amounts to the same degree of firepower, it has the benefit of concentrating the damage to a single location.
column2: CN9-AH 变体是对标准百夫长的较大偏离，它把标准 AC10 和中型激光换成一门 AC20。虽然火力总量相当，但它有利于把伤害集中在单一部位。

column1: The AH model gives the Centurion more of a focused punch, but I still prefer the original for keeping the OpFor at arm's reach.
column2: AH 型号赋予百夫长更集中的打击力，但我仍偏好原版，因为它能让对手保持在臂长之外。

column1: The AL variant of the Centurion tends to trade the larger burst damage of an Autocannon for more Energy weaponry and heavier armor. ALs can take an incredible amount of damage for their size but still pack a good punch.
column2: 百夫长的 AL 变体倾向于以自动炮较大的爆发伤害换取更多能量武器和更厚的装甲。AL 就其尺寸而言能承受惊人的伤害，同时打击力依然不错。

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-B1 models are able to engage at extreme range thanks to a Light Gauss Rifle and stay in the field with their AMS and Medium Shield.
column2: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-B1 型号凭借一门轻型高斯步枪能在极远距离交战，并靠其 AMS 与中型盾牌留在战场。

column1: Flanker & Support
column2: 侧翼与支援

column1: The D variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3049, is the first of many upgrades using Star League technology. The chassis was re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction techniques. Next the power plant was changed from the standard engine to an GM 300 extralight engine, increasing its maximum speed to 97.2 km/h. Finally, the weapons were upgraded. The Autocannon/10 was swapped for a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 and an Artemis IV fire control system was added to the LRM launcher. The two medium lasers were retained.
column2: 百夫长的 D 变体于 3049 年推出，是众多星盟科技升级中的首个。底盘经重新设计以采用内骨骼构造工艺。随后动力装置从标准引擎改为 GM 300 超轻型引擎，最高速度提升至 97.2 公里/小时。最后武器也获升级：自动炮/10 换成迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，LRM 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，两门中型激光予以保留。

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-D models are upgraded for a LB-X AC and Artemis supported MML.
column2: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-D 型号升级为 LB-X AC 和 Artemis 支援的 MML。

column1: The CN9-D3 variant introduced in 3052 is identical to the CN9-D Centurion with one exceptional difference. The D3 uses Triple Strength Myomer to increase its top speed up to 118.8 kph while it is running hot.
column2: 3052 年推出的 CN9-D3 变体与 CN9-D 百夫长完全相同，只有一个特殊差异。D3 使用三倍强度人造肌，在过热运转时把最高速度提升至 118.8 公里/小时。

column1: The D3D variant of this 'Mech is a potent long-range sniper, first built in 3060. It uses the same chassis and engine combination as the D3 variant but uses MASC to augment its movement to give it a maximum speed of 129.6 kph. The primary weapon on the D3D is a Light Gauss Rifle. For added long range assistance, the 'Mech carries an LRM-10 launcher and for close range combat it carries an ER Medium Laser. This is all protected with eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 该机甲的 D3D 变体是威力强大的远程狙击型，于 3060 年首次建造。它使用与 D3 变体相同的底盘与引擎组合，但用 MASC 增强其移动，最高速度达 129.6 公里/小时。D3D 的主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。为增强远程支援，机甲携带一具 LRM-10 发射器，近战则一门 ER 中型激光。这一切由八吨铁纤维装甲保护。

column1: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive armour and engine but counteracts this with a masive alpha from it's 40 Rockets.
column2: 这是首款完全由霸权工厂出品的马里安机甲。它以原始装甲和引擎压低成本，但用 40 枚火箭构成的巨型齐射来抵消这一劣势。

column1: Brawler & General Trooper
column2: 近战与通用士兵

column1: The armour is shit, the engine is shit but what do you expect from a slaver nation. It still can serve as a trooper in a pinch.
column2: 装甲是垃圾，引擎也是垃圾，但你对一个奴役者国家还能指望什么。不过必要时它仍能充当通用机。

column1: Chameleon
column2: 变色龙

column1: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name.
column2: 变色龙旨在帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动与散热管理技巧，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，跳跃距离一百八十米。该机甲还配备几乎全能量的武器配置，但仅由十台标准散热器冷却。散热器的匮乏迫使机甲战士专注于机甲的热量水平。某些情况下，变色龙被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间。变色龙的生产曾在 3052 年短暂中断，当时迪法恩斯工业决定将生产转向夜空，但在 J.B. 机甲公司购得该设计权后迅速恢复。J.B. 机甲还推出了两款具备战斗力的变色龙变体。变色龙是一款训练机甲，旨在通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各类对手。变色龙是中型机甲，但不总是看起来像。它可以加装额外装甲板改变外观，并携带特殊电子设备伪造自身信号；这些特殊能力让它看起来和扫描起来都不像自己，因此得名。

column1: Scout
column2: 侦察兵

column1: The 7W variant of the Chameleon looked to use the 'Mech in a full time combat role. The 'Mech had upgraded the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser. Additionally, the Machine Guns and Small Lasers had been removed and replaced with a Medium Pulse Laser and double heat sinks.
column2: 变色龙 7W 变体试图让机甲承担全职战斗角色。机甲把大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光。此外，机枪和小型激光被移除，换成一门中型脉冲激光和双倍散热器。

column1: Another combat variant of the Chameleon, the 7Z carried as its primary weapons two Large Lasers and a single ER Large Laser. The 7Z carried no other secondary weapons on its chassis and used twelve double heat sinks to handle its massive heat load.
column2: 作为变色龙的另一战斗变体，7Z 以两门大型激光和一门 ER 大型激光为主武器。7Z 底盘上没有其他次要武器，并使用十二台双倍散热器处理其庞大热负荷。

column1: Champion
column2: 冠军

column1: Where the CHP-2N is the downgraded Succession Wars variant of the Champion, the -1N is the fully powered Star League variant and is the original one the designers introduced. The high speed for a mech its size remains as does the somewhat anemic armor, the main benefit the mech gets from Star League technology is found in the weaponry: a LB-10X Autocannon, a SRM 6 with an Artemis IV system, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers. Otherwise, the -1N is much the same as the -2N and performs the same in many ways.
column2: CHP-2N 是冠军在继承战争中的降级版，而-1N 则是完整的星盟版本，也是设计师最初推出的原始型号。对如此尺寸的机甲而言速度依旧很高，装甲依然略显单薄，机甲从星盟科技中获得的主要好处体现在武器上：一门 LB-10X 自动炮、一具配 Artemis IV 系统的 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光。除此之外，-1N 与-2N 大体相同，表现也多有相似。

column1: During the Star League when the Champion-1N was in full production, there was a frequent pilot modification that turned into a production variant. This mech, the -1N2, is exactly the same as the -1N with the exception of the heat sinks, which have been upgraded to doubles. In all other respects, the -1N2 is the same as the -1N.
column2: 星盟时期，冠军-1N 全速生产时，有一种常见的飞行员改装后来变成了量产变体。这台机甲就是-1N2，除散热器升级为双倍外，与-1N 完全相同。其他方面-1N2 与-1N 一致。

column1: Royal Champion
column2: 皇家冠军

column1: A variant reserved for SLDF Royal units, this Champion was introduced in 2751 and replaces all the standard weaponry with a Gauss Rifle and ER PPC. It also uses double heat sinks. This gave the -1Nb an extremely long range weapon profile and a serious punch while also solving its heat issues.
column2: 这是为星盟防卫军皇家部队保留的变体，2751 年推出，将所有标准武器换成一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC。它还使用双倍散热器。这使-1Nb 拥有极远射程的武器配置和强悍打击力，同时解决了散热问题。

column1: Heavy Recon and Sniper
column2: 重型侦察与狙击

column1: The Champion debuted in 2602 as a generalist combat 'Mech with a focus on heavy reconnaissance and fast strike capabilities. While definitely faster and more maneuverable than other heavy 'Mechs, it was criticized by many for being too large, underarmed and underarmored. The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM 6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size.
column2: 冠军于 2602 年首次亮相，是一款通用战斗机甲，侧重重型侦察与快速打击能力。虽然确实比其他重型机甲更快更灵活，它却被许多人批评体型过大、武装与装甲不足。许多人认为冠军的武器就其尺寸而言过于孱弱，尤其在失去星盟的先进技术之后。它携带一门 AC/10、一具 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光，就尺寸而言武装弱得可怜。

column1: Charger
column2: 冲锋者

column1: The Charger is seen as an example of abject failure in BattleMech design. Wells Technologies originally wanted to produce an ultra-heavy scout 'Mech for the Star League Defense Force that was not only fast but could survive contact with the enemy. This was done by building the Charger on an 80-ton frame, making it the heaviest scout 'Mech in existence, and powering it with a massive LTV 400 fusion engine that took up almost sixty percent of the Charger's mass. With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction.
column2: 冲锋者被视为战斗机甲设计中彻底失败的例子。威尔斯科技原本想为星盟防卫军生产一款超重型侦察机甲，不仅快速，还能在与敌接触中存活。为此他们把冲锋者建在 80 吨骨架上，使其成为现存最重的侦察机甲，并以一台占据冲锋者近百分之六十质量的巨大 LTV 400 聚变引擎驱动。凭借使其能跑赢大多数其他机甲的极高速度，冲锋者随后获得十吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲，足以反复承受 20 级自动炮的命中。然而这些特性几乎没给进攻能力留下空间——这是设计团队有意为之的缺陷，因为他们认为除收集数据之外的任何任务都是干扰。

column1: The 1A5 variant of the Charger was one of the first variants of the Charger made to take it from the role of scout to assault 'Mech. A Capellan modification to the CGR-1Ls they received as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the engine was downgraded to a 320 version, which reduced the maximum speed of the 'Mech to 64.8 km/h, and four of the small lasers were removed. In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs.
column2: 冲锋者 1A5 变体是最早把冲锋者从侦察角色转变为突击机甲的变体之一。它是卡佩兰对作为卡普坦协定一部分所获 CGR-1L 的改装，引擎降级为 320 版本，把机甲最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并移除四门小型激光。取而代之的是作为主武器的"友鹤"自动炮/20、两具比卡尔 SRM-6 发射器和一门阿尔格拉 3L 中型激光，机甲装甲增加五吨。这使 CGR-1A5 在近程极为危险，速度可与多数重型机甲相当，同时装甲与其他八十吨机甲持平。

column1: Assault & Brawler
column2: 突击与近战

column1: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license.
column2: 1A9 是联合体-LAW 为使冲锋者在远程更有效所做的尝试，它采用缩小的 320 级引擎，把最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并全面改造了武器库。所有较小激光（除头部那门）都换成中型激光，右躯干安装一具 LRM-20 发射器，左躯干携带两吨再装填。为弥补丧失的机动性，还安装了四个跳跃推进器（每腿两个），使冲锋者可跳跃至一百二十米。该变体及时投入战场，在 3039 年战争中令联邦太阳系武装部队大为意外，但此后数年因一次法律纠纷授予雷文纳电子生产许可，该设计落入外域联盟之手。

column1: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
column2: CGR-1L 是作为卡普坦协定一部分出售给卡佩兰邦联的出口型号，是对冲锋者的简单改装，试图在 3023 年查拉星上的灾难性使用之后让它更有效。1L 以四吨半装甲和全部五门小型激光为代价，在右臂装一门大型激光，两侧躯干各两门中型激光。虽然更易过热、防护也更差——装甲水平堪比传统侦察机甲——但它更能抵御其他侦察机甲，而在当时，对卡佩兰邦联武装部队绝望的战士而言已经足够。此后 CGR-1L 一直留在卡佩兰服役，作为训练机甲，据传也是对付异见士兵的惩罚性差事。

column1: Heavy Scout & Sniper
column2: 重型侦察与狙击

column1: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
column2: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。

column1: Called Challenger by its designers, the -SB modification is not remarkable because it is not particularly difficult to apply.  Using a common and well-know reactor in the refit and essentially only upgrading the existing lasers to heavier versions, in turn requiring the Targeting-Tracking System to be tampered with.
column2: -SB 改装被设计者称为"挑战者"，它并不起眼，因为实施起来并不特别困难。改装中使用了常见且知名的反应堆，本质上只是把现有激光升级为更重的版本，相应地需要对瞄准追踪系统进行调整。

column1: Cicada
column2: 知了

column1: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
column2: 说实话，蝉总体上非常脆弱。2A 型号被设计得与任何轻型机甲一样快，但那台庞大的引擎几乎没给其他东西留下空间。不过只要谨慎使用，它仍能成为成功的侦察与佯动机甲。

column1: A swap out of the 2A's Small Laser and half a ton of armor for a Flamer, this 'Mech can be quickly maneuvered in to heat up an opponent that is already having issues.
column2: 它以一台火焰喷射器换掉 2A 的小型激光和半吨装甲，可以迅速机动上去给本就散热吃紧的对手再加把火。

column1: Not much of an improvement over the 2A model, if anything, the removal of half a ton of armor just makes you a bit more vulnerable.
column2: 相比 2A 型号没什么改进，反而移除半吨装甲只让你更脆弱一点。

column1: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
column2: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区袭扰型，速度快、打击狠，但缺乏耐久，一旦倾泻完弹药就难以久撑。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲火力的主体，运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察与猎头机甲，具备凶悍的全力齐射，不论目标是谁都能撕碎大多数对手。它易于维护、更易替换，用可从大多数战场回收或在任何后街集市、不名誉军火市场上买到的零件建造。事实上，大多数新的 2P 都是被拖离战场的残骸重新拼装，尽快重建而成。

column2: 猎头者
