column2: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区劫掠者，快速且打击凶狠，但缺乏耐力，一旦投出载荷便无法长久生存。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲的主要火力，若运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共配一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察兵与猎头者，其凶猛的齐射足以撕裂大多数对手，无论目标为何。2P 为易于维护、更易于替换而设计，其部件可从大多数战场回收，或从任意后巷集市和不入流的军火市场弄到。事实上，多数新的 2P 往往是从战场拖回的报废机体被尽快重建而成。

column1: The Cicada 3C is slightly slower than the 2A but has more room for weaponry and armor. It still generally underperforms in most areas except speed, but it can put up more of a fight, with better survival rates.
column2: 蝉 3C 比 2A 略慢，但有更多空间容纳武器和装甲。除速度外它在多数方面仍普遍表现不佳，但它更能一战，生存率也更高。

column1: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Refitting a standard 2A with an XL Engine, Gibson Federated stripped the weapons and replaced them with a pair of LRM-15’s and 3 tons of ammunition. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
column2: 这是一款略显另类的设计，这款火力支援机甲在较先进的外围区国家和许多佣兵部队中颇受欢迎。吉布森联邦将一个标准 2A 换上 XL 引擎，拆除武器代之以两具 LRM-15 和三吨弹药。它被构想为一款相对廉价的支援机甲，速度足以跟上轻型侦察部队，弹药也足以支撑大多数交战，自推出以来销量稳定，并说服吉布森改装了他们一条较老的 2A 生产线以生产此变体。从自由世界联盟到外域联盟都在部署，这款机甲已遍布内天体，在防御驻军中十分常见。批评者指出它缺乏装甲与 C.A.S.E.，支持者则称赞其低成本与战术灵活性。

column1: The 3F Cicada is one of the most advanced versions of this 'Mech, its upgrades based on combat reports from the front lines of the Clan Invasion, and was introduced in 3052. The chassis has been constructed using Endo Steel construction techniques and the 'Mech is protected with six and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 3F is powered by an extralight engine and carries a weapons loadout that appears to be a cross between the 2A and 3C models. The primary weapon is an ER PPC, which is backed up by two medium lasers. What's more the Cicada can now jump up to two hundred and forty meters thanks to the inclusion of eight jump jets.
column2: 3F 蝉是该机甲最先进的版本之一，其升级基于氏族入侵前线的战斗报告，于 3052 年推出。底盘采用内骨骼建造技术，机甲由六吨半铁纤维装甲保护。3F 由超轻型引擎驱动，武器配置看起来介于 2A 与 3C 型号之间。主武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以两门中型激光。更重要的是，得益于八个跳跃推进器的加入，蝉如今能跳起至二百四十米。

column1: Based off of the same chassis as the 3F, the 3G was introduced in 3056 to transform the chassis into a more dedicated recon platform. It trades in the PPC for an ER Large Laser, a Beagle Active Probe, and additional armor.
column2: 3G 与 3F 使用相同底盘，于 3056 年推出，旨在把底盘改造为更专注的侦察平台。它把 PPC 换成 ER 大型激光、比格犬主动探测器和额外装甲。

column1: A Combine rebuild of captured 3E’s, this design swaps the LRM-15’s for a pair of MRM-20’s and 2 tons of ammo, augmented by an Artemis IV system. Assigned to the Ghost Regiments and the Legions of Vega, these Cicadas are typically employed as scout-skirmishers and scout hunters. Unfortunately the limited ammo and lack of serious protection has lead to many mechwarriors petitioning for reassignment to other units or refusing to pilot these mechs. The Procurement Department on the other hand, is thrilled that it can offload these retrofitted Cicadas to units who have no choice in the matter. Nonetheless pilots who can master this design, report satisfaction with it’s performance and many have turned to field conversions to improve it’s endurance. The most commonly one reported is the installation of an Endosteel skeleton allowing another ton of ammo or the installation CASE II.
column2: 这款设计是联合体对缴获 3E 的重建，把 LRM-15 换成一对 MRM-20 和 2 吨弹药，并加装 Artemis IV 系统。这些蝉被配属给幽灵团与维加军团，通常作为侦察散兵和侦察猎手使用。遗憾的是，有限的弹药和缺乏像样的防护导致许多机甲战士申请调往其他单位或拒绝驾驶这些机甲。另一方面，采购部门却为能把这些改装蝉甩给别无选择的单位而欣喜若狂。尽管如此，能驾驭此设计的飞行员报告对其性能满意，许多人转而进行野战改装以提升其续航力。最常被报告的改装是安装内骨骼骨架以多带一吨弹药，或加装 C.A.S.E. II。

column1: The Cicada 3L is a succession war refit turning it into a fire support platform.
column2: 蝉 3L 是继承战争时期的改装型，将其改造为火力支援平台。

column1: The 3M upgrade of this older BattleMech uses some of the newest technology available at its introduction in 3049. It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.
column2: 这款较老战斗机甲的 3M 升级版使用了 3049 年推出时可获得的部分最新技术。它采用同款皮特班 320 引擎的超轻型版本，腾出额外空间把小型激光升级为小型脉冲激光，并在左躯干加装一门超速自动炮/5。这门新实弹武器由右躯干储存的一吨弹药供弹，并在弹药爆炸时由 C.A.S.E. 保护。"星板"装甲也已换成杜拉莱克斯轻型，尽管防护量与 2A 相同。

column1: The Cicada 4L is yet another refit born from a shortage of proper parts. It carries two Light Rifles with two tons of ammo.
column2: 蝉 4L 又是一个因缺乏合适零件而生的改装型。它携带两门轻型步枪和两吨弹药。

column1: Clint
column2: 克林特

column1: This was once a Clint mech, but now it has spikes all over and it's current weapons, that either fire or blow up in your face.
column2: 这曾经是一台克林特机甲，但现在浑身是尖刺，武器不是开火就是炸你一脸。

column1: Pirate Mech
column2: 海盗机甲

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。1-2R 克林特是最初的原型变体，携带一门阿姆斯特朗"破坏者"自动炮/10，以一门中型激光为次要武器，且没有跳跃推进器。

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 2-2R Clint is an even more cheap refit of the original variant, equipping primitive, cheaper weaponry, that periphery states can afford.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。2-2R 克林特是原变体更为廉价的改装版，装备原始而便宜的武器，是外围区国家负担得起的。

column1: Primitive Mech
column2: 原始机甲

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3U is a Capellan field upgrade of the Clint that strips all of the armaments from the chassis and replaces them with more potent and enduring weaponry, the most radical of which is the primary weapon. The AC/5 has been replaced with an ER PPC while both the Medium Lasers were replaced with Medium Pulse Lasers; as a result, it runs much hotter than the original. The 3U also packs double heat sinks in place of single models and is more deadly in combat.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。克林特 2-3U 是克林特的卡佩兰野战升级型，它剥离底盘上全部武器，换上更强劲耐久的装备，其中最激进的是主武器。AC/5 换成 ER PPC，两门中型激光则换成中型脉冲激光；因此它比原版热得多。3U 还以双倍散热器取代单散热器，在战斗中更为致命。

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This variant of the Clint carries two Autocannon/2s in place of the single AC/5, giving it one of the longest ranges possible on such a small chassis. It also bears a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon. Like the 1-2R variant, the 2-4T also has no jumping capability.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。此克林特变体以两门自动炮/2 取代单门 AC/5，在如此小的底盘上拥有最远的射程之一。它还携带一门中型激光作为次要武器。与 1-2R 变体一样，2-4T 也没有跳跃能力。

column1: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
column2: 2784 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领星盟防卫军大部流亡时，带上了克林特战斗机甲的原型机。在狼獾氏族被灭绝后，雪鸦氏族重新审视这些原型，于 2830 年得以开始量产并于 2842 年推出。他们确保其跟上氏族技术的进步，最终演变为如今被称为克林特 IIC 的设计。这款高速中型机甲装备一门 KOV 型 LB-10X 自动炮和两门 2d 系列 ER 中型激光，使其成为高效的轻型机甲杀手。凭借四吨弹药，它能远离补给线长期作战，不过它仅使用十台标准散热器和七吨标准装甲。

column1: Clan Sniper & Light Brawler
column2: 氏族狙击手与轻型近战

column1: Commando
column2: 突击手

column1: The original Commando used prototype equipment that was similarly primitive to those found in the first BattleMech, the Mackie. This version was completely replaced by its successor. First constructed in 2463, the 'Mech was equipped with only an Odin Large Laser mounted in its right arm.
column2: 原版突击队员使用与首款战斗机甲"麦基"同样原始的原型装备。此版本已被其继任者完全取代。该机甲于 2463 年首次建造，仅装备右臂一门奥丁大型激光。

column1: Light Sniper & Scout
column2: 轻型狙击手 & 侦察兵

column1: The Large Laser mounted by most 1B models is nothing to sniff at, but it lacks the close-up impact of the SRMs it replaces. Best to keep these units at range for flanking and spotting.
column2: 大多数 1B 型号装备的大型激光不容小觑，但它缺乏被它取代的 SRM 那种近距离冲击力。最好让这些单位保持距离，用于侧翼包抄和目标指示。

column1: The Commando 1C is a recent variant that attempts to make a long range direct fire support unit, by removing the missiles and replacing them with a single AC2 in the right arm.
column2: 突击队员 1C 是近期变体，试图打造一款远程直射支援单位：它移除导弹，在右臂换上一门 AC2。

column1: The predesessor to the 2D, the Commando 1D was meant to give the MechWarrior a little more long range punch with a Large Laser. at the cost of some of its armor.  While the 2D is superior in most aspects, there are still a number of this older design still in service today.
column2: 作为 2D 的前身，突击队员 1D 意在用一门大型激光为机甲战士提供更多远程打击力，代价是部分装甲。虽然 2D 在多数方面更优，但这款较老设计至今仍有不少在役。

column1: You don't see many of these outside of Lyran space.  While I like the added range, the reduced armor and increased heat profile make this a troublesome 'Mech.  There is a reason they moved on to the 2D.
column2: 在莱兰空间之外你见不到多少这种机甲。虽然我喜欢它增加的射程，但减少的装甲和升高的热量曲线使它成为一台麻烦的机甲。他们转向 2D 是有原因的。

column1: Dubbed the 'Blazing Inferno', this variant of the 2D chassis removes all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor.
column2: 此变体绰号"炽烈地狱"，基于 2D 底盘，移除全部导弹，改为加装三门中型激光和六门小型激光，以及额外一吨装甲。

column1: With all those SRMs, the COM-2D is like a small, highly mobile shotgun that can take down 'Mechs twice its size or bigger. You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
column2: 凭借这些 SRM，COM-2D 就像一把小型、高度机动的霰弹枪，能放倒体型两倍于己或更大的机甲。不过你得小心使用，因为它经不起多少打击。

column1: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
column2: 3055 年，陶里安协约的范登堡机械化工业公司限量生产了这款突击队 COM-2D 的工厂改装型，使用从卡佩兰邦联进口的隐形与传感器组件。成果是一款有效的侦察机甲，具备可观的伏击能力，但与基础型号相比的高昂成本以及跨国生产的困难，使其未能被广泛采用。

column1: Well Commander, as outfitted from the factory it's certainly a superior Commando. At the chassis level it's not much different than it's cheaper cousins. But the custom Null Signature system puts it on another level.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，按出厂配置它的确是一台更优秀的突击队员。在底盘层面它与其较廉价的表亲区别不大。但定制的"虚无信号"系统让它上升到了另一个层次。

column1: The Commando 2I features modified SRMs with an Inferno payload. This pirate favorite is notorious for its ability to harass and disable, while also packing a punch with its two RL-10s.
column2: 突击队员 2I 采用装有燃烧弹载荷的改装 SRM。这款海盗最爱以骚扰与瘫痪能力而臭名昭著，同时凭借两具 RL-10 也有相当打击力。

column1: A very recent variant, the 3A mounts a pair of SRM-6 racks and supplements its close in firepower with a Flamer.  It is an excellent quick strike 'Mech, but suffers in drawn out fights due to a limited supply of ammunition for the SRMs.
column2: 3A 是极新的变体，装备一对 SRM-6 挂架，并以一具火焰喷射器补充其近距火力。它是出色的快速打击机甲，但由于 SRM 弹药有限，在持久战中会吃亏。

column1: For a light 'Mech, the COM-3A can dish out a lot of damage in a single volley.  Though it is bound to chew up that ammo faster than my crew would go through a case of Triple-F Burgers.
column2: 作为轻型机甲，COM-3A 单次齐射就能造成大量伤害。不过它肯定会比我手下那帮人吃"三重 F 汉堡"还快地耗光弹药。

column1: The Commando 4H is the Marian Hegemony's primary garrison mech, often sent out against pirates twice the weight with surprising success. 90 Rockets ensure that even out weighed it isn't out gunned.
column2: 突击队员 4H 是马里安霸权的首要驻防机甲，常被派去对抗两倍重量的海盗并取得惊人成功。90 枚火箭确保它即便体重落于下风，火力也不落于下风。

column1: The Commando 4H is a periphery pilots dream as far as light mechs go. All mechs are equal under such a ridiculous rocket barrage.
column2: 就轻型机甲而言，突击队员 4H 是外围区飞行员的梦想。在如此荒谬的火箭弹幕之下，所有机甲都是平等的。

column1: The COM-5S was introduced in 3050 and was the first Commando to feature Star League technology. Its new Cyclops MultiTasker 10 Targeting System links an Artemis IV Fire Control System to the Coventry 90 mm SRM-6, which replaces the Shannon Six-Shooter, and exchanges the SRM-4 with a Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launcher. Additionally, the chassis has been upgraded with Endo Steel, the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous, and CASE has been added to protect the ammunition.
column2: COM-5S 于 3050 年推出，是首款采用星盟科技的突击队。其新的独眼巨人 MultiTasker 10 瞄准系统将 Artemis IV 火控系统与考文垂 90 毫米 SRM-6（取代香农六发左轮）联动，并将 SRM-4 换成考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器。此外底盘升级为内骨骼，装甲升级为铁纤维，并加装 C.A.S.E. 保护弹药。

column1: This update of the COM-5S introduced in 3059 is also built on an Endo Steel chassis but uses a new Light Fusion engine. The 'Mech carries two Streak SRM-2 launchers, an SRM-4 with an Artemis IV Fire Control System, and an ER Medium Laser in each arm
column2: 3059 年推出的这款 COM-5S 更新版同样建立在内骨骼底盘上，但采用新的轻型聚变引擎。机甲携带两具连续 SRM-2 发射器、一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4，每臂各一门 ER 中型激光

column1: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
column2: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

column1: Copperhead
column2: 铜头蛇

column1: First produced in late fall of 3054, the Copperhead is a finely honed arena 'Mech. The design rose to fame when Silver Dragons Stables MechWarrior Brendon Frazer piloted his Copperhead, the Silver Snake, into the Solaris Top Twenty prior to his untimely death. The Silver Dragons commissioned Solaris Arms to develop a new exclusive variant to try and repeat the feat, but the new model's expensive experimental weaponry forced them to allow sales to other interested parties. The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery snapped up a number of the original CPR-HD-002 models. While not increasing the original model's meager four and half tons of armor coverage, Solaris Arms chose to replace the original Durallex plating with ArcShield Reflective Armor to enhance its endurance against the large volume of energy weapons carried by Arena 'Mechs. Already a relatively speedy design, the addition of a Supercharger enhanced its ground speed. Its extremely short jumping distance was neither improved nor removed; instead it was retained to expand a pilot's options in tight terrain. An extra Double Heat Sink, bringing the total to thirteen, is still not enough to keep up with the increased heat produced by the CPR-HD-003's advanced laser weaponry. Allowing the designers to squeeze in the new systems, a cramped Small Cockpit is used, which is less of a liability in the short duration arena battles than on an actual battlefield.
column2: 铜斑蛇于 3054 年深秋首次生产，是一台精炼的竞技场机甲。当银龙马疚的机甲战士布伦登·弗雷泽驾驶他的铜斑蛇"银蛇"齐身索拉里斯前二十名后，这一设计声名大噪——随后他不幸身亡。银龙委托索拉里斯兵工厂开发一款新的独家变体以图重现这一壮举，但新型号昂贵的实验性武器迫使他们允许向其他有意方销售。德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队迅速抢购了若干原版 CPR-HD-002 型号。索拉里斯兵工厂并未增加原型那可怜的四吨半装甲覆盖，而是选择把原有的杜拉莱克斯装甲板换成"弧盾"反射装甲，以增强其对竞技场机甲所携带大量能量武器的耐久力。这本来就已是相对高速的设计，加装增压器后地面速度进一步提升。它极短的跳跃距离既未改进也未取消，而是保留下来以拓展飞行员在狭窄地形中的选择。增加一台双倍散热器使总数达到十三台，仍不足以应对 CPR-HD-003 先进激光武器产生的更高热量。为让设计者塞进这些新系统，采用了狭窄的小型驾驶舱——在短时的竞技场战斗中，这比在真实战场上危害更小。

column1: The original model lacked the CPR-HD-003's supercharger and small cockpit. Instead of the Reflective armor, it was fitted with Ferro-Fibrous armor and carried only twelve heat sinks. The weapons loadout consisted of four Medium Lasers, a Small Pulse Laser, a standard SRM-4, and a one-shot Streak SRM-2.
column2: 原版型号没有 CPR-HD-003 的增压器和小型驾驶舱。它没有采用反射装甲，而是装铁纤维装甲，仅携带十二台散热器。武器载荷包括四门中型激光、一门小型脉冲激光、一具标准 SRM-4 和一具一次性连续 SRM-2。

column1: Corsair
column2: 海盗

column1: While Corsair is supposedly a generic Periphery term referring to heavy and assault class FrankenMechs cobbled together out of desperation as the Succession War era dragged on, with no specific weight or base chassis, the most successful of these are ninety-five ton brutes modeled in a generally similar style, usually marked with a COR designation. Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair's primary weapons are an AC/10 and LRM-15 mounted in its right torso, supported by a trio of Medium Lasers split between its left and center torsos and a SRM-6 and Large Laser mounted in its vestigial left arm.
column2: 虽然"海盗船"据称是外围区的泛称，指继承战争时代拖长过程中因绝望而拼凑起来的重型与突击级"科学怪机"，没有特定重量或基础底盘，但其中最成功的那些是九十五吨的猛兽，造型大体相似，通常标以 COR 编号。海盗船装备五花八门的武器，主武器为装在右躯干的一门 AC/10 和一具 LRM-15，辅以分置左、中躯干的三门中型激光，以及装在退化左臂上的一具 SRM-6 和一门大型激光。

column1: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works. I guess we should be grateful that it works at all.
column2: 老大，这到底是什么玩意儿？我向来乐意接受挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗版的死亡陷阱。不知怎的它居然能用，但我说不清为什么或怎么用的。我想我们该庆幸它至少还能用。

column1: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility.
column2: 本质上它仍是典型的外围区拼装机甲，但它得到了"她"的主人——以一位臭名昭著的泰拉海盗女王命名——的精心照料。这款特定设计装备一门重锤火炮与巴里摩尔弹药公司的弹药，赋予其卓越的战术灵活性。
