column2: 奥马利的复仇

column1: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility
column2: 本质上这仍是一台典型的外围区"科学怪机"，但它得到了"她"主人的悉心照料——这台机甲以一位臭名昭著的泰拉海盗女王命名。这款特定设计装有一门重锤火炮和巴里摩尔弹药公司出品的弹药，赋予其卓越的战术灵活性

column1: Cossack
column2: 哥萨克

column1: The Cossack is named after the mercenary unit Khorsakov's Cossacks in honor of their faithful service to the St Ives Compact. The Cossack is a practice in compromise. Originally requested as the fastest 'Mech that Ceres Metals Industries could produce, the emphasis of the design changed throughout its development to a slow moving, heavily armored light 'Mech. The final design that was accepted became the current incarnation of the Cossack. The Cossack is built on a Taijian Series X Endo Steel chassis to save weight. More weight was cut from the design by using a lightweight Hermes 120 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Six Pitban LFT-65 jump jets allow the Cossack to jump up to hundred and eighty meters, allowing the 'Mech to easily handle most rough terrain. For protection, the Cossack has three tons of armor and has ten heat sinks to handle the heat produced by the weapons payload carried by the 'Mech. Overall, the compromise that created the Cossack has turned it into a light trooper 'Mech that works well as part of a team but alone excels at no one role.
column2: 哥萨克以佣兵部队霍尔萨科夫的哥萨克命名，以表彰他们对圣艾夫斯共同体的忠诚服役。哥萨克是妥协的实践。它最初被要求成为塞雷斯金属工业所能生产的最快机甲，但在开发过程中设计重心转变为一款缓慢、重装甲的轻型机甲。最终被采纳的设计成为哥萨克现在的模样。哥萨克基于"太极 X 系列"内骨骼底盘建造以减轻重量。设计还通过使用轻量化的赫尔墨斯 120 XL 引擎进一步减重，赋予机甲 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度。六个皮特班 LFT-65 跳跃推进器使哥萨克能跳起至一百八十米，使机甲能轻松应对大多数崎岖地形。防护方面，哥萨克有三吨装甲和十台散热器，以处理机甲武器载荷产生的热量。总体而言，造就哥萨克的妥协把它变成了一款轻型通用机甲，作为团队成员表现良好，但单独行动时在任何角色上都不出众。

column1: The primary weapons on the Cossack are a Kajuka Type 2 Bright Blossom Medium Laser and a MilDouglas Duke SRM-6. These are backed up by a pair of Jackson Model 12 Small Lasers. While this is not an impressive arsenal, the Cossack is capable of defending itself from most light 'Mechs and vehicles.
column2: 哥萨克的主武器是一门"卡尤卡 2 型亮花"中型激光和一具"米尔道格拉斯公爵"SRM-6。它们由一对"杰克逊 12 型"小型激光支援。虽然这算不上出色的武器库，哥萨克仍有能力抵御大多数轻型机甲与车辆。

column1: Cougar
column2: 美洲狮

column1: Cronus
column2: 克洛诺斯

column1: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
column2: 克洛诺斯由安格斯·吉尔摩设计，旨在为佣兵和小型外围区单位提供一款使用报废军用装备、成本效益高的机甲。第三次继承战争中从自由世界联盟军队退役后，吉尔摩和他招募的许多前技师开始在其母星塔利莎为家族企业吉尔摩军工工作。虽然吉尔摩军工大部分时间用于重建/修复报废装备，有余力的技师们小批量地制造克洛诺斯。作为一款廉价的手工打造设计，克洛诺斯融合了现代战场上多种 55 吨战斗机甲的设计特点。

column1: Skirmisher
column2: 伏击手

column1: An older variant of the Cronus, the 3M uses all standard technologies that have been available to the Inner Sphere in 3031. As its primary weapon, the 3M has a Large Laser which is backed up by three Medium Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher. The 3M is slightly slower than the 5M, with a top speed of 86.4 km/h and it carries a price tag of 4,896,656 C-Bills, which is less than the 5M by of 7,754,522.
column2: 3M 是克洛诺斯的较老变体，使用 3031 年内天体可获得的全套标准技术。作为主武器，3M 有一门大型激光，辅以三门中型激光和一具 SRM-4 发射器。3M 比 5M 略慢，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，售价 4,896,656 C 币，比 5M 便宜 7,754,522。

column1: The upgraded Cronus is built on a lightweight Earthwerk SHD II Endo Steel chassis that carries a VOX 330 XL engine, providing a top speed of 97.2 km/h. The Cronus has enhanced mobility with six Northrup 12000 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. It is protected with ten and a half tons of Maximillian 43 armor, with CASE. The Cronus is able to handle the heat from its weapons with fourteen double heat sinks and is fitted with a C3 slave unit, allowing it to be integrated into a C3 unit. The Cronus has a Magna Sunspot ER PPC as its primary long ranged weapon. The ER PPC is capable of delivering consistent damage at all of its range brackets. For close combat, the Cronus has two Diverse Optics Type ER Medium Lasers and a single Diverse Optics Type ER Small Laser. Finally, to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor, the Cronus carries a Harpoon-4S Streak SRM-4.
column2: 升级版克洛诺斯基于轻量化的"地球工厂 SHD II"内骨骼底盘建造，搭载一台 VOX 330 XL 引擎，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时。克洛诺斯有六个"诺斯罗普 12000"跳跃推进器增强机动性，使机甲能跳起至一百八十米。它由十吨半"马克西米利安 43"装甲保护，并配 C.A.S.E.。克洛诺斯能用十四台双倍散热器处理武器热量，并装有 C3 从属单元，可被整合进 C3 单位。克洛诺斯以一门"玛格纳太阳黑子"ER PPC 为主要远程武器。这门 ER PPC 能在其所有射程段稳定输出伤害。近战方面，克洛诺斯有两门"多元光学 ER 型"中型激光和一门"多元光学 ER 型"小型激光。最后，为搜寻敌方装甲上的弱点，克洛诺斯携带一具"鱼叉-4S"连续 SRM-4。

column1: Crusader
column2: 十字军

column1: Introduced in 2596, this variant was originally produced for the SLDF during the Reunification War. It upgraded the heat sinks to double heat sinks and utilized an Endo Steel internal structure to save mass. All of the ammunition is located in the side torsos and protected by CASE.
column2: 此变体于 2596 年推出，最初在统一战争期间为星盟防卫军生产。它把散热器升级为双倍散热器，并采用内骨骼内部结构以节省质量。全部弹药都位于两侧躯干并由 C.A.S.E. 保护。

column1: The Crusader received its baptism of fire during the Reunification War and remained a common fixture in the regiments of the SLDF for many centuries.
column2: 十字军在统一战争中接受了战火洗礼，并在许多世纪里一直是星盟防卫军各团的常见装备。

column1: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multi-role design.
column2: 十字军最初为星盟防卫军设计为近战战斗机甲，但很快证明自己是一款适应性极强的多用途设计。

column1: This Mech was built with an advanced Prototype Fire control System.
column2: 此机甲配备了先进的原型火控系统。

column1: The 3D variant of the Crusader is a simple modification to make the 'Mech's heat load more manageable. Introduced in 2756 and used mostly by House Davion, the two SRM-6 launchers were replaced with two SRM-4 launchers and the machine guns were removed so that the number of heat sinks could be increased by four.
column2: 十字军 3D 变体是一次简单改装，旨在让机甲的热负荷更易管理。它于 2756 年推出，主要供达维昂家族使用，将两具 SRM-6 发射器换成两具 SRM-4，并移除机枪，以便把散热器数量增加四台。

column1: The 4D variant of the Crusader was a common field modification kit, utilizing Star League technology recovered from the Helm Memory Core, used by both Davion and Liao forces starting in 3049. This variant has had the medium lasers and the SRM-6 launchers removed and in their place has two Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers mounted.
column2: 十字军 4D 变体是常见的野战改装套件，采用从赫尔姆记忆核心找回的星盟技术，自 3049 年起为达维昂与廖势力双方使用。此变体移除了中型激光和 SRM-6 发射器，在原位安装了两具连续 SRM-2 发射器和两门中型脉冲激光。

column1: The 4D variant of the Crusader was a common field modification kit, utilizing Star League technology recovered from the Helm Memory Core.
column2: 十字军 4D 变体是常见的野战改装套件，采用从赫尔姆记忆核心找回的星盟技术。

column1: The 5M was the official production-model upgraded variant of the Crusader for the Free Worlds League, introduced in 3049 and using recovered Star League technology. Though using the same Crucis-B chassis as before the 'Mech was powered by a Hermes 260 XL Engine and carried thirteen double heat sinks to vent its heat more efficiently.
column2: 5M 是自由世界联盟十字军的官方量产升级变体，于 3049 年推出，采用重新找回的星盟技术。虽然仍使用与先前相同的"十字-B"底盘，机甲改由赫尔墨斯 260 XL 引擎驱动，并携带十三台双倍散热器以更高效地排热。

column1: Daboku
column2: 打木

column1: Equiped with 4 Imperator Smoothie AC/2s, 2 Holly LRM-10 Launchers and 2 Large Lasers this 'Mech was nothing more than a laughingstock when it was first released. It served as the basis for the more successful Mauler
column2: 装备 4 门"帝皇奶昔"AC/2、2 具"冬青"LRM-10 发射器和 2 门大型激光，这台机甲首次发布时不过是个笑柄。它成为后来更成功的重击者的基础

column1: Daimyo
column2: 大名

column1: The Daimyo is named for the title used for warlords from the medieval Japanese empire. The 'Mech, first produced in 3053, attempts to live up to the heritage of its name admirably. It is armed primarily for long range combat but can hold its own if the situation warrants it. The Daimyo's maximum speed of 86.4 kph and its Nissan 200 fusion engine make the Daimyo a rugged 'Mech that can survive an amazing amount of damage, while bringing the fight to the enemy.
column2: 大名之名取自中世纪日本帝国对军阀的称号。该机甲于 3053 年首次生产，竭力不负其名的传承。它以远程战斗为主要武装，但必要时也能自保。大名 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度与日产 200 聚变引擎，使它成为一款坚固的机甲，能承受惊人的损伤并将战斗带到敌人面前。

column1: The primary long range weapon on the Daimyo is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC, which allows the 'Mech to strike at an enemy from extreme ranges. Once the 'Mech closes with its enemy, it is able to bring its close range arsenal to bear. This consists of two Victory 23R Medium Lasers, which are backed up by a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 missile launcher.
column2: 大名的主要远程武器是一门"主之光 2"ER PPC，使机甲能从极远距离打击敌人。一旦机甲接近敌人，它便能动用其近程武器库。这包括两门"胜利 23R"中型激光，由一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 导弹发射器支援。

column1: An attempt to make the Daimyo a cooler running 'Mech, the 2K variant removes the ER PPC and replaces it with an ER Large Laser and a double heat sink. While this does give the Daimyo a better heat profile, it also shortens the distance at which the Daimyo can strike an enemy.
column2: 2K 变体试图让大名成为一台更凉的机甲，它移除 ER PPC，换成一门 ER 大型激光和一台双倍散热器。这确实改善了大名的热量曲线，但也缩短了大名打击敌人的距离。

column1: The 4K variant of the Daimyo is also an attempt to modify the 'Mech to make it more heat efficient. This variant accomplishes this by removing the SRM-6 launcher and replacing it with an additional Medium Laser. The saved weight is used to add four more double heat sinks, making the Daimyos heat curve much more manageable.
column2: 大名 4K 变体同样是为了让机甲更散热而进行的改装。此变体通过移除 SRM-6 发射器并换成一门额外中型激光来实现。节省的重量用于加装四台更多双倍散热器，使大名的热量曲线好驾驭得多。

column1: Dart
column2: 飞镖

column1: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 kph and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently.
column2: 飞镖诞生于联邦联邦寻找不依赖弹药的机甲之时。它以全能量武器配置建立在极高速底盘上。机甲速度可达 151 公里/小时，并有三吨半装甲。虽然武器轻，飞镖却是出色的侦察机甲，在游击队中也很管用——能量武器让它能独立作战。

column1: The Dart is armed with three Magna 200P Small Pulse Lasers which do not have a long range but provide the Dart with highly accurate short range firepower.
column2: 飞镖装备三门"玛格纳 200P"小型脉冲激光，射程不长，但为飞镖提供极为精准的近程火力。

column1: The 4S modifies the Dart in an attempt to add much needed firepower to the design without sacrificing the 'Mechs independence from ammunition. This is done by removing the three Small Pulse Lasers and replacing them with three Medium Lasers. While this reduces the 'Mech's accuracy, the range and damage profiles are both increased over the 3S model.
column2: 4S 对飞镖进行改装，试图在不牺牲机甲弹药独立性的情况下为其增加急需的火力。它移除三门小型脉冲激光，换成三门中型激光。虽然这降低了机甲的精度，但相比 3S 型号，射程与伤害都得到提升。

column1: The 6S variant of the Dart increases both its firepower and armor protection. The 'Mech carries four and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 'Mech is armed with two Medium Lasers. Even with one less Medium Laser than the 4S model, the 6S brings more overall firepower to the field than the 3S.
column2: 飞镖 6S 变体同时提升了火力与装甲防护。机甲携带四吨半铁纤维装甲。机甲装备两门中型激光。即便比 4S 型号少一门中型激光，6S 带来的战场总火力仍高于 3S。

column1: Dervish
column2: 苦行僧

column1: This Star League era variant uses an XL Engine, twelve single heat sinks, and upgrades the LRM-10s to LRM-15s. Three tons of ammunition are in a CASE protected torso bin.
column2: 此星盟时代变体使用 XL 引擎、十二台单散热器，并将 LRM-10 升级为 LRM-15。三吨弹药存于有 C.A.S.E. 保护的躯干弹药箱中。

column1: The 7D Dervish is a 3047 upgrade of the design using Star League technology. The 'Mech is built with an Endo Steel chassis and also uses eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE for protection against ammunition explosions. With the saved weight, the SRM-2s have been upgraded to Federated SuperStreak SRMs and the 'Mech uses double heat sinks. This variant was first produced by Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon.
column2: 7D 苦行僧是 3047 年使用星盟技术对该设计的升级。机甲采用内骨骼底盘建造，并使用八吨铁纤维装甲及 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。凭借节省的重量，SRM-2 升级为联邦超级连续 SRM，机甲也改用双倍散热器。此变体最初由新阿瓦隆上的阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司生产。

column1: The 7P is a Medium Range Missile Boat, carrying an MRM-20 and MRM-10 in each arm, supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and side torso. Such a heavy loadout while retaining the Dervish's usual seven and half tons of armor and five jump jets is made possible with an 275 rated extralight engine and Endo Steel frame. The 7P is fitted with ten double heat sinks and carries a combined four tons of MRM reloads.
column2: 7P 是一款中程导弹平台，每臂携带一具 MRM-20 和 MRM-10，由每臂及每侧躯干各一门中型激光支援。在保留苦行僧惯常的七吨半装甲和五个跳跃推进器的同时实现如此沉重的载荷，要归功于一台 275 额定超轻型引擎和内骨骼框架。7P 装有十台双倍散热器，并携带共四吨 MRM 再装填。

column1: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
column2: 苦行僧 IIC 是星盟时代苦行僧的 55 吨氏族改装版，于 3058 年首次出现在烟虎氏族与德拉科尼斯联合体接壤的前线。它的移动与跳跃能力与原版苦行僧相似，但火力显著更强。

column1: DireStar DS-Prime
column2: 恐星 DS-原装型

column1: DireStar
column2: 恐星

column1: OmniMech
column2: 万能机甲

column1: This Direwolf Commander is a piece of work by a nutcase clanner and I have seen many weird stuff. The madman or whoever designed this, must have been clearly out of his mind. Sacrificing everything for pure firepower this mech mounts 11 clan ERPPCs, that will instantly shut down your mech, if you try to alpha strike as well bringing lot of pain to the target. If the mech doesn't get destroyed while being shutdown it will definitely blow up by all the excess heat by firing all those PPCs.
column2: 这台"恐狼指挥官"是某个疯子氏族人的杰作，而我已经见过很多古怪的东西。这个疯子——或不管是谁设计的——显然完全失去了理智。为了纯粹的火力牺牲一切，这台机甲装了 11 门氏族 ER PPC，如果你试图齐射，它会立刻让你的机甲停机，同时给目标带来巨大痛苦。如果机甲在停机状态下没被摧毁，它也会因发射所有这些 PPC 产生的过量热量而爆炸。

column1: Dire Wolf DW-A
column2: 恐狼 DW-A

column1: Dire Wolf DW-B
column2: 恐狼 DW-B

column1: Dire Wolf DW-C
column2: 恐狼 DW-C

column1: Dire Wolf DW-PRIME
column2: 恐狼 DW-原装型

column1: The DRG-1C uses an AC2 instead of the more standard AC5.  This allows it to have extreme reach across the battlefield, but at a reduced damage rate.
column2: DRG-1C 使用一门 AC2 取代更标准的 AC5。这使它能在战场上拥有极远射程，但伤害率降低。

column1: I always had a soft spot for the DRG, it was one of the 'Mechs I first trained on.  Though it is a little bittersweet, as a hiccup in the controls caused me to lose my right foot.
column2: 我一直对 DRG 情有独钟，那是我最初受训时用的机甲之一。不过这有点苦乐参半，因为控制装置的一次故障让我失去了右脚。

column1: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets.
column2: 大龙 1N 是一台结实的机器，能承受重击，但武器略显单薄。不过它作为重型机甲移动很快，这使它非常适合逼近较慢的目标进行近战。

column1: The Dragon 1R is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating, mounting twin Inferno SRMs to complement its CQC capabilities.
column2: 大龙 1R 是一台结实的机器，能承受重击，装备双联燃烧弹 SRM 以补充其近距近战能力。

column1: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
column2: 黑玉美洲豹曾由烟虎氏族大量装备，如今已扩散至克伦斯基的众多氏族，不过狼、翡翠猎鹰与郊狼等氏族仍继续装备地狱使者。

column1: Long Range Fire Support
column2: 远程火力支援

column1: Elemental
column2: 元素战士

column1: Emperor
column2: 皇帝

column1: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
column2: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。

column1: Enfield
column2: 恩菲尔德

column1: The Enfield was originally designed to replace the Wyvern as an urban combat 'Mech, but the design never made it to mass production. The plans for the Enfield were lost during the Succession Wars and were recovered by the Federated Suns on the world of Achernar in 2870. Knowledge of the design was kept hidden until the 3050s, when the NAIS selected the Enfield as a companion 'Mech to the Enforcer. The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat.
column2: 恩菲尔德最初旨在取代双足飞龙成为城市战斗机甲，但从未进入量产。其图纸在继承战争中遗失，2870 年由联邦太阳系在阿克尔纳星上寻回。该设计的知识一直被保密到 3050 年代，NAIS 选定恩菲尔德作为执法者的搭档机甲。恩菲尔德于 3055 年开始生产，因氏族的持续威胁而在莱兰联盟大量部署。机甲携带十一吨星卫 III 装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。恩菲尔德建立在黑石 MD2E 内骨骼底盘上，使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，以节省重量从而搭载重型武器库。然而由于使用超轻型引擎，它在激烈战斗中落下了"脆弱"的冤枉名声。

column1: The 6J variant of the Enfield removes the Small Laser from the 'Mech and exchanges the Large Pulse Laser for a Large Laser. The saved weight is used to add five jump jets, allowing the Enfield to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant of the Enfield is very reliable, and although it loses some firepower and accuracy in the Large Laser, the addition of the jump jets gives it a high degree of mobility and survivability.
column2: 英菲尔德的 6J 变体移除机甲上的小型激光，并把大型脉冲激光换成大型激光。节省的重量用于加装五个跳跃推进器，使英菲尔德能跳起至一百五十米。英菲尔德此变体非常可靠，虽然大型激光损失了一些火力与精度，但跳跃推进器的加入赋予它高度机动性与生存性。

column1: The Enfield carries a Defiance Disintegrator LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon. This weapon can fire both solid and cluster ammunition, making it a highly effective anti-aircraft weapon. For close combat, the Enfield has a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser, two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers, and a ChisComp 32 Small Laser.
column2: 英菲尔德以一门"迪法恩斯粉碎者"LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器。该武器可发射实心弹与集束弹，使它成为极为有效的防空武器。近战方面，英菲尔德有一门"雷霆-12"大型脉冲激光、两门"迪法恩斯 B3M"中型激光和一门 ChisComp 32 小型激光。

column1: Enforcer
column2: 执法者

column1: The precursor to the Enforcer 4R, the 3R models originally mounted twin Medium Lasers in the left arm along with 2 extra Heat Sinks to help the 'Mech dissipate heat.  It was also slightly better protected, as it had an additional ton of armor.
column2: 作为执法者 4R 的前身，3R 型号最初在左臂装双联中型激光，并配 2 台额外散热器帮助机甲散热。它的防护也略好，因为多了一吨装甲。

column1: The old 3R didn't see much action, as it was quickly supplanted by the 4R model.  But, I don't think it is all that bad, especially in a close in or city fight situation.  Though I think most pilots will miss the extra long distance punch of the Large Laser.
column2: 老式 3R 服役时间不长，很快就被 4R 型号取代。不过我觉得它并不那么差，尤其在近距或城市战情境中。只是我想大多数飞行员会怀念大型激光那份额外的远距离打击力。

column1: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets, a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat.
column2: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮与巨型激光的沉重威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来，是致命的组合。它能在中远距离一直到抵近射击的交战，这些机甲在战斗中灵活而令人意外。

column1: First walking off the production line in late 3050, the 5D Enforcer is a major upgrade to the standard 'Mech, meeting many of its pilots' desire for something faster, better-protected and with more endurance. The Nissan 200 engine has been removed and replaced with a Magna 250 Extralight Engine, increasing the Enforcer's top speed to 86.4 km/h and the amount of space available for other additions. The armor has been stripped from the 'Mech and replaced with StarGuard CIV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion while the weapons payload has also been changed. Retaining the small laser both the Autocannon/10 and the Large Laser were replaced for a new Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, fed by two tons of ammunition, and a BlazeFire Sweetshot ER Large Laser. Finally, an additional jump jet was added, increasing the jumping distance by thirty meters to keep up with the Enforcer's new speed profile.
column2: 5D 执法者于 3050 年末首次下线，是标准机甲的重大升级，满足了许多飞行员对更快、防护更好、续航更久的需求。日产 200 引擎被移除，换成玛格纳 250 超轻型引擎，将执法者最高速度提升至 86.4 公里/小时，并腾出更多空间用于其他加装。装甲被剥离，改为星卫 CIV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸，武器配置也作了更改。保留小型激光的同时，自动炮/10 和大型激光换成一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10（由两吨弹药供弹）和一门烈焰"甜射"ER 大型激光。最后加装一个跳跃推进器，使跳跃距离增加三十米，以跟上执法者新的速度曲线。

column1: Executioner EXE-A
column2: 行刑者 EXE-A

column1: Executioner
column2: 行刑者

column1: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
column2: 与主型号相比，行刑者 A 缩短了总体交战距离：它去掉高斯步枪，换成一大批大型脉冲激光，辅以四门 ER 中型激光。此变体是外面所有轻型机甲的噩梦。

column1: Lumbering Pain Machine
column2: 笨重痛苦机器

column1: Executioner EXE-B
column2: 行刑者 EXE-B

column1: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
column2: 样样通吃的变体。行刑者 B 被设定为在战场能提供的所有射程上都有效。极端与远程有 ER PPC，较近射程则有绝对毁灭性的 UAC/20，B 以蛮力处决它的敌人。先进瞄准系统确保无处可逃……无处可藏。

column1: Executioner EXE-C
column2: 行刑者 EXE-C

column1: Sometimes you just need to lob some missiles at them. The Executioner C trades direct hit firepower of its sister variants for a set of Artemis IV guided Long Range Missiles. But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.
column2: 有时你就是需要朝他们甩几发导弹。行刑者 C 以一套 Artemis IV 制导远程导弹取代其姊妹变体的直击火力。但要提醒所有以为能偷偷接近这头怪物的人：它仍然以 UAC/20 的形式保留着庞大的近距离打击力。

column1: Executioner EXE-D
column2: 行刑者 EXE-D

column1: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
column2: 快速、精准、致命。行刑者 D(isco) 利用其惊人的敏捷逼近敌人……只为以各种颜色和尺寸的脉冲激光向它们倾泻地狱之火。LPL、MPL、SPL……你点得出来的，EXE-D 都有。不过警告飞行员们：最好带上冰镇饮料，因为这玩意儿热得发烫！

column1: Executioner EXE-E
column2: 行刑者 EXE-E

column1: In a logical step up from other, earlier variants the Executioner E sticks with the idea of being effective and deadly at all ranges. ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.
column2: 行刑者 E 是对其他早期变体的合理升级，坚持在所有距离上都有效而致命。ER 大型激光和 ATM 将在远距离与中距离提供巨量火力，而一批重型中型激光和重型小型激光将提供近距离环形防御…或者用于给已受损对手补上那一点额外伤害。

column1: Executioner EXE-PRIME
column2: 行刑者 EXE-原装型

column1: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
column2: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

column1: Exterminator
column2: 灭绝者

column1: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. Advanced systems allowed it to easily infiltrate enemy lines. Once the Exterminator had breached the enemy's rear, its mission was to find and destroy as much of the enemy's command structure as possible. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units.
column2: 灭绝者在 2630 年设计，用途最可疑却也最必要：猎杀指挥官。先进系统使它易于渗透敌线。一旦突入敌后，灭绝者的任务就是尽可能多地寻找并摧毁敌方指挥体系，包括攻击机动指挥部、野战基地和指挥级军官。灭绝者不编入标准编制，而是配属团级或更高指挥部，往往是指挥连的第五名成员，然后才被分配至具体单位。

column1: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. The 4Db was the most guarded secret of the SLDF, combining even more advanced Electronics with a Chameleon Light Polarization shield, giving it unparalleled stealth capabilities.
column2: 灭绝者是 2630 年为最可疑却必要的用途——猎头——而设计的战斗机甲。4Db 是星盟防卫军保守最严的秘密，它把更先进的电子设备与"变色龙光偏振护盾"结合，赋予其无与伦比的隐身能力。

column1: Falcon
column2: 猎鹰

column1: Originally developed as an anti-infantry and Bug Hunter 'Mech, the Falcon is a highly popular light recon and skirmisher 'Mech. Initially created for the newly formed Star League Defense Force's use in the Reunification War, the popular design remained in production until the destruction of Stormvanger's Hesperus II Falcon line during the Third Battle of Hesperus II in 2789, becoming all but extinct until the arrival of Wolf's Dragoonsin 3005. Well regarded by the mercenaries, the Dragoons upgraded their dwindling number of Falcons in the early 3050s before eventually commissioning Blackwell Industries to restart production of the design in early 3060 to produce advanced Clan-tech versions for their exclusive use, as well as more mundane and affordable versions for the general mercenary market. While originally sporting a weapons array similar to the Locust, Stinger and Waspit was charged to defeat, the Falcon's six tons of StarGuard Type II armor provided it with vastly superior protection, allowing it to outlast them and remain combat effective longer. When it was originally developed, the 'Mech's top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters allowed it to keep up with other light recon 'Mechs. But by the 3060s the Falconwas outclassed by newer and faster designs, only its use of a cheaper standard Fusion Engine rather than a more expensive and fragile Light or XL Engine kept buyers interested.
column2: 猎鹰最初是作为反步兵与"猎虫者"机甲开发的，是一款极受欢迎的轻型侦察与游骑机甲。它最初为新成立的星盟防卫军用于统一战争而制造，这款广受欢迎的机型一直生产到 2789 年第三次赫斯佩鲁斯 II 战役中斯托姆万格的赫斯佩鲁斯 II 猎鹰生产线被毁，此后几乎灭绝，直到 3005 年狼之龙骑兵到来。这支佣兵团对它评价甚高，于 3050 年代初升级了日益减少的猎鹰，最终在 3060 年代初委托布莱克威尔工业重启生产，为其独家生产先进的氏族科技版本，也为普通佣兵市场提供更朴素实惠的版本。猎鹰原本的武器配置与其要击败的蝗虫、毒刺和黄蜂相似，但其六吨星卫 II 型装甲提供了远为优越的防护，使其能比对手更持久、更久地保持战斗力。初研制时，它 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百五十米的跳跃距离使其能跟上其他轻型侦察机甲。但到 3060 年代，猎鹰已被更新更快的设计超越，唯有其使用较便宜的标配聚变引擎而非更昂贵脆弱的轻型或 XL 引擎，才让买家保持兴趣。

column1: The original Falcon designed in 2582, the 4N model has a lighter arsenal more akin to 'Mechs 10 tons lighter. The primary weapon is a SunGlow Type 1 Medium Laser with two Omnicron 1000 Small Lasers as secondary weapons. To deter infantry attacks, the 'Mech carries two rear mounted Reginald Mark VI Machine Guns with a shared single ton of ammo. The 4N was equipped with a Garret T20C communications system and a Dynatec 150A targeting and tracking system.
column2: 4N 型号是 2582 年设计的原版猎鹰，武器较轻，更像轻 10 吨的机甲。主武器是一门"阳光 1 型"中型激光，次要武器为两门奥米克戎 1000 小型激光。为威慑步兵攻击，机甲携带两挺后向"雷金纳德 Mark VI"机枪，共用一吨弹药。4N 装备加勒特 T20C 通讯系统和 Dynatec 150A 瞄准追踪系统。

column1: Used by various Pentagon World factions during the Exodus Civil War, the PP variant replaced the advanced snub-nose particle cannon of the Royal Falcon with a standard PPC. The increased weight, however, required the removal of the medium laser mounted in the right arm.
column2: 出埃及内战期间被五角世界各派系使用，PP 变体以一门标准 PPC 取代皇家隼的先进短管粒子炮。不过增加的重量要求移除装在右臂的中型激光。

column1: Another Exodus Civil War era modification of the Royal Falcon, the PP2 replaced the snub-nose PPC with an ER Large Laser. The saved weight allowed the left arm laser to be upgraded with pulse technology.
column2: 作为出埃及内战时期皇家隼的又一改装，PP2 以一门 ER 大型激光取代短管 PPC。节省的重量使左臂激光得以升级为脉冲技术。

column1: Built for the Royal SLDF Divisions at the captured Roe Weapon Systemsplant on Apollo during the Amaris Civil War, the so-called Royal Falconcarried an experimental Parti-Kill Snub-Nose PPC backed up by two medium lasers. It was also equipped with double heat-sinks, and was built on a Duralyte 300 Endo-Steel chassis. All known examples and design specs were taken with the Exodus Fleet.
column2: 这款所谓的皇家隼在阿马里斯内战期间于阿波罗缴获的罗伊武器系统工厂为星盟防卫军皇家师建造，携带一门实验性"党杀"短管 PPC，辅以两门中型激光。它还装双倍散热器，基于"杜拉莱特 300"内骨骼底盘建造。所有已知样机与设计规格都随出埃及舰队一同离去。

column1: Originally developed as a field upgrade before becoming Blackwell's standard production model, the 4P Falcon carries a light arsenal that is primarily based around energy weapons. While the two Omnicron 1000 Small Lasers were retained, the original standard Medium Laser was swapped for a short-ranged but highly accurate Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser. Finally, for protection from missiles, the rear-facing machine guns were dropped for a forward facing Sure Fire 444 Anti-Missile System and a single ton of ammunition.
column2: 4P 猎鹰最初是作为野战升级开发的，后来成为布莱克韦尔的标准量产型号，它携带一套主要基于能量武器的轻型武器。它保留两门奥米克戎 1000 小型激光，但原有的标准中型激光被换成射程较短却极为精准的玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光。最后，为防御导弹，后向机枪被拆掉，换成一具前向"必火 444"反导系统和一吨弹药。

column1: Fireball
column2: 火球

column1: The Fireball was a quick response BattleMech built as a direct result of the Clans' Elemental infantry. As the Clans swept through the Inner Sphere, members of the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth met with scientists from the New Avalon Institute of Science to discuss, among other things, how to counter their new Battle Armored foes. The result was a 'Mech which on paper met many of the criteria for successfully dealing with Elementals: it had weapons with a high rate-of-fire for taking on swarms of Toads as they were known, had ammunition stores to maintain that rate for extended periods, and an extremely high speed so it could quickly come to the aid of heavier units. These Fireballs were given to units with prior experience fighting the Clans but assigned to rookie pilots, partly because the 'Mech's capabilities fit the personality of many of these new Mechwarriors, partly to more quickly build up their combat experience. The Crucis Lancers, Deneb Light Cavalry and Ceti Hussars were the first regiments to receive these 'Mechs in 3053, employing them immediately on the front lines as raiding along the border between the Inner Sphere and Occupation Zones commenced following the Truce of Tukayyid.
column2: 火球是为直接应对氏族元素步兵而建造的快速反应战斗机甲。当氏族席卷内天体时，联邦联邦武装部队成员与新阿瓦隆科学研究院的科学家会面，讨论如何对抗这些新的战斗装甲敌人等问题。成果是一款在纸面上满足成功应对元素战士多项标准的机甲：它拥有高射速武器以对付成群的"蟾蜍"，有足以长时间维持该射速的弹药储备，以及极高的速度以便迅速支援较重的单位。这些火球被分配给有对抗氏族经验但机师为新手的部队，部分原因是机甲的特性契合许多新机甲战士的性格，部分原因是为了更快积累他们的实战经验。克鲁西斯枪骑兵、德内布轻骑兵和塞提骠骑兵是 3053 年首批接收这些机甲的团，图卡伊德休战协定后内天体与占领区边境的袭扰战开始，它们立即被投入前线。

column1: The Fireball is built around a massive 5-ton DAV 220 extra light fusion engine, which propels the 'Mech to a cruising speed of 119 km/h and top speed of 184 km/h, allowing it to respond to a call from anywhere in the line for immediate support. The high speed of the Fireball comes at a price though, as the 'Mech only has four tons of armor protection and a very light weapons array. A Hovertec Streak SRM-2 serves as its primary weapon, giving it highly accurate short-range firepower. The launcher is mounted over the left shoulder along with one ton of reloads. The 'Mech is also armed with a LFN Lindblad Machine Gun for anti-infantry combat, carried over the right shoulder with one ton of ammunition. Aiming these weapons is the Corean B-Tech Targeting-Tracking System, a proven component chosen because of previous battlefield experience and because it was manufactured on New Avalon as well, cutting down on shipping time.
column2: 火球围绕一台巨大的 5 吨 DAV 220 超轻型聚变引擎建造，推动机甲达到 119 公里/小时的巡航速度和 184 公里/小时的最高速度，使其能响应战线任何地方的召唤立即支援。但火球的高速也带来代价，机甲只有四吨装甲防护和极轻的武器阵列。一具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 是其主武器，赋予它极为精准的近程火力。发射器装在左肩上方，配一吨再装填。机甲还装备一挺 LFN 林德布拉德机枪用于反步兵作战，位于右肩上方，配一吨弹药。为这些武器瞄准的是"科里安 B-Tech"瞄准追踪系统——这一经过验证的组件之所以被选中，既因为过往的实战经验，也因为它同样在新阿瓦隆制造，缩短了运输时间。

column1: The 8D variant of the Fireball released in 3054 was built with the hope of reducing the Fireballs ammunition dependence as well as increasing its firepower. This is done by removing the Streak launcher and replacing it with two Medium Lasers, vastly increasing the raw firepower of the Fireball. The 'Mech has also received an additional half ton of armor.
column2: 3054 年发布的火球 8D 变体，其建造初衷是降低火球对弹药的依赖并提升火力。它移除连续发射器，换成两门中型激光，大幅提升火球的原始火力。机甲还多获得半吨装甲。

column1: The 9D is a compromise between the 7D and 8D models. Released at the same time as the 8D, this variant removes the machine gun and its ammunition and replaces them with a single medium laser. The 'Mech retains its Streak launcher, but gains an additional half ton of armor protection.
column2: 9D 是 7D 与 8D 型号之间的折中。它与 8D 同期发布，移除机枪及其弹药，换成一门中型激光。机甲保留连续发射器，但获得额外半吨装甲防护。

column1: Firefly
column2: 萤火虫

column1: Firestarter
column2: 纵火者

column1: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage. Carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces.
column2: 就其吨位而言，火焰使者是危险的机甲。精心掌握时机用火焰喷射器发动攻击，可让任何机甲停机，任你的其他部队痛击。

column1: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage, carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces. The FS1-H is a prototype from the Age of War.
column2: 火焰使者就其吨位而言是危险的机甲，以火焰喷射器精心把握时机的攻击能让任何机甲停机，使其暴露在你其他部队的打击之下。FS1-H 是战锤时代的原型机。

column1: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage. Carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces. The FS1-H is a prototype from the Age of War.
column2: 火焰使者就其吨位而言是危险的机甲。以火焰喷射器精心把握时机的攻击能让任何机甲停机，使其暴露在你其他部队的打击之下。FS1-H 是战锤时代的原型机。

column1: The original Firestarter model, the FS9-A used Small Lasers instead of Machine Guns and mounted an extra ton of armor.  This caused some heat issues and led to the development of the more familiar FS9-H, with its Machine Guns.
column2: 原版火焰使者型号 FS9-A 以小型激光取代机枪，并多装一吨装甲。这造成了一些散热问题，并促成了我们所熟悉的、带机枪的 FS9-H 的诞生。

column1: Don't see many of these older models around these days.  Seems to me that the extra ton should have been used on a Heat Sink instead of armor - I can get the crew on that for you now if you want.
column2: 如今这些较老型号不多见了。在我看来，多出的那一吨应该用在散热器而不是装甲上——如果你愿意，我现在就能让伙计们去改。

column1: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage, carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces. The FS9-H also makes a decent light 'Mech hunter-killer.
column2: 火焰使者就其吨位而言是危险的机甲，以火焰喷射器精心把握时机的攻击能让任何机甲停机，使其暴露在你其他部队的打击之下。FS9-H 也是出色的轻型机甲猎杀者。

column1: Originally designed as a companion model for the Firestarter FS9-H, the FS9-K has proved popular in its own right with the Large Laser giving the FS9-K the reach that its companion lacked.
column2: FS9-K 最初设计为火焰使者 FS9-H 的搭档型号，如今已凭自身实力广受欢迎——大型激光赋予 FS9-K 其搭档所缺乏的射程。

column1: Nicknamed the Mirage, the FS9-M was a late Succession Wars attempt to turn the Firestarter into a frontline 'Mech by swapping out the Flamers for Small Lasers, adding a Heat Sink and adding armor.
column2: FS9-M 绰号"幻影"，是继承战争晚期把火焰使者改造成前线机甲的尝试：它以小型激光替换火焰喷射器，加装一台散热器并增加装甲。

column1: Not a bad conversion of the original, with the increased firepower and armor allowing it to act as a Scout Hunter.  You really don't see many of these around, guess that is why they are called the Mirage.
column2: 原版的改装相当不错，增加的火力与装甲使它成为侦察猎手。你真的很少见到这种机甲，我想这就是它被称为"幻影"的原因。

column1: The FS9-S is an overhaul of the FS9-H introduced in 3049. The structure has been upgraded to use an Endo Steel chassis. The weapons carried are four flamers, two medium lasers, and a single small laser. An Anti-Missile System with one ton of ammo has been added to protect against missile attacks, and a Beagle Active Probe has been installed to enhance the Firestarter's scouting role.
column2: FS9-S 是 3049 年推出的 FS9-H 全面翻修版。结构升级为内骨骼底盘。武器为四具火焰喷射器、两门中型激光和一门小型激光。加装一套反导系统（配一吨弹药）以防导弹攻击，并安装比格犬主动探测器以增强火焰使者的侦察作用。

column1: The FS9-S1 is an overhaul of the FS9-H introduced in 3049. The structure has been upgraded to use an Endo Steel chassis. The weapons carried are four flamers, two medium lasers, and a single small laser. An Anti-Missile System with one ton of ammo has been added to protect against missile attacks, and a Guardian ECM suite has been installed to increase survivability.
column2: FS9-S1 是 3049 年推出的 FS9-H 全面翻修版。结构升级为内骨骼底盘。武器为四具火焰喷射器、两门中型激光和一门小型激光。加装一套反导系统（配一吨弹药）以防导弹攻击，并安装守护者 ECM 套件以提升生存性。

column1: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage, carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces. The FS9-T is designed to operate without supply lines.
column2: 就其吨位而言，火焰使者是危险的机甲，精心掌握时机用火焰喷射器发动攻击，可让任何机甲停机，任你的其他部队痛击。FS9-T 则设计为无需补给线即可作战。

column1: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
column2: 全面型火焰使者最终克服了诞生时的政治波折，被证明是一款高效灵活的设计，联合体用它替代了凤凰鹰等老化的中量级主力机甲

column1: The Firestarter A carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/10 that allows the 'Mech to work in an anti-aircraft or vehicle hunting role. As a secondary weapon in the A configuration, the 'Mech carries a Small Laser and retains two Flamers for anti-personnel combat.
column2: 火焰使者 A 以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器，使机甲能担任防空或猎杀车辆的角色。作为 A 配置的次要武器，机甲携带一门小型激光并保留两具火焰喷射器用于反人员作战。

column1: Configured as a close combat and spotting 'Mech, the Firestarter B carries, as its primary weapon, a Large Pulse Laser, which is backed up by a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Laser. The 'Mech also carries two Flamers to deter infantry attacks and also allow the 'Mech to start fires for cover. The centerpiece of the B configuration is its electronics package, which consists of a TAG spotting laser for directing artillery fire and a C3 Slave unit that allows the Firestarter to share targeting data with allied units.
column2: 火焰使者 B 配置为近战与目标指示机甲，以一门大型脉冲激光为主武器，辅以两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。机甲还携带两具火焰喷射器以威慑步兵攻击，也能让机甲点火制造掩护。B 配置的核心是其电子设备包，包括一具用于引导炮火的 TAG 指示激光和一台使火焰使者能与友军单位共享瞄准数据的 C3 从属单元。

column1: Intended as a long-range fire support configuration, the Firestarter C carries a pair of LRM-10 launchers. The 'Mech has two Flamers and a Small Laser for close combat. Additionally, a C3 Slave Unit is carried so that the Firestarter C can benefit from sharing targeting data with allied units.
column2: C 配置意为远程火力支援，携带一对 LRM-10 发射器。机甲有两具火焰喷射器和一门小型激光用于近战。此外还携带一台 C3 从属单元，使火焰使者 C 能受益于与友军单位共享瞄准数据。

column1: The D configuration is intended for long-range direct fire support and sniping. This is done by using an ER PPC as its primary weapon. Backing this up is an LRM-5 launcher, a Medium Laser, and two Flamers for direct fire support. The D Configuration carries a Guardian ECM Suite to protect itself from an enemy's electronic warfare equipment. The 'Mech also carries a C3 Slave Unit.
column2: D 配置用于远程直射火力支援与狙击。它使用一门 ER PPC 作为主武器。支援它的是一具 LRM-5 发射器、一门中型激光和两具火焰喷射器，用于直射火力支援。D 配置携带一套守护者 ECM 套件以防御敌方的电子战设备。机甲还携带一台 C3 从属单元。

column1: The E configuration of the Firestarter is intended for close combat and carries as its primary weapon an MRM-20 launcher. This is backed up by a Medium Pulse Laser, a Small Pulse Laser, and two Flamers. A Sword provides superb accuracy in melee combat situations.
column2: 火焰使者 E 配置用于近战，以一门 MRM-20 发射器为主武器。它由一门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和两具火焰喷射器支援。一把剑在近战中提供卓越精度。

column1: This variant is exclusively used by the Free Worlds League. The F carries two ER Large Lasers, which are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and two Flamers.
column2: 此变体仅供自由世界联盟使用。F 型携带两门 ER 大型激光，辅以两门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和两具火焰喷射器。

column1: In its primary configuration the Firestarter is built to stay at long ranges when facing an enemy. The primary weapons are a pair of Large Lasers. The Large Lasers provide the 'Mech with respectable long-range firepower. To allow the 'Mech to create cover for itself and to clear woods, the Firestarter Prime carries two extra flamers on top of its fixed pair, bringing the total to four. Finally, to allow the 'Mech to search out hidden units, the Prime carries a Beagle Active Probe.
column2: 主配置中，火焰使者被设计为面对敌人时保持远程。主武器为一对大型激光。这两门大型激光为机甲提供可观的远程火力。为让机甲能为自己制造掩护并清除林地，火焰使者主型号在固定的一对之外另装两具火焰喷射器，共四具。最后，为让机甲能搜寻隐藏单位，主型号携带一具比格犬主动探测器。

column1: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-enhanced Clan LRM-10 and a pair of Clan-tech ER Large Lasers.
column2: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器支援后续波次的星盟防卫军部队，装备一具 Artemis IV 火控系统增强的氏族 LRM-10 和一对氏族技术 ER 大型激光。

column1: This version carries several experimental systems. Reminiscent of the Firestarter H, it's equipped with an Angel ECM Suite and Bloodhound Active Probe. It carries the twin center torso Flamers common to all Firestarter variants, and augments them with a Streak SRM-2 and a Large X-Pulse Laser.
column2: 此版本携带若干实验性系统。它让人想起火焰使者 H，装备天使 ECM 套件和猎犬主动探测器。它携带所有火焰使者变体通用的中央躯干双联火焰喷射器，并以一具连续 SRM-2 和一门大型 X 脉冲激光加以增强。

column1: Flea
column2: 跳蚤

column1: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit.
column2: FLE-14 跳蚤于 2519 年投产，是打造超轻型战斗机甲的一次尝试。它仅重十五吨，可以说算得上是与真正的跳蚤不同的一款机甲设计。它能达到近 150 公里/小时的最大地面速度，跳跃能力 120 米。然而其武器与装甲都极轻：只有一吨装甲保护该单位，右臂上那门孤零零的中型激光勉强使它成为可用的战场单位。

column1: Ultralight Recon
column2: 超轻型侦察

column1: An expensive mech that is good against other 20 ton mechs and infantry but not able to stand up to any major threat from larger mechs.
column2: 一台昂贵的机甲，对付其他 20 吨机甲和步兵不错，但无力抵御更大机甲的任何重大威胁。

column1: Armed Scout
column2: 武装侦察

column1: The Flea has a good weapon loadout to use against other smaller light mechs but man I would not want to be caught in one, just like a Locust, not a lot of protection.
column2: 跳蚤有不错的武器配置用于对付其他较小的轻型机甲，但老天，我可不想被逮在里面——就像蝗虫一样，防护不多。

column1: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15.
column2: FLE-16 是作为狼之龙骑兵与地球工厂公司独家合同的一部分而建造的，该合同旨在第四次继承战争结束时补充龙骑兵的损失，与重新生产的原版跳蚤一同问世，是这款极为稀有机甲数世纪以来首个新量产型号。此变体通过在 20 吨底盘上结合惊人的速度与额外的装甲和武器，弥补了早期 FLE-14 的弱点。引擎升级为 GM 180，以达到近 150 公里/小时的相近最高地面速度。它装有两门中型激光和一具火焰喷射器，同时保留与早期 FLE-15 相似的装甲配置。

column1: Hyperfast Recon
column2: 超高速侦察

column1: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating.
column2: 该设计最初专为龙骑兵生产，直到卡佩兰邦联在 3040 年代通过一次马斯克罗夫卡突袭获得其图纸。赫尔姆记忆核心之后的 FLE-17 变体以较老的 FLE-15 型号为基础。由于龙骑兵更多将跳蚤用作侦察而非反人员机甲，地球工厂通过融入回收技术构想出新设计。在保持 97.2 公里/小时最高速度的同时，加装内骨骼底盘腾出重量用于 MASC 系统，使机甲速度可在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。速度的提升是确保在现代战场生存所必需的，因为 FLE-17 仅披着可怜的三吨利文斯顿陶瓷装甲。

column1: A very light sniper mech with a very big laser but cannot take a hit.
column2: 极轻型狙击机甲，装备超大型激光但不堪一击。

column1: This Flea is a glass cannon with a large laser and no armor, so better keep it away from the direct combat or I'll be rebuilding it and we will saying good-bye to whoever you assigned to pilot it.
column2: 这台跳蚤是门玻璃大炮，一门大型激光、毫无装甲，所以最好让它远离直接战斗，否则我就得重建它，而我们就得跟被派去驾驶它的人告别了。

column1: Franky
column2: 弗兰基

column1: The Franky is a typical periphery Frankenmech sporting a weird array of weaponry and being cobbled together from many different MechParts
column2: 弗兰基是典型的外围区拼装机甲，装备着奇异的武器组合，由许多不同机甲零件拼凑而成

column1: Galahad
column2: 加拉哈德

column1: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50 ton mech weapon loadout.
column2: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。此变体使用原本 50 吨机甲的武器配置。

column1: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. With the development of the new Gauss Rifle, Mitchell Vehicles decided in 2594 to redesign the Galahad around these new weapons. The Galahad utilizes special building materials in the form of eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internals. To fit the massive weapons on the Galahad, the engine was dropped to a GM 180, giving it a maximum speed of only 54 km/h, making it difficult for the 'Mech to keep up with its companions in most cases. The GLH-2D carries two massive M-7 Gauss Rifles, with two tons of ammo for each rifle. It was a showing of the powerful new weapons at the time and earned it the nickname of Gausszilla.
column2: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。随着新型高斯步枪的发展，米切尔车辆于 2594 年决定围绕这些新武器重新设计加拉哈德。它采用特殊建造材料：十一吨铁纤维装甲与内骨骼内部结构。为在加拉哈德上装下这些巨型武器，引擎降至 GM 180，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时，使机甲在多数情况下难以跟上同伴。GLH-2D 携带两门巨型 M-7 高斯步枪，每门配两吨弹药。它在当时展示了这种强大的新武器，并为它赢得"高斯斯拉"的绰号。

column1: Gargoyle A
column2: 石像鬼 A

column1: Gargoyle
column2: 石像鬼

column1: Gargoyle B
column2: 石像鬼 B

column1: Configured almost exclusively for long range combat, the B configuration of the Gargoyle carries a powerful Gauss Rifle backed up by an LRM-10 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, allowing it to keep its distance from enemy units. For self defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-4 launcher which is also enhanced with an Artemis IV FCS. The main drawback to this configuration is its over reliance on ammunition based weaponry, making it effective only so long as it has sufficient ammunition for its weapons.
column2: 石像鬼 B 配置几乎专为远程战斗而设，携带一门强力高斯步枪，辅以一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器，使其能与敌方单位保持距离。近程自卫方面，机甲有一具同样加装 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。此配置的主要缺点是过度依赖弹药类武器，使它只在弹药充足时有效。

column1: Gargoyle C
column2: 石像鬼 C

column1: A dedicated close combat configuration, the Gargoyle C carries as its primary weapon a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 that has twice the rate of fire as a standard Autocannon. This is supported by a brace of six ER Medium Lasers that make the 'Mech a highly effective brawler.
column2: 石像鬼 C 是专职近战配置，主武器为一门强力超速自动炮/20，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由六门 ER 中型激光支援，使机甲成为极为高效的缠斗者。

column1: Gargoyle E
column2: 石像鬼 E

column1: This variant makes use of Clan technology developed in the 3060s. An ATM 12 in the right arm has enough ammunition bins to make use of all of the types available to an Advanced Tactical Missile Launcher. Four Heavy Medium Lasers provide a powerful punch as short range, while a Streak SRM-6 can exploit those holes. A pair of ER Micro Lasers round out the offensive armament. A Targeting Computer makes the lasers more accurate.
column2: 此变体使用 3060 年代开发的氏族技术。右臂的一具 ATM 12 拥有足够的弹药箱以使用高级战术导弹发射器可用的全部弹种。四门重型中型激光在近距离提供强大打击，而一具连续 SRM-6 可利用这些破口。两门 ER 微型激光为攻击武器收尾。一台瞄准计算机让激光更为精准。

column1: Gladiator
column2: 角斗士

column1: The first homegrown BattleMech produced by the Draconis Combine was the Gladiator. The 55-ton 'Mech took seven years to design, as Coordinator Kozo Von Rohrs refused to open up the process to anybody but a select group at New Samarkand Armor Works (the predecessor of Luthien Armor Works) who were under constant surveillance by DEST. 2468 finally saw the GLD-1R Gladiator hit mass-production. Following the Battle of Nox in 2475, the dishonored 'Mech was retired from official production, with NSAW closing down the production lines by 2488. Merryweather Industries was the first private company to attempt BattleMech production without governmental support. Despite their location in the Terran Hegemony, they acquired the plans to the Gladiator and produced a new run in 2490. They were unable to raise the capital to finish their second run, the 4R, and nearly went bankrupt before moving into IndustrialMechs. The GLD-4R production lines were closed down in 2495. A few salvaged Gladiator -1Rs were still in service with militaries across the Inner Sphere and Periphery, though these relics were finally pushed to extinction during the Reunification War. The 55-ton Gladiator has a top speed of 86 km/h, comparable to many other 'Mechs of the same weight. Nine and a half tons of armor provides a respectable amount of protection. Five jump jets enables the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time.
column2: 联合体自主生产的第一款战斗机甲是角斗士。这款 55 吨机甲耗时七年设计，因为协调官科佐·冯·罗尔斯拒绝将此过程向除新萨马尔坎德装甲工厂（卢西恩装甲工厂的前身）一小批人之外的任何人开放，这批人还处于 DEST 的持续监视之下。2468 年 GLD-1R 角斗士终于进入量产。在 2475 年诺克斯战役后，这款蒙羞的机甲被正式停产，NSAW 于 2488 年关闭生产线。梅里韦瑟工业是第一家在没有政府支持下尝试生产战斗机甲的私营公司。尽管位于地球霸权境内，他们仍取得了角斗士的图纸，并于 2490 年生产了新一轮机型。他们无力筹集资金完成第二轮生产（4R 型），几乎破产，随后转向工业机甲。GLD-4R 生产线于 2495 年关闭。少数回收的角斗士-1R 仍在内外天体的军队中服役，但这些老古董最终在统一战争中彻底消亡。55 吨的角斗士最高速度达 86 公里/小时，与同重量的许多机甲相当。九吨半装甲提供了可观的防护。五个跳跃推进器使机甲一次可跳跃至 150 米。

column1: A more modern variant that still used some primitive technologies, the 2R upgraded the top speed of the 1R to 86 km/h. Few of these were ever fielded, as the design was apparently just a test bed for the newer technologies. Production of the GLD-2R stopped by 2488.
column2: 2R 是更现代的变体，但仍使用部分原始技术，它把 1R 的最高速度提升至 86 公里/小时。此类机甲投产极少，因为该设计显然只是新技术的试验平台。GLD-2R 的生产于 2488 年停止。

column1: The test platform for Merryweather, the 3R upgraded the Large Laser to two LRM-10s.
column2: 作为梅里韦瑟的试验平台，3R 把大型激光升级为两具 LRM-10。

column1: A Lord's Light P1 PPC provides long range firepower. Two Argra 1L Medium Lasers is just as powerful up close and adds a Thunderstroke SRM-6 to exploit any holes in an enemy's armor.
column2: 一门"主之光 P1"PPC 提供远程火力。两门"阿尔格拉 1L"中型激光在近距同样强劲，另加一具"雷霆一击"SRM-6 以利用敌方装甲上的破口。

column1: Affectionately known as the 'Grand Dragon', the DRG-1G replaces the AC5 with a PPC, Medium Laser and 2 extra Heat Sinks.
column2: DRG-1G 被亲切地称为"大龙"，它将 AC5 换成一门 PPC、一门中型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

column1: The Grand Dragon 3K is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating and carries heavier weaponry than its smaller cousin. Equipped with a heavy-duty gyro, a PPC and Gauss rifle, this variant is a formidable heavy weapons platform.
column2: 大龙 3K 是一台强壮的机器，能承受严重打击，并携带比其小型表亲更重的武器。它配备重型陀螺仪、一门 PPC 和一门高斯步枪，是令人敬畏的重型武器平台。

column1: Grasshopper
column2: 蚂蚱

column1: An upgrade of the Grasshopper using Star League technology, the 5J replaces the Diplan large laser with a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser, replaces the Conan/S launcher with a Hovertech Streak SRM-2 model, and removes the two torso-mounted medium lasers for a SureFire 444 Anti-Missile System.
column2: 5J 是使用星盟科技的蚱猛升级版，将迪普兰大型激光换成多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，将柯南/S 发射器换成霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，并移除两门躯干中型激光，改为一套必火 444 反导系统。

column1: The 5N is a very basic field upgrade of the Grasshopper introduced around 3040. The large laser and missile launcher have both been removed and in their place was added a PPC and a fifth medium laser respectively. Though the change increases the design's firepower, it also comes at a greater risk of overheating the 'Mech, especially if the pilot is careless.
column2: 5N 是约 3040 年推出的蚱猛非常基础的野战升级。大型激光和导弹发射器均被移除，分别换成一门 PPC 和第五门中型激光。虽然这一改动提升了设计的火力，但也带来了更高的过热风险，尤其当飞行员粗心大意时。

column1: A basic modification of the 5J model introduced by the Combine in 3052, the Grasshopper-C carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to be integrated into a C3 lance. These models often served as the point 'Mech in a C3 lance, where its speed and armor allowed it to get close enough to the enemy and share this targeting data with friendly units. To make room for the addition of the C3 unit, ammunition for the Streak SRM-2 launcher was reduced by one ton, though since the Streak launcher was already an ammo-efficient design this resulted in no drop in performance
column2: 作为联合体 3052 年推出的 5J 型号的基础改装，蚱猛-C 携带一台 C3 从属单元以便编入 C3 小队。这些型号常作为 C3 小队中的尖兵机甲，其速度与装甲使它能够逼近敌人并把瞄准数据共享给友军单位。为腾出空间加装 C3 单元，连续 SRM-2 发射器的弹药减少了一吨，不过由于连续发射器本就是弹药效率很高的设计，这并未导致性能下降

column1: A basic modification of the 5J model introduced by the Combine in 3052, the Grasshopper-C carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to be integrated into a C3 lance. These models often served as the point 'Mech in a C3 lance, where its speed and armor allowed it to get close enough to the enemy and share this targeting data with friendly units. To make room for the addition of the C3 unit, ammunition for the Streak SRM-2 launcher was reduced by one ton, though since the Streak launcher was already an ammo-efficient design this resulted in no drop in performance.
column2: 作为联合体 3052 年推出的 5J 型号的基础改装，蚱猛-C 携带一台 C3 从属单元以便编入 C3 小队。这些型号常作为 C3 小队中的尖兵机甲，其速度与装甲使它能够逼近敌人并把瞄准数据共享给友军单位。为腾出空间加装 C3 单元，连续 SRM-2 发射器的弹药减少了一吨，不过由于连续发射器本就是弹药效率很高的设计，这并未导致性能下降。

column1: Griffin
column2: 狮鹫

column1: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though.
column2: 狮鹫 1N 利用跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全处向对手投掷火力。不过，如果它们整场都在战场上蹦跳打冷枪，也可能过热。

column1: Griffin 1Ss mount closer-range weaponry than their 1N cousins, allowing them to jump in for closer attacks and then move away to disengage or flank. They're generally better at dealing with heat buildup, too.
column2: 狮鹫 1S 比其 1N 表亲装备更偏近程的武器，使它们能跳入发动近距离攻击，再后撤脱离或包抄。它们在处理热量积累方面通常也更好。

column1: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. Its weapons generated a lot of heat, but the old Double Heat Sinks were put in to handle it.
column2: 狮鹫 2N 是一款老式星盟型号，在其全盛时期是最多才多艺的机甲之一。它的武器产生大量热量，但装设的老式双倍散热器足以应对。

column1: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. The rare B variant was specifically made for Covert Ops and carried advanced surveillance and stealth equipment.
column2: 狮鹫 2N 是一款老式星盟型号，在其全盛时期是最多才多艺的机甲之一。罕见的 B 变体专为秘密行动而制，携带先进的监视与隐形设备。

column1: Scout & Headhunter
column2: 侦察与猎头

column1: Created by a pilot who lost the LRM rack off his Griffin, the -6CV replaces the long-range payload with a mid-range weapon system: a MRM 30. Backing up the MRM rack is an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor for extra punch. To keep the heat under control, the -6CV mounts double heat sinks and is powered by a Light Fusion Engine for speed. It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability
column2: -6CV 由一位失去了格里芬 LRM 挂架的飞行员创造，它以一套中程武器系统取代远程载荷：一具 MRM 30。支援 MRM 挂架的是一门带 PPC 电容器的 ER PPC，以提供额外打击力。为控制热量，-6CV 装双倍散热器，并由一台轻型聚变引擎提供速度。它还增加了一点装甲以提升生存性

column1: A Griffin sporting ClanTech upgrades.
column2: 装备氏族科技升级的狮鹫。

column1: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
column2: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。

column1: Grizzly
column2: 灰熊

column1: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
column2: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。

column1: Totem & Heavy Scout
column2: 图腾 & 重型侦察

column1: The Grizzly actually packs a solid long-range punch with a Omega 12-coil Gauss Rifle and a Type X Short Bow LRM-10 Launcher.
column2: 灰熊实际上拥有扎实的远程打击力：一具"欧米茄 12 线圈"高斯步枪和一具"X 型短弓"LRM-10 发射器。

column1: Hammer
column2: 战锤

column1: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. The 'Mech is built around a long-range arsenal that can provide both direct and indirect fire support. It is also often paired with the Anvil, using its missiles to soften up the enemy at a distance until the Anvil can bring its lasers to bear. The Hammer has a maximum speed of 86.4 kph, which is enough for a 'Mech intended to stay at the edges of a battlefield acting in a fire support role. Additionally, the 'Mech has a respectable six tons of armor protection. With its average speed and good armor protection combined with its long-range weapons, the Hammer is a good overall light fire support 'Mech.
column2: 战锤是为轻型机甲提供火力支援而制造的机甲。它以远程武器库为核心，可提供直射与间接火力支援。它常与铁砧搭档，在远距离用导弹削弱敌人，直到铁砧能以激光发起攻击。战锤最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，对于一款意在战场边缘执行火力支援角色的机甲而言已足够。此外，它还拥有可观的六吨装甲防护。凭借平均速度、良好装甲与远程武器的组合，战锤是一款整体出色的轻型火力支援机甲。

column1: Called the Claw-Hammer, the 3C is built to make the Hammer capable of better defending itself when an enemy closes on the battlefield. This is done by removing one of the LRM launchers and replacing it with four additional Medium Lasers, which gives the Hammer the ability to attack the enemy with an overwhelming laser barrage at close ranges. This variant also works well as a bodyguard 'Mech in a lance of Hammer 'Mechs.
column2: 3C 被称为"爪锤"，其设计目标是让锤式在敌人逼近时能更好地自卫。它移除一具 LRM 发射器，换成四门额外中型激光，使锤式能在近距离以压倒性的激光弹幕攻击敌人。这一变体在锤式小队中也很好地充当护卫机甲。

column1: The primary weaponry that the Hammer employs is a pair of Coventry Five-Tube LRM-5 launchers that allow the Hammer to rain destruction down on a target at up to 630 meters. These launchers are supplied with a ton of ammo each and both are augmented with an Artemis IV fire control system for greater accuracy. For close combat the 'Mech carries three Martell Medium Lasers.
column2: 锤式采用的主要武器是一对"考文垂五管"LRM-5 发射器，使锤式能在 630 米外向目标倾泻毁灭。这些发射器各配一吨弹药，并都加装 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。近战方面，机甲携带三门马特尔中型激光。

column1: Also called the Pein-Hammer, the 3P is an extensive modification of the Hammer. The entire arsenal has been removed from the 'Mech. The 'Mech is armed with a short-range assortment of weapons making it an excellent brawler. The primary weapons are a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers. These are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers which provide the 'Mech with excellent close range protection.
column2: 3P 又称"痛苦之锤"，是对锤式的大幅改装。机甲上原有武器库已被全部移除。它装备一套近程武器，使它成为出色的缠斗者。主武器为一对连续 SRM-4 发射器。它们由两门 ER 中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光支援，为机甲提供出色的近程防护。

column1: The 3S is commonly called the Slammer. The 'Mech looks to increase the longevity of the Hammer on the battlefield as a fire support 'Mech. This is done by removing two of the Medium Lasers and replacing them with two more tons of ammunition. The 'Mech can fire a sustained barrage of LRM fire for up to eight minutes.
column2: 3S 通常被称为"重击者"。这台机甲力求提升锤式作为火力支援机甲的战场续航力。它移除两门中型激光，换成两吨额外弹药。机甲可连续发射 LRM 弹幕长达八分钟。

column1: Hatamoto-Chi
column2: 旗本-血

column1: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
column2: 最初版本于 3039 年生产。尽管缺少 HTM-27 的失落科技，原版野战测试型旗本-血的唯一一次量产恰在 3039 年战争前夕完成，令进攻的莱兰与达维昂部队大为震惊。由于建立在标准底盘上，26T 装甲较少、少一台散热器，SRM 弹药也仅有一吨存于标准弹药箱中。

column1: Hatamoto-Kaze
column2: 旗本-风

column1: The 27V, known within the Combine as the Hatamoto-Kaze, is a variant focused on long range combat. The 'Mech removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-5 launchers, giving the Hatamoto-Kaze the ability to stay back from the battlefield and provide indirect fire.
column2: 27V 在联合体内部被称为旗本-风，是一款专注远程战斗的变体。它移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-5，使旗本-风能远离战场提供间接火力。

column1: Hatamoto-Ku
column2: 旗本-空

column1: The 27W, also known as the Hatamoto-Ku, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with an Autocannon5. The 'Mech has a powerful direct fire capability.
column2: 27W 又称旗本-空，移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成一门自动炮5。该机甲具备强大的直射火力。

column1: Hauptmann
column2: 上尉

column1: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion.
column2: 首款由莱兰联盟自行设计并制造的全能机甲。上尉的灵感源自氏族使用的"大师"全能机甲。利用缴获的"大师"资料以及由德拉科尼斯联合体分享的火焰使者全能机甲建造数据，最终成果是一款强大的全能机甲，能在大多数战斗情形下自保。上尉采用标准底盘，由 285 聚变引擎驱动，这增强了它的耐久性，使其不会因失去侧面躯干而被击毁。它底盘上固定有十一台双倍散热器，必要时可在各配置中加装更多。防护方面，上尉携带十八吨半装甲，并在右侧躯干固定 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

column1: The primary configuration carries a varied and powerful arsenal. For long range combat, the Hauptmann carries two ER Large Lasers as its primary long range weapons. These give the Hauptmann Prime a good long range damage capability. For close combat, the 'Mech has an LB-X Autocannon/20 for devastating close range firepower backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers. Finally, to protect the 'Mech against enemy electronic warfare systems, the Hauptmann Prime has a Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: 主配置携带多样而强大的武器库。远程战斗方面，上尉以两门 ER 大型激光为主要远程武器。这赋予上尉主型号良好的远程伤害能力。近战方面，机甲有一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 提供毁灭性近程火力，辅以两门中型脉冲激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一对连续 SRM-2 发射器。最后，为保护机甲免受敌方电子战系统干扰，上尉主型号装有守护者 ECM 套件。

column1: Intended for close combat, the Hauptmann A is armed with four ER Medium Lasers as its primary short-ranged weapons with a pair of SRM-6 launchers linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For increased mobility, the Hauptmann A has three jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters. Finally, to defend itself if it ends up in a long range firefight, the Alpha configuration mounts a Gauss Rifle. To handle the massive heat load, it carries an additional six double heat sinks.
column2: 上尉 A 为近战而设，主近程武器为四门 ER 中型激光，另有一对联接 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度的 SRM-6 发射器。为提升机动性，上尉 A 有三个跳跃推进器，使机甲能跳起至九十米。最后，若陷入远程对射，阿尔法配置装有一具高斯步枪自卫。为处理庞大热负荷，它多装六台双倍散热器。

column1: Configured for both long- and short-range engagements, the B configuration of the Hauptmann has a pair of ER PPCs which give it the capability to engage an enemy at long ranges. For close combat, the 'Mech has three Medium Pulse Lasers and a devastatingly powerful Ultra Autocannon/20. To handle the 'Mech's high heat generated from its weapons, the B configuration has five additional double heat sinks.
column2: 上尉 B 配置能应对远程与近程交战，装有一对 ER PPC，使其能在远距离与敌交战。近战方面，机甲有三门中型脉冲激光和一门毁灭性极强的超速自动炮/20。为处理武器产生的高热量，B 配置多装五台双倍散热器。

column1: The C configuration of the Hauptmann is intended to close with its enemies and wear them down as it approaches, delivering the killing blow at short range. For long range combat, the Hauptmann C carries an LRM-20 launcher linked to an Artemis IV fire control system to increase the accuracy of its missiles. For close combat, the Hauptmann C has a massive Heavy Gauss Rifle. This is supported by two ER Medium Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a Medium Pulse Laser. This configuration of the Hauptmann has an additional two double heat sinks and a Guardian ECM Suite to protect itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.

column1: Despite its initial success, the combat service of the Hellfire has not be flaw free. Aside from the sensor interference caused by firing its signature Heavy Lasers, a number of battlefield reports indicate the heavy laser tubes can violently rupture in the heat of battle. The 'Mech also experiences a fifteen percent higher rate of MASC failure than usual, though technicians have yet to determine whether this is due to the age of the Lupus chassis or if this is something caused by the Heavy Lasers.
column2: 尽管初期成功，地狱火的战场服役并非毫无瑕疵。除了其标志性重型激光开火造成的传感器干扰外，若干战场报告指出重型激光管在激战中可能剧烈爆裂。该机甲的 MASC 故障率也比通常高出百分之十五，不过技师们尚未确定这是源于狼人底盘的老化，还是重型激光造成的问题。

column1: The Highlander 732B is an ancient model from the Star League days! Its Gauss Rifle was a terrifying weapon that gave it a huge punch at almost any range, but you can't find those anymore. And of course, it still has the jump capability it's always been known for.

column1: The Highlander 733 is one of the few jump-capable assault 'Mechs. A mixture of medium- and long-range weaponry ensures that while the Highlander excels at no particular role, it is decent at all of them.
column2: 高地人 733 是为数不多具备跳跃能力的突击机甲之一。中远程武器的混合搭配确保高地人在任何单一角色上都不出众，却在所有角色上都相当不错。

column1: The Highlander 733C is a simple variant of the 733 model that removes 2 tons of missile ammunition and upscales its Autocannon 10 to an Autocannon 20.  This sacrifices some of its long range functionality, but give it a true brawler profile.
column2: 高地人 733C 是 733 型号的简单变体，移除 2 吨导弹弹药并把自动炮 10 升级为自动炮 20。这牺牲了一些远程功能，却赋予它真正的缠斗者特质。

column2: 高地人 733P 是 733 型号的变体，移除自动炮并换成 PPC。它对积热的处理也更好。

column1: This ComStar version of the Highlander introduced in the late 3050s has been upgraded to carry the improved C3 computer, as well as upgrading the LRM-20 with an Artemis IV fire control system and replacing the SRM-6 to a Streak SRM-4.
column2: 这款康星版高地人于 3050 年代末推出，已升级为携带改进型 C3 计算机，并把 LRM-20 升级为配 Artemis IV 火控系统，SRM-6 则换成连续 SRM-4。

column1: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
column2: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。

column1: Hitman
column2: 杀手

column1: The Hitman was designed to work as a spotter 'Mech for advanced Arrow IV missile artillery rounds. In order to do this, the 'Mech is built to be able to close to effective range for its Forward-1 Target Acquisition Gear spotting gear rapidly with a Kagushima 210 XL propelling it up to 118.8 kph and a MASC system pushing the 'Mech up to 151.2 kph in short bursts. The 'Mech also carries an Apple Churchill Guardian ECM Suite to foul any enemy electronics warfare equipment and a Wunderland Beagle Active Probe to detect any hidden enemy units. With the recent invention of semi-guided LRMs the Hitman can also guide LRM fire to a unit targeted with its TAG unit. The Hitman carries five tons of armor protection to protect it against any attacks that may hit it.
column2: 杀手被设计为先进箭矢 IV 导弹炮弹的侦察机甲。为此，机甲能迅速接近其 Forward-1 目标捕获指示器的有效距离：管岛 210 XL 引擎推动它达到 118.8 公里/小时，MASC 系统则在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。机甲还携带苹果·丘吉尔守护者 ECM 套件以干扰敌方电子战设备，以及旺德兰比格犬主动探测器以侦测隐藏的敌方单位。随着半制导 LRM 的问世，杀手还能将其 TAG 标记的目标引导给 LRM 火力。杀手携带五吨装甲防护，以抵御可能命中它的攻击。

column1: The Hitman carries an arsenal that is capable of striking an enemy regardless of the ranges they are at. For long range engagements while closing with an enemy the Hitman is armed with a Thunderstroke-L LRM-5 with Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. When the Hitman closes to the effective range for its TAG it is able to use its three Argra 3L Medium Lasers to defend itself.
column2: 杀手携带的武器库能在任何距离打击敌人。在接近敌人时用于远程交战，杀手装备一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度的"雷霆-L"LRM-5。当杀手接近其 TAG 的有效射程时，它可用三门"阿尔格拉 3L"中型激光自卫。

column1: The HM-2 Hitman is a field refit that is popular with units that do not have a large number of artillery assets but do have C3 lances. The TAG unit has been removed in favor of a C3 Slave unit and the LRM-5 launcher has been removed in favor of a Narc Missile Beacon. The 'Mech is able to work as a lead unit in a C3 lance or as a spotter for a fire support lance with its Narc Missile Beacon.
column2: HM-2 杀手是野战改装型，深受那些没有大量火炮资产但拥有 C3 小队的单位欢迎。TAG 单元被移除，换成一台 C3 从属单元；LRM-5 发射器被移除，换成一具 NARC 导弹信标。机甲可作为 C3 小队的领队单位，或凭借其 NARC 导弹信标充当火力支援小队的目标指示者。

column1: The F5 variant, called the Hollander II, is a variant of the Hollander that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's problems by building it on a chassis ten tons heavier than the original, pushing it into the medium weight class. First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.
column2: 名为荷兰人 II 的 F5 变体是荷兰人的改型，试图通过把底盘加重十吨、跨入中量级来解决机甲的问题。它于 3058 年首次建造，仍以高斯步枪为主武器，但辅以一门中型激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。

column1: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
column2: F7 于 3061 年亮相，是 F5 的改型，利用荷兰人 II 更大的武器负载能力搭载莱兰联盟新型重型高斯步枪，能在中近距离造成大量伤害。虽然火力优于前型，但为容纳这些巨型武器而移除备用武器，使它仍带有原版荷兰人的同样问题。

column1: Hollander
column2: 荷兰人

column1: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. The Federated Commonwealth was in dire need of a response to the fast-moving, long-range firepower of the Clan Invaders at the time, and looked at a number of light 'Mech designs featuring PPCs or LRMs as a potential answer. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.
column2: 荷兰人于 3054 年推出，专门为了把高斯步枪带上战场并担任狙击手。当时联邦联邦急需应对氏族入侵者快速机动的远程火力，考察了多款装备 PPC 或 LRM 的轻型机甲设计方案。考文垂大胆决定装上如此巨大的武器——既没有其他设计那样的过热或弹药爆炸缺陷——从而赢得了合同。凭借其单门巨型火炮和对重新发现技术的运用，荷兰人能在极远距离一炮摧毁另一台轻型机甲，并轻易威胁更重的目标。

column1: The G1 variant of the Hollander is built to address concerns about the Hollander's lack of back up weapons. First debuting in 3056 the 'Mech replaces the heavy Gauss Cannon with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon, freeing up weight to mount two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers in its arms as backup weapons and add two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The G1 is an excellent 'Mech for vehicle hunting as well as anti-aircraft use with its LB-X cluster rounds.
column2: 荷兰人的 G1 变体旨在解决人们对荷兰人缺乏备用武器的担忧。它于 3056 年首次亮相，将重型高斯炮换成 LB-X 自动炮/10 作为主武器，腾出重量在双臂装两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光作为备用，并加两吨铁纤维装甲。凭借 LB-X 集束弹，G1 是出色的反车辆兼防空机甲。

column1: Hoplite
column2: 重装步兵

column1: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The 4B variant of the Hoplite is an early variant of the 'Mech that attempts to both alleviate the ammunition dependence of its primary weapon and increase its long-range damage potential. This is done by mounting a Magna Hellstar PPC as the primary weapon that is backed up by a massive Mitchell Systems LRM-15 launcher with two tons of reloads, giving it excellent long-range and indirect fire support capabilities.
column2: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。重装步兵 4B 变体是该机甲的早期变体，试图同时缓解其主武器的弹药依赖并提升远程伤害潜力。做法是装备一门玛格纳"地狱星"PPC 作为主武器，辅以一具巨型米切尔系统 LRM-15 发射器（配两吨再装填），赋予其出色的远程与间接火力支援能力。

column1: Essentially a Royal variant in everything but name, the Double B Hoplite was put into production at Strana Mechty MechWorks and Eden Weaponry Consolidated just before the death of Aleksandr Kerensky and found its way both into the forces of the Pentagon Powers and the infant toumans of the Clans. Keeping the LRM rack of the 4B, the Double B upgrades the Holly LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV system, swaps the PPC for an Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC, and increases the 'Mech's survivability with a Guardian ECM system, CASE in both torsos, double heat sinks, and an anti-missile system. However, the design's speed and armor were not upgraded, enforcing the need to deploy the 4Bb as a fire-support unit.
column2: 双 B 重装步兵实质上除名字之外一切皆为皇家变体，在亚历山大·克伦斯基去世前夕于斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂机甲工厂与伊甸兵器联合体投产，既进入五角势力部队，也进入氏族初生的图曼。双 B 保留 4B 的 LRM 挂架，把"冬青"LRM-15 发射器升级加装 Artemis IV 系统，把 PPC 换成"族杀 H 级"ER PPC，并通过守护者 ECM 系统、两侧躯干的 C.A.S.E.、双倍散热器和一套反导系统提升机甲生存力。然而该设计的速度与装甲并未升级，因此 4Bb 必须作为火力支援单位使用。

column1: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. Effectively identical to the original Hoplite, the 4C carries as its primary weapon a Luxor HV Autocannon/10, which allows it to put a good amount of damage on a target, with a low amount of heat. The 'Mech is also armed with a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher. Arriving with the Wolf's Dragoons, these were the first Hoplites seen in the Inner Sphere since their extinction during the Succession Wars.
column2: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。4C 与原版重装步兵实际上完全相同，主武器为一门卢克索 HV 自动炮/10，能以低热量对目标造成可观伤害。机甲还装备一具柯南/5 LRM-5 发射器。这些机甲随狼之龙骑兵抵达，是自继承战争中灭绝以来在内天体首次见到的重装步兵。

column1: A Hell's Horses field refit from Operation KLONDIKE, the 4Cb removes the weapons, electronics suite, and a heat sink in favor of a Gauss rifle, SRM-6, and Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 4Cb 是"克朗代克"行动中地狱马的野战改装，它移除武器、电子套件和一台散热器，换成高斯步枪、SRM-6 和铁纤维装甲。

column1: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. Refitted by the Dragoons after the Inner Sphere's recovery of the Helm Memory Core, the HOP-4D Hoplite is armed with an impressive Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, which allows it to fire either standard rounds or cluster rounds, which are similar to the blast from a shotgun, only on a 'Mech scale. As a secondary weapon, the Hoplite carries a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher, which also allows it to keep the enemy at long ranges.
column2: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。内天体找回赫尔姆记忆核心后，龙骑兵改装了 HOP-4D 重装步兵，装备一门令人印象深刻的迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹或集束弹——后者类似霰弹枪的散射，只是机甲级别。作为次要武器，重装步兵携带一具柯南/5 LRM-5 发射器，同样能迫使敌人远距离交战。

column1: Developed after the Battle of Luthien, the Hoplite C is a variant exclusively used by the Wolf's Dragoons that uses all Clan technology. Clad in 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous and fitted with double heat sinks, the 'Mech carries as its primary weapon an Ultra Autocannon/10. This is supported for long-range engagements by an LRM-15 launcher and for close range combat the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser.
column2: 重装步兵 C 在卢西恩战役后开发，是狼之龙骑兵独家使用的变体，全部采用氏族科技。它披挂 10 吨铁纤维装甲并配双倍散热器，主武器为一门超速自动炮/10。远程交战由一具 LRM-15 发射器支援，近战则有两门中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 中型激光。

column1: Hornet
column2: 大黄蜂

column1: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industriesrediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor.
