column1: The M variant is an upgrade using Star League technology first fielded in 3049. Replacing the standard engine with a Hermes 300 XL Engine and shaving off a half-ton of armor allows the 'Mech to retain the same speed while mounting a number of upgrades.
column2: M 变体是 3049 年首次投入战场的星盟科技升级版。以赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎取代标准引擎，并削减半吨装甲，使机甲在保持相同速度的同时搭载多项升级。

column1: Command Console refit built in 2913 - Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on a ON1-V, requiring the removal of one ton of SRM, LRM, and AC ammunition. The loss of ammunition reduces its capability to maintain fire for long, but a Commander will typically not be located at the head of a formation.
column2: 2913 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——标准改装通常在 ON1-V 上安装指挥控制台，需要移除一吨 SRM、LRM 和 AC 弹药。弹药的损失降低了它长时间持续开火的能力，但指挥官通常不会处在队列最前方。

column1: The Orion is already a challenging opponent, but I heard these late Third Succession War refits from the Free Worlds League were especially dangerous to encounter. It appears they fit a Command Console by removing one ton of each ammo type. However, unless you have the ability to resupply in the field, I would advise conserving ammunition if possible.
column2: 猎户座本就是难缠的对手，但我听说这些自由世界联盟在第三次继承战争后期的改装尤其危险。看来他们通过移除每种弹药各一吨来安装指挥控制台。不过，除非你有能力在战场上补给，我建议尽可能节约弹药。

column1: The Orion V trades some of the armor the K model is known for to mount additional weaponry. This increases its overall damage output, but many pilots consider the loss of armor to be risky.
column2: 猎户座 V 以 K 型闻名的部分装甲为代价搭载额外武器。这提升了总体伤害输出，但许多飞行员认为失去装甲颇为冒险。

column1: Instead of sacrificing armor, the Orion VA trades out some of it's long range punch by removing the LRM-15.  This allows it to not only maintain the stock armor, but also add 6 Heat Sinks for better heat management.
column2: 猎户座 VA 不以装甲为代价，而是通过移除 LRM-15 换掉部分远程打击力。这使它不仅能维持原装装甲，还能加装 6 台散热器以改善散热管理。

column1: Ostroc
column2: 奥斯特洛克

column1: The Ostroc carries as its primary weapons two Fuersturm-C Large Lasers in the left and right torsos. These give the Ostroc good medium to long range damage capabilities. The Ostrocs secondary weapons are two Fuersturm-b Medium Lasers also mounted in the side torsos and a Totschlagen SRM-4 launcher in the right torso for close-range combat, with one ton of reloads carried in the center torso. While the Ostroc's laser-heavy weapons payload allows it to operate well as a guerrilla fighter since it has limited dependency on supply lines, its short arms are a handicap in close combat, and the shocks of hand-to-hand fighting can easily damage the Fuersturm systems.
column2: 奥斯特罗克以左右躯干的两门"元首-C"大型激光为主武器。这赋予奥斯特罗克良好的中远程伤害能力。奥斯特罗克的次要武器是同样装在两侧躯干的两门"元首-b"中型激光，以及右躯干一具"重击"SRM-4 发射器用于近程战斗，中央躯干携带一吨再装填。虽然奥斯特罗克偏重激光的武器载荷使它对补给线依赖有限、能很好地充当游击战士，但其短小的手臂在近战中是个缺陷，肉搏的冲击很容易损坏"元首"系统。

column1: This upgrade of the 2C was used by the SLDF Royals starting in 2729. The large lasers are upgraded to ER Large Lasers, and the SRM-4 is replaced with a pair of Streak SRM-2s. Fourteen double heat sinks keep this 'Mech cool, while Ferro-Fibrous armor gives it additional protection.
column2: 此 2C 的升级版自 2729 年起供星盟防卫军皇家部队使用。大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光，SRM-4 换成两具连续 SRM-2。十四台双倍散热器使机甲保持凉爽，铁纤维装甲则提供额外防护。

column1: An experimental model produced by Kong Interstellar for the Free Worlds League in 2793, the 2M variant of the Ostroc focuses on the 'Mech's maneuverability. Five jump jets, two in each leg and one in the rear torso, have been added to the design, giving it a maximum jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. In order to make this change, the medium lasers and the SRM-4 launcher were removed. Relatively few of these were built between the League's annexation of Connaught and the factory's destruction.
column2: 2M 变体是康格星际于 2793 年为自由世界联盟生产的实验型号，聚焦于机甲的机动性。设计中加入五个跳跃推进器（每腿两个、后躯干一个），使最大跳跃距离达一百五十米。为做此改动，中型激光和 SRM-4 发射器被移除。在联盟吞并康诺特到工厂被毁之间，这样的机甲建造得相当少。

column1: The 3C variant looks to improve the long-range direct firepower of the Ostroc. Introduced in 2876, the two medium lasers and the SRM-4 have been removed in order to add a third large laser mounted in the right torso.
column2: 3C 变体旨在提升奥斯特洛克的远程直射火力。它于 2876 年推出，移除两门中型激光和 SRM-4，以便在右躯干加装第三门大型激光。

column1: Ostscout
column2: 奥斯曼侦察兵

column1: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional. The Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. However its ability to run and leap out of danger came at the expense of offensive capability. In fact were it not for aggressive lobbying on the part of its test pilots the final production model would have been completely weaponless. As it is, the Ostcout would be hard-pressed to win a fight against all but the lightest 'Mechs. A poor combatant, the 'Mech excels at operating deep behind enemy lines, gathering as much information as possible about the terrain and the disposition of enemy forces. Besides the Great Houses, ComStar also utilized the Ostscout, and in the aftermath of the Clan Invasion and ComStar Schism began developing a new Ostscout variant for their Com Guards. This new model would maintain the same maneuverability and intelligence-gathering capabilities of the original while improving its offensive and defensive capabilities. Debuting with success in 3064, within the next three years nearly half of all Com Guard Ostscouts had been upgraded to the new variant; however it was soon discovered that both the Lyran Alliance and Word of Blake were fielding their own updated Ostscouts identical to ComStar's. The intelligence leak would be confirmed and traced back to Dag Kesselring, former Precentor of the 66th Division, who passed on information about the program to both the Lyrans and Blakists.
column2: 奥斯特侦察由奥斯特曼工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲。为此它完全围绕收集数据与脱离险境而构建，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越。奥斯特侦察速度快到足以逃出大多数陷阱，几乎没有其他设计能在速度与机动性上与之匹敌。然而它跑得快、跳得远的能力是以攻击力为代价换来的。事实上，若不是测试飞行员积极游说，最终量产型本会完全没有武器。即便如此，奥斯特侦察除了对抗最轻的机甲外，很难赢下任何战斗。作为战斗者它很差，但在敌后深处行动、尽可能收集地形与敌军部署情报方面却极为出色。除各大议院外，康星也使用奥斯特侦察，在氏族入侵与康星分裂之后，他们开始为其康卫开发新的奥斯特侦察变体。新机型将保持原版同样的机动性与情报收集能力，同时提升攻防能力。该型于 3064 年成功亮相，此后三年内近半数康卫奥斯特侦察都升级到了新型号；然而很快发现莱兰联盟与布雷克之言都在装备与康星型号完全相同的自家更新版奥斯特侦察。泄密最终被确认并可追溯到达格·凯塞尔林——第 66 师的前任主祭——他将该计划的信息同时传给了莱兰人与布雷克派。

column1: The Ostscout carries a single Tronel II Medium Laser mounted in its center torso. This weapon, while not extremely powerful, is enough to dissuade most light scout assets from attempting to pursue. The ten heat sinks the 'Mech carries is more than enough to handle the heat output of this single laser - indeed the Ostscout can jump 210 meters and fire laser at the same time without overheating at all. While it is protected by four and a half tons of armor, the real protection for the 'Mech is its speed and maneuverability. A massive sixteen-ton fusion engine more commonly seen in 'Mechs twice its size propels the Ostscout to a cruising speed of 86.4 km/h. Eight jump jets built into the left and right legs give it a maximum jumping distance of 240 meters, rivaling that of the Spider.
column2: 东探在中央躯干装有一门"特罗内尔 II"中型激光。这门武器虽不特别强大，却足以劝阻大多数轻型侦察资产不要追击。机甲携带的十台散热器远超处理这单门激光热量所需——事实上东探能一边跳 210 米一边发射激光而完全不过热。虽然它由四吨半装甲保护，但机甲真正的防护是其速度与机动性。一台通常见于两倍体型机甲的巨型十六吨聚变引擎推动东探达到 86.4 公里/小时的巡航速度。装在左右腿的八个跳跃推进器赋予它 240 米的最大跳跃距离，可与蜘蛛相匹敌。

column1: Introduced at the same time as the original model and used by the SLDF Royal units, the 7Jb is the only variant of the Ostscout built prior to the Clan Invasion. This variant uses Endo Steel to free up enough mass to add a Beagle Active Probe.
column2: 与原型同期推出并由星盟防卫军皇家单位使用，7Jb 是氏族入侵前建造的唯一东探变体。此变体使用内骨骼腾出足够质量加装一具比格犬主动探测器。

column1: The 7K Ostscout was introduced in 3050 and replaces the medium laser with a Garret Mole TAG laser designator, sacrificing its limited offensive capability to allow it to designate targets for Arrow IV artillery missiles. Otherwise, the 7K Ostscout is identical to the 7J model, and while utterly defenseless is still swift enough to escape from most danger.
column2: 7K 东探于 3050 年推出，以"加勒特偃鼠"TAG 激光指示器取代中型激光，牺牲其有限的进攻能力，以换取为箭矢 IV 火炮导弹指示目标的能力。除此之外，7K 东探与 7J 型号完全相同，虽然完全无防御能力，速度却仍足以逃开大多数危险。

column1: Ostsol
column2: 奥斯特索尔

column1: Nine tons of armoring is considered decent for a heavy 'Mech, while its fast cruising speed of 54 km/h is thanks to a nineteen-ton Vlar 300 fusion engine. Besides speed though it's the 'Mech's highly-sensitive TRSS.2L3 targeting-tracking system, able to detect enemies over several kilometers in even the most difficult terrain, which makes it a good command platform for scouting missions. Sixteen heat sinks also help manage the heat output of its all-energy weapons payload.
column2: 对重型机甲而言九吨装甲称得上不错，而 54 公里/小时的快速巡航速度要归功于一台十九吨的 Vlar 300 聚变引擎。不过除速度之外，真正亮点是机甲高度灵敏的 TRSS.2L3 瞄准追踪系统——即便在最困难的地形中也能探测数公里外的敌人，这使它成为侦察任务的优良指挥平台。十六台散热器也有助于管理其全能量武器载荷的热量输出。

column1: The 4F Ostsol introduced in 2871 was the only common variant of the 'Mech pre-Clan Invasion, completely removing the laser weapons and replacing them with two Dominion-V PPCs in the side torsos. The 'Mech is seen as, in some ways at least, a poor man's Marauder or Warhammer, and the PPC array can quickly overload the sixteen heat sinks. Though, on its own merits, the variant is a good long-range direct fire support 'Mech which uses its top speed of 86.4 kph to dictate combat ranges against most heavier 'Mechs.
column2: 4F 奥斯特索尔于 2871 年推出，是氏族入侵前该机甲唯一常见的变体，它完全移除激光武器，在两侧躯干换成两门"自治领-V"PPC。该机甲在某种程度上被视为穷人版的掠夺者或战锤，而 PPC 阵列会迅速让十六台散热器过载。不过就自身而言，该变体是一款优秀的远程直射支援机甲，能利用 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度对抗大多数更重的机甲来决定交战距离。

column1: The 5M variant of the Ostsol is an upgrade of the design using Star League technology and is built for close-range combat with production starting in 3050. The original engine, heat sinks, and weapons have been stripped from the chassis and replaced with a Hermes 300 XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Taking the place of its standard weapons, the 5M Ostsol carries two Tronel XIII Large Pulse Lasers and four Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers, two of which remain rear-mounted to discourage attacks against the 'Mech's weak rear armor. Finally, for added protection against missile attacks, the 5M carries a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System in its right torso with one ton of ammo in the left.
column2: 奥斯特索尔 5M 变体是使用星盟技术对该设计的升级，专为近程战斗而造，自 3050 年起生产。原有引擎、散热器和武器已从底盘上拆除，换成赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎和十六台双倍散热器。5M 奥斯特索尔以两门"特罗内尔 XIII"大型脉冲激光和四门"特罗内尔 XII"中型脉冲激光取代标准武器，其中两门仍为后向安装，以遏制对机甲薄弱后方装甲的攻击。最后，为加强对导弹攻击的防护，5M 在右躯干装一套林德布拉德霰弹反导系统，左躯干配一吨弹药。

column1: Ostwar
column2: 奥斯特战争

column1: An updated version of the primitive Ostwar developed in 2620, this variant carries 12 tons of standard BattleMech armor and a modern cockpit. The chassis has been upgraded to use Endo Steel, while an XL Engine increases the Ostwar's ground speed to 84 kmh. Eighteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from three ER Large Lasers and twin SRM-6 launchers.
column2: 此变体是 2620 年开发的原始奥斯特战争的更新版，携带 12 吨标准战斗机甲装甲和现代驾驶舱。底盘升级为内骨骼，XL 引擎把奥斯特战争的地面速度提升至 84 公里/小时。十八台双倍散热器散发三门 ER 大型激光和双联 SRM-6 发射器的热量。

column1: Owens
column2: 欧文斯

column1: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
column2: 欧文斯旨在作为詹纳战斗机甲的全能机甲升级型。其定位是骑兵机甲，可沿敌方战线机动并为我方箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。凭借固定安装的 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬探测器与 C3 从属单元，欧文斯既是优秀的侦察单位，也是 C3 小队的先锋机甲。

column1: OmniMech Spotter
column2: 全能机甲侦察兵

column1: Panther
column2: 黑豹

column1: The 10K Panther is a high tech upgrade of the 9R model introduced by Wakazashi Enterprises. The chassis has been rebuilt using Endo Steel construction techniques and the saved weight used to add an Artemis IV fire control system to the missile launcher, as well as upgrading the PPC to a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. Since its introduction the 10K has gone on to replace the 9R as the most common model employed by the DCMS.
column2: 10K 黑豹是若林重工推出的 9R 型号高科技升级版。底盘以日式建筑技术重建，节省的重量用于为导弹发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，并把 PPC 升级为"主之光 2"ER PPC。自推出以来，10K 已取代 9R 成为 DCMS 最常用的型号。

column1: The 10KA Panther is a field refit of the Panther 10K. It removes the ER PPC and replaces it with a standard PPC to alleviate some heat problems.
column2: 10KA 黑豹是黑豹 10K 的野战改装。它移除 ER PPC，换成标准 PPC 以缓解一些热量问题。

column1: The Panther 5T is a Taurian refit, replacing the PPC and SRM with a low-tech Heavy Rifle and Flamer. Born from extreme shortages of replacement parts, this is a cheap alternative favoured by mercenaries and hired security.
column2: 黑豹 5T 是陶里安改装型，将 PPC 和 SRM 换成低技术重型步枪与火焰喷射器。它因替换零件极度短缺而生，是佣兵与雇佣保安青睐的廉价替代品。

column1: An early version of the Panther that is occasionally seen in the Periphery, it is armed with the ancient Tronel Large Laser in place of the PPC.  This laser suffers from faulty heat exchangers and generates more heat than a standard Large Laser.  Most of these have long since been retrofitted.
column2: 这是黑豹的早期版本，偶尔在外围区可见，它以古老的"特罗内尔"大型激光取代 PPC。这门激光受热交换器故障困扰，比标准大型激光产生更多热量。其中大多数早已被改装。

column1: First thing I am doing is ripping out that piece of crap laser and replacing it with something more reliable...
column2: 我第一件事就是把那门垃圾激光拆掉，换上点更可靠的东西……

column1: Known for their highly mobile nature, the Draconis Combine's Amphigean Light Assault Group upgrade the engines by removing the Jump Jets.
column2: 德拉科尼斯联合体的安菲吉亚轻型突击集群以高度机动著称，它们通过移除跳跃推进器来升级引擎。

column1: Not a bad upgrade, really allows this model to keep up with other lights in open ground - though it also suffers from the loss of those same Jump Jets when in rough terrain.
column2: 升级不差，确实让这个型号能在开阔地形跟上其他轻型机甲——不过在崎岖地形上它也因失去同样的跳跃推进器而吃亏。

column1: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect.
column2: 黑豹 9R 是扎实的全能机甲，只是稍偏慢。它靠跳跃推进器、可观的装甲和标志性 PPC 的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于近身肉搏，效果不俗。

column1: The PNT-C is a modification of the -10K model and simply removes the Artemis IV for a C3 slave.
column2: PNT-C 是-10K 型号的改装，仅移除 Artemis IV，换成一台 C3 从属单元。

column1: The PNT-CA is a simple weapon swap. A cooler firing standard PPC is used in place of the PNT-C's ER PPC.
column2: PNT-CA 是一次简单的武器更换。它以一门散热更低的标准 PPC 取代 PNT-C 的 ER PPC。

column1: Perseus
column2: 珀尔修斯

column1: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
column2: 珀尔修斯是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。珀尔修斯与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者不仅外观上大体相似，还使用了若干相同部件。这种相似让不少联盟军技师将新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"，而珀尔修斯的部署也主要面向那些大量装备其前身的精锐部队，一对一替换老旧猎户座。珀尔修斯采用轻量化内骨骼底盘，由赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的结构与引擎为武器和装备腾出大量重量。它以十四吨英勇拉梅洛装甲防护，装甲水平约为此尺寸机甲的平均值。它还固定配备十二台双倍散热器。

column1: Configured for long range fire support, the A configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers in its arm, both of which are linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The 'Mech also has a leg-mounted TAG laser designator, allowing it to call in Semi-Guided LRM and Arrow IV attacks from friendly units and has an ECM Suite to defend itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.
column2: A 配置为远程火力支援而设，臂部装一对 LRM-20 发射器，均联接 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。近程防御方面，机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器。机甲还有一具装在腿部的 TAG 激光指示器，使其能召唤友军单位的半制导 LRM 和箭矢 IV 攻击，并有一套 ECM 套件防御敌方电子战系统。

column1: Capable of fighting at close and long ranges, the B configuration has a Gauss Rifle and ER Large Laser for long range combat, though only a single ton of reloads relegates the Gauss to use as a secondary rather than primary weapon. The Perseus B is also capable of handling close combat with two Large Pulse Lasers and has an Anti-Missile System to protect itself from missile attacks.
column2: B 配置能在近程与远程作战：远程有一门高斯步枪和一门 ER 大型激光，不过仅一吨再装填使高斯更宜作次要而非主要武器。英仙座 B 也能以两门大型脉冲激光应对近战，并有一套反导系统防御导弹攻击。

column1: An all around configuration, the C is built to be capable of engaging an enemy at both long and short ranges. To do this, the Perseus C carries a Light Gauss Rifle, giving the 'Mech an extremely long reach. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 capable of engaging the enemy as they close. For close combat, the Perseus C has three ER Medium Lasers, a Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Two tons of gauss reloads, three tons of Ultra autocannon ammunition and a ton of missile reloads give the design adequate field endurance.
column2: C 配置是全方位配置，能在远程与近程交战。为此，英仙座 C 携带一门轻型高斯步枪，赋予机甲极远的射程。它由一门能在敌人接近时交战的超速自动炮/10 支援。近战方面，英仙座 C 有三门 ER 中型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。两吨高斯再装填、三吨超速自动炮弹药和一吨导弹再装填为设计提供足够的战场续航力。

column1: Configured specifically for close combat, the D configuration has an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy as well as an LB-X Autocannon/10 for long range combat. For close ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, three ER Medium Lasers, and a ER Small Laser. The D also has an ECM suite to protect itself from enemy electronic warfare systems and a Beagle Active Probe that allows it to find hidden units in close combat situation.
column2: D 配置专为近战而设，装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度的 LRM-20 发射器，以及一门用于远程交战的 LB-X 自动炮/10。近程方面，机甲有一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器、三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。D 还装有 ECM 套件以防御敌方电子战系统，以及一具比格犬主动探测器，使其能在近战中找出隐藏单位。

column1: The primary configuration of the Perseus shares a great deal with the Orion. For long range direct and indirect fire support, the Perseus carries an LRM-20 with Artemis IV for increased missile accuracy. For long range direct fire, the Perseus carries a powerful Ultra Autocannon/10 that is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon. The Perseus has a devastating short range arsenal with a highly accurate Medium Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers , an ER Small Laser, and finally an SRM-4 launcher that is linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The primary configuration mounts two tons each of both Ultra Autocannon and LRM munitions as well as single ton of SRM reloads in CASE protected ammunition bays in both its side torsos.
column2: 英仙座主配置与猎户座有诸多共通之处。远程直接与间接火力支援方面，英仙座携带一具带 Artemis IV 以提升导弹精度的 LRM-20。远程直射火力方面，英仙座携带一门强力超速自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。英仙座拥有毁灭性的近程武器库：一门极为精准的中型脉冲激光、四门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光，最后一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。主配置在两侧躯干受 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱中各携带两吨超速自动炮弹药和两吨 LRM 弹药，以及一吨 SRM 再装填。

column1: Land/Air-Mech
column2: 陆/空机甲

column1: Phoenix Hawk
column2: 凤鹰

column1: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk is one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk is still the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs are measured.
column2: 凤凰鹰由地球霸权于 2568 年首次推出，是内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一。这台机甲的诞生始于奥古斯工业意识到它可以强化毒刺底盘造出更大版本——一个与毒刺速度与机动性相同，但拥有更优装甲、火力与电子设备的型号。尽管并非毫无缺点，凤凰鹰至今仍是衡量所有其他侦察机甲的标准。

column1: Scout & Skirmisher
column2: 侦察 & 游击

column1: The 1D variant of the Phoenix Hawk is commonly used by the forces of House Davion, though it is slowly being phased out by the upgraded 3D. Contrasted with the base PXH-1, it removes the machine guns and replaces them with two additional heat sinks. While removing a small amount of the 'Mech's short-range firepower, the additional heat sinks make the 1D's heat load more manageable.
column2: 凤凰鹰 1D 变体常为达维昂家族部队使用，不过正被升级版 3D 逐步淘汰。与基础 PXH-1 相比，它移除机枪并换上两台额外散热器。这虽然削减了机甲少量近程火力，额外散热器却让 1D 的热负荷更易管理。

column1: After the destruction of their main production line in 2928, Solaris 7 based Blue Shot Weapons looked for other means of income. They took the idea behind the STR-3G Stinger variant and created a similar variant of the Phoenix Hawk by adding a second Large Laser in the left arm. To free up the necessary weight the PXH-1GS removes the Medium Lasers and Machine Guns and sacrifices some speed & maneuverability, but also adds 3 Heat Sinks and two Small Lasers. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname.
column2: 在 2928 年主生产线被毁后，驻扎索拉里斯 7 的蓝射武器公司寻找其他收入来源。他们借鉴 STR-3G 毒刺变体的思路，通过在左臂加装第二门大型激光，为凤凰鹰打造了类似变体。为腾出所需重量，PXH-1GS 移除中型激光和机枪，并牺牲部分速度与机动性，但也增加 3 台散热器和两门小型激光。两门主激光都装在枪袋中，为该变体赢得了"枪手"的绰号。

column1: Sacrificing speed on the battlefield is usually a bad idea.  The Gunslinger is still plenty fast for the confines of the Solaris arenas, and can dish out a good amount of damage with its two large lasers.
column2: 在战场上牺牲速度通常是个坏主意。"枪手"对索拉里斯竞技场的封闭空间而言仍然足够快，并可用两门大型激光造成可观的伤害。

column1: The 1K variant is particularly favored by House Kurita, though when it was introduced in 2603 it represented a departure from the traditional thinking of the Phoenix Hawk. By removing all jump jets from the 'Mech, room is freed up to install three additional heat sinks and another one and a half tons of armor. The machine guns and ammunition have also been removed from the design and replaced with a single Small Laser carried in the center torso.
column2: 1K 变体尤其受库瑞塔家族青睐，不过它在 2603 年推出时代表了与凤凰鹰传统思路的背离。通过移除机甲上全部跳跃推进器，腾出空间安装三台额外散热器和另外一吨半装甲。机枪与弹药也一并从设计中移除，换成装在中央躯干的一门小型激光。

column1: Based on the PXH-1, this electronic warfare variant introduced in 2599 drops the machine guns and ammunition in favor of a Guardian ECM Suite and another half-ton of armor.
column2: 这款电子战变体基于 PXH-1，于 2599 年推出，它舍弃机枪与弹药，改配一套守护者 ECM 套件和另外半吨装甲。

column1: The Phoenix Hawk 2L is compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, upgrading them to a standard beyond the PXH-2. An endo-steel chassis means that an ER large laser and heat sinks can be mounted whilst the machineguns are sacrificed in favour of Guardian ECM. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage.
column2: 凤凰鹰 2L 是一次彻底翻新，设计上与外围区各地无数 PXH-1 变体兼容，把它们升级到超越 PXH-2 的标准。内骨骼底盘意味着可以安装 ER 大型激光和散热器，同时牺牲机枪以换取守护者 ECM。它可向外围区各地出口，唯一的生产制约是缺乏 PXH 底盘的生产设施，不过联盟机甲厂计划在该设计受欢迎时建造一条专用的 PHX 生产线。在此之前，当前产量仅限于对现有机甲的就地改装和战场残骸的修复。

column1: The Phoenix Hawk 2L is compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, upgrading them to a standard beyond the PXH-2. An endo-steel chassis means that an ER large laser and heat sinks can be mounted whilst the machineguns are sacrificed in favour of Guardian ECM.
column2: 凤凰鹰 2L 是一次彻底翻新，设计上与外围区各地无数 PXH-1 变体兼容，把它们升级到超越 PXH-2 的标准。内骨骼底盘意味着可以安装 ER 大型激光和散热器，同时牺牲机枪以换取守护者 ECM。

column1: Like all PXH-3 models, the 3D is an upgraded Phoenix Hawk using rediscovered technology. By upgrading Davion's favorite 1D variant with an Endo-Steel chassis and XL engine, Davion scouts can cram quite a lot of firepower into their scout 'Mechs. To sustain the extra laser firepower the design replaces all single heat sinks with doubles, further improving upon the cooling upgrades from its parent variant. Whilst it lacks the Ferro-Fibrous armor of its Kuritan counterpart, the design does make room for an AMS system, allowing it to dive behind cover without having to worry about indirect fire.
column2: 与所有 PXH-3 型号一样，3D 是使用重新发现技术的凤凰鹰升级版。通过给达维昂最爱的 1D 变体升级内骨骼底盘和 XL 引擎，达维昂侦察兵能在侦察机甲中塞进相当多的火力。为支撑额外的激光火力，该设计把所有单散热器换成双倍散热器，在母变体的散热升级基础上更进一步。虽然缺少其库瑞塔对应型的铁纤维装甲，该设计却腾出空间装了一套 AMS 系统，使它能躲到掩体后而不必担心间接火力。

column1: The 3K Phoenix Hawk is another upgrade of the design that uses rediscovered technologies. Inspired by the 1K variant, the 3K uses an XL engine to upgrade the firepower to Medium Pulse and ER Large Lasers as well as reintroducing House Kurita to jump jets. Taking the 1K's additional heat sinks and upgrading those to doubles alongisde an Ferro-Fibrous armor upgrade means that the 'Mech can stay in the fight for longer, though it remains a scout at heart. It is notably the only PXH-3 variant that does not include AMS.
column2: 3K 凤凰鹰是该设计又一次使用重新发现技术的升级。受 1K 变体启发，3K 用 XL 引擎把火力升级为中型脉冲激光和 ER 大型激光，也把跳跃推进器重新带回库瑞塔家族。它继承 1K 的额外散热器并升级为双倍，同时升级铁纤维装甲，意味着机甲能在战斗中坚持更久——尽管它本质上仍是侦察机甲。值得注意的是，它是唯一不含 AMS 的 PXH-3 变体。

column1: The 3M variant of the Phoenix Hawk was introduced in 3048 alongside everyone else's attempt to upgrade the 'Mech with LosTech, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory. Endo-Steel, double heat sinks and an XL engine allow the design to carry ER Large Lasers and Medium Pulse Lasers. The 'Mech retains a machinegun from the original design, whilst the other is replaced with an Anti Missile System. This gives it slightly more firepower then its Kuritan and Davion brethren, at the cost of fewer heat sinks and slightly worse armor.
column2: 凤凰鹰 3M 变体于 3048 年推出，与各方用失传技术升级该机甲的尝试同期，由地球工厂公司在其基斯通工厂生产。内骨骼、双倍散热器和 XL 引擎使该设计得以携带 ER 大型激光与中型脉冲激光。机甲保留原设计的一挺机枪，另一挺换成反导系统。这使它的火力略强于库瑞塔与达维昂的同门，代价是散热器更少、装甲略差。

column1: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, is another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempts to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine is upgraded to an ExtraLight version and double heat sinks improve heat management. The armor has both been strengthened and replaced with the lighter Ferro Fibrous armor. A large pulse laser adds extra firepower, though it still retains the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system is mounted on the right arm, with CASE protection for its ammo. Its primary difference from other variants is the addition of a MASC system, which allows the 'Mech to reach higher speeds in short bursts.
column2: 该机甲的 3S 型号于 3042 年首次部署，是又一次利用重新发现技术的升级，力图让凤凰鹰在侦察上更有效。引擎升级为超轻型版本，双倍散热器改善散热管理。装甲既被强化，也换成了更轻的铁纤维装甲。一门大型脉冲激光增加额外火力，同时仍保留原版的两门中型激光和机枪。此外右臂还安装一套反导系统，其弹药有 C.A.S.E. 保护。它与其他变体的主要区别在于加装了 MASC 系统，使机甲能在短促爆发中达到更高速度。

column1: The PXH-1b, or Phoenix Hawk 'Special' is a Star League model that manages to be far scarier then even the PHX-3 variants that were introduced not so long ago. Beyond the Endo-Steel chassis and ExtraLight engine that is now more commonly found across the Inner Sphere, the 1b sports a Guardian ECM system and IFF jammer. Its large laser has been upgraded to an ER variant, but on top of its original weaponry the SLDF somehow managed to get an ER PPC in there as well.
column2: PXH-1b，即凤凰鹰"特种"，是一款星盟型号，比不久前推出的 PHX-3 变体还要可怕得多。除内骨骼底盘和如今在内天体更常见的超轻型引擎之外，1b 还装有守护者 ECM 系统和 IFF 干扰器。它的大型激光已升级为 ER 版本，而在原有武器之上，星盟防卫军不知怎的还设法塞进了一门 ER PPC。

column1: A classic for a reason! Very mobile with good punch for it's tonnage. New pilots need to be careful not to overheat though.
column2: 经典自有其道理！机动性极佳，就其吨位而言打击力也不错。不过新手飞行员要小心别过热。

column1: The Phoenix Hawk Special! This upgraded model of the scout 'Mech represents the peak of Star League technology, still being tested when the Exodus happened. Contrasted to the already spectacular 1b, this variant uses an experimental snub nose PPC to bring the weight down for additional armour, making it the most heavily armoured variant of the Phoenix Hawk that I know of. Just like the 1b it carries a full ECM suite.
column2: 凤凰鹰"特种"！这款侦察机甲的升级型号代表星盟技术的巅峰，在出埃及发生时仍在测试中。与已经出色的 1b 相比，此变体使用一门实验性短管 PPC 以降低重量换取额外装甲，使其成为我所知装甲最厚重的凤凰鹰变体。与 1b 一样，它携带全套 ECM 套件。

column1: A classic for a reason! Very mobile with good punch for it's tonnage. New pilots need to be careful not to overheat, but in this case they are protected with some extra armor.
column2: 经典自有其道理！机动性极佳，就其吨位而言打击力也不错。新手飞行员要小心别过热，不过这台机甲多了一层装甲保护。

column1: Piranha
column2: 食人鱼

column1: The Piranha was developed by Clan Diamond Shark to combat conventional infantry and light vehicles. The sheer speed that the BattleMech is capable of has also made it something of a scout, though it lacks sophisticated electronic equipment. The Piranha is protected mostly by its speed.
column2: 食人鱼由钻石鲨氏族开发，用于对抗常规步兵和轻型车辆。这台战斗机甲所能达到的纯粹速度也使它多少充当侦察兵，尽管它缺乏精密电子设备。食人鱼主要靠速度自保。

column1: Quickdraw
column2: 快枪手

column1: Quickdraw 4Gs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
column2: 快枪手 4G 是重型机甲中最快、最机动的一类，武器也相当不错。同时使用全部功能时会出现棘手的过热问题，因此需要一些谨慎。

column1: Quickdraw 4Hs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
column2: 快枪手 4H 是重型机甲中最快、最机动的一类，武器也相当不错。同时使用全部功能时会出现棘手的过热问题，因此需要一些谨慎。

column1: The Quickdraw 5A was designed to give the 'Mech more endurance than the stock 4G. By removing the LRM-10, two additional Medium Lasers and four additional Heat Sinks could be mounted. Unfortunately, the 5A still runs too hot for most pilots.
column2: 快手 5A 的设计目标是为机甲提供比标准 4G 更强的续航力。通过移除 LRM-10，可以加装两门额外中型激光和四台额外散热器。遗憾的是，5A 对大多数飞行员而言仍然过热。

column1: The 5K Quickdraw is an upgraded variant using Star League technology produced by Luthien Armor Works in 3049. Carrying the same weaponry as the 5A model, its use of seventeen double heat sinks solves the problem of excessive waste heat. It also uses Ferro-Fibrous armor, giving the 5K superior armor protection to the 5A model, with no added weight.
column2: 5K 快枪手是卢西恩装甲工厂于 3049 年使用星盟科技生产的升级变体。它携带与 5A 型号相同的武器，但使用十七台双倍散热器解决了废热过多的问题。它还使用铁纤维装甲，使 5K 在不增加重量的情况下拥有优于 5A 的装甲防护。

column1: Rakshasa MDG-1A
column2: 罗刹 MDG-1A

column1: Rakshasa
column2: 罗刹

column1: The Rakshasa was designed by engineers at the New Avalon Institute of Science in an attempt to copy the Mad Cat. The finished product, while not as powerful as the OmniMech it emulates, is a powerful 'Mech with an undeserved bad reputation. The Rakshasa is powered by a GM 375 XL engine and built on a GM Marauder Special MD Endo Steel chassis to save weight and allow the 'Mech to carry as similar a weapons payload as possible to the Mad Cat.
column2: 罗刹由新阿瓦隆科学院的工程师设计，试图复制疯猫。成品虽然不如它所模仿的全能机甲强大，却是一台强悍的机甲，背负着不该有的坏名声。罗刹由一台 GM 375 XL 引擎驱动，基于"GM 掠夺者特种 MD"内骨骼底盘建造，以减轻重量并使机甲能携带尽可能接近疯猫的武器载荷。

column1: Heavy Striker
column2: 重型攻击手

column1: The Rakshasa was designed by engineers at the New Avalon Institute of Science in an attempt to copy the Mad Cat . The finished product, while not as powerful as the OmniMech it emulates, is a powerful 'Mech with an undeserved bad reputation. The Rakshasa is powered by a GM 375 XL engine and built on a GM Marauder Special MD Endo Steel chassis to save weight and allow the 'Mech to carry as similar a weapons payload as possible to the Mad Cat.
column2: 罗刹由新阿瓦隆科学院的工程师设计，试图复制疯猫。成品虽然不如它所模仿的全能机甲强大，却是一台强悍的机甲，背负着不该有的坏名声。罗刹由一台 GM 375 XL 引擎驱动，基于"GM 掠夺者特种 MD"内骨骼底盘建造，以减轻重量并使机甲能携带尽可能接近疯猫的武器载荷。

column1: Raptor
column2: 猛禽

column1: The Raptor began as a proof of concept design by Luthien Armor Works that turned into a respected recon and fast strike OmniMech. The Raptor is built on an Alshain Type KR140 Endo Steel chassis and uses a weight-saving Omni 175 XL Engine, which gives the Raptor a top speed of 118.8 kph.
column2: 猛禽最初是卢西恩装甲工厂的概念验证设计，后来成为广受尊重的侦察与快速打击全能机甲。它建立在 Alshain KR140 型内骨骼底盘上，使用节省重量的 Omni 175 XL 引擎，最高速度达 118.8 公里/小时。

column1: Proto OmniMech
column2: 原型全能机甲

column1: The Raptor A is intended for extended operations from supply lines. The Raptor A carries as its primary weapons two Large Lasers and for close range combat the A configuration carries three Small Lasers.
column2: 猛禽 A 意在远离补给线执行长期任务。它以两门大型激光为主武器，近战方面 A 配置携带三门小型激光。

column1: The B configuration carries three SRM-6 launchers and a Small Laser. This configuration is intended for close combat and works well in a vehicle-hunting role as well as in mop up operations.
column2: B 配置携带三具 SRM-6 发射器和一门小型激光。此配置为近战设计，在反车辆任务和清剿行动中都表现出色。

column1: Configured for medium to close range combat, the C configuration of the Raptor is built to swoop in on a target and overwhelm an enemy with fire from its six Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers and adds two more double heat sinks. For missile defense the Raptor C carries an Anti-Missile System.
column2: 猛禽 C 配置为中近距离战斗而设，旨在扑向目标，用六门中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光压制敌人，并加装两台额外双倍散热器。导弹防御方面，猛禽 C 携带一套反导系统。

column1: Loaded with advanced electronic equipment, the D configuration carries a TAG laser designator, a Beagle Active Probe, and a C3 Slave unit. The Raptor D is armed with a short-range arsenal of three Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Small Lasers. To deter infantry attacks, the D configuration has two Machine Guns. The combination of a Beagle Active Probe with TAG and a C3 slave make the Raptor D an excellent point 'Mech for light C3 lances, since it is able to share targeting information with allied units and also find hidden units and designate them for highly accurate artillery fire.
column2: D 配置装载先进电子设备，携带 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬主动探测器和一台 C3 从属单元。猛禽 D 以三具连续 SRM-2 发射器和两门小型激光构成近程武器库。为威慑步兵攻击，D 配置有两挺机枪。比格犬主动探测器加 TAG 与 C3 从属单元的组合，使猛禽 D 成为轻型 C3 小队的优秀先锋机甲，因为它能与友军共享瞄准信息，也能发现隐藏单位并为高精度炮火标记它们。

column1: A medium range missile barrage 'Mech, the E configuration carries three MRM-10 launchers with a single Small Laser as a backup weapon.
column2: E 配置是一款中程导弹弹幕机甲，携带三具 MRM-10 发射器，以一门小型激光作为备用武器。

column1: Similar to the C configuration, the F configuration of the Raptor carries five ER Medium Lasers and adds three additional double heat sinks. The Raptor F has added maneuverability with the addition of seven jump jets, allowing it to jump up to two hundred and ten meters.
column2: 与 C 配置相似，猛禽 F 配置携带五门 ER 中型激光，并加装三台额外双倍散热器。猛禽 F 通过加装七个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至二百一十米。

column1: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. This configuration mounts an array of Clan-tech Extended Range Lasers, with an ER Large and medium in each arm and a ER Small Laser beside a C3 Slave unit in the center torso.
column2: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。此配置装备一系列氏族科技增程激光：每臂一门 ER 大型和一门 ER 中型，中央躯干一门 ER 小型激光与一台 C3 从属单元并列。

column1: Rifleman II
column2: 步枪手II

column1: The Rifleman II was an upgrade fielded by the SLDF Royals in 2720, adding twenty tons to its overall mass. The Rifleman II used an Endo Steel structure and an XL Engine, and carried a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s and Large Pulse Lasers, one in each arm, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers, a Beagle Active Probe, and fourteen Double Heat Sinks.
column2: 步枪手 II 是星盟防卫军皇家部队于 2720 年装备的升级型，整体质量增加二十吨。步枪手 II 采用内骨骼结构和 XL 引擎，每臂各携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门大型脉冲激光，另有两门中型激光、一具比格犬主动探测器和十四台双倍散热器。

column1: This Chassis is weird boss, it definitely was a Star League Era Design, but it seems to have been rebuilt and repaired so many times that barely anything is left of it, dont even want to speculate how a bunch of Pirates got their hands on it.
column2: 这个底盘很奇怪，老大。它绝对是星盟时代的设计，但似乎被重建和修理过太多次，几乎没剩下什么了。我甚至不想猜测一群海盗是怎么弄到它的。

column1: Rifleman
column2: 步枪手

column1: Designed as a medium fire-support platform, the Rifleman was plagued with a variety of problems since its debut and was ill-suited as a front-line combatant.
column2: 步枪手被设计为中型火力支援平台，自问世以来便受各种问题困扰，并不适合担任前线战斗单位。

column1: The Rifleman is highly specialized at long-range direct-fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way.
column2: 步枪手高度专精于远程直射支援。它的防护与近程武器都不多，所以让它保持距离、远离危险。

column1: The 4D was one of two variants designed by Hanse Davion; it was intended to compete with the heavier Warhammer. It replaced the autocannon/5s with PPCs and removed the medium lasers, using the freed-up weight to mount an five extra heat sinks. In spite of the extra heat sinks, this model suffered from significant overheat problems.
column2: 4D 是汉斯·达维昂设计的两款变体之一，意在对抗更重的战锤。它把自动炮/5 换成 PPC 并移除中型激光，用腾出的重量加装五台额外散热器。尽管增加了散热器，该型号仍受严重过热问题困扰。

column1: Anti-Aircraft & Direct-Fire Support
column2: 防空与直射火力支援

column1: This variant removes all of the weapons and equipment, and replaces them with four Ultra Autocannon/2s and six tons of ammunition. The weight saved, plus a half ton from armor, is used to upgrade the engine to allow the 'Mech a top speed of 64 km/h. MechWarriors must be exceptionally wary of the large, vulnerable ammo bins.
column2: 此变体移除全部武器与装备，换成四门超速自动炮/2 和六吨弹药。节省的重量加上半吨装甲用于升级引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64 公里/小时。机甲战士必须格外警惕那些庞大而脆弱的弹药箱。

column1: Direct-Fire Support
column2: 直接火力支援

column1: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra Autocannon/5 in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the A is fitted with sixteen Double Heat Sinks and four tons of UAC ammo.
column2: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 RFL-3N 步枪手的现代演绎。A 变体在每臂装备一门大型脉冲激光和一门超速自动炮/5，两侧躯干各由一门 ER 中型激光支援。它以 260 级 XL 引擎、内骨骼框架和十吨铁纤维装甲为基础，配十六台双倍散热器和四吨 UAC 弹药。

column1: Simple, straightforward, and accurate; the Rifleman IIC is armed with four Large Pulse Lasers. This allows it to pick apart enemies from a respectable range, as well as easily target incoming aircraft. A single ER Small Laser is installed, seemingly as an afterthought. Nineteen double heat sinks keep heat mostly in check, though volley fire should be used.
column2: 简单、直接而精准；步枪手 IIC 装备四门大型脉冲激光，使其能在相当远的距离拆解敌人，也能轻松瞄准来袭飞行器。一门 ER 小型激光像是事后想起才装上的。十九台双倍散热器基本能压制热量，不过仍应使用齐射。

column1: Roughneck
column2: 粗汉

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. Featuring a mixed if short ranged weapons loadout, the Roughneck's primary weapons are an AC/10 and SRM-4 in its torsos, supported by a trio of Machine Guns and a head-mounted Small Laser. While tying it to supply lines, two tons of SRM and autocannon rounds provide adequate field endurance, only a ton and a half of rounds supporting three machine guns run dry quickly.
column2: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。它的武器配置杂糅而偏近程，主武器是躯干上的 AC/10 和 SRM-4，辅以三挺机枪和头部一门小型激光。虽然这让它依赖补给线，但两吨 SRM 与自动炮弹药提供了足够的野战续航，仅有一吨半弹药支撑三挺机枪，很快就打光。

column1: Militarized Loadermech
column2: 军用装载机甲

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1B swaps the AC/10 of the -1A for an AC/5 and upgrades the missiles to a pair of SRM 6 racks. The Small Laser and two of the Machine Guns are retained.
column2: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。粗汉-1B 把-1A 的 AC/10 换成 AC/5，并把导弹升级为两具 SRM 6 挂架。小型激光和其中两挺机枪得以保留。

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1C leans hard on its missiles for firepower, carrying a pair of SRM 6s and a pair of Machine Guns for close range power, with long range firepower provided by a LRM 10 and an AC/5.
column2: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。粗汉-1C 的火力重度依赖导弹，携带两具 SRM 6 和两挺机枪负责近程，远程火力则由一具 LRM 10 和一门 AC/5 提供。

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-3A is an advanced technology version of the Roughneck that makes heavy use of Double Heat Sinks to power an all-energy loadout of 2 PPCs, 4 Medium Lasers, and a solitary Small Laser. 18 Double Heat Sinks keep the mech nice and cool.
column2: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。粗汉-3A 是粗汉的先进技术版本，大量使用双倍散热器来驱动一套全能量配置：2 门 PPC、4 门中型激光和一门单独的小型激光。18 台双倍散热器让机甲保持凉爽。

column1: he Savage Coyote OmniMech was created as a showcase OmniMech. The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
column2: 野蛮郊狼全能机甲是作为展示型全能机甲而打造的。这台机甲也是可汗科加重振发明全能机甲却日渐衰落的氏族的努力之一。

column1: The primary configuration of the Savage Coyote makes use of a pair of the largest ATM, An ER PPC, an LB-X Autocannon/10, three ER Medium Lasers, and a pair of ER Small Lasers. MechWarriors must carefully manage heat levels, even with three additional double heat sinks
column2: 野蛮郊狼主配置使用一对最大的 ATM、一门 ER PPC、一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、三门 ER 中型激光和一对 ER 小型激光。即便有三台额外双倍散热器，机甲战士也必须小心管理热量水平

column1: Sentry
column2: 哨兵

column1: The Sentry was developed under pressure from the Draconis and Capellan marches for a more advanced 'Mech to defend the borders of the Federated Suns. The 'Mech is built on a light weight Dorwinion hyperactive 3 Endo Steel chassis. This chassis saves weight, allowing the 'Mech to carry heavier weapons and equipment. The Sentry is powered by a Nissan 200 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h that is augmented by five HildCo Model 12 jump jets that make it possible for the Sentry to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. To compensate for its less than average mobility, the Sentry has an impressive eight and a half tons of Starshield A armor that has been fitted with CASE to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion.
column2: 哨兵是在德拉科尼斯与卡佩兰边疆区压力下开发的，旨在为保卫联邦太阳系边境提供一款更先进的机甲。机甲基于轻量化的"多温尼恩亢奋 3"内骨骼底盘建造。这一底盘节省重量，使机甲能携带更重的武器和装备。哨兵由一台日产 200 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，并由五个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器增强，使哨兵能跳起至一百五十米。为弥补其低于平均的机动性，哨兵拥有令人印象深刻的八吨半"星盾 A"装甲，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸。

column1: The Sentry has a diverse mix of weapons that allow it to carry out a wide variety of missions. For anti-'Mech and vehicle combat the Sentry carries a Parti-Kill PPC and a pair of Magna 200P Small Pulse Lasers which can double as anti-infantry weapons. For anti-infantry and crowd control missions, the Sentry has a quartet of Sperry Browning Machine Guns and a Zippo Flamer.
column2: 哨兵武器搭配多样，能执行多种任务。反机甲与车辆战斗方面，哨兵携带一门"党杀"PPC 和两门"玛格纳 200P"小型脉冲激光，后者可兼任反步兵武器。反步兵与人群控制任务方面，哨兵有四挺"斯佩里-勃朗宁"机枪和一具"芝宝"火焰喷射器。

column1: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
column2: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

column1: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
column2: 最初且缺陷颇多的原型机于 2680 年完成。以影鹰 SHD-2H 为基础，该机甲以一门 2 级自动炮取代 5 级。SHD-X1 仅有 6.5 吨装甲用于防护。因其图纸错误导致多次坠机，仅有一台机体幸存。它的最高地面速度与前辈 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 公里/小时，并使用十台单散热器。

column1: REPORT ME
column2: 报告我

column1: BRING THE LOG TO DISCORD SO WE CAN FIX THIS APPEARING OR GET REKTED AGAIN!
column2: 把日志发到 Discord 让我们修复这个显示问题，否则又要被虐！

column1: First introduced in 2467, this first generation of the Shadow Hawk employs early BattleMech technology in its weaponry, equipment and its armor. This design was first produced by Lang Industries on Caph, where it was designed as part of the Hegemony's efforts to keep ahead of the Inner Sphere's newly stolen BattleMech technology.
column2: 影鹰的第一代于 2467 年首次推出，其武器、装备与装甲都采用早期战斗机甲技术。该设计最初由卡夫星上的朗工业制造，是霸权为保持领先于内天体新近窃取战斗机甲技术的努力的一部分。

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2D is an interesting model. Its default payload sacrifices a lot of armor to mount a bit more firepower, though some argue the tradeoff isn't worth it. Its Alpha Strikes are better, though, soÔÇª I guess you can be the judge.
column2: 暗影鹰 2D 是一款有趣的型号。它的默认载荷牺牲大量装甲以装备略多火力，尽管有人认为这一取舍不值得。不过它的齐射确实更好，所以……我想你可以自行评判。

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular.
column2: 暗影鹰 2H 是"样样通吃"的完美范例。它具备适用于所有射程的武器，速度与跳跃能力可观，装甲也相当不错。代价是它在任何方面都不特别出众。

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2Hb was designed for the Star League's Royal regiments, which changed the mission profile to favor close range engagements exclusively. The -2Hb has little at range but is deadly dangerous up close thanks to its heavy weapons load.
column2: 影鹰 2Hb 为星盟皇家团设计，任务定位改为专门偏好近距离交战。-2Hb 在远距离几乎无能为力，但凭借重型武器装载，近身时极为凶险。

column1: Line Assault
column2: 阵线突击

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
column2: 影鹰 2I 变体配备一门 UAC/10 和一具凶恶的燃烧弹发射器，但为此牺牲了跳跃能力。

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2K removes all the armaments of the original, aside from its LRM-5, and replaces them with a single PPC.  Five additional Heat Sinks are also added to help with the excess heat.
column2: 影鹰 2K 移除原版除 LRM-5 之外的全部武器，换成单门 PPC，并加装五台额外散热器以应对多余热量。

column1: The 2K model is a poor man's Griffin, and is underarmed for its weight class.
column2: 2K 型号是穷人版的狮鹫，火力配置低于其重量级别。

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
column2: 影鹰 2Ki 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2803 年第一次继承战争期间构想。当愤怒的联邦太阳系将库瑞塔部队击退时，联合体大幅改造底盘，替换了几乎所有原始武器，最显著的是用一门升级版 PPC 换下自动炮。

column1: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
column2: 5M 影鹰是该设计的首次彻底翻修与升级，由地球工厂于 3048 年为自由世界联盟推出。底盘升级为地球工厂 SHD II 内骨骼框架，增加一吨装甲，加装两个跳跃推进器使总跳跃距离达 150 米，引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 的超轻型版本，武器配置几乎全面翻新。原始自动炮升级为帝皇超速自动炮/5，LRM 发射器换为末日芽 LRM-20，头部 SRM 发射器换为霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2。弹药携带量与左臂中型激光保持不变，散热器数量虽减至十台但升级为双倍强度型号。

column1: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed to expensive too produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
column2: 5MI 由马弗里克工业打造，是马里克家族 5M 型号的重新设计。为与狮鹫 1DS 及其他新设计竞争，马弗里克试图借此赢得固执的联邦联邦军方青睐。5MI 聚焦于提升生存性与战场续航，采用 DHS 与 Artemis IV 火控系统等新技术以获得优势。遗憾的是该设计被认为生产成本过高，军方因此拒绝采购首批量产的任何一台。如此糟糕的表现导致第二轮生产被取消，资源被转投更有前途的生产线。幸存的型号被卖给各佣兵团，不过马弗里克工业的继承人在第 10 莱兰卫队服役期间使用过一台，为公司从团队袍泽那里赢得了零星的改装或定制订单。

column1: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
column2: 5S 是特种部队使用的 5M 变体。它将所有标准武器换成一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光。此外还携带比格犬主动探测器和一套 ECM 套件。

column1: Shadowhawk
column2: 影鹰

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC that Inner Sphere forces encountered is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。内天体部队遭遇的第一版影鹰 IIC 是为近战而设，看起来在设计时考虑了城市战。

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. This variant is designed for long-range, direct-fire support.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。此变体为远程直射支援而设计。

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。较新的变体，可追溯至 3050 年代末，IIC 3 的主炮是一门重型大型激光。

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。

column1: Shootist
column2: 枪手

column1: The Shootist first saw service in 2621 as a heavily armored, electronic warfare-capable command 'Mech for SLDF Royal BattleMech Regiments. However, the Shootist's upgraded electronic suites proved no match for the cutting edge of electronic warfare of its own time. When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches.
column2: 射击手于 2621 年首次服役，作为星盟防卫军皇家战斗机甲团的重视装甲、具备电子战能力的指挥机甲。然而射击手升级后的电子套件被证明敌不过同代最前沿的电子战。当战将在射击手推出仅十年后就在其预定的指挥车辆角色上超越它时，星盟防卫军改变了射击手的任务参数。射击手均衡的武器与速度搭配以及厚重装甲让它获得了新角色：近战重型小队的主宰者，后来又成为指挥小队的护卫单位。这一角色从未有利于射击手的长久存续；自继承战争以来，这台战斗机甲在康卫、布雷克之言民兵和古老的氏族布莱恩仓库之外已很少见到。

column1: The Shootist has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, giving it an average level of mobility for a heavy 'Mech. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks that allow the Shootist to dissipate the waste heat that is produced by its heavy weapons payload. The Shootist carries twelve tons of MV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect the 'Mech in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Shootist is armed to engage an enemy at various ranges. The only long-range weapon on the 'Mech is a Blankenburg ER Large Laser that has an effective range of five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the Shootist carries a devastating Deathgiver Autocannon/20 which is capable of downing most light and even some medium 'Mechs in a single salvo. Finally, for point blank defense, the 'Mech has two Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and a Dinatech Mark III Small Laser.
column2: 射击手最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，对重型机甲而言机动性属中等水平。机甲有十三台双倍散热器，使射击手能散发其沉重武器载荷产生的废热。射击手携带十二吨 MV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E.，在弹药爆炸时保护机甲。射击手武装到能在多种距离交战。机甲上唯一的远程武器是一门"布兰肯堡"ER 大型激光，有效射程五百七十米。中近程战斗方面，射击手携带一门毁灭性的"死亡赐予者"自动炮/20，单次齐射就能击倒大多数轻型甚至某些中型机甲。最后，抵近防御方面，机甲有两门"布兰肯堡"中型脉冲激光和一门"迪纳科技 Mark III"小型激光。

column1: Sidewinder SW-PRIME
column2: 响尾蛇 SW-原装型

column1: Sidewinder
column2: 响尾蛇

column1: Sling
column2: 投石索

column1: Meant mostly as a high-speed fire support unit, the minimally-armored Sling was meant to remain out of the way of enemy fire, saturating the target area with its fifteen long-range missile tubes.
column2: 投石索主要作为高速火力支援单位，装甲极少，意在远离敌方火力，用十五根远程导弹发射管饱和覆盖目标区域。

column1: With all those Thunder LRM's, the SL-1G can lay a minefield anywhere and anytime you need one. You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
column2: 凭借那些雷霆 LRM，SL-1G 能在你需要布雷的任何时间地点布设雷场。不过你得小心使用它，因为它可经不起多少打击。

column1: Meant as a more traditional skirmish unit, the SL-1H replaced all three missile launchers with a pair of standard medium lasers and a single medium pulse laser.
column2: SL-1H 意在成为更传统的散兵单位，它以一对标准中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光取代了全部三具导弹发射器。

column1: This one packs a nasty punch for a light mech.  You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
column2: 这台机甲作为轻型机甲打击力凶狠。不过你得小心使用它，因为它可经不起多少打击。

column1: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 kph. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat.
column2: 蛇是一台在"元素猎手"名义下建造的机甲。不过事后看来，蛇显然是为猎杀内天体战斗装甲服而设计的。机甲采用 VOX 225 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。蛇还具备一百五十米的跳跃能力，使其能胜过任何战斗装甲服，也能与大多数中型机甲并驾齐驱。蛇还披挂七吨装甲，并使用双倍散热器散发机甲的多余热量。

column1: The Snake's primary weapon is a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 which can fire both standard rounds as well as firing cluster rounds which act like 'Mech sized shotgun shells. The 'Mech is also armed with three Hovertec Streak SRM-2s which are highly effective in finding weak spots in an enemy's armor or against Inner Sphere battle armor.
column2: 蛇的主武器是一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹，也能发射类似机甲级霰弹的集束弹。机甲还装备三门"气垫"连续 SRM-2，在寻找敌方装甲弱点或对付内天体战斗装甲时极为有效。

column1: Spector
column2: 幽灵

column1: The Spector was originally designed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs to be a lighter version of the Exterminator BattleMech, made to hunt down light command 'Mechs. The first Spector rolled off the assembly line on 6 June, 2639, and following extensive testing the SLDF ordered 600. The Star League's enthusiasm for the Spector is due to the BattleMechs stealth capabilities, a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield
column2: 幽灵最初由北欧风暴战斗机甲设计，作为灭绝者的轻型版本，用于猎杀轻型指挥机甲。首台幽灵于 2639 年 6 月 6 日下线，经大量测试后星盟防卫军订购了 600 台。星盟对幽灵的热情源于其隐形能力——变色龙光偏振护盾

column1: Headhunter
column2: 猎头者

column1: Spider
column2: 蜘蛛

column1: The 5D Spider is geared towards anti-infantry work, removing one of the medium lasers and replacing it with a Flamer in the right arm.  However, the combination of its speed with the Flamer can deliver an unpleasant surprise.
column2: 5D 蜘蛛偏重反步兵工作，移除一门中型激光，在右臂换成火焰喷射器。不过它的速度与火焰喷射器的组合能带来不愉快的惊喜。

column1: An anti-infantry variant, the 5K mounts Machine Guns in each arm along with a single Medium Laser in its center torso.  In order to make room for the added weapons, a pair of JumpJets are removed, hampering some of the Spider's vaunted mobility.
column2: 5K 是反步兵变体，每臂安装机枪，中央躯干一门中型激光。为给新增武器腾出空间，移除了两个跳跃推进器，削弱了蜘蛛引以为傲的部分机动性。

column1: The Spider 5V is hands down the most maneuverable 'Mech you can fieldÔÇª but it's made of paper. It's an excellent scout, though, and can even jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots.
column2: 蜘蛛 5V 毫无疑问是你能派上场的最灵活机动的机甲……但它纸糊一般。不过它是出色的侦察机甲，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方射界，来一记出其不意的背射。

column1: The 7M was Nimakachi's upgrade of the venerable Spider with recovered Star League technology. Released in 3051 it uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and three tons of Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing up weight to replace the two medium lasers with two Tronel XII medium pulse lasers. Many of the components were also replaced with proprietary technology, including Rawlings 75 jump jets, an Omicron 4002 Networking Channel, and a TRSS Eagle Eye targeting system. One thing they could not do however was include an ejection system for the pilot.
column2: 7M 是尼玛卡奇用回收的星盟科技对古老蜘蛛的升级。它于 3051 年发布，使用十字-II 豪华内骨骼底盘和三吨卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维装甲，腾出重量把两门中型激光换成两门特罗内尔 XII 中型脉冲激光。许多部件也换成自有技术，包括罗林斯 75 跳跃推进器、奥米克戎 4002 网络通道和 TRSS 鹰眼瞄准系统。然而有一件事他们做不到：为飞行员加装弹射系统。

column1: The 8M is a simple upgrade of the 7M developed by the FWLM in 3060, replacing the single heat sinks with double strength versions. Otherwise, both variants are completely identical.
column2: 8M 是 FWLM 于 3060 年开发的 7M 简单升级版，把单散热器换成双倍强度型号。除此之外，两个变体完全相同。

column1: This Draconis Combine variant, introduced in 3054 and based on the 7M, swaps out one of the pulse lasers for a standard medium and a C3 Slave Unit.
column2: 这款德拉科尼斯联合体变体于 3054 年推出，以 7M 为基础，将其中的一门脉冲激光换成标准中型激光和一台 C3 从属单元。

column1: The Spider I1 is a cheap refit from the Frontier Worlds that comes with a Plasma Cutter and Fluid Gun, along with marginally improved armour.
column2: 蜘蛛 I1 是边疆世界出品的廉价改装型，配备等离子切割器和流体枪，装甲也略有改善。

column1: Cheap refit
column2: 廉价改装

column1: Stalker
column2: 潜行者

column1: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry, even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely.
column2: 潜行者 3F 装备的武器数量即便对突击机甲而言也荒唐得多。它还以极其糟糕的散热管理著称，这是它为如此惊人的伤害输出付出的代价。强大，但需明智使用。

column1: Created for the Star League's Royal regiments, the Stalker-3Fb is much like its lesser kin: a walking death machine. It carries a similar payload but makes use of lostech double heat sinks to cool down much more effectively, letting it fire continuously much longer than a normal Stalker-3F.
column2: 潜行者-3Fb 为星盟皇家团打造，与其较弱的同类一样：一台行走的死亡机器。它携带相似的有效载荷，但使用失传技术双倍散热器更高效地降温，使其能比普通潜行者-3F 持续开火久得多。

column1: The Stalker 3H was intended as a seige 'Mech.  Replacing the twin LRM-10s and Large Lasers for paired LRM-20s, the STK-3H is a powerful fire support 'Mech.
column2: 潜行者 3H 本意是作为攻城机甲。STK-3H 以成对的 LRM-20 取代双联 LRM-10 和大型激光，是一款强大的火力支援机甲。

column1: Juggernaut & Heavy Fire Support
column2: 重装与重型火力支援

column1: By removing one of the LRM launchers and adding more Heat Sinks, the Stalker 4N can dish out more damage per round without as much fear of baking the pilot alive.
column2: 通过移除一具 LRM 发射器并增加更多散热器，潜行者 4N 每回合能造成更多伤害，而不必太担心把飞行员活活烤熟。

column1: Due to ongoing structual weakness issues with the aging Stalker chassis, it was necessary to reduce the load by 10 tons by removing a LRM launcher effectively reclassifying this variant as a Heavy 'Mech.
column2: 由于老化的潜行者底盘持续存在结构强度问题，有必要移除一具 LRM 发射器以减载 10 吨，这实际上把该变体重新归类为重型机甲。

column1: Juggernaut & Ranged Heavy
column2: 重装与远程重型

column1: Stealth
column2: 潜行者

column1: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 kph and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 kph in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units.
column2: 隐形是联邦太阳系与莱兰联盟使用的重型侦察机甲。它采用 GM 315 XL 引擎，速度可达 118.8 公里/小时，机上的 MASC 系统可在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。这一惊人机动性由跳跃推进器进一步增强，隐形可跳跃至二百一十米。它还配备了独眼巨人-比格犬主动探测器，可用于寻找隐藏的敌方单位。

column1: The Stealth is armed with an eclectic short range weapons arsenal. The primary weapons in this arsenal are a pair of Diplan M3 Medium Lasers which are backed up by a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 and a Federated SuperStreak Streak SRM-2 which both allow the 'Mech to find weak spots in an enemy 'Mech's armor.
column2: 潜行者装备一套兼收并蓄的近程武器。这套武器的主武器是一对"迪普兰 M3"中型激光，辅以一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 和一具"联邦超级连续"连续 SRM-2，两者都让机甲能寻找敌方机甲装甲上的弱点。

column1: Stiletto
column2: 短剑

column1: The original Stinger LAM used by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions, this version carried a Medium Pulse Laser and replaced the Machine Guns with Small Pulse Lasers. Double heat sinks kept the temperature manageable. It was also more heavily armored than its forerunner, carrying five tons of protection.
column2: 这是星盟防卫军皇家师使用的原始毒刺 LAM，此版本携带一门中型脉冲激光，并以轻型脉冲激光取代机枪。双倍散热器使温度可控。它的装甲也较前型更厚，携带五吨防护。

column1: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms.
column2: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。标准量产型使用三门玛格纳中型激光，分装于头部与双臂。

column1: Stinger
column2: 毒刺

column1: Designed as a fast, jump-capable reconnaissance platform, the Stinger has served capably in that role for well over half a millennium, a testament to the utility of the original design
column2: 作为一款快速、具备跳跃能力的侦察平台，毒刺在这一角色上已称职服役超过半个千年，印证了原始设计的实用性

column1: Long history and all, Best to keep these units at range for flanking and spotting.
column2: 尽管历史悠久，最好还是让这些单位保持距离进行侧翼与侦察。

column1: The SLDF improved upon the stock Stinger with the addition of many new technologies unavailable when the 'Mech was first designed. Designed as a fast, jump-capable reconnaissance platform, the Stinger has served capably in that role for well over half a millennium, a testament to the utility of the original design.
column2: 星盟防卫军以多项在机甲最初设计时尚不可得的新技术改良了标准毒刺。作为一款快速、具备跳跃能力的侦察平台，毒刺在这一角色上已称职服役超过半个千年，印证了原始设计的实用性。

column1: The Royal Stinger, nice find. But still best to keep these units at range for flanking and spotting.
column2: 皇家毒刺，好东西。但还是最好让这些单位保持距离，用于侧翼包抄和目标指示。

column1: This upgraded version of the Stinger produced by Earthwerks Incorporated on Keystone and Calloway VI took advantage of several technologies that were rediscovered, thanks in part to the Helm Memory Core. The chassis was upgraded to an Earthwerks STG II Endo Steel model, allowing it to carry an additional half-ton of armor. The 'Mech retained the Omicron medium laser but swapped the machine guns for a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System on its right arm and a Flame Tech Flamer on its left. One ton of AMS ammo was carried in the right torso, while the Datacom 26 and Dynatec 990 electronic systems remain unchanged.
column2: 这款毒刺升级版由地球工厂公司在基斯通与卡洛威 VI 生产，得益于多项重新发现的技术，其中部分要归功于赫尔姆记忆核心。底盘升级为地球工厂 STG II 内骨骼型号，使其能多携带半吨装甲。机甲保留奥米克戎中型激光，但把机枪换成右臂的林德布拉德霰弹反导系统和左臂的火焰科技火焰喷射器。右躯干携带一吨 AMS 弹药，而 Datacom 26 与 Dynatec 990 电子系统保持不变。

column1: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8kph. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms.
column2: 石犀牛 5 基于"阿马里斯之愚"的早期规格设计，使用 400XL 引擎达到最高 64.8 公里/小时的速度。它在躯干安装四门 LB-5X 自动炮，并以臂部六门 ER 中型激光作为补充。

column2: 风暴鸦

column2: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为近战。

column2: 近战战斗机甲

column2: 风暴鸦 SCR-B

column2: 精确打击战斗机甲

column2: 风暴鸦 SCR-C
