column1: Utilizing locally produced components such as the Kali Yama Big Bore autocannon and Hellion-V medium lasers, the Kali Yama-produced 5M Hunchback is a simple upgrade of the original 4G model that first saw production in 3046. The most notable changes saw the heat sinks upgraded to double-strength models, while the small laser was upgraded to a Sunglow Prism-Optic Small Pulse Laser, and CASE was added to protect against ammunition explosions. The extra weight required to add the newer systems forced Kali Yama to reduced ammunition storage to a single ton of reloads, making it unpopular with MechWarriors and spawning the unofficial HBK-5N variant.
column2: 5M 驼背由卡利亚马生产，使用本地制造的部件如卡利亚马大口径自动炮和海利昂-V 中型激光，是原 4G 型号的简单升级，于 3046 年首次投产。最显著的变化是散热器升级为双倍强度型号，小型激光升级为"日辉"棱镜光学小型脉冲激光，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装新系统所需的额外重量迫使卡利亚马把弹药储存减至一吨再装填，这让机甲战士颇为不满，也催生了非官方的 HBK-5N 变体。

column1: A very simple FWLM field upgrade of the lackluster 5M Hunchback introduced in 3057, the 5N model simply downgrades the pulse laser back to a small laser and removes the CASE to carry an extra ton of reloads, retaining the double heat sinks.
column2: 5N 型号是 3057 年推出的平淡无奇的 5M 驼背的极简 FWLM 野战升级，它把脉冲激光降级回小型激光，并移除 C.A.S.E. 以多携带一吨再装填，同时保留双倍散热器。

column1: This variant, produced in 3059, was Kali Yama's response to the complaints about the lack of AC/20 ammunition that spawned the ad hoc -5N field refit. The -6N removes three extra double heat sinks and replaces them with three more tons of reloads.
column2: 此变体于 3059 年生产，是卡利亚马对"AC/20 弹药不足"抱怨的回应——正是那些抱怨催生了临时的-5N 野战改装。-6N 移除三台额外双倍散热器，换成三吨额外弹药。

column1: The Archer 8L is a prototype chassis designed to provide fire support with 2 Arrow IV Launchers loaded with Incendiary Missiles and the newly developed Guardian ECM and Stealth Armor.
column2: 弓箭手 8L 是原型底盘，旨在以 2 具装填燃烧弹的箭矢 IV 发射器，加上新研制的守护者 ECM 与隐形装甲提供火力支援。

column1: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.
column2: 此 C3 变体将机甲远程火力支援提升到新层次：拆掉两具 LRM-15 发射器，换成一套箭矢 IV 火炮系统，使投石机得以与战场保持安全距离。

column1: A Heavier Clan Tech upgraded Catapult. This Variant swapped its main weaponry for Arrow IV artillery system.
column2: 一款更重的氏族技术升级版弹射器。此变体把主武器换成箭矢 IV 火炮系统。

column1: Dragon II
column2: 龙 II

column1: The Dragon II is a Heavy BattleMech built by LAW for the armed forces of the Draconis Combine during the post-Jihad era. Built as a successor to the aging Dragon, the 'Mech was designed with Advanced Technology to allow it to handle threats of the new era. The design was phased in as a replacement to the older Dragons, which were nearing the end of their service lives.
column2: 龙 II 是 LAW 为德拉科尼斯联合体武装力量在后圣战时代建造的重型战斗机甲。作为老化的龙的继任者，该机甲以先进技术设计，以应对新时代的威胁。它被逐步引入，以替换寿命将至的老旧龙。

column1: Helepolis
column2: 攻城塔

column1: First unleashed by the Terran Hegemony in 2460, the Helepolis is a ponderous BattleMech designed to deliver artillery fire. The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
column2: 攻城塔于 2460 年由地球霸权首次推出，是一款笨重的战斗机甲，用于投送炮火。它多次被证明效果不佳，2775 年生产设施被毁后，该设计在继承战争中失传。HEP-2H 可追溯至 2488 年。

column1: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
column2: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

column1: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
column2: 5A 在氏族入侵期间开发，利用了新近重新引入的箭矢 IV 与 Artemis IV 火控系统。它旨在支援一个小队或作为专用炮组的一员，混合携带寻的导弹与多用途弹药；既能轰击被友军标记的目标，也能按需布撒 FASCAM 等特种弹药。守护者 ECM 扰乱并致盲敌方传感器，大幅降低其精准反炮击的可能，而 C.A.S.E. 的使用则防止灾难性的弹药爆炸。作为卡利亚马对战争努力的贡献，该设计向任何有意买家出售，已遍布内天体，并越来越多地出现在对可靠廉价火炮资产需求旺盛的外围区。

column1: Arrow IV Boat
column2: 箭矢 IV 火力平台

column1: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a Word of Blake designed upgrade to the older 4E design. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the design with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older design. Installing a new Light Fusion Engine and Endo Steel enabled the designers to swap the Thumper for the much larger and more powerful Sniper Artillery Canon. Defensively the design mounts CASE to protect against the ammunition explosions that plagued the older 4E model. A swap to ER Lasers and DHS round out the design, giving it increased range and striking power. Popular with Hunchback pilots and Artillery units, the design is slated for continuous production; with Kali Yama having to expand their Hunchback line to keep up with demand.
column2: 5E 于 3063 年亮相，是布雷克之言为较老的 4E 设计所作的升级。为在保护国民兵单位与自由世界联盟编队中部署，布雷克派谋求用更新的技术重建该设计，并纠正旧设计中明显的缺陷。安装新的轻型聚变引擎与内骨骼，使设计师得以把重锤换成大得多、威力也强得多的狙击炮。防御方面，该设计装设 C.A.S.E. 以防困扰旧 4E 型号的弹药爆炸。激光换成 ER 型号并配 DHS，为设计收尾，赋予其更远的射程与更强的打击力。它受驼背飞行员与炮兵单位欢迎，被排入持续生产；卡利亚马不得不扩建其驼背生产线以满足需求。

column1: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
column2: 麦基 9Hb 在阿马里斯内战期间建造，是为解决星盟防卫军先进突击机甲突然短缺的权宜之计。通过从霸权剩余库存中取用麦基 9H 并以剩余部件升级，星盟防卫军希望打造一款用于后方梯队与支援任务的多用途突击机甲，从而腾出装备更精良的机器用于前线。9Hb 装备两门重锤火炮与一个驾驶舱指挥台，兼具指挥机甲与火炮支援平台的功能。虽然作为支援单位表现出色，但在直接战斗中表现糟糕。尤其致命的是弹药匣周围缺乏 C.A.S.E.，这是设计过程仓促的后果。

column1: A clan buster refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design in a cheap and easy to maintain upgrade package. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers disregarded the other weakness – the designs slow ground speed – as being of lesser importance. The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
column2: 9Hc 是利用康星封存的 9Hb 开发的"破氏族"改装型，旨在以廉价易维护的升级包修正前型设计的缺陷。康卫设计师认定缺乏 C.A.S.E. 与足够的次要武器是关键弱点，而将设计的另一缺陷——地面速度缓慢——视为次要。设计师选择内骨骼骨架为首选方案，否决了其他更昂贵的解决途径。两个弹匣都安装了 C.A.S.E.，并将中型激光升级为 ER 版本；过程中还额外加装 3 门，并配以双倍散热器以平衡热量尖峰。5 台完成的原型机在图卡伊德表现出色，尽管该设计从未进入量产；在布雷克之言夺取地球及其剩余的 9Hb 库存前，仅又完成了 2 台改装。.

column1: Naga
column2: 娜迦

column1: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems.
column2: 娜迦是第一代樵夫全能机甲的支援后继型，但在许多方面都颇为另类。本可作为吊舱空间的大部分位置，实际被两套固定式箭矢 IV 火炮系统占据。

column1: This design mounts only five tons of ammo. It also carries an ER Small Laser and a pair of ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 该设计仅携带五吨弹药。它还装有一门 ER 小型激光和一对 ER 中型激光。

column1: This variant carries four tons of ammunition, three ER Mediums and an ER Small.
column2: 此型号携带四吨弹药、三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。

column1: The C Configuration carries four ammo bins that can each hold a ton for the artillery weapons. For backup, it has a pair of ER Small Lasers and an SRM-6s.
column2: C 配置携带四个弹药箱，每个可为火炮武器装载一吨弹药。作为后备，它有一对 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-6。

column1: This variant downgrades the missile launcher of the C to an SRM-4 and upgrades one of the ER Smalls to an ER Medium Laser.
column2: 此变体把 C 型的导弹发射器降级为 SRM-4，并把其中一门 ER 小型激光升级为 ER 中型激光。

column1: This fast assault 'Mech mounts a meager nine tons of armor, but tactical doctrine keeps it far from the front lines. The Naga is often derided because it rarely allows for the glory that comes from an individual kill.
column2: 这款快速突击机甲只装九吨装甲，但战术条令让它远离前线。娜迦常被嘲笑，因为它很少带来个人击杀所能获得的荣耀。

column1: This Naga Replaces the ARROW IV Launchers with LRMS.
column2: 此娜迦用 LRM 替换了箭矢 IV 发射器。

column1: Well I guess the society decided they could make an artillery mech an LRM boat.
column2: 好吧，我猜 society 决定把一台火炮机甲改造成 LRM 平台。

column1: O-Bakemono
column2: 大妖怪

column1: The O-Bakemono weighs in at eighty tons and has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, which is considered a good ground speed for an assault 'Mech..
column2: O-Bakemono 重达八十吨，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，对突击机甲而言这是不错的地面速度。

column1: The M11 downgrades the O-Bakemono's engine to a standard 240 Pitban, reducing its top speed to 54 km/h. The artillery pieces, along with their expensive ammunition, are removed and replaced with a pair of cheap MRM 40s.
column2: M11 把 O-Bakemono 的引擎降级为标准皮特班 240，把最高速度降至 54 公里/小时。火炮及其昂贵弹药被移除，换成一对廉价的 MRM 40。

column1: The M12 is a rarer variant due to the difficulty involved in the modifications to the 'Mech's loadout. The variant on the M11 removes two heat sinks and two tons of ammo to replace the C3 unit with a C3 Computer so that it can coordinate a lance's fire
column2: M12 由于改装机甲载荷难度较大而较为罕见。这一基于 M11 的变体移除两台散热器和两吨弹药，把 C3 单元换成一台 C3 计算机，以便协调一个连的火力

column1: The M12 is a rarer variant due to the difficulty involved in the modifications to the 'Mech's loadout. The variant on the M11 removes two heat sinks and two tons of ammo to replace the C3 unit with a C3 Computer so that it can coordinate a lance's fire.
column2: M12 由于改装机甲载荷难度较大而较为罕见。这一基于 M11 的变体移除两台散热器和两吨弹药，把 C3 单元换成一台 C3 计算机，以便协调一个连的火力。

column1: Artillery Support
column2: 火炮支援

column1: Boss, I don't know how this got past the design review board but this thing has two Thumper Artillery pieces and nothing else. If anything gets in close, there isn't much it can do. However, those cannons will pulverize most things that are unfortunate enough to be spotted.
column2: 老大，我不知道这东西是怎么通过设计评审的，但这玩意儿装了两门重锤火炮，别的什么都没有。一旦有什么东西贴近，它几乎无能为力。不过，那两门炮会把大多数不幸被发现的目标碾成粉末。

column1: TsarBomba
column2: 沙皇炸弹

column1: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti air and anti mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either it’s own launcher or the rest of it’s lancemates. The designs speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with it’s armour unable to stand up to much punishment.
column2: 沙皇炸弹由马弗里克工业在"蛇"与"斗牛犬"行动后生产，旨在提升炮兵单位的灵活性与生存性。注意到许多装备箭矢 IV 的单位损失、其乘员在氏族突破中被屠杀，马弗里克工业的设计团队寻找改善之道。凭借已获得的荷兰人 BZK-F3 生产许可，他们决定生产一款使用 XL 引擎以搭载箭矢 IV 发射器的升级型号。现代炮兵战术要求部署防空与反机甲单位保护这些宝贵资产，因此马弗里克只在机甲上装了一门小型脉冲激光并配 TAG；使荷兰人能对付步兵渗透者，并为自己或其他队友的发射器侦察。该设计的速度被认为足以避开其他可能威胁它的目标，尤其考虑到它的装甲经不起太多打击。

column1: Urbanmech UM-AIV
column2: 城市机甲 UM-AIV

column1: Arrow IV Urbanmech
column2: 箭矢 IV 城市机甲

column1: This variant of the UrbanMech replaces the standard weaponry with an Arrow IV missile launcher and ER Medium Laser. It requires an Endo Steel chassis and Small Cockpit to provide room, and the UrbanMech can only carry ten rounds for the Arrow system. Despite these limitations, it is still a decent fire support unit.
column2: 这款都市机甲变体以箭矢 IV 导弹发射器和 ER 中型激光取代标准武器。它需要内骨骼底盘和小型驾驶舱来腾出空间，且都市机甲只能携带十发箭矢系统弹药。尽管有这些限制，它仍是不错的火力支援单位。

column1: Designed by the Capellans in the Succession Wars, the UM-R100 was deemed a failure due to mechanical issues with its large Thumper artillery cannon. However, after the introduction of the Helm Memory Core and Star League technologies, the Confederation revisted the -R100 and created this, the -R100X. Using Endo-Steel and Ferro-Fibrous as well as CASE, the -R100X brings tube artillery to the battlefield in a cheap and affordable package. Other than its Thumper cannon, the -R100X has only a pitiful ER Small Laser for defense.
column2: UM-R100 由卡佩兰人在继承战争中设计，因其大型重锤火炮的机械问题而被判定为失败。然而在赫尔姆记忆核心与星盟技术问世后，邦联重新审视-R100 并打造出这款-R100X。使用内骨骼、铁纤维以及 C.A.S.E.，-R100X 以廉价实惠的方案把管式火炮带上战场。除了重锤炮，-R100X 只有一门可怜巴巴的 ER 小型激光用于防御。

column1: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
column2: 在陶里安协约入侵联邦太阳系时儿子被杀后，本尼迪克特·圣詹姆斯将自己的 VTR-9K 改装上实验性武器与装备以复仇。他把标准武器换成一门长汤姆炮和两门中型 X 脉冲激光，使圣詹姆斯的胜利者能对猎物造成巨量伤害。为给武器腾出空间，机甲的跳跃推进器不得不拆除，技师还为其配上铁纤维与标准装甲的拼装方案作为另一项减重措施。引擎上加装的增压器为胜利者提供了出其不意的速度爆发。

column1: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.
column2: 最早版本使用标准散热器，其原始引擎仅能维持 30 公里/小时。这构成了挑战：早期攻城塔必须完全停下才能发射狙击炮，然后在对炮反击摧毁它之前再次启动。二十吨半的原始装甲保护攻城塔免受敌方火力。原始系统的重量与体积使设计师无法安装后期型号使用的远程导弹。

column1: The Helepolis is built around an Armstrong Industries Sniper Artillery Piece. The accurate, long-range fire makes it effective against static defenses. The 'Mech does carry some backup weapons to augment its screening forces. It can defend itself with a Coventry Starfire LRM-10 and Nova Large Laser. If an enemy gets close, the MechWarrior can call upon a Thunderstroke SRM-6 and a Starflash Medium Laser. This 2625 model upgrades the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser.
column2: 攻城塔以阿姆斯特朗工业的狙击炮为核心。精准的远程火力使其对固定防御极为有效。该机甲确实携带一些备用武器以增强其掩护部队。它可用一门考文垂"星火"LRM-10 和一门新星大型激光自卫。若敌人逼近，机甲战士还能依靠一门雷霆 SRM-6 和一门星光中型激光。此 2625 型号将大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光。

column1: This variant was introduced much more recently by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team. VEST rebuilt a factory on Solaris VII after the Word of Blake had left that world. There, they began to produce an upgraded version of the Helepolis. This upgrade of the 3H is built on an Endo Steel frame. It is powered by a 300-rated Light Fusion Engine that gives it a top speed of 64 km/h, though this necessitated splitting the missile launcher into two LRM-5s.
column2: 此变体由维宁工程与打捞队新近推出。布雷克之言离开太阳系 VII 后，VEST 重建了那里的一座工厂，并开始生产升级版攻城塔。此 3H 升级版建立在内骨骼框架上，由 300 级轻型聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 64 公里/小时，但为此不得不把导弹发射器拆为两具 LRM-5。

column1: Helepolis HEP-4H
column2: 攻城塔 HEP-4H

column1: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
column2: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

column1: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
column2: 北极狐主配置意在远距离磨掉敌人装甲，然后逼近收尾。为此，北极狐携带一门 ER PPC，能在六百九十米外命中目标。近战方面，两门中型激光构成主要打击力，而两具 SRM-4 发射器搜寻敌人装甲上的弱点。

column1: The A configuration is intended for short range engagements and carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and three Small Pulse Lasers. Six jump jets have been added in order to increase mobility.
column2: A 配置用于近程交战，携带四门中型脉冲激光和三门小型脉冲激光。为提升机动性加装了六个跳跃推进器。

column1: Useful in anti-aircraft and in vehicle hunting roles, the B configuration has an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a Medium Laser. This configuration is highly flexible in its roles but also severely handicapped by its reliance on a ballistic weapon.
column2: B 配置适用于防空与猎杀车辆角色，以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器。它由一门中型激光支援。此配置在角色上高度灵活，但也因依赖实弹武器而严重受限。

column1: Another sniper and cleanup 'Mech rolled into one, the C configuration mounts an ER PPC as its primary weapon, giving it superb long range firepower. This is matched up with a Large Pulse Laser, which has a much shorter range but is extremely accurate.
column2: C 配置把狙击手与清道夫合二为一，以一门 ER PPC 为主武器，赋予它卓越的远程火力。与之搭配的是一门大型脉冲激光，射程短得多但极其精准。

column1: A dedicated fire support configuration, the D configuration carries two LRM-10 missile launchers linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy.
column2: D 配置是专职火力支援配置，携带两具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 导弹发射器以提升导弹精度。

column1: A Combine modification of the K model introduced in 3050, the C model carried a C3 Slave unit into combat. This was achieved by removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers from the K model. The extra free ton was used to add another heat sink to the design.
column2: C 型是 3050 年推出的 K 型的联合体改装，它把一台 C3 从属单元带入战斗。这通过从 K 型移除一门中型脉冲激光实现。多出的一吨用于为设计增加一台散热器。

column1: Another 'Mech design that the Combine inherited when they took Independence Weaponries on Quentin in the War of 3039, the Atlas C was one of the first designs thought of when Combine Engineers began incorporating C3 units into BattleMechs. Since the Atlas has such a large arsenal of weapons, the removal of one medium pulse lasers was of small consequence. Added in its place was a C3 slave and another heat sink to help the design dissipate the huge amounts of heat it already produces.
column2: 作为联合体在 3039 年战争中接管昆汀上的独立兵器公司时继承的另一款机甲设计，阿特拉斯 C 是联合体工程师开始把 C3 单元整合进战斗机甲时最先想到的设计之一。由于阿特拉斯武器库庞大，移除一门中型脉冲激光影响很小。代替它加装的是一台 C3 从属单元和一台额外散热器，以帮助该设计散发它本来就会产生的大量热量。

column1: Another modification of the K model of the Atlas introduced in 3050, the CM Atlas was designed to carry a C3 Master Computer into battle. In order to do this one of the ER Large Lasers was removed and in its place a C3 Master computer was installed, allowing it to coordinate a C3 lance.
column2: CM 阿特拉斯是 3050 年推出的阿特拉斯 K 型的又一改装，旨在把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。为此移除了一门 ER 大型激光，在原位安装 C3 主控计算机，使其能协调一个 C3 小队。

column2: 指挥与中远程突击

column1: The AS7-K-DC is a command version of the AS7-K. To be able to fit the command console, a ton of LRM ammo and one medium pulse laser was removed.
column2: AS7-K-DC 是 AS7-K 的指挥版本。为容纳指挥控制台，移除了一吨 LRM 弹药和一门中型脉冲激光。

column1: Command & Mid/Long Assault
column2: 指挥与中/远程突击

column1: A command variant of the AS7-K, designated the AS7-K-DC, uses a command console in place of a ton of LRM ammo and one medium pulse laser.
column2: AS7-K 的指挥变体，代号 AS7-K-DC，以一吨 LRM 弹药和一门中型脉冲激光换取一台指挥控制台。

column1: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to Double Heat Sinks. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.
column2: S 型是 3050 年推出的标准阿特拉斯联邦联邦版基础升级，从设计中移除五台散热器，其余升级为双倍散热器。节省的重量用于加装两具后向考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器，增强阿特拉斯后方射界的防护。内战之后此型号停产，但两个分裂国家的驻防部队仍在使用，AFFS 单位为自动炮使用精确弹药，LAAF 单位则使用从自由世界联盟缴获的特种 LRM 弹药。

column1: The S2 Atlas was a major upgrade of the design by the Lyran Alliance coming out of the Hesperus II facility in 3061. The 'Mech was built with a Light Fusion Engine and carried an Artemis IV Fire Control System enhanced LRM-15 launcher and two ER large lasers as its primary long range weapons. For close combat, the 'Mech was armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle. The S2 mounted a Guardian ECM Suite in place of the AMS to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
column2: S2 阿特拉斯是莱兰联盟于 3061 年从赫斯佩鲁斯 II 工厂推出的重大升级。机甲采用轻型聚变引擎建造，携带一具 Artemis IV 火控系统增强的 LRM-15 发射器，以及两门 ER 大型激光作为主要远程武器。近战方面，机甲装备一门重型高斯步枪。S2 以守护者 ECM 套件取代 AMS，用于抵御敌方电子战装备。

column1: A basic upgrade to the original 8Q introduced in 3057, the heat sinks are upgraded to double heat sinks and are reduced to nineteen. The saved weight is used to add a fourth PPC to the 'Mech as well as a Guardian ECM Suite. Although there was some criticism for using basic PPCs and not upgrading to ER models, the 9Q proved itself during Operation Guerrero to be quite devastating.
column2: 9Q 是 3057 年推出的对原版 8Q 的基础升级，散热器升级为双倍并减少至十九台。节省的重量用于为机甲加装第四门 PPC 以及一套守护者 ECM 套件。尽管有人批评它使用基础 PPC 而未升级为 ER 型号，9Q 在"格雷罗"行动中证明自己相当具毁灭性。

column1: This variant of the Awesome is designed for units that cannot afford the newer, and more costly, variants or for older machines that, due to past damage, cannot be upgraded with the newer weapon systems and construction materials. The 9Q has a higher damage curve than previous models due to the inclusion of a fourth particle projectile cannon. Included into the design is also a Guardian ECM suite, making the design difficult to target with many of the newer weapon systems available to date. While the Awesome of past days were feared, this newest refit of the Awesome will strike fear into any warrior that crosses its path.
column2: 神奇的这一变体是为那些买不起更新、更昂贵变体的单位，或因过往损伤无法用新武器系统与建造材料升级的老旧机器设计的。由于加入第四门粒子投射炮，9Q 的伤害曲线高于前型号。设计中还加入了守护者 ECM 套件，使该设计难以被迄今可用的许多较新武器系统锁定。过去的神奇令人畏惧，而神奇这一最新改装将让任何与它相遇的战士心生恐惧。

column1: An upgrade of the 3S variant using Star League technology, the 5S replaces the engine with an XL Engine and uses double heat sinks to save weight, restoring its top speed to 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is armed for long range combat with a Poland Main Model A Gauss Rifle and two Defiance 1001 ER PPCs. For close ranges, the 'Mech has a TharHes Maxi SRM-6, four Defiance B3M Medium Lasers, and two Defiance B3S Small Lasers, and is also equipped with an Angst Clear Channel 3 comsys.
column2: 5S 是使用星盟科技的 3S 变体升级版，将引擎换成 XL 引擎并用双倍散热器节省重量，把最高速度恢复到 64.8 公里/小时。机甲为远程战斗装备一门波兰 A 型主炮高斯步枪和两门迪法恩斯 1001 ER PPC。近程则有一具塔尔赫斯 Maxi SRM-6、四门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光和两门迪法恩斯 B3S 小型激光，还配备安格斯特清频 3 通信系统。

column1: The 1Gb was an upgraded BattleMaster that was used by the Terran Hegemony-based SLDF Royal units. Introduced in 2760 it was built on an Endo Steel chassis and used double heat sinks. It only retained the forward-facing medium lasers to which was added a pair of ER PPCs, one in each arm, and a Large Pulse Laser in the center torso.
column2: 1Gb 是升级版战斗大师，供以地球霸权为基地的星盟防卫军皇家部队使用。它于 2760 年推出，建立在内骨骼底盘上并使用双倍散热器。它仅保留了前向中型激光，并加装两门 ER PPC（每臂一门）和中央躯干一门大型脉冲激光。

column1: A variant of the 1Gb introduced in 2763, this model dropped three heat sinks to incorporate a Command Console.
column2: 此 1Gb 变体于 2763 年推出，它减少了三台散热器以装设一个指挥台。

column1: A much less radical upgrade of the 1G, the 1Gc upgraded the heat sinks to double strength models and removed the machine guns to make room for a command console.
column2: 1Gc 是对 1G 温和得多的升级，它把散热器升级为双倍强度型号，并移除机枪以腾出空间安装指挥控制台。

column1: A command variant of the BLR-3M that removes two medium lasers and one double heat sink to fit a Cockpit Command Console.
column2: BLR-3M 的指挥变体，移除两门中型激光和一台双倍散热器以安装驾驶舱指挥控制台。

column1: Command 'Mech, Heavy Brawler & Close Assault
column2: 指挥机甲、重型近战 & 近身突击

column1: The 3M was a basic upgrade of the BattleMaster utilizing Star League technology. Introduced by Earthwerks Incorporated for the Free Worlds League in 3049, the 'Mech replaces the standard heat sinks with double heat sinks, upgrades its primary weapon to a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC and removes one of the machine guns to add CASE to the design to protect itself in the event of an ammunition explosion.
column2: 3M 是利用星盟技术对战将的基础升级。它由地球工厂公司于 3049 年为自由世界联盟推出，把标准散热器换成双倍散热器，主武器升级为"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，并移除一挺机枪以给设计加装 C.A.S.E.，在弹药爆炸时保护自身。

column1: This is the Free Worlds League official version of the Battlemaster from  Earthwerks factory on Keystone, the BLR-3M. It features Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to guard against an internal explosion, and double heat sinks, allowing it to dissipate great amounts of heat in a short time. The only change in weaponry is mounting the Fusigon Longtooth Extended-Range Particle Projection Cannon instead of the older Donal model and dropping one of the two machine guns.
column2: 这是自由世界联盟官方版本的战将，出自基斯通上的地球工厂，即 BLR-3M。它采用蜂窝式弹药储存设备以防内部爆炸，并使用双倍散热器，使它能在短时间内散发大量热量。武器上唯一的变化是装用"富西贡长牙"增程粒子投射炮取代较老的"多纳尔"型号，并去掉两挺机枪中的一挺。

column1: Unqiue among Wolfs Dragoon's, this is apparantly a downgraded Stone Rhino equipped with locally made Inner Sphere technology. The sole known example was lost at the battle of Misery and the Dragoon's have been unusually reticent about the mech or it's origins, refusing to confirm where the mech came from or whether they posses anymore.
column2: 这在狼之龙骑兵中独一无二，显然是一台装备了本地制造内天体技术的降级石犀牛。已知唯一一台在米瑟里战役中损失，而龙骑兵对这台机甲或其来历异常默默，拒绝确认它的来源或他们是否还拥有更多。

column1: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
column2: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

column1: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
column2: C 型是近距支援变体，装备六门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6。它还使用三台额外双倍散热器以帮助控制热量水平。

column1: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
column2: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

column1: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
column2: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the bloodasp was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 血复于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

column1: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 0X model was a limited prototype that contained hardwired Electronics Warfare Equipment but never received full Line production.
column2: 我们把铠装骑兵称为"科学怪机"，因为它身上东拼西凑了各种东西。0X 型号是有限的原型，内嵌硬连线的电子战设备，但从未进入全面量产。

column1: The longest ranged weapon carried by the CTF-3D Cataphract is a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra AC-5 in its right arm, boasting a rate of fire twice that of a standard autocannon. This is backed up by a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 in its right torso, capable of firing both solid and cluster rounds. It is a more popular weapon than the Ultra AC-5, especially for use in an anti-conventional and anti-aircraft role without the possibility of jamming. Finally, the 'Mech has four Intek Medium Lasers for close range defense, one in each arm firing forward and two in its torso covering the rear. With only two tons of ammo for the LB-X 10 and one ton for the Ultra, if it runs dry the Cataphract must fall back to be reloaded before continuing the fight. Eleven tons of armor combined with CASE allowed the Cataphract to easily absorb damage. Sixteen heat sinks keep it cool while four HildCo Model 12 jump jets gave it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Room for these improvements was made by using a GM 280 XL Engine.
column2: CTF-3D 铠装骑兵携带的最远射程武器是右臂的一门通用汽车"新星-5"超速 AC-5，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由右躯干一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10 支援，可发射实心弹与集束弹。它比超速 AC-5 更受欢迎，尤其用于反常规与防空任务且不会卡壳。最后，机甲有四门英泰克中型激光用于近程防御，每臂一门向前，躯干两门覆盖后方。LB-X 10 只有两吨弹药、超速炮一吨，一旦打空，铠装骑兵必须后撤装填才能继续作战。十一吨装甲结合 C.A.S.E. 使铠装骑兵能轻易吸收伤害。十六台散热器使其保持低温，四个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器赋予它一百二十米的跳跃距离。这些改进所需的空间来自一台 GM 280 XL 引擎。

column1: Produced by the Capellans based on stolen Davion designs, the 3L is an upgraded version of the Cataphract that follows more in line with the prototype 1X model. It is propelled by an XL Engine with MASC instead of jump jets allowing it to reach speeds of 86.4 km/h in short bursts. While it is also armed with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon this is instead matched with a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC for powerful striking capabilities at long range. Other differences include the use of four Medium Pulse Lasers and double heat sinks in place of the standard models. This design was produced by the Confederation at Grand Base following the ascension of Chancellor Romano Liao.
column2: 3L 由卡佩兰人基于窃取的达维昂设计生产，是铁甲舰的升级版，更贴近原型 1X 型号。它由配 MASC 的 XL 引擎驱动而非跳跃推进器，可在短促爆发中达到 86.4 公里/小时。虽然主武器同为 LB-X 自动炮/10，但它改配一门谷神星军械"战士"ER PPC，具备强大的远程打击能力。其他差异包括使用四门中型脉冲激光和双倍散热器取代标准型号。此设计在罗曼诺·廖大臣登位后由邦联在格兰德基地生产。

column1: An upgrade of the C4 model. The standard fusion engine is replaced with an extralight engine. With the extra freed tonnage, a large laser and Beagle Active Probe can be mounted. The two Small Lasers are replaced with a single pulse version. The heat sinks are upgraded to double strength models.
column2: C4 型号的升级。标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎。凭借腾出的额外吨位，可安装一门大型激光和一具比格犬主动探测器。两门小型激光换成一门脉冲版本。散热器升级为双倍强度型号。

column1: An upgrade of the C3 model, this variant first appeared during the St. Ives Conflict. It retains the Arrow IV artillery system, but its chassis has been upgraded to Endo Steel and its heat sinks to improved versions. This allows the C5 to increase its armor coverage to twelve and a half tons, upgrade its lasers to ER Medium Lasers, and quadruple the amount of ammo carried with protection provided by CASE.
column2: 此变体是 C3 型号的升级版，首次出现在圣艾夫斯冲突期间。它保留箭矢 IV 火炮系统，但底盘升级为内骨骼，散热器升级为改进型。这使 C5 能把装甲覆盖增至十二吨半，将激光升级为 ER 中型激光，并把弹药携带量翻两番，同时以 C.A.S.E. 提供保护。

column1: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-B was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-B carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a medium laser and a medium pulse laser.
column2: CN10-B 是经典百夫长的 55 吨加重版本，于 3057 年建造，使用内骨骼底盘为设计减重，同时通过 220 额定标准聚变引擎保留 CN9-A 原有的地面速度。与 CN9-D 十分相似，10-B 以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器，配一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后备。

column1: Draconis Combine's 3K was an upgrade of the 1A9 that used an uprated XL engine to raise the Charger's top speed back to 86.4 km/h. The head-mounted small laser was removed, the medium lasers were swapped out for Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-20 launcher was mated with an Artemis IV fire control system to improve accuracy. The addition of a fifth jump jet mounted in the rear torso gave the 'Mech a jumping distance of up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant was confirmed to have been deployed on An Ting in the War of 3039 and may have been what Davion forces initially dubbed the Charger II; however, descriptions of the Charger II suggest that it was more likely a LRM-equipped variant of the Hatamoto-Chi (presumably the -Kaze).
column2: 联合体的 3K 是 1A9 的升级版，使用升级的 XL 引擎把冲锋者最高速度重新提升至 86.4 公里/小时。头部小型激光被移除，中型激光换成中型脉冲激光，LRM-20 发射器配以 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。在后躯干加装的第五个跳跃推进器使机甲跳跃距离达一百五十米。该变体被证实曾在 3039 年战争中部署于安廷，也许正是达维昂部队最初称为冲锋者 II 的机型；不过对冲锋者 II 的描述表明，它更可能是旗本-血的 LRM 装备变体（推测是-风）。

column1: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
column2: 作为 3K 的升级，冲锋者 C 经改装携带一台 C3 从属单元，使其能与本单位的其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为加装从属单元，必须从设计中移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的质量用于为 LRM 发射器增加额外弹药。

column1: A succession wars attempt at turning the Cicada into a fire support platform, the 3D is widely considered as failure. Armed with 2 lrm-5's and 2 medium lasers, it relies on a 280 rated engine to fit the heavier arsenal. Despite possessing more firepower and armour than other Cicada models, it's lack of speed and raw fire proved a major draw back and only a few survived through succession wars.
column2: 这是继承战争时期把蝉改造为火力支援平台的尝试，3D 被普遍认为是失败之作。它装备 2 具 lrm-5 和 2 门中型激光，依靠一台 280 额定引擎来容纳更重的武器库。尽管拥有比其他蝉型号更多的火力与装甲，它缺乏速度与原始打击力成为主要缺点，只有少数在继承战争中幸存。

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Hellhound was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族地狱犬长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

column1: Considered to be a middleweight machine compared to the heavier Mackies and Ymirs already in circulation, the Crossbow was built to be a fast missile support unit. As was the case with the Coventry Defense Conglomerate, Arcturan Arms’ engineers initially failed to make their prototype Crossbow live up to expectations, but as the techniques for producing BattleMechs grew more refined, the Crossbow received an upgrade worthy of its original concept.
column2: 与当时已在使用的更重型的麦基和伊米尔相比，弩弓被视为中量级机体，被造成快速导弹支援单位。与考文垂防务集团的情况类似，大熊座军械的工程师最初未能让原型弩弓达到预期，但随着战斗机甲生产技术日趋精良，弩弓获得了与其原始构想相称的升级。

column1: Missile Support
column2: 导弹支援

column1: Developed during the Golden Century by Clan Steel Viper as an early second-generation OmniMech, the Crossbow is a relatively cheap OmniMech. The Crossbow was Clan Steel Viper's first attempt to crash-start their OmniMech manufacturing capability, and was initiated in part by a small cadre of captured Clan Snow Raven scientist caste.
column2: 弩弓是钢蛇氏族在黄金世纪开发的早期第二代全能机甲，造价相对低廉。它是钢蛇氏族首次尝试速成其全能机甲制造能力，部分工作由一小批被俘的雪鸦氏族科学家种姓发起。

column1: A variant of the Crusader concentrating on lessening its heat burden, the 3K was introduced by the Draconis Combine in 2765. It downsized the LRM launchers to LRM-10 models and removed the machine guns to make room for an additional six heat sinks.
column2: 作为专注减轻热负担的十字军变体，3K 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2765 年推出。它把 LRM 发射器缩小为 LRM-10 型号，并移除机枪，以腾出空间安装另外六台散热器。

column1: The 3L variant of the Crusader takes concepts from both the 3D and the 3K models to save weight with a twist. Built for the Capellan Confederation starting in 2753, the 'Mech has removed the LRM-15 and SRM-6 launchers and replaced them with two LRM-10 launchers and two SRM-4 launchers. This frees up room for two additional heat sinks as well as the inclusion of four GM Jetstar jump jets, two each in either side torso, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters.
column2: 十字军 3L 变体借鉴 3D 与 3K 两种型号的思路来减重，并别出心裁。它自 2753 年起为卡佩兰邦联建造，移除了 LRM-15 和 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-10 和两具 SRM-4 发射器。这腾出空间容纳两台额外散热器，并加装四个通用"喷气星"跳跃推进器（两侧躯干各两个），使其跳跃距离达一百二十米。

column1: A field modification kit based on the 3K variant and introduced for Kuritan forces in 3049, the 4K removes two heat sinks and replaces the two medium lasers of the 3K with Magna 400P medium pulse models.
column2: 4K 是基于 3K 变体的野战改装套件，于 3049 年引入库瑞塔部队，它移除两台散热器，并把 3K 的两门中型激光换成玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲型号。

column1: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
column2: 2520 年生产的原版苦行僧未达到当时地球霸权设计的同等标准。使用相对"原始"的部件导致驾驶舱与引擎更重、装甲效率更低。因此 1S 的最高速度为 64 公里/小时，且只能跳九十米。虽然导弹发射器与 6M 相同，但它没有该型号的激光。1S 变体继续存在于民兵部队中，但在继承战争期间被拆解取件。它并非为前线使用而设计，而是供民兵单位使用。尽管到 2990 年代末所剩无几，圣战期间由于供应链被打断，低技术世界再次开始生产它们。

column1: A simple direct fire configuration of the Dire Wolf, the H configuration carries a pair of Gauss Rifles as its primary long range weaponry. These are backed up by two Heavy Large Lasers for medium to short ranges. Finally, for short range combat, the H configuration has a Medium Pulse Laser and a Flamer. All of this configuration's weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer, increasing their accuracy.
column2: 恐狼 H 配置是一款简单的直射配置，携带两门高斯步枪作为主要远程武器。它们由两门重型大型激光支援中近距离。最后，近战方面 H 配置有一门中型脉冲激光和一具火焰喷射器。此配置的所有武器都联动一台瞄准计算机，以提升精度。

column1: The S configuration is intended for the close confines of urban and jungle warfare. The S configurations primary weapon is a massive LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of disabling most light and medium 'Mechs in a single blast. This is backed up by a single Large Pulse Laser to provide some long range firepower should the Dire Wolf S be caught in the open. Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti infantry capabilities. The S configuration has added mobility with three jump jets allowing it to jump up to ninety meters.
column2: S 配置为城市与丛林战的狭窄环境而设。S 配置的主武器是一门巨型 LB-X 自动炮/20，能一击瘫痪大多数轻中型机甲。它辅以一门大型脉冲激光，若恐狼 S 身陷开阔地可提供一些远程火力。额外近程火力来自五门中型脉冲激光和两具连续 SRM-4 发射器。两个反人员荚舱和两挺机枪提供出色的反步兵能力。S 配置通过三个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至九十米。

column1: This Wolf's Dragoons variant is effective at both long and short range. For long range, it uses a Gauss Rifle, an ER Large Laser, and an LRM-20. At close range, an Ultra Autocannon/20, ER Small Laser, and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers provide devastating firepower. Twenty double heat sinks allow the design to almost continually fire all of its weapons.
column2: 这款狼之龙骑兵变体在远程与近程都很有效。远程使用一门高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-20。近程则由一门超速自动炮/20、一门 ER 小型激光和一对中型脉冲激光提供毁灭性火力。二十台双倍散热器使该设计几乎能持续发射全部武器。

column1: This variant carries a Targeting Computer to guide the fire of a Large Pulse Laser, Heavy Medium Laser, twin ER Micro Lasers, an Ultra AC/10 and the solid shot of an LB 5-X autocannon. To provide missile support, the Daishi X carries an ATM 6 with a ton of each ammunition type, a head mounted Streak SRM-2, and an SRM-4 and LRM-15. The SRM-4 and LRM-15 are each equipped with an Artemis IV FCS.
column2: 此变体携带一台瞄准计算机，用于引导一门大型脉冲激光、一门重型中型激光、两门 ER 微型激光、一门超速 AC/10 以及一门 LB 5-X 自动炮的实心弹。为提供导弹支援，大石 X 携带一具 ATM 6（每种弹药各一吨）、一门头部安装的连续 SRM-2，以及一具 SRM-4 和一具 LRM-15。SRM-4 与 LRM-15 均配备 Artemis IV 火控系统。

column1: The 5N variant of the Dragon was used as a bridge between it and the Grand Dragon. This field upgrade, which utilizes formerly lost technology, upgrades its normal autocannon to an Ultra Autocannon/5, which is capable of firing at twice the rate of a standard model. Additionally, the rear facing Medium Laser has been removed from the 'Mech.
column2: 龙的 5N 变体是它与大龙之间的过渡型号。这项野战升级利用了曾经失传的技术，将普通自动炮升级为超速自动炮/5，射速可达标准型号的两倍。此外，机上的后向中型激光被移除。

column1: Developed by Cappellan Engineers just before the Clan Invasion, this Emperor is a retrofit of the standard 5A. Armed with the newly introduced Arrow IV launcher and a pair of large lasers, the 5B is built to provide fire support at long range.
column2: 这款皇帝由卡佩兰工程师在氏族入侵前夕开发，是标准 5A 的改装型。它装备新推出的箭矢 IV 发射器和两门大型激光，5B 旨在提供远程火力支援。

column1: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
column2: 与主型号相比，行刑者 A 缩短了总体交战距离：它去掉高斯步枪，换成一大批大型脉冲激光，辅以四门 ER 中型激光。此变体是外面所有轻型机甲的噩梦。

column1: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
column2: 样样通吃的变体。行刑者 B 被设定为在战场能提供的所有射程上都有效。极端与远程有 ER PPC，较近射程则有绝对毁灭性的 UAC/20，B 以蛮力处决它的敌人。先进瞄准系统确保无处可逃……无处可藏。

column1: Sometimes you just need to lob some missiles at them. The Executioner C trades direct hit firepower of its sister variants for a set of Artemis IV guided Long Range Missiles. But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.
column2: 有时你就是需要朝他们甩几发导弹。行刑者 C 以一套 Artemis IV 制导远程导弹取代其姊妹变体的直击火力。但要提醒所有以为能偷偷接近这头怪物的人：它仍然以 UAC/20 的形式保留着庞大的近距离打击力。

column1: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
column2: 快速、精准、致命。行刑者 D(isco) 利用其惊人的灵活性逼近敌人…只为用各种颜色与尺寸的脉冲激光向它们倾泻地狱之火。LPL、MPL、SPL…你能想到的，EXE-D 都有。不过要提醒飞行员：最好带上些冰镇饮料，因为这家伙跑起来很热！

column1: In a logical step up from other, earlier variants the Executioner E sticks with the idea of being effective and deadly at all ranges. ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.
column2: 行刑者 E 是对其他早期变体的合理升级，坚持在所有距离上都有效而致命。ER 大型激光和 ATM 将在远距离与中距离提供巨量火力，而一批重型中型激光和重型小型激光将提供近距离环形防御…或者用于给已受损对手补上那一点额外伤害。

column1: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
column2: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

column1: The original Firebee used a single LRM-5 backed up by a trio of SRM-2s. The Primitive Engine provided a top speed of 85 km/h, more than enough to engage armored vehicles and infantry, and supporting heavier units. The lack of jump jets, combined with six and a half tons of Primitive Armor, forced pilots to pay attention to the terrain to insure they could move effectively.
column2: 原版火蜂使用一具 LRM-5，辅以三具 SRM-2。原始引擎提供 85 公里/小时的最高速度，足以与装甲车辆和步兵交战，并支援较重的单位。缺少跳跃推进器，加上六吨半的原始装甲，迫使飞行员注意地形以确保有效机动。

column1: The 2E Firebee mounts a Star Cutter 80cm Large Laser, giving it respectable firepower. Up close, four Maui Crossbow SRM-2 launcher can unleash eight missiles. Whether it is using Inferno rounds or not, something that its two tons of ammunition allows MechWarriors to utilize on a regular basis, the Firebee is a potent anti-vehicle platform.
column2: 2E 火蜂装备一门"星切"80 厘米大型激光，火力可观。近距离则四具毛伊弩炮 SRM-2 发射器可倾泻八枚导弹。无论是否使用燃烧弹——其两吨弹药让机甲战士能经常使用——火蜂都是威力强大的反车辆平台。

column1: Designed with the aim of upgrading the ageing Firebee with more advanced Star League technology, the 2Ep was still a prototype when the Succession Wars began. The only completed models of this design were lost with the destruction of the Exedor factory in the First Succession War. The design was briefly revived in the 3045, with a few surviving Firebee’s being converted as a showcase of home grown Capellan science and engineering. Armed with an ER Large Laser, dual Streak SRM-2's and augmented with the addition of a Beagle Probe, the 2Ep is a fast scout hunter and skirmisher.
column2: 2Ep 旨在用更先进的星盟科技升级老化的火蜂，在继承战争爆发时仍是原型机。该设计仅有的成品随第一次继承战争中埃克塞多工厂的毁灭而遗失。该设计在 3045 年短暂复兴，几台幸存的火蜂被改装以展示卡佩兰本土科学与工程的水平。2Ep 装备一门 ER 大型激光、双联连续 SRM-2，并加装比格犬探测器，是一款快速的侦察猎手与游骑机甲。

column1: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
column2: 全面型火焰使者最终克服了诞生时的政治波折，被证明是一款高效灵活的设计，联合体用它替代了凤凰鹰等老化的中量级主力机甲

column1: In its primary configuration the Firestarter is built to stay at long ranges when facing an enemy. The primary weapons are a pair of Large Lasers. The Large Lasers provide the 'Mech with respectable long-range firepower. To allow the 'Mech to create cover for itself and to clear woods, the Firestarter Prime carries two extra flamers on top of its fixed pair, bringing the total to four. Finally, to allow the 'Mech to search out hidden units, the Prime carries a Beagle Active Probe.
column2: 主配置中，火焰使者被设计为面对敌人时保持远程。主武器为一对大型激光。这两门大型激光为机甲提供可观的远程火力。为让机甲能为自己制造掩护并清除林地，火焰使者主型号在固定的一对之外另装两具火焰喷射器，共四具。最后，为让机甲能搜寻隐藏单位，主型号携带一具比格犬主动探测器。

column1: The Firestarter A carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/10 that allows the 'Mech to work in an anti-aircraft or vehicle hunting role. As a secondary weapon in the A configuration, the 'Mech carries a Small Laser and retains two Flamers for anti-personnel combat.
column2: 火焰使者 A 以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器，使机甲能担任防空或猎杀车辆的角色。作为 A 配置的次要武器，机甲携带一门小型激光并保留两具火焰喷射器用于反人员作战。

column1: Configured as a close combat and spotting 'Mech, the Firestarter B carries, as its primary weapon, a Large Pulse Laser, which is backed up by a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Laser. The 'Mech also carries two Flamers to deter infantry attacks and also allow the 'Mech to start fires for cover. The centerpiece of the B configuration is its electronics package, which consists of a TAG spotting laser for directing artillery fire and a C3 Slave unit that allows the Firestarter to share targeting data with allied units.
column2: 火焰使者 B 配置为近战与目标指示机甲，以一门大型脉冲激光为主武器，辅以两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。机甲还携带两具火焰喷射器以威慑步兵攻击，也能让机甲点火制造掩护。B 配置的核心是其电子设备包，包括一具用于引导炮火的 TAG 指示激光和一台使火焰使者能与友军单位共享瞄准数据的 C3 从属单元。

column1: Intended as a long-range fire support configuration, the Firestarter C carries a pair of LRM-10 launchers. The 'Mech has two Flamers and a Small Laser for close combat. Additionally, a C3 Slave Unit is carried so that the Firestarter C can benefit from sharing targeting data with allied units.
column2: C 配置意为远程火力支援，携带一对 LRM-10 发射器。机甲有两具火焰喷射器和一门小型激光用于近战。此外还携带一台 C3 从属单元，使火焰使者 C 能受益于与友军单位共享瞄准数据。

column1: The D configuration is intended for long-range direct fire support and sniping. This is done by using an ER PPC as its primary weapon. Backing this up is an LRM-5 launcher, a Medium Laser, and two Flamers for direct fire support. The D Configuration carries a Guardian ECM Suite to protect itself from an enemy's electronic warfare equipment. The 'Mech also carries a C3 Slave Unit.
column2: D 配置用于远程直射火力支援与狙击。它使用一门 ER PPC 作为主武器。支援它的是一具 LRM-5 发射器、一门中型激光和两具火焰喷射器，用于直射火力支援。D 配置携带一套守护者 ECM 套件以防御敌方的电子战设备。机甲还携带一台 C3 从属单元。

column1: The E configuration of the Firestarter is intended for close combat and carries as its primary weapon an MRM-20 launcher. This is backed up by a Medium Pulse Laser, a Small Pulse Laser, and two Flamers. A Sword provides superb accuracy in melee combat situations.
column2: 火焰使者 E 配置用于近战，以一门 MRM-20 发射器为主武器。它由一门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和两具火焰喷射器支援。一把剑在近战中提供卓越精度。

column1: This variant is exclusively used by the Free Worlds League. The F carries two ER Large Lasers, which are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and two Flamers.
column2: 此变体仅供自由世界联盟使用。F 型携带两门 ER 大型激光，辅以两门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和两具火焰喷射器。

column1: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-enhanced Clan LRM-10 and a pair of Clan-tech ER Large Lasers.
column2: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器支援后续波次的星盟防卫军部队，装备一具 Artemis IV 火控系统增强的氏族 LRM-10 和一对氏族技术 ER 大型激光。

column1: This version carries several experimental systems. Reminiscent of the Firestarter H, it's equipped with an Angel ECM Suite and Bloodhound Active Probe. It carries the twin center torso Flamers common to all Firestarter variants, and augments them with a Streak SRM-2 and a Large X-Pulse Laser.
column2: 此版本携带若干实验性系统。它让人想起火焰使者 H，装备天使 ECM 套件和猎犬主动探测器。它携带所有火焰使者变体通用的中央躯干双联火焰喷射器，并以一具连续 SRM-2 和一门大型 X 脉冲激光加以增强。

column1: The D configuration of the Gargoyle is armed with two ER Large Lasers for long range combat. These are backed up for short range engagements with three highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser. The 'Mech is frighteningly accurate due to its advanced Targeting Computer, which increases the accuracy of all the weapons in this configuration.
column2: 石像鬼 D 配置装备两门 ER 大型激光用于远程战斗。近程则由三门极为精准的中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 小型激光支援。由于配备先进瞄准计算机，该机甲精准得令人恐惧——它会提升此配置下所有武器的精度。

column1: Configured to take advantage of new Heavy Laser technology, the H configuration is a capable 'Mech at any range. For long range jousting with an enemy, the 'Mech has an LRM-10 launcher. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 and a new Heavy Large Laser for intermediate ranges. Finally, for added punch at close range, the 'Mech has two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: H 配置旨在利用新型重型激光技术，在任何距离上都能胜任。与敌人远程周旋时，它有一具 LRM-10 发射器。它由中距离的一门超速自动炮/10 和一门新型重型大型激光支援。最后，为增强近距离打击，机甲配有两门 ER 中型激光。

column1: Modified specifically to carry a C3 slave unit into combat, the C is a modification of the DRG-5K introduced in 3050. The 'Mech carries a C3 slave in the place of its rear-facing medium laser. While this does reduce the Grand Dragons short range firepower somewhat, it also makes the machine far more accurate when working in a C3 lance.
column2: C 型专为把 C3 从属单元带入战斗而改装，是 3050 年推出的 DRG-5K 的改装版。机甲用后向中型激光的位置安装一台 C3 从属单元。这虽在一定程度上降低了大龙的近程火力，却使它在 C3 小队中作战时精准得多。

column1: The 1DS variant of the Griffin, built by Defiance Industries, Kallon Industries and Norse BattleMech Works from their respective production lines starting in 3049, was intended to become the new standard model for the Federated Commonwealth. The engine was upgraded to Hermes 275 extralight engine, fourteen double heat sinks improved cooling and the weapons were stripped from the chassis. The 'Mech now carried a Doombud LRM-20 launcher over the right shoulder and a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser in the right arm. It also employed CASE to protect the two tons of missile reloads stored in the left torso. The capture of Norse BattleMech on Marduk by the Draconis Combine meant this variant was also employed by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
column2: 狮鹫的 1DS 变体由迪法恩斯工业、卡隆工业和北欧战斗机甲厂自 3049 年起在各自生产线上制造，意在成为联邦联邦的新标准型号。引擎升级为赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型引擎，十四台双倍散热器改善散热，武器则从底盘上全部拆除。机甲右肩上方安装末日芽 LRM-20 发射器，右臂装备雷霆-12 大型脉冲激光。它还使用 C.A.S.E. 保护存于左躯干的两吨导弹再装填。北欧战斗机甲在马尔杜克被德拉科尼斯联合体夺取，意味着该变体也被德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队使用。

column1: The Grizzly actually packs a solid long-range punch with a Omega 12-coil Gauss Rifle and a Type X Short Bow LRM-10 Launcher.
column2: 灰熊实际上拥有扎实的远程打击力：一具"欧米茄 12 线圈"高斯步枪和一具"X 型短弓"LRM-10 发射器。

column1: Developed in parallel with the standard Hammer 3M, the 3G is a cheap side grade designed for garrison and budget conscious buyers. The expensive Endo Steel is removed along with the Artemis IV system, dramatically decreasing the cost and relatability of the mech. Popular with many smaller mercenary units and on backwater garrisons every where through Marik space, the design is liked by Mektechs everywhere for the ease of maintenance and ready supply of replacement parts.
column2: 3G 与标准战锤 3M 同期开发，是一款面向驻防与预算敏感买家的廉价副线产品。它去掉了昂贵的内部骨骼与 Artemis IV 系统，大幅降低成本并提升可维护性。它在许多较小佣兵部队和马里克空间各处偏远驻军中广受欢迎，也因易于维护、备件供应充足而受各地机甲技师的喜爱。

column1: The precursor to the 1H, the 0H was a flawed design that ran too hot and had insufficient armament or heat sinks for sustained combat. Armed with a Howitzer in place of the iconic Sniper piece, it lacks the range and stopping power of the later versions, whilst running significantly hotter due to the second large laser it mounted. Only a couple of test models were every introduced and the design was lost to the mists of history with the debut of the 1H and then the 2H, in 2480. Occasionally Helepolises in the periphery will be rebuilt along similar lines, the prized Sniper artillery pieces stripped off for other uses and local hardware retrofitted in its place.
column2: 作为 1H 的前身，0H 是一个有缺陷的设计：过热严重，武器与散热器都不足以支撑持续战斗。它以一门榴弹炮取代标志性的狙击炮，既缺乏后期版本的射程与停止力，又因装有第二门大型激光而热得多。仅制造过几台测试型号，随着 2480 年 1H 与 2H 的问世，该设计湮没于历史迷雾中。外围区偶尔会按类似思路重建攻城塔，把珍贵的狙击炮拆下另作他用，改装本地硬件顶上。

column1: The Helepolis is built around an Armstrong Industries Sniper Artillery Piece. The accurate, long-range fire makes it effective against static defenses. The 'Mech does carry some backup weapons to augment its screening forces. It can defend itself with a Coventry Starfire LRM-10 and Nova Large Laser. If an enemy gets close, the MechWarrior can call upon a Thunderstroke SRM-6 and a Starflash Medium Laser.
column2: 攻城塔围绕一门"阿姆斯特朗工业"狙击炮建造。精准的远程火力使其对固定防御工事十分有效。机甲确实携带一些备用武器来增强其屏护部队。它可用一具"考文垂星火"LRM-10 和一门"新星"大型激光自卫。若敌人逼近，机甲战士可动用一具"雷霆一击"SRM-6 和一门"星闪"中型激光。

column1: The Hellbringer A bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
column2: 地狱使者 A 在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

column1: The Hellbringer B is a Mech that appears to be a Jack of all trades. It does not accel at any one role but can apply damage at any range.
column2: 地狱使者 B 是一台看似样样通吃的机甲。它在任何单一角色上都不出众，却能在任何距离上施加伤害。

column1: The Hellbringer C is a Mech that appears to be a Jack of all trades. It does not accel at any one role but can apply damage at any range.
column2: 地狱使者 C 是一台看似样样通吃的机甲。它在任何单一角色上都不出众，却能在任何距离上施加伤害。

column1: This variant carries a pair of LB 10-X's, one in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser. Another pair of ER Medium Lasers and a single SRM-6 launcher round out the weapons.
column2: 此变体携带两门 LB 10-X，每臂一门，由一门 ER 中型激光支援。另有一对 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 发射器补全武器配置。

column1: The Hellbringer GP is a laser heavy version of the mech. Designed for sustained duration combat, this mech can always go the distance.
column2: 地狱使者 GP 是该机甲的重激光版本。它为持久战而设计，总能坚持到底。

column1: The Hellbringer H bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
column2: 地狱使者 H 在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

column1: The Hellbringer Prime bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
column2: 地狱使者主型号在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

column1: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. Initially designed as a dedicated city and installation defender, the original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, but perhaps its most useful asset were the three Hildco jump jets giving it a jumping range of 90 meters. The heaviest 'Mech design to feature jump jets at the time, their original task was to allow the Highlander the ability to jump over inconvenient obstacles such as buildings and outpace other 'Mechs with a faster ground speed, but because of this increased mobility and its versatile weaponry the Highlander proved to be a capable fighter on any battlefield and within decades nearly every BattleMech regiment of the Regular and Royal Armies featured them. However it was during the design's initial trial runs that pilots began using these 'Mechs in what would infamously become known as the "Highlander Burial". Leaping into the air and landing directly on their enemy, a Highlander could literally drive a light 'Mech into the ground. So successful was this maneuver that the design team re-engineered the legs to withstand repeated death-from-above attacks and turned what had been a desperation move into an art form, giving Highlander pilots an additional psychological edge.
column2: 高地人是星盟防卫军最知名的突击机甲之一，自 2592 年首次服役以来已光荣服役近两个世纪。它最初被设计为专职的城市与设施防御者，原版型号装备多种武器与十五吨半铁纤维装甲，但也许最宝贵的资产是三个希尔德科跳跃推进器，赋予它 90 米的跳跃距离。作为当时配备跳跃推进器的最重机甲设计，它们最初的任务是让高地人能跃过建筑之类碍事的障碍，并追上地面速度更快的其他机甲；但由于这一增强的机动性和多用途武器，高地人在任何战场上都证明是能干的战士，数十年内常备军与皇家军几乎每个战斗机甲团都装备了它。然而在该设计的初期试跑中，飞行员开始以后来臭名昭著的"高地人葬礼"方式使用这些机甲。跃入空中并直接落在敌人头上，高地人能真把一台轻型机甲踩进地里。这一战术如此成功，设计团队重新设计了腿部以承受反复的"从天而降之死"，把原本的绝望之举变成了一门艺术，为高地人飞行员增添了额外的心理优势。

column1: The Highlander is a well known SLDF Era Battlemech. Originally designed as a base or installation defender, the HGN-732 is probably the most famous Highlander model. At long ranges, a Gauss Rifle and LRM 20 can effectively deter many more lightly armored opponents. If a mech does decide to close the distance, two Medium Lasers and a SRM 6 are waiting to meet them.
column2: 高地人是星盟时代知名的战斗机甲。它最初被设计为基地或设施防御者，HGN-732 大概是高地人最著名的型号。远距离上，一门高斯步枪和一具 LRM 20 能有效威慑许多装甲较薄的对手。若有机甲决定拉近距离，两门中型激光和一具 SRM 6 正等着它们。

column1: The Hussar has a single weapon on its chassis in a unique turreted mount on the center torso, an Extended Range Large Laser. While the use of a single weapon limits the defensive capabilities of the Hussar, the superior reach of the ER laser allows the 'Mech to engage enemies at a standoff range and its speed means the Hussar can dictate the range of the engagement, forcing enemies to fight on its terms. If enemies do get too close the Hussar can still engage in physical combat with kicks and punches but this is less than ideal. Ten double heat sinks are enough to keep the 'Mech cool in combat, but only one and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor makes the Hussar among the least-protected 'Mechs ever built.
column2: 轻骑兵在中央躯干上一个独特的炮塔式挂架上装有其唯一武器：一门增程大型激光。虽然只有一门武器限制了轻骑兵的防御能力，但 ER 激光的优越射程使机甲能在对峙距离上交战，而其速度意味着轻骑兵能决定交战距离，迫使敌人按它的条件作战。若敌人确实逼近，轻骑兵仍能以踢击和拳击进行肉搏，但这并不理想。十台双倍散热器足以让机甲在战斗中保持低温，但仅一吨半铁纤维装甲使轻骑兵成为史上防护最少的机甲之一。

column1: An upgrade of the 200 introduced in 2735 and used exclusively by SLDF Royal units, the 200Db is powered by an XL Engine. This enables an upgrade of the 'Mech's electronics with a Beagle Active Probe and a Guardian ECM Suite in the side torsos. In addition, the armor coverage is increased to five and a half tons.
column2: 200Db 是 200 型的升级版，于 2735 年推出，专供星盟防卫军皇家部队使用，由 XL 引擎驱动。这使其得以在两侧躯干加装比格犬主动探测器和守护者 ECM 套件来升级电子设备。此外装甲覆盖增至五吨半。

column1: The 300-D Hussar is a simple downgrade of the 200-D Hussar, gifted to the Draconis Combine by ComStar in 3035. The primary changes in the design are the replacement of the ER large laser with a standard Defiance B3L Large Laser, standard heat sinks in place of the double-strength models, and replacement of the Ferro-Fibrous armor with standard Riese Reliable armor at a negligible cost to the already weak armor protection.
column2: 300-D 骠骑兵是 200-D 骠骑兵的简单降级版，由康星于 3035 年赠予德拉科尼斯联合体。设计的主要变化是将 ER 大型激光换成标准的迪法恩斯 B3L 大型激光，双倍强度散热器换为标准型号，铁纤维装甲换成标准里瑟可靠装甲，对本就脆弱的防护影响微乎其微。

column1: This Combine variant on the 300-D was introduced in 3038. It lowers the Hussar's top speed to 126 km/h by replacing the engine with a Pitban 240. The weight saved from the smaller power plant was used to add a Medium Laser to each arm and an extra ton of armor.
column2: 这款联合体版本的 300-D 于 3038 年推出。它用皮特班 240 替换引擎，把轻骑兵的最高速度降至 126 公里/小时。较小动力装置节省的重量用于为每臂加装一门中型激光和一吨额外装甲。

column1: One of the Clanbuster upgrades developed by ComStar in 3052, the 400-D is an extreme modification of the original Hussar. The ER large laser and the engine have both been stripped from the chassis to make room for a LB-X Autocannon/10 with one ton of ammo, an additional 1.5 tons of armor and a GM 240 XL Engine, reducing the Hussar's speed to 129.6 km/h. This variant of the Hussar, due to the cluster rounds that can be fired from the LB-X Autocannon, performs admirably in anti-vehicle screening forces.
column2: 400-D 是康星 3052 年开发的"破氏族"升级之一，是对原版骠骑兵的极端改装。ER 大型激光与引擎都被从底盘上剥离，以腾出空间装载一门 LB-X 自动炮/10（配一吨弹药）、额外 1.5 吨装甲和一台 GM 240 XL 引擎，把骠骑兵的速度降至 129.6 公里/小时。由于 LB-X 自动炮可发射集束弹，此骠骑兵变体在反车辆掩护部队中表现出色。

column1: Built with lessons learned from the Battle of Tukkayid, the 450-D is armed with an LB-5X mounted in the Right Torso. 2 tons of ammo keep the main gun well supplied, whilst a pair of ER Medium Lasers offer provide some degree of deterrence against foes closing in. Rounding out the design is an extra ton of armour, allowing it to weather heavier damage than it's predecessor.
column2: 450-D 汲取图卡伊德战役的教训建造，右躯干装有一门 LB-5X。两吨弹药让主炮补给充足，两门 ER 中型激光则对逼近的敌人提供一定威慑。设计以额外一吨装甲收尾，使其比前型能承受更重的打击。

column1: The 500-D Hussar, built by Bonn Mekarmorwerks and introduced in 3060, is armed with an ER PPC. The targeting system has been mated to an Improved C3 Computer, making it deadly accurate at long range when working closely with other units.
column2: 500-D 骠骑兵由波恩机甲兵工厂制造，3060 年推出，装备一门 ER PPC。其瞄准系统与改进型 C3 计算机联动，与其他单位密切协同时可在远距离实现致命精准。

column1: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
column2: A 配置携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/2，具备出色的远程狙击能力。它辅以两门 ER 中型激光提供近战能力，以及一套反导系统增加对导弹武器的防御。

column1: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
column2: 冰貂 B 只有一门 ER 大型激光作为远程武器。近战方面，B 配置携带一具 SRM-4 和一具 SRM-6 发射器，以及一门极为精准的小型脉冲激光。

column1: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
column2: 冰貂 C 是冰貂的火力支援配置，装备三具 LRM-5 发射器，每具联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度。近程防御方面，机甲有一门 ER 小型激光。

column1: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
column2: 主配置中，冰貂能胜任多种角色。它携带主动探测器，可侦测隐藏的敌方单位。近战方面，冰貂主型号有一具连续 SRM-2 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光。远程交战时，机甲装备一门 ER PPC，就其尺寸而言拥有出色的远程打击力。

column1: The original Imp, introduced in 2793, carries an ER PPC and Medium Pulse Laser in the right and left torso. Supporting these weapons are 2 Medium Pulse Lasers mounted in the center torso and a Small Laser in the head. The left arm mounts another Medium Pulse Laser, while the right arm carries an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20. The engine is a standard fusion model, and the missile ammunition is protected by CASE. This version was the original Imp design specified by Nicholas Kerensky and was intended for battlefield commanders.
column2: 原版 Imp 于 2793 年推出，右躯干装一门 ER PPC，左躯干一门中型脉冲激光。支援这些武器的是中央躯干两门中型脉冲激光和头部一门小型激光。左臂另装一门中型脉冲激光，右臂则携带一具 Artemis IV 增强的 LRM-20。引擎为标准聚变型号，导弹弹药由 C.A.S.E. 保护。此版本是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基指定的原始 Imp 设计，供战场指挥官使用。

column1: Similar to the Imp 1A variant, this model trades the Medium Pulse Lasers for Medium Lasers. It also trades the head mounted Small Laser for a Medium Pulse Laser. It keeps the ER PPCs and LRM-20 and Artemis IV system. The biggest change is the addition of a Guardian ECM suite in the 'Mech's right torso.
column2: 与 Imp 1A 变体相似，此型号把中型脉冲激光换成中型激光。它还把头部小型激光换成中型脉冲激光。它保留 ER PPC、LRM-20 和 Artemis IV 系统。最大的变化是在机甲右躯干加装了守护者 ECM 套件。

column1: Another early version based on the Imp 1B, this variant mounts a Gauss Rifle in the right arm. The Imp 1C uses the head mounted Small Laser of the Imp 1A in place of the Medium Pulse Laser. The Guardian ECM suite is still in the right torso. One heat sink is removed, giving the Imp 1C a total of seventeen double heat sinks.
column2: 这是基于 Imp 1B 的另一早期版本，此变体在右臂装一门高斯步枪。Imp 1C 用 Imp 1A 的头部小型激光取代中型脉冲激光。守护者 ECM 套件仍在右躯干。移除一台散热器，使 Imp 1C 共有十七台双倍散热器。

column1: An early variant of the Imp and the first version to be seen by the Inner Sphere, the 2E model uses all non-Star League technology. The 'Mech is armed with a pair of PPCs and an LRM-15 launcher for long range combat. For close combat, the 'Mech carries five Medium Lasers.
column2: Imp 的早期变体 2E 型号是内天体首见的版本，全部采用非星盟技术。它对远程战斗装备两门 PPC 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，近战则携带五门中型激光。

column1: This upgrade of the Imp is built exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons using only Clan technology. The 'Mech is armed with two ER PPCs and an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System for long range combat. For close ranges, the 'Mech carries five Medium Pulse Lasers. The Imp C is also armored with nineteen tons of armor.
column2: 这款 Imp 升级版专为狼之龙骑兵建造，仅使用氏族技术。机甲装备两门 ER PPC 和一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 发射器用于远程战斗。近程方面，机甲携带五门中型脉冲激光。Imp C 还披挂十九吨装甲。

column1: Firewalker
column2: 火焰行者

column1: SRM Boat
column2: SRM 火力平台

column1: This support variant replaces the short-range missile launchers with an ER Large Laser and an LRM-5. A Small Pulse Laser provides defense against conventional infantry and other units that stray too close. Its jumping capacity is increased to 270 meters.
column2: 此支援变体将短程火箭发射器换成一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-5。一门小型脉冲激光提供对常规步兵和靠得太近的其他单位的防御。其跳跃能力提升至 270 米。

column1: Clan Nova Cat, the primary users of the Jenner IIC, created this variant after they moved to the Inner Sphere. Though it changes the appearance of the 'Mech, the actual specifications of the design changed little. It retains the Streak SRM-4, but replaced the standard missile launchers with a pair of ATM 3s, each of which is accompanied by a ton of ammunition.
column2: 作为詹纳 IIC 的主要使用者，新星猫氏族在迁入内天体后打造了此变体。虽然它改变了机甲的外观，设计的实际规格却变化甚微。它保留连续 SRM-4，但把标准导弹发射器换成一对 ATM 3，每具各配一吨弹药。

column1: The A configuration of the Kit Fox uses a Gauss Rifle as its primary long-range weapon. Two ER Medium Lasers provide medium and short-range firepower.
column2: 小狐 A 配置以一门高斯步枪为主要远程武器。两门 ER 中型激光提供中近程火力。

column1: The B configuration of the Kit Fox boasts a rapid-fire Ultra Autocannon-10 as its primary weapon, startling considering the 'Mech's tonnage. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and an SRM-6 rack allow the Kit Fox B to finish off anything that manages to close ranges.
column2: 小狐 B 配置以一门速射超速自动炮-10 为主武器，就机甲的吨位而言令人吃惊。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-6 挂架使小狐 B 能干掉任何设法接近的目标。

column1: The Kit Fox D is configured for indirect fire support, mounting dual LRM-15 racks as well as a LRM-5. A Narc Missile Beacon is also carried, which may be exploited by the Kit Fox D itself, as the targeting systems of Clan LRMs lack a minimum range; this literally allows the Kit Fox D to run up to an enemy and mark them for increased accuracy, and then fall back, firing the entire time.
column2: 小狐 D 配置为间接火力支援，装备双联 LRM-15 挂架以及一具 LRM-5。它还携带一具 NARC 导弹信标，且此信标可被小狐 D 自己利用——因为氏族 LRM 的瞄准系统没有最小射程，这实际上让小狐 D 能冲到敌人跟前为其标记以提升精度，然后一面后撤一面持续开火。

column1: In its primary configuration, the Kit Fox mounts an ER Large Laser and Small Pulse Laser on the left arm as its primary source of firepower. These are supplemented by an LB 5-X Autocannon for tactical flexibility and a Streak SRM-4 rack for close range combat.
column2: 主配置中，小狐左臂装备一门 ER 大型激光和一门小型脉冲激光作为主要火力。它们由一门 LB 5-X 自动炮（提供战术灵活性）和一具连续 SRM-4 挂架（用于近战）作补充。

column1: The Kit Fox S is a Clan Snow Raven variant based for space combat. The primary weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, while a Medium Pulse Laser and a Small Pulse Laser complement this, with a Streak SRM-4 for additional firepower.
column2: 小狐 S 是雪鸦氏族的太空战变体。主武器是一门大型脉冲激光，另有一门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光作配合，并以一具连续 SRM-4 提供额外火力。

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Lacerator comes equiped with 2 Clan AC5's with 2 medium lasers as backup. An AMS is installed for defense.
column2: 撕裂者是一款流畅、机动而多用途的设计，装备 2 门氏族 AC5，另有 2 门中型激光备用。为防御还安装了 AMS。

column1: This Clan Smoke Jaguar version is set up to sport an Extended Range Large Laser in its center torso, with a Small Pulse Laser in each arm, making this variant a quite capable infantry killer in addition to its role as a fast sniper.
column2: 这款烟虎氏族版本在中央躯干装有一门增程大型激光，每臂各一门小型脉冲激光，使此变体除担任快速狙击手之外，也是相当能干的步兵杀手。

column1: The original Longbow built in 2480, carried twin LRM-20s each with three tons of ammunition, supported by two Medium Lasers and a Small Laser. The Primitive Technology used limited the design's top speed to 54km/h, but this was deemed acceptable for a fire support unit.
column2: 原版长弓于 2480 年建造，携带双联 LRM-20（各配三吨弹药），辅以两门中型激光和一门小型激光。所使用的原始技术把该设计的最高速度限制在 54 公里/小时，但这对于火力支援单位而言可以接受。

column1: This configuration was used for direct fire support roles. A Large Pulse Laser in one arm supported an Ultra AC/10 in the other. A pair of ER Medium Lasers gave the Lupus A additional firepower in case the 'Mech went through all 30 reloads for the autocannon. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat manageable.
column2: 此配置用于直射火力支援角色。一臂的大型脉冲激光支援另一臂的超速 AC/10。两门 ER 中型激光为狼人 A 在自动炮的 30 发再装填打完后提供额外火力。十二台双倍散热器使热量保持在可控范围。

column1: This version also used an autocannon, but it was a massive LB 20-X AC with three tons of ammunition. This was supported by a pair each of Medium Pulse Lasers, ER Small Lasers, and ER Medium Lasers. This variant carried eleven double heat sinks.
column2: 此版本同样使用自动炮，但是一门巨型 LB 20-X AC，配三吨弹药。它由成对的中型脉冲激光、ER 小型激光和 ER 中型激光支援。该变体携带十一台双倍散热器。

column1: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
column2: 狼人的主配置取代了弓箭手与轰炸机两款机甲。两具配改进型 Artemis IV 制导系统的 LRM-20 发射器，让战士能在敌人接近前将其摧毁。狼人主型号还携带一套跳跃推进器，让聪明的战士有机会保持距离，用重型导弹弹幕轰炸敌人。唯一缺点是弹药有限：仅三吨弹药只够短暂交战。若敌人逼近狼人，也并非无计可施。每臂的 ER 中型激光让狼人能削切装甲，而 ECM 套件使狼人主型号更难被锁定。

column1: The Mad Dog A can bring devastating fire on targets at any range, mounting an ER PPC and an LB 5-X AC, with which it can easily cripple enemies from long range. Should it get close enough, its six SRM-6 racks ensure the demise of nearly any foe.
column2: 疯狗 A 能在任何距离上向目标倾泻毁灭火力，装备一门 ER PPC 和一门 LB 5-X AC，凭此可轻易在远距离瘫痪敌人。一旦它贴近，六具 SRM-6 挂架几乎能确保任何敌人的灭亡。

column1: The Mad Dog's most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
column2: 疯狗最显著的特征是其侧面躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这款机甲最初是作为远程支援单位构想的。高高倾斜的躯干模块非常适合导弹，而臂部则如同延伸炮塔，适合直射武器。

column1: The Mad Dog C greatly differs from the other configurations, having replaced its entire weapon load with two massive Gauss Rifles for a powerful long-range punch.
column2: 疯狗 C 与其他配置差异极大，它把全部武器载荷换成两门巨型高斯步枪，换取强大的远程打击力。

column1: This variant uses a pair of ATM 12s that are powerful at all ranges. It also uses paired ER Medium Lasers, Medium Pulse Lasers, and ER Small Lasers. An extra heat sink helps to keep heat levels under some control.
column2: 此变体使用两具在所有距离上都强劲的 ATM 12。它还配有成对的 ER 中型激光、中型脉冲激光和 ER 小型激光。一台额外散热器有助于将热量水平控制在某种程度的掌握之中。

column1: Built with new Heavy Laser technology, the Mad Dog H downgrades the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s, so it can mount it's arsenal of a Heavy Large Laser and three Heavy Medium Lasers, making it much more capable at close range.
column2: 疯狗 H 采用新型重型激光技术建造，将 LRM-20 发射器降级为 LRM-15，以便搭载由一门重型大型激光和三门重型中型激光组成的武器库，使其在近距离强大得多。

column1: In its primary configuration the Men Shen is a powerful close combat 'Mech and is capable of providing indirect fire support to friendly units. For close-range combat, the primary configuration has four highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. To provide both direct and indirect long range fire support, the primary configuration of the Men Shen has an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy.
column2: 主配置中，门神是一台强大的近战机甲，并能向友军单位提供间接火力支援。近程战斗方面，主配置有四门极为精准的中型脉冲激光。为提供直接与间接的远程火力支援，门神主配置装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度的 LRM-15 发射器。

column1: A versatile configuration, the A configuration has an LB-X Autocannon/10 that allows it to fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For close combat, the A configuration has three ER Medium Lasers and a TAG laser designator allowing the 'Mech to call in friendly artillery fire on a target.
column2: A 配置是多用途配置，装有一门 LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹与集束弹。近战方面，A 配置有三门 ER 中型激光和一具 TAG 激光指示器，使机甲能召唤友军炮火打击目标。

column1: Intended to act as a long range sniper, the B configuration of the Men Shen carries as its primary weapons a pair of LB-X Autocannon/2s that allow it to fire either standard and cluster ammunition as well as act as a anti-aircraft 'Mech. For close combat, the B configuration has four ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 门神 B 配置意在担任远程狙击手，主武器为一对 LB-X 自动炮/2，可发射标准弹与集束弹，也能充当防空机甲。近战方面，B 配置有四门 ER 中型激光。

column1: A close combat machine, the C configuration carries two highly accurate Large Pulse Lasers as its primary weapons. These are backed up by an ER Small Laser. To handle the 'Mech's heat load, the C configuration has an additional double heat sink. The C configuration also has an ECM Suite to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
column2: C 配置是一台近战机器，以两门极为精准的大型脉冲激光为主武器，辅以一门 ER 小型激光。为处理机甲的热负荷，C 配置多一台双倍散热器。C 配置还装有 ECM 套件以抵御敌方电子战设备。

column1: Intended for both long range and close combat, the D configuration of the Men Shen has an ER PPC to provide long range firepower. When it closes with an enemy, it can bring its two SRM-4 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers to bear. For added heat dissipation, the D configuration has an additional double heat sink.
column2: 门神 D 配置兼顾远程与近战，装有一门 ER PPC 提供远程火力。接近敌人时，它可动用两具 SRM-4 发射器和两门中型脉冲激光。为提升散热，D 配置多一台双倍散热器。

column1: A close combat configuration, the Mist Lynx B has two ER Medium Lasers and two SRM-6 launchers for its primary weapons. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser as a weapon for extremely close ranges.
column2: 雾豹 B 是近战配置，以两门 ER 中型激光和两具 SRM-6 发射器为主武器。它们由一门 ER 小型激光作为极近距离武器支援。

column1: The C configuration of the Mist Lynx is armed with a single ER Large Laser as its primary weapon backed up by an ER Medium Laser for close combat. For added protection, the Mist Lynx C has an Anti-Missile System for protection from missile fire and an ECM Suite to protect it from enemy electronic warfare systems.
column2: 雾豹 C 配置以一门 ER 大型激光为主武器，辅以一门 ER 中型激光用于近战。为增强防护，雾豹 C 装有反导系统以抵御导弹火力，以及 ECM 套件以抵御敌方电子战系统。

column1: In its primary configuration the Mist Lynx is armed to engage an enemy at any range. For long range combat, the Mist Lynx carries a single LRM-10 launcher, which is backed up by a Streak SRM-4 launcher for close combat. Finally, to protect itself from infantry, the Mist Lynx carries two Machine Guns.
column2: 主配置中，雾豹可在任何距离接敌。远程方面，雾豹携带一具 LRM-10 发射器，辅以一具连续 SRM-4 发射器用于近战。最后，为防御步兵，雾豹携带两挺机枪。

column1: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems.
column2: 娜迦是第一代樵夫全能机甲的支援后继型，但在许多方面都颇为另类。本可作为吊舱空间的大部分位置，实际被两套固定式箭矢 IV 火炮系统占据。

column1: This design mounts only five tons of ammo. It also carries an ER Small Laser and a pair of ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 该设计仅携带五吨弹药。它还装有一门 ER 小型激光和一对 ER 中型激光。

column1: This variant carries four tons of ammunition, three ER Mediums and an ER Small.
column2: 此型号携带四吨弹药、三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。

column1: The C Configuration carries four ammo bins that can each hold a ton for the artillery weapons. For backup, it has a pair of ER Small Lasers and an SRM-6s.
column2: C 配置携带四个弹药箱，每个可为火炮武器装载一吨弹药。作为后备，它有一对 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-6。

column1: This variant downgrades the missile launcher of the C to an SRM-4 and upgrades one of the ER Smalls to an ER Medium Laser.
column2: 此变体把 C 型的导弹发射器降级为 SRM-4，并把其中一门 ER 小型激光升级为 ER 中型激光。

column1: The Night Gyr B seeks to destroy opponents before they can return fire. A pair of Gauss Rifles and LB-X Autocannon/2s carry out that mandate. Ammo is somewhat lacking, however, so this design cannot stray far from supply, especially as it has no backup energy weapons.
