column2: 夜隼 B 力求在对手还击之前将其摧毁。两门高斯步枪和两门 LB-X 自动炮/2 执行这一使命。然而弹药稍显不足，因此该设计不能远离补给，尤其因为它没有备用能量武器。

column1: This missile boat carries four LRM-20 launchers, each of which is slaved to an Artemis IV FCS. Six tons of ammunition is barely enough to keep it firing for a minute. A Large Pulse Laser and Medium Pulse Laser are effective backup weapons.
column2: 这款导弹平台携带四具 LRM-20 发射器，每具都从属于一套 Artemis IV 火控系统。六吨弹药勉强够它持续开火一分钟。一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光是有效的备用武器。

column1: The original primitive Orion 'Mech as it was first commissioned lacked an LRM launcher and used an Autocannon/5 in place of the AC/10.  A massive 360 engine allowed the 'Mech to obtain a maximum speed of nearly 64.8 km/h, however there was not enough saved weight to mount additional weaponry besides two Medium Lasers, one in each arm. In addition it only mounted 14.5 tons of armor, and ultimately would be considered too lightly armed and armored with the prototype dismissed as a candidate for production.
column2: 初版原始猎户座机甲在被首次定型时没有 LRM 发射器，并以一门自动炮/5 取代 AC/10。一台巨大的 360 引擎使机甲能达到近 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度，但节省的重量不足以在每臂各一门中型激光之外加装更多武器。此外它只披挂 14.5 吨装甲，最终被认为武装与装甲都过于薄弱，该原型被排除在量产候选之外。

column1: Built by General Mechanics, the ON1-H was the third known primitive prototype of the Orion 'Mech that was eventually accepted for mass production in 2456. While slower than the first iterations, with a top speed of only 54 km/h (the same as that of a Mackie or Banshee), due to the inclusion of a smaller 275-class engine, the additional weight saved allowed the designers to mount far more firepower. A newly developed Class-10 Prototype Autocannon was installed and two tons of ammo in place of the AC/5. This was backed up by two 5-tube Long-Range Missile launchers with one ton of reloads in the left torso for striking enemies at range and a short-range SRM-4 missile launcher and a ton of ammunition installed in the left arm for close-in defense. It was also heavily protected by 21 tons of armor. A minimal amount of heatsinks, however, could cause build-up of heat within crippling levels, but could be avoided by competent MechWarriors.
column2: ON1-H 由通用机械制造，是猎户座机甲第三个已知的原始原型，最终于 2456 年被批准量产。虽然比最初几版更慢，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时（与麦基或女妖相当），因为采用了更小的 275 级引擎，但节省的额外重量让设计师能装上多得多的火力。它安装了新研制的 10 级原型自动炮和两吨弹药，取代 AC/5。远程打击方面辅以两具 5 管远程导弹发射器（左躯干一吨再装填），近身防御则有左臂的一具短程 SRM-4 导弹发射器和一吨弹药。它还有 21 吨装甲的重型防护。然而散热器数量极少，热量可能累积到致残水平，但能干的机甲战士可以避免这一点。

column1: This is one of the many minor variants of the ON1-M model introduced in 3052. The Narc Missile Beacon is removed to allow a larger SRM-6 to replace the four pack. Both missile racks also have Artemis IV Fire Control System to increase accuracy. Finally, medium pulse lasers are mounted in place of original mediums.
column2: 这是 3052 年推出的 ON1-M 型号众多次要变体之一。它移除 NARC 导弹信标，以便用更大的 SRM-6 取代四联装。两个导弹挂架也都配有 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。最后，原来的中型激光换成中型脉冲激光。

column1: A second minor variant of the ON1-M introduced in 3058. The LB-X Autocannon/10 is swapped for a Light Gauss Rifle with a single ton of ammunition while the medium lasers are upgraded to extended range versions.
column2: 这是 3058 年推出的 ON1-M 第二个次要变体。LB-X 自动炮/10 换成一门轻型高斯步枪（配一吨弹药），中型激光则升级为增程版本。

column1: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 2D variant of the Ostroc extends the 'Mechs maximum range by replacing the Large Lasers with two ER Large Lasers. The 2D retains the Medium Lasers and SRM-4 of the 2C model. To handle the heat burden it is also equipped with double heat sinks. Being a relatively rare design, the Ostroc had no official field refit kit but the 2D variant was a common upgrade in 3050 if the parts could be obtained.
column2: 奥斯特洛克 2D 变体以星盟科技升级，将大型激光换成两门 ER 大型激光，从而拓展机甲的最大射程。2D 保留 2C 型号的中型激光和 SRM-4。为应对热负荷它还配备双倍散热器。作为一个相对罕见的设计，奥斯特洛克没有官方野战改装套件，但 2D 变体在 3050 年是常见的升级方案——前提是能弄到零件。

column1: The 2L variant of the Ostroc introduced in 2884 is modified for long range combat. The SRM-4 launcher has been replaced with an LRM-5 launcher, increasing the 'Mechs long-range damage capabilities slightly by sacrificing some of its close range firepower.
column2: 奥斯特罗克 2L 变体于 2884 年推出，为远程战斗而改装。SRM-4 发射器换成 LRM-5 发射器，以牺牲部分近程火力为代价略微提升机甲的远程伤害能力。

column1: The 2M Ostwar was armed with a twenty-tube Doombud Long Range Missile launcher for its long range attacks. In close range, the 'Mech was armed with two four-tubed Shannon SH-40 Short-Range Missile launchers in each of its paddle shaped forearms. It also mounted two Martell Medium Lasers mounted on the left torso. The 'Mech carried three tons of ammunition for the LRM rack, while carrying a ton of SRM ammunition in its left arm.
column2: 2M 奥斯特战争装备一具 20 管末日芽远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离方面，它的两只桨形前臂各装备两具四管香农 SH-40 短程火箭发射器。左躯干还装有两门马特尔中型激光。机甲为 LRM 挂架携带三吨弹药，左臂则携带一吨 SRM 弹药。

column1: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
column2: 珀尔修斯是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。珀尔修斯与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者不仅外观上大体相似，还使用了若干相同部件。这种相似让不少联盟军技师将新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"，而珀尔修斯的部署也主要面向那些大量装备其前身的精锐部队，一对一替换老旧猎户座。珀尔修斯采用轻量化内骨骼底盘，由赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的结构与引擎为武器和装备腾出大量重量。它以十四吨英勇拉梅洛装甲防护，装甲水平约为此尺寸机甲的平均值。它还固定配备十二台双倍散热器。

column1: Fast Striker Omni
column2: 快速打击全能机甲

column1: Technicron's replacement for the original 4G model, the 5M was introduced in 3049 as an answer to the original's heat problems by replacing the thirteen normal heat sinks with double-strength versions. It also improved the design's defenses by swapping out the regular armor with Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous and installing CASE for the LRM's ammunition. The space necessary for these upgrades was provided for by removing the SRM launcher for a one-shot Hovertec SRM-4 Launcher, a disposable missile launcher more commonly found on VTOLs, hovercraft and similar combat vehicles. The loss in sheer short-range firepower is more than made up for by the other upgrades to the design.
column2: 5M 是泰克尼创为原 4G 型号打造的替代品，于 3049 年推出，以双倍强度散热器取代十三台普通散热器来回应原版的热量问题。它还通过把常规装甲换成卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维、并为 LRM 弹药安装 C.A.S.E. 来改善设计的防御。这些升级所需的空间来自移除 SRM 发射器，换成单次发射的霍弗泰克 SRM-4 发射器——一种在垂直起降机、悬浮车及类似战斗车辆上更常见的可弃导弹发射器。近程火力上的损失，被其他升级远远补偿。

column1: he Savage Coyote OmniMech was created as a showcase OmniMech. The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
column2: 野蛮郊狼全能机甲是作为展示型全能机甲而打造的。这台机甲也是可汗科加重振发明全能机甲却日渐衰落的氏族的努力之一。

column1: The primary configuration of the Savage Coyote makes use of a pair of the largest ATM, An ER PPC, an LB-X Autocannon/10, three ER Medium Lasers, and a pair of ER Small Lasers. MechWarriors must carefully manage heat levels, even with three additional double heat sinks
column2: 野蛮郊狼主配置使用一对最大的 ATM、一门 ER PPC、一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、三门 ER 中型激光和一对 ER 小型激光。即便有三台额外双倍散热器，机甲战士也必须小心管理热量水平

column1: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
column2: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC that Inner Sphere forces encountered is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。内天体部队遭遇的第一版影鹰 IIC 是为近战而设，看起来在设计时考虑了城市战。

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。较新的变体，可追溯至 3050 年代末，IIC 3 的主炮是一门重型大型激光。

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。

column1: Reintroduced in 3053, the Spector mounts a Magna 245 XL engine in combination with an XL Engine and an  Endo Steel chassis. It carries seven and a half tons of armor along with seven jump jets. The Spector carries a Nightwind Large Laser as its primary weapon,  backed up by a pair of Defiance B3M Medium Lasers and a single Defiance B4S Small Laser for close combat. Defensively the Spector carries a Norse Guardian ECM Suite that allows it to defend itself against advanced enemy targeting and range finding equipment.
column2: 幽灵于 3053 年重新推出，采用玛格纳 245 XL 引擎，结合 XL 引擎与内骨骼底盘。它携带七吨半装甲和七个跳跃推进器。幽灵以一门风夜大型激光为主武器，辅以两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光和一门迪法恩斯 B4S 小型激光用于近战。防御方面，幽灵携带北欧守护者 ECM 套件，可防御敌方先进的瞄准与测距设备。

column1: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations.
column2: 5M 变体源自自由世界联盟，是潜行者的升级版，于 3050 年推出，使用了适度数量的星盟技术。大部分武器得以保留，但两门大型激光被移除，换成一门装在机甲中线上的"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光，以及左躯干一具 NARC 导弹信标配两吨再装填，使潜行者能为敌方单位打上自导信标并把友军导弹火力引导到它们身上。5M 的十七台双倍散热器赋予它远胜前型号二十台单散热器的散热效率，尽管它仍无法同时发射全部武器，另加了一吨装甲以提升生存性。其他改动包括采用专有组件，如"伊里安 E.A.R."通讯系统、里泽-456 装甲和伊里安 30 级底盘。遗憾的是，新 5M 的设计者放弃了 C.A.S.E.，这一因素直接导致氏族入侵期间数台潜行者因过热与武器穿透引发弹药殉爆而损毁。

column1: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker uses moderate amounts of Star League technology. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models. The Large Lasers were removed, replaced with a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon. The beacon allows the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacons, allowing friendly 'Mechs to easily send missile salvos its way. Finally, the 'Mech bears an additional ton of armor for added survivability.
column2: 5M 变体源自自由世界联盟，使用适度数量的星盟技术。5M 的十七台双倍散热器赋予它远胜前型号二十台单散热器的散热效率。两门大型激光被移除，换成一门装在机甲中线的"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光和一具 NARC 导弹信标。信标使潜行者能为敌方单位打上自导信标，让友军机甲轻易向它倾泻导弹齐射。最后，机甲多携带一吨装甲以提升生存性。

column1: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
column2: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为近战。

column1: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
column2: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种近战配置。

column1: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
column2: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。

column1: A long range support configuration, the Stormcrow D has, as its primary weapons, a pair of LRM-20 launchers. These are backed up by two SRM-2 launchers for close combat.
column2: 风暴鸦 D 是一款远程支援配置，主武器为两具 LRM-20 发射器。它们由两具 SRM-2 发射器支援用于近战。

column1: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 暴风鸦 E 能在任何距离上交战，主武器为一对 ATM-9 发射器。它们能发射短程、中程和远程弹药。为增强近程火力，这些发射器由四门 ER 小型激光和两门 ER 中型激光支援。

column1: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
column2: H 是主配置的重型激光版本，以两门重型大型激光为主武器。它们由三门 ER 中型激光支援。

column1: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
column2: H 是主配置的重型激光版本，以两门重型大型激光为主武器。它们由三门 ER 中型激光支援。

column1: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. To ferret out hidden enemy forces, the Stormcrow I configuration mounts an Active Probe in the head.
column2: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。为搜出隐藏的敌军，暴风鸦 I 配置在头部安装一具主动探测器。

column1: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser.
column2: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。

column1: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
column2: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责近战。

column1: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
column2: 召唤者 B 是一款导弹轰炸配置，携带两具 LRM-20 发射器用于远程交战。近战方面，它有两具 SRM-4 发射器。一具 NARC 导弹信标让召唤者能为其他友军单位的导弹火力标记目标。召唤者 B 还通过一套反导系统获得进一步保护，提升对导弹攻击的防御。

column1: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
column2: 召唤者 C 是一款近战近战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。

column1: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
column2: 主配置中，召唤者拥有基础却有效的武器库。主要直射武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，后者可发射标准弹与集束弹。用于火力支援与轰炸，召唤者有一具 LRM-15 发射器。

column1: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
column2: A 配置几乎与主型号针锋相对，每侧躯干装双联超速 AC/2，若两吨超速弹药耗尽，则由每臂一门 ER 大型激光支援。该配置另有一台额外双倍散热器补全。

column1: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。

column1: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
column2: C 配置是经典的 LRM 导弹平台，每臂装备两具 LRM-15，两侧躯干各以一具 LRM-20 支援。它携带六吨 LRM 导弹，一台额外双倍散热器尽力维持太阳蜘蛛的火力。

column1: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

column1: The Sun Spider F configuration mounts an ERPPC in each arm and an LBX10 Autocannon in the right torso. A single AP Gauss rifle and anti-Battlearmor pod help deal with enemy infantry. A pair of anti-missile systems and an ECM suite enhance defense.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 F 配置在每臂装一门 ER PPC，右躯干一门 LBX10 自动炮。一门单装 AP 高斯步枪和反战斗装甲荚舱帮助对付敌方步兵。两套反导系统和一套 ECM 套件增强防御。

column1: The F model of the Sun Spider can put out some solid hits at almost any range, it's well protected with a pair of AMS and slight up-armoring.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 F 型号几乎能在任何距离上打出扎实的命中，它由一对 AMS 和少量额外装甲保护好。

column1: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为近战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

column1: Four Myths
column2: 四个神话

column1: The Thorn carries a weapons array that is not usually seen on light 'Mechs: a Zeus-5 LRM launcher mounted in the right arm with one ton of reloads in the right torso, paired with two Hellion Spitfire Medium Lasers split between the head and left arm. Four and a half tons of armor provides the Thorn with good protection, especially when mated with CASE to contain any ammunition explosions.
column2: 荆棘携带轻型机甲上不常见的武器阵列：右臂一具宙斯-5 LRM 发射器（右躯干一吨再装填），配以分列头部与左臂的两门海利昂"喷火"中型激光。四吨半装甲为荆棘提供良好防护，尤其配合 C.A.S.E. 遏制弹药爆炸时。

column1: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn.
column2: THE-N1 于 3051 年根据战务长官阿纳斯塔修斯·福赫特的命令开发，试图缩小氏族与康卫之间的差距，这款工厂改装型在图卡伊德战役中接受了战火洗礼。它得出了与 THE-Nb 相似的结论，因此舍弃 C.A.S.E. 并把标准引擎换成 XL 引擎，以便剥离标准武器、改用全能量武器阵列：右臂一门"族杀 H 级"ER PPC 和头部一门英泰克小型激光。这一新武器阵列在双倍散热器的强化下，为荆棘带来了前所未有的杀伤力。

column1: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML 7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher.
column2: THE-N2 是布雷克之言于 3071 年开发的 THE-N1 新量产变体，它同时借鉴了 THE-N 与 THE-T 变体，把 ER PPC 换成 MML 7，标准小型激光换成多元光学 ER 小型激光。一个两吨、有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱使 THE-N2 能同时携带 LRM 与 SRM 弹药，以最大化利用多用途导弹发射器。

column1: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
column2: 这款先进型号于 2743 年由星盟防卫军皇家师使用，它把机甲的角色从导弹平台改为能量平台，以一门 ER 大型激光取代 LRM 发射器，保留一门中型激光，另一门降级为小型激光。舍弃不再需要的 C.A.S.E.，机甲还使用 MASC 系统实现临时速度爆发，并以双倍散热器排出增加的废热。THE-Nb 装 XL 引擎以省出重量安装这些额外装备，代价是生存性降低。

column1: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced.
column2: THE-S 由康星作为 3035 年"玫瑰花蕾"行动的一部分提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，是 THE-N 的降级工厂改装型。它拆除了先进的内骨骼底盘和 C.A.S.E.，改用较重的标准底盘，迫使荆棘的装甲防护减少半吨，其中大部分从头颅和后躯干扣除。通讯系统也换成更原始的奥姆斯特德 30，尽管奥米克戎 VII 瞄准追踪系统的性能与被它取代的猎户座 80 相近。

column1: Developed in 3038 by the Draconis Combine in an attempt to upgrade the 'Mech's short range firepower prior to the War of 3039, the THE-T is a field refit of the downgraded THE-S that swaps out the LRM launcher for an SRM-4.
column2: THE-T 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 3038 年开发，试图在 3039 年战争前升级机甲的近程火力，它是对降级版 THE-S 的野战改装，把 LRM 发射器换成 SRM-4。

column1: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
column2: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

column1: the Turkina mounts enough jump jets to vault 90 meters hardwired onto the frame, rather than using them in modular pods. While this simplified repair, it also uses tonnage that could be devoted to other systems when a mission does not call for jumping.
column2: 图尔基娜装有足以跃过 90 米的跳跃推进器，且是硬接在框架上而非使用模块化吊舱。这虽然简化了维修，但也占用了在任务无需跳跃时可分配给其他系统的吨位。

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
column2: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

column1: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor.
column2: 女武神 II 项目最初是给两个 NAIS 学员设计小组的作业：基于女武神 VLK-QA 打造一款新的重型侦察与散兵机甲。两队之间的竞争以及达维昂官僚的外来压力，把两个设计都推得远超 VLK-QA 的替代品。阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司获得合同建造女武神 II-1A，它配备一台赫尔墨斯 360XL 引擎、六个跳跃推进器、一门 ER PPC、一具 LRM10 以及超过十一吨装甲。

column1: Heavy Recon
column2: 重型侦察

column1: I heard of this project; it was pretty bad, lot's of money changing hands and lot's of competing design requirements. It's a miracle these things ever made it to production. I will say this, the Valkyrie II is faster than the original despite being twice the weight while carrying a stronger weapons and armor compliment. It may not excel at anything in particular but it can work for most jobs it is tasked with.
column2: 我听说过这个项目；相当糟糕，大量资金易手，大量相互冲突的设计要求。这些东西能投产简直是奇迹。我得说，女武神 II 虽然重量是原版的两倍，却比原版更快，还携带更强的武器与装甲配置。它也许在任何方面都不突出，但能胜任交给它的大多数工作。

column1: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9K replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9K is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor.
column2: 9K 是使用星盟技术的升级，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮/20，能在远得多的距离上造成严重伤害。机甲还携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-4 发射器用于近战。为实现这些改动，9K 基于内骨骼底盘建造。凭借节省的重量，机甲还多携带一吨装甲。

column1: The VTR-9K incorporates several Lostech technologies, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, the Medium Lasers with Medium Pulse Lasers, and adding CASE, all on an Endo-Steel frame.
column2: VTR-9K 融入多项失传技术，以一门高斯步枪取代 AC/20，以中型脉冲激光取代中型激光，并加装 C.A.S.E.，全部基于内骨骼框架。

column1: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
column2: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。

column1: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
column2: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。

column1: This House Kurita variant, introduced in 3054, was built on an Endo Steel skeleton. It carried ER PPCs, two medium lasers, and two small pulse lasers. The SRM-6 was replaced by a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers, while a TAG system allowed the 7K to spot for friendly artillery units.
column2: 这款库瑞塔家族变体于 3054 年推出，建立在内骨骼骨架上。它携带 ER PPC、两门中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光。SRM-6 换成两具连续 SRM-2 发射器，TAG 系统则使 7K 能为友军炮兵单位侦察。

column1: The 7M variant was introduced in 3047 by Ronin Inc. as the official upgraded variant of the Warhammer for the Free Worlds League. Built around a Magna 280 fusion engine, the 7M had a top speed of 64.5 km/h and carried eighteen double heat sinks to handle the waste heat generated by its two Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right.
column2: 7M 变体由浪人公司于 3047 年推出，是自由世界联盟战锤的官方升级变体。它围绕玛格纳 280 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.5 公里/小时，携带十八台双倍散热器以处理两门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 产生的废热。支援这些新武器的是两侧躯干的两门马特尔中型激光和右肩上方一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 发射器。右躯干携带一挺 LFN 林德布拉德机枪，左侧则装一套 LFN 林德布拉德霰弹反导系统。中央躯干携带一吨机枪弹，右侧则各携带一吨导弹再装填和一吨 AMS 弹药。

column1: The 7S Warhammer was the official upgraded version built for the Federated Commonwealth by Olivettie Weaponry. Built out of their Sudeten factory starting in 3050, the 7S retained the small lasers of the original but updated the rest of the weaponry. It carried two arm-mounted ER PPCs, two Defiance P5M medium pulse lasers in the side torsos, and two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers in place of the SRM-6 launcher. Eighteen double heat sinks handled the additional waste heat and one ton of reloads for the Streak launchers was carried in the center torso.
column2: 7S 战锤是奥利维蒂兵器为联邦联邦建造的官方升级版。自 3050 年起在其苏德滕工厂生产，7S 保留了原版的小型激光，但更新了其余武器。它携带两门臂载 ER PPC、两侧躯干各两门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，以及两具考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器取代 SRM-6。十八台双倍散热器处理额外废热，中央躯干携带一吨连续发射器再装填。

column1: Apparently designed to reduce heat, this configuration of the Warhawk carries a single ER PPC in each arm backed up by an LRM-20 and LRM-10. A torso-mounted Ultra AC/2 rounds out the weapons. Like most Warhawk variants, this version carries an advanced Targeting Computer.
column2: 此战鹰配置显然是为降低热量而设计，每臂一门 ER PPC，辅以一具 LRM-20 和一具 LRM-10。躯干搭载的是一门超速 AC/2。与大多数战鹰变体一样，此版本配备先进瞄准计算机。

column1: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets.
column2: 玉皇以中国古代神话中主宰天庭的玉皇大帝命名，首次亮相时孙泰子承诺"它将坐镇战场之上，向那些侵犯我们的人施以正义"。为不负卡佩兰邦联大臣的承诺，玉皇在首次生产时携带了当时最先进的技术。它建立在战车型 II 内骨骼底盘上，搭载赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64.8 公里/小时。凭借四个罗丹 90 跳跃推进器，机甲可跳跃至一百二十米。

column1: The H10G variant is designed to directly engage an enemy at short ranges. The 10G removes all of the 'Mechs weapons. Instead, it carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for long range combat. This is supported by an ER Large Laser for additional long range firepower. For close combat, the 10G has six ER Medium Lasers and also carries a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe to both protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronics systems and find hidden enemy units to prevent ambushes.
column2: H10G 变体设计用于在近程直接与敌交战。10G 移除机甲全部武器，改为携带一门强力高斯步枪用于远程战斗。它由一门 ER 大型激光支援以增加远程火力。近战方面，10G 有六门 ER 中型激光，还携带一套守护者 ECM 套件和一具比格犬主动探测器，既能保护机甲免受敌方先进电子系统干扰，也能找出隐藏的敌方单位以防伏击。

column1: This Clan upgraded Alacorn mounts four Gauss Rifles with five tons of ammo. Developed in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Deployed throughout the Periphery, General Aleksandr Kerensky was reported to have taken hundreds of them during the Exodus. Although some of the earliest versions mount various autocannons the Alacorn became famous for it's array of gauss rifles. Their combination of heavy punch and long range makes the Alacorn a threat to any unit on the field. Tracked: Slow but able to cross most terrain. Fusion: Expensive engine that works in a Vacuum.
column2: 这款氏族升级版阿拉科恩装备四门高斯步枪和五吨弹药。阿拉科恩于 2587 年开发，在星盟防卫军中赢得了高效可靠坦克的声誉。它被部署到整个外围区，据报亚历山大·克伦斯基将军在出埃及期间带走了数百辆。尽管最早的一些版本装的是各种自动炮，阿拉科恩是因它那批高斯步枪而成名的。重击与远程的结合使阿拉科恩成为战场上对任何单位的威胁。 履带式： 缓慢，但能穿越大多数地形。 聚变： 昂贵的引擎，可在真空中工作。

column1: The AS7-K-DC is a command version of the AS7-K. To be able to fit a command console, a ton of LRM ammo and one medium pulse laser was removed.
column2: AS7-K-DC 是 AS7-K 的指挥版本。为容纳一台指挥控制台，移除了一吨 LRM 弹药和一门中型脉冲激光。

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan hellhound was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族地狱犬长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

column1: A Griffin sporting ClanTech upgrades.
column2: 装备氏族科技升级的狮鹫。

column1: With a high damage profile at long and short range, the Hellbringer B does not utilize energy weapons as much, and so has few issues with heat buildup.
column2: 凭借远程与近程的高伤害曲线，地狱使者 B 不太使用能量武器，因此在积热上问题不大。

column1: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
column2: 詹纳于 2784 年 9 月首次投入战场，同年的 11 月，最终成为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们究竟如何在如此短的时间内获得这一设计尚不清楚，但已知的是氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。

column1: A ClanTech upgraded Kintaro.
column2: 氏族科技升级的金太郎。

column1: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.
column2: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产与运营成本成为内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一，在氏族中同样广为人知。2832 年，猫鼬氏族向氏族推出这款古老机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。该高速设计与猫鼬战术相得益彰，使他们赢下许多试炼。

column1: This version was redesigned so that it could be produced in the Inner Sphere by Clan Jade Falcon on their Occupation Zone headquarters world of Sudeten. It replaces the small lasers of the standard variant with three General Systems Heavy Small Lasers in each arm. The medium pulse laser has been downgraded to a Series 7Ja ER Medium Laser, while a pair of additional double heat sinks are added to help deal with the increased heat.
column2: 此版本经过重新设计，以便翡翠猎鹰氏族能在其占领区总部世界苏德滕于内天体生产。它将标准变体的小型激光换成每臂三门通用系统重型小型激光。中型脉冲激光被降级为 7Ja 系列 ER 中型激光，同时加装两台额外双倍散热器以应对增加的热量。

column1: The Mad Dog’s most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
column2: 疯狗最显著的特征是其侧躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这台机甲在设计时就构想为远程支援单位。躯干模块高高倾斜，非常适合安装导弹，而臂部则充当适于直射武器的延伸炮塔。

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Nova was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族诺瓦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

column1: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout.
column2: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。

column1: The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
column2: 这台机甲也是可汗科加重振发明全能机甲却日渐衰落的氏族的努力之一。

column1: A Clan redesign of 'Amaris Folly'.
column2: 氏族重新设计的"阿马里斯之愚"。

column1: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
column2: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为近战。

column1: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
column2: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种近战配置。

column1: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
column2: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。

column1: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 暴风鸦 E 能在任何距离上交战，主武器为一对 ATM-9 发射器。它们能发射短程、中程和远程弹药。为增强近程火力，这些发射器由四门 ER 小型激光和两门 ER 中型激光支援。

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
column2: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了——它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC.
column2: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans’ return to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。

column1: This was a Turhan Urban Assault Vehicle. Someone stuffed most of a space to ground microwave power transmission system into it's infantry bay. This large red button worries me.
column2: 这是一台图尔汗城市突击车辆。有人把一套空对地微波输电系统的大部分塞进了它的步兵舱。这个大红按钮让我担心。

column1: This rebadged Sleipnir replaces one of the standard medium lasers with a TAG to mark targets for allied strikes. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
column2: 这款换牌的斯雷普尼尔以一门 TAG 取代一门标准中型激光，为友军打击标记目标。装甲运兵车不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是把步兵班从一个战场运到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以安装相当的武器。

column1: This rebadged Vargr replaces one of the standard medium lasers with a TAG to mark targets for allied strikes. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
column2: 这款换牌的瓦格以一门 TAG 取代一门标准中型激光，为友军打击标记目标。装甲运兵车不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是把步兵班从一个战场运到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以安装相当的武器。

column1: The Heavy APC is twice is big as it's standard cousin, but otherwise similar. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
column2: 重型 APC 的体积是标准型表亲的两倍，其他方面相似。APC 不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是将步兵班从一个战场运送到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以搭载可观的武器。

column1: The Turhan was first built for the Terran Hegemony in 2530 by Dieron's Buhallin Military Products. The vehicle serves to transport and support troops in urban combat.
column2: 图尔汗于 2530 年由迪耶隆的布哈林军事产品公司为地球霸权首次建造。该车辆用于在城市战斗中运输与支援部队。

column1: APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
column2: APC 不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是将步兵班从一个战场运送到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以搭载可观的武器。

column1: The J-27 Ordnance Transport was the backbone of the Star League Defense Force and remains a common sight in Inner Sphere and Periphery armies. Consisting of a tracked cab and wheeled trailer unit driven by two crewmen, each J-27 can carry eleven tons of ammo in total.
column2: J-27 弹药运输车曾是星盟防卫军的脊梁，至今仍常见于内天体与外围区的军队中。它由一辆履带式驾驶舱和一个轮式拖车组成，由两名乘员驾驶，每辆 J-27 总共可运载十一吨弹药。

column1: Axman
column2: 刀斧手

column1: Developed by Team Banzai as the big brother of the highly successful Hatchetman, the Axman was designed exclusively to be a 'Mech killer. The Axman was also intended as a symbol of solidarity throughout the Federated Commonwealth by using components that were produced in Davion, Steiner, and even former Liao space. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 斧兵由班宰小队研发，是极为成功的刽子手的大哥，专门被设计为机甲杀手。斧兵还被用作整个联邦共同体团结的象征——它的部件分别产自达维昂、施泰纳乃至前廖氏领地。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.07

column1: An early prototype of the Axman, the AXM-1X paved the road for the large investments into the project by the AFFC that eventually led to its large success. Besides its large hatchet it mounts a Autocannon/10, a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. It also used a standard size engine and single heat sinks, making it quite inferior to many production run Axmans. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 作为斧兵的早期原型，AXM-1X为AFFC对该项目的大笔投资铺平了道路，最终带来了它的巨大成功。除了一把大斧，它还装有一门自动炮/10、一门大型激光器和两门中型激光器。它还采用标准尺寸引擎和单重散热器，使其远逊于多数量产型斧兵。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.07

column1: The 2N variant of the Axman, introduced in the late 3040s, has been called a mistake by some and a stroke of genius by others. The 2N carries two LRM-15 launchers in place of the massive Autocannon/20 as the autocannon often jammed on early models. While this changes the 'Mech's role from a city fighter to a long-range bombardment 'Mech, it also allows the Axman to be a support 'Mech that can defend itself with its massive Hatchet at ranges where the LRMs are ineffective if an enemy closes. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 斧兵的2N改型于3040年代末推出，有人称其为错误，也有人称之为神来之笔。由于早期型号的自动炮经常卡壳，2N以两具LRM-15发射器取代了庞大的自动炮/20。这虽然把该机甲的角色从城市战士变为远程轰炸机甲，但也让斧兵成为一台能自保的支援机甲——当敌人逼近、LRM失效时，它可以靠那把巨斧自我防卫。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: A short range brawler variant of the Axman, the AXM-2R is often run as the follow-up unit after other Axman models punched through most of an enemy's armor. Its short range loadout of two Artemis IV-enabled SRM-6 launchers, two Medium Pulser Lasers and a single Large Pulser Laser can deliver quite the punch. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 作为斧兵的近距近战改型，AXM-2R常在其他斧兵型号打穿敌方大部分装甲之后作为后续单位投入。它那套由两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的SRM-6发射器、两门中型脉冲激光器和一门大型脉冲激光器构成的近距载荷，打击力相当可观。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: The Furillo manufactured 3S introduced in 3057 removes the XL Engine of the 1N and 2N variants and replaces it with a Light Fusion Engine. This exclusively Lyran variant of the Axman is armed with a massive LB-X Autocannon/20, which allows it to fire either solid rounds or cluster rounds that act like a 'Mech sized shotgun. The 'Mech also carries three ER Medium Lasers for close combat and a Guardian ECM Suite, which defends against enemy electronic warfare equipment. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这台由富里洛制造、3057年推出的3S，拆掉了1N与2N改型的XL引擎，换成一具轻型聚变引擎。这款莱兰专属的斧兵改型武装为一门巨大的LB-X自动炮/20，可发射实心弹或集束弹，效果如同机甲尺寸的霰弹枪。该机甲还携带三门增程中型激光器用于近战，以及一套守卫者ECM套件，用于防御敌方电子战装备。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: Crab
column2: 螃蟹

column1: Designed in 2719 during the last days of the Star League, the Crab was built as a medium-weight raider and guerrilla fighter for the Star League Defense Force. Although lacking hand actuators or jump jets, it possessed good overland speed and its all-energy weapons payload was suitable for long-range missions without the prospect for resupply. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 螃蟹于2719年、星盟最后的日子里设计，是星盟防卫部队的中量级袭扰与游击战斗机甲。虽然没有手部驱动器或跳跃推进器，它拥有良好的地面速度，且全能量武器载荷使其适合在无从补给的情况下执行远程任务。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Crab CRB-27-EC was an upgrade of the CRB-27 that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，螃蟹CRB-27-EC是CRB-27的升级版，把武器换成了早期氏族变体。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: Crab 27s fulfill an oft overlooked role, that of a skirmisher with firepower. Wielding strong energy weapons, the Crab delivers a punch at nearly all ranges, with no ammunition constraints. The blend of firepower, heat efficiency, and speed make the Crab the perfect 'Mech to raid enemy positions. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 螃蟹27履行着一个常被忽视的角色：带火力的游击手。凭借强力的能量武器，螃蟹几乎在所有射程上都能打出打击，且不受弹药限制。火力、热效率与速度的结合，使螃蟹成为袭扰敌方阵地的完美机甲。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: A simple upgrade utilized by the SLDF Royals concurrently with the original Crab, the 27b replaces the heat sinks with double-strength models and the Lasers with Extended Range variants. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是SLDF皇家部队与原版螃蟹同期使用的一次简单升级，27b把散热器换成双倍强度型号，激光器换成增程型号。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: A simple upgrade utilized by the SLDF Royals concurrently with the original Crab, the 27sl changes the weapons payload to pulse variants. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是SLDF皇家部队与原版螃蟹同期使用的一次简单升级，27sl把武器载荷换成脉冲型号。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Crab 30s are a complete overhaul of the old Crab design, upgrading its electronics, engine and weapons to the latest standards. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 螃蟹30是对老旧螃蟹设计的彻底翻新，把电子设备、引擎与武器升级到最新标准。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: The CRB-C Crab is a minor update of the design modified to include a C3 Slave Unit. Introduced by the Draconis Combine in 3056 this Crab makes space for the C3 unit by removing the medium laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: CRB-C螃蟹是该设计的小幅更新版，加装了一套C3从属系统。它由龙尼斯联合体于3056年推出，通过拆除中型激光器为C3单元腾出空间。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: Based on the Crab that Judith Faber piloted during the Battle of Tukkayyid, this model named Florentine, this variant is a virtual mini-King Crab mounting an Ultra AC/5 in each arm supported by a left-torso mounted LRM-5 and a right-torso mounted Medium Laser. Carrying one ton of LRM missiles and three of Ultra Autocannon rounds, the Florentine's weapon loadout is made possible through use of a 250 XL Engine and an Endo Steel frame. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该型号名为“佛罗伦萨”，基于朱迪思·法贝尔在图卡伊德战役中驾驶的螃蟹。它实际上是一台迷你帝王蟹，双臂各装一门超速AC/5，由左躯干的LRM-5和右躯干的中型激光器支援。它携带一吨LRM导弹和三吨超速自动炮弹，之所以能装下这套武器，得益于250 XL引擎与内层钢框架。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Repurposed by a Goliath Scorpion Seeker who recovered it from a lost Brian Cache, this CRB-27b has undergone an extensive restoration effort. Sporting Clan tech weapons, augmented by a targeting computer and an active probe; this Crab aids the Seeker in their search for Star League relics. Surprisingly, the design mounts jump jets – enough to leap 150 metres at a time- an unusual addition to the Crab. Intended to aid in exploration work, they have surprised many opponents in combat or a circle of equals, helping to contribute to the Seeker's many victories. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台CRB-27b由一位从失落布莱恩储藏库中寻回它的蝎狮氏族探寻者重新启用，并经过大规模修复。它装备氏族科技武器，辅以一台瞄准计算机和一个主动探测器；这台螃蟹协助探寻者搜寻星盟遗物。令人意外的是，该设计装了跳跃推进器——足以一次跃出150米——这对螃蟹而言是异乎寻常的加装。它们本意是辅助勘探工作，却在战斗或同齐圆环中让许多对手措手不及，为探寻者的诸多胜利立下功劳。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Cyclops
column2: 独眼巨人

column1: The most notable of all Cyclops variants, introduced in 2750, fits the 'Mech with a Collapsible Command Module strapped to its rear torso, allowing a fully operational headquarters bunker to be set up in fifteen minutes. In order to make room for the module the Autocannon/20 and its ammunition was removed from this variant. Irreparable damages suffered during the Succession Wars means less than half of those Cyclopses with a working B-2000 have an operable command module. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 作为所有独眼巨人改型中最著名的一款，它于2750年推出，在后躯干绑上一台可折叠指挥模块，能在十五分钟内搭建起一座完整运作的指挥部掩体。为给该模块腾出空间，这一改型拆掉了自动炮/20及其弹药。继承战争期间遭受的不可修复损伤，意味着装有可用B-2000的独眼巨人中，不到一半还保有可运转的指挥模块。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: A refit of the original CP-10-HQ that replaces two heat sinks with two extra tons of ammunition. This refit is very uncommon, only seeing use at a few select battle fields where it was a last ditch effort to have even the command 'Mechs engage in prolonged battles, thus needing the extra ammunition. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这是原版CP-10-HQ的一次改装，用两吨额外弹药替换两具散热器。该改装非常罕见，只在少数几处战场上使用过——那是最后的无奈之举，为的是让连指挥机甲也投入持久战，因此需要额外弹药。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: Cyclops 10-Qs are strong support units. Lacking the close in weapons and command suite of the 10-Z variant, this model instead capitalizes on a longer range weapon configuration and added armor. The protection and expanded missile racks make the 10-Q a significant threat at range in the right hands. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 独眼巨人10-Q是强力的支援单位。它没有10-Z改型的近距武器与指挥套件，改而以一套更远程的武器配置和增加的装甲取胜。防护与扩充的导弹架使10-Q在行家手中成为远程上的重大威胁。 特质: 罩壳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: A custom variant of the Cyclops CP-10-Q, fielded by Wolf's Dragoons and their affiliated Mercnary outfits. Replacing almost all of the equipment with Clan tech, the 'Mech primarily save use as a defensive AMS platform as the Wolf's Dragoons did not consider the 'Mech of much battleworth. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 这是独眼巨人CP-10-Q的定制改型，由狼族龙骑兵及其附属雇佣兵部队使用。它把几乎所有装备换成氏族科技，但该机甲主要被当作防御性AMS平台使用，因为狼族龙骑兵并不认为这台机甲有多少战斗价值。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.22

column1: Cyclops 10-Zs use their imposing presence and unique communications equipment to control the battlefield. While the 10-Z carries a lethal array of close range weaponry, its primary role is command and control, bolstering friendly units with its specialized battle computer. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 独眼巨人10-Z凭借其威压般的存在感与独特的通讯设备掌控战场。虽然10-Z携带致命的近距离武器阵列，其主要角色仍是指挥与控制，用专门的战斗计算机增强友军单位。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: An attempt by Wolf's Dragoons to make the CP-10-Z more useful in battle. Upgrading most of its weaponry with ER or Clan versions, the main weapon is a side torso mounted UAC/10 and two Artemis IV enabled LRM-10 launchers. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 这是狼族龙骑兵为使CP-10-Z在战斗中更有用所做的一次尝试。它把大部分武器升级为增程或氏族版本，主武器是侧躯干的一门UAC/10与两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-10发射器。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.22

column1: The Cyclops is one of the Capellan Confederation's preferred 'Mechs to install Dual Cockpits. This standard refit installs the Dual Cockpit on a CP-11-A, removing one ton of gauss rifle ammunition. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 独眼巨人是卡佩兰联邦偏爱的双座座舱安装平台之一。这一标准改装在CP-11-A上安装双座座舱，拆掉一吨磁轨炮弹药。 特质: 罩壳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: A common modification of the Cyclops that uses some rediscovered Star League technology, the 11-A was introduced in 3045 and replaces the massive Autocannon/20 for a Zeus Slingshot Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammo. Although doing slightly less damage it has a much larger effective range. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 作为独眼巨人常见的一项改装，11-A使用了部分重新发现的星盟科技，于3045年推出，把那门庞大的自动炮/20换成一门宙斯弹弓磁轨炮配两吨弹药。虽然伤害略低，其有效射程大得多。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: The 11-C is similar to the 11-A in that they carry an almost identical weapons payload. Built in 3050 the only difference is that the 11-C has removed the LRM-10 launcher and replaced it with a C3 Computer, which allows it to share targeting data and coordinate C3 lances. An additional two tons of armor have been added to the design as well. This makes the 11-C a highly effective sniper and command 'Mech. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 11-C与11-A相似，两者武器载荷几乎相同。11-C造于3050年，唯一区别在于它拆掉了LRM-10发射器，换上一台C3计算机，使其能共享瞄准数据并协调C3分队。该设计还额外加装了两吨装甲。这使11-C成为高效的狙击与指挥机甲。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: A full redesign of the Cyclops, the 11-G was built by Grumium Creations for the Second Star League Defense Force, Com Guards and Free Rasalhague Republic. Debuting in 3058 it redesigns the chassis to use Endo Steel construction and also replaces the standard armor with fifteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. For long range combat it retains the Gauss Rifle and LRM-10 missile launcher minus one ton of missile reloads, while the arm-mounted medium lasers and center-torso SRM launcher were also upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All ammunition for the weapons was also shifted to the right-side torso and uses CASE to protect itself from complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 作为独眼巨人的全新设计，11-G由格鲁缪姆创意为第二星盟防卫部队、康卫队与自由拉萨尔哈格共和国建造。它于3058年首次亮相，底盘改用内层钢构造，并以十五吨铁纤装甲替换标准装甲。远程作战方面，它保留磁轨炮和LRM-10导弹发射器（少一吨导弹备用弹），同时把臂装中型激光器与中央躯干SRM发射器升级为增程中型激光器和一具连发SRM-4发射器。所有武器弹药也移到右侧躯干，并使用CASE以防弹药爆炸时整机尽毁。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: This version of the Cyclops was improved by using an Endo Steel frame. As a result the variant is able to mount a SRM 4 in the center torso, a LRM-5 along with Guardian ECM in the left torso, 2 AC/5's in the right torso, and 2 Medium Lasers in each arm. Rounding up the design is 14 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 这一版独眼巨人通过采用内层钢框架得到改进。因此该改型得以在中央躯干装一具SRM 4，左躯干装一具LRM-5和守卫者ECM，右躯干装2门AC/5，双臂各2门中型激光器。该设计另有14吨铁纤装甲收尾。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: The 12-K variant of the Cyclops takes the 'Mech to the logical conclusion based on equipment available to the DCMS. Built by Grumium and introduced in 3059, the 'Mech is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/10 for close to intermediate range combat. In place of the LRM launcher it carries an MRM-20 launcher, which compliments the Autocannon's range profile, while retaining two ER medium lasers and a Streak SRM-4 for for close ranges. The 'Mech is also armored with fourteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 独眼巨人的12-K改型基于DCMS可获得的装备，把这台机甲推向合乎逻辑的终点。它由格鲁缪姆建造并于3059年推出，武装为一门超速自动炮/10，负责近至中距作战。它以一具MRM-20发射器取代LRM发射器，与自动炮的射程曲线相配，同时保留两门增程中型激光器和一具连发SRM-4用于近距离。该机甲还披挂十四吨半装甲。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: There is little knowledge of the source of this variant of the Cyclops. Similar in base design to CP-10 and CP-11 models mounting C3 units, the design also incorporates an XL engine on an Endo Steel frame, allowing both more armor and weapons to be mounted. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 关于这台独眼巨人改型的来源所知甚少。它的基础设计与装有C3单元的CP-10和CP-11型号相似，同时在内层钢框架上采用XL引擎，使其能装下更多装甲与武器。 特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: Hatchetman
column2: 刽子手

column1: Hatchetman 3Fs are the king of the close quarters fight. Packing high impact short range weaponry, and a unique melee Hatchet, any target is in danger when close to the Hatchetman. The Hatchetmans lighter armor requires it to rely on maneuvering and ambushing to stay in the fight. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 斧手3F是近距离近战之王。它携带高冲击力的短程武器和一把独特的近战斧，任何目标一旦靠近斧手都处于危险之中。斧手较薄的装甲要求它依靠机动与埋伏来留在战斗中。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: A field refit of the -3F, converting the mech to use double heat sinks and downgrades one of the medium lasers to a small so CASE protection can be added. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 这是-3F的战地改装，把机甲改用双重散热器，并把其中一门中型激光器降级为小型，以便加装CASE防护。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: Originally assigned to the NAIS Training Cadres, it was selected as a NAIS technology test bed before being assigned to Fox's Teeth member Austin Vorster in the lead-up to the War of 3039. Mounting a NAIS Mk. 1 LB 10-X Autocannon prototype saved enough weight to add a third medium laser, moving all three to the left arm to avoid inhibiting use of the 'Mech's hatchet. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 它最初被分配给NAIS训练干部，后被选为NAIS技术试验台，随后在3039年战争前夕分配给狐牙成员奥斯汀·沃斯特。装上一门NAIS Mk. 1 LB 10-X自动炮原型省下的重量足以加装第三门中型激光器，三门全部移到左臂，以免妨碍该机甲使用斧头。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.03

column1: This unusual variant of the Hatchmen does not actually bring a hatchet. Instead it improves the cooling of the 'Mech. This was however never an intended design, but rather a field refit of 'Mechs that were waiting for replacement Hatchets after losing theirs. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 这一不寻常的斧手改型其实并没有带斧头。它改为改善机甲散热。不过这从不是有意设计的改型，而是对那把斧头丢失后等待替换的机甲所做的战地改装。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: The Hatchetman -3X further indexes on the stock design's close combat role, adding more armor and replacing its AC/10 for an array of SRMs, Lasers, and Anti-Personnel weapons. This is the ultimate melee brawler. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 斧手-3X进一步强化了原设计的近战角色，增加装甲，并把它的AC/10换成一批SRM、激光器和反人员武器。这是终极的近战蛮牛。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: An upgrade to the -3 series of Hatchetmen, using Endo Steel structure to allow adding both more armor and two more tons of ammo. The 'Mech is also converted to use double heat sinks. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 这是对斧手-3系列的升级，采用内层钢结构，得以同时增加装甲和两吨弹药。该机甲也改用双重散热器。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: Dismissed by some upon its introduction as little more than a rapidly overheating deathtrap, the HCT-5S is nonetheless one of the most efficient city and close quarters fighting 'mechs ever produced. Its LB-X AC/10 and three Medium Pulse Lasers give it destructive alpha strike potential at close range, and the Hatchetman's natural melee abilities give it a useful fallback when at risk of overheating. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: HCT-5S推出时曾被一些人贬为不过是个很快就会过热的死亡陷阱，但它仍是有史以来最高效的城市与近距战斗机甲之一。它的LB-X AC/10与三门中型脉冲激光器赋予其近距离毁灭性的全弹齐射潜力，而斧手天生的近战能力在有过热风险时提供了有用的退路。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.03

column1: Receiving a 3050s era 5S model after the Fox's Teeth faced Clan Jade Falcon on Wotan in 3051, Austin Vorster had it refitted in the lead-up to the FedCom Civil War. Almost identical to the 6S created by the Lyran Alliance in the conflict, the only significant difference is the placement of all ER Medium Lasers in the 'Mech's left arm. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 在狐牙于3051年在沃坦对上翡翠猎鹰氏族之后，奥斯汀·沃斯特收到了一台3050年代的5S型号，并在联邦共同体内战前夕对它进行了改装。它与莱兰联盟在那场冲突中打造的6S几乎完全相同，唯一显著差别是所有增程中型激光器都装在机甲左臂。 特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.05

column1: Scarabus
column2: 圣甲虫

column1: The Scarabus is equipped with a close range weapons arsenal, with the primary weapons being a pair of medium lasers backed up by a pair of small lasers. To defend itself when the 'Mech gets into extremely close range combat, the Scarabus carries a two ton hatchet, which allows it to cleave into an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Guardian ECM suite to protect itself from advanced electronic detection equipment when scouting against an enemy, and mounts a TAG to designate targets for Arrow IV artillery attacks. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 圣甲虫装备一套近距离武器库，主武器是一对中型激光器，由一对小型激光器提供后援。为了在机甲陷入极近距离战斗时自保，圣甲虫携带一把两吨重的斧头，能劈开敌方装甲。该机甲还装备一套守卫者ECM套件，在对敌侦察时保护自己免遭先进电子探测设备的发现，并装有一具TAG，为箭矢IV炮击标定目标。 特质: 坚固 投放成本倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: The 9B variant of the Scarabus is built using Triple Strength Myomer to enhance the 'Mech's speed and strength once in the proper heat range. This enhances the 'Mech's top speed to a maximum of 183.6 km/h and also increases the sheer amount of damage that the Scarabus is capable of doing with its hatchet. The only other change is the conversion to use double heat sinks for improved cooling, something that can be seen as counterproductive for the added TSM. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 圣甲虫的9B改型采用三倍强度肌纤维建造，在达到合适热量区间后提升机甲的速度与力量。这将其最高速度提升到183.6公里/小时，也大幅增加圣甲虫用斧头所能造成的伤害。唯一的其他改动是改用双重散热器以改善散热——考虑到新增的TSM，这可以看作是反效果。 特质: 坚固 投放成本倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: The Screamer LAM is a prototype Land-Air 'Mech which was produced during the reign of Emperor Stefan Amaris when his forces were occupying the Terran Hegemony in late Star League Era. The design shares the same tonnage as the Shadow Hawk LAM. The 'Mech was built as a harasser and quick strike machine. Unlike the original prototype LAM, the Screamer was able to transition into a fighter, 'Mech, or AirMech modes. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战的最后一年作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲研发，被打造为流亡星盟军事实力的象征。-1A武装为四门自动炮/10和四门中型激光器。虽然不如最初的-2A精准，1A仍是一台破坏力极强、极度危险的机甲，没有机师愿意与它交战。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这仍是一个令人生畏、威力强大的设计：原本的歼灭者-1A携带着一批强力自动炮，而-1E改而选择全能量武器载荷。四门粒子投射炮赋予歼灭者-1E残暴而难以置信的打击力，同时继承了-1A的中型激光器用于近距离自卫，并略微增加装甲防护以减轻敌方回击。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: This variant had an ER PPC in the right torso, and three Gauss Rifles (one in each arm, and one in the left torso) to provide hard hitting firepower. Each Gauss Rifle had two tons of ammunition. Ten double heat sinks were more than adequate to keep the machine cool. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这一改型右躯干装一门增程PPC，另有三门磁轨炮（双臂各一门，左躯干一门）提供沉重打击火力。每门磁轨炮配两吨弹药。十具双重散热器足以让这台机器保持凉爽。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: The original model created in 2779 was equipped with a head-mounted Small Laser, four LB 10-X AC, a pair of Small Pulse Lasers, and four Medium Lasers. It carried six tons of LB 10-X ammunition, and the torsos were protected with CASE. Ten double heat sinks kept heat manageable. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 最初于2779年创造的型号装备头部一门小型激光器、四门LB 10-X AC、一对小型脉冲激光器和四门中型激光器。它携带六吨LB 10-X弹药，躯干以CASE保护。十具双重散热器将热量控制在可管理范围。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战的最后一年作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲研发，被打造为流亡星盟与新生氏族双方军事实力的象征。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: An upgrade of 'acquired' ANH-1X variant 'Mechs from Clans storage as they were phased out due to their inferior design. The main goal of the update was increasing its mobility through a 300-rated XL engine. While the design managed to keep the four LBX AC/10 and Medium Lasers, to be able to carry the engine both the C.A.S.E. protection and the small lasers had to be dropped. However, a C3 Slave unit was added in the 'Mechs head. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是对从氏族库存中“获得”的ANH-1X改型机甲的一次升级——它们因设计低劣而被逐步淘汰。升级的主要目标是通过一具300级XL引擎提升其机动性。该设计设法保留了四门LBX AC/10和中型激光器，但为了装下这台引擎，必须去掉C.A.S.E.防护和小型激光器。不过，机甲头部加装了一套C3从属系统。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: The ANH-4W is a Wolf Dragoon's upgrade performed on some of the Annihilators they managed to 'free' from the clans control. These Annihilators were upgraded with a 200 XL clan engine and switched to clan double heat sinks. The weaponry was exchanged with a highly unusual mix of Ultra and LBX autocannons, since this is what was in surplus at the time. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: ANH-4W是狼族龙骑兵对他们设法从氏族控制下“解放”的部分歼灭者所做的升级。这些歼灭者换装了一台200 XL氏族引擎，并改用氏族双重散热器。武器被换成一种极不寻常的超速与LBX自动炮混合配置，因为当时手上富余的就是这些。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: A variant of the Annihilator that was built using only Clan technology and used exclusively by the Wolf's Dragoons, the Annihilator C increased its maximum speed to 54 km/h. The 'Mech was armed with four Ultra Autocannon/10s and four ER Medium Lasers. The Ultra Autocannon/10s allowed the 'Mech to fire at twice the rate of a normal autocannon, allowing it to put as much fire out as if it was carrying eight regular autocannons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为仅使用氏族科技建造、且由狼族龙骑兵独家使用的歼灭者改型，歼灭者C把最高速度提升到54公里/小时。该机甲武装为四门超速自动炮/10和四门增程中型激光器。超速自动炮/10让该机甲能以普通自动炮两倍的射速开火，使其火力输出相当于携带八门常规自动炮。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Apparently based on the ANH-1G, this variant only uses Clan technology. The 'Mech's top speed was 32.4 km/h and the armor protection was reduced, but four Gauss Rifles backed up by an ER PPC in the center torso and a head mounted ER Small Laser provided withering firepower for defensive engagements. Ten tons of ammunition kept the Gauss Rifles fed through the longest engagements. To make room for all these weapons, the C2 used an Endo Steel internal structure. Integrated CASE protected the arms and torsos from Gauss Rifle explosions. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一改型显然以ANH-1G为基础，只使用氏族科技。该机甲最高速度32.4公里/小时，装甲防护有所减少，但四门磁轨炮配以中央躯干的一门增程PPC和头部一门增程小型激光器，为防御作战提供了摧枯拉朽的火力。十吨弹药让磁轨炮能撑过最漫长的交战。为容纳这些武器，C2采用了内层钢内部结构。整合式CASE保护双臂与躯干免受磁轨炮爆炸之害。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: Designed as a joke, the "Gausszilla" was never intended for production, let alone deployment. Nobody is quite sure who submitted the design file titled "Gausszilla_Meme_Final_NOTFINAL_DONOTUSE_v3.mtf" to the factory. Stranger still is that it was greenlit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为玩笑设计的“磁轨炮哥斯拉”从未打算投产，更不用说部署。没人十分确定是谁把那份名为“Gausszilla_Meme_Final_NOTFINAL_DONOTUSE_v3.mtf”的设计文件提交给工厂的。更奇怪的是它居然被批准了。 特质: 精准武器 - 磁轨炮 投放成本倍率: 1.2 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Apparently based on the Annihilator C 2, this customized variant of the chassis carries five Clan Gauss rifles. It was thought lost to history. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台定制改型的底盘显然以歼灭者C 2 为基础，装有五门氏族磁轨炮。它一度被认为已湮没于历史。 特质: 精准武器 - 磁轨炮 投放成本倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: A custom battlefield refit of the ANH-3A1 that gained some popularity, as trading the C3 slave unit for putting the CASE protection back in was well worth it to many 'MechWarriors that had the choice. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是ANH-3A1的一次战地定制改装，并颇受欢迎——对许多有得选的机师来说，用C3从属系统换回CASE防护非常值得。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 2P于3026年推出，为近距离与近战重建，只保留ARC-2R的左侧与中央躯干中型激光器，拆掉LRM架，改为每侧躯干各装一具SRM-4和SRM-6架，省出的重量用于在右臂携带一把重型长剑。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column2: 这是-2R的战地改装，把中央躯干的两门中型激光器换成C.A.S.E.系统侧躯干防护和一套C3从属系统。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08
