column1: We've only got their word that this target is a terrorist, but that sort of extralegal maneuvering is why they're hiring us instead of using their own forces. Still, best to be alert for anything.

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that the leader of an insurgent cell backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to take out one of the primary enemies of the legitimate {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regime in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Additionally, we'll include a bonus payment if you're able to destroy all of the target's escorting units.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}支持的叛乱小组领袖正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上除掉合法{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政权主要敌人之一的难得机会。此外，如果你能摧毁目标的所有护卫单位，我们将额外支付奖金。[警告：丧尸]

column2: 他一倒下，就前往撤离点等待接运。

column2: 目标已消灭. 扫荡剩下的敌人，或前往撤离区.

column2: 指挥官，该区域已清理完毕. 达吕斯已批准我立即着陆. 保持原地待命.

column1: Let's hope we didn't blow up our bonus. Well done, Commander. Sumire will pick you up there.

column1: Good job, managed to get the captive back alive.

column1: As I mentioned, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, before we can begin operations on the planet, we need to neutralize an observation post. Conveniently, we can then use the facility's resources to stage further assaults. Our information suggests the base is quite well defended, which is unsurprising, given the planet's location on multiple potentially hostile borders. Once the base is taken, we won't have to worry about errant calls for reinforcements, but to be safe, it would be best for you to hunt down all enemy forces to prevent them from retreating and spreading word of the attack.
column2: 正如我提到的，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，在开始行星上的行动之前，我们需要先清除一处观察哨。顺便，我们之后还能利用该设施的资源来发动进一步攻击。我们的情报显示该基地防御相当严密，考虑到该行星地处多条潜在敌对的边界上，这并不意外。一旦拿下基地，我们就不必担心有人误发增援呼叫，但为稳妥起见，最好还是由你猎杀所有敌军，防止他们撤退并把袭击的消息传开。

column1: We'll be outnumbered two to one, Commander. I don't particularly like those odds, but we're committed now, so let's buckle down and get the job done.
column2: 我们会被二比一压制，指挥官。我不太喜欢这种胜算，但既然已经投入，就沉住气把活干完。

column1: With our beachhead secured, it is time to start moving against the Capellans here on Kern. There are multiple potential targets in the area, but before we discuss them, we need to clear the field. Our technicians have extracted the force deployment data from the base computers, and we know that there are two heavy lances of 'Mechs on patrol right now, somewhere on the other side of the river. You'll get in by Leopard and sweep the woods; eliminate any Capellan units you uncover.
column2: 滩头阵地已经拿下，现在是时候对克恩这里的卡佩兰人动手了。这一带有多个潜在目标，但在讨论它们之前，我们得先清场。我们的技师已从基地计算机里提取了部队部署数据，我们知道此刻有两支重型机甲分队正在河对岸某处巡逻。你乘豹式进去，清扫林地；发现任何卡佩兰单位就消灭。

column2: 这座基地听起来难啃，指挥官。预计场上会有整整两个小队，外加炮塔。我们最好带上最重的机甲。

column1: This logistical base is a key component of the Capellans' hold on this area of Kern. Any significant force in the region needs this base to remain operational and supplied in the field. The main facility is located in deep woods, well concealed and well defended. Expect heavy resistance before reaching it, and expect turret defenses at the base itself. A secondary base nearby houses technicians and staff; destroying it is not required, but if you manage to, it will ensure the main facility remains permanently closed and unrepairable.
column2: 这座后勤基地是卡佩兰人掌控克恩这一区域的关键组成部分。该地区任何有分量的部队都需要这座基地保持运作并在战场上获得补给。主设施位于深林之中，隐蔽良好、防守严密。预期在抵达之前会遇到强烈抵抗，并预期基地本身有炮塔防御。附近一处次级基地安置着技师与职员；摧毁它并非必需，但如果你做到，将确保主设施永久关闭且无法修复。

column2: 中尉宋上校

column1: Yang's been filling me in about Song, Commander. He says they're supposed to be the best shot in the entire CCAF. We're going to be lucky to get out of this one without serious losses.
column2: 杨一直在跟我讲宋的事，指挥官。他说他们应该是整个CCAF里最好的射手。我们要是能没有重大损失地从这一仗脱身，就算走运了。

column1: Those aren't just reinforcements, Commander. That's our target: the CCAF commander, Lieutenant Colonel Song. As a reminder, they're a deadly MechWarrior as well as a skilled strategist. Their arrival on the field presents an opportunity—if we act swiftly, we can achieve our goals here on Kern in a single strike, making this world an easy pickup when we mount the full-scale attack. This is it, Commander. Don't screw this up.

column1: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Capellan command is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
column2: 这些传输数据足以让我们定位该地区卡佩兰指挥部藏身的加固掩体。他们以为在那里很安全，但我们在轨道上有一门舰载PPC，随时能在他们下面建的任何东西上打出一个洞。你需要把你的机甲移动到位，好让我们进行精准打击；这一炮打出去之后，我们的空投艇就必须脱离轨道逃跑，所以只有一次做对的机会。我们对你有完全的信心，指挥官；到目前为止你的判断都精准无误。祝好运。

column1: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!

column1: Commander, they are deploying vehicles and tanks from their motorpool.

column1: Commander, this is it; when we destroy this facility, we'll have shattered the Capellan defenses on this world, and hopefully eliminated their best field commander.
column2: 指挥官，就是这里了；摧毁这座设施，我们就粉碎了该行星上的卡佩兰防御，但愿也能除掉他们最出色的战地指挥官。

column1: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets Destroyed.

column1: Greetings, Commander. Understand that this facility is as important to the {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} as it is to our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends.

column1: I don't have any way to know where they will land, but you can bet they will be close to the base.
column2: 我无法知道他们会在哪里着陆，但可以肯定他们会靠近基地。

column1: Inbound strike team, Boss. We've lingered a bit too long and their quick reinforcements are arriving shortly.
column2: 打击小队来袭，老板。我们逗留得太久了，他们的快速增援马上就到。

column1: Let's see what you got.

column1: Once all three beacons are placed, wait for the orbital strike to confirm its effect. Then make for the extraction LZ and the Leopard will pick you up.

column1: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.
column2: 我们将与你并行行动，消灭任何遭遇的抵抗。

column1: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
column2: 我们完了，指挥官。你又得靠自己了。

column1: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.

column1: The ISF believes that Nephrite has already made planetfall and is tracking a FedSuns convoy moving out from the landing site. It's probable that the target is in the convoy; if we strike now, we should be able to end this little insurrection before it even begins. Engage the vehicles and destroy them all. Then, our people will sort through the remains and see if we hit our target. If we're lucky, we'll be done with this in time for dinner.
column2: ISF认为涅夫莱特已经着陆，并正在追踪一支从着陆点出发的联邦太阳国车队。目标很可能就在车队里；若我们此刻出手，应该能在这场小叛乱开始之前就了结它。与那些车辆交战并全部摧毁。随后我们的人会翻检残骸，看是否命中了目标。如果运气好，我们还能赶在晚饭前把这事办完。

column1: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
column2: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

column1: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
column2: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

column1: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
column2: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

column2: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

column1: What an ugly place this is. At any rate, this is the region my staff believes the convoy will be traveling through.
column2: 这里的一切多么丑陋. 无论如何，我手下的人判断车队会穿过这片区域.

column2: 栗田联盟 III

column1: I'm not sure I necessarily follow the ISF's logic here, Commander, but we're being paid to shoot the people they tell us to shoot.
column2: 我不确定自己是否能理解ISF这里的逻辑，指挥官，但人家付钱让我们打他们叫我们打的人。

column1: We have a new report from the ISF, Commander. They've located a heavily armed lance of 'Mechs in the badlands of this cold and unpleasant planet. They're way outside the usual FedSuns patrol routes, which leads my staff to suspect this is our target, moving with a significant escort to whatever their meeting place is. If they go to ground, it's going to be extremely challenging to dig them back out, so let's avoid that eventuality by intercepting this lance immediately and turning them all into smoking craters.
column2: 指挥官，我们收到ISF的新报告。他们在这颗寒冷而令人不快行星的荒地里定位到一支重武装机甲分队。他们远远偏离了联邦太阳通常的巡逻路线，这让我的幕僚怀疑这就是我们的目标，正带着相当规模的护卫前往他们的会面地点。如果他们转入地下，再想把它们挖出来将极其困难，所以让我们通过立即拦截这支分队、把它们全变成冒烟的弹坑来避免那种情况。

column1: Commander, I have good news and bad news. First, well done! The enemy target is nothing more than a pile of scrap and salvage. Good shooting.
column2: 指挥官，我有一个好消息和坏消息. 首先，做得不错! 这里的敌人已经全部变成可回收的废物. 打得好.

column1: Destroy the target, and then move to the evacuation area for pickup.

column1: I honestly do not understand how it can be this difficult to kill one. Single. Person. By this time, Nephrite is likely throwing a dinner party with the Steiner and Davion ambassadors.
column2: 我真的不明白，杀死一个人怎么会这么难，！目前，Nephrit 可能正在与施泰纳家族和戴维恩家族的大使举行晚宴.

column1: This is the region where the ISF agents reported sighting the enemy lance.

column1: Capturing this base is going to be tough, Commander. We'll be outnumbered and possibly outgunned. I hope it's worth it.
column2: 拿下这座基地会很艰难，指挥官。我们会寡不敌众，可能火力也不及。我希望这值得。

column1: I still believe this approach is a mistake, Commander, but I'll continue to defer to your judgment. For both our sakes, let's hope you're right and that capturing this base will be a better long-term plan than simply obliterating it. The ISF reports that the facility is defended by both Davion 'Mechs and turrets, which strongly suggests there's something there worth protecting. You'll need to eliminate any hostile forces before my people can move in and sweep the base for our target.
column2: 我仍然认为这个做法是个错误，指挥官，但我会继续遵从你的判断。为了我们双方，但愿你是对的，夺取这座基地比直接把它夷平是更好的长期方案。ISF报告该设施由达维昂机甲和炮塔共同防守，这强烈暗示那里有值得保护的东西。在我的人能进驻并彻底搜查基地寻找我们的目标之前，你需要消灭任何敌对势力。

I've decided to forestall any possible future problems by literally bringing the big guns to bear on the situation. I have a military DropShip, the Fujin, waiting on station, and you're going to provide it with targeting information. Nephrite is in a fortified bunker, meeting right this moment with representatives from both Davion and Steiner. I'm tired of chasing them. Let's obliterate them instead.
column2: 说实话，指挥官，我很意外你居然没有像我一样对这番局面感到既沮丧又筋疲力尽；毕竟，可以说整场闹剧从头到尾都得靠你亲自上阵奔走。为了一劳永逸地杜绝后患，我决定直接把重炮摆上台面。我有一艘军用降落舰 Fujin 已在轨道待命，而你要为它提供目标信息。Nephrite 正待在一座加固掩体中，此刻正在与 Davion 和 Steiner 两方的代表会面。我追他们追腻了。不如直接把他们都轰平。

column2: 放置信标 Alpha 以指示火力任务目标

column1: Place Beacon Bravo for Fire Mission Designation
column2: 放置信标 Bravo 以指示火力任务目标

column1: Place Beacon Charlie for Fire Mission Designation
column2: 放置信标 Charlie 以指示火力任务目标

column1: Place the Artillery Beacons Quickly
column2: 快速放置火炮信标

column1: Secure the Facility and Designate the Fire Mission's Target
column2: 夺取设施并为火力任务指定目标

column1: Ah, Commander? My staff thinks you should know that a DropShip flying Steiner colors is on its way to your location.
column2: 啊，指挥官? 我手下认为你应该知道，一艘Steiner空投艇正前往你的位置.

column1: All AFFS forces, this is Major Brisbane. Focus all fire on the enemy forces attempting to place targeting beacons for an orbital strike!
column2: 全体恒星联邦部队，这是布里斯班少校. 集中火力攻击那些试图放置轨道打击信标的敌军！

column1: All units, close distance on enemy forces. We have to disrupt those beacons!
column2: 所有单位，向敌军逼近。我们必须干扰那些信标！

column1: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this area of operation!
column2: 指挥官，我的传感器显示一支庞大的敌方反应部队正在逼近。撤出这个作战区域！

column1: It's part of the hardened bunker, and we can't disable it until the orbital strike completes. So, I suggest moving quickly.
column2: 它是加固掩体的一部分，在轨道打击完成之前我们无法使其失效。所以我建议动作快点。

column1: Our strike force is touching down now. Withdraw or you will be destroyed.
column2: 我们的打击部队正在降落. 立即撤退，否则你们将被摧毁.

column1: There it is. That's where our terrorist is meeting, right at this very moment, with representatives from Davion and Steiner.
column2: 就是那里。就在此刻，我们的恐怖分子正在那里与达维昂和施泰纳的代表会面。

column1: Unknown mercenary commander: this is Captain Krause of the LCAF. The Lyran Commonwealth will not allow this assault on our allies in the Federated Suns.
column2: 未知的佣兵指挥官，我是来自LCAF的克劳斯上尉. 天琴共同体不会宽恕对我们恒星联邦盟友的这次袭击.

column1: This whole mission makes my skin crawl, Commander. We're attacking a civilian facility on the say-so of the Kurita spy network. Just… just keep your eyes open, okay?
column2: 这整个任务都让我浑身发毛，指挥官。我们在凭栗田间谍网络的一面之词去攻击一处民用设施。就……就睁大眼睛，好吗？

column1: I'm pleased we could agree that the direct approach is likely to be the most effective. The facility that the ISF believes Nephrite is hiding in is in a god-awful frozen wasteland. It shouldn't be too heavily defended, but there will probably be turrets. Remember that we need that facility flattened. Once the place is nothing but rubble, my people will search the ruins for our Rasalhague friend and confirm the kill. And then we can all go home, and honestly, I cannot wait. This place is wretched.
column2: 我很高兴我们能达成共识：直接的方式大概最有效。ISF认为内芙莱特藏身的那处设施位于一片糟糕透顶的冰封荒原。那里的防御应该不会太重，但很可能有炮塔。记住，我们要把那处设施夷平。等那里只剩瓦砾，我的人会在废墟中搜寻我们这位拉萨尔哈格朋友并确认击杀。然后我们就能回家了，老实说，我迫不及待。这地方太糟糕了。

column1: Destroy the Enemy Facility and Extract Safely
column2: 摧毁敌方设施并安全撤退

column1: Destroy the Facility
column2: 摧毁设施

column1: As much as I detest the cold, I find new-fallen snow so peaceful to look at.
column2: 尽管我讨厌寒冷，我喜欢刚下雪的镇静效果.

column1: Commander, my staff tells me that the patrol they detected earlier is inbound to your position.
column2: 指挥官，我的同事报告，之前发现的巡逻队正在向你的位置移动.

column1: Await DropShip Arrival
column2: 等待空投舰抵达

column1: Destroy the Enemies
column2: 消灭敌人

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth will not allow this assault on our allies. Our strike force is touching down now. Withdraw or you will be destroyed.
column2: 天琴共同体绝不容许对其盟友发动如此攻击. 我们的打击部队正在着陆. 立刻撤退，否则将予以歼灭.

column1: Unknown mercenary commander: this is Captain Krause of the LCAF. Your shameful destruction of a civilian facility will not go unpunished.
column2: 未知的佣兵指挥官，我是来自LCAF的克劳斯上尉. 你对民用设施的可耻破坏将受到惩罚.

column1: Liao Alliance
column2: 廖氏联盟

column1: This seems straightforward, Commander, though getting into a shooting fight with the FedSuns doesn't sound like my idea of a good time.
column2: 这看起来很直接，指挥官，不过跟联邦太阳国打枪战可不符合我对好时光的定义。

column1: The situation planetside is deteriorating rapidly. Two Federated Suns lances are closing rapidly on our team's location, and without immediate intervention the operation will fail. I need you to intercept those 'Mechs and disable them before moving on to the facility where our covert team is hiding. You may handle this situation as you see fit; I have every confidence in you and your people, Commander.
column2: 地表局势正在迅速恶化。两支联邦太阳分队正快速逼近我方小队的位置，若不立即干预，行动将会失败。我需要你拦截那些机甲，在继续前往我们隐蔽小队藏身设施之前使其失去战力。你可以按自己认为合适的方式处置局面；我对你和你的部下有充分信心，指挥官。

column1: Destroy the Davion Lances
column2: 摧毁戴维恩家族机甲

column1: Destroy the First Davion Lance
column2: 摧毁第一支戴维恩机甲小队

column1: Destroy the Second Davion Lance
column2: 摧毁第二支戴维恩机甲小队

column1: As you requested, Commander, we've arranged your interception well clear of the facility where my team is hiding.
column2: 按你的要求，指挥官，我们把拦截点安排得远远离开我小队躲藏的那处设施。

column1: Commander, I am calling into question my own judgment as well as your own. This is extremely disappointing.
column2: 指挥官，我现在不仅质疑你的判断，也质疑我自己的. 这实在令人非常失望.

column1: Good luck, Commander. Liao out.
column2: 祝你好运，指挥官. 廖氏完毕.

column1: Liao Alliance II
column2: 廖氏联盟 II

column1: I wouldn't count on the defenses being particularly weak, Commander. Like the lady said, this is a border world, so everything's going to be bristling with guns and 'Mechs.
column2: 我不会指望那处防御特别薄弱，指挥官。正如那位女士所说，这是一颗边界行星，所以一切都会布满枪炮与机甲。

column1: I wish I could offer you more time to rearm and reequip, Commander, but I'm not sure how much longer the Maskirovka team can hold out. It's only a matter of time before someone looks into the hangar where my people are hiding and the shooting starts. We need to take that facility before the Davion forces realize they have unwelcome guests. Thankfully they don't seem to have gone on higher alert, so the base should be relatively undefended, at least as far as any facility on the Federated Suns border can be undefended.
column2: 我希望我能给你更多时间重新武装与补给，指挥官，但我不确定伪装局小队还能撑多久。有人查看我的人藏身的机库、然后开始交火，只是时间问题。我们必须在达维昂部队意识到他们有不受欢迎的客人之前拿下那处设施。幸好他们似乎没有提高警戒级别，所以基地应该相对无人防守，至少就联邦太阳边界上的任何设施而言算是无人防守。

column1: Capture the Davion Facility
column2: 占领戴维恩设施

column1: Hold Out as Enemies Counterattack
column2: 在敌军反攻时坚守

column1: Pacify the Area around the Facility
column2: 平定设施周边区域

column1: Mercenary force, be advised that a patrol lance was dispatched two hours ago, and it should be returning soon. Be on the lookout for enemy reinforcements.
column2: 雇佣兵部队，请注意：两小时前派出的巡逻机甲小队预计很快归队. 保持警惕，留意敌方增援.

column1: The target facility is just ahead, Commander. As we expected, it seems to be lightly guarded, but be cautious nonetheless.
column2: 目标设施就在前方，指挥官. 正如预期的那样，守备似乎不严，但还是要小心行事.

column1: Liao Alliance III
column2: 廖氏联盟 III

column1: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
column2: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

column1: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
column2: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

column1: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
column2: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

column1: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
column2: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

column1: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
column2: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

column1: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
column2: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

column1: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
column2: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

column1: I know this was your call, Commander, but frankly I'd prefer to just torch their \"materials\" and leave. This is vile.
column2: 我知道这是你的决定，指挥官，但坦白说我更愿意直接烧掉他们的"物资"然后走人。这太恶心了。

column1: My Maskirovka liaison wishes me to convey her thanks, Commander. We recognize that this is making your job more difficult, but the Confederation has significant plans, currently in progress, that your help in this matter will facilitate. That said, we've received word that several Davion lances are en route to the facility to retake it. I need you to hold that facility, Commander. Loading the materials aboard the transport vehicles will take time, and until it's complete, we cannot move our people.
column2: 我的马斯基洛夫卡联络官想转达她的谢意，指挥官。我们清楚这让你任务更难做了，但联邦有重大计划正在进行，你在此事上的帮助将推动它们。话虽如此，我们已收到消息，数支戴维恩小队正前往该设施夺回它。指挥官，我需要你守住那处设施。把那些物资装上运输车需要时间，在装完之前我们无法转移人员。

column1: Davion Forces Inbound
column2: 戴维恩单位逼近

column1: Defend ALL Target Buildings from Destruction
column2: 保护所有目标建筑免遭摧毁

column1: Defend Facility
column2: 保卫设施

column1: Defend the Target Buildings
column2: 保卫目标建筑

column1: Destroy the Davion Vanguard
column2: 摧毁戴维恩家族Vanguard

column1: Escort Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
column2: 护送工程师装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

column1: Hold Out Until Loading Is Complete
column2: 保持位置，直到加载完成

column1: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
column2: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

column1: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
column2: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

column1: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
column2: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

column1: Commander, those tubes are LosTech and must be handled with extraordinary care, so the team will need you to keep any enemy forces well away from the base.
column2: 指挥官，那些管道是失落科技，必须极其小心地处理. 所以工程团队需要你将任何敌军都远远挡在基地之外.

column1: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
column2: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

column1: Keep the facility standing, Commander. We cannot afford to lose these materials.
column2: 保持设施完好，指挥官. 我们不能失去这些物资.

column1: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
column2: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

column1: My Lady, we're loading the materials now. My people are working as quickly as we can, given the delicate nature of the cargo.
column2: 女士，我们正在装载物资。考虑到货物娇贵，我的人已经尽可能加快速度。

column1: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are off-line.
column2: 他们在基地周围设有据点防御系统. 但目前处于离线状态.

column1: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
column2: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

column1: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
column2: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

column1: Liao Alliance IV
column2: 廖氏联盟 IV

column1: Capture Convoy Rally Point, Escort Convoy to Safety, and Extract Safely
column2: 占领车队集结点，护送车队至安全地带，并安全撤离

column1: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
column2: 护送友军单位前往目的地

column1: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
column2: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

column1: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
column2: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。

column1: Secure the Convoy Rally Point
column2: 确保车队集结点安全

column1: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
column2: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

column1: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try adn stop the player from reaching the rally point.
column2: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

column1: The objective to escape with all the player units.
column2: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

column1: Davion's got to know what's on those vehicles by now. If it were me, I'd be trying to torch them at this point, too.
column2: 达维昂现在肯定已经知道那些车辆上装的是什么了。要是我，这会儿也会试着把它们烧掉。

column1: Our convoy is making good progress, Commander, but there's a small problem. My people are reporting the way forward is thick with Federated Suns forces, and the moment they spot the convoy, they'll converge on it, and that will be the end of our operation. I need you to deploy a lance to clear the way to the extraction zone, and keep it clear while our Leopard comes in for the pickup. The LZ is likely to be extremely hot, Commander, and the enemy will be targeting the vehicles. You need to keep them alive and get them onto that DropShip.
column2: 指挥官，我们的运输队进展顺利，但有个小问题。我的人报告说前方道路上联邦太阳国部队密布，他们一旦发现运输队就会向它合围，那我们的行动就完了。我需要你派出一支小队，打通通往撤离区的道路，并在我们的 Leopard 前来接运期间保持道路畅通。指挥官，着陆区很可能极度危险，敌人会以车辆为目标。你必须保住它们，并把它们送上那艘降落舰。

column1: Capture the Convoy Rally Point, Escort the Convoy to Safety, and Extract
column2: 攻克集结点，护送车队安全撤离

column1: Destroy the Enemy Blocking Force
column2: 摧毁敌方拦截部队

column1: Ensure All Convoy Units Survive during Extraction
column2: 确保撤离期间车队全部单位存活

column1: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Hunter Lance for Mission Completion
column2: 隐藏目标: 摧毁猎人小队以完成任务

column1: Protect the Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
column2: 保护车队登上空投舰

column1: Protect the Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
column2: 保护车队直到空投舰抵达

column1: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
column2: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

column1: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
column2: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

column1: Thank you, Captain. Keep those scientists alive, Commander. The Confederation is depending on you.
column2: 谢谢你，船长. 让那些科学家活下来，指挥官. 联邦就指望你了.

column1: The convoy is hunkered down in the facility nearby, Commander, waiting for your signal.
column2: 车队藏在附近的设施中，等待你的信号，指挥官.

column1: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
column2: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

column1: The FedSuns are going to assume we're still back at the base getting things loaded up and ready to go, Commander. Let's give them a surprise.
column2: 指挥官，联邦太阳国会以为我们还在基地装卸、准备出发。我们给他们来个惊喜。

column1: Before the Maskirovka team can transport the scientists to the extraction point, we need to deal with the Davion forces that are closing on our position. We've located two lances of 'Mechs that are inbound, and I need you to intercept them before they get here. Once they're dealt with, we can start moving the team, and the scientists, to the extraction point. And Commander… I apologize for my curt tone earlier. I didn't brief you fully, and that was unprofessional of me.
column2: 在伪装局小队把科学家们运到撤离点之前，我们需要先解决正在逼近我们位置的达维昂部队。我们已定位两支正在赶来的机甲分队，我需要你在他们抵达前拦截他们。等他们被解决，我们就能把小队和科学家们转移到撤离点。还有，指挥官……我为先前生硬的语气道歉。我没有向你做完整简报，那是我的不专业。

column1: Radar puts them in this vicinity. Move forward and clear them out, but keep your eyes open for that second lance.
column2: 雷达显示他们就在这个区域附近. 向前推进并清除他们，但要留意那第二支小队.

column1: We've located one of the Federated Suns lances, Commander. No sign of the other one.
column2: 我们已定位联邦太阳的其中一支分队，指挥官。另一支没有踪迹。

column1: Davion has no way of knowing we abandoned the stasis tubes. If it were me, I'd be doing everything I could to torch the convoy, too.
column2: 达维恩无法知道是我们放弃了那些滞留舱。如果是我，我也会竭尽全力把车队烧掉。

column1: Marik Alliance
column2: 马里克联盟

column1: We're assaulting a fortified base with an underweight lance, Commander. Sort of feels like old times, doesn't it?
column2: 指挥官，我们要用一支吨位不足的小队攻打一座设防基地。有点像往昔的日子，对吧？

column1: The communications facility has not been alerted to our presence, as we'd hoped, Commander. That means we will be able to land your team unnoticed and disable the facility. The defenses will be light; it has one lance as a garrison and one lance as a patrol element, plus fixed gun emplacements. However, I'd still recommend caution, given the limited force strength we were able to drop and still remain covert. As mentioned, the covert approach means we have limited intel about the base itself, so you'll be operating somewhat blind at first.
column2: 通讯设施并未如我们所愿察觉到我们的存在，指挥官。这意味着我们能在不被发现的情况下投放你的小队并瘫痪该设施。防御会很薄弱；他们有一个分队作为驻军，一个分队作为巡逻力量，另有固定炮位。不过，考虑到我们能投放并保持隐蔽的兵力有限，我仍建议谨慎。如前所述，隐蔽接近意味着我们对基地本身情报有限，所以你起初会在某种程度上盲着行动。

column1: Destroy the Liao Communications Facility
column2: 摧毁廖氏的通讯设施

column1: Destroy the Liao Facility and Extract Safely
column2: 摧毁廖氏的设施并安全撤离

column1: Destroy the Liao Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁廖氏增援

column1: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Base Turrets
column2: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

column1: Commander, the comms facility is just on the other side of that hill, straight ahead.
column2: 指挥官，通讯设施就在那座小山的另一侧，正前方.

column1: Commander, we need to abort the operation; they managed to get a signal out to their headquarters, reporting our presence here.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要中止行动. 他们成功向总部发出了信号，报告了我们的存在.

column1: Marik Alliance II
column2: 马里克联盟 II

column1: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past us who can call for help. The vehicles will do what vehicles always do in fights with 'Mechs: they'll die.
column2: 指挥官，我在这里看到的唯一真正危险，是他们设法让人溜过我们身边去求援。在与机甲的战斗中，车辆会做车辆一贯会做的事：它们会死。

column1: The vehicles seem to be a standard supply convoy, with an escorting lance. It was simple bad luck that they happened to be scheduled to arrive just after we neutralized the base. We need to eliminate them before they arrive here and see League salvage and intel teams all over their facility. I wouldn't expect more than a single lance as an escort, but it's possible the vehicles themselves may pose a significant threat, given the restrictions a covert operation places on your drop tonnage.
column2: 这些车辆看起来是标准补给车队，配一支护卫分队。它们偏偏安排在我们刚清除基地之后抵达，纯属运气不好。我们必须在它们抵达这里、看到联盟的打捞与情报小队遍布他们设施之前将其消灭。我预计护卫不会超过一支分队，但考虑到秘密行动对你投放吨位的限制，这些车辆本身也可能构成重大威胁。

column1: Destroy the Convoy and Extract Safely
column2: 摧毁车队并安全撤退

column1: Destroy the Enemy Convoy
column2: 消灭敌方车队

column1: Prevent the Convoy from Escaping
column2: 阻止车队逃跑

column1: All the escort units are down, Commander. Focus your fire on any remaining units.
column2: 所有护卫单位均已摧毁，指挥官. 集中火力攻击任何残余单位.

column1: Force Commander, mercenary unit dropped in the AO. Ground vehicles and BattleMechs spotted.
column2: 部队指挥官，雇佣兵部队已在作战区域投放. 侦测到地面车辆与战斗机甲.

column1: Force Commander, we just intercepted a transmission positively IDing us as a League strike force.
column2: 部队指挥官，我们刚刚截获了一段广播，清楚地表明我们是联盟的特遣队.

column1: Once the convoy is handled, move to the extraction LZ here. The Leopard will remain on station to handle the pickup.
column2: 一旦解决完车队，前往此处撤离点. 豹式会待命执行接应任务.

column1: Right on target, Lieutenant. Well done. Commander, if you bring your lance up to this position, you should be able to see the convoy and its escort.
column2: 完美，中尉. 干得好. 指挥官，如果你把小队带到这个位置，应该能看到目标车队及其护卫.

column1: The convoy will be in sight of the destroyed base soon, Commander. You need to bring them down immediately, or the operation will be exposed.
column2: 车队应该很快就会看到被摧毁的基地了，指挥官. 你必须立刻干掉他们，否则行动就暴露了.

column1: Marik Alliance III
column2: 马里克联盟 III

column1: Should be a simple pickup job, Commander, but remember that we're going in light, which means the pickup 'Mech is going to be more vulnerable than usual.
column2: 应该是一份简单的接送活，指挥官，但记住我们是轻装前往，这意味着接人的那台机甲会比平常更脆弱。

column1: Our operative, Jawad, is in deep cover at the naval logistics base on this tiny island, Commander. Once you arrive at the facility, he'll break cover and board your unit in the rumble seat. Then you just need to get him and the data he carries out of the facility. We'll have the Leopard on standby to pick you up. Because you're going in quiet, the facility shouldn't be alerted to our insertion, and the opposition should be light.
column2: 我们的特工贾瓦德正深藏在这个小岛上的海军后勤基地里，指挥官。你一抵达该设施，他就会现身并坐进你的单位副驾驶位。然后你只需要把他和他携带的数据带出设施。我们会让豹式待命接应你。由于你是静默进入，该设施不应察觉我们的投放，抵抗应该很轻。

column1: Recover the Operative by Securing the Designated Area
column2: 控制目标区域，回收特工

column1: Retrieve the Operative and Extract Safely
column2: 营救特工并安全撤离

column1: Expect light opposition. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 预计会遇到轻微抵抗. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Mercenary unit deployed, Force Commander.
column2: 雇佣兵被废黜，部队指挥官.

column1: Once you have our operative, continue clockwise to reach the designated extraction LZ.
column2: 一旦你接到我们的特工，就继续顺时针前进，到达指定的撤离着陆区.

column1: Signal from Jawad, Force Commander Singh. He has eyes on our friendlies and is moving out.
column2: 来自贾瓦德的信号，部队指挥官辛格. 他已确认友方位置并开始撤离.

column1: Marik Alliance IV
column2: 马里克联盟 IV

column1: Chu-i Tetsuhara
column2: 忠义哲原

column1: All this covert action has my nerves wound tight. I'm glad we're finally getting to flex our muscles a bit.
column2: 这些秘密行动搞得我神经紧绷。很高兴我们终于能活动活动筋骨了。

column1: We're approaching the joint research base, Commander. Once you're in the AO, you'll need to move up to the base and set beacons to triangulate around it so that our covert DropShip, the Airavata, can transmit the authentication code and download the research data. We have a limited window of opportunity before the Liao ships in orbit detect our presence and come to investigate, so you'll be operating under a relatively tight timeline. So far, we've managed to keep things quiet, so while I expect significant opposition, you should be able to handle it.
column2: 我们正在接近联合研究基地，指挥官。一旦你进入行动区域，你需要推进到基地并设置信标对其进行三角定位，好让我们的隐蔽空投艇艾拉瓦塔能传送认证代码并下载研究数据。轨道上的廖氏舰船探测到我们并前来调查之前，我们的时间窗口有限，所以你将在相对紧张的时间表下作业。到目前为止，我们一直成功保持安静，所以虽然我预计会遇到可观的抵抗，你应该应付得来。

column1: Confirm the Data Transmission
column2: 确认此航向，离开轨道并前往跃迁舰

column1: Destroy the Additional Liao Forces
column2: 消灭额外的廖氏部队

column1: Destroy the Kurita Special Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁栗田家族特别增援部队

column1: Place Beacon Alpha
column2: 放置信标 Alpha

column1: Place Beacon Bravo
column2: 放置信标 Bravo

column1: Place Beacon Charlie
column2: 放置信标 Charlie

column1: Place the Beacons Quickly
column2: 快速放置信标

column1: Set Targeting Beacons for Data Transfer
column2: 设置信标以进行数据传输

column1: All units, close distance on enemy forces. Move quickly!
column2: 所有单位，缩短与敌军的距离. 快速推进！

column1: AUTHENTICATION CONFIRMED. COMMENCING TRANSMISSION.
column2: 认证已确认. 传输开始.

column1: Commander, they are deploying vehicles and tanks from their motor pool.
column2: 指挥官，你使用武器库中的车辆和坦克.

column1: Keep the pressure on to deny them the chance to place those beacons!
column2: 保持压制，防止他们有机会放置信标！

column1: Mercenary unit is on the ground in the area of operation, Force Commander Singh.
column2: 雇佣兵部队已在作战区着陆，部队指挥官辛格.

column1: Once all three beacons are placed, wait for confirmation that our DropShip has received the data. Then, make for the extraction LZ and the Leopard will pick you up.
column2: 一旦三个信标都放置完毕，请等待空投艇确认接收数据的信号. 随后立即前往撤离点，豹式会来接应你们.

column1: Upload complete. We have successfully transmitted the data.
column2: 上传完成. 我们已经成功传输了数据.

column1: I doubt they'll have been able to get more than a single backup lance over to this remote island in the time they'll have before we show up, guns blazing.
column2: 我怀疑在我们带着枪炮出现之前，他们来不及往这座偏远小岛再调一个后备小队。

column1: Our operative, Jawad, is in deep cover at the naval logistics base on this tiny island, Commander. Once you arrive at the facility, he'll break cover and board your unit in the rumble seat. Then you just need to get him and the data he carries out of the facility. We'll have the Leopard on standby to pick you up. We're going in loud, Commander, which means the facility is going to know you're coming. Be prepared for heavy resistance.
column2: 指挥官，我们的特工贾瓦德正深藏在这座小岛上的海军后勤基地里。你抵达设施后，他会现身并坐进你单位的简易座椅。接下来你只需把他和他携带的数据带出设施。我们会让豹式待命接你。指挥官，这次我们是大张旗鼓地进去，也就是说设施会知道你要来。做好迎击顽抗的准备。

column1: Ensure the Data Recovery Unit Survives
column2: 确保数据回收单位存活

column1: Ensure the Operative Recovery Unit Survives
column2: 确保回收特工的单位存活

column1: Recover the Data by Securing the Designated Area
column2: 通过控制目标区域来回收数据

column1: Recover the Operative by Securing the Secondary Designated Area
column2: 控制次要目标区域，回收特工

column1: Blast. They must have caught him uploading the data on their facilities. Is there anything else, Lieutenant?
column2: 该死！他们肯定是在他上传数据时抓住了他. 还有其他情况吗，中尉?

column1: Force Commander Singh, we're picking up a tight-beam transmission coming from the secondary facility in the lagoon. It's our operative's distress signal.
column2: 辛格部队指挥官，我们收到来自潟湖中次级设施的一束窄波通讯。那是我们干员的求救信号。

column1: He knew the risks of this operation. Commander, get that data out intact. Make his death mean something.
column2: 他知道这次行动的风险. 指挥官，把那些数据完整带出来. 让他的死有所意义.

column1: If they're expecting us, Commander, there's no telling how many units are going to be down there. This is going to get messy.
column2: 如果他们正等着我们，指挥官，那下面会有多少单位就说不准了。这会变得很乱。

column1: We're approaching the joint research base, Commander. Once you're in the AO, you'll need to move up to the base and set beacons to triangulate around it so that our covert DropShip, the Airavata, can transmit the authentication code and download the research data. We have a limited window of opportunity before the Liao ships in orbit detect our presence and come to investigate, so you'll be operating under a relatively tight timeline. Be aware that my people picked up a very large spike in comms chatter right after our previous mission, so they're expecting you.
column2: 我们正在接近联合研究基地，指挥官。一旦你进入行动区域，你需要推进到基地并设置信标对其进行三角定位，好让我们的隐蔽空投艇艾拉瓦塔能传送认证代码并下载研究数据。轨道上的廖氏舰船探测到我们并前来调查之前，我们的时间窗口有限，所以你将在相对紧张的时间表下作业。请注意，我的人在上次任务之后立刻截获了一次极为剧烈的通讯量激增，所以他们在等着你。

column1: This trafficking ring has to be put to a stop immediately Commander. We can't allow any more Nekos or Magistracy citizens to be captured
column2: 这条贩运链必须立即制止，指挥官。我们不能再容许任何猫娘或治安官辖区公民被掳走

column1: As discussed previously {COMMANDER.LastName}, it is essential that you pounce on any defenders and capture this Neko Holding Facility before my fellow members of MEOW can be shipped away. Once under our control, we’ll have to make our hasty exit stage wherever. You'll have to keep the facility safe while we whisk any prisoners into our protection
column2: 如前所述{COMMANDER.LastName}，你必须扑向任何守军并在我的MEOW同僚被运走之前夺取这处猫娘关押设施。一旦它归我们控制，我们就得从某个地方匆匆退场。在我们把任何囚犯纳入我们的保护之下时，你得保证设施安全

column1: This is the target area, Commander. Move forward with caution, eliminate any defenders and capture the Neko Holding Facility. Please, keep the prisoners safe and remember we're sensitive!
column2: 这就是目标区域，指挥官。谨慎推进，消灭任何守军并夺取猫娘关押设施。拜托，保证囚犯安全，记住我们很敏感！

column1: I'd usually expect well trained pilots with expensive gear Commander, but this time I'm not so sure. You'll have to assess the situation for yourself, but all this 'training' of theirs might just be nonsense. As always, use caution. We can't fail now.
column2: 指挥官，通常我会预期遇到训练有素、装备昂贵的飞行员，但这次我不太确定。你只能自己判断局势了，而他们那套“训练”可能纯属胡扯。一如既往，谨慎行事。我们现在不能失败。

column1: There were far more prisoners than originally anticipated, but thankfully due to your company's bravery and my quick thinking we were able to rescue them all. However, in the kerfuffle, one of the weeb leaders responsible for this outrage has blockaded our escape route. We’ll have to teleport behind them and take their forces down before we can escape. Don't let these fools stand in our way for a moment longer, let's show them the fury of a Canopian scorned.
column2: 俘虏比最初预估的多得多，但幸亏有你们连队的勇敢和我的机敏，我们得以把他们全部救出。不过在一阵混乱中，一个应对这场暴行负责的二次元头目封锁了我们的逃生路线。我们得瞬移到他们背后，在逃离之前先解决他们的部队。别让这些蠢货再多挡我们一刻，让他们见识被激怒的卡诺帕人的怒火。

column1: Destroy the Mercenary Patrols
column2: 摧毁雇佣兵巡逻队

column1: Commander, you're entering the area where our scouts last reported the weebs skulking about
column2: 指挥官，你正进入我们侦察兵上次报告二次元们潜伏的区域

column1: MoC III
column2: 卡诺帕斯 III

column1: This neko holding facility was specifically designed to keep us locked up with minimal risk of escape. Unfortunately we cannot commit to fully destroying it at this time for fear of damaging any of our equipment or any information pertaining to the location of Nyanderthal era artifacts. I’ve marked key structures to eliminate so we can recover the vital objectives later. This will be tricky, as while we were evacuating the prisoners additional forces have moved in to hold this position. That, and the heavy turrets...
column2: 这处猫娘关押设施专门设计为以最小逃脱风险把我们关住。不幸的是，由于担心损坏我们的任何装备或任何与尼安德特时代遗物位置有关的信息，我们目前无法承诺把它彻底摧毁。我已标出需要清除的关键建筑，以便我们稍后能回收重要目标。这会有难度，因为在我们撤离囚犯时，又有额外部队进驻守住这个位置。再加上那些重型炮塔……

column1: Destroy Neko Holding Facility and Extract Safely
column2: 摧毁猫娘关押设施并安全撤离

column1: Commander, the facility is just up ahead. Get visuals and remain cautious.
column2: 指挥官，设施就在前方。获取视觉信息并保持谨慎。

column1: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
column2: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

column1: Yang's been filling me in about this Maurice person, Commander. He says the mech signature reads like nothing he's ever seen, but the piloting appears wonky and unconfident. Be aware of any supporting forces, they may pose the real threat.
column2: 杨一直在跟我讲这个叫莫里斯的人，指挥官。他说那台机甲的信号特征是他从没见过的，但驾驶手法看起来别扭而缺乏自信。留意任何支援部队，他们可能才是真正的威胁。

column1: We've cornered them Commander, intel suggest his real name is 'Maurice', the vile ogre responsible for this atrocity. He speaks highly of his own skills on the battlefield but I'm not so certain at all. You'll have to determine that with your own wits, but we warned: His mech is sporting rather rare, expensive gear. It appears as though he hasn’t spared a dime on equipment. Let's slaughter this revolting individual and be done with it.
column2: 我们把他们逼到角落了，指挥官，情报显示他的真名是"莫里斯"，这场暴行的元凶、那个可憎的食人魔。他对自己在战场上的本领评价很高，可我一点也不确定。你得靠自己的判断力去验证，但我们要提醒你：他的机甲装备着相当稀有昂贵的器材。看来他在装备上不惜血本。让我们宰了这个令人作呕的家伙，了结此事。

column1: Destroy Maurice and Escape
column2: 摧毁莫里斯并撤离

column1: Destroy the Supporting Mercenary Forces
column2: 消灭支援的佣兵部队

column1: Commander, we're recieving a transmission from... well our target himself. On screen.
column2: 指挥官，我们收到一条来自……嗯，来自我们目标本人的通讯。在屏幕上。

column1: Remember, clearing the enemry forces here isn't our objective. Getting back the Nyans stuff is. The mechs are incidental... however they're still going to be to be shooting our 'Mechs in the ass, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
column2: 记住，清掉这里的敌军不是我们的目标。夺回尼扬的东西才是。机甲是附带的……不过它们仍然会朝我们机甲的屁股开火，指挥官。我们得保持移动。

column1: Now that we’ve decrypted the location of the Nyanderthal era artefact and our stolen equipment, we can drop in and claim back what is justly ours by birth right and legal purchase! Getting our equipment back takes utmost priority, as we can’t bring our musical joy to the Canopian masses without our equipment. Investigating the Nyanderthal artefact takes secondary priority, although its important, these wild goose chases turn out to be hogwash more often than not.
column2: 既然我们已经解密了尼安德特时代遗物和我们被盗装备的位置，我们就可以降落下去，夺回按出生权和合法购买本应属于我们的东西！取回我们的装备是最高优先事项，因为没有装备我们就无法把音乐的欢乐带给卡诺帕的民众。调查尼安德特遗物是次要优先事项，虽说它很重要，但这类大海捞针的追查十有八九是竹篮打水。

column1: Retrieve the Nyans Equipment and Extract Safely
column2: 取回尼扬的装备并安全撤离

column1: You're coming up on operational AO, Commander.
column2: 你正进入作战行动区域，指挥官。

column1: Simply mark the three designated target zones and watch the fireworks, knowing you're doing some good in the galaxy, Commander. This facility has to be destroyed completely.
column2: 只需标出三个指定目标区域，然后看烟花绽放，同时知道自己为这个银河做了些好事，指挥官。这处设施必须被彻底摧毁。

column1: Purrfect, now we get to witness the full firepower of this fully armed and operational… We have orbital units standing by with some particularly impressive fireworks ready to display, just for us.  You’ve got to move in and triangulate the target for us so we can accurately dispense some flashy justice. Yes, we enjoy a few explosions when we’re the ones setting them off. Additionally we have roused some local support for the battle, expect them to provide assistance as best they can
column2: 完美，现在我们可以见证这套全副武装、完全运作的……的完整火力了。我们有轨道单位待命，准备好一些特别震撼的烟火表演，专为我们展示。你得推进去并为目标做三角定位，好让我们准确地施放华丽的正义。是的，当我们是点火的那一方时，我们挺享受几次爆炸的。此外我们还为该战唤起了当地一些支援，预计他们会尽力提供协助

column1: Commander, this is it; destroying this facility will ensure no more nekos or citizens can be captured. Normal prisons are incapable of holding us for long, so once this is blasted into oblivion they'll have no place to keep us
column2: 指挥官，就是这里了；摧毁这处设施就能确保不再有猫娘或平民被俘。普通监狱没办法长期关住我们，所以一旦这里被炸成虚无，他们就没有地方可以关押我们了

column1: Steiner Alliance
column2: 施泰纳联盟

column1: Force Commander Onovo
column2: 部队指挥官奥诺沃

column1: They want us to take on a 20-year veteran of the Succession Wars with an underweight lance. This is going to hurt, Commander.
column2: 他们想让我们用一个缺编的小队去对抗一位在继承战争中服役了20年的老兵. 这仗会打得很疼，指挥官.

column1: The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMarikFWLM],FWLM]] Force Commander is currently traveling between installations on an inspection tour. He is heavily guarded, with two escorting lances of 'Mechs piloted by veterans who have served with him for years. However, this is still the best opportunity we'll have to strike at the League's command structure in Claybrooke.
column2: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMarikFWLM],自由世界联盟军队]]的部队指挥官目前正在各设施之间进行视察旅行。他护卫森严，有两支由跟随他多年的老兵驾驶的机甲小队护航。但即便如此，这仍是我们打击克莱布鲁克联盟指挥体系的最佳机会。

column1: Destroy the Force Commander and Escape
column2: 消灭部队指挥官并逃脱

column1: Destroy the FWLM Force Commander
column2: 消灭联盟的部队指挥官

column1: Commander, welcome to the operation. The target is confirmed to be in the region.
column2: 指挥官，欢迎加入这次行动. 目标已确认在该区域.

column1: Good. Commander, you are clear to evacuate the area.
column2: 好的. 指挥官，您现在可以退出该地区.

column1: My Lord, the mercenary team is back aboard the Leopard.
column2: 大人，佣兵部队已经回到了豹式空投艇上.

column1: My Lord, we have confirmation of target destruction.
column2: 大人，我们已确认目标被摧毁.

column1: Once the target is down, make your way to the designated evacuation area.
column2: 一旦目标关闭，前往约定的疏散区.

column1: This is a highly disappointing outcome that reflects poorly on you and your people, Commander.
column2: 这个结果非常令人不满意，让您和您的团队处于非常糟糕的状态，指挥官.

column1: Steiner Alliance II
column2: 施泰纳联盟 II

column1: This is bizarre, Commander. We just finished a covert drop to avoid drawing attention, and now we're going to blow up a military base?
column2: 这太离奇了，指挥官。我们刚完成一次隐蔽投放以避免引起注意，现在却要去炸掉一处军事基地？

column1: I've received word from Margrave General Neil; our success was well received within Cavanaugh Theater Command. Margrave Neil has passed on the results of their stragetic planning session, and we've been asked to strike one of the local military installations. The goal is to completely neutralize the facility, to send a message to local forces that they are vulnerable.
column2: 我收到尼尔边区将军的消息；我们的成功在卡瓦诺战区指挥部广受好评。尼尔边区将军转达了他们战略规划会议的结果，我们被要求打击当地一处军事设施。目标是彻底瘫痪该设施，向当地部队发出信号：他们并非固若金汤。

column1: Destroy the Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
column2: 摧毁敌方建筑，安全撤退

column1: Destroy the Facility Garrison
column2: 摧毁设施的驻军

column1: Commander, the target facility is just on the other side of that highway.
column2: 指挥官，瞄准设施在这条高速公路的对面.

column1: Destruction of enemy forces in the region is not mandatory, but will be rewarded.
column2: 摧毁该地区的敌方单位不是强制性的，但是，它会得到奖励.

column1: Hmm. Commander, I trust that you can handle any additional enemy forces?
column2: 唔指挥官，我猜，你会和几个额外的敌人相处?

column1: My Lord, we have additional contacts in the area. It might be an ambush.
column2: 大人，我们在该区域发现了更多接触信号. 这可能是个埋伏.

column1: Your objective is to cause as much damage as possible to critical facility structures.
column2: 你的任务是，对设施中最重要的建筑物造成尽可能多的破坏.

column1: Steiner Alliance III
column2: 施泰纳联盟 III

column1: Defeat Enemy Air Defense to allow Reinforcements to Land
column2: 击败敌方防空以让增援得以着陆

column1: Enemy Ally Special Reinforcement Lance
column2: 敌方盟友特种增援小队

column1: Enemy Garrison Lance
column2: 敌方驻防小队

column1: Enemy Supplemental 1 Lance
column2: 敌方补充 1 小队

column1: Enemy Supplemental 2 Lance
column2: 敌方补充 2 小队

column1: Move quickly… with assault-class 'Mechs. Commander, this is absurd. I hope they're paying well.
column2: 用突击级机甲快速机动。指挥官，这太荒唐了。我希望他们给的报酬够好。

column1: I approve of your choice of 'Mechs for this mission, Commander. This ought to be just the show of force that Margrave Joss was hoping for. Also, I have additional support to provide, thanks to Kommandant General Plath; you'll need to clear the antiair defenses before the support lance can land, though. Remember: Gungnir, our DropShip, can remain on station to fire at the planet only for a limited time. Move quickly, Commander.
column2: 我赞成你为这次任务选择的机甲，指挥官。这应该正是约斯边区将军所希望的那种武力展示。另外，多亏普拉特总监将军，我还有额外的支援可以提供；不过你得先清除防空防御，支援分队才能降落。记住：冈格尼尔，我们的空投艇，只能有限时间内停留在轨道上对行星开火。动作快点，指挥官。

column1: Attack the Installation and Place Beacons for a Fire Mission
column2: 攻击设施并放置信标以执行火力任务

column1: Destroy the Additional Marik Forces
column2: 摧毁额外的马里克部队

column1: Destroy the Marik Garrison
column2: 摧毁马里克驻军

column1: Destroy the Marik Special Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁马里克家族的特殊增援部队

column1: Disable the Antiair Turrets
column2: 关闭高射炮

column1: Get Visual Confirmation of the Shot's Effect
column2: 目视确认射击的效果

column1: Marik Reinforcements Inbound
column2: 马里克增援部队正在逼近

column1: *static* -ell, this round is yours. *cough* Until next time.
column2: *静电* ……好吧，这一轮算你的。*咳嗽* 下次再说。

column1: Ah, Commander, that extra support I promised is arriving now.
column2: 啊，指挥官. 我承诺的额外支援现在就到了.

column1: Ah, yes, Commander. The objective is to place three targeting beacons around the hardened military facility, so that our DropShip can fire its main gun at the base.
column2: 啊，是的，指挥官. 任务是要在这个坚固的军事设施周围放置三个目标信标，好让我们的空投艇能够用主炮攻击基地.

column1: Commander, this is LCAF First Lieutenant Langford. My people and I will be assisting you on the field.
column2: 指挥官，这是Langford中尉，来自LCAF(天琴共和军). 我的人会在战场上协助你.

column1: Expect enemy forces to interfere with your beacon placement. You will need to protect the beacons for a short time by remaining nearby.
column2: 预计敌军会干扰你的信标放置. 你还需要在附近停留，保护一段时间.

column1: Keep the pressure on to deny them a chance to place those beacons!
column2: 保持压制，阻止机甲放置信标！

column1: My Lord, the mercenary lance is now in the operational area. Opening comms to them.
column2: 大人，雇佣兵小队现已进入作战区域. 正在开启与他们的通讯.

column1: My Lord, we have new contacts. Looks like vehicles from a hardened motor pool.
column2: 大人，我们发现了新目标. 看起来像是来自一个加固车辆维修场的车辆.

column1: Once the facility is destroyed, move to the evacuation point. I await reports of your success, Commander.
column2: 设施摧毁后立即前往撤离点. 我会等待你的好消息，指挥官.

column1: We are on a very short timeline, Commander. Our orbital asset can conceal its signature only for a short time before it will be discovered, after which expect more enemy resistance.
column2: 我们的时间窗口非常有限，指挥官. 我们的轨道平台只能在短时间内隐藏其信号特征，之后便会被发现. 一旦暴露，预计会遭遇更强烈的敌军抵抗.

column1: Steiner Alliance IV
column2: 施泰纳联盟 IV

column1: I really don't like going in with this little information, Commander. This seems very rushed and poorly prepared.
column2: 我真的很不喜欢带着这么点情报就上，指挥官。这看起来非常仓促、准备不足。

column1: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to catch her while she's still in transit, and eliminate her. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.
column2: 我们对军事设施的打击带来了一个机会，指挥官。克莱布鲁克的军事统治者切斯汀中校正从首都逃往一处未公开的安全地点，想必是为了避免再次被打击。如果我们行动迅速，应该能趁她还在途中抓住她并除掉她。这次任务由卡瓦诺战区边区将军艾丽丝·施泰纳女公爵亲自要求，所以我们必须成功。

column1: Commander, if you do not act quickly, the convoy is likely to escape, and the target with it.
column2: 指挥官，如果你不迅速行动，车队将与我们的目的地一起逃跑.

column1: Commander, your performance has disappointed not only myself, but Duchess Steiner and by extension the entire Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: 指挥官，你的表现不仅让我失望，还让施泰纳男爵夫人失望，因此也让整个天琴共同体失望.

column1: Excellent. My agents have not been able to pinpoint which vehicle the Lieutenant Colonel is traveling in, so to be safe, just eliminate all of them.
column2: 很好. 我的特工们一直无法确定中校乘坐的是哪辆车. 因此，为了安全起见，把他们全部消灭.

column1: Good. Commander, focus your fire on the vehicles.
column2: 好的. 指挥官，将火力集中在车辆上.

column1: My Lord, the convoy is arriving at its extraction point!
column2: 大人，车队到达撤离点！

column1: My Lord, we have deployed the mercenary force in the area of operation.
column2: 大人，我们已将雇佣兵部队部署在行动区域.

column1: Once the convoy is destroyed, move to the evacuation zone for pickup.
column2: 一旦车队被摧毁，就移动到撤离区等待接应.

column1: I don't know what kind of show of force they were expecting aside from \"Boom, your base is gone,\" Commander.
column2: 指挥官，除了“轰，你的基地没了”，我不知道他们还能期待什么样的武力展示。

column1: I still believe that this mission would be more effective if you had chosen to bring heavier 'Mechs, but the orbital strike should still be the show of force that Margrave Joss was hoping for. Also, I have additional support to provide, thanks to Kommandant General Plath; you'll need to clear the antiair defenses before the support lance can land, though. Remember: Gungnir, our DropShip, can remain on station to fire at the planet only for a limited time. Move quickly, Commander.
column2: 我仍然认为，如果你选择带来更重的机甲，这次任务会更有效，但轨道打击应该仍能达到约斯边区将军所希望的那种武力展示效果。另外，多亏普拉特总监将军，我还有额外的支援可以提供；不过你得先清除防空防御，支援分队才能降落。记住：冈格尼尔，我们的空投艇，只能有限时间内停留在轨道上对行星开火。动作快点，指挥官。

column1: Attack the Installation and Place the Beacons for a Fire Mission
column2: 攻击设施并放置信标以执行火力任务

column1: Destroy the Enemy Special Reinforcements
column2: 消灭敌人的特殊增援部队

column1: We are on a very short timeline, Commander. Our orbital asset can conceal its signature only for a short time before it will attract attention from our foes. After that time we can all expect enemy reinforcements.
column2: 我们的时间非常紧迫，指挥官. 我们的轨道平台只能短暂隐藏自身信号，之后就会引来敌军注意. 在那之后，我们就要面对敌人的增援了.

column1: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to intercept her convoy and take her captive. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.
column2: 我们对军事设施的打击创造了一个机会，指挥官. Claybrooke的军事指挥官，Chestine中校，正在逃离首都前往一个未公开的安全地点 - 大概是为了避免成为另一次打击的目标. 如果我们行动迅速，应该能在途中拦截她的车队并俘虏她. 这个任务是卡瓦诺战区总督Iris Steiner女公爵亲自要求的，所以我们取得成功至关重要.

column1: Escort Friendly Units to Their Destination
column2: 护送友军单位前往目的地

column1: Excellent. Commander, please escort our guests to the extraction area.
column2: 很好. 指挥官，请陪同我们的客人到疏散区.

column1: My staff informs me that the convoy has taken shelter in a nearby facility and requested reinforcements.
column2: 我的工作人员报告称，车队已就近躲入某设施并请求了增援.

column1: Then, escort them to where our Leopard will load them aboard.
column2: 然后护送他们到LZ，在那里他们将被装载到我们的豹式中.

column1: Chapter 1 Verse 76
column2: 第一章第 76 节

column1: Pirates tend not to be the best armed forces, at least.
column2: 至少，海盗往往不是装备最好的军队。

column1: We have a large pirate strike force moving on our base. While they try to encircle us, you'll use the opportunity to crush their forward position. Smash through their defenders and move onto their base as quickly as you can.
column2: 一支大规模海盗打击部队正向我们的基地推进。当他们试图包围我们时，你将利用这个机会碾碎他们的前沿阵地。冲垮他们的守军，尽快推进到他们的基地。

column1: Destroy the pirate Lances
column2: 摧毁海盗小队

column1: We have enemy contact, I would recommend a solid firing line. Tactics should not be their strong suite.
column2: 发现敌军接触，我建议排成稳固的射击线。战术应该不是他们的强项。

column1: With such light resistance, I figured you would get here pretty quickly. The pirate's forward base is up ahead and I need it captured so I can retrieve any information about their motives. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 抵抗这么弱，我猜你很快就到了。海盗的前沿基地就在前方，我需要它被夺取，好让我取回任何关于他们动机的信息。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Capture the pirate Facility
column2: 夺取海盗设施

column1: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next Objective.
column2: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

column1: As expected, their base is lightly guarded. Always use caution though.
column2: 如我们所料，他们的基地守卫松散。不过永远要谨慎。

column1: Chapter 1 Verse 76 III
column2: 第一章第 76 节 III

column1: We made the right call, commander.
column2: 我们做对了，指挥官。

column1: Instructions are to hold our position until relieved. Protect those buildings at all costs. I'll stay in contact as we move to stop the flanking pirate unit.
column2: 指令是坚守阵地直到被替换。不惜一切代价保护那些建筑。我们移动去阻截那支包抄的海盗部队时会保持联系。

column1: Looks like we will need to buy a bit more time.
column2: 看来我们得多争取一点时间。

column1: Chapter 1 Verse 76 IV
column2: 第一章第 76 节 IV

column1: Pirates got to know what's on those vehicles by now. Might be a fight.
column2: 海盗现在肯定已经知道那些车辆上装的是什么了。可能会有一场仗打。

column1: We had a spy who infiltrated this rabble-rousing lot some time ago. They have picked up valuable information and now require a field extraction. I'm sure you're familiar with the specifics.
column2: 我们有个间谍早先打入了这群煽动闹事的人当中。他们已获取了宝贵情报，现在需要一次战地撤离。具体细节想必你很清楚。

column1: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
column2: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

column1: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there and keep them safe until we can get them out.
column2: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

column1: Lady Alekto
column2: 阿勒克托女士

column1: I really think the pirates are in for a surprise - or a laugh.
column2: 我真觉得这些海盗要大吃一惊了——或者大笑一场。

column1: Commander, do you see those pirates over there? Well, I don't want to. All understood?
column2: 指挥官，你看到那边那些海盗了吗？嗯，我不想看到。都明白吗？

column1: We've located one of the Pirate Lances, Commander. No sign of the other one.
column2: 指挥官，我们定位到了其中一支海盗小队。另一支没有踪迹。

column1: I am surprised we have enough forces to complete this, Commander.
column2: 我很惊讶我们还有足够的兵力完成这件事，指挥官。

column1: Hope you're holding up okay, Commander. We got word that a caravan carrying an ally of ours was near the area where you were fighting the pirate leadership. We now need you to retrieve an agent of ours who infiltrated their ranks.
column2: 希望你撑得住，指挥官。我们得到消息，一支载着我们一位盟友的商队曾在你与海盗首领交战区域附近。我们现在需要你去接回我们一名已潜入他们内部的干员。

column1: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
column2: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

column1: Clan Scouts
column2: 氏族侦察兵

column1: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance, Star... Whatever.
column2: 主要目标是摧毁敌方小队，星……随便吧。

column1: Clanners may be difficult to handle, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's put on our game faces.
column2: 部族分子可能不好对付，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。让我们摆出认真脸。

column1: I am so glad you answered our call, Commander. These Clanners know no mercy and they have just about driven us underground at this point. I trust you are familiar with doing violence and we'll leave the small details of this operation to you.
column2: 我很高兴你响应了我们的召唤，指挥官。这些氏族人毫无怜悯，他们此刻几乎把我们逼到地下去了。我相信你熟悉动武这套，行动的小细节就交给你了。

column1: And I captured the entire show on Holovid! Nice, crisp footage, ready for air.
column2: 而且我已经用全息影像全程录下来了！画质清晰利落，随时可以播出.

column1: Our surveillance drones have spotted a group of Clanners near this location.
column2: 我们的监视无人机在此位置附近发现了一群氏族人。

column1: That was glorious, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! You beat them bloody without a shred of hesitation or remorse!
column2: 真是精彩绝伦，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}！你毫不犹豫、毫无怜悯地把他们打得落花流水！

column1: What about refits and repairs? Our lance just took fire down there.
column2: 那改装和维修呢? 我们的小队刚刚在下面挨了打.

column1: You heard the man. Let's get this job done.
column2: 听到他的话了。我们把活干完。

column1: The Clan forward base is directly ahead of you. Capture it to get the Clan Galaxy Commander's attention. We want you to make a noise and show these interlopers that the Inner Sphere isn't finished here.
column2: 部族前进基地就在你正前方。夺取它以引起部族星系指挥官的注意。我们要你闹出动静，让这些闯入者知道内层星域在这里还没完。

column1: Capture the Clan Forward Base
column2: 夺取氏族前沿基地

column1: Destroy the Enemy Force
column2: 摧毁敌军

column1: Hold Out as Enemies Counter Attack
column2: 在敌军反攻时坚守

column1: Occupy the Base
column2: 占领基地

column1: Pacify the Area Around the Base
column2: 肃清基地周边区域

column1: Scout the Base
column2: 侦察基地

column1: Turrets. Remember they can spot you from a very long way off, Commander.
column2: 炮台. 请记住它们能在很远的距离上发现你，指挥官.

column1: Dropship inbound for landing! We're going to get in and out quick!
column2: 空投舰正在降落！我们要速进速出！

column1: The base is ours, Commander. Well done.
column2: 这座基地是我们的了，指挥官. 做得不错.

column1: The facility looks unoccupied save for some automated turrets, Commander. If we can bust those defenses and get inside the perimeter, our employer can send in their salvage crews to take control.
column2: 指挥官，这座设施看来还没有被占领，除了一些自动炮台. 如果我们打破那些防御力量并进入周界，我们的雇主就可以派遣他们的回收人员接管控制.

column1: We're here to capture the Base.
column2: 我们来这里是为了夺取基地。

column1: Clan Scouts III
column2: 氏族侦察兵 III

column1: I will mark a possible ambush spot just in case.
column2: 以防万一，我会标记一处可能的伏击点。

column1: Keep your eyes open down there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. We're going in with a single MechWarrior, and I don't trust this one bit.
column2: 在下面睁大眼睛，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们要只带一名机师进去，而我一点都不信这事。

column1: This is it, Commander. The Clan Commander has issued a batchall and you have accepted. One on one, honourable combat with the freedom of this world at stake. We'll be recording it for posterity.
column2: 就是这一下了，指挥官。氏族指挥官发出了批战挑战，而你接受了。一对一，荣誉之战，赌注是这颗行星的自由。我们会把它录下来留给后人。

column1: I challenge you to Zellbrigen, one on one combat!
column2: 我向你发起泽尔布林根挑战，一对一决斗！

column1: Wow, that was... entertaining?
column2: 哇，那真是……挺有娱乐性？

column1: Safe bet the Galaxy Commander has more forces near by, look out for them, this could be dangerous.
column2: 星系指挥官附近很可能有更多部队，当心他们，这可能会很危险。

column1: Commander. Your lance versus the Galaxy Commander, and whatever reinforcements he dares to call. Free this world!
column2: 指挥官。你的分队对上星系指挥官，以及他敢叫来的任何增援。解放这颗行星！

column1: You Dishonorable Dezgra!  You dare refuse my Batchall
column2: 你这无耻的德兹格拉！你竟敢拒绝我的战前叫阵

column1: Close the Gate
column2: 关上大门

column1: AI ZOMBIE
column2: AI 僵尸

column1: Commander, this will be grueling. Swap out pilots when you can.
column2: 指挥官，这会很折磨人。有机会就轮换飞行员。

column1: Your directive is simple: fight your way through the AI's lines and eventually, locate their forward base. Then ruin it all.
column2: 你的指令很简单：杀穿AI的防线，最终找到他们的前沿基地。然后把它彻底毁掉。

column1: Destroy the AI Zombie Lance
column2: 摧毁AI丧尸分队

column1: Destroy the AI Zombie Lances
column2: 摧毁 AI 僵尸小队

column1: Push through as quickly as you can. This first area looks like scavenged 'Mechs.
column2: 尽可能快地推进。这第一片区域看起来是被捡拾拼装的机甲。

column1: Close the Gate II
column2: 关上大门 II

column1: Smooth sailing so far, Commander.
column2: 到目前为止一帆风顺，指挥官。

column1: Looks like we are starting to see some heavier resistance. Make whatever preparations you can and prepare for another drop.
column2: 看来我们开始遇到更顽强的抵抗了。尽可能做好准备，为下一次投放待命。

column1: Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 狩猎愉快，指挥官。

column1: More of those AI controlled BattleMechs. Again try to push through quickly.
column2: 又是那些AI控制的战斗机甲。同样试着快速推进。

column1: Close the Gate III
column2: 关上大门 III

column1: Make sure to swap in fresh units when possible.
column2: 有机会就确保换上新单位。

column1: The wear on the equipment and Pilots are mounting Commander.
column2: 装备与飞行员的损耗正在加剧，指挥官。

column1: Eliminate the AuriganPirates Hostiles
column2: 消灭奥里根海盗敌人

column1: I worry about the whole environmental effect of a legion of Zombie 'Mechs.
column2: 我担心一整支僵尸机甲军团的整体环境影响。

column1: I'm pulling you out, Commander. We're done here.
column2: 我要把你撤出来，指挥官。我们这里结束了。

column1: Close The Gate IV
column2: 关上大门 IV

column1: Just two short missions to go.
column2: 只剩两个短任务了。

column1: Commander, this looks like the last staging area before we reach the primary target. Your endurance is appreciated, but this is not yet over. The infernal machine fights on.
column2: 指挥官，这似乎是抵达主要目标前的最后一个集结区了。感谢你的坚持，但事情还没结束。那台地狱般的机器仍在战斗。

column1: Eliminate the AI Zombies
column2: 消灭 AI 僵尸

column1: Looks like these are fresh 'Mechs commander, be careful.
column2: 看来这些是崭新的机甲，指挥官，小心。

column1: Close the Gate V
column2: 关上大门 V

column1: AI ZOMBIE ELITE
column2: AI 僵尸精英

column1: We can finally pack this in. Go get 'em, Commander
column2: 我们终于可以收尾了。去干掉他们，指挥官

column1: We've finally arrived. This is the AI stronghold and its last bastion. This is your moment, Commander. Orbital ordinance is primed and awaiting your firing solution. Move fast and we'll end this.
column2: 我们终于到了。这是AI的据点，它的最后堡垒。这就是你的时刻，指挥官。轨道弹药已就绪，等待你的射击方案。动作快点，我们就能了结这一切。

column1: Commander the main objective is to place the beacons so we can take out the AI core with orbital emplacements.
column2: 指挥官，主要目标是放置信标，这样我们就能用轨道装置摧毁AI核心。

column1: Looks like we should swap out pilots as we go to conserve strength.
column2: 看来我们该在过程中轮换飞行员以保存体力。

column1: We are almost at our goal. It's not polite to tell a mercenary how to do their work, but I do advise you switch out your pilots to maintain morale.
column2: 我们快到目标了。指导雇佣兵怎么干活并不礼貌，但我确实建议你轮换飞行员以维持士气。

column1: Get up there commander they are waiting for you.
column2: 上去吧指挥官，他们在等你。

column1: We've earned our rest after this!
column2: 之后我们可要好好休息！

column1: Apply pressure and we'll have our victory.
column2: 施加压力，我们就能拿下胜利。

column1: Two lances here, Crush them.
column2: 这里有两支小队，碾碎他们。

column1: Swap out the fatigued pilots for fresh ones, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，把疲劳的飞行员换成精神饱满的。

column1: We are halfway there and combat exhaustion is setting in. Watch your people's status and we'll all get through this. We're fighting a war of attrition now.
column2: 我们已经走了一半，战斗疲劳正在显现。留意你手下的状态，我们都能撑过去。我们现在打的是一场消耗战。

column1: Quite a few zombies around.
column2: 周围有不少丧尸。

column1: Just one more area 'til we can get to the base. Stay strong, Commander.
column2: 再过一片区域我们就能抵达基地了。撑住，指挥官。

column1: We are approaching a guarded forward staging area. Pace yourself and press through, Commander. This is a marathon, not a sprint and we are almost done.
column2: 我们正在接近一处设防的前沿集结区。稳住节奏，持续推进，指挥官。这是一场马拉松，不是短跑，而我们快完成了。

column1: Eliminate the AI Zombie Hostiles
column2: 消灭AI丧尸敌军

column1: Getting Close Commander, Just a short more distance to go.
column2: 快到了，指挥官，再走一小段就到了。

column1: Agent X
column2: 特工 X

column1: This sounds like a terrible idea, but this is why they pay us the big bucks.
column2: 这听起来是个糟糕透顶的主意，但正因如此他们才付我们大钱。

column1: Your mission requires you to act as our can opener. We are preparing to punch a hole into the installation to see what's inside and your lance will provide the targeting data.
column2: 你的任务要求你充当我们的开罐器。我们正准备在该设施上打出一个洞看看里面有什么，而你的分队将提供瞄准数据。

column1: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past.
column2: 指挥官，我在这里看到的唯一真正危险，是他们设法让人溜过去。

column1: I have tracked Sybil and her last supporters to this planet. I need her eliminated.
column2: 我已追踪西比尔和她最后的支持者到这颗行星。我需要她死。

column1: My minions tell me Sybil is on that caravan moving to her firebase. Destroy her and her men!
column2: 我的手告诉我西比尔就在那支前往她火力基地的商队上。摧毁她和她的人！

column1: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces, and Escape
column2: 摧毁目标，肃清区域内的额外部队，并撤离.

column1: She really has a problem getting good intel.
column2: 她确实很难搞到好情报。

column1: She may have escaped us earlier, but I see her lance up ahead. Get down there and make sure there is nothing left to salvage.
column2: 她上次可能从我们手里逃脱了，但我看到她的分队就在前面。下去，确保没留下任何可打捞的东西。

column1: She is here somewhere, fan out and find her, Commander!
column2: 她就在这附近某处，散开找她，指挥官！

column1: Place Beacon Alpha for Artillery Desgination
column2: 安放Alpha信标，用于火炮指示

column1: Place Beacon Bravo for Artillery Desgination
column2: 安放Bravo信标，用于火炮指示

column1: Place Beacon Charlie for Artillery Desgination
column2: 安放Charlie信标，用于火炮指示

column1: I'm glad she has confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field. Keep an eye out for Grim; she should be a priority target.
column2: 我很高兴她对我们有信心，但坦白说，我更希望战场上有一些增援。留心格里姆；她应该是个优先目标。

column1: All right! Got her cornered in her last stronghold. I would assume she's going to be well armed. I brought a can opener and a Nut Cracker with me. Time to crack some skulls
column2: 好！把她逼到了最后的据点。我猜她会武装得很充分。我带了个开罐器和一把胡桃夹子。是时候敲碎几颗脑袋了

column1: I will finally put this behind me. By killing the bitch who stole my minions.
column2: 我终于能把这事了结了。杀掉那个偷走我手下的贱人。

column1: Evolving Situation
column2: 局势演变

column1: Mechwarriors, I have a mission for you. The local government has requested our assistance in neutralizing a group of hostile mechs. We'll be setting up an ambush and taking them out before they know what hit them. It's a simple mission, but we can't let our guard down.
column2: 机甲战士们，我有个任务给你们。当地政府请求我们协助消灭一伙敌对机甲。我们将设下埋伏，在它们反应过来之前就把它们干掉。任务很简单，但我们不能放松警惕。

column1: Alright everyone, listen up! We're heading out on an ambush mission. Our target is a convoy of enemy mechs. Move out!
column2: 好了各位，听着！我们要出发执行一次伏击任务。目标是敌方一支机甲车队。出发！

column1: Professor, please calm down. We need to approach this with caution, not excitement.
column2: 教授，请冷静。我们需要谨慎对待这件事，而不是兴奋。

column1: Commander, we've got a promising lead on one of the enemy's commanding units. Oh, the possibilities for what we could learn from taking them down! Let's make it happen.
column2: 指挥官，我们找到了一条很有希望的线索，指向敌军的一支指挥单位。哦，干掉他们能让我们学到的东西，可能性太多了！让我们把它变成现实。

column1: Destroy Enemy Leader
column2: 消灭敌方首领

column1: Destroy the Local Government Enemy Commander
column2: 摧毁当地政府的敌方指挥官

column1: This is the region where we agents reported sighting the enemies.
column2: 这就是我们的特工报告发现敌人的区域。

column1: Evolving Situation III
column2: 局势演变 III

column1: Commander, this won't be an easy task. We're going up against a well-defended enemy stronghold, and we may be outnumbered and outgunned. But if you think it's worth the risk, we'll do our best to succeed.
column2: 指挥官，这不会是件容易的事。我们要对付一座防御良好的敌方要塞，而且可能在数量与火力上都处于劣势。但如果你认为值得冒险，我们会尽力成功。

column1: The mission is to capture the enemy base intact. The QuadVees will be a critical asset for this mission. We need to approach the base carefully, neutralize any enemy forces, and then secure the facility. Once we have control, we can search for any intelligence that might be valuable to our cause.
column2: 任务是完整夺取敌方基地。四足机甲将是这次任务的关键资产。我们需要谨慎接近基地，清除任何敌军，然后拿下该设施。一旦控制住，我们就能搜寻任何可能对我们事业有价值的情报。

column1: Destroy the Defenders
column2: 摧毁防御者

column1: The base is just ahead. Be on your guard, Commander.
column2: 基地就在前方。保持警惕，指挥官。

column1: Evolving Situation IV
column2: 局势演变 IV

column1: Commander, it seems we've finally located the Production Facilities. Shall we proceed to take the whole thing down?
column2: 指挥官，看来我们终于找到了生产设施。我们直接把整个地方端掉好吗？

column1: After all that, it appears that our only path to victory is to demolish their base. We have a Naval PPC at the ready, but we require a target..
column2: 折腾这么多之后，看来我们唯一的胜利之路就是摧毁他们的基地。我们有一门舰载 PPC 待命，但需要目标。

column1: There it is. Whatever they are building, it's not good for any of us. Take that base down!
column2: 就是那里。不管他们在造什么，对我们都没好处。端掉那座基地！

column1: I'm glad to hear that, Pillow. An easier mission is always more favorable to us. Let's get in there and take out their production facilities.
column2: 听到这个我很高兴，枕头。任务轻松些对我们总是更有利。我们进去把他们的生产设施端掉。

column1: Ok so our chances of obtaining the valuable data and research have been cut short, but this way does have a higher survivability. We will be destroying their production capabilities to hopefully drive them off this rock.
column2: 好吧，所以我们获取那些宝贵数据与研究的机会已经断了，但这条路确实生存率更高。我们将摧毁他们的生产能力，希望能把他们赶出这块石头。

column1: Well, it looks like we'll have to destroy the base after all. It's a shame we couldn't get our hands on their data and research, but I suppose it can't be helped.
column2: 好吧，看来我们终究还是得摧毁那座基地。可惜我们没能弄到他们的数据与研究，但我想这也没办法。

column1: Extracurricular Activities
column2: 附带活动

column1: You heard the man, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. This deployment is just setup for a larger fight to come, so try not to get too beat up out there.
column2: 你听到他说的了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 这个任务只是一场更大的战斗的第一部分，所以尽量别在外面伤得太重.

column1: You'll find the Davion munitions factory at the coordinates I've outlined, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Take it from them, that it may serve as the bait for the trap that I'm paying you to set.
column2: 你会在标出的坐标找到达维昂弹药厂，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。从他们手中夺过来，好让它充当那个我付钱请你设下的陷阱的诱饵。

column1: Capture the Munitions Factory
column2: 占领军工厂

column1: Destroy the Davion Garrison
column2: 摧毁戴维恩驻军

column1: Eliminate the Davion Reinforcements
column2: 消灭戴维恩增援部队

column1: Hold Out As Enemies Counterattack
column2: 在敌军反攻时坚守

column1: Occupy the Munitions Factory
column2: 占领军工厂

column1: Pacify the Surrounding Area
column2: 平定周边区域

column1: Scout the Munitions Factory
column2: 侦察军工厂

column1: DropShip inbound, Commander!
column2: 空投艇抵达，指挥官!

column1: Excellent work, Commander! Most excellent work indeed. The munitions factory is yours, and our trap has been set. Now all we need do is sit back and wait.
column2: 干得好，指挥官！实在漂亮极了. 军工厂归我们了，陷阱也已设好. 现在只需静待猎物上钩.

column1: The Davion munitions factory should be just ahead of your lance, Commander.
column2: 戴维恩军工厂应该就在你机甲小队前方了，指挥官.

column1: You are defeated, Commander. And I am extremely disappointed.
column2: 你失败了，指挥官. 而我对你失望透顶.

column1: Extracurricular Activities II
column2: 附带活动 II

column1: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of those locations.
column2: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施以夺取那些地点的控制权。

column1: You heard the man. Hold the base and take out all comers.
column2: 你听到他说的了. 守住基地并消灭所有来犯之敌.

column1: Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!
column2: 杰斯珀领主和他的小队正在赶来挑战你的路上. 守住工厂并让他弹射逃生，败兴而归！把他那珍贵的祖传机甲烧成冒烟的废墟！

column1: Baddies Inbound
column2: 敌人来袭

column1: Defend the Munitions Factory
column2: 保卫弹药工厂

column1: Ensure All Buildings Survive
column2: 确保所有建筑存活

column1: Escort the Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
column2: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

column1: Hold Out for Reinforcements
column2: 坚守待援

column1: And you did your work beautifully! The pride of House Bisset lays strewn across the battlefield, reduced to a broken heap!
column2: 你出色地完成了工作! 比塞特家族的骄傲在战场上散落得遍地都是，成了一堆废铁!

column1: I don't know who you are or who sent you, mercenary. But in the name of House Bisset and House Davion, you will abandon this factory or you will be destroyed!
column2: 我不知道你是谁，也不知道是谁派你来的，雇佣兵。但以比塞特家族与戴维恩家族之名，你要么放弃这座工厂，要么就会被彻底摧毁！

column1: Roger that, Graf Stieglitz-Bradford.
column2: 收到，斯蒂格里茨·布拉德福德伯爵.

column1: You are beaten, mercenary! Run back to your masters and never return!
column2: 你败了，佣兵！滚回你主子那儿去，永远别再回来！

column1: Capture Convoy Rally Point and Escort Convoy to Safety
column2: 占领车队集结点并护送车队至安全地带

column1: Let's knock this out quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I don't want to try Graf Stieglitz-Bradford's patience any more than we have to.
column2: 我们快点解决这事，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我不想比必要更久地去耗施蒂格利茨-布拉德福德伯爵的耐心。

column1: We'd be dead without your assistance, Commander. Full stop. There are at least a dozen different bandit gangs operating on the outskirts of our territory, and any one of 'em would jump at the chance to gun us down. So… thanks for doing what's decent. From all of us.
column2: 没有你的协助我们就死定了，指挥官。句号。我们领地郊外至少有十几伙不同的匪帮在活动，任何一伙都会扑上来把我们打成筛子。所以……谢谢你做了体面的事。我们所有人都是。

column1: Destroy the Bandit Reinforcements
column2: 消灭强盗增援部队

column1: Eliminate the Bandit Roadblock
column2: 清除土匪路障

column1: Ensure that All Refugee Vehicles Survive
column2: 确保所有难民车辆到达目的地

column1: Escort the Refugees to Safety and Escape
column2: 把难民带到安全的地方然后撤退

column1: Escort the Refugees to the Safe Zone
column2: 护送难民到安全区

column1: Recover your lance and return to the munitions factory. You still have a fight to win, and I am counting on your success.
column2: 回收你的小队并返回军工厂. 你还有一场仗要赢，我指望你成功.

column1: Thank you for helping us out of this, Commander. I've gotta admit, when I first reached out to you, I didn't have much hope that you'd respond.
column2: 感谢你帮我们摆脱这件事，指挥官。我得承认，我第一次联系你时，并没抱多大希望你会回应。

column1: Extracurricular Activities III
column2: 附带活动 III

column1: Now that your humanitarian responsibilities have been seen to, perhaps you'll be good enough to focus your attention on your real job? Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!
column2: 既然你的人道主义责任已经尽到，也许你可以好心把注意力放在你真正的工作上了？杰斯珀领主和他的分队正在前来挑战你。守住工厂，把他打回他的弹射舱里，让他败北受辱！把他那台珍贵的祖传战斗机甲留成一堆冒烟的废墟！

column1: The Eyrie
column2: 鹰巢

column1: Retrieve the Data and Extract Safely
column2: 回收数据并安全撤离

column1: They seem confident, but the opposition is firing on our 'Mechs, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
column2: 他们看起来很自信，但对手正在向我们的机甲开火，指挥官。我们需要保持移动。

column1: We're starting this simple, Commander. Your job is asset extraction. This is complicated by the Local Government not wanting you to escape, but I'm sure you know what to do. They've posted a heavily armed escort to stop this, but we trust that this won't trouble you.
column2: 指挥官，这次先从简单的任务开始。你的任务是撤离目标资产。麻烦之处在于当地政府不想让你离开，但我相信你知道该怎么做。他们已派出重装护卫来阻止这件事，不过我们相信这难不倒你。

column1: Retrieve Data Core
column2: 取回数据核心

column1: [GENERIC VO] The asset has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
column2: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

column1: Good work Commander.
column2: 干得好，指挥官.

column1: You're coming up on the government facility, Commander.
column2: 你正在接近政府设施，指挥官。

column1: Raza Mercenary Elite
column2: 拉扎佣兵精英

column1: I don't like the sound of this.
column2: 我不喜欢这听起来的样子。

column1: Today we will see if you can accomplish tasks by staying On Mission. Do not dissapoint us. Blow that base up by placing the beacons.
column2: 今天我们要看看你能否坚守任务目标完成任务。别让我们失望。放置信标把基地炸掉。

column1: Secure the Facility and Designate the Fire Mission Target
column2: 保护设施，取回样品

column1: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Good effect on target. Targets destroyed.
column2: 火控中心，这里是观察员实况：命中效果良好。目标已摧毁。

column1: They really want to hold on to that technology. It's a real shame we have to blow them up.
column2: 他们真的很想守住那项技术。真遗憾我们不得不把他们炸掉。

column1: Operation: Flattened Earth
column2: 行动: 焦土

column1: Razorback Company C&C Unit
column2: 尖背野猪公司指挥机甲

column1: Destroy the target, clear area of additional forces, and escape
column2: 摧毁目标，肃清区域内的额外部队，并撤离.

column1: Let's do this thing quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I don't want us spending any more time on these jokers than we have to.
column2: 快点把这事办了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我不想在这些活宝身上多花一分钟时间。

column1: Before you can rid us of the Volkovites, you're going to have to deal with Razorback Company, the hired guns they imported from the Frontier. Our surveillance drones have identified the company's command-and-control 'Mech, a CP-10-Z Cyclops. Eliminate it to cripple Razorback Company and clear a path to your real target.
column2: 在你除掉沃尔科维特人之前，你得先应付剃刀背连，那是他们从边疆雇来的枪手。我们的监视无人机已确认该连的指挥控制机甲，一台CP-10-Z独眼巨人。消灭它就能瘫痪剃刀背连，为通往你真正目标清出道路。

column1: Destroy the Razorback Company Cyclops and Escape
column2: 摧毁尖背野猪公司的“独眼巨人”机甲并撤退

column1: Eliminate the Razorback Company Cyclops
column2: 消灭尖背野猪公司的“独眼巨人”机甲

column1: Prevent the Cyclops from Escaping
column2: 阻止“独眼巨人”逃跑

column1: As brave as she is foolish. Engage the enemy and destroy them, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Liao out.
column2: 勇敢……但愚蠢. 攻击并消灭他们，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 廖完毕.

column1: For this first drop, I want you to hunt down Razorback Company's C&C 'Mech, a CP-10-Z Cyclops. It appears to be running a stock configuration, and it will be combat-capable at any range.
column2: 这次首个投放，我要你猎杀剃刀背连的指挥控制机甲，一台CP-10-Z独眼巨人。它似乎运行的是原厂配置，在任何射程上都具备战斗能力。

column1: Kill confirmed, Commander. The Cyclops is down, and you are cleared for extraction.
column2: 击杀确认，指挥官. “独眼巨人”已被击倒. 你可以进行撤离了.

column1: You are defeated, Commander. The Chancellor has asked me to express his displeasure at your performance, and to inform you that he will find another company to carry out his will.
column2: 你失败了，指挥官. 总理让我向你传达他对你表现的不满，并告知你，他会另找一家公司来执行他的意志.

column1: Operation: Flattened Earth II
column2: 行动: 焦土 II

column1: Tough luck for Razorback Company, but they knew what they were getting themselves into when they took sides against House Liao.
column2: 尖背野猪公司运气不佳，但他们选择与廖氏为敌时就该明白后果.

column1: My contacts in the Maskirovka tell me that you rejected Commander Elliathy's offer. A wise decision, Commander. Bring down the remainder of Razorback Company, and nothing will stand between you and the seditionist camp.
column2: 我在伪装局的联络人告诉我，你拒绝了埃利亚西指挥官的提议。明智的决定，指挥官。把剃刀背连的残部也打掉，你与煽动者营地之间就没有任何阻隔了。

column1: Destroy Razorback Company's BattleMechs
column2: 摧毁剃刀背连的战斗机甲

column1: And I will remember it, Mr. Oliveira. Now proceed to your next drop site.
column2: 我会记住的，奥利维拉先生. 现在，前往下一个降落点吧.

column1: Holy shit! We won! We actually won!
column2: 天啊！我们赢了！我们真的赢了！

column1: The Chancellor has asked me to express his displeasure at this humiliation, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. I will find another company to carry out the will of House Liao.
column2: 总理已要求我转达他对此次蒙羞的不满，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 我会另找一家公司来执行廖氏家族的意志.

column1: The remnants of Razorback Company have taken position ahead of you, Commander. I'd advise you to approach them with the caution you would a wounded animal. Commander Elliathy has little left to lose.
column2: 剃刀背连的残部已在你前方占据阵地，指挥官。我建议你像接近受伤野兽一样谨慎地接近他们。埃利亚西指挥官已经没什么可失去的了。

column1: Operation: Flattened Earth III
column2: 行动: 焦土 III

column1: Destroy Volkovite Structures
column2: 摧毁沃尔科维特建筑

column1: The sooner we can finish this, the better. Let's just… get it done.
column2: 我们越早办完这事越好。我们就……把它办了吧。

column1: The remaining Volkovites have holed up in a sanctuary you'll find in this valley. Destroy it, and eliminate whatever resistance they can bring to bear. The eyes of the Chancellor are on you, Commander. Don't disappoint him.
column2: 剩余的沃尔科维特人窝藏在这个山谷里你会找到的一处避难所。摧毁它，消灭他们能组织起的任何抵抗。议长的目光在你身上，指挥官。别让他失望。

column1: Destroy the Volkovite Reinforcements
column2: 消灭沃尔科维特的增援部队

column1: Destroy the Volkovite Sanctuary and Escape
column2: 摧毁沃尔科维特的避难所并逃脱

column1: Destroy the Volkovite Sanctuary
column2: 摧毁沃尔科维特的避难所

column1: Eliminate the Volkovite Garrison
column2: 消灭沃尔科维特驻军

column1: Guardians and protectors, come to us in our hour of need!
column2: 守护者和保护者，在我们最黑暗的时刻站在我们身边！
