column1: Outstanding work, Commander. You have performed your task with the grim efficiency that it required.
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官. 你以任务所要求的坚强不屈完成了它.

column1: The Volkovite compound should be just ahead of you, Commander. With Razorback Company out of the way, you should have no trouble putting it to the torch.
column2: 沃尔科维特据点应该就在你前方，指挥官. 既然尖背野猪公司无法再妨碍你，你应该能毫不费力地把它付之一炬.

column1: We are professionals, Lady Marina. We carry out our assignments, however distasteful they may be.
column2: 我们是专业人士，玛丽娜女士——无论任务多么令人厌恶，我们都会完成.

column1: No good deed goes unpunished, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Not ever.
column2: 好心没好报，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 历来如此.

column1: Good on you for being on the right side of this conflict, {COMMANDER.Callsign}… I know it couldn't have been an easy decision. And speaking of difficult matters, you're about to have a fight on your hands. House Liao has sent a detachment of 'Mechs to finish your job for you, and unfortunately, Razorback Company is no position to deal with 'em.
column2: 你能站在这场冲突正确的一方，值得称赞，{COMMANDER.Callsign}……我知道这个决定不容易。说到棘手的事——你马上就有仗要打了。廖氏家族派出了一队机甲来替你完成任务，可惜剃刀背连可没能力应付他们。

column1: Destroy the Liao Attack Units
column2: 摧毁廖氏的进攻单位

column1: Eliminate the Liao Units
column2: 消灭廖氏单位

column1: Uh, Boss? I'm seeing a couple of Liao attack lances on my screen, and I'm willing to bet their pilots are pretty angry.
column2: 呃，老大？我在屏幕上看到两支廖氏攻击分队，而我敢打赌他们的飞行员相当愤怒。

column1: This is turning into one hell of a long haul, but the sooner we get these people out of Capellan space, the sooner we can collect our pay.
column2: 这将变成一段艰难的长途旅程，但我们越早将这些民众带离卡佩拉联邦，就能越早拿到酬劳.

column1: The last of the Volkovites have packed themselves onto a series of transport vehicles, and they're ready to roll. We've lined up a DropShip to take them to Joppa, but you're gonna have to get 'em there. We're nearly through this situation, Commander… just a little bit further to go.
column2: 最后一批沃尔科维特人已经挤进了一串运输车辆，随时可以出发。我们已经安排好一艘空投艇送他们去约帕，但你得把他们送到那儿。我们快熬过这个局面了，指挥官……再往前走一点点就到了。

column1: Ensure All Volkovite Units Survive
column2: 确保所有沃尔科维特单位存活

column1: Escort the Volkovite Convoy to Safety and Escape
column2: 护送沃尔科维特车队到达目的地并撤离

column1: Escort the Volkovite Convoy to the Evac Point
column2: 护送沃尔科维特车队前往撤离点

column1: Protect the Volkovites As They Board the DropShip
column2: 保护沃尔科维特人员登舰

column1: Good luck and godspeed, Commander. Get us to safety and protect us, for we cannot protect ourselves. Our lives are in your hands.
column2: 祝你好运，指挥官. 把我们带到安全的地方并保护我们吧，因为我们无法自保. 我们的生命掌握在您的手中.

column1: I truly hope that it never comes to that, Mr. Oliveira. But if it does, your company will be the first that I call.
column2: 我真诚地希望事情不会走到那一步，奥利维拉先生. 可如果发生了，那我第一个找的就是你们公司.

column1: Okay, Commander. We've got the Volkovites all bundled up into a convoy of vehicles.
column2: 好，指挥官。我们已经把沃尔科维特人全都塞进了一支车辆车队。

column1: Take care of yourself, Commander. And cheers again for doing the right thing.
column2: 请多保重，指挥官. 再次为你选择正确之举而致敬.

column1: Fortress Door
column2: 堡垒大门

column1: Here we go chasing ghosts again, Commander. I think she will have an aneurysm if we run into Jimmy.
column2: 又来了，我们又在追鬼影，指挥官。我想我们要是撞上吉米，她会气得血管爆掉。

column1: We have tracked ComStar to this hell hole of a planet. Whatever they are hiding here, I have to have. So let's start simple. Agent X has been sighted here with his crew. Get down there and take him out.
column2: 我们追踪康星到了这颗地狱般的行星。不管他们在这里藏了什么，我都要拿到。所以从简单的开始。X特工和他的队伍在这里被发现过。下去，把他做掉。

column1: Destroy Agent X and Escape
column2: 消灭特工 X 并撤离

column1: We have him this time. I am going to skewer his eyeballs and serve them for dessert tonight.
column2: 这次我们逮住他了。我要把他的眼珠串起来，今晚当甜点端上桌。

column1: I have a sneaky suspicion Jimmy has some serious Plot armor Commander.
column2: 我有个偷偷的猜测，吉米身上有很厚的剧情护甲，指挥官。

column1: I am going to put this ship in a bottle, even if it kills him. That little bastard stole from me, made me chase him all around the Sphere, and now he taunts me from inside a base. Use extreme prejudice eliminating him.
column2: 我要把这艘船装进瓶子里，哪怕这要了他的命。那小混蛋偷了我的东西，让我绕着内天体追了他一圈，现在他还躲在一座基地里嘲弄我。用极端手段消灭他。

column1: Target building destroyed, good work Commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
column2: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

column1: Why did the Pirate cross the road? TO KILL JIMMY!
column2: 海盗为什么要过马路？为了杀吉米！

column1: Fortress Door IV
column2: 堡垒大门 IV

column1: Oh boy, let's hope Jimmy isn't down there or we may not get anything.
column2: 天哪，但愿吉米不在下面，否则我们可能什么都拿不到。

column1: Okay, we made it to the planet. We have everything we need except for the geo-location of the fortress where they have whatever they have, and I want it. Get down there and smash that convoy and kill whoever to get the information we need.
column2: 好，我们到行星了。我们什么都不缺，只差那座堡垒的地理位置——他们手里有什么都无所谓，我要的就是它。下去摧毁那支车队，杀掉任何人，拿到我们需要的情报。

column1: Well, we're here.  Let's go clean up a convoy.
column2: 好吧，我们到了。去清理一支车队。

column1: Fortress Door III
column2: 堡垒大门 III

column1: Good times, large explosions, maybe a plot twist. Sounds like a fun time.
column2: 好时光、大爆炸，也许还有个剧情转折。听着挺有意思。

column1: By now you know the drill. We will be firing our Naval Gauss Rifle from orbit, We can only keep it charged so long. Get the beepy things in the Target zone so we can blow a hole in this base.
column2: 到现在你该熟悉流程了。我们将从轨道上发射舰载磁轨炮，我们只能让它充能这么久。把那些会叫的东西放进目标区，好让我们在这座基地上炸出一个洞。

column1: Attack the Installation and Place Beacons To Make a new door in the base
column2: 攻击设施并放置信标，在基地上开一道新门

column1: We have touchdown. Scanning COM channels.
column2: 我们已着陆。正在扫描通讯频道。

column1: Drop is looking good, should see our target shortly.
column2: 投放看起来不错，很快就能看到我们的目标。

column1: Alright, we will try it your way. I think that we should kill the target, but if you want to capture him we will go with that.
column2: 好，我们按你的方式来。我认为我们应该杀掉目标，但如果你想俘获他，我们就照办。

column1: My minions have the target loaded and ready. They are just waiting on you for their escort.
column2: 我的手下已经把目标装载好、准备就绪。他们只等着你去做护卫。

column1: Great now we are going to free an AI that has gone mad. Doesn't anyone take the holovid warnings from the late 20th century seriously.
column2: 好极了，现在我们要去释放一个已经疯掉的AI。难道没人把20世纪末那些全息影像警告当真吗。

column1: Ok, we got some great information from the escort mission. First thing we learned was that I hate escort missions. Secondly however, is that this place serves two purposes: one is to protect the AI on a nearby planet, and two it has some nice loot.
column2: 好，我们从护送任务里得到了很棒的情报。第一件学到的事是我讨厌护送任务。第二件则是，这地方有两个用途：一是保护附近一颗行星上的AI，二是它有一些不错的战利品。

column1: Opening COMs, looks like we have a serious situation here.
column2: 打开通讯，看来这里情况严重。

column1: The Steel Beast
column2: 钢铁野兽

column1: I've got nothing to add, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's go beat up some violent drunks.
column2: 我没什么要补充的，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们去揍几个暴力的醉汉吧。

column1: If we are to draw the Steel Beast into a fight, we must first provoke him. The wholesale slaughter of his revolting followers seems like a reasonable first step. I'll point you in the right direction, you'll bring the firepower, and we'll scour this world of Bogdan Tubbs's fan club. Then we'll move on to a more high-profile target.
column2: 如果我们要把钢铁野兽引出来打一场，就必须先激怒他。把他那些令人作呕的追随者成批屠杀，看来是合理的第一步。我给你们指方向，你们带来火力，我们就把博格丹·塔布斯的粉丝俱乐部从这个世界上彻底清除。然后我们再转向更引人注目的目标。

column1: Destroy the Steel Beast's Retinue
column2: 摧毁钢铁野兽的随从

column1: Our surveillance drones have spotted a group of the Steel Beast's friends and followers near this location.
column2: 我们的监视无人机在此位置附近发现了一群钢铁野兽的朋友和追随者。

column1: Then by all means, we should broadcast it. We move on Ironwood Productions and their Holo-distribution facility, and we do it now!
column2: 既然如此，那就尽管播出去吧！我们现在就行动，占领Ironwood Productions的全息分发设施！

column1: The Steel Beast II
column2: 钢铁野兽 II

column1: Ironwood Productions' Holo-distribution facility is just ahead of you, Commander. Take it, and we will use it to ensure that the Steel Beast hears your challenge.
column2: 铁木制作公司的全息发行设施就在你前方，指挥官。拿下它，我们就能用它确保钢铁野兽听到你的挑战。

column1: Capture the Holo-Distribution Facility
column2: 占领全息分发设施

column1: Destroy the Security Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁安保部队增援部队

column1: Eliminate the Corporate Security Forces
column2: 消灭安保部队

column1: Pacify the Area around the Holo-Distribution Facility
column2: 平定全息分发设施周围的区域

column1: Scout the Holo-Distribution Facility
column2: 侦察全息分发设施

column1: Huh. Looks like Ironwood Productions shelled out for point-defense turrets. I was not expecting that.
column2: 哼. 看起来Ironwood Productions还真掏钱买了点防御炮台. 这我倒没料到.

column1: I am inbound for landing, Commander.
column2: 我正在进场准备降落，指挥官.

column1: I would advise your lance to scout the facility before engaging it. Ironwood Productions has security contracts with a number of local mercenary outfits, and resistance is likely to be heavy.
column2: 我建议你的机甲小队先侦察设施再发动攻击. Ironwood Productions与多家当地雇佣兵公司签有安保合约，预计将遭遇激烈抵抗.

column1: The Holo-distribution facility should be just ahead of you, Commander.
column2: 全息分发设施应该就在你前面，指挥官.

column1: The Steel Beast III
column2: 钢铁野兽 III

column1: Keep your eyes open down there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. We're going in with a single MechWarrior, and I don't trust this joker to stick to his end of the deal.
column2: 在下面睁大眼睛，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们要只带一名机师进去，而我不信这个活宝会守约。

column1: This is it, Commander. Your one-on-one contest with the Steel Beast. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!
column2: 就是这一刻了，指挥官. 你和那头“钢铁野兽”的一对一对决. 让他尝尝他应得的正义制裁吧！

column1: Eliminate the Steel Beast
column2: 消灭钢铁野兽

column1: Shut up and fight, you murderous swine. Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} will make you suffer, as you made my nephew Arjun suffer!
column2: 闭嘴受死吧，你这杀人猪猡. 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}会让你尝尽痛苦，就像你折磨我侄子阿琼那样！

column1: What is wrong with him?
column2: 那有什么问题?

column1: You're here. Good! I've been LOOKING FORWARD to BREAKING YOUR NECK!
column2: 你来了。好！我一直盼着扭断你的脖子！

column1: I'm willing to bet that Bogdan Tubbs is bringing friends to this drop, same as we are. Just a feeling I get. So, yeah… keep your eyes open.
column2: 我敢打赌博格丹·塔布斯这次投放会带朋友来，跟我们一样。只是我的感觉。所以，嗯……睁大眼睛。

column1: This is it, Commander. Your lance versus the Steel Beast, and whatever reinforcements he dares to call. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!
column2: 就是现在，指挥官. 你的机甲小队对上“钢铁野兽”，以及他敢叫来的任何增援. 给予他罪有应得的正义！

column1: Scratch one Steel Beast. He had it coming, I have to say.
column2: 解决掉一头“钢铁野兽”. 他这是自找的，不得不说.

column1: You're here… and look, you've brought friends! You're a LIAR and a CHEAT, and you're gonna REAP THE STEEL BEAST'S WHIRLWIND!
column2: 你来了……而且你看，你还带了朋友！你是个骗子、一个作弊鬼，而你将承受钢铁野兽的旋风！

column1: Criminal Minds
column2: 犯罪思维

column1: Bront Shivraj
column2: 勃朗特·希瓦吉

column1: Seems straightforward enough, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Get in there and make it happen.
column2: 任务很明确，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 进场执行吧.

column1: Commander, find and eliminate the Iron Sparrow's courier and his bodyguard. I want Shivraj dead and whatever intelligence he's carrying in my hands.
column2: 指挥官，找到并消灭铁麻雀的信使和他的保镖。我要希夫拉杰死，他携带的任何情报都要落在我手里。

column1: Eliminate Bront Shivraj
column2: 消灭勃朗特·希瓦吉

column1: Eliminate the Iron Sparrow's Courier
column2: 消灭铁麻雀的信使

column1: Prevent Shivraj from Escaping
column2: 阻止希瓦吉逃跑

column1: Proceed to the Evac Zone
column2: 前往撤离区

column1: A timely arrival, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. My people have eyes on Mr. Shivraj and his bodyguard.
column2: 来得正是时候，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 我的人已锁定希瓦吉及其护卫.

column1: Good hustle, Subcommander Boris. Our people will be ready.
column2: 干得漂亮，副指挥官鲍里斯. 我的人会做好准备.

column1: They are CCAF soldiers, Mr. Oliveira. Their efficiency is beyond question. Now I suggest that you clear the line and prepare your lance. They will be deploying imminently.
column2: 他们是卡佩拉武装部队的士兵，奥利维拉先生. 他们的效率不容置疑. 现在我建议你保持通讯通畅并让你的小队做好准备. 他们即将部署.

column1: You have your orders, Commander. Do not disappoint me. Tianyu out.
column2: 命令已下达，指挥官. 不要让我失望. 天宇完毕.

column1: Criminal Minds II
column2: 犯罪思维 II

column1: According to Subcommander Tianyu, the warehouse should be full of mining equipment… generators, churn drills, that sort of thing. Nothing we'd be interested in, but worth a lot to the right people.
column2: 根据田雨副指挥官的说法，那座仓库里应该全是采矿设备……发电机、螺旋钻之类的东西。我们不会感兴趣，但对合适的人来说值不少钱。

column1: The intel you got from the Iron Sparrow's courier points here, to the warehouse you'll find just ahead. Take it for House Liao until the Liao Reserves arrive to relieve you.
column2: 你从铁麻雀的信使那里得到的情报指向这里——你正前方的那座仓库。为廖氏家族夺取它，直到廖氏预备队抵达接替。

column1: Capture the Iron Sparrow's Warehouse
column2: 夺取铁麻雀的仓库

column1: Destroy the Criminal Reinforcements
column2: 消灭犯罪集团增援部队

column1: Eliminate the Point-Defense Turrets
column2: 清除防御炮台

column2: 占领这个区域

column2: 平定仓库周围的区域

column1: A terrible disappointment, Commander. But the Liao Reserves will succeed where you have failed.
column2: 太令人失望了，指挥官. 但廖家的预备役部队会完成你未能做到的事.

column1: DropShip inbound, Commander.
column2: 空投艇正在进场，指挥官.

column1: Gee, Subcommander Boris. Thanks.
column2: 哇，鲍里斯副指挥官. 谢谢.

column1: This is the place, Commander. The Iron Sparrow's warehouse lies just ahead of you, its contents ripe for the picking.
column2: 就是这里，指挥官。铁麻雀的仓库就在你前方，里面的东西正等着人去拿。

column1: Criminal Minds III
column2: 犯罪思维 III

column1: Defend Base from Attackers
column2: 抵御进攻者保卫基地

column1: Unpleasant as Subcommander Tianyu may be, he's getting his vault, SLDF Griffin and all. Our reputation with House Liao is worth more than a single 'Mech.
column2: 田雨副指挥官虽然讨人厌，但他会拿到他的金库，连同SLDF格里芬一起。我们与廖家族的声望比一台机甲更值钱。

column1: The Iron Sparrow has dispatched all of his remaining units to attack the vault's northmost entrance, Commander. Hold them off until the Liao Reserves arrive to relieve you.
column2: 指挥官，铁麻雀已派出他所有剩余部队攻击金库最北端的入口。顶住他们，直到廖氏预备队抵达接替。

column1: Escort the Combat Engineer APCs to the Turret Control Center
column2: 与技术人员一起护送 MTW 到炮台控制中心

column1: Hostile Units Inbound
column2: 敌对单位来了

column1: Only one building is still standing, you fool! If the Iron Sparrow brings it down, this whole campaign will be over!
column2: 你这个蠢货，只剩下一栋建筑了！如果“铁麻雀”也摧毁了它，整个战役就全完了！

column1: Run, then. Flee like the coward you are.
column2: 跑吧. 像个懦夫一样逃跑吧.

column1: The Iron Sparrow's forces are converging on the vault's northmost entrance point, Commander. Doubtless, they were hoping to catch you by surprise. Ready yourselves, they'll be on you soon enough.
column2: 铁麻雀的部队正向金库最北端的入口点集结，指挥官。毫无疑问，他们本想打你个措手不及。做好准备，他们很快就到。

column1: Subcommander Tianyu isn't going to let us keep what's in this vault without a fight, and it'll take time for Yang's crew to gather up all the pieces of that SLDF 'Mech. Now that we're committed to doing this, let's do it right.
column2: 田雨副指挥官不会让我们不战而保住这个金库里的东西，而杨的团队要收齐那台SLDF机甲的所有部件也需要时间。既然我们已经决定要做，就把它做对。

column1: I know what your man has done. Lady Marina may be fool enough to trust in mercenaries, but I've had agents watching you from the start—and now I find my suspicions confirmed. Prepare yourself to face the full wrath of the Liao Reserves, Commander—I will claim the contents of that vault you so covet, and then I will bury you in it.
column2: 我知道你的人做了什么。玛丽娜女士也许蠢到去信任雇佣兵，但我从一开始就派了特工监视你——如今我发现我的怀疑得到了证实。准备好面对廖氏预备队的全力怒火吧，指挥官——我要夺取你如此觊觎的那个金库里的东西，然后我会把你埋在里面。

column1: Defend the Iron Sparrow's Warehouse
column2: 防守铁麻雀的仓库

column1: Defend the Warehouse against the Liao Reserves
column2: 保卫仓库对抗廖氏预备役部队

column1: Ensure That All Structures Survive
column2: 确保所有建筑物存活

column1: I'll tear that thrice-damned shack down around you to reclaim what you have stolen from me, mercenary scum!
column2: 我会把那座三度该死的破屋在你周围拆平，夺回你从我这里偷走的东西，雇佣兵渣滓！

column1: NOT USED IN THIS FLASHPOINT - CHUNK IS OFF.
column2: 未在此闪点中使用 - 块已关闭.

column1: Your treachery is matched only by your incompetence, Commander. The spoils of this conflict are mine.
column2: 你的背叛程度，唯有你的无能能与之匹敌，指挥官. 这场冲突的战利品全归我了.

column1: Let's make some noise, {COMMANDER.Callsign}. Do as much damage as you can. When the Zhao siblings scatter, we'll choose our target and finish this.
column2: 来点动静吧，{COMMANDER.Callsign}。尽可能造成破坏。等赵家兄妹散开，我们就选定目标，收尾。

column1: Descend on the Flak Jackals and punch a hole in their lines. Make them pay for the Federation citizens they've killed, Commander—it is imperative that this pirate filth learn the cost of crossing the Federated Suns.
column2: 突袭高炮豺狼，在他们防线上打穿一个洞。让他们为杀害的联邦公民付出代价，指挥官——必须让这些海盗渣滓明白冒犯联邦太阳的代价。

column1: Destroy the Flak Jackal Reinforcements
column2: 消灭“高炮胡狼”的增援部队

column1: Eliminate the Flack Jackal Lance
column2: 消灭“高炮胡狼”机甲小队

column1: Eliminate the Flak Jackal Lance
column2: 消灭高射豺狼机甲小队

column1: Get out there and show them what a real mercenary company can do.
column2: 出击让他们见识真正佣兵团的实力.

column1: I've got a Flak Jackal lance on radar just ahead of you, Commander.
column2: 雷达上有一支高炮豺狼分队就在你前方，指挥官。

column1: Headhunting II
column2: 斩首行动 II

column1: Remember, Orchid is a brawler—she likes to get in close, and her 'Mech is equipped to facilitate that. I'd suggest that you engage her from range if possible.
column2: 记住，奥琪德是个近战好手——她喜欢贴身缠斗，而她的机甲也是为此配备的。如果可能，我建议你从远距离与她交战。

column1: Hunt down and eliminate Orchid \"Thresher\" Zhao, one of the two leaders of the Flak Jackals. Be advised that her personal BattleMech is equipped with LosTech weaponry and equipment.
column2: 追捕并消灭奥琪德"脱粒机"赵，高炮豺狼两名首领之一。请注意，她的私人战斗机甲装备有失传科技武器与装备。

column1: Defeat Orchid Zhao and Escape
column2: 击败奥基德·赵并撤离

column1: Destroy the Supporting Flak Jackal Forces
column2: 消灭支援的“高炮胡狼”部队

column1: Reach the Evac Zone
column2: 抵达撤离区

column1: Stop Orchid Zhao from Escaping
column2: 阻止奥基德·赵逃跑

column1: [Incoming Transmission.]
column2: [传入传输.]

column1: Oh, the things that we did to your lance, Commander. The absolute horror of it! Did you hear your little friends screaming over the comms? Makes my heart bleed, knowing how terribly they suffered.
column2: 哦，我们对你的小队做了什么，指挥官. 真是太可怕了！你听到你那帮小朋友在通讯频道里的尖叫了吗? 知道他们遭受了如此可怕的痛苦我的心都碎了.

column1: Remember, Dominik is a sniper—he likes to sit back and punch holes in things at range, and his 'Mech is equipped to facilitate that. I'd suggest closing into knife-fight range if possible.
column2: 记住，多米尼克是个狙击手——他喜欢待在后面，在远距离上把东西打穿，而他的机甲就是为此配备的。如果可能，我建议你逼近到白刃距离。

column1: Hunt down and eliminate Dominik \"Whistler\" Zhao, one of the two leaders of the Flak Jackals. Be advised that his personal BattleMech is equipped with LosTech weaponry and equipment.
column2: 追猎并消灭多米尼克·“哨声”·赵，高炮胡狼的两名首领之一。请注意，他的私人战斗机甲装备了失落科技武器与设备。

column1: Defeat Dominik \"Whistler\" Zhao and Escape
column2: 击败多米尼克·“哨声”·赵并撤离

column1: Prevent Dominik Zhao from Escaping
column2: 阻止多米尼克·赵逃跑

column1: Bourbon & BattleMechs
column2: 波旁威士忌和战斗机甲

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Structures
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 建筑

column1: Well, this should be fun.
column2: 嗯，这应该会很有趣。

column1: The Stratford Narwhal is one of Garrilac's favorite watering holes. It's also a cesspool of vice, corruption, and terrible music. Taking it out may prove more difficult than you'd think; the bar was built in the husk of an old military complex, and its MechWarrior patrons will probably attack you on sight.
column2: 斯特拉特福独角鲸是加里拉克最爱的酒馆之一。它同样也是恶习、腐败和糟糕音乐的污水坑。拿下它可能比你想象的更难；这家酒吧建在一座旧军事建筑群的残骸里，其机师顾客大概一见到你就会动手。

column1: Destroy the Belligerent Drunks
column2: 消灭好战的醉汉

column1: Destroy the Stratford Narwhal
column2: 摧毁斯特拉特福独角鲸

column1: Eliminate the Hostile Inebriates
column2: 消灭敌方酒鬼

column1: A dump with point-defense turrets. This Garrilac guy must really like drinking in peace.
column2: 带点防御炮台的垃圾场. 这个加瑞拉克真的不想在喝酒的时候被打扰.

column1: Good news and bad news, Commander. On the good side, the Stratford Narwhal is out of business.
column2: 有好消息还有坏消息，指挥官. 好的方面就是，斯特拉特福独角鲸停业了.

column1: I was with you, then you lost me.
column2: 我想同意你的看法，但我只能摇头.

column1: Picking up more belligerent drunks on radar, Boss. Just an FYI.
column2: 雷达上出现了更多恼怒的醉汉，老板——只是提醒你一下.

column1: The Stratford Narwhal is just up ahead, Commander. Looks like a real dump.
column2: 斯特拉特福独角鲸就在前方，指挥官. 看起来真是个垃圾场.

column1: Bourbon & BattleMechs II
column2: 波旁威士忌和战斗机甲II

column1: Garrilac may seem like kind of a joke, but you shouldn't underestimate Mason's Marauders. I've heard stories about their effectiveness on the field.
column2: 加里拉克看起来也许像个笑话，但你不该低估梅森的劫掠者。我听说过他们在战场上的效力。

column1: Garrilac's lance is on the ground and waiting for you. Destroy them.
column2: 加里拉克的分队已经落地，正等着你们。摧毁他们。

column1: Destroy the Marauder Reinforcements
column2: 消灭掠夺者增援部队

column1: Keep talking, hotshot. Our lance will take you down first.
column2: 继续说吧，高手. 我们的机甲会先把你干掉.

column1: So. You're {COMMANDER.Callsign}. I hope you're ready to get your teeth kicked in, because that's what's about to happen.
column2: 那么，你就是{COMMANDER.Callsign}。我希望你准备好被打得满地找牙，因为那正是即将发生的事。

column1: Yes, thank you. We get it.
column2: 好吧，谢谢. 我们已经明白了.

column1: Large Military Building
column2: 大型军用建筑

column1: Escort the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} mechs back to the base.
column2: 护送{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲返回基地.

column1: Darius is pretending he has useful advice to offer.
column2: 达里乌斯正在假装自己有什么有用的建议可提。

column1: This facility is close to where the rumors of massive tanks seem to originate. It's probably the best place to start your search.
column2: 这处设施离那些关于巨型坦克的传言似乎发源的地方很近。那里大概是你开始搜寻的最佳地点。

column1: All target buildings must survive
column2: 所有目标建筑必须存活

column1: Cover the friendly lance.
column2: 掩护友军小队.

column1: Defend Occupied Base
column2: 保卫已占领基地

column1: Defend Target Buildings
column2: 保卫目标建筑

column1: Destroy the Enemy Vanguard
column2: 摧毁敌方先锋

column1: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
column2: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

column1: Commander, one of our lances was hit on the way to the facility and has suffered 50% losses.
column2: 指挥官，我方一支小队在前往设施的途中遭到袭击，已损失过半.

column1: Commander, we lost a building!
column2: 指挥官，我们损失了一栋建筑!

column1: The base is secure. Hopefully {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} can hold it themselves, now.
column2: 基地安全了. 希望{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}人能够靠他们自己坚守下来，至少现在.

column1: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
column2: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

column1: Welcome Commander.  About 100 clicks east of here is where some civvies reported unusual activity.
column2: 欢迎，指挥官。往东约100公里处，有平民报告了异常活动。

column1: Large Military Building II
column2: 大型军事建筑 II

column1: Commander, there is nothing glamorous about sighting targets for big guns, but the fireworks can be exciting. Just make sure you're clear of the blast radius before those shells land.
column2: 指挥官，为大口径火炮观测目标不是什么光鲜的活，但那场面确实够刺激。只要确保炮弹落地之前你已经离开爆炸半径就行。

column1: We traced the origin of the Soarece tanks to this location. We're not sure if it's a cache or a functioning automated factory. Either way, it needs to go. Place beacons for our Artillery to target, and exfiltrate while our guns destroy the base.
column2: 我们追踪索阿雷斯坦克的来源到了这里。我们不确定这是一处储藏库还是一座在运转的自动化工厂。不管是哪种，它都得消失。为我方炮兵放置信标，在我方火炮摧毁基地时撤离。

column1: Await Dropship Arrival
column2: 等待空投舰抵达

column1: Destroy Enemy Garrison
column2: 摧毁敌方守军

column1: Destroy Enemy Special Reinforcements
column2: 消灭敌方的特别援军

column1: Get Visual Confirmation of Artillery Effect
column2: 获取火炮打击效果的目视确认

column1: All units, close distance on enemy forces. Send a short wave burst near them to disrupt enemy Artillery from locking on! Move quickly!
column2: 所有单位注意，缩短与敌军的距离. 在他们附近发起一次短促突击，扰乱敌方大炮的锁定! 快点!

column1: Artillery does not discriminate about what it destroys. Be sure to clear the area once the firing starts.
column2: 炮击可不长眼睛. 开火后务必确保撤离出该区域.

column1: Enemy units can disrupt the targeting of the beacons. They will deploy forces with the intent to disrupt our beacons. Do not let enemies get near them.
column2: 敌方单位能中断信标的指示. 他们会派遣部队试图破坏我们的信标. 不要让敌人接近信标.

column1: Fire Control this is Observer Actual: Confirmed. Shot, out.
column2: 火控，这里是观察员: 确认——射击完毕.

column1: I am putting a stop to this, no way we pull this out of the fire. Abort Mission.
column2: 我正在叫停这个任务，我们没办法解决这个麻烦了. 放弃任务.

column1: Keep the pressure on to prevent them a chance to place those beacons!
column2: 继续压制，别给他们安放那些信标的机会!

column1: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Shot Over. Splash in 30
column2: 观察员，请注意，这里是火控: 发射完毕. 30秒后弹着.

column1: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Firing for Effect. HE 5 rounds. Danger Close.
column2: 观察员，这里是火控: 目标锁定，实施火力压制——发射高爆5发，危险临近！

column1: We are tasked with marking an area for artillery strike.
column2: 我们的任务是标定一块区域进行炮击.

column1: You need to place beacons to designate the attack position. This will take some time to do, so keep the unit placing the beacon nearby.
column2: 你需要放置信标指示攻击位置. 这需要一些时间，所以让安放信标的单位留在附近.

column1: Limited Gladiator
column2: 限定角斗士

column1: A local mercenary is trying to make it big. He thinks by calling you out he can gain fame and fortune.
column2: 一名本地佣兵想出头。他以为向你叫板就能名利双收。

column1: Destroy Enemy Units
column2: 摧毁敌方单位

column1: Game Over. Good shooting.
column2: 游戏结束。射得好。

column1: That's it, game over.
column2: 就这样，游戏结束。

column1: That's the round start signal! Good Luck!
column2: 这是本回合开始的信号！祝好运！

column1: S From Vulcan
column2: 来自火神的 S

column1: Your challenger has a reputation for dishonest tactics. Watch yourself out there, Commander.
column2: 你的挑战者以手段不光彩而闻名。在外面多留神，指挥官。

column1: You have been invited to a Divisional Round in the 'Gladiator Challange League'. Your opponent is expecting you.
column2: 你受邀参加“角斗士挑战联赛”的分区轮次。你的对手正等着你。

column1: Divisional Champion
column2: 分区冠军

column1: Kill The Divisional Challenger
column2: 击杀分区挑战者

column1: It is time to test your skills mercenary scum!
column2: 是时候检验你的技艺了，雇佣兵渣滓！

column1: Guess he is pissed.
column2: 看来他气坏了。

column1: The bar for an 'honest' fight in these parts is set so low it's usually underground. Be cautious, Commander.
column2: 在这一带，"诚实"对决的门槛低到通常在地下。谨慎点，指挥官。

column1: You have been invited to the Gladiator Challenge Divisionals. The opponent should be ready for you. Now, we want an honest fight from you with nothing below the belt. Eyes front and claws out.
column2: 你已被邀请参加角斗士挑战赛分区赛。对手应该已经准备好迎战你了。现在，我们希望你打一场干净的对决，不打阴招。目视前方，利爪亮出。

column1: Kill the Divisional Challenger
column2: 击杀分区挑战者

column1: Local Merc With a chip
column2: 带着怨气的本地佣兵

column1: I can't help it if my fans are ravenous for action. I can't help that I am beautiful.
column2: 我的粉丝对动作如饥似渴，我没办法。我天生丽质，我也没办法。

column1: Is he for real?
column2: 他是认真的吗？

column1: Expect some of the Mercs to be less than honest.
column2: 预料部分佣兵不会那么诚实。

column1: You have been invited to a Divisional Round in the 'Gladiator Challenge'. The opponent should be ready for you.
column2: 你已被邀请参加"角斗士挑战"的分区轮。对手应该已做好准备。

column1: I can't help it if my fans are ravinous for some action. I can't help I am beautiful.
column2: 我的粉丝们渴望看到动作我又有什么办法。我天生丽质我也没办法。

column1: I can't help it if my fans are ravenous for some action. I can't help I am beautiful.
column2: 我的粉丝渴望看点火爆的，这怪不得我。我天生丽质，也怪不得我。

column1: I wouldn't buy the stuff about an honest fight, Commander. Some of these fights are known for audience participation.
column2: 我不太相信那套关于公平对决的说法，指挥官。有些比赛以观众参与而闻名。

column1: You have been invited to the Gladiator Challenge Divisionals. We want a good, honest asskicking from you and no shots below the belt. Your opponent awaits your challenge.
column2: 你已被邀请参加角斗士挑战赛分区赛。我们希望你打一场干净利落、堂堂正正的痛击，不打阴招。你的对手等着你的挑战。

column1: Welcome to the arena, Mercenary! Today, we test our skills.
column2: 欢迎来到竞技场，雇佣兵！今天，我们来检验彼此的本事。

column1: It is time to test your skills Mercenary!
column2: 是时候检验你的本领了，佣兵！

column1: Being in the limelight is great, but prepare for the worst.
column2: 身处聚光灯下很棒，但要做好最坏的准备。

column1: This is an invitation to the Gladiatory Divisionals. You and another fighter in steel-crunching, skull-cracking live broadcast action. Are you in or are you in?
column2: 这是角斗分区赛的邀请。你与另一名战士在碾碎钢铁、击碎颅骨的实况直播中对抗。你来不来，还是来不来？

column1: Local merc with a chip
column2: 带着怨气的本地佣兵

column1: I can't help it if my fans admire me so much and want to partake. This isn't a feeling you're familiar with is it?
column2: 我的粉丝这么仰慕我、想沾点光，我也没办法。这种感觉你不熟悉吧，是不是？

column1: Bring enough ammo to deal with stragglers. These things get messy.
column2: 带够弹药来对付掉队者。这些事会很乱。

column1: Commander, a pleasure. Does the idea of getting into a closed ring of DANGER to face down a RABID enemy Mechwarrior appeal to you? Okay, what if we paid well?
column2: 指挥官，很高兴见到你。想不想到一个封闭的"危险"擂台上，去正面迎战一名狂怒的敌方机师？好吧，如果我们付得很好呢？

column1: I'll mark a possible ambush location just in case.
column2: 以防万一，我会标出一处可能的伏击位置。

column1: The fine print on the contract doesn't specify anything about a fair fight. Just saying.
column2: 合约的小字部分可没规定什么公平对决。我就随口一说。

column1: You are cordially invited to partake in COCKPIT-VENTING, MECH-CRUSHING, FACE-BREAKING gladiatorial combat action. Should you be victorious, you can expect a handsome payout and a variety of salvage perks. And of course, the coveted love from millions of our fans.
column2: 诚邀你参加座舱弹射、机甲碾压、面部粉碎的角斗战斗。若你获胜，可期待一笔可观的报酬和各式打捞福利。当然，还有数百万粉丝的渴慕之爱。

column1: I see you didn't register to deploy a whole lance and came alone instead. A common mistake.
column2: 我看你没有登记部署一整支分队，而是独自来了。常见的错误。

column2: 限定角斗士队伍

column1: ATTN ANDREW
column2: 注意 安德鲁

column1: Looks like a 3 team brawl commander, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 看来是一场三队近战，指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName}。

column1: Welcome to Team Gladiator Combat, Mechwarrior. Duncan Fisher here where we are more interested in new sponsorship than a Mechwarrior's life. Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
column2: 欢迎来到团队角斗士对战，机甲战士。我是邓肯·费雪，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机甲战士的性命。说到这个，本场比赛的赞助方是——没有人……因为赞助商都太怕我那出了名的"解说一句倒一家公司"的本事。

column1: Eliminate The Gladiator Team
column2: 消灭角斗士队伍

column1: Eliminate The Gladiator
column2: 消灭角斗士

column2: 确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队安全撤离
