column2: 确保 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队安全撤离

column1: Survive The Tournament
column2: 在锦标赛中存活

column1: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdrawal, Commander.
column2: 我们所有目标都已完成，掩护我们撤退，指挥官。

column1: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
column2: 精彩，我就知道指挥官有这个本事！

column1: Copy that lance Leader, welcome to the party.
column2: 收到，小队队长，欢迎加入。

column1: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
column2: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

column1: Heads up Commander, it's a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
column2: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

column1: Heads up Commander, it's a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
column2: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

column1: Heads up, Commander. I see Drop Pods inbound.
column2: 注意，指挥官。我看到空投舱来袭。

column1: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
column2: 嘿，邓肯！今天能与你共事真是荣幸。

column1: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
column2: 我还请来了一位客座解说，他自称是超级粉丝。各位，欢迎达里乌斯。

column1: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
column2: 我是说四换一的交易！谁能拒绝这个？！？

column1: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.
column2: 但愿他们的准头比长相好。

column1: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
column2: 看来其他佣兵也加入了战斗！

column1: Our employer has kindly added destroying this group to our objectives. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
column2: 雇主好心地把这群敌人的消灭也加进了我们的目标。想拿到报酬，我们就得干掉他们。

column1: Our employer has offered a bonus if we eliminate this group as well.
column2: 雇主承诺如果我们一并消灭这帮人，会有额外奖励。

column1: Stepping in the drop area may be good for polls, but it wont be good for your 'Mech repair costs.
column2: 站到投放区里也许对民调有好处，但对你的机甲修理费用可没好处。

column1: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
column2: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

column1: This fight just got tighter than two hairs in a manbun!
column2: 这场战斗的气氛紧得像发髻里的两根头发！

column1: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
column2: 说这场战斗刚变得动真格的，都是轻描淡写！

column1: Understood Lance Leader, glad to have you with us.
column2: 明白，小队队长，很高兴你加入我们。

column1: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
column2: 等等，你说过我们没有被录音的！

column1: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
column2: 等等……达里乌斯，这是你安排的吗？

column1: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
column2: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

column1: What a day for a classic Brawl!
\n Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
\n I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
column2: 多么适合经典近战的一天！

column1: \n 我们的选手清楚自己的价值，这正是他们今天到场的原因。
\n 我听说其中一位角斗士被许诺了一份麦片盒代言，所以他才露面。
column2: LocalizationRecovered

column1: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
column2: 哇，你看看这个。看来今天的赔率制定者大错特错了。

column1: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
column2: 哇。这是我今天见过的最精彩的战斗！

column1: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
column2: 你之前可没这么自信。解说席上的一些音频已经传疯了。

column1: Amazing tactics there, kid. Except... not really!
column2: 战术真精彩啊，小子。只不过……其实并不！

column1: Copy that Lance Leader, welcome to the party.
column2: 收到，小队队长，欢迎加入。

column1: Maybe you should try again later. Much, much later!
column2: 也许你该晚点再来。晚很多很多！

column1: Welcome to Team Gladiator Combat, Mechwarrior. Duncan Fisher here where we are more interested in new sponsorship than a Mechwarriors life. Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
column2: 欢迎来到团队角斗战斗，机师。我是邓肯·费舍尔，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机师的性命。说到这个，这场比赛由"没有人"赞助……因为赞助商都太害怕我那能把公司拖垮的传奇解说能力。

column1: \n I hear that one of Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
column2: 今天可真是打一场经典乱斗的好日子！\n我们的参赛者清楚自己的价值，这正是他们今天到场的原因。\n我听说有位角斗士收到了一份麦片盒代言合约，这就是他露面的理由。

column1: Welcome to Team Gladiator Combat, Mechwarrior. Duncan Fisher here where we are more interested in new sponsorship than a Mechwarrior's life. Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... 'cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
column2: 欢迎来到团队角斗士对战，机甲战士。我是邓肯·费雪，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机甲战士的性命。说到这个，本场比赛的赞助方是——没有人……因为赞助商都太怕我那出了名的"解说一句倒一家公司"的本事。

column1: Limited Light Engagement
column2: 限定轻型交战

column1: I don't have to tell you that speed is of the essence here.
column2: 不用我多说，你也知道速度在这里至关重要。

column1: Good day, Commander. Mission intelligence is as follows: conditions on the ground do not allow for dropping 'Mechs of heavy tonnage, or particularly large numbers of them. You're being tasked with deploying a fast strike force into a hostile zone. Bring the best you can squeeze into a small package.
column2: 日安，指挥官。任务情报如下：地面条件不允许投放重型吨位的机甲，也不允许投放特别多的数量。你的任务是把一支快速打击部队投放进一处敌意区域。在有限载荷内塞进你所能带的最好的东西。

column1: Ensure Secondary Asset Recovery unit survives
column2: 确保次要资产回收单位存活

column1: Recover the VIP's assistant by securing the Secondary Designated Area
column2: 占领次要指定区域以接回要人的助手

column1: Retrieve the Clan Technology and escape
column2: 取回氏族技术并撤离

column1: Unit Carrying the Tech Must Survive
column2: 装有技术设备的单位必须存活

column1: Best of luck, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

column1: Commander, the target location is likely to be well defended.
column2: 指挥官，目标地点很可能防守严密。

column1: Hold this location until our people can grab the asset.
column2: 坚守该位置直到我们的人拿到资产.

column1: We need to move up, get eyes on the location, and neutralize any enemy forces.
column2: 我们需要行动起来看看那个地方，然后消灭任何敌方部队.

column1: You cheated me. Now I am going to prevent you from cheating anyone else.
column2: 你骗了我。现在我要阻止你再去骗别人。

column1: We don’t have to tell you speed is of the essence here.
column2: 不用我们多说，你也知道速度在这里至关重要。

column1: We need you to get in get and out fast.
column2: 我们需要你进去再快速出来。

column1: We don't have to tell you speed is of the essence here.
column2: 不用我们多说，你也知道速度在这里至关重要。

column1: We need you to get in and get out fast.
column2: 我们需要你快速进出。

column1: Limited Medium Engagement
column2: 限定中型交战

column1: Foreign forces have established a forward base on our territory. We need you to go in and destroy their invasion capabilities.
column2: 外军已在我们领土上建立前进基地。我们需要你突入并摧毁他们的入侵能力。

column1: Base Destruction.
column2: 基地摧毁。

column1: Destroy the Forward Base
column2: 摧毁前进基地

column1: Destroy the Occupational Force
column2: 消灭占领军

column1: Eliminate the Hostiles
column2: 消灭敌方目标

column1: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good work.
column2: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

column1: Picking up enemy reinforcements.
column2: 侦测到敌方增援.

column1: The forward base is just up ahead, Commander.
column2: 前进基地就在前面，指挥官。

column1: The OpFor was a lot stronger than predicted, let me get you out of there.
column2: 敌方兵力远超预期，我这就把你们撤出来.

column1: Turrets have been spotted.
column2: 已发现炮台.

column1: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
column2: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

column1: The Long Hunt
column2: 漫长的狩猎

column1: Destroy Colonel Lees's stronghold
column2: 摧毁李斯上校的据点

column1: You heard what Lees did on Shaul Khala. The galaxy will be a better place without a man like him in it.
column2: 你已听闻利斯在绍尔哈拉的暴行. 这个星系少了他这样的恶徒只会更加安宁.

column1: My agents have traced Colonel Basil Lees to a stronghold in the basin ahead. I want you to raze it to the ground, and destroy anything that attempts to protect it. Show this Davion animal what the Draconis Combine does to those who would slaughter its people.
column2: 我的特工已经追踪到巴泽尔·利斯上校在前方盆地的一处据点. 我希望你将其夷为平地，摧毁一切试图保护它的东西. 向这头戴维恩猪展示，天龙联合体会对那些屠杀其人民的人做什么.

column1: Destroy Colonel Lees's Stronghold
column2: 摧毁李斯上校的据点

column1: Eliminate the Davion Garrison
column2: 消灭戴维恩驻军

column1: I raise my glass to you and your lance, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Bring that son of a bitch to justice.
column2: 我举杯向你和你的小队致敬，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 将那个混蛋绳之以法.

column1: I will, but to listen only. I have nothing to say to that murderous swine.
column2: 我会的，但只是听而已. 我对那个杀人恶徒无话可说.

column1: Quitting the field, eh? Go on and run, then. Run back to your Kurita masters like the lickspittle coward you are.
column2: 你已经放弃了吗?然后迅速跑回到你的栗田大师那里 - 就像你是舔唾液的懦夫.

column1: Sorry to butt in, but we just received a message from Colonel Lees. I hate to say it, but it looks authentic.
column2: 抱歉打断你们，但我们刚收到一条来自利斯上校的消息. 我讨厌这么说，但看来是真的.

column1: The base is down, Commander. Good work.
column2: 基地完了，指挥官. 干得好.

column1: The disused stronghold that Colonel Lees and his band of war criminals have holed up in should be just ahead of you, Commander.
column2: 利斯上校及其一群战争罪犯占据的废弃据点应该就在你前方，指挥官.

column1: Watch yourself, Boss. It looks like Lees just called in the cavalry.
column2: 小心，老板. 看起来像利斯刚才召唤的骑兵.

column1: The Long Hunt II
column2: 漫长的狩猎 II

column1: This is our best shot at finding a way out of here, Commander. Let's get it done.
column2: 这是我们找到离开这里办法的最佳机会，指挥官。把它办成。

column1: The sensor array that you'll need to capture to escape this system is further ahead, but there are Davion 'Mechs between you and the facility. Kill them before they kill you.
column2: 你需要夺取以逃离该星系的传感器阵列还在更前方，但你与那处设施之间有达维昂机甲。在他们杀了你之前先杀了他们。

column1: Eliminate the Davion Hostiles
column2: 消灭敌方戴维恩单位

column1: I'm picking up a lot of enemy movement on my sensors, Commander. We may not be hunting Colonel Lees anymore, but it doesn't look like he's given up on hunting us.
column2: 我在传感器上读到大量敌方动向，指挥官。我们也许不再猎杀利斯上校了，但看起来他并没有放弃猎杀我们。

column1: The Long Hunt III
column2: 漫长的狩猎 III

column1: This has been a hell of a slog, but we're almost through it. Keep moving, Commander. Get our people home.
column2: 这一路真是苦战，但我们快熬过去了。继续前进，指挥官。带我们的人回家。

column1: The Davion sensor array you'll need to capture is just ahead, Commander. Take it, and Ms. Meyer will have what she needs to neutralize Lees's threat to the Argo.
column2: 指挥官，你需要夺取的Davion传感器阵列就在前方。拿下它，Meyer女士就能得到她所需要的东西，用以解除Lees对Argo的威胁。

column1: Capture the Sensor Array
column2: 占领传感器阵列

column1: Occupy the Sensor Array
column2: 占领感应塔

column1: Pacify the Array Grounds
column2: 平定传感器阵列周围的区域

column1: Reconnoiter the Sensor Array
column2: 侦察传感器阵列

column1: You're running, eh? Fleeing like a craven? Let me guess: you want to use the array to expedite your escape.
column2: 你在跑，是吧？像懦夫一样逃？让我猜猜：你想用阵列来加速逃跑。

column1: This is a bit of a Catch-22 situation, Commander… we can't afford to leave these jokers standing, but I'll bet you anything that Lees sent them here to soften us up before our attack on the base.
column2: 这有点进退两难，指挥官……我们承受不起让这些活宝活着，但我敢跟你打赌，利斯派他们来这里是为了在我们攻打基地之前削弱我们。

column1: My people on the ground have picked up a lance of Davion BattleMechs on their sensors, Commander. If you move on Lees without dealing with them, they'll be in position to outflank you.
column2: 我在地面的人员在传感器上发现一支达维昂战斗机甲分队，指挥官。如果你不先解决他们就向利斯推进，他们就会处于包抄你的位置。

column1: A performance as pathetic as it was disappointing. Bask in your shame, Reynauld! Your attempt on my life has failed.
column2: 一场既可悲又令人失望的表演. 沉浸在你的耻辱中吧，雷纳德！你对我的刺杀失败了.

column1: Acknowledged, Colonel Lees. It will be our pleasure.
column2: 收到，利斯上校. 这将是我们的荣幸.

column1: Ah, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. You've accepted my challenge, then? Good. It would have been terribly anticlimactic if you'd fled.
column2: 啊，{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官。那么你接受了我的挑战？很好。如果你逃了，那可就太虎头蛇尾了。

column1: My mercenaries will punish you for the butchery you committed on Shaul Khala, Lees. You will die in disgrace.
column2: 我的雇佣兵将严惩你在绍尔哈拉犯下的暴行，利斯. 你终将耻辱地死去.

column1: You're running, eh? Fleeing like a craven? Let me guess: you want to use the array's computers to expedite your escape.
column2: 你在跑，是吧？像懦夫一样逃？让我猜猜：你想用阵列的计算机来加速逃跑。

column1: The Long Hunt IV
column2: 漫长的狩猎 IV

column1: Apprehend Colonel Basil Lees
column2: 俘获巴泽尔·利斯上校

column1: We've got Lees backed into a corner. Time to finish the job.
column2: 我们已把里斯逼到角落。是时候了结这桩事了。

column1: Colonel Lees's stronghold is just ahead of you, Commander. For all his arrogant bluster, it would seem that the Butcher of Shaul Khala is a coward at heart. I've seen no sign that he intends to meet you on the field of battle. So be it; if he won't leave his fortress voluntarily, then I will have your BattleMechs remove him by force.
column2: 指挥官，利斯上校的据点就在你前方。尽管他吹得狂妄，绍尔哈拉的屠夫骨子里似乎是个懦夫。我没看到任何他打算在战场上与你会面的迹象。那就这样吧；既然他不肯主动离开堡垒，我就让你的战斗机甲把他强行搬走。

column1: Pull Colonel Lees from His Hiding Place
column2: 把利斯上校从藏身之处拖出来

column1: I welcome your mercenaries to try, drunkard. They will find themselves quite outmatched.
column2: 我欢迎你的雇佣兵来试试，你这个酒鬼. 他们会发现自己完全不是对手.

column1: Justice? You call this justice?! Those Kuritan dogs will have me executed without trial!
column2: 正义?你这叫正义?！这些栗田混蛋会不经审判就处决我！

column1: This is it, Commander. My agents tell me that the Butcher of Shaul Khala is sheltering in a disused tower just ahead of you. Apparently, he'd rather hide in his command center than face you directly.
column2: 就是这里，指挥官。我的特工告诉我，绍尔哈拉的屠夫就藏在你正前方一座废弃塔楼里。看来他宁愿躲在自己的指挥中心里，也不愿直接面对你。

column1: Joint Venture
column2: 合资企业

column1: Escort the Steiner Convoy to its Destination
column2: 护送施泰纳车队前往目的地

column1: House Steiner isn't even supposed to have a presence in this system, so be careful. When the Capellans pick you up on their sensors, I imagine that all hell is gonna break loose.
column2: 斯坦纳家族本不该在这个星系有任何存在，所以小心。当卡佩兰人在传感器上发现你时，我想一切都会乱了套。

column1: We have eyes on Sentry Team Alpha, Commander—they're patrolling the AO, just as I said they would be. Expect moderate-to-heavy resistance on the path to your objective. As a reminder, it is absolutely vital that this convoy reach its destination. Do not disappoint me.
column2: 我们盯上哨兵小队阿尔法了，指挥官——他们正在巡逻行动区域，正如我所料。通往目标的路途上预期会遇到中到重度抵抗。提醒一下，这支车队抵达目的地绝对至关重要。别让我失望。

column1: Eliminate Sentry Team Alpha
column2: 消灭“哨兵Alpha”

column1: Ensure That All Steiner Units Survive
column2: 确保所有施泰纳单位存活

column1: Escort the Steiner Convoy to Its Destination
column2: 护送施泰纳车队前往目的地

column1: All Capellan troops, destroy that convoy! Your families will be held accountable if you fail!
column2: 所有卡佩拉军队: 摧毁这支车队！如果你们失败了，你们的家人会为此付出代价！

column1: I've marked Graf Stieglitz-Bradford's rendezvous point on your map, Commander. Convoy leader, do you copy?
column2: 我已在地图上标出施蒂格利茨-布拉德福德伯爵的会合点，指挥官。车队领队，收到了吗？

column1: Joint Venture II
column2: 合资企业 II

column1: Defend Targetted Base Structures from Attackers
column2: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

column1: Hidden Objetive: Destroy the Second Lance
column2: 隐藏任务: 消灭第二支小队

column1: This new Steiner-Davion BattleMech looks pretty damned impressive for its class. Let's hope it's enough to get us through this.
column2: 这台新的施泰纳-达维昂战斗机甲在其级别里相当惊艳。但愿它足以让我们撑过去。

column1: House Liao's occupation force is moving on our Mech Bay in force, Commander. I know that you've had no time to refit or repair your BattleMechs, but I'm going to need your assistance all the same. In light of this, I've authorized the deployment of a Steiner asset—the very rare and precious BattleMech that you just delivered to this site—to assist you, with one of my own MechWarriors to pilot it.
column2: 指挥官，廖氏家族的占领军正大举逼近我们的机甲库。我知道你还没来得及改装或修理你的战斗机甲，但我还是需要你的协助。鉴于此，我已授权部署一件施泰纳资产——你刚送到这里的、极为稀有珍贵的战斗机甲——来协助你，并由我的一名机甲战士驾驶。

column1: Defend All Target Buildings from Destruction
column2: 保护所有目标建筑免遭摧毁

column1: Defend the Fortified Mech Bay
column2: 保卫加固的机甲库

column1: Destroy the Liao Vanguard
column2: 消灭廖氏的先锋

column1: Escort the Engineer APCs to the Inactive Base Defenses
column2: 与技术人员一起护送 MTW 前往停用的基础防御

column1: Commander. I'm afraid that Dr. Murad's sensor readings have been confirmed: a large contingent of Liao Reserves are en route to the Mech Bay at this moment, and they are eager to strike.
column2: 指挥官。恐怕穆拉德博士的传感器读数已经得到证实：大批廖氏预备部队此刻正前往机甲库，他们急切地想要发起攻击。

column1: NOT USED IN THIS FLASHPOINT.
column2: 本闪点中未使用。

column1: Like the man said, we're going into this one blind, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. House Steiner isn't even supposed to have a presence in this system, so whatever we're about to walk into, we're doing it alone.
column2: 就像那人说的，我们这次是盲着进去，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。施泰纳家族本不该在这个星系有任何存在，所以不管我们即将撞上什么，都得独自应对。

column1: We have little to no intel on what you're going to find out there, Commander. Keep your eyes open; it's absolutely vital that this convoy reach its destination.
column2: 我们对你将在外面遇到什么几乎一无所知，指挥官。睁大眼睛；这支车队抵达目的地绝对至关重要。

column1: Eliminate the Liao Resistance
column2: 消灭廖氏抵抗力量

column1: The Baying of Hounds
column2: 猎犬的狂吠

column1: Remember, Viribium is an airless planet. Watch your heat levels out there.
column2: 别忘了，维里比姆是一颗没有大气层的行星. 注意机甲的热量.

column1: The Beasts of Balawat have units scattered all across this basin. More importantly, they've got a monster LRM boat that needs to go down before we can even try to move the convoy to a landing site. It's an assault 'Mech, Stalker-class, heavily modified for indirect fire. Destroy it and proceed to the rendezvous site.
column2: 巴拉瓦特野兽队在这一盆地里散布着各单位。更重要的是，他们有一艘怪物级LRM艇，必须在我们可以试着把车队移向着陆点之前先干掉。那是一台突击机甲，潜行者级，为间接火力大幅改装。摧毁它，然后前往会合点。

column1: Destroy the Beasts of Balawat Units
column2: 摧毁“巴拉瓦特野兽”的单位

column1: Destroy the Beasts of Balawat's Modified Stalker
column2: 摧毁巴拉瓦特野兽队的改装潜行者

column1: Destroy the LRM Stalker Before It Escapes
column2: 在 LRM 潜行者逃脱之前摧毁他

column1: Destroy the Modified Stalker
column2: 摧毁改装的潜行者

column1: Eliminate the Beasts of Balawat Reinforcements
column2: 消灭“巴拉瓦特野兽”的增援部队

column1: It looks like my faith in your company was misplaced, {COMMANDER.LastName}. Pick up the pieces of your lance and fall back to a safe distance. My Kell Hounds and I will handle this situation on our own.
column2: 看来我对你们公司的信任是错付了，{COMMANDER.LastName}. 收拾好你们小队的残局，撤退到安全距离. 我和我的凯尔猎犬会自行处理这个局面.

column1: The Beasts of Balawat's modified Stalker should be somewhere in this area of operation, Commander.
column2: 巴拉瓦特的野兽那台改装潜行者应该就在这一行动区域的某处，指挥官。

column1: The Baying of Hounds II
column2: 猎犬的狂吠 II

column1: Rendezvous with Tempest's Convoy and escort it to the Evac Point
column2: 与暴风雨的车队会合并护送其前往撤离点

column1: In theory, we've already done the heavy lifting on this one, but keep your eyes open. We still don't know why the Beasts of Balawat are chasing Kell's people.
column2: 理论上，我们在这件事上已经干完了重活，但睁大眼睛。我们仍不知道巴拉瓦特野兽队为什么追凯尔的人。

column1: With the LRM Stalker down, you should be clear to rendezvous with Tempest's convoy. Escort the vehicles to the pickup point, and get them there in one piece. All other considerations are secondary.
column2: 随着LRM潜行者被击倒，你应当可以安全地与暴风的车队会合了。护送车辆抵达接应点，并确保它们完好无损地到达。其余一切考虑都是次要的。

column1: Destroy the Beasts of Balawat Reinforcements
column2: 消灭“巴拉瓦特野兽”的增援部队

column1: Eliminate the Beasts of Balawat Units
column2: 消灭“巴拉瓦特野兽”的单位

column1: Ensure That All Convoy Units Survive
column2: 确保车队所有单位存活

column1: Escort the Convoy to the Extraction Point
column2: 护送车队前往撤离区

column1: Protect the Convoy during DropShip Extraction
column2: 保护车队，直到空投艇安全

column1: Rendezvous with Tempest's Convoy and Escort It to the Evac Point
column2: 与暴风雨的车队会合并护送其前往撤离点

column1: The convoy is holed up near this location, Commander. They're surrounded by BattleMechs flying the colors of the Beasts of Balawat; you may have taken out their fire support, but they're still in the fight.
column2: 车队窝藏在这个位置附近，指挥官。他们被涂着巴拉瓦特野兽队配色的战斗机甲包围着；你也许打掉了他们的火力支援，但他们仍在战斗。

column1: The Baying of Hounds III
column2: 猎犬的狂吠 III

column1: If Kell is saying that this will be tough, I'm inclined to believe him. Get your war face on, Commander. This is gonna be a hell of a drop.
column2: 如果凯尔说这会很难，我倾向于相信他。摆出你的战斗表情，指挥官。这一投可够狠的。

column1: This will be a difficult fight, Commander. The Beasts of Balawat are former Kell Hounds; they've received some of the best training and equipment you'll find anywhere. But more than that, they've got something to prove.
column2: 这一仗会很艰难，指挥官。巴拉瓦特野兽队是前凯尔猎犬；他们受过你所能找到的最好的训练、拥有最好的装备。但更重要的是，他们有东西要证明。

column1: Destroy the Beasts of Balawat
column2: 消灭“巴拉瓦特野兽”

column1: Morgan. You're here. After all these years, you can't imagine how gratifying it is to see you on the other end of a battlefield.
column2: 摩根。你来了。这么多年之后，你无法想象在战场另一端见到你有多令人欣慰。

column1: You promised to release Tempest and Megan. I expect you to keep your word.
column2: 你承诺过会释放坦佩斯特和梅根. 我希望你能遵守诺言.

column1: This is going to be risky, but it seems like the only way to be certain that Kell's people make it home safe.
column2: 这会有风险，但看起来这是唯一能确保凯尔的人安全回家的办法。

column1: The Beasts of Balawat's armory is just ahead of you, Commander. Strike swiftly, take the facility, and hold it until Megan and Tempest can be extracted. The Kell Hounds and I will handle Rhee and her people. Let's do this.
column2: 巴拉瓦特野兽队的军械库就在你前方，指挥官。迅速出击，拿下设施，并守住它，直到梅根和暴风能被撤离出来。凯尔猎犬和我来处理李和她的人。动手吧。

column1: Capture the Beasts of Balawat's Armory
column2: 夺取巴拉瓦特野兽队的军械库

column1: Destroy the Beasts of Balawat Forces
column2: 消灭“巴拉瓦特野兽”的部队

column1: Destroy the Hostile Reinforcements
column2: 消灭敌人的增援部队

column1: Occupy the Armory
column2: 占领军械库

column1: Pacify the Area Surrounding the Armory
column2: 平定军械库周围的区域

column1: Damn it. We bit off more than we could chew, {COMMANDER.LastName}. This is my failure as much as it is yours.
column2: 该死的. 我们胃口太大，吞不下了，{COMMANDER.LastName}. 这次失败，我跟你一样有责任.

column1: DropShip inbound, Commander. Watch your heads.
column2: 空投艇正在进场，指挥官. 注意头顶.

column1: Okay, {COMMANDER.Callsign}. I've got an assault lance on the ground keeping Rhee and her Beasts occupied. They won't be expecting a backdoor attack on their armory.
column2: 好，{COMMANDER.Callsign}。我已派出一支突击分队在地面缠住李和她的野兽们。他们不会料到有人从后门打他们的军械库。

column1: Let's keep our eyes open for any surprises, Commander.
column2: 睁大眼睛留意任何意外，指挥官。

column1: There she is - up in that base. I want my 'Mech back. Bring it in, and we'll clear the area of these traitors. I'm sure you understand the need for vengeance when your name is on the line and they've stolen your fighting machines.
column2: 她就在那儿——在那座基地里。我要拿回我的机甲。把它带出来，我们就替这片区域清掉这些叛徒。我相信你能理解，当你的名字被挂在上面、而他们偷走了你的战斗机甲时，复仇是多么必要。

column1: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next objective.
column2: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

column1: Over there! The facility is just up ahead.
column2: 在那边！设施就在前方。

column1: This is odd. Pirates fighting pirates. Wait, now that I think about it... it makes perfect sense.
column2: 这真奇怪。海盗打海盗。等等，仔细一想……这完全说得通。

column1: Commander, you've been referred to us for your reputation for discretion and efficiency. The job is as follows: we need you to help us break the Queen out of jail. Then extract her from the area safely.
column2: 指挥官，你因谨慎高效的声名被推荐给我们。任务如下：我们需要你帮我们把女王从监狱里弄出来。然后把她安全撤离该地区。

column1: Capture the Convoy Rally Point, Break LA out of Jail, Escort the Convoy to Safety, and Extract
column2: 占领车队集结点，将LA从监狱救出，护送车队至安全地带，然后撤离

column1: If ya move up, you can secure the area and we can bust our Queen out of jail!
column2: 如果你继续推进，就能控制该区域，我们就能把女王从监狱里捞出来！

column1: This should be extremely painful.
column2: 这应该会非常痛苦.

column1: Time for some payback. Since Sybil's unit isn't here. I am going to pound her men into the ground. Be a good minion and help me with this.
column2: 该算账了。既然西比尔的部队不在这里，我就要把她的人砸进地里。做个好手下，帮我一把。

column1: Destroy the Enemy Patrols
column2: 摧毁敌人 Patrols

column1: Destroy the First  Patrol
column2: 摧毁第一支巡逻队

column1: Destroy the Second  Patrol
column2: 摧毁第二支巡逻队

column1: They are around here somewhere, Lets run these traitors into the ground.
column2: 他们就在附近某处，让我们把这些叛徒追到地底下去。

column1: Time to bring the thunder.
column2: 是时候降下雷霆了。

column1: {COMMANDER.LastName}, We will be dropping in hot near a ComStar operations base. We will be disrupting their communications while the clan leaders gather.
column2: {COMMANDER.LastName}，我们将在通讯之星一处作战基地附近热投。趁部族首领们聚集时，我们将破坏他们的通讯。

column1: Capture the Communication Post
column2: 夺取通讯站

column1: Occupy the facility and destroy any forces you encounter. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 占领该设施，并摧毁你遇到的任何部队. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Hopefully we have bought the clan leaders enough time to gather.
column2: 但愿我们已经为部族首领们争取到足够时间聚集。

column1: ComStar Reinforcments have arrived. Let us meet them in the field.
column2: 康星的增援已抵达。让我们在战场上会会他们。

column1: Destroy the ComStar Patrols
column2: 摧毁康星巡逻队

column1: We are approaching the location.
column2: 我们正在接近该地点。

column1: Taking it directly to the head of the clan. Nothing like some honorable combat in the morning
column2: 直接把事摊到氏族首领面前。早上来点荣誉战斗再没有更好的了

column1: The Khan of the clan is up ahead. End his misery, Commander
column2: 这个氏族的可汗就在前方。结束他的痛苦吧，指挥官

column1: Destroy The Khan and Escape
column2: 摧毁可汗并撤离

column1: Commander, we're receiving a transmission from the Clan Forces.
column2: 指挥官，我们收到氏族部队的通讯。

column1: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commision. The employer will be pleased.
column2: 读数表明埋伏的单位没用了. 雇主会满意的.

column1: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field.
column2: 我很高兴他们对我们有信心，但说实话，我更希望在战场上有些增援。

column1: We have reached the destination: The bunker containing the genetic legacy of the Reaved Clan.
column2: 我们已抵达目的地：收容被洗劫氏族基因遗产的掩体。

column1: Commander, I've got inbound sensor contacts. Expect enemy reinforcements to drop in at any moment.
column2: 指挥官，我探测到入境接触。预计敌方增援随时会空降。

column1: Commander, this is it. When we destroy this facility, we will have reaved the genetic legacy of this clan.
column2: 指挥官，就是这里了。摧毁这座设施，我们就等于洗劫了这个氏族的基因遗产。

column1: Rescue Max Billings
column2: 营救马克斯·比林斯

column1: More spies. Makes me wonder how deep ComStar infiltration actually goes.
column2: 又是间谍。让我不禁想康星的渗透到底有多深。

column1: Commander, we have another agent trying to safely return to base. We need you to retrieve and deliver them to us. The agent's knowledge is crucial to providing us with strike coordinates.
column2: 指挥官，我们又有一名特工正试图安全返回基地。我们需要你去接应他们并把人交给我们。这名特工掌握的情报对提供打击坐标至关重要。

column1: Max has always been a reliable source. Presently, he has an archive of the targets these pirates have been hitting and their future goals.
column2: 马克斯一直是个可靠的来源。目前他手里有一份档案，记录着这些海盗袭击过的目标以及他们未来的意图。

column1: Revelations II
column2: 启示录 II

column1: Looks like more fighting overpowered pirates. Least I don't see the Queen's unit marked on the map.
column2: 看来又是打那些不堪一击的海盗。至少地图上没标出女王的部队。

column1: You will need to fight through to get to the base we talked about. They have it guarded pretty decently.
column2: 你得一路打过去才能抵达我们谈过的那座基地。他们守得相当严密。

column1: I'm picking up a lot of enemy movement on my sensors, Commander. They seem agitated that we rescued Max.
column2: 我的传感器探测到大量敌军动向，指挥官。他们似乎因为我们救出马克斯而躁动。

column1: Destroy Pirates' stronghold
column2: 摧毁海盗据点

column1: These pirates loot and pillage. No need to feel sorry for them, Commander.
column2: 这些海盗抢劫掠夺。无需为他们难过，指挥官。

column1: Pirate Base straight ahead, and beyond that their drop zone. Let's move up and send a message!
column2: 海盗基地就在正前方，再过去是他们的投放区。我们推进，发个信息过去！

column1: Destroy Pirates' Stronghold
column2: 摧毁海盗据点

column1: The Pirates forward base is just ahead of you, Commander.
column2: 海盗的前沿基地就在你前方，指挥官。

column1: This is dragging out. I hope we can keep up the supply lines
column2: 这拖得太久了。希望我们能维持住补给线

column1: Guess we will go in and capture the base. Should provide more information on what these Pirates are actually doing.
column2: 我想我们就进去夺取基地吧。应该能提供更多关于这些海盗到底在干什么的信息。

column1: Scout the forward base
column2: 侦察进阶基地

column1: Hey, leave my crap alone. I have had enough of you Mercs!
column2: 嘿，别碰我的东西。我受够你们这些雇佣兵了！

column1: The objective to scout the space port that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the space port.
column2: 侦察正被夺取的太空港的任务。必须在太空港实际被夺取之前完成。

column1: Taking down a Dropship on a full night's rest and fully repaired 'Mechs might be easier. Make sure to withdraw Commander, if you get stuck.
column2: 如果有一整晚休息和完好机甲，干掉空投艇也许更容易。指挥官，如果陷住了，务必撤退。

column1: I need you to take down the pirate Dropship before they can take off. This could be quite dangerous, but it may be our only hope of saving the Sphere.
column2: 我需要你在那艘海盗空投艇起飞之前把它拿下。这可能会相当危险，但这也许是我们拯救内天体的唯一希望。

column1: Hey!  You know how much that cost me?!? Yeah, you're right... I just stole it. But I will make you pay me for it if you break it.
column2: 嘿！你知道那花了我多少钱吗？！？对，你说得对……那是我刚偷的。但你要是弄坏了，我会让你赔。

column1: Let's flush out this guy and restore our rating.
column2: 让我们把这家伙揪出来，恢复我们的评级。

column1: The communications facility has not been alerted to our presence as we'd hoped, Commander. That means we will be able to land your team unnoticed and destroy the facility.
column2: 指挥官，通讯设施并未如我们所愿察觉到我们的存在。这意味着我们能让你的队伍在无人察觉的情况下着陆并摧毁该设施。

column1: Destroy the  Reinforcements
column2: 消灭援军

column1: Destroy the Facility and extract safely
column2: 摧毁设施并安全撤离

column1: Commander, the facility is just on the other side of that hill, straight ahead.
column2: 指挥官，设施就在那座山丘的另一侧，正前方。

column1: Return of the Steel Beast II
column2: 钢铁野兽归来 II

column1: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past us.
column2: 指挥官，我在这里看到的唯一真正危险，是他们设法让人溜过我们身边。

column1: Their command structure is fleeing, with an escorting lance... I wouldn't expect more than a single lance as an escort.
column2: 他们的指挥体系正在逃跑，带一支护航小队……我不指望护航超过一支小队。

column1: Return of the Steel Beast III
column2: 钢铁野兽归来 III

column1: I'm not questioning your judgement about bringing a single 'Mech against this guy. All I'm saying is I could lose a lot of money on the company betting pool if this goes South.
column2: 我不是在质疑你带一台机甲去对付这家伙的判断。我只是说，要是这事搞砸了，我在公司的赌盘上会输很多钱。

column1: The Steel Beast is back. And he's searching for revenge.
column2: 钢铁野兽回来了。而他正在寻找复仇。

column1: I am going to show the universe the Steel Beast is not to be messed with!
column2: 我要让全宇宙知道，钢铁野兽不是好惹的！

column1: Tubbs needs to go down hard, Commander. The only acceptable measure of victory is enemy tonnage destroyed.
column2: 塔布斯必须被彻底打倒，指挥官。唯一可接受的胜利标准是摧毁敌方吨位。

column1: Commander, Tubbs is down there. He has supporters - mostly gladiators with no love for you. Exercise caution, but remember your goal here: drop and eliminate.
column2: 指挥官，塔布斯就在下面。他有支持者——大多是看你不顺眼的角斗士。谨慎行事，但记住你在这里的目标：投放并消灭。

column1: Destroy the reinforcements
column2: 消灭援军

column1: Your name will be equated with defeat! I will drink from your skull, Commander.
column2: 你的名字将与失败划上等号！我要用你的头骨饮酒，指挥官。

column1: Return of the Steel Beast IV
column2: 钢铁野兽归来 IV

column1: Retrieve Tubbs and Extract Safely
column2: 接回塔布斯并安全撤离

column1: These 'debt collectors' have BattleMechs. Cheating only pays the enforcers, it looks like.
column2: 这些"讨债人"有战斗机甲。看来作弊只养肥了执法者。

column1: You won't like this, but Tubbs is signaling for a rescue. Talk about choosing beggars. He is currently up to his ass in debt, and our Solaris reps want him off planet alive. We are to pick him up and then turn him over to local authorities for processing.
column2: 你不会喜欢这个，但塔布斯正在发信号求救。真是会挑人。他目前深陷债务，而我们的索拉里斯代表要他活着离开这颗星球。我们要去接他，然后把他交给当地当局处置。

column1: We're picking up a tight-beam transmission coming from the secondary facility in the lagoon. It's Tubbs' distress signal.
column2: 我们收到来自潟湖中次级设施的一束窄波通讯。那是塔布斯的求救信号。

column1: This is going to get messy.
column2: 这会变得很乱。

column1: The Target has gone to ground, apparently a Stable has set up base for him here to retreat to. I say we blow it sky high and end our Tubb-y friend.
column2: 目标已转入地下，显然有一家马疚在此为他设了据点供他退守。我说我们把它炸上天，了结我们这位胖乎乎的塔布朋友。

column1: Set Targeting Beacons for Orbital Bombardment
column2: 为轨道轰炸设置瞄准信标

column1: Solaris Stable Gladiators are on the ground in the area of operation.
column2: 索拉里斯马疚角斗士已抵达行动区域。

column1: The Opportunist
column2: 机会主义者

column1: This shouldn't be anything out of the ordinary, Commander. Let's get it done.
column2: 这应该没什么特别的，指挥官。我们把它办完。

column1: Ms. Hadley's prison transport is waiting for you on the planet's surface, Commander. You will meet with it at a designated rendezvous point, then escort it to a distant repair bay. The personnel there stand ready to hold Ms. Hadley and patch up the prison transport APCs. When they're finished, you'll be free to press on to the extraction point.
column2: 哈德利女士的囚犯运输车在行星地表等着你，指挥官。你将在指定会合点与它会合，然后护送它前往一处遥远的维修舱。那里的人员随时准备关押哈德利女士并修补囚犯运输装甲车。他们完工后，你就可以自由前往撤离点。

column1: Destroy the Bandit Roadblock
column2: 摧毁土匪的路障

column1: Ensure That All Prison Transport Convoy Units Survive
column2: 确保所有囚车护卫队单位存活

column1: Escort the Prison Transport to the Repair Bay
column2: 护送囚车到维修站

column1: Proceed to the Repair Bay
column2: 去维修区

column1: Good to see you, Commander. We're ready to get moving as soon as you reach the rendezvous point.
column2: 很高兴见到你，指挥官。你一抵达会合点，我们就准备出发。

column1: The Opportunist II
column2: 机会主义者 II

column1: Well, this just got interesting. Saddle up, {COMMANDER.FirstName}, we've got a prison to defend.
column2: 好吧，这下有意思了。上马，{COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们有座监狱要守。

column1: Our sensors indicate several large groups of incoming vehicles and BattleMechs, Commander. Whoever they are, I need you to hold them off and drive them away. Above all, they cannot be allowed to free Ms. Hadley from confinement. She belongs to us.
column2: 我们的传感器显示有多支大型车辆和战斗机甲部队正在逼近，指挥官. 无论他们是谁，我都需要你挡住他们并将其击退. 最重要的是——绝不能让他们把哈德利女士从监禁中解救出来. 她是我们的.

column1: Defend the Fortified Repair Bay
column2: 保卫加固的维修区

column1: Destroy the Incoming Hostiles
column2: 消灭进攻的敌方单位

column1: [Incoming transmission.]
column2: [传入传输.]

column1: Both groups of unidentified hostiles are moving into comms range now, Commander. Hopefully they're in a talking mood, because I want to know what we're up against.
column2: 指挥官，两群不明敌意单位现在都进入了通讯范围。但愿他们愿意谈，因为我想知道我们要面对什么。

column1: Your attention, please: this is Commander Mitchell Pearle of the Joppan Light Cavalry. You have custody of a woman who is wanted on my world for multiple charges of larceny, burglary, and grand theft. You will surrender her to me immediately, or my people will take her from you.
column2: 注意，注意！我是乔帕轻骑兵的指挥官米切尔·珀尔. 你们目前关押着一名女子，她在我的世界因多项盗窃、入室行窃和重大盗窃罪而被通缉. 请立即将她移交给我，否则我方将强行夺人.

column1: The Opportunist III
column2: 机会主义者 III

column1: I don't trust Hadley—or Sweeney, or whatever her name really is—for a second, but she should be secure enough in the repair bay's makeshift brig. My advice? Let's go in expecting a double cross, and let's monitor Hadley's cell. At the first sign of trouble, we double back and get her to Lady Cunningham.
column2: 我一秒也不信任哈德利——或者说斯威尼，不管她真名叫什么——但她待在维修舱那个临时牢房里应该足够安全。我的建议？我们进去时就假定会被摆一道，并盯住哈德利的牢房。一有麻烦的迹象，我们就折返把她交给坎宁安女士。

column1: I'm glad that you decided to listen to reason, Commander—you'd be surprised how many so-called mercenaries lack the savvy to jump on an opportunity like this when it presents itself. Now, the LosTech cache that I'm sending you after is close to our location, but there's a catch: it's sealed away in a defunct mineshaft. I've got a way in, though. Follow my instructions, and we'll all get rich.
column2: 我很高兴你决定听从理性，指挥官——你会惊讶地发现，有多少所谓的雇佣兵在机会来临时缺乏抓住它的精明。现在，我派你去找的那处失传科技储藏点离我们位置很近，但有个条件：它被封在一处废弃的矿井里。不过我有进去的办法。照我的指示做，我们都能发财。

column1: Control Targeting Relays in the Time Allotted
column2: 在分配的时间内接管目标获取中继

column1: Eliminate the Hostile Antiaircraft Weaponry
column2: 摧毁敌方防空武器

column1: Eliminate the Local Military Garrison
column2: 消灭当地的驻军

column1: Escape before Enemy Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 在敌方援军到达之前逃跑

column1: Obtain Visual Confirmation of the Artillery Targeting
column2: 亲眼确认火炮目标锁定

column1: Take Over the Artillery Control Facility
column2: 控制炮兵控制中心

column1: Take Position at Artillery Control Relay Alpha
column2: 在炮兵控制中心Alpha处就位

column1: Take Position at Artillery Control Relay Bravo
column2: 在炮兵控制中心Bravo处就位

column1: Take Position at Artillery Control Relay Charlie
column2: 在炮兵控制中心Charlie处就位

column1: Gods, what a fiasco. On the plus side, this little diversion bought me all the time I needed to slip out of my cage with my new friend here from the repair crew.
column2: 天哪，真是一场灾难. 但至少这个小小的分心让我有时间，和我的小伙伴从维修队逃跑.

column1: Looks like the big guns have a target lock, Boss. The fireworks should begin any second now.
column2: 看起来大家伙已经锁定了目标，老板. 烟花随时都会开始.

column1: Okay, Commander. Tell your lances to put their game faces on, 'cause there's a lot of lovely salvage out there for the taking, and we're only going to get one shot at this.
column2: 好，指挥官。让你的人摆好比赛脸，因为外面有大量可爱的战利品等着拿，而我们只有一次机会。

column1: Shot out, cue the explosions any second now!
column2: 发射大炮 - 声音会很大！

column1: This should not be used in this Flashpoint.
column2: 不应在本闪点中使用。

column1: The sooner we get these people to the rendezvous point, the sooner we can go home. Let's get a move on, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 我们越早把这些人送到会合点，就能越早回家。快点动身，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

column1: I've received the coordinates for the rendezvous point from Lady Cunningham, Commander… we should be ready to roll when you are. I haven't managed to get Lady Cunningham herself on the horn—some kind of atmospheric interference is scrambling our long-range comms. But it should be pretty straightforward, all things said.
column2: 我从坎宁安女士那里收到了会合点的坐标，指挥官……你准备好我们就能出发。我没能联系上坎宁安女士本人——某种大气干扰扰乱了我们的远程通讯。不过总的来说，应该相当直接。

column1: Eliminate the Hostile Bandits
column2: 消灭敌对的土匪

column1: Ensure That All Prison Transport Vehicles Survive
column2: 确保所有囚犯运输车辆存活

column1: Escort the Prison Transport to Lady Cunningham's DropShip
column2: 护送囚犯运输车至坎宁安女士的空投艇

column1: Proceed to the Rendezvous Point
column2: 前往集合点

column1: Protect the Prison Convoy As It Boards the DropShip
column2: 在囚犯押运车队登上空投艇时保护该车队

column1: Protect the Prison Convoy Until the DropShip Arrives
column2: 在空投艇抵达前保护囚车护卫队

column1: All right, Commander, we're all patched up and ready to roll.
column2: 好，指挥官，我们都修补好了，随时可以出发。

column1: Pack it in, Commander. Nothing left to do here.
column2: 收工吧，指挥官。这里没别的事了。

column1: Sounds like a plan. Our lance will keep them off of you while you move on the pickup point.
column2: 听起来是个计划. 当你们前往撤离点时，我们的机甲将把敌人挡在外面.

column1: Seven Pieces
column2: 七块碎片

column1: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to move Jimmy to another prison. Kill them.
column2: 敌对方渣滓正试图把吉米转到另一所监狱。杀了他们。

column1: Seems simple enough. Stop a local government convoy carrying a suspected traitor. No one should even care if he dies to be honest.
column2: 听起来够简单。拦下一支载着一名疑似叛徒的当地政府车队。说实话，就算他死了也该没人在乎。

column1: Get on with it. Time's a tickin'.
column2: 快点动手吧。时间不等人。

column1: Told you this wouldn't be simple.
column2: 我早说过这事不会简单。

column1: Apparently they are moving our target again. This time by 'Mech. We are switching this to an assassinate mission and giving you the coordinates. Good Luck, Commander.
column2: 显然他们又把我们的目标转移了。这次是用机甲运。我们把这次改成刺杀任务并给你坐标。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Destroy Jimmy's 'Mech and Escape
column2: 摧毁吉米的机甲并撤离

column1: 'Tis where we last saw that traitor, Jimmy. Get 'im.
column2: 咱就是在这儿最后看见那个叛徒吉米的。逮住他。

column1: Seven Pieces III
column2: 七块碎片 III

column1: The objective to scout the Prison that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
column2: 侦察正被夺取的监狱的任务。必须在基地实际被夺取之前完成。

column1: Capturing this Prison is going to be tough, Commander.
column2: 夺取这座监狱会很艰难，指挥官。

column1: Gettin' this prison be goin ta be rough sailin'. I don't 'ave much faith that th' warden will 'ave any useful information anyway.
column2: 把这个监狱弄到手会是趟艰难的航行。我也不太相信那个典狱长会有什么有用的情报。

column1: Go an' look at th' prison ta see wha' we be up against.
column2: 去瞅瞅那座监狱，看看咱要对付的是啥。

column1: Seven Pieces IV
column2: 七块碎片 IV

column1: Jus' place th' markers, 'n we 'ave a Naval Gauss Rifle that shall zoom in 'n put a hole in that base so big that Fat Karl could walk in thar n get th' loot.
column2: 把那些标记放好，我们就有门舰载高斯步枪能嗖地射进去，在那座基地上开个大洞，大到胖卡尔都能走进去拿战利品。

column1: Finally! Me plunder be so close. Jus' 'ave ta make a new door or two ta get it out.
column2: 终于！我的战利品近在咫尺。只需开一两个新门把它弄出来。

column1: Now we're destroying a civilian prison. Are we sure this was a good idea?
column2: 现在我们又在摧毁一座民用监狱。我们确定这是个好主意吗？

column1: I be glad we see eye ta eye commander. Let's burn this prison ta th' ground 'n show th' Planetary Government no one pilfers from me. I be sick o' this goose chase. Let's destroy 'n loot me piece.
column2: 我很高兴我们看法一致，指挥官。咱们把这座监狱烧成灰，让行星政府知道没人能从我这偷东西。我受够这场追捕了。咱们毁掉那玩意儿，把属于我的那份拿走。

column1: Destroy the Enemy Prison and Extract Safely
column2: 摧毁敌方监狱并安全撤离

column1: 'Tis cold 'n snowin. A fittin' grave fer our enemies.
column2: 天寒地冻、大雪纷飞。这墓穴配得上我们的敌人。

column1: Jus' place th' markers, 'n we 'ave a Naval Gauss Rifle that shall zoom in 'n put a hole in that base so big, Fat Karl could walk in thar 'n get th' loot.
column2: 只管把标记放好，咱就有一门舰载磁轨炮会嗖地飞过来，在那座基地上开出一个大洞——大到胖卡尔都能走进去把战利品搬出来。

column1: White Lies
column2: 善意的谎言

column1: This assignment is clearly important to Force Commander Singh. Let's do this job right, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 这项任务对辛格部队指挥官显然很重要。{COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们把这活干好。

column1: Before we can eliminate the person responsible for attacking my family, we must identify him. His mercenary cat's-paws, Arslan's Janissaries, have a base of operations at our first drop site. You will seize the base from them. My forensics team will then scour their computers to put a name to their employer.
column2: 在我们能除掉那个对我家族下手的人之前，我们必须确认他是谁。他的雇佣兵爪牙阿尔斯兰禁卫军在我们要去的第一个投放点有一处作战基地。你要从他们手中夺取该基地。我的法医团队随后会翻查他们的计算机，查出他们雇主的名字。

column1: Capture the Janissary Base
column2: 占领禁卫军基地

column1: Capture the Outpost
column2: 占领前哨基地

column1: Destroy the Janissary Forces
column2: 摧毁禁卫军

column1: Eliminate the Janissary Reinforcements
column2: 消灭禁卫军增援部队

column1: Hold Out against the Janissary Reinforcements
column2: 保护自己免受禁卫军增援攻击

column1: Pacify the Surrounding Territory
column2: 平定周边地区

column1: Arslan's Janissaries maintain a fortified stronghold and base of operations here, on this plateau. It was from this site that they negotiated their contract against my family.
column2: 阿尔斯兰的禁卫军在这片台地上维持着一处筑垒据点和作战基地。他们就是从这处地点谈判签下针对我家族的合约的。

column1: I need you to take the structure, but you must capture it in one piece.
column2: 我需要你夺取该建筑，但不要摧毁它.

column1: Nicely done, Commander. Sit tight and hold the facility. My forensics team should be joining you within the hour.
column2: 干得好，指挥官. 留在那里并保护设施. 我的取证小组应该会在一小时内抵达.

column1: When the facility is ours and the Janissaries have been vanquished, my forensics team will scour the area. Gods willing, they will uncover the identity of my true enemy, that we may visit justice upon him.
column2: 当设施被我方控制且禁卫军被歼灭后，我的取证团队将彻底搜查该区域. 诸神保佑，愿他们能揭露我真正敌人的身份，以便我们施以正义.

column1: White Lies II
column2: 善意的谎言 II

column1: Nice, clean, and simple. Just the kind of job I like, and just what we'd have missed if we'd taken our shadowy friend up on his offer. You made the right call, {COMMANDER.FirstName}—now let's finish this thing.
column2: 干净利落、简单明了。正是我喜欢的那种活儿，也正是我们若接受那位神秘朋友的提议就会错过的。你做了正确的决定，{COMMANDER.FirstName}——现在我们把这事办完。

column1: According to the information my team pulled from the base you captured, our target—my enemy—is one Murdoch Dhawan, a small-time political extremist from Kilarney. He's here, in this basin. Destroy him and you will be well rewarded.
column2: 根据我团队从你夺取的基地中提取的信息，我们的目标——我的敌人——是基拉尼的一个小混混式政治极端分子，名叫默多克·达万。他就在这个盆地里。摧毁他，你会得到丰厚报酬。

column1: Destroy the Criminal BattleMechs
column2: 摧毁罪犯的战斗机甲

column1: Eliminate Murdoch Dhawan
column2: 消灭默多克·达万

column1: Prevent Dhawan from Escaping
column2: 阻止Dhawan逃跑

column1: Dhawan is here, in this basin. According to the intel my people dug up in the computers you seized, Dhawan is a political extremist whose juvenile philosophy begins and ends with \"eat the rich.\"
column2: 达万就在这里，就在这个盆地里。根据我的人在你缴获的计算机中挖出的情报，达万是一名政治极端分子，他那幼稚的哲学从头到尾只有一句"吃掉富人"。

column1: They can try, Singh. I will spit on their corpses, and then I will spit on yours.
column2: 他们可以试试，辛格. 我将在他们的尸体上吐口水……然后再吐到你的尸体上.

column1: Looks like Force Commander Singh's forensics team bought the false intel we planted. Let's hope it leads to the payoff we were promised.
column2: 看来辛格部队指挥官的取证小组买下了我们植入的假情报。但愿它能带来承诺的回报。

column1: According to the information recovered by my forensics team, our target—the person responsible for my family's suffering—is Lord Parzival Gurung, the head of a minor noble house from Atreus. Lord Gurung is well connected and well defended. If we're going to capture him, first we must strike against his bodyguard.
column2: 根据我的法医团队恢复的信息，我们的目标——那个对我家族苦难负责的人——是帕齐瓦尔·古隆领主，来自阿特柔斯的一个小贵族家族的族长。古隆领主关系网深、护卫严密。如果我们要俘获他，必须先打击他的保镖。

column1: Destroy the Enemy Units
column2: 摧毁敌方单位

column1: Gurung is no MechWarrior, but he has a robust and powerful bodyguard. I need you to eliminate as many of them as you can before we can advance on his location.
column2: Gurung不是机甲战士，但他拥有强大且久经考验的保镖. 在我们面对他之前，你必须尽可能多地消灭他们.

column1: Thanks to you, Commander, I finally know who's been attacking my family. In retrospect, his identity should have been obvious to me. My father sent Gurung's mother to prison for sedition nearly 20 years ago, and evidently he's still holding a grudge.
column2: 多亏了你，指挥官，我终于知道是谁一直在袭击我的家族。事后看来，他的身份本该显而易见得让我一眼认出。我父亲近二十年前以煽动叛乱罪把古隆的母亲送进了监狱，显然他到今天还怀恨在心。

column1: White Lies III
column2: 善意的谎言 III

column1: Singh still believes that Gurung was behind the attacks on his family. That's bad news for Gurung, but it's good for us. Let's do this thing and get paid.
column2: 辛格仍相信古隆是他家族遭袭的幕后黑手。这对古隆是坏消息，对我们却是好消息。我们把这事办了拿钱。

column1: With Lord Gurung's bodyguard in ruins, we are clear to advance on the armory he's taking refuge in. When the building is ours, I will deal with the man personally. He will pay for what his hirelings have done to my family.
column2: 古隆领主的保镖已被击溃，我们可以放心向着他藏身的军械库推进。等那栋建筑归我们，我会亲自处置这个人。他会为他的雇佣手下对我家人所做的一切付出代价。

column1: Capture the Armory
column2: 占领军械库

column1: Eliminate the Security Reinforcements
column2: 消灭安保部增援部队

column1: Hold the Armory against Security Reinforcements
column2: 守住军械库，抵御安保增援部队

column1: A trace on Gurung's last comm signal places him at the armory just ahead of you, Commander.
column2: 对古隆最后一次通讯信号的追踪把他定位在你前方的军械库，指挥官。

column1: Heads up, Commander! DropShip inbound!
column2: 注意，指挥官！空投艇逼近！

column1: While House Gurung hails from the capital system of Atreus, they have their fingers in industries all over the Frontier. This armory belongs to one of their top arms dealers.
column2: 虽然古隆家族来自首都星阿特柔斯星系，但其产业遍布边境. 这座军械库属于他们最大的军火商之一.

column1: Simple Greeting
column2: 简单问候

column1: Not much to say, Commander. Shoot to kill.
column2: 没什么可说的，指挥官. 往死里打.

column1: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, no parlay, and no prisoners.
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲分队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们一路焚毁人口中心、烧掉田地和炼油厂、洗劫仓储设施。他们显然在尽一切所能把我们的民众赶走。这是恐怖主义，纯粹而简单。我们要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不许谈判，不留俘虏。

column1: Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

column1: This is going to be a stand-up fight, Commander. Your lance against the opposing force's.
column2: 这将是一场正面硬仗，指挥官。你的分队对上对方的分队。

column1: Simple Greeting II
column2: 简单问候 II

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy is trying to deliver contraband to a hostile faction. Destroy it.
column2: 一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队正试图向敌对势力运送违禁品。摧毁它。

column1: These are going to be lightly armored targets, Commander. The real challenge will be keeping them from making a run for it.
column2: 这些都是轻装甲目标，指挥官. 真正的挑战是阻止他们逃跑.

column1: We're tracking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoys that have been delivering weapons and explosives to a self-appointed warlord here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. In return, his fighters have been wreaking havoc on {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facilities in the region. We need you to interdict the convoy and destroy it.
column2: 我们正在追踪{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给运输队，它们一直在向{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一个自封军阀运送武器和炸药。作为回报，他的战士一直在破坏该地区的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。我们需要你拦截并摧毁这支运输队。

column1: Destroy Hostile Reinforcements
column2: 消灭敌对援军

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Convoy and Escape
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队并撤离

column1: Destroy the Convoy Escorts
column2: 消灭车队护卫

column1: Intercept the Convoy
column2: 拦截车队

column1: Commander, we need to stop those weapon convoys.
column2: 指挥官，我们得阻止那些武器车队.

column1: The convoy guards are down, Commander! Great work.
column2: 车队的护卫完了，指挥官! 干得漂亮.

column1: I really like 'loud and fatal' as a job description, Commander. I may get it put on a plaque.
column2: 我真的很喜欢"响亮而致命"这个职位描述，指挥官。也许我该把它刻在牌子上。

column1: We're planning an operation and to pull it off, we need the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities to be temporarily distracted. We need you to create that distraction. We'll point you at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol. You do something loud and fatal to them. Meanwhile, we execute our operation and give you a cut of the proceeds. Oh, and there may be reinforcements. That's good; that's one less lance to get in our way.
column2: 我们正在筹划一次行动，而要成功，就需要让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局暂时分心。我们需要你来制造这场干扰。我们会为你指明一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队。你去给他们来点动静大又致命的东西。与此同时，我们执行自己的行动，并分你一杯羹。哦，对了，可能还会有增援。那正好；那就少一支小队来挡我们的路。

column1: Destroy Enemy Patrol
column2: 摧毁敌方巡逻队

column1: Oh, and remember there will likely be reinforcements, Commander.
column2: 哦，记住可能会有援军，指挥官.

column1: This is the place. Time to start the party, Commander.
column2: 就是这个地方. 是时候开始派对了，指挥官.

column1: Destroy Enemy Structures
column2: 摧毁敌方建筑

column1: This sort of tit-for-tat never works out well, but it means steady work for us.
column2: 这种针锋相对的做法从来不能有效地解决问题，但对我们来说意味着稳定的工作.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has been taking an increasingly hard line against {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-affiliated corporate interests in the Rimward Periphery; {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has recently authorized the military interdiction of assets and resources from our corporate affiliates. Their behavior is tantamount to theft, and cannot go unpunished. We need you to send a message back to them by destroying one of their munitions factories on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层在缘向外围对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}下属企业的利益集团采取了越来越强硬的立场; 最近，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层甚至授权军方对我们公司附属机构的资产和资源进行查扣. 这种行为无异于盗窃，必须予以惩罚. 我们需要你摧毁他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一座军工厂，以此回敬他们一个信息.

column1: Destroy Base Garrison
column2: 摧毁基地守军

column1: Destroy Enemy Structures and Escape
column2: 摧毁敌方建筑物并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Munitions Factory
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军工厂

column1: This should be a fairly straightforward combat drop. Locate the enemy facility, raze it to the ground, and get back out again.
column2: 这该是场相当简单明了的战斗空降. 找到敌方设施，将其夷为平地，然后撤离.

column1: These missions never go smoothly.
column2: 这些任务从来不会顺利。

column1: {COMMANDER.LastName}, you're being asked to take control of a data storage facility under local government jurisdiction. This mission should be straightforward enough. Payment will be supplied as per standard procedures. Good hunting.
column2: {COMMANDER.LastName}，你被要求夺取一处受当地政府管辖的数据存储设施。这次任务应该相当直接。报酬将按标准程序发放。祝狩猎顺利。

column1: Capture the Local Government Base
column2: 占领地方政府基地

column1: Head over there and get eyes on the base. We'll plan our next move from there.
column2: 到那边去盯着基地看一眼。我们从那里规划下一步。

column1: Looks like some strong opposition, more reinforcements from local government troops.
column2: 看来抵抗相当强，还有更多来自当地政府部队的增援。

column1: That little bastard and his fat friend are not getting away from me. Take the fight to them Commander.
column2: 那个小混蛋和他那个胖朋友别想从我手里跑掉。指挥官，把战斗打到他们身上去。

column1: Destroy the Second Patrol
column2: 摧毁第二支巡逻队

column1: You're in the area where those traitors have last been seen.
column2: 你已进入那些叛徒最后一次被发现的区域。

column1: Solar Winds III
column2: 太阳风 III

column1: Well here it is a ComStar Base on Terra. We will need some heavy firepower for this one.
column2: 好吧，这里是地球上的一处康星基地。这一仗我们需要一些重型火力。

column1: Destroy the File Vault and get out
column2: 摧毁档案库然后撤出

column1: There it is, the File Vault! I bet we can find some good information in there.
column2: 就在那儿，档案库！我打赌我们能在里面找到些好东西。

column1: Solar Winds IV
column2: 太阳风 IV

column1: Agent X is leading them Commander, I don't see his Waneta though. We may have gotten lucky. We don't know much more about him than he is really deadly.
column2: X特工正率领他们，指挥官，不过我没看到他的瓦内塔。也许我们运气不错。关于他我们知道的并不多，只知道他极其致命。

column1: Those are specialized ComStar reinforcements, Commander. Expect nothing but the best this time around.
column2: 那些是康星的特种增援，指挥官。这次除了最强的对手什么都别指望。

column1: Commander, we're receiving a transmission from the ComStar forces.
column2: 指挥官，我们收到康星部队的通讯。

column1: We need to keep moving on this one. Looks like the ComGuard presence is thick.
column2: 这一票我们得抓紧推进。看来康卫队的存在相当密集。

column1: Good evening, Commander. One of my minions has the details of the base that we would like removed. With prejudice. I need you to retrieve them.
column2: 晚上好，指挥官。我的一名手下手里有那座我们希望拆除的基地的详情——不留余地。我需要你去把它们取回来。

column1: You're coming up on the ComStar facility, Commander.
column2: 你快到通讯之星设施了，指挥官。

column1: Keep an eye out for Agent X, he could be a real problem for us.
column2: 留意X特工，他可能给我们带来不小麻烦。

column1: Well we found the base, it is heavily guarded.
column2: 我们找到基地了，守卫森严。

column1: Let's blow this facility a mile high. Then I will get the information I need.
column2: 让我们把这座设施炸上天。然后我就能拿到我需要的信息。

column1: Succeeded Colony I
column2: 成功建立的殖民地 I

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, While you capture Maximums Base We will sneak into their production Facilities and Snatch their prototype. We are counting on you Commander
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，当你们夺取Maximums基地时，我们会潜入他们的生产设施，抢夺他们的原型机. 我们指望你了，指挥官.

column1: Next we find a defensable Position and repel their Recovery lances.
column2: 接下来我们找一个可防守的位置，击退他们的回收小队.

column1: This is the target area, Commander.
column2: 这就是目标区域，指挥官.

column1: Whats the next move?
column2: 下一步行动是什么?

column1: SucceededColony II
column2: 成功建立的殖民地 II

column1: Now that we have secured the asset, The Company is going to be all over us.I expect heavy assortment of mercs and security guards coming after us.
column2: 既然我们已经拿到了资产，公司肯定会全力追击我们. 我预计会有各式各样的雇佣兵和安保人员追来.

column1: Destroy the Mercenaries
column2: 消灭雇佣兵

column1: Destroy the Security Patrol
column2: 摧毁安保巡逻队

column1: Commander, The mechs are incoming lets engage them quickly!
column2: 指挥官，敌方机甲正在逼近，我们快速接敌!

column1: Lets clear out them out, Commander, while my men assemble a briefing on our next target. Good luck.
column2: 让我们把他们清理掉，指挥官，与此同时我的人会整理关于我们下一个目标的简报. 祝你好运.

column1: SucceededColony III
column2: 成功建立的殖民地 III

column1: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field. Keep an eye out.
column2: 我很高兴他们对我们有信心，但说实话，我更希望在战场上有些增援。留意点。

column1: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Maximum Distric Leadership is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
column2: 这些传输数据足以让我们定位该地区最高行政区领导层藏身的加固掩体。他们以为在那里很安全，但我们在轨道上有一门舰载PPC，随时能在他们下面建的任何东西上打出一个洞。你需要把你的机甲移动到位，好让我们进行精准打击；这一炮打出去之后，我们的空投艇就必须脱离轨道逃跑，所以只有一次做对的机会。我们对你有完全的信心，指挥官；到目前为止你的判断都精准无误。祝好运。

column1: Destroy the Company Lance
column2: 摧毁公司小队

column1: Extract before Additional Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 在增援抵达前撤离

column1: Commander, they are depolying vehicles and tanks from their motorpool.
column2: 指挥官，他们正从车辆调配场调动车辆和坦克.

column1: Commander, this is it; when we destroy this facility, we'll have shattered Maxiumu defenses on this world, and hopefully eliminated their best Distict Manager.
column2: 指挥官，就是这样；我们摧毁这处设施后，就能打碎该星球上最大的防御，并有望除掉他们最好的区域经理。

column1: No! We were so close. So very close!!!!
column2: 不! 我们差一点就成功了. 就差那么一点点!!!!

column1: Test Drive III
column2: 试驾 III

column1: Well, I guess that makes sense.
column2: 好吧，我想这说得通.

column1: We have decided to use these Mechs' advanced maneuverability to destroy the Local Government's leadership. I hope that this is within your abilities, Commander.
column2: 我们已决定利用这些机甲出色的机动性摧毁当地政府的领导层。指挥官，我希望这在你能力范围之内。

column1: Destroy Local Government Leadership and Escape
column2: 摧毁地方政府领导层并撤离

column1: Destroy the Leader of the Local Government
column2: 摧毁地方政府首脑

column1: Destroy the Supporting Forces
column2: 摧毁支援部队

column1: Commander, we're receiving a transmission from Duchess.
column2: 指挥官，我们收到女公爵的通讯。

column1: I see him up there. I bet he thinks he can drive us off planet.
column2: 我看到他在上面了. 我敢打赌他以为自己能把我们赶出星球.

column1: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
column2: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

column1: The Local Leader has perished. A Leopard is on standby for pickup.
column2: 地方首脑已死亡. 一架豹式运输机已待命准备接应.

column1: Well, that seems pretty straightforward.
column2: 嗯，这看起来相当直接了当.

column1: You performed within specifications of the mission. I will brief you on the Argo
column2: 你的表现符合任务要求. 我将在阿尔戈号上向你进行简报.

column1: Test Drive II
column2: 试驾 II

column1: Base Defense is usually a long and drawn out afair.
column2: 基地防御通常是一场旷日持久的事情.

column1: Glad you could join us, Commander. The Local Government Leader has decided to try and take one of our bases. I want you to take these mechs and put them through their paces.
column2: 很高兴你能加入我们，指挥官. 当地政府首脑决定试图夺取我们的一处基地. 我要你驾驶这些机甲，让它们经历实战考验.

column1: Destroy the Local Government Vanguard
column2: 摧毁当地政府先遣队

column1: Ah, you managed to get the turrets online. I will note it in the performance review.
column2: 啊，你成功让炮台上线了. 我会在表现评估中记下这一点.

column1: I will add this to the Quad mission profile. Expect a new mission shortly when you get back to the Argo.
column2: 我会将此加入四足机甲任务档案. 等你回到阿尔戈号后，很快就会收到一项新任务.

column1: Local Government Forces arriving. Try to not disappoint me.
column2: 当地政府部队正在抵达. 尽量别让我失望.

column1: See that the base is at least somewhat functional by the time I get there.
column2: 确保在我到那里之前，基地至少能维持基本运转.

column1: They might not matter to you, but I have friends who work in that facility.
column2: 它们对你可能不重要，但我有朋友在那个设施里工作.

column1: Try and do something right. That last building must survive.
column2: 这次可别再搞砸了. 最后那座建筑必须保住.

column1: Warning Commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
column2: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

column1: You have made it to the half-way point. Our men will be there soon.
column2: 你已经撑到了半程. 我们的人很快就到.

column1: Test Drive I
column2: 试驾 I

column1: We have arranged a training mission on this planet. Of course, we did not inform the Local Government we would be using their forces as training dummies.
column2: 我们已在这颗星球上安排了一次训练任务. 当然，我们并没有通知当地政府我们将把他们的部队用作训练假人.

column1: Destroy the Local Government Patrols
column2: 摧毁当地政府巡逻队

column1: Commander, you're entering the area that the data indicated the lances were patrolling.
column2: 指挥官，你正进入数据所标示的分队巡逻区域。

column1: The Defector
column2: 叛逃者

column1: House Liao is attempting to move Okada to safety. Kill him.
column2: 廖家族正试图把冈田转移到安全处。杀了他。

column1: This seems relatively straightforward, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's get in there and get it done.
column2: 这看起来相对直接，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们进去把事办了。

column1: Your lance will be dropping directly in the path of Yoshito Okada's convoy. Smash it flat—there can be no survivors. When the defector's death has been confirmed, you will receive your reward.
column2: 你的分队将直接降落在冈田义人的车队路线上。把它彻底砸平——不能有幸存者。叛逃者的死亡得到确认后，你就会收到报酬。

column1: Ambush and Destroy Yoshito Okada's Convoy
column2: 伏击并摧毁冈田义人的车队

column1: Destroy the Liao Convoy Guards
column2: 摧毁车队的廖氏保护者

column1: Destroy the Liao Reinforcement Units
column2: 摧毁廖氏的援军

column1: Eliminate the Liao Convoy Guards
column2: 消灭廖氏护送队的护卫

column1: Prevent the Convoy from Reaching Safety
column2: 阻止运输队抵达安全区域

column1: A miserable performance, Commander. But fear not, the needs of House Kurita will be satisfied. The Galedon Regulars will succeed where you have failed!
column2: 多么可悲的成就，指挥官，但别担心，栗田家的需求会得到满足. 盖尔登常备团不会重蹈你的覆辙！

column1: According to my scouts, Yoshito Okada's convoy is already moving through the AO you've touched down in. All you need do is locate and destroy it.
column2: 据我的侦察兵说，冈田义人的车队已经穿过你降落的行动区域。你只需定位并摧毁它。

column1: An adequate showing, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. For mercenaries, your people showed remarkable discipline.
column2: 表现得相当不错，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 作为佣兵，你的部队展现出非凡的纪律性.

column1: We shall see. If you do succeed in destroying the convoy, proceed to the extraction point. The Galedon Regulars will then take command of the area to confirm your kill.
column2: 我们拭目以待. 如果你真的摧毁了车队，请前往撤离点. 盖尔登常备团将接管该区域以确认战果.

column1: The Defector II
column2: 叛逃者 II

column1: \"His honor,\" my ass. Let's just get this done, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 他的荣誉，去他的。把这事办完吧，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

column1: You've chosen to complete your contract, to satisfy your obligation to House Kurita. Good. On my honor, you will receive your pay when Okada is dead—and not a moment before.
column2: 你选择了完成合约，履行你对栗田家族的义务。很好。以我的荣誉起誓，冈田死后你才会拿到报酬——一秒钟都不会早。

column1: Eliminate the Defector's Convoy and Extract Safely
column2: 消灭叛逃者的车队并安全撤离

column1: And I will be monitoring you to make sure that the job is done correctly this time. If your company gets in over its head, my lance is poised to relieve you.
column2: 这次我会监督你们，以确保任务正确执行. 如果你们公司搞砸了，我的机甲小队也能随时准备接手.

column1: Okay, Commander. We're here to take on yet another convoy—the correct convoy this time. I'd stake my reputation on it.
column2: 好，指挥官。我们来这里对付又一支车队——这次是正确的那支。我拿我的名声打赌。

column1: So be it, mercenary. Now get to work.
column2: 如你所愿，雇佣兵. 现在开始工作.

column1: There will be no need, Mr. Oliveira. Join me in a secure channel and we will discuss your payment.
column2: 没有必要，奥利维拉先生. 请接入安全频道商议付款事宜.

column1: He sounded awfully sure of himself. Let's wipe the smile off of that smug son of a bitch's face.
column2: 他听起来自信得过分。让我们把那个得意混蛋脸上的笑抹掉。

column1: You dare take up arms against the Galedon Regulars?! Your hubris will destroy you, mercenary dog—and I will personally put your broken corpse into the ground!

column1: Save your excuses and remove yourselves from my sight. My people and I still have a defector to kill, and we can waste no more time on you.
column2: 收起你的借口，从我眼前消失. 我和我的人民要去处理一个叛徒，没时间在你身上浪费.

column1: Sumire was able to trace Chu-i Gaku Hironaka's transmissions to a structure just ahead of you, Commander.
column2: 苏米蕾成功追踪到了中尉学·广中的通讯，指向你前方的一处建筑，指挥官。

column1: You miserable fools! House Kurita will have your heads for this!

column1: As we discussed, this will be a joint operation. As long as Gwydion Company doesn't drop the ball, I'm confident that we can handle our end of the job.
column2: 正如我们讨论过的，这将是一次联合行动。只要格威迪恩连不掉链子，我有信心我们能干好自己这摊事。

column1: House Steiner has constructed a military stronghold within our territorial boundaries. We have artillery in place to destroy it, but we need you to place targeting beacons in key locations before we can pull the trigger. While you work, a mercenary lance from Gwydion Company will keep any Steiner reinforcements off your backs.
column2: 施泰纳家族在我们的领土内建立了一个军事要塞. 我们已部署炮兵准备将其摧毁，但在开火前，需要你们在关键位置布设信标. 在你们执行任务期间，格威迪恩公司的一支雇佣兵机甲小队将负责阻挡施泰纳的任何增援部队，确保你们无后顾之忧.

column2: 施泰纳增援部队正在逼近

column1: Beautifully done, Commander. That hideous barnacle of a fortress has been cracked in two, and House Steiner has lost its foothold in Marik space.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 这座可憎的堡垒已成为历史，施泰纳家族在马里克领土的立足点已不复存在.

column1: Close in on those artillery spotters, damn it! Crush them before their Long Toms can get a lock on us!
column2: 摧毁炮兵观察员，该死的！在他们的长汤姆斯抓住我们之前摧毁他们，！

column1: Commander, your window of opportunity for this strike is closing! Move quickly and place the beacons before the Lyrans turn their own artillery on us!
column2: 指挥官，这次军事行动的时间窗口正在迅速关闭！在天琴人将他们自己的大炮对准我们之前，立即将信标安装到位！

column1: Fire Control, this is Observer Actual: Confirmed. Shot, out.
column2: 火控中心，这里是观察员. 目标确认. 开火，完毕.

column1: Hey, no problem. Gwydion Company will work with you anytime.
column2: 嘿，没问题. 格威迪恩公司期待下次合作.

column2: 未在此闪点中使用

column2: 观察员，这是火控中心: 实施火力压制——发射高爆30发，危险临近！

column1: Our pleasure, Force Commander Singh. Thanks for the assist, Commander Carnby.
column2: 乐意效劳，辛格指挥官. 感谢协助，卡恩比指挥官.

column1: Thank you, Commander Carnby. We appreciate the assist.
column2: 谢谢你，卡恩比指挥官. 我们很感谢此次协助.

column1: This is a target acquisition run, Commander—we're going to mark House Steiner's unauthorized military base for destruction, and Marik artillery will handle the rest.
column2: 这是一次目标获取行动，指挥官——我们要把施泰纳家族的非法军事基地标定为摧毁目标，剩下的由马里克炮兵处理。

column1: What about Gwydion Company?
column2: 格威迪恩公司呢?

column2: 不速之客 II

column1: You know the drill, Commander. Get in there, take down the strike team, and rescue Gwydion Company. I'll call out targets for you as I see 'em.
column2: 你懂流程，指挥官。进去，干掉打击队，救出格威迪恩连。我看到目标就给你报点。

column1: Carronade sends her thanks for the assist, Commander—we're doing Gwydion Company a solid that a lot of other mercenary commands wouldn't. Our friends have taken shelter in a subterranean bunker, and a Steiner strike team has them penned in. Carronade needs us to engage and destroy the Lyrans so that she and her people can escape.
column2: 短炮向你的协助致谢，指挥官——我们在帮格威迪恩连，这是许多其他雇佣兵部队不会做的事。我们的朋友躲进了一处地下掩体，一支施泰纳打击队把他们围住了。短炮需要我们交战并消灭这些莱兰人，好让她和她的人逃脱。

column1: Destroy the Steiner Strike Team
column2: 摧毁施泰纳突击小队

column1: Thank the gods, the cavalry is here at last. Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, you are a lifesaver, and I do mean that literally.
column2: 谢天谢地，援军终于来了. 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，你真是我们的救星——字面意思！

column1: This should be a milk run, {COMMANDER.FirstName}… Graf Stieglitz-Bradford doesn't actually care about taking down this facility; he just wants us out of the way while his strike team takes down Gwydion Company.
column2: 这应该是一趟轻松差事，{COMMANDER.FirstName}……施蒂格利茨-布拉德福德伯爵其实并不在乎拿下这处设施；他只是想把我们支开，好让他的打击队干掉格威迪恩连。

column1: I'm so pleased that you've chosen to work with us, Commander. You destroyed one of our facilities at the behest of House Marik; it seems only fair that you do the same for us. Turnabout is fair play, after all. The facility will be minimally guarded, and your pay will be extremely generous.
column2: 我很高兴你选择与我们合作，指挥官。你曾应马里克家族的要求摧毁了我们的一处设施；那么你为我们做同样的事，看起来才公平。毕竟，来而不往非礼也。那座设施只有最低限度的守卫，而你的报酬将极其丰厚。

column1: Destroy the Armory Garrison
column2: 摧毁军械库

column2: 摧毁马里克家族军械库

column1: A lovely world, this Pilpala. It seems a shame to bring war to such a beautiful place.
column2: Pilpala真的是一个美妙的世界. 在这样的地方开战真是太可惜了.

column1: But House Marik has wronged us, and you were its triggerman. Not that I blame you, of course! We both know how enticing a paycheck can be.
column2: 但是马里克家族袭击了我们，而你正是他们的执行者. 当然，我并不是在责怪你！我们都知道一张薪水单能有多诱人.

column1: Go on, Commander. Proceed to the armory and burn it to cinders. You will be well rewarded for your help.
column2: 继续，指挥官. 前往军械库，把它烧成灰烬. 你的帮助将会得到丰厚的回报.

column1: Very good, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Exceptional work indeed. Honor is satisfied, an injustice has been repaid, and all is right with the world.
column2: 非常好，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 真是杰出的工作. 荣誉得到了满足，不公得到了报应，世上的一切各安其位.

column1: When you reach orbit, you will find your payment overflowing your accounts. Enjoy it in good health, with the knowledge that I hold you in high esteem. Good day to you, Commander.
column2: 当你到达轨道的时候，你会发现你的账户装满了报酬. 带着健康的身心，还有我对你的尊敬享用它吧. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Sounds like someone has a case of the Mondays.
column2: 听起来有人得了周一综合症。

column1: The punishment for Mutiny, is called Walking the Plank. In this case I don't have a plank long enough to make them walk. So we're going to punish the Mutineers. And track down that bitch Sybil
column2: 叛变的惩罚叫做"走跳板"。这次我没有够长的跳板让他们走。所以我们要惩罚这些叛变者。并追查出那个贱人西比尔

column1: Destroy the Pirate Patrols
column2: 摧毁海盗巡逻队

column1: They are around here somewhere! Let's run these traitors into the ground.
column2: 他们就在这附近某处！咱们把这些叛徒追到地底下去。

column1: I am not sure if our reputation with Pirates is going up or down right now Commander.
column2: 我不确定我们现在在海盗那里的名声是在上升还是下降，指挥官。

column1: Found another group of Traitors. Let's see if they know anything about where I can find Sybil.
column2: 又发现一群叛徒。看看他们知不知道我在哪儿能找到西比尔。

column1: They are around here somewhere. Let's run these traitors into the ground.
column2: 他们就在这附近某处。咱们把这些叛徒追到地底下去。

column1: Not being ambushed by pirates in alleyways would be nice.
column2: 不在小巷里被海盗伏击就好了。

column1: We're up to our boots in shit, Commander. Mainly because we stomped on them so hard. I am sure one of these guys have to know where Sybil is. At minimum they will stop harassing our daily lives.
column2: 我们陷到靴子那么深的屎里了，指挥官。主要是因为我们把他们踩得太狠。我相信这些人里总有一个知道西比尔在哪。至少他们会停止骚扰我们的日常生活。

column1: Her lieutenant is around here somewhere. I can smell his fear.
column2: 她的副官就在附近某处。我能闻到他恐惧的味道。

column1: Words Found
column2: 找到的话

column1: {COMMANDER.FirstName}, time to remove some Pirates from this planet.
column2: {COMMANDER.FirstName}，是时候把一些海盗从这颗行星上清除了。

column1: You'll find the Pirates Forward Base at the coordinates I've outlined, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Make sure to crush them... to make an example of course.
column2: 你会在标出的坐标找到海盗前沿基地，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。务必碾碎他们……当然，是为了以儆效尤。

column1: The Pirates forward base should be just ahead of your lance, Commander.
column2: 海盗的前沿基地应该就在你的分队前方，指挥官。

column2: 找到的话 II

column1: Hold the base while ComStar units arrive.
column2: 在康星部队抵达前守住基地。

column1: The Pirates are trying to retake their base. Don't let them have it!
column2: 海盗正试图夺回他们的基地。别让他们得逞！

column1: I don't know who you think you are, Mercenary! But I am taking back what is mine
column2: 我不知道你以为自己是谁，雇佣兵！但我要把我的一切拿回来

column1: Warning Commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
column2: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

column1: Getting food and medical supplies delivered is a very humanitarian goal.
column2: 把食物与医疗物资送到，是非常人道主义的目标。

column1: Well, I guess this one is unpaid work commander. The local government has taken a beating from the Pirate occupation force.
column2: 好吧，我想这次是无偿劳动了，指挥官。当地政府被海盗占领军打得够呛。

column1: Escort the Supplies to the local government pick up point

column1: If they destroy the cargo we are truly doomed.
column2: 要是他们毁掉这批货，我们就真完了.

column1: Thank you for helping, Commander. I've gotta admit, when I first reached out to you, I didn't have much hope that you'd respond.
column2: 谢谢你的帮助，指挥官。我得承认，我第一次联系你时，并没抱多大希望你会回应。

column1: The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second Evac Zone for extraction there.
column2: 车队安全离开了行动区域. 干得漂亮，指挥官. 现在带你剩下的部队前往第二撤离区撤离.

column1: I don't know who you think you are, Mercenary! But I am taking back what is mine!
column2: 我不知道你以为自己是谁，雇佣兵！但我要夺回属于我的东西！
