column2: 任务目标是保护持有次要已签署发票的单位存活. 若该单位被摧毁，任务将失败.

column1: I think I've lost track of how many layers of betrayal this represents. Is this a quadruple-cross? This must be some scientist
column2: 我想我已经数不清这代表了第几层背叛了。这是四重背叛吗？这科学家一定不简单

column1: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Needs some industrial gear from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We have aquired the gear for her. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell it back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to deliver the gear to the scientist through more proactive means.
column2: 一名为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}效力的科学家需要从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}获取一些工业设备. 我们已经为她取得了这些设备. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层提出将设备赎回，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望拖延时间，让你通过更主动的方式将设备交付给这名科学家.

column1: Deliver the Package
column2: 递送包裹

column1: Drop off the Industrial Gear
column2: 交付工业设备

column1: Ensure the Secondary Signed Invoice Unit Survives
column2: 确保携带次要已签署发票的单位存活

column1: Recover the Signed Invoice by Securing the Designated Area
column2: 通过占领指定区域回收已签署发票

column1: Mechazon Really Carries a lot of Items at reasonable prices.
column2: Mechazon还真是什么都有卖，价格也挺公道.

column1: Thank you, Commander.
column2: 谢谢你，指挥官.

column1: The industrial Equipment was delivered Commander
column2: 工业设备已经交付，指挥官.

column1: Wonder what they are going to use it for.
column2: 不知道他们打算拿它做什么.

column1: Abandoned Factory
column2: 废弃工厂

column1: Somehow I doubt there's a lost 'Mech factory on this backwater world. It probably manufactures low-g bicycles or something else as useless.
column2: 我有点怀疑这颗穷乡僻壤上会有什么失落的机甲工厂。它大概生产低重力自行车或者别的同样没用的东西。

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol detected unexpected signals here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and we'd like you to investigate. Analysis suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an abandoned factory on the planet's surface. We don't know what this particular facility was used for, but given the effort they're sinking into this, it must be valuable. We want it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}探测到意外信号，我们希望你去调查。分析显示{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}重新启用了星球地表一座废弃工厂。我们不知道这处设施具体做什么，但看他们投入的力气，它一定很有价值。我们要它。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Capture the Factory
column2: 夺取工厂

column1: Scout the Factory
column2: 侦察工厂

column1: DropShip inbound for landing! We're going to get in and out quick!
column2: 空投舰正在降落！我们要速进速出！

column1: Turrets. Remember they can spot you from a very long way off, Commander.
column2: 炮台. 请记住它们能在很远的距离上发现你，指挥官.

column1: We're here to capture the abandoned factory.
column2: 我们来夺取这座废弃工厂。

column1: Bargaining Chip
column2: 谈判筹码

column1: This is a general objective to indicate the player must keep playing and eliminate enemies as they come.
column2: 这是一个通用目标，表示玩家必须继续作战并消灭陆续出现的敌人。

column1: I'm not sure the outcome will be what they want, but I don't specialize in interstellar politics. It sounds like a declaration of war to me so be prepared for more than a little resistance.
column2: 我不确定结果是否会如他们所愿，但星际政治并非我的专长。在我看来，这听起来就像一份宣战书，所以请做好准备，抵抗恐怕不会小。

column1: Trade negotiations between {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have broken down. We believe that if we capture and hold a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system, we will be able to force them back to the negotiating table. Your job is to take the base and hold it until our forces can occupy it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}之间的贸易谈判破裂。我们相信，如果我们夺取并守住{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系中一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地，就能迫使对方回到谈判桌。你的任务是拿下该基地并守住它，直到我们的部队能够占领。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Capture {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Military Base
column2: 夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Defenders
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 守军

column1: Destroy Defensive Turrets
column2: 摧毁防御炮塔

column1: Hold the base until {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces Arrive
column2: 守住基地直到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队抵达

column1: Commander, we're getting intel about the base's location.
column2: 指挥官，我们收到了关于基地位置的情报。

column1: DropShip arriving! Prepare to head out.
column2: 空投艇来了! 准备出发.

column1: Eliminate any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defenders and secure the base, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 消灭所有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}守军然后拿下基地，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Watch for additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} forces on the ground, and expect contact.
column2: 注意地面上可能出现的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}增援部队，准备迎战.

column1: Data Piracy
column2: 数据海盗

column1: This shouldn't be too difficult, but we'll need Dr. Murad on the ground to do the actual data hacking. She's already agreed to go in with your team.
column2: 这应该不算太难，但我们需要穆拉德医生亲自到场做数据入侵。她已经同意跟你的队伍一起进去。

column1: We've been monitoring communications traffic on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and discerned a pattern. There's a well-defended {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we suspect of being a secure data storage facility. We'd like your team to land, capture the base, and take a complete image of the contents of their databases. Once the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces realize what we're doing, they'll launch a counteroffensive, so we'll need you to stay in the field until the download is complete.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们一直在监视{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的通讯流量，并辨认出一种规律。那里有一处防御严密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，我们怀疑它是安全数据存储设施。我们希望你的团队降落、夺取该基地，并完整拍摄其数据库内容。一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队意识到我们在做什么，他们就会发起反攻，因此我们需要你留在战场直到下载完成。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} data storage facility
column2: 夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}数据储存设施

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Defenders
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}守卫

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}援军

column1: Commander, once you reach the base I'll be able to start extracting the data. It shouldn't take very long; I can't imagine their data security is very sophisticated.
column2: 指挥官，等你抵达基地，我就能开始提取数据了。应该不会花太久；我无法想象他们的数据安全措施有多精密。

column1: We should get eyes on that base before we charge in shooting. This should be a good vantage point.
column2: 在我们冲进去射击之前，应该先看看那座基地. 这里应该是最佳视点.

column1: Aborted Colony
column2: 夭折的殖民地

column1: My guess is that there was a credible threat made on the colony, and that's why they're pulling out. Expect fighting, Commander.
column2: 我猜是殖民地受到了可信的威胁，所以他们才撤离。准备战斗，指挥官。

column1: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 这个星系是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}扩张计划的目标之一。不幸的是，殖民计划落空了，我们现在必须在殖民者被敌对势力拦截之前，把他们从行星表面撤出来。由于对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}存在互相矛盾且可疑的主权声索，而该殖民地本是秘密，我们不能公开进行一次大规模救援行动。我们需要一个可否认的中间人。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Blocking Force
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 拦截部队

column1: Ensure All Convoy Units Survive
column2: 确保车队全部单位存活

column1: Escort {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Convoy To Evac Point
column2: 护送 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队前往撤离点

column1: Escort Convoy to Safety and Escape
column2: 护送车队至安全地带并撤离

column1: Protect Convoy as they Embark on the Dropship
column2: 保护车队登上空投舰

column1: Protect Convoy while Dropship Arrives
column2: 在空投舰抵达期间保护车队

column1: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
column2: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

column1: The colonists have assembled into a convoy of vehicles.
column2: 殖民者已经集合到一支车队里了.

column1: The survivors of the failed colony are safely away, Commander. Good job.
column2: 那些沦陷殖民地的幸存者已经安全离开了，指挥官. 干得好.

column1: This is a disaster. We need to review the mission logs and see what went wrong.
column2: 这真是一场灾难. 我们需要回顾任务日志看看哪里出错了.

column1: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try and stop the player from reaching the rally point.
column2: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

column1: Rumor has it that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} have been smuggling restricted munitions in amongst their medical supplies. On the surface, at least, we're being tasked with a humanitarian escort mission.
column2: 有传言称{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}一直在把受限弹药混在医疗物资中走私。至少表面上，我们的任务被说成是一次人道主义护送。

column1: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 违背战场上一切体面与可接受的行为，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在把目标对准我们的医院与医疗物资。我们正设法把补给重新分配到更安全的地点，但有一支车队还没有适当护卫。这就需要你了。虽然{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会因试图拦截我们所有分开的货运而被摊薄，但你可以预料这一批不会无人注意。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Escort Medical Convoy to Safety and Escape
column2: 护送医疗车队前往安全地点并摆脱敌人

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The medical convoy safely reached extraction.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 医疗车队安全抵达了撤离点.

column1: Move to their position and provide support.
column2: 前往他们的位置并提供支援。

column1: Pack it in, Commander. Those medical supplies are only so much trash now.
column2: 结束吧，指挥官. 那些医疗物资现在只是这些垃圾了.

column1: We have friendly units under fire.
column2: 我们的一个友方单位正受到攻击.

column1: Hostage Rescue
column2: 营救人质

column1: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.
column2: 假设人质还活着，我们要让他们保持活着可就难了。

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一艘{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇坠毁在这块空荡的岩石上，此后不久我们探测到来自地表的求救信号。我们赶到时，船员已被一支装备精良的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获。我们在该星系内没有足够大的军事存在来执行人质营救行动，所以我们在找一家称职的雇佣兵公司来做。我们需要你抵达关押船员的那处设施，摧毁看守他们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，并护送他们到安全地带。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
column2: 预计会遭遇激烈抵抗，因为{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已经警觉，准备应对营救行动.

column1: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
column2: 我收到设施的无线电通话，指挥官。听起来船员发动了起义。

column1: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
column2: 船员安全地返回了轨道，指挥官. 做得不错.

column1: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
column2: 我们需要抵达他们的位置，拿下这一地区，这样他们就可以逃走了.

column1: Top Secret
column2: 最高机密

column1: The Algea A Varient Quadvee, designed by Clan Hells Horse, is a force to be reckoned with. Equipped with 60 LRM tubes and a trio of ER medium lasers, this 100-ton assault mech is a versatile and deadly addition to any battlefield. With its impressive long-range capabilities and quick maneuverability, the Algea can rain down a barrage of missiles on enemies from afar or close in for devastating laser strikes. Its armor plating is reinforced with the latest materials and its engines are top of the line, ensuring both speed and protection. The Algea is a true feat of engineering and a testament to the ingenuity of its creator. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 由地狱马部族设计的 Algea A 变型 QuadVee 是一支不可小觑的力量。这台 100 吨的突击机甲装备了 60 管 LRM 和三门增程中型激光，是任何战场上多才多艺且致命的战力。凭借出色的远程打击能力和灵活的机动性，Algea 可以从远处向敌人倾泻导弹弹幕，也能逼近目标施以致命的激光打击。其装甲板采用最新材料强化，引擎也是顶级配置，兼顾速度与防护。Algea 是真正的工程杰作，也是其设计者智慧的明证。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Equipped with 60 Long Range Missile tubes and a trio of Extended Range medium lasers. At first, I was skeptical about how effective it could be without the Gauss rifles, but I have to say, I'm excited to see it in action. The LRM tubes will give us a serious punch at long range, and the ER medium lasers will provide some added flexibility up close. Let's hope the professor's other modifications are just as promising.
column2: 它装60具远程导弹发射管和三门增程中型激光器。起初我怀疑没有磁轨炮它能有多有效，但我得说，我很期待看它实战。LRM发射管会给我们远程带来沉重一击，增程中型激光器则在近距离提供额外的灵活性。希望教授的其他改装也同样有前途。

column1: Variant B of the Algea Quadvee is equipped with 36 SRM tubes and a single ER medium laser. While it sacrifices some of the long-range capabilities of the original Prime variant, it excels in close combat situations with its impressive missile loadout. The single ER medium laser provides additional firepower for mid-range engagements. With its 100-ton weight and sturdy construction, the Algea Variant B is a formidable opponent on any battlefield. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Algea 四足变形车辆的 B 型配备 36 个 SRM 发射管和一具增程中型激光。它牺牲了原始 Prime 型的一部分远程能力，却凭借可观的导弹搭载量在近距离战斗中表现突出。单独一具增程中型激光为中距离交战提供了额外火力。凭借 100 吨的重量和坚固的结构，Algea B 型在任何战场上都是令人生畏的对手。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Commander, you're going to love Variant B of the Algea Quadvee! It's a real brawler, equipped with 36 SRM Tubes and a single ER med laser. With this loadout, it can dish out massive damage at close range and keep the pressure on the enemy. It's perfect for those intense urban combat situations where you need to get up close and personal with the enemy. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!
column2: 指挥官，你一定会喜欢阿尔盖四足机甲B型的！它是个十足的近战好手，装备36具SRM发射管和一门增程中型激光器。凭借这套配置，它能在近距离输出巨量伤害并持续压制敌人。对于那些需要与敌人贴身肉搏的高强度城市战场合，它是完美的选择。相信我，你不会失望的！

column1: The Algea Variant C was designed as a highly mobile skirmisher, utilizing its top speed of 64kph to engage enemies at range with its primary weapon, a Rotary Autocannon 5. It also boasts a quad array of ER medium lasers for additional firepower. While lacking in heavier weaponry, its lighter weight and speed make it a formidable opponent in the hands of a skilled pilot. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Algea 的 C 变型被设计为高机动游击机甲，凭借 64kph 的最高速度，以主武器一门旋转自动炮 5 在远距离与敌交战。它还拥有四联装增程中型激光阵列以增强火力。虽然缺乏更重的武器，但它较轻的重量与速度使其在熟练机师手中成为可怕的对手。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Commander, we have a Variant C of the Algea. It's been modified to replace the Hyper Gauss rifles with a Rotary Autocannon 5 and two tons of ammo. To be honest, I'm not thrilled about this setup, but we could use it as a brawler if we position it right. We'll need to be strategic with our movements and use cover effectively. It's not ideal, but we can make it work if we have to.
column2: 指挥官，我们有一台阿尔盖的C型。它经过改装，把超磁轨炮换成一门旋转自动炮5和两吨弹药。老实说，我对这套配置并不兴奋，但如果我们位置摆得好，可以把它当近战者用。我们需要在移动上讲策略，并有效利用掩体。这不是理想方案，但必要时我们能凑合。

column1: The Algea's advanced targeting systems and enhanced sensor suite make it a formidable opponent, capable of engaging multiple targets simultaneously with deadly precision. Its armored hull, reinforced by cutting-edge composite materials, offers unparalleled protection against enemy fire, while its sophisticated ECM suite can disrupt enemy communications and sensors, rendering them ineffective against its onslaught. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Algea 先进的瞄准系统和增强型传感器套件使它成为一名令人生畏的对手，能够以致命的精度同时应对多个目标。其装甲外壳由尖端复合材料强化，对敌方火力提供无与伦比的防护；而精密的电子对抗套件则能干扰敌方的通讯与传感器，使其在它的猛攻面前形同虚设。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: I'm not sure about this one, Commander. The hyper gauss rifles are impressive, no doubt, but can the chassis handle the recoil? And what about the ammo? Still, I have to admit, I'm excited to see it in action. If it works, we could have a real game-changer on our hands.
column2: 我对这个不太确定，指挥官。超高斯步枪无疑令人印象深刻，但底盘承受得住后坐力吗？弹药呢？不过我得承认，我很期待看它上场。如果它能行，我们手里就有了真正的游戏规则改变者。

column1: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 战斗大师 1G 功能多样且威力强大，是现存最著名的战斗机甲之一。它通常搭载种类繁多的能量武器，能在任何距离上与敌人交战，并且打击力惊人。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Debuted in 3141 on the King of the Mountain Arena and piloted by Adrienne Caselotti, this variant of the Calliope packs a pair of Streak SRM-4, supported by a Clan ER PPC augmented by a PPC Capacitor and a Clan Improved Heavy Medium Laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该变型于3141年在“山之王”竞技场首次亮相，由阿德里安娜·卡塞洛蒂驾驶。卡利俄佩的这款变型装有2具连发SRM-4，并辅以1门加装PPC电容器的部族增程粒子炮和1门部族改进型重型中型激光。 <特性：易于维护 <投放费用倍率：1.02 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

column1: Debuted in 3141 on the King of the Mountain Arena and piloted by Adrienne Caselotti, this variant of the Calliope packs a pair of Streak SRM-4, supported by a Clan ER PPC augmented by a PPC Capacitor and a Clan Improved Heavy Medium Laser.
column2: 该改型于3141年在山王竞技场首次亮相，由阿德里安娜·卡塞洛蒂驾驶，这台卡利俄佩装有两具连发SRM-4，由一门增程PPC支援——后者配有一座PPC电容器——以及一门氏族改进型重型中型激光器。

column1: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 啊，投石机 C1。正如它的名字一样，它擅长隔着地形向远处抛射大量导弹，而无需担心遭到反击。出人意料的是，它在迫不得已时打近战也毫不含糊。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 百夫长是一台坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也擅长打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离上交战，而且越接近目标，其伤害曲线越高。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款定制Solaris改型于3128年在Noisiel首次登场，先后由Natalia Porter及其女儿Carolyn Fischer驾驶。这型Clint IIC的升级一反部族改装内层星域机体的潮流。它以部族制造的骨架为起点，拆除了跳跃推进器以更改武器配置。它保留了那两门部族增程中型激光，并把部族LB 10-X AC换成一门大型可变速度脉冲激光与一门中型再工程激光，再将它们全部连接至一具部族瞄准计算机。标准平板装甲则替换为实弹强化装甲。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor.
column2: 这款索拉里斯定制变型于3128年在努瓦西尔首次亮相，先后由娜塔莉亚·波特和她的女儿卡罗琳·费雪驾驶。这台克林特IIC升级版逆转了“部族改装内层星域机体”的潮流：它从部族制造的框架出发，拆掉跳跃推进器以更换武器载荷。它保留两门部族增程中型激光，把部族LB 10-X自动炮换成一门大型可变速度脉冲激光和一门中型再工程激光，并把它们全部接入一台部族瞄准计算机。标准板式装甲则换成弹道强化装甲。

column1: This custom chassis based on the Cougar is apparently an attempt by the Jade Falcons to use experimental technology in a combat unit. Unlike the early prototype designated the Cougar XR, this unit actually is a fully developed Land Air Mech. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这一基于美洲狮的定制底盘显然是玉猫部族在战斗单位上使用实验技术的尝试。与早期被编号为美洲狮XR的原型不同，此单位实际上是一台完整开发的地空机甲。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: Cougar LAM
column2: 美洲狮 LAM

column1: A uniquely hybridized brawler built from the husk of a CRB-20. Bogdan ''The Steel Beast'' Tubbs had the Big Steel Claw's chassis rebuilt to support the mounting of ballistic weaponry, presumably in the interest of creating a louder and more violent spectacle in the arena. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是一款由CRB-20残骸打造出的独特混合式斗士。博格丹·“钢铁野兽”·塔布斯让人重建了大钢爪的底盘，以支撑弹道武器的安装，想必是为了在竞技场中制造更响亮、更暴力的场面。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Check it out, Boss we've landed ourselves a FrankenMech! Looks like a Crab, but on the inside, it's at least a quarter Urbie... that's where the new ballistic mounting hardware came from. I'm honestly amazed that this thing even works, but it does, and it's ours now!
column2: 你瞧，老大，我们弄到一台拼装机甲！看着像螃蟹，但里面至少有四分之一是城市仔……新的弹道挂载硬件就是从那儿来的。老实说我很惊讶这东西居然能用，但它确实能用，而且现在是我们的了！

column1: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 龙 1N 是一台皮糙肉厚的机器，能承受沉重打击，但武器配置略显单薄。不过作为重型机甲，它移动得很快，因此非常适合逼近较慢的目标发动近战攻击。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets, a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮和大型激光的强大威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来，是致命的组合。这些机甲能从中远距离一路打到贴身距离，在战斗中灵活多变、出人意料。 特性：改进冷却套 - 自动炮 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry, even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 潜行者 3F 搭载的武器多到离谱，即便对突击机甲来说也是如此。它还以极其糟糕的散热管理著称，这正是如此惊人输出能力的代价。强大，但要善加使用。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 该机于 3144 年在田纳西河谷竞技场首次亮相，由玛丽·科斯塔驾驶。这台机器上最引人注目的技术是虚空信号系统，其次是取代了原有卡佩兰式星盾隐形装甲的部族规格铁纤维装甲，以及十一台双散热器。武器方面，原本的双联 MML-3 变成了一具 MML-9 发射器，同时该机甲舍弃轻型粒子炮，换用更多增程中型激光（现为三门）。鱼鹰主动探测器被取消，改为一具改进型纳克导弹信标。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon
column2: 该改型于3144年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由玛丽·科斯塔驾驶，这台机器最引人注目的技术是虚空信号系统，其次是取代其原卡佩兰式星盾隐形装甲的氏族规格铁纤装甲，以及它的十一具双重散热器。武器部分，原本的双MML-3换成了一具MML-9发射器，同时该机甲放弃轻型PPC，改用更多增程中型激光器（现为三门）。它不再有比格犬主动探测器，改为带一具改进型Narc导弹信标

column1: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 狮鹫 1N 利用跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全的位置向对手倾泻火力。不过，如果它们整场都在战场上跳跃着打冷枪，就会过热。 特性：战斗拳套 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: This Griffin was introduced to the Taurian Concordat. It carries a Plasma Cannon and three ER medium lasers. It also has a higher top speed than its inspiration and can jump farther as well.
column2: 这台狮鹫是为金牛座协约国推出的。它装备一门等离子炮和三门增程中型激光，最高速度也比其灵感来源更快，跳跃距离也更远。

column1: The Gundam is a testament to cutting-edge technology and raw power. With advanced weapons and mobility systems, this machine is built for domination on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior provides unrivaled protection from enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent for any force that stands in its way. The Gundam is a technological marvel, and the pilots who use it should be ready for a high-powered and efficient machine. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 高达是尖端技术与原始力量的证明。凭借先进武器与机动系统，这台机器为统治战场而生。其厚重装甲外壳提供无与伦比的防护，使它成为任何阻挡者的可怕对手。高达是技术奇迹，驾驶它的飞行员应准备好迎接一台高性能、高效率的机器。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Gundam is a technological marvel. Its advanced weapons and mobility systems make it a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior offers unparalleled protection from enemy attacks. I'm impressed with its capabilities and I have no doubt it will perform well in combat. Anyone using it should be prepared for a high-powered, efficient machine.
column2: 高达是技术奇迹。其先进武器与机动系统使它成为战场上不容小觑的力量，厚重装甲外壳提供无与伦比的防护。它的能力令我印象深刻，我毫不怀疑它会在战斗中表现出色。使用它的人应准备好迎接一台高性能、高效率的机器。

column1: The “Cinderella” is a high speed flashbulb. Fast and nimble, this Gunsmith variant—developed for Team Godmother with a little help from FedSuns benefactors—features Clan-spec weapons and a laser antimissile system to maximize its reach, hitting power, and accuracy all at once Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: “Cinderella”是一台高速闪光灯。这款 Gunsmith 变型既快速又灵活，由“教母小队”（Team Godmother）在联邦太阳国资助者的一点帮助下开发，配备部族规格武器和一套激光反导弹系统，从而同时最大化其射程、打击力与精度。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: The “Cinderella” is a high speed flashbulb. Fast and nimble, this Gunsmith variant—developed for Team Godmother with a little help from FedSuns benefactors—features Clan-spec weapons and a laser antimissile system to maximize its reach, hitting power, and accuracy all at once
column2: 灰姑娘是一枚高速闪光弹。这台枪匠改型快速灵活——它是为教母小队研发的，并得到联邦太阳赞助人的一点帮助——采用氏族规格武器和一套激光反导弹系统，一举最大化其射程、打击力与精度

column1: This ComStar developed variant is equipped with a pair of Artemis IV-equipped MML-7 launchers with four tons of ammo. It keeps the Gauss Rifle of the standard Highlander and mounts a pair of ER Medium Lasers. CASE II systems protect the Gauss Rifle and missile ammunition from explosions. A C3 Slave unit allows the Highlander to share targeting data. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款由通讯之星开发的改型装备两具带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 MML-7 发射器，配 4 吨弹药。它保留了标准 Highlander 的高斯步枪，并加装两门增程中型激光。CASE II 系统可防止高斯步枪弹药和导弹弹药发生爆炸。C3 从属单元让 Highlander 能够共享瞄准数据。 特性：强化腿部 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: This ComStar developed variant is equipped with a pair of Artemis IV-equipped MML-7 launchers with four tons of ammo. It keeps the Gauss Rifle of the standard Highlander and mounts a pair of ER Medium Lasers. CASE II systems protect the Gauss Rifle and missile ammunition from explosions. A C3 Slave unit allows the Highlander to share targeting data.
column2: 这一康星研发的改型装备一对带阿尔忒弥斯IV的MML-7发射器和四吨弹药。它保留标准高地人的磁轨炮，并装有一对增程中型激光器。CASE II系统保护磁轨炮与导弹弹药免于爆炸。一套C3从属系统让高地人能共享瞄准数据。

column1: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Anastasia is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The 'Mech is a hulking brute that moves fairly slow yet hits hard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: HBK-LGN-Pin“丑继妹阿纳斯塔西娅”（Ugly Stepsister Anastasia）由三台不同战斗机甲的部件拼装而成：一台 3050 年代出产的驼背、一台早期批次的军团士兵（Legionnaire）以及一台部族制造的翼羽（Pinion）。这台机甲是一头笨重迟缓却打击凶狠的巨兽。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Anastasia is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The 'Mech is a hulking brute that moves fairly slow yet hits hard.
column2: HBK-LGN-Pin"丑继姐"阿纳斯塔西娅由三台截然不同的战斗机甲的部件拼装而成：一台3050年代的老式驼背、一台早期批次的军团兵，以及一台氏族制造的翼羽。这台机甲是个庞大的蛮物，移动相当缓慢，但打击沉重。

column1: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Drizella is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The mech has a decent speed and carries enough laser weapons to host a lethal, but short-ranged, rave party. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: HBK-LGN-Pin“丑姐妹”德里泽拉由三台不同战斗机甲的部件组装而成：一台3050年代的驼背、一批早期生产的军团兵，以及一台部族制造的翼羽。该机甲速度尚可，携带的激光武器足以开一场致命但射程有限的狂欢派对。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Drizella is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The mech has a decent speed and carries enough laser weapons to host a lethal, but short-ranged, rave party.
column2: HBK-LGN-Pin"丑继姐"德莉泽拉由三台截然不同的战斗机甲的部件拼装而成：一台3050年代的老式驼背、一台早期批次的军团兵，以及一台氏族制造的翼羽。这台机甲速度不错，携带的激光武器足以举办一场致命但短程的电音派对。

column1: The JagerMech S model is highly specialized at long-range Autocannon fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 猎手机甲 S 型号高度专精于远程自动炮火力支援。不过它没有多少防护，近距离武器也不多，所以要让它保持距离、远离危险。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 迅捷D发热高、跑得快，但能迅速跃进战斗打出一记击倒重拳，即便面对更重的单位也一样。不过，这种速度与火力上的能力往往以装甲较薄为代价。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: In 2775 as Aleksander Kerensky's forces were tightening the noose around the Amaris Empire, weapons development became increasingly frantic in hopes of finding a miracle weapon to turn the tides of the war. The most well known of these is the Matar, commonly referred to as Amaris' Folly, an attempt to create a BattleMech able to withstand an entire company. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 2775 年，当 Aleksander Kerensky 的部队正逐步收紧对 Amaris 帝国的绞索时，武器研发变得愈发疯狂，人们希望找到一种奇迹武器来扭转战局。其中最有名的便是 Matar——通常被称为“Amaris 的蠢行”——其目标是造出一台能抵挡整整一个连队的战斗机甲。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Superheavy Prototype
column2: 超重型原型

column1: In 2775 as Aleksander Kerensky's forces were tightening the noose around the Amaris Empire, weapons development became increasingly frantic in hopes of finding a miracle weapon to turn the tides of the war. The most well known of these is the Matar, commonly referred to as Amaris' Folly, an attempt to create a BattleMech able to withstand an entire company.
column2: 2775年，当亚历山大·克伦斯基的部队正收紧对阿马里斯帝国的绞索时，武器研发变得愈发疯狂，只为找到一件能扭转战局的奇迹武器。其中最著名的是玛塔尔，通常被称为“阿马里斯之愚”——一次尝试造出一台能抗衡整个连队的战斗机甲。

column1: This Mongoose variant was developed for the SLDF Gunslinger Program, but never saw service. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这款Mongoose变型是为SLDF枪手计划研发的，但从未投入使用。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: This is one fast ghost. Invisible and packing a nasty punch; its a shame the star league never put this one into production.
column2: 这是个快得吓人的幽灵。隐形且带着凶狠的一击；可惜星盟从没把这一款投入生产。

column1: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 猎户座 K 是第一台真正的重型机甲。作为多面手近战机甲，猎户座能在各种距离上迎战敌人，凭借充足的装甲，它能在集火下坚持相当长的时间。速度是慢，但威力强大。 特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 黑豹 9R 是性能均衡的全能机甲，只是速度稍慢。它凭借跳跃推进器、可观的装甲以及招牌粒子炮的沉重打击弥补了这一缺憾，甚至曾被用于近身肉搏战并取得不错的效果。 特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Originally built as a new assault class mech by Jade Falcon just three years after Project Eryie the Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM is based on the venerable 50 ton Phoenix Hawk LAM but almost twice as heavy at 90 tons. The Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM features as close as possible speed and agility to the original Phoenix Hawk LAM making it an effective fast interdiction unit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM 最初由翡翠隼在"鹰眼计划"仅三年后作为新型突击级机甲建造，它基于经典的 50 吨凤凰鹰 LAM，但重近一倍，达 90 吨。其速度与灵活度尽可能贴近原版凤凰鹰 LAM，使其成为有效的快速拦截单位。 特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM
column2: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM

column1: Originally built as a new assault class mech by Jade Falcon just three years after Project Eryie the Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM is based on the venerable 50 ton Phoenix Hawk LAM but almost twice as heavy at 90 tons. The Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM features as close as possible speed and agility to the original Phoenix Hawk LAM making it an effective fast interdiction unit.
column2: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM 最初是翡翠猎鹰在 Eryie 计划之后仅三年作为新型突击级机甲打造的，它以久经考验的 50 吨凤凰鹰 LAM 为基础，但重量几乎翻倍，达到 90 吨。凤凰鹰 IIC LAM 的速度与灵活性尽可能贴近原版凤凰鹰 LAM，使其成为高效的快速拦截单位。

column1: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, not surprising that at some point the Clanners decided to refit one and see what they could get out of it. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 该系统于2692年为星际联盟防御军皇家师团研发，因此部族成员后来决定改装一台、看看能从中榨出什么性能，也就不足为奇了。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: Phoenix Hawk LAM C
column2: 凤凰鹰 LAM C

column1: Wow, and here I thought that clanners were against such things. Jade Falcon been running some serious secret R&D.
column2: 哇，我还以为氏族反对这类东西。翡翠猎鹰一直在搞一些相当厉害的秘密研发。

column1: Similar to the C configuration, the F configuration of the Raptor carries five ER Medium Lasers and adds three additional double heat sinks. The Raptor F has added maneuverability with the addition of seven jump jets, allowing it to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 与 C 配置相似，猛禽 F 配置携带五门 ER 中型激光，并额外加装三台双倍散热器。F 型通过加装七个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳起至二百一十米。 特质：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.93 臂部驱动器限制：全能

column1: Thunderbolt SE models lose a little of their firepower in exchange for mounting Jump Jets. The greater mobility is intended to allow for more precision attacking maneuvers, though it all depends on the battlefield terrain. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 雷霆 SE 各型号牺牲了一点火力，以换装跳跃推进器。更高的机动性旨在实现更精准的攻击机动，不过这一切都取决于战场地形。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Debuted in 3140 on The Coliseum Arena and piloted by Kaley Macdonald, this Trebuchet upgrade is actually based more on a Clan Invasion-era model than the older medium support raider. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这一投石车升级型于3140年在竞技场首次登场，由凯莉·麦克唐纳驾驶，其基础实际上更多来自部族入侵时代的型号，而非那台更古老的中型支援袭击者。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Debuted in 3140 on The Coliseum Arena and piloted by Kaley Macdonald, this Trebuchet upgrade is actually based more on a Clan Invasion-era model than the older medium support raider.
column2: 该改型于3140年在斗兽场竞技场首次亮相，由卡莉·麦克唐纳驾驶，这次投石机升级实际上更多基于氏族入侵时代的型号，而非更古老的中型支援袭扰者。

column1: Local news sources have started purchasing these retrofitted camera mechs for filming live combat. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 当地新闻机构已开始购买这些加装了摄像设备的改装机甲，用于拍摄实况战斗。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.77 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Local news sources have started purchasing these retrofitted camera mechs for filming live combat.
column2: 本地新闻机构已开始采购这些改装过的摄影机甲，用于拍摄实况战斗。

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Hartford Gardens Arena and piloted by Robert Benson, The Beast is a remote-operated drone controlled from the copilot seat of the Watchman known as Belle and may well be a triumph of modern military technology. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 野兽于3144年在哈特福德花园竞技场首次亮相，由罗伯特·本森驾驶。它是一架遥控无人机，从名为“美人”的守夜人副驾驶座上操控，很可能代表了现代军事技术的一项成就。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Hartford Gardens Arena and piloted by Robert Benson, The Beast is a remote-operated drone controlled from the copilot seat of the Watchman known as Belle and may well be a triumph of modern military technology.
column2: 凶兽于3144年在哈特福德花园竞技场首次亮相，由罗伯特·本森驾驶，它是一具遥控无人机，从名为"贝尔"的守夜人副驾驶座操控，很可能堪称现代军事技术的杰作。

column1: Debuted in 3141 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Ira Kuhn-Bedard, the variant keeps the best features of this hundred-year-old machine and make it even better. With Clan Ferro-Lamellor Armor improving its resistance to nearly all forms of damage and combined with a Clan-spec XL Engine model instead of the original Inner Sphere one to improve endurance. MASC boosting its land speed, and four Clan ER Medium Lasers replacing all the original weaponry. A Hatchet has been fitted to make it more Solaris Games enabled. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 该变型于 3141 年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由伊拉·库恩-贝达德驾驶；它保留了这具百年老机体最优秀的特点，并使其更加出色。部族铁鳞装甲提升了它对几乎所有伤害形式的抵抗力，同时以部族规格的 XL 引擎取代原本的内层星域型号，以增强耐久性。MASC 提升了它的地面速度，四门部族中型增程激光则替换了原有的全部武器。此外还加装了一把战斧，使其更适应 Solaris 竞技赛。 特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Solaris Mech
column2: 索拉里斯机甲

column1: Debuted in 3141 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Ira Kuhn-Bedard, the variant keeps the best features of this hundred-year-old machine and make it even better. With Clan Ferro-Lamellor Armor improving its resistance to nearly all forms of damage and combined with a Clan-spec XL Engine model instead of the original Inner Sphere one to improve endurance. MASC boosting its land speed, and four Clan ER Medium Lasers replacing all the original weaponry. A Hatchet has been fitted to make it more Solaris Games enabled.
column2: 该改型于3141年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由伊拉·库恩-贝达德驾驶，它保留了这台百年老兵的最佳特性并使其更加出色。氏族铁甲装甲提升了它对几乎所有伤害形式的抗性，并以氏族规格的XL引擎型号取代原本的内天体型号以提升续战力。MASC提升了它的地面速度，四门氏族增程中型激光器替换了原有的全部武器。它还装上了一把斧头，使其更适合索拉里斯赛事。

column1: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 幽灵亚历山大由安吉莉克·克劳指导、为兹尔布里根马疚研制，融合了部族与内层星域的实验技术，打造出一台独一无二的机甲。它采用部族制造的XL引擎以保持高速，并腾出空间安装更多装备。跳跃推进器、内骨架结构和短管粒子炮均为内层星域制造，而两具增程中型激光、铁纤维装甲和一对部分翼则出自部族之手。这对部分翼将幽灵的跳跃距离提升至270米。 特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters.
column2: 在安吉莉克·克劳的指导下为泽尔布林根马疚研发，幽灵亚历山大融合了氏族与内天体的实验科技，造出一台独特的机甲。采用氏族制造的XL引擎保持高速度，并允许安装更多装备。跳跃推进器、内层钢结构和短鼻PPC都是内天体制造，但两门增程中型激光器、铁纤装甲和一对部分翼由氏族建造。部分翼将幽灵的跳跃距离提升到270米。

column1: They've got to be kicking themselves for letting their VIP go out without more security. Their screw-up is our payday, though.
column2: 他们一定在懊悔让贵宾没有更多护卫就出门。不过他们的失误就是我们的收获。

column1: We have a VIP at a base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just received a garbled transmission from a local agent that the base will be attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They're striking at the VIP, and they know our forces are not in position to come to his aid. We need a team of competent mercenaries to protect the facility and our personnel.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处基地有一位贵宾，刚收到当地特工发来的混乱讯息，称基地将遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的袭击。他们的目标就是这位贵宾，而且他们知道我军的兵力无法及时赶到救援。我们需要一支能干的雇佣兵小队来保护设施和我们的人员。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Defend {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} Base
column2: 守卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}基地

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Vanguard
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 先锋

column1: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses
column2: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

column1: Protect the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} VIP
column2: 保护{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}VIP

column1: As expected, we have multiple incoming {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
column2: 不出所料，我们遭遇到多个来袭的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位.

column1: Commander, we need to protect the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base and keep the VIP safe.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要保护这座{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，确保VIP的安全.

column1: Escort them to the generators and we can boost our firepower and repel the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
column2: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们可以加强自身火力，击退{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队.

column1: Hold the base, keep the buildings upright, and eliminate any threats. Oliveira out.
column2: 守住基地，保持建筑物屹立不倒，同时消灭任何威胁. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Our employers are providing us with extra support, Commander.
column2: 我们的雇主正在为我们提供额外的支援，指挥官.

column1: The engineers are in position and have disembarked from the APCs. The vehicles will scatter and support you; just keep those turrets online.
column2: 工程师已经就位并从装甲运兵车上下来了. 现在车辆将会散开支援你; 请保持那些炮台在线.

column1: Garrison Duty
column2: 守备任务

column1: Commander, while there's a lot of fighting in the region, the supply depot is well behind the current front lines. I can't help but be suspicious about their 'no intel' claim.
column2: 指挥官，虽然该区域战斗频繁，但补给站远在当前前线之后。对他们“没有情报”的说法，我实在无法不起疑心。

column1: We have a centralized supply depot here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, located to support multiple fronts of hostile action. With so many troops elsewhere, we're looking for a lance of Mercs to babysit our outpost. We have no intel that suggests a specific threat, but better to be certain.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一个集中补给站，用来支援多个敌对战线的行动。由于兵力大多调往他处，我们想找一支雇佣兵分队来看守我们的前哨。没有任何情报显示存在特定威胁，但还是稳妥为上。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Defend {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Supply Buildings
column2: 守卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}补给建筑

column1: Escort friendly vehicles to Base Defenses
column2: 护送友方车辆前往基地防御设施

column1: Guard the supply depot
column2: 守卫补给站

column1: Buckle up, Commander. This is going to get exciting.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 好戏要开场了.

column1: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!
column2: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

column1: Maybe this will be a quiet contract for once--
column2: 也许这次合约能消停一回——

column1: Scratch that, Commander. Orbital imagery is showing multiple incoming hostile contacts.
column2: 当我没说，指挥官. 轨道影像正显示多批敌方目标正在逼近.

column1: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
column2: 他们在基地周边布置了近距离防御设施，不过目前处于离线状态。

column1: Professional Ethics
column2: 职业道德

column1: The Professional
column2: 专家

column1: Why would anyone give their target a warning? And what the hell does 'professional ethics' mean? This is bizarre.
column2: 怎么会有人去警告自己的目标？还有"职业操守"到底是什么意思？这太诡异了。

column1: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, \"professional ethics.\" We have no idea what that means.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们有一个极其古怪的任务给你。我们在下面那颗行星上有一处制造设施，我们一直知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队在附近侦察。我们预计他们会有所动作，但没料到他们会……事先给我们发警告？显然他们雇了一名雇佣兵，那人联系我们告知攻击将在何时进行，因为——我引用原话——"职业操守"。我们完全不明白那是什么意思。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Defend Manufacturing Facility
column2: 守卫制造设施

column1: Argo, my engineers are powering the turrets up now. The APCs will scatter and provide support.
column2: 阿尔戈号，我的工程师正在启动炮台. 装甲运兵车将散开提供支援.

column1: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
column2: 阿尔戈号，这里是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}本地司令部. 我们的炮台因破坏而失效了.

column1: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
column2: 我有一队工程师，他们能手动重启炮台，但只能亲自在炮台控制站做到.

column1: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
column2: 收到，本地指挥部. 指挥官，看来我们这边要有些枪炮了.

column1: The manufacturing facility is just up ahead. Meyer, any sign of our polite opposition?
column2: 制造设施就在前面. 梅耶尔，有什么我们彬彬有礼的对手的迹象吗?

column1: To prove which of us is better: your whole company... or me.
column2: 来证明我们哪个更好些: 你的整个公司...还是我.

column1: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
column2: 真是一场该死的灾难。我们回轨道上做简报吧。

column1: Clever Girl
column2: 聪明的女孩

column1: The Raptors are notorious for using coordinated unit tactics, flanking, and misdirection. Be on your guard, Commander.
column2: 猛禽组织以运用协同单位战术、侧翼包抄和声东击西而臭名昭著. 请保持警惕，指挥官.

column1: The Raptors are holed up at their Salinization Plant, converting all the raw materials they can get their hands on into salt. Intercepted transmissions from the facility have been somewhat garbled, but they're apparently on the brink of setting up something called a 'salt meme economy', whatever that is. What they're up to doesn't really matter; we're going to go in, demolish their operation, take them out, and collect that bounty.
column2: 那些猛禽窝在他们的盐碱化工厂里，把能弄到手的原材料全变成盐。从该设施截获的通讯有些含混不清，但他们显然即将建立一种叫"盐梗经济"的东西，管它是什么。他们在搞什么都不重要；我们要进去，捣毁他们的运作，干掉他们，然后领走那笔赏金。

column1: Destroy All Raptor Forces
column2: 消灭所有猛禽部队

column1: Destroy Raptor Reinforcements
column2: 消灭猛禽增援部队

column1: Destroy Salinization Plant and Escape
column2: 摧毁盐碱化工厂并撤离

column1: Destroy the Salinization Plant
column2: 摧毁盐碱化工厂

column1: Move in, engage the base defenses, and start the demolition.
column2: 行动，和基地的防御力量交火，然后开始拆毁基地.

column1: The Raptor garrison is still on-site, so be ready for opposition.
column2: 猛禽的驻军仍在现场，做好迎敌准备.

column1: The Salinization Plant is just up ahead, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，盐碱化工厂就在前方.

column1: They've got multiple units protecting this facility. Be careful not to get caught in an ambush.
column2: 他们有多支部队保护这座设施。小心别被伏击。

column1: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
column2: 我不喜欢这听起来的样子，指挥官。没有卫星覆盖就没有地形情报。我们要在没有地图的情况下进入未知局面。

column1: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.[WARNING: Zombies]

column1: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.[WARNING: Zombies]

column1: Darius brings to the briefing an issue that has lingered on the back-burner ever since that ill-fated Contract to eliminate a defector from the Draconis Combine.

\n\"The Mercenary Review Board has finally reviewed our claim of Non-Payment, and have invited us to a sit down with the House Kurita envoy, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],Shugo Yamaguchi]].\"
\nSumire bristles in her chair. \"Finally! I say we take our pound of flesh, and an extra pound for our troubles!\"
\nDarius shakes his head. \"I can't believe I'm suggesting walking away from C-Bills, but If we allow Yamaguchi to save face here, we could gain a significant boost in our reputation with Kurita.\"

\nDr. Murad clears her throat and pauses, holding the room's attention. \"Remember how the Shugo delegated the contract to his [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],underling]], so he could rush off to Herotitus? The notorious pleasure planet?\" She pauses again before adding,  \"Do you think we could get some leverage from that?\"
column2:
达里乌斯在简报会上提出一个自那次不幸的清除龙尼斯联合体叛逃者合约以来一直搁置的问题。

"雇佣兵审查委员会终于审理了我们关于未付款的申诉，并邀请我们与栗田家族特使[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],山口修护]]坐下来谈谈。"

苏米蕾在椅子上浑身一紧。"终于！我说咱们得拿走应得的血肉，再额外多拿一磅辛苦费！"

达里乌斯摇摇头。"我简直不敢相信我会建议放弃C币，但如果我们让山口在这儿保住面子，我们与栗田的声望可能会有显著提升。"

穆拉德博士清了清嗓子，顿了顿，把全场的注意力都抓住了。"还记得吗，那位修护把合约委派给了他的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],下属]]，好让自己赶去赫罗提图斯？那颗臭名昭著的享乐星球？"她又停了一下，然后补上一句："你们觉得我们能拿这件事做点文章吗？"

column1: We have an operative in place in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility, and for the past year they've been gathering sensitive research data for us. They've notified us that they're ready for us to extract the data, and we need a deniable force to arrange that extraction. The research facility is not connected to any data networks, and all the secure laboratories are far enough underground that wireless data signals are blocked. To get the information out, we're going to need to position a satellite receiver directly above the site. Your task will be to place positioning beacons to allow the satellite to lock on to the research data signal and download it.

column1: We have an operative in place in a covert {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility, and for the past year they've been gathering sensitive research data for us. They've notified us that they're ready for us to extract the data, and we need a deniable force to arrange that extraction. The research facility is not connected to any data networks, and all the secure laboratories are far enough underground that wireless data signals are blocked. To get the information out, we're going to need to position a satellite receiver directly above the site. Your task will be to place positioning beacons to allow the satellite to lock on to the research data signal and download it.

column1: There is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base in this region. We have the equipment to level it, however our recon capability has been diminished. We would like you to take a team and attack the installation. Place beacons for our artillery to target, and exfiltrate while our guns destroy the base.
column2: 该区域有一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的基地. 我们有夷平它的装备，但侦察能力已受损. 我们希望你们派一支小队攻击该设施，为我们的火炮放置目标指示信标，然后在我方炮火摧毁基地时撤离.

column1: We are engaged in delicate negotiations with a private manufacturer from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} space, but we have reached an impasse. Your team will provide on-site assistance to target an abandoned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base near the trade conference. We'll have a WarShip standing by to light it up… dramatically.

column1: Commander, one of our senior operatives has defected to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They know far too much about our operations to be allowed to share their knowledge with their new friends. It seems the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} handlers have realized how valuable the knowledge our operative possesses is, because they're being held in an extremely secure facility, deep underground. Such extreme defensive measures probably makes them feel as though they're untouchable. We have a military DropShip with a naval PPC on station to demonstrate to them just how touchable they are. We need you to help us precisely target the PPC.
column2: 指挥官，我们一名高级特工叛逃到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}。他们对我们行动的知情太多，不能容许他们把所知分享给新朋友。看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的接头人已经意识到我们特工掌握的情报有多宝贵，因为他们被关押在一处极其安全、深埋地下的设施里。这种极端的防御措施大概让他们觉得自己不可触及。我们在轨道上有一艘装备舰载PPC的军用空投艇，可以演示给他们看他们有多可触及。我们需要你帮我们精准瞄准那门PPC。

column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 这个任性的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}科学家在回家的路上了.

column2: 苏米尔会等候你的信号来接应你. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column2: 敌人肯定会料到有人要尝试图突破他们的包围，所以会有激烈抵抗.

You will sweep aside the opposition, recover our VIP, and transport her to a designated landing zone for extraction. Be prepared for opposition - the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units surrounding the embassy won't let you extract our personnel without a fight. Payment will be issued when you deliver our VIP alive and in one piece.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们的一位贵宾在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施里。我们需要把她送出行星，但那栋建筑被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队包围。你要清扫对手，接回我们的贵宾，并把她送到指定着陆区撤离。为遭遇抵抗做好准备——包围使馆的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队不会让你安然带走我们的人员。当贵宾活着、完好地送到时，报酬即行支付。[警告：丧尸]

Before joining our side, this defector worked at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on this planet. She claims she was responsible for extracting data from a device that sounds, from her descriptions, very much like a Star League era memory core. We don't know what data is on it, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} cannot be allowed to keep it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}叛逃者给了我们一条极其有趣且时效紧迫的情报，我们需要快速反应。在投向我们这边之前，这名叛逃者在这颗行星上的一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施工作。她声称自己负责从一个装置中提取数据，从她的描述看，那东西非常像星盟时代的记忆核心。我们不知道上面是什么数据，但不能让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}留着它。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, and no prisoners.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲小队一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们烧毁居民点、焚烧农田与炼油厂、劫掠仓储设施。他们显然在尽其所能把我们的人赶走。这是纯粹的恐怖主义。我们需要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不要俘虏。[警告：丧尸]

We'd like you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it.[WARNING: Zombies]

column1: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] sprints into the Command Center, excitedly waving a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMRBC],MercNet]] bulletin.

\n\"Commander, a bounty was just posted against a paramilitary group known as The Raptors, and it appears they're here in this system. I've always suspected they were really pirates and it looks like they finally crossed the line. For years I've hoped to have a chance at taking them down, but they've always proved too clever. No more.\"

\n[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],Darius]] looks over the bulletin, his eyes twinkling as he gets to the numbers at the bottom. \"Say the word Commander, and we'll hit the Raptors hard and collect this bounty. Should be a pretty good payday! The bounty is set at 250,000 c-bills on top of whatever we can salvage on-site.\"
column2:
[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]冲进指挥中心，兴奋地挥舞着一份[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMRBC],雇佣网]]公告。

"指挥官，刚刚发布了一笔针对一个叫"猛禽"的准军事团体的赏金，而他们似乎就在这个星系。我一直怀疑他们其实是海盗，看来他们终于越了线。多年来我一直盼望有机会干掉他们，但他们总是太狡猾。不会再有下次了。"

[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],达里乌斯]]看着公告，当目光落到最下面的数字时眼睛发亮。"你一句话，指挥官，我们就把猛禽狠狠打一顿并领走这笔赏金。应该是笔相当可观的进账！赏金定为25万C币，外加我们在现场能打捞到的一切。"

column2: 重击者加农炮

column1: Red Corsair IV
column2: 红海盗 IV

column1: Never trust a pirate. I've got a bad feeling about this, Commander.
column2: 永远别信海盗。我有种不祥的预感，指挥官。

column1: This is it, Commander. We may have a rare opportunity to bring this pursuit to a close. I have negotiated a duel with the leader of the opposing force versus a combined unit from us both.
column2: 就是这一下了，指挥官。我们可能有一个难得的机会把这场追击画上句号。我已谈妥一场决斗：对方部队的领袖对上我们从双方各出一支组成的联合单位。

column1: Get Ready, She may try anything!
column2: 准备好，她什么都干得出来！

column1: This has been an interesting ride Commander. I wonder how this duel will play out?
column2: 这一路可真够精彩的，指挥官。我很好奇这场决斗会怎么打？

column1: It seems Morgan Kell has arrived on planet. He has challenged us to a trial of combat. We have the advantage. His entire force endured a high G burn from the jump point to get here so fast, so we will be fresh for battle. After we win, it will buy us the time I need to complete my plan.
column2: 看来摩根·凯尔已经抵达行星。他向我们发起了战斗试炼的挑战。我们占据优势。他的全部部队从跳跃点一路承受高G加速才这么快赶到，所以我们会是精力充沛的一方。等我们赢了，就能为我争取到完成计划所需的时间。

column1: Kell is a fool to challenge me. Don't screw up. Just make sure we win this and all will be worth your time.
column2: 凯尔挑战我简直是愚蠢。别搞砸了。只要确保我们赢下这场，你花的时间就都值了。

column1: Expect Some of the Mercs to be less than honest.
column2: 预料部分佣兵不会那么诚实。

column1: You have been invited to a Divisional Round in the 'Gladiator Challange'. The opponent should be ready for you.
column2: 你已被邀请参加"角斗士挑战赛"的分区轮。对手应该已经准备好迎战你了。

column1: Red Corsair
column2: 红海盗

column1: I am getting odd IFF readings from the planet, Commander. It looks like they have been... altered.
column2: 指挥官，我从那颗行星上收到古怪的敌我识别读数。看起来它们被……改动过。

column1: The forces protecting this planet have departed and a local militia has sprouted up in its place. The militia are fighting a losing battle against some especially well-equipped pirates, with no connections to any other group you've encountered. Your assistance in this sensitive matter is requested.
column2: 保护这颗行星的部队已经撤离，取而代之的是一支当地民兵。那支民兵正与一些装备特别精良的海盗打一场必败之仗，那些海盗与你此前遭遇过的任何团体都没有关联。请你协助处理这一敏感事务。

column1: Commander, thank you for the assistance. Our oppposition consists of pirates with high-end equipment and we are struggling.
column2: 指挥官，感谢你的协助。我们的对手是装备高端武器的海盗，我们打得很吃力。

column1: Red Corsair II
column2: 红海盗 II

column1: Wait, the local government Milita are Clan Wolf forces? This is Inner Sphere space. I am still trying to wrap my head around this one Commander.
column2: 等等，当地政府的民兵是狼族部队？这里是内天体空间。指挥官，我到现在还没想明白这件事。

column1: These 'Militia' as they call themselves are freeborn Clan Wolf warriors. They don't belong in the inner sphere, and I am trying to drive them out. Break through their front lines then we will take down their base.
column2: 这些自称"民兵"的人是狼族氏族的自由出生者战士。他们不属于内天体，而我在试图把他们赶出去。突破他们的前线，然后我们就拿下他们的基地。

column1: Destroy the Militia Lances
column2: 摧毁民兵分队

column1: You will see for yourself. Up ahead should be a second line unit or better Touman.
column2: 你会亲眼看到的。前方应该是二等部队或更好的图曼。

column1: Red Corsair III
column2: 红海盗 III

column1: Time to kick the Clan Pups off this ball of rock. Engage their base and clear out any remaining Touman.
column2: 该把那些部族崽子从这块石头上踢下去了。攻击他们的基地，清掉任何残留部队。

column1: Capture the Militia Facility
column2: 夺取民兵设施

column1: If we can kick Clan Pup hard enough here it will break their ability to resist and I can finish driving them off of this world.
column2: 如果我们能在这里狠狠踢小狗族一脚，就能打断他们的抵抗能力，我就能把他们彻底赶出这颗行星。

column1: Well, looks like we're going to stop a disaster today instead of starting one, for a change.
column2: 好吧，看来今天我们是要阻止一场灾难，而不是引发一场，算是换换花样。

column1: Things are going well. It seems Kell has lured the Corsair out for single battle. However, I have come upon information this was not her real goal. We discovered there is a nuclear warhead device being set up in the potential area of the duel. We will need you to deploy to draw off any defenders while we attempt to gain access and disarm the device. Expect heavy resistance.
column2: 事情进展顺利。看来凯尔已经把海盗引出来进行单挑了。不过我查到情报，说这并不是她真正的目的。我们发现决斗可能发生的区域里正被安放一件核弹头装置。我们需要你部署出去引开任何守军，而我们尝试接近并拆除该装置。预期会遇到强烈抵抗。

column1: Let's get in there and stop the Red Corsair's plan. Lord Commander has given us the coordinates of the nuclear device.
column2: 我们进去，阻止红海盗的计划。领主指挥官已经把核装置的坐标给了我们。

column1: What a Charlie Foxtrot, Commander.
column2: 真是一团乱麻，指挥官。

column1: Now we are being ambushed by Clan Wolf. How can this day get any worse? I need you to head out and defend our east flank, Commander.
column2: 现在我们又遭到狼族伏击。这一天还能更糟吗？我需要你出去防守我们的东翼，指挥官。

column1: We are getting multiple contacts.
column2: 我们正在接收多个接触信号。

column1: We have our work cut out for us on this one. We have to make sure these guys stay safe so they can get back in the fight and help us.
column2: 这一票我们得下大功夫。我们必须确保这些人安全无余，好让他们能重新投入战斗并帮助我们。

column1: Glad you're still with us. Since setting up this outpost we have been constantly harassed by the Red Corsair and her pirate goons. They must be making a tidy profit since she can afford some seriously advanced technlogy. Let's protect the base and give our personnel a chance to recuperate
column2: 很高兴你还活着。自打建起这座前哨，我们就不断遭到红海盗和她的海盗喽啰骚扰。他们一定赚得盆满钵满，因为她买得起一些相当先进的技术。让我们守住基地，给手下人一个喘息的机会

column1: A chance to dish out some pain back to the enemy, always my favorite.
column2: 有机会把痛苦还给敌人，永远是我最喜欢的。

column1: We need you to search for and destroy any pirate stragglers, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你搜寻并消灭任何落单的海盗。

column1: Glad we could get some revenge on these Solahma!... I mean Pirates.
column2: 很高兴我们能对这些索拉赫玛报一箭之仇！……我是说海盗。

column1: It definately feels like a festive engagement.
column2: 这确实像是一场节日般的交战。

column1: We're under heavy assault from Kell's Hounds. I need you to take out the advancing forces while I prepare to meet with their leaders. We have almost made it to the goal. I am thrilled you decided to stick around. The party is going to be fun.
column2: 我们正遭到凯尔猎犬的猛烈攻击。我需要你在准备会见他们领袖时干掉那些推进的部队。我们几乎就要达成目标了。我很高兴你决定留下。这场派对会很有趣。

column1: Destroy the Hound's Lances
column2: 摧毁猎犬的分队

column1: We have enemy contact, I would recommend a solid firing line. Tactics should not be one of their strong suites.
column2: 发现敌军接触，我建议排成稳固的射击线。战术应该不是他们的强项之一。

column1: The Annihilator is an extremely rare 'Mech that is essentially a mobile siege tower. It can kick out more damage than almost any other unit on the field. It's unbelievably slow, though, and poorly armored for its size. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 歼灭者是一种极为稀有的机甲，本质上是一座可移动的攻城塔，能打出的伤害几乎超过战场上的任何其他单位。但它慢得难以置信，就体型而言装甲也很差。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Annihilator is an extremely rare 'Mech that is essentially a mobile siege tower. It can kick out more damage than almost any other unit on the field. It's unbelievably slow, though, and poorly armored for its size.
column2: 歼灭者是一种极为稀有的机甲，本质上是一座移动的攻城塔。它能比战场上几乎任何其他单位打出更多伤害。不过它慢得难以置信，就其体型而言装甲也很差。

column1: The Archer's 2S variant trades some of its long-range punch to become even deadlier when it gets up close, mounting SRMs to follow up what its LRMs have battered. Its heat management still poses a huge problem, though, so its pilots have to stay very wary of overheating. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 弓箭手的2S变型牺牲了部分远程打击力，换来近身后的更强杀伤力——它加装的SRM能在LRM轰击之后继续追击。不过它的散热依然是一大难题，机师必须时刻警惕过热。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: The Archer's 2S variant trades some of its long-range punch to become even deadlier when it gets up close, mounting SRMs to follow up what its LRMs have battered. Its heat management still poses a huge problem, though, so its pilots have to stay very wary of overheating.
column2: 弓手的2S改型牺牲部分远程打击力，以便在近身时更加致命，加装SRM来跟进其LRM已经打坏的部位。不过它的热量管理仍是巨大问题，所以其飞行员必须非常警惕过热。

column1: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the "missile boat" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 广为人知的弓手是“导弹母舰”概念的典范，常被发现躲在山头后方，向目标倾泻致命的LRM弹群。它在较近距离的交战中也不算差。唯一真正的弱点是糟糕的热量管理。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the \"missile boat\" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management.
column2: 著名的弓手是"导弹艇"概念的典范。它常被发现躲在土丘的安全后方，向目标抛掷致命的LRM弹群。在近距离战斗中它也不差。它唯一真正的弱点是糟糕透顶的热量管理。

column1: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: Atlas 是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人眼花缭乱的各种武器。它还以通常搭载尽可能多的装甲而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存下来。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: The personal 'Mech of the mysterious Red Corsair started life as a Royal BLR-1Gbc model, but was refitted with Clan-tech weaponry and structural components. A single ER PPC is located in each arm, with a Large Pulse Laser installed in the center torso, and all six of the medium lasers are upgraded to medium pulse lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks manage the heat generated by these weapons. To command her force, the Red Corsair's BattleMaster mounted a Command Console in the head. Sixteen tons of standard armor protected an Endo Steel skeleton and an XL engine. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21
column2: 神秘的“红海盗”（Red Corsair）的座机最初是皇家 BLR-1Gbc 型，但被改装上了部族科技武器与结构部件。每条手臂各装有一门增程粒子炮，中央躯干内装有一门大型脉冲激光，六门中型激光则全部升级为中型脉冲激光。二十一台双散热器负责处理这些武器产生的热量。为指挥她的部队，红海盗的战斗大师（BattleMaster）在头部装有一台指挥控制台。十六吨标准装甲保护着内骨架结构和 XL 引擎。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.21

column1: The personal 'Mech of the mysterious Red Corsair started life as a Royal BLR-1Gbc model, but was refitted with Clan-tech weaponry and structural components. A single ER PPC is located in each arm, with a Large Pulse Laser installed in the center torso, and all six of the medium lasers are upgraded to medium pulse lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks manage the heat generated by these weapons. To command her force, the Red Corsair's BattleMaster mounted a Command Console in the head. Sixteen tons of standard armor protected an Endo Steel skeleton and an XL engine.
column2: 这位神秘红海盗的私人机甲最初是皇家BLR-1Gbc型，但改装了氏族科技武器与结构组件。两臂各装一门增程PPC，中央躯干装一门大型脉冲激光器，六门中型激光器全部升级为中型脉冲激光器。二十一具双重散热器处理这些武器产生的热量。为指挥她的部队，红海盗的战斗大师在头部装了一台指挥控制台。十六吨标准装甲保护着内层钢骨架和一具XL引擎。

column1: I've never seen anything like this, Commander. This 'Mech oozes deadly grace and can obviously devastate anything in its path. It's otherworldly, but clearly influenced by Star League tech. It has a mounted artillery piece to boot, I wonder where it came from. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 我从没见过这样的东西，指挥官。这台机甲散发着致命的优雅，显然能摧毁路上的一切。它非人间所有，却明显受星际联盟技术影响。它还装了一门火炮，我真想知道它从哪来。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: I've never seen anything like this, Commander. This 'Mech oozes deadly grace and can obviously devastate anything in its path. It's otherworldly, but clearly influenced by Star League tech. It has a mounted artillery piece to boot, I wonder where it came from.
column2: 我从没见过这样的东西，指挥官。这台机甲散发着致命的优雅，显然能摧毁路上的一切。它非人间所有，却明显受星际联盟技术影响。它还装了一门火炮，我真想知道它从哪来。

column1: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 掠夺者最初由通用汽车公司于2612年制造，用作攻击与直射火力支援战斗机甲。作为首款摆脱以往人形机甲传统造型的机甲，掠夺者是有史以来最负盛名的机甲之一，最初被寄望于开启机甲的新一代。遗憾的是，随着星际联盟的覆灭，这一代新机甲终究未能真正成形。不过就自身实力而言，掠夺者是一台极具毁灭性的强力机甲，唯有潜行者、战斗大师等更大型的机体才能压过它一头。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: The RFL-3N Rifleman is as well known for its terrible armor as for its ability to hammer opponents from long range. It has only average speed and poor heat sinking ability, but if you can put it in the right position, it can rain death on anything it surveys. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: RFL-3N Rifleman 以装甲薄弱闻名，也以能从远距离猛击对手而闻名。它的速度平平，散热能力也很差，但只要你能把它摆到合适的位置，它就能让视野内的一切目标沐浴在死亡之雨中。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The RFL-3N Rifleman is as well known for its terrible armor as for its ability to hammer opponents from long range. It has only average speed and poor heat sinking ability, but if you can put it in the right position, it can rain death on anything it surveys.
column2: “步枪手 3N”以其可怕的装甲和远距离打击对手的能力而闻名. 尽管它只有平均水平的速度以及极差的散热能力，但在正确的位置它会对能看到的一切降下死亡之雨.

column1: Darius calls you to the bridge. \"My contacts came through, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've got a lead on the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]].\" A grainy image fills the viewscreen. \"What you're looking at is a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],Baumann Group]] distribution center on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreIndependence],Independence]]. Every scrap of exotic contraband that's been turning up on the black market has gone through this site.\"
\nSumire nods thoughtfully. \"Sounds good, XO. I'll mark it on the star map. When we're ready to check it out, just let me know.\"

\n\"One other thing, Commander.\" Darius pulls up a dossier on the viewscreen. \"For 50,000 C-Bills, I can arrange for a portion of Baumann's security team to call in sick on the day of our arrival. Could save us some trouble when we follow up on this.\"
column2: 达里乌斯把你叫到舰桥。"我的联系人办成了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我拿到了关于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]的线索。"一张颗粒感很重的图像占满了显示屏。"你看到的是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],鲍曼集团]]在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreIndependence],独立星]]上的一个配送中心。所有出现在黑市上的异域违禁品，都是从这里流出去的。" 苏米蕾若有所思地点点头。"听起来不错，执行官。我会把它标在星图上。等我们准备去查看时，告诉我一声就行。" "还有一件事，指挥官。"达里乌斯在显示屏上调出一份档案。"给我5万C币，我可以安排鲍曼的部分安保人员在我们抵达那天请病假。这也许能让我们后续追查时省点麻烦。"

column1: (100)-Darius arranges the bribe.
column2: (100) - 达吕斯处理贿赂.

column1: Authorize Darius to arrange the bribe.
column2: 授权达吕斯安排贿赂.

column1: Decline the offer.
column2: 拒绝这个提议.

column1: Supply & Demand
column2: 供需关系

column1: Yang calls you to the MechLab, where you find him standing in the shadow of an enormous ferro-aluminum crate. \"I don't think that the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBountyHunter],Bounty Hunter]] realized what he was giving us, Boss. What we've got is one third of a mothballed assault 'Mech—mostly the guts, so it doesn't look like much to the untrained eye. But what I can tell you is that this 'Mech is strange. Never seen anything quite like it.\"

\nFarah raises her hand. \"And I think I have a lead on the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]]. An old colleague of mine contacted me about a group of patients at the hospital she administrates. They were suffering from what appeared to be [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]-induced injuries. I think it's worth investigating.\"

\nSumire rubs her temples. \"I can't believe I'm saying this, but I've got one, too. A [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],JumpShip]] operator I used to hang with has been running his mouth about a big job he just did for Notker Baumann. Want me to follow up?\"
column2: 杨把你叫到机甲实验室，你看见他站在一只巨大的铁铝合金箱子的阴影里。"我觉得[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBountyHunter],赏金猎人]]没意识到他给了我们什么，老大。我们拿到的是三分之一的封存突击机甲——大部分是内脏，所以在没受过训练的人眼里看着不起眼。但我能告诉你的是，这台机甲很怪。我从没见过类似的东西。" 法拉举起手。"而我想我有一条关于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]的线索。我的一位老同事联系我，说她主管的医院里有一群病人。他们遭受的似乎是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],误跳]]造成的损伤。我觉得值得调查。" 苏米蕾揉着太阳穴。"我简直不敢相信我会这么说，但我也有条线索。一个以前跟我混在一起的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],跃迁舰]]操作员一直在吹嘘他刚为诺特克·鲍曼做的一桩大活。要我去跟进吗？"

column1: Farah calls you to the Argo's Command Center, where you find the viewscreen overflowing with grainy Holo images and dossiers. \"Multiple sources confirm that an unknown spacecraft crashed into a saltwater lake on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore],Mantharaka]] about a month ago. Her surviving crew was medevaced to an orbiting station, where they were all found to have suffered misjump-induced injuries.\"
\n\"That's the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]]!\" Farah pumps her fist, her smile radiant with triumph. \"It has to be!\"

\nDarius nods. \"Yes, and that was the good news. The bad news is, we're not the only company on the derelict's trail. The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackWidow],Black Widow]] has been carving a bloody trail across the Frontier, burning out black market sites on over a dozen worlds. And I have reliable information that she's moving toward Mantharaka.\"
\nSumire shakes her head. \"If we fight the Black Widow, she's gonna end us. This is a bad idea, Commander.\"
\nFarah shrugs. \"So we move fast. If we recover the Dobrev's navigation logs before she gets there, we won't even need to fight.\"
column2: 法拉把你叫到阿戈号的指挥中心，那里显示屏上满是颗粒感强烈的全息影像与档案。"多个来源确认，约一个月前有一艘不明航天器坠入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore],曼塔拉卡]]的一处咸水湖。其幸存的船员被医疗后送到一座轨道站，在那里发现他们全都遭受了误跳造成的损伤。" "那就是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]！"法拉挥拳庆祝，笑容因胜利而灿烂。"一定是它！" 达里乌斯点点头。"是的，那是好消息。坏消息是，我们不是唯一在追这艘废船的。[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackWidow],黑寡妇]]在边疆一路血洗，烧毁了十几个世界的黑市据点。而我有可靠情报说她正朝曼塔拉卡移动。" 苏米蕾摇头。"如果跟黑寡妇打，她会把我们了结掉。这是个坏主意，指挥官。" 法拉耸耸肩。"那我们就快点行动。如果在她到那儿之前取回多布雷夫的导航日志，我们根本不用打。"

column2: 好，指挥官，我已把我们的分队降落在鲍曼集团视野范围之外。\n\n防御大概会偏重型，所以我建议谨慎接近。

column1: Obviously, this deployment is gonna be a little fraught. It's on us to handle it anyway.
column2: 显然，这次部署会有点惊险。无论如何都得由我们来处理。

column1: Nicely done, pal! You just pulled my feet out of the fire, big time!
column2: 干得漂亮，伙计！你刚刚把我从火坑里拉了出来，太及时了！

column1: The Dobrev is gone, but its crew left an undefined amount of valuable contraband behind at the spaceport. Unfortunately, the Black Widow wants to melt every scrap of that contraband to slag. The Moderbjörn will draw the Black Widow's attention away from our AO, which should buy Yang and me enough time to ransack the spaceport. We'll be relying on your lance to protect us from anyone else who might come along.
column2: 多布雷夫已经不见了，但它的船员在太空港留下了数量不明的贵重违禁品。不幸的是，黑寡妇想把这些违禁品全部熔成矿渣。莫德比约恩会把黑寡妇的注意力引离我们的行动区域，这应该能给我和杨争取到足够时间洗劫太空港。我们将依靠你的分队保护我们免受任何其他来人干扰。

column2: 保卫已疏散的太空港.

column1: Destroy Black Widow Company Mercenaries
column2: 消灭黑寡妇公司的雇佣兵.

column2: 保护所有太空港支撑结构.

column2: 保护已疏散的太空港，抵御黑寡妇公司的进攻.

column1: All right, Commander. I've just set you down in front of the Baumann Group's abandoned spaceport. Farah, Yang, and their team should already be inside.
\nCan you confirm that, Yang?
column2: 好了，指挥官。我刚把你放在鲍曼集团废弃的太空港前。法拉、杨和他们的团队应该已经在里面了。\n\n杨，你能确认吗？

column1: Escort them safely to the generators. We can boost our defensive capabilities with those turrets activated. Good luck!
column2: 护送他们安全抵达发电机那里，一旦那些炮台启动，我们的防御能力就能大幅提升. 祝你好运！

column1: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are offline.
column2: 他们在基地周围设置了炮台. 不过目前处于离线状态.

column1: We have a friendly convoy of engineers eager to get at those defenses and bring them online.
column2: 一个充满技术人员的盟军车队必须被护送到防御，以便他们可以被激活.

column1: Move fast, {COMMANDER.FirstName}! The Black Widow and the Bounty Hunter are on their way.
column2: 快，{COMMANDER.FirstName}！黑寡妇和赏金猎人正在路上.

column1: We've found the Dobrev, and this time, it's in no condition to run. Time is of the essence here, so we're going to deploy alongside the Moderbjörn's drones. Hit the Baumann Group fast, hit 'em hard, and wipe the AO clean. After we've taken the Dobrev, we'll discuss our next steps.
column2: 我们找到多布雷夫了，而这一次，它没法再跑了。时间紧迫，所以我们将与莫德比约恩的无人机一同部署。快速打击鲍曼集团，狠狠打击，把行动区域清干净。等我们拿下多布雷夫，再讨论下一步。

column1: We're up against legends. Again. But the hell with it, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's go make a legend of our own.
column2: 我们又要对上传奇了。又是这样。但管他呢，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。咱们去创造属于我们自己的传奇。

column1: This is it—the final confrontation between ourselves, the Black Widow, and the Bounty Hunter. Succeed in this, and the Moderbjörn will have all the time it needs to harvest the Dobrev's navigation logs. The secrets of the Star League lie within our grasp, Commander. I know we can do this, so let's get to it.
column2: 就是这一下了——我们、黑寡妇与赏金猎人之间的最后对决。成功之后，莫德比约恩就会有充足的时间来提取多布雷夫的导航日志。星盟的秘密就在我们掌握之中，指挥官。我知道我们能做到，那就动手吧。

We'll be moving our own 'Mechs and Leopards in as quickly as we can but before we can land them and extract the personnel, we need you to pacify that military base.
