column2: Alarion是Alarion省的行政首府，也是众多工业的所在地，其中包括跃迁舰和战舰制造商，如鲍伊工业和Alarion海军学院.

column1: Albalii is an excellent example of arid terraforming. When first colonized, the interiors of the planet were deserts, using dropships and vast amounts of purified seawater, the interiors of the continents were turned into lush crop producing havens.
column2: Albalii是干旱地球化改造的一个绝佳范例. 最初殖民时，这颗行星的内陆地区还是沙漠；后来借助降落飞船和大量净化海水，大陆腹地被改造成了郁郁葱葱的产粮乐土.

column1: There are reports of a habitable planet in this system, and also pirate ghost stories! As of yet no effort has been made to find Morituri's Ghost Awesome. Although some say if you listen to the wind at night, you can hear him howling...
column2: 有报告称该星系存在一颗宜居行星，还有海盗鬼故事！到目前为止，还没有人努力去找莫里图里的幽灵"恐怖"。

column1: A quiet agricultural system, its sole claim to fame is a ancient monument to the SLDF troopers who conducted a HALO insertion to eliminate a pirate band who took a whole city hostage hundreds of years ago.
column2: 一个安静的农业星系，它唯一出名之处是一座古老的纪念碑，纪念数百年前执行HALO空降渗透、消灭了一伙劫持整座城市为人质的海盗的SLDF士兵.

column1: Home to the Holden Mining Corporation, and Prefecture capital of the Albiero Prefecture, this world contains vast iron and copper deposits. Recent wars and tech loss have caused many mines to close, and the population is slowly diminishing.
column2: 这里是Holden Mining Corporation的所在地，也是Albiero Prefecture的首府；这颗星球蕴藏着丰富的铁和铜矿藏. 近期的战争与技术遗失导致许多矿场关闭，人口正在缓慢减少.

column1: There is not a world here, keep looking. Definitely not a “Pentagon World” whatever that means. Also what is a Burrock? I haven’t ever seen one have you!? Leave freebirth, or so help me I’ll send the ghost of Kerensky after you!
column2: 这里没有世界，继续找。绝对不是什么"五角世界"，管那是什么意思。还有，什么是岩蜍？我从没见过，你见过吗！？滚开，自由出生者，否则我发誓我会派克伦斯基的鬼魂来追你！

column1: The Albion system was settled during the Star League era and vanished from maps during the Third Succession War indicating that the system had been abandoned or depopulated.
column2: Albion星系在星际联盟时代有人定居，并在第三次继承战争期间从地图上消失，这表明该星系已被废弃或人口锐减.

column1: Here there be Vikings! But don't worry they left the Inner Sphere to get away from war. Still.... Vikings.
column2: 这里有维京人！但别担心，他们离开内天体是为了远离战争。不过……维京人。

column1: Due to an extreme axial tilt, Alchiba is split into two very different biomes. The northern half is temperate and has the entire world's agriculture sector, while the southern half is exclusively for mining. No industry outside these exist on Alchiba
column2: 由于极端的转轴倾角，阿尔基巴被分为两个截然不同的生物群系。北半部气候温和，拥有全世界的农业部门，而南半部专用于采矿。除此之外阿尔基巴上不存在任何工业

column1: Minerals attracted the first colonizers to Alcor. Unfortunately Alcor doesn't have a diverse enough biome to support extended farming. So Alcor out of necessity became a trading hub. This arrangement has worked well over the last 800 years.
column2: 矿产吸引了最初的殖民者来到阿尔科尔。不幸的是，阿尔科尔没有足够多样的生物群系来支撑长期农业。于是阿尔科尔出于必要成了贸易枢纽。这套安排在过去800年里运作良好。

column1: Alcyone has been traded between the different factions since its inception in 2036. Farmers have learned to stay away from the cities as they become host to invading armies every few decades.
column2: Alcyone自2036年建立以来，就一直在不同派系之间易手. 农民们已经学会远离城市，因为这些城市每隔几十年就会成为入侵军队的驻扎地.

column1: Throughout its history, Aldebaran has been a contested world. Until recently, House Liao was able to maintain control through all the invasions. However in 3028 House Davion finally succeeded in wresting control and have held firm to counter attacks.
column2: 纵观其历史，Aldebaran一直是一个争夺激烈的世界. 直到最近，廖氏家族仍能在所有入侵中维持控制. 然而在3028年，戴维恩家族终于成功夺取了控制权，并牢牢顶住了反攻.

column1: Aldertaine is known for their popular children's drink, Aldertiane Blue. Aldertaine corporations pay lots of money to Comstar to have their commercials played beside cartoons across the Innersphere. Rumors of permanent blue teeth are unfounded.
column2: 奥尔德泰恩以其广受欢迎的儿童饮品"奥尔德泰恩蓝"闻名。奥尔德泰恩的企业花大钱付给康星，让他们的广告在内天体各处的卡通片旁边播出。关于牙齿会永久变蓝的传言毫无根据。

column1: Formerly a Terran world, Alrecht was abandoned during the First Succession War due to most of the population being wiped out.
column2: Alrecht曾是一颗泰伦星球，在第一次继承战争期间因大部分人口被消灭而被废弃.

column1: Alegro was named for the 21st century drug Allegra. The local dialect changed it eventually to Alegro. It was named this because it was the only drug found to stop the psychosis caused by the local mushroom spores.
column2: Alegro得名于21世纪的药物Allegra. 当地方言最终将其改成了Alegro. 之所以这样命名，是因为它是唯一被发现能阻止当地蘑菇孢子引起的精神病的药物.

column1: Formed during a mass exodus from what used to be Russia, this colony is known for its potato based economy. It's also has the best damn vodka in Lyran space and Katrina Steiner is known to keep a bottle in her bar at all times.
column2: 这个殖民地是在一次从前俄罗斯地区的大规模外流中建立的，以马铃薯经济著称。它还拥有莱兰空间最好的伏特加，据说卡特琳娜·施泰纳的酒吧里永远备着一瓶。

column1: Known for its pastoral beauty and high culture, Alexandria has been a hub of the arts since the Star league. Unfortunately this also made it a target during the Succession wars, and is now constantly under siege from one aggressor or another.
column2: Alexandria以其田园之美和高雅文化而闻名，自星际联盟时代以来一直是艺术中心. 不幸的是，这也使它在继承战争期间成为目标，如今则不断遭到不同侵略者的围攻.

column1: Once a populous and profitable mining colony, local strife abruptly depopulated Alexandria, as well as poisoning most of the native life.
column2: 亚历山德里亚曾是一个人口稠密，利润丰厚的矿业殖民地，当地的冲突使它的人口急剧下降，同时也荼毒了大部分的土著生物.

column1: Discovered by a misjump that damaged their jumpship's K-F drive. Alfirk has remained isolated for hundreds of years. Only Comstar has had any contact with Alfirk. Comstar helped cure a plague and promoted isolationism based on their view of the IS.
column2: 它由一次损坏了跃迁舰K-F驱动器的跳跃失误而被发现。阿尔弗克已与世隔绝数百年。只有通讯之星与阿尔弗克有过接触。通讯之星帮助治愈了一场瘟疫，并基于他们对内层星域的看法推行了孤立主义。

column1: A strategic world for both the Star League and the DC. Algate has housed a military company almost since its founding. The world itself is mainly an agricultural center, with many comparing it to Kansas on Earth.
column2: 对星际联盟和DC双方来说，这都是一个战略要地. Algate几乎自建立之初就驻扎着一支连级部队. 这个世界本身主要是一个农业中心，许多人将其比作地球上的堪萨斯.

column1: As the capital system of the Algedi Prefecture, Algedi is a major trade and manufacturing system. As such it is heavily defended and boast a large Bazaar in the capital city Algiers, where it is said you can find anything your heart desires.
column2: 作为Algedi行政区的首府星系，Algedi是一个重要的贸易与制造星系. 因此，它防御森严，并在首府城市Algiers拥有一个大型集市，据说在那里你可以找到任何心之所向的东西.

column1: A recent addition to the Hegemony, Algenib was colonized for the vast mineral wealth found under its ice sheets. After colonization it was found that the ice was actually Earth standard fresh water and ice shipping operation soon commenced.
column2: 作为霸权新近纳入的领地，Algenib因在其冰盖下发现的丰富矿产资源而被殖民. 殖民之后，人们发现这些冰实际上是地球标准淡水，于是运冰业务很快便开始了.

column1: Settled to take advantage of the rich supply of fish, the discovery of rich fertile soil led to it being developed for agricultural concerns, and Algol would go on to be an major exporter to every planet within a jump of itself.
column2: 最初定居于此是为了利用丰富的鱼类资源，而肥沃土壤的发现促使其被开发为农业产业；Algol后来则成为其一次跃迁范围内每颗行星的主要出口方.

column1: A binary star system with a K class star orbiting an A class supergiant. The planet's economy is based on mining and ore extraction. To protect themselves from the intense solar radiation, most of the Alborabians live in underground cities.
column2: 一个双星系统，一颗K级恒星围绕一颗A级超巨星运行。该行星的经济以采矿与矿石开采为基础。为保护自己免受强烈的太阳辐射，大多数阿尔博拉比人住在地下城市里。

column1: Algot is a beautiful Terran world with a reputation for being bad for ones health - due to a plague centuries ago. Ironically it has one of the highest life expectancies in the Federated Suns.
column2: Algot是一颗美丽的类地世界，因几个世纪前的一场瘟疫而落得对健康有害的名声. 讽刺的是，它却拥有恒星联邦中最高的预期寿命之一.

column1: Alhena is a world that travels between two suns via an eccentric orbit, leading to long winters and short summers. The lack of arable land on the surface and a lack of free water on the surface meant that Alhena needs to import most of their food.
column2: Alhena是一颗以偏心轨道在两颗恒星之间运行的星球，这导致其冬季漫长、夏季短暂. 地表缺乏可耕地，也缺乏自由水，这意味着Alhena需要进口其大部分食物.

column1: The Al Hillah system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and before the Age of War.
column2: Al Hillah星系是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久、并在战争时代之前被殖民的.

column1: Alioth's most distinctive feature is its atmosphere, which can best be described as hyper-oxygenated. The high oxygen content allows plant life to flourish on the world, making it a true breadbasket.
column2: 阿里奥最显著的特征是它的大气，最恰当的描述是高度富氧。高含氧量让植物在该行星茂盛生长，使它成为真正的粮仓。

column1: The Al Jafr system was home to at least one habitable world, and was located in the Timbuktu Theater of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Al Jafr星系至少拥有一颗宜居星球，位于天琴共同体的廷巴克图战区.

column1: Al Jubaylah is a farming world. Most the world is plains and to maximize farmable land the cities and rich live in the few mountainous areas. The ruling Mullahs are even handed and it is a prosperous world whose citizens enjoy freedoms most do not.
column2: Al Jubaylah是一个农业星球. 该星球大部分为平原，为了最大化可耕种土地，城市和富人都居住在为数不多的山区. 统治的毛拉们处事公正，这是一个繁荣的星球，其公民享有大多数地方所没有的自由.

column1: Alkaid is situated four months away from the nearest jump point and has a single moon named Vishnu. Alkaid has been home to a substantial chemical industry for centuries, hosting such companies as Toloy Chemicals.
column2: Alkaid距离最近的跃迁点有四个月路程，并拥有一颗名为Vishnu的卫星. 数个世纪以来，Alkaid一直是规模可观的化学工业所在地，拥有Toloy Chemicals等公司.

column1: Alkalurops is a world laden with a dense atmosphere that frequently spawns hurricanes and tornadoes. The colonists (mostly miners and natural gas exporters) constructed most of their homes in the caves and cliffs of the planet's mountain ranges.
column2: 阿尔卡鲁普斯是一颗大气浓密、频繁生成飓风与龙卷风的世界。殖民者（大多是矿工与天然气出口商）把大部分住所建在该行星山脉的洞穴与峭壁中。

column1: Alkes is covered with vast, deep oceans. A large axial tilt and a highly elliptical orbit make for extremes of temperature, driving a highly unpredictable and notoriously unpleasant weather system.
column2: Alkes被广阔而深邃的海洋覆盖. 巨大的轴倾角和高度椭圆的轨道造成了极端的温度变化，催生出极其难以预测且出了名地恶劣的天气系统.

column1: Alktral's only major landmass features rocky terrain and several active volcanoes. No indigenous lifeforms exist here, and the only human habitation was centered around small-scale mining operations which is now abandoned.
column2: 阿尔克特拉尔唯一的大陆以岩石地形和数座活火山为特征。这里没有本土生命，唯一的人类居住点围绕着小规模采矿作业，如今已被废弃。

column1: An agricultural world which grows the native plumberry - a thumb-sized purple fruit which tasted like a cross between a blueberry and a lemon. The plumberry wine industry employs millions of seasonal workers.
column2: 一个农业世界，种植着本地的plumberry——一种拇指大小、紫色的果实，尝起来像是蓝莓和柠檬的混合体. plumberry葡萄酒产业雇佣了数百万季节性工人.

column1: A desert world with a nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. The planet's only ocean surrounds its northern ice-cap.
column2: 一颗拥有氮氧大气的沙漠行星。该行星唯一的海洋环绕着它的北极冰盖。

column1: Allerton is a large world with a hefty manufacturing base dedicated to light vehicles and scout Mechs. Once devastated during the First Succession War, its economic output is only just now returning to historic levels.
column2: Allerton是一颗大型星球，拥有规模庞大的制造基地，专门生产轻型车辆和侦察机甲. 它曾在第一次继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，其经济产出直到现在才刚刚恢复到历史水平.

column1: Alloway is rocky and barren, except for a 200km-wide equatorial band of lush jungle that teems with native life. Human settlements are mostly concentrated on the edges of this band.
column2: 阿洛韦是片满是石头的不毛之地，只有一条200公里宽的赤道带具有茂密的丛林，拥有大量的土著生物. 人类定居点多集中于这一地带的边缘.

column1: Alma Alta system was settled during or just after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal when the Protectorate joined with the Tamar Pact and Federation of Skye to form the Lyran Commonwealth in 2341.
column2: Alma Alta星系是在第一次离开地球的大迁徙期间或刚结束后不久被开拓的，并且在2341年多尼戈尔保护国与塔马尔公约和斯凯联邦合并组建天琴共同体时，它是该保护国的一员.

column1: Almach is an oft contested world. The real item of interest is Almach's extensive ocean-farming installations. Prior to the Succession Wars the products of Almach's seas fed every world in the Chesterton Commonality
column2: 阿尔马赫是一颗常被争夺的行星。真正有价值的其实是阿尔马赫规模庞大的海洋养殖设施。在继承战争之前，阿尔马赫海域的产物供养着切斯特顿共同体中的每一颗行星

column1: A small planetoid orbit a gas giant, Almunge is nevertheless a majestically habitable world with lush grass and rolling green hills.
column2: 一颗小行星体环绕着一颗气态巨行星运行，尽管如此，Almunge仍是一个极为宜居的壮丽世界，有着茂密的草地和连绵起伏的绿色丘陵.

column1: Alnadal was settled during the Star League era and was an oft traded border world between the Federated Suns and Draconis Combine, until the Third Succession War when it was finally abandoned. Little remains of the mining facilities.
column2: Alnadal在星际联盟时代得到殖民开发，是恒星联邦与天龙联合体之间一个频繁易手的边境世界，直到第三次继承战争期间才最终被废弃. 采矿设施已所剩无几.

column1: Capital of the Al Na'ir Prefecture in the DC, The system has 2 major population centers, Al Na'ir itself and the Yuri Mech Works, located in domed cities in the asteroid belt around the planets. It is one of the most valuable systems the DC owns.
column2: 作为DC中阿尔纳伊尔管区的首府，该星系有两个主要人口中心：阿尔纳伊尔本身与尤里机甲厂，后者位于该行星周围小行星带中的穹顶城市里。它是DC拥有的最有价值的星系之一。

column1: Alnasi is known for its vast ore mining and mineral facilities dotted around the capital city of Gantarius. The low gravity makes sending large amounts of material to orbit extremely cost effective.
column2: Alnasi以其遍布首府城市Gantarius周围的庞大矿石开采和矿物设施而闻名. 低重力使得将大量材料送入轨道极具成本效益.

column1: Alorton was one of fifty-one contested worlds to be placed under Terran Hegemony authority during the Star League era. During the First Succession War Alorton once more became a flashpoint between the Free Worlds League and Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Alorton是星际联盟时代被置于泰拉霸权管辖之下的五十一个争议世界之一. 第一次继承战争期间，Alorton再次成为自由世界联盟与天琴共同体之间的冲突焦点.

column1: Alpha Eridani II - named Achernar by the population - has been inhabited for centuries and is host to a number of industrial facilities belonging to companies such as Achernar IndustrialMechs, Achernar BattleMechs and Valiant Systems.
column2: Alpha Eridani II——被当地居民称为Achernar——已有数百年的居住历史，并且是多家工业设施的所在地，这些设施属于Achernar IndustrialMechs、Achernar BattleMechs和Valiant Systems等公司.

column1: Alphard is is known for its precious ore mining and gem refining facilities dotted around the capital city of Haquinus.
column2: Alphard以其珍贵的矿石开采和宝石精炼设施而闻名，这些设施散布在首都Haquinus周围.

column1: The capital of the Marian Hegemony since that nation was founded, Alphard was host to at least two major manufacturers - Alphard Trading Corporation and Marian Arms Incorporated - as well as an aerospace training academy and the Senate House.
column2: 自马里安霸权建国以来，Alphard一直是其首都，这里至少拥有两家主要制造商——Alphard Trading Corporation和Marian Arms Incorporated——以及一所航空航天训练学院和参议院大楼.

column1: The Alphecca system was settled prior to the mid-twenty-fourth century and was a member of the Federation of Skye prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth. Alphecca II is the second planet in the Alphecca system.
column2: Alphecca星系在二十四世纪中叶之前就有人定居，并且在天琴共同体成立之前是斯凯联邦的成员. Alphecca II是Alphecca星系中的第二颗行星.

column1: Alpheratz is the fourth planet in the and the Capital of the Outworlds Alliance. Alpheratz is home to the Alliance Executive Parliament and the largest weapons industry in the Alliance. Alpheratz has a single moon named Aisha.
column2: Alpheratz是该星系中的第四颗行星，也是外域联盟的首都. Alpheratz是联盟执行议会和联盟内最大武器工业的所在地. Alpheratz有一颗名为Aisha的卫星.

column1: Alrakis II is the second planet of three in the Alrakis system and has five moons named Cassius, Delvia, Fermosa, Weir, and Zalazar, many of which are rich in minerals making this system hotly contested during the succession wars.
column2: Alrakis II是Alrakis星系三颗行星中的第二颗，拥有五颗卫星，分别名为Cassius、Delvia、Fermosa、Weir和Zalazar，其中许多卫星富含矿物，使该星系在继承战争期间成为激烈争夺之地.

column1: Alrescha was colonized to feed the peoples of Tikonov in the 2300s. It was not the most ideal candidate for a farm world because of its unbreathable atmosphere. However it was close, warm and wet, just the way Tikonovians liked.
column2: Alrescha被殖民是为了在2300年代养活Tikonov的人民. 由于大气无法呼吸，它并不是农业世界的最理想候选地. 然而，它距离近、温暖且湿润，正合Tikonov人的喜好.

column1: Alsek's claim to fame is that a ruling Davion died here! In 2445 Major Arthur Davion died while fighting against rebels on the planet. Since they are apart of the Federated Suns, they don't talk about it much.
column2: 阿尔塞克之所以出名，是因为一位戴维恩统治者死在这里！2445年，亚瑟·戴维恩少校在该星球与叛军作战时阵亡。由于他们属于联邦太阳国，这事他们不太提起。

column1: A heavily forested world with abundant mineral reserves, which has extensive Mechfactories creating Dragon and Panther 'Mechs for the Combine.
column2: 一颗森林茂密、矿产储量丰富的行星，拥有大量机甲工厂，为联合体生产龙与黑豹机甲。

column1: Alta vanished from maps during the Third Succession War, abandoned due to the fighting.
column2: 在第三次继承战争期间，Alta从星图上消失，因战火而被遗弃.

column1: The system has a class F7III star that produces an unusual amount of surface activity. Solar storms leave Altair without comms for long periods, and so it is unsurprising that the system has been subjected to numerous raids throughout its history.
column2: 该星系拥有一颗F7III型恒星，其表面活动异常频繁. 太阳风暴使Altair长时间无法通讯，因此，该星系在历史上遭受过无数次袭击也就不足为奇了.

column1: The jungles and prairies that originally lured settlers to this world were gone when a comet hit the equator soon after colonization, causing mass extinctions. It also caused active volcanism and rare earth metals to become readily available.
column2: 殖民后不久，一颗彗星撞击了赤道，引发大规模灭绝，原本吸引定居者来到这个世界的丛林与草原也因此消失. 彗星还引发了活跃的火山活动，并使稀土金属变得易于获取.

column1: Alta Vista was the site of a prominent engine trader in the Star League era but during the Second Succession war they became irrelevant, leaving a minor industrial and agricultural base behind.
column2: Alta Vista在星际联盟时代曾是一家著名引擎交易商的所在地，但在第二次继承战争期间，它变得无足轻重，只留下了一个小型的工业与农业基地.

column1: Settled as a farming community, Altdorf no longer is suitable for this. Gamma rays destroyed the atmosphere a few hundred years after colonization. Instead the DC now uses this planet as a prison and work camp.
column2: Altdorf最初作为农业社区被殖民定居，但如今已不再适合这一用途. 殖民数百年后，伽马射线摧毁了大气层. 取而代之的是，DC现在将该行星用作监狱和劳改营.

column1: Currently locked in an extended ice age. Years of fighting has led the planetary government to join the Free Rasalhague Republic. It is now a buffer between the LC and DC and the citizens hope their backyard will no longer be a battlefield.
column2: 目前仍深陷于漫长的冰河期. 多年的战斗促使行星政府加入了自由拉萨尔哈格共和国. 如今它成为LC与DC之间的缓冲区，市民们希望他们的后院不再成为战场.

column1: Located close to the capital system of Atreus, Alterf has traditionally been used as a bread basket world. However its southern continent is reserved for military exercises by the Free Worlds League.
column2: Alterf位于Atreus首都星系附近，传统上一直作为粮仓世界使用. 不过，其南部大陆被自由世界联盟保留用于军事演习.

column1: Located on the scenic edge of the inner sphere, Althastan is a thriving nudist colony. Settled after the star league era, colonists were quickly conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth and a no clothes law was established. A fun family vacation spot!
column2: Althastan位于内天体风景优美的边缘，是一个繁荣的裸体主义者殖民地. 殖民者在星际联盟时代之后定居于此，但很快被天琴共同体征服，并确立了一项禁止穿衣的法律. 一个有趣的家庭度假胜地！

column1: Althea's Choice was named after the leader of the colonists had to make a choice between systems to settle. Some say she got it wrong.
column2: 阿尔西娅之选以殖民者领袖命名，她必须在几个星系之间做出定居的抉择。有人说她选错了。

column1: Alto was settled during the Star League era, until the Third Succession War when it was finally abandoned. Little remains of the mining facilities.
column2: Alto于星际联盟时代被殖民，一直延续至第三次继承战争时最终被废弃. 采矿设施几乎无存.

column1: The DC uses Altona as a low G training world for its troops. Other then the industrial military complex present on Altona, not much else exists. Mechwarriors-in-training are taught how to survive on low G worlds and fight aerospace assets here.
column2: DC将Altona用作其部队的低重力训练世界. 除了Altona上存在的军工工业综合体之外，那里几乎别无他物. 受训中的机甲战士在此学习如何在低重力世界生存，并与航空航天力量作战.

column1: Altoona is a rare example of a system orbiting a red dwarf star. Even rarer that the planet itself is a moon of a gas giant. But what makes it exceptional is that there are 3 habitable moons orbiting the same gas giant although only one is inhabited.
column2: Altoona是一个围绕红矮星运行的星系，这十分罕见. 更罕见的是，行星本身还是一颗气态巨行星的卫星. 但真正让它非同寻常的是，同一颗气态巨行星周围有 3 颗宜居卫星，尽管其中只有一颗有人居住.

column1: Altoona was destroyed during the second succession war. A small mining colony, no one bothered to recolonize it because it was barely habitable to begin with. Most survivors were glad to be rid of the horrible place.
column2: Altoona在第二次继承战争期间被摧毁. 那是一个小型采矿殖民地，由于这里本来就几乎不适合居住，没人费心去重新殖民它. 大多数幸存者都为摆脱这个可怕的地方而庆幸.

column1: Altorra IV - more commonly known simply as Altorra - is a world with relatively low gravity and a single moon named Delilah.
column2: Altorra IV——通常简称为Altorra——是一个重力相对较低的星球，拥有唯一一颗名为Delilah的卫星.

column1: Traditionally a BattleMech producing center, Alula Australis no longer has the means to produce Mechs, they were all destroyed for a 4th and final time during the 3rd succession war and were moved off world. Now it is mined for its rare metals.
column2: Alula Australis传统上是一个战斗机甲生产中心，如今已不再具备生产机甲的能力；在第三次继承战争期间，这些设施第四次也是最后一次被全部摧毁，生产也被迁离该星球. 现在，这里开采的是其稀有金属.

column1: Colonized to take advantage of the rare earth elements readily available on the surface, Alula Borealis is a backwater mining colony with enough strategic value to have a garrison stationed on planet. Not much has changed since the Star League days.
column2: 为了利用地表易于获取的稀土元素，Alula Borealis被殖民；它是一个偏远落后的矿业殖民地，但其战略价值足以让星球上驻扎一支驻军. 自星际联盟时代以来，这里几乎没有什么变化.

column1: Alya and its moon are characterised by both the unusual elongated revolutionary cycle around the star and by Xanadu's unusual orbital path, both being the result of the gravitational influence of a huge gas giant in the outer reaches of the system.
column2: 阿莉亚及其卫星的特点是绕恒星的公转周期异常绵长，而桑纳杜的轨道也与众不同，两者都是该星系外缘一颗巨大气态行星引力影响的结果。

column1: The Alyina system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The first livestock on the world ate the local vegetation and began to hallucinate, sending them escaping across the vast plains.
column2: Alyina星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民. 这个星球上的第一批牲畜吃了当地植被后开始产生幻觉，纷纷逃窜着穿过广袤的平原.

column1: Ambatomainty was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ambatomainty在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Amber was settled during the Star League era, until the Third Succession War when it was finally abandoned.
column2: Amber于星际联盟时代被殖民，直到第三次继承战争时最终被废弃.

column1: The Ambergrist system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Ambergrist was notable for producing a flavorful vermouth
column2: Ambergrist星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民. Ambergrist以出产一种风味浓郁的味美思而闻名.

column1: Amber Grove, named after the amber like glow from the forests situated on mudflats, was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and for much of its history was a part of the Taurian Concordat.
column2: Amber Grove，得名于位于泥滩上的森林所散发的琥珀般光辉，于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，在其历史的大部分时间里都是金牛协约国的一部分.

column1: Ambrose was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ambrose于统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Amiga system was settled during the early twenty-fourth century at some point shortly after the formation of the Federated Suns as an expansive silicon mining colony to power the industrial might of House Davion.
column2: Amiga星系在二十四世纪早期、恒星联邦成立后不久的某个时候被殖民，成为一个庞大的硅矿开采殖民地，为戴维恩家族的工业实力提供动力.

column1: Amity is the second planet in the Amity system. Lacking any moons, Amity has been home to a number of industrial facilities belonging to various companies including Imstar Aerospace
column2: Amity是Amity星系中的第二颗行星. 由于没有卫星，Amity一直是包括Imstar Aerospace在内的多家公司旗下众多工业设施的所在地.

column1: Amminadav is a boring world - literally. It's thermal boreholes extend deep into the surface to provide access to a wealth of minerals.
column2: 阿米纳达夫是一颗无聊的行星——字面意义上的。它的热钻孔深达地表之下，让人能获取丰富的矿物。

column1: Ammon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ammon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of many worlds settled and then subsequently abandoned and forgotten about during the succession wars.
column2: 这是众多在继承战争期间被开拓、随后又被废弃和遗忘的世界之一.

column1: Exploratory boreholes were sunk through the glaciers of Amu Darya, and early samples showed promising mineral wealth, but the costs of the Succession Wars made exploiting that wealth too expensive for the Capellan leadership.
column2: 勘探钻孔挖穿了阿姆达里亚的冰川，早期样本显示出了富有前景的矿产资源，但继承战争的代价使得开发那财富对卡佩拉领导人而言过于昂贵了.

column1: Amu Darya
column2: 阿姆达里亚

column1: Anaea was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Anaea是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Anaheim was settled at some point in the twenty-second century and was contested in the early parts of the Reunification War. Not much of its industrial base survived the Succession Wars, though Suwama Munitions maintains a mega factory here.
column2: Anaheim在二十二世纪的某个时候被殖民，并在统一战争初期成为争夺之地. 历经继承战争，其工业基础所剩无几，不过Suwama Munitions仍在此维持着一座巨型工厂.

column1: Anatolia (Pillory 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Anatolia（Pillory 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ancha is best known for the fate of the first wave of colonists who all died to plague. The second wave, using the notes from the first wave, managed to synthesize a cure, meaning that their sacrifice was not in vain.
column2: Ancha最为人所知的是第一批殖民者的命运，他们全都死于瘟疫. 第二批殖民者利用第一批留下的记录成功合成了解药，这意味着他们的牺牲没有白费.

column1: To expand the habitable area of the planet to exploit the native faunas health properties, the Star League built large solar mirrors in orbit to focus energy from the sun toward the planet, which created storms that wrack the planet centuries later.
column2: 为了扩大星球的宜居区域，以利用本土动物群的保健特性，星际联盟在轨道上建造了大型太阳反射镜，将太阳的能量聚焦向星球，由此产生的风暴在几个世纪后肆虐该星球.

column1: Andarmax is not a single planet, but rather a gas giant with a large number of moons, in varying states of terraforming. The seat of government and the ComStar temple are located on Heinlein, the smallest of the moons.
column2: 安达马克斯不是一个单一的行星，而是一个拥有大量卫星的气态巨星，这些卫星都处于不同状态的地球化改造中. 政府所在地和通讯之星神殿位于最小的卫星海因莱因.

column1: Andelys was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Andelys在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、星际联盟时代期间被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Apart from a few warm lakes and rivers, Andro is dry. Noxious gases erupt from deep fissures. Some local plants hover in mid-air, held aloft by gas bags.
column2: 除了少数温暖的湖泊和河流外，Andro十分干旱. 有毒气体从深处裂隙中喷涌而出. 一些当地植物悬停在半空中，由气囊托浮着.

column1: Andurien is the fifth planet in the Andurien system and has served as the capital world of both the Andurien Commonality and the Duchy of Andurien as well as being home to a number of defense industries such as Andurien AeroTech.
column2: Andurien是Andurien星系中的第五颗行星，曾作为Andurien共同体和Andurien公国的首都世界，同时也是Andurien AeroTech等众多国防工业的所在地.

column1: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, Anegasaki is characterised by a rocky desert lit by a harsh red sun. Deep canyons cut into the planet's crust. The plants are shaped like brittle trumpets pointing up at the sky.
column2: 阿内加萨基在第一次从地球出发的大逃亡期间被殖民，特征是岩石沙漠，被一颗刺眼的红色恒星照亮，深峡谷切入星球地壳。那里的植物形似脆弱的喇叭，朝天而立。

column1: An unremarkable world scarce in everything, Anembo was still the site of a Castle Brian nicknamed Castle Kodiak during the Star League era as well as a large BattleMech garrison. Scavengers scour the surface constantly looking for LosTech.
column2: Anembo是一个平平无奇、什么都匮乏的世界，但在星盟时代，它仍是一座绰号为“科迪亚克城堡”的布莱恩城堡所在地，并驻扎着一支庞大的战斗机甲卫守部队. 拾荒者不断在星球表面搜寻失落科技.

column1: Settled to access radium and cesium, Angell has a stark social structure. Water supplies are tainted with a chemical called citrium which is poisonous in large doses. As a result the population is reliant on technology and fresh water shipments.
column2: 为了获取镭和色而在此定居，Angell的社会结构极为严酷. 供水被一种名为citrium的化学物质污染，大剂量摄入会中毒. 因此，民众依赖科技和淡水运输.

column1: Angelsey was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Angelsey是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: In common with the other worlds of the New Delphi Compact, ninety percent of the population of Anglia lived an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century
column2: 与新德尔斐盟约国的其他世界一样，Anglia百分之九十的人口过着农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于泰拉在十八世纪末或十九世纪初的技术维持.

column1: When Angol was discovered by humans it was already a frozen planet, locked in orbit around a small, dying red star. Settled by prisoners and other \"undesirables\" from nearby Tikonov, the society was modelled after Communism.
column2: 当人类发现安戈尔时，它已经是一颗冰封行星，被锁在一颗微小垂死红星的轨道上。它由来自附近提科诺夫的囚犯与其他"不受欢迎者"定居，其社会以共产主义为蓝本。

column1: Angra was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Angra是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The surface of Anguilla is tundra and a few frozen lakes. There are extensive fossilized forests with squat, knotted trunks with black spines. Large amounts of petroleum sit under the surface, the basis for the economy on this ruined world.
column2: Anguilla的表面是苔原和几片结冰的湖泊. 那里有大片化石森林，树干矮壮、多节，长着黑色尖刺. 地表下蕴藏着大量石油，是这个破败世界经济的根基.

column1: Vast parts of the habitable continent are covered in shallow frozen lakes and swamps. The local plant life takes the shape of small orange bubbles, with hundreds of dark green animals hunting in well-coordinated packs.
column2: 宜居大陆的大片区域被浅浅的冰封湖泊和沼泽覆盖. 当地植物呈小型橙色气泡状，还有数百只深绿色动物以配合默契的群体进行狩猎.

column1: Ankaa wasn't settled until four centuries after the first JumpShips left Terra. The hot world resembled the African and Middle East regions, but the middle latitudes and equator were far harsher and hotter than any Terran desert.
column2: 安卡在首批跃迁舰离开地球之后四百年才被殖民。这颗炎热的行星类似非洲与中东地区，但中纬度与赤道比任何类地沙漠都更加严酷炽热。

column1: The Anklan system is located near the Elbing and Visby systems and trades rare materials from its cavernous mines with other worlds in the Hanseatic League.
column2: Anklan星系位于Elbing和Visby星系附近，并用其巨穴矿井中出产的稀有材料与汉萨同盟的其他世界进行贸易.

column1: A sandy desert lit by a dim blue sun. Huge grey rocks litter the land. A thin dusting of brown lichen covers the land. Many dormant volcanos litter the land.
column2: 一片沙质沙漠，被一颗暗淡的蓝色太阳照耀. 巨大的灰色岩石遍布大地. 一层薄薄的棕色地衣覆盖着大地. 许多休眠火山遍布大地.

column1: Annapolis is a 'potential' garden world colonized during the First Exodus. Famine and disease have reduced Annapolis to 19th Century level technology. Most of the citizens survive by subsistence farming, and life for most is brutal and dirty.
column2: 安纳波利斯是第一次大逃亡期间被殖民的“潜在”田园世界。饥荒与疾病把安纳波利斯的技术水平拉回到19世纪。大多数居民靠自给农作维生，多数人的生活残酷而肮脏。

column1: There are scattered forests of thick light green stems with massive flowers. Squat muscular bipeds move between the flowers. The lifeforms on this planet appear to be part of a kind of superorganism.
column2: 这里有零散分布的森林，由粗壮的浅绿色茎干组成，上面开着巨大的花朵. 矮壮而肌肉发达的双足生物在花朵之间穿行. 这颗行星上的生命体似乎是某种超个体的一部分.

column1: Annwyn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Annwyn在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Antallos III is an arid world with two moons. Following the collapse of the Star League, civilization on Antallos collapsed quickly, and by the thirty-first century the barren wastes (\"Free Zones\") are home to the worst of humanity.
column2: 安塔洛斯III是一颗拥有两颗卫星的干旱世界。星盟崩溃之后，安塔洛斯的文明迅速瓦解，到三十一世纪，这些荒芜的废土（"自由区"）成了人类中最恶劣者的家园。

column1: A desert world of jagged rocks, there are large plateaus with steep sides. Fauna takes the shape of green geodesic domes within which colonies of small many-colored creatures live. The air is filled with organic compounds that induce hallucinations.
column2: 一个由嶙峋岩石构成的沙漠世界，分布着侧壁陡峭的大型高原. 动物群呈绿色测地线穹顶状，穹顶内栖息着色彩斑斓的小型生物群落. 空气中弥漫着可致幻的有机化合物.

column1: The icy world of Antias was a battleground of the Second Succession War. To survive, the local government made the world a free haven for pirates and mercenaries. Currently, the government is controlled by pirate cartels.
column2: 冰天雪地的安提亚斯星球是第二次继承战争的战场. 为了生存，当地政府把世界变成了海盗和佣兵的自由天堂. 目前，政府被海盗卡特尔所控制.

column1: The Antietam system was settled relatively early during human expansion across the Inner Sphere, possibly during the First Exodus from Terra, and is the home to numerous small aerovehicle exporters.
column2: Antietam星系在人类向整个内天体扩张期间相对较早地就被定居，可能是在从地球出发的第一次大迁徙期间，并且是众多小型飞行器出口商的所在地.

column1: An Ting is a dry world where farmers eke out a living. Many agrimechs survived the Star League era, and there are often competitions with Cattlemaster agromechs such as Space Bull Rodeo.
column2: An Ting是一个干旱的世界，农民们在那里勉强度日. 许多农业机甲在星际联盟时代幸存下来，那里经常举办使用Cattlemaster农业机甲的竞赛，例如太空公牛竞技.

column1: There are scattered forests of orange fronds. A network of tunnels extends under much of the surface. The air is filled with dark orange fluttering creatures. Most of the local animals are different morphs of the same highly versatile species.
column2: 零星分布着橙色叶状体组成的森林. 地表之下的大部分区域延伸着一片隧道网络. 空气中满是深橙色、振翅飞舞的生物. 当地大多数动物都是同一种高度多能物种的不同形态.

column1: Antwerp is the fifth planet in the Antwerp system and is home to the major Bordello Military Goods, Inc. industrial plant - the only military manufacturing plant in the Hanseatic League.
column2: Antwerp是Antwerp星系中的第五颗行星，也是Bordello Military Goods，Inc. 主要工业工厂的所在地——汉萨同盟唯一的军事制造工厂.

column1: Once a site of a major Diplass BattleMechs site, the only remnant now is a Star League era continent spanning train service. A common phrase spoken here is to \"Take the midnight train going Anywhere\"
column2: 这里曾是迪普拉斯战斗机甲的一处主要厂址，如今只剩下星盟时代横贯大陆的列车服务。这里常说的一句话是"搭上午夜列车，去往任何地方"

column1: Aodh was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Aodh在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The barren rock of Aomen was a viable source of germanium, a critical element for K-F Drives. With fewer drives in production, and more easily extracted sources of the rare mineral available, the League ultimately abandoned the mining facility.
column2: 奥蒙光秃秃的岩石可以提供锗这种K-F驱动器的重要元素. 随着驱动器的产量日益减少，以及这种稀矿有了更多易于开采的来源，联盟最终放弃了这座矿业设施.

column1: Aosia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Aosia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Apinzel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Apinzel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: A Place was devastated by famine after the first succession war. A small terrain world notable for political intrigue during the second succession war, not much happens other than farming here. It earns its name.
column2: A Place在第一次继承战争后因饥荒而遭受重创. 一个在第二次继承战争期间以政治阴谋闻名的小型地形世界，这里除了农耕之外没什么事情发生. 它名副其实.

column1: Apolakkia has a planet-wide, deep ocean that is constantly steaming. Black winged creatures spend their lives in flight, not even landing to reproduce. Most of the local animals are different morphs of the same highly versatile species.
column2: Apolakkia有一个覆盖全球的深海，海水不断冒着蒸汽. 黑翼生物终生都在飞行中度过，甚至连繁殖也不降落. 当地大多数动物都是同一适应力极强的物种的不同形态.

column1: Apollo was for several centuries the capital world of the Rim Worlds Republic. Apollo is been home to a number of manufacturing facilities operated by companies such as United Mechanics, as well as massive fortresses modelling after Castle Brians.
column2: Apollo在数个世纪里一直是边缘世界共和国的首都星球. Apollo曾是联合机械公司等企业运营的众多制造设施，以及仿照布莱恩城堡建造的巨型要塞的所在地.

column1: A planet-wide ocean mostly free of ice, except at the poles. Groups of striped creatures splash and frolic in the shallows. The adults hunt their own juveniles for food. Constant hurricanes ravage the surface.
column2: 整个星球被海洋覆盖，除两极外大部分不结冰. 成群带条纹的生物在浅滩中溅水嬉戏. 成年个体会捕猎自己的幼体作为食物. 持续不断的飓风肆虐着地表.

column1: Appian features a lush, fertile Terran world called Omen. Every attempt to colonize Omen has failed, and the world is littered with ruins. The inhabitants are researchers in a small station, trying to pierce Omen's secrets.
column2: 阿皮亚拥有一颗名为"预兆"的葱郁肥沃类地行星。对预兆的每一次殖民尝试都失败了，这颗行星遍布废墟。居民是一些小站点里的研究人员，试图揭开预兆的秘密。

column1: The Apriki system was colonized at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War and became a major industrial center for the Draconis Combine. Osaka Heavy Metrics produces many IndustrialMech designs here, such as the CattleMaster.
column2: Apriki星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候被殖民，并成为天龙联合体的主要工业中心. Osaka Heavy Metrics在这里生产许多工业机甲设计，例如CattleMaster.

column1: Apsalar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Apsalar在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A former holding of the Free Worlds League, Aquagea lost much of its infrastructure to the League's reprisals during their independence movement. The current inhabitants are fiercely nationalistic and detest the League.
column2: 作为自由世界联盟的前属地，阿夸盖亚在其独立运动期间因联盟的报复行动而失去了大部分基础设施。现在的居民极为民族主义，痛恨联盟。

column1: Aquavita was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Aquavita在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Aquileia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Aquileia是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: Aragon was one of the systems that formed a part of the region in the Deep Periphery known as Nueva Castile.
column2: Aragon是组成深空外围中被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的区域的一部分的星系之一.

column1: Arboris is the fifth planet of seven in the Arboris system and is a temperate world with three moons.
column2: Arboris是Arboris星系中七颗行星里的第五颗行星，是一颗拥有三颗卫星的温带世界.

column1: Arcadia is a temperate and somewhat habitable world that, in common with many other Clan worlds, has been held by - and contested by - several Clans at the same time for the majority of its history as a settled world.
column2: Arcadia是一个温带且勉强宜居的世界，与许多其他氏族世界一样，在其作为定居世界的绝大部分历史中，一直同时被数个氏族占据并争夺.

column1: Arcadia (FS) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Arcadia (FS) 在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时刻被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

column1: Strong in agriculture and manufacturing, Arcadia is nevertheless an awkwardly situated world with heavy gravity and planetary wide storms.
column2: 尽管在农业和制造业方面实力雄厚，Arcadia仍是一个位置尴尬的星球，拥有高重力和全球性风暴.

column1: Arc-Royal system was originally a quiet, pastoral world; later the planet was a heavily-fortified world with a significant number of important industrial facilities.
column2: Arc-Royal星系最初是一个宁静的田园世界；后来这颗行星成为一个戒备森严的世界，拥有大量重要的工业设施.

column1: The original Capital of the Lyran Commonwealth for centuries, the resulting population shift as inhabitants followed the capital to Tharkad has left a series of cities on the world that are vastly oversized for the current population.
column2: 作为数百年来天琴共同体的原首都，居民随首都迁往Tharkad所导致的人口转移，使这个星球上留下了一系列对当前人口而言规模过大的城市.

column1: The Ardoz system was settled during or soon after the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Draconis Combine.
column2: Ardoz星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被开拓，到战争时代结束时已被并入天龙联合体.

column1: Ares has been home to a number of various defense industries and is associated with the interstellar treaty called the Ares Convention.
column2: Ares一直是众多不同国防工业的所在地，并与被称为《Ares公约》的星际条约有关.

column1: The Arganda system was settled soon after the First Exodus from Terra and by the early twenty-fourth century the system was a part of the Federation of Skye. When the Lyran Commonwealth formed in 2341 the Arganda system became a part of that nation
column2: Arganda星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙后不久便得到殖民，到二十四世纪初，该星系已成为斯凯联邦的一部分. 当天琴共同体于2341年成立时，Arganda星系成为了该国的一部分.

column1: SURVEY DATA INCOMPLETE
column2: 勘测数据不完整

column1: The savannahs and deserts of Argos are dominated by native fauna, but a small network of hardy, fiercely independent townships have carved out a distinct culture in the temperate zone.
column2: 阿尔戈斯的稀树草原和沙漠被土著动物所控制，但是，一个由顽强，极端独立的小镇组成的小网络，在温带地区开拓出了一种独特的文化.

column1: Argyle is located near New Avalon, but wasn't settled until that world became too crowded. It quickly became one of the Crucis March's breadbasket worlds and exports a great deal of food to neighboring worlds, along with other manufactured goods.
column2: 阿盖尔位于新瓦隆附近，但直到那颗星球过度拥挤之后才被殖民。它很快成为克鲁西斯边区粮仓世界之一，向邻近星球出口大量粮食以及其他制成品。

column1: Home to Toddlette Industries (now Earthwerks Incorporated), this high tech industrialised world is known for the production of the smallest BattleMech, the Flea.
column2: 这里是Toddlette Industries（现为Earthwerks Incorporated）的所在地，这个高科技工业化世界以生产最小的战斗机甲——Flea而闻名.

column1: Aristotle is notable for the large anarchist commune in residence on the planet, and the Commonwealth was more than happy to point to the technological backsliding of Aristotle as example to illustrate how useful central government was by comparison.
column2: Aristotle以其星球上居住着的大型无政府主义公社而闻名，而共同体则非常乐意拿Aristotle的技术倒退作为例子，来说明相比之下中央政府有多么有用.

column1: The Arkab system was settled at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War by a large muslim population. The vast deserts of Arkab are mineral rich, and the planet is home to Cairo Enterprises, the manufacturer of the Sand Devil hovertank.
column2: Arkab星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候由大批穆斯林人口定居. Arkab的广袤沙漠矿产丰富，该行星也是沙魔悬浮坦克制造商开罗企业的所在地.

column1: Arlanda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Arlanda于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Arlington system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra, and was home to an SLDF garrison in the final years of the Star League. A ruined but intact Castle Brian still stands firm amidst the undergrowth.
column2: Arlington星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，并在星际联盟的最后几年里曾驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军. 一座残破但结构完整的布莱恩城堡依然矗立在灌木丛中.

column1: Arluna is a temperate world with vast jungles and an abundance of native life. Once the site of ancient battles, nature has reclaimed the old fortifications and cities.
column2: Arluna是一颗温带星球，拥有广袤的丛林和丰富的本土生命. 这里曾是古代战役的所在地，如今自然已经重新占据了古老的防御工事与城市.

column1: The Armaxa system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and in 3029 became part of the newly formed St. Ives Compact.
column2: Armaxa星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，并于3029年成为新成立的圣艾夫斯协约国的一部分.

column1: The Armington system was settled at some point during or prior to the Age of War and was part of the growing Taurian Concordat at the time.
column2: Armington星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，当时是不断扩张的金牛协约国的一部分.

column1: Armstrong was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Armstrong是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Arn (Jia Tian 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Arn（Jia Tian 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Arnaudville system was colonized during the Star League era and has been one of the great exporters of pasturised milk to the milk drinkers in the Federated Suns for centuries. Milk barons rule here.
column2: Arnaudville星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，几个世纪以来一直是向恒星联邦的饮奶者出口巴氏杀菌牛奶的主要出口地之一. 牛奶大享统治着这里.

column1: Arromanches was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Arromanches是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Artru is a barren, icy rock with almost nothing of value; a token staff keeps the massive industrial mining equipment running. It's a major travel link to Hellespont, however, and Hellespont is the headquarters of the rimward branch of the ComStar Explorer Corps.
column2: 阿尔特鲁是一块贫瘠冰冷的岩石，几乎没有任何价值；仅有一支象征性的工作人员维持着庞大的工业采矿设备运转。不过它是通往赫勒斯滂的重要交通节点，而赫勒斯滂正是通讯之星探险者军团外围分支的总部所在地。

column1: Arundel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Arundel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ascella is a young, warm planet with no moons. Home to a small industry that produces fusion and electrical plants for civilian and light military vehicles, it also exported large amounts of radioactive materials and heavy metals.
column2: Ascella是一颗年轻、温暖的行星，没有卫星. 这里有一个小型工业，为民用和轻型军用车辆生产聚变与电力装置，同时还出口大量放射性材料和重金属.

column1: Known as the north Donkey of the Cancer constellation in Old Terran, the Asellus Australis system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Asellus Australis星系在古泰拉语中被称为巨蟹座的北驴，是在第一次离开泰拉的大迁徙期间被定居的.

column1: Known as the south Donkey of the Cancer constellation in Old Terran, the Asellus Borealis system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: 在旧泰拉语中被称为巨蟹座的南驴，Asellus Borealis星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民的.

column1: Asgard was one of the first planets colonised, and was part of the original Terran Alliance.  The population have always been reluctant members of the Combine, in spite of generations of brainwashing.
column2: Asgard是最早被殖民的行星之一，并且是原始泰拉联盟的一部分. 尽管历经数代洗脑，其民众始终是天龙联合体中不情愿的成员.

column1: Ashburton is a minor planet in the FWL, known for its somewhat excentric orbit which produces seasonal extremes and wild weather.  It also houses Ashburton Prison, one of the largest prisons in the FWL.
column2: Ashburton是FWL中的一颗次要行星，以其略显偏心的轨道而闻名，这造成了季节性的极端变化和狂野天气. 它还设有Ashburton监狱，这是FWL中最大的监狱之一.

column1: Ashio has a native species which resembles an elephant-sized cow and which is farmed for meat that is almost indistinguishable from Terran beef, making it one of the Inner Sphere's primary beef exporters. The drug Brace is rumoured to be made here.
column2: 阿希奥有一种原生生物，形似大象大小的牛，被饲养取肉，其肉几乎与类地牛肉无法区分，使该行星成为内天体主要的牛肉出口地之一。据传毒品"支撑"也在这里制造。

column1: Ashkum is a minor planet on the Fed/Capellan border.  Recently conquered by the Feds, it remains a typical \"border world\" - underdeveloped and over garrisoned.
column2: 阿什库姆是联邦与卡佩兰边界上的一颗小行星，最近被联邦征服，如今仍是一个典型的“边界世界”——欠发达而驻军过剩。

column1: Ashley is an unremarkable self-sufficient planet, notable only because Prince David Varney was killed in a riot here during the Davion Civil Wars.
column2: Ashley是一颗并不起眼、自给自足的行星，唯一值得注意的是，戴维恩内战期间，大卫·瓦尼亲王在这里的一场暴乱中丧生.

column1: A former colony of the  Magistracy of Canopus, this planet was taken over by SLDF forces in 2580 and annexed to the FWL.  The planet itself has significant petrochemical reserves being tapped by several operations.
column2: 作为船底自治区的前殖民地，这颗行星于2580年被SLDF部队占领，并被并入FWL. 该行星本身拥有大量石化储量，目前正由多个开采项目进行开发.

column1: As Samik was one of the three worlds settled at the same time that formed the nucleus of what become the 17-world United Hindu Collective, which existed for centuries before being absorbed by the Federated Suns.
column2: 由于Samik是同时建立殖民地的三颗星球之一，它们构成了后来拥有17个世界的联合印度教集体的核心；该集体在被恒星联邦吞并之前已经存在了数个世纪.

column1: Recently taken from the Combine, Asta is a world that refuses to die, in spite of being ravaged by WMD in the days of the Amaris Empire, and being a battleground recently.  It is a highly agrarian \"breadbasket\" planet.
column2: 阿斯塔最近刚从联合体手中夺取，是一颗拒绝死去的星球——尽管在阿马里斯帝国时期被大规模杀伤性武器摧残，最近又成为战场。它是一颗高度农业化的“粮仓”星球。

column1: Astrokaszy is hot, dry and windswept despite having a large amount of water. Treasure hunters are still drawn to the planet by rumors of a Star League Defense Force cache of precious metals, hidden during the Reunification War.
column2: 尽管拥有大量水资源，Astrokaszy依然炎热、干燥且多风. 有关星际联盟防卫军在统一战争期间藏匿的贵金属秘藏的传闻，仍吸引着寻宝者前往这颗行星.

column1: Asturias is the fifth planet in the Asturias system and for centuries served as the capital of the Castilian Principalities. Asturias was home to one of the few defense industries to be found within Nueva Castile, namely Sanctuary Station.
column2: Asturias是Asturias星系中的第五颗行星，数个世纪以来一直作为卡斯蒂利亚诸公国的首都. Asturias是新卡斯蒂利亚境内为数不多的国防工业所在地之一，即圣所站.

column1: Asuncion is a mineral rich world that is home to Asuncion Industries, a manufacturer that produces small spacecraft and personal vacuum environment survival equipment.
column2: Asuncion是一个矿产资源丰富的星球，也是Asuncion Industries的所在地，这家制造商生产小型航天器和个人真空环境生存装备.

column1: Athenry is notable for the fact that almost every plant on this predominantly water planet has a medicinal value, and for the ruins of an earlier civilisation found near the capital.
column2: Athenry的著名之处在于，这颗以水域为主的星球上几乎每种植物都具有药用价值，并且在首府附近发现了早期文明的遗迹.

column1: Athna of the low albedo was established as a graphite mine before being all but abandoned by the Liao after a rebellion. But some of the old domes remain unshattered and scavengers of all sorts can be found within.
column2: 低反射率的阿斯纳是作为石墨矿建立起来的，直到一场叛乱之后被廖氏家族废弃. 但一些老旧的穹顶建筑仍然完好无损，各色拾荒者混迹其中.

column1: Atlas is a marginal system, remarkable only for the ruins of a primitive pre-space civilisation dotted around the planet, and for Atlas Prison, one of the larger facilities in Commonwealth space.
column2: Atlas是一个边缘星系，唯一值得注意的只有散布在行星各处的原始前太空文明遗迹，以及Atlas监狱——共同体境内规模较大的设施之一.

column1: Atocongo is an unimportant little world on the edge of Lyran space.
column2: Atocongo是天琴星域边缘一个无足轻重的小世界.

column1: Atreus is a clan homeworld.  Yes, that's right, you shouldn't be here, and will probably die.  This has been a community service announcement.
column2: 阿特柔斯是一个氏族母星。是的，没错，你不该在这里，而且很可能会死。这是一条社区服务公告。

column1: Atreus for centuries served as the capital of the Free Worlds League. Atreus is home to a number of important defense industry facilities and is notable for being the location of the headquarters of SAFE, the League intelligence agency.
column2: 数个世纪以来，Atreus一直是自由世界联盟的首都. Atreus拥有众多重要的国防工业设施，并且以作为联盟情报机构SAFE的总部所在地而闻名.

column1: A pleasant world in the heart of the Concordat, Atreus Prime was scarred by an ancient battle between the SLDF and Taurian rebels, well before the Amaris Civil War. A swath of the planet is a barren radioactive wasteland, littered with the shells of dead 'Mechs.
column2: 作为协约腹地一颗宜人的星球，阿特柔斯主星在阿马里斯内战之前很久，就被SLDF与金牛座叛军之间的一场古老战斗所创伤。该星球的一片区域是荒芜的放射性废土，散落着死寂机甲的残壳。

column1: Atreus Prime
column2: 阿特柔斯主星

column1: Now a tropical water world with little to recommend it, Atria was first occupied during the Terran Exodus.  Limited resources, and only survives because of tourism.
column2: 如今是一个乏善可陈的热带水世界，Atria在地球大迁徙期间首次有人定居. 资源有限，仅靠旅游业才得以维持.

column1: Atsugi is a self-sufficient but otherwise unremarkable world colonised by the FWL early in the 26th Century.
column2: Atsugi是一个自给自足但除此之外平平无奇的世界，于26世纪初被自由世界联盟（FWL）殖民.

column1: %%SURVEY INFORMATION CORRUPT%%
column2: %%勘测信息损坏%%

column1: Atzenbrugg is a minimally habitable world with an atmosphere that is breathable with no more than a basic pollen filter, it is regarded as tainted due to the fact that almost all the native life contains varying degrees of hallucinogens.
column2: Atzenbrugg是一个勉强宜居的世界，其大气只需基本的花粉过滤器即可呼吸；由于几乎所有本土生命都含有不同程度的致幻剂，它被视为受污染.

column1: Aubisson, due to being a moderately important agricultural and manufacturing world on the Combine/Commonwealth border, has changed hands numerous times through its history.  Recently \"reclaimed\" from the Commonwealth, for now...
column2: 奥比松由于地处联合体/联邦边界、是一颗中等重要的农业与制造业世界，在历史上曾多次易手。最近才从联邦手中"收复"，暂时如此……

column1: An unremarkable, self-sufficient planet only notable because the Capellan's seem to have an interest in it.  Aucara seems to have an unusual amount of \"alleged\" Maskirovka agents captured on it - which the Capellans deny.
column2: 一颗平平无奇、自给自足的行星，唯一值得注意之处是卡佩兰人似乎对它有兴趣。奥卡拉上似乎异常多地"抓获"了"据称"的伪装局特工——而卡佩兰人对此予以否认。

column1: August was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: August是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Augusta itself is a modest planet with no real benefits apart from a breathable atmosphere, however the other 7 planets in the system house a wealth of minerals which support a thriving manufacuring base.
column2: Augusta本身是一颗不起眼的行星，除了拥有可供呼吸的大气外并无真正优势，但该星系中的其他7颗行星蕴藏着丰富的矿产，支撑起繁荣的制造业基地.

column1: Originally settled by Jesuits, during the Succession Wars most of the population was killed or driven offworld. A warm, pleasant world, it has seen much of the population loss reversed in the thirty-first century as new immigrants arrived.
column2: 最初由耶苏会士定居，在继承战争期间，大部分人口被杀或被迫离开星球. 作为一个温暖宜人的世界，随着新移民到来，它在31世纪扭转了大部分人口损失.

column1: A hot and humid world famed for its many rivers and swamps, as well as its dark damp forests. Auldhouse is home to a vast quantity of unique native fauna which Kodiak Pharmaceuticals often tries to exploit.
column2: 一个炎热潮湿的世界，以众多河流、沼泽以及幽暗潮湿的森林而闻名. Auldhouse是大量独特本土动物的家园，科迪亚克制药公司经常试图对其加以利用.

column1: A large temperate world with large amounts of mineral riches, Aur is a gem of the Commonwealth. Home to Edasich Motors, a major manufacturer of Fusion Engines, as well as Interstellar Expeditions.
column2: Aur是一个广袤的温带世界，拥有大量丰富的矿产资源，是共同体的一颗瑰宝. 这里是聚变引擎的主要制造商Edasich Motors以及Interstellar Expeditions的所在地.

column1: Austerlitz (Scauld 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Austerlitz（Scauld 3130+）在星际联盟时代、再统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Australia is vitally important to the Lyran state despite its unimportant location and relative lack of resources. It is the home of one of the Commonwealth's Mint and Reserve Banks, making it a vital financial center.
column2: 澳大利亚对莱兰国家极为重要，尽管其位置不重要、资源也相对匮乏。它是联邦造币与储备银行之一的所在地，使之成为重要的金融中心。

column1: A warm garden planet that caters to vacationers, Autumn Wind is a popular spot for the richer citizens in the Free Worlds.
column2: Autumn Wind是一颗温暖的田园行星，专为度假者服务，是自由世界中较富裕公民的热门去处.

column1: Avawatz is a planet-wide ocean. Gigantic scintillating creatures live in the ocean, moving slowly by using their siphons. Day and night rapidly follow on from each other.
column2: Avawatz是一片覆盖整颗行星的海洋. 巨大的闪烁生物生活在海洋中，利用它们的虹吸管缓慢移动. 白昼与黑夜迅速交替.

column1: Avellaneda was first colonised by a mostly Argentinian population during the First Exodus from Terra.  This warm, mountainous planet is noted in that it contains ruins of a previous pre-spaceflight civilisation.
column2: Avellaneda最初是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间由以阿根廷人为主的人口殖民的. 这颗温暖多山的行星以拥有一个更早的前太空飞行文明的遗迹而闻名.

column1: Avigait is notable in that its dominant fungal lifeform seems to have developed a rudimentary intelligence.  For no explicable reason, the fungus seems to avoid growing near Human habitations.  Currently being studied.
column2: Avigait的显著之处在于，其占主导地位的真菌生命形式似乎已发展出初步智能. 无法解释的是，这种真菌似乎会避免在人类居住地附近生长. 目前正在研究中.

column1: The Avior system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and was incorporated into the Principality of Regulus prior to the formation of the Free Worlds League.
column2: Avior星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并在自由世界联盟成立之前被并入Regulus公国.

column1: Avon is the fifth planet in the Avon system. The surface of Avon is host to at least two significant defense manufacturers, with Matabushi Incorporation producing DropShip parts for the Combine.
column2: Avon是Avon星系中的第五颗行星. Avon表面至少有两家重要的国防制造商，其中Matabushi Incorporation为天龙联合生产空投船部件.

column1: The Avranches system was colonized by the Draconis Combine at some point in the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War but was destroyed in the First Succession War. A recent colonisation effort failed due to the Third Succession War.
column2: Avranches星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被天龙联合体殖民，但在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭. 最近的一次殖民努力因第三次继承战争而失败.

column1: Awano was the headquarters of the XIV Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force centuries ago, and caches are found regularly on the world in less habitable areas.
column2: Awano数百年前曾是星际联盟防卫军第十四军的总部，且在该星球较不适宜居住的区域经常能发现物资储藏点.

column1: Awyron was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Awyron于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Axton is the third planet in the Axton system and has been host to both an industrial facility belonging to Wangker Aerospace and a training facility operated by the New Avalon Institute of Science. Axton has two moons named Greenbacck and Jeremiah.
column2: Axton是Axton星系中的第三颗行星，曾同时拥有Wangker Aerospace的一座工业设施以及New Avalon Institute of Science运营的一处训练设施. Axton有两颗卫星，分别名为Greenbacck和Jeremiah.

column1: This system is home to a mineral rich but cold arctic world named Ayacucho.
column2: 这个星系中有一个矿产资源丰富但寒冷的极地世界，名为Ayacucho.

column1: Aylmer was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, its ammonia rich soils belie the otherwise barren grey and rocky nature of this world.
column2: Aylmer是在统一战争之后的某个时期、于星际联盟时代被殖民的；其富含氨的土壤掩盖了这颗星球在其他方面贫瘠、灰暗且多岩的本质.

column1: Ayn Tarma is often described in Colonist's Brochures as a \"lucrative mining world\" - without mentioning that it is vitally dependent on a lifeline of iceships supplied by Curtiss Hydrosystems - the cost of which is enormous.
column2: 在殖民者宣传册中，艾恩塔玛常被描述为“利润丰厚的采矿世界”——却只字不提它极其依赖由柯蒂斯水利系统公司供应的冰船生命线，而这条生命线的成本高得惊人。

column1: Azha is important to the CCAF as it possesses an excellent strategic location. The near desert environment makes it difficult to farm, but the vast stores of minerals and metals beneath the surface have given birth to a thriving electronics industry.
column2: Azha对卡佩拉邦联武装力量至关重要，因为它拥有极佳的战略位置. 近乎沙漠的环境使农耕十分困难，但地表之下蕴藏的丰富矿物和金属储量催生了一个繁荣的电子产业.

column1: Azur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Azur在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: While habitable and habitated, Babaeski's complete lack of anything remarkable has spared it from conflict, in spite of being a border world.
column2: 虽然宜居且有人居住，巴巴埃斯基完全没有任何值得注意之处，这使它虽为边界世界却免于冲突。

column1: A barely inhabited water planet on the fringe of Combine space.  Population is limited to the few islands that rise above the ocean.
column2: 联合体星域边缘一颗鲜有人烟的水世界. 人口仅限于少数高出海面的岛屿.

column1: Somehow, you made it to the deep periphery, and into the heart of Clan territory.  Perhaps you should GTFO before they notice you?
column2: 不知怎么的，你竟然抵达了深空外围，还深入到了氏族领地的核心. 也许你该在他们发现你之前赶紧滚蛋？

column1: An insignificant ball of dirt at the edge of known space.  The only notable thing about this that the habitable zone where Baccalieu orbits is very close to the tiny main-sequence star of the system.
column2: 已知空间边缘一颗无足轻重的泥球. 唯一值得注意的是，Baccalieu在其中运行的宜居带非常靠近该星系那颗微小的主序星.

column1: Originally a Capellan world, Bacum has been under Federated control for the last 200 years. This isn't likely to change, as there is little to make Bacum significant save its limited production of a particularly fine wine from native berries.
column2: 巴库姆原本是卡佩兰的世界，过去200年一直在联邦控制之下。这大概不会改变，因为巴库姆除了用本地浆果少量生产一种特别优质的葡萄酒之外，几乎没有什么值得一提之处。

column1: A small marginal Martian like planet with negligible resources, formerly claimed by the Taurian Concordant, but most recently little more than a pirate enclave.
column2: 一颗小型边缘类火星行星，资源微不足道，曾由Taurian Concordant宣称主权，但最近不过是一个海盗飞地.

column1: A dense cluster of stars, within which are located some fifty assorted planets, which has been home to outlaws for centuries. A single planet within the cluster, Badlands, had been colonized by the Taurian Concordat prior to the Reunification War. The Concordat ceded control over the Badlands Cluster during the Third Succession War.
column2: 一个密集的星团，其中分布着大约五十颗各类行星，数个世纪以来一直是亡命之徒的藏身之所. 星团中的一颗行星，Badlands，在统一战争之前已被金牛协约国殖民. 该协约国在第三次继承战争期间放弃了对Badlands Cluster的控制权.

column1: A moderately populated manufacturing and mining world, Bad News has been under Kurita Control for almost 500 years. Currently home to the Nineteenth Galedon Regulars.
column2: Bad News是一个人口中等的制造业与采矿业世界，近500年来一直处于栗田家族的控制之下. 目前是第十九加勒顿正规军的驻地.

column1: Briefly colonised and claimed by both the Rim Worlds Republic and the Lyrans, Baggville now lies abandoned due to limited resources
column2: Baggville曾被边缘世界共和国和天琴人短暂殖民并宣示主权，如今因资源有限而被废弃.

column1: Colonised by the Feds around 2750, Bahl's Retreat was abandoned some 100 years later.
column2: 由联邦约在2750年殖民，巴尔的退隐在约100年后被废弃。

column1: A moderately industrialized agricultural planet, originally colonised during the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: 一颗工业化程度中等的农业行星，最初是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的.

column1: This agricultural world is otherwise unremarkable apart from being the former headquarters of Baker Phamacuticals prior to its recent acquisition by Nashan Pharmaceuticals.
column2: 这个农业星球除此之外平平无奇，只是在最近被纳尚制药公司收购之前，它曾是贝克制药公司的总部所在地.

column1: Long ago, frozen Balawat was struck by a meteor that dug a hole deep in the planet's crust, letting shine its inner light. Now, only in this giant crater, life thrives, including a single large Magistracy port initially established as an art colony and since maintained by the mining industry.
column2: 很久以前，冰封的巴拉瓦特被一颗流星击中，在行星地壳上砸出一个深洞，让它内部的辉光透了出来。如今只有在这座巨型火山口里生命才繁盛，其中包括一座大型的卡诺帕辖区港口——最初作为艺术殖民地建立，此后由采矿业维持。

column1: A typical self sufficient world, only noteworthy because it is the home of the Combine's Second Sword of Light, one of the most prestigious units in the DCMS.
column2: 一颗典型的自给自足行星，唯一值得注意之处是它是联合体第二光之剑的驻地——那是DCMS中最负盛名的部队之一。

column1: Baliggora is the regional capital of the Baliggora Outworld Province, and apart from the presence of a minor ComStar base, is a typical Rimward world.  Most of the population is concentrated around the slightly warmer equatorial band.
column2: Baliggora是Baliggora外世界省的地区首府，除了驻扎着一个小型ComStar基地外，它是一个典型的边缘向世界. 大部分人口集中在略温暖的赤道带附近.

column1: Balkan was always listed in early Lyran charts as \"Marginally Habitable\".  When the Combine captured it during the 3rd succession war, they soon discovered what a drain on resources it was, and abandoned it shortly thereafter.
column2: 在早期莱兰海图中，巴尔干一直被列为“勉强宜居”。当联合体在第三次继承战争中夺取它时，很快发现它是个资源无底洞，随后不久便放弃了它。

column1: One of the more important Hegemony planets, Ballalaba's high concentration of heavy metal deposits have given rise to an extensive mining industry, in spite of its extensive vulcanism.
column2: 作为霸权较重要的行星之一，巴拉拉巴的重金属矿床浓度极高，催生了庞大的采矿业，尽管那里火山活动频繁。

column1: A former Federated Suns world that suffered extensive infrastructure damage during the First Succession War, it now lays abandoned save for the occasional independent mining operation, and pirates of course.
column2: 一个曾属于恒星联邦的世界，在第一次继承战争中遭受了大规模基础设施破坏，如今已被废弃，只有偶尔的独立采矿作业，当然还有海盗.

column1: Another \"quiet and unremarkable\" Lyran world, known for its large areas of strong but slow growing native trees, the production of a particularly smooth single malt whisky, and a native fish similar to the sardine that grows to weigh 600lb.
column2: 又一个"安静而不起眼"的莱兰世界，以其大片生长缓慢却坚固的原生林木、一种格外顺滑的单一麦芽威士忌，以及一种长得像沙丁鱼、却能长到600磅重的原生鱼闻名。

column1: The primarily Scandinavian population of this system have recently become part of the Rassalhague Republic, and have already geared up production of moderately priced flat-packed furniture and mech parts.
column2: 该星系以斯堪的纳维亚人为主的居民最近成为了Rassalhague共和国的一部分，并且已经加紧生产价格适中的平板包装家具和机甲部件.

column1: This former Taurean system has long been abandoned due to limited resources and an almost non-existent atmosphere.
column2: 这个昔日的Taurean星系因资源有限且大气几乎不存在而早已被废弃.

column1: Briefly colonised by the Federated Suns after the Reunification War, Banberg was quickly abandoned and now serves as little more than a hole-in-the-wall for pirates escaping local authorities.
column2: 统一战争后，恒星联邦曾短暂殖民Banberg，但很快便将其废弃；如今，这里不过是躲避地方当局的海盗们的一个简陋藏身之处.

column1: One of the founding systems of the Capellan Co-Prosperity Sphere, Bandora has remained in Capellan hands for its entire history.  Bandora has a little of everything, and remains an important part of the Confederation.
column2: 作为卡佩拉共荣圈的创始星系之一，Bandora在其整个历史中一直掌握在卡佩拉人手中. Bandora包罗万象，并且仍是邦联的重要组成部分.

column1: The Banfora system was colonised at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Shortly after it was captured by the FWL from the Capellans during the Succession Wars, Banfora was abandoned.
column2: Banfora星系在统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民. 在继承战争期间被自由世界联盟从卡佩拉人手中夺取后不久，Banfora便被废弃了.

column1: Deep in Combine space, Bangor has remained an important mining and manufacturing planet since Star League times. Rumors still claim there is an untouched SLDF cache somewhere on the planet, although officially none has never been found.
column2: 在天龙联合体领空深处，自星际联盟时代以来，Bangor一直是重要的采矿与制造行星. 谣言仍声称该星球某处存在一个未被动过的SLDF藏匿点，尽管官方从未发现过任何此类藏匿点.

column1: A Garden Planet deep in Combine space, known for its wide variety of Terran and non-Terran produce.
column2: 一颗位于联合体星域深处的花园行星，以种类繁多的地球与非地球农产品而闻名.

column1: Colonised during the Star League Era, Bannerhoft was once a major population centre.  However, the collapse of the Star League lead to extensive pirate and slaver raids, and by the end of the First Succession War it was abandoned.
column2: Bannerhoft曾在星际联盟时代被殖民，曾是一个主要人口中心. 然而，星际联盟的崩溃导致了大规模的海盗和奴隶贩子袭击，到第一次继承战争结束时，它已被废弃.

column1: The Banori system is home to a centuries old Outworlds Alliance colony. Once invaded by the SLDF, they managed to stave off numerous assaults to retain their independence.
column2: Banori星系是外域联盟一个已有数百年历史的殖民地的所在地. 该殖民地曾遭星际联盟防卫军入侵，却成功抵御了多次进攻，保住了独立.

column1: Barahona was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Barahona在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Baranda system is located in the June Operational Area of the Periphery March of the Federated Suns. The Baranda system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Baranda星系位于恒星联邦外缘边区的六月作战区. Baranda星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民.

column1: Barcella is an early Kerensky Cluster colony world. The planet became the capital of Clan Nova Cat. It was later colonized by other Clans in the following years, however the Nova Cats hold a large percentage of this world.
column2: Barcella是克伦斯基星团中的一个早期殖民地世界. 该行星成为新星猫氏族的首府. 后来在接下来的几年里，其他氏族也殖民了这里，但新星猫氏族拥有这个世界的很大一部分.

column1: Originally intended by the Rim Worlds Republic to be a \"hedgehog\", a giant fortified firebase that Republican forces could use to slow the advance of any invading force, most fortifications were decimated during the Reunification War.
column2: 它最初被边缘世界共和国设计为一只"刺猬"——一座巨大的筑垒火力基地，供共和国部队用来迟滞任何入侵部队的推进，大部分工事在统一战争期间被摧毁。

column1: The Barlaston system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra, and is named after the Barlaston family holdings, who own most of the utilities on the surface.
column2: Barlaston星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间殖民的，其名称源自Barlaston家族领地，该家族拥有地表上大部分公用设施.

column1: Once the planet's capital city was a sprawling network of tunnels and hab domes in a mega-city named Rough Patch. Only in the past century has terraforming progressed enough to allow colonists on the surface.
column2: 该行星的首府曾是一座名为"崎岖地"的超级城市中由隧道与居住穹顶组成的庞大蔓延网络。直到过去一个世纪，地球改造才进展到足以让殖民者住到地表。

column1: With a population of nearly 3.5 billion and a thriving trade economy, Barras is a critical link between the Capellans and the League. As a consequence, it is also a hotbed of intrigue and espionage.
column2: 巴拉斯拥有近35亿人口和蓬勃发展的贸易经济，是卡佩拉人与联盟之间的重要纽带. 因此，它也是阴谋和间谍活动的温床.

column1: Barstow's population was almost wiped out entirely during the First Succession War in a combined Nuclear, Biological and Chemical weapons attack. The tainted atmosphere still persists to this day.
column2: 巴斯特罗的人口在第一次继承战争期间几乎被一场核、生、化联合武器攻击彻底抹去。被污染的大气至今仍然存在。

column1: Bartrock was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bartrock在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Baruun Urt system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. It's vast steppes and high gravity breed strong large plains horses which are exported to farmlands across the sector.
column2: 巴伦乌尔特星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民。它广袤的草原与高重力培育出强壮的大型平原马，出口到该星区各地的农牧区。

column1: The Baryshevo system was colonised during the Star League era at the end of the Reunification War. The Brunswick family has ruled this planet for many generations, serving the LCAF as a reinforced regiment.
column2: Baryshevo星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争末期被殖民的. 布伦瑞克家族统治这颗行星已有许多代，并以一支加强团的编制为LCAF效力.

column1: Basalt was one of the first worlds settled by explorers from the Terran Hegemony. Despite the high gravity, incredible air pressure, and wild weather, the world has long been a source of excellent raw materials.
column2: Basalt是最早由泰拉霸权的探险者定居的星球之一. 尽管有着高重力、惊人的气压和狂暴的天气，这个世界长期以来一直是优质原材料的来源.

column1: Settled during the first Terran Exodus alongside Panpour and As Samik, Basantapur became the capital of the Collective and gave its name to the treaty that saw the Collective incorporated as a semi-autonomous member of the Federated Suns in 2540.
column2: Basantapur在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间与Panpour和As Samik一同被殖民，后来成为集合体的首都，并以其名字命名了使该集合体于2540年作为半自治成员并入恒星联邦的条约.

column1: Basiliano's location on the border between the Draconis Combine and Lyran Commonwealth gives the small, water-poor world a far greater significance to the Draconis Combine than any inherent worth in the planet itself.
column2: 巴西利亚诺位于龙尼斯联合体与莱兰联邦的边界上，这使这颗缺水的小行星对龙尼斯联合体而言，其意义远超行星本身固有的价值。

column1: Bass has an excentric orbit, which results in temps varying seasonally up to +/- 70° from a mean of just 5°C.  Most dwellings are in disused mining shafts, including the \"Dungeons\" - one of Bass's more popular tourist spots for BDSM practitioners.
column2: 巴斯的轨道偏心，导致季节温差可偏离均值5°C达上下70度。大多数住所位于废弃的矿井中，其中包括"地牢"——巴斯最受BDSM爱好者欢迎的旅游点之一。

column1: Bassfield is predominately a water world, and boasts some of the most obscure species of fish in known space. It's widely scattered, populated island chains are separated by deep oceans.
column2: 巴斯菲尔德主要是一颗水世界，拥有已知空间中最罕见的一些鱼类。它的岛链分布广泛而零散，彼此被深海分隔。

column1: The Bastian system was located in the Chirikof Operational Area of the Crucis March within the Federated Suns, close to the Reisterstown and Steeles systems. The Bastian system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Bastian星系位于恒星联邦境内克鲁西斯边疆的奇里科夫作战区，靠近Reisterstown和Steeles星系. Bastian星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被定居的.

column1: The Bastrop system was located in the Woodbine Operational Area of the Periphery March within the Federated Suns.  Originally part of the Outworlds Alliance, it was ceded to the Federated Suns during the early years of the Succession Wars.
column2: Bastrop星系位于恒星联邦境内外域边境的伍德拜恩作战区域. 它最初是外围联盟的一部分，在继承战争的早期被割让给恒星联邦.

column1: The Batajnica system was the location of at least one habitable world in the Buena Province of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Batajnica星系是天琴共同体布埃纳省至少一颗宜居行星的所在地.

column1: The Batavia system was the location of at least one habitable world and is located in the Markesan Operational Area of the Crucis March within the Federated Suns.
column2: Batavia星系是至少一个宜居世界的所在地，并位于恒星联邦境内克鲁西斯边区的马凯桑作战区.

column1: Battaraigi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Battaraigi是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of the poorest and most ignorant worlds in the Davion realm, Baxley contributes more recruits to ComStar than any other world in the Federated Suns, the impoverished and uneducated population seeing the Blessed Order's representives as near gods.
column2: 作为达维昂领地中最贫穷、最闭塞的行星之一，巴克斯利向康星输送的新兵比联邦太阳任何其他行星都多——贫困而未受教育的民众把受福修会的代表们近乎视为神明。

column1: Baxter is a world that experiences earthquakes and dust storms nearly every day. The resulting tidal stresses caused a great deal of upheaval in Baxter's ecosphere, with much of the land on the planet becoming desert by the thirty-first century.
column2: 巴克斯特是一颗几乎每天都发生地震与沙暴的行星。由此产生的潮汐应力对巴克斯特的生态圈造成巨大动荡，到三十一世纪时该行星大部分陆地已化为沙漠。

column1: Bayeux was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bayeux在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: In the final years of the Star League, Bayindir hosted a SLDF base, Fort Gates, where the 58th BattleMech Division operated. The unit was successful in defending the world from multiple pirate attacks. The ruins can still be seen to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Bayindir曾是SLDF基地盖茨要塞的所在地，第58战斗机甲师驻扎于此. 该部队成功抵御了多次海盗袭击，保卫了这颗星球. 其废墟至今仍可见到.

column1: Bayis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bayis在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Bearclaw II - more commonly known simply as Bearclaw has been held by - and contested by - several Clans at the same time for the majority of its history as a settled world.
column2: Bearclaw II——更常被简称为Bearclaw——在其作为定居世界的大部分历史中，一直同时被数个氏族占有并争夺.

column1: The Beaumont system was colonized during the Star League era during the buildup to the Reunification War, and fortified rapidly with a Castle Brian, whose ruins now stand looking over Beauchamp City.
column2: Beaumont星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争备战期间被殖民，并迅速以一座布莱恩城堡设防，其废墟如今俯瞰着博尚城.

column1: Beauvais was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Beauvais是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Beckars was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Beckars是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被开拓定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of five worlds to be a part of the Stewart Confederation, Bedeque suffered immensely following the withdrawal of Terran authority in the 23rd Century. Statues to David Genovese, saviour of the planet, still stand today across the surface.
column2: 作为斯图尔特邦联的五个世界之一，Bedeque在23世纪泰伦当局撤离后遭受了巨大苦难. 为纪念这颗行星的救世主大卫·杰诺维斯而立的雕像，至今仍矗立在地表各处.

column1: A tropical world with numerous pharmaceutical industries, Beecher still has hidden ruins and depots dotting the surface from the First Succession War.
column2: Beecher是一个拥有众多制药产业的热带世界，其地表至今仍散布着第一次继承战争留下的隐蔽废墟和补给站.

column1: The Beenleigh system was colonised by the Federated Suns during the Star League era.  A quiet, peaceful little world in a galaxy full of strife.
column2: Beenleigh星系在星际联盟时代被恒星联邦殖民. 一个在充满纷争的银河中安静、和平的小小世界.

column1: Another nondescript planet in a galaxy of more interesting planets, Beid is remarkable only by the size of the trees in its tropical forests.
column2: 在一个满是更有趣行星的星系中，Beid不过是又一颗不起眼的行星，唯一引人注目的是其热带森林中树木的巨大尺寸.

column1: Beils was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Beils在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Belacruz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Belacruz在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: This Federation planet is known for its quirky designations for its planetary government.  The planetary leader is known as the \"Prince\", although the title is elected and has nothing to do with any royal lineage.
column2: 这颗联邦行星以其对行星政府的古怪称呼而闻名。其行星领袖被称为"亲王"，尽管这一头衔是选举产生，与任何王室血统无关。

column1: Belamor (Zanzor 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Belamor (Zanzor 2822+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of the 12 habitable planets of the New Delphi Compact, Belgae is an agricultural planet with a low technological dependency, in accordance with the Omniss anti-tech philosophy of the region.
column2: Belgae是新德尔斐盟约国的12颗宜居行星之一，是一颗农业行星，技术依赖度低，符合该地区Omniss的反科技哲学.

column1: Bell X - more commonly known simply as Bell. Bell has been contested repeatedly during its history as an inhabited world and has been home to significant defense manufacturing facilities. The population was wiped out in 2358 and has been rebuilt.
column2: Bell X——更常简称为Bell. 在其作为有人居住星球的历史中，Bell屡次成为争夺之地，并曾是重要国防制造设施的所在地. 其人口于 2358 年被消灭，之后得以重建.

column1: Bell (OA) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bell (OA) 是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: A nondescript border world between the LC and the FWL, Bella has seen its share of battles over the centuries. Due to this, there is little manufacturing infrastructure on the world, in spite of reasonable mineral reserves.
column2: 作为LC与FWL之间一个不起眼的边境世界，Bella数百年来也经历过不少战斗. 正因如此，尽管拥有相当可观的矿产储量，这个世界上的制造业基础设施却很少.

column1: The Belladonna system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra or shortly after. It houses a major industrial facility for Cal-Boeing.
column2: Belladonna星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 这里设有Cal-Boeing的一座主要工业设施.

column1: Bellatrix has a long and proud history, having been settled in the First Exodus. The system was briefly captured by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era, but was retaken by mercenaries employed by the Capellan Confederation.
column2: 贝拉特里克斯拥有古老而光辉的历史，初次迁徙中人们在此定居. 在星际联盟时期，这个星系被自由世界联盟短暂地占领，但是被卡佩拉联邦雇佣的佣兵夺回了.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Belle Isle is a small agricultural colony set up amongst a water world.
column2: 第四次继承战争结束后不久才有人定居，Belle Isle是一个建立在水世界中的小型农业殖民地.

column1: Recently liberated from mercenaries and religious fanatics, lightly-inhabited Bellerophon is arid and inhospitable, and conflicts over limited agricultural resources are common.
column2: 最近才从佣兵和极端宗教分子手里解放的，没多少人定居的柏勒洛丰是片干旱的不毛之地，经常发生争夺有限农业资源的冲突.

column1: Archaeologists have determined that Bellevue was once a vibrant Terran-like planet with a pre-spaceflight indigenous population, but the ecosystem was destroyed by unknown means.  Many ruins dot the planet.
column2: 考古学家已确定，Bellevue曾是一颗生机勃勃、类似地球的行星，拥有尚未进入太空时代的原住民，但其生态系统被未知手段摧毁. 行星上遍布着许多废墟.

column1: Belluevue was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Belluevue在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Benedict is a fairly typical planet, notable only for a small cadre of religious fanatics who inhabit a large monastery on the northern continent, and for being a regional trade hub.
column2: Benedict是一颗相当典型的行星，唯一引人注目的是北部大陆上一座大型修道院中居住着一小群宗教狂热分子，以及它作为区域贸易枢纽的地位.

column1: The Benet system was colonized at some point during or shortly before the Age of War. Benet III was settled in order to take advantage of the metals in the world's crust. These metals are largely platinum and related metals.
column2: 贝内特星系在战火时代期间或稍早的某个时期被殖民。贝内特III的定居是为了开采该行星地壳中的金属。这些金属主要是铂及相关金属。

column1: Notable for the Benfled Cadet Academy and a highly diverse ecosystem compatible with Human life, Benfled has long been a peaceful \"breadbasket\" planet of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: 本弗莱德以本弗莱德士官学院和与人类生命相容的高度多样生态系统而闻名，长期以来一直是莱兰联邦和平的“粮仓”星球。

column1: First colonised during the Terran Exodus, Benjamin has long supported a strong petrochemical and manufacturing industry, and a self-sufficient agricultural base.  Poor environmental practices have lead to the atmosphere becoming tainted.
column2: 在泰拉大出走期间首次被殖民，Benjamin长期以来一直支撑着强大的石化和制造业，以及自给自足的农业基础. 糟糕的环保做法导致大气受到污染.

column1: Although Bensinger has been part of the Commonwealth for nearly 300 years, the planet has always had the undertone of rebellion since the days of the Rimworld Republic.  Otherwise, it is a self-sufficient world with a moderate manufacturing base.
