column2: 尽管Bensinger成为共同体的一部分已有近300年，但自边缘世界共和国时代起，这颗行星始终带着叛乱的暗流. 除此之外，它是一个自给自足的世界，拥有中等规模的制造业基础.

column1: Officially listed as \"marginally habitable\", Bentley is an ice-bound world who's population centres cluster around a barely habitable equatorial band, an a few geothermal hotspots.
column2: 官方列为"勉强可居"的宾利是一颗冰封行星，其人口中心聚集在一条勉强宜居的赤道带以及几处地热热点周围。

column1: Beowulf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Beowulf在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Benenson is a world with a turbulent past.  Up until some 200 years ago, the planet changed hands so frequently that even some historical documents can't agree on who held it at various times.
column2: 贝嫩森是一颗有着动荡过往的行星。直到大约200年前，这颗行星易手之频繁，连某些历史文献都说不清各个时期究竟是谁占着它。

column1: Bergen is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Bergen是组成深空外围国家汉萨同盟的星球之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

column1: A fairly marginal border world, recently retaken from the Feds.  Bergman's only real claim to fame is its hostile environment and ecosystem, and the existence of a smallish prison for some of the Combine's political prisoners.
column2: 一颗相当边缘的边界世界，最近刚从联邦手中夺回。伯格曼唯一真正值得一提之处是它恶劣的环境与生态系统，以及一座关押联合体部分政治犯的小型监狱。

column1: On Bergtatt, a sand-sharp wind has cut mountains into howling arches and singing spires, and the endless noise makes long-term residence impossible. It also makes the planet difficult to scan, which mean it has a steady population of short-term residents on the run.
column2: 在博格塔特，一种剧烈的风沙将山脉切成咆哮拱门和鸣震尖塔，这无穷无尽的噪音使得长期定居变得不可能. 这也使得扫描行星变得困难，这意味着它的在逃短期居民人口较为稳定.

column1: The Bernardo system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and was independent prior to joining the Capellan Confederation when the Confederation was founded. Bernardo is home to BattleMech factories for Earthwerks and Kallon Industries.
column2: Bernardo星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立时加入该邦联之前一直保持独立. Bernardo是Earthwerks和Kallon Industries的战斗机甲工厂所在地.

column1: First colonised in the early 2700's, Bessarabia has been passed back and forth a few times between the Combine and the Commonwealth, before it was claimed by the newly formed FRR.  Notable for its high concentrations of heavy metals.
column2: 比萨拉比亚在2700年代初首次被殖民，此后在联合体与联邦之间几度易手，最终被新成立的FRR占有。它以重金属浓度极高而著称。

column1: The seventh planet of the Beta system is a heavily forested world, still containing the now decaying ruins of the defences originally set up by the Rim Worlds Republic prior to the Lyran Commonwealth taking control of the system in 2775.
column2: Beta星系的第七颗行星是一个森林茂密的世界，仍存有最初由边缘世界共和国建立的防御工事如今已破败的遗迹，这些工事是在天琴共同体于2775年接管该星系之前设置的.

column1: The Beta Mensae V system is located close to the Altdorf and Kaznejoy systems. The Beta Mensae V system was colonized at some point prior to the Reunification War.
column2: Beta Mensae V星系位于Altdorf和Kaznejoy星系附近. Beta Mensae V星系在统一战争之前的某个时候被殖民.

column1: Beta Regulus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Beta Regulus在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Beta Salandor is located in the spinward region of the Deep Periphery, in a remote location anti-spinward of the Orion Rift and coreward of Lambda Orionis.
column2: Beta Salandor位于深空外围的顺旋区域，地处Orion Rift的逆旋方向、Lambda Orionis的核心方向这一偏远位置.

column1: Betelgeuse is an important Capellan factory world on the border with the Free Worlds League. Coveted by House Marik, it is often the target of raids. Betelgeuse is home to Warrior House Kamata who vigorously guard the factories on the planet.
column2: Betelgeuse是卡佩拉位于与自由世界联盟边境上的重要工厂星球. 它被马里克斯家族觊觎，经常成为突袭目标. Betelgeuse是卡玛塔武士之家的所在地，他们全力守卫着这颗星球上的工厂.

column1: The Beten Kaitos system is located in the Kathil Operational Area of the Capellan March within the Federated Suns. Beten Kaitos is a harsh and marginally habitable world but rich in resources, first discovered by explorers from Muskegon.
column2: Beten Kaitos星系位于恒星联邦卡佩拉边疆区的Kathil作战区. Beten Kaitos是一颗环境严酷、仅勉强适宜居住但资源丰富的星球，最初由来自Muskegon的探险者发现.

column1: The Bethel system is located close to the Andro and Knutdor systems. It held a secret research facility associated with the NAIS which was the target of a Capellan Confederation raid on 9 April 3029.
column2: Bethel星系靠近Andro星系和Knutdor星系. 它设有一个与NAIS有关的秘密研究设施，该设施于3029年4月9日成为卡佩拉邦联突袭的目标.

column1: The Bethonolog system is located in the Magistracy of Canopus. The Bethonolog system is located close to the Obrenovac and Restitution systems. The Bethonolog system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Age of War.
column2: Bethonolog星系位于船底自治区. Bethonolog星系靠近Obrenovac和Restitution星系. Bethonolog星系在战争时代结束前的某个时候被殖民.

column1: The Bettendorf system is located close to the Hoff and Sakhara V systems. Bettendorf was invaded during the first half of the major invasion into the Federated Suns launched by the Draconis Combine in May 2787.
column2: Bettendorf星系位于Hoff和Sakhara V星系附近. 在2787年5月天龙联合体对恒星联邦发动的大规模入侵的前半段，Bettendorf遭到入侵.

column1: Bex was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bex于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Bhaktapur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bhaktapur在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Bharat was originally settled by colonists from Terra's Indian subcontinent. They brought with them many Terran tree species. The world's only military manufacturer is Killosh Industries, notable for producing the Magi tank.
column2: 巴拉特最初由来自地球印度次大陆的殖民者定居。他们带来了许多类地树种。该世界唯一的军工制造商是基洛什工业，以生产法师坦克闻名。

column1: Bhykov was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bhykov在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Bicester system is located in the Xinyang Prefecture of the Benjamin Military District within the Draconis March. The system is located close to the Omagh and Yumesta systems, and has terrain suitable for MechWarrior training.
column2: Bicester星系位于天龙边区内本杰明军区的新阳府. 该星系靠近Omagh和Yumesta星系，并拥有适合机甲战士训练的地形.

column1: Biegga was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Biegga在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Prior to human habitation Biham had an extremely fragile ecosystem; this ecosystem was brutalised during the human occupation of the world. The corporate headquarters of Yoshimatsu Chemicals and a major plastics and polymers plant are located here.
column2: 在人类定居之前，Biham拥有一个极其脆弱的生态系统；在这个世界被人类占据期间，这一生态系统遭到了严重破坏. 吉松化学公司的企业总部以及一座大型塑料与聚合物工厂就坐落于此.

column1: Bilma was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bilma在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: The Biloela system is located close to the Bobruisk and Maisons systems. The Biloela system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Biloela星系位于Bobruisk星系和Maisons星系附近. Biloela星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代期间的某个时候被殖民.

column1: Binyang was one of a number of worlds conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth as part of a two-pronged invasion of the Free Worlds League that threatened to capture the important industrial world of Acrux.
column2: Binyang是天琴共同体在双线入侵自由世界联盟期间征服的众多世界之一，那次入侵曾威胁要夺取重要的工业世界Acrux.

column1: The Biota system was located near the Cusset and Rastaban systems. Biota was settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Biota星系位于Cusset星系和Rastaban星系附近. Biota是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候由天琴共同体殖民的.

column1: The Birmensdorf system is home to at least one habitable world and is located in the June Operational Area of the Periphery March within the Federated Suns. Birmensdorf was settled during the Age of War by the United Hindu Collective.
column2: Birmensdorf星系至少拥有一颗宜居行星，位于恒星联邦内外围边区的六月作战区. Birmensdorf是在战争时代由联合印度教集体殖民建立的.

column1: The Birqash system is the location of at least one habitable world or construct and is located in the Sirdar Operational Area of the Capellan March within the Federated Suns. The Birqash system is located close to the El Kerak and Kiserian systems.
column2: Birqash星系至少拥有一个可居住世界或设施，位于恒星联邦内卡佩拉边疆区的Sirdar作战区域. Birqash星系靠近El Kerak和Kiserian星系.

column1: The Bismarck system is home to a tropical world that is known for its lush forests and lumber exports. The Bismarck system was located near the Lengkong and Mankova systems. Bismarck was settled during or shortly before the Age of War
column2: Bismarck星系有一个热带世界，以茂密的森林和木材出口而闻名. Bismarck星系位于Lengkong和Mankova星系附近. Bismarck在战争时代期间或稍早之前有人定居.

column1: Bithinia is best known for its tourist resorts which cater to the richest citizens of both the Capellan Confederation and foreigners. There is also significant iron mining on the planet, making Bithinia an important steel supplier.
column2: Bithinia最闻名的是其旅游度假胜地，这些度假胜地服务于卡佩拉邦联最富有的公民以及外国游客. 该星球上还有大量铁矿开采，使Bithinia成为重要的钢铁供应地.

column1: The Biuque system is home to at least one habitable world and is located near the Krievci and Wrociaw systems. Biuque was settled during or shortly before the Age of War.
column2: Biuque星系至少拥有一颗宜居星球，位于Krievci星系和Wrociaw星系附近. Biuque是在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民的.

column1: The Bjarred system was located near the New Sarum and Sawyer systems and consists of a class F4V primary orbited by at least five planets. A recharge station was in place at the nadir jump point during the thirty-first century.
column2: Bjarred星系位于New Sarum和Sawyer星系附近，由一个F4V型主星和至少五颗环绕它的行星组成. 在三十一世纪时，天底跃迁点处设有一座充电站.

column1: The Bjornlunda system is located in the Donegal Province of the Lyran Commonwealth. The Bjornlunda system was located near the Jaumegarde and Turinge systems. Bjornlunda was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Bjornlunda星系位于天琴共同体的多尼戈尔省. Bjornlunda星系位于Jaumegarde和Turinge星系附近. Bjornlunda是在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: The Elysian worlds (Elissa, Mangringaine, and Nyserta) are temperate planets maintained in their pristine wilderness state. The people supported themselves mainly as hunters and gatherers.
column2: Elysian诸世界（Elissa、Mangringaine和Nyserta）是温带行星，保持着原始荒野状态. 当地居民主要以狩猎和采集为生.

column1: Black Earth was intended to be a \"hedgehog\", a giant fortified firebase that the Rim Worlds Republic  forces could use to slow the advance of any invading force. Black Earth was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: 黑土本意是要成为一只"刺猬"，一座巨大的筑垒火力基地，供边缘世界共和国的部队用来迟滞任何入侵部队的推进。黑土在共和国-联邦战争期间被莱兰联邦征服。

column1: The Blackjack system was located near the Goat Path and Hot Springs systems and consists of a class G3V primary orbited by at least three planets. Blackjack became infamously known to being the home of the Blackjack School of Conflict.
column2: Blackjack星系位于Goat Path和Hot Springs星系附近，由一颗G3V型主星以及至少三颗环绕其运行的行星组成. Blackjack因作为Blackjack冲突学校的所在地而臭名昭著.

column1: Sharp jagged black rocks coat the landscape of this world, known for its stoneworks. Blackstone has been home to many pirate bands over the years.
column2: 尖锐嶙峋的黑色岩石覆盖着这个星球的地貌，这里以其石作闻名. 多年来，Blackstone一直是许多海盗团体的家园.

column1: Blair Atholl was settled during the Star League era, and is damp rainy world where the most prosperous life forms are the various types of fungus. Malthus Gambling Unlimited is rumoured to use the planet as a tax haven.
column2: Blair Atholl是在星际联盟时代有人定居的，是一个潮湿多雨的世界，那里最繁盛的生命形态是各种真菌. 据传，Malthus Gambling Unlimited将该行星用作避税天堂.

column1: A once beautiful world that is now scarred with dead zones from attacks centuries ago during the First Succession War, Blandinsville now relies on a skilled workforce to produce consumer electronics.
column2: Blandinsville曾是一颗美丽的星球，如今却因几个世纪前第一次继承战争期间的攻击而满目疮痍，遍布死区；现在它依靠一支熟练的劳动力队伍生产消费电子产品.

column1: Blandou was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Blandou于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Blida was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Blida在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Blommestein was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Blommestein于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The world of Blue Diamond was struck by a plague in 2766 that swept through the crops grown on the planet and killed over a third of the population. It is now the site of several medical research facilities dedicated to disease control.
column2: Blue Diamond世界在2766年遭遇了一场瘟疫，瘟疫席卷了该行星上种植的农作物，并导致超过三分之一的人口死亡. 如今，这里是若干致力于疾病控制的医学研究设施的所在地.

column1: The preponderance of fresh water on Blue Hole immediately made colonists wealthy as they exported fresh water to any number of worlds in the Lyran Commonwealth. Tourism also forms a large part of the economy.
column2: Blue Hole上丰富的淡水资源使殖民者迅速致富，因为他们将淡水出口到天琴共同体的众多世界. 旅游业也构成了经济的重要组成部分.

column1: Blue Sava was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Blue Sava是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间因战火而消亡.

column1: Blueys was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Blueys在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Settled around 500 years ago, Bluford is a small agricultural planet known for its unusual native flora, most of which causes altered mental states in humans.
column2: Bluford在大约500年前被定居，是一颗小型农业行星，以其不寻常的原生植物群而闻名，其中大多数会导致人类精神状态发生改变.

column1: Originally settled by Canadians from Terra, Blumenort is a nondescript temperate planet with minimal mineral wealth. Recently ruins from a previous possibly spacefaring race have been discovered, leading to a tourism boom.
column2: Blumenort最初由来自泰拉的加拿大人定居，是一颗不起眼的温带行星，矿产资源极少. 最近发现了来自先前一个可能具备太空航行能力的种族的遗迹，从而引发了旅游热潮.

column1: Boara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Boara在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Boardwalk is just the right distance from its huge class O star to make life habitable, barely, on the few islands of this tiny water world.  Only its distance from the jump point makes the planet non-viable as a source of transportable water.
column2: Boardwalk与其巨大的O型恒星之间的距离恰到好处，使得这颗小小水世界上的少数岛屿勉强能够维持生命. 唯一让它无法成为可运输水源的，是它距离跃迁点太远.

column1: Dunklewälderdunklerflüssenschattenwelt the original name, made up when the first settlers tried some plants, was unpronounceable for everyone outside the Lyran Commonwealth. So the planet was renamed in something everyone could pronounce... Bob....
column2: Dunklewälderdunklerflüssenschattenwelt这个原名，是第一批定居者尝试了一些植物后编造出来的，对天琴共同体以外的所有人来说都难以发音. 于是，这颗行星被重新命名为一个所有人都能念出来的名字……Bob……

column1: A pleasant temperate world, filled with lush purple forests and generally peaceful reptilian life. Home to SeraVideo Entertainments Incorporated.
column2: 一个宜人的温带世界，遍布茂密的紫色森林，以及通常性情平和的爬行动物生命. 这里是SeraVideo Entertainments Incorporated的所在地.

column1: Bodnath was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bodnath在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡.

column1: Boeotia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Boeotia在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Bogard is a self-sufficient planet who's native alpha-carnivore is a large 4 meter long lizard with an amazing ability to blend into the environment due to its chameleon-like ability to change colours.
column2: 博加德是一颗自给自足的星球，其本土顶级食肉动物是一种长达4米的大蜥蜴，因具备变色龙般的变色能力而极善于融入环境。

column1: Bogerth was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bogerth是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Bogrib was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bogrib是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: A dry mountainous world, Bolan was originally settled by people from the Indian subcontinent on Terra. Bolan has served as a regional capital for the Free Worlds League and the Lyrans. Bolan is home to the Melissa Steiner Martial Academy of Bolan.
column2: 一个干燥的多山世界，Bolan最初由来自地球印度次大陆的人定居. Bolan曾作为自由世界联盟和天琴人的地区首府. Bolan是Bolan的梅丽莎·斯坦纳军事学院的所在地.

column1: Bonaire was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bonaire于星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡.

column1: The original colonists of this frozen world died out soon after the colony's founding, but the planet has found new life as a base for pirates that prey on traffic between Liao and the Magistracy.
column2: 这颗冰封世界最初的殖民者在建殖后不久就灭亡了，但这颗行星在作为海盗基地方面获得了新生命——那些海盗劫掠廖氏与治安官辖区之间的往来交通。

column1: Bondurant is a nondescript arid world, home to the Bondurant Tank Academy, arguably one of the best schools for tank operations in the Inner Sphere.
column2: Bondurant是一个不起眼的干旱世界，是Bondurant坦克学院的所在地，该学院可以说是内天体中最优秀的坦克作战学校之一.

column1: Bone-Norman was originally settled by the Rim Worlds Republic and was a part of the Apollo Province. It was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Bone-Norman最初由边缘世界共和国建立定居点，曾是阿波罗省的一部分. 在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间，它被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Bonneau is a small agricultural world deep in Federation space, known for its humid climate and the fact that the entire planet is overrun by a particularly hardy (and tasty) form of mushroom.
column2: Bonneau是联邦星域深处的一个小型农业世界，以其潮湿的气候以及整个星球都被一种格外顽强（且美味）的蘑菇所遍布而闻名.

column1: The Booker system was settled by the Magistracy of Canopus during the Star League era. It is home to Bermuda Combat Systems, a manufacturer of VTOLs and primitive versions of BattleMechs.
column2: Booker星系在星盟时代由船底自治区殖民. 这里是Bermuda Combat Systems的所在地，该公司制造垂直起降飞行器和原始型战斗机甲.

column1: The planet Boondock is almost completely covered with ice and snow and only near the equator does the temperature allow human habitation. Boondock supplies a major portion of the Federated Commonwealth's gold.
column2: 本多克行星几乎完全被冰雪覆盖，只有赤道附近的气温才允许人类居住。本多克供应联邦共同体黄金产量的很大一部分。

column1: Recently acquired from the Capellans during the 4th Succession War, Bora sits near the borders of the FWL. The main equatorial continent, Bora Bora, is known for its tourism industry.
column2: 在第四次继承战争期间刚从卡佩拉人手中获得，Bora位于FWL边境附近. 主要的赤道大陆Bora Bora以其旅游业闻名.

column1: Once Borden had vast lakes but now those lakes are dry, with salt beaches. But the land, when watered, is still fertile and the planet supports a specialized black market and a sizable mining community that harvests salt, diamond and corundum.
column2: 博登有过广阔的湖，但是现在那些湖都干涸了，只有盐滩. 但是它的土地在得到灌溉时依然肥沃，而且这颗行星支持着一家专门的黑市，和一个巨大的矿区，那里盛产盐，钻石和刚玉.

column1: As a system originally colonized in the initial exodus from Terra, this rough backwater is easily forgotten.  Small and rocky, the majority of the population is comprised of a single large spaceport and a one-way prison for political dissidents.
column2: 作为最初在从泰拉出发的初始大迁徙中被殖民的星系，这片崎岖的穷乡僻壤很容易被人遗忘. 它小而多岩，人口中的大多数都集中在一座大型太空港和一座关押政治异见者的有去无回的监狱里.

column1: Borgan's Rift suffers from the crippling of interstellar economies and dramatic technological decline and was regularly pillaged by pirates. Borgan's Rift was sold to Shanti Magliss who built warehouses and distribution centers all over the planet.
column2: 博尔甘裂隙饱受星际经济瘫痪与技术急剧衰退之苦，还常遭海盗劫掠。博尔甘裂隙被卖给了香缇·玛格丽丝，后者在全行星建起了仓库与配送中心。

column1: The population of Borghese was self-sustaining, providing its own food crops and famed for its exotic fish export known as the \"mermaid\" fish. The planet's capital was named Houston, which was also its largest city.
column2: 博尔盖塞的人口曾自给自足，自产粮食作物，并因出口名为"美人鱼"的奇特鱼类而闻名。该行星的首府名叫休斯敦，也是其最大的城市。

column1: As with so many marginal mining colonies, Borka's value dropped off significantly during the Succession Wars; importing food to the cold and barren planet soon became prohibitively expensive, and the League abandoned the world.
column2: 就像许多边缘采矿殖民地一样，博尔卡的价值在继承战争期间大幅下滑；向这颗寒冷荒芜的行星进口粮食很快变得贵得离谱，联盟最终放弃了这个世界。

column1: Bossangoa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bossangoa在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The obsidian sand from Botany Bay enabled them to establish a trade route whereby industrial sand was delivered to Sigurd and Sigurdian dross extractors shipped to Botany Bay for water purification.
column2: 来自Botany Bay的黑耀石砂使他们得以建立一条贸易路线，借此将工业用砂运往Sigurd，并将Sigurd的浮渣提取器运往Botany Bay用于水净化.

column1: Bothwell was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bothwell在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Bougie was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bougie是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Boulsi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Boulsi于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: The largest agricultural planet within the Lyran Commonwealth, Bountiful Harvest has huge tracts of flat and arable lands and two large oceans, the entire word an agricultural haven able to support its own needs as well as neighboring systems.
column2: 作为天琴共同体内最大的农业行星，Bountiful Harvest拥有大片平坦且可耕种的土地以及两片广阔的海洋；整个星球是一座农业天堂，既能满足自身需求，也能供应邻近星系.

column1: Bowang was a major trading hub within the Free Worlds League during the Succession Wars. The planetary leaders, recognizing their ideal position, encouraged a stance of neutrality in all business and political dealings.
column2: Bowang在继承战争期间是自由世界联盟内的主要贸易枢纽. 行星领导人认识到其理想位置，鼓励在所有商业和政治往来中采取中立立场.

column1: Braben's Frontier was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 布拉本边境在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束之后的某个时候被殖民，却在继承战争的战火中消亡。

column1: Brabent was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Brabent是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Once described as \"Not Hell, but you can see it from here\", the large Martian like planet Brailsford would never have been colonised if it were not for its massive mineral reserves.  It also now contains one of the Combine's largest jails.
column2: 曾被形容为"不是地狱，但你能从这儿看到它"，这颗类似火星的大行星布雷斯福德若不是因为其庞大的矿产储量，根本不会被殖民。它如今也拥有联合体最大的监狱之一。

column1: Branzoll was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Branzoll在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Arriving in the early twenty-sixth century, the first settlers established the city of Alaikum, which would survive both the Reunification War and the decline of the Star League, becoming a center of Shi'ite scholarship and learning.
column2: 最早的定居者在二十六世纪初抵达，建立了阿莱库姆城；这座城市挺过了统一战争与星盟的衰落，成为什叶派学术与学问的中心。

column1: Braum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Braum是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Braunschweig is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Braunschweig是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的诸世界之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

column1: One of the Combine's most productive breadbasket planets, Braunton acts as a trade hub for the local area as well.
column2: 作为联合体产量最高的粮仓行星之一，布劳顿同时也充当周边地区的贸易枢纽。

column1: Breed was invaded by the Eleventh Benjamin Regulars. Defending Breed were the Second Robinson Rangers. The campaign was still ongoing, with the Eleventh in control of the cities on Breed while the Rangers dominated the wilderness.
column2: Breed遭到了第十一Benjamin正规军的入侵. 防守Breed的是第二Robinson游骑兵. 战役仍在进行中，第十一Benjamin正规军控制着Breed上的城市，而Robinson游骑兵则控制着荒野.

column1: Bremen is the capital world of the Hanseatic League, and contains the main houses of the large trading families as well as the Council of Merchants.
column2: Bremen是汉萨同盟的首府星，设有大型贸易家族的总部以及商人议会.

column1: Bremen (RW) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bremen (RW) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Bremond was liberated by the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns in 2798-9, in one of a wave of uncoordinated retaliatory attacks launched in response to the news about the Kentares Massacre, having been occupied by the Combine at some point in 2797.
column2: Bremond于 2798 年至 2799 年间被恒星联邦武装部队解放，这是为回应肯塔雷斯屠杀的消息而发动的一波缺乏协调的报复性攻击中的一次；该星系此前曾在 2797 年的某个时候被天龙联合体占领.

column1: Brest was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Brest是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中最终消亡.

column1: Described as \"The happiest place in Lyran space\", Breukelen's native flora release pollens that are mildly euphoric to humans.  This has resulted in a significant tourism industry, and a \"hippy\" culture on the planet.
column2: 被描述为"莱兰空间里最快乐的地方"，布鲁克伦的原生植物会释放对人有轻度欣快作用的花粉。这带来了可观的旅游业，以及行星上的一种"嬉皮"文化。

column1: Brighton was originally settled by miners looking to exploit the copper and silver ores on the world. Brighton's other claim to fame is that it was the site of the only official Capellan political prison.
column2: 布莱顿最初由觊觎该行星铜矿与银矿的矿工建立。布莱顿另一项为人所知之处，在于它是卡佩兰唯一官方政治监狱的所在地。

column1: An otherwise unremarkable planet on the spinward edge of the Combine, Brihuega has become known as \"The planet of spies\" due to its \"use\" as a training ground for Commonwealth agents operating out of Farstar.
column2: 作为联合体朝自转方向边缘一颗不起眼的星球，布里韦加因其被“用作”联邦特工（以远星为基地）的训练场而以“间谍之星”闻名。

column1: The Brim system is the location of a habitable world, Brim IV, and is located in the Deep Periphery region
column2: Brim星系是宜居世界Brim IV的所在地，位于深空外围区域.

column1: A lush, high-gravity world, Bringdam's atmosphere is so dense as to be almost unbreathable. The humidity makes it a poor location for mining, but it is an excellent agricultural world, supplying itself and a number of nearby systems.
column2: 布林格丹是一颗植被繁茂的高重力行星，其大气浓密到几乎无法呼吸。潮湿的气候使这里不适合采矿，但它却是一颗绝佳的农业行星，不但自给自足，还供应附近多个星系。

column1: Brinton is an infamous world due to the plague that bears its name. Centuries ago the Capellans released a bio-weapon on the surface, which continues to be deadly even now. The target of numerous raids, Brinton is now heavily guarded by the Concordat.
column2: 布林顿是一个臭名昭著的星球，因为它的名字是瘟疫的名字. 几个世纪以前，卡佩拉人在地表释放出一种生物武器，甚至到现在依然致命. 作为无数袭击的目标，布林顿现在由协约国重兵把守.

column1: Brisbane is a beautiful ocean world with pristine white-sand beaches that conceal a deadly secret: a viral degenerative nerve disease with no cure. Those unlucky enough to contract it gradually lose the use of their limbs and muscles.
column2: 布里斯班是一个美丽的海洋星球，原生态的白沙海滩下掩藏着一个致命的秘密: 那就是某种无法治愈的神经退行性疾病病毒. 那些不幸被感染的患者逐渐失去了对四肢和肌肉的控制.

column1: Colonised during the First Exodus from Terra, Bristol has always been a planet heavily geared towards manufacturing, although the ravages of the Succession Wars has reduced this to one significant arms maker - Jolassa-Kumbold Armored Weapons.
column2: Bristol是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民的，它始终是一颗高度偏向制造业的行星，尽管继承战争的摧残已使其缩减为一家重要的武器制造商——Jolassa-Kumbold Armored Weapons.

column1: Brixtana is a cold world with windswept tundra and boreal forests. Once the site of an SLDF garrison, it was conquered early in the Reunification War despite dogged resistance by Magistracy-aligned mercenaries.
column2: 布里克斯塔纳是一个寒冷的星球，那里有风袭苔原和北极针叶林. 布里克斯塔纳曾经是一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队的地方，尽管与自治区结盟的雇佣兵顽强抵抗，但它在统一战争中早早就被征服了.

column1: Broaddus is a temperate world, with large areas of grasslands ideal for the farming of cattle and other herbivores.  Coastal areas of this almost hillless planet form large areas of marshland, which should be avoided by heavy vehicles (and 'Mechs).
column2: 布罗德斯是一颗温带行星，有大片适合养牛及其他食草动物的草原。这颗几乎没有丘陵的行星沿海区域形成大片沼泽，重型车辆（以及机甲）应当避开。

column1: Brocchi's Cluster contains what appears to be the remnants of a large planet in the \"green zone\" of this Class M star, which at some point has exploded into a large asteroid belt.  Over 40 inhabited planetoids and constructs exist in the area.
column2: 布罗基星团包含了这颗M级恒星"绿区"中一颗大行星看似爆炸后形成的大片小行星带残骸。该区域存在40多个有人居住的小行星体与构造物。

column1: Brockton is a planet of small settlements and vast untouched wilderness.  The local flora has adapted to cope with the underground fungus that exists across the planet, however this fungal growth makes traditional farming almost impossible.
column2: Brockton是一颗由小型定居点和广袤未受破坏的荒野组成的行星. 当地的植物群已经适应了遍布整个行星的地下真菌，然而这种真菌的生长使得传统农业几乎无法进行.

column1: A rugged, harsh world, Brockway was colonized only due to its rich mineral resources. Originally held by the Concordat, the planet was seized by the Federated Suns after the Reunification War and has been a Davion holding ever since.
column2: 布罗克维是个崎岖，严酷的行星，因其丰富的矿产资源而被殖民. 这颗星球最初为协约国所有，在统一战争后被恒星联邦占领，从那时起就一直为戴维恩所有.

column1: Broken Wheel is a Fed planet on the edge of the Inner Sphere, unremarkable save for the extensive repair and refit facilities that dot the planet.
column2: Broken Wheel是内天体边缘的一颗联邦星球，除了遍布星球的大规模维修与改装设施外，毫不起眼.

column1: The arid world of Bromhead was settled in the first wave of colonization, and was a Taurian holding until the Reunification War. It is now a Davion possession, with a large population in sprawling river-bank cities that nestle in the vast deserts.
column2: 在第一波殖民浪潮中，就有人定居在了布罗姆黑德这个干旱的星球，在统一战争之前它都是金牛领土. 现在它是戴维恩的属地，大量人口都在位于大沙漠，而且连绵不绝的河岸城市里.

column1: A major mining and refining planet for the Feds, Brookeland also has a bright Type O star which makes it favoured as a recharge point for jump routes.
column2: 作为联邦的重要采矿与精炼行星，Brookeland还拥有一颗明亮的O型恒星，这使其成为跳跃航线中备受青睐的充能点.

column1: Another \"Breadbasket\" world deep in Lyran territory, Brooloo is a laid back world of large farms untouched by conflict.
column2: 作为莱兰领地深处的又一颗"粮仓"行星，布鲁卢是个悠闲的世界，大片农庄从未被战火触及。

column1: Brownsville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Brownsville在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A former Combine planet recently annexed by the FRR, Bruben is notable only in the fact that it is (more-or-less) self sufficient, with a balanced mix of agriculture and manufacturing.
column2: Bruben是一颗最近被FRR吞并的前Combine星球，唯一值得注意之处在于它（或多或少）能够自给自足，且农业与制造业保持着均衡的组合.

column1: Bruges is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Bruges是属于被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的行星之一，向其他汉萨同盟行星出口货物.

column1: Brundage is a desert world with vast mountain ranges, that can barely support its own population.  Recent rumours of a lost Star League cache has brought treasure seekers to the world, who have so far found nothing.
column2: Brundage是一个沙漠世界，山峦广袤，几乎无法养活自身人口. 最近关于一处失落的星际联盟秘藏的传闻引来了寻宝者，但他们至今一无所获.

column1: No data exists for this planet.  Orbital scans show no significant settlement, or life for that matter.
column2: 这颗行星没有任何数据. 轨道扫描显示这里没有显著的定居点，也没有生命.

column1: Brusett is a typical backwater farming planet, near the border with the Taurean Concordant.  Rural, and boring.
column2: Brusett是一个典型的偏远农业星球，靠近与金牛协约国的边境. 充满乡村气息，而且枯燥乏味.

column1: Bryant was the subject of an early terraforming project which succeeded. Unfortunately the satellites which stabilized Bryant's changed climate were destroyed during the Amaris Civil War and the climate has now returned to its original hostile state.
column2: 布莱恩特是一项早期地球改造项目的对象，并且成功了。不幸的是，稳定布莱恩特改变后气候的卫星在阿马里斯内战中被摧毁，气候如今已恢复原本的恶劣状态。

column1: Originally settled by the Outworlds Alliance, Bryceland was ceded to the Combine in 2585, before being lost to the Feds during the Second Succession War.  Bryceland remains home to several Battlemech plants.
column2: 最初由外域联盟定居，Bryceland于 2585 年被割让给天龙联合，后在第二次继承战争期间被联邦夺走. Bryceland至今仍是数座战斗机甲工厂的所在地.

column1: Buchlau was settled for its fish. The planet only has a single continent, Vienna, which is surrounded by a massive ocean. This ocean is teeming with life.
column2: Buchlau因其鱼类而被殖民. 这颗行星只有一个大陆——维也纳，它被一片巨大的海洋所环绕. 这片海洋中生机勃勃.

column1: Bucklands - the planet that should have been called Farmlands.  Almost every inch of landmass on this planet is farmed to take advantage of its highly arable soil.
column2: Bucklands——本该被称作“农田”的星球. 为了充分利用其极为适宜耕作的土壤，这颗星球上几乎每一寸陆地都被开垦耕种.

column1: Buckminster is a regional capital in the Combine, and remains one of its most important agriculture and production planets.  Only recently has the Second Sword of Light moved off-planet, leaving its defence to the 7th and 8th Alshain Regulars.
column2: Buckminster是联合体的一个地区首府，并且仍是其最重要的农业与生产行星之一. 直到最近，第二光之剑才离开该行星，将其防御留给第7和第8 Alshain常备军.

column1: Budingen is a minor mining and manufacturing planet, plagues by brutal storms and frigid winters.  It's importance is more for its proximity to the Outworld Alliance than its actual worth.
column2: 布丁根是一颗次要的采矿与制造行星，饱受残酷风暴与严寒冬季之苦。它的重要性更多来自它靠近外域联盟，而非其自身价值。

column1: In 3020 the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces opened the War College of Buena, a military academy that specialized in training MechWarriors and teaching Maintenance Sciences.  Beyond that, the planet is basically mediterranean style farms.
column2: 3020年，天琴共同体武装部队开办了Buena战争学院，这是一所军事学院，专门训练机甲战士并教授维护科学. 除此之外，该星球基本上都是地中海式农场.

column1: This agricultural world has been the target of repeated Marik attempts to conquer it. To protect its food production, most farms were moved underground or to hydroponic offshore platforms. The planet's capital, also called Buenos Aires, is a teeming metropolis of millions.
column2: 这颗农业世界一直是马里克反复试图征服的目标。为保护其粮食生产，大多数农场被转入地下或移到水培式海上平台。该行星的首府也叫布宜诺斯艾利斯，是一座拥有数百万人口的繁华大都市。

column1: Buenos Aires
column2: 布宜诺斯艾利斯

column1: Burnt Rock was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Burnt Rock是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Burton is a company world, the home of one of the largest Taurian electronics manufacturers. Most of the world's small population consists of employees, staff, and support services for O-P Computer Electronics.
column2: 伯顿是一个公司世界，陶里安最大电子制造商之一的所在地。该世界稀少的人口大多是O-P电脑电子的雇员、职员与配套服务人员。

column1: Bushmill was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Bushmill是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Butler is a peaceful earth-like planet, with a diverse manufacturing base.  Plans are in place to build an orbital ship yard, which will no doubt boost Butler's economy.
column2: 巴特勒是一颗和平的类地行星，拥有多样化的制造基础。建造轨道船坞的计划已就位，无疑将提振巴特勒的经济。

column1: Butte Hold is a minor planet in the newly formed Greater Valkyrate.  Barely self-sufficient agriculturally, and totally dependent on importation of manufactured goods, it is of little importance.
column2: Butte Hold是新成立的大瓦尔基里特中的一颗次要行星. 它在农业上勉强自给自足，并且完全依赖进口制成品，因此无足轻重.

column1: Butzfleth (AKA \"Butt Flesh\"), is a minor FWL planet only important because it contains one of the largest prisons in FWL space.  The inhospitable planet is otherwise only inhabited by miners and local support businesses.
column2: 布茨弗莱斯（又名"屁股肉"）是FWL一颗次要行星，其重要性仅在于它拥有FWL空间内最大的监狱之一。这颗不宜居住的行星除此之外只有矿工和本地配套商家居住。

column1: Bye's Ship was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 拜伊之船是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: A minor planet on the Combine/FRR border, Byesville is only inhabitable at the poles, with the rest of the planet too hot to support human life.
column2: 作为联合体与FRR边界上的一颗次要行星，拜斯维尔只有在两极才可居住，行星其余部分热得无法支持人类生命。

column1: A desolate system that is devoid of colonists, initially settled during the Star League era, but now lays abandoned in the outskirts of the Draconis Combine
column2: 一个没有殖民者的荒凉星系，最初在星际联盟时代有人定居，如今却被遗弃在天龙联合体的边垂.

column1: A system on the edge of human explored space, formally settled by the Taurians during the Star League era, it now lays empty, possibly due to one of the many orbiting asteroids crashing down on the settlers.
column2: 一个位于人类已探索太空边缘的星系，在星际联盟时代由金牛人正式建立了定居点，如今却空无一人，可能是因为众多在轨小行星中的一颗砸向了定居者.

column1: Cadiz is a small, tropical planet, known for its endless swamps, and swarms of insects.  Not a nice place to live, unless you are a frog.
column2: Cadiz是一颗小型的热带行星，以无尽的沼泽和成群的昆虫而闻名. 除非你是一只青蛙，否则这里可不是个适合居住的好地方.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Cadiz is a small agricultural world.
column2: Cadiz是在第四次继承战争后新近有人定居的小型农业星球.

column1: A system initially settled by Davions in the Draconis March. It was immediately found that the local flora was very hostile, with extremely large Venus Fly Traps eating several explorers. It was finally abandoned due to increasing raids by the DCMS.
column2: 一个最初由戴维恩家族在天龙座边境殖民的星系. 人们立刻发现当地植物群极具敌意，极其巨大的捕蝇草吃掉了数名探险者. 由于DCMS不断升级的袭击，它最终被废弃.

column1: After the end of the Reunification War, some Kuritans were ashamed of their soldiers' role in the massacres, and sought to get away from the actions of the DCMS. Sadly, the colony failed as the settlers were not used to the harshness periphery.
column2: 统一战争结束后，一些库瑞塔人为其士兵在大屠杀中的角色感到羞耻，试图远离DCMS的所作所为。遗憾的是，该殖民地失败了，因为定居者不习惯外围地区的严酷。

column1: Caesar's Crown is a young star cluster in the anti-spinward Deep Periphery.
column2: 凯撒之冠是反自转方向纵深外围中一个年轻的星团。

column1: Cahokia IV - more commonly known simply as Cahokia - is the fourth planet in the Cahokia system and has a single moon named Sequoia. Cahokia has been home to a manufacturing plant operated by Achernar BattleMechs.
column2: Cahokia IV——通常简称为Cahokia——是Cahokia星系中的第四颗行星，拥有一颗名为Sequoia的卫星. Cahokia一直是Achernar BattleMechs运营的一家制造工厂的所在地.

column1: Caillinius was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Caillinius在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cajamarca is an anomaly - A smallish planet with a high gravity, thanks to its abundant reserves of heavy metals. As a result, mining operations are plentiful, in spite of its hostile environment.
column2: Cajamarca是个异数——一颗体积较小、却因富含重金属而拥有高重力的行星. 因此，尽管环境恶劣，采矿作业依然十分兴盛.

column1: Calafell is typical of a central Lyran planet - heavily industrialised, but also self-sufficient.  Trade opportunities abound, particularly if you know where to look.
column2: Calafell是典型的天琴中部行星——高度工业化，但也自给自足. 贸易机会比比皆是，尤其是如果你知道该去哪里寻找.

column1: Calchedon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Calchedon在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: A typical Periphery world, Caldarium has just enough resources to be more-or-less self sufficient, but not enough to cause the Lyran Commonwealth to be interested enough to remove the substantial pirate presence to take it over.
column2: 作为一个典型的外围世界，Caldarium的资源刚好足以让它勉强自给自足，却不足以让天琴共同体感兴趣到愿意清除那里规模可观的海盗势力并将其接管.

column1: Caldrea was captured by the Draconis Combine in 2812, using fast-moving BattleMech forces that were able to defeat the defending forces despite the defenders using nuclear weapons in an effort to try and resist the invasion.
column2: 2812年，天龙联合体使用快速机动的战斗机甲部队攻占了Caldrea；尽管守军动用核武器试图抵抗入侵，这些部队仍击败了守军.

column1: Caldwell has been a Fed planet for most of the last 450 years.  In spite of being the home to the Fighting Urukhai (under contract to the Feds), rumours abound of a hidden pirate base, if not on-planet, then at least in-system.
column2: Caldwell在过去450年的大部分时间里一直是联邦星球. 尽管这里是好战乌鲁克（受雇于联邦）的驻地，但有关隐藏海盗基地的传闻仍甚嚣尘上——即使不在行星上，至少也在星系内.

column1: Caledea was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Caledea于统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Caledon suffered heavy damage when House Kurita conquered the planet in 2849 and effectively scorched the planet. The world was slow to recover, and was subsequently ruled from offworld for over a century, first from Hesperus II and then Tharkad.
column2: Caledon在2849年被栗田家族征服时遭受重创，实际上被烧成了焦土. 该星球恢复缓慢，随后一个多世纪里一直由其他星球统治，最初是Hesperus II，后来是Tharkad.

column1: Calingasta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Calingasta在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Calish is an anomaly - the system has 2 planets in the habitable zone.  The primary planet, Calish III, is an arctic world with a broad band of arable land around the equator, while Calish II is an arid hotbox with large mineral deposits.
column2: Calish是一个异常现象——该星系在宜居带内拥有 2 颗行星. 主行星Calish III是一个极寒世界，赤道周围有一条宽阔的可耕地带，而Calish II则是一个干旱的酷热世界，蕴藏着大量矿藏.

column1: Callison supports a large, relatively prosperous population but lacks in mineral wealth or strategically important heavy industry. Traditionally a part of the FWL, Callison was only incorporated in to the Lyran Commonwealth in 3029.
column2: Callison支撑着庞大且相对富裕的人口，但缺乏矿产资源或具有战略重要性的重工业. 传统上，Callison是自由世界联盟（FWL）的一部分，直到 3029 年才被并入天琴共同体.

column1: Callisto's claim to fame is tourism and retirement.  Rich folks with nothing better to do come and spend 18+ hours a day in one fantasy neural-link game or another.  I bet none of them ever entered data into a spreadsheet either...
column2: 卡利斯托赖以成名的是旅游和养老。有钱又无事可做的人跑来一天花18小时以上泡在这个或那个幻想神经链接游戏里。我打赌他们中也从没有人往电子表格里输过数据……

column1: The Calloway system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War. 3 moons at Calloway VI reflect so much sunlight that no city on the world has had to install street lamps. Trading is a bedrock of the planetary economy.
column2: Calloway星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民. Calloway VI的3颗卫星反射了如此多的阳光，以至于该星球上没有一座城市需要安装路灯. 贸易是该行星经济的基石.

column1: Sitting right on the Capellan/FWL border for as long as anyone can remember, Calpaca has remarkably remained a peaceful place of rolling purple hills, where strangely attractive alien sheep roam, herded by macho looking agromechs.
column2: 自人们记忆所及，卡尔帕卡就紧贴卡佩兰/FWL边界，却出奇地保持着和平，是一片起伏的紫色丘陵，怪异地迷人的外星绵羊在其中游荡，由看起来很有男子气概的农用机甲放牧。

column1: A mining and industrial world of more strategic than economic value, Calseraigne was seized from the Capellans during the Third Succession War by the Free Worlds League. The inhabitants chafe under Marik rule, and unrest and minor sabotage is common.
column2: 卡塞莱涅是一个战略意义重于经济价值的矿业和工业行星，在第三次继承战争期间它被自由世界联盟从卡佩拉人手中夺走了. 居民不忿于马里克的统治，经常会有骚乱和小规模的破坏.

column1: Calvados was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Calvados在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The system is strewn with thousands of asteroids and three large gas giants. The Department of Mega Engineering terraformed one of the moons in the system to serve as a base for system wide asteroid mining operations.
column2: 该星系散布着数千颗小行星和三颗巨大的气态巨行星. 巨型工程部对该星系中的一颗卫星进行了地球化改造，将其用作全星系小行星采矿作业的基地.

column1: Don't look at me, please. I'm an honest mistake that I had no part in creating.
column2: 请别看我。我是个无辜的错误，我完全没参与创造我自己。

column1: A rugged world with many ruins, Cambiano is home to one the Federations key archaeological sites, the Mighty Nein.
column2: Cambiano是一个崎岖且遍布废墟的世界，是联邦重要考古遗址之一——Mighty Nein——的所在地.

column1: The Cameron system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra, and was a member of the Principality of Regulus prior to the formation of the Free Worlds League in the late twenty-third century.
column2: Cameron星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并在二十三世纪后期自由世界联盟成立之前曾是Regulus公国的成员.

column1: An otherwise nondescript planet deep in Lyran space, Cameron is known for its agriculture, and its production of a particularly nice single malt scotch.
column2: Cameron是天琴领空深处一颗原本毫不起眼的行星，以其农业和出产一种格外优质的单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌而闻名.

column1: Camlann was one of many worlds to be colonized after the widespread adoption of the Laranth water-purification process in the 2630s, technology that made the terraforming easier by removing the requirement for the importing of pure water by ice ship.
column2: Camlann是2630年代Laranth净水工艺被广泛采用后众多被殖民的星球之一，这项技术消除了用冰船进口纯净水的需求，使地球化改造变得更加容易.

column1: Originally settled by fanatical Muslims around 2400, Camlann has recently passed from Lyran to Combine hands a few times.  Now \"safely\" in Draconis hands again, Camlann is typical of a border world full of militant religious fanatics... Interesting.
column2: 卡姆兰最初在约2400年由狂热的穆斯林定居，近来在莱兰与联合体之间几度易手。如今又"安全"地回到龙尼斯手中，卡姆兰是典型的充满好战宗教狂热分子的边界世界……有意思。

column1: Typical of a border world, Cammal has seen frequent raids from the Confederation ever since the system was taken over by the Federation during the Second Succession War.  Such raids have always had \"Plausable Deniability\", as such raids always do...
column2: 作为典型的边界世界，自该星系在第二次继承战争期间被联邦接管以来，卡马尔一直遭受来自联邦的频繁袭击。这类袭击向来都有"合理的可否认性"，向来如此……

column1: Campbelton III is the third planet in the Campbelton system and has a single moon named Atholville. Campbelton has been host to at facilities operated by at least one significant defense manufacturing company.
column2: Campbelton III是Campbelton星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Atholville的卫星. Campbelton一直是至少一家重要国防制造公司运营设施的所在地.

column1: The general rule is that border worlds don't contain significant manufacturing facilities.  Campertown is an exception to the rule, with Sacrada Industries having some important facilities here, manufacturing communications and guidance systems.
column2: 通常的规则是边界世界不包含重要的制造设施。坎珀顿是这条规则的例外，萨克拉达工业在这里有一些重要设施，制造通讯与制导系统。

column1: A stop-over point for those heading into the Periphery and Deep Periphery. A large population of retired spacers, combined with the trading and exploration route, made Campoleone a storehouse of knowledge in the Free Worlds League.
column2: 对于前往外围和深空外围的人来说，这里是一个中途停留点. 大量退役宇航员，加上贸易与探索航线，使Campoleone成为自由世界联盟中的一座知识宝库.

column1: The Canal system is located near the Moriguchi and Sweet Water systems. During the final years of the Star League, Canal was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: Canal星系位于Moriguchi和Sweet Water星系附近. 在星际联盟的最后几年，Canal驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

column1: Candiear is a very \"liberal\" planet, who's fertile farmlands are just as likely to be producing plants for \"recreational purposes\" as they are food.  The net result is a distinct \"hippy\" feel to the planet, and a small tourist trade.
column2: 坎迪尔是一颗非常"自由主义"的行星，它肥沃的农田既可能种出供"消遣用途"的植物，也可能种出粮食。净结果是该行星有一种鲜明的"嬉皮"气氛，以及一点旅游生意。

column1: The ruins of a Star League-Era manufacturing facility lay seemingly dormant and neglected.  A careful eye might notice the occasional heat signature, but no inhabitants ever intentionally make themselves known.
column2: 星际联盟时代制造设施的废墟看似沉寂荒废、无人问津. 细心留意的话，或许会注意到偶尔出现的热信号，但从未有居民刻意暴露自己的存在.

column1: Canopus IV has served as the planetary capital of the Magistracy of Canopus since the founding of the nation, and was heavily-industrialized for a Periphery planet
column2: 自建国以来，Canopus IV一直是船底自治区的行星首府，并且以一颗边缘星球而言，其工业化程度很高.

column1: Being deep in Fed space has allowed Capac a \"more or less peaceful\" existence over the years, which is one of the reasons it was chosen to house a large prison complex.
column2: 多年来，身处联邦空间的深处让卡帕克享有"大致和平"的存在，这也是它被选来安置一座大型监狱建筑群的原因之一。

column1: The former capital of the Capellan Confederation, Capella remains an important industrial planet with orbital shipyards.  Additionally, the Capellan War College remains one of the premier centres of learning in the Confederation.
column2: 作为卡佩拉邦联的前首都，卡佩拉仍是一颗拥有轨道船坞的重要工业行星. 此外，卡佩拉战争学院仍是邦联中首屈一指的学术中心之一.

column1: Caph has large swath of tropical rainforests, fertile lands and large amounts of mineral wealth. Sections of the planet were rendered uninhabitable during the First and Second Succession Wars, but Caph maintains many other Star League era facilities.
column2: Caph拥有大片热带雨林、肥沃的土地和大量矿产资源. 在第一次和第二次继承战争期间，该行星的部分区域变得无法居住，但Caph仍保留着许多其他星际联盟时代的设施.

column1: Capolla's thick surface jungle hides significant mineral wealth. The residents have long-standing political ties with their neighbours on Terra Firma, and the two planets tend to wield their economic and political power together.
column2: 卡波拉厚重的表层丛林隐藏着可观的矿产财富。居民与他们在特拉菲尔马的邻居有着长期的政治纽带，两颗行星往往联手运用其经济与政治力量。

column1: Capra was the headquarters world of the XXIII Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force during the final years of the Star League.  As a result, there are the usual rumours of a \"hidden cache\" that always surround former SLDF bases.
column2: 卡普拉在星盟最后几年是星盟防卫部队第二十三军（星盟）的总部世界。因此，围绕前SLDF基地总会有那种关于"隐秘储藏库"的老套传言。

column1: Capricorn was once a significant manufacturing planet for Wu Industries, however they discontinued operations in 2612 due to depleted mineral reserves increasing the cost of production.
column2: Capricorn曾是吴氏工业的重要制造星球，然而由于矿物储量枯竭导致生产成本上升，该公司于2612年停止了运营.

column1: Cap Rouge has three continents named beauport, Sainte-Foy and Sillery.  Hero Training Institute, a military academy specializing in training MechWarriors and Aerospace personnel, is located on Sillery.
column2: Cap Rouge拥有三块大陆，分别名为beauport、Sainte-Foy和Sillery. 英雄训练学院是一所专门训练机甲战士和航空航天人员的军事学院，位于Sillery.

column1: Caracol was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Caracol在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Carbonis' was the home of an insurgent movement that targeted both Confederation and SLDF troops. Carbonis was the site of Fort Dunedin, a Star League era base.
column2: 在星盟的最后几年，卡波尼斯是一支叛乱运动的据点，同时针对联邦与SLDF部队。卡波尼斯也是邓尼丁堡的所在地，一处星盟时代的基地。

column1: Carcassonne was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Carcassonne是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cardff was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cardff在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Caria was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Caria在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Caripare is a garden planet, who's lush vegetation and highly arable soil have made it almost vital to the survival of surrounding planets. Further, its warm waters support a wide variety of aquatic life, most of which is edible.
column2: 卡里帕雷是一颗花园行星，其葱郁植被与高度可耕的土壤使它几乎对周边行星的存续至关重要。此外，它温暖的水域支撑着种类繁多的水生生物，其中大多可食用。

column1: A largely peaceful and well-industrialized planet with a terrestrial climate, Carlisle was home to a large planetary militia as well as supplemental defense forces controlled by the owners of the factories located on the planet.
column2: Carlisle是一个总体和平、高度工业化且拥有类地气候的星球，拥有庞大的行星民兵，以及由该星球上工厂所有者控制的辅助防御部队.

column1: During the Star League era, Carmacks was considered a major commercial and transport hub. This concentration of wealth and its location attracted numerous bandit raids which kept its SLDF defenders active.
column2: 在星盟时代，Carmacks被视为主要的商业与运输枢纽. 财富的集中及其地理位置招来了大量匪帮劫掠，使其SLDF守军疲于应对.

column1: Carmelita was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Carmelita是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间消亡了.

column1: Carmen is a small Capellan planet of little apparent importance.  Ruins of a pre-human civilisation still dot the planet, which scientists believe was wiped out over 200000 years ago by an unknown event.
column2: Carmen是卡佩拉的一颗小型行星，表面上无足轻重. 前人类文明的遗迹仍散布在这颗行星上，科学家认为该文明在20多万年前被一场未知事件毁灭.

column1: Storms and befouled air make Carmichael a miserable place. The Taurian inhabitants fought a long, brutal guerilla war against the SLDF during the Reunification War, but ultimately lost; since then, the world has been a Davion holding.
column2: 风暴和污浊的空气使得卡迈克尔成了一个悲惨的地方. 在统一战争期间，金牛住民与星际联盟防卫军进行了一场漫长而残酷的游击战争，但最终失败了; 从那时起，该星球就一直是戴维恩的土地.

column1: Carnac was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Carnac于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Carnwath is a relatively unimportant world with a hot, humid climate. The world is known primarily for two things; its tropical fruit exports and its infamous swarms of stinging insects.
column2: Carnwath是一颗相对不重要的星球，气候炎热潮湿. 这颗星球主要以两件事闻名: 热带水果出口，以及声名狼藉的刺人昆虫群.

column1: A double sun and Carse's unusual orbit provided four cycles of seasons. During a Cold Cycle, the temperature plummeted, oceans froze, and only DropShips and the largest air vehicles could survive the heavy winds.
column2: 双日和卡尔斯不寻常的轨道带来了四个季节循环。在寒季，气温骤降，海洋封冻，只有空投艇和最大的飞行器能在狂风下幸存。

column1: Carsphairn has very fertile soil but it wracked by dangerous storms. Over the centuries large weatherproofing domes have been built over the best farmland, ensuring a good harvest each year.
column2: Carsphairn拥有非常肥沃的土壤，但饱受危险风暴的侵袭. 几个世纪以来，最好的农田上方建起了巨大的防风雨穹顶，确保每年都有好收成.

column1: The fourth planet in the Carstairs system is named New Tucson. It is site of a major copper mining operation by FrictionTechInc, who often hire small mercenary outfits for protection.
column2: Carstairs星系中的第四颗行星名为New Tucson. 这里是FrictionTechInc大型铜矿开采作业的所在地，该公司经常雇佣小型雇佣兵部队提供保护.

column1: The Cartago system was colonized at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was the subject of the Cartago Conflict in the early 2400s. It had been incorporated into the Federated Suns by the end of the Age of War.
column2: Cartago星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在2400年代初成为Cartago冲突的焦点. 到战争时代结束时，它已被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Carthage is so far out in the distant Periphery, and so isolated, that despite its pleasant climate it remains only lightly settled by eccentrics, adventurers, and criminals. Its single spaceport is little more than a concrete pad with a few service buildings.
column2: 迦太基在遥远的外围，与世隔绝，尽管它气候宜人，仍然只有少许怪人，冒险家和罪犯居住. 它唯一的一座太空港不过是一块混凝土板和一些服务建筑.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Carvajal is a small agricultural colony set up amongst a fertile volcanic plain.
column2: 在第四次继承战争后不久才建立定居点的Carvajal，是一个坐落在一片肥沃火山平原之中的小型农业殖民地.

column1: Located in a central area between several factions, the Carver system has been in the hands of many different rulers. As such, its populace has little allegiance to any faction, and generally try to do the best for themselves.
column2: Carver星系位于几个派系之间的中心地带，曾落入许多不同统治者的手中. 因此，其民众对任何派系都几乎没有忠诚可言，通常只求为自己谋取最大利益.

column1: Cascade was always a FWL planet, and given its limited resources it has remained peaceful in spite of its border position with the Lyrans.  Several strange ruins have been found on the planet, hinting of a (now dead) former civilisation.
column2: Cascade一直是自由世界联盟（FWL）的星球；由于资源有限，尽管地处与天琴人接壤的边境，它仍一直保持和平. 在这颗行星上发现了数处奇怪的遗迹，暗示着一个（现已消亡的）古代文明.

column1: Despite being similar to Terra, Caselton is too dry and too cold to easily grow crops. Similarly it has enough minerals to support its population, but not enough to export.  It has an asteroid belt (the Cassini Belt) that is mined for minerals.
column2: 尽管与泰拉相似，Caselton过于干燥、过于寒冷，难以轻松种植作物. 同样，它的矿物足以维持其人口，但不足以出口. 它有一条小行星带（卡西尼带），人们在那里开采矿物.

column1: The Casere system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War and by the Star League era was a part of the Draconis Combine, where it remained until the formation of the Free Rasalhague Republic.
column2: Casere星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候被殖民，到星际联盟时代时已成为天龙联合体的一部分，并一直如此，直到自由拉萨尔哈格共和国成立.

column1: Cassias is a tropical world located on the Draconis Combine/Federated Suns border. It also acted as the border between the \"Outback\" and the more densely populated inner systems of the Federated Suns.
column2: 卡西亚斯是一颗位于龙尼斯联合体与联邦太阳边界上的热带行星。它同时也充当了联邦太阳"内陆"与人口更稠密的内部星系之间的分界。

column1: This aquatic world is famed for its bountiful, deadly oceans. The population is clustered on volcanic island chains along the equator, while the oceans are ruled by a vast array of native predatory life forms.
column2: 这颗丰水星球因其广阔，致命的海洋而闻名. 人口聚集在赤道沿线的火山岛链上，而海洋则被大量的土著食肉生物所统治.

column1: Castile is the fourth planet in the system and is home to the only BattleMech manufacturing at King Dumount Defense Facility in the Nueva Castile region.
column2: Castile是该星系的第四颗行星，也是新卡斯蒂利亚地区King Dumount Defense Facility唯一战斗机甲制造业务的所在地.

column1: Castor has been the site of regular raids and battles between the Lyran and Free Worlds Armed Forces for the last two centuries. Famously, a raid from the Kell Hounds in 3011 destroyed a stockpile of ancient nuclear warheads on Castor.
column2: 过去两个世纪里，Castor一直是天琴与自由世界武装部队之间定期突袭和战斗的发生地. 其中尤为著名的是，3011年凯尔猎犬的一次突袭摧毁了Castor上的一批古代核弹头储备.

column1: Castrovia was a member of the Sian Commonwealth prior to the formation of the Capellan Combine in the mid-twenty-fourth century. Many educational institutes offer extensive archaeological courses surveying the planets many ruins.
column2: 在二十四世纪中叶卡佩拉联合体成立之前，Castrovia曾是锡安共同体的成员. 许多教育机构提供广泛的考古课程，考察该行星上的众多遗迹.

column1: Cate's Hold was settled as a gambling and resort world, but soon became a critical logistical center for the Magistracy in the Reunification War. Recent prospectors have discovered caches of SLDF technology and radioactive ores, once more drawing interest to the planet.
column2: 凯特之握最初作为赌博与度假星球被殖民，但很快成为卡诺帕斯行政区在统一战争中的关键后勤中心。近期的勘探者发现了SLDF技术储藏与放射性矿石，再次引起对该星球的兴趣。

column1: Catroxx was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Catroxx于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cavalor was settled after the Reunification War, as the Capellans sought to reinforce their borders with the Magistracy and the Free Worlds League. Since that time, fertile soil and plentiful resources have caused the population of the world to explode.
column2: 卡瓦罗尔是在统一战争后，因为卡佩拉人企图加强他们与船底自治区和自由世界联盟的边界而被殖民的. 从那时起，肥沃的土壤和丰富的资源导致星球人口激增.

column1: Naming conventions on Cavanaugh appear to have been strongly influenced by the tales and legends of King Arthur.  Steer clear of Camellot though - it is a silly place.
column2: Cavanaugh上的命名惯例似乎深受亚瑟王传说与传奇的影响. 不过要避开Camellot——那是个愚蠢的地方.

column1: Cayuga was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cayuga在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Ceará was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ceará 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cebalrai is a border world, and its surface has the scars of numerous battles between the Combine and the Commonwealth to show for it.  The atmosphere is thin, but breathable.
column2: Cebalrai是一个边境世界，其表面布满了联合体与共同体之间无数次战斗留下的疮痍. 大气稀薄，但可以呼吸.

column1: Ceiba was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ceiba是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Celano is a warm temperate planet with ample water sources apparently settled at some point in the early 3000s. Despite the plentiful water, the vicious storm systems that occur frequently on the world have made survival a challenge.
column2: Celano是一颗水源充足的暖温带行星，显然在3000年代初的某个时候有人定居. 尽管水源充沛，但频繁肆虐该星球的猛烈风暴系统使生存成为一项挑战.

column1: Celebes was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Celebes在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Celentaro is one of the core Taurean planets first colonised around 2700.  Like most Taurean planets, it is mostly self-sufficient, and not particularly notable for anything.
column2: Celentaro是金牛的核心行星之一，最初于约2700年殖民. 与大多数金牛行星一样，它基本自给自足，并无特别值得一提之处.

column1: Centavido was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Centavido是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cephi is a currently uninhabited planet, with little known about it.
column2: Cephi是一颗目前无人居住的行星，人们对它知之甚少.

column1: Ceram was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ceram在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: \"Cerberus Lives!\". System was colonized prior to the end of the Age of War. A regional capital and the most heavily industrialized planet within the Outworlds Alliance. See the \"Treaty of Cerberus\", year 2585
column2: 刻耳柏洛斯长存！。该星系在战火时代结束之前被殖民。它是外域联盟内的一个区域首府，也是工业化程度最高的行星。参见2585年的"刻耳柏洛斯条约"

column1: Cerignola was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cerignola是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cerillos is one of the so-called \"Southwestern Worlds\", an association of three worlds in the Free Worlds League. These agrarian worlds have a unique culture descended from North American Indian and Hispanic peoples.
column2: 塞里略斯是所谓"西南世界"之一，那是自由世界联盟中三颗行星的联合体。这些农业世界拥有一种源自北美印第安与西班牙裔民族的独特文化。

column1: During the Star League era, the planet Cerulean was the site of a research facility dedicated to finding new water purification technologies.  While much of this research has been abandoned over the years, it continues on a smaller scale to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Cerulean行星曾是一座致力于寻找新型水净化技术的研究设施所在地. 尽管多年来这项研究的大部分已被放弃，但它至今仍以较小规模继续着.

column1: Ceuta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ceuta在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Chaffee system is the location of at least one habitable world and as at 3095 was an independent system located in the Deep Periphery.  Little is known about it.
column2: Chaffee system是至少一个宜居世界的所在地，并且截至3095年，它是位于深空外围的一个独立星系. 人们对它知之甚少.

column1: The thin atmosphere and vivid sunsets here inspired artists from all the Terran colonies... before being utterly forgotten and abandoned.  With no atmosphere to speak of, some of the ruins still show signs of habitation.
column2: 这里稀薄的大气层和绚丽的日落曾启发了来自所有地球殖民地的艺术家……直到这里被彻底遗忘并遭废弃. 由于几乎谈不上有什么大气，一些废墟至今仍显现出有人居住的痕迹.

column1: Chagos is a fairly self-sufficient planet, with a relatively peaceful history.  The planet is primarily water, however it is dotted with numerous small islands with quite fertile soil, formed by the planets extensive vulcanic action.
column2: Chagos是一个相当自给自足的星球，历史相对和平. 该星球主要被水覆盖，但点缀着众多小岛，这些小岛由这颗星球广泛的火山活动形成，拥有相当肥沃的土壤.

column1: Chahar worked hard to bring corporations to the planet, and by 3025 it had succeeded. Not only is it the home of Dobless Information Services, but Trellshire Heavy Industries built a weapons plant near its capital city.
column2: Chahar努力将企业引入这颗行星，到3025年时已成功. 这里不仅是Dobless Information Services的总部所在地，Trellshire Heavy Industries还在其首府附近建造了一座武器工厂.

column1: The Chaine Cluster is a collection of 7 stars in a very close proximity - Turpin, Corell, Aeryn, Alnabog, Hillburg, Brekke, and Dark Mist.  While it has had several colonisation attempts, the area is mostly inhabited by pirates.
column2: Chaine Cluster是由7颗距离非常近的恒星组成的集合——Turpin、Corell、Aeryn、Alnabog、Hillburg、Brekke和Dark Mist. 虽然曾有过数次殖民尝试，但该地区大部分居民是海盗.

column1: A somewhat anomalous little planet in the middle of Federation space, Chakachamma is actually a moon orbiting a gas giant which is in the outer edge of the habitable zone of its class A star.  The result is a icy planet with widely varying temps.
column2: Chakachamma是联邦星域中部一颗略显异常的小星球，实际上它是一颗卫星，环绕着一颗气态巨行星运行，而这颗气态巨行星位于其A型恒星宜居带的外缘. 其结果是一颗温度变化剧烈的冰封星球.

column1: A tropical world, Chalouba is known for its large generally hostile insects, and constant rumors of a Lostech cache hidden during the days of the Star League by the 9th Army and the XVIII Corps.
column2: 一个热带世界，Chalouba以其体型巨大且通常具攻击性的昆虫而闻名，并且一直有传言称，在星际联盟时期，第九集团军和第十八军藏匿了一处失落科技储藏库.

column1: A recent Federated acquisition from the 4th Succession War, Chamdo has a cool temperate climate suitable for agriculture, and high mountains filled with minerals.
column2: Chamdo是第四次继承战争中联邦新近吞并的星系，拥有适宜农业的凉爽温带气候，以及蕴藏丰富矿产的高山.

column1: Champadanga is an icy world, where temperatures reach up to 150°C. Whilst it is rich with raw materials under the ice, the only settlements are those in sheltered chasms powered and heated by enormous Star League era steam generators.
column2: Champadanga是一颗冰封世界，温度可达150°C. 尽管冰层下蕴藏着丰富的原材料，但唯一的定居点位于受遮蔽的峡谷中，由星际联盟时代的巨型蒸汽发电机供电和供暖.

column1: This cold and rocky world is choked by silt and ash in the air from the constant volcanic activity. Inhabitants live in hab-spheres, emerging only to work in the extensive mines or research the local silicon-based life forms.
column2: 这个寒冷的岩质星球塞满了持续性火山活动带来的泥沙和火山灰. 居民在球型居住舱中生活，只在广阔的矿山中工作，或研究当地的硅基生命时出现.

column1: Chandler and its orbital moon Bing are home to a thriving financial sector, once a major part of the Combine. Financial transponders are often dispatched from here to nearby worlds to ensure regulatory compliance.
column2: Chandler及其轨道卫星Bing是蓬勃发展的金融部门的所在地，这里曾是联合体的重要组成部分. 金融应答器经常从这里被派往附近世界，以确保监管合规.

column1: Chanute has a strange past. Once settled by religious pilgrims during the Exodus, it became a God Cult when one of the self proclaimed leaders thought he could order the tides back. He could not.
column2: Chanute有着一段离奇的过往. 大迁徙期间，这里曾由宗教朝圣者定居，后来却变成了一个神教，只因其中一位自封的领袖以为自己能喝令潮汐退去. 他做不到.

column1: Not many people have heard of Chapineria, but almost everyone in the Combine wears one of their reknown trillion unit export rugged shoes and boots.
column2: 没有多少人听说过Chapineria，但联合体里几乎每个人都穿着他们那著名的、出口量达万亿双的耐用鞋靴.

column1: Massive planetwide forests cover this oxygen rich tropical world, a veritable breadbasket if ever there was one.
column2: 广袤的全球性森林覆盖着这颗富氧的热带世界，若世上真有粮仓，那便是此地.

column1: An almost uninhabitable dustball that was gifted to Tibetan pilgrims during the age of Exodus, Charity remains barely habitable to this day. The Combine operate a large prison complex here for undesirables.
column2: 一个几乎无法居住的尘球，在出埃及时代被赠予西藏朝圣者，Charity至今仍勉强可居住. 联合体在这里运营着一座大型监狱综合体，用于关押不受欢迎的人.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Charleston is a small mining colony set up amongst a large mountain range.
column2: 第四次继承战争后不久才有人定居，Charleston是一个建立在大山脉中的小型采矿殖民地.

column1: Charleywood was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Charleywood在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: An arable world with bands of temperate climate across the planet. Bottles of Chateau are exported across the Lyran Commonwealth, and include some of the finest wines in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 一颗可耕种的星球，整个星球分布着温带气候带. Chateau瓶装酒出口到整个天琴共同体，其中包含内天体最优质的葡萄酒.

column1: Chatham is home to a number of major manufacturing concerns both on the surface of the world and in orbit. Centuries of manufacturing have tainted the atmosphere, causing it to have some of the worst air in the entire Inner Sphere.
column2: Chatham是众多大型制造企业的所在地，这些企业既位于行星表面，也位于轨道上. 数个世纪的制造活动污染了大气，使这里的空气在整个内天体中都属于最糟糕之列.

column1: Chaumont was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chaumont在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Chaville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chaville是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Chebanse system was colonized at some point during the First Exodus from Terra, and is a dangerous and icy world. The dangers mean nothing to the brave Chebanse, who often free climb glaciers or swim in the sub arctic waters with fanged wildlife.
column2: Chebanse星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间的某个时候被殖民，是一个危险且冰封的世界. 危险对勇敢的Chebanse人来说不值一提，他们常常徒手攀爬冰川，或是在满是长着尖牙的野生动物的亚北极水域中游泳.

column1: Chengdu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chengdu于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Colonised shortly before the Age of War, Chenier is a nondescript planet notable only for some truly ancient ruins, and a large research complex devoted to studying them.
column2: 在战争时代前不久被殖民，Chenier是一颗平平无奇的行星，唯一值得注意的是若干极其古老的遗迹，以及一座专门用于研究这些遗迹的大型研究设施.

column1: Chennai was little more than a communications outpost and refueling point for the Capellans, and as the Succession Wars ground on, even that role stopped being worthwhile, and the world was abandoned to pirates and other criminals.
column2: 金奈仅仅是卡佩拉人的通讯前哨和燃料补给点，随着继承战争的长期持续，就连这点价值也渐渐丧失，最终这颗星球被遗弃，落入了海盗和其他罪犯之手.

column1: Overrun by Yakuza and otherwise unremarkable is probably the best way to describe Cheriton.  Then again that could be said for most Combine planets.
column2: 被极道肆虐，除此之外平平无奇，大概是对Cheriton最恰当的描述. 不过话说回来，大多数联合体星球都可以这么说.

column1: Chertan is water-poor but mineral rich. It was a significant manufacturing center during the Star League Era but has declined over the last few centuries due to both a decline in interstellar trade and frequent raids from the Lyran Alliance.
column2: Chertan缺水但矿产丰富. 在星际联盟时代，它曾是一个重要的制造中心，但由于星际贸易的衰退以及天琴联盟的频繁袭击，在过去的几个世纪里已经衰落.

column1: Chesterton was the capital of one of the earliest interstellar states to form in the Inner Sphere, the Chesterton Trade League and remains an important administrative world even to this day.
column2: Chesterton曾是内天体中最早形成的星际国家之一——Chesterton贸易联盟——的首都，至今仍是一个重要的行政星球.

column1: Chhaprauli was colonized during the Star League era by mining concerns looking to cash in on the planet's easily accessible germanium and iridium. The mining boom ended along with the Star League and the planet has been marginal ever since.
column2: 恰帕劳利在星盟时代由矿业公司殖民，他们想利用该行星易于开采的锗和衣获利。采矿热随星盟一同结束，此后该行星一直处于边缘地位。

column1: Elements of the 211th Jump Infantry Division were stranded here for awhile after their JumpShip sprung a helium leak centuries ago, leaving valuable Star League technology on the icy surface.
column2: 第211跳跃步兵师的部分部队在几个世纪前因他们的跃迁舰发生He泄漏而在此滞留了一段时间，并在冰封的地表上留下了宝贵的星际联盟科技.

column1: Chichibu's first settlers were wiped out by a virulent strain of smallpox. Since HPG communication hadn't been invented at the time, the rescuers and medical aid for these settlers arrived too late. Since then, nothing exciting has happened here.
column2: 秩父最早的定居者被一种致命的痘病毒消灭。由于当时尚未发明超脉冲通讯，为这些定居者准备的救援与医疗援助来得太迟。此后，这里再没发生过什么激动人心的事。

column1: Chillon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chillon在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Chilung system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent system prior to being incorporated into the Free Worlds League at some point during the Age of War.
column2: Chilung星系是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民的，并且在战争时代的某个时候被并入自由世界联盟之前，一直是一个独立星系.

column1: Chimpaw was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chimpaw在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Colonised at some point prior to the Reunification War, the aging structures of Chinmen Tao reflect the lack of support the world receives from the rest of the Draconis Combine. Many citizens resort to joining the DCMS in order to escape their world.
column2: Chinmen Tao在统一战争之前的某个时期被殖民，其老化的建筑反映出这个世界从天龙联合其他地区获得的支援何等匮乏. 许多公民为了逃离自己的星球，只得加入天龙联合军.

column1: An otherwise bleak world, Chirala still bears the marks of warfare from half a millenia ago when the Star League marshalled their forces upon the world before their strike against the Outworlds Alliance.
column2: Chirala是一个在其他方面都荒凉的世界，但仍留有五百年前战争的痕迹，当时星际联盟在向外世界联盟发动打击之前，曾在此星球集结兵力.

column1: Originally settled as a mining colony, Chirikof IV exported germanium to Galax well into the thirty-first century. As expansion efforts along the Taurian border grew, Chirikof became more and more important as a travel stop. Ships and crews use Chirikof as a base station during their explorations, which stimulated the Federated Suns' leadership to build space stations and permanently station military forces there.
column2: 奇里科夫IV最初作为采矿殖民地被定居，直到三十一世纪仍向加拉克斯出口锗。随着沿陶里安边界的扩张努力增长，奇里科夫作为旅行落脚点越来越重要。舰船与船员在探索期间以奇里科夫为基地，这促使联邦太阳领导层在那里建造太空站并常驻军事力量。

column1: Settled originally as Chisholm, the planet was renamed as Elgin in honour of Captain Edward Elgin who defended the world against the Free Worlds League in 2878. Most recently it became the capital of the short lived Tikonov Free Republic, whose mark many buildings still bear.
column2: 最初作为Chisholm定居，这颗行星后来更名为Elgin，以纪念在 2878 年抵御自由世界联盟、保卫该世界的Edward Elgin上尉. 最近，它成为短命的Tikonov自由共和国的首都，许多建筑至今仍带有其印记.

column1: Chita was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chita是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Chitwan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chitwan在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Choex was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Choex是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A minor and unimportant system deep in Davion space, the Cholame system was colonized at some point during the First Exodus from Terra. A Battle of Cholame, six week fight between AFSS and DCMS fleets with more than 200 warships destroyed in total on both sides, took place in 2790 at this otherwise unremarkable system.
column2: Cholame星系是戴维恩星域深处一个次要且不起眼的星系，在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间的某个时候被殖民. 2790年，在这个原本平平无奇的星系爆发了Cholame战役，这是AFSS与DCMS舰队之间为期六周的战斗，双方共有超过200艘战舰被摧毁.

column1: The infamous world of Chorley, known mainly for its production of ration packs amongst Combine troops, is a bleak world that harvests fungi to fill its nutritional needs.
column2: 臭名昭著的Chorley星球主要因生产供联合体部队使用的口粮包而闻名，这是一个荒凉的世界，靠采集真菌来满足自身的营养需求.

column1: Chota was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chota是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Choudrant system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Federated Suns.
column2: Choudrant星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代末期已被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Chouli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Chouli在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Christiania was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Christiania在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The aerospace weaponry produced on Chukchi by Maxell Metals are considered be essential to the defense of the Commonwealth, though the citizens of Chukchi III are far from pleased to be the ones supplying it. Heavy pollution from the industrial activities on the surface ensure there is a low level of discontent amongst the population at all times.
column2: Maxell Metals在Chukchi生产的航空航天武器被认为对共同体的防御至关重要，尽管Chukchi III的公民远不乐意成为供应这些武器的人. 地表工业活动造成的严重污染，使得民众中始终弥漫着低度的不满情绪.

column1: Chupadero in the modern day is highly loyal to the Combine, seemingly to make up for its origins as an Age of War prison colony. The locals pride themselves on being able to repair and use equipment many would have scrapped decades ago.
column2: 如今的Chupadero对天龙联合体极为忠诚，似乎是为了弥补其作为战争时代监狱殖民地的出身. 当地人以能够修理并使用许多人在几十年前就会报废的装备为荣.

column1: The Ciampino system was colonized during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War. Relatively unpopulated, its chief exports are rare fungi and spores used within the pharmaceutical industry.
column2: Ciampino星系是在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代被殖民的. 该星系人口相对稀少，其主要出口产品是用于制药业的稀有真菌和孢子.

column1: Cielo is a System that was Recently brought into the Bigger Picture. Though not much is Known about it on Starmaps, there might be a Lot of Potential in this Planet.
column2: Cielo是一个最近才被纳入更大格局的星系. 尽管星图上对其知之甚少，但这颗行星可能蕴藏着巨大的潜力.

column1: Cilvituk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cilvituk在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Cimeron system was colonized during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Cimeron星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代被殖民的.

column1: The second settlement of Ciotat, built upon the ruins of the first settlement that was destroyed in the age of war, is home to many deep boreholes built to harvest the raw materials contained within the icy permafrost. Seismic activity on the planet makes mining dangerous but also ensures a ready supply of new rich deposits.
column2: Ciotat的第二座定居点建在战争时代被摧毁的第一座定居点的废墟之上，这里有许多深钻孔，用于开采蕴藏在冰封永久冻土中的原材料. 星球上的地震活动使采矿十分危险，但也确保了新的富矿藏源源不断.

column1: The Circe system is the location of a habitable world, Circe I, and is located in the Deep Periphery region. The Circe system consists of a G2Ia class primary orbited by four worlds
column2: Circe system是宜居世界Circe I的所在地，位于深空外围区域. Circe system由一颗G2Ia级主星和环绕它的四颗行星组成.

column1: Circinus IV is the capital of the Circinus Federation. Has two moons named Bronco and Raxx. The Capital city is called Clayborne Remembered. C. J \"Bob\" McIntyre is name of their \"president\"
column2: 奇尔奇努斯IV是奇尔奇努斯联邦的首都。它有两颗卫星，名为野马和拉克。首府城市叫"克莱伯恩纪念城"。C·J"鲍勃"·麦金泰尔是他们"总统"的名字

column1: Cirebon is home to a large chemical industry that imports rare earths from Alula Australis, which feeds its nascent aerospace and computer industries.
column2: Cirebon拥有庞大的化学工业，从Alula Australis进口稀土，这些稀土供给其初生的航空航天和计算机产业.

column1: Claxton's industry consists of heavy industrial mines throughout its rich crystalline fields. Smaller settlements subsist of the mining and export industries that have arisen here.
