column2: 克拉克斯顿的工业由遍布其丰富水晶矿田的重工业矿场构成。较小的定居点靠这里兴起的采矿与出口产业维生。

column1: Claybrooke is a wealthy industrial and agricultural world. Ruled by a military dictatorship installed by Marik intelligence operatives, the world has become increasingly aligned with the Duchy of Andurien.
column2: 克雷布鲁克是个富裕的工农业星球. 该地由马里克情报人员扶植的军政府统治，已经越来越向安杜瑞恩公国看齐.

column1: Named after the great prairies located upon the world, Clearfield offers mostly flat terrain ideal for pastoral farming.
column2: Clearfield因该星球上广阔的大草原而得名，其地形大多平坦，非常适合畜牧业.

column1: Colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic during the Star League era, Clermont produces substantial electronics used in heavy machinery across the Commonwealth.
column2: 在星际联盟时代由边缘世界共和国殖民，Clermont生产大量电子产品，供整个共同体的重型机械使用.

column1: Settled during the early days of human colonization, Clinton is probably best known for being the home of Snord's Irregulars, and the impressive museum of historical artifacts they have amassed over the past several decades.
column2: 克林顿在人类殖民早期被定居，最为人所知的可能是斯诺德非正规军的驻地，以及他们过去几十年间积累起来的令人赞叹的历史文物博物馆。

column1: Clipperton has one of the few active manufacturing centers of Dropships and Jumpships remaining in the Inner Sphere. The colony itself largely exists to support this industry.
column2: Clipperton拥有内天体仅存的少数仍在运作的降落飞船和跳跃飞船制造中心之一. 殖民地本身在很大程度上就是为了支持这一产业而存在.

column1: The Clovis system was colonized during or shortly before the Age of War and by the end of the era had been incorporated into the Federated Suns. After that planet was conquered twice during First and Third Succession Wars by Draconis Combine but was liberated by AFFS after a short period of occupation.
column2: Clovis星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，到该时代结束时已被并入恒星联邦. 此后，该行星在第一次和第三次继承战争期间两次被天龙联合体征服，但在短暂占领后被AFFS解放.

column1: The Zhaomaon system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zhaomaon星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: Cogdell is a world possessed of considerable quantities of potable water, flourishing forests and rich farmland was settled by a group of convicts who were extorted to the world by a Periphery world. Colonists were able to survive and were absorbed by Federated Suns before Third Succession War. Capital city: Hangman's Death.
column2: 科格德尔是一颗拥有相当数量可饮用水、繁茂森林和肥沃农田的世界，由一群被某个外缘世界敲诈流放到此的罪犯定居。殖民者得以存活下来，并在第三次继承战争之前被联邦太阳吸收。首府城市：绞刑之死。

column1: The largest industry on Cohagen during the Star League era was salt mining. The huge salt plains that cover the world were so large that they were recognizable from space. The salt plains were also incredibly flat leaving vast swathes of unbroken terrain covering the planet.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Cohagen上最大的产业是盐矿开采. 覆盖这颗星球的巨大盐原面积如此之大，以至于从太空中都能辨认出来. 这些盐原还极其平坦，使得大片连绵不断的地形覆盖着整个星球.

column1: The northern continent of Cohay was heavily wooded and prone to raging forest fires during dry seasons. During the Star League era it was common for the Ninth Avalon Hussars, as the local garrison, to deploy to help fight the forest fires.
column2: Cohay的北部大陆森林茂密，在旱季很容易发生肆虐的森林大火. 在星盟时代，作为当地驻军，第九阿瓦隆骠骑兵团经常出动协助扑救森林大火.

column1: Once a shining jewel of the Federated Suns, Colchester was devastated during the First Succession War leaving lasting ecological damage.
column2: Colchester曾是恒星联邦的一颗璀璨明珠，但在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭，留下了持久的生态破坏.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Colchis is a small agricultural colony set up amongst a water world.
column2: Colchis是在第四次继承战争后不久才被殖民的，是一个建立在水世界中的小型农业殖民地.

column1: Settled as part of the Rim Worlds Republic, the world was seized by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2775. Coldbrook mainly exports machinery adapted for low temperatures to nearby worlds thanks to its industrial base.
column2: 作为边缘世界共和国的一部分被殖民后，该星球于2775年被天琴共同体夺取. 得益于其工业基础，Coldbrook主要向附近世界出口经过低温适配的机械.

column1: Cole Harbour became famous during the Reunification War as the location of the Star League Defense Force headquarters of the task force assigned to conquer the Magistracy of Canopus, and was one of the locations where massive vaults of Star League equipment were found, contributing to the richness of the planet.
column2: Cole Harbour在统一战争期间因作为被指派征服船底自治区的特遣部队的星际联盟防卫军总部所在地而闻名，并且是发现大量星际联盟装备储藏库的地点之一，这为这颗星球的富饶作出了贡献.

column1: One of the major trading ports between the Lyran Commonwealth and the Free Worlds League, Colfax is a cosmopolitan metropolis.
column2: 作为天琴共同体与自由世界联盟之间的主要贸易港之一，Colfax是一座国际化大都市.

column1: Colia is a breadbasket world that has been settled since the time of the First Exodus. Although invaded during the First Succession War, it avoided the devastation that came with most conquests at that time.
column2: Colia是一个粮仓星球，自第一次大迁徙时期以来便已有人定居. 尽管它在第一次继承战争期间遭到入侵，却避开了当时大多数征服所带来的毁灭.

column1: Colinas is a prairie like world that has been settled since the time of the First Exodus. Agricultural exports are its main source of economy.
column2: Colinas是一个类似草原的世界，自第一次大迁徙时期以来就有人定居. 农产品出口是其经济的主要来源.

column1: This system is uninhabited, but contains two fairly promising worlds for colonization.
column2: 此星系无人居住，但拥有两颗颇具殖民前景的行星.

column1: A, hot, dry world which is nearly uninhabitable near the equator, Colmar's only reason for existing as a colony is its impressive quantities of mineral and chemical resources, buried under its silicate crust.
column2: 科尔马是一颗炎热干燥、赤道附近几乎无法居住的星球，它之所以成为殖民地，唯一原因是其硅酸盐地壳下埋藏着数量可观的矿物与化学资源。

column1: Coloma is a dry world that has been settled since the time of the First Exodus. Although invaded during the First Succession War by the Draconic Combine, its civilian populace rose up against the invaders and assisted in the liberation of their world.
column2: Coloma是一个干旱世界，自第一次大迁徙时期起就有人定居. 尽管在第一次继承战争期间遭到天龙联合体入侵，但其平民奋起反抗入侵者，并协助解放了自己的世界.

column1: Colorado was historically the world with the richest germanium deposits in the entire of the Federated Suns. This led to extensive strip mining that slowly transformed the planet into an ecological disaster. Nowadays deposits are becoming more and more scarce.
column2: Colorado在历史上曾是整个恒星联邦中锗矿藏最丰富的星球. 这导致了大规模的露天开采，慢慢将这颗行星变成了一场生态灾难. 如今，矿藏正变得越来越稀少.

column1: Columbine is a desert mining world, dominated by equatorial rocky deserts and dry-weather grasslands in the temperate zone. Valuable deposits of rare earth elements and fissile materials make the inhospitable world a viable colony.
column2: 哥伦拜恩是一个沙漠矿业星球，以赤道地区的戈壁和温带地区的干旱草原为主. 稀土元素和裂变材料的宝贵矿藏使这颗不适宜居住的星球成为一个切实可行的殖民地.

column1: Mining operations in this unimaginatively-named system are coordinated from Gulf Breeze Station in the asteroid belt, but a ground colony does exist on the fifth planet. LosTech prospectors can sometimes be found here, excavating centuries-old ruins.
column2: 在这个名字毫无想象力的星系中，采矿作业由小行星带中的Gulf Breeze Station进行协调，但第五颗行星上确实存在一个地面殖民地. 这里有时能发现失落科技勘探者，他们在发掘数百年前的废墟.

column1: Conakry's colonization in 2614 was made possible by advances in terraforming technology, the effects of which have mostly stuck despite the Star League's fall. The locals claim to have the best jollof rice in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 科纳克里于2614年的殖民得益于地球改造技术的进步，其效果在星盟覆灭之后大多仍然保留。当地人声称拥有内天体最好吃的乔洛夫饭。

column1: Despite initial Lyran influence during the First Succession War, Concord has been a staple of the Free Worlds League for centuries, supplying nearby worlds with much needed medical and agricultural supplies.
column2: 尽管在第一次继承战争期间最初受到天琴影响，Concord数百年来一直是自由世界联盟的中坚，为邻近星球提供急需的医疗和农业补给.

column1: Conley's Patch was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 康利地块是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: Previously the home of the 17th Star League Defense Fleet, the orbital drydocks and shipyard remain... but in a state of disrepair.  While a prime candidate for a refurbished Star League shipyard, the ruins remain untouched and thick with rust.
column2: 这里曾是第17星际联盟防卫舰队的母港，轨道干船坞和造船厂依然存在……但已年久失修. 尽管这里是翻新为星际联盟造船厂的上佳之选，这片废墟却依旧无人触碰，锈迹厚重.

column1: Initially colonised and part of the Capellan Confederation for centuries whilst maintaining good trade links with nearby worlds, during the Third Succession War the planet overthrew its government and joined the Free Worlds League.
column2: 该行星最初被殖民，并作为卡佩拉邦联的一部分长达数百年，其间与邻近星球保持着良好的贸易联系；在第三次继承战争期间，该行星推翻了其政府并加入了自由世界联盟.

column1: Most of Conroe is covered by glaciers and ice flats, with civilization existing in the taigas near the equator or pockets of geothermal warmth. It hosts frequent military training maneuvers.
column2: Conroe的大部分区域被冰川和冰原覆盖，文明存在于赤道附近的泰加林或地热温暖地带. 这里经常举行军事训练演习.

column1: Constance was colonised towards the end of the Reunification War, and maintained a Star League garrison until the final days of the Star League. It's industrial base mainly consists of automotive and mining equipment manufacturers.
column2: 康斯坦斯在统一战争末期被殖民，并维持了一支星际联盟驻军直到星际联盟最后的日子。其工业基础主要由汽车与采矿设备制造商构成。

column1: By 2890 the world was marked as associated with the short lived \"Duchy of Don't\", though by 3022 it was no longer in the maps
column2: 到2890年，这颗行星被标记为与短命的"唐特公国"有关联，而到3022年它已不再出现在星图上

column1: Conwy was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Conwy是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cooperland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cooperland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间因战火而消亡.

column1: Coopertown was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Coopertown在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Coraines system was either colonised by the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War
column2: Coraines星系要么是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被外域联盟殖民的.

column1: Corbeanca is often described as a tax haven, due to its lax administrative control and rumours of knock backs. Tourism remains high though, with vast resorts located on its many shores.
column2: Corbeanca常被称为避税天堂，因为其行政管控宽松，且有回扣传闻. 不过，旅游业依然兴旺，众多大型度假胜地遍布其许多海岸.

column1: Cor Caroli is a mineral rich world featuring an even more mineral rich asteroid belt in close orbit. Despite the constant presence of a Lyran 'Mech Regiment on the planet, constant raids have degraded the planets mining capability significantly.
column2: 猎犬座α是一颗矿产丰富的世界，其近轨道上还有一条矿藏更丰富的小行星带。尽管该行星上常驻着一个莱兰机甲团，持续不断的袭击仍显著削弱了它的采矿能力。

column1: Founded and named after the Corwin Diverse Agricultural Group, a 22nd-century corporation (now long defunct), Cordiagr has been a bountiful breadbasket for Capella and other nearby worlds for eight centuries.
column2: Cordiagr由Corwin Diverse Agricultural Group创立并以其命名，该集团是22世纪的一家公司（现已消亡已久）；八个世纪以来，Cordiagr一直是卡佩拉及其他邻近世界丰饶的粮仓.

column1: An often contested world by the Umayyad Caliphate over the centuries, Nueva Castile reclaimed Córdoba after capturing BattleMech technology in 2850.
column2: 数个世纪以来，Córdoba一直是乌玛雅王朝频繁争夺的星球；在2850年获得战斗机甲技术后，新卡斯蒂利亚收复了Córdoba.

column1: The Corella system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the St. Ives Mercantile League prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century becoming a breadbasket world and a trading hub for the region.
column2: Corella星系在第一次从泰拉进行的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在24世纪中叶卡佩拉联盟成立之前曾是圣艾夫斯商业联盟的成员，成为该地区的粮仓世界和贸易中心.

column1: Home to defense contractor Hollis Industries, Corey is a heavily industrialised world which has been the target of substantial attacks in previous Succession Wars. An industrial recovery is underway, whilst the threat of warfare ensures that the world is heavily defended.
column2: 国防承包商Hollis Industries的所在地，Corey是一个高度工业化的世界，在以往的继承战争中一直是大量攻击的目标. 工业复苏正在进行中，而战争威胁确保该世界处于重兵防御之下.

column1: Corfu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Corfu于统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The gem caves of Coriscana are a wonder that brings rich tourism to the world, which is otherwise unremarkable. A black market in rare crystals has emerged in recent years.
column2: Coriscana的宝石洞穴是一处奇观，为这个在其他方面平平无奇的世界带来了繁荣的旅游业. 近年来，稀有水晶的黑市已然兴起.

column1: The Star League's plan to terraform Cork to fully habitable status was meant to take about 300 years. The destruction of the Succession Wars ensured Cork would revert to its desolate state. Only dusty artifacts remain.
column2: 星盟把科克改造为完全宜居行星的计划原定耗时约三百年。继承战争的破坏使科克注定退回荒凉状态。只剩下蒙尘的遗物。

column1: Initially settled by the Taurian Concordat, Corodiz was conquered centuries ago by the Capellans in a particularly brutal campaign which included civilian massacres and torture. Its position as a crossroads between three powerful states makes it politically unstable.
column2: 科罗迪兹最初由金牛协约国殖民，几个世纪前，经由一场特别残酷的战役而被卡佩拉人征服，这场战役中有平民遭到屠杀和折磨. 科罗迪兹的位置处在三个强国间的十字路口上，这使它在政治上很不稳定.

column1: Coromodir is the center of power of the Aurigan government. Two habitable worlds house nearly three billion people, and at the heart of Coromodir 6 is the vast Taurian fortress that serves as both capital and last bastion of defense. Both House Arano and House Espinosa consider Coromodir their ancestral home.
column2: 科罗摩迪尔是御夫座政府的权力中心. 两颗宜居星球定居着近30亿人口，而在科罗摩迪尔6号的核心则是巨大的金牛要塞，它既用做首都，也用作最后的防御工事. 阿拉诺家族和埃斯皮诺萨家族都将科罗摩迪尔视为他们的母星.

column1: Corridan IV was a keenly-sought colony world, with an ecosystem that was perfect for humans and their crops, with one small exception - The water supply was filled with lethal levels of heavy metals and a bacteria that would make every living plant or animal on the world toxic to humans. Eventually new water filtration technology was discovered that turned Corridan into a rich world. It's main exports are still from Water Pure Industries.
column2: 科里丹IV曾是一颗备受追捧的殖民世界，其生态系统对人类及作物都完美适宜，只有一个小例外——水源中充满了致命浓度的重金属，以及一种会让世界上每一种动植物都对人类有毒的细菌。最终人们发现了新的水过滤技术，把科里丹变成了一颗富裕的世界。其主要出口仍来自净水工业公司。

column1: Corsica Nueva is unremarkable, except that it is home to a vast asteroid belt, with a Star League era asteroid base named Mizutoshi which is under the control of the Seimeiyoshi-rengo, the Draconis Combine's federation of gangs which operates a thriving black market.
column2: 新科西嘉本身并无特别之处，只是它拥有一片辽阔的小行星带，其中有一座星际联盟时代的小行星基地，名为水户，目前由清明吉联合（Seimeiyoshi-rengo）控制——这是龙脉联合体各帮派的联合组织，经营着兴旺的黑市。

column1: The Corydon system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and had been incorporated into the Federated Suns by the end of the Age of War. Captured by DCMS in 2789, it was liberated again by AFFS in 2806 during first major counter-offensive against the Draconis Combine in First Succession War.
column2: Corydon星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代结束时已被并入恒星联邦. 2789年，该星系被天龙联合体军队占领；2806年，在第一次继承战争中针对天龙联合体的首次大规模反攻期间，又被恒星联邦武装部队解放.

column1: Cosenza is known mainly for its beautiful planetary rings, that are visible at all times during the day on its otherwise inhospitable surface.
column2: Cosenza主要因其美丽的行星环而闻名，在它那原本不宜居住的地表上，这些行星环白天始终可见.

column1: The Cotocallao system was settled at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent system within the Capellan Zone prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century and conquered by AFFS in 2864.
column2: Cotocallao星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在二十四世纪中叶卡佩拉邦联成立之前是卡佩拉区内一个独立星系，于2864年被AFFS征服.

column1: Coudoux was home to a Star League Defense Garrison during the last days of the Star League, which makes the world a prime target for treasure hunters.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后岁月里，Coudoux曾是星际联盟防卫驻军的驻地，这使该星球成为寻宝者的首要目标.

column1: The Cosenza system was at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent system within the Capellan Zone prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century. Was conquered by Federated Suns during Second Succession war.
column2: Cosenza星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后的某个时间点，并且在二十四世纪中叶卡佩拉邦联成立之前，是卡佩拉区域内的一个独立星系. 第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服.

column1: Courchevel is a heavily mined planet, with large plains broken up by massive rifts. One such plain is the Graveyard, a vast arid plain with rock formations shaped like gravestones.
column2: Courchevel是一颗被大规模开采的星球，广阔的平原被巨大的裂谷分割. 其中一片这样的平原名为“墓地”，是一片广袤干旱的平原，遍布形似墓碑的岩层.

column1: Courtney was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Courtney在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Coventry is a major industrial world and has served as the administrative capital of a province within the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Coventry是一颗主要的工业星球，并一直作为天琴共同体内一个行省的行政首府.

column1: The Covington system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and was a founding member of the Crucis Pact.
column2: Covington星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并且是克鲁西斯公约的创始成员.

column1: Coyle was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Coyle在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cranston was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cranston是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Crawford was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Crawford是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Crawford's Delight was founded by the aforementioned magnate Crawford, who uncovered massively mineral deposits within the mountains. One famous mountain is the Gatshadow, a vast black obsidian mountain that towers above the city of Westruun.
column2: 克劳福德之乐由前述大享克劳福德建立，他在群山中发现了庞大的矿藏。其中一座著名的山是盖特影子山，一座巨大的黑色黑耀石山，高耸于西特伦城之上。

column1: Cree was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cree是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The vast jungles of Crellacor are home to savage alien hunters and other primitive beings. Its great jungles are also known as \"Fortress Green\" thanks to the defensive possibilities they offer.
column2: 克雷拉科尔广袤的丛林是野蛮外星猎手和其他原始生物的家园。它的大片丛林也被称为"绿色堡垒"，因为它们提供了防御上的种种可能。

column1: Cresson was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cresson在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Crestoblus was founded during the age of war, and was one of the worlds conquered by the Federated Suns during the War of Reunification. It escaped damage for the most part and has remained a solid member of the Outworlds Alliance for centuries.
column2: Crestoblus建立于战争时代，是统一战争期间被恒星联邦征服的星球之一. 它大体上未受破坏，数百年来一直是外世界联盟的坚定成员.

column1: The Vaj system, better known by its main planets name of Crevedia, is located within the Donegal province.
column2: Vaj星系，更常以其主行星Crevedia之名而闻名，位于Donegal省内.

column1: Crichton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Crichton是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Crimond was discovered as the result of a misjump by the Gak's Revenge, a JumpShip. The team found a world filled with rare gemstones, minerals and ores but with a toxic soil. Never the less, over centuries the population of Crimond has become wealthy and rival any within the Commonwealth.
column2: 克里蒙德是因跃迁舰“加克复仇号”的一次跳跃失误而被发现的。搜索队发现了一颗满是稀有宝石、矿物与矿石、但土壤有毒的星球。尽管如此，几个世纪以来克里蒙德的居民已变得富有，可与联邦内任何人匹敌。

column1: Home to major manufacturers and a Star League era megaplant owned by StarCorps Industries, Crofton supplies the AFFS with a large portion of their materiel.
column2: Crofton是多家主要制造商以及StarCorps Industries旗下的一座星际联盟时代巨型工厂的所在地，为AFFS供应其很大一部分物资.

column1: Cronulla was colonised during the first exodus from Terra, and joined the short lived Sian Commonwealth prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation.
column2: Cronulla在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前加入了短暂的锡安共同体.

column1: The colony on Cruz Alta became self sufficient after the Reunification War, and has grown into a thriving community of landowners.
column2: Cruz Alta上的殖民地在统一战争后实现了自给自足，并已发展成为一个繁荣的土地所有者社区.

column1: Cryfder was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Cryfder是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Csesztreg was settled for its vast expanses of heavy metals. These metals were a key component of industry, but it wasn't until the Jamerson-Ulikov water purification technique was perfected that this world could be safely inhabited.
column2: 切斯特雷格因其广袤的重金属矿藏而被殖民。这些金属是工业的关键组成部分，但直到贾默森-乌里科夫净水技术完善之后，这颗行星才能安全居住。

column1: Csomad was colonised after the Age of War, and was briefly a member of the Taurian Concordat prior to the reunification war. Mostly self sufficient, the world spends most of its resources on imported food.
column2: Csomad在战争时代之后被殖民，并在统一战争之前短暂地成为金牛协约国的一员. 该星球基本自给自足，却将大部分资源用于进口粮食.

column1: Ctesiphon was the site of a surface trading post located close to the jump point in the Deep Periphery, though little more is known about it.
column2: Ctesiphon曾是深空外围中靠近跃迁点的一处地表贸易站的所在地，但除此之外人们对它知之甚少.

column1: Culmia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Culmia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled after the Reunification War by the widows of those lost during said war, Cumberland still maintains its matriarchal traditions. The societal tenets of Cumberland are designed in a way that children inherit their mother's surname.
column2: 坎伯兰在统一战争之后由那场战争中失去丈夫的寡妇们建立，至今仍保持其母系传统。坎伯兰的社会准则规定，孩子继承母亲的姓氏。

column1: The Cumbres system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal, prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth in the mid-twenty-fourth century.
column2: Cumbres星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的，并且在24世纪中叶天琴共同体成立之前，曾是多尼戈尔保护国的一员.

column1: Curaumilla is home to numerous ice wine vineyards, which are exported across the Free Worlds League.
column2: Curaumilla拥有众多冰酒葡萄园，其冰酒出口至自由世界联盟各地.

column1: Cursa had long been abandoned as too marginal a colony to sustain, but played a role in the war between ComStar and the Free Worlds League. The world was used as bait for a trap, chosen because of its lack of strategic value.
column2: 长期以来，科尔萨因为太过边缘，难以维持而被遗弃，但是它在通讯之星和自由世界联盟的战争中发挥了作用. 这颗星球曾被选作陷阱的诱饵，因为它缺乏战略价值.

column1: Once named Cussar, the world was renamed Barlow's Folly after a band of insurgents sabotaged DCMS forces for decades during the First Succession War and was then lampooned when finally defeated.
column2: 这颗行星原名库萨尔，在第一次继承战争期间一伙叛军在此数十年间持续破坏DCMS部队，最终被击败并遭到嘲讽之后，被改名为巴洛的愚行。

column1: Alien bacteria and vegetation on Cusset has made settlement difficult here, but pharmaceutical companies continue to pour money into research and development here.
column2: Cusset上的外星细菌和植被使这里很难建立定居点，但制药公司仍不断在这里投入资金进行研发.

column1: Custozza was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Custozza在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Cygnus has a distinctive feature: a flower dubbed the 'tundra witch', whose pollen has hallucinogenic properties. As a consequence the local megafauna - a kind of native caribou - is prone to massive stampedes in springtime.
column2: 天鹅座有一个独特之处：一种被称为"冻原女巫"的花，其花粉具有致幻性。因此当地的巨型动物群——一种原生驯鹿——在春天容易爆发大规模狂奔。

column1: Colonised centuries ago for its rich mineral deposits, the planet was devastated during the Succession Wars which has caused severe climate changes. The population has diminished rapidly as the ice age advances.
column2: 几个世纪前，这里因其丰富的矿藏而被殖民，但这颗星球在继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，导致了剧烈的气候变化. 随着冰河期推进，人口迅速减少.

column1: Liao, named after the Capellan namesake, has served as a capital for many years until its devastation during the Succession Wars reduced it to a backwater. It still maintains its importance to the Capellan Confederation however.
column2: Liao，以卡佩拉的同名者命名，多年来一直是首府，直到继承战争期间的毁灭使其沦为穷乡僻壤. 然而，它对卡佩拉联盟的重要性依旧未减.

column1: Cyrenaica is home to numerous native truffle farms, which are exported across the Draconis Combine.
column2: Cyrenaica拥有众多原生松露农场，出产的松露出口至天龙联合体各地.

column1: Cyrton is known for being lawless, and a thriving pharmaceutical trade.
column2: Cyrton以无法无天和繁荣的制药贸易而闻名.

column1: Czarvowo is known for its kilometers of mudflats and its mudskiff racing.
column2: Czarvowo以其绵延数公里的泥滩和泥地滑行艇竞速而闻名.

column1: Dabih was originally settled sometime during the twenty-fifth century by Muslim colonists. After ekeing out a hard existence, technological progress allowed resource extraction of the petroleum under the surface, which increased quality of life for all.
column2: Dabih最初是在二十五世纪的某个时候由穆斯林殖民者定居的. 在艰难维持生计之后，技术进步使得能够开采地表下的石油资源，从而提高了所有人的生活质量.

column1: The Dagda system consists of an F9V class primary named \"Tuath\" orbited by eight worlds.
column2: 达格达星系由一颗名为"图阿斯"的F9V级主星及环绕它的八颗行星组成。

column1: Dagda (LC) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dagda (LC) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被定居，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Despite the harsh climate on Dahar IV, the plentiful deposits of ores and minerals attracted colonists to the planet. Local engineers create some of the most advanced mining equipment found anywhere in the Inner Sphere, equipment which is then licensed to other worlds.
column2: 尽管Dahar IV的气候严酷，但丰富的矿石和矿物矿藏仍吸引殖民者来到这颗行星. 当地工程师制造出内天体中任何地方都能见到的一些最先进的采矿设备，随后这些设备被授权给其他世界.

column1: This frozen world is made habitable by the constant geothermal activity that convulses its surface. This also makes it a source of highly valuable radioactive ores, and the Magistracy keeps a garrison on the planet to protect its interests there.
column2: 这个冰封星球由于持续的地热活动而变得适宜居住，这种地热活动也使其地表剧烈震动. 这也使它成为极其重要的放射性矿石的来源，自治区在这颗行星留有一支守备部队，以保护在那里的利益.

column1: Dainmar Majoris
column2: 丹马尔马约里斯

column1: Settled after the Reunification War, Dalcour served as the headquarters of the XII Corps until the final days of the Star League. Caches are rumoured to be hidden amongst the icy hills.
column2: 统一战争后有人定居，Dalcour曾一直是第十二军的总部，直到星际联盟的最后岁月. 据传，储备库藏匿在冰封丘陵之间.

column1: Dalian was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dalian在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the Star League era, Dalkeith was home to billions. The First Succession war devastated the planet, killing billions and leaving the atmosphere still polluted today.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Dalkeith是数十亿人的家园. 第一次继承战争摧毁了这颗行星，导致数十亿人死亡，并使其大气至今仍处于污染之中.

column1: Dalmantia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dalmantia在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dalton is a water rich planet with stormy weather, and a merit based government allowing excellence in every craft.
column2: Dalton是一颗水资源丰富、风暴频发的星球，其政府以功绩为基础，使各行各业都能精益求精.

column1: Damevang was the site of numerous battles during the First Succession War, though only limited nuclear weapons were deployed.
column2: Damevang在第一次继承战争期间是众多战斗的发生地，不过只部署了有限的核武器.

column1: Damian was one host to a Star League Defense Garrison, which has led numerous historians and treasure seekers to the planet to search for caches. None have been found however.
column2: Damian曾是一支星际联盟防御驻军的驻地，这吸引了众多历史学家和寻宝者前往该行星搜寻秘藏. 然而，至今尚未发现任何秘藏.

column1: The thick forests of Danais allow for a thriving lumber industry upon the world.
column2: Danais茂密的森林使得这颗星球上的木材产业蓬勃发展.

column1: Deneshmand is home to numerous agricompounds that utilise Inner Sphere technology to boost their yields.
column2: Deneshmand是众多农业园区的所在地，这些园区利用内天体技术来提高产量.

column1: Ninety percent of the population of Dania lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth  century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the New Delphi Compact.
column2: Dania百分之九十的人口过着一种农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于泰拉十八世纪晚期技术的科技维持，这是新德尔斐盟约国Omniss哲学产生重大影响的结果.

column1: Daniels is home to numerous pharmaceutical companies that harvest the psychedelic hallucinogenic fauna found on the surface.
column2: Daniels拥有众多制药公司，它们采集在地表发现的致幻迷幻动物群.

column1: Danli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Danli是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dansur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dansur是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dante is the center of the Omniss movement that rejects all non-essential technologies. Communications are sporadic with the system however, and ship traffic suggests more population than what is officially reported.
column2: Dante是Omniss运动的中心，该运动拒绝一切非必要技术. 然而，与该星系的通信时断时续，而舰船往来表明其人口比官方报告的更多.

column1: Danxian is a relatively unimportant industrial base, though its lax trading laws means certain goods may be easier to acquire.
column2: Danxian是一个相对无关紧要的工业基地，不过其宽松的贸易法规意味着某些商品可能更容易获取.

column1: Danzig is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Danzig是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口商品.

column1: Orbital bombardment of Daol during the First Succession War destroyed its climate in a planet-wide firestorm. The ejecta from the mass driver strikes formed a dangerous field of debris in orbit.
column2: 在第一次继承战争期间，对道尔的轨道轰炸产生了全球性的风暴性大火，摧毁了星球的气候. 质量加速器攻击产生的抛射物在轨道上形成了危险的碎片区域.

column1: Dar-es-Salaam is the center of the Muslim faith within the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Dar-es-Salaam是天琴共同体境内穆斯林信仰的中心.

column1: Darius produces mid tech boats and yachts for export to nearby worlds.
column2: Darius生产中等科技船只和游艇，用于出口到附近星球.

column1:
The Dark Nebula is not a system, but an area of space—a vast cloud of ionized gas near the Periphery border of the Trellshire Province of Lyran Commonwealth's Tamar Pact (later Clan Jade Falcon occupation zone), roughly between the systems of Somerset, Apollo, and Wotan. The coordinates given designate the nebula's approximate center point.

The nebula interferes with sensors and communications and gives off intense radiation. There are several white and red dwarf stars in the nebula, as well as seventeen known pulsars.

A Star League naval base, Camelot Command, was hidden in a hollowed-out asteroid around one of the red dwarf stars. After the facility's rediscovery in 3050, "Dark Nebula" was often used to refer to Camelot Command or the specific star within the nebula that the facility orbits, though this is technically incorrect.
column2:
暗星云不是一个星系，而是一片太空区域——一团位于莱兰联邦塔马条约（后来是翡翠猎鹰氏族占领区）特雷尔郡省外缘边界附近的庞大电离气体云，大致位于萨默塞特、阿波罗和沃坦几个星系之间。给定的坐标标出的是该星云的大致中心点。

该星云干扰传感器与通讯，并释放强烈辐射。星云中有若干白矮星与红矮星，以及十七颗已知脉冲星。

一座星盟海军基地"卡美洛指挥部"被藏在一颗红矮星附近一颗被掏空的小行星中。在3050年该设施被重新发现之后，"暗星云"常被用来指代卡美洛指挥部或星云中该设施所环绕的那颗特定恒星，尽管这在技术上并不准确。

column1: Darwendale is known for its thriving pseudo-synthetic clothing ranges, which it exports to nearby worlds.
column2: Darwendale以其繁荣的伪合成服装系列而闻名，并将这些服装出口到附近的世界.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Davetal is a small trading post colony set up upon a lunar outpost.
column2: Davetal在第四次继承战争结束后不久才被拓殖，是一个建立在月球前哨站上的小型贸易站殖民地.

column1: The water on David is infected with a microbe that causes severe allergic reactions. Due to this, David does not export any goods but is self sufficient with light industry.
column2: David上的水源被一种会导致严重过敏反应的微生物污染. 因此，David不出口任何货物，但依靠轻工业实现了自给自足.

column1: Davisville was founded by a deserting Varnayist regimental commander 500 years ago. The locals export lumber and eke out a subsistence existence here, as the mineral-poor world supports little else.
column2: Davisville是500年前由一名叛逃的瓦尔奈派团指挥官建立的. 当地人出口木材，并在这颗矿产贫乏、几乎无法维持其他产业的星球上勉强度日.

column1: Filled with dangerous sinkholes, Dawn is a lightly populated center known for its administration and bureaucracy.
column2: 遍布危险的天坑，Dawn是一个人口稀少的中心，以其行政管理和官僚体系而闻名.

column1: Home to Metamorphosis Inc, Dayr Khuna is known for its biomedical industries and biotechnology.
column2: Dayr Khuna是Metamorphosis Inc的所在地，以其生物医学产业和生物技术而闻名.

column1: Ddraig was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ddraig在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Death's Gaze Cluster is a star cluster in the Deep Periphery, which gets its name from its appearance as a 4 lightyear spanning 'eye' that floats in the void.
column2: 死亡凝视星团是深远外缘的一个星团，其名称来自它那宛如一只横跨4光年、漂浮在虚空中的"眼睛"的样貌。

column1: De Berry uses the heavy silicon found within its soils to produce solar technology for export to nearby worlds.
column2: De Berry利用其土壤中发现的重硅生产太阳能技术，并出口到附近的星球.

column1: This fog-shrouded water planet is the site of one of the Capellan Confederation's Regional Training Centers, where new CCAF recruits are trained in amphibious assaults and combined-arms tactics.
column2: 这颗雾气笼罩的水世界是卡佩兰联邦一处地区训练中心的所在地，新的CCAF新兵在此接受两栖突击与合成兵种战术训练。

column1: Declan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Declan在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: They say it always rains on Decus. The mudflats turn into vast mudpits which cause tracked vehicles to become bogged down or even lost within their muddy depths.
column2: 人们说Decus总是下雨. 泥滩会变成大片泥坑，使履带式车辆深陷其中，甚至消失在泥泞深处.

column1: Defiance was originally settled as a mining colony. Defiance has four major continents named Auglaize, Cuyahoga, Maumee and Sandusky. Jerseyville: the planetary capital city, located on Maumee. Tainted atmosphere, please use masks.
column2: Defiance最初是作为采矿殖民地建立的. Defiance有四个主要大陆，分别名为Auglaize、Cuyahoga、Maumee和Sandusky. Jerseyville: 行星首府，位于Maumee. 大气受污染，请佩戴面罩.

column1: Those who have heard of Dehgolan will often only know it for its fever-ridden swamps, though its therapeutic mud baths are meant to be some of the best in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 听说过Dehgolan的人，往往只知其热病肆虐的沼泽，尽管据说其疗养泥浴在内天体中数一数二.

column1: Settled by Deists, the colonists intentionally keep their birthrates low as not to spoil the beauty of their world.
column2: 由自然神论者定居，殖民者有意保持低生育率，以免破坏他们世界的美景.

column1: Delacambre is a rich agricultural world that supports several near planets with its vast exports.
column2: Delacambre是一个富饶的农业世界，依靠其庞大的出口支撑着附近数颗行星.

column1: Devastated during the First Succession War, Delacruz has never quite recovered the full glory of its Star League days.
column2: 在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭性破坏后，Delacruz始终未能完全恢复其星际联盟时代的全部荣光.

column1: Delagoa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Delagoa在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Delevan is home to numerous manufacturing concerns such as Federated Boeing Interstellar and EHKodiak Industries which feed the Universal Ship Yards in orbit.
column2: Delevan拥有众多制造企业，例如Federated Boeing Interstellar和EHKodiak Industries，它们为轨道上的Universal Ship Yards提供配套.

column1: The Delios system consists of a G8VI class primary star orbited by seven worlds.
column2: Delios星系由一颗G8VI型主星以及环绕其运行的七颗星球组成.

column1: Delacambre is a world filled with rich petroleum and ore deposits that supports several near planets with its vast exports.
column2: Delacambre是一颗拥有丰富石油和矿藏的世界，凭借其庞大的出口支撑着附近数颗行星.

column1: Only a small portion of the land on Dell is above water, limiting agriculture but ensuring that vast fishing industries exist.
column2: Dell上只有一小部分陆地高于水面，这限制了农业，但确保了庞大的渔业产业得以存在.

column1: The gem of Delos is Blue City, the administrative hub filled with rich sapphire encrusted statues and buildings.
column2: Delos的明珠是蓝城，这座行政中心遍布着镶满蓝宝石的华丽雕像和建筑.

column1: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, Delphos's original governmental building is now an historic monument of a time long past.
column2: 德尔福斯在首次从地球出走期间被殖民，其最初的政府建筑如今已成为久远过往的历史纪念物。

column1: Demeter was one of the first worlds to become self sufficient after the Exodus, and was invested in heavily during the Star League. Lycom-Davion IntroTech have a large aerotech manufacturing complex here.
column2: Demeter是大流亡后最早实现自给自足的世界之一，并在星际联盟时期获得了大量投资. Lycom-Davion IntroTech在这里拥有一座大型航空航天制造综合体.

column1: Denbar is unique in that it lacked a permanent settlement for most of its history. Though claimed by the Capellan Confederation, no effort was made to colonize it until recently after the remains of a Star League expedition were found on the planet.
column2: Denbar的独特之处在于，在其历史的大部分时间里都没有永久定居点. 尽管卡佩拉邦联宣称对其拥有主权，但直到最近在星球上发现星际联盟远征队的遗迹之后，才开始有人着手殖民.

column1: An arid world filled with dangerous wildlife such as the Nayaraptor. Tourism for those aristocrats with the money to hunt the beasts is a growing trend.
column2: 一个干旱的世界，充满Nayaraptor等危险野生动物. 对那些有钱猎杀这些野兽的贵族来说，旅游业正日益兴起.

column1: Deneb Kaitos was once populated by billions, until the Amaris Civil War where the world was devastated by nuclear weapons. Even now the world still imports food to counteract the ecological devastation.
column2: Deneb Kaitos曾拥有数十亿人口，直到阿马里斯内战期间，该星球被核武器严重摧毁. 即便如今，该星球仍进口粮食以应对生态破坏.

column1: Denebola is a cold world and dependent on trade with other worlds for food. Due to its location, Denebola has traded hands many times over the Succession Wars, including a brief occupation by FWL mercenaries only a decade ago.
column2: Denebola是一个寒冷的星球，依赖与其他星球进行贸易来获取食物. 由于其位置，Denebola在历次继承战争期间多次易手，包括仅仅十年前曾被FWL雇佣兵短暂占领.

column1: Only a small portion of the land on Denizli is suitable for agriculture, limiting farming but ensuring that vast fishing industries exist.
column2: Denizli上的土地仅有一小部分适宜农业，限制了种植业，但确保了庞大的渔业产业得以存在.

column1: Derby was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Derby在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

column1: Vickers Mining own most of the mines of Derf, extracting vital rare materials for export to other worlds.
column2: 维克斯矿业拥有Derf的大部分矿场，开采重要的稀有材料以供出口到其他世界.

column1: Recently colonised by settlers from the Lothian League and Circinus Federation, the world is filled with prairies ideal for pastoral farming.
column2: 该星球最近被来自洛锡安联盟和瑟西努斯联邦的定居者殖民，遍布着非常适合发展畜牧业的大草原.

column1: Settled just before the Age of War, Des Arc's main economic base consists of numerous offices and administration buildings supported by a light industrial base.
column2: 德斯阿克于战争年代前不久被殖民，其主要经济基础由众多办公与行政建筑构成，并有轻工业基础支撑。

column1: Deschenes is home to numerous geneticists and biomedical companies which perform experiments on the local fauna. Many research and development laboratories exist here.
column2: Deschenes是众多遗传学家和生物医学公司的所在地，它们对当地动物群进行实验. 这里设有许多研发实验室.

column1: Deshler is famous for its giant blooms of red algae. Its location on the Davion-Kurita border has not done the population or industry any favors, given the near-constant raids and battles that play out on its scattered landmasses.
column2: Deshler以其巨大的红藻水华而闻名. 它位于戴维恩-栗田边界，这一位置对当地人口和工业毫无益处，因为在其分散的陆块上几乎持续不断地发生着袭击与战斗.

column1: Desolate Plains has had the misfortune of being caught between Davion, Liao, and the Taurians, and has suffered as a consequence: space battles led to the complete destruction of the planet's single small moon, leaving a dangerous ring system in orbit.
column2: 荒原平原不幸地夹在达维昂、廖氏和陶里安人之间，并因此深受其害：太空交战导致该行星唯一的小卫星被彻底摧毁，在轨道上留下了一个危险的环系。

column1: Desolate Plains
column2: 戴索雷特原

column1: Formerly a Magistracy holding, Detroit is a modest mining and agricultural world. During the abortive Taurian-Canopian War, the Taurians unsuccessfully attempted an invasion of the planet.
column2: 底特律过去为船底自治区所有，是颗不大的矿业和农业星球. 在流产的金牛-船底战争中，金牛人对该星球发动入侵的企图没有成功.

column1: Devil's Breath was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 恶魔之息是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: Devil's Rock is a more habitable place than its name implies; it was a bustling trade hub during the peak of the Star League. While its prosperity has declined somewhat since, it still features bustling ports and a thriving black market.
column2: 恶魔岩比它名字听起来更宜居；在星盟鼎盛时期它曾是一个繁忙的贸易枢纽。虽然其繁荣此后有所衰退，它仍拥有热闹的港口和兴旺的黑市。

column1: Devin was host to a massive Star League era battle where upon numerous warships crashed into the surface of the world, littering it with wreckage. Now known as the 'Boneyard', this salvage site is home to numerous salvagers.
column2: 德文曾是一场星盟时代大规模战役的战场，当时众多战舰坠毁在该行星表面，遍地残骸。如今被称为"骸骨场"的这处打捞地是众多打捞者的家园。

column1: Deweidewd was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Deweidewd在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: DeWitt is a heavily guarded system, with a large training academy for Commonwealth personnel.
column2: DeWitt是一个戒备森严的星系，设有一所面向共同体人员的大型训练学院.

column1: Dhaulgiri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dhaulgiri是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Named for the massive diamond reserves found near the surface, Diamantia is ran by what equates to a Cartel.
column2: Diamantia因在靠近地表处发现的大量钻石储量而得名，由相当于卡特尔的组织管理.

column1: The hot surface of Diass requires all colonists to wear environmental suits when outside the colony enclosure, however it does allow easy access to rare chemicals.
column2: Diass炽热的地表要求所有殖民者在殖民地围栏之外时必须穿着环境防护服，不过这也使得获取稀有化学品变得容易.

column1: The Federated Suns took Diboll as a protectorate to protect them from the SLDF in the Reunification War. Rich with valuable water, Diboll's economy relies on the purification and shipping of many billions of litres every year.
column2: 联邦太阳在统一战争期间把迪博尔收为保护国，以保护他们免受SLDF侵害。迪博尔拥有宝贵的水资源，其经济依赖于每年净化并外运数十亿升水。

column1: Dicallus is home to a branch of Bowie Industries, the premium manufacturer of the Gabriel hovercraft. Almost every industry on Dicallus exists thanks to Bowie.
column2: Dicallus是Bowie Industries一家分部的所在地，而Bowie Industries是Gabriel气垫船的顶级制造商. Dicallus上几乎每一个产业都因Bowie而存在.

column1: Dichell was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dichell是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dickinson is known amongst many pilots for its dangerous approach - Wind speeds can reach 1,800 km/h in the upper atmosphere
column2: 迪金森在许多飞行员中以其危险的进近著称——高层大气中的风速可达1,800公里/小时

column1: Once a pleasant Terran world, Dicon's climate was disastrously ruined by strip-mining of metals from its crust. Mining operations still continue, though there is little of value left to extract from the impoverished planet.
column2: 迪康曾是一颗宜人的类地世界，其气候因地表金属被露天开采而灾难性地毁坏。采矿作业仍在继续，尽管这颗贫瘠的行星上已几乎没有什么值得开采的东西。

column1: Originally an independent world, Diefenbaker was one of the planets offered membership in the Taurian Concordat, which they accepted. The world has since been conquered by Davion, but the people still have a streak of fierce independence.
column2: 迪芬贝克最初是一个独立的星球，得到了金牛协约国的加入邀请，而他们接受了. 这颗星球后来被戴维恩所征服，但人民依然具有强烈的独立倾向.

column1: Die Moot is home to the Federated Judicial Academy, one of the premium academies for lawyers in the Inner Sphere.
column2: Die Moot是联邦司法学院的所在地，该学院是内天体顶尖的律师学院之一.

column1: Dieron is a mountainous planet with significant mining and manufacturing industries. It was been an important world for centuries; serving as an administrative center for the Star League before serving the same role in the Draconis Combine.
column2: Dieron是一颗多山的行星，拥有重要的采矿业和制造业. 数个世纪以来，它一直是一个重要世界；它曾是星际联盟的行政中心，之后又在天龙联合体中担任同样的角色.

column1: Dieudonné was colonised due to extensive mineral wealth and readily available native lifeforms that were tasty and nutritious. It was devastated in the Amaris Civil War however, which killed most of the native wildlife.
column2: Dieudonné 之所以被殖民，是因为其拥有丰富的矿产资源，且当地存在大量美味又营养的本地生命体. 然而，它在阿马里斯内战中遭到严重破坏，大部分本土野生动物因此死亡.

column1: Dì-fang was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dì-fang在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Diik is a small black market colony set up amongst a large irrigated desert.
column2: Diik是在第四次继承战争结束后不久才有人定居的，它是一个建立在一片广阔灌溉沙漠中的小型黑市殖民地.

column1: Dijonne (Pain 3050+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dijonne（Pain 3050+）是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dili was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dili是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Distrustful of the Inner Sphere ever since their cities were massacred in the Reunification War, Dindatari maintains good relations with nearby Outworlds Alliance members.
column2: 自从其城市在统一战争中遭到血洗以来，Dindatari一直对内天体心存疑虑，但与附近的外世界联盟成员保持着良好关系.

column1: A barren world with a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. There are no continents, but there are several small seas and lakes.
column2: 一颗贫瘠的世界，拥有可呼吸的氮氧大气。那里没有大陆，但有几个小海与湖泊。

column1: Dirkel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dirkel于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Dirk's Gulf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 德克湾是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: A warm world filled with wildlife, Dixie is home to numerous abandoned Castle Brian's and emptied SLDF caches.
column2: 作为一颗充满野生动植物的温暖行星，迪克西拥有众多被废弃的布莱恩堡和被搬空的SLDF储藏库。

column1: Dneiper is home to a large academy for the AMC, where trainees from nearby worlds can train with the latest Periphery equipment.
column2: Dneiper拥有一所大型的AMC学院，来自附近星球的学员可以在这里使用最新的边垂装备进行训练.

column1: The Dnepropetrovsk system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra, was co-opted into the Alliance of Galedon, and then the Draconis Combine prior to the Age of War.
column2: Dnepropetrovsk星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，先被纳入加勒顿联盟，随后在战争时代之前被纳入天龙联合体.

column1: Dobson is home to a vast rainforest covering much of the planets surface. Historic records show Star League training facilities somewhere on the planet, but they appear lost to the undergrowth.
column2: Dobson拥有覆盖该行星表面大部分区域的广袤雨林. 历史记录显示，星际联盟的训练设施曾位于该行星某处，但它们似乎已湮没在林下植被中.

column1: Doggerbank is a jump point located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery. The closest inhabitable system is over 110 light years away.
column2: Doggerbank是位于深空外围反旋向区域的一个跃迁点. 最近的可居住星系在超过 110 光年之外.

column1: Dol was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dol在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Domain is a world of rolling plains and steppes, filled with large ranches containing vast herds of animals.
column2: Domain是一个由起伏的平原和草原构成的世界，遍布着大型牧场，牧场里饲养着庞大的兽群.

column1: Domeyko was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Domeyko是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Dompaire has a few Star League boreholes that are still in operation that brings rare materials to the surface.
column2: Dompaire拥有几个仍在运作的星际联盟钻孔，这些钻孔将稀有材料带到地表.

column1: Orbiting above Donegal IV there are 2 space settlements known as \"The Tin Cans\", which as well developed as the planet below. 3 continents: Dunellan, Hinterlands and Lockenar. Capital: Marsdenville. Twenty-fourth Lyran Guards are living there.
column2: 多尼戈尔IV轨道上方有两处名为“锡罐”的太空定居点，其发达程度与下方星球相当。三大洲：邓内兰、腹地与洛克纳。首府：马斯登维尔。第24莱兰卫队驻扎在那里。

column1: Donenac is home to numerous biomedical companies that located to the surface after a massive outbreak of the Chelosian virus last century.
column2: Donenac是众多生物医学公司的所在地，这些公司在上世纪切洛西亚病毒大规模爆发后迁至地表.

column1: A small industrialised colony, it is however home to the Meistmorn Academy, a premium MechWarrior training centre.
column2: 这是一个小型工业化殖民地，但却是Meistmorn学院的所在地——一所顶尖的机甲战士训练中心.

column1: Dorian's Tears is a significant astronomical feature in the anti-spinward Deep Periphery, though the system itself is unremarkable.
column2: 多里安之泪是反自转方向纵深外围中一处重要的天文特征，尽管该星系本身平平无奇。

column1: Recently colonised thanks to its vast agricultural lands, Dormandaine is quickly establishing itself as a premium exporter of meat products.
column2: 得益于其广袤的农业用地，Dormandaine最近才被殖民，并正迅速成为优质肉类产品的出口地.

column1: Dorpat is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Dorpat是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口货物.

column1: Dortmund is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Dortmund是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨世界出口商品.

column1: Vast underground caverns are where the majority of the population of Dothan live, as the surface is inhospitable.
column2: 广阔的地下洞穴是Dothan大部分人口居住的地方，因为地表不宜居住.

column1: Dove was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dove在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The surface of Dover has been host to a number of institutes of higher learning as well as a number of significant industrial concerns, while the Dover Shipyards operates in low orbit above the surface of the planet.
column2: Dover的表面一直是许多高等教育机构以及若干重要工业企业的所在地，而Dover造船厂则在行星表面上方低轨道运行.

column1: Dowles was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dowles在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Drachenfeld is located in the spinward region of the Deep Periphery, with the closest inhabited system over a hundred light years away.
column2: Drachenfeld位于深空外围的旋臂区域，距离最近有人居住的星系超过一百光年.

column1: Dralkig was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dralkig在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: Settled by a band of pirates and their families during the Third Succession War, this small world offers treasures and other delights not for sale on civilized worlds.
column2: 第三次继承战争期间，一群海盗及其家人在此定居；这个小小的世界提供着文明世界上买不到的珍宝和其他享乐.

column1: Dreadlord was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.

column1: Whilst the surface of Dienfontein is inhospitable, underground caves and rifts allow a large population to eke out a living.
column2: 尽管Dienfontein的地表不宜居住，但地下洞穴和裂隙让大量人口得以勉强维生.

column1: Dromini VI's location on the Lyran/Kuritan border has made it a frequent base for and target of units launching raids across the border. Ownership changed 3 times in 3029-3030 alone, though House Kurita has retained control since.
column2: 德罗米尼VI位于莱兰与库瑞塔边界，这使它常成为跨境袭掠部队的基地与目标。仅3029至3030年间，其归属就三度易手，不过此后库瑞塔家族一直保有控制权。

column1: Drosendorf supports nearby such as Zvolen thanks to its rich and fertile soils.
column2: 得益于其肥沃的土壤，Drosendorf为附近的Zvolen等地提供支持.

column1: A teeming agricultural world, Drozan is critical to Capellan food supply, and features massive urban centers, research facilities and food laboratories. The vast automated fields and fisheries are protected by elite Capellan Warrior House troops.
column2: 德罗赞是一个拥挤的农业星球，对卡佩拉人的食品供应很重要，它的特点是巨大的市中心区，研究设施和食品实验室. 巨大的自动化农田和渔场由精锐的卡佩拉勇士世家部队保护.

column1: Drusibacken is a self sufficient colony with a light industrial base, mining petroleum products from deep within the rainforests.
column2: Drusibacken是一个自给自足的殖民地，拥有轻工业基础，从雨林深处开采石油产品.

column1: Duantia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Duantia在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Located in a binary system, Dubhe is famous for its periodic 'super summers' when the normal hot season lines up with a relatively close approach to the systems secondary star.
column2: 杜贝位于一个双星系统中，以其周期性的"超级夏天"闻名，那时正常的热季会与相对靠近该系统次星的时间重合。

column1: The high gravity on Dukambia restricted plant growth until local scientists uncovered inverted farming methods, utilising the gravity to improve yields.
column2: Dukambia的高重力限制了植物生长，直到当地科学家发现了倒置农业法，利用重力来提高产量.

column1: Du Lac was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.

column1: The vast amounts of sunlight available on Dumaring allow for large amounts of photosynthesis amongst the vegetation, which has adapted to the high temperatures.
column2: Dumaring上充足的日照使植被能够进行大量光合作用，这些植被已经适应了高温.

column1: Dumassas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dumassas在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The industrial world of Dunianshire, home to the Majesty Metals corporation, is choked by pollution and the sulfurous by-products of heavy industry. The majority of the population lives in the city of Londinium, where breathing filters are required to go outdoors.
column2: 工业星球杜尼安郡，威严金属公司的总部，充斥着重工业的污染物和含硫副产品. 大多数人口居住在朗蒂尼亚姆城，在那儿需要戴呼吸过滤器才能出门.

column1: Dunkerque was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dunkerque在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Durabon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Durabon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Duran is a dry world, filled with dangerous sandstorms. It's rich mineral base allows it to import the food it needs from nearby worlds.
column2: 杜兰是一颗干燥的世界，遍布危险的沙暴。它丰富的矿产基础使其能从附近星系进口所需粮食。

column1: \"Where the elite meet, greet, and satisfy their most wicked desires\" is the slogan of Dustball, an inhospitable world that is vastly wealthy thanks to its pleasure palaces.
column2: “精英在此相聚、相交，并满足自己最邪恶的欲望”——这是“尘球”的宣传语。这颗环境严酷的星球因其享乐宫殿而极为富有。

column1: Duxford was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Duxford在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Duxfort was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Duxfort在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Though water is scarce on Dyev's surface, settlers uncovered an underground freshwater sea early in the planet's history. This supply of freshwater allows the planet to feed itself, while the productive mines on the planet drive its economy.
column2: 虽然迪耶夫地表缺水，但定居者在该星球历史早期就发现了一片地下淡水海。这份淡水供应让星球能养活自己，而星球上高产的矿场则驱动其经济。

column1: A mountainous world with heavy rainfall and fertile soils, Dyfed was home to a Castle Brian during the Star League era - the location of which has been lost to time.
column2: Dyfed是一个多山、降雨充沛且土壤肥沃的星球，在星际联盟时代曾是布莱恩城堡的所在地——其位置已随时间流逝而失传.

column1: Eagle Rest was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eagle Rest是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Eaglesham is known for its large oasis spread throughout the deserts, which are surrounded by fertile land.
column2: Eaglesham以遍布沙漠的大型绿洲而闻名，这些沙漠被肥沃的土地环绕.

column1: Early Dawn was conquered by the SLDF during the Reunification War. It returned to Magistracy control after the war ended, and is now dedicated to fishing and farming. The home office of Magliss Spirits, the leading producer of wine and brandy in the Periphery, is located here.
column2: 在统一战争期间，厄利道恩被星际联盟防卫军征服. 战争结束后，它回归了自治区控制，现在它专注于渔业和农业. 外围一流的葡萄酒和白兰地生产商马格利斯烈酒公司，它的总公司就设在这儿.

column1: Early Dawn
column2: 厄利道恩

column1: The Eaton system was colonised during the early twenty-fourth century and was an independent system prior to being incorporated into the Lyran Commonwealth at some point during or shortly before the Age of War. Pro-Skye Separatists' second home.
column2: 伊顿星系在二十四世纪初被殖民，在被并入莱兰联邦之前是一个独立星系，并入时间在战火时代期间或稍早。它是亲斯凯分离主义者的第二家园。

column1: All lakes and seas on Ebensburg are covered with a thick layer of algae. Some simple animal species feed on the algae, and their habitat is limited to within a few miles of the coast.
column2: Ebensburg上的所有湖泊和海洋都覆盖着一层厚厚的藻类. 一些简单的动物物种以这些藻类为食，它们的栖息地仅限于海岸几英里范围内.

column1: A very rural world with little resources, the population of Ebro has little contact with the rest of the galaxy.
column2: 一个非常乡村化的世界，资源匮乏，Ebro的居民与银河系其他地方几乎没有什么联系.

column1: Death is like the insect
\nMenacing the tree,
\nCompetent to kill it,
\nBut decoyed may be.
\nBait it with the balsam,
\nSeek it with the saw,
\nBaffle, if it cost you
\nEverything you are.
\nThen, if it have burrowed
\nOut of reach of skill,
\nWring the tree and leave it,
\n'Tis the vermin's will.'
\n- Emily Dickinson, ancient Terran poet
column2:
死亡如同昆虫
威胁着树木，
足以杀死它，
却也可被诱走。

用香脂引诱它，
用锯子寻找它，
挫败它，哪怕要你付出
你所有的一切。

然后，若它已钻入
技艺够不到的深处，
绞紧树木然后离开它，
那便是这虫豸的意愿。'

- 艾米莉·狄金森，古类地诗人

column1: High from the void above,
\nEntropy shall claim all,
\nInside our quiet reflections,
\nSerenity rules.
\nCall upon the loyal and,
\nOut we rage against the void.
\nMay the truthful word rise,
\nInfinite and immovable.
\nNone stand before us,
\nGreatness will prevail.'
\n- Last broadcast from DropShip Arlund's Pike II prior to loss of contact
column2:
自上方虚空高处，
商将吞没一切，

在我们静谧的沉思之中，
宁静主宰。

召唤忠诚者，
我们向虚空怒吼。
愿真言升起，
无穷而不可动摇。
无人能立于我们之前，
伟大必将胜出。”

——失联前来自空投艇阿伦德的派克II号的最后广播

column1: WARNING: Travel advisory is in effect. This system is occupied by extremely hostile and well-armed pirate elements that have refused peaceful contact and will engage passerby with lethal force. Captains are advised to plot routes around this system under any circumstances.
column2: 警告: 旅行警告已生效. 此星系被极端敌对且装备精良的海盗势力占据，他们拒绝和平接触，并会以致命武力攻击过往者. 建议舰长在任何情况下都规划绕开此星系的航线.

column1: The greatest gift the common people can have is a heart too large to falter and a mind to small to regret.' - Unknown
column2: '平民能拥有的最大礼物，是一颗大得不会动摇的心，和一个小得不会后悔的头脑。'——佚名

column1: Core sampling from the Southern polar surface revealed fragments of manufactured alloys. We must note that there is no record of the world ever being settled, nor any orbital conflicts that would have scattered debris onto the surface. The samples were also found to be microscopic in size and prevalent in the planetary crust, a characteristic more in line with the outcomes of manufacturing pollution than debris fall. We strongly urge an in-depth survey of the world prior to any colonisation efforts.'
\n- Preliminary survey report, unsealed by orders of General Vilma Alekto
column2: 对南极地表的岩芯取样发现了人造合金碎片。我们必须指出，没有任何记录显示该世界曾被殖民，也没有任何轨道冲突会把残骸散落至地表。样本还被发现尺寸极微且遍布行星地壳，这一特征更符合制造业污染的结果而非残骸坠落。我们强烈建议在着手任何殖民之前对该世界进行深入勘测。'\n\n- 初步勘测报告，经维尔玛·阿莱克托将军下令解封

column1: When this blazing sun is gone,
\nWhen he nothing shines upon,
\nThen you show your little light,
\nTwinkle, twinkle, through the night.
\nThen the traveller in the dark
\nThanks you for your tiny spark;
\nHe could not see where to go,
\nIf you did not twinkle so.
\n - Ancient traveler's prayer
column2:
当这颗炽烈的太阳消失，
当他不再照耀任何事物，
那时你便显出微光，
一闪一闪，照亮整夜。

黑暗中的旅人于是
感谢你小小的火花；
若你不曾如此闪烁，
他便不知该往何处去。

——古旅人祷词

column1: Primitives residing in their conclaves on the plains fear to venture into the Old Canyons. On the eve each twin moonrise, the conclave elders retell their story of The Lashing, or their exile from those canyons. The details and precise wording have changed over time. Even the title differs from kinship to kinship, be it 'Worza's Lament', 'The Dawn of Knives', or 'Downfall'. No matter the small details of this fable, its central theme has never faltered: retribution.
column2: 居住在平原上各聚居区的原始人不敢冒险进入老峡谷。每至双月升起的夜晚，聚居区的长老们都会讲述他们关于"鞭答"的故事——也就是他们被逐出那些峡谷的往事。细节与具体的措辞随时间而变。连标题在不同血缘间也各不相同，或叫《沃尔扎的哀叹》，或叫《刀锋黎明》，或叫《陨落》。无论这则寓言的小节如何变化，其核心主题从未动摇：报复。

column1: The role of the explorer is not simply the charting of unknown territories, for that is aimless wandering with extra expense. The great explorer ventures out in the interests of something bolder and larger themselves: country, unity and family. Our expedition is not in pursuit of petty glory, for we fly the colours of House Davion and we will only depart once those colours are nailed firmly to the mast, with our eyes on an endless horizon. Only then, we will do our duty, for country and countrymen.'
\n - Proceedings from the 827th Expeditionary Planning Board, House Davion
column2: 探索者的角色并不只是为未知疆域绘图，因为那不过是额外花钱的盲目游荡。伟大的探索者出发是为了比自身更宏大更勇敢的东西：国家、团结与家族。我们的远征并非追求卑微的荣耀，因为我们悬挂的是达维昂家族的旗帜，只有当那些旗帜牢牢钉上桅杆、我们的目光投向无尽的地平线时，我们才会启程。只有到那时，我们才会尽我们的职责，为了国家与同胞。'\n\n ——达维昂家族第八二七次远征规划委员会会议记录

column1: Loathe the enemy within. Hate the enemy without. Fear the enemy beyond.'

column1: EC821-387D was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: EC821-387D在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Echo is a barren, tundra-covered planet, whose icy cyclones scourge the surface of the world. It is home to a large Zen monastery.
column2: Echo是一颗贫瘠、被苔原覆盖的行星，冰冷的气旋肆虐着世界表面. 这里是一座大型禅宗寺院的所在地.

column1: Home to Edasich Motors, the vast manufacturing base supports a highly industrialised populace.
column2: Edasich Motors的所在地，庞大的制造业基地支撑着高度工业化的人口.

column1: Eden is one of five systems known as the Pentagon Worlds and was the final Pentagon system to be settled by the Star League-in-Exile. Habitable but dry, Eden has been held by several Clans for the majority of its history as a settled world.
column2: Eden是被称为Pentagon Worlds的五个星系之一，也是流亡星际联盟最后定居的Pentagon星系. Eden适宜居住但干旱，在其作为定居世界的大部分历史中，曾被数个氏族占据.

column1: Edirne (Brank 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Edirne（Brank 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Edmondson is home to numerous borehole mining facilities that extract minerals from deep under the burning deserts.
column2: Edmondson拥有众多钻孔采矿设施，从灼热沙漠深处开采矿物.

column1: Home to Journey Aerospace, Edwards has numerous landing sites situated across the planet.
column2: Edwards是Journey Aerospace的所在地，星球各地分布着众多着陆场.

column1: This critical military and logistical world features a Duchy Regional Training Center, where volunteers for the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces are sent for training. The RTC on Egress specializes in infantry and vehicle training.
column2: 这个重要的军事与后勤星球，其特色是公国的地方训练中心，卡佩拉联邦武装部队的志愿者被派往那里受训. 埃格雷斯的地方训练中心专攻步兵与车辆训练.

column1: The low gravity on Eguilles allows for vast megaflora to be grown amongst the fertile soils.
column2: Eguilles的低重力使得肥沃的土壤中能够生长出广袤的巨型植物群落.

column1: Abandoned during the Age of War, it was subsequently repopulated during the War of Reunification as a military depot.
column2: 在战争时代被废弃，随后在统一战争期间作为军事仓库重新有人定居.

column1: Eigerland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eigerland在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The inhospitable temperatures on the surface of Eilenburg force most of the population to stay within their habitation domes.
column2: Eilenburg地表恶劣的温度迫使大多数人口只能留在居住穹顶内.

column1: Eion was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eion在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ejeda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ejeda于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Elba was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Elba在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Elbar once served as a resupply depot for the Star League, but now most facilities sit ruined under vegetation.
column2: Elbar曾是星际联盟的补给站，但如今大部分设施都已荒废，掩埋在植被之下.

column1: Elbing (FWL) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Elbing (FWL) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Elbing is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Elbing是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口货物.

column1: El Dorado was vital to the commercial empire being built by Adam Davion and which laid much of the groundwork for the future Federated Suns. Has a number of \"Super Lakes\"
column2: 埃尔多拉多对亚当·达维昂正在建立的商业帝国至关重要，也为未来的联邦太阳奠定了许多基础。它拥有若干"超级湖"

column1: One of the three inhabited worlds of the Pleiades, Electra is a highly populated and industrialized planet with extensively irrigated farmlands in the major river valleys, and deep mines in the desert highlands.
column2: 伊莱克特拉是七姐妹星团三颗有人类居住的星球之一，它是颗人口稠密，高度工业化的行星，在主要的河谷地带拥有大量的水浇田，在沙漠高地拥有深井.

column1: Elektrougli is mostly a sandy desert lit by a bright blue sun, with deep canyons cut into the planet's crust.
column2: 埃列克特罗乌格利主要是被一颗明亮蓝色恒星照亮的沙漠，星球地壳上刻有深深的峡谷。

column1: The vast cities on Eleusis are filled with glass windows and fantastic views due to the tainted atmosphere which can only be breathed for a few hours every day.
column2: Eleusis上广阔的城市里满是玻璃窗和绝美的景色，因为这里受污染的大气每天只有几个小时可以呼吸.

column1: El Giza is a world of purple fronds instead of conventional trees or grasses. The Heather - as its known to locals - grows up to between three and four meters tall.
column2: El Giza是一个遍布紫色叶状体而非传统树木或草类的世界. 当地人称之为“石楠”的这种植物可长到三到四米高.

column1: After the stable and self-sufficient colony on Tortuga was well-established, the Dominions began the colonization of other worlds, leading to the settlement of New Port Royal and four other worlds.
column2: 在Tortuga上稳定且自给自足的殖民地稳固建立之后，自治领开始殖民其他世界，最终在New Port Royal和其他四个世界上建立了定居点.

column1: Elidere is a rather small and drab world. It possesses several modest deposits of oil and metals that provide the resources for the planet's metals industry.
column2: 埃利德尔是一颗相当小而不起眼的星球。它拥有若干中等规模的石油与金属矿藏，为星球的金属工业提供原料。

column1: Originally settled by people looking to escape from technology, Elissa was conquered by the Oberon Confederation during the Succession Wars who strip mined the world for the few resources it offered and brutalized the population.
column2: 最初由寻求逃离科技的人们定居，Elissa在继承战争期间被奥伯龙邦联征服，后者为获取这颗星球仅有的少量资源而对其进行剥离式开采，并残暴对待当地民众.

column1: Elix was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Elix是在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时候被开拓定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: El Kerak was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: El Kerak在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ellengurg is a small mining colony on a high gravity world. The raw materials are painstakingly drawn from the surface, though mine collapses are common.
column2: Ellengurg是一个位于高重力星球上的小型采矿殖民地. 原材料需要艰难地从地表开采，尽管矿井坍塌十分常见.

column1: Ellijay is unremarkable, except for a long, narrow continent that follows the line of the equator, stretching half way around the planet.
column2: Ellijay毫无特别之处，除了一条狭长的大陆沿着赤道线延伸，环绕了星球半圈.

column1: Home to a small aerospace manufacturer, Gutierrez Aerospace, Ellsworth provides raw material and expertise to the aerotech industry.
column2: 作为小型航空航天制造商Gutierrez Aerospace的所在地，Ellsworth为航空技术产业提供原材料和专业知识.

column1: There are scattered forests of dark green fungal towers that cross Elnath, and multicoloured solar flares occur annually, rendering electronics useless for a time.
column2: Elnath上散布着由深绿色真菌塔构成的森林，每年都会发生五彩斑斓的太阳耀斑，使电子设备在一段时间内失效.

column1: Eltanin is home to the virulent 'Eltanin Brain Fever', as well as a sun that may go nova at a moment's notice. Their disaster planning is therefore second to none.
column2: 埃尔塔宁是剧毒的"埃尔塔宁脑热病"的家园，也有一颗随时可能变成新星的太阳。因此他们的灾难预案无人能及。

column1: Elume is a small self sufficient colony which exports dry wines and meats to nearby worlds.
column2: Elume是一个小型、自给自足的殖民地，向邻近星球出口干葡萄酒和肉类.

column1: Emar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Emar在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Emerson is a harsh and marginally habitable world but rich in resources, and was founded by prisoners from a nearby system.
column2: Emerson是一个环境恶劣、勉强宜居的星球，但资源丰富，由来自附近星系的囚犯建立.

column1: Home to Ritza MechWarrior Academy, Emporia is also known for its numerous rare art collections and museums from eras past.
column2: 作为Ritza机甲战士学院的所在地，Emporia也以其众多来自昔日时代的珍稀艺术收藏和博物馆而闻名.

column1: A heavily industrialised world, Emris is home to Hollis Industries and StarCorps Industries which produce munitions for use across the Free Worlds League.
column2: Emris是一个高度工业化的世界，霍利斯工业和星团工业均坐落于此，它们为整个自由世界联盟生产弹药.

column1: Settled as an agricultural world, the initial settlers had to deal with the planet's axial tilt resulting in extremely long-lasting seasons.
column2: 该行星作为农业世界被殖民，最初的定居者必须应对行星的转轴倾角所造成的极为漫长的季节。

column1: Ender's Cluster is one of a number of multi-star clusters found within the Inner Sphere, though no notable worlds are inhabited within the cluster - mostly pirate bases and rogue settlements for those who do not wish to be found.
column2: 恩德星团是内天体内发现的若干多恒星星团之一，不过该星团内没有值得注意的有人居住世界——大多是海盗基地，以及那些不愿被找到者的非法定居点。

column1: Ancient ruins of the early Succession Wars can be found across the surface of Engadin.
column2: 在Engadin的地表，随处可见早期继承战争留下的古老遗迹.

column1: Settled by prisoners from the Rim Worlds Republic, Engadine has many areas that are covered with light snow and heavy ice. These harsh conditions forced the early involuntary settlers to become hardy survivalists.
column2: Engadine由来自边缘世界共和国的囚犯定居，许多地区覆盖着薄雪和厚冰. 这些严酷的条件迫使早期非自愿定居者成为坚韧的生存主义者.

column1: Enif's circular orbit means temperature variations are caused by the day/night cycle only.
column2: 恩尼夫的圆形轨道意味着其温度变化仅由昼夜循环造成。

column1: The plant-like organisms on Enkoping are dominated by various types of grass, but they only reach short heights due to the high gravity.
column2: Enkoping上的类植物生物以各种草类为主，但由于高重力，它们只能长到很矮的高度.

column1: Enkra was once a mining world, shipping raw materials to nearby Brinton. Over-mining and the Succession Wars made it no longer a viable industry, but the planet has seen a rebirth as an agricultural world outside of the badly-polluted industrial zones.
column2: 恩克拉曾经是个矿业星球，将原材料运往附近的布林顿. 过度开采和继承战争使它不再是一个切实可行的产业，但是在污染严重的工业园区之外，这颗行星已经见证了作为一颗农业星球的重生.

column1: Entalun was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Entalun是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Enzesfled was colonised just before the Age of War, and has so far avoided any devastation in the Succession Wars.
column2: Enzesfled在战争时代开始前不久被殖民，并且迄今为止在继承战争中未遭受任何破坏.

column1: An extremely hot planet. The equatorial regions are too hot for most species, and so the only settlements are situated in the extreme polar regions.
column2: 一颗极其炽热的行星. 赤道地区对大多数物种来说都过于炎热，因此唯一的定居点都位于极地地区.

column1: Epsilon is a damp, boggy world, prone to excessive rain and wide-scale flooding.
column2: Epsilon是一个潮湿、沼泽遍布的世界，常常降雨过多，并容易发生大范围洪涝.

column1: Epsilon Eridani is a pleasant but damp world, prone to frequent mild rainstorms. It primarily exports food, though it also has significant chemical and heavy industrial manufacturing.
column2: Epsilon Eridani是一个宜人但潮湿的星球，常有频繁而温和的暴雨. 它主要出口食品，不过也拥有重要的化工和重工业制造业.

column1: Epsilon Indi is a hot, dry world rich in heavy metals. It once boasted a Star League SDS of military drone satellites capable of destroying incoming drop ships, but the SDS has been lost as pieces were destroyed and repair parts could not be sourced.
column2: Epsilon Indi是一颗炎热、干燥且富含重金属的星球. 它曾拥有一个由军用无人机卫星组成的星际联盟SDS，能够摧毁来袭的降落船，但由于部件被摧毁且无法获取维修零件，该SDS已经不复存在.

column1: Used as a base by both the Terran Hegemony and the SLDF, Columbus was abandoned until it was rediscovered by the Explorer Corps.
column2: Columbus曾被泰拉霸权和星际联盟防卫军共同用作基地，后来被废弃，直到被探索兵团重新发现.

column1: Erdvynn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Erdvynn在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Known primarily for sheep farming and wool, Erewhon is home to a small colony and light industrial base mainly used for light vehicles for agriculture.
column2: Erewhon主要以养羊和羊毛闻名，拥有一个小型殖民地和一个轻工业基地，主要用于生产农用轻型车辆.

column1: Controlled by the lawless Von Strang family, this world is made up of a wealthy aristocracy and vast numbers of feudal workers. If you've got the money, you can buy many things here.
column2: 这颗行星由无法无天的冯·斯特朗家族控制，由富裕的贵族阶层和大量封建劳工组成。只要你有钱，在这里可以买到许多东西。

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Erod's Escape is a small colony set up by a mercenary band who fled their employer.
column2: 埃罗德的逃脱在第四次继承战争后不久被殖民，是一支从雇主手下逃走的雇佣兵队伍建立的小型殖民地。

column1: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, Eromanga is filled with strange native wildlife called weebs that the local farmers harvest.
column2: Eromanga是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被定居的，这里到处都是名为weebs的奇特本土野生动物，当地农民会捕猎它们.

column1: Errai is home to a large number of casinos and clubs, making it a popular recreation destination.
column2: Errai拥有大量赌场和俱乐部，是备受欢迎的休闲目的地.

column1: Eschenberg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eschenberg是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, Escobas is filled with strange native fauna called Harels that the local farmers crossbreed and harvest.
column2: 在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，Escobas遍布一种名为Harels的奇异本土动物，当地农民会对其进行杂交培育并收获.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Espakeh was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Rumours of hidden caches on the surface still exist to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Espakeh曾驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队. 关于其地表藏有隐秘储藏点的传闻至今仍然存在.

column1: An inhospitable muddy rock, Espia was colonized only for its use as a jump route. The population lives on rocky outcroppings amid the endless, deadly mud-flats, which are capable of swallowing an entire 'Mech whole.
column2: 作为一颗环境严酷的泥泞岩石星球，埃斯皮亚被殖民只是因为它是条跳跃航线。居民生活在岩石露头上，四周是无边而致命的泥滩——泥滩能整台吞没一台机甲。

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Esteros was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Rumours of hidden caches on the surface still exist to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Esteros曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻扎地. 关于地表藏有秘密储备库的传言至今仍然存在.

column1: The icy world of Estuan is home to vast mining facilities which pump rare material from deep within the permafrost.
column2: 冰封世界Estuan拥有庞大的采矿设施，它们从永久冻土深处抽取稀有材料.

column1: Esztergom was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Esztergom在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、于星盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dense jungles of stone towers cover Etiler, which formed due to massive planetary damage.
column2: 茂密的石塔丛林覆盖着Etiler，这些石塔是在大规模行星破坏中形成的.

column1: Filled with unique forms of native life, Euclid has been home to many research teams from bioscience departments across the Inner Sphere.
column2: Euclid充满独特的原生生命形态，一直是内天体各地生物科学部门众多研究团队的所在地.

column1: Euschelus is an icy desert, with large water-filled caves that are present just beneath the surface.
column2: Euschelus是一片冰冷的沙漠，地表之下分布着充满水的大型洞穴.

column1: Apart from a few frozen lakes and rivers, Eustatius is dry. Basins of red dust exist where oceans should be.
column2: 除了少数冰封的湖泊和河流外，Eustatius十分干燥. 本该是海洋的地方，只有红色的尘土盆地.

column1: Eutin is a poor system with a growing manufacturing base, which has found a niche in being able to produce goods for a lower price than many competitors. Investors believe TharHes Industries may be interested in the growing system.
column2: Eutin是一个贫穷的星系，但制造业基础不断增长，并凭借能够以低于许多竞争对手的价格生产商品而找到了自己的市场定位. 投资者认为TharHes Industries可能会对这个不断发展的星系感兴趣.

column1: The once thriving Star League Defense Force industrial facilities on Evansville were destroyed by the Draconic Combine during the First Succession War, and centuries later the effects are still being felt.
column2: Evansville上曾经繁荣的星际联盟防卫军工业设施在第一次继承战争期间被天龙联合体摧毁，数个世纪后，其影响仍能感受到.

column1: Evciler is home to numerous high tech medical centres due to recurring outbreaks of Edison White Flu.
column2: 由于爱迪生白流感反复爆发，Evciler拥有众多高科技医疗中心.

column1: Everett was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Everett是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被建立为定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This system was originally named for Ewan Rigg, a noted entrepreneur and adventurer. During the Star League era Ewanrigg had a reputation as a vacation spot.
column2: 该星系最初以著名企业家和冒险家Ewan Rigg命名. 在星际联盟时代，Ewanrigg曾以度假胜地而闻名.

column1: Exedor was originally home to military industry, but was devastated during the First Succession War. Now it is the storage facility for the Liao family's treasures, kept in underground bunkers and guarded by members of the Chesterton Reserves.
column2: 埃克塞多原本是军工产业的所在地，但在第一次继承战争中被摧毁。如今它是廖氏家族宝物的储存设施，保存在地下掩体中，由切斯特顿预备队成员看守。

column1: Home to the Galtor Blue Water Naval Yards, Exeter is wealthy planet that is the primary exporter of militarised seafaring vessels in this part of the Inner Sphere.
column2: Exeter是Galtor Blue Water Naval Yards的所在地，是一颗富裕的星球，也是内天体这一地区军用海上舰船的主要出口地.

column1: Fable was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fable是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A FWL system that was settled during the Age of War by refugees fleeing the conflict with the CCAF. As such, it always wasn't entirely behind the martial laws of the \"Free\" Worlds League.
column2: 这是一个自由世界联盟星系，在战火时代由逃离与CCAF冲突的难民所殖民。正因如此，它从来不曾完全拥护"自由"世界联盟的军管法。

column1: The Fager system is an uninhabited system located in the Rimward sector of the Deep Periphery past the Perseus-Cepherus Cloud Complex, a vast molecular cloud or stellar nursery.
column2: Fager星系是一个无人居住的星系，位于英仙座-刻甫斯云复合体之外、深空外围的外缘扇区；后者是一片巨大的分子云或恒星孕育区.
