column1: Fagerholm is a dry world with large canyon systems that are the result of millions of years of erosion from the rivers that once crossed its surface. Originally a Capellan colony, it was lost to the Free Worlds League in the aftermath of the First Succession War.
column2: 法格霍姆是个干燥的星球，有着巨大的峡谷体系，这是数百万年来穿过地面的河流侵蚀的结果. 它原本是卡佩拉的殖民地，在第一次继承战争之后被自由世界联盟占领.

column1: A wealthy world, with vast mineral wealth, Fairfax has been the administrative capital of the Fairfax Combat region.
column2: Fairfax是一个富裕的星球，拥有丰富的矿产资源，一直是Fairfax战区的行政首府.

column1: Named due the great amounts of farmland available to settlers, it was soon discovered that bacteria within the soils of the planet rendered all crops sterile. The same bacteria can be used within medical supplies, which has created a large soil mining operation on the planet.
column2: 由于可供定居者使用的农田面积广阔而得名，但人们很快发现，行星土壤中的细菌会让所有作物无法繁育. 同样的细菌可用于医疗物资，这已在行星上催生出大规模的土壤开采产业.

column1: Faleolo is nothing more than a rocky desert lit by a dim blue sun. Deep canyons cut into the planet's crust, where small mining operations eke out a living.
column2: 法莱奥洛不过是一片被昏暗蓝日照亮的岩石沙漠。深邃的峡谷切入行星地壳，小规模采矿作业在那里勉力为生。

column1: Fallen Stars was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fallen Stars是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Although terraformed partially during the Star League era, Fallon still has a tainted atmosphere which limits outdoor pursuits.
column2: 尽管在星际联盟时代进行过部分地球化改造，Fallon的大气仍受到污染，限制了户外活动.

column1: Fallry was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fallry在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: False Dawn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: False Dawn在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Falsterbo was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison, which led to the discovery of numerous small Star League caches across the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Falsterbo驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军，这使得人们在星球表面发现了众多小型星际联盟储藏点.

column1: Falsterbo is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Falsterbo是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口货物.

column1: Famdo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Famdo是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候建立的定居点，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: An icy and wintery world, Farandir was host to a Star League Defense Force garrison in the final years of the Star League.
column2: Farandir是一个冰天雪地的世界，在星际联盟的最后几年里，它曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Farcry was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Farcry在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Farhome is little more than a scientific outpost gathering data on an alien world.
column2: Farhome不过是一个收集异星世界数据的科学前哨站.

column1: Farnsworth is home to strange moss like flora - the ground is covered in thick purple slime. The large flora takes the shape of giant purple geodesic domes.
column2: Farnsworth是奇特苔藓类植物的家园——地面覆盖着厚厚的紫色黏液. 大型植物呈巨大的紫色测地线穹顶状.

column1: Far Reach is over a hundred days from the jump point into the system, rendering it extremely isolated from any other system.
column2: Far Reach距离进入该星系的跃迁点超过一百天，这使其与其他任何星系都极为隔绝.

column1: Farstar is a recent colony world situated spinward of the Draconis Combine. It's large asteroid field can obscure fleets of vessels.
column2: 远星是最近才建立殖民地的行星，位于龙尼斯联合体的旋臂方向。它庞大的小行星带能遮蔽成群的舰船。

column1: Farwell is a harsh, cold world. The high oxygen and low temperatures force the population to exist indoors. Large Star League era greenhouses still exist, filled with Terran flora as one of the only morale boosters to the miners.
column2: Farwell是一个严酷而寒冷的世界. 高氧和低温迫使居民只能在室内生活. 星际联盟时代的大型温室依然存在，里面种满了地球植物，是矿工们为数不多的精神慰藉之一.

column1: Fasa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fasa是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Fathepur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fathepur是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Infamous for being the site of the assassination of Alistair Steiner over half a millenia earlier, Fatima is an otherwise peaceful planet with a large industrial base.
column2: Fatima因作为五百多年前Alistair Steiner遇刺的地点而臭名昭著，除此之外，它是一颗和平的星球，拥有庞大的工业基础.

column1: Fefferfer was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fefferfer是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Feijo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Feijo在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Fellanin was hit by a city sized asteroid over a millenia ago, rendering much of the world uninhabitable. Mining settlements and farms are connected by subterranean railways to easily exploit the mineral deposits.
column2: Fellanin在一千多年前被一颗城市大小的小行星撞击，导致该星球大部分地区无法居住. 采矿定居点和农场由地下铁路相连，以便轻松开采矿藏.

column1: Little is Known about this system, only that it was under the control of the Escorpión Imperio in 3140
column2: 关于这个星系所知甚少，只知道 3140 年它处于"天蝎帝国"的控制之下

column1: Numerous settlements around the planet make up the industrialised world of Feltre. It's large trading centre is home to numerous interstellar corporations.
column2: 费尔特雷这颗工业化世界由行星周围众多定居点组成。它的大型贸易中心是众多星际公司的所在地。

column1: Sealed complexes make up the main settlement on Ferihegy, due to the toxic atmosphere on this extremely mineral rich planet.
column2: 由于这颗矿产资源极其丰富的行星大气有毒，Ferihegy上的主要定居点由密封建筑群构成.

column1: Dense jungles of large purple flora cover Ferleiten, which has large fertile soils due to radiation from the planetary rings.
column2: Ferleiten上覆盖着由大型紫色植物构成的茂密丛林，由于行星环的辐射，这里拥有大片肥沃的土壤.

column1: Ferranil was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ferranil在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ferrara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ferrara在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ferris is the location of an AGDA training facility for militia MechWarriors for the Outworlds Alliance. Mercenary and Pirate groups also recruit here.
column2: Ferris是外域联盟民兵机甲战士的AGDA训练设施所在地. 雇佣兵和海盗团体也在此招募.

column1: Settled by a group of rebels from the Draconis Combine during the Third Succession War, Ferris is now home to many hordes of disreputables. Good ale though.
column2: 第三次继承战争期间，一群来自天龙联合体的叛军在此定居，如今Ferris成了大批声名狼藉之徒的家园. 不过麦酒倒是不错.

column1: Fetsund is made up of a rocky desert lit by a wan yellow sun. There are extensive fossilized forests throughout the planet.
column2: Fetsund由一片岩石沙漠构成，被一颗暗淡的黄色太阳照耀. 整个星球上遍布着广袤的化石森林.

column1: The Fianna Massacre occurred here in 3017, where the clashes between the inexperienced Oberon Guards and rioting populace inadvertently released massive amounts of chemical weapons into the atmosphere, killing half the population and rendered the colony crippled.
column2: 3017年，Fianna大屠杀发生在这里. 当时，缺乏经验的奥伯龙卫队与暴乱民众发生冲突，意外地将大量化学武器释放到大气中，导致半数人口丧生，并使该殖民地陷入瘫痪.

column1: Fieferana welcomed Star League forces onto the planet, until the end of the Star League. Caches are believed to be hidden across the world.
column2: Fieferana欢迎星际联盟部队来到该星球，直到星际联盟终结. 据信，补给藏匿点遍布全球.

column1: Fiery Plains was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fiery Plains是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of the more notable worlds in the Davion 'Outback', Filtvelt is a naturally verdant planet and an agricultural breadbasket, despite the painful decline of its industrial base and constant pirate raids.
column2: 作为戴维恩“内陆”较为知名的星球之一，菲尔维尔特是一颗天然翠绿的星球与农业粮仓，尽管其工业基础正痛苦衰退、海盗袭掠不断。

column1: A sandy desert lit by a dull red sun. The local wildlife builds their shells out of rare metals, which are hunted by settlers.
column2: 一片被暗红色太阳照耀的沙质荒漠. 当地野生动物用稀有金属构筑外壳，遭到定居者的猎捕.

column1: Findal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Findal是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Finmark was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Finmark在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Finse was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Finse在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Finsterwalde system was colonized by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but then captured by the Lyran Commonwealth in the Second Succession war.
column2: Finsterwalde星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被自由世界联盟殖民，但随后在第二次继承战争中被天琴共同体占领.

column1: As key suppliers of salted fruits to the Commonwealth, Firenze has evolved into an economic powerhouse.
column2: 作为向共同体供应盐渍水果的主要供应商，Firenze已发展成为一个经济重镇.

column1: Firgrove is a large industrial hub, with the orbital Clyde Shipyards requiring large amounts of material for the construction of vessels.
column2: Firgrove是一个大型工业中心，轨道上的克莱德造船厂需要大量材料来建造舰船.

column1: The original colony was largely underground, built in the sides of deep kilometer-wide shafts that breach the ice that envelops this world. Fjaldr survives on its rich mineral resources and its position as a well-connected hub world near the Inner Sphere.
column2: 菲亚德尔最初的殖民地大部分都在地下，建在数千米宽的深井侧面，这些深井破开了包裹这个星球的冰层. 菲亚德尔依靠其丰富的矿产资源，以及处于内天体附近四通八达的枢纽位置而生存.

column1: Fjernet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fjernet是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This frozen world in the heart of Taurian space is the moon of a large ice giant. Tidal stresses from the planet have created an ocean of liquid water below the ice, and in that ocean, submarine dome cities cluster around warm volcanic vents to exploit the rich minerals found there.
column2: 这颗冰封星球位于金牛太空的中心，是一颗大型冰态巨星的卫星. 来自该行星的潮汐力在冰下创造了一片液态水的海洋，在海洋里，海底穹顶城市聚集在温暖的火山喷口周围，开采那里丰富的矿藏.

column1: Flatspin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Flatspin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Most of the few inhabitants of this arid world live in the extremely fertile floodplains of the planet's only major river system, where they operate and maintain the automated farms. A smaller number of people live in the mining plants of Flaum's north polar region.
column2: 这颗干旱世界稀少的居民大多生活在该行星唯一主要水系那极其肥沃的洪泛平原上，在那里操作与维护自动化农场。较少的人住在弗劳姆北部极区的采矿厂里。

column1: Once home to numerous weapons manufacturers during the Star League which were destroyed during the Succession Wars, Fletcher is now the base of Fusigon Heavy Weaponry.
column2: Fletcher曾是星际联盟时期众多武器制造商的所在地，这些制造商在继承战争中遭到摧毁，如今Fletcher是Fusigon重型武器公司的总部.

column1: Home to Flame Tech manufacturing facilities, Fletcher is a large manufacturing hub for nearby systems.
column2: 作为Flame Tech制造设施的所在地，Fletcher是附近星系的大型制造中心.

column1: Settled by pirates from Tortuga, Fletcher's Feast is a veritable hive of scum and villainy.
column2: 由来自托尔图加的海盗殖民，弗莱彻盛宴是一处名副其实的渣滓与恶棍巢穴。

column1: The site of a major naval battle during the Reunification War, Flintoft's orbit is still dangerously littered with debris. The industrial world has a bustling secondary market in salvaged technology from orbit as well as the many battlefields on the surface.
column2: 作为统一战争期间一场大规模海战的战场，弗林托夫特的轨道至今仍危险地散落着碎片。这颗工业世界在取自轨道的打捞技术以及地表众多战场方面，有着繁忙的二级市场。

column1: Florarda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Florarda于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Florida was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Florida最初是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: The original settlements on Flushing were destroyed in the First Succession War, but some homesteads still remain.
column2: Flushing上的最初定居点已在第一次继承战争中摧毁，但仍有一些农庄留存下来.

column1: Flychenia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Flychenia在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Flynn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Flynn在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Fomalhaut is a tropical world whose population mostly live on island chains. It serves primarily as a resort world, and despite its presence along the Kurita/Davion border has been largely spared from the destruction of the Succession Wars.
column2: 北落师门是一颗热带行星，其人口大多住在岛链上。它主要作为度假世界，尽管地处栗田/达维昂边界沿线，却在继承战争的破坏中大体幸免。

column1: The settlements on Foochow are carved out of the planet wide jungles, filled with dangerous predators and fauna.
column2: Foochow上的定居点是在覆盖全球的丛林中开辟出来的，那里充满了危险的掠食者和动物群.

column1: Foot Fall is known for its rapidly changing weather cycles. Both continents feature expansive mountain ranges and relatively little arable land, although the arable land that exists is prolifically fertile.
column2: Foot Fall以其迅速变化的天气周期而闻名. 两片大陆都拥有广阔的山脉和相对稀少的可耕地，不过现有的可耕地却极为肥沃.

column1: Home to an office of Skye Traders, as well as a manufacturing plant of Ford Military Limited, Ford is a stable manufacturing hub within the Inner Sphere.
column2: Ford设有Skye Traders的办事处以及Ford Military Limited的制造厂，是内天体中的一个稳定制造业中心.

column1: The Forkas system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Forkas星系是在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: An important world for much of the Lyran Commonwealth's history, Fort Loudon is home to an operational Fort Brian.
column2: 作为莱兰联邦历史上长期的重要世界，劳登堡拥有一座仍在运作的布莱恩堡。

column1: The Fortymile system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, and is an unimportant agricultural world.
column2: Fortymile星系在统一战争后的某个时期于星际联盟时代被殖民，是一个无足轻重的农业世界.

column1: The Foster system is a mineral rich and fertile terrestrial world orbiting close the jump point around a class M primary.
column2: Foster星系是一个矿产丰富且土地肥沃的类地世界，在围绕一颗M级主星的跃迁点附近运行.

column1: The Franklin system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. Devastated in both the First and Second Succession Wars, little remains of the vast mineral boreholes that were created here.
column2: Franklin星系是在自泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 它在第一次和第二次继承战争中均遭到毁灭性破坏，曾在此开凿的广阔矿物钻孔如今已所剩无几.

column1: Frankson was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Frankson在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Interstellar Expeditions has marked this world as suitable for colonisation, however little more is known about it.
column2: 星际远征组织已将这颗星球标记为适宜殖民，但除此之外对它知之甚少.

column1: Frazer is a major petroleum exporter, which provided the motivation for colonists to clear a broad swath of the native rainforest for agricultural production, allowing the world to be self-sufficient. The heavy rainfall is well-suited to Terran rice crops.
column2: 弗雷泽是个重要的石油出口地，为殖民者在当地雨林中开出大片荒地，从事农业生产提供了动力，从而使这颗星球可以自给自足. 大强度的降雨量很适合地球的稻米.

column1: Settled in the 2600s by expatriates from the Lyran Commonwealth, Fredotto fell into anarchy after the Amaris Civil War when its economy collapsed. It's few remaining settlers are mostly agrarian, with any industry being used in the export of high quality infantry weapons to neighbouring worlds.
column2: 弗雷多托于2600年代由来自莱兰联邦的侨民定居，在阿马里斯内战期间经济崩溃后陷入无政府状态。它剩下的少数定居者多为务农者，仅有的工业用于向邻近星系出口高质量步兵武器。

column1: Freedom VI is a hospitable world with a single moon named Vigil's Light. Famous for its part in the Outer Reaches Rebellion. Was directly involved in the events that led to collapse of the Terran Alliance. Home of Twentieth Avalon Hussars.
column2: 自由VI是一颗宜居行星，拥有一颗名为"守夜之光"的卫星。它以外围边区叛乱中的角色而闻名。它直接卷入了导致地球联盟崩溃的一系列事件。它是第二十阿瓦隆骠骑兵的驻地。

column1: The Freisland system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra, and was one of the founding members of the Federated Suns via the Crucis Pact.
column2: Freisland星系在泰拉第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并通过《克鲁西斯协定》成为恒星联邦的创始成员之一.

column1: Once the site of an Interstellar Expeditions genetic engineering research post, it has since been abandoned.
column2: 这里曾是星际探险组织一处基因工程研究站的所在地，但此后已被废弃.

column1: The Fröislandis system is located in the Anti-Spinward sector of the Deep Periphery past the Cygnus Loop, and is an icy world inhabited by a small outpost of researchers.
column2: Fröislandis星系位于天鹅座环之外的深空外围反旋臂星区，是一个冰封世界，居住着一支小型研究人员前哨站.

column1: Fronc was simultaneously colonized by both the Magistracy and the Concordat, and the fragile peace between the two colonial nations has been periodically broken by terrorism, local brush wars, and heated rhetoric.
column2: 弗龙茨同时被自治区和协约国殖民，两个殖民国家之间的脆弱和平已经被恐怖主义，当地的低烈度战争，还有激烈的言辞周期性地破坏掉了.

column1: Frondas is a small mining colony built to lay claim to the system during the First Exodus from Earth, but unlike most other planets of that era it has not grown substantially over the past few centuries.
column2: Frondas是一个小型采矿殖民地，建于第一次从地球出发的大迁徙期间，目的是宣示对该星系的主权；但与那个时代的大多数其他行星不同，它在过去几个世纪里并未有显著发展.

column1: Fronde was colonised after the Age of War, due to scans of rare rich platinum deposits under the surface.
column2: Fronde是在战争时代之后被殖民的，因为扫描发现其地表下蕴藏着稀有而丰富的铂矿藏.

column1: Fuentes was colonised during the First Exodus from Earth, and exports most of its foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: Fuentes是在第一次地球大迁徙期间被殖民的，并将大部分食品出口到附近的世界.

column1: Fugeres was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fugeres在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Fujidera system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Federation of Oriente prior to the formation of the Free Worlds League.
column2: Fujidera星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民，并在自由世界联盟成立之前是Oriente联邦的成员.

column1: The Fukuroi system was the site of Riots during the Star League era, which were brutally quashed. Memorials to the futility of standing against the Combine still exist to this day.
column2: Fukuroi星系曾是星际联盟时代暴乱的爆发地，这些暴乱遭到残酷镇压. 纪念对抗天龙联合体徒劳无功的纪念碑至今依然存在.

column1: Blessed with abundant resources and a rich biosphere, Furillo was rapidly colonized during the First Exodus and has been crucial to the Lyran industrial base for centuries. It houses a set of major production facilities, including a Mech factory.
column2: 凭借丰富的资源和繁茂的生物圈，Furillo在第一次大迁徙期间被迅速殖民，数个世纪以来一直是天琴工业基础的关键所在. 这里设有一系列重要生产设施，包括一座机甲工厂.

column1: The Furud system was colonised at some point in the late twenty-third or early twenty-fourth century and was a member of the Sian Commonwealth prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation.
column2: Furud星系在二十三世纪末或二十四世纪初的某个时候被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前是锡安共同体的成员.

column1: The Futuna system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Free Worlds League.
column2: Futuna星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代结束时已被并入自由世界联盟.

column1: The Fuveau system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War
column2: Fuveau星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Interstellar Expeditions has marked Fylover as suitable for colonisation, however little more is known about it.
column2: 星际远征已将Fylover标记为适宜殖民，但除此之外对它知之甚少.

column1: Gabenstad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gabenstad在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gacrux possesses vast mineral wealth but the star it orbits is slowly dying. As solar output wanes, the planet's average temperature drops by about a degree every century.
column2: 加克鲁克斯拥有庞大的矿产财富，但它所环绕的恒星正在慢慢死去。随着恒星输出衰减，该行星的平均温度每世纪下降约一度。

column1: Gaeri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gaeri在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Gahral was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gahral在统一战争结束后的某个时期、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Galatea began to prosper when a clever treaty was negotiated with ComStar, via which the planetary government managed to establish Galatea as the center of the mercenary trade. The influx of trade led to a boom in the economy.
column2: Galatea在与ComStar达成一项巧妙条约后开始繁荣，通过该条约，行星政府成功将Galatea确立为雇佣兵贸易的中心. 贸易的涌入促成了经济繁荣.

column1: Galatia lacks strategic value or resources, which has left it largely unscathed by the Succession Wars.
column2: Galatia缺乏战略价值或资源，这使得它在继承战争中基本未受波及.

column1: Galax's large moon causes turmoil on the surface and in the atmosphere, but allows a constantly replenishing amount of new raw materials and petroleum.
column2: 加拉克斯的大卫星在地表与大气中造成动荡，却也带来不断补充的新原材料与石油。

column1: Originally settled in 2282, the fifth planet in the Galedon system was attractive to early settlers due to its diamond deposits and abundant fresh water.  Galedon remains both a key agricultural centre, and an important industrial planet.
column2: Galedon星系中的第五颗行星最初于2282年有人定居，因其钻石矿藏和丰富的淡水而吸引了早期定居者. Galedon如今仍是一个重要的农业中心，也是一颗重要的工业行星.

column1: Galicia is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery region known as Nueva Castile
column2: Galicia是构成被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的深空外围区域一部分的星球之一.

column1: The Galisteo system was settled at some point during or prior to the Age of War, and avoided devastation during the Succession Wars
column2: Galisteo星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，并在继承战争期间免遭毁灭.

column1: Settled during the second wave of the First Exodus from Sol, Gallatin provides materials to nearby worlds.
column2: 在从Sol出发的第一次大迁徙的第二波期间有人定居，Gallatin为附近的世界提供材料.

column1: Gallery presents a barren surface to observers. The system's weak sun cannot penetrate the perpetual heavy cloud cover, and the planet is constantly swept by violent storms. Tax laws make it a haven for less reputable companies such as Quikscell.
column2: 加勒里向观测者展现出一片荒芜的地表。该星系微弱的恒星无法穿透终年厚重的云层，行星上暴风肆虐不休。税收法律使它成为Quikscell之类名声不佳的公司的避风港。

column1: The Gallis system was colonised at some point during or prior to the Age of War, and held an SLDF garrison which was banished to a remote part of the planet.
column2: Gallis星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，并曾驻扎有一支SLDF驻军，该驻军被放逐到了该行星的偏远地区.

column1: The Gallitzin system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Gallitzin星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: Galtor was a populous garden world until the Succession Wars, which devastated the world and its population due to its location on the border between the Federated Suns and Draconis Combine.
column2: Galtor曾是一个人口稠密的花园世界，直到继承战争因其所处的恒星联邦与天龙联合体边界位置而摧毁了这个世界及其人口.

column1: Adverts for the tropical world of Galuzzo often talk about the \"Exotic wines and the best pizza in known space\" which supports a thriving tourist industry.
column2: 热带世界加卢佐的广告常常宣传"异域美酒与已知空间里最好的披萨"，这支撑起了一个兴旺的旅游业。

column1: The Gambarare system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Gambarare星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并且在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前，曾是联合印度教集合体的一员.

column1: From the 2200s to the 2400s, the Gambier system was a stopover point for colony ships moving to other systems spinward from Terra. Now it is little more than an entertainment hub.
column2: 从2200年代到2400年代，Gambier星系是从泰拉向顺旋方向前往其他星系的殖民船的中转站. 如今它几乎只是一个娱乐枢纽.

column1: The Gambilon system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: 在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代，Gambilon星系在某个时候被殖民了.

column1: Gamlestolen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gamlestolen在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Originally found due to a misjump, the Gandy's Luck system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra prior to joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: 甘迪之运星系最初因一次错误跳跃而被发现，在首次从地球出走期间被殖民，后来加入龙尼斯联合体。

column1: As a recently-colonized world, Gangtok is bustling with boom-town energy; temporary cities have sprung up all over the unremarkable Terran world, as eager prospectors, colonists, and merchants crowd in, all looking to strike it rich.
column2: 甘托克作为一个新近殖民的星球，正因新兴城市的能量变得热闹起来; 随着热切的勘探者，殖民者和商人蜂拥而入，寻求发财致富，临时城市在这颗不起眼的类地星球上遍地涌现.

column1: The Gannett system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Gannett星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时期被殖民的.

column1: The Ganshoren system was colonized at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra, and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Ganshoren星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，到战争时代结束时已被并入天琴共同体.

column1: During the Star League era, Gan Singh served as the headquarters for the XXIV Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force, supporting by a nascent mining industry which still exists to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Gan Singh曾是星际联盟防卫军第24军（星际联盟）的司令部所在地，并得到当时新兴采矿业的支持，该产业至今仍然存在.

column1: Recently settled, the colonists on Gant eke out a limited living on the hard scrabble like soils.
column2: 最近才有人定居，Gant上的殖民者在坚硬贫瘠的土壤上勉强维持着有限的生活.

column1: The original colony on Gardnaus has been almost completely reclaimed by the scouring sandstorms that constantly sweep the planet's surface. A few research teams still pick through the battlefield remnants from Star League era conflicts.
column2: 加德纳斯上的最初殖民地几乎已被不断横扫地表的蚀骨沙暴完全夺回。仍有几支研究队在这片星盟时代冲突留下的战场残骸中翻找。

column1: Garrison is so named for its military training center and post. Pockmarked by weapon testing sites, it still churns out thousands of new recruits every year.
column2: Garrison因其军事训练中心和驻地而得名. 尽管遍布武器试验场，它每年仍源源不断地培养出数千名新兵.

column1: A water rich world, much of its wealth comes from the 'Underdepth Oceans', a mineral rich subterranean cavern system filled with water.
column2: 一颗水资源丰富的行星，其大部分财富来自"深渊洋"——一个充满水的富矿地下洞穴系统。

column1: The steppes and prairies of Gatchina provide ample farming ground for the population.
column2: Gatchina的草原和普雷里为当地居民提供了充足的农田.

column1: Gatekeeper is an early Star League-In-Exile colony which was established prior to the SLDF's collapse in 2801.
column2: 守门人是一处早期星盟流亡殖民地，建立在SLDF于2801年崩溃之前。

column1: Gateway is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Gateway是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

column1: The Gatineau system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Gatineau星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民的.

column1: This agricultural world supplies food to nearby systems and the Taurian Concordat. Much of this industry is based on factory farming of the genetically-engineered Gaucin Hog, a native life-form that some activists believe is sapient.
column2: 这颗农业星球为附近的星系和金牛协约国供应食物. 这儿的产业大部分都以基因工程高辛猪的养殖工厂作为基础，这是一种土著生物，一些活动家相信它有智慧.

column1: Recently settled, the colonists on Gaul eke out a limited living from the toxic waters and tough soils.
column2: 最近才有人定居，Gaul上的殖民者靠着有毒的水域和坚硬的土壤勉强度日.

column1: Geifer is home to the Capellan Institute of Linguistics; one of the few major universities that survived the Succession Wars. Many members of the Capellan diplomatic and intelligence services are trained here.
column2: Geifer是卡佩拉语言学院的所在地；该学院是少数在继承战争中幸存下来的主要大学之一. 许多卡佩拉外交与情报部门的成员都在这里接受培训.

column1: Gei-Fu III - more commonly known simply as Gei-Fu - is the third planet in the Gei-Fu system and has a single moon named Yè xīng. While still a Capellan world, the population is known to have a large number of St. Ives sympathists in it.
column2: Gei-Fu III——通常简称为Gei-Fu——是Gei-Fu星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Yèxīng的卫星. 尽管它仍是一个卡佩拉世界，但据悉其人口中有大量圣艾夫斯同情者.

column1: Genf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Genf在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled in 2175, the harsh desert has forced the settlers to vast rich underground caverns with great river networks.
column2: 定居于2175年，严酷的沙漠迫使定居者转入广阔富饶、拥有庞大河网的地下洞穴.

column1: Gettorf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gettorf于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Settled as late as 2750, Ghaziabad is a dry world with limited resources.
column2: 直到 2750 年才有人定居，Ghaziabad是一个干燥且资源有限的世界.

column1: Ghent is a system in the Deep Periphery beyond Ctesiphon.
column2: Ghent是Ctesiphon之外的深空外围中的一个星系.

column1: This unfortunate world was once a Capellan colony. In recent years the last few surviving inhabitants were driven off-planet by mercenaries hired by the Magistracy, in order to create a larger buffer between the two nations.
column2: 这个不幸的星球曾经是一处卡佩拉殖民地. 近年来，最后几名残存的居民被自治区雇佣的佣兵赶出了星球，其目的是为了在两国之间建立一个更大的缓冲区.

column1: Giausar is home to numerous chemical agricompound plants that utilise cutting edge technology to boost their yields.
column2: Giausar是众多化学农用化合物工厂的所在地，这些工厂利用尖端技术来提高产量.

column1: Ioto Galactic Enterprises maintains a massive manufacturing hub at the LaGrange Point between Gibbs and its moon.
column2: Ioto Galactic Enterprises在Gibbs与其卫星之间的拉格朗日点运营着一座庞大的制造中心.

column1: Gibraltar is home to an operational Star League facility, Fort Calpe.
column2: Gibraltar是仍在运作的星际联盟设施——卡尔佩堡的所在地.

column1: Gibson is the home of Gibson Federated Battlemechs and Brigadier Corporations. Together these are the two largest producers of Battlemechs and Warships in the Free Worlds League.
column2: Gibson是Gibson Federated Battlemechs和Brigadier Corporations的所在地. 这两家企业共同是自由世界联盟中最大的战斗机甲和战舰生产商.

column1: Gienah is a heavily industrialised world that is home to Gienah Automotive, which also manufactures parts for military vehicles.
column2: Gienah是一个高度工业化的世界，是Gienah Automotive的所在地，该公司还生产军用车辆零部件.

column1: Forests of giant fungal organisms for which the planet takes its namesake dominate much of the surface. The flesh of these huge mushroom trees dry out during the long, hot days, becoming tough and woody.
column2: 巨大真菌生物构成的森林占据了地表的大部分，这颗星球也正因它们而得名. 在漫长炎热的白天里，这些巨型蘑菇树的肉质会干枯，变得坚韧而木质化.

column1: Gillingham is a terrestrial planet with an extremely slow axial rotation. Days and nights here can last as long as an Earth-week
column2: Gillingham是一颗类地行星，其自转极其缓慢. 这里的白昼和黑夜可以持续长达一个地球周之久.

column1: A small Earth-like planet with dangerous levels of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere. Seasonal grasslands cover the entire surface.
column2: 一颗小型类地行星，大气中的二氧化碳含量达到危险水平. 整个地表覆盖着季节性草原.

column1: Gingeria was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gingeria在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The majority of Girondas's surface area is covered by shallow oceans. Of the 20% of the planet's surface that is land, most is a vast marshland, hot and foul-smelling, but excellent for both agriculture and fish farming.
column2: 吉龙达大部分地表被浅海覆盖。在该星球20%的陆地中，大部分是辽阔的沼泽，炎热而气味难闻，却对农业与养鱼业都极好。

column1: Gitarama was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gitarama是在统一战争结束后的某个时间、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Giverny was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Giverny于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Givrodat was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Givrodat是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Glabach was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Glabach是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gladius' surface is 94% covered by water and is famous for its jade green seas. The planet possesses relatively little mineral wealth so its economy is mostly based around being a tourist and retirement destination for the upper classes.
column2: 短剑的表面94%被水覆盖，以其翡翠绿的海闻名。该行星矿产财富相对稀少，所以其经济主要建立在成为上流阶级的旅游与退休目的地之上。

column1: Glasgow is a terrestrial planet famous for its carnivorous trees and stormy weather. The sap from the trees is known to be a powerful intoxicant.
column2: Glasgow是一颗类地行星，以其食肉树木和暴风雨天气而闻名. 这些树木的树液被认为是一种强效致醉物.

column1: Glengarry had been a prosperous world focused on trade and light industry during the Star League era, but has been in steep decline ever since. It is now a minor world consisting mostly of small agricultural communities.
column2: Glengarry曾是星际联盟时代一个以贸易和轻工业为重点的繁荣世界，但自那以后便急剧衰落. 如今它只是一个次要星球，主要由小型农业社区组成.

column1: Glenlivet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Glenlivet在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Glenmora's central continent, named Hades, is so named for the ring of volcanoes that surround it.
column2: 格伦莫拉的中部大陆名为哈迪斯，得名于环绕它的那一圈火山。

column1: This industrial world's economy was shattered by the Second Succession War, in which Davion captured it from Liao. The atmospheric dust from orbital bombardment led to a precipitous drop in global temperatures.
column2: 这个工业世界的经济在第二次继承战争中被打得粉碎，当时达维恩从廖氏手中夺取了它。轨道轰炸造成的大气尘埃导致全球气温骤降。

column1: Teaming with life, Glevakha's islands drift on the planets ocean, a phenomena caused by helium and other gases trapped in porous rock - spewed out from subaqueous volcanoes.
column2: 格列瓦哈的岛屿与生命共生，漂浮在行星的海洋上，这一现象由被困在多孔岩石中的亥与其他气体造成——它们从水下火山喷涌而出。

column1: Glitnir was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Glitnir在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Glory is a remote world known for its low mountains, sparse and runty vegetation, and its breathable air.
column2: Glory是一颗偏远的星球，以其低矮的山脉、稀疏且矮小的植被以及可供呼吸的空气而闻名.

column1: Gniezno was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gniezno在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Goat Path is so named due to the rocky terrain of the world that renders conventional vehicles useless. Combat on this world must be conducted using aircraft or bipedal transport.
column2: Goat Path之所以得名，是因为该星球遍布岩石的地形使常规车辆毫无用处. 在这个星球上的战斗必须使用飞行器或双足车辆进行.

column1: A small rocky planet in the Lagrange point of a gas giant. The planet has no atmosphere, but incredibly there is life here, living in large underground reservoirs of water
column2: 一颗位于气态巨行星拉格朗日点的小型岩质行星. 这颗行星没有大气层，但令人难以置信的是，这里有生命存在，它们生活在巨大的地下水储层中.

column1: Goetville is a world consisting mostly of carbon, with a dense diamond core. Several mines on the surface extract diamonds from beneath the surface, making the planet a major source of wealth.
column2: Goetville是一个主要由碳构成的星球，拥有致密的钻石核心. 地表的几座矿场从地表之下开采钻石，使这颗行星成为主要的财富来源.

column1: Goito has five continents, Mantovana where the capital city Gonzaga is located, Rodigo, Volta, Roverbella and Marmirolo.
column2: Goito有五块大陆，分别是Mantovana（首都Gonzaga所在地）、Rodigo、Volta、Roverbella和Marmirolo.

column1: Golandrinas is what is called an Eyeball or 'tidally locked' planet. As such Golandrinas does not have a day/night cycle but a fixed day side and night side.
column2: 戈兰德利纳斯是一颗所谓的“眼球”或“潮汐锁定”星球。因此它没有昼夜循环，只有固定的白昼面与黑夜面。

column1: Goldlure was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Goldlure在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gomeisa was a heavily contested world centuries ago during the Age of War, and still bears the pockmarks of war to this day.
column2: Gomeisa在数百年前的战争时代曾是一个争夺激烈的星球，至今仍留有战争的疮痍.

column1: Goodna's vast forests filled with wildlife make this known as a planet filled with rare edible delicacies.
column2: 古德纳广袤的森林里满是野生动植物，因此这里被认为是充满珍稀食材的行星。

column1: Gorfynt was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gorfynt在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gorgon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gorgon在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gorki was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gorki在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Goshen has been a hotly contested world during the Succession Wars thanks to its raw materials and arable land.
column2: 在继承战争期间，Goshen因其原材料和可耕地而成为一个激烈争夺的世界.

column1: Goslar is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Goslar是构成名为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

column1: Goth Khakar is a world consisting mostly of harsh jagged plateaus, with a dense mineral core that heats up the surface. Several mines on the surface extract material from beneath the surface, providing the planet with a major source of wealth.
column2: Goth Khakar是一个主要由崎岖嶙峋的高原组成的世界，其致密的矿物核心使地表升温. 地表的若干矿场从地表之下开采物质，为这颗行星提供了主要财富来源.

column1: Once a glorious world in the Rim Worlds Republic, the colony was devastated during the Amaris Civil War and remains stuck in a nuclear winter. Now the scant population remaining either herds local reindeer or supports nearby pirate activities.
column2: 曾是边缘世界共和国一颗荣耀的世界，该殖民地在阿马里斯内战期间遭到毁灭，至今仍困于核冬天. 如今，仅存的稀少人口要么放牧当地驯鹿，要么支持附近的海盗活动.

column1: The Goubellat system colonized during the First Exodus from Terra. Then it became a border world between the Draconis Combine and the Outworlds Alliance. In 26th century The SLDF marshalled the Forty-second Brigade on Goubellat prior to the invasion.
column2: Goubellat星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民. 随后它成为天龙联合体与外域联盟之间的边境世界. 在26世纪，SLDF在入侵前于Goubellat集结了第42旅.

column1: Gouderak has a very arid and oppressively hot climate, and has at least two major continents, named Ayles and Halton. Water problems continue to plague settlements here.
column2: Gouderak气候极其干旱且酷热难耐，至少有两个主要大陆，分别名为Ayles和Halton. 水源问题持续困扰着这里的定居点.

column1: Malthus Gambling Unlimited is rumoured to control the local government on the planet, which is known for its lax tax measures and black market supplies.
column2: 据传，Malthus Gambling Unlimited控制着该行星的地方政府，该行星以宽松的税收措施和黑市供应而闻名.

column1: Graham once supported significant military manufacturing capabilities. Unfortunately, this made the planet a target for WMD attacks during the 1st Succession War. With the atmosphere tainted, most inhabitants have left over the centuries.
column2: Graham曾拥有重要的军事制造能力. 不幸的是，这使这颗行星在第一次继承战争期间成为了大规模杀伤性武器攻击的目标. 由于大气受到污染，几个世纪以来，大多数居民已经离开.

column1: The gojo harvest attracts traders every year, as it is known for its usage in high end recipes and potent alcoholic spirit.
column2: gojo的丰收每年都吸引着商人，因为它以被用于高端食谱和烈性酒而闻名.

column1: Gran was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gran在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The sole factory world amongst the region known as Nueva Castile, it is also home to many governmental buildings.
column2: 在被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的地区中，它是唯一的工厂世界，也是许多政府建筑的所在地.

column1: Grand Base is home to an Earthwerks Ltd. 'Mech production facility; the 2nd largest such factory in the Capellan Confederation. Warrior House Fujita defends this critical facility which produces Shadow Hawks, Griffins, and Cataphracts for the CCAF.
column2: 大基地是地球工厂有限公司一处机甲生产设施所在地，也是卡佩兰联邦第二大同类工厂。藤田武士团守卫着这座关键设施，它为CCAF生产影子鹰、狮鹫与甲胄骑兵。

column1: Granera has not been strategically important since the Reunification War, when it was a supply depot for SLDF forces deployed against the Magistracy. It is a minor Marik colony world now, with a small but growing population.
column2: 自统一战争以来，格拉内拉在战略上就不重要了，当时它是部署在自治区面前的星际联盟防卫军的补给站. 现在它是一颗较小的马里克殖民星球，人口虽少却在不断增长.

column1: Grankum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Grankum在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Grant's Station is home to a terrestrial world, rich with minerals and water.
column2: 格兰特站拥有一颗陆地行星，矿产与水资源丰富。

column1: Graus is the innermost planet of the system, and has a notable dust ring. During the 2980s, the local government banned all heavy military equipment from the surface.
column2: Graus是该星系最内侧的行星，拥有一个显眼的尘埃环. 在2980年代，当地政府禁止所有重型军事装备出现在其地表.

column1: The failure of its Star League terraforming technology has caused much of its water to evaporate. Nonetheless, Gravenhage still hosts a sizable military presence and training facility. It is also a popular destination for LosTech prospectors.
column2: 其星际联盟地球化改造技术的失败导致大部分水体蒸发. 尽管如此，Gravenhage仍驻有相当规模的军事力量和训练设施. 这里也是失落科技探矿者的热门目的地.

column1: Gravensteen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gravensteen是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Graz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Graz于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Named originally after a massive canyon that spans the southern hemisphere, Great Gorge has flourished over the centuries as the ecology has adapted to Terran vegetation.
column2: Great Gorge最初得名于一条横跨南半球的巨大峡谷，几个世纪以来，随着生态系统适应了地球植被，这里已繁荣兴旺.

column1: Great X has two moons, Y and Z. It has spent most of its history being a waypoint on the way to the front lines.
column2: Great X有两颗卫星，Y和Z. 在其历史的大部分时间里，它一直是通往前线途中的一个中转站.

column1: Most of Greeley is covered by arctic tundras. The planet's extreme axial tilt and small star ensure that it will always be cold.
column2: 格里利的大部分被北极冻原覆盖。该行星极端的转轴倾角和微小的恒星确保它永远是寒冷的。

column1: The Greenlaw system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Greenlaw星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并且在天琴共同体成立之前曾是多尼戈尔保护国的一员.

column1: Until the Third Succession War the Clayborne system was known by the name Green Stone due to the vast jade deposits under the surface which were heavily mined.
column2: 直到第三次继承战争之前，Clayborne星系因地下蕴藏着大量并曾被大规模开采的翡翠矿藏，而被称为Green Stone.

column1: Greifswald is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Greifswald是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口货物.

column1: Greypearl was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Greypearl在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Griffith system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. It houses small but important weapons manufacturers which utilise the low temperatures to refine circuitry.
column2: Griffith星系在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民. 该星系拥有规模虽小但重要的武器制造商，它们利用低温来精炼电路.

column1: Grobin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Grobin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gronholt is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources.
column2: Gronholt是一个贫困的星系，几乎没有矿产资源或财富.

column1: Grootfontein was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Grootfontein在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Grossbach is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources.
column2: Grossbach是一个贫困的星系，几乎没有什么矿产资源或财富.

column1: The Grosvenor system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Its capital city, Andreas, houses numerous bureaucratic offices for nearby worlds.
column2: Grosvenor星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的. 其首府安德烈亚斯设有众多为附近世界服务的行政办公室.

column1: Groveld III is an arid world, with short days. Notable terrain features on Groveld III include a desert named the Vashner Flats, a region surrounded by badlands, the ancient battlefield of the Viking Flats and the St. Adrian Plains.
column2: Groveld III是一颗干旱星球，白昼短暂. Groveld III上显著的地形特征包括一片名为瓦什纳平原的沙漠、一片被荒地环绕的区域、维京平原的古战场，以及圣阿德里安平原.

column1: Grumium is home to the Frihet Training Facility, which trains conventional forces and MechWarriors from nearby worlds. Grumium Creations is based here, a recent manufacturing with many products.
column2: Grumium是Frihet训练设施的所在地，该设施负责训练来自附近星球的常规部队和机甲战士. Grumium Creations也设在这里，这是一家新近成立、产品种类繁多的制造企业.

column1: The Grunwald system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Grunwald星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在天琴共同体成立之前是多尼戈尔保护国的一员.

column1: Gruyeres was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gruyeres在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Guangzho was settled during the Exodus from Terra by settlers from China.
column2: Guangzho是在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间，由来自中国的定居者开拓定居的.

column1: The Guatavita system was settled by the Lyran Commonwealth at some point during or shortly before the Age of War.
column2: Guatavita星系在战争时代期间或稍早的某个时候被天琴共同体殖民.

column1: The ancestral home of House Madeira, Guldra is the most Earth-like planet in the entire Aurigan region, and is a major breadbasket for the area. Massive cities house a total population just over a billion, and exporting food has made Guldra an extremely wealthy, diverse, sophisticated world.
column2: 古尔德拉是马德拉家族的母星，是整个御夫座地区最像地球的行星，也是该地区的一大面包篮子. 大城市安置了超过10亿的人口，而食品出口则让古尔德拉成为一颗极为富裕，多样化，发达的星球.

column1: Gulkana has a single continent, Pangaea, and the majority of Gulkana's surface is barren, rocky, and devoid of native life due to its harsh, arid climate. It is home to Yeffters Weapons Factory.
column2: 古尔卡纳只有一块大陆——泛大陆，而它地表的大部分因严酷干旱的气候而是荒芜的岩石，没有原生生命。它是耶夫特斯武器厂的所在地。

column1: Gunthar is a pleasant world covered in water. The major cities are all built on the rocky coastlines of the single small continent; however, a spray of islands in a planet-girdling archipelago support a vast agricultural enterprise.
column2: 冈萨尔是一个被水覆盖的舒适星球. 主要城市都建在唯一一小块大陆的岩质海岸线上; 然而在环绕行星的列岛中，有一群岛屿支撑着一个巨大的农业企业.

column1: The Gunzburg system was settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The planet is still recovering from damage from the First Succession War.
column2: Gunzburg星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期由天琴共同体殖民. 该星球仍在从第一次继承战争造成的破坏中恢复.

column1: Gurgaldar is located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery between the Vul Rift and the Eagle Cloud Complex.
column2: Gurgaldar位于深空外围的逆旋向区域，介于Vul裂谷与鹰云复合体之间.

column1: The Gurnet system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Gurnet星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的.

column1: The Gurrnazovo system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Gurrnazovo星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民的，并且在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前，曾是该集体的成员.

column1: A heavily forested world, Gustrell offers agricultural produce to nearby worlds.
column2: Gustrell是一个森林茂密的世界，向附近的世界供应农产品.

column1: According to the latest Interstellar Expeditions charts, Gwithian is a colony world located in the Deep Periphery.
column2: 根据最新的星际远征星图，Gwithian是位于深空外围的一个殖民世界.

column1: Gwynedd was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gwynedd在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡.

column1: The Gypsum system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Gypsum星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民的.

column1: The Haappajarvi system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Haappajarvi星系是在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: A system rich in resources and with a strong industry.\nIts 3.6 billion inhabitants enjoy comparatively more freedoms than most Draconians do.\nIt's known for an excessive night life, its high crime rate & several high ranking Yakuza as overt chairmen.
column2: 一个资源丰富、工业强大的星系。\n它的36亿居民享有的自由比大多数龙尼斯人多。\n它以过度的夜生活、高犯罪率，以及若干公开担任董事长的黑帮高层闻名。

column1: Haddings was devastated by WMDs during the Amaris Civil War, to the point the planet disappeared off star charts. ComStar rediscovered it in 3028 and found it populated by small communities living at an approximately 17th century level of technology.
column2: Haddings在阿马里斯内战期间被大规模杀伤性武器摧毁，以至于这颗行星从星图上消失了. 通讯之星于 3028 年重新发现了它，并发现其上居住着一些小型社区，其技术水平大约相当于 17 世纪.

column1: The Hadnall system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Hadnall星系是在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: Haerhbin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Haerhbin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Haggard was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Haggard是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: The Hagiwawa system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. It was a member of the Alliance of Galedon before joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: Hagiwawa星系是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 它在加入德拉科尼斯联合体之前，曾是加勒顿联盟的成员.

column1: The Hahira system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hahira星系是在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: The Hainfeld system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hainfeld星系是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Hakkaido was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hakkaido于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Halesowen system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Halesowen星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Halfway is best described as a barely-habitable rock. With only primitive, fern-like vegetation as the highest form of life, Halfway has largely been a stopover point for travelers for centuries.
column2: Halfway最好被描述为一块勉强可居住的岩质星球. 由于最高等的生命形式只是原始、类似蕨类的植被，数个世纪以来，Halfway在很大程度上一直是旅行者的中途落脚点.

column1: Halgrim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Halgrim是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Halifax was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic though was almost abandoned during the Republic-Commonwealth war. It is now used as a base of operation for exploration teams.
column2: Halifax最初是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu省的一部分，但在共和国-共同体战争期间几乎被废弃. 如今它被用作勘探团队的行动基地.

column1: Most of the population live an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the Compact
column2: 大多数人口过着农业生活方式，其维持技术相当于十八世纪晚期在泰拉上所见的技术，这是盟约国内部Omniss哲学强烈影响的结果.

column1: Hall is a populous planet with a significant agricultural sector as well as a large light industrial base. Only recently lost by the Capellan Confederation, a battalion of Wolf's Dragoons currently makes up part of the planetary garrison.
column2: 霍尔是一颗人口稠密的星球，拥有可观的农业部门以及庞大的轻工业基础。它最近刚被卡佩兰联邦丢掉，目前有一营狼之龙骑兵构成行星驻军的一部分。

column1: Halla was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Halla是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A bleak and frozen world, Halloran has nonetheless hosted considerable mining and manufacturing industries since its colonization, exporting large quantities of ice, copper, and hydrocarbons to other worlds.
column2: \n\n一个荒凉冰封的世界，Halloran自殖民以来仍发展起了可观的采矿和制造业，向其他世界出口大量冰、铜和碳氢化合物.

column1: The Halmyre Deans system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War. They are known for their multi million c-bill production line which exports Halmyre Beans to nearby worlds.
column2: Halmyre Deans星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民. 该星系以产值达数百万C-币、向附近世界出口Halmyre豆的生产线而闻名.

column1: Halstead Station is a world settled exclusively for its vast mineral resources. The atmosphere is toxic, so the population lives in vast underground cities.
column2: Halstead Station是一个专为其丰富矿产资源而有人定居的世界. 大气有毒，因此居民生活在巨大的地下城市中.

column1: Hamal was originally colonised by settlers from the highland regions of South America on Terra. Hamal have passed from a Capellan to the Federated Suns during the Fourth Succession War. Most of the population live in a tribal, nomadic fashion.
column2: Hamal最初由来自泰拉南美洲高地地区的定居者殖民. 在第四次继承战争期间，Hamal从卡佩拉邦联转归恒星联邦. 大多数人口以部落、游牧方式生活.

column1: Hamar was settled by the JàrnFòlk because of the large metal deposits and other raw materials located there. The mining communities are dependent on special equipment to generate a livable environment for the workers and on food produced by the farming communities found in the lowlands.
column2: 铁民联盟因当地拥有大量金属矿藏和其他原材料而在Hamar定居. 采矿社区依赖特殊设备为工人营造宜居环境，并依赖低地农业社区生产的食物.

column1: Hamburg is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Hamburg是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口商品.

column1: Hamilton was one of some fifty-one heavily contested worlds to have been placed under Terran Hegemony authority as a jointly-administered world during the Age of War or Star League era, and was almost wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Hamilton是战争时代或星际联盟时代被置于泰拉霸权管辖之下、作为共管世界的大约五十一个激烈争夺世界之一，并在第一次继承战争中几乎被彻底摧毁.

column1: The planetary capital city, Triergart, is located west of Lake Carivorn which is renown for its boating tourism.
column2: 行星首府特里尔加特位于卡里沃恩湖以西，该湖以划船旅游而闻名.

column1: Most of Hammer is covered by arctic tundras. The planet's extreme axial tilt and small star ensure that it will always be cold.
column2: 锤星的大部分被北极冻原覆盖。该行星极端的转轴倾角和微小的恒星确保它永远是寒冷的。

column1: Handa is a favorite retirement spot thanks to its warm climate and arable land.
column2: Handa因其温暖的气候和可耕地而成为备受青睐的退休之地.

column1: Saxe-Heidelberg Heavy Industries and People's Protection form the industrial backbone of Hanover, which exports its products across the Inner Sphere.
column2: 萨克森-海德堡重工业与人民保护组织构成了汉诺威的工业脊梁，该行星的产品出口遍及内天体。

column1: Hanseta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hanseta在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Harbin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Harbin在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Hardcore is a warm and temperate world that is home to Fox Infantry Systems, a major manufacturer.
column2: Hardcore是一个温暖且气候温和的世界，是主要制造商Fox Infantry Systems的所在地.

column1: A singular continent makes up the landmass on this watery world, known for its native Water Horse.
column2: 这个水世界由单一大陆构成其陆地，因当地原生的水马而闻名.

column1: Harlez was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Harlez是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A minor world in the Capellan Confederation, Harloc's prosperity is limited by its reliance on food imports.
column2: 作为卡佩兰联邦的一颗次要行星，哈洛克因依赖粮食进口而繁荣有限。

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Harminous was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison who were experts in amphibious operations.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Harminous驻扎着一支精通两栖作战的星际联盟防卫军守备部队.

column1: Harmony MetalWorks has recently acquired a repair and refit center from SelaSys Incorporated, and have begun to produce Mech parts.
column2: Harmony MetalWorks最近从SelaSys Incorporated手中收购了一处维修与改装中心，并已开始生产机甲部件.

column1: The Harpster system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Harpster星系是在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: Harris is a surface garrison within the Deep Periphery, near Trinity and P3.
column2: Harris是深空外围内的一个地表驻军，靠近Trinity和P3.

column1: Harrow's Sun is a developed world that has been invaded numerous times due to its rich mineral wealth and fertile lands.
column2: 哈罗之阳是一颗发达世界，因丰富的矿产与肥沃土地而屡遭入侵。

column1: The Harsefield system was colonised during the Star League era, however lost much of its technological base during the First Succession War, from which it is only just recovering.
column2: Harsefield星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间失去了大部分技术基础，如今才刚刚开始从中恢复.

column1: The Hartshill system was colonised at some point during or immediately prior to the Age of War.
column2: Hartshill星系在战争时代期间或紧接其之前的某个时候被殖民.

column1: The continent of Ohio is the location of most of Harvest's major cities and agricultural industries.
column2: 俄亥俄大陆是哈维斯特大多数主要城市与农业产业的所在地。

column1: A water rich world, Hassad survived the First Succession War intact only to fall victim to seismic activity which caused massive tsunamis which reduced much of the settlement to rubble.
column2: 一个水资源丰富的世界，Hassad在第一次继承战争中原封不动地幸存下来，却沦为地震活动的受害者，地震活动引发了大规模海啸，将大部分定居点化为瓦砾.

column1: Hassi R'Mel was colonized during the formation of the Star League. The system is the primary stop for ships leaving the Draconis Rift in an area of space with few habitable worlds.
column2: 哈西尔梅尔在星盟形成期间被殖民。对于离开龙尼斯裂隙的舰船来说，该星系是那片缺少宜居世界的太空中主要的落脚点。

column1: The wasteland planet of Hastur is primarily a prison world, with the major city, Lockdown, functioning as a city-sized penal colony. Prisoners provide slave labor for the planet's dangerous mining industry.
column2: 荒原行星哈斯特主要是一颗监狱行星，其主要城市"封锁"发挥着城市规模流放地的作用。囚犯为该行星危险的采矿业提供奴工。

column1: Haublan was once a failed colony world inside the borders of the Rim Worlds Republic, before being abandoned to its own devices. Now the world is ruled by the remains of an Agricorp, a pirate band and the few nobles who are left.
column2: Haublan曾是边缘世界共和国境内一个殖民失败的世界，后来被弃置，任其自生自灭. 如今，这个世界由一家农业公司的残部、一伙海盗以及仅存的少数贵族统治着.

column1: Prisoners assigned to the harsh landscape of Havdhem tend not to complain for long. The average life span is measured in months.
column2: 被分配到Havdhem严酷环境中的囚犯往往不会抱怨太久. 平均寿命以月计算.

column1: Hawktor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hawktor在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: A large rocky planet with high gravity and a thin atmosphere. The atmosphere only extends about three miles above sea level, and many mountain tops are exposed to the vacuum of space.
column2: 一颗巨大的岩质行星，重力很高，大气稀薄. 大气层仅延伸至海平面以上约三英里，许多山峰暴露在太空真空中.

column1: Hazeldean was colonised at the start of the Star League era, thanks to its abundance of arable land.
column2: Hazeldean在星际联盟时代初期被殖民，这得益于其拥有大量可耕地.

column1: The Hazelhurst system was colonized during or at some point prior to the Age of War, and prior to the Reunification War was a member of the Outworlds Alliance.
column2: Hazelhurst星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，并且在统一战争之前是外域联盟的成员.

column1: The Hean system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra, and may have been one of the worlds rendered independent as a result of the Demarcation Declaration. Hean subsequently joined or was annexed by the Terran Hegemony prior to the Age of War.
column2: Hean星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民，并且可能是因《分界宣言》而获得独立的世界之一. Hean随后在战争时代之前加入或被泰拉霸权吞并.

column1: Heart Fjord was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Heart Fjord在星联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Heathville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Heathville在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Hecheng system was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hecheng星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的.

column1: Hechnar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hechnar在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: One of the first worlds colonized after the landing on Strana Mechty, Hector is a frigid world. It is home to the Ice Hellion, a cunning pack predator of the world's snowy mountains, which preyed on the first Clan explorers.
column2: 赫克托是登陆斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂之后最早被殖民的行星之一，是一颗严寒的世界。它是冰地狱蜥的家园——一种狡黠的群猎掠食者，栖息于该行星的雪山之中，曾猎食最早的氏族探险者。

column1: The Hednesford system was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hednesford星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Hegel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hegel是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Heidelburg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Heidelburg在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

column1: Heidrunn is located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery and at almost nineteen hundred light-years distant from Terra is one of the farthest-flung inhabited systems to have been identified by Interstellar Expeditions.
column2: Heidrunn位于深空外围的反旋臂区域，距离泰拉近一千九百光年，是星际探险组织已确认的最遥远有人居住星系之一.

column1: Was colonized during the Age of War by Lyran Commonwealth. The name seems to be a misspelling of Heiligenkreuz (German, roughly translates as \"Saint's Cross\").
column2: 在战火时代由莱兰联邦殖民。这个名字似乎是Heiligenkreuz的拼写错误（德语，大致意为"圣十字"）。

column1: Originally known as the Helbrent system, the colony was annihilated during the Second Succession War. It was recolonised as the Andiron system a century later.
column2: 最初被称为Helbrent星系，该殖民地于第二次继承战争期间被彻底毁灭. 一个世纪后，它作为Andiron星系被重新殖民.

column1: Helduza was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helduza在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Originally a wealthy world, the population of Helen was exterminated by Amaris forces during the Amaris Civil War. It has not recovered.
column2: Helen原本是一个富庶的世界，但在阿马里斯内战期间，其人口被阿马里斯军队灭绝. 它至今仍未恢复.

column1: Heliat is a pleasant agricultural world, but also a backwater, thanks to its position away from all major trade routes. This relative isolation has led to an insular, conservative culture, centered around the local offshoot of Catholicism.
column2: 赫利亚特是一颗宜人的农业星球，但也是个闭塞的地方，这要感谢它的位置远离所有的主要贸易路线. 这种相对的隔绝导致了一种孤立而保守的文化，它以天主教在当地的分支为中心.

column1: The capital city of Helio is surrounded by verdant green hills, making it a popular world in brochures.
column2: Helio的首府四周环绕着郁郁葱葱的绿色丘陵，使其成为宣传册中广受欢迎的星球.

column1: Helios features diverse geological features and environments that makes the world capable of supporting a thriving population.
column2: Helios拥有丰富多样的地质特征和环境，使这颗星球能够支撑繁荣的人口.

column1: Helixmar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helixmar于星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Helland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Despite its location far from the Inner Sphere, Hellespont is a rich, high-tech manufacturing world. The headquarters of the ComStar Explorer Corps (Rimward) is located on the planet, and the infrastructure necessary for ComStar's operations has led to prosperity and investment.
column2: 尽管位置远离内天体，赫勒斯滂却是一颗富庶的高科技制造行星。康星探索军团（核心方向）的总部就位于该行星，而康星运作所需的基础设施带来了繁荣与投资。

column1: Hellgate is a volcanic world with an atmosphere tainted by sulfur. Life can only exist on Hellgate within huge, translucent domes that cover most major installations.
column2: Hellgate是一颗火山星球，大气被硫磺污染. 生命只能存在于Hellgate上那些覆盖了大部分主要设施的巨型半透明穹顶之内.

column1: Hellos Minor orbits a large gas giant, and was colonised at the start of the Star League era, thanks to its abundance of arable land.
column2: Hellos Minor环绕着一颗巨大的气态巨行星运行，并在星盟时代之初因可耕地丰富而被殖民.

column1: Hell's Paradise was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 地狱天堂是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: Helm was an SLDF logistical depot long time ago. Was known for being the site of the discovery of the Helm Memory Core in 3028 by the Gray Death Legion. The Memory Core triggered the technological renaissance of the mid-31st century.
column2: Helm在很久以前曾是SLDF的一处后勤补给站. 它因是3028年灰死军团发现Helm记忆核心的地点而闻名. 该记忆核心引发了31世纪中叶的技术复兴.

column1: The Helsingfors system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. It was a member of the Alliance of Galedon before joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: Helsingfors星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 在加入天龙联合体之前，它曾是加勒顿联盟的成员.

column1: Ninety percent of the population of Helvetia lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the Compact.
column2: Helvetia百分之九十的人口过着农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于18世纪末泰拉上技术水平的科技维持，这是Omniss哲学在盟约国产生重大影响的结果.

column1: Helvetica was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helvetica在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Hephzibah system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hephzibah星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Herat (FS) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Herat (FS) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Herbania was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Herbania在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Here is home to a vast ancient catacomb system, due the millions of deaths during the Reunification War.
column2: 由于统一战争期间数百万人的死亡，这里成为了庞大古老地下墓穴系统的所在地.

column1: Hergazil was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hergazil在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Hermagor system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hermagor星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: The Herndon system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Herndon星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Herotitus is famed for its planet-wide pleasure industry; it is a sought-after vacation and recreational world. This hedonism exists side-by-side with the original agricultural colonists, who are largely puritanical and staid.
column2: 希罗提多因其遍布星球的娱乐产业闻名; 这是颗炙手可热的度假与休闲之星. 这种享乐主义和那些古板的清教徒原始农业殖民者共存.

column1: Herrmaz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Herrmaz在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Andrea County Armor Yards and Kaiser Systems both employ or contract with a large portion of Herzbergs population
column2: Andrea County Armor Yards和Kaiser Systems均雇佣或与Herzberg的大部分人口签订合约.

column1: Hè-shì was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hè-shì在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Hesperus system is one of the most important manufacturing system in the Lyran Commonwealth. It has many production lines for battlemechs, including one of the last few in the Inner Sphere that can produce new Atlases for the ever expanding LCAF
column2: Hesperus星系是天琴共同体最重要的制造星系之一. 它拥有许多战斗机甲生产线，其中包括内天体所剩无几的、能够为不断扩张的天琴共同体武装部队生产新型阿特拉斯的生产线之一.

column1: The Herndon system was colonised during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Capellan Confederation.
column2: Herndon星系在从泰拉出走期间被殖民，并在加入卡佩拉邦联之前是锡安共同体的一部分.

column1: Hiberius was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hiberius是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Most of the population of Hibernia lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the Compact.
column2: Hibernia的大部分人口过着农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于泰拉在18世纪晚期所拥有的技术来维持，这是盟约国Omniss哲学强烈影响的结果.

column1: This lush forest world teems with diverse insect and plant life. Almost all this life, however, is highly toxic to humans, and the theocratic government has strict laws against entering the forest without protective gear.
column2: 这颗茂盛的森林星球充斥着多种多样的昆虫和植物. 然而，几乎所有的生命对人类都是有剧毒的，神权政府有着严格的法律，禁止在没有防护装备的情况下进入森林.

column1: The Hickok system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hickok星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民.

column1: Highspire II - more commonly known simply as Highspire - is the second planet in the system and has a single moon named Peak.
column2: Highspire II——更常被简称为Highspire——是该星系中的第二颗行星，只有一颗名为Peak的卫星.

column1: Hildaman was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hildaman是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Herndon system was colonised during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Protectorate of Donegal before joining the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Herndon星系是在从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的，并在加入天琴共同体之前曾是多尼戈尔保护国的一部分.

column1: Originally named Himmels, the colony was devastated during the First Succession War, leaving a scant population to survive for centuries. During the Third Succession War, it came under the dominion of the Circinus Federation.
column2: 该殖民地最初名为Himmels，在第一次继承战争期间遭到毁灭性破坏，仅剩稀少的人口幸存下来并延续了数个世纪. 在第三次继承战争期间，它落入瑟西努斯联邦的统治之下.

column1: Those who have heard of Hinckley will often only know it for its geothermal swamps, though its therapeutic baths are meant to be some of the best in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 听说过Hinckley的人往往只会因为它那些地热沼泽而知道它，尽管据称它的疗养浴是内天体中数一数二的.

column1: Prior to the Fall of the Star League, Hindmarsh served as the homeport for the 7th Fleet (SLDF) of the Star League Navy. Many caches have been found over the centuries.
column2: 在星际联盟覆灭之前，Hindmarsh曾是星际联盟海军第7舰队（SLDF）的母港. 几个世纪以来，人们发现了许多储藏点.

column1: The Hiratsuka system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and remains an important colony due its exports of sulfur.
column2: Hiratsuka星系在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时间点被殖民，并因其硫磺出口而仍然是一个重要的殖民地.

column1: Hirtshals was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hirtshals于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The hot surface of Hivrannee requires all colonists to wear environmental suits when outside the colony enclosure, however it does allow easy access to rare chemicals.
column2: Hivrannee灼热的地表要求所有殖民者在殖民地围护区外时必须穿着环境防护服，不过这也使得获取稀有化学品变得十分便利.

column1: A cold world, Hoard gets its name from the vast mineral wealth contained within the mountain regions which has barely been tapped.
column2: Hoard是一颗寒冷的星球，其得名于山区蕴藏的巨量矿产资源，而这些资源几乎尚未被开采.

column1: During the Succession Wars the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns used the caves on Hobbs as a giant warehouse for supplies and materiel, used to support units throughout the Capellan March. The native animals known as the Takooma viewed this as an intrusion into their habitat, and waged a guerilla war against the human intruders.
column2: 在继承战争期间，恒星联邦武装部队将Hobbs上的洞穴用作巨型仓库，储存补给和军用物资，用于支援整个卡佩拉边区的部队. 被称为Takooma的当地动物将此视为对其栖息地的侵入，并向人类入侵者发动了一场游击战.

column1: The Hobson system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War, and had been incorporated into the Federated Suns by the beginning of the Reunification War.
column2: Hobson星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，并在统一战争开始时已并入恒星联邦.

column1: Hódmezovásárhely was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hódmezovásárhely在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Hoensbroek was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hoensbroek是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Hoff, sometimes called 'The Hoff', developed advanced industry prior to the Succession Wars. Crippled during the Succession Wars, The Hoff then became the home of the Friden Aerospace Park, which developed prototype double heat sinks.
column2: 霍夫，有时被称作"那个霍夫"，在继承战争之前发展了先进工业。它在继承战争中被重创，之后成为弗莱登航空航天园区的所在地，该园区研发了原型双重散热器。

column1: With all bar a twentieth of the surface of Hofn covered by water, the JàrnFòlk who colonised the planet established subterranean settlements, away from the mighty storms that raged across the oceans.
column2: Hofn表面有二十分之十九被水覆盖，因此殖民这颗星球的铁民联盟在远离肆虐于各大洋的猛烈风暴之处建立了地下定居点.

column1: The Hohenems system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War, and is an unremarkable world with calm weather and steady seasons ideal for agriculture.
column2: Hohenems星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，是一个平平无奇的世界，气候平和、季节稳定，非常适合农业.

column1: The world of Hollabrunn was re-colonized during the Star League era; originally having been colonized centuries earlier during the days of the Terran Alliance, the first colony was a casualty of the Age of War.
column2: Hollabrunn星球在星际联盟时代被重新殖民；它最初是在数个世纪前的泰拉联盟时期被殖民的，而第一个殖民地则成了战争年代的牺牲品.

column1: Holloway is home to the 2nd Battalion of Warrior House Fujita. Holloway is not an important world for raw materials or manufacturing, but it provides the Warrior House with an excellent base to conduct raiding operations against FedCom border worlds.
column2: Holloway是藤田武士团第二营的驻地. Holloway并非一个在原材料或制造业方面重要的世界，但它为武士团提供了一个极佳的基地，以便对联邦共同体边境世界展开袭扰行动.

column1: Colonists from the Federal Democratic Republics of Finland, Norway and Sweden emigrated in significant numbers to Holmsbu, and set up a colony based on their freedoms from Terra.
column2: 来自芬兰、挪威和瑞典联邦民主共和国的殖民者大量移民至Holmsbu，并建立了一个以他们从泰拉获得的自由为基础的殖民地.

column1: Holt was one of some fifty-one heavily contested worlds to have been placed under Terran Hegemony authority as a jointly-administered world during the Age of War or Star League era.
column2: 在战争时代或星际联盟时代，Holt是约五十一颗作为共管世界被置于泰拉霸权管辖之下的激烈争夺星球之一.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Homam was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Homam曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: \"There is no such thing as a wrong opinion\" is the slogan of Kira Place, a premium center for education located on Home.
column2: 不存在错误观点这回事是基拉广场的口号——那是位于家园的一处高端教育中心。

column1: The Hongon system was colonised during the Star League era for its easily accessible gemstone deposits.
column2: Hongon星系在星际联盟时代因拥有易于开采的宝石矿藏而被殖民.

column1: Hongquio is notable for its steamy jungle environments, from natural boreholes located deep within the rainforests.
column2: Hongquio以其湿热的丛林环境而闻名，这种环境源自雨林深处的天然孔洞.

column1: Following the discovery of rich gem and mineral deposits on Hoonar by teams from Gronholt, relations between the two worlds broke down substantially.
column2: 在来自Gronholt的队伍于Hoonar发现丰富的宝石与矿藏后，两个世界之间的关系急剧恶化.

column1: A remote Periphery world, Randis IV was unremarkable until an order of warrior monks decided to call it home. Many pirates have since been driven offworld, and it looks as though stability may finally have arrived at last.
column2: 一个偏远的边垂世界，Randis IV原本毫不起眼，直到一个战士修士教团决定在此安家. 此后，许多海盗被逐出该星球，看起来稳定终于可能降临了.

column1: Home of Marian Arms Incorperated, Horatius serves as one of the major industrial centers of the Marian Hegemony. It is the birth place of the Ravager and Marauder Battlearmour.
column2: 作为Marian Arms Incorperated的所在地，Horatius是马里安霸权的主要工业中心之一. 它是Ravager和Marauder战斗装甲的诞生地.

column1: Horgens is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery beyond the Perses-Cepherus Cloud Complex and the California Nebula, and has been identified by Interstellar Expeditions as the site for a possible colony.
column2: Horgens位于深空外围的外缘区域，在英仙座-仙王座星云复合体和加利福尼亚星云之外，并被星际探险组织认定为可能建立殖民地的地点.

column1: The Horneburg system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal, prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth in the mid-twenty-fourth century.
