column2: Horneburg星系在泰拉第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并且在24世纪中叶天琴共同体成立之前，是多尼戈尔保护国的一部分.

column1: Hornir's Keep was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 霍尼尔的堡垒是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: Originally a Taurian world, Horsham boasted several Taurian Defense Force naval yards. During the Reunification War, Horsham was overrun by the SLDF, pacified, and taken by the Federated Suns. The total destruction of the naval yards was a crippling blow to the world's economy.
column2: 霍舍姆原本是陶里安的世界，曾拥有若干陶里安防卫军海军船坞。在统一战争期间，霍舍姆被SLDF攻占、平定，并被联邦太阳夺取。海军船坞的彻底摧毁是对该世界经济的致命打击。

column1: The Hortense system was colonised at some point during or shortly before the Age of War. It was once home to the Grandin family, who have since been ousted.
column2: Hortense星系在战争时代期间或稍早的某个时候被殖民. 它曾是格兰丁家族的家园，但他们后来被驱逐了.

column1: The world was noted for its mineral water and for having sizable portion of its people of Black American and African descent from later half of the 28th century. Tectonically active, the planet has two continents that are covered in active volcanoes.
column2: 这个星球以其矿泉水闻名，并且自28世纪下半叶起，其人口中有相当大一部分具有美国黑人和非洲人血统. 该行星地壳活动活跃，拥有两个遍布活火山的大陆.

column1: Housekarle is a moderately prosperous world in the Capellan Confederation. A safe distance from the FedCom border and the presence of a working Recharge Station have made it a popular stop for shipping in the Confederation.
column2: Housekarle是卡佩拉邦联中一个中等繁荣的世界. 与联邦共同体边界保持着安全距离，再加上拥有一座正常运作的充电站，使其成为邦联内航运的热门停靠点.

column1: The Howick system was colonised during the Star League era due to the rich deposits of petroleum under its oceans.
column2: Howick星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，原因是其海洋下蕴藏着丰富的石油矿藏.

column1: The Howrah system was colonised during the Star League era due to the rich deposits of petroleum under its oceans.
column2: Howrah星系在星际联盟时代因海洋下丰富的石油矿藏而被殖民.

column1: Hoyleton is a successful agricultural world with a large temperate zone. Many ranches dot this zone where they are the center of a large processed meat industry, based on the Terran Buffalo and the native Hoyleton Forest Steer, that exported food to other star systems.
column2: Hoyleton是一个成功的农业世界，拥有大片温带区域. 许多牧场散布在这一区域，它们是大型加工肉类产业的中心，该产业以地球水牛和当地Hoyleton森林牛为基础，将食品出口到其他恒星系.

column1: Hrafn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hrafn在统一战争结束后的某个时间点于星盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Hsien was only recently integrated into the Federated Commonwealth, having been a Liao possession until 3029. It is heavily garrisoned in order to protect the significant mineral wealth of the planet.
column2: Hsien直到最近才被并入联邦共同体，在此之前直到3029年一直是廖氏的领地. 该星球驻有重兵，以保护其丰富的矿产资源.

column1: The Huaide system was colonised during the Star League era due to the rich deposits of rare gemstones found amidst its turbulent volcanic band.
column2: Huaide星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，因为在其动荡的火山带中发现了丰富的稀有宝石矿藏.

column1: Much of Huan's water was made toxic to human life by overmining, chemical dumping, and fallout from the Succession Wars, which is why the largest water-purification company in the Inner Sphere is headquartered here.
column2: 环星的许多水源因过度开采、化学倾倒和继承战争辐射尘而对人类有毒，这也是内天体最大的净水公司总部设在这里的原因。

column1: The icy surface of Hudeiba is home to numerous mining facilities, as well as a nascent snow sports industry.
column2: Hudeiba的冰封地表上坐落着众多采矿设施，以及一个新兴的雪上运动产业.

column1: Huesta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Huesta在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被建立定居点，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Humansville system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Humansville星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民.

column1: Hunan is a large inhospitable mining colony which has earned itself the reputation for being possibly the last place in the Inner Sphere anyone would want to visit, let alone live.
column2: Hunan是一个大型且环境恶劣的采矿殖民地，它为自己赢得了这样的名声: 可能是内天体中任何人最不愿造访、更不用说居住的地方.

column1: Despite the industry present on Hun Ho, along with well over one and a half billion people, much of the planet remains a tropical paradise.
column2: 尽管Hun Ho上存在工业，且人口远超十五亿，这颗行星的大部分地区仍是热带天堂.

column1: Hunter's Paradise was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 猎人天堂是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: The Huntington system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: 在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代，Huntington星系在某个时候被殖民.

column1: Huntress is a hospitable world with two continents. The aptly named continent of Abysmal is a vast inhospitable desert wasteland, whilst the other is a terrestrial dream.
column2: Huntress是一个宜居的世界，拥有两块大陆. 被恰如其分地命名为Abysmal的大陆是一片广阔、不宜居的沙漠荒原，而另一块大陆则是人间乐土.

column1: Hurgh was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hurgh在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Hurik is a garden world, its steep valleys and broad plains home to over one billion inhabitants. As the gateway to the Aurigan Reach, it is a nexus for trade and exploration, and supplies food and manufactured goods to all its neighbors.
column2: 赫里克是个园艺星球，它有着陡峭的山谷和广阔的平原，是超过10亿居民的故乡. 作为御夫座远邦的门户，它是贸易和勘探的枢纽，也为所有的邻星提供食品和制成品.

column1: The Huron system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Huron星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间的某个时候或之后不久被殖民.

column1: Hustaing is the long-time home of the 1st McCarron's Armored Cavalry. While a mercenary command, the 'Big Mac' has served House Liao for years; first against the Federated Suns and now against the St. Ives Compact.
column2: 胡斯泰因是麦卡伦第一装甲骑兵长期以来的驻地。虽然是雇佣兵部队，"大麦"多年来一直为廖家族效力；先是打联邦太阳，如今又打圣艾夫斯紧凑国。

column1: The Hyades Cluster is a collection of stars within close proximity to each other. During the Reunification War it was home to vast shipyards, which have now been lost to war.
column2: Hyades Cluster是一组彼此距离很近的恒星. 在统一战争期间，这里曾是庞大造船厂的所在地，而这些造船厂如今已在战火中不复存在.

column1: Named after a Terran semi-precious stone, Hyalite was originally settled to gain access to chemical compounds and gemstones. Whilst the gemstone industry ran dry centuries ago, the chemical industry still remains strong with uses including munitions and propellant.
column2: Hyalite以地球的一种半宝石命名，最初建立定居点是为了获取化合物和宝石. 尽管宝石产业在几个世纪前就已枯竭，但化学工业依然发达，其用途包括弹药和推进剂.

column1: Zettle Metals Incorporated produces purified precious metals and industrial alloys for use in civilian, commercial and military industries from the rich metal mines on Hyde.
column2: Zettle Metals Incorporated利用Hyde上丰富的金属矿藏，生产用于民用、商业和军事工业的提纯贵金属与工业合金.

column1: Luthien Armor Works operates a large facility on Hyner. The thick cloud cover makes orbital surveillance difficult.
column2: 卢西恩装甲工厂在Hyner运营着一座大型设施. 厚厚的云层使轨道侦察变得困难.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Hyperion was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Hyperion曾是星际联盟防卫军一支守备部队的驻地.

column1: Massive herds of three-legged, brown beasts move across the planet in time with the seasons.
column2: 庞大的三足棕色兽群随着季节更替穿越这颗行星.

column1: Large homesteads cover the landscape of Ibstock, whilst the capital city of Torrick has a burgeoning textiles industry.
column2: 大型农庄遍布Ibstock的地貌，而Torrick的首府则拥有蓬勃发展的纺织业.

column1: The planet of Icar has most of its surface covered by water with two continents separated by a vast channel.
column2: Icar行星的大部分表面被水覆盖，两个大陆被一条宽阔的海峡隔开.

column1: Ichlangis is a Martian planet, with atmosphere too thin to breathe, no surface water, and temperature below freezing. The planet is rich in titanium, and the ores are made easily accessible by the deep chasms that crack the planet's surface.
column2: 伊奇兰吉斯是一颗火星般的行星：大气稀薄无法呼吸，地表无水，气温低于冰点。该星球富含钛，而撕裂地表的深峡谷让矿石易于开采。

column1: Ichmandu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ichmandu是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ictus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ictus是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Ideyld system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Ideyld星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间的某个时候或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: A quiet colony not far from the Periphery, Idlewind is a minor trading hub and a semi-popular base for independent Deep Periphery explorers.
column2: Idlewind是一个距外围不远的宁静殖民地，是一个小型贸易枢纽，也是独立深空外围探险者较为青睐的基地.

column1: The failing pirate haven on Idrmach received a new lease of life when a jumpship lost in time appeared in orbit bringing new colonists in 2811.
column2: Idrmach上日渐衰败的海盗避风港重获新生: 2811年，一艘迷失于时间中的跃迁舰出现在轨道上，带来了新的殖民者.

column1: Ife was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ife是在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Igualada has a circular orbit around its primary, meaning seasonal and temperature variations are caused by the day/night cycle only.
column2: 伊瓜拉达沿其主星做圆周轨道运行，意味着季节与温度变化仅由昼夜循环造成。

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Iijima was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Iijima曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: The Ikast system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Ikast星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民.

column1: The Iknogoro system was colonised during the Exodus from Terra. Now a thriving agrimarket world, its history was much more grim with the Iknogoro Famine of the 2400s.
column2: Iknogoro星系是在从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的. 如今它是一个繁荣的农业市场世界，但它的历史却因2400年代的Iknogoro饥荒而阴暗得多.

column1: Ildlandet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ildlandet在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ilion was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ilion于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

column1: Illium was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Illium是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Illushin is famed for its cheeses; its two continents feature vast fertile grasslands on which a variety of herd animals can be grazed. Large coastal spaceport cities ship luxury foods off-world, as well as manufactured goods and military supplies.
column2: 伊鲁申因其奶酪闻名; 它的两块大陆上有着广阔的肥沃草原，在那里可以放牧各种各样的牧群动物. 沿海的大型太空港城市将奢侈食品运出星球，一起运出的还有制成品和军用物资.

column1: Settled by the poorest nations, Illizi operates at a mid 20th century level of development.
column2: Illizi由最贫穷的国家殖民建立，发展水平相当于20世纪中期.

column1: Once the capital planet of the Illyrian Palatinate, for many years Illyria's inhabitants spent their time searching their world for Star League caches rumored to exist on the world.
column2: 伊利里亚曾是伊利里亚帕拉丁国的首都行星，多年来它的居民花费时间在自己的世界上搜寻据传存在的星盟储藏库。

column1: Ilmachna was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ilmachna于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ilmar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ilmar是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战事中消亡了.

column1: Ilzra is home to numerous rice wine vineyards, which are exported across the Inner Sphere.
column2: Ilzra拥有众多米酒葡萄园，其产品出口到内天体各地.

column1: The Imalda system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Sian Commonwealth prior to the founding of the Capellan Confederation
column2: Imalda星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前是锡安共同体的成员.

column1: Was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra. Was liberated in 2804-05 during the first major AFFS counter-offensive of the First Succession War against the Draconis Combine.
column2: 于第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民. 在第一次继承战争期间，AFFS对天龙联合体的首次大规模反攻中，于2804-05年获得解放.

column1: A fairly cold world, Imbros is only important due to its strategic positioning within 2 jumps of Terra, the Draconis Combine, the Free Worlds League, and both halves of the Federated Commonwealth.
column2: Imbros是一颗相当寒冷的世界，其重要性仅在于它的战略位置: 距泰拉、天龙联合体、自由世界联盟以及联邦共同体的两半都只有 2 次跳跃.

column1: The Immenstadt system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War. Cold for much of the year, it has a strong hydroponic industry.
column2: Immenstadt星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民. 一年中大部分时间气候寒冷，拥有强大的水培产业.

column1: Ina was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ina在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Inarcs had a most unusual founding when it was selected as a Star League penal colony world sight unseen, after a clerical error in the twenty-fourth century incorrectly classified the comfortable planet as uninhabitable. Nowadays, it is a thriving hub of activity.
column2: Inarcs的建立过程极不寻常: 24世纪的一场文书错误将这颗环境宜人的行星误判为不宜居住，随后它便在无人实地考察的情况下被选为星际联盟的流放地星球. 如今，这里已是一个繁荣活跃的中心.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Inchicore was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Inchicore曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: The Inculkalns system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra due to its rich mineral content.
column2: Inculkalns星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候，因其丰富的矿产资源而被殖民.

column1: Independence is a lush world, dominated by vast oceans and jungle-covered volcanic islands. The plutocratic government runs the planet primarily for recreational tourists, with the inhabitants regulated by a strict caste system.
column2: 自由星是一颗郁郁葱葱的星球，大片海洋和覆盖热带丛林的火山岛构成了其主要地貌. 其富豪统治政府主要将这颗星球作为观光度假用途来运营，同时以严格的种姓制度管理着本地居民.

column1: Indicass was settled by Ceres Metals Industries and the company invests a sizeable sum in ensuring the population is comfortable despite the planet's harsh climate. Ceres' plants on Indicass manufacture a variety of munitions and military vehicles.
column2: 因迪卡斯由刻瑞斯金属工业殖民，该公司投入可观资金确保人口在这颗气候严酷的行星上生活舒适。刻瑞斯在因迪卡斯的工厂生产多种弹药与军用车辆。

column1: Indrapurai was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Indrapurai在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Ingenstrem system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Ingenstrem星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候被殖民了.

column1: Ingersoll is a very properous world, as not only is it widely believed to be the most beautiful in the entire Confederation but it also possesses large deposits of gold and silver ore.
column2: Ingersoll是一颗非常繁荣的星球，不仅被广泛认为是整个邦联中最美丽的世界，而且还拥有大量金矿和银矿矿藏.

column1: This bleak, rocky world was captured from the Capellans early in the First Succession War. The fierce fighting has left centuries-old ruins scattered around the surface, and scavengers still turn up valuable technology on occasion.
column2: 这颗荒凉的岩质星球在第一次继承战争早期就被人从卡佩拉人手里夺走了. 激烈的战斗在地表留下了星罗棋布的古老废墟，拾荒者们偶尔还能翻出有价值的技术.

column1: Ingress was one of the first worlds settled during the Terran Exodus. Its rich soil soon allowed the inhabitants to grow a great deal of food, far more than they needed. These crops remain the foundation of Ingress' economy, but the planet does have some light industry as well, making it totally self-sufficient.
column2: 因格瑞斯是地球出走期间最早被殖民的世界之一。它肥沃的土壤很快让居民种出大量粮食，远超所需。这些作物至今仍是因格瑞斯经济的基础，但该行星也有一些轻工业，使其完全自给自足。

column1: The oldest inhabited system in the modern Chainelane Isles, Ingvolstand was once home to numerous huge manufacturing complexes which were destroyed during the Amaris Civil War. Nowadays it is ran by the Helena Collective, a matriarchal pirate band known for forcing men into servitude and many coming of age orgies. Less fun than it sounds.
column2: 现代钱莱恩群岛中最古老的有居民星系，Ingvolstand曾是众多巨大制造综合体的所在地，这些综合体在阿马里斯内战期间被摧毁. 如今它由Helena Collective统治，这是一个母权制海盗团伙，以强迫男性为奴和举行许多成年礼性狂欢而闻名. 没听起来那么有趣.

column1: The Inman system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Age of War and known for its native wildlife that tastes suspiciously like chicken.
column2: Inman星系在战争时代结束前的某个时期被殖民，并因其本土野生动物而闻名，它们的味道可疑地像鸡肉.

column1: Inner Surge was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Inner Surge在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This system is little more than a supply and operations base for Instellar Expeditions teams.
column2: 这个星系不过是Instellar Expeditions团队的补给与行动基地而已.

column1: Now known as Diedre's Den, the original colony of Iolas died out during the Second Succession War, and was claimed by colonists from the Circinus Federation who found an abandoned colony still in working order - just no people.
column2: 如今被称为迪德蕾巢穴的伊奥拉斯原始殖民地，在第二次继承战争期间灭亡，随后被来自奇尔奇努斯联邦的殖民者占有——他们发现了一处仍在运转、只是没有人的废弃殖民地。

column1: Ionus has only one major continent, Ionus where the capital city Kargon is located. In orbit, the Illium Shipyards produce components vital for warship construction.
column2: Ionus只有一块主要大陆——Ionus，首都Kargon就坐落于此. 在轨道上，Illium造船厂生产对战舰建造至关重要的部件.

column1: The Ipava system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was one of the founding worlds of the Crucis Pact.
column2: Ipava星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或结束后不久被殖民，是克鲁西斯协定的创始世界之一.

column1: The Ipava system was colonised shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was one of the founding worlds of the Sian Commonwealth.
column2: Ipava星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙后不久就被殖民，并且是锡安共同体的创始世界之一.

column1: The planet Irece has three continents, Santana, Salvador and Baiano. It is also the home of a 9.7 kilometer tall mountain known as Tengoku, which reaches into the planet's stratosphere and is located a hundred kilometers from the world's capital city.
column2: 伊雷塞星球有三大洲：圣塔纳、萨尔瓦多与巴伊亚诺。它也是高9.7公里的“天国”山的所在地——此山深入星球平流层，距该星球首府一百公里。

column1: Irian is a heavily industrialized world and for much of its history has been a local power. It is the headquarters of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited, a large interstellar corporation.
column2: Irian是一个高度工业化的世界，在其历史的大部分时间里一直是当地的一股强权. 它是大型星际企业Irian BattleMechs Unlimited的总部所在地.

column1: Clan Jade Falcon's capital and location of their primary training and manufacturing facilities. The capital city is also called Ironhold City.
column2: 玉猫部族的首都及其主要训练与制造设施所在地。首府城市也叫铁堡城。

column1: Iron Land was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Iron Land在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Irurzun contains a great deal of metal ores, gemstones, and radioactive materials, with New Samarkand Metals finding new deposits almost annually for centuries.
column2: Irurzun蕴藏着大量金属矿石、宝石和放射性物质，几个世纪以来，New Samarkand Metals几乎每年都能发现新的矿藏.

column1: The Isabela system was colonised during the Star League era, beginning life as a mining colony.
column2: Isabela星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，最初是一个采矿殖民地.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Isesaki was the headquarters world of the XXXV Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force. It has been a trading post for centuries, with massive warehouses storing goods for dispersal to worlds across the Inner Sphere.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Isesaki是星际联盟防卫军第35军（星际联盟）的总部世界. 数个世纪以来，它一直是一个贸易站，拥有庞大的仓库，储存着要分发到内天体各世界的货物.

column1: Isfahan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Isfahan是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The primary agricultural world of the Taurian Concordat, Ishtar was one of the earliest colonies in the region. It is totally undefended, and has no manufacturing or heavy industry, in an effort to make it less appealing to raiders. The entire population is engaged in food production.
column2: 伊什塔尔是金牛协约国主要的农业星球，是这一地区最早的殖民地之一. 它完全不设防，也没有制造业或重工业，以此让它不那么吸引盗匪. 整个星球的人口都从事食品生产.

column1: Once part of the United Hindu Collective, Islamabad's difficulty integrating into the Federated Suns has led to centuries of on-and-off religious tension and smoldering caste-based revolts.
column2: 伊斯兰堡曾是联合印度教集团的一部分，它在融入联邦太阳域方面的困难导致了数百年断断续续的宗教紧张与阴燃的种姓叛乱。

column1: Ruled by the Humphrey Family the world of Islington is a water world that helps supply the millions of marian subjects with fresh fish. It also is the main training world for Marian Marines and terrestial naval personel.
column2: 由Humphrey家族统治的Islington星球是一个水世界，为数百万Marian臣民供应鲜鱼. 它也是Marian陆战队和地面海军人员的主要训练星球.

column1: Issaba was originally settled as part of the Finmark Province of the Rim Worlds Republic due to being extremely hospitable to human life.
column2: Issaba最初是因极其适宜人类居住而作为边缘世界共和国芬马克省的一部分被殖民的.

column1: Settled by the Terran New Habitat during the Exodus from Terra due to rich rhenium deposits, Itabaiana has an extremely agreeable climate.
column2: 由于拥有丰富的来矿藏，Itabaiana在从地球出走期间被地球新栖息地组织建立定居点，并拥有极其宜人的气候.

column1: Itica was never better than marginally habitable, and was colonized by the Capellans mostly as a defensive measure. During the Second Succession War, the Free Worlds League seized it; they pursued a scorched-earth policy, quite literally scorching the earth to bare rock.
column2: 易提卡一直都只勉强适合居住，卡佩拉人殖民于此主要是作为一种防御措施. 在第二次继承战争期间，自由世界联盟夺走了它; 他们奉行的是焦土政策，确切地说是把土地烧成裸岩.

column1: Settled towards the end of the Star League era, the rich fertile jungles of Ito allow for large exports to nearby worlds.
column2: Ito于星际联盟时代末期被殖民，其富饶肥沃的丛林使其得以向附近世界大量出口.

column1: One of the four founding worlds of the Aurigan Coalition under the direction of House Gallas, Itrom is a jewel of the region, a pleasant Terran world with a population of over a billion. Centuries-old wars left a scar across the surface: a cratered radioactive wasteland that dominates the northern hemisphere.
column2: 伊特罗姆是御夫座联盟四大创始星系之一，由加拉斯家族统治，也是该地区的一颗明珠，是颗有着超过10亿人口的宜人类地星球. 长达数世纪的战争在地表留下了一道伤疤: 一个遍布弹坑、主导北半球的放射性荒地.

column1: Itsbur is a frozen world, nearly uninhabitable, and as a consequence the Capellan government had a difficult time recruiting colonists. Terraforming efforts never made it past the early stages, and eventually the colony died out, with insufficient population growth.
column2: 埃茨伯是一颗冰封星球，几近不适宜居住，因此卡佩拉政府在招募殖民者的过程中遇到了困难. 地球化的努力从来没有越过早期阶段，最终因人口增长不足使得殖民地消亡了.

column1: Itzehoe was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Itzehoe于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Izar is actually a binary system; the major star in the system is a blue-white B5 supergiant, which is orbited by a cool orange K0 star.
column2: Izar实际上是一个双星系统；该系统中的主星是一颗蓝白色B5 超巨星，有一颗温度较低的橙色K0 星围绕其运行.

column1: Izmir was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Izmir在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Jaboatao system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra due to its rich mineral content.
column2: Jaboatao星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候，因其丰富的矿产资源而被殖民.

column1: The Jaboatao system was colonised at some point towards the end of the Star League era as successor states clamoured for resources.
column2: Jaboatao星系在星际联盟时代末期某个时候被殖民，当时各继承国正争相攫取资源.

column1: Jacobabad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jacobabad在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A hot, wet world with a dense atmosphere, Jacomarle has very little to attract conflict; the residents are farmers and fishers, and local industry produces consumer goods for nearby systems. Thus despite being one jump from the border, there are no real military threats.
column2: 雅各马尔勒是一颗炎热，潮湿，有着稠密大气的星球，几乎不会吸引冲突; 居民是农民和渔民，当地工业为附近星系生产消费品. 因此，尽管距离边境只有一跃(迁)之遥，那里也没有真正的军事威胁.

column1: Jacson is a lush, verdant world, dominated by an equatorial megaforest known as the Perpetual Forest. The massive boles make modern sensors useless, and overmatched military forces can retreat into its relative safety.
column2: 雅克松是一个郁郁葱葱的星球，一片巨大的森林覆盖在赤道上，被称为永久森林. 巨大的树干让现代传感器变得毫无用处，这使得被击败的军队可以撤到相对安全的地方.

column1: Jaipur has long been an agricultural world that exports its products to nearby systems, though in recent years the ruling family has been attempting to industrialise.
column2: Jaipur长期以来一直是一个农业世界，向附近星系出口其产品，不过近年来统治家族一直在尝试工业化.

column1: One of the founding worlds of the Taurian Concordat, Jamestown is a peaceful, modestly prosperous world, with three continents and vast oceans. Once the site of a SLDF garrison, the planet still benefits from the high-tech industrial infrastructure.
column2: 詹姆斯敦是金牛协约国的创始星球之一，是一个平静，中等繁荣的星球，拥有三片大陆和广阔的海洋. 这颗行星曾是星际联盟防卫军一支守备部队的地方，现在依然受益于高科技工业基础设施.

column1: Janina was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Janina在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jansen's Hold is a dry, cold world, dominated by windswept tundra in the temperate zones, and glacial mountains in the north and south. Heavily industrialized, the planet is a manufacturing center for a major arms manufacturer, Taurus Territorial Industries.
column2: 扬森要塞是一颗干燥寒冷的世界，温带地区以狂风呼啸的冻原为主，南北则是冰川山脉。该行星工业化程度很高，是重要武器制造商陶里安领地工业的制造中心。

column1: Jápminboddu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jápminboddu在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jardangal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jardangal在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: This system appears in the Argo database, but must have been struck from official records, as it does not exist on any recent charts. Strange.
column2: 这个星系出现在Argo数据库中，但肯定已从官方记录中抹去，因为最近的所有星图上都没有它. 奇怪.

column1: Alshain Weapons has a large manufacturing facility here. After the planet was attacked by the mysterious Minnesota Tribe after the Second Succession War, the company rigged the facility with explosives to ensure it can never be captured.
column2: Alshain Weapons在这里拥有一座大型制造设施. 第二次继承战争后，这颗行星遭到神秘的明尼苏达部落袭击之后，该公司在该设施内布设了炸药，以确保它永远不会被占领.

column1: Issaba was originally settled during the First Exodus from Terra due to its largest continent being extremely hospitable to human life.
column2: Issaba最初是在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民的，因为其最大的大陆极其适宜人类生活.

column1: Jászberény was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jászberény在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Jatznik system was colonised at some point towards the end of the Star League era as successor states clamoured for resources.
column2: Jatznik星系在星际联盟时代末期某个时候被殖民，当时各继承国正竞相争夺资源.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile jungles of Jaumegarde allow for large exports to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jaumegarde得到殖民开发，其富饶肥沃的丛林使其得以向附近星球大量出口.

column1: Java was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Java在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Jeanette Naval Yards produces submarine vehicles in a vast naval yard on the Tal'Dorei ocean. Their specializations in naval vehicles has created an expert workforce.
column2: 珍妮特海军船坞在塔尔多雷海上的一座庞大海军船厂内生产水下车辆。他们在海军车辆上的专精造就了一支专业化的工人队伍。

column1: Jeju was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jeju在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jenet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jenet是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的定居点，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jeppens was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jeppens是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jerangle was originally settled as part of the Finmark Province of the Rim Worlds Republic due to being extremely hospitable to human life, however the planet did sustain some ecological damage during the Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Jerangle最初是作为边缘世界共和国芬马克省的一部分被殖民的，因为这里极其适宜人类生存，不过该行星在共和国-共同体战争期间确实遭受了一些生态破坏.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile oasis of Jeronimo allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jeronimo这片富饶肥沃的绿洲得到殖民开发，从而能够向邻近世界大量出口食品.

column1: Jesenice was originally settled as part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic due to its easily accessible mineral deposits, however the facilities did sustain some damage during the Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Jesenice最初是作为边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分而建立的，因为其矿藏易于开采，不过其设施在共和国-共同体战争期间确实遭受了一些损坏.

column1: A small, dry planet colonised purely because of the discovery of sizable veins of tin and silver. The entire population is involved in the small but significant mining industry, which is totally reliant on interstellar shipping for food.
column2: 一颗小而干燥的行星，之所以被殖民，纯粹是因为发现了可观的锡和银矿脉. 全体人口都从事着规模虽小但意义重大的采矿业，而该产业完全依赖星际航运来获取食物.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile oasis of Jezersko allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jezersko这片富饶肥沃的绿洲得以定居，使得大量食品能够出口到附近的世界.

column1: Jiddah was originally settled at the beginning of the golden age of the Star League due to its easily accessible mineral deposits.
column2: Jiddah最初是在星际联盟黄金时代初期，因其易于开采的矿藏而有人定居的.

column1: Jilin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jilin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候建立定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Joan's Post was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 琼之哨站在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束之后的某个时候被殖民，却在继承战争的战火中消亡。

column1: Neukirchen was originally named Jodipur, and was one of the three planets which formed the nucleus of the United Hindu Collective, along with Basantapur and Panpour.
column2: Neukirchen最初名为Jodipur，是与Basantapur和Panpour一同构成联合印度教集体核心的三颗行星之一.

column1: Johnson was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Johnson在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Wunderland Enterprises and Valiant Systems export military vehicles, communications systems and electronics from Johnsondale across the Inner Sphere.
column2: Wunderland Enterprises和Valiant Systems从Johnsondale向整个内天体出口军用车辆、通信系统和电子设备.

column1: The statue of the horse of a Tikonov Grand Union general stands outside the city hall, a symbol of remembrance of the Tikonov massacres.
column2: Tikonov大联盟一位将军的骏马雕像矗立在市政厅外，是纪念Tikonov大屠杀的象征.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile oasis of Jonzac allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jonzac这片富饶肥沃的绿洲被建立为定居点，使得大量食品得以出口到附近世界.

column1: The colony of Joppa IV is located on Specula, the gas giant's largest moon, in the remains of an SLDF station. With no significant resources, the inhabitants of the moon have leveraged their position as a trade hub to survive.
column2: 约帕IV殖民地坐落在气态巨行星斯佩库拉最大的卫星上，建在一座SLDF站的残骸中。由于该卫星没有重要资源，居民们凭借其作为贸易枢纽的位置谋生。

column1: A core world of the Outworlds Alliance, it escaped most notice during Operation UNION HOLD. It's primary export is of a tabletop wargame where each player controls numerous BattleMechs in battles against each other. Designed for children, it has nevertheless gained a strong foothold amongst the older aristocracy.
column2: 作为外域联盟的核心世界，它在联合控制行动期间几乎没有引起注意。它的主要出口产品是一种桌面战争游戏，每位玩家操控众多战斗机甲互相对战。它虽然是为儿童设计的，却在年长的贵族阶层中站稳了脚跟。

column1: The Joradian Cluster is a collection of stars within close proximity to each other.
column2: Joradian Cluster是一群彼此距离很近的恒星.

column1: Jorvikland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jorvikland在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Joshua was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Joshua在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间因战乱而消亡.

column1: Josselin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Josselin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, it was originally part of the Federation of Oriente.
column2: 于从泰拉大迁徙期间建立定居点，最初是Oriente联邦的一部分.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich ore fields of Joyz allow for large exports of minerals to nearby worlds.
column2: Joyz建于星际联盟的黄金时代，其丰富的矿田使其得以向附近世界大量出口矿物.

column1: The Juazeiro system was colonised during the Star League era, beginning life as a mining colony.
column2: Juazeiro星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，最初是一个矿业殖民地.

column1: Jubka has been described as a \"lucrative mining world\" that is however vitally dependant on a lifeline of iceships supplied by Curtiss Hydrosystems.
column2: 朱布卡被描述为"利润丰厚的采矿世界"，但它极度依赖由柯蒂斯水务系统供应的冰船生命线。

column1: This system contains near to nothing. It's whole purpose is to refill your jumpdrive.
column2: 这个星系几乎空无一物。它的唯一用途就是为你的跃迁引擎补给。

column1: Junction once held sway over several smaller worlds in the region centuries ago, before willingly joining the Draconis Combine for protection. Its importance has waned, but it still serves as a military depot and logistical hub.
column2: 数百年前，Junction曾支配该地区的数个较小世界，后来为寻求保护而自愿加入天龙联合. 它的重要性已经减弱，但仍作为军事仓库和后勤枢纽发挥作用.

column1: Michaelson Heavy Industries utilises the raw materials from the numerous mines to create components for VTOL, as well as having a secondary line for armour threading.
column2: Michaelson Heavy Industries利用来自众多矿场的原材料制造VTOL组件，同时还设有一条用于装甲编织的辅助生产线.

column1: Jungar Qi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jungar Qi于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间因战乱而消亡.

column1: Settled during the golden age of the Star League, the rich ore fields of Junior allow for large exports of minerals to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代建立定居点，Junior丰富的矿田使其能够向附近世界大量出口矿物.

column1: Juniper was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Juniper于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: When Kabah was first settled, there was a terrible hemorrhagic fever that scythed through the colony. The population slowly developed a resistance to it over the centuries.
column2: 当Kabah最初被殖民时，一场可怕的出血热如镰刀般席卷了整个殖民地. 数百年来，居民逐渐对它产生了抵抗力.

column1: After suffering an attack from the Daemien's Destroyers mercenary unit during the First Succession War, the government is reluctant to hire mercenaries.
column2: 在第一次继承战争期间遭到戴米恩毁灭者雇佣兵部队袭击之后，该政府不愿再雇佣雇佣兵。

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the vast jade deposits under the surface are heavily mined.
column2: 于星际联盟时代有人定居，地表之下蕴藏的丰富玉矿正被大规模开采.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Kagoshima was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. It is the capital of the local prefecture.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Kagoshima驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支守备部队. 它是当地管区的首府.

column1: The Kaguyak system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Kaguyak星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的.

column1: Kaifeng is an agricultural world that exports its food surplus to feed a number nearby worlds, especially Sarna and Sakhalin.
column2: Kaifeng是一个农业世界，将其盈余粮食出口以供养附近若干世界，尤其是Sarna和Sakhalin.

column1: Kaitangata is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources.
column2: Kaitangata是一个贫困的星系，几乎没有什么矿产财富或资源.

column1: The Kaiyuh system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Kaiyuh星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民，并在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前是该集体的成员.

column1: Kajikazawa is a prefecture capital in the Benjamin Military District, and houses numerous luxury holiday homes for politicians and bureaucrats from Benjamin.
column2: Kajikazawa是Benjamin军区的一个专区首府，并拥有大量供来自Benjamin的政客和官僚使用的豪华度假住宅.

column1: Kakada is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources. It's main source of income is the production of woodcrafts thanks to abundant lumber.
column2: 卡卡达是一个贫困星系，几乎没有什么矿产财富或资源。它的主要收入来自木器制作，因为这里有大量木材。

column1: Kaldu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kaldu是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Mercilessly hot and dry, Kalidasa is nonetheless a major industrial world, hosting large amounts of cross-border trade and a major Mech factory.
column2: 尽管酷热难耐、干燥无情，Kalidasa仍是一个重要的工业世界，拥有大量跨境贸易和一座大型机甲工厂.

column1: Kalmar (CC) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kalmar (CC) 在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Kalmar is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds. It is a mostly water world, with vast ship building facilities for boats.
column2: Kalmar是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物. 它主要是一个水世界，拥有庞大的船只造船设施.

column1: Broiling with discontent, the population of Kamarod is known for their rebel activities.
column2: Kamarod的民众因不满而群情激愤，以叛乱活动闻名.

column1: Memorials to the 7th Bolan Defenders stand proud in many cities across Kamenz, an historic reminder of the end of the Star League.
column2: 纪念第7博兰防卫者的纪念碑傲然矗立在Kamenz的许多城市中，成为星际联盟终结的历史性提醒.

column1: Kampen is one of the worlds that form a part of the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds. It is an icy mining facility for the most part, but small manufacturers are setting up here in recent years.
column2: Kampen是组成汉萨同盟一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口货物. 它大体上是一个冰封的采矿设施，但近年来，小型制造商正开始在这里设厂.

column1: Was the provincial capital of the Duchy of Andurien.  Have a few military schools including three of significant size. One of which - the Humphreys School of Warfare - was opened in 2762 and is pretty hi-tech.
column2: 曾是Andurien公爵领的首府. 拥有几所军事学校，其中包括三所规模较大的. 其中一所——汉弗莱斯战争学院——于2762年开办，并且技术相当先进.

column1: Settled a few years before the formation of the Star League, the rich fertile oasis of Kandersteg allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟成立几年前，Kandersteg这片富饶肥沃的绿洲便已有人定居，使其得以向附近世界大量出口食品.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the rich fertile mountains of Kandis allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 于星际联盟时代拓殖，Kandis肥沃富饶的山地使其得以向附近世界大量出口食品.

column1: Kannon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kannon在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Lacking an atmosphere, barren Kanowit would have fallen off the maps of the Inner Sphere entirely if not for its impressive mineral riches, and the ease with which the Combine's prisoners extract them.
column2: 由于缺乏大气，若非其令人惊叹的矿产财富以及联合体囚犯开采这些矿产的便利，荒芜的卡诺威特本会彻底从内天体的星图上消失。

column1: The small and frozen world of Kansu was only settled in the second half of the 24th century. The icy world's flora is unique in that it stores energy as frozen methane rather than as fat. Whilst now a source of power, the initial encounters were quite explosive.
column2: 寒冷的小世界甘肃直到二十四世纪后半叶才被殖民。这颗冰封世界的植物群独特之处在于，它以冻结的甲烷而非脂肪形式储存能量。虽然如今它是一种能源，但最初的接触相当具有爆炸性。

column1: Kanto was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kanto于星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by poor African and Arabic colonists, Kapoeta is a dismal world that operates at a mid 20th century level of development.
column2: 由贫穷的非洲和阿拉伯殖民者定居，Kapoeta是一个凄凉的世界，发展水平仅相当于20世纪中期.

column1: The vast sulfur fields of Karachi leave the otherwise breathable atmosphere with a constant smell of rotten egg, ensuring visitors rarely stay for long periods of time.
column2: Karachi广阔的硫磺地带使原本尚可呼吸的大气中持续弥漫着臭鸡蛋味，使得访客很少长时间停留.

column1: Karakiraz is a relatively poor system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources. It's main source of income is the production of woodcrafts thanks to abundant lumber.
column2: 卡拉基拉兹是一个相对贫困的星系，几乎没有什么矿产财富或资源。它的主要收入来自木器制作，因为这里有大量木材。

column1: A tropical paradise known for its rare gemstones, Karbala's aristocrats are some of the wealthiest in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 作为以稀有宝石闻名的热带天堂，卡巴拉的贵族是内天体最富有的一批人。

column1: Karkkila was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Karkkila最初是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu省的一部分，并在共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Karlstejn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Karlstejn在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Most of the population of Karpathos lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy
column2: Karpathos的大部分人口过着农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于18世纪末或19世纪初泰拉上的技术维持，这是奥姆尼斯哲学深刻影响的结果.

column1: Settled during the golden age of the Star League, the rich mineral fields of Karston allow for large exports to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代被殖民，Karston丰富的矿藏使其得以向邻近世界大量出口.

column1: The Kasdach system was colonised shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was one of the founding worlds of the Sian Commonwealth. Despite constant volcanic activity, the soils remain infertile in many areas.
column2: Kasdach星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙后不久便被殖民，并且是锡安共同体的创始世界之一. 尽管火山活动持续不断，许多地区的土壤仍然贫瘠.

column1: Kashilla is an unremarkable tropical world within the Capellan Confederation near the border with the Free Worlds League. While it supports a large population, it lacks any major military, research, or manufacturing facilities.
column2: Kashilla是卡佩拉联盟境内一个不起眼的热带世界，靠近与自由世界联盟的边境. 虽然它承载着大量人口，但缺乏任何主要的军事、研究或制造设施.

column1: Kathil itself was an insignificant planet with limited rare metal deposits until the Star League set up the James McKenna Shipyards in 2602.  While the Succession Wars effectively destroyed them, rumors are that the Feds have recently rebuilt them.
column2: Kathil本身曾是一颗无足轻重的行星，稀有金属矿藏有限，直到星盟于2602年建立了詹姆斯·麦肯纳造船厂. 尽管继承战争实际上摧毁了这些造船厂，但有传言称联邦最近已将其重建.

column1: The SLDF facility on this world made it a prime target during the Periphery Uprising, and an orbital mass-driver strike left an enormous crater and a badly-disrupted ecosystem. The potential for scavenging LosTech continues to flood the system with prospectors and colonists.
column2: 这颗星球上的星际联盟防卫军设施使它成为外围起义期间的主要目标，而一部轨道质量加速器的攻击留下了一个巨大的弹坑和遭严重破坏的生态系统. 寻找失落科技的潜在可能使它一直有勘探者和殖民者持续涌入.

column1: The constant vulcanism of Katla made it suitable for only a minor surveillance outpost. When that outpost was destroyed in a minor skirmish during the Third Succession War, not enough remained of it to make it viable to rebuild.
column2: 持续的火山活动让卡特拉只适合小型监视前哨. 当那座前哨在第三次继承战争期间毁于一起小规模冲突时，残存的部分已经不足以让重建成为可行了.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the vast copper deposits of Katlehong have been heavily mined for centuries.
column2: Katlehong在星际联盟时代建立定居点，其庞大的铜矿储量已被大量开采了数百年.

column1: Kaufermann was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kaufermann是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Kaumberg was settled for its vast mountain ranges and forest lands. Though mining would seem to be a logical industry for the world, most of Kaumberg's economy is based on the timber trade.
column2: 考姆贝格因其广袤的山脉与林地而被殖民。虽然采矿业看似是这颗行星合乎逻辑的产业，考姆贝格的经济却大多建立在木材贸易上。

column1: Kaus Australis was only settled to take advantage of the mineral resources available in its crust, particularly Germanium. Without this vital metal, JumpShips cannot travel between the stars.
column2: Kaus Australis的殖民仅仅是为了利用其地壳中蕴藏的矿产资源，尤其是锗. 若没有这种至关重要的金属，跃迁舰便无法在恒星之间航行.

column1: When it was originally settled, Kaus Borealis was a paradise of green plants, fresh water, and beautiful seasons. In the past 300 years, however, a series of volcanic eruptions and other geological events have spewed massive amounts of ash, methane, and sulfur into the atmosphere, tainting it.
column2: 最初被殖民时，Kaus Borealis是一个拥有绿色植物、淡水和美丽季节的天堂. 然而，在过去300年里，一系列火山喷发和其他地质事件向大气中喷出了大量火山灰、甲烷和硫，使其受到污染.

column1: Kaus Media had nearly everything the early colonists needed to make a successful colony: Foodstuffs, water, temperate climate. The only thing they lacked was any sort of easily accessed mineral resource to build industry. After discovering that Kaus Australis had the opposite problem, traders from Kaus Media rapidly established mutually-beneficial trade agreements that allowed both worlds to survive.
column2: Kaus Media几乎拥有早期殖民者建立成功殖民地所需的一切: 食物、水和温和的气候. 他们唯一缺少的是任何易于获取的矿产资源来发展工业. 在发现Kaus Australis面临相反的问题后，来自Kaus Media的商人迅速建立了互利的贸易协定，使两个世界都得以生存.

column1: Kautokeino was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kautokeino是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Kawabe was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Kawabe驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支守备部队.

column1: Kawich's soil is spread across ten large island continents in shallow sea basins. The soil itself isn't good for agriculture, but it is packed with petroleum, minerals, and metal ores that are extremely valuable to manufacturers.
column2: 卡维奇的土壤散布在浅海盆地中的十块大型岛屿大陆上。土壤本身不适合农业，但富含对制造商极有价值的石油、矿物与金属矿石。

column1: For centuries Kazanka has been a major industrial and mining world that supplies Yttrium, an element used in the production of high-tech laser optics and crystals. A heavy Star League presence existed centuries ago, and many caches are still being found today.
column2: 数百年来，Kazanka一直是一个主要的工业和采矿世界，供应钇——一种用于生产高科技激光光学元件和晶体的元素. 几个世纪前，这里曾有星际联盟的大量存在，如今仍不断发现许多储藏点.

column1: Kazlam is located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery, in a remote location anti-spinward of the Hanseatic League and coreward of Interstellar Expeditions Base 14.
column2: Kazlam位于深空外围的反旋臂区域，地处汉萨同盟反旋臂方向、星际探险组织14号基地核心方向的偏远位置.

column1: Kaznejov was a sun-baked world with modest ore deposits that prompted colonization in the early 24th century. Since then, the population has imported life-forms to make this world more habitable.
column2: Kaznejov是一个被太阳炙烤的世界，拥有适量的矿石储量，这促成了它在24世纪初被殖民. 自那以后，居民们引入了生命形态，使这个世界变得更加宜居.

column1: A barren expanse of sand and rock, Kazu was inhabited as recently as a century ago. The technology used to extract water from the limited subterranean aquifers was destroyed in the ending days of the Second Succession War, and the planet was abandoned to the sand.
column2: 卡祖是一片广阔，由沙子和岩石构成的不毛之地，在一个世纪以前就有人定居了. 在第二次继承战争最后的日子里，用来从有限的地下含水层中提取水的技术设备被摧毁，于是该行星被遗弃给了黄沙.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the oceans of Kearny are filled with underwater volcanoes, which bring raw material to the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟时代被殖民，Kearny的海洋中遍布海底火山，它们将原料带到水面.

column1: Settled by poor African and Arabic colonists, Kebili is a poor world that operates at a mid 20th century level of development.
column2: Kebili由贫穷的非洲和阿拉伯殖民者定居，是一个发展水平处于20世纪中期的贫困世界.

column1: In the final years of the Star League, Keeling served as the headquarters world for the XXVI Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force. The main base on world was Fort Wittman, which is now the site of a ruined Castle Brian.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Keeling曾是星际联盟防卫军第26军（星际联盟）的总部所在星球. 该星球上的主要基地是维特曼堡，如今那里是一座已成废墟的布莱恩城堡的所在地.

column1: Kefya is a poor world that operates at a mid 20th century level of development.
column2: Kefya是一个贫穷的世界，其发展水平相当于20世纪中期.

column1: A fertile, slightly colder Earth like world; Keid was one of the first planets settled outside the Sol system. Though its orbital shipyards were lost in the First Succession War, the planet's agrarian and industrial economies remain strong.
column2: 作为一颗肥沃、略冷的类地世界，凯德是太阳系之外最早被定居的行星之一。虽然它的轨道船坞在第一次继承战争中丧失，该行星的农业与工业经济依然强健。

column1: The Keihoku system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. It was a member of the Alliance of Galedon before joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: Keihoku星系是在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 它在加入天龙联合之前曾是加勒顿联盟的成员.

column1: Kek was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kek在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the oceans of Kelang teem with aquatic life, allowing for large exports of fishstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟时代有人定居，Kelang的海洋中水生生物繁盛，使得大量鱼类产品得以出口至附近星球.

column1: The weak electromagnetic field around Kelenfold means that its citizenry have some of the highest cancer rates in the Inner Sphere. Visitors are advised to wear sunscreen.
column2: Kelenfold周围微弱的电磁场意味着其居民癌症发病率在内天体位居最高之列. 建议访客涂抹防晒霜.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Kempten was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Kempten曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Natives of Kendall are some of the best-fed people in the League, and the combination of good nutrition and light gravity means that natives routinely reach seven feet in height.
column2: Kendall的原住民是联盟中吃得最好的人之一，良好的营养加上低重力，使得当地人通常能长到七英尺高.

column1: Kenilworth was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kenilworth在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: An agrarian world settled by the Outworlds Alliance, it was seized by the Star League in in 2582.
column2: 一颗由外域联盟拓殖的农业世界，于2582年被星际联盟夺取.

column1: Kent was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kent在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: This is the site of one of the largest war crime in history. The Kentares Massacre was a dark mark in the proud history of the DCMS, and it rallied the Davions to mount an invigorated defense that exemplifies the stalemate in the succession wars.
column2: 这里是历史上最大规模的战争罪行之一的遗址. Kentares大屠杀是DCMS自豪历史中的一个黑暗印记，却促使戴维恩家族发起了一场更为猛烈的防御，这场防御正是继承战争中僵持局面的典型写照.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the forests of Kentwood teem with native wildlife, allowing for large exports of protein to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟时代有人定居，Kentwood的森林中遍布本土野生动物，使得可以向附近星球大量出口蛋白质.

column1: Kerman was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kerman是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Once a highly-fortified military world, Kern's garrison, the 8th Sian Dragoons, was tasked with rapid response along the Rimward border. As the Third Succession War began, the armories and fortresses were shut down and demolished to prevent their potential capture.
column2: 曾是高度设防的军事世界，克恩的驻军——第8西安龙骑兵——负责沿边缘方向边界的快速反应。随着第三次继承战争爆发，军械库与要塞被关闭并拆除，以防被敌方夺取。

column1: Kervil's mineral rich surface is mostly covered with water, with multiple volcanic island chains scattered across the world. Numerous manufacturers exist on the planet including Wakazashi Enterprises.
column2: 克尔维尔的富矿地表大部分被水覆盖，多座火山岛链散布全球。行星上有众多制造商，包括若狭企业。

column1: Kesai IV is a barren and forbidding world. It was once home to a major Star League military depot, the remains of which have been fought over for centuries.
column2: Kesai IV是一颗荒凉而险恶的星球. 它曾是星际联盟一个重要军事补给站的所在地，其遗迹已被争夺了数个世纪.

column1: Kessel was a pristine world rich in minerals and metals and has always been a key manufacturing planet.  Since being captured by the Draconis Combine in 2866, poor environmental practices have tainted the atmosphere, and organised crime is rampant.
column2: Kessel曾是一个原始纯净的世界，富含矿物和金属，并且一直是一个关键的制造行星. 自 2866 年被天龙联合体占领以来，糟糕的环保做法污染了大气，有组织犯罪猖决.

column1: Kestrel is a beautiful garden world with fertile plains and plentiful natural resources. The world's colonization and industrial expansion were planned wisely. Most of the heavy industry operates on Kestrel's two moons, which were terraformed into habitable worlds of their own.
column2: 红隼是一颗美丽的田园星球，拥有肥沃的平原与丰富的自然资源。该星球的殖民与工业扩张规划得当，大部分重工业都在红隼的两颗卫星上运作——那两颗卫星也已被地球化改造为自身的宜居世界。

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the forests of Kettering teem with native fungi, allowing for large exports of fungal protein to nearby worlds.
column2: Kettering在星际联盟时代被拓殖，其森林中遍布原生真菌，使得可以向邻近世界大量出口真菌蛋白.

column1: Keuterville is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources.
column2: Keuterville是一个贫困的星系，几乎没有矿产财富或资源.

column1: Keystone is a harsh world that was initially settled for its supply of minerals and other raw metals. The presence of these materials more than made up for the thin atmosphere and poisonous soil.
column2: Keystone是一个严酷的世界，最初因矿物和其他原金属的供应而有人定居. 这些材料的存在足以弥补其稀薄的大气和有毒的土壤.

column1: Keytesville was one of the last wave of worlds colonised during the Exodus from Terra.
column2: Keytesville是在从泰拉出走期间最后一批被殖民的星球之一.

column1: The Khartoum system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League, and was host to a Star League garrison.
column2: Khartoum星系在星际联盟统治时期的某个时候被殖民，并曾驻扎有一支星际联盟守备部队.

column1: Khi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Khi是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Khon Kaen system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League
column2: Khon Kaen星系在星际联盟统治时期的某个时候被殖民.

column1: The planet Kiamba is exceptionally large and hot, with three continents along the equator and extensive polar oceans. Between the continents, numerous island chains of volcanic origin exist.
column2: Kiamba行星异常巨大且炎热，赤道沿线有三块大陆，极地则有大片海洋. 大陆之间分布着众多火山成因的岛链.

column1: The Kiesen system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League
column2: Kiesen星系在星际联盟统治时期的某个时候被殖民.

column1: Kievanur is a planet or system which was originally located within the Duchy of Orloff region of the Free Worlds League. Kievanur is between Vanra and Fuentes and vanished from maps during the 2nd Succession War.
column2: Kievanur是一颗行星或星系，最初位于自由世界联盟的奥洛夫公爵领区域内. Kievanur位于Vanra和Fuentes之间，并在第二次继承战争期间从星图上消失.

column1: The Kigamboni system was colonized during the Exodus from Terra.
column2: Kigamboni星系是在从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的.

column1: Originally discovered shortly after the fall of the Terran Alliance, Kikuyu was first colonized on the more temperature archipelagos by New Zealanders, Australians, and Tasmanians.
column2: Kikuyu最初是在泰拉联盟覆灭后不久被发现的，最早由新西兰人、澳大利亚人和塔斯马尼亚人在气候较温和的群岛上殖民.

column1: The Kilarney system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League.
column2: Kilarney星系在星际联盟统治期间的某个时候被殖民.

column1: Kilbourne is one of the few Outback worlds of the Federated Commonwealth to have a military academy, which is located within one hundred kilometers of a small series of volcanoes, allowing the cadets to train in harsh conditions.
column2: Kilbourne是联邦共同体少数拥有军事学院的边远世界之一，该学院位于一小片火山群一百公里范围内，使学员能在严酷条件下训练.

column1: The Killarney system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League.
column2: Killarney星系在星际联盟统治时期的某个时候被殖民.

column1: Killbourn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Killbourn在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Kilmarnock system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. It was a member of the Alliance of Galedon before joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: Kilmarnock星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民. 它在加入天龙联合体之前曾是加勒顿联盟的成员.

column1: First settled by a colonists supported by a wealthy twenty-first century industrial magnate interested in the mineral resources available on the world and in its asteroid belt, Kimball II offered an ecosystem with abundant free water and support for Terran crops.
column2: Kimball II最初由一群殖民者定居，他们得到了一位富有的21世纪工业巨头的支持，此人对该世界及其小行星带中可用的矿产资源很感兴趣. Kimball II提供了拥有丰富自由水并能支持地球作物的生态系统.

column1: The presence of two habitable worlds in this system, one arctic and one tropical, make it a rarity. Both are ruled by a theocracy, the New Salvationist Order, that preserves the ruins of SLDF bases in-system as religious shrines.
column2: 这个星系有两颗宜居星球，一颗是极地环境，一颗是热带环境，使它很罕见. 两颗星球都由一支僧侣政权，新救世修会统治，他们将星系内的星际联盟防卫军基地废墟用作圣殿.

column1: Kinbrace is a surface cargo station within the Deep Periphery, near Santiago and the Hanseatic League.
column2: Kinbrace是深空外围中的一个地表货运站，靠近Santiago和汉萨同盟.

column1: Kingtribel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kingtribel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Kinkaid system was colonized by the Outworlds Alliance at some point during the reign of the Star League.
column2: Kinkaid星系在星际联盟统治期间的某个时候被外世界联盟殖民.

column1: When colonised in the last years of the Star League, the world of Kirbyville was in the middle of a global ice age.
column2: 当Kirbyville星球在星际联盟的最后几年被殖民时，它正处于全球冰河期之中.

column1: Kirchbach has few natural resources, but does possess plenty of arable land to allow the population to feed themselves.
column2: Kirchbach几乎没有自然资源，但拥有大量可耕地，足以让当地人口养活自己.

column1: Kirei Na Niwa (\"Beautiful Garden\") is a world whose economy is largely based on agriculture. The broad plains and fertile soil allow many crops to be grown here year round.
column2: 奇丽庭园（“美丽花园”）是一颗经济以农业为主的星球。广阔的平原与肥沃的土壤让许多作物可以全年种植。

column1: A harsh world with an atmosphere that has been tainted over millenia, Kirin would be uninhabited if not for its vast mineral wealth.
column2: 一个严酷的世界，其大气历经数千年已被污染；若不是拥有丰富的矿产资源，Kirin本会无人居住.

column1: Ninety percent of Kirkcaldy is owned by a single corporation, Baker Pharmaceuticals. Kirkcaldy is relatively free of pollution, with the bulk of the manufacturing activity going on in areas of Liska, while the continent of Arcas tended to be home to managerial or creative efforts.
column2: Kirkcaldy的百分之九十由一家公司——贝克制药公司所有. Kirkcaldy相对没有污染，大部分制造活动都集中在Liska地区，而Arcas大陆则通常是管理或创意工作的所在地.

column1: Settled in the Exodus from Terra, it was part of the Marik Republic before joining the Free Worlds League
column2: 在从泰拉的大迁徙中建立定居点，它曾是马里共和国的一部分，后来加入了自由世界联盟.

column1: Kirklin is an industrialised world with Kallon Industries and its subsidiaries making up much of the workforce.
column2: Kirklin是一个工业化世界，Kallon Industries及其子公司构成了其大部分劳动力.

column1: Kirkvåg (Toch Zu 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kirkvåg（Toch Zu 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Kiruna was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kiruna在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League, Kiserian is a world with a harsh climate.
column2: Kiserian于星际联盟诞生之初被殖民，是一颗气候严酷的星球.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Kitalpha was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Kitalpha曾驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

column1: Kitopler was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kitopler在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: When initially colonised, Kittery was known as an inhospitable jungle world. Civilization finds a way however, and the rich deposits under the surface have allowed vast cities to spring up all across the world.
column2: 最初殖民时，Kittery被称作一个不适宜居住的丛林世界. 然而文明总能找到出路，地表之下丰富的矿藏让庞大的城市得以在星球各处拔地而起.

column1: Inhabited since the Exodus from Terra, the colony was impoverished until the discovery of radioactives under the surface which revitalised the economy.
column2: 自泰拉大迁徙以来，该殖民地便有人居住，但一直贫困，直到在地表下发现放射性物质，经济才得以复兴.

column1: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, the initial colony remained independent for centuries before joining the Free Worlds League in the Star League era.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，最初的殖民地保持独立数个世纪，直到在星际联盟时代加入自由世界联盟.

column1: Ki Zoban was a core industrial planet within the Outworlds Alliance until it was utterly destroyed and abandoned during the Second Succession War.
column2: Ki Zoban曾是外世界联盟的一个核心工业行星，直到第二次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁并被废弃.

column1: The Kladnitsa system was either settled by the Rim Worlds Republic at some point during or shortly before the Age of War.
column2: Kladnitsa星系是在战争时代期间或稍早之前的某个时候由边缘世界共和国殖民的.

column1: Klamriz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Klamriz是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Klathandu IV is a sparsely populated world in the Klathan system with little arable land or industry, described as arid and marginally habitable. The infrastructure of the world is very fragile.
column2: Klathandu IV是Klathan星系中一个人口稀少的星球，可耕地和工业都很少，被描述为干旱且仅能勉强居住. 该星球的基础设施非常脆弱.

column1: Klayne was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Klayne于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Kleinwelt was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kleinwelt在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Klenkar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Klenkar在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, the initial colony remained independent for decades before joining the Federated Suns.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间建立，最初的殖民地保持独立数十年，之后才加入恒星联邦.

column1: According to the latest Interstellar Expeditions maps, Knechee is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery, close to the Perses-Cepherus Cloud Complex.
column2: 根据最新的Interstellar Expeditions星图，Knechee位于深空外围的外缘区域，靠近英仙座-仙王座星云复合体.

column1: Knutdor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Knutdor于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Knutstad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Knutstad在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Ko is possessed of great swathes of arable land and thus primarily exports foodstuffs. It was recently conquered by the Lyran Alliance and the local Kuritan garrison put up only token resistance.
column2: Ko拥有大片可耕地，因此主要出口食品. 它最近被天琴联盟征服，当地栗田驻军只进行了象征性抵抗.

column1: A once hospitable world, the original colonies were destroyed when massive volcanic activity decimated the world turning it into an arctic wasteland. The rich material brought to the surface makes Kobe a major producer of electronics and chemical engines.
column2: 这里曾是一个宜居的星球，但大规模火山活动摧毁了整个世界，将其变成了一片极地荒原，最初的殖民地也随之毁灭. 被带到地表的丰富物质使Kobe成为电子产品和化学引擎的主要生产地.

column1: Kochab is a seismically active arid world. Largely ignored, the Lyran Commonwealth has not invested much money into the system.
column2: Kochab是一颗地震活动频繁的干旱星球. 由于基本被忽视，天琴共同体没有向该星系投入太多资金.

column1: Low G martian world with a couple of bases. Pretty nothing to do in here, commander.
column2: 低重力火星世界，只有几座基地. 这儿基本没什么可做的，指挥官.

column1: Köln (FWL) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Köln (FWL) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Köln is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Köln是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口商品.

column1: Köningsberg is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds. It is a rocky, but hospitable planet.
column2: Köningsberg是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口货物. 它是一颗多岩但适宜居住的行星.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, Kogl is an unremarkable world.
column2: Kogl在星际联盟时代被殖民，是一颗毫不起眼的星球.

column1: Kohlman was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kohlman在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the Star League era by the Draconis Combine.
column2: 于星际联盟时代由天龙联合体建立定居点.

column1: Kola was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kola在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Kolobrzeg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kolobrzeg是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Kolovraty was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Kolovraty曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Komephoros was settled by colonists looking to take advantage of the vast mineral resources they suspected were underneath the glaciers of this frozen world. The first wave of settlers vanished without a trace however, when decades later their dropships were discovered under one of the massive glaciers frozen within ice.
column2: Komephoros由殖民者建立定居点，他们希望开采这个冰冻世界冰川之下疑似蕴藏的丰富矿产资源. 然而，第一批定居者却消失得无影无踪；数十年后，人们在一座巨大冰川下发现了他们的降落船，冻结在冰层之中.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Koniz served as the headquarters of the II Corps (Star League).
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Koniz曾是星际联盟第二军的总部.

column1: Konopiste was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Konopiste是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Konstance is known for its Carbon Dioxide rich atmosphere, which forces its population to rely on CO2 scrubbers to sustain life on the planet.
column2: Konstance以其富含二氧化碳的大气而闻名，这迫使当地居民依赖二氧化碳清除器来维持星球上的生命.

column1: Named after a fictional womanizer's mansion, Kooken's Pleasure Pit is a small planet with a pleasant climate and a thriving set of \"pleasure industries\".
column2: 库肯乐园以一位虚构花花公子的宅邸命名，是一颗气候宜人的小行星，拥有繁荣的"娱乐产业"。

column1: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, the initial colony remained independent for decades before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
column2: 最初的殖民地是在从泰拉大迁徙期间建立的，它保持了数十年的独立，之后被并入天龙联合体.

column1: Korramabad has a punishingly hot climate and is dominated by open plains and sandy deserts; only the hardiest souls can tolerate living on the planet.
column2: Korramabad的气候酷热难耐，地貌以开阔平原和沙质沙漠为主；只有最坚韧的灵魂才能忍受在这颗星球上生活.

column1: Korvitz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Korvitz是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the Star League era by the Free Worlds League, Kosciusko has abundant native Kodiak bear like animals that act like herd creatures.
column2: Kosciusko在星际联盟时代由自由世界联盟殖民定居，盛产类似科迪亚克熊的原生动物，它们像群居动物一样活动.

column1: Koskenkorva was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Koskenkorva在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Kosssandra's Memory was a newly-settled colony when the Star League invaded the Magistracy of Canopus in 2577, the colony established by the Magistracy Armed Forces as a redoubt for MAF units. Presumably Kossandra refers to Kossandra Centralla, however there is no record of her stepping foot on the world.
column2: 科桑德拉之忆在2577年星际联盟入侵卡诺帕斯行政区时还是一处新殖民地，由行政区武装部队建立，作为MAF单位的堡垒。科桑德拉大概指的是科桑德拉·森特拉，但没有她踏足该星球的任何记录。

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, Kostinbrod was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison
column2: Kostinbrod于星际联盟时代由天琴共同体建立，并曾是星际联盟防卫军驻军的驻地.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns before the Star League era, the planet of Kotzebue is known for its breweries.
column2: 在星际联盟时代之前，恒星联邦便已殖民了Kotzebue星球，这里以其酿酒厂而闻名.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era, Koulen is known for its lax intoxication laws.
column2: Koulen在星际联盟时代由天龙联合体殖民定居，以其宽松的醉酒法律而闻名.

column1: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, the initial colony remained independent for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间建立定居点，这个最初的殖民地保持独立了一个多世纪，随后被并入天龙联合体.

column1: A harsh world, the capital city of Kountze is known for its powerful tropical cyclones. The local apex predator is known as the Arctic Terror.
column2: 一个严酷的世界，Kountze的首府以其强烈的热带气旋而闻名. 当地的顶级掠食者被称为“北极恐怖”.

column1: Koury was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Koury是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Kowloon was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Kowloon曾是边缘世界共和国的阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Krakatau was an early mining and industrial colony, but heavy pollution poisoned the air and heated up the climate to uninhabitability. By the fall of the Star League, the colony was importing all its food, and stopped being economically viable.
column2: 喀拉喀托是个早期的矿业和工业殖民地，但严重的污染使空气有毒，使气候升温，变得不适合居住. 在星际联盟垮掉之前，这个殖民地的所有食品都来自进口，经济也无法自持.

column1: Kreller was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kreller是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A lightly industrialised world, Alshain Weapons does maintain a small repair facility on the surface.
column2: 在这个轻度工业化的世界上，Alshain Weapons确实在地表维持着一个小型维修设施.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, Krievci is known for its raw fish delicacies.
column2: Krievci于星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民，以生鱼佳肴闻名.

column1: A hidden colony until the Reunification war, Krimari is home to numerous manufacturing complexes from Detroit Consolidated MechWorks and Novis AT-H.
column2: 在统一战争之前，Krimari一直是一个隐秘的殖民地；如今，这里是Detroit Consolidated MechWorks和Novis AT-H众多制造综合体的所在地.

column1: Krin is a prosperous world along the Capellan/League border. The 4th Tau Ceti Lancers have recently been redeployed to the world to recover after suffering significant losses against House Davion forces over the last decade.
column2: 克林是卡佩兰与联盟边界上一颗繁荣的星球。第4金牛座塞提枪骑兵最近被重新部署到该星球，以在近十年对戴维恩家族部队的惨重损失后恢复元气。

column1: Kristiandsund was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kristiandsund在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, Krung Thep is known for its street food.
column2: 在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民建立，Krung Thep以其街头小吃闻名.

column1: Ksabi operates at a mid 20th century level of development. It is the only one of twelve in the Axumite Providence to be governed as a theocracy.
column2: Ksabi的发展水平相当于20世纪中叶. 在阿克苏姆天命国的十二个星系中，它是唯一一个实行神权统治的.

column1: Kublenz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kublenz于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled as an science outpost as part of the Principality of Rasalhague, it remained sparsely populated until the Star League era where upon a proper colony was established.
column2: 作为Rasalhague公国的一部分，该地最初是作为科学前哨站建立的；在星际联盟时代建立正式殖民地之前，它一直人口稀少.

column1: Settled by the Free World League during the Star League era, Kujari is known for its narcotic plant life.
column2: Kujari在星际联盟时代由自由世界联盟殖民，以其麻醉性植物而闻名.

column1: Kumqwat was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kumqwat在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Kupang (CC) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kupang (CC) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Kupang (RW) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kupang (RW) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争的战事中消亡了.

column1: During the era of the Terran Alliance, Ares was one of the founding members of the Capellan Co-Prosperity Sphere negotiated by the Capellan ruler Jurdan Aris between 2220 and 2225. In exchange for the continued free and open exchange of information with Capella, Kurragin and the other nations of the pact - which included Ares and Bandora - would come to the defense of Capella if it found itself under attack from hostile parties.
column2: 在泰拉联盟时代，Ares是卡佩拉Co-Prosperity Sphere的创始成员之一，该共荣圈由卡佩拉统治者Jurdan Aris在2220年至2225年间谈判促成. 作为与拉佩拉继续保持自由、开放信息交流的交换条件，Kurragin以及该协定的其他成员国——包括Ares和Bandora——将在拉佩拉遭到敌对势力攻击时前来保卫卡佩拉.

column1: Colonized during the Second Exodus, Kurvasa accepted refugees from across Capellan space. Its canyon-cities are sprawling and riotous with different cultures and traditions, and farming on the fertile mud-flats supports all 700 million residents.
column2: 库尔瓦萨是在二次大迁徙期间被殖民的，它接受了来自卡佩拉太空的难民. 其峡谷城市连绵不绝，杂糅了不同的文化和传统，而肥沃的泥滩农田则支撑着全部7亿居民的生活.

column1: Settled at the start of the Star League era, Kutludugun is known for its raw fish and sugared potato delicacies.
column2: Kutludugun在星际联盟时代初期有人定居，以生鱼和糖渍土豆等美味佳肴而闻名.

column1: Recent investments in Kuzuu have modernised many of the old buildings and the population has swelled due to mass immigration from nearby worlds.
column2: 最近对Kuzuu的投资使许多老旧建筑实现了现代化，而来自附近世界的大规模移民也让人口激增.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth in the early years of the Star League, Kvistgard is a world rich with nitrates.
column2: 在星际联盟早期，天琴共同体在Kvistgard建立了殖民地，这是一颗富含硝酸盐的星球.

column1: Many of the industrial areas on Kwamashu are powered by the highly unstable radioactives that are found in the planet's crust.
column2: 夸马舒的许多工业区都由该行星地壳中发现的极不稳定放射性物质供电。

column1: Kwangchowwang was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Kwangchowwang曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-联邦战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Defiance Industries is the sole major exporter on Kwangjong-ni, utilising salvaged machinery from an underwater facility that was destroyed during the Amaris Civil War.
column2: Defiance Industries是Kwangjong-ni上唯一的主要出口商，利用从阿马里斯内战期间被摧毁的水下设施中打捞出的机械.

column1: Kyeinnisan is better known as the Gambler's World. Within the many lavish, smoke filled casinos and gambling halls, every game of chance known to man can be found as well those willing to bet it all for a chance at wealth.
column2: 凯尼尼桑更以"赌徒世界"闻名。在许多奢华、烟雾缭绕的赌场与赌厅里，人类所知的一切博彩游戏都能找到，还有那些愿意为一线致富机会押上一切的人。

column1: During the Star League era, Kyrkbacken was a heavily industrialised world. Unfortunately during the Second Succession War, it was devastated and now has reverted to a mostly agrarian economy.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Kyrkbacken曾是一个高度工业化的世界. 不幸的是，在第二次继承战争期间，它遭到严重破坏，如今已倒退为以农业为主的经济.

column1: La Blon is primarily a water world, with popular beach resorts on the 3 island landmasses on its surface. One of its moons, Ivanov, also supports a large mining operation. La Blon saw a great deal of fighting during the 3020's.
column2: 拉布隆主要是一颗水世界，其地表3块岛屿陆地上有很受欢迎的海滩度假地。它的一颗卫星伊万诺夫也支撑着一处大型采矿作业。拉布隆在3020年代经历了大量战斗。

column1: Labouchere was settled during the golden age of the Star League, becoming self sufficient within decades.
column2: Labouchere在星际联盟的黄金时代被殖民定居，并在数十年内实现了自给自足.

column1: Labrea was settled during the golden age of the Star League, becoming self sufficient within decades.
column2: Labrea于星际联盟的黄金时代被殖民，并在几十年内实现了自给自足.

column1: Lacadon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Lacadon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Lackhove was one of seven worlds settled by colonists from the Rim Worlds Republic between 2334 and 2338 as an attempt by Maxwell Rowe to create a buffer zone between the Republic, the Draconis Combine and the Tamar Pact.
column2: Lackhove是2334年至2338年间由来自边缘世界共和国的殖民者定居的七个世界之一，这是麦克斯韦·罗试图在该共和国、天龙联合体和塔玛协定之间建立缓冲区的一次尝试.

column1: Lackland is almost entirely oceanic apart from a few archipelagoes. The local population finds life on this quiet planet idyllic, despite the chronic inability of any industry to turn a profit.
column2: Lackland除少数几处群岛外几乎全是海洋. 尽管任何产业都长期无法盈利，当地居民仍觉得在这颗宁静星球上的生活宛如田园诗般美好.

column1: Laconis is a cold, watery world, and between the chilly temperatures and the annual hurricane season, most of the 75 million inhabitants live below-ground. Taurus Majoris Mining is the world's largest employer, but many other smaller industrial firms have relocated to the prosperous world.
column2: 拉科尼斯是一颗寒冷多水的世界，介于低温与年度飓风季之间，7500万居民大多生活在地下。陶里安大矿是该世界最大的雇主，但许多其他较小的工业公司也迁到了这颗繁荣的世界。

column1: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, the initial colony remained part of the Tamar Pact for decades before joining the Commonwealth.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间建立定居点后，最初的殖民地数十年来一直是Tamar协定的一部分，后来才加入共同体.

column1: Lahti was settled during the golden age of the Star League, becoming self sufficient within decades.
