column2: 莫尔文在星盟时代被殖民，其石化工业为附近世界供货。

column1: Mosiro is predominantly Islam. The capital Al-Ilb, carved into a 1km cliff, is devoted to arts and has the largest mosque rimward of Terra. The Ministry of Information houses one of the most extensive libraries of physical books found in the League.
column2: Mosiro以伊斯兰教为主. 首都Al-Ilb开凿于一座1公里高的悬崖中，以艺术为特色，并拥有泰拉外缘方向最大的清真寺. 信息部收藏着联盟境内规模最大的纸质书图书馆之一.

column1: Mostaganem is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. Largely at twentieth century levels of industrial technology, although manufacturing does allow for industrial fusion power plants.
column2: Mostaganem是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一颗殖民星球，工业技术水平大体处于二十世纪水平，不过制造业确实能够建造工业聚变发电厂.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, Moultrie's nascent petrochemical industry supplies nearby worlds.
column2: 莫尔特里在星际联盟时代被殖民，其初生的石化工业为附近星球供货。

column1: Settled during the Star League era in order to capture the world's massive petroleum deposits, it was devastated during the First Succession War leaving only the northernmost continent inhabitable.
column2: 它在星际联盟时代为攫取该星球巨大的石油矿藏而被殖民，却在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭，只剩最北端的大陆尚可居住。

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Mualang was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Mualang是一支星际联盟防卫军驻军的驻扎地.

column1: While Multan is a sparsely populated agricultural world, it was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison during the final years of the Star League.
column2: 尽管Multan是一个人口稀少的农业世界，但在星际联盟的最后几年里，它曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Mumbai was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Mumbai在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: An independent agricultural world for over a century, it was conquered by the Free Worlds League after the fall of the Terran Alliance.
column2: 作为一个独立农业世界长达一个多世纪，它在泰拉联盟覆灭后被自由世界联盟征服.

column1: Muphrid is blessed with mild seasons, expansive seas and fertile soil. The world has been heavily zoned to protect its natural environment, including a entire continent which is designated as a nature preserve.
column2: Muphrid幸有温和的季节、辽阔的海洋和肥沃的土壤. 这颗星球已进行严格的分区规划以保护其自然环境，其中包括一整块被指定为自然保护区的完整大陆.

column1: Murchison is a habitable planet with a moon (Oasis) that also supports Terran life, and has three continents Abla, Harschweld and Felkra. Whilst Oasis was once an agricultural paradise, it was irradiated during the Succession Wars and the population moved back to Murchison
column2: Murchison是一颗宜居行星，拥有一颗同样支持地球生命的卫星（Oasis），并有三块大陆: Abla、Harschweld和Felkra. 虽然Oasis曾是一片农业天堂，但它在继承战争期间遭到辐射污染，人口因此迁回了Murchison.

column1: Granted as a backhanded reward to a troublesome minor Liao family, Muridox is a deep-water planet with vast floating hydroponics platforms and settlements on the polar ice caps dedicated to deep-dive harvests of native sea life.
column2: 穆里多克斯曾被作为一份讽刺性的奖赏授予给了一个讨厌的廖氏小家族，它是颗深海行星，拥有大量的浮动式无土栽培平台和极地冰盖上的定居点，这些地方专门从事土著海洋生物的深海捕捞.

column1: Murmansk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Murmansk是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Muroto was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Muroto于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Murris is a vibrantly alive planet with an oxygen-rich atmosphere and legendarily huge megafauna. It enjoyed a brief period as a safari destination for the Capellan Confederation nobility, but the fad for fighting giant animals with Battlemechs passed.
column2: 穆里斯是一颗生机勃勃的星球，拥有富含氧气的大气和传奇般的巨型动物. 它在短暂的时期里被视为卡佩拉联邦贵族的狩猎胜地，但是使用战斗机甲与巨型动物战斗的热潮已经过去了.

column1: Muscida was one of the founding worlds of the Principality of Regulus, before the formation of the Free Worlds League.
column2: 在自由世界联盟成立之前，Muscida是Regulus公国的创始星球之一.

column1: Muskegon is described as a harsh, marginally habitable planet on which survival depended on equally harsh measures. It's petroleum and plastics industry bring riches to the world that belie the horrid conditions on the surface.
column2: 马斯基根被描述为一颗严酷、勉强可居的行星，在那里生存依赖于同样严酷的手段。它的石油与塑料工业为该世界带来财富，与地表恶劣的条件形成反差。

column1: Muswell was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Muswell在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Myrrdin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Myrrdin在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Myrvoll was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Myrvoll于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The faceted domes over the mining outposts of Mystras glitter along the twilight zone of the tidally locked planet, where constant winds keep the sky clear. Despite the planet's challenges the Taurians have found mining there extremely lucrative.
column2: 米斯特拉斯采矿前哨上方的多面穹顶，在潮汐锁定星球的暮光带上闪闪发光，那里常风让天空保持晴朗。尽管该星球困难重重，牛郎星人发现那里的采矿极为有利可图。

column1: Mytilene was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Mytilene是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被开拓殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Naco was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Naco是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Nadrin was settled due its vast stepped plains and transplanted with many terran forests and wildlife. It holds the distinction as one of the founding worlds of the Alliance of Galedon before the formation of the Draconis Combine.
column2: Nadrin因其广袤的阶梯平原而得到殖民，并移植了许多地球森林与野生动物. 它拥有一项殊荣: 在天龙联合体成立之前，它是加勒登联盟的创始世界之一.

column1: The world of Nagel is water-rich and most settlements, during the Star League era, lay close to sea level. Boats and hovercraft are preferred methods of travel due to large areas of mangrove trees that restrict ground movement. Every year, the inhabitants hold a boat parade to celebrate the colonization of the planet.
column2: Nagel星球水资源丰富，在星际联盟时代，大多数定居点都位于接近海平面的地方. 由于大片红树林限制了地面交通，船只和气垫船是首选的出行方式. 每年，居民们都会举行船队游行，以庆祝该星球的殖民.

column1: Settled by colonists from Croatia during the Exodus from Terra, it joined the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，由来自克罗地亚的殖民者定居，并于星际联盟成立前数年加入了恒星联邦.

column1: Naikongzu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Naikongzu在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Naissus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Naissus在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Nai-Stohl was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nai-Stohl是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Najha was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison, however has been scoured clean of any caches during the Succession Wars.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Najha曾驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军卫守部队，但在继承战争期间，其所有储藏库都已被彻底清除.

column1: The Naka Pabni system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was annexed into the Draconis Combine during its formation.
column2: Naka Pabni星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并在天龙联合体成立时被吞并.

column1: The Naka Pabni system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Naka Pabni星系在第一次自泰拉大迁徙期间被建立定居点，并在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前，是该集体的一员.

column1: Nam Dinh was a part of the Andurien Commonality of the Capellan Confederation, but was conquered by the Free Worlds League during the 1st Succession War. Nam Dinh vanished from most maps during the 3rd Succession War due to depopulation.
column2: Nam Dinh曾是卡佩拉邦联安杜里安共同区的一部分，但在第一次继承战争期间被自由世界联盟征服. 由于人口减少，Nam Dinh在第三次继承战争期间从大多数星图上消失.

column1: Located in the Coreward Combat Theatre of the Capellan March, Namen is near Helixmar and Quittacas but vanished from most maps during the 3rd Succession War due to abandonment.
column2: Namen位于卡佩拉边疆的核心方向战区，邻近Helixmar和Quittacas，但在第三次继承战争期间因被废弃而从大多数星图上消失.

column1: Nanking was founded during the reign of the Terran Alliance, and has been the capital of numerous nations over the centuries. It is an extremely wealthy world that is home to Rivverson Technologies and Kallon Industries.
column2: Nanking建立于泰拉联盟统治时期，数世纪以来一直是众多国家的首都. 这是一个极其富裕的星球，是里弗森科技和卡隆工业的所在地.

column1: Nara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nara在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Settled by colonists from Cyprus during the Exodus from Terra, it joined the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在逃离泰拉的大迁徙期间，来自Cyprus的殖民者在此定居，并在星际联盟成立前的岁月里加入了恒星联邦.

column1: Naryn is a pretty blue-gold snowball that the Liao made a brief attempt to colonize before more practical minds realized it was best appreciated in holovids made from orbit. Three failed colonies are slowly sinking into the permafrost.
column2: 纳伦是一颗美丽的金蓝色雪地星球，廖氏家族曾一度试图对其殖民，接着家族中某些更为务实的人意识到他们还是在轨道上摄制的全息影像中欣赏它为好. 三个失败的殖民地正缓缓陷入永冻土层中.

column1: Nashira is a heavily industrialised world, that was once segregated into two. The remnants of the Terran Alliance have all but been washed away over time however.
column2: Nashira是一颗高度工业化的星球，曾一度被分隔为两部分. 然而，随着时间流逝，泰拉联盟的残余几乎已被冲刷殆尽.

column1: Settled during the Star League era by the Capellan Confederation due to its vast edible vegetation.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，卡佩拉邦联因其广袤的可食用植被而在此定居.

column1: Used mostly as a recreational hub for the Free Worlds Military, the agricultural world of Nathan is a prime relaxation spot.
column2: 主要作为自由世界军方的休闲中心，农业世界Nathan是一个绝佳的放松胜地.

column1: Navarre is one of the worlds that formed a part of the Deep Periphery region known as Nueva Castile, and is the headquarters of Quixote Industries.
column2: Navarre是构成被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的深空外围地区的星球之一，也是Quixote Industries的总部所在地.

column1: Nebula D77 was the name given to a nebula located rimward from the Capellan Confederation, approximately 1,947 lightyears from Terra, in the Rimward Sector
column2: Nebula D77是赋予一个星云的名称，该星云位于卡佩拉邦联外缘方向，距泰拉约1，947光年，位于外缘星区.

column1: Necedah was settled by the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star League to cement the system and its trade routes as being Davion territory.
column2: Necedah在星际联盟成立期间由恒星联邦殖民，以将该星系及其贸易路线牢固确立为戴维恩领土.

column1: Necromo's tiny population of about a million are there purely to support the planet's Star League orbital dropship manufacturing and repair facility. The planet is wholly dependent on imported food.
column2: 内克罗莫约一百万的小规模人口纯粹是为支持该行星的星盟轨道空投艇制造与维修设施而存在。该行星完全依赖进口粮食。

column1: Neerabup was settled by colonists who commandeered their jumpship after reaching their initial destination as they wished to go further. A mostly agrarian world, it has had an influx of herdlife recently.
column2: Neerabup是由殖民者定居的，他们在抵达最初的目的地后征用了自己的跃迁舰，因为他们希望继续走得更远. 这是一个以农业为主的世界，最近有大量牧群生物涌入.

column1: Once an independent world with rich resources, it joined the Lyran Commonwealth for protection after the Terran Alliance fell.
column2: 它曾是一个资源丰富的独立星球，在泰拉联盟覆灭后，为寻求保护而加入了天琴共同体.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era to claim its rich ytterbium deposits.
column2: 星际联盟时代，恒星联邦为获取其丰富的镱矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

column1: Nerum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nerum在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Home to the Nellus Military Academy, this mostly agricultural world is filled with transplanted Terran crops, and exports Terran style foodstuffs to nearby worlds. The rolling hills are ideal for training purposes.
column2: 这里是Nellus军事学院的所在地，这颗以农业为主的行星遍布移植而来的地球作物，并向附近世界出口地球风味的食品. 起伏的丘陵非常适合训练.

column1: The New Aberdeen system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War, and is pockmarked with fresh water lakes across every continent.
column2: New Aberdeen星系在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民，每个大陆上都遍布着淡水湖.

column1: New Abilene is a grassy world dedicated to raising livestock. The pastureland is mostly owned by a few wealthy 'barons' who are prone to violent squabbles over water rights and shipping privileges; MechWarrior marshals try to keep the peace.
column2: 新阿比林是一颗以饲养牲畜为业的草原世界。牧场大多归几位富有的"男爵"所有，他们常因水权与运输特权发生暴力争执；机师执法官们则努力维持和平。

column1: New Abilene
column2: 新阿比林

column1: New Ålborg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: NewÅlborg于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: New Aragon is an agricultural world which resides in the near core of the Inner Sphere, anti-spinward of Terra. It's location brings it wealth, as well as a large transient population.
column2: 新阿拉贡是一颗位于内层星域近核心区、地球反自转方向的农业星球。它的位置为它带来财富，也带来大量流动人口。

column1: New Athens was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Athens是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: As the capital world of the Federated Suns since the founding of the nation in the twenty-fourth century New Avalon is a heavily industrialized and populated planet, home to numerous major defense corporations and military academies.
column2: 自二十四世纪建国以来，New Avalon作为恒星联邦的首都世界，是一颗高度工业化和人口稠密的行星，也是众多主要国防企业和军事学院的所在地.

column1: New Avalon
column2: 新阿瓦隆

column1: Settled by colonists from the Scandinavian region of Terra, New Bergen formed one of the core worlds of the Rasalhague Consortium before being annexed by the Draconis Combine during its expansion.
column2: New Bergen由来自泰拉斯堪的纳维亚地区的殖民者建立，在 天龙联合体 扩张期间被吞并之前，曾是Rasalhague Consortium的核心世界之一.

column1: New Britain (Inglesmond 2349+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Britain（Inglesmond 2349+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

column1: The vast agricultural shipping facilities in the city of Avesta provide transport to billions of tons of foodstuffs every year. The ruined Castle Brian known as Redcastle sits overlooking the landings sights.
column2: Avesta城中庞大的农业运输设施每年运送数十亿吨食品. 名为Redcastle的布赖恩城堡废墟俯瞰着着陆场.

column1: New Caledonia
column2: 新喀里多尼亚

column1: As the Terran Hegemony collapsed, the Capellan Confederation seized the rich mines and fields of New Canton with little bloodshed.
column2: 随着泰拉霸权崩溃，卡佩拉邦联几乎兵不血刃地夺取了New Canton富饶的矿山和农田.

column1: New Capetown still retains an unstated class system based on skin colour that carries over from the days of Terra.
column2: New Capetown仍然保留着一种从泰拉时代沿袭下来的、基于肤色的不成文阶级制度.

column1: Settled by Free Worlds colonists during the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立期间，由自由世界联盟殖民者建立定居点.

column1: New Ceylon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Ceylon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: New Crete was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Crete在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: New Dallas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Dallas在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: New Damascus is the eighth planet in the system, and is home to manufacturing facilities belonging to a subdivision of Federated Industries.
column2: New Damascus是该星系中的第八颗行星，也是属于联邦工业下属分支机构的制造设施所在地.

column1: The vast rainfall on New Delos causes many of the rapidly flowing rivers to flood in areas where there are no defences.
column2: New Delos上大量的降雨导致许多湍急的河流在缺乏防御设施的地区泛滥.

column1: The capital of the New Delphi Compact, this warm humid world is located far from the Inner Sphere.
column2: 新德尔斐盟约国的首都，这颗温暖潮湿的星球远离内天体.

column1: New Delphi
column2: 新德尔斐

column1: Crescent City is known for being a pilot's wet dream, with eclectic adornments to suit even the most savage beast.
column2: 新月城以“飞行员的春梦”著称，那里的装饰五花八门，连最凶蛮的野兽都能满足。

column1: New Florence was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Florence在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: New Galicia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Galicia是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: On New Ganymede, a career miner finds novelty: the valuable ore is on the surface while the water is underground.The Taurian Concordat also maintains a desert warfare training facility in the polar region.
column2: 在新盖尼米德，一名职业矿工有了新奇的发现: 宝贵的矿石在地表，而水却在地下. 金牛协约国还在极地地区维持着一处沙漠作战训练设施.

column1: New Ganymede
column2: 新盖尼米德

column1: After the stable and self-sufficient colony on Tortuga was well-established enough, colonization begun on other worlds, leading to the settlement of New Gascony and four other worlds.
column2: 当Tortuga上稳定且自给自足的殖民地发展得足够完善后，殖民活动开始转向其他世界，促成了New Gascony以及其他四个世界的定居.

column1: New Hessen orbits the system primary at a much greater range than Terra does Sol. This means that even though the star is hotter than Sol, the world should be much cooler than it is. Thanks to the thick atmosphere, however, New Hessen enjoys a tropical climate.
column2: New Hessen以比泰拉绕Sol大得多的距离环绕该系统的主星运行. 这意味着，尽管这颗恒星比Sol更热，这个世界本应比现在冷得多. 然而，由于浓厚的大气层，New Hessen享有热带气候.

column1: A moderately prosperous mining world, New Home has seen a lot of combat over the years as the Lyran Alliance, Free Worlds League, and Capellan Confederation have fought for control.
column2: 一个中等繁荣的矿业世界，New Home多年来历经了大量战斗，因为天琴联盟、自由世界联盟和卡佩拉邦联曾为争夺其控制权而交战.

column1: New Hope was colonised by classic holovid fans at some point before the formation of the Star League.
column2: New Hope在星际联盟成立之前的某个时候被经典全息视频爱好者殖民.

column1: The New India system was discovered and colonized in the early to mid-twenty-second century. It is currently home to the New India Parts Depot, a thrift shop for old and scrapped BattleMechs.
column2: New India星系在22世纪早期至中期被发现并殖民. 它目前是New India零部件仓库的所在地，这是一家出售老旧和报废战斗机甲的二手商店.

column1: New Ivaarsen is a center of industry, agriculture, learning, and culture, on par with many of the more famous worlds of the Inner Sphere. This has, of course, made it a coveted prize.
column2: New Ivaarsen是工业、农业、学术与文化的中心，可与内天体许多更为著名的世界相媲美. 这自然使它成了一个令人垂涎的目标.

column1: New Kent is a remote world located at the spinward fringe of the Kerensky Cluster in Clan space. The world is best known for being the capital world of Clan Steel Viper. The planet is noted for its high carbon dioxide levels.
column2: New Kent是位于氏族空间克伦斯基星团顺旋边缘的一颗偏远世界. 该世界最为人熟知的是作为钢蛇氏族的首府世界. 这颗行星以其高二氧化碳水平而闻名.

column1: The hostile fauna on New Kyoto took many years to tame, but during the Star League era it was a shining jewel of human ingenuity. Sadly during the Succession Wars, the great Bolson Shipyards in orbit were destroyed, littering the surface with debris. Whilst New Kyoto still has a bouyant electronics industry, it is still producing less than half of its Star League glory days.
column2: New Kyoto上充满敌意的动物群历经多年才被驯服，但在星际联盟时代，这里曾是人类智慧的璀璨明珠. 遗憾的是，在继承战争期间，轨道上宏伟的博尔森造船厂被摧毁，残骸散落于地表. 尽管New Kyoto仍拥有蓬勃的电子产业，其产量仍不到星际联盟鼎盛时期的一半.

column1: New Macau was colonised by classic casino enthusiasts at some point before the formation of the Star League.
column2: New Macau是在星际联盟成立之前的某个时候由经典赌场爱好者殖民的.

column1: New Mendham was a thriving world filled with ranches until joining the Federated Suns, who invested much into industrialising the world.
column2: New Mendham曾是一个遍布牧场、繁荣昌盛的星球，直到加入恒星联邦；后者大力投资于该星球的工业化.

column1: New Olympia is home to both the Lloyd Marik-Stanley Aerospace School and the Allison MechWarrior Institute. It's Star League era agridomes produces billions of tons of foodstuffs every year for export to nearby worlds.
column2: 新奥林匹亚是劳埃德·马里克-斯坦利航空航天学校与艾利森机师学院的所在地。其在星盟时代的农业穹顶每年生产数十亿吨食物，出口到附近的星系。

column1: New Oslo is an icy world home to many manufacturers such as Alshain Weapons and Galileo Instruments.
column2: New Oslo是一个冰封世界，众多制造商在此设厂，例如Alshain Weapons和Galileo Instruments.

column1: New Praha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Praha在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A harsh desert world, it is home to the \"Colossii of New Rhodes\", a chain of nearly 150 geological towers scattered across the vast desert like islands in a sea, which has become a tourist attraction that brings people from across the Inner Sphere.
column2: 一颗严酷的沙漠世界，这里有"新罗得岛巨像"——一条近150座地质塔链，如海中岛屿般散布在广袤沙漠上，已成为吸引内天体各地人们前来的旅游胜地。

column1: New Roland is a Terra-like planet with unusually mobile and predatory plant life, so most of the residents live on the coastlines and work on the oceans, which is also where most of the non-insectile animal life dwells.
column2: 新罗兰是一颗类地星球，有着不同寻常的自行与掠食性植物生命，所以大部分居民都在海岸线生活，在海洋上工作，而海洋也是大多数非昆虫动物生命栖息的地方.

column1: New Roland
column2: 新罗兰

column1: New Sagan was part of the Capellan Commonality before joining the Confederation.
column2: New Sagan在加入卡佩拉邦联之前曾是卡佩拉共同体的一部分.

column1: This former capital of the Draconis Combine was once heavily populated and industrialised, although it has recently been in decline.  It is however still the home of the Combine's ISF and an important university.
column2: 这个龙尼斯联合体的前首都曾人口稠密、工业发达，虽然近来已趋衰落。不过它仍是联合体ISF的所在地，也有一所重要大学。

column1: New Sapporo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Sapporo是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Originally called New Sarna, Tsinghai served as a prefecture capital world in the Sarna Supremacy. After the Supremacy joined the Capellan Confederation, Tsinghai's residents turned to mining and the export of nuclear fuel as the cornerstone of their economy.
column2: 它原名新萨尔纳，青海曾是萨尔纳霸权的一个管区首府世界。霸权加入卡佩兰联邦之后，青海居民转向采矿与核燃料出口，作为其经济的基石。

column1: New Sarum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Sarum是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: New Sierra was colonized in the late twenty-sixth century, and grew to three billion people by the late twenty-eighth century. Soon after, a conflict broke out among the population that led to a global thermonuclear war and nuclear winter...
column2: New Sierra在二十六世纪晚期被殖民，到二十八世纪晚期人口增长至三十亿. 不久之后，民众之间爆发冲突，导致全球热核战争和核冬天……

column1: New St. Andrews is an isolated Periphery planet. The planet possesses few natural resources but it does have a manufacturer - Meridian Manufacturing - which produces menacing looking Mechs such as the Arbiter.
column2: New St. Andrews是一个与世隔绝的边垂星球. 该星球自然资源匮乏，但它确实有一家制造商——Meridian Manufacturing——生产诸如Arbiter这类外形凶悍的机甲.

column1: New Stevens was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Stevens在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: New Sumatra was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Sumatra是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Originally settled in the late 2260's, New Syrtis is an icy planet with a narrow temperate band around the equator.  New Sytris is an important mining, manufacturing and military training planet for the Feds.
column2: 新瑟提斯最初在2260年代后期被殖民，是一颗冰封行星，赤道周围有一条狭窄的温带。新瑟提斯是联邦重要的采矿、制造与军事训练行星。

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era, it was heavily damaged during the First and Second Succession Wars, leading to mass depopulation from which it is only now recovering.
column2: 在星际联盟时代由恒星联邦建立殖民地，在第一次和第二次继承战争中遭到严重破坏，导致人口大规模锐减，直到现在才逐渐恢复.

column1: Newtown Square was a world within the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic, and the site of numerous large battles during the Reunification War.
column2: Newtown Square是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省境内的一个星球，也是统一战争期间众多大规模战役的发生地.

column1: New Troy was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: New Troy于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: New Valencia was a major food exporter during the Star League era. The destruction of JumpShips during the Succession Wars resulted in New Valencia's agriculture shifting to expensive boutique foods.
column2: 新瓦伦西亚在星际联盟时代是主要的粮食出口地。继承战争中跃迁舰被毁，导致新瓦伦西亚的农业转向昂贵的精品食品。

column1: The mining colony of New Vallis is located on the tidally locked moon of a gas giant locally known as Joramander. It has a single city, with a notoriously active nightlife, on a plateau covered with huge, slow-growing trees.
column2: 新瓦利斯的矿业殖民地地处一颗潮锁卫星上，后者属于一颗当地称为若拉曼德的气态巨星. 这里有座城市，坐落在一片覆盖着缓慢生长的巨木的高原上，它有着活跃的夜生活，活跃程度名声在外.

column1: New Vallis
column2: 新瓦利斯

column1: Long after its eponymous Uprising, New Vandenburg remains a core component in the Taurian Concordat's military industrial complex, while also maintaining a wealth of other industries that make it a highly desirable place to live.
column2: 在其同名起义过去很久之后，新范登堡依然是陶里安协约国军工综合体的核心组成部分，同时维持着众多其他产业，使其成为非常宜居的地方。

column1: New Vandenburg
column2: 新范登堡

column1: New Venice was founded by the Marian Hegemony to capitalise on trade routes during the Third Succession War. Little more than a trading outpost, it still garners a fair amount of traffic.
column2: New Venice由马里安霸权建立，旨在第三次继承战争期间利用贸易路线. 它不过是个贸易前哨，却仍吸引了相当可观的运输流量.

column1: New Wessex was once a beautiful world that had light industry and moderate agricultural production, but due to the Succession Wars is now a poisoned world with a diminishing population.
column2: New Wessex曾是一个拥有轻工业和适度农业生产的美丽星球，但由于继承战争，如今已成为一个饱受毒害、人口日渐减少的星球.

column1: New Sagan was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Confederation.
column2: New Sagan在加入邦联之前曾是锡安共同体的一部分.

column1: Nexus Ri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nexus Ri在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ngake Ducal Spaceport is one of the few remaining DropShip manufacturers left in the Inner Sphere.
column2: Ngake公爵太空港是内天体仅存的少数降落船制造商之一.

column1: Niangol is one of the main petroleum and ore processing centers in the Commonwealth.
column2: Niangol是共同体主要的石油和矿石加工中心之一.

column1: Nichol's Rest was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 尼科尔的安息在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束之后的某个时候被殖民，却在继承战争的战火中消亡。

column1: Nightwish was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nightwish在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Nihal is a mainly agricultural world that was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Confederation centuries ago.
column2: Nihal是一个以农业为主的世界，在几个世纪前加入邦联之前，它曾是 锡安共同体的一部分.

column1: Annexed into the Free Worlds League during its formation, Niihau is mainly known for its timber products.
column2: Niihau在自由世界联盟成立期间被并入，主要以其木材产品闻名.

column1: Niles is the homeworld of Clan Hell's Horses, in the Kerensky Cluster. Numerous manufacturers are based here, churning out the war machine for Clan Hell Horses.
column2: 奈尔斯是地狱马氏族在克伦斯基星团的母星。众多制造商以此为基地，为地狱马氏族源源不断产出战争机器。

column1: Niles was a recently settled world when it was conquered by the Star League during the Reunification War, which killed most of its nascent population. Now mostly an agricultural world, its light industrial base is suitable for minor Mech repairs.
column2: Niles在被星际联盟于统一战争期间征服时，还是一个刚刚殖民的星球，那场战争消灭了其大部分新生人口. 如今它主要是一个农业世界，其轻工业基础适合进行小型机甲维修.

column1: Ningpo's wide and fertile plains make it an agricultural producer of some renown.  Covered in several exotic hardwood tree species, careful logging practices have allowed custom furniture businesses to produce some of the most beautiful furniture in the Inner Sphere. Some suggest that the Celestial Throne on Sian is made from Ningpo timber.
column2: 宁波广阔的肥沃平原使其成为颇具名气的农业产地。该星球覆盖着若干外来硬木树种，谨慎的伐木作业让定制家具企业得以生产出内层星域最精美的一些家具。有人说西安的天界宝座就是用宁波木材制成的。

column1: Though Ningxia has many diamonds perfect for industrial processes, the world was actually settled for its beautiful landscapes. Regarded as a planet-sized bonsai garden, every effort since the fall of the Star League to exploit the diamonds has been stopped by highly placed nobles, including Coordinator Takashi Kurita.
column2: 尽管Ningxia拥有许多非常适合工业加工的钻石，这颗星球实际上却是因其美丽的风景而有人定居的. 它被视为一座行星大小的盆景园，自星际联盟覆灭以来，每一次开采这些钻石的尝试都被位高权重的贵族阻止，其中包括协调者栗田隆.

column1: Niomede is the largest airless rock in a system full of them. Yet people dwell there, deep under the surface in sealed caves. The original valuable mineral deposit was long ago exhausted, but a thriving astronomical research community endures.
column2: 尼奥米德是它那个星系中最大的一个岩质星球，缺乏空气，星系里满是这样的星球. 目前还是有人居住在那里，住在深入地面的密闭洞穴内. 原有的珍贵矿藏早已耗尽，但一个欣欣向荣的天文研究团体依然在支撑着.

column1: The Niops system was colonized by the Star League to conduct the first study of a falling star based on generations of direct observation. After the fallout of the League, they elected to remain forgotten, a technocracy with no ruler.
column2: Niops星系被星际联盟殖民，以基于数代人的直接观测，对一颗流星展开首次研究. 星际联盟覆灭后，他们选择继续被遗忘，成为一个没有统治者的技术官僚政体.

column1: The Niquinohomo system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Niquinohomo星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前是该集体的成员.

column1: Nirasaki is a warm but pleasant world whose people are known for their fierce streak of independence. While not home to any military production, Maltex Corporation maintains a 'Mech design thinktank on the planet.
column2: 尼拉萨基是一颗温暖却宜人的世界，其人民以强烈的独立心性著称。虽然这里没有任何军工生产，马尔泰克斯公司在该行星维持着一处机甲设计智库。

column1: Nis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nis在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

column1: Nito was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nito于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Nizina system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent world prior to joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Nizina星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，在加入恒星联邦之前是一个独立世界.

column1: An icy world known for its whales, seals and aquatic life.
column2: 一个以鲸鱼、海豹和水生生物闻名的冰雪世界.

column1: Nobel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nobel是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: The Nockatunga system was colonized at some point prior to or during the early 23rd Century. During the Star League era, it was classified as a 'vital' world and the construction of many Fort Brian's commenced. Only one remains today, Fort Brittany.
column2: 诺卡通加星系在二十三世纪初或之前某个时期被殖民。在星盟时代，它被列为"关键"世界，并开始建造众多布莱恩堡。如今只剩一座留存：布列塔尼堡。

column1: Nogales was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nogales在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Noh-wan Hohm was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Noh-wan Hohm在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Noisiel is a small and humble Lyran Commonwealth system, best known for its summer 'Mech games.
column2: 努瓦西尔是莱兰联邦一个不起眼的小型星系，以其夏季机甲运动会最为知名。

column1: Non Diz was briefly occupied by the Capellan Confederation, in order to keep it clear of pirates. Eventually they determined even pirates didn't want to deal with the endless dust storms, and redirected their resources elsewhere.
column2: 非迪兹曾被卡佩兰联邦短暂占领，以防止海盗盘踞。最终他们认定连海盗都不想应付那无尽的沙尘暴，便把资源调往别处。

column1: Non Diz
column2: 诺恩迪兹

column1: Nopah is a world with a dying star. Though well suited for flora the radiation from the star had killed all native life by the time the first settlers arrived. In response they imported insects from Terra to make sure their crops were fertilized. This effort was successful, and Nopah became a breadbasket world supporting many nearby systems
column2: Nopah是一颗环绕垂死恒星的世界. 尽管这里很适合植物生长，但当第一批定居者抵达时，来自恒星的辐射已经杀死了所有原生生命. 为此，他们从泰拉引进了昆虫，以确保作物能够授粉. 这项努力取得了成功，Nopah也成为了一个粮仓世界，支撑着周边许多星系.

column1: Settled during the Star League era after colonists from the Capellan Confederation misjumped into the system, the world was luckily not far from known space.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，来自卡佩拉邦联的殖民者因跳跃失误进入该星系后，这里得以被定居；幸运的是，这颗星球距离已知空间并不远.

column1: Thyne Weapons Plant utilises local radioactives to produce numerous weaponry for export across the Free Worlds.
column2: Thyne武器工厂利用当地放射性物质生产大量武器，出口至整个自由世界联盟.

column1: Norman's World was settled during the Star League era, and was the site of a large rebellion. Norman told them to stop it though, and they did.
column2: 诺曼世界在星际联盟时代被殖民，并曾发生一场大规模叛乱。不过诺曼叫他们停下，他们就停了。

column1: The most habitable world in the Norn system, Verthandi, is considered a Lostech world with its people dependent on others for transport and commerce. Primary industries are agriculture and manufacturing which supports agriculture and local commerce.
column2: Norn星系中最宜居的星球Verthandi被视为一个失落科技世界，其人民在运输和商业上依赖他人. 主要产业是农业，以及支撑农业和当地商业的制造业.

column1: Northfield is home to numerous germanium mines and refineries.
column2: Northfield拥有众多锗矿和精炼厂.

column1: Northsun was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Northsun是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Northwind is the homeworld of the famed mercenary unit the Northwind Highlanders and Northwind Military Academy. Cosara Weaponries and Bulldog Enterprises also have large manufacturing facilities on the surface.
column2: Northwind是著名雇佣兵部队Northwind Highlanders和Northwind Military Academy的母星. Cosara Weaponries和Bulldog Enterprises在地表也拥有大型制造设施.

column1: During the Star League era, great chasms opened up on the surface due to a once in a million years seismic event.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，由于一场百万年一遇的地震事件，地表裂开了巨大的深谷.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Nouasseur was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Nouasseur曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Nouveau Toulouse was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nouveau Toulouse是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候建立定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Nouveaux Paris is a colony world located in the Deep Periphery, approximately 250 light years coreward of the border between the Inner Sphere and the Periphery, near Trelleborg and Bazaar.
column2: Nouveaux Paris是一颗位于深空外围的殖民星球，大约在内天体和外围之间边界朝核心方向约250光年处，靠近Trelleborg和Bazaar.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Novara was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Novara曾是星际联盟防卫军驻军的驻扎地.

column1: Nova Roma is an agrarian world. Lacking a strategic position and possessing a great deal of arable land, Nova Roma quickly became one of the \"breadbasket worlds\" in the Free Worlds League.
column2: 新罗马是一颗农业行星。由于缺乏战略位置却拥有大量可耕地，新罗马很快成为自由世界联盟的"粮仓行星"之一。

column1: Novaya Zemlya has the dubious honor of being the first inhabited world bombarded by WarShips. The resulting bombardment killed three-quarters of the world's population, destroyed nearly all cities and planetary infrastructure, and poisoned the farmlands. The few survivors had to then deal with the \"nuclear winter\" that resulted from the dust and debris thrown into the world's upper atmosphere. The Federated Suns are currently pouring many resources into the world.
column2: 新地岛有着成为首个被战舰轰击的有人居住世界的不光彩荣誉。那场轰击杀死了该世界四分之三的人口，摧毁了几乎所有城市与行星基础设施，并毒化了农田。少数幸存者随后还得应对尘埃与碎屑抛入高层大气所导致的"核冬天"。联邦太阳目前正向该世界投入大量资源。

column1: Novgorod is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Novgorod是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口商品.

column1: Novo Franklin is a hot, agricultural world settled in 2598 by Reunification War refugees fleeing the Outworlds Alliance. Over the next four hundred years, all of these splinter groups had developed feudal states, as many as 55 different kingdoms.
column2: Novo Franklin是一颗炎热的农业世界，于2598年由逃离外域联盟的统一战争难民定居. 在接下来的四百年里，所有这些分裂群体都发展出了封建邦国，多达55个不同的王国.

column1: An arid world, it is relatively poor with few visitors.
column2: 一个干旱的世界，相对贫穷，访客寥寥.

column1: Nowhere is aptly named. While it was spared the general devastation of the Succession Wars, it has little that makes it stand out, making it a marginal world on the edge of space.
column2: Nowhere之名恰如其分. 虽然它躲过了继承战争的普遍浩劫，却几乎没有什么出众之处，使它在太空边缘成为一个无足轻重的世界.

column1: Nox was settled by the wealthy Tamar family and was one of the worlds within the Tamar Pact, a short lived protostate. It's mines are operated by Metals of the Earth, who have a loose relation with Operational Health and Safety.
column2: 诺克斯由富裕的塔玛家族殖民，是塔玛协定这一短命原初国家中的世界之一。其矿场由“大地金属”公司运营，而该公司与职业健康安全部门关系松散。

column1: Nuelson Minor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nuelson Minor是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Nukus was a minor colony until the Capellans withdrew, leaving the residents to fend for themselves. Only the volcanic equatorial region is inhabited, where temperate climate allows some subsistence agriculture. Elsewhere, the planet is scoured by ice storms.
column2: 在卡佩拉人撤出努库斯，留下居民自力更生之前，那儿是个小型殖民地. 只有赤道火山地区才有人居住，那里温和的气候使一些自给自足的农业生产得以存在. 而在其它地方，行星一直被冰风暴冲刷.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Nullarbor was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Free Worlds League.
column2: Nullarbor由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，在加入自由世界联盟之前，曾作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Numenor largely escaped the ravages of warfare during the Succession Wars, leading to the population becoming some of the most confident, erudite and snobbish to be found in the Federated Suns. It is home to Aston-Martin, one of the premium electric vehicle manufacturers in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 在继承战争期间，Numenor基本未遭战火揉躏，这使得当地居民成为恒星联邦中最为自信、博学且势利的一群人. 这里也是Aston-Martin的所在地，它是内天体高端电动汽车制造商之一.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era due to one of the Kuritas wanting to play with a space seal. Yes, really.
column2: 星际联盟时代，天龙联合体在此建立定居点，起因是栗田家族的一位成员想和一只太空海豹玩耍. 是的，真的.

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth settled Nuneaton at some point during the Star League era, taking advantage of the thick lumber in the primeval forests.
column2: 天琴共同体在星际联盟时代的某个时期殖民了Nuneaton，以利用原始森林中粗壮的木材.

column1: Nusakan, despite its cold climate, has become home to many consumer electronics and luxury aircraft manufacturers. While these are not military industries, they are highly profitable.
column2: 尽管气候寒冷，Nusakan已成为众多消费电子产品和豪华飞行器制造商的所在地. 虽然这些并非军事产业，但利润极为丰厚.

column1: Nyamlell is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. The world is at approximately a 20th Century technological level.
column2: Nyamlell是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一颗殖民星球. 该星球的技术水平大约相当于20世纪.

column1: Nyasa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nyasa在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Annually, a viral plague would break-out on Nykvarn's northern continent, which was also the site of special type of grain that was the only viable cure for it. At the first sign of the plague, the grain was harvested and baked into loaves of bread which the locals ate to survive that year's outbreak.
column2: 每年，尼克瓦恩北大陆都会爆发一场病毒瘟疫，而那里也生长着一种特殊谷物，是唯一有效的解药。瘟疫一露头，人们就收割这种谷物并烤成面包，当地人就靠吃它撑过那一年的疫情。

column1: Oberon, the capital of perhaps the most infamous bandit kingdom, has been home to numerous proto states over the centuries. A great pirates fortress towers over the main capital city.
column2: Oberon，或许是史上最臭名昭著的匪帮王国的首都，数百年来一直是众多原始政权的所在地. 一座巨大的海盗堡垒高耸于主要首府城市之上.

column1: The Obrenovac system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Age of War by the Magistry of Canopus, before becoming part of the Inner Sphere during the Reunification War.
column2: Obrenovac星系在战争时代结束前的某个时候被卡诺帕斯行政区殖民，随后在统一战争期间成为内天体的一部分.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Oceana was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Free Worlds League.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，Oceana在加入自由世界联盟之前，作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Odabase was an independent colony for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，Odabase在被并入天龙联合体之前，曾作为独立殖民地存续了一个多世纪.

column1: Odawara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Odawara在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Odell's Star League industrial base was destroyed entirely during the First Succession War
column2: 奥德尔的星盟工业基础在第一次继承战争中被彻底摧毁

column1: Odessa was settled early in humanity's expansion to the stars and is home to the Odessan Raxx, a reptilian pack animal used across the world.
column2: 敖德萨在人类向群星扩张的早期被殖民，是敖德萨拉克的家园——一种遍布全世界的爬行类驮兽。

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, O'Fallon was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Federated Suns.
column2: 奥法伦由逃离地球的殖民者建立，作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪之后才加入联邦太阳国。

column1: During the Star League era, the planet Offerman was a lightly populated industrial world. Whilst never invaded, the fall of the Star League caused most of the factories to fall into disrepair and most of the remaining industry is related to lumber and woodwork.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Offerman行星是一个人口稀少的工业世界. 尽管从未遭到入侵，但星际联盟的崩溃导致大多数工厂失修，而剩余的工业大多与木材和木工有关.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ogano was an independent colony for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
column2: 由逃离地球的殖民者建立，Ogano在被并入天龙联合体之前，曾作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ogilvie was an independent colony for over a century before being incorporated into the Federated Suns.
column2: Ogilvie由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪，之后才被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Fort Gorndack is the first sight of many to the world of Ohrensen, a vast heavily defended Star League era spaceport.
column2: Fort Gorndack是许多人抵达Ohrensen星球时看到的第一处景象，它是一座庞大且防御森严的星际联盟时代太空港.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns at the dawn of the Star League, Okains is known for its high quality gemstones that are mined from the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟成立之初，恒星联邦在Okains建立了定居点，Okains以其从地表开采的高品质宝石而闻名.

column1: Okaya was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Okaya在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Having been colonised in the twenty-sixth century by deeply religious individuals seeking the solitude of deep space, by the end of the Second Succession War Okefenokee was one of the poorest worlds to be found within the borders of the Federated Suns.
column2: 在二十六世纪被一群寻求深空孤寂的虔诚宗教信徒殖民后，到第二次继承战争结束时，Okefenokee已成为恒星联邦境内最贫穷的星球之一.

column1: Maarakiva University, located on Olafsvik, is one of the Free Worlds League's top two business schools. Maarakiva focuses more on the academic and theoretical in its courses, with particular attention paid to advertising and market research.
column2: 位于奥拉夫斯维克的马阿拉基瓦大学是自由世界联盟两所顶级商学院之一。马阿拉基瓦的课程更偏重学术与理论，尤其注重广告与市场研究。

column1: Great canyons scour the desert world of Olancha, remnants of massive detonations from the First Succession War where it was brutally and swiftly taken by the Combine.
column2: 巨大的峡谷切割着Olancha的沙漠世界，这些峡谷是第一次继承战争中大规模爆炸留下的遗迹；当时该星球被天龙联合体残酷而迅速地夺取.

column1: Old Canton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Old Canton在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Infamously known as the planet where the Inner Sphere's only known deployment of a gigaton-range nuclear device occurred, Old Kentucky is still recovering from the centuries of abuse in the Succession Wars.
column2: 老肯塔基因内天体已知唯一一次千兆吨级核装置的使用而臭名昭著，至今仍在从继承战争中数世纪的摧残中恢复。

column1: Oldsmith was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oldsmith在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Oli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oli是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Oligar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oligar于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns at the dawn of the Star League, Olindo is known for its high quality radioactives that are mined from the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟成立之初，Olindo由恒星联邦殖民定居，并以从地表开采的高品质放射性材料而闻名.

column1: Oliver is an important industrial world, site of both a Brigadier Corporation's 'Mech factory and a Quickscell Military Vehicle Plant. The planet was only recently seized from the Free Worlds League who no doubt desire it back.
column2: 奥利弗是一颗重要的工业世界，既有旅长公司的机甲工厂，又有快销军事车辆厂。该行星最近才从自由世界联盟手中夺来，而后者无疑渴望收回。

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns at the dawn of the Star League, Olindo is known for its high quality hydrocarbons that are mined from the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟初建之时，恒星联邦在Olindo建立了定居点；Olindo以其从地表开采的高品质碳氢化合物而闻名.

column1: Omagh was one of the initial colonies that made up the Alliance of Galedon, before it formed the Draconis Combine.
column2: 在Galedon联盟演变为天龙联合体之前，Omagh曾是组成该联盟的初始殖民地之一.

column1: Onverwacht was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Onverwacht是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Oporto (Veil 3075+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oporto（Veil 3075+）于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: During the Second Succession War, Isla Liao attacked the planet, only to be rebuffed. She was killed directing the Rearguard action which allowed most of her forces to escape - the first Liao Chancellor to die on the battlefield.
column2: 在第二次继承战争期间，伊斯拉·廖进攻了这颗行星，却被击退. 她在指挥后卫行动时阵亡，这次行动使她的大部分部队得以逃脱——她是首位战死沙场的廖氏首相.

column1: The major population center on Ordino, a city of a few hundred thousand, was destroyed during the Third Succession War. The remaining inhabitants eke out a living on the impoverished world, but the Capellans have largely withdrawn from the system.
column2: 奥尔迪诺上的大型人口中心，一座10万人的城市，在第三次继承战争期间被摧毁. 剩下的居民在贫瘠的星球上苦苦维生，但大部分卡佩拉人都撤离了这个星系.

column1: The world is quiet and unassuming, except for the massive rainforests that circle the equator. Here trees that tower more than 500 meters tall block out the sun, creating a mood of perpetual twilight at the forest floor.
column2: 这颗星球安静而低调，唯有环绕赤道的广袤雨林例外. 在这里，高耸超过500米的树木遮蔽了阳光，在森林地面上营造出一种永恒暮色的氛围.

column1: Organo has two continents, Alphus and Omegus. The capital city, Typae, is located on Alphus. The Pinard Protectorates Limited plant is located in a vast cavern located at the interface zone between a large agricultural area and a desert.
column2: Organo拥有两块大陆: Alphus和Omegus. 首府Typae位于Alphus上. Pinard Protectorates Limited的工厂位于一片大型农业区与沙漠交界地带的一处巨大洞穴中.

column1: Oriente was the capital of the protostate known as the Federation of Oriente, before the formation of the Free Worlds. It's status as a regional capital is maintained to this day.
column2: 奥连特曾是名为奥连特联邦的原始国家的首都，那是在自由世界联盟形成之前。它作为区域首府的地位一直保持到今天。

column1: One of the core worlds of the Tamar Pact, it became a defacto world of the Lyran Commonwealth when it formed.
column2: 作为塔玛协定的核心世界之一，它在天琴共同体成立时成为其事实上的世界.

column1: Recently settled by the Taurian Concordat due to the wealth gained in the Fourth Succession War, Orkney is little more than a farming outpost at this time.
column2: 由于在第四次继承战争中获得的财富，金牛协约国最近才在Orkney建立定居点，目前Orkney不过是一个农业前哨站.

column1: Ormal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ormal在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Ormstown system was colonized during or shortly before the Age of War and had been incorporated into the Rim Worlds Republic by the time of the Reunification War, where it was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Ormstown星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，到统一战争时已被并入边缘世界共和国，并在那场战争中被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Settled by the Taurian Concordat in the wake of the Fourth Succession War, many privateers are attempting to create diamond and rare heavy metals industries from the harsh surface of the world.
column2: 第四次继承战争后，金牛协约国在此建立了殖民地，许多私掠者正试图利用这颗星球严酷的地表，建立钻石和稀有重金属产业.

column1: Oshika has long been a prefecture capital world. Large quantities of rare earths and germanium in the mountains power a vast economy and industrial base.
column2: Oshika长期以来一直是行政区首府星球. 山区中大量的稀土和锗支撑着庞大的经济与工业基础.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Osmus Saar was an independent colony after the fall of the Terran Hegemony until it was annexed by the Draconis Combine.
column2: 由逃离地球的殖民者建立，Osmus Saar在泰拉霸权崩溃后曾是一个独立殖民地，直到被天龙联合体吞并.

column1: Osset was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Osset在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Osumi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Osumi是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Otho was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Otho是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Otisberg is the fourth planet in the system and has a single moon named Miloe. Recently there have been talks with nearby worlds about forming an Alliance to band together, but so far talks have stalled.
column2: Otisberg是该星系中的第四颗行星，拥有一颗名为Miloe的卫星. 最近，它与附近的世界一直在商谈组建一个联盟以联合起来，但迄今为止谈判已陷入停滞.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ottumwa was an independent colony for over a century before being incorporated into the Federated Suns.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者定居建立，Ottumwa在被并入恒星联邦之前，作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Ouagadougou (Silence 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ouagadougou (Silence 3130+) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ourem was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ourem是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era due to the high concentrations of mineral wealth within the continent spanning Kodiak mountains.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，天龙联合体因横贯大陆的Kodiak山脉中高度集中的矿产资源而在此建立了定居点.

column1: Originally only a small outpost, it gained notoriety thanks to the exotic holovid productions which used Outpost as a daring setting.
column2: 起初只是一个小型前哨站，但由于那些将Outpost用作大胆场景的异域全息影像作品，它变得声名大噪.

column1: Outreach was first settled during the twenty-second century by Terran colonists attracted to the planet's warm climate. Tourism became the mainstay of the planet's economy after it played host to the Star League Martial Olympiads in 2704.
column2: 奥特里奇在22世纪由被该星球温暖气候吸引的地球殖民者首次殖民。在2704年承办星际联盟军事奥林匹克之后，旅游业成为该星球经济的支柱。

column1: Ovan is a rocky world with a river that runs around the entire equator. Ovan's industrial economy was damaged by the first two Succession Wars, and has been further damaged by mismanagement in recent years.
column2: 奥万是一颗多岩石的行星，有一条环绕整个赤道的河流。奥万的工业经济在前两次继承战争中受损，近年来又因管理不善进一步恶化。

column1: Overton is temperate, mostly water covered world near where the Capellan, St. Ives, and Federated Suns borders meet. It supports a population of just under a billion, most of whom are involved in the aquaculture industry.
column2: Overton是一个气候温和、大部分被水覆盖的世界，位于卡佩拉、St. Ives和恒星联邦边界交汇处附近. 它拥有略低于十亿的人口，其中大多数人从事水产养殖业.

column1: Oyevaina was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oyevaina在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Once a lush and beautiful world, Ozawa was wracked by nuclear bombardment. Nonetheless, its lucrative mines have kept civilization alive on this poisoned world, and there are occasional signs of recovery.
column2: Ozawa曾是一个郁郁葱葱、美丽的世界，却饱受核轰炸摧残. 尽管如此，其利润丰厚的矿藏仍让文明在这颗中毒的世界上延续，并且偶尔可见复苏的迹象.

column1: Paches was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Paches在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

column1: Pacifica has highly fertile soil and is home to a Mechwarrior Academy. Unfortunately, Pacifica has highly unpredictable weather and only a 14 hour long day-night cycle, so it requires quite a while to acclimate.
column2: Pacifica拥有极其肥沃的土壤，并且是机甲战士学院的所在地. 不幸的是，Pacifica的天气极其难以预测，而且昼夜周期只有14小时，因此需要相当长的时间才能适应.

column1: Paf was briefly a Taurian research station, but the punishing climate made large-scale construction far too expensive to further exploit the planet's possible resources.
column2: 帕夫曾短暂作为金牛座的研究站，但恶劣的气候使大规模建设成本过高，无法进一步开发该星球的潜在资源。

column1: Pajarito was annexed into the Inner Sphere during the Reunification war, which caused thousands of refugees to flee the world. The ruins of entire cities can be seen from orbit.
column2: Pajarito在统一战争期间被并入内天体，这导致成千上万的难民逃离该星球. 从轨道上可以看到整座整座城市的废墟.

column1: One of the founding colonies of the Sian Commonwealth, Palladaine was the source of much of the initial mineral wealth of the Capellan Confederation.
column2: 作为锡安共同体的创始殖民地之一，Palladaine是卡佩拉邦联早期大部分矿产财富的来源.

column1: Novis AT-H, Inc maintains a megafactory on the surface of Palladix, which gets its name from the vast Palladium fields.
column2: Novis AT-H，Inc在Palladix表面运营着一座巨型工厂，Palladix因广阔的钯矿区而得名.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Palm was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Palm曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Palmyra Petrochemicals has a monopoly on the vast deposits of petroleum contained within the deserts of Palmyra, and is a major exporter.
column2: Palmyra石化公司垄断了Palmyra沙漠中蕴藏的巨量石油资源，并且是主要出口商.

column1: Palos is a large world with vastly different climates on each of its five continents.
column2: Palos是一颗巨大的星球，其五个大陆的气候差异极大.

column1: Settled by colonists from different regions, Pandora was settled due to it being a rich world. However, wars and battles raged over the world for most of its early history until the Lyran Commonwealth annexed the system before the Star League era.
column2: 来自不同地区的殖民者在此定居，Pandora之所以被殖民，是因为它是一颗富饶的星球. 然而，在其早期历史的大部分时间里，战争与战斗在这颗星球上肆虐，直到星际联盟时代之前，天琴共同体吞并了该星系.

column1: Pangkalan was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Pangkalan曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年共和国-共同体争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Settled during the Star League era by colonists from the Free Worlds League.
column2: 于星际联盟时代由来自自由世界联盟的殖民者建立.

column1: During the Succession Wars, Panpour was responsible for a vast portion of the Federated Suns industrial output thanks to its rich minerals and industrial base.
column2: 在继承战争期间，得益于其丰富的矿产和工业基础，Panpour占据了恒星联邦工业产出的很大一部分.

column1: As a result of multiple conflicts above the surface of Panzyr, the orbital approach to the planet is potentially hazardous, so despite its pleasant climate and resources, Panzyr is in a slow decline. House Decimis, originally from Guldra, took possession of the world and it is now their home system.
column2: 由于潘济尔天上的多起冲突，从轨道前往该行星具有潜在的危险，所以即便有着宜人的气候和资源，潘济尔依然处于缓慢的衰退中. 最初来自古尔德拉的德希米斯家族，占有了该星球，现在它是他们的母星.

column1: Settled during the Star League era by relocated colonists and prisoners from the Draconis Combine.
column2: 于星际联盟时代，由来自天龙联合体的重新安置殖民者与囚犯定居建立.

column1: Sarcastically named Paradise, the dim sun makes growing crops extremely difficult whilst the constantly seismic activity makes mining dangerous.
column2: 讽刺地被命名为Paradise，昏暗的恒星使种植作物极其困难，而持续不断的地震活动又使采矿十分危险.

column1: Parakoila is a mineral rich world, known for its gold and heavy metals. The planet's capital is the city of Mainstrike, named after the vast gold veins that were struck here.
column2: 帕拉科伊拉是一颗矿产丰富的世界，以黄金与重金属闻名。该行星的首府是梅因斯特赖克城，得名于这里被发现的巨大金矿脉。

column1: Paran VI served as a breadbasket system for the Rim Worlds Republic, covered in island-spanning orchards and massive fisheries. After the Amaris Civil War ended, Paran kept to itself, and slid back into 20th century tech.
column2: Paran VI曾是边缘世界共和国的粮仓星系，遍布着横跨岛屿的果园和大规模渔场. 阿马里斯内战结束后，Paran与世隔绝，并倒退回了20世纪的技术水平.

column1: Pardeau was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pardeau是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Parian was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Parian在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the reign of the Star League, the 171st Mechanized Infantry Division of the Star League Defense Force was formed on this planet, and Fort McKittrick stands to this day as a ruined symbol of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟统治时期，星际联盟防卫军第171机械化步兵师在这颗行星上组建，而麦基特里克堡至今仍作为星际联盟的残破象征矗立着.

column1: The arable lands and parks of Park Place make this an ideal retirement world for the eldest and wealthiest citizens in the Inner Sphere.
column2: Park Place的可耕地和公园，使其成为内天体最年长、最富有公民的理想退休世界.

column1: Originally the settlers of Parma organized themselves into a plethora of city-states and declared that no one, not even the Duke, could interfere with the affairs of each city. This did not work.
column2: 最初，Parma的定居者将自己组织成众多城邦，并宣称任何人，甚至公爵，都不得干涉各城事务. 但这并未奏效.

column1: Parvan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Parvan在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich gold veins contained with the peaks of Pascagoula.
column2: 在星际联盟时代初期，恒星联邦殖民者在此定居，并对Pascagoula群峰中蕴藏的丰富金矿脉提出了所有权主张.

column1: Pasemah was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pasemah在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Pasig was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Pasig曾是星际联盟防卫军一支守备部队的驻地.

column1: Patan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Patan在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich gold veins contained with the peaks of Pattison
column2: 在星际联盟时代初期，由恒星联邦殖民者建立定居点，他们宣称对Pattison群峰中蕴藏的丰富金矿脉拥有所有权.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich platinum veins contained with the peaks of Pattonsbrug
column2: 在星际联盟时代初期，恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居，他们宣称对Pattonsbrug群峰中蕴藏的丰富铂金矿脉拥有所有权.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich plains ideal for agriculture.
column2: 由恒星联邦殖民者在星际联盟时代初期建立定居点，他们宣称对适宜农业的富饶平原拥有所有权.

column1: Recently colonised by the Lothian League, the rich platinum veins under the surface are being exported to nearby worlds, making the initial colonists very wealthy.
column2: 最近被洛锡安联盟殖民，地表下丰富的铂矿脉正被出口到附近世界，使最初的殖民者变得非常富有.

column1: Named after the famous mercenary commander Paul the Paulrus. The locals changed the name to Paulus after Paul's death. Their planetary flag is a walrus with machine guns and a cigar.
column2: 以著名雇佣兵指挥官保罗·海象命名。保罗死后当地人把名字改成了保卢斯。他们的行星旗帜是一只叼着雪茄、架着机枪的海象。

column1: Pavia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pavia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Paxon is a Clan world in the Kerensky Cluster. One manufacturer for Clan Diamond Shark is based here, churning out armaments for the war efforts.
column2: Paxon是克伦斯基星团中的一个氏族世界. 钻石鲨氏族的一家制造商设在这里，为战争行动源源不断地生产军备.

column1: This arid world was the site of a 'gold rush' of scavengers looking for LosTech. When hopes of sudden Star League era wealth proved unfounded, the planet was slowly abandoned, and is now littered with ghost towns.
column2: 这颗干旱星球曾是寻宝者寻找失落科技的“淘金地”。当一夜暴富的星际联盟时代财富幻想被证明无据之后，星球被缓慢废弃，如今遍布鬼城。

column1: Payvand was the site of many battles during the Reunification War, and many of its urban areas were turned into battlefields by the SLDF despite being a clear breach of the Ares Convention.
column2: Payvand是统一战争期间许多战役的发生地，尽管明显违反了《阿瑞斯公约》，星际联盟防卫军仍将其许多城区变成了战场.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, it was incorporated into the Federated Suns before the Star League era.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者定居，并在星际联盟时代之前并入恒星联邦.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Peacock was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Peacock驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队.

column1: Pec was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pec在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Pegasi is an independent Periphery world located close to the worlds of Carcri and Cephei and the Tortuga Dominions
column2: Pegasi是一个独立的外围世界，靠近Carcri和Cephei世界以及托尔图加领地.

column1: Pell was never more than a stopping-off point on the way to Buenos Aires. During the Third Succession War the refueling station in orbit was shut down due to lack of parts and technical expertise. The Capellans have since abandoned the system.
column2: 佩尔只不过是前往布宜诺斯艾利斯途中的一个中间站. 第三次继承战争期间，轨道上的燃料补给站因缺乏零件和技术人员而关闭. 自那以后，卡佩拉人就放弃了该星系.

column1: Originally one of the worlds of the Sian Commonwealth, it became a defacto member of the Capellan Confederation during its inauguration.
column2: 它原本是锡安共同体的星球之一，在卡佩拉邦联成立之际成为了其事实上的成员.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Pencader was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Towerlund City as it is now called is a large walled city located close to the Oxide Desert.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Pencader曾驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队. 如今被称为塔沃伦德城的是一座大型带城墙城市，位于氧化物沙漠附近.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, it is a mostly self sufficient agri-world.
column2: 在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体建立殖民地，这里是一个基本自给自足的农业世界.

column1: Pentvar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pentvar是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Once the site of a Taurian mining colony, this world was polluted beyond recovery after only a few hundred years of industry. Now the air is foul and unbreathable, and the surface is cracked by fault lines and volcanoes.
column2: 这颗星球曾经是金牛矿业殖民地的所在地，在仅仅几百年的工业活动后就被污染得无药可救了. 现在这里的空气又臭又不宜呼吸，地表被断层线和火山所分裂.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns early in the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 星际联盟时代早期，恒星联邦为获取地表下丰富的矿产资源而在此定居.

column1: The oceanic world of Perdition is wracked by constant storms and vulcanism. It would be a fairly unpleasant place to live if not for the money that its mining and military manufacturing industries bring in.
column2: Perdition这颗海洋世界饱受持续风暴和火山活动的摧残. 要不是其采矿业和军工制造业带来的金钱，这里会是个相当不宜居住的地方.

column1: Périgueux was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Périgueux于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间战火中消亡.

column1: An oft contested world, the original industrial base was destroyed in the Succession Wars, leaving only deep mine shafts to provide material.
column2: 一个屡遭争夺的星球，最初的工业基础已在继承战争中毁灭，仅剩下深层矿井还能提供材料.

column1: When the Free Worlds League withdrew its support from the mining colony of Pernik, the residents who chose to stay were able to survive by moving to subterranean hydroponic agriculture in the planet's extensive cave systems.
column2: 当自由世界联盟撤回对佩尔尼克采矿殖民地的支持时，选择留下的居民靠转入该行星广阔洞穴群中的地下水培农业得以生存。

column1: Alternatively known as Perrot or Shaula throughout the Succession Wars, it is an unremarkable agri world with areas filled with natural hot springs.
column2: 在历次继承战争期间，它也被称为Perrot或Shaula；这是一个毫不起眼的农业世界，部分地区遍布天然温泉.

column1: Persistence was one of seven worlds settled by colonists from the Rim Worlds Republic between 2334 and 2338 as an attempt by Maxwell Rowe to create a buffer zone between the Republic, the Draconis Combine and the Tamar Pact. It was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Persistence是2334年至2338年间由来自边缘世界共和国的殖民者定居的七个世界之一，此举是麦克斯韦·罗为在共和国、天龙联合体和塔玛协定之间建立缓冲区而进行的尝试. 它在2773—2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Pesht was discovered by early explorers which were part of the Ozawan merchants in 2212, but due to hostile wildlife wasn't colonised until 2320. A heavily forest world, it is extremely hospitable to humanoid life.
column2: 佩什特于2212年由奥扎万商人中的早期探险者发现，但由于野生动物具有敌意，直到2320年才被殖民。这是一颗森林覆盖极广的星球，对人形生命极为宜居。

column1: Named for its vast petroleum deposits under the ice, Petrolia is a heavily industrialised world.
column2: Petrolia因冰层下蕴藏的大量石油矿藏而得名，是一个高度工业化的世界.

column1: The Phact system was colonized sometime prior to 2366, and has had a long history as an industrialised world.
column2: Phact星系在2366年之前的某个时候被殖民，并且作为工业化世界有着悠久的历史.

column1: Settled for rich high-quality metal and oil deposits, the only inhabited planet in the system is 'Hades', a hot caustic world.
column2: 为富饶的高品质金属与石油矿藏而殖民，该星系唯一有人居住的星球是“哈迪斯”，一颗灼热而腐蚀性的世界。

column1: Phecda is a cold and inhospitable world in slow decline. The world's economy is kept afloat only by its important strategic position and its ability to produce high-tech water purification systems. It was home to Snord's Irregulars in the 3020's.
column2: 菲克达是一颗寒冷而不宜居、正在缓慢衰落的星球。其经济仅靠重要的战略位置与生产高科技净水系统的能力维持。3020年代曾是斯诺德非正规军的驻地。

column1: An industrialised world, its flagship exporter is Longanecker PlastiSteel which utilises locally sourced petroleums and materials to produce synthetic plastics and materials.
column2: 一个工业化的世界，其旗舰出口商是Longanecker PlastiSteel，该公司利用当地采购的石油和材料生产合成塑料和材料.

column1: An industrialised world, its flagship exporter is Osaka Heavy Metrics which utilises locally sourced silicon to produce electronics.
column2: 一个工业化的世界，其旗舰出口商是Osaka Heavy Metrics，该公司利用本地开采的硅生产电子产品.

column1: Piedmont holds the infamous distinction of being the home of Chungalomeningitis, a disease that killed over a billion people during the Age of War. The Piedmont Institute for Disease Control was formed shortly afterwards, in order to prevent further outbreaks.
column2: Piedmont因是Chungalomeningitis的故乡而臭名昭著，这种疾病在战争时代夺去了超过十亿人的生命. 此后不久，Piedmont疾病控制研究所成立，以防止疫情进一步爆发.

column1: The initial mining colony founded by the Taurian Concordat was annexed by the Federated Suns during the Reunification War.
column2: 由金牛协约国建立的最初采矿殖民地，在统一战争期间被恒星联邦吞并.

column1: Pietermaritzburg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pietermaritzburg是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Pike's population live in heavy stone structures as the planet's rocky surface is regularly swept by powerful windstorms. Pike is rich in metals and most of the population make their living as miners or supporting the mining industry on the planet.
column2: 派克的居民住在厚重的石制建筑中，因为该行星多岩石的表面经常被强劲的风暴横扫。派克金属资源丰富，大多数居民以采矿或为行星上的采矿产业提供配套服务为生。

column1: An independent mining colony for centuries, it was annexed by the Draconis Combine during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 作为独立的采矿殖民地存在了数个世纪，它在星际联盟成立初期被天龙联合体吞并.

column1: Pilon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pilon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Pilpala recently changed hands when the Free Worlds League moved in a large number of mercenaries that dominated the few troops stationed there by the Capellan Confederation. The planet's mercantile population is uneasily adapting to the regime change.
column2: 皮尔帕拉最近易手，当时自由世界联盟投入大量雇佣兵，压倒了卡佩兰联邦在那里驻扎的少数部队。该行星的商民人口正在不安地适应这次政权更替。

column1: Pinard was and is a Taurian manufacturing center, despite having its cities bombed into radioactive rubble during the Reunification War. The Taurians built new cities and new factories, leaving the dangerous ruins as an eternal reminder.
column2: 尽管在统一战争期间，皮纳德的城市被炸成了放射性废墟，但它过去是，现在还是一处金牛制造中心. 金牛人造起了新的城市和新工厂，把危险的废墟当作永恒的提醒.

column1: An independent mining colony for centuries, it joined the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 几个世纪以来一直是一个独立的采矿殖民地，在星际联盟成立初期加入了自由世界联盟.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era to ensure a monopoly on the world's uranium deposits.
column2: 在星盟时代由龙尼斯联合体殖民，以确保对该行星铀矿的垄断。

column1: While visitors to Piriapolis are welcomed at its starport, the privilege of emigrating there is jealously guarded as a way of protecting the precious Lipizzaner horses that were once almost wiped out during a bandit raid.
column2: 造访皮里亚波利斯的访客会在星港受到欢迎，而向那儿移民的特权却被小心翼翼地限制着，作为保护珍贵的利皮扎马的一种方式，这种马在一场盗匪袭击中曾一度濒临灭绝.

column1: Annexed by the Federated Suns during the Reunification War, Pitkin is a quiet agricultural world with no particular claim to fame since then, apart from a military garrison.
column2: Pitkin在统一战争期间被恒星联邦吞并，是一个安静的农业世界，自那以后除了一支驻军外，并无特别出名之处.

column1: A mountainous world, Placida provides raw material to nearby worlds.
column2: Placida是一个多山的世界，为附近的世界提供原材料.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the seabed.
column2: 星盟时代由天琴共同体建立定居点，以获取海床下蕴藏的丰富矿产.

column1: Plataea was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Plataea是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Pleione is a planet with a relatively small landmass - less than twenty percent of the surface of the planet is dry land, concentrated in a single continent named Jezrael.
column2: Pleione是一颗陆地面积相对较小的行星——其表面不到百分之二十是陆地，且集中在一块名为杰兹雷尔的大陆上.

column1: Pliska was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pliska在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Originally one of the worlds of the Protectorate of Donegal, it became a defacto member of the Lyran Commonwealth when it formed.
column2: 它最初是Donegal保护国的星球之一，在天琴共同体成立时成为其事实上的成员.

column1: Pocologan was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Pocologan原本是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu省的一部分，并在 2773-2775 年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Point Barrow was originally settled to exploit the massive deposits of rare earth minerals. Aside from that, there is no reason for humans to be on the world. The only other interesting feature is the Point Barrow Military Academy.
column2: Point Barrow最初建立殖民地是为了开采大量稀土矿藏. 除此之外，人类没有任何理由待在这个星球上. 唯一另一个有趣之处就是Point Barrow军事学院.

column1: Pojos, with its colored ice ring, is beautiful to look at but dangerous to approach. The planet specializes in botanical concerns, and the tolerances of the thorny Pojos Rose make it a desirable bloom across the Confederation.
column2: 波若斯，拥有其五彩斑斓的冰环，看起来很美，但是却很危险. 这颗行星专门研究植物学课题，且多刺波若斯玫瑰的耐受性使其成为联邦各地向往的花朵.

column1: Pokhara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pokhara在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Polcenigo was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. The families of the forces that made up the garrison were the original colonists.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Polcenigo驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军驻军. 组成这支驻军的部队的家属就是最初的殖民者.

column1: Pollux is an arid world that was settled early on in human expansion. It has significant heavy metal reserves, though its industrial development has been inhibited over the course of the Succession Wars as the FWL and LA have fought over the planet.
column2: Pollux是一颗干旱星球，在人类扩张早期就已被殖民. 它拥有可观的重金属储量，但在继承战争期间，由于FWL和LA为争夺该星球而交战，其工业发展受到了抑制.

column1: One of many worlds settled during the Star League, Polybius was subsequently abandoned and forgotten about during the succession wars. Some claim the entire star system is nothing more than an urban legend
column2: 作为星际联盟时期殖民的众多世界之一，Polybius后来在继承战争期间被遗弃并遗忘. 有些人声称整个星系不过是一个都市传说而已.

column1: As of 3025, Pomme De Terre is considered the most productive agricultural world within the Draconis Combine. The value of this world was high due to the fact that many Combine worlds could not provide enough food for themselves.
column2: 截至3025年，Pomme De Terre被认为是天龙联合体内生产力最高的农业世界. 这个世界的价值很高，因为许多联合体世界无法为自己提供足够的食物.

column1: Pompey is a crucial Marian world. Home to Harian Mechanized Industries it employs vast numbers of slaves to meet the Marian Armed forces vicious appetite for fighting vehicles.
column2: Pompey是马里安的一个重要星球. 作为Harian Mechanized Industries的所在地，该公司雇佣大量奴隶，以满足马里安武装部队对战斗车辆贪得无厌的需求.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine in the run up to the Reunification War, it was used as a marshalling point for Star League forces.
column2: 在统一战争前夕，天龙联合体在此建立定居点，这里曾被用作星际联盟部队的集结地.

column1: Porrima has abundant, but not overwhelming, supplies of industrial metals, gemstones, and arable land. When originally settled, it was a paradise until the settlers discovered that every 62 years a neighbouring planet orbits close enough to cause horrific storms upon the surface.
column2: Porrima拥有丰富但并不过剩的工业金属、宝石和可耕地储量. 最初殖民时，这里曾是一处世外桃源，直到殖民者发现，每隔62年，一颗邻近行星就会运行到足够近的位置，从而在Porrima表面引发可怕的风暴.

column1: Port Arthur is a relatively sparsely-populated world, owing largely to endemic root parasites within its soil that make farming difficult. However, it boasts incredible natural and mineral resources, crucial for military production.
column2: Port Arthur是一个人口相对稀少的星球，主要因为其土壤中特有的根部寄生虫使农业耕作十分困难. 然而，它拥有惊人的自然和矿产资源，对军事生产至关重要.

column1: The Porthos system was colonized by the faction known as the Inheritors. Foreswearing any military might and with no wealth, these worlds are of no use to anyone.
column2: Porthos星系由被称为“继承者”的派系殖民. 他们摒弃一切军事力量，又毫无财富，这些世界对任何人都毫无用处.

column1: A former Taurian world, Portland was invaded as part of the Taurian-Canopian war, but its inhabitants successfully repelled the Magistracy with guerilla tactics. Now independent, the population engages in subsistence farming and a slow trickle of food exports.
column2: 波特兰过去是颗金牛星球，因金牛-船底战争而遭入侵，但是其居民成功地利用游击战术击退了船底人. 现在独立后，人们从事勉强自持的农业和细水长流的食品出口行业.

column1: The planet itself is very plain and stable. Typical weather, terrain and resources focus life into the cities where the Lyran merchants have their colorful bazaars making it an important, if boring, trading hub.
column2: 这颗行星本身非常平淡而稳定. 典型的气候、地形和资源将生活集中到城市中，天琴商人在那里经营着色彩斑斓的集市，使其成为一个重要却乏味的贸易枢纽.

column1: A relatively poor world, much of the population works in mining or manual labour.
column2: 一个相对贫穷的世界，大部分人口从事采矿或体力劳动.

column1: A rich world filled with farmlands and rich mountain ranges, it never the less has substantial socio economic problems.
column2: 一个富饶的世界，遍布农田和富饶的山脉，尽管如此，它仍有着严重的社会经济问题.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era due to its extensive farmland availability.
column2: 由于该星系拥有大片可用农田，自由世界联盟在星际联盟时代在此建立了定居点.

column1: Praxton is the Outworlds Alliance's primary producer of precious fusion engines, used in their tanks, AeroFighters, and Mechs. As such it is a crucial part of the Alliance's military logistics, and a constant target of attacks.
column2: 普拉克斯顿是外域联盟主要的珍贵聚变引擎产地，其引擎用于他们的坦克、航空战机与机甲。因此它是联盟军事后勤的关键一环，也是袭击的常年目标。

column1: The original settlers of Prediltz fled the world when the Draconic Combine invaded during the Age of War, leaving only the stupid or brave behind.
column2: Prediltz最初的定居者在战争时代天龙联合入侵时逃离了这颗星球，只留下愚蠢或勇敢的人.

column1: Even at the height of the Star League era Premana was considered something of an isolated system, as ships traveling to the system via inhabited systems - rather than taking the riskier option of traveling through uninhabited systems - were forced to either approach from the Rimward direction, or journey outside of Commonwealth space
column2: 即便在星际联盟时代的鼎盛时期，Premana也被视为一个相当孤立的星系，因为经由有人居住星系前往该星系的飞船——而不是选择风险更高的穿越无人星系路线——被迫要么从边缘方向接近，要么航行到共同体领域之外.

column1: Pressby was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pressby在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Pressville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pressville在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: By 2271, there was two worlds colonised by settlers from Terra. The clerk in charge of system naming should have by rights demanded one change their name to prevent duplicates but they couldn't be arsed.
column2: 到 2271 年，已有两个星球被来自地球的定居者殖民。负责星系命名的文书按理本应要求其中一个星球改名以免重名，但他懒得操这份心。

column1: Primus is a fertile world of vast river floodplains, and its land is given over to highly-automated farming. Small farming communities serve the logistical needs of the automated farms, and a single spaceport moves food off-world.
column2: 普赖默斯是一个富饶的星球，有着广阔的泛滥平原，其土地被用于高度自动化的农业. 小型农业社区为自动化农场提供后勤服务，唯一的一座太空港则将食品运送到星球之外.
