column1: Principia is the seat of the judiciary for the Capellan Confederation and, as such, caters to the needs of Capellan nobles who have taken it as a vacation home. It also has courts dedicated to adjudicating mercenary contracts with the Liao.
column2: 普林西皮亚(字面意思为“原则”)是卡佩拉联邦的司法机构所在地，因此，它迎合了将此地作为度假屋的御夫座贵族的需要. 它还有专门裁决与廖氏所签的佣兵合约的法庭.

column1: Devastated during the Reunification War, the population has revitalised many of the poisoned continents.
column2: 统一战争期间惨遭揉躏，如今民众已让许多饱受毒害的大陆重获生机.

column1: Priori was colonized by the Clans by the 29th century. Its Terran-like atmosphere and ecology made it a popular site for colonization and was one of the major worlds held by Clan Burrock.
column2: Priori在29世纪时已被氏族殖民. 其类似地球的大气与生态使它成为热门的殖民地点，并且是Burrock氏族所控制的主要世界之一.

column1: This major manufacturing and commercial world is known for the massive typhoons that occasionally form in the vast tropical ocean. During storm season, the skyscrapers of the coastal cities seal themselves against the gale-force winds.
column2: 这颗大型制造业与商业星球之所以知名，是因为它广大热带海洋中偶尔形成的巨大台风. 在风暴季节，沿海城市的摩天大楼都要封闭，以此对抗大风.

column1: Procyon's rocky soil is ill-suited to agriculture but rich in heavy metals. While not possessed of any military industry, the output from the planets mines are used to produce a variety of civilian vehicles.
column2: 普罗西翁多岩石的土壤不适合农业，却富含重金属。虽然它没有任何军事工业，该行星矿场的产出被用于生产各种民用车辆。

column1: Promised Land is one of the major ports of entry for Lyran traders entering League space, the city closest to the planet's primary spaceport containing a magnificent bazaar teeming with an endless array of merchants, wholesalers and speculators
column2: 应许之地是莱兰商人进入联盟空间的主要入口之一，离该行星主要太空港最近的城市里有一座宏伟的集市，挤满了无穷无尽的商人、批发商和投机者

column1: Settled as one of the Capellan Commonality worlds, it became a defacto member of the Capellan Confederation when it formed.
column2: 作为卡佩拉共同体的世界之一被殖民，当卡佩拉邦联成立时，它事实上成为了其成员.

column1: Proserpina was one of the Core Worlds housing heavy industry companies such as Guided Technologies and Bulldog Enterprises. These factories, and many others, exploited the petrochemical and mineral resources of the planet directly and refined metals from the ores in the world were shipped to many other planets. During the succession wars, two out the five continents were rendered uninhabitable nuclear wastelands, which the population hasn't recovered from to this day.
column2: 普洛塞庇娜是众多核心世界之一，拥有导向技术与斗牛犬企业等重工业公司。这些工厂以及许多其他工厂直接开采该行星的石化与矿产资源，从矿石中提炼出的金属被运往许多其他行星。在继承战争期间，五块大陆中有两块变成了无法居住的核废土，当地人口至今都未从这场灾难中恢复。

column1: Prydain was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Prydain在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Pula was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pula在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Capellan Confederation during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 在星盟时代，卡佩拉邦联在此建立定居点，以获取地表之下丰富的矿产资源.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 星际联盟时代，天龙联合体在此定居，以获取地表下丰富的矿产资源.

column1: Puttalam was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Puttalam是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Technically part of the Taurian Concordat, Pyrrhus is a dreary rock where convicts are turned loose with a pickaxe and a pat on the back, there to make a poor living as a miner, or, more likely, join one of the resident pirate gangs.
column2: 从技术上讲，皮洛士是金牛协约国的一部分，是块沉闷的岩石. 在那儿，给犯人们背上一把十字镐，再在背后拍一把，就打发他们去做矿工谋生，或者，更可能的是，加入一个驻在那儿的海盗团伙.

column1: Qalzi is a relatively recent addition to Aurigan holdings. The cold and rocky Terran world is in a legal limbo, with the Taurian Concordat maintaining that their original colony, since abandoned, gives them a prior claim on the system.
column2: 喀奥齐是最近加入御夫座领地的. 这颗冰冷的岩质类地星球处于法律未定状态，金牛协约国坚持他们废弃了的最初殖民地，给了他们对此星系的优先主张权.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 星际联盟时代，天琴共同体为获取地表下丰富的矿产资源而在此定居.

column1: Qandahar is a world that was totally exploited by humanity for its vast natural resources. Unfortunately the early settlers didn't show any care in handling the output of their factories and this has led the ecosystem of Qandahar to collapse.
column2: 坎大哈是一颗被人类为争夺其庞大自然资源而彻底榨取的星球。遗憾的是早期定居者在处理工厂排放时毫不谨慎，这导致坎大哈的生态系统崩溃。

column1: Qualip is the site of a failed colony which died out due to an experiment with G-23 Paxilon Hydrochlorate, a chemical compound added to the air processors in order to pacify the populace.
column2: Qualip是一个失败殖民地的所在地，该殖民地因一项使用G-23 帕西隆盐酸盐的实验而消亡，这种化学化合物被添加到空气处理系统中，以安抚民众.

column1: Quantraine was devastated during the Reunification war and became depopulated until recently, where new colonists are striving to set up a new colony.
column2: Quantraine在统一战争期间遭到严重破坏，变得荒无人烟，直到最近才有新殖民者努力建立新的殖民地.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Quarell was considered important enough to host a SLDF garrison thanks to its rich boreholes.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Quarell因其丰富的钻孔而被认为重要到足以驻扎一支星际联盟防卫军守备队.

column1: Quatre Belle is a lightly-populated, agricultural world. The planet's soil was rich in nutrients from volcanic activity and the system's F-class primary provided abundant energy for the world to be covered in lush vegetation.
column2: 四美人是一颗人口稀少的农业行星。该行星的土壤因火山活动而富含养分，而该星系的F级主星提供了充沛能量，使整颗行星覆满葱郁植被。

column1: Quelimane was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quelimane是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The icy world of Quernoy was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Sarna Supremacy prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation
column2: 冰封的Quernoy世界是在从泰拉第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的，并且在卡佩拉联邦成立之前是Sarna Supremacy的成员.

column1: Despite its tainted atmosphere, the planet of Quentin has been a prize for most of the Succession Wars due to its intact 'Mech production facilities. Recently captured by the Combine, its facilities pump out MAD-3Rs and AS-7Ks for the DCMS.
column2: 尽管大气受到污染，昆汀这颗行星在大部分继承战争期间因完好的机甲生产设施而成为争夺的奖赏。最近被联合体夺取，其设施为DCMS源源不断产出MAD-3R和AS-7K。

column1: Quiberas is a core world within the Outworlds Alliance, though is but still bears the marks of the Reunification war where the Star League burned cities and populations across the Periphery.
column2: Quiberas是外域联盟内的一个核心世界，但依然留有统一战争的痕迹，在那场战争中星际联盟焚毁了边缘星域各处的城市与人口.

column1: Despite a lack of natural resources or majestic scenery, Quimberton has managed to become a recreational hub, mostly due to vast estates it rents out as timeshares to well-off people who want a taste of true wealth.
column2: 尽管昆伯顿缺乏自然资源或壮观的景色，但它已经成功地成为了一个娱乐中心，这多半要归功于那些以分时共享方式租给富人的大量庄园，那些人想品尝到真正的财富.

column1: Quimper (Chirac 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quimper（Chirac 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Quimper was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quimper是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Quincy system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was incorporated into the Federated Suns during or shortly before the Age of War
column2: Quincy星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在战争时代期间或之前不久被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Quines was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quines是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Quittacas system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was incorporated into the Federated Suns during or shortly before the Age of War
column2: Quittacas星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在战争时代期间或之前不久被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Qurayyat was discovered and colonized in the early to mid-twenty-second century by settlers from the Middle East who were drawn to the vast desert oasis on the surface.
column2: Qurayyat于22世纪早期至中期被来自中东的定居者发现并殖民，他们被地表上广阔的沙漠绿洲所吸引.

column1: Raballa was once a vast food exporter, but in the late Succession Wars the world's weather patterns shifted. With this shift in weather the amount of food it could grow declined and the population is slowly declining.
column2: 拉巴拉曾是庞大的粮食出口地，但在继承战争后期该星球的气候模式发生转变。随着气候转变，它能种植的粮食减少，人口也在缓慢下降。

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era to claim the vast petroleum fields.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，天龙联合为夺取广袤的油田而在此建立定居点.

column1: Before the fall of the Star League, Radostov was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟覆灭之前，Radostov曾驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支卫守部队.

column1: Radstadt is mostly known for a unique wood, the Radstadt pine which, when processed, shimmers like gold. The decentralized population is supplied with food from the planet's rich oceans
column2: 拉德施塔特最为人所知的是它一种独特的木材——拉德施塔特松，加工后会像黄金般闪烁。分散的人口由该行星富饶的海洋供应食物

column1: Discovered by Albert Radulov, it was renamed to Tanis after he was convicted of interstellar fraud. The system contains three inhabitable worlds which produces mostly agricultural products which are traded amongst each other.
column2: 由阿尔伯特·拉杜洛夫发现，在他因星际欺诈被定罪后，该星系被更名为Tanis. 该星系包含三颗可居住星球，主要生产农产品，这些农产品在彼此之间进行贸易.

column1: Raetia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Raetia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ragusa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ragusa是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rahne is a small world without adequate water or growing seasons. Major dust storms fling themselves across the planet creating a need to protect exposed machinery, which constantly churns through the vast fields of radioactives.
column2: Rahne是一个缺乏充足水源和生长季节的小型世界. 猛烈的沙尘暴横扫这颗行星，因此需要保护暴露在外的机械，而这些机械不断在广阔的放射性物质田中作业.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era due to the vast germanium deposits under the polar ice caps.
column2: 由于极地冰盖下蕴藏着大量锗矿藏，天琴共同体在星盟时代于此建立了定居点.

column1: The Raldamax system was settled by the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War by refugees from the worlds seized by the Star League.
column2: Raldamax星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候，由外域联盟利用来自被星际联盟夺取的诸世界的难民建立的.

column1: The Raman system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent world prior to joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Raman星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并在加入恒星联邦之前是一个独立世界.

column1: Ramen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ramen在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by prisoners from the Draconis Combine during the initial years of the Star League, it remains one of the less pleasant penal colonies within the Draconis Combine.
column2: 在星际联盟成立初期，来自天龙联合的囚犯在此定居；如今它仍是天龙联合境内最不宜人的流放地之一.

column1: The Ramona system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent world prior to joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Ramona星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，在加入恒星联邦之前是一个独立世界.

column1: A warm, semi-tropical world, Ramora is home to small industrial complexes for United Outworlders Corporation and Ravenna Electronics.
column2: Ramora是一个温暖的半热带世界，是联合外世界人公司和拉文纳电子的几座小型工业综合体所在地.

column1: Ramsau is a large cold desert with ice across half the planet, and a day six times longer than it ought to be thanks to its position as an almost tidally locked world.
column2: Ramsau是一颗广袤的寒冷荒漠行星，半个星球被冰层覆盖；由于它几乎处于潮汐锁定状态，它的一天长度是应有长度的六倍.

column1: Ramsey is a surface garrison within the Deep Periphery, near St. Jean and Santiago. During Operation Revival, Ramsey is operated by Clan Steel Viper.
column2: Ramsey是深空外围内的一支地表驻军，靠近St. Jean和Santiago. 在复兴行动期间，Ramsey由钢蝰蛇氏族运作.

column1: Randar was part of the Capellan Commonality before joining the Capellan Confederation. It supplies nearby worlds with electronics and timber products.
column2: Randar在加入卡佩拉邦联之前曾是卡佩拉共同国的一部分. 它为附近的星球供应电子产品和木材产品.

column1: Raphael is a mainly agricultural world that was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Confederation centuries ago.
column2: Raphael是一个以农业为主的世界，在几个世纪前加入邦联之前曾是锡安共同体的一部分.

column1: Rapla was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war
column2: Rapla原本是边缘世界共和国Timbuktu行省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Annexed by the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立初期被自由世界联盟吞并.

column1: A warm world with a light industrial base, Rasalgethi is entirely self sufficient.
column2: Rasalgethi是一个拥有轻工业基础的温暖世界，完全自给自足.

column1: The capital of the newly re-created Free Rasalhague Republic, Rassalhague has long been an important industrial and agricultural world.
column2: Rassalhague作为新近重建的自由拉绍格共和国的首都，长期以来一直是重要的工业和农业世界.

column1: Home to Rastaban Agricultural, one of the key agricultural transport companies within the Commonwealth.
column2: 这里是Rastaban Agricultural的所在地，它是共同体重要的农业运输公司之一.

column1: Redfield boasts several large plains well-suited to growing crops and raising herd animals, with a thick iron deposit under the surface in many areas - hence the name of 'Redfield'
column2: 雷德菲尔德拥有数片大平原，非常适合种植作物和饲养牲畜，许多地区地表之下还有厚实的铁矿床——"雷德菲尔德"（红野）之名便由此而来

column1: Settled by colonists from the Federated Suns in the years leading up to the formation of the Star League. It is now an important agri-world with numerous Star League era agri-domes.
column2: 在星际联盟成立之前的岁月里，来自恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居. 如今，这里是一个重要的农业世界，拥有众多星际联盟时代的农业穹顶.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Reese Station was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Reese Station曾是星际联盟防卫军一支卫守部队的驻地.

column1: Refuel Base Gamma is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery, close to the coreward border of the Vul Rift. The nearest identified inhabited system is the Deep Periphery system known as Doggerbank.
column2: 伽马燃料补给基地位于深空外围的外缘区域，靠近Vul裂谷的核心方向边界. 最近的已确认有人居住星系是被称为“Doggerbank”的深空外围星系.

column1: Regis Roost is filled with fungal life, in a dizzying array of forms; fungal 'plants', 'fish' and even 'animals' comprise the complex biosphere of the world. Consequently, the air is thick with spores. Visitors are prone to an unpleasant illness known as 'spore-lung'.
column2: 雷吉斯罗斯特遍布真菌生命，形态之繁多令人眼花缭乱；真菌“植物”、“鱼”甚至“动物”共同构成了这个世界的复杂生物圈。因此，空气中弥漫着浓密的孢子。访客很容易患上一种名为“孢子肺”的讨厌疾病。

column1: Regis Roost
column2: 里吉斯鲁斯特

column1: Once the capital world of the Principality of Regulus, it remains an important world. During the Star League era, SLDF troops would form part of the honor guard for the ruling family of the Principality of Regulus.
column2: 它曾是Regulus公国的首都星球，如今仍是一个重要星球. 在星际联盟时代，星际联盟防卫军部队会组成Regulus公国统治家族仪仗队的一部分.

column1: Reinbak was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Reinbak是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Reinhardstein was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Reinhardstein于星际联盟时代、在统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Annexed by the Draconis Combine during the initial years of the Star League for its vast rubidium deposits.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年，因其丰富的如矿藏而被天龙联合体吞并.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era due to the vast germanium deposits under the polar ice caps.
column2: 星际联盟时代，恒星联邦因极地冰盖下储量巨大的锗矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

column1: Annexed by the Capellan Confederation during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 于星际联盟初期被卡佩拉邦联吞并.

column1: During the Star League era, Remagen was the site of the annual Remagen Rally, a military exercise for jump troops.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Remagen是一年一度的Remagen Rally的举办地，这是一项面向跳跃部队的军事演习.

column1: Remshield exports its vast mineral wealth from its capital city, aptly named 'Mineral City'
column2: 雷姆希尔德从其首府城市出口大量矿产财富，那座城市恰如其名，叫"矿城"。

column1: \"Habited\" the description in your star atlas says, and nothing more.  It seems like there should definitely be more information, but once you visit you'll understand.
column2: 你的星图上只写着“有人居住”，再无其他。看起来肯定该有更多信息，但你亲自去过就会明白。

column1: One of the original planets of the Taurian Concordat, Renfield has a deep purple nutrient-rich ocean that produces the raw materials for most of the planet's thriving industries. The residents are known for being particularly antisocial.
column2: 作为陶里安协约国的原始行星之一，伦菲尔德拥有一片深紫色、富含养分的海洋，为该行星大部分繁荣产业提供原材料。当地居民以格外不喜社交而闻名。

column1: Rennes was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rennes在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Renorsal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Renorsal在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Renown is a Terran paradise when the skies are clear, which unfortunately doesn't happen very often. The planet is subject to vast tornadoes and 'meteorologist' is an essential position in Renown's mostly-automated factories and farms.
column2: 天气晴朗时，雷农是一处类地天堂，可惜这并不常发生。该行星常遭巨型龙卷风侵袭，在雷农那些大多自动化的工厂与农场里，"气象员"是一个关键岗位。

column1: Renren was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Renren是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rentz is a habitable world with breathable atmosphere. The MacLean Valley on Rentz is a pleasant rural landscape with towns, extensive farms, and scattered grain silos as well as rivers, forests, and abandoned mine shafts.
column2: Rentz是一颗拥有可呼吸大气层的宜居星球. Rentz上的麦克莱恩谷是一片宜人的乡村景观，有城镇、广阔的农场、散落的谷物筒仓，以及河流、森林和废弃的矿井.

column1: Repulse is a lush agricultural world with valuable mining deposits accessed through vast gashes at the rocky poles. Despite the planetary resources, the population remains low due to an undesirable and mercurial climate.
column2: 里帕尔斯是一颗富饶的农业星球，通过这颗岩质星球两极的巨大裂缝，可以开采宝贵的矿藏. 尽管行星富有资源，但由于讨厌而多变的气候，人口仍然很少.

column1: Restitution was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Restitution是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The installation known as Rest Stop is located in the system in the Deep Periphery cataloged by the Star League as SLSC M9III.2855, the site of a Star League era Recharge Station thanks to the suns amazing potential.
column2: 被称为Rest Stop的设施位于深空外围中由星际联盟编目为SLSC M9III.2855 的星系，得益于这颗恒星惊人的潜力，这里曾是星际联盟时代一座充电站的所在地.

column1: Revel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Revel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Settled by colonists from the Lyran Commonwealth during the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立期间，由来自天琴共同体的殖民者定居.

column1: A small farming combine near the Marian Hegemony, Reykavis manages to eke out a good living from the harsh terrain.
column2: 作为马里安霸权附近的一个小型农业联合体，Reykavis在严酷的地形中勉强维持着不错的生计.

column1: The history of Rezak's Hole is intertwined with that of the pirate group known as the Band of the Damned, pirates that raid nearby Combine worlds with little regard for human life.
column2: 雷扎克洞穴的历史与一个叫"被诅咒者团"的海盗团体紧密交织，这些海盗劫掠联合体附近的星系，毫不顾惜人命。

column1: Rhodos (Runrig 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rhodos（Runrig 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗期间消亡了.

column1: Richmond is a pleasant and very habitable planet, with breathable atmosphere, forests and rivers.
column2: Richmond是一颗宜人且非常宜居的星球，拥有可呼吸的大气、森林和河流.

column1: Once a lush world, the initial colonists brought a pictovirus with them that ended up wiping all life off the planet - down to the smallest microbes. Now quarantined, Murrain is best left to its own devices.
column2: 这里曾是一个生机盎然的世界，但最初的殖民者带来了一种pictovirus，最终将这颗行星上的所有生命——直至最小的微生物——尽数抹除. 如今Murrain已被隔离，最好任其自生自灭.

column1: Richvale is a humid and hot world best known for the Quickscell Company plants on the surface
column2: Richvale是一个潮湿炎热的星球，以其地表上的Quickscell Company工厂而闻名.

column1: The lightly populated world of Ridgebrook is best known for the battles fought there during the Reunification War. The world's surface and orbital space are littered with military debris, making salvage one of the planet's major industries.
column2: 里奇布鲁克人口稀少，以其在统一战争中发生的战斗最为知名。该星球表面与轨道空间散落着军用残骸，使打捞成为该星球的主要产业之一。

column1: Riga is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, and trades many aquatic goods with nearby worlds.
column2: Riga是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一，并与附近星球交易许多水产货物.

column1: Previously called Alpha Centauri, Regil Kent or Rigil Kentarus was also one of the Prime or First Circuit A-Class Hyperpulse Generator stations of the SLCOMNET and ComStar HPG Network.  The only moon is called Riken Minor. Highest native life: Mammals.
column2: Regil Kent或Rigil Kentarus曾被称为Alpha Centauri，它也是SLCOMNET与ComStar HPG Network的首要或第一回路A级超脉冲发生器站之一. 唯一的卫星名为Riken Minor. 最高原生生命: 哺乳动物.

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #11 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned... Or was it?
column2: 边缘世界共和国第11号前哨站是边缘世界共和国在这个星系中建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃了……还是说，并没有？

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #11
column2: 边缘世界共和国前哨11号

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #27 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned, before being found by pirates who settled here.
column2: 边缘世界共和国Outpost#27 是该星系中由边缘世界共和国建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃，之后被海盗发现并在此定居.

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #4 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned... Or was it?
column2: 边缘世界共和国Outpost#4 是边缘世界共和国在这个星系中建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃了……还是说并非如此？

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #7 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned... Or was it?
column2: 边缘世界共和国7号前哨站是由边缘世界共和国在本星系建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃了……还是说，并没有？

column1: When first settled, Rio was a beautiful world covered in scenic valleys. With little to export, the world instead became known as a prime vacation spot, artists colony, and tri-vid production planet and one of the richest worlds in the Star League. Fierce nuclear bombardments throughout the Succession Wars have rendered the world dead.
column2: Rio最初被殖民时，是一颗美丽的星球，遍布风景如画的山谷. 由于可供出口的物产寥寥无几，这颗星球反而以顶级度假胜地、艺术家聚居地和三维视频制作星球闻名，并且是星际联盟中最富有的星球之一. 继承战争期间猛烈的核轰炸已使这颗星球彻底死寂.

column1: A recently discovered Star League cache has brought other visitors to this sleepy agricultural world.
column2: 最近发现的一处星际联盟秘密仓库给这个沉睡的农业世界带来了其他访客.

column1: Roadside was settled in the late 24th century to take advantage of the vast amounts of fertile soil. These vast plains were perfect for agricultural production of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Roadside于24世纪后期有人定居，以利用大量肥沃的土壤. 这些广袤的平原非常适合天琴共同体的农业生产.

column1: Originally settled during the Terran Exodus, Robinson became one of the 5 founding systems of the Federated Suns, and remains a key system to the Feds to this day.  It is home to the recently rebuilt Robinson Battle Academy.
column2: Robinson最初在泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，后来成为恒星联邦的5个创始星系之一，并且至今仍是联邦的重要星系. 这里也是最近重建的Robinson战斗学院的所在地.

column1: The site of the largest naval battle in the Reunification War, Robsart's orbital space is choked with debris even now. During its pacification, the SLDF used orbital bombardments against civilians, damaging the climate and killing a quarter million people.
column2: 作为统一战争期间最大规模海战的战场，罗布萨特的轨道空间至今仍被碎片堵塞。在其平定期间，SLDF对平民使用轨道轰炸，破坏了气候并杀死了二十五万人。

column1: Roche is a world located in the Kerensky Cluster in Clan space, and is the former capital of Clan Widowmaker.
column2: Roche是位于氏族空间的克伦斯基星团中的一颗行星，曾是寡妇制造者氏族的前首都.

column1: Rochelle is a rainy world with violent thunderstorms. It's industrial base was mostly destroyed during the Succession Wars, leaving the atmosphere poisoned.
column2: 罗谢尔是一颗多雨的世界，伴有猛烈的雷暴。它的工业基础在继承战争中大部分被摧毁，留下被毒化的大气。

column1: Rochers was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rochers在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rochester features wide plains full of arable land and pristine oceans. Unfortunately the soil and water also contain a series of trace elements that combine in Terran lifeforms to form poison, which led to the abandonment of the colony until technology was discovered during the Star League era which made the world habitable again.
column2: Rochester拥有广阔平原，遍布可耕地和原始海洋. 不幸的是，其土壤和水源中还含有多种微量元素，这些元素在地球生命体内结合后会形成毒素，导致殖民地被废弃，直到星际联盟时代发现了使该星球重新宜居的技术.

column1: Rockland is a small planet with large mountain range across the surface which gave it its name. Most of its population is concentrated on the southern continent called Granite, which is where the capital city is. The northern continent, Limerock, has numerous spread-out settlements concentrated on mining and quarrying.
column2: Rockland是一颗小型行星，表面横亘着巨大的山脉，这也正是其名字的由来. 它的大部分人口集中在名为Granite的南部大陆，首府也位于那里. 北部大陆Limerock拥有众多分散的定居点，主要集中在采矿和采石业.

column1: Formerly a Magistracy world, Rockwellawan has found new life as an independent mining colony. During the abortive Taurian-Canopian War, the Taurians landed on the planet, but were unable to decisively engage the Magistracy.
column2: 罗克韦拉万过去是颗自治区星球，它已经找到了以独立矿业殖民地为生的新生活方式. 在流产的金牛-船底战争中，金牛人登上了这颗星球，但却没能果断地与自治区交战.

column1: Rocky was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rocky在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立期间，由天琴共同体殖民定居.

column1: Annexed by the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年被自由世界联盟吞并.

column1: Temperate Rollis is the source of a rare and highly valued variety of wood, and, consequentially, a busy black market. It also serves as a jumping-off point for those planning an adventurous journey into the Periphery.
column2: 温暖的罗利斯是一种稀有且非常珍贵的树种来源地，因此，这里是个繁忙的黑市. 对于那些计划冒险进入外围的人来说，这里也是一个起点.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年，由自由世界联盟殖民定居.

column1: The home of the Romulans, pointy eared ali%%%. ERROR. Holovid database corrupted.
column2: 罗慕伦人的家园，尖耳朵的外星人%%%. 错误. 全息视频数据库已损坏.

column1: The weak soils on Rondane make agriculture difficult, and starvation is commonplace.
column2: Rondane上贫瘠的土壤使农业难以发展，饥荒司空见惯.

column1: Rondon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rondon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ronel is an inhospitable world located close to its parent star. Though it possesses significant mineral wealth, the planet was never settled properly. Instead mining companies assigns workers to multi-year contracts on the world and then rotates them off-world
column2: Ronel是一颗不宜居的星球，距离其母恒星很近. 尽管它拥有可观的矿产财富，这颗星球却从未被真正定居. 相反，矿业公司会以多年期合约将工人派驻该星球，随后再将他们轮换到星球之外.

column1: A young and geologically active world, Rosamond joined the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star league.
column2: 一个年轻且地质活跃的世界，Rosamond在星际联盟成立期间加入了恒星联邦.

column1: Roscoff was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Roscoff于统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Rosendal was a cold but habitable world when it was settled just after the Reunification War, but the same instability that produced its magnificent rings slowly shifted its orbit until the planet was glacier-bound and howling ice storms swept its surface.
column2: 统一战争之后就被殖民的鲁森达尔那时是个寒冷但适宜居住的星球，但造就其壮丽星环的不稳定性同样慢慢偏移了它的轨道，直到这颗行星被冰川裹住，咆哮的冰风暴席卷了它的表面.

column1: Settled by colonists from the Federated Suns during the Star League era. It was named after a local tree with viscous thorns.
column2: 星际联盟时代，来自恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居. 它得名于当地一种长有黏性尖刺的树木.

column1: Rosetta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rosetta在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by colonists from the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星盟建立期间，来自恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居.

column1: After its rediscovery by Interstellar Expeditions during their exploration of the region, Rover has evidently been the subject of some kind of experiment conducted by the Star League due to the vast network of satellites in orbit.
column2: 在星际探险公司探索该区域期间重新发现Rover后，由于轨道上庞大的卫星网络，Rover显然曾是星际联盟进行的某种实验的对象.

column1: Settled by colonists from Croatia during the Exodus from Terra, Rowe joined the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，来自克罗地亚的殖民者定居于Rowe；在星际联盟成立前的数年间，Rowe加入了恒星联邦.

column1: Royal was one of the worlds engulfed in conflict during what became known variously as the Second Hidden War of the Star League era, also known as the War of Davion Succession. DCMS infantry forces captured the First Prince, pulling him from his cockpit, forcing him to kneel and then beheading him.
column2: Royal是星际联盟时代后来以不同名称闻名的那场冲突——即第二次隐秘战争，也被称为戴维恩继承战争——中卷入战火的星球之一. DCMS步兵部队俘获了第一王子，将他从驾驶舱中拖出，强迫他跪下，然后将他斩首.

column1: The headquarters of Foxx Infantry Systems, Royal Foxx has three continents named Vixen, Skulk, and Waagosh. The capital city of Reynard is located on Vixen.
column2: Foxx Infantry Systems的总部所在地Royal Foxx拥有三块大陆，分别名为Vixen、Skulk和Waagosh. 首府城市Reynard位于Vixen.

column1: Royalston was an important trading world within the St. Ives Mercantile League  thanks to numerous jump points within easy reach of the planet.
column2: 得益于该行星近旁众多易于抵达的跃迁点，Royalston曾是圣艾夫斯商业联盟内的重要贸易世界.

column1: Rubigen is a small, dark, and cold world with over half of its surface locked away under ice. Over 15% of the admiralty of the Draconis Combine comes from Rubigen, proving the addage that tough times create tough people.
column2: Rubigen是一个微小、昏暗且寒冷的世界，其表面超过一半被冰封. 天龙联合体超过15%的海军将领都来自Rubigen，这印证了那句老话: 艰难岁月造就坚韧之人.

column1: Michaelson Heavy Industries is headquartered on Ruchbah, and is the main source of income for the world.
column2: 迈克尔森重工业总部位于Ruchbah，是该行星的主要收入来源.

column1: Settled by the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era, this quiet world avoids attention for the most part.
column2: 在星际联盟时代由外空联盟殖民定居，这个宁静的世界大多数时候都不引人注意.

column1: Rukbat is a poisoned jewel of a world. Despite the abundant plant and animal life, the vast mineral resources, and a climate much like Terras, the environment is totally incompatible with human and Terran lifeforms.
column2: Rukbat是一颗如毒宝石般的世界. 尽管拥有丰富的动植物生命、储量巨大的矿产资源以及与地球十分相似的气候，但其环境与人类和地球生命形式完全不相容.

column1: Ruschegg once rebelled against the Free Worlds League, but mercy granted by Marion Marik has ensured that the population is now fiercely loyal.
column2: Ruschegg曾反抗自由世界联盟，但玛丽昂·马里克赐予的仁慈确保了当地民众如今忠心耿耿.

column1: Rushaven didn't attract significant attention from the Star League and Draconis Combine forces during Operation UNION HOLD.
column2: 在联合控制行动期间，拉什黑文并未引起星盟与龙尼斯联合体部队的太多注意。

column1: A hot, arid world with a single, shallow, briny sea, Ryans Fate survives on flood farming in the brief rainy seasons, and mining high-quality crystals and fissionable materials from the extensive caverns that honeycomb the planet's surface.
column2: Ryans Fate 是一颗炎热干旱的世界，只有一片浅而咸的海域。它依靠短暂雨季中的漫灌农作，以及从遍布地表的广阔洞穴中开采高品质晶体与裂变材料来维持生存。

column1: Ryans Fate
column2: 瑞安斯菲特

column1: Ryde is a cold world with a great deal of volcanic activity. It is an important manufacturer of pharmaceuticals, water purifiers, and chemicals (including explosives) and therefore enjoys a permanent defensive garrison of Lyran 'Mech Regiments.
column2: 赖德是一颗寒冷而火山活动频繁的星球。它是重要的药品、净水器与化学品（包括炸药）制造地，因此常年驻有莱兰机甲团作为防御卫守。

column1: Most of Ryerson's lowlands are taken up by a single massive megacity, carefully planned in the reconstruction following the Second Succession War. Industrial centers in the highlands supply raw materials to the factories at the outskirts of the city.
column2: 赖尔森的洼地大部分被一座巨大的超级都市占据，这座城市是在第二次继承战争后重建时精心规划的。高地上的工业中心为城市郊区的工厂供应原材料。

column1: Rypful was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rypful是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rzhishchev was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Free Worlds League over three centuries later.
column2: Rzhishchev在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间由殖民者建立，之后一直顽强地保持独立，直到三百多年后最终加入自由世界联盟.

column1: Saaremaa was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
column2: Saaremaa是在从泰拉大出走期间由殖民者拓殖的，并一直是Galedon联盟的一部分，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

column1: Gold is only one of the precious metals found here, and the other rare metals, minerals, and gems, as well as the more common metal ores, make Sabinillas a valuable resource center. Sabanillas Mining Company has an almost mafia like grip on the government.
column2: 黄金只是这里发现的贵金属之一，而其他稀有金属、矿物和宝石，以及更常见的金属矿石，使Sabinillas成为一个宝贵的资源中心. Sabanillas Mining Company对政府有着近乎黑手党般的控制.

column1: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Sabik is a sparsely populated desert world in a strategically important location. While there are some profitable mining operations on the planet, most of the small population exists to support the garrisoned 11th Lyran Regulars.
column2: Sabik是一颗人口稀少的沙漠世界，地处具有战略重要性的位置. 虽然星球上有一些有利可图的采矿作业，但这里稀少人口中的大多数都是为了支持驻守于此的第11天琴正规军而存在.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the green rolling hills of Sackville are known for producing pipeweed and Bagginses.
column2: 在星际联盟时代有人定居，Sackville的翠绿起伏丘陵以出产烟斗草和巴金斯家族而闻名.

column1: This subterranean colony is excavated into a barren rocky planet. It serves as a critical shipping and travel link between the Aurigan region and the Magistracy. Trade, both legal and otherwise, thrives here.
column2: 这片地下殖民地挖入了一颗贫瘠的岩质行星. 它是御夫座地区和自治区之间重要的运输与航行纽带. 无论是合法的贸易还是其它的贸易，都在这里蓬勃发展.

column1: Most of Sadachbia's inhabitants live along the large islands scattered through the northernmost ocean for the simple reason that the most of the inland areas are harsh deserts.
column2: 萨达奇比亚的大多数居民生活在散布于最北部海洋中的大岛沿岸，原因很简单：大部分内陆地区都是严酷的沙漠。

column1: Sadalbari is a mostly tropical world; most of the two major continents, Aberlani and Beth'lamel, and the island continent of New Kenya are covered with rainforests and jungles.
column2: 萨达尔巴里主要是一颗热带行星；两大主要大陆阿贝拉尼和贝斯拉梅尔，以及岛屿大陆新肯尼亚，都覆盖着雨林与丛林。

column1: The agricultural world of Sadurni once served as the HQ of the SLDF 7th Army. Since then it has traded hands between Liao and Marik several times. The small population is spread out in rambling rural villages and cities, serving the surrounding farms.
column2: 农业星球萨杜尔尼曾是星际联盟防卫军第7集团军的总部. 自那以后它在廖氏和马里克之间易手了好几次. 少量的人口分散在杂乱的乡村和城市里，为周边的农场干活.

column1: Safe Port was an important trading world within the St. Ives Mercantile League  thanks to numerous jump points within easy reach of the planet.
column2: Safe Port是圣艾夫斯商业联盟内一个重要的贸易世界，这得益于该行星附近有众多易于抵达的跃迁点.

column1: Saffel is an arctic world along the Davion/Kurita border. Both a common target and staging area for attacks between the two nations, Staffel was only just seized by the Kuritans in 3039.
column2: 萨菲尔是戴维恩与库瑞塔边界上的一颗极寒星球。它既是两国之间攻击的常见目标也是集结地，3039年刚被库瑞塔人夺取。

column1: Discovered by an eagle eyed private citizen as part of the OBT movement, Saggina is a long way from anywhere.
column2: 作为OBT运动的一部分，Saggina是由一位目光敏锐的普通公民发现的，它地处偏远，离哪里都不近.

column1: Saginaw was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Saginaw是由殖民者在从泰拉向外大迁徙期间建立的，并且一直保持着强烈的独立倾向，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: Saidia is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. Like most Axumite worlds, it survives on a late 20th Century technological level, with limited access to technology for most of the population.
column2: Saidia是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一个殖民世界. 与大多数阿克苏姆世界一样，它维持着20世纪后期的科技水平，大多数人口获取技术的机会有限.

column1: The headquarters of Sitwell Corporation, the main competitor to Bluth Corporation.
column2: Sitwell Corporation的总部，Bluth Corporation的主要竞争对手.

column1: An independent world for centuries until annexed by the Draconis Combine. During the final years of the Star League, Sakai was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 数个世纪以来，它一直是一颗独立星球，直到被天龙联合体吞并. 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Sakai曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: The icy world of Sakhalin was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Sarna Supremacy prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation
column2: 冰封星球Sakhalin在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前是萨尔纳霸权的一员.

column1: Sakhalin marks one edge of the area of space within which the interstellar trade company Skye Traders was the dominant commercial interest, and was once host to an SLDF Garrison.
column2: Sakhalin标出了星际贸易公司Skye Traders曾占据主导商业利益的那片空间区域的一侧边缘，并且曾是一支SLDF驻军的驻地.

column1: Sakhara V was originally settled for its wide variety of rare earth metals. The harsh local terrain, mostly desert, also serves as a demanding training environment. With that in mind, the Sakhara Academy was established here.
column2: Sakhara V最初因拥有种类繁多的稀土金属而被殖民. 当地严酷的地形，多为沙漠，也可作为要求严苛的训练环境. 有鉴于此，Sakhara Academy在此建立.

column1: Sakuranoki was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
column2: Sakuranoki是在泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居的，曾隶属于加勒顿联盟，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

column1: Once a minor travel hub, this system was quarantined due to an incurable, disfiguring viral plague. The moons serve as bases for pirate activity, but the status of the population on the surface is unknown.
column2: 这个星系曾经是一个小型航行枢纽，由于一种可致毁容，无药可救的病毒性疫情而遭隔离. 它的卫星群是海盗活动的基地，但地表的人口状况不详.

column1: Salem is the location of a significant percentage of the defense manufacturing that supplies the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns.
column2: Salem是相当大一部分为恒星联邦武装部队提供补给的国防制造业所在地.

column1: Home to the University of Salford, its lessons focus more on practical applications than theory.
column2: 作为Salford大学的所在地，该校的课程更注重实际应用而非理论.

column1: Salisberg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Salisberg是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Salonika is a fleet base stationed at the Nadir jump point of an A4V star in the Deep Periphery. Located near Ctesiphon and Suda Bay, Salonika was operated by Clan Nova Cat during Operation Revival.
column2: Salonika是深空外围中一颗A4V型恒星天底跃迁点处的一处舰队基地. Salonika位于Ctesiphon和Suda Bay附近，在复兴行动期间由新猫氏族运作.

column1: During the Star League era both Saltillo and the nearby Millungera system were jointly administered by the Free Worlds League and the Star League, which sparked conflict.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Saltillo和附近的Millungera星系均由自由世界联盟与星际联盟共同管理，这引发了冲突.

column1: Saltural was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Saltural在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Saltville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Saltville是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Federation of Oriente during the initial years after the Exodus from Terra.
column2: 由Oriente联邦在从泰拉出走后的最初几年建立定居点.

column1: Salvende was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Salvende在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of the founding planets of the Taurian Concordat, Samantha is a large planet where cold-weather entertainment thrives and a broad range of manufacturing industries benefit from the low temperatures.
column2: 萨曼莎是金牛协约国的创始行星之一，是一颗大行星，在那儿，适于寒冷天气的娱乐产业蓬勃发展，许多制造业也受益于低温环境.

column1: San Carlos was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: San Carlos在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sanda was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
column2: Sanda是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者建立定居点的，并一直是加勒登联盟的一部分，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

column1: Sanilac was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Sanilac在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间由殖民者建立，并在之后一直顽强保持独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: Santa-Ana was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Santa-Ana在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的交战中消亡了.

column1: Santiago IV is a surface garrison located in the Deep Periphery, near Kinbrace and Ramsey. During Operation Revival, Santiago IV was controlled by Clan Jade Falcon.
column2: Santiago IV是位于深空外围、靠近Kinbrace和Ramsey的一支地表驻军. 在复兴行动期间，Santiago IV由翡翠猎鹰氏族控制.

column1: Santander is also known as Santander's World. The infamous pirate Helmar Valasek is believed to launch operations from this planet.
column2: 桑坦德也被称为桑坦德世界。臭名昭著的海盗赫尔马·瓦拉塞克据信就是从这颗行星发起行动的。

column1: Santiago IV is a surface garrison located in the Deep Periphery, near Kinbrace and Ramsey.
column2: Santiago IV是位于深空外围、靠近Kinbrace和Ramsey的地表驻防部队.

column1: Santiago (OA) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Santiago (OA) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Sanurcha (Ildrong 2750+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sanurcha（Ildrong 2750+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Sanurcha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sanurcha在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱期间消亡了.

column1: The Saonara system was home to a military outpost prior to the Reunification War, and became a colony world after the end of the War.
column2: Saonara星系在统一战争之前曾是一座军事前哨站的所在地，战争结束后则成为了一个殖民世界.

column1: Sapienza was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Sapienza原本是边缘世界共和国Timbuktu行省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Sappho was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sappho是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年间，由天琴共同体建立定居点.

column1: Sardis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sardis在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Sargasso was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Sargasso曾驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支卫守部队.

column1: Colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic before the era of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟时代之前由边缘世界共和国殖民.

column1: Sarkel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sarkel在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: An industrialised world of grasslands and forests, Sarmaxa exports many products across the Inner Sphere thanks to the Tao 'Mechworks facility.
column2: 作为一颗拥有草原与森林的工业化世界，萨尔马克萨凭借陶氏机甲厂向整个内天体出口众多产品。

column1: Sarna has a dense population spread across seven mountainous heavily industrialized continents. The other seventy percent of the planet is deep saltwater oceans.
column2: Sarna拥有稠密的人口，分布在七个多山且高度工业化的大陆上. 这颗行星其余百分之七十是深邃的咸水海洋.

column1: After the original Terran colony was violently destroyed during the Age of War, the Star League tried to re-establish a functioning colony here with marginal success.
column2: 在战争时代，最初的泰拉殖民地被暴力摧毁后，星际联盟曾试图在此重建一个能正常运作的殖民地，但收效甚微.

column1: Sartu (Bastille 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sartu (Bastille 3130+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Covered in wide volcanic plains and plagued by storms, Satalice still has enough oases of beauty to support a moderate-sized population and even a 'Mech production plant.
column2: 萨塔利斯遍布广阔的火山平原，又饱受风暴困扰，但仍有足够多的美丽绿洲，足以支撑一个中等规模的人口，甚至还有一座机甲生产厂。

column1: Sauk City was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Sauk City是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居建立的，并一直保持强烈的独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: Saumur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Saumur是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Saunemin was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Saunemin是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居的，并一直保持着强烈的独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: The major manufacturer on Savannah is Technicron Manufacturing, which is one of the medium sized military hardware manufacturers in the Free Worlds League, producing both a smattering of BattleMechs as well as JumpShips and WarShips.
column2: Savannah上的主要制造商是Technicron Manufacturing，它是自由世界联盟中一家中型军用硬件制造商，既生产少量战斗机甲，也生产跃迁舰和战舰.

column1: Savinsville is best known for the behavior of its satellites. Every thirty three years Schlera, Iris and Pupil (the moons) line up in the sky in such a way that they resemble a human eye. Luthien Armor Works built a factory on this world, which led to the population expanding quickly.
column2: Savinsville最出名的是其卫星的运行方式. 每隔三十三年，Schlera、Iris和Pupil（这三颗卫星）便会在天空中排成一线，看起来就像一只人眼. Luthien Armor Works在这颗星球上建造了一座工厂，这使得人口迅速增长.

column1: Savonburg is home to the Colleges of Savonburg, which educate millions of students every year. Recently, mysterious drop ships have been reported landing in the uninhabited continent of Solestra, with rumours abounding as to their purpose ranging from time travel experiments to alien invasion.
column2: Savonburg是Savonburg学院的所在地，这些学院每年培养数百万学生. 最近，据报道有神秘降落飞船降落在无人居住的索莱斯特拉大陆上，关于其目的的谣言四起，从时间旅行实验到外星入侵，不一而足.

column1: Settled during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立初期被开拓定居.

column1: An ancient water world dotted with thousands of island chains, Sax is the home of a Liao training facility as well as several specialized research campuses that rely on the planet's tectonic stability.
column2: 萨克是一颗古老的水世界，散布着数千个岛链。它既是廖氏一处训练设施所在地，也是若干依赖该星球地壳稳定性的专业研究园区所在地。

column1: Scarborough Licensing PLC is all that remains of Scarborough Manufacturing, a once massive manufacturing complex that was destroyed centuries ago in the First Succession War.
column2: Scarborough Licensing PLC是Scarborough Manufacturing仅存的一切，后者曾是一个庞大的制造综合体，于数百年前的第一次继承战争中遭到摧毁.

column1: Scheat has basic metal ores in its crust and rich fertile soil, and is known for exporting iron, aluminium, lumber and textiles.
column2: Scheat的地壳中蕴藏着基础金属矿石，并拥有肥沃的土壤，以出口铁、铝、木材和纺织品而闻名.

column1: Schedar was settled for its mineral resources. These minerals are key ingredients in semiconductors, and the harsh desert environment minimizes the incoming settlers.
column2: Schedar因其矿产资源而被殖民. 这些矿物是半导体的关键成分，而严酷的沙漠环境使迁入的定居者数量极少.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League due to its easily accessible petroleum deposits.
column2: 星盟时期，自由世界联盟因其易于开采的石油矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

column1: Scheurheck once rebelled against the Free Worlds League, but mercy granted by Marion Marik has ensured that the population of Schuerheck is now fiercely loyal.
column2: Scheurheck曾反抗自由世界联盟，但马里昂·马里克赐予的仁慈确保了Schuerheck的民众如今极为忠诚.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League due to its easily accessible gemstone deposits.
column2: 在星际联盟时期，自由世界联盟因其易于开采的宝石矿藏而在此定居.

column1: Schirmeck is a world with little industry, but is relatively self sufficient thanks to abundant agriculture and lumber.
column2: Schirmeck是一个工业寥寥的世界，但由于农业和木材资源丰富，相对而言能够自给自足.

column1: Schmitt was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Schmitt在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Schrim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Schrim在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dharma HyperSpace operates one of the last JumpShip facilities in the Inner Sphere in this system, with numerous other industries propped up by the vast mineral requirements.
column2: Dharma HyperSpace在该星系运营着内天体最后一批跃迁舰设施之一，而庞大的矿物需求也支撑着众多其他产业.

column1: The capital city of Schwartztadt lies near to the Komache Fields, a vast empty plain suitable for pastoral farming.
column2: Schwartztadt的都城位于Komache Fields附近，那是一片适合畜牧的广阔空旷平原.

column1: The forested world of Scituate was originally settled by the St Ives Mercantile League thanks to its many warp points.
column2: 森林覆盖的Scituate星球最初由圣艾夫斯商业联盟殖民，这得益于其众多的跃迁点.

column1: Prior to the fall of the Star League, Scudder was a lightly-populated world rich in germanium. Multiple mining sites were scattered over the world's four large continents. The germanium mined on this world was used in the construction of K-F drives in dozens of shipyards.
column2: 在星际联盟崩塌之前，斯卡德是一颗人口稀少、富含锗的星球。多处矿点散布在该星球的四块大陆上。这里开采的锗被用于在数十家船厂建造K-F驱动器。

column1: Sebha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sebha在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Second Chance is still littered with battle debris centuries after the First Succession War, where numerous drop ships and war ships were brought down over the surface.
column2: 第一次继承战争过去数百年后，Second Chance上仍散落着战斗残骸，当年大量降落船和战舰被击落在其表面.

column1: After the initial colony landing site was destroyed in an earthquake, the colonists moved to a new one and renamed their planet Second Try.
column2: 最初的殖民地登陆点在地震中被摧毁后，殖民者迁往了一处新地点，并将他们的行星更名为Second Try.

column1: Segerica was a Capellan industrial world, with extensive manufacturing facilities tucked into its planet-wide canyon systems. These facilities were the target of orbital nuclear strikes from the Free Worlds League, and the planet has been an empty wasteland since.
column2: 塞格利卡曾经是卡佩拉人的工业星球，遍布全球的峡谷中藏着大量的制造设施. 这些设施成了自由世界联盟轨道核打击的目标，自那以后整颗星球就变成了一片荒芜的废土.

column1: Seginus is a planet in slow decline. Bad weather paired with a long in system transit time has led to trade with the planet declining over time, although the long travel times also keeps the planet peaceful as it dissuades most raiders.
column2: Seginus是一颗正在缓慢衰落的行星. 恶劣的天气，再加上漫长的星系内航行时间，使得与该行星的贸易逐渐衰退；不过，漫长的旅途时间也让这颗行星保持安宁，因为这吓退了大多数劫掠者.

column1: Seiduts is described as being a rocky world, sparsely populated, with forests and jungles around the equator.
column2: Seiduts被描述为一个岩石世界，人口稀少，赤道周围分布着森林和丛林.

column1: Sekulmun is described as being a beautiful world, sparsely populated, with volcanoes around the equator.
column2: Sekulmun被描述为一个美丽的星球，人口稀少，赤道周围分布着火山.

column1: The dangerously high temperatures on Semenyih are just one of the dangers the miners here face.
column2: Semenyih上危险的高温只是这里的矿工面临的危险之一.

column1: The ice plains of Semichi are inhospitable to most life, but are home to a breed of bear similar to a terrestrial Kodiak.
column2: Semichi的冰原对大多数生命而言都不适宜生存，但这里却栖息着一种类似地球科迪亚克熊的熊类.

column1: Sendai was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sendai在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sendalor's inland forests are home to the Manx Treecat, a rare delicacy that is only found on this world.
column2: 森达洛尔的内陆森林是曼克斯树猫的家园，这是一种只在本行星才能找到的稀有珍馐。

column1: Senftenberg's industrial base in the Cavez Valley was destroyed during the Second Succession War, which thankfully spared most of the populace.
column2: 森夫滕贝格在卡韦兹谷的工业基地在第二次继承战争中遭到摧毁，所幸大多数平民得以幸免。

column1: Senorbi was used centuries ago as a staging post during the Reunification War, which has led many treasure hunters to the surface to look for caches.
column2: Senorbi在几个世纪前曾被用作统一战争期间的中转站，这使得许多寻宝者前往其地表寻找储藏点.

column1: Sentarus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sentarus是在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Serenity was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Serenity在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: Apart from a few frozen lakes and rivers, Sertar is dry. Basins of red dust exist where oceans should be.
column2: 除了少数冰封的湖泊与河流外，Sertar十分干燥. 在本该是海洋的地方，分布着红色尘土的盆地.

column1: The planet Setubal is a desert world with very hot equatorial zones. Human habitation is only possible in the polar regions with their tropical and subtropical climate. Settled for its abundant subterranean water supplies, Setubal features extensive cave systems which are used to grow edible fungi.
column2: Setubal行星是一个沙漠世界，赤道地区极其炎热. 人类只可能在拥有热带和亚热带气候的极地地区居住. 由于拥有丰富的地下水源而在此定居，Setubal拥有庞大的洞穴系统，这些洞穴被用于种植食用真菌.

column1: Seuta Bimyeong was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Seuta Bimyeong于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Seven Lands (Garotte 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Seven Lands (Garotte 3130+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sevon - is a lightly-populated and lightly industrialized world with a single moon. A mutual distrust of outsiders is common across the world, due to the devastation caused to their world during the Succession Wars.
column2: Sevon——是一颗人口稀少、工业化程度较低、拥有一颗卫星的星球. 由于在继承战争期间他们的星球所遭受的破坏，整个星球普遍对外来者怀有共同的不信任.

column1: The presence of radioactive materials within the crust of Sevren support the burgeoning industrial base, which offers power plants to numerous worlds across the Inner Sphere
column2: Sevren地壳中放射性物质的存在支撑着其蓬勃发展的工业基础，该工业基础为内天体的众多世界提供发电厂.

column1: Shadow is a large moon orbiting a gas giant. The system's sun is only a slightly larger star in Shadow's dark sky which is dominated by the gas giant. The world is in twilight most of the time, with no discernible day-night-cycle.
column2: 暗影是一颗环绕气态巨行星的大型卫星。该星系的太阳在暗影黑暗的天空中只是一个略大的恒星，天幕由那颗气态巨行星主宰。该世界大部分时间处于暮光之中，没有可辨识的昼夜循环。

column1: Placed deep in the Deep Periphery astrogeographical feature known as the Orion Rift, the installation known colloquially as Shady Palms is located within the asteroid belt around the the yellow-white super giant star catalogued as SLSC F81a.0086.
column2: 位于被称为Orion Rift的深空外围天文地理特征深处，俗称Shady Palms的设施坐落在编号为SLSC F81a.0086 的黄白色超巨星周围的小行星带内.

column1: One of the only Axumite Providence worlds with the resources to maintain an industrial fusion power plants, Shahhat is at roughly mid 21st century levels of technology.
column2: 作为仅有的几个拥有维持工业聚变发电厂所需资源的阿克苏姆天命国世界之一，Shahhat的技术水平大致处于21世纪中叶.

column1: The forested moon of Shahr Kord was originally settled by the Rim Worlds Republic.
column2: Shahr Kord的森林卫星最初由边缘世界共和国拓殖.

column1: Shalaine was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shalaine在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Shardayne was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shardayne在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Sharpe vanished from maps during the Third Succession War, but the Argo still contains its location. I wonder what is there?
column2: Sharpe在第三次继承战争期间从星图上消失了，但阿尔戈号仍然存有它的位置. 我想知道那里有什么？

column1: Sharqah was once the base for an SLDF Division. After they left, the world's most notable feature was a series of religious retreats and pilgrimage sites in the world's craggy mountains.
column2: 沙尔卡曾是某支SLDF师的基地。他们离开之后，该世界最引人注目之处就是其嶙峋群山间的一系列宗教静修所与朝圣地点。

column1: Settled by colonists from South America during the Exodus from Terra. Shasta is home to large amounts of native wildlife such as the Skatha Ape, Agouti Rat and Lute Shrike.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，来自南美洲的殖民者在此定居. Shasta是大量本土野生动物的家园，例如斯卡萨猿、刺豚鼠和鲁特伯劳.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Shaul Khala was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Shaul Khala曾驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

column1: Shaul Khala
column2: 绍尔哈拉

column1: Shaun (Burl 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shaun（Burl 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The population of Shaunavon is mostly confined to domes and subterranean facilities. Deep fissures in the crust allow miners to reach rare earth minerals, and the planet's economy is built around their extraction.
column2: 肖纳文的人口大多局限于穹顶与地下设施中。地壳深处的裂隙让矿工能够触及稀土矿物，该行星的经济便建立在其开采之上。

column1: Iroquois Machinery Limited is the primary exporter of goods from Shawnee, a heavily industrialised world.
column2: 易洛魁机械有限公司是Shawnee所产商品的主要出口商，Shawnee是一个高度工业化的星球.

column1: Sheliak is a minor planet with few resources, and very little garrison.
column2: Sheliak是一颗资源匮乏、驻军极少的次要行星.

column1: Shensi is a Earth-like world, which is most notable for its extensive forestry and mineral reserves. It has three continents (Klondike, Mongot and Kungara), which are extensively forested.
column2: Shensi是一颗类地星球，以其广阔的森林和矿产资源而闻名. 它有三块大陆（克朗代克、蒙戈特和昆加拉），上面森林广布.

column1: Shenwan's inland seas are home to the Manx Kipper, a rare delicacy that is only found on this world.
column2: 神湾的内海是曼克斯腌鱼的家园，这是一种只在本行星才能找到的稀有珍馐。

column1: Sheratan is described as being a beautiful world, sparsely populated, with forests and jungles around the equator.
column2: Sheratan被描述为一个美丽的星球，人口稀少，赤道周围有森林和丛林.

column1: Sheridan contains many ores that are considered rare within the Inner Sphere, making it an ideal world for manufacturing and industry.
column2: Sheridan蕴藏着许多在内天体被视为稀有的矿石，使其成为制造业和工业的理想世界.

column1: Dense jungles of light purple fungal towers cover Sheridan, with kilometers of large plateaus with steep sides breaking through the glowing canopy.
column2: Sheridan被茂密的浅紫色真菌塔丛林覆盖，绵延数公里、边缘陡峭的大型高原穿透了发光的林冠.

column1: Sherwood is one of those worlds that was eminently suitable for human colonisation without the need for terraforming, with a flourishing ecology that features towering, tree-like plants that reach heights of more than 100 metres.
column2: Sherwood是那些极其适合人类殖民、无需地球化改造的世界之一，其繁茂的生态系统以高逾100米的参天树状植物为特色.

column1: The hot, dry, high-gravity world of Shiba is a center for mining and manufacturing, and its two billion inhabitants live in an endless urban sprawl that surrounds the factories that drive the world's economy.
column2: 炎热干燥的高重力世界希瓦是采矿与制造中心，其二十亿居民生活在无边无际的城市蔓延之中，环绕着驱动该世界经济的工厂。

column1: Shibukawa is the world where Cholobara grows, a fruit from which a potent and valuable but perishable aphrodisiac wine can be made.
column2: Shibukawa是Cholobara生长的世界，这种水果可以酿成一种强效、珍贵但不耐储存的催情酒.

column1: Shiloh is an unappealing planet, inhabited almost entirely by a splinter religious group known as the Exituri. The Exituri shun interstellar politics and advanced technology, and so Shiloh has remained an unimportant and barely inhabited world.
column2: Shiloh是一颗不讨喜的行星，居民几乎全是被称为Exituri的一个分裂宗教团体. Exituri回避星际政治和先进技术，因此Shiloh一直是一个无足轻重且几乎无人居住的世界.

column1: Shimoda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shimoda在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Shimonita possesses a single large industrialised continent surrounded by islands. The surrounding ocean is constantly whipped into a frenzy by massive storm activity that perpetually forms in Shimonita's atmosphere.
column2: 下仁田拥有一块被岛屿环绕的大型工业化大陆。周围海洋因该行星大气中永久形成的猛烈风暴而不断翻腾激荡。

column1: Transport pilots tell stories about the horrific winds over Shimonoseki which have wrecked numerous dropships.
column2: 运输飞行员们讲述着Shimonoseki上空的可怕狂风，这些狂风已经摧毁了许多降落飞船.

column1: Shimosuwa was conquered by the Draconis Combine during the First Succession War, which resulted in massive civilian casualties and an end to the industrial base on the planet.
column2: 在第一次继承战争期间，Shimosuwa被天龙联合征服，导致大量平民伤亡，并终结了该行星上的工业基础.

column1: Shinonoi has a long, mild growing season, fertile land and ample native livestock, which continues to this day. Great mineral wealth was found during the Star League era which further boosted its economy.
column2: Shinonoi拥有漫长而温和的生长季、肥沃的土地和丰富的本土牲畜，这些优势延续至今. 星际联盟时代发现了大量矿产资源，进一步推动了其经济发展.

column1: Shionoha is a quiet, industrialised world that has slightly too much nitrogen in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators for long periods outside.
column2: Shionoha是一个宁静的工业化世界，其大气中的氮气含量略高于人类舒适范围，长时间在户外需要服用特殊药物或佩戴呼吸器.

column1: Shipka was discovered by traders under the command of Captain Phillip Shipka out of St. Andre who were trying to reach Highspire. After exploring the system they discovered that the world was rich in natural resources and possessed abundant fresh water.
column2: Shipka是由来自St. Andre、试图抵达Highspire的商人发现的，他们由Phillip Shipka上尉指挥. 在探索该星系后，他们发现这颗星球自然资源丰富，并拥有充足的淡水.

column1: Shipton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shipton是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Shira was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shira在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Shiri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shiri在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: As one of the first colonised worlds, Shiro is a heavily industrialised world with major factories of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited and Grumman Amalgamated producing massive quantities of material.
column2: 作为最早被殖民的星球之一，Shiro是一个高度工业化的世界，拥有Irian BattleMechs Unlimited和Grumman Amalgamated的大型工厂，生产着大量物资.

column1: Brusk, Massona and Meijer are the trio of cities that make up the Triumverate government of Shirotori.
column2: Brusk、Massona和Meijer是组成Shirotori三城执政政府的三座城市.

column1: Shitara's inhospitable desert like surface was originally settled not for agricultural or manufacturing reasons, but to serve as a regional transportation hub. With access to many star systems, Shitara is now a wealthy waystation and refueling point for expeditions into the further reaches of the Inner Sphere.
column2: 设田那不宜居住的沙漠般地表最初被殖民，并非出于农业或制造的原因，而是要充当区域交通枢纽。由于能通往众多星系，设田如今是一个富裕的中转站与补给点，供深入内天体更远地区探险者使用。

column1: Shoreham has vast mudflats that criss cross its continents.
column2: Shoreham拥有广阔的泥滩，纵横交错贯穿其大陆.

column1: Sighisoara has vast fungal growths that criss cross its continents, used for chemical and medicinal purposes.
column2: Sighisoara拥有广袤的真菌群落，纵横交错地遍布其各大洲，被用于化学和医药用途.

column1: The planet Shuen Wan is the homeworld of the Kincha fruit, a delicacy that resists all attempts to grow it on other worlds.
column2: Shuen Wan行星是Kincha果实的母星，这种美味佳肴无法在其他任何世界种植，所有尝试均告失败.

column1: Shui-pào was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shui-pào是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sialkot was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sialkot在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sian is the modern capital world of the Capellan Confederation, noted be the best defended planet of House Liao. It is the home of much of House Liao's major industries and political leadership.
column2: 罗罗是卡佩兰联邦如今的都城世界，被认为是廖家族防御最严密的行星。它是廖家族大部分主要产业与政治领导层的所在地。

column1: Sichuan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sichuan在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sidon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sidon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Siendou is a rocky, resource-rich world and an established constitutional theocracy. Adherants to the global faith of Siendou are prohibited from serving in a national military.
column2: Siendou是一个岩石质、资源丰富的世界，也是一个成熟的宪政神权政体. Siendou全球信仰的信徒被禁止在国家军队中服役.

column1: Sierpc is a quiet, average world that has slightly too much ozone in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators.
column2: Sierpc是一个安静、普通的星球，其大气中的臭氧含量对人类舒适而言略高，需要服用特殊药物或佩戴呼吸器.

column1: Vast tundras filled with mineral rich rock ensure the population of Sierra is at least well paid amidst the inhospitable environment.
column2: 广袤的冻原上遍布富含矿物的岩石，这至少确保了Sierra的居民在这片不宜居的环境中能获得丰厚的报酬.

column1: Sighisoara has vast mud flats that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
column2: Sighisoara拥有广袤的泥滩，纵横交错地分布在其各个大陆上，既用于采矿，也用于休闲娱乐.

column1: Despite being a small, cold and inhospitable world Sigma Mare is rather overpopulated. By the end of the Third Succession War Sigma Mare was known as a center of research for geophysical/terraforming research, something that helped make the planet liveable.
column2: 尽管是一颗寒冷小而不宜居的星球，西格玛母马却人口过剩。到第三次继承战争结束时，西格玛母马已以地球物理与地球化改造研究中心闻名，这也帮助该星球变得可居。

column1: Sigurd is the cold moon of a glowing gas giant, described as a striped sphere that fills a third of the sky. The surface of Sigurd is completely made up of an ice mantle several hundred meters thick, with liquid water below.
column2: Sigurd是一颗寒冷的卫星，围绕着一颗发光的气态巨行星运行，被描述为一个布满条纹的球体，占据了天空的三分之一. Sigurd的表面完全由数百米厚的冰幔构成，冰层之下是液态水.

column1: Sikkim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sikkim在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Sileste was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sileste在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间战火中消亡.

column1: Acid rain is a persistent problem on Silkeborg. The rain is so acidic that it poses a danger to human health, although it does carve the native rock into some interesting formations.
column2: 酸雨是Silkeborg长期存在的问题. 雨水酸性极强，对人类健康构成威胁，不过它也确实将原生岩石侵蚀成了某些有趣的地貌.

column1: Named for the large deposits of silver found on the surface, Silver is a wealthy mining colony.
column2: 因地表发现的大量银矿藏而得名，Silver是一个富裕的采矿殖民地.

column1: Simancas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Simancas在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Acid rain is a persistent problem on Simferopol. The rain is so acidic that it poses a danger to human health, although it does carve the native rock into some interesting formations.
column2: 酸雨是Simferopol长期存在的问题. 雨水酸性极强，对人体健康构成危险，不过它确实将原生岩石侵蚀成了些有趣的地貌.

column1: Simone was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Simone在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Named after a dessert thanks to a typo by a clerk, Simpson Desert is actually a world filled with beautiful forests and rolling hills.
column2: 因一名文员的笔误而以甜点命名，Simpson Desert实际上是一颗遍布美丽森林和起伏丘陵的星球.

column1: A minor Capellan colony, Sindalin's frequent impact events from its asteroid-choked orbit eventually led Liao to abandon the world. The colony buildings were soon consumed by the planet's endless dust storms.
column2: 作为卡佩兰的一块次要殖民地，辛达林因其小行星密布的轨道而频繁遭受撞击事件，最终让廖氏放弃了这颗行星。殖民地的建筑很快被该行星无尽的沙暴吞没。

column1: Sinope served as the headquarters world for the XV Corps of the Star League Defense Force before the end of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟终结之前，Sinope曾是星际联盟防卫军第15军的总部世界.

column1: There are large underground reservoirs of liquid water, heated by geothermal vents. Occasionally this water erupts onto the surface and freezes in the cold vacuum, covering the planet with tiny ice crystals.
column2: 地下有巨大的液态水储层，由地热喷口加热. 偶尔这些水会喷涌到地表，在寒冷的真空中冻结，使整个行星覆盖上细小的冰晶.

column1: The moon of Sirius VI was colonised first, before the terraforming on the mineral rich oxygen poor main planet could take place. Sirius was recently a member of the Tikonov Free Republic until the end of the Fourth Succession War.
column2: Sirius VI的卫星最先被殖民，那时对资源丰富但氧气稀薄的主行星进行的地球化改造尚未开始. 直到第四次继承战争结束前，Sirius最近还是Tikonov自由共和国的一员.

column1: One of the original worlds of the Rasalhague Consortium, it was conquered by the Draconis Combine during its war of conquest.
column2: 它是Rasalhague Consortium的原始世界之一，在天龙联合体的征服战争期间被征服.

column1: Often used as an administrative hub or tax haven over the centuries thanks to its location, Skandia is an otherwise unexceptional world.
column2: 由于其地理位置，几个世纪以来，Skandia常被用作行政枢纽或避税天堂；除此之外，它只是一颗毫不起眼的行星.

column1: Skaslien was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Skaslien在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Skat is a quiet, average world that has slightly too much ozone in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators.
column2: Skat是一个安静、普通的世界，大气中的臭氧含量对人类舒适度而言略高，因此需要特殊药物或呼吸器.

column1: Skepptana was the site of a major warship crash during the Amaris Civil War, leaving its surface a war torn wreck. Many scavengers and pirates find their way here to pick up repaired weaponry or mechs.
column2: Skepptana曾是阿马里斯内战期间一艘大型战舰坠毁的地点，其地表因此沦为饱受战火摧残的废墟. 许多拾荒者和海盗辗转来到此地，以获取修复过的武器或机甲.

column1: Skiland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Skiland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: An ice world rich in minerals, its geothermal vents produce much of the power for the mining facilities.
column2: 一个富含矿物的冰封世界，其地热喷口为采掘设施提供了大部分动力.

column1: Skondia possesses abundant deposits of rare metals and minerals. Skondia produces nickel-alloys, titanium, and steel, used in everything from forks to fusion reactors. Ownership has changed hands multiple times over the course of the Succession Wars.
column2: Skondia拥有丰富的稀有金属和矿产储量. Skondia生产镍合金、钛和钢，用于从餐叉到聚变反应堆的各种产品. 在继承战争期间，其所有权曾多次易手.

column1: Settled after the age of war, the vast bulbous plant life on on Skvorec is not very tasty but is extremely mineral rich.
column2: 战争时代之后才有人定居，Skvorec上广袤的球状植物并不太美味，但富含矿物质.

column1: The planet Skye is dominated by a single supercontinent that reaches into more than one hemisphere. Skye is a rarity, in that it is a habitable planet within a binary star system; when Skye was discovered by explorers it was an unspoiled world.
column2: Skye行星由一个延伸至不止一个半球的单一超级大陆所主导. Skye十分罕见，因为它是双星系统中的一颗宜居行星；当探险者发现Skye时，它还是一片未遭破坏的世界.

column1: A science colony which had over two million people at one point, Skyfog was abandoned in 2769 when the Amaris Coup ended the supply runs that the colonists needed to survive. The moon was rediscovered by Interstellar Expeditions in 3003.
column2: Skyfog曾是一个科学殖民地，一度拥有超过两百万人口；2769年，阿马里斯政变中断了殖民者赖以生存的补给运输，Skyfog因此被废弃. 3003年，这颗卫星被星际探险组织重新发现.

column1: Slaithwaite has vast mud flats that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
column2: Slaithwaite拥有广袤的泥滩，纵横交错于其各大陆之上，用于采矿和休闲娱乐.

column1: The Slewis system was colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic by the end of the Age of War and became an fiercely independent world after the fall of the Star League.
column2: Slewis星系在战争时代末期被边缘世界共和国殖民，并在星际联盟覆灭后成为一个极度独立的世界.

column1: Devastated during the Amaris Civil War, Slocum still remains hostile to life due the nuclear bombardment centuries ago
column2: 在阿马里斯内战期间遭到毁灭性打击，由于几个世纪前的核轰炸，Slocum至今仍不适合生命生存.

column1: Small World is an arctic world in the middle of a two thousand year long ice age. Settlements are limited to a narrow band around the planet's equator and the only exports of note are high grade thorium and uranium ore.
column2: 小世界是一颗北极世界，正处于长达两千年的冰河期中。定居点仅限于行星赤道周围一条狭窄地带，值得一提的出口产品只有高品位钍矿与铀矿。

column1: A former Star League era armory and fortification, Smithon is the home system of House Karosas. The old Capellan fortresses have been converted to civilian habitation, and enterprising scavengers scour the planet for any remaining LosTech.
column2: 史密森是一处前星际联盟时代的军火库兼要塞，也是卡罗萨斯家族的母星. 这座古老的卡佩拉要塞已经转变为民用居所，而有商业头脑的拾荒者则在此星球搜寻任何残存的失落科技.

column1: Early in Smolensk's history it was the site of the Smolensk Incident, where many colonists were killed by Terran Colonial Marines. It remains wary of Terra ever since.
column2: 斯摩棱斯克历史早期曾发生“斯摩棱斯克事件”，许多殖民者被地球殖民陆战队杀害。此后它一直对地球心存戒备。

column1: The howling winds of Smolnik are believed to contain the souls of the departed, according to folklore.
column2: 根据民间传说，Smolnik呼啸的狂风被认为承载着逝者的灵魂.

column1: Smythe was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Smythe在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被开拓，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Snailzar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Snailzar是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Snowdon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Snowdon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled after the age of war, the vast fungi growths on Sodertalje are not very tasty but are very nutritious.
column2: 在战争时代之后才有人定居，Sodertalje上广袤的真菌虽然不太好吃，但营养非常丰富.

column1: Sodus has vast salt plains that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
column2: Sodus拥有广袤的盐原，纵横交错地分布在其各个大陆上，既用于采矿，也用于休闲娱乐.

column1: Soilihull was colonised early in the Exodus from Terra, and remains an important agricultural world for nearby systems.
column2: Soilihull在泰拉大迁徙早期就被殖民，至今仍是附近星系重要的农业世界.

column1: Solaris VII is known across the galaxy for its 'Mech fights. Gamblers place exorbitant amounts of money on longshot bets, and fortunes are won and lost daily. Solaris City, in particular, hosts six major arenas and numerous MechWarrior stables.
column2: 索拉里斯VII在整个银河以其机甲近战闻名。赌徒在冷门赌注上押下巨额金钱，财富每日在此赢得又输掉。尤其是索拉里斯城，拥有六个主要竞技场和众多机师马疚。

column1: Solor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Solor在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Somerset I - more commonly known simply as Somerset - is the innermost planet in the system and has two moons named Bull and Hint. Somerset has been home to a small military academy during its history.
column2: Somerset I——通常简称为Somerset——是该星系中最内侧的行星，拥有两颗名为Bull和Hint的卫星. 在其历史上，Somerset曾是一所小型军事学院的所在地.

column1: The Songgang system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War by the United Hindu Collective.
column2: Songgang星系是在战争时代期间或稍早之前由联合印度教集体殖民的.

column1: Son Hoa has an interesting geographical feature: The Vanishing Sea. During the blistering summers, all the water in the sea evaporates. Once the seasons turn, the water condenses out of the atmosphere and returns to the seabed.
column2: Son Hoa拥有一个有趣的地理特征: 消失之海. 在酷热的夏季，海中所有水分都会蒸发. 一旦季节转换，水便会从大气中凝结出来，并重新回到海床.

column1: Settled at the start of the First Succession War by refugees from the borders, Sonnia has grown into an economic powerhouse.
column2: 在第一次继承战争之初，来自边境的难民定居于Sonnia，如今它已发展成为一个经济重镇.

column1: A center for the arts and learning, Sophie's Choice is an idyllic planet with vast fertile oasis dotted throughout its desert like surface.
column2: 作为艺术与学术的中心，苏菲之选是一颗田园般的行星，沙漠般的地表上点缀着大片肥沃的绿洲。

column1: Sornath was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sornath在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sorsk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sorsk在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sorunda has a large population of Buddists. It also possesses three continents named Black Falls, Serenity, and Xeno.
column2: Sorunda拥有大量佛教徒. 它还拥有三块大陆，分别名为Black Falls、Serenity和Xeno.

column1: Soul is a generally inhospitable world. The unforgiving environment is a combination of the dimness of the system's star, as well as Soul's lack of an axial tilt. Soul is home to a Blankenburg Technologies assault mech factory.
column2: 索尔总体上是颗不宜居的星球。严酷的环境源于该星系恒星的昏暗，以及索尔缺乏轴倾角。索尔是布兰肯堡科技公司一处突击机甲工厂的所在地。

column1: Kilometer wide rapids criss cross this otherwise stepped world, allowing the creation of vast hydroelectric plants.
column2: 宽达一公里的急流纵横交错于这个在其他方面呈阶梯状的世界，使得建造庞大的水力发电厂成为可能.
