column1: Home to Marley Munitions Works, Sparrevohn is specialized in the production of munitions
column2: 作为Marley Munitions Works的所在地，Sparrevohn专门从事弹药生产.

column1: Sparta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sparta是在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代建立的殖民地，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This former Taurian world is encircled by a vast shallow ocean, teeming with native and Terran aquatic life. During the abortive Taurian-Canopian War, the Magistracy invaded as a retaliation for attacks on their worlds.
column2: 这颗前金牛星球被一片广袤的浅海包围着，其中充满着本土和地球的水生生物. 在流产的金牛-船底战争期间，自治区出于对袭击他们星球的报复，入侵了这里.

column1: Spica has been fought over for centuries, leaving its surface a war torn wreck. Many scavengers and pirates find their way here to pick up repaired weaponry or mechs.
column2: 数个世纪以来，各方为争夺Spica而战，使其地表沦为饱受战火揉躏的废墟. 许多拾荒者和海盗会寻路至此，获取修复后的武器或机甲.

column1: Spirit was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Second Succession War.
column2: Spirit在星际联盟时代，即统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

column1: Orignally a Draconis Combine world, Spittal is now part of the Free Resalhague Republic. Spittal is home to Benson and Bjorn which manufacures a variety of military vehicles.
column2: Spittal原本是一个天龙联合体星球，现在是自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的一部分. Spittal是Benson and Bjorn的所在地，该公司生产各种军用车辆.

column1: A nearly lifeless world reminiscent of primordial Terra, Spitz is primarily of interest to exogeologists who study the early days of future life-bearing planets.
column2: 施皮茨是一个几乎没有生命的星球，让人回忆起原始地球. 关注施皮茨的人主要是研究未来宜居行星的早期阶段的地外地质学家.

column1: St. Andre is a red desert planet located anti-spin of Terra, notable for its rich natural resources. St. Andre is noteworthy for the meeting of leaders in 2366 that formed the Capellan Confederation.
column2: St. Andre是一颗位于泰拉反旋向的红色沙漠行星，以其丰富的自然资源而闻名. St. Andre之所以引人注目，是因为2366年在此举行的领导人会议组建了卡佩拉邦联.

column1: St. Timalin is a recently rediscovered planet in the St. Andreas system, orbiting a dim red primary. It is a dark world, with black flora that has evolved to survive on the dim light emitted by the red primary, which the colonists named St. Andreas.
column2: St. Timalin是St. Andreas星系中最近被重新发现的一颗行星，环绕一颗暗淡的红色主星运行. 它是一颗黑暗的世界，拥有黑色植物群，这些植物已经进化到能在红色主星St. Andreas发出的微弱光线下生存.

column1: St. Cyr was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: St. Cyr是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: St. Gall was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: St. Gall在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: St. Ives is the capital of the newly formed St. Ives League. The military industries on the planet have been built in to the vast cavern networks present on the planet, forcing attackers to attempt to seize them in costly close quarters actions.
column2: St. Ives是新成立的St. Ives联盟的首都. 该行星上的军事工业已建入行星上庞大的洞穴网络之中，迫使进攻者试图以代价高昂的近距离作战夺取它们.

column1: St. Ives
column2: 圣艾夫斯

column1: The St. Jean colony is situated on the system's second planet. Barely 500 monks remain on the colony, as the planet slowly dies out as its largest moon falls towards the planet.
column2: 圣让殖民地位于该星系的第二颗行星上。殖民地仅剩不到500名修士，因为随着它最大的卫星向行星坠落，这个世界正慢慢消亡。

column1: St John is an oceanic world, consisting of a few large islands that are dotted around an ocean mostly free of ice, except at the poles. There are great tidal plains that appear during the lunar cycle, showcasing wreckage from ancient battlefields.
column2: St John是一个海洋世界，由几座大岛组成，这些岛屿散布在一片大部分无冰的海洋中，只有两极除外. 在月相周期期间会出现大片潮汐平原，露出古代战场的残骸.

column1: St. Loris is an important agricultural center. In 3010 the 2nd St. Ives Lancers fought the Ceti Hussars there and much of the planet's vital wheat crop was destroyed, which caused a mighty famine. The crop has recovered, but the population has not.
column2: 圣洛里斯是一处重要的农业中心。3010年，第2圣艾夫斯枪骑兵在此与塞提骠骑兵交战，星球上大量重要的小麦作物被毁，引发了一场严重饥荒。作物后来恢复了，人口却再未回到从前。

column1: St. Loris
column2: 圣洛里斯

column1: Dense jungles of light blue fungal towers cover St. Robert, with kilometers of large plateaus with steep sides breaking through the canopy.
column2: 茂密的淡蓝色真菌塔丛林覆盖着St. Robert，绵延数公里、侧壁陡峭的大型高原穿透了林冠.

column1: Staffin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Staffin于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: A large recruiting world for the Marian Hegemony, Stafford's high gravity produces extremely muscular troopers who excel in mountainous terrain.
column2: 作为马里亚纳霸权的大型募兵世界，斯塔福德的高重力造就了极为强壮的士兵，他们在山地地形中表现出色。

column1: A supercontinent with some small, shallow seas that are constantly steaming. Spires of sharp stone interrupt the otherwise flat terrain.
column2: 一片超大陆，点缀着几片不断冒着蒸汽的浅小海洋. 尖锐的石峰打破了原本平坦的地形.

column1: Settled by scientists during the first Exodus as a research station to examine the planet's rings, 'Stantsia' has evolved into a fully self sufficient colony.
column2: 作为第一次大逃亡期间科学家们为考察该星球环系统而建的研究站，“斯坦齐亚”已发展为一个完全自给自足的殖民地。

column1: Stanzach took severe damage in the Fourth Succession War, and the recovery was stifled when it become part of the recently formed Free Rasalhague Republic. Regardless, it is still an important economic system for the FRR.
column2: Stanzach在第四次继承战争中遭受了严重破坏，而当它成为新近成立的自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的一部分时，其复苏又受到了抑制. 尽管如此，它仍是FRR重要的经济星系.

column1: Named for its poor agriculture, Stapelfeld is a grubby little world with little going for it. And that's what the last mayor called it.
column2: 因农业贫瘠而得名，施塔佩尔费尔德是一颗邋遢的小行星，几乎一无是处。而这话还是上一任市长说的。

column1: An unexplored star cluster outside the Inner Sphere.
column2: 内天体之外一处未经探索的星团。

column1: Star Cluster 752
column2: 星团752

column1: Stardawn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stardawn于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A former mining system, Star's End has only one planetary body, Novo Cressidas, and several large asteroid belts that make navigation in the system extremely hazardous without intimate knowledge of the system.
column2: 作为一个前采矿星系，星之尽头只有一个行星体新克雷西达斯，以及若干庞大的小行星带，若没有对系统的深入了解，在该星系中航行极其危险。

column1: Starshine was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Starshine是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: An icy world consisting of tundra and a few frozen lakes. Towering columns of hexagonal black stone permeate the land, whilst constant snow storms ensure no right minded individual would wish to settle here.
column2: 一个由苔原和几片冰封湖泊组成的冰封世界. 高耸的六边形黑色石柱遍布大地，而持续不断的暴风雪使得任何头脑正常的人都不会想在此定居.

column1: Steelton was settled by a mixture of artists and craftsmen from Kufstein and Predlitz, technicians from St. John and engineers from New Bergen. This mix of settlers are responsible for some of this worlds magnificent architecture.
column2: Steelton的定居者包括来自Kufstein和Predlitz的艺术家与工匠、来自St. John的技术人员以及来自New Bergen的工程师. 正是这种定居者的融合，造就了该世界一些宏伟的建筑.

column1: The high energy star offers ample solar energy for this otherwise barren world, allowing crops to grow with poor soil.
column2: 高能恒星为这个原本贫瘠的世界提供了充足的太阳能，使作物能在贫瘠的土壤中生长.

column1: Private colonists setting out for a beautiful garden world were shocked to find the only habitable regions were in the highland peninsulas, thus naming the world after their founder, Stein's Folly.
column2: 私人殖民者出发前往一颗美丽的田园星球，却震惊地发现唯一宜居的区域都在高地半岛上，于是以创始人之名把该星球命名为“斯坦的愚行”。

column1: Stellaris was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stellaris是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: A small industrial world located near to the jump point for quick access, Sterling offers a multitude of products... and sins... for the right price.
column2: 一个位于跃迁点附近、便于快速进出的小型工业世界，只要价钱合适，Sterling能提供琳琅满目的商品……以及种种罪恶……

column1: Most cities on Sterlington are located on high plateaus, above an ever turbulent sea of clouds. Whilst oxygen is thin here, it does provide ample opportunity for recreation and cloud diving.
column2: Sterlington上的大多数城市坐落在高耸的高原上，俯瞰着一片永远汹涌的云海. 这里的氧气虽然稀薄，却为休闲娱乐和云中潜水提供了充足的机会.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Sternwerde was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Heavy cloud cover causes many issues for exporting from Sternwerde, but below the cloud is a moist but mild climate.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Sternwerde曾驻扎有星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军. 厚重的云层给从Sternwerde出口带来了许多问题，但云层之下是湿润而温和的气候.

column1: Sterope, sometimes named New Taurus, is an industrial world located in the rimward Periphery. The planet is home to Sterope Defense Industries as well as corporate unit of Taurus Territorial Industries.
column2: Sterope，有时也被称为New Taurus，是一颗位于边缘方向外围星域的工业世界. 这颗行星是Sterope Defense Industries以及Taurus Territorial Industries下属企业单位的所在地.

column1: Stettin (FWL) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stettin (FWL) 于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Stettin is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League and trades goods internally within the League.
column2: Stettin是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，并在同盟内部进行货物贸易.

column1: Stewart was settled by colonists from the British Isles, who engineered vast terraforming works on the surface. Stewart maintains its healthy environment to this day and is one of the richest worlds in the Free Worlds League.
column2: Stewart由来自不列颠群岛的殖民者定居，他们在其表面实施了大规模的地球化改造工程. Stewart至今仍保持着良好的环境，是自由世界联盟中最富庶的星球之一.

column1: Stirling was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stirling于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Stockpoll was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stockpoll在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Stonarboi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stonarboi在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Storfors is the planet most like Terra in the Storfors system, but two other worlds are inhabited as well. J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated manufactures Mech parts here.
column2: Storfors是Storfors星系中最像泰拉的行星，但另外两个世界也有人居住. J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated在此生产机甲零件.

column1: Once a heavily populated world filled with factories, Strotzing was bombarded during the Second Succession War, leaving the population to subsist on agriculture for centuries amidst a tainted atmosphere.
column2: Strotzing曾是一个遍布工厂、人口稠密的世界，却在第二次继承战争期间遭到轰炸，使当地居民数百年来只能在受污染的大气中依靠农业勉强度日.

column1: Stralsund is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, trading goods amongst the other worlds in the League.
column2: Stralsund是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，在同盟内的其他星球之间进行货物贸易.

column1: Strana Mechty is considered an almost sacred world to the Clans. It is the site where Nicholas Kerensky escaped too, and where he founded the rigid social structure of the Clans. The world can be seen as the birthplace of the Clans.
column2: Strana Mechty对氏族而言被视为一个近乎神圣的世界. 这里也是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基逃往的地方，以及他建立氏族严格社会结构的地方. 这个世界可以被视为氏族的诞生地.

column1: The Strandfontein system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League, and was host to a large SLDF garrison. Unfortunately the bases were raided during the Succession Wars, so no LosTech can be found here.
column2: Strandfontein星系在星际联盟统治时期的某个时候被殖民，并曾驻扎着一支庞大的SLDF驻军. 遗憾的是，这些基地在继承战争期间遭到劫掠，因此这里找不到任何失落科技.

column1: The world of Stratford has large rocky, polar continents with many fjords. These continents are cold and wet, yet still life thrives in this hard environment. The Stratford narwhal makes its breeding grounds near and within the many natural inlets.
column2: Stratford星球拥有大片岩石嶙峋的极地大陆，遍布众多峡湾. 这些大陆寒冷潮湿，但生命仍在这严酷环境中繁盛. Stratford独角鲸在许多天然水湾附近及其中繁育.

column1: Strato Domingo is a planet in the Clan Homeworlds that was held jointly by the Diamond Sharks and the Hell's Horses. It is the only location in Clan space where HarJel is found, and the Sharks guard it zealously.
column2: 斯特拉托·多明戈是部族母星世界中的一颗星球，由钻石鲨与地狱马共同持有。它是部族空间内唯一出产哈杰尔的地方，鲨鱼部族对其严加看守。

column1: A once beautiful world that was ravaged by the Combine in both the First and Second Succession wars, Strawn has never fully recovered.
column2: Strawn曾是一颗美丽的星球，但在第一次和第二次继承战争中被天龙联合体揉躏，至今仍未完全恢复.

column1: Once a heavily populated world filled with automated farms, Streator was bombarded by nuclear weapons during the First Succession War, decimating the population which has only now recovered to pre war levels.
column2: 曾经是一个人口稠密、遍布自动化农场的星球，Streator在第一次继承战争期间遭到核武器轰炸，人口锐减，直到现在才恢复到战前水平.

column1: Sturganos was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sturganos在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Once a heavily populated world filled with factories, Sturgis was bombarded for two months by the Draconis Combine during the Second Succession War, leaving the population to subsist on agriculture for centuries amidst a tainted atmosphere.
column2: Sturgis曾是一个人口稠密、遍布工厂的世界，在第二次继承战争期间遭到天龙联合体长达两个月的轰炸，导致其人口在受污染的大气中靠农业为生长达数个世纪.

column1: Four-fifths of the surface of the planet Styk is covered with various saltwater oceans; dotted around the surface are nine assorted continents of varying sizes. It is heavily industrialised, with Tao MechWorks being a major employer and exporter.
column2: Styk星球表面的五分之四被各类咸水海洋覆盖；表面散布着九块大小不一的各类大陆. 该星球高度工业化，Tao MechWorks是主要雇主和出口商.

column1: Styriania was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Styriania在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Styx is a world of storms, flash floods, and mudslides, wild weather patterns caused by the gravitational pull of the planet's three moons. Nevertheless, the storms often reveal rich mineral deposits which make Styx extremely wealthy.
column2: 斯提克斯是一颗风暴、山洪与泥石流肆虐的世界，其狂暴的天气模式由该行星三颗卫星的引力造成。尽管如此，风暴常常揭露出丰富的矿藏，使斯提克斯极为富庶。

column1: Suda Bay is a fleet base at the Nadir jump point of a type F21a star in the Deep Periphery near Ctesiphon and Trelleborg. Ships recharging in the system take 173 hours to recharge.
column2: Suda Bay是深空外围中一颗F21a型恒星的天底跃迁点处的一座舰队基地，靠近Ctesiphon和Trelleborg. 在该星系中充电的舰船需要 173 小时完成充电.

column1: Sudeten circles its brilliant sun at a distance of nearly three astronomical units. A mostly terran planet, it has three continents. Dargoth where the capital city Hammarr is located, Holcomb and Jarho Islands.
column2: Sudeten以近三个天文单位的距离环绕着它那颗耀眼的恒星运行. 它是一颗大部分为类地环境的行星，拥有三块大陆: 首都哈马尔所在的达戈斯、霍尔科姆和雅霍群岛.

column1: One of the worlds conquered by the Marian Hegemony, Suetonius provides logistical support to nearby Legions.
column2: 作为马里安霸权征服的星球之一，Suetonius为附近的军团提供后勤支援.

column1: A border world against the Outworlds Alliance, munitions depots were created all across the icy world of Suianheer. Nowadays, the mining colonies occasionally stumble across LosTech and more.
column2: 作为一处与外域联盟接壤的边境世界，军火库曾遍布冰冷的Suianheer星球. 如今，采矿殖民地偶尔会偶然发现失落科技以及更多东西.

column1: Suk II is a mining world rich in rare and valuable resources. It would be a pleasant world if it were not for poisonous algae that contaminate around half of the world's water and make water purification plants a requirement at all settlements.
column2: 苏克II是一颗富含稀有贵重资源的采矿世界。如果不是因为有毒藻类污染了全世界约一半的水源、使所有定居点都必须配备净水厂，它本会是一颗宜人的行星。

column1: An beautiful world, it would be a breadbasket if not for the heavy metals poisoning the soil across the most habitable continent, a remnant of Lyran savagery during the First Succession War.
column2: 一个美丽的世界，若非重金属毒害了最宜居大陆的土壤，这里本会成为粮仓——这是第一次继承战争期间天琴人野蛮行径的遗留.

column1: During the Star League era, the LXVI Corps had its headquarters located on world, surrounded by mountains on a world covered in them. Sometime during the Succession Wars, the location was lost and it has been hunted for forever since.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，第66军的司令部设在一颗行星上，四周群山环绕，而这颗行星本身就遍布山脉. 在继承战争期间的某个时候，该地点失传了，自那以后人们便一直在搜寻它.

column1: Summer has been an important mining world for the last several centuries. It possessed an SLDF garrison before the fall of the Star League and has since been garrisoned by the Lyran armed forces in order to protect the planet from Kuritan raids.
column2: Summer在过去几个世纪里一直是一个重要的采矿世界. 在星际联盟覆灭之前，它曾拥有SLDF驻军，此后一直由天琴武装部队驻守，以保护该星球免受栗田袭击.

column1: Summerstide was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Summerstide在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Summit has a unique flat tax rate for its citizens, which stems from its role in the initial Outer Reaches Rebellion centuries ago. It does have a surprisingly equalising effects with high rates of contentment amongst the population.
column2: Summit对其公民实行一种独特的统一税率，这源于它几个世纪前在最初的外缘叛乱中所扮演的角色. 它确实产生了出人意料的平等化效果，民众的满意度很高.

column1: Sumy was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sumy于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sunchon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sunchon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战事中消亡.

column1: Sunnywood is a disingenuously-named barren rock world where an ambitious colony spent centuries dying. Many ruins dot the world as a testament to humanity's optimism.
column2: 阳光木是一颗名字起得极不诚实的荒芜岩石世界，一个野心勃勃的殖民地在上面用了几个世纪慢慢死去。行星上遍布废墟，见证着人类的乐观。

column1: Sun Prairie, famous for its name sake, is a vast steppe covered world which feeds the population on numerous surrounding worlds.
column2: Sun Prairie，因其同名而闻名，是一个广袤的、被草原覆盖的世界，为周边众多世界上的人口提供食物.

column1: Famous for its Kodiak Bearfish fished from its frozen seas, Surcin is an icy world with a plethora of native aquatic life. Once a major manufacturer of arctic survival wear, it now relies on mass aquatic life exports.
column2: 以从冰封海洋中捕捞的科迪亚克熊鱼而闻名，Surcin是一个拥有丰富本土水生生物的冰雪世界. 它曾是极地生存服装的主要制造商，如今则依赖大规模水生生物出口.

column1: In 3023 Kurita troops were sent in to break up a Leif Erickson Day celebration sponsored by the Sons of Knute and the Chrysanthemum Cross-Cultural Appreciation Society, which led to the rebellion which resulted in them joining the FRR.
column2: 3023年，栗田部队被派去驱散由克努特之子会和菊花跨文化欣赏协会赞助的莱夫·埃里克森日庆祝活动，这引发了叛乱，并最终导致他们加入了FRR.

column1: When people hear of Susulatna, they think of Susulatna Sultanas, those juicy inch long delights that can be found at many neighbouring worlds. Apart from fruits, Susulatna has a pleasant climate for wealthier Commonwealth citizens to relax at.
column2: 当人们听说Susulatna时，他们会想到Susulatna苏丹娜葡萄——那些多汁、一英寸长的美味，在众多邻近世界都能找到. 除了水果，Susulatna还拥有宜人的气候，供较富有的共同体公民放松休憩.

column1: Firmly situated amongst the Draconic Combine for centuries, Sutama produces a vast range of citrus fruits and pharmaceuticals for export. The tropical climate of Sutama makes it a vacationing hotspot for higher ranked Nobles of the Combine.
column2: Sutama数百年来一直稳固地处于天龙联合体之中，生产种类繁多的柑橘类水果和药品供出口. Sutama的热带气候使其成为天龙联合体高阶贵族的度假热点.

column1: Famous for Ando Bass fished from its frozen seas, Suzano is an icy world with a plethora of native aquatic life. Once a major manufacturer of light vehicles, it has since suffered in the most recent Succession Wars.
column2: Suzano是一个冰封世界，以其冰冻海洋中捕捞的Ando Bass而闻名，拥有大量本土水生生物. 它曾是轻型车辆的主要制造商，但后来在最近的继承战争中遭受重创.

column1: Svalstad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Svalstad在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间消亡.

column1: Rolling green hills and forests surround the main city of Port Svarstaad, the central city of the planet where most major lumber based industries and exporters are located.
column2: 起伏的绿色丘陵和森林环绕着Port Svarstaad的主要城市，它是该行星的中心城市，大多数主要木材产业和出口商都位于那里.

column1: A founder of the short-lived Principality of Rasalhague, prior to the Principality being conquered by the Draconis Combine in the early to mid Twenty-fourth century, Svelvik has once again reclaimed its heritage.
column2: 作为短命的Rasalhague公国的创建者之一——该公国在二十四世纪早期至中期被天龙联合体征服——Svelvik再次夺回了自己的传承.

column1: An independent world at first, Sverdlovsk was contacted by Shiro Kurita, the Director of the newly-created Alliance of Galedon with an offer to join. They declined. Sverdlovsk was thus the first world conquered by Kurita by military force.
column2: 起初是一个独立世界，Sverdlovsk被新成立的Galedon联盟的领导者Shiro Kurita联系，对方提出邀请其加入. 他们拒绝了. 因此，Sverdlovsk成为Kurita以军事力量征服的第一个世界.

column1: Producers of the hardest, roughest swill on this side of the Lyran Commonwealth, this agricultural world has a reputation for hardy farmers in the tough climate.
column2: 作为天琴共同体这一侧最烈、最粗劣的劣酒产地，这颗农业星球以在严酷气候中坚韧耐劳的农民而闻名.

column1: Swales was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Swales在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Do you like Swartklips? Well come on down to Swartklip, home of the universe's only Swartklips!
column2: 你喜欢斯瓦特克利普吗？那就来斯瓦特克利普吧，宇宙唯一斯瓦特克利普的故乡！

column1: Sweet Water was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sweet Water在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: The native life on Sylvan is lithe and quick, often darting away before colonists can catch even a glimpse of the wonderous creatures. The nature preserves on Sylvan are renown for their beauty.
column2: Sylvan上的原生生物轻盈敏捷，常常在殖民者还没来得及瞥见这些奇妙生物一眼之前就飞快地溜走. Sylvan上的自然保护区以其美丽而闻名.

column1: The low gravity ice world of Sylvester is a popular destination for many thrill seekers, with its population devoted almost entirely to a service based economy.
column2: 低重力的冰封世界Sylvester是许多寻求刺激者的热门目的地，其人口几乎完全投身于以服务为基础的经济.

column1: An unremarkable system, noted only for the mining facilities built to withstand the high gravity and rocky terrain, as well as being located only a weeks travel from the jump point.
column2: 一个平平无奇的星系，唯一值得一提的是为抵御高重力和崎岖地形而建造的采矿设施，以及它距离跃迁点只有一周的行程.

column1: Symsonia is unique for its architecture. Many buildings are designed using local stonework and metals which create a citywide symphony when a fohn wind blows between them.
column2: Symsonia以其建筑而独具特色. 许多建筑采用当地石材与金属建造，当焚风穿行其间时，便会奏响一曲遍及全城的交响乐.

column1: Synsstad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Synsstad于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被建立定居点，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Syrma is a water-rich world with a host of natural resources. Considered a dream world for development when it was found by explorers, Syrma remains a highly industrialised world even now.
column2: Syrma是一颗水资源丰富、拥有大量自然资源的星球. 被探险者发现时，它曾被视为开发的理想之地；时至今日，Syrma仍是一个高度工业化的星球.

column1: Once the site of numerous SLDF caches, they were bombarded from orbit when the SLDF left - leaving the world in ruins. Numerous plagues have not done the population much good over recent years.
column2: 这里曾是众多SLDF储藏库的所在地；当SLDF离开时，这里遭到了轨道轰炸——只留下一个沦为废墟的世界. 近年来，无数瘟疫也没让当地民众好过多少.

column1: Szepes was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Szepes于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Szombathely was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Szombathely是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被建立为定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Tabayama is the capital world of the Galedon Military District, and many citizens are employed in running the government. There is also a market in venison exports, due to deer thriving on the surface - hunting is mandatory to save the croplands.
column2: Tabayama是Galedon军事区的首府星球，许多公民受雇从事政府管理工作. 由于鹿在地表大量繁殖，这里还有鹿肉出口市场——为保护农田，狩猎是强制性的.

column1: Tabit (Tyrfing 2350's+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 塔比特（提尔锋2350年代+）是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: Tadjoura is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. The system is just over 38 light-years from the Axumite Providence capital, Thala, and 1,010 light-years anti-spinward from Terra.
column2: Tadjoura是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一个殖民世界. 该星系距离阿克苏姆天命国首府Thala仅略超过38光年，并位于泰拉逆旋向1，010光年处.

column1: Taga was founded and settled by the St. Ives Mercantile League in the 23rd Century, but fell under Capellan rule soon after. This world, famed for its export of Kaidok survival wear, is often known for its rebellious tendencies.
column2: Taga由圣艾夫斯商业联盟于23世纪建立并殖民，但不久后便落入卡佩拉统治之下. 这个以出口Kaidok生存服而闻名的世界，常因其反叛倾向而著称.

column1: The ruins of Tainjin BattleWorks still fill the Kodi Valley today, picked over by salvagers of centuries past. Without industry, Tainjin is now just a harsh mining world.
column2: Tainjin BattleWorks的废墟至今仍遍布科迪谷，过去几个世纪的打捞者早已将其翻找殆尽. 失去工业后，Tainjin如今只是一个严酷的矿业世界.

column1: Takata (New Start 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Takata (New Start 3130+) 于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Talcott has the significant percentage of the defense manufacturers that supply the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns. New Avalon, Crofton, Kathil, Panpour, Salem and Talcott supply move than half of all the equipment used by the AFFS.
column2: Talcott拥有为恒星联邦武装部队供货的国防制造商中相当大的比例. New Avalon、Crofton、Kathil、Panpour、Salem和Talcott供应了AFFS所用全部装备的一半以上.

column1: Talisker was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Talisker在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Prior to the Fall of the Star League, Talitha served as the headquarters of the 8th Army of the SLDF and had sway over all the Free Worlds League. Devastation from recent wars have left Talitha struggling to provide for its own citizens.
column2: 在星际联盟陨落之前，Talitha曾是星际联盟防卫军第八集团军的总部所在地，并左右着整个自由世界联盟. 近年来的战火摧残使Talitha难以供养自己的公民.

column1: Tallassee was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Tallassee于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间因战乱而消亡.

column1: Tallin was founded and settled by the St. Ives Mercantile League in the 23rd Century, but fell under Capellan rule soon after. This world, famed for its Kodiak bear pelts and clothing industry, is often known for its rebellious tendencies.
column2: Tallin由St. Ives商业联盟于23世纪建立并殖民，但不久后便落入卡佩拉统治之下. 这个星球以科迪亚克熊皮和服装产业闻名，也常因其反叛倾向而著称.

column1: Tallmadge is a large breadbasket of a world with a large local manufacturing base for personnel weaponry and small armoured vehicles. There is a large monument to a Valkyrie riding Mechwarrior, left over from the First Succession Wars.
column2: Tallmadge是一个庞大的粮仓世界，本地拥有庞大的单兵武器和小型装甲车辆制造基地. 这里还有一座巨大的纪念碑，纪念一位驾驶Valkyrie的机甲战士，这是第一次继承战争遗留下来的.

column1: Tall Trees is infamous as the site of the New Tierra del Fuego II plague, a virulent plague which hit the island and killed everyone living there. Rumour has it that the plague was actually created in a Capellan genetic research lab.
column2: Tall Trees因作为新火地岛II瘟疫的发生地而臭名昭著，这种烈性瘟疫袭击了该岛，并杀死了所有居住在那里的人. 有传言说，这种瘟疫实际上是在卡佩拉的一个基因研究实验室中制造出来的.

column1: Tamar has long been a self-sufficient world, notable only for the War College of Tamar, an important Commonwealth military academy.
column2: Tamar长期以来一直是一个自给自足的世界，仅因Tamar战争学院而闻名，那是一所重要的共同体军事学院.

column1: Tamarind is known across the Inner Sphere for the quality of its artwork. Many artists start on Tamarind and charge a premium for their artworks. This was the cause to many raids and combat engagements that took place on the world.
column2: Tamarind因其艺术品的品质而闻名于整个内层空间. 许多艺术家从Tamarind起步，并为自己的艺术作品收取高价. 这正是导致该星球上发生许多突袭和战斗冲突的原因.

column1: Tamaron is a world located in the Kerensky Cluster. It is best known for being the capital of Clan Coyote. Though Tamaron was once considered only marginally habitable, Clan Coyote has overcome its ecosystem and built a thriving culture on world.
column2: Tamaron是位于克伦斯基星团的一颗行星. 它最出名的是作为郊狼氏族的首都. 尽管Tamaron曾被认为仅勉强宜居，但郊狼氏族克服了其生态系统的限制，并在该星球上建立了繁荣的文化.

column1: A few islands are dotted around an ocean covered by ice everywhere except near the equator. There are wide, black, rocky beaches. The plants are tall purple stalks covered in black tentacles, each with a single circular leaf at the top.
column2: 几座岛屿散布在一片海洋中，除了赤道附近，海面到处都被冰层覆盖. 这里有宽阔的黑色岩石海滩. 植物是高大的紫色茎秆，上面覆满黑色触手，每根茎的顶端都长着一片圆形叶子.

column1: An extremely Earth like world with large mineral reserves, Tancredi is home to many manufacturers such as Precision Weaponry as well as the Tancredi War College.
column2: 一个与地球极为相似、拥有大量矿产储量的世界，Tancredi是众多制造商的所在地，包括Precision Weaponry以及Tancredi战争学院.

column1: Tangerz (Mayadi 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Tangerz（Mayadi 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dense forests of tall, white stalks cover Tangipahoa. The remains of an ancient, massive impact crater can be seen all the way from orbit - the ruins of a catastrophe from the First Succession War.
column2: 高大白色茎秆组成的茂密森林覆盖着Tangipahoa. 从轨道上就能看到一处古老而巨大的撞击坑遗迹——那是第一次继承战争留下的灾难废墟.

column1: A sandy desert lit by a bright blue sun. The local plant life takes the shape of small green bubbles. The apex predators inject their prey with digestive enzymes and appear to be part of a kind of a fungal superorganism.
column2: 一片被明亮蓝色恒星照耀的沙质沙漠. 当地的植物生命呈小型绿色气泡状. 顶级掠食者会向猎物注入消化梅，并且似乎是一种真菌超个体的一部分.

column1: A hot volcanic world, the Fifth Sword of Light uses this world as a training ground for laser based combat in hot or low gravity environments.
column2: 一个炎热的火山世界，第五光之剑将这个世界用作在高温或低重力环境下进行激光作战的训练场.

column1: Mu (μ) Ursa Major, Tania Australis, is a red star in the right hind paw of the Greater Bear. Settled long after its sister world, Tania Borealis, Tania Australis is a fertile agricultural world known for its rich pepper wines.
column2: Mu (μ) Ursa Major，即Tania Australis，是大熊座右后爪上的一颗红星. Tania Australis比其姊妹世界Tania Borealis晚得多才被殖民，是一个肥沃的农业世界，以醇厚的胡椒酒闻名.

column1: Lambda (λ) Ursa Major, Tania Borealis, is a star in the right hind paw of the Greater Bear. One of five worlds to be a part of the Stewart Confederation before the Star League, Tania Borealis lost its manufacturing capabilities centuries ago.
column2: Lambda (λ) Ursa Major，Tania Borealis，是大熊座右后爪中的一颗恒星. 作为星际联盟之前斯图尔特邦联一部分的五颗星球之一，Tania Borealis在几个世纪前失去了其制造能力.

column1: A desert world with sands rich in silicon, Tannil is home to numerous small electronics industries. The Second Arkab Legion, still at full strength as they sat out the Fourth Succession War, make this one of their patrol worlds.
column2: 一个沙粒富含硅的沙漠世界，Tannil拥有众多小型电子产业. 第二阿卡布军团因未参与第四次继承战争而仍保持满编，他们将这里作为其巡逻世界之一.

column1: SURVEY DATA CORRUPT
column2: 勘测数据损坏.

column1: Tantallon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Tantallon在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Prior to the Fall of the Star League, Tantara was the headquarters world of the Star League Defense Forces LVII Corps (Star League) and 12th Jump Infantry Division. Rebellions were common amongst the population, a fact that remains until this day.
column2: 在星际联盟覆灭之前，Tantara曾是星际联盟防卫军第LVII军（星际联盟）和第12跳跃步兵师的总部星球. 民众中叛乱频发，这一情况至今依旧.

column1: Tanz was a part of the Traders Domain province of the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era, but was devastated in the Second Succession Wars, leading to its abandonment.
column2: 在星盟时代，Tanz曾是外域联盟贸易者领域行省的一部分，但在第二次继承战争中遭到毁灭，导致其被废弃.

column1: The exceedingly high gravity of Tapachula means that the mineral wealth on the surface is too dangerous to extract, and thus the world has been relegated to mostly agricultural products. The foods here grow chewy in the gravity.
column2: Tapachula极高的重力意味着其地表的矿产资源开采起来太过危险，因此这颗星球主要沦为农产品产地. 这里的食物在这种重力下长得很有嚼劲.

column1: Taran's World was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 塔兰世界是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

column1: Tarazed city sits atop a large plateau above the extensive mudflats of the world. Mining operations are common here for easily accessible heavy ores and petroleum.
column2: Tarazed城坐落于该世界广袤泥滩上方的一座大型高原之上. 由于重矿石和石油易于开采，这里的采矿作业十分常见.

column1: Tarkio has many large and small islands centered around the south pole and between the equator and south pole. Easily mined metals are scarce, but boreholes allow access to the rich depths.
column2: Tarkio拥有众多大大小小的岛屿，主要分布在南极周围以及赤道与南极之间. 易于开采的金属十分稀缺，但钻孔可以通往富饶的深层矿藏.

column1: Tarnby has five major landmasses, with the three largest centered around the polar areas. Geological activity is active across most of the surface, which brings easily mined materials in key spots.
column2: Tarnby拥有五块主要大陆，其中最大的三块集中在极地地区. 大部分地表地质活动活跃，这使得关键地点蕴藏着易于开采的材料.

column1: Settled at some point prior to the end of the Age of War, Tarol IV was a member of the Magistracy of Canopus when an SLDF task force under the command of Captain-General Marion Marik was assigned to conquer the Magistracy of Canopus in 2577.
column2: Tarol IV在战争时代结束前的某个时候被殖民，在2577年，当由马里昂·马里克元帅指挥的SLDF特遣部队被指派征服船底自治区时，它是该自治区的成员.

column1: This inhospitable world is subjected to fierce tidal stresses from the gas giant it orbits, with constant earthquakes and storms making colonization a deadly enterprise. Even so, some hardy people cling to the world, mining heavy metals and fissionable material.
column2: 这颗不宜居星球受到自身围绕的气态巨星的强大潮汐力影响，地震与风暴连续不断，殖民无异于送死. 即便如此，依然有些坚强勇敢之辈坚守在这颗星球，开采重金属与裂变材料.

column1: A hot inhospitable world, it is nevertheless a bountiful source of rare gems not found on other worlds.
column2: 一个炎热且不宜居住的世界，尽管如此，它却是其他世界所没有的稀有宝石的丰富来源.

column1: The Tatopani system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but was destroyed in the Second Succession War.
column2: Tatopani星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争中毁灭.

column1: A vast desert covers three quarters of the planets surface, whilst the remaining quarter is left to an organic rich ocean with deep sea farms.
column2: 广袤的沙漠覆盖了这颗行星四分之三的表面，而剩余的四分之一则是富含有机物的海洋，并设有深海农场.

column1: Tau Ceti is famous as the destination of the first manned mission to another star system, when Captain Norm McKenna on the TAS Pathfinder jumped to Tau Ceti and back in 2108, leading to the founding of the first human colony, named New Earth.
column2: Tau Ceti因作为首次载人前往另一个恒星系统的目的地而闻名，当时诺姆·麦肯纳船长乘坐TAS Pathfinder于 2108 年跃迁至Tau Ceti并返回，促成了首个名为新地球的人类殖民地的建立.

column1: Taumaturgo was a part of the Traders Domain province of the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era, but vanished during the First Succession War as the colony died out.
column2: Taumaturgo在星际联盟时代曾是外域联盟贸易者领域省的一部分，但在第一次继承战争期间随着殖民地消亡而消失了.

column1: The political and cultural capital of the Taurian Concordat, and the technological heart of the Periphery, this system is defended by a dangerous asteroid belt that makes it nearly impossible to approach without local support.
column2: 金牛协约国在政治和文化上的首府，也是外围的技术核心，这个星系由一条危险的小行星带保护着，没有当地支持的话接近它几乎是不可能的.

column1: Naturally forming geothermal holes pockmark the surface of Tawas, allowing easy access to drawing rich mineral wealth out of the deepest depths of the planet. Rumours of large shadow like creatures below are just that, rumours.
column2: Tawas表面遍布天然形成的地热孔洞，这使得人们可以轻松地从这颗行星的最深处开采出丰富的矿产财富. 有关其下方存在巨大阴影状生物的传闻，不过是传闻而已.

column1: An agricultural world wracked with storms, the capital city of Taygeta city still maintains some of the most nitrogen rich soils land in the entire Inner Sphere.
column2: 一个饱受风暴摧残的农业世界，其首府城市Taygeta City仍保有整个内天体中一些氮含量最丰富的土壤.

column1: Tazaraki is a planet or system within the Federated Suns territory. Located in the Edgeward Combat Theatre of the Capellan March, Tazaraki is near Beenleigh and Jenet and was wiped out during the Third Succession War.
column2: Tazaraki是恒星联邦领土内的一个行星或星系. 它位于卡佩拉边疆区的边缘战斗战区，靠近Beenleigh和Jenet，并在第三次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁.

column2: %%勘测数据损坏%%DEVIL!!EYE!!

column1: A major refiner and manufactury for nigonium, Tchamba secures its place at the heart of the Free Worlds League.
column2: 作为尼戈尼姆的主要精炼与制造中心，Tchamba稳居自由世界联盟的核心.

column1: Techne's Revenge was a member of the Magistracy of Canopus when a Star League Defense Force task force under the command of Captain-General Marion Marik was assigned to conquer the Magistracy of Canopus in 2577.
column2: 技术之复仇在2577年时是卡诺帕治安官辖区的一员，当时一支由马里昂·马里克总监将军指挥的星盟防卫部队特遣部队被派去征服卡诺帕治安官辖区。

column1: Founded in the Star League era, this colony was a hive of artistry and poetry until the Succession Wars, where upon its pristine forests were harvested for lumber and ironwood, and strip mining began.
column2: 建立于星际联盟时代，这个殖民地曾是艺术与诗歌的繁荣之地，直到继承战争爆发，其原始森林被砍伐以获取木材和铁木，露天采矿也随之开始.

column1: Tedibyhr was a Star League-era inhabited system in the Kathil Operational Area of the Capellan March within the Federated Suns, which was utterly destroyed by nuclear and fission weaponry during the First Succession War.
column2: Tedibyhr是星际联盟时代恒星联邦卡佩拉边区卡希尔作战区内的一个有人居住星系，在第一次继承战争期间被核武器和裂变武器彻底摧毁.

column1: A dry desert world orbit a K class star, Telgaldanas has two continents, separated by an ocean sized canyon.
column2: Telgaldanas是一个围绕K型恒星运行的干燥沙漠世界，拥有两块大陆，被一条海洋般大小的峡谷分隔.

column1: Tellman IV is an icy mining world within the Outworlds Alliance
column2: Tellman IV是外域联盟境内的一个冰封采矿世界.

column1: The colonists were overwhelmed by a small bat-like predator which led Dr. Tellman to forsooth that they were all doomed, but the bite turned out to be rarely fatal with the survivors boasting of better immune and digestion systems.
column2: 殖民者被一种小型蝙蝠状掠食者弄得不堪其扰，这让Tellman博士言之凿凿地断言他们都注定要完蛋，但这种咬伤后来被证明极少致命，幸存者还吹嘘自己拥有更强的免疫和消化系统.

column1: Telos IV has four continents: Dulles, Rustov, Fellin, and Haranshire. The capital city, Triumph, is located on Dulles. It has a large population that works in financial services as well as a satellite branch of Luthien Armour Works.
column2: Telos IV拥有四块大陆: Dulles、Rustov、Fellin和Haranshire. 首府城市Triumph位于Dulles. 它拥有大量从事金融服务业的人口，同时还有Luthien Armour Works的一个卫星分支机构.

column1: A small industrial outpost surrounds the main colony on this barren world. Many recreational facilities exist and nearby pirates are known to use it as a rest stop.
column2: 在这个贫瘠的世界，一座小型工业前哨站环绕着主殖民地. 这里有许多娱乐设施，已知附近的海盗会将其用作休息站.

column1: A small dry Earth-like planet with approximately half the gravity of Earth. The planet is covered by one enormous ocean. There are only two small continents, each no larger than the island of Borneo.
column2: 一颗干燥的小型类地行星，重力约为地球的一半. 这颗行星被一片巨大的海洋覆盖. 只有两块小大陆，每块都不大于婆罗洲岛.

column1: A small colony located on a hot ball of rock near to the B class star throughout most of the Succession Wars, it was destroyed by a solar flare.
column2: 一个位于靠近B型恒星的炽热岩石星球上的小型殖民地，在继承战争的大部分时间里都存在，最终被一次恒星耀斑摧毁.

column1: Deep boreholes pockmark the surface of Teniente, drawing rich mineral wealth out of the deepest depths of the planet. Some miners say they can see creatures down there...
column2: 深钻孔洞遍布Teniente的表面，从这颗行星的最深处开采出丰富的矿产资源. 一些矿工说，他们能在下面看到生物……

column1: Named as such for the first tentative steps of the colonists during the Star League era making their way onto a barren world, they nevertheless have managed to prosper and turn this world into a livable home.
column2: 之所以如此命名，是因为星际联盟时代殖民者初次试探性地踏上这个荒芜世界，尽管如此，他们还是成功繁荣发展，并将这个世界变成了宜居的家园.

column1: Terra is the home planet of humanity. Terra has been the capital of several interstellar nations and is the most industrialized planet in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 泰拉是人类母星. 泰拉曾是数个星际国家的首都，也是内天体中工业化程度最高的行星.

column1: Covered in huge forests and possessing abundant mineral resources, Terra Firma formed several trade agreements with its neighboring worlds. Bander BattleMechs have a facility here.
column2: 泰拉 Firma覆盖着广袤的森林，并拥有丰富的矿产资源，因而与周边世界缔结了多项贸易协定. Bander BattleMechs在此设有一处设施.

column1: Tetersen is a small atmospheric-less planetoid orbiting a large gas giant, which is inhabited by laboratories and hydroponics bays which research the impact of crop growing with a low gravity environment.
column2: Tetersen是一颗无大气的小型类行星体，围绕一颗巨大的气态巨行星运行，其上设有实验室和水培舱，用于研究低重力环境下作物种植的影响.

column1: Tetschner was settled during the Star League era, but was abandoned by the time of the Third Succession War.
column2: Tetschner于星际联盟时代建立定居点，但在第三次继承战争时已被废弃.

column1: Tetski was settled during the Star League era, and was a major industrial world until it was destroyed by chemical and biological agents during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tetski在星盟时代有人定居，并曾是一个主要工业世界，直到它在第二次继承战争期间被化学和生物制剂摧毁.

column1: With the highest population growth rate of the St. Ives worlds, Texlos is a pleasant garden-planet.Texlos serves as the main recruiting pool for the St. Ives Armored Cavalry regiments and also maintains a large and well equipped militia force.
column2: 作为St. Ives世界中人口增长率最高的星球，Texlos是一颗宜人的花园行星. Texlos是St. Ives装甲骑兵团的主要征兵来源地，同时也维持着一支规模庞大且装备精良的民兵部队.

column1: Previously a world containing numerous small automated mining colonies and a token population, it was destroyed during the Third Succession War.
column2: 这里曾是一个拥有众多小型自动化采矿殖民地和象征性人口的世界，但在第三次继承战争中遭到毁灭.

column1: A hot inhospitable world, it is nevertheless a bountiful source of rare materials not found on other worlds.
column2: 一个炎热而不宜居住的世界，但它却是其他世界上找不到的稀有材料的丰富来源.

column1: Recently colonised by the Circinus Federation, this icy cold mining colony is a source of precious Germanium for the Federation.
column2: 最近被圆规座联邦殖民，这个极寒的采矿殖民地是该联邦珍贵锗的来源.

column1: Thala is the capital world of the Axumite Providence. It was first settled in 2239 by colonists fleeing the Terran Alliance. Thala is a lush world with multiple smaller continents and ancient mountain ranges.
column2: Thala是阿克苏姆天命国的首都世界. 它于2239年由逃离泰拉联盟的殖民者首次定居. Thala是一颗郁郁葱葱的星球，拥有多个较小的洲和古老的山脉.

column1: An agricultural world wracked with storms, the capital city of Thannhausen Gate still maintains some of the most fertile land in the entire Inner Sphere.
column2: 一个饱受风暴侵袭的农业世界，Thannhausen Gate的首府仍保有整个内天体中一些最肥沃的土地.

column1: Tharkad is a icy and rugged planet, similar to the arctic wilderness of Terra. The planet consists of five major continents and three major island chains. The largest continent is Bremen and is home to Tharkad City, capital of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Tharkad是一颗冰冷而崎岖的行星，类似泰拉的极地荒野. 该行星由五大洲和三条主要岛链组成. 最大的大陆是不来梅，Tharkad城就坐落于此，它是天琴共同体的首都.

column1: Most of the population of Thasos live an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy.
column2: Thasos的大部分人口过着农业生活方式，其维持技术相当于泰拉在十八世纪末或十九世纪初的技术水平，这是Omniss哲学巨大影响的结果.

column1: Thazi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the Outworlds Alliance until it was abandoned entirely during the First Succession War.
column2: Thazi在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，并一直是外域联盟的一部分，直到第一次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Despite regular attack in the Succession Wars the Star League era Kallon Industries facilities still maintain the levels required for production of BattleMechs, such as the Wolverine.
column2: 尽管在继承战争中经常遭受攻击，星际联盟时代的卡隆工业设施仍保持着生产诸如“狼獾”等战斗机甲所需的水准.

column1: Thessalonika is a relatively poor world in terms of natural resources. Limited to a few petroleum deposits and gemstone veins, the first settlers landed here for a different feature: broad grasslands.
column2: Thessalonika在自然资源方面是一个相对贫瘠的世界. 这里的资源仅有少量石油矿藏和宝石矿脉，而首批定居者却是为了另一种特征在此登陆: 广阔的草原.

column1: Originally a frozen ball known only for precious metal deposits, a massive meteor strike pushed the planetoid into a closer orbit, rendering the planet habitable.
column2: 最初只是一颗仅以贵金属矿藏闻名的冰冻球体，一次巨大的陨石撞击将这颗小行星推入更近的轨道，使其变得宜居.

column1: A cluster of worlds located far from the Inner Sphere.
column2: 一群位于远离内天体的星球.

column1: A heavily irrigated desert world, most of the agricultural work is automated. It produces many exports, considering its small size.
column2: 一个灌溉程度很高的沙漠世界，大部分农业工作都已自动化. 考虑到其规模很小，它的出口商品却很多.

column1: Thimphu is a simple agricultural world that was devastated in the Fourth Succession War when a JumpShip crashed into the main colony.
column2: Thimphu是一个质朴的农业世界，在第四次继承战争中，一艘跃迁舰撞上了主要殖民地，使其遭到毁灭性破坏.

column1: Thirty Weight was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the Marik Commonwealth until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Thirty Weight在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被建立定居点，并一直是马里克共同体的一部分，直到第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Thorin is a Terra-like world, which has one moon (Thorin's Twin). It is considered a jewel of a world and is home to much metal and mineral wealth utilised by manufacturers such as Newhart Industries and Johnson-Aldis Weaponries.
column2: 索林是一颗类地行星，拥有一颗卫星（索林之双）。它被视为一颗宝石般的世界，蕴藏着大量金属与矿产财富，被纽哈特工业与约翰逊-阿尔迪斯兵工等制造商所利用。

column1: Thorn is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League.
column2: Thorn是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一.

column1: Thraxa is a semi-arctic world on the border between the Magistracy of Canopus and the Marian Hegemony. The northern landmass is tundra, a result of a deliberate conservation policy that keeps the tundra intact between cities and settlements.
column2: Thraxa是一颗半北极星球，位于船底自治区与马里安霸权之间的边境上. 北部大陆是苔原，这是刻意实施保护政策的结果，该政策使城市与定居点之间的苔原保持原貌.

column1: Thuban is a vast open-environment world with a breathable atmosphere and wide, lava-encrusted plains around Scorpius Mons, the planet's largest highest volcano
column2: 图班是一颗广阔的开阔环境行星，拥有可呼吸的大气，其最大最高的火山蝎子山周围环绕着大片覆满熔岩的平原

column1: Thule is divided into three large continents. Vik with the capital 'Thule City', Akranes as the agricultural center, whilst Husavik is frozen wasteland with several research posts. Bergan Industries, a major Locust manufacturer, has facilities here.
column2: 图勒分为三块大陆。维克拥有首都"图勒城"，阿克拉内斯是农业中心，而胡萨维克则是冰封荒原，设有若干研究站。主要蝗虫制造商贝根工业在这里有设施。

column1: Thun is known for its deep, dry canyons which are often subject to landslips and falls under the high gravity of the world.
column2: Thun以其深邃、干燥的峡谷而闻名，这些峡谷在该世界的高重力下常常发生滑坡和崩塌.

column1: The site of a decisive battle between the SLDF and the Magistracy almost 500 years ago, Thurrock has long since recovered from that war and now thrives as a regional industrial and tourism center.
column2: 瑟罗克在500年前是星际联盟防卫军与船底自治区一场决定性战斗的战场，但它早已从战争中恢复过来，现在是地区性的工业中心与旅游中心.

column1: Tianamon was part of the Sarna Commonality of the Cappelan Confederation, but was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War due to famine.
column2: Tianamon曾是卡佩拉邦联Sarna共同体的一部分，但在第三次继承战争期间因饥荒被彻底废弃.

column1: A large manufacturing center situated on a rich mineral world, Clan Hell Horse and Wolf both have large facilities here.
column2: 一个位于矿产资源丰富世界的大型制造中心，地狱马氏族和狼氏族都在此拥有大型设施.

column1: Tiber is probably best known as the home of Earthwerks Incorporated. Recently the world has been rocked by violence as the labor unions on the world incited their members to riot
column2: Tiber最出名的可能便是它是地球工厂股份有限公司的所在地. 最近，该星球上的工会煽动其成员暴动，使这颗星球陷入了暴力动荡.

column1: An average agricultural world that produces large amounts of Terran timber. This timber is exported, but before it leaves the world it serves as an obstacle to the severe wind storms. The world is notable only for the Surb Gevorg Manufacturing plant.
column2: 一个普通的农业星球，出产大量地球木材. 这些木材会被出口，但在离开这个星球之前，它们被用来阻挡猛烈的风暴. 这个星球唯一值得注意的是Surb Gevorg制造厂.

column1: A well-educated population and the highly industrialized economy make Tigress a significant asset for the controlling house. Large Star League era fusion generators power the cities and provide free power to industry across the world.
column2: 受过良好教育的人口和高度工业化的经济，使Tigress成为掌控家族的一项重要资产. 星际联盟时代的大型聚变发电机为城市供电，并为全球工业提供免费电力.

column1: One of the earliest systems colonised, Tikonov has seen more than its share of conflict.  The numerous Earthwerks (and other) factories has seen it become a battlefield several times, and was most recently taken over by the Feds some 10 years ago.
column2: 作为最早被殖民的星系之一，Tikonov经历的冲突远超其应承受的程度. 众多的Earthwerks（以及其他）工厂使其数次沦为战场，而最近一次是在大约10年前被联邦接管.

column1: Timbiqui is home to a major manufacturer, Timbiqui Spirits, which is known throughout the Inner Sphere primarily for its best-known brand of beer, Timbiqui Dark. A favored choice among mercenaries, Timbiqui Dark is even sold in the Deep Periphery.
column2: Timbiqui是大型制造商Timbiqui Spirits的所在地，该公司在整个内天体声名远扬，主要是因为其最著名的啤酒品牌Timbiqui Dark. Timbiqui Dark深受雇佣兵青睐，甚至在深空外围也有销售.

column1: A dry desert world orbit a K class star, Timbuktu has two continents, Hades and Saharius where the capital city Greene is located. The Timbuktu-based corporation Diplass BattleMechs was destroyed entirely during the Amaris Civil War.
column2: Timbuktu是一颗环绕K型恒星运行的干燥沙漠世界，拥有两块大陆——哈迪斯和萨哈里乌斯，首都格林位于萨哈里乌斯. 总部位于Timbuktu的迪普拉斯战斗机甲公司已在阿马里斯内战期间被彻底摧毁.

column1: An Earth-like planet with an unusually large axial tilt causing extreme seasonal changes. Both the northern and southern hemispheres experience complete darkness for several months at a time.
column2: 一颗类地行星，其自转轴倾角异常巨大，导致极端的季节变化. 南北半球每次都会经历长达数月的完全黑暗.

column1: A cold, tundral world at the outer edge of its star's habitable zone. There are no oceans or continents, but the surface is littered with lakes and small seas. Coniferous forests cover much of the surface.
column2: 一颗寒冷、冻原化的世界，位于其恒星宜居带外缘。那里没有海洋或大陆，但地表散布着湖泊与小海。针叶林覆盖了大部分地表。

column1: Tinaca has one major continent, 'The Island' where the capital city Tandalola is located. It is home to a live fire training ground often utilised by the Sun Zhang MechWarrior Academy.
column2: 蒂纳卡有一个主要大陆——"岛屿"，首府坦达洛拉坐落于此。这里是孙章机师学院经常使用的实弹训练场的所在地。

column1: Tincalunas was abandoned due to natural disasters that make it a marginal colony despite its Terran climate. Intense tidal forces from a nearby gas giant shattered the planet's moon and cause constant volcanism on the surface.
column2: 廷卡卢纳斯因自然灾害而被废弃，那些灾害使它尽管拥有类地气候却仍是边缘殖民地。附近一颗气态巨行星强烈的潮汐力撕碎了该行星的卫星，并在地表造成持续不断的火山活动。

column1: In 2412, FWLM force invaded Tintavel. The battle escalated until both sides employed weapons of mass destruction, leading to over 300,000 casualties and abandonment of the planet. The tragedy caused all sides to meet and form the Ares convention.
column2: 2412年，FWLM部队入侵了Tintavel. 战斗不断升级，直到双方都动用了大规模杀伤性武器，导致超过30万人伤亡，该星球也因此被废弃. 这场悲剧促使各方会面并缔结了《阿瑞斯公约》.

column1: Tirabad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tirabad是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Tiruchchirappalli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tiruchchirappalli是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃了.

column1: An extremely hot planet. Mostly desert but with some small seas in the northern and southern hemispheres. The equatorial regions are too hot for most species, and so the only settlements are situated in the extreme polar regions.
column2: 一颗极其炎热的行星. 大部分地区是沙漠，但在北半球和南半球有一些小片海洋. 赤道地区对大多数物种来说过于炎热，因此唯一的定居点都位于极地地区.

column1: A hot prison world with a nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. This planet was once covered with lush rainforest, but was burnt away during the First Succession War.
column2: 一颗拥有氮氧大气的酷热监狱世界。这颗行星曾覆盖着葱郁雨林，但在第一次继承战争期间被烧毁。

column1: A large rocky planet with high gravity and a thin atmosphere. The atmosphere only extends about 1 mile above sea level, and many mountain tops are exposed to the vacuum of space. Habitable areas are in the deep valleys between mountain ranges.
column2: 一颗大型岩石行星，重力高，大气稀薄. 大气仅延伸至海平面以上约1英里，许多山峰暴露在太空真空中. 宜居区域位于山脉之间的深谷中.

column1: Tiverton is a lush water world, with archipelagos of volcanic islands strewn all around the surface. Fishing and algae farming are the backbone industries, but its also known for being a haven for organized crime and piracy.
column2: 郁郁葱葱的水系星球蒂弗顿遍布着由火山岛组成的群岛. 渔业和藻类养殖是星球上的支柱产业，但这里同时也是著名的有组织罪犯与海盗的避风港.

column1: An enormous gas giant at the outer edge of its star's habitable zone. It supports a system of small to medium-sized moons. One of the moons has a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere but is not considered habitable due to extremes of temperature.
column2: 一颗位于其恒星宜居带外缘的巨型气态行星。它拥有由中小型卫星组成的卫星系。其中一颗卫星有可呼吸的氮氧大气，但因温度极端而不被认为适宜居住。

column1: Toffen is an arid world with a meagre population largely made up of isolationist loners living on scattered farms.
column2: Toffen是一个干旱的世界，人口稀少，主要由生活在分散农场中的孤立主义独居者组成.

column1: During the Star League era, Togura was rich in much-needed industrial metals and rare earths which turned it into a heavily industrialised world. Even now, numerous companies such as Stellar Trek and Osaka Heavy Metrics maintain shipyards in orbit.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Togura富含急需的工业金属和稀土，这使其成为一个高度工业化的世界. 即便现在，Stellar Trek和Osaka Heavy Metrics等众多公司仍在轨道上维护着船坞.

column1: A small world with extremely low gravity, about the size of Earth's moon. The planet is home to the 'Jump-World Low Gravity Theme Park', which is situated inside a giant glass dome for the safety and breathing-comfort of its visitors.
column2: 一颗引力极低的小型世界，大小约相当于地球的月亮。该星球上有“跳跃世界低重力主题公园”，坐落在一座巨大玻璃穹顶之内，以保证游客的安全与呼吸舒适。

column1: A small Earth-like planet with oceans and several large continents typified by open grassland regions. The planet serves as an agricultural colony, with large farms covering much of its surface.
column2: 一颗小型类地行星，拥有海洋和若干大片以开阔草原地带为特征的大陆. 该行星作为农业殖民地，其表面大部分被大型农场覆盖.

column1: Tokasha's most notable feature is the high levels of oxygen in its atmosphere. The planet has wide ranges of oceans and lush wilderness of forests and jungles. The native animal life is highly hostile to terrestrial based life.
column2: 托卡沙最显著的特征是其大气中的高氧含量。该星球拥有广阔海洋以及茂密森林与丛林的荒野。本土动物对陆地生命极具敌意。

column1: A vastly populated jungle world with many untapped resources. Alshain Weapons is headquartered on Tok Do and produces light BattleMechs for the Draconis Combine.
column2: 一个人口稠密的丛林星球，拥有许多未开采的资源. Alshain Weapons总部位于Tok Do，为天龙座联合体生产轻型战斗机甲.

column1: Toland was settled by a mixture of artists and craftsmen fleeing from the First Succession War. Toland has three moons, expanses of jungle and natural resources that include rare minerals.
column2: Toland最初由一群逃离第一次继承战争的艺术家和工匠混合定居. Toland拥有三颗卫星、大片丛林，以及包括稀有矿物在内的自然资源.

column1: Deep within the Hanseatic League, Tomalov exports many foodstuffs to other Hanseatic Worlds.
column2: 在汉萨同盟腹地，Tomalov向其他汉萨世界出口大量食品.

column1: Tomans is home to the Lyran Biomaterials Complex, a vast research complex that researches and manufactures new materials.
column2: Tomans是天琴生物材料综合体的所在地，这是一座庞大的研究综合体，负责研究和制造新材料.

column1: Tongatapu is an arid world that is rich in high grade ores and material. It's surface is dotted with mines owned by Technicron Manufacturing which produce raw material which is then shipped to Tamarind, their JumpShip shipyard.
column2: 汤加塔布是一颗干旱世界，富含高品位矿石与材料。它地表遍布技术电子制造公司的矿场，产出的原材料随后被运往塔马林德，即他们的跃迁舰船坞所在地。

column1: Tordenskjold was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tordenskjold在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Torgvei was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Torgvei在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间被彻底毁灭.

column1: An Earth-like planet with an unusually large axial tilt causing extreme seasonal changes. Both the northern and southern hemispheres experience harsh winters, with cold nights that can last for weeks or months at a time depending on latitude.
column2: 一颗类地行星，其转轴倾角异常巨大，导致极端的季节变化. 北半球和南半球都会经历严酷的冬季，寒冷的夜晚视纬度而定，一次可持续数周甚至数月.

column1: An icy world with vast underground caverns and unique fauna, Torrence is home to military manufacturer Veridian Dynamics and one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the Suns, Vinson Pharmaceuticals.
column2: Torrence是一个拥有广阔地下洞穴和独特动物群的冰封世界，是军事制造商Veridian Dynamics以及恒星联邦最大的制药公司之一Vinson Pharmaceuticals的所在地.

column1: The Tortuga Prime system was settled by the remains of the 237th Light Cavalry Regiment in the closing stages of the Reunification War. It is the Capital of the bandit kingdom known as the Tortuga Dominions.
column2: Tortuga Prime星系由第237轻骑兵团的残部在统一战争末期建立定居点. 它是被称为Tortuga Dominions的强盗王国的首都.

column1: Toten was settled during the Star League era due to its asteroid field rich in germanium, a vital material for JumpShip construction. As such a vital target, it was destroyed utterly during the violence of the First Succession War.
column2: Toten在星际联盟时代因小行星带富含锗而得到殖民，锗是建造跃迁舰的重要材料. 作为如此重要的目标，它在第一次继承战争的战火中被彻底摧毁.

column1: Totness was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Totness在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时间被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Tottori was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was devastated and abandoned during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tottori在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间遭到毁灭并被废弃.

column1: Tovetin (Tovetine) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was destroyed entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Tovetin（Tovetine）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但它在第三次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁了.

column1: Towne is a slightly cooler Terran world which boasts good mineral and lumber wealth. The many active volcanoes and other geological activities continue to give the impression that the world is bigger than it actually is.
column2: Towne是一颗略偏寒冷的类地行星，拥有丰富的矿产和木材资源. 众多活火山及其他地质活动不断使其显得比实际更为庞大.

column1: A small Earth-like planet with approximately half the gravity of Earth. The planet is dotted with many small islands and a large continent covers the northern polar region. Much of the exports from Trasjkis are in the form of aquatic food.
column2: 一颗类似地球的小型行星，重力约为地球的一半. 行星上散布着许多小岛，北部极区被一块大陆覆盖. Trasjkis的出口商品大部分是水产品.

column1: Traussin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Traussin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃了.

column1: Winfield was originally named Treeline, but was gifted to the commander of the Stealths, Colonel Raymond Winfield, by Archon Elizabeth Steiner after their destruction in the conquest of Sakhalin in 2863 and renamed \"Winfield\" in his honour.
column2: 温菲尔德原名“树线”，2863 年隐形部队在征服萨哈林一役中全军覆没后，大公伊丽莎白·施泰纳将其赠予这支部队的指挥官雷蒙德·温菲尔德上校，并以其姓氏重新命名为“温菲尔德”。

column1: A planetary year on Trellwan is only 45 standard days, while a planetary day is 30.5 standard days due to the planet's slow rotation. As a result, vulcanism and earthquakes are common and the climatic changes are quite abrupt and severe.
column2: 特雷尔万的恒星年只有45个标准日，而行星日因该行星自转缓慢长达30.5个标准日。因此火山活动与地震频发，气候变化也相当突兀剧烈。

column1: Trellisane was settled by rabid democrats with the excitement to enact a direct democracy. It did not last until a novel solution was found only allowing a third of the population to vote on a rotating basis.
column2: Trellisane由狂热的民主主义者定居，他们满怀热情地想要推行直接民主. 但这种制度没能维持多久，直到有人想出一种新奇的解决方案: 只允许三分之一的人口轮流投票.

column1: An enormous super-earth planet with a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere but extremely high gravity. One large continent stretches from the north pole to the south pole. Forests of carnivorous plants cover much of the landmass.
column2: 一颗巨大的超级地球行星，拥有可呼吸的氮氧大气，但重力极高。一整块大陆从北极延伸到南极。食肉植物森林覆盖了大部分陆地。

column1: An ocean world with few large landmasses but thousands of tiny islands. The islands of Northern Trentham are famous for their petrified forests. Nearby islands are used for training, weapons testing, and secretive research facilities.
column2: 一个海洋世界，大型陆地稀少，但拥有成千上万个小岛. Northern Trentham的岛屿以石化森林闻名. 附近的岛屿被用于训练、武器测试和秘密研究设施.

column1: Tresspass was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War after substantial bombardment.
column2: Tresspass在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间遭受大规模轰炸后被完全废弃.

column1: An industrialised world during the Star League, Triesting was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. In the First Succession War the factories were erased from existence, leaving only scant remains which still exist today.
column2: 在星际联盟时期，Triesting是一个工业化世界，并曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地. 第一次继承战争期间，工厂被彻底抹去，只留下少量至今仍存的残迹.

column1: A lifeless planet with an economy centered around gambling. Aside from a few uranium mines, gambling is the only industry on the planet. Loose gaming laws are the only reason this backwater colony exists.
column2: 一颗没有生命的行星，其经济以赌博为中心. 除了几座铀矿外，赌博是这颗行星上唯一的产业. 宽松的博彩法律是这个偏远落后殖民地得以存在的唯一原因.

column1: Trinidad has three heavily populated continents: Arawak, Galibi, and Raleigh. The capital city, Warao, is located on Raleigh.
column2: Trinidad拥有三块人口稠密的大陆: Arawak、Galibi和Raleigh. 首府Warao位于Raleigh.

column1: A terrestrial planet with an extremely slow axial rotation. Forests of giant fungal organisms dominate much of the surface. In orbit are three heavily fortified moons.
column2: 一颗自转极其缓慢的类地行星. 巨型真菌生物构成的森林覆盖了大部分地表. 轨道上运行着三颗防御严密的卫星.

column1: An almost lifeless rock with no atmosphere, about the size of Earth's moon. A few uranium mines are the only signs of life here, and they're mostly automated. Rumours of Star League caches hidden under the surface keep the population busy though.
column2: 这是一块几乎无生命、没有大气的岩石，大小约相当于地球的月亮。几座铀矿是这里唯一的生命迹象，而且大多是自动化的。关于地表下藏有星际联盟储藏点的传言让当地人忙个不停。

column1: A former Combine world that is now a key planet in the Free Rasalhague Republic.  Recent vulcanic activity has brought a plethora of mineral deposits to the surface, making this an important mining planet for the FRR.
column2: 一个曾是联合体世界、如今是自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的关键行星. 近期的火山活动将大量矿床带到了地表，使其成为FRR的重要采矿行星.

column1: Trondheim is home to some of the JàrnFòlk's few heavy industries, concentrated around the capital city of Narvik, and is where all of the parts for their various starships are manufactured and shuttled to orbiting dry docks.
column2: 特隆赫姆是雅恩福克人少数重工业的所在地，集中在首都纳尔维克周围，他们各类星舰的所有部件都在这里制造，然后被运往轨道干船坞。

column1: Primarily an iron and processed steel heavy goods manufacturing world, Trondheimal is a vital part of the growing Illyrian Palatinate economy. Habitable areas are restricted to the mountain sides.
column2: Trondheimal主要是一个以铁和加工钢材为主的重型货物制造世界，是不断发展的伊利里亚帕拉蒂纳特经济中至关重要的一部分. 宜居区域仅限于山坡地带.

column1: Once a desert planet with vast irrigated flood plains, Truth was devastated in the Third Succession War. Most of the populated die of famine, leaving only a few token hardy survivors on the surface.
column2: Truth曾是一颗沙漠星球，拥有辽阔的灌溉洪泛平原，但在第三次继承战争中遭到毁灭性打击. 大部分人口死于饥荒，地表上只剩下少数顽强求生的幸存者.

column1: The Trznadel Cluster is a quaternion system, containing numerous mineral rich planets, which are mined to power the Magistracy of Canopus's industrial base.
column2: 特尔兹纳德星团是一个四星系系统，包含众多富含矿物的星球，其矿产被开采来驱动卡诺帕斯行政区的工业基础。

column1: Originally named Tsunami, Tsamma was settled as an agricultural world. The many turbulent oceans have a low salt content which make it easy to create potable water. This has made Tsamma the largest exporter of drinking water in fifty light years.
column2: Tsamma最初名为Tsunami，是作为农业世界建立殖民地的. 众多汹涌的海洋盐度很低，因此很容易制取饮用水. 这使Tsamma成为五十光年范围内最大的饮用水出口地.

column1: An ocean world with a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. Only a single island-continent rises above sea-level. While the ocean is teeming with complex life, only single-celled organisms have ventured onto the land.
column2: 一颗拥有可呼吸氮氧大气层的海洋世界。只有一块岛状大陆高出海平面。海洋中充满复杂生命，但只有单细胞生物登上了陆地。

column1: A small rocky planet in the Lagrange point of a gas giant. The planet has no atmosphere, but incredibly there is life here, living in large underground reservoirs of water.
column2: 一颗位于气态巨行星拉格朗日点上的小型岩石行星. 这颗行星没有大气层，但不可思议的是，这里有生命存在，它们生活在巨大的地下储水层中.

column1: A small, flat, muddy planet. There are no oceans, instead the surface is covered with a shallow layer of water. A single moon creates a strong tidal effect, making the entire planet a tidal mudflat - perfect for certain crops and brewing of beer.
column2: 一颗小巧、平坦、泥泞的行星. 没有海洋，取而代之的是表面覆盖着一层浅水. 一颗卫星产生强烈的潮汐效应，使整个行星成为潮汐泥滩——非常适合某些作物和酿造啤酒.

column1: Tsitsang's warm and temperate climate allows the colonists are able to enjoy three full growing seasons on each of the three continents on the planet, all of which were located on the equator.
column2: 齐齐桑温暖温和的气候让殖民者得以在该行星三块大陆上各享受三个完整的生长季，而这些大陆全都位于赤道上。

column1: From orbit this tropical paradise looks idyllic, however the wildlife draws energy from nitrogen rather than oxygen, and are completely inedible. All food must be imported to Tsukude but the vast amounts of rare gases are a major export.
column2: 从轨道上看，这个热带天堂宛如田园诗般宁静，然而这里的野生动物从氮而非氧中获取能量，并且完全无法食用. 所有食物都必须进口到Tsukude，但大量的稀有气体是主要出口产品.

column1: A small Earth-like planet with a thin nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. A long, narrow continent follows the line of the equator, stretching half way around the planet. The most successful creatures on the planet are large protomammals.
column2: 一颗小型类地行星，拥有稀薄的氮氧大气。一条狭长的大陆沿赤道线延伸，环绕该行星半圈。该行星上最成功的生物是大型原哺乳动物。

column1: Tuat was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned before the Third Succession War. It was once host to a large SLDF garrison, which means rumours of LosTech caches are rampant.
column2: Tuat在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在第三次继承战争之前被废弃了. 它曾拥有一支庞大的SLDF驻军，这意味着关于失落科技储藏点的谣言甚嚣尘上.

column1: This picturesque world offers a multitude of different terrain, with many religious monasteries dotting its surface. Pretty unremarkable and will be resigned to be forgotten in the history books...
column2: 这个风景如画的世界拥有多种不同的地形，其表面点缀着许多宗教修道院. 相当平平无奇，注定会被历史书遗忘……

column1: The valuable Turin beef is grown on the vast grasslands of the planet's single continent, although maintaining the alien-Terran hybrid is expensive. In recent years, the ranchers have begun branching out into horse breeding.
column2: 珍贵的都灵牛肉生长在该行星唯一大陆的广袤草原上，尽管维持这种外星-类地杂交品种成本高昂。近年来，牧场主们开始向马匹繁育拓展。

column1: A terrestrial planet with an unusually large axial tilt causing extreme seasonal changes. The most advanced forms of life on the planet are marsupials.
column2: 一颗类地行星，其轴倾角异常巨大，导致极端的季节变化. 该行星上最高级的生命形式是有袋类动物.

column1: Turkalia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a major battleground in the First Succession War until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Turkalia是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民定居的，并在第一次继承战争中成为主要战场，直到在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: Turko was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Turko在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Turov was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Turov是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃了.

column1: Turtle Bay is a world located near the Periphery border with the Draconis Combine.
column2: Turtle Bay是一颗位于与天龙联合体接壤的边地边境附近的行星.

column1: The fertile soils of Tuscarawas are home to many farms, as well as Interstellar Harvesters, an agricultural and industrial equipment producer.
column2: Tuscarawas肥沃的土壤是众多农场的家园，也是农业及工业设备生产商Interstellar Harvesters的所在地.

column1: Twycross is a weather-wild desert planet, where cataclysmic events and powerful wind storms are common. Due to these storms the population placed their cities and towns underground or made surface structures squat and flat.
column2: Twycross是一颗气候狂暴的沙漠行星，灾难性事件和强风暴在这里十分常见. 由于这些风暴，居民将城市和城镇建在地下，或将地表建筑建得低矮扁平.

column1: Tybalt is a world that suffers from frequent earthquakes. Eleven continents are on the world, but ten of them are so covered in mountains that large human settlement is impossible.
column2: Tybalt是一个频繁遭受地震的星球. 该星球上有十一个大陆，但其中十个都布满山脉，以至于无法进行大规模人类定居.

column1: Tylarzka was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Tylarzka是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: Tyrlon's two worlds are both inhabited. Arid Tyrlon 5 is an agricultural world, with farming in the flood-plains of its major river systems. Oceanic Tyrlon 6 has a toxic concentration of oxygen but is habitable on plateaus above the dense cloud layer. It is there that House Parata has its seat of power.
column2: 泰尔隆的两颗星球都有人居住。干旱的泰尔隆 5 是农业星球，人们在其主要河系的泛滥平原上耕作。海洋星球泰尔隆 6 的氧气浓度有毒，但可在浓密云层之上的高原居住。帕拉塔家族（House Parata）的权力中枢就设在那里。

column1: Tyrrhenia is home to numerous mining companies who desire access to the vast riches contained under the surface of this otherwise barren world. The Fourth Succession War has delayed further industrialisation.
column2: Tyrrhenia是众多采矿公司的所在地，它们渴望获取这颗在其他方面贫瘠的星球地表之下蕴藏的巨大财富. 第四次继承战争推迟了进一步的工业化.

column1: Ubangi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ubangi在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: A small agricultural world with a plethora of native life, Udibi has a growing pharmaceuticals sector. The tasty Gyru lizards also roam the many forests.
column2: Udibi是一个小型农业世界，拥有大量本土生命，其制药业正在不断发展. 美味的Gyru蜥蜴也出没于众多森林中.

column1: Ueda is a cold planet orbiting at the outer edge of its star's habitable zone, but it is kept relatively warm by its atmosphere, which is mostly composed of CO2. This is a damp, boggy world, prone to excessive rain and seasonal flooding.
column2: 上田是一颗寒冷行星，运行在其恒星宜居带的外缘，但它的大气（主要由二氧化碳构成）让它相对温暖。这是一颗潮湿泥泞的世界，多雨且季节性洪水频发。

column1: Ugland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ugland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: By the end of the Star League era Uhuru was a major industrial center, but the First Succession War devastated the planet. By the Second, those living on Uhuru were reduced to a bare subsistence level of existence from which they have not recovered.
column2: 到星际联盟时代末期，Uhuru已是一个主要工业中心，但第一次继承战争使这颗行星遭到毁灭性打击. 到第二次继承战争时，生活在Uhuru上的人们已沦落到仅能勉强维生的生存水平，至今仍未恢复.

column1: Ukunela was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ukunela在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被建立定居点，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: A habitable dwarf planet famous for its “stone forests”.
column2: 一个适宜居住的矮行星，以其“石林”而闻名.

column1: Settled in 2271 thanks to its steppe landscapes suitable for pastoral farming. In the years prior to the fall of the Star League, the SLDF built numerous small forts and hidden boltholes across the landscape of Ulan Bator.
column2: 2271年，由于拥有适合畜牧业的草原地貌，这里得以建立定居点. 在星际联盟覆灭前的那些年里，SLDF在Ulan Bator的地貌上建造了许多小型堡垒和隐蔽的藏身处.

column1: Ullieri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ullieri是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居的，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃了.

column1: Ulsan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ulsan在统一战争结束后的星联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Ulubis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Ulubis在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Ulvskollen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ulvskollen是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: An agricultural world known for their oversized four leaf clovers and their gigantic alien honey bees. The Tsamma Crucis March Militia often recruited here.
column2: 一个农业世界，以其超大的四叶草和巨大的外星蜜蜂而闻名. Tsamma Crucis March Militia经常在此招募.

column1: Due to the tidal stresses of Umgard's two moons, the planet is torn by volcanoes and earthquakes, and the air is a near-toxic soup of foul-smelling gases. It's a jungle world, with forests teeming with life, but machinery tends to corrode quickly in the murky environment.
column2: 由于 Umgard 两颗卫星引发的潮汐应力，这颗星球被火山与地震撕扯得支离破碎，空气中弥漫着近乎有毒的恶臭气体浓汤。这是一颗丛林星球，森林中生机盎然，但机械在这种阴暗潮湿的环境中往往腐蚀得很快。

column1: A hotspot for Yakuza activity, Umijiri has recently been the key training ground of the Seventh and Eight Ghost regiments. These regiments are made up of former (and current) criminals and prisoners.
column2: 作为极道活动的热点，Umijiri最近一直是第七和第八幽灵团的重要训练场. 这些团由曾经的（以及当前的）罪犯和囚犯组成.

column1: Umka was settled for its extremely rich aquaculture, but it wasn't until later that heavy ores were discovered. Kerr-McGuiness, a manufacturer of BattleMech armour, has a large facility here, producing thousands of tons of Mech armour annually.
column2: 乌姆卡因其极其丰富的水产养殖而被殖民，但直到后来才发现重金属矿。战斗机甲装甲制造商科尔-麦吉尼斯在这里有大型设施，每年生产数千吨机甲装甲。

column1: A small rocky planet in the Lagrange point of a gas giant. The planet has no atmosphere, but incredibly there is life here, living in large underground caverns filled with a mixture of atmospheric gasses.
column2: 一颗位于气态巨行星拉格朗日点的小型岩石行星. 这颗行星没有大气层，但令人难以置信的是，这里有生命存在，它们生活在充满混合大气气体的巨大地下洞穴中.

column1: A star cluster containing numerous small colonies far from the Inner Sphere.
column2: 一个远离内天体、包含众多小型殖民地的星团.

column1: An agricultural world with a substantial trading outpost. One corporation, Pesht Motors, has a small facility on the planet producing many small cars and tractors, but with the option to expand into larger units.
column2: 一个农业世界，设有一座规模可观的贸易前哨站. 一家名为Pesht Motors的企业在该星球上拥有一座小型设施，生产大量小型汽车和拖拉机，但也可选择扩展至更大型的产品.

column1: Unkador was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Unkador是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃了.

column1: The surface of Untran is an endless bleak desert, with scouring winds and sand. It's honeycombed with caves, where the original Capellan colonists harvested precious stones and ores. The planet has no agriculture at all; when it was abandoned, the colonies withered and died.
column2: 安特兰的地表是一片无尽荒凉的沙漠，饱受蚀骨狂风与沙尘。它满是洞穴，最初的卡佩兰殖民者在那里采掘宝石与矿石。该行星完全没有农业；它被废弃时，殖民地便枯萎死亡。

column1: A tropical paradise known for its rainforests, beaches, and colorful wildlife. With little natural resources of its own, it survives as an R&R stop off point for many ships.
column2: 一个热带天堂，以雨林、海滩和色彩斑斓的野生动物而闻名. 自身几乎没有自然资源，依靠作为许多飞船的R&R中途停靠站而存续.

column1: An arctic world with rocky terrain and majestic canyons, such as the Hester-Kester Fjord. Once the site of an ancient Castle Brian, it now houses a rugged but determined group of miners.
column2: 这是一个极寒世界，地形崎岖多岩，拥有壮丽的峡谷，例如Hester-Kester峡湾. 这里曾是古老布莱恩城堡的所在地，如今居住着一群粗犷却意志坚定的矿工.

column1: A tropical paradise known for its rainforests, beaches, and colorful wildlife. A single continent stretches unbroken around the planet's equator, separating the northern and southern oceans. This continent is teeming with life, as are the oceans.
column2: 一处以雨林、海滩和绚丽野生动植物闻名的热带天堂。一整块大陆不间断地沿该行星赤道延伸，分隔北南海域。这块大陆生机勃勃，海洋亦然。

column1: The arctic like planet is one of the training groups for the 2nd Ceti Hussars.
column2: 这颗类似北极的行星是第二鲸鱼座骠骑兵的训练场地之一.

column1: Úr Cruinne is a frozen wasteland, but geothermal vents create temperate zones in which the planet's few inhabitants live and mine the plentiful mineral resources.
column2: 乌尔克林涅是一片冰封荒原，但地热喷口造就了温带区域，星球上为数不多的居民便生活在那里，开采丰富的矿产资源。

column1: Úr Cruinne
column2: 乌尔克鲁纳

column1: The Urich system was colonized either during or shortly before the Age of War. During the final years of the Star League, Urich was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: Urich星系在战争年代期间或之前不久被殖民. 在星际联盟的最后几年，Urich驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

column1: Settled before the Reunification War, it look substantial damage during that war from Free Worlds forces. The rocky terrain allows for jump jet capable troops to ambush others in large canyons and ridges.
column2: 在统一战争之前已有人定居，在那场战争中它遭到了自由世界联盟部队的严重破坏. 多岩石的地形使具备跳跃喷射能力的部队得以在大型峡谷和山脊中伏击他人.

column1: The capital city of Utrecht is Naragajan, situated high on the Labbie Plateau, one of the flattest regions of this otherwise jagged and rocky planet.
column2: Utrecht的首府是纳拉加詹，坐落在拉比高原高处，这里是这颗在其他方面崎岖多岩的星球上最平坦的区域之一.

column1: Situated close to the sun in this system, the local time on Uzhgorod only has 41 standard minutes per hour, said to be the shortest in the entire Lyran Commonwealth at the time.
column2: 由于位于该星系中靠近恒星的位置，Uzhgorod上的当地时间每小时仅有 41 标准分钟，据说当时是整个天琴共同体中最短的.

column1: Vaajakoski was a system in the Kajikazawa Prefecture of the Benjamin Military District of the Draconis Combine until it was destroyed and abandoned during the Second Succession War.
column2: Vaajakoski曾是天龙联合体本杰明军区尾川辖区内的一个星系，直到第二次继承战争期间被摧毁并废弃.

column1: An agroworld that is home to a regiment of the mercenary group known as the Dioscuri.
column2: 一个农业世界，是名为Dioscuri的雇佣兵集团一个团的驻地.

column1: Vakarel is an ice world with a turbulent atmosphere of perpetual blizzards called the \"Star Veil\". Native fauna includes the predatory Ugmar. There are rumours that Qaere Crystals are found in great quantity on Vakarel, but not officially confirmed.
column2: 瓦卡雷尔是一颗冰封世界，其动荡的大气被称为"星幕"，永不停歇的暴风雪。原生动物群包括掠食性的乌格玛。有传言称瓦卡雷尔上大量存在奎尔晶体，但未获官方证实。

column1: The Valabhi system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Valabhi星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: The Valasha system is a key entry point to the Outworlds Alliance. With its high energy star, multiple jumpships as well as cargo transfer and recharge stations could be found at both of Valasha's main jump points.
column2: 瓦拉沙星系是外域联盟的关键入口。由于其高能恒星，瓦拉沙的两个主要跳跃点都能见到多艘跃迁舰以及货运转运与充能站。

column1: Valdives was originally colonized by those looking to exploit its vast geothermal energy, but the volcanos proved to be more trouble than it was worth. Lostech prospectors sometimes tell tales about the treasures under the ash.
column2: 最初殖民瓦尔代夫的是那些期望开发其庞大地热能的人，但结果和它的价值比起来，火山要更加麻烦. 勘探失落科技的人时常会讲述火山灰底下埋藏着宝藏的传说.

column1: Valencia is a beautiful oceanic planet with settlements dotted around the coastlines of the many islands that make up the world.  It exports agricultural and aquatic produce to nearby worlds.
column2: Valencia是一个美丽的海洋星球，定居点散布在构成这个世界的众多岛屿的海岸线周围. 它向附近的星球出口农产品和水产品.
