column1: Subject to a decimation by Draconis forces during the Reunification War, the system serviced the Draconis Combine for centuries. This was the last system that the Minnesota Tribe was last sighted in before Comstar lost their trail.
column2: 在统一战争期间遭到天龙部队的毁灭性打击后，该星系为天龙联合体服务了数百年. 这是ComStar失去其踪迹之前，明尼苏达部落最后被目击到的星系.

column1: Valerius is an habitable world that appears to have moderate mineral deposits. Its astrographical location is its more important trait.
column2: Valerius是一颗宜居行星，似乎拥有中等规模的矿藏. 其天文位置才是它更重要的特征.

column1: Valexa was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and exports aquatic produce to nearby worlds. The Valexa Cappelan March Militia are headquartered here.
column2: Valexa在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，并向邻近世界出口水产. Valexa卡佩拉边疆民兵的总部设在这里.

column1: Valil'yevskiy was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and exports agricultural and aquatic produce to nearby worlds.
column2: 瓦利利耶夫斯基在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，向附近世界出口农产品与水产。

column1: The Valladolid system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was annihilated by multiple nuclear strikes during the First Succession War and left uninhabitable.
column2: Valladolid星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在第一次继承战争期间被多次核打击彻底毁灭，并变得无法居住.

column1: Valloire was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds. It's tropical climate is known for producing the best teas in the quadrant.
column2: 瓦卢瓦尔在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，为附近世界生产农产品。它的热带气候以出产该星区最好的茶闻名。

column1: Valmiera was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds.
column2: Valmiera在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，并为附近的世界生产农产品.

column1: The Valois system was settled during the Star League era, until it was abandoned during the Third Succession War. Centuries ago a BattleMech Division earned the name \"The Alamo Division\", sacrificing to save their target from nuclear annihilation.
column2: 瓦卢瓦星系在星盟时代被殖民，直到第三次继承战争期间被废弃。数百年前，一支战斗机甲师获得了"阿拉莫师"之名，为把他们的目标从核毁灭中拯救出来而牺牲。

column1: Vandalia was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural goods for nearby worlds, including delicacies such as owlbear and axebeak.
column2: Vandalia是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，并为邻近世界生产农产品，包括枭熊和斧喙鸟等美味佳肴.

column1: Van Diemen IV was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and is a picturesque world that produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds.
column2: Van Diemen IV是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，这是一颗风景如画的世界，为附近的世界生产农产品.

column1: Vanern was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds. The mumba fruit is unique to this world.
column2: Vanern在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，并为附近的世界生产农产品. mumba果是这个世界独有的.

column1: The Vangburg system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Outworlds Alliance until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Vangburg星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并且在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃之前，一直是外世界联盟的成员.

column1: Settled during the Reunification War, Vannes was originally the site of a large Merkava tank production line. The SLDF also set up a Castle Brian here, now known as Castle Vannes with a vast underground network underneath.
column2: 在统一战争期间有人定居，Vannes最初是一条大型梅卡瓦坦克生产线的所在地. SLDF还在这里建立了一座布莱恩城堡，如今被称为Vannes城堡，其下方有着庞大的地下网络.

column1: Once the site of a large battle during the First Succession War where superior tactics won out against numbers, the forested planet of Vanra is now home to the Orloff Military Academy.
column2: Vanra曾是第一次继承战争期间一场大规模战役的发生地，当时卓越的战术战胜了数量优势；如今，这颗森林覆盖的星球是奥尔洛夫军事学院的所在地.

column1: Vantaa was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds, specifically fruit.
column2: Vantaa在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，并为附近星球生产农产品，尤其是水果.

column1: Almost a billion people live in the cleverly engineered treetop cities of Vard, where descent to the lush jungle of ground level is only possible for short times and with armed protection from the wildlife.
column2: 瓦德星上精心设计建造的树梢城市中生活着近10亿人，树底葱葱郁郁的丛林不可长时间逗留，得全副武装抵御野生生物.

column1: Vargtass was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War but died out sometime between the Second and Third Succession Wars.
column2: Vargtass在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在第二次和第三次继承战争之间的某个时候消亡了.

column1: The Várri system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Rim Worlds Republic until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Várri星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，并一直是边缘世界共和国的一部分，直到第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: A small penal colony on a harsh world, Vaucluse holds many dangerous criminals from across the Commonwealth.
column2: Vaucluse是一座位于严酷世界上的小型流放地，关押着来自共同体各地的许多危险罪犯.

column1: The Vecchio system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Federated Suns until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Vecchio星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，并一直是恒星联邦的一员，直到第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: A small penal colony on a harsh world, Veckholm holds many dangerous criminals from across the Commonwealth.
column2: Veckholm是一个位于环境恶劣星球上的小型流放地，关押着来自共同体各地的许多危险罪犯.

column1: Vega is a world rich in minerals, metallic ores, and fresh water. It is home to numerous manufacturers and research complexes such as Cosby Myomer Research Firm
column2: Vega是一个富含矿物、金属矿石和淡水的世界. 这里是众多制造商和研究综合体的所在地，例如科斯比肌纤维研究公司.

column1: The Velhas system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War. The Fourth Donegal Guards have a large training range amongst the mudflats and have often been sighted in the area.
column2: Velhas星系在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民. 第四多尼戈尔卫队在泥滩中拥有一座大型训练场，并经常在该地区被目击.

column1: The Venaria system was colonized either during or shortly before the Age of War. During the final years of the Star League, Venaria was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: Venaria星系是在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民的. 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Venaria设有一支星际联盟防卫军驻军.

column1: Vendrell has two moons named Ying and Yang and is been home to manufacturing facilities operated by the noted defense manufacturer Mountain Wolf BattleMechs.
column2: Vendrell有两颗名为Ying和Yang的卫星，并且一直是著名防务制造商Mountain Wolf BattleMechs运营的制造设施所在地.

column1: The Ventabren system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra. During the Third Succession War, it suffered a Scorched Earth campaign which resulted in a hefty rebuilding effort after the war.
column2: Ventabren星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民. 在第三次继承战争期间，它遭受了一场焦土战役，导致战后需要进行大规模重建.

column1: The Verde system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra. Whilst the planetside population is poor, the lucrative mining facilities on the asteroid belt provide heavy raw materials to Galtor Naval Yards in the Exeter System.
column2: Verde星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的. 尽管行星地表的居民十分贫困，但小行星带上利润丰厚的采矿设施为Exeter星系中的Galtor海军船坞提供了大量原材料.

column1: The Verdigreis system was colonized at some point prior to the end of the Age of War, and by the eve of the Reunification War was a member of the Taurian Concordat, but fell to the Federated Suns during the First Succession War.
column2: Verdigreis星系在战争时代结束前的某个时候被殖民，到统一战争前夕时已是金牛协约国的成员，但在第一次继承战争期间落入恒星联邦之手.

column1: The Verdinge system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Federated Suns until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Verdinge星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并一直是恒星联邦的一部分，直到第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: The Vereeniging system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War due to famine.
column2: Vereeniging星系是在统一战争结束后、星盟时代的某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间因饥荒而被完全废弃.

column1: Constant earthquakes and volcanic eruptions shake the surface of Verlo, a highly volatile world. Rich mineral deposits exist here for those brave enough to endure the harsh climate.
column2: 持续不断的地震和火山喷发撼动着Verlo的表面，这是一个极度动荡的世界. 这里蕴藏着丰富的矿藏，等待着那些敢于忍受严酷气候的人.

column1: The Vermezzo system settled during or shortly before the Age of War, and remained Lyran for centuries. It is known the Óleo Reserve, a very rich deposit of petroleum, notable for being the largest in the local region of space.
column2: Vermezzo星系在战争时代期间或之前不久建立定居点，并在数个世纪里一直属于天琴. 它以Óleo Reserve而闻名，那是一处极其丰富的石油矿藏，以当地太空区域中规模最大而著称.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, Versailles vanished from maps during the First Succession War, which suggests that the system had been abandoned or depopulated, though there is evidence that the system was removed from most maps by ComStar.
column2: Versailles在星际联盟时代有人定居，却在第一次继承战争期间从星图上消失，这表明该星系已被废弃或人口减少，不过有证据表明，该星系是被通讯之星从大多数星图上移除的.

column1: Vestallas was known to hold the Capellan Confederation's treasure. Its underground vaults contained priceless works of art; precious stones; bars of gold, silver, and germanium; and hard currency from the Confederation and other Successor States.
column2: 维斯塔拉斯以藏有卡佩兰联邦的财宝而闻名。其地下金库存有无价的艺术品、宝石；金、银和锗锭；以及来自联邦和其他继承国的硬通货。

column1: Viborg itself is described as a \"garden world\", and the population preferred to import ores and steel from the abundant asteroid belts via the Penance mining habitat over mining the planet itself.
column2: 维堡本身被描述为"花园世界"，居民宁愿通过苦修采矿栖息地从丰富的小行星带进口矿石与钢材，也不愿开采行星本身。

column1: The Vibrunum system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War. The system mainly provides agricultural produce to nearby manufacturing worlds.
column2: Vibrunum星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民. 该星系主要向附近的制造业星球供应农产品.

column1: The Vicente system settled during or shortly before the Age of War. The system mainly provides agricultural produce to nearby manufacturing worlds.
column2: Vicente星系在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民. 该星系主要向附近的制造业星球供应农产品.

column1: The Vicksland system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Vicksland星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: The administrative capital of its Capellan Confederation Commonality, Victoria is famous for its violently bad weather, underground cities, and beautiful domed parks. Many industries take advantage of the local natural resources.
column2: 维多利亚是其所在卡佩拉联邦共同区的行政首府，因其极度恶劣的天气，地下城市，以及美丽的穹顶公园而盛名在外. 许多产业都充分利用了当地的自然资源.

column1: The Victralla system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Victralla星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: The Vihtijarvi system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The system mainly provides agricultural produce to nearby manufacturing worlds.
column2: Vihtijarvi星系在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民. 该星系主要向附近的制造业世界提供农产品.

column1: The Vikindu system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War and by the end of that era was a part of the Free Worlds League. The harsh desert climate prevents growth of most crops, requiring large amounts of imports for the population.
column2: Vikindu星系在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民，到该时代末期已成为自由世界联盟的一部分. 严酷的沙漠气候使大多数作物无法生长，导致人口需要大量进口物资.

column1: Villanueva is a lightly-settled, extremely humid water planet. Most of the inhabitants are engaged in food production and processing, and live in small settlements around automated facilities.
column2: 比亚努埃瓦是个少人居住，极度潮湿的丰水行星. 大多数居民从事食品生产和加工产业，生活在自动化工厂周边的小型定居点.

column1: The Villuisk system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the short lived Finmark Free Republic until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Villuisk星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，并曾是短暂的芬马克自由共和国的一部分，直到在第二次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: Vindemiatrix is best known for the Vindemiatrix Observatory, a university that focuses almost completely on stellar life cycles and planetology.
column2: Vindemiatrix最出名的是Vindemiatrix天文台，这是一所几乎完全专注于恒星生命周期和行星学的大学.

column1: The Vinstra system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the Outworlds Alliance until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Vinstra星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并一直是外世界联盟的一部分，直到在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: The Vinton system was colonized during the Golden Century. In 3011 a comet passed close enough to the Diamond Shark naval cache in the system to damage the WarShips significantly enough to prevent them being restored to active service.
column2: Vinton星系于黄金世纪被殖民. 3011年，一颗彗星经过时距离该星系中钻石鲨的海军储备库足够近，严重损坏了其中的战舰，使其无法恢复现役.

column1: The Vintru system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Vintru was conquered by the Federated Suns during the Second Succession War and abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War
column2: Vintru星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居. Vintru在第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服，并在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: One of the founding worlds of the Rasalhague Consortium, Vipaava enjoys a temperate climate and a healthy industry.
column2: 作为Rasalhague Consortium的创始世界之一，Vipaava享有温带气候和繁荣的工业.

column1: The Virentofta system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War by colonists of Scandinavian descent, who settled into the arctic conditions admirably well.
column2: Virentofta星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候被斯堪的纳维亚血统的殖民者殖民，他们令人钦佩地适应了那里的极地环境.

column1: The airless world of Viribium was a critical military base, defending Liao's border from the Free Worlds League. The League seized the base in the Second Succession War, and then abandoned it, detonating nuclear devices inside the facilities before leaving.
column2: 无大气的维里比乌姆世界曾是一处关键军事基地，为廖氏防守边界、抵御自由世界联盟。联盟在第二次继承战争中夺取该基地，随后放弃它，离开前在设施内部引爆了核装置。

column1: The Viroflay system was settled during the Star League era, and was a known pirate haven with a large human trafficking operation, until it was destroyed in the Succession Wars.
column2: Viroflay星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，曾是一个已知的海盗避风港，并有着大规模的人口贩卖活动，直到它在继承战争中被摧毁.

column1: The capital city of Redlight on Virtue is the headquarters of Virtue Cartographers Unlimited, the premier starmap makers in the Lyran Commonwealth, rivaling the expertise of even the ComStar Cartographic Corps.
column2: Virtue上的首府城市Redlight是Virtue Cartographers Unlimited的总部——天琴共同体首屈一指的星图制造商，其专业水准甚至可与ComStar制图兵团相媲美.

column1: An oceanic planet filled with islands, Visby offers fresh aquatic life to nearby worlds.
column2: Visby是一颗遍布岛屿的海洋行星，为附近世界提供新鲜的水生生物.

column1: Depopulated in the Succession Wars, a small consortium of Canopian corporations have resettled the world as a skiing and winter sports resort for wealthy patrons.
column2: 在继承战争中人口流失殆尽后，一个由卡诺帕斯企业组成的小型财团重新定居了这个世界，将其打造为面向富裕主顾的滑雪与冬季运动度假胜地.

column1: The Voehn system was settled during the Star League era, and was a minor colony on the periphery of the Outworlds Alliance, until the Third Succession War when it was abandoned along with many other worlds.
column2: Voehn星系在星际联盟时代有人定居，曾是外域联盟边缘的一个小型殖民地，直到第三次继承战争期间，它与许多其他世界一起被废弃.

column1: The Volders system was settled shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. During the Fourth Succession War a massive cache of Star League Mechs and weapons were discovered by Snords Irregulars.
column2: Volders星系在第一次地球大迁徙后不久便有人定居. 第四次继承战争期间，斯诺德非正规军发现了一处巨大的星际联盟机甲与武器储藏库.

column1: The Vonja system was settled during the Star League era, and became a minor colony on the periphery of the Outworlds Alliance, until the Third Succession War when it was abandoned.
column2: Vonja星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，并成为外世界联盟边缘的一个小型殖民地，直到第三次继承战争时被废弃.

column1: The Vorarlberg system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War was a part of the Lyran Commonwealth. It was heavily damaged during the Second Succession War, and is an contested world thanks to its factories.
column2: Vorarlberg星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代结束时已成为天琴共同体的一部分. 它在第二次继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，并因其工厂而成为一颗争夺中的星球.

column1: The Vortalcoy system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned after the main colony was destroyed during the First Succession War in a chemical weapons strike.
column2: Vortalcoy星系可能是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在第一次继承战争期间，其主要殖民地因一次化学武器打击而被摧毁后，该星系便被废弃了.

column1: The Vorzel system was settled at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Vorzel星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候有人定居，并在天琴共同体成立之前是多尼戈尔保护国的成员.

column1: The Vosloorus system was settled at some point during the Age of War, and was a member of the Free Worlds League by the end of that era. Pharmaceuticals are researched produced in vast amounts here, thanks to the unique fungi growing on the planet.
column2: Vosloorus星系在战争时代的某个时期被殖民，到了那个时代末期，它已成为自由世界联盟的成员. 得益于该行星上生长的独特真菌，这里大量研究和生产药品.

column1: The Vulcan system was colonised by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The arid and rocky climate of the world leaves it quite defensible.
column2: Vulcan星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被天琴共同体殖民. 该世界干旱多岩的气候使其相当易守难攻.

column1: The Vulture's Nest system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned during the Second Succession War after pirates conquered and pillaged the system.
column2: 秃鹫巢星系是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争中被废弃——海盗征服并洗劫了该星系。

column1: The Waddesdon system was settled before the Reunification War, and has remained part of the Draconis Combine for centuries. It's vast mudflats cover a large collection of Star League era vaults, many of which are still being found to this day.
column2: 瓦德斯登星系在统一战争之前被殖民，数百年来一直是龙尼斯联合体的一部分。它广袤的泥滩之下埋藏着一大批星盟时代的储藏库，其中许多至今仍在被发现。

column1: The Waimalu system was settled before the Age of War, and has remained part of the Federated Suns for centuries. It is a largely agricultural world with the finest meats cut from the avian creatures that inhabit the second continent.
column2: Waimalu星系在战争时代之前就已有人定居，数百年来一直是恒星联邦的一部分. 这是一个以农业为主的世界，最上等的肉类取自栖息在第二大陆的鸟类生物.

column1: The Waina Point system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned during the Second Succession War after the capital city was destroyed in a nuclear attack.
column2: Waina Point星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间，其首府在一次核攻击中被摧毁后，该星系被废弃了.

column1: The Waipahu system was settled before the Age of War, and has remained part of the Federated Suns for centuries. It has a low tech but heavy industrial base which continues to churn out parts for ground forces, and a growing narcotics trade.
column2: Waipahu星系在战争时代之前便已有人定居，并在数个世纪里一直是恒星联邦的一部分. 它的技术水平低下，但拥有雄厚的重工业基础，持续为地面部队生产零部件，同时毒品贸易也在日益增长.

column1: The Waitur system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned during the Third Succession War as famine struck.
column2: Waitur星系可能是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间因饥荒而被废弃.

column1: The Waldheim system was settled before or during the Reunification War. A high gravity world known for its rugged nature, many ground forces train here to simulate mountainous battles.
column2: Waldheim星系在统一战争之前或期间被殖民. 这是一颗以崎岖险峻著称的高重力星球，许多地面部队在此训练，以模拟山地战斗.

column1: Waldorff is the second planet in the system and has a single moon named Nikola. The capital of Waldorff City is known for its cavernous storm drains used for illegal racing, a dangerous pursuit in light of the savage storms that can hit the world.
column2: Waldorff是该星系中的第二颗行星，拥有一颗名为Nikola的卫星. Waldorff的首府Waldorff City以其洞穴般的排洪渠而闻名，这些排洪渠被用于非法赛车；鉴于可能袭击这个世界的狂暴风暴，这是一项危险的活动.

column1: The Wallacia system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and had a training ground amongst the vast mudflats created for the Second Oriente Hussars.
column2: Wallacia星系是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并在广阔的泥滩中设有一处专为第二奥连特骠骑兵团建立的训练场.

column1: Wallis is the sixth planet in the system and has a single moon. Wallis is home to factories belonging to at least one significant defense manufacturer, Ronin Incorporated. Vuzar, the seventh planet, is an icy retreat for wealthier citizens.
column2: Wallis是该星系中的第六颗行星，拥有一颗卫星. Wallis拥有至少一家重要国防制造商Ronin Incorporated的工厂. 第七颗行星Vuzar则是较富裕公民的冰冷度假胜地.

column1: The Wantorill system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but suffered famine during the Third Succession War, leaving it depopulated.
column2: Wantorill星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间遭遇饥荒，导致人口凋零.

column1: Wapakoneta is an oceanic world, with the local economy largely based around exporting aquaculture-grown marine life, although the planet had many small, beautiful islands suitable for tourism.
column2: Wapakoneta是一颗海洋世界，当地经济主要依靠出口水产养殖的海洋生物，尽管这颗行星拥有许多适合旅游的美丽小岛.

column1: Large canyons and heavy seismic activity make mining activities dangerous on Wappingers - but also highly lucrative. High risk, high reward is often their motto.
column2: 巨大的峡谷和剧烈的地震活动使得在Wappingers上的采矿活动十分危险——但同时也利润丰厚. 高风险、高回报往往是他们的座右铭.

column1: Ward is a warm water planet with one small continent. The utopian ideals of Ward's original settlers remain strong in its population of 1.5 billion, and the planet thrives based on their reputation for solid construction work.
column2: 沃德是一颗温水星球，只有一块小大陆。沃德最初定居者的乌托邦理想在其十五亿居民中依然强烈，该星球凭借其扎实建筑工艺的名声而繁荣。

column1: Located relatively close to the Deep Periphery systems known as Cambridge and Trinity, the Wark system primary is a type G0V star.
column2: Wark星系的主星是一颗G0V型恒星，其位置相对靠近被称为Cambridge和Trinity的深空外围星系.

column1: Warlock is the third planet in the system and has a single moon named Blackguard. Warlock is the home to at least one facility operated by Ceres Metals Industries while Blackguard is the site of a substantial naval repair base.
column2: Warlock是该星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Blackguard的卫星. Warlock拥有至少一座由Ceres Metals Industries运营的设施，而Blackguard则设有一座大型海军维修基地.

column1: An unremarkable agro world, its capital city of Hutch contains a massive memorial hall dedicated to the Third Dragonlords regiment, of whom lost many members centuries ago in a tragic dropship accident.
column2: 一颗毫不起眼的农业世界，其首府Hutch设有一座巨大的纪念堂，纪念第三龙领主团——该团数百年前在一场悲惨的降落船事故中损失了许多成员.

column1: The Warrumbungle system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but the atmosphere was boiled away during the fighting in the Second Succession War, leaving it depopulated.
column2: Warrumbungle星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争的战斗中，其大气被蒸发殆尽，导致该星系人口灭绝.

column1: The Wasat system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a major industrial world for the Star League. The ruins of many Castle Brian's can be found across the planet, a source of LosTech.
column2: 瓦萨特星系在首次从地球出走期间被殖民，曾是星盟的重要工业世界。全行星都能找到许多布莱恩堡的废墟，是失传科技的来源。

column1: The Washburn system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra. Washburn II is the second planet in the Washburn system and has three moons named Cephas, Elihu and Israel. Washburn has been home to a refit facility operated by Irian Technologies.
column2: Washburn星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的. Washburn II是Washburn星系中的第二颗行星，拥有三颗名为Cephas、Elihu和Israel的卫星. Washburn一直是Irian Technologies运营的一处改装设施的所在地.

column1: The Watermael system was settled during the Age of War and then became a member of the Free Worlds League. The 21st Royal Division of the SLDF fought on this world centuries ago, and rumours exist of Star League weapons caches hidden away here.
column2: Watermael星系在战争时代被殖民，随后成为自由世界联盟的一员. 数个世纪前，SLDF的第21皇家师曾在这个世界上作战，并且有传闻称这里藏有星际联盟的武器储藏库.

column1: Waunakee was liberated by the Federated Suns during the first majorcounter-offensive of the First Succession War against the Draconis Combine. Centuries later, the industrial base has still not recovered to Star League era levels.
column2: Waunakee在第一次继承战争期间恒星联邦针对天龙联合体发动的首次大规模反攻中被解放. 数百年后，其工业基础仍未恢复到星际联盟时代的水平.

column1: The Waxell system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. Since the Third Succession War, its factories and industrial base have been exporting large amounts of polymers to nearby worlds.
column2: Waxell星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久建立殖民地的. 自第三次继承战争以来，其工厂和工业基础一直向附近世界出口大量聚合物.

column1: The Waycross system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but the atmosphere was boiled away during the fighting in the Second Succession War, leaving it depopulated.
column2: Waycross星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间，其大气层在战斗中被蒸发殆尽，导致该星系变得荒无人烟.

column1: The Waypoint system was settled during the Star League era, but the population eked out a meager living until recently. They have recently signed a deal for a HPG with Comstar however.
column2: Waypoint星系是在星际联盟时代有人定居的，但直到最近，当地居民都只能勉强维持微薄生计. 不过，他们最近与ComStar签署了一项关于HPG的协议.

column1: Waypoint 531 consists of a red giant sun and \"The Brothers\", four large asteroids in varying orbits around the star. The THS Yosemite, a Terran Hegemony colony JumpShip, was lost here over five hundred years ago.
column2: 五三一号航点由一颗红巨星和"兄弟"组成——那是四颗以不同轨道环绕该恒星的大型小行星。五百多年前，地球霸权的殖民跃迁舰THS约塞米蒂在此失事。

column1: An oft traded world, Wazan is nevertheless full of surprises with its deep mines amongst its rocky terrain.
column2: 作为一颗贸易频繁的星球，Wazan依然充满惊喜，其崎岖地形中分布着深邃的矿坑.

column1: The Weatogue system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Ignored during the Succession Wars, Weatogue is an perma-frost agricultural world known for its Ice Cold Beer.
column2: Weatogue星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的. 在继承战争期间被忽视，Weatogue是一颗永久冻土的农业世界，以其冰镇啤酒闻名.

column1: The Wedderborg system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War and survived the first two Succession Wars, until it was struck by famine during the Third and abandoned.
column2: Wedderborg星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，并挺过了前两次继承战争，直到在第三次继承战争期间遭遇饥荒并被废弃.

column1: The Wedgefield system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra, and is known for its pastures and cloth industries.
column2: Wedgefield星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久有人定居，并以其牧场和纺织业闻名.

column1: The Weekapaug system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the St. Ives Mercantile League prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century.
column2: Weekapaug星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在24世纪中叶卡佩拉邦联成立之前，是圣艾夫斯商业联盟的成员.

column1: During the Fourth Succession War a repository of Star League chemical weaponry and nerve agents was discovered and unleashed on the population of this world, killing almost a billion citizens. Wei is still in recovery now.
column2: 在第四次继承战争期间，一处星际联盟化学武器和神经毒剂的储藏库被发现，并被释放到这颗星球的人口之中，导致近十亿公民死亡. Wei至今仍在恢复之中.

column1: Weingarten is best known for its vast wine industry. The mild weather and long growing seasons make Weingarten ideal for growing crops, particularly grapes. Wine from the world is highly prized which leads to large profit margins for exporters.
column2: Weingarten最著名的是其庞大的葡萄酒产业. 温和的气候和漫长的生长季使Weingarten非常适合种植农作物，尤其是葡萄. 该星球出产的葡萄酒备受推崇，这为出口商带来了丰厚的利润空间.

column1: Weippe is best known for its fine grain sands and glassblowing industries, which are unique to the planet.
column2: Weippe以其细粒砂和吹玻璃产业而闻名，这些是该行星独有的.

column1: A binary star system, the fifth world is nicknamed \"Brimstone\" by the natives; it has a large satellite world called Fire. The temperature range at the polar capital of Port Erebus can vary over 70 degrees in one day.
column2: 一个双星系统，其第五颗行星被当地人昵称为"硫磺"；它有一颗巨大的卫星世界叫"火"。极地首府厄瑞玻斯港的气温一天内可变化超过70度。

column1: The Weistheimer system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, but has been abandoned and resettled numerous times over the centuries as mineral deposits are found and depleted.
column2: Weistheimer星系在星盟时代、统一战争后的某个时期被殖民，但几个世纪以来，随着矿藏被发现和耗尽，它曾多次被废弃并重新殖民.

column1: This grim and bleak ball of mud was only colonized for its central position in rimward Capellan space. The outpost was eventually abandoned in favor of refueling stations at the jump points, and the planet-side colony buildings sunk into the mud.
column2: 这颗严酷荒凉的泥泞星球之所以被殖民，仅仅是因为它处在缘向卡佩拉星域的中心位置. 这处前哨最终被废弃，代之以设在跃迁点的燃料补给站，而星球表面的殖民地建筑则逐渐沉入泥沼之中.

column1: The Weiz system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War. Weiz vanished from maps at some point after the end of the First Succession War after the atmosphere became too irradiated for the colonists.
column2: Weiz星系在统一战争之后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民. 第一次继承战争结束后的某个时候，由于大气层变得辐射过强，殖民者无法生存，Weiz从星图上消失了.

column1: The Weldon system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and is home to a galaxy famous author who often writes about the heroic tales of MechWarriors.
column2: Weldon星系于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被殖民定居，这里是一位享誉银河的作家的家乡，他经常撰写关于机甲战士英雄事迹的故事.

column1: Weldry is a cold world with a thin atmosphere that's only breathable in the lowlands and valleys. The highlands are barren, windswept, uninhabited ice. The highest form of life is a vicious stinging insect that can form mile-wide swarms.
column2: 韦尔德里是一颗寒冷而大气稀薄的星球，空气只在低地和山谷中可以呼吸。高原地带是贫瘠、风蚀、无人居住的冰原。那里最高等的生命是一种凶狠的刺人昆虫，能形成宽达数英里的虫群。

column1: The Werfer system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War by the Taurian Concordat, but was abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Werfer星系在战争时代期间或开始前不久由金牛协约国殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: Wernke is the third planet in the Wernke system and has a single inhabited and heavily-industrialized moon named Talon, which oft confuses stellar cartographers and map makers alike.
column2: Wernke是Wernke星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Talon的有人居住且高度工业化的卫星，这常常令恒星制图师和地图绘制者感到困惑.

column1: Westerhand is the second planet in the system and has three moons named Delsia, Ralston and Vannora. Known for its Star League era mech repair facilities, which are renown throughout the Sian Commonality.
column2: Westerhand是该星系中的第二颗行星，拥有三颗卫星，分别名为Delsia、Ralston和Vannora. 这里以其星际联盟时代的机甲维修设施而闻名，这些设施在整个Sian Commonality都享有盛誉.

column1: The Westerstede system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the founding of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Westerstede星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被开拓定居，并且在天琴共同体成立之前曾是多尼戈尔保护国的成员.

column1: The Westfield system was settled during the Star League era but was devastated during the First Succession War, leaving the planet a molten uninhabitable ruin.
column2: Westfield星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭，使该行星变成了一片熔融、无法居住的废墟.

column1: Westover is the fourth planet in the Westover system and has a single moon named Duban. Westover is been home to facilities belonging to numerous defense manufacturers, most notably Andurien AeroTech.
column2: Westover是Westover星系中的第四颗行星，拥有一颗名为Duban的卫星. Westover一直是众多国防制造商旗下设施的所在地，其中最著名的当属Andurien AeroTech.

column1: The Westphalia system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, and conquered by the Federated Suns during the Second Succession War. The system was later abandoned in the fighting of the Third Succession War.
column2: Westphalia星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争之后的某个时期被殖民，并在第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服. 该星系后来在第三次继承战争的战斗中遭废弃.

column1: The Wetumpka system was settled before or during the Age of War and was a part of the Federated Suns by the end of the era. Wetumpka is known for its massive rumbling waters from its many rivers and waterfalls.
column2: Wetumpka星系在战争时代之前或期间被殖民，到该时代结束时已成为恒星联邦的一部分. Wetumpka以其众多河流和瀑布中奔涌轰鸣的巨量水流而闻名.

column1: Named \"Wheel\" after the massive recharge station and habitat at its zenith jump point (featuring a wheel-shaped gravdeck around a needle-shaped core) that also serves as administrative center for the asteroid facilities in the system.
column2: 它以天顶跳跃点那巨大的充能站与居住区命名（其特色是围绕针状核心的轮形重力甲板），那里同时也是该星系小行星设施的管理中心。

column1: The Whittington system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The planet is mostly barren, with small patches of fertile land surrounding the extensive volcanic activity.
column2: Whittington星系是在统一战争结束后的某个时候，于星际联盟时代被殖民的. 该行星大部分贫瘠，广袤的火山活动周围只有小片肥沃土地.

column1: Wildwood is a lush and sparsely populated planet nearing the outer edge of the Magistracy of Canopus. In spite of a small population, Wildwood was the largest producer of wine and other agricultural products in the Magistracy.
column2: Wildwood是一颗郁郁葱葱、人口稀少的行星，位于船底自治区外缘附近. 尽管人口稀少，Wildwood仍是船底自治区最大的葡萄酒和其他农产品生产地.

column1: The Wilkes system was settled before or during the First Exodus from Terra, and has a thriving industrial base thanks to the thermal boreholes that descend deep into the planets mantle.
column2: Wilkes星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙之前或期间就已有人定居，并且得益于那些深入行星地幔的热力钻孔，拥有繁荣的工业基础.

column1: The Willowick system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and became during the Age of War a member of the Federated Suns. It's large lakes and watersports are tourist hotspots for nearby worlds.
column2: 威洛威克星系在首次从地球出走期间被殖民，在战火时代成为联邦太阳的一员。它的大湖与水上运动是附近世界的旅游热点。

column1: The Willunga system was originally a part of the Finmark Province by the Rim Worlds Republic, but joined the Lyran Commonwealth when the Star League fell.
column2: Willunga星系最初是边缘世界共和国芬马克省的一部分，但在星际联盟覆灭时加入了天琴共同体.

column1: The Wiltshire system was settled by the Rim Worlds Republic during the Star League era, but fell into Lyran hands during the fall of the Star League.
column2: Wiltshire星系在星际联盟时代由边缘世界共和国殖民定居，但在星际联盟崩溃期间落入天琴人之手.

column1: The Windhoek system was colonised prior to the Age of War, but was abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Windhoek星系在战争时代之前已被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The Windsor system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Grand palaces and country seats dot the pristine landscape of Windsor, known for its aristocratic nature.
column2: Windsor星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民. 宏伟的宫殿与乡间宅邸点缀着Windsor原始纯净的景观，这里以其贵族气质而闻名.

column1: Wing was settled not for the world itself, but because its four moons have extensive amounts of titanium, bauxite, and germanium. The Capital of Crow's Nest is situated high in the mountains, providing Line of Sight to facilities on the moons.
column2: 翼星被殖民并非为了这颗行星本身，而是因为它的四颗卫星上拥有大量钛、铝土和锗。首府鸦巢坐落于高山之上，与卫星上的设施保持视线联系。

column1: The Wingzar system was colonised during the Star League era, but was destroyed during the Second Succession War.
column2: Wingzar星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第二次继承战争中被摧毁.

column1: Once the site of a major Displass Technologies industrial hub, Winter was devastated during the Amaris Civil War. Many facilities were completely destroyed and now only a moderate industrial base remains.
column2: Winter曾是Displass Technologies一个重要工业中心的所在地，但在阿马里斯内战期间遭到严重破坏. 许多设施被彻底摧毁，如今仅剩中等规模的工业基础.

column1: The Wisconsin system was colonized by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and maintains strong links with neighbouring worlds.
column2: Wisconsin星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被自由世界联盟殖民，并与邻近世界保持着紧密联系.

column1: Ruled by the Council of Merchants, Wismar is an agricultural world that provides food sources for the trade hubs across the Hanseatic League. There are also rumours of a black market in narcotics thanks to the hallucinogenic plants native to Wismar.
column2: Wismar由商人议会统治，是一个农业世界，为汉萨同盟各地的贸易枢纽提供食物来源. 由于Wismar原产的致幻植物，还有传言称这里存在毒品黑市.

column1: The Wittington system was annexed by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era, then conquered by the Federated Suns during the Second Succesion War before being eventually destroyed during the Third Succession War.
column2: Wittington星系在星际联盟时代被天龙联合体吞并，随后在第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服，最终在第三次继承战争期间被摧毁.

column1: The Wokha system was settled at some time during the Star League era, but the colony died out sometime during the First Succession War.
column2: Wokha星系在星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但该殖民地于第一次继承战争期间的某个时候消亡了.

column1: The Wolcott system was colonised at some point during or prior to the Age of War, with the capital of Farmingbury being the muddy jewel of the entire system. The Succession Wars have succeeded in causing Wolcott to maintain a low profile.
column2: Wolcott星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，首府Farmingbury是整个星系中泥泞的明珠. 继承战争成功地使Wolcott保持了低调.

column1: Wolf Orbital 82 is an orbital fleet base stationed at the Zenith jump point of a G6IV type star. Dense asteroid fields hurtle around this system, causing major navigational hazards.
column2: Wolf Orbital 82 是驻扎在一颗G6IV型恒星天顶跃迁点的一处轨道舰队基地. 密集的小行星带在该星系周围疾驰，造成重大航行危险.

column1: The Wolof system was settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. It is known for its quiet coastal villages and its vast fishing population.
column2: Wolof星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期由自由世界联盟殖民的. 它以宁静的沿海村庄和庞大的渔业人口而闻名.

column1: The Wonju system was annexed by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era, but was destroyed in the fighting during the First Succesion War.
column2: Wonju星系在星际联盟时代被天龙联合体吞并，但在第一次继承战争的战斗中遭到摧毁.

column1: The Woodbine system was colonized by the Federated Suns during the Age of War. A world known for its vast planetwide forests and large mineral content, Woodbine's population is still hindered by the high gravity of their world.
column2: 伍德拜恩星系在战争年代由联邦太阳国殖民。该世界以遍布星球的大片森林与丰富的矿物含量著称，但伍德拜恩的居民至今仍受该星球高重力之苦。

column1: The Woodstock system was colonized in the second half of the twenty-second century. During the Amaris Civil War, chemical weapons rendered an entire continent uninhabitable. Still uninhabitable today, it is used for research purposes.
column2: Woodstock星系于22世纪下半叶被殖民. 在阿马里斯内战期间，化学武器使一整片大陆变得无法居住. 如今那里仍无法居住，仅被用于研究目的.

column1: The Woogi system was colonised during the Star League era, but was destroyed during the Second Succession War.
column2: Woogi星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被摧毁.

column1: The Worrell system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra, and is now ruled from New Samarkand.
column2: Worrell星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民的，如今由New Samarkand统治.

column1: The Wotan system is home to numerous industries such as Krauss-Lieman Incorporated and Wotan Mining Systems, making it a key industrial location. It also houses the remains of Hevrol Aero Base, a Star League era facility.
column2: Wotan星系拥有众多工业，例如克劳斯-利曼公司和Wotan矿业系统公司，这使其成为一处关键的工业地点. 它还留有赫夫罗航空基地的遗迹，那是一座星际联盟时代的设施.

column1: Wrentham is a minor industrial world that is notable only for the volcanic activity caused by its proximity to its gas giant primary. Tidal forces flex and stress the crust of the world, but the extreme ocean tides have led to flourishing sea life.
column2: 伦瑟姆是个小型工业星球，它之所以出名仅仅是因为相邻气态巨型主星导致的火山活动. 潮汐力扭曲压迫着星球的地壳，但极端的潮汐也导致了蓬勃的海洋生命.

column1: The Wright system was colonized by the Confederation during the Star League era after the Reunification War, and is now part of the Sian Commonality - containing most of the valuable industry and developed worlds of the Confederation.
column2: Wright星系在统一战争之后的星际联盟时代被邦联殖民，如今是Sian共同区的一部分——该共同区包含邦联大部分宝贵的工业和发达世界.

column1: The Wrociaw system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra, and is known for its heavy tank track production facilities.
column2: Wrociaw星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，并以其重型坦克履带生产设施而闻名.

column1: The Wroxeter system was colonized during or shortly before the Age of War, and is located near the Crucis March. Deep boreholes allow for mining petroleum and other fuels from deep within the mantle of the planet.
column2: Wroxeter星系在战争时代期间或前夕被殖民，位于克鲁西斯边区附近. 深钻孔使得可以从该行星地幔深处开采石油和其他燃料.

column1: Wyatt is a planet of deserts and strange rock formations, perfect for defensive purposes. Bowie Industries maintains manufacturing facilities on the planet, producing mech and dropship parts.
column2: Wyatt是一颗遍布沙漠和奇异岩层的行星，非常适合防御用途. Bowie Industries在该行星上设有制造设施，生产机甲和降落船部件.

column1: The colony of Thamel was abandoned after several battles left the surface irradiated and uninhabitable. The Capellans have made several attempts to re-establish an outpost on the world, renaming it Wyeth's Glory after one of the MechWarriors killed in battle there.
column2: 塔梅尔殖民地在一连串战斗使地表受到辐射、变得无法居住之后被废弃。卡佩兰人曾多次尝试在该行星重建前哨，并将其更名为"怀斯之荣"，以纪念在那里战死的一名机师。

column1: The Wynn's Roost system was colonised in the Star League era, and survived to become capital of the Trader's Domain, a short lived micro-state. Eventually it succumbed to pirate attacks and was abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: 温之栖木星系在星盟时代被殖民，并幸存下来成为"商人领地"这个短暂微型国家的首都。它最终屈服于海盗袭击，在第三次继承战争期间被废弃。

column1: The Wypoute system was colonised in the Star League era, but was destroyed during the Third Succession War.
column2: Wypoute星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被摧毁.

column1: The Xanthe system was colonized by the Capellan Confederation during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The moon of Xanthe III is still littered with debris from an ancient battle long ago.
column2: Xanthe星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候由卡佩拉邦联殖民的. Xanthe III的卫星上至今仍散落着很久以前一场古老战斗留下的残骸.

column1: Xanthe III
column2: 赞希3号

column1: The Xenia system was colonized during the Age of War, and is situated within the Crucis March. Renown for its lumber production, this system acts as a central trading hub for nearby worlds.
column2: Xenia星系在战争时代被殖民，位于克鲁西斯边区内. 该星系以木材生产闻名，是邻近星球的中心贸易枢纽.

column1: A icy planet with a large population, Xhosa is known for its Aerospace Academy. The nearby Aerospace industry is however somewhat depressed by war.
column2: Xhosa是一颗人口众多的冰冷星球，以其航空航天学院而闻名. 然而，附近的航空航天工业因战争而略显萧条.

column1: The Xieng Khouang system was settled at some point prior to the Age of War, and often relies on mercenaries for protection.
column2: Xieng Khouang星系在战争时代之前的某个时期被殖民，并经常依赖雇佣兵提供保护.

column1: Xinyang is the capital world of the Xinyang Prefecture. If Xinyang had anything other than a large amount of fresh water, it could be an industrial powerhouse. Unfortunately the water is the only resource the planet really offers.
column2: Xinyang是Xinyang辖区的首府星球. 如果Xinyang除了大量淡水之外还有任何其他资源，它本可以成为一个工业强国. 不幸的是，水是这颗星球真正能提供的唯一资源.

column1: The Yamarovka system was settled at some point during the beginning of the Terran Hegemony in 2319. Yamarovka is noted for its overcast and monsoon type seasonal wealth. It's two principle cities are Yama and New Circe.
column2: 亚马罗夫卡星系在2319年地球霸权成立之初的某个时期被殖民。亚马罗夫卡以其阴云密布、季风式的季节物产而闻名。它的两座主要城市是亚马和新喀耳刻。

column1: The Yamoussoukra system was colonised in the Star League era, but was wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Yamoussoukra星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁.

column1: The Yanchep system was colonised by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but opposing planetary governments constantly seeks its independence.
column2: Yanchep星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被自由世界联盟殖民，但与之对立的行星政府不断寻求其独立.

column1: Massive dams were constructed across Yangtze during the Star League era to turn the desert into an agricultural paradise, but were sabotaged during the Succession Wars leading to over a billion deaths.  Only smaller agricultural areas remain.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，人们在Yangtze上修建了巨大的水坝，将沙漠变成农业天堂，但在继承战争期间这些水坝遭到破坏，导致超过十亿人死亡. 如今只剩下较小的农业区.

column1: The Yàn-huì system was colonized by the Confederation during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was devastated due to the fighting during the Third Succession War.
column2: Yàn-huì星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被邦联殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间因战火而遭到严重破坏.

column1: The Yardley system was settled at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War. The three moons surrounding Yardley cause planetwide storms due to tidal effects.
column2: Yardley星系在统一战争结束前的某个时期被殖民. 环绕Yardley的三颗卫星因潮汐效应而引发全球性风暴.

column1: The Yed Posterior system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. Previous a major manufacturing hub, all Mechworks facilities were destroyed during the Second Succession War and have not been rebuilt.
column2: Yed Posterior星系是在第一次泰拉大出走期间或之后不久被殖民的. 它曾是一个主要的制造中心，但所有Mechworks设施都在第二次继承战争期间被摧毁，且至今未重建.

column1: The Yed Prior system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. It is also home to the famous Mitchellson University of Arts and Crafts.
column2: Yed Prior星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被开拓的. 它也是著名的米切尔森艺术与工艺大学的所在地.

column1: Yeguas has spent most of the Succession Wars as a quiet agricultural world famous for raising horses and growing food. Massive agricultural concerns own most of the third largest continent, producing large amounts of exportable crops.
column2: Yeguas在继承战争的大部分时间里一直是一个安静的农业星球，以养马和种植粮食而闻名. 大型农业企业拥有第三大洲的大部分土地，生产大量可供出口的农作物.

column1: The Yidtall system was colonised in the Star League era, but was wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Yidtall星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁.

column1: The Ylemelke system was colonised in the Star League era, but was wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Ylemelke星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁.

column1: The Yongd system was colonised in the Star League era, but was wiped out during the Third Succession War.
column2: Yongd星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁.

column1: Yorii was a major trading hub throughout most of the peacetime years, whilst maintaining a sizeable industrial complex too. Neo-Tokyo, the capital city, often has citizens of dual-nationalities within its boundaries.
column2: 在大部分和平时期，Yorii一直是一个主要的贸易枢纽，同时也维持着规模可观的工业综合体. 首府新东京的边界内经常有双重国籍的公民.

column1: York is a large and warm planet with relatively intense tectonic activity. The planet had large mountain ranges with several volcanoes reaching the stratosphere. Most of the planet's population was concentrated near the shorelines.
column2: 约克是一颗庞大而温暖的行星，构造活动相对剧烈。该行星拥有大片山脉，其中若干火山高达平流层。行星上大部分人口集中在海岸线附近。

column1: The colony of York was founded by Scots-Irish refugees fleeing from the war between the Stewart Confederation and the Free Worlds League in 2305.
column2: York殖民地由逃离 2305 年斯图尔特邦联与自由世界联盟之间战争的苏格兰-爱尔兰难民建立.

column1: The Ype-Jhu system was colonised in the Star League era, but was abandoned during the First Succession War after heavy fighting.
column2: Ype-Jhu星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间经历激烈战斗后被废弃.

column1: The Yufu system was colonised in the Star League era, but was abandoned during the First Succession War after heavy fighting.
column2: Yufu星系在星盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间因激烈战斗而被放弃.

column1: The Yumesta system was settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era. Along with other cultural plazas, it is the site of the Regis Art Gallery, a large complex built solely for housing royal artifacts.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Yumesta星系由天龙联合体殖民. 除了其他文化广场之外，这里还是Regis艺术画廊的所在地——这是一座专为收藏皇家文物而建的大型建筑群.

column1: Despite its considerable mineral wealth, Yunnah remained nearly uninhabited as late as 3025, when the Capellan government established advanced repair and medical facilities here.
column2: 尽管拥有相当丰富的矿产资源，Yunnah直到 3025 年仍几乎无人居住，当时卡佩拉政府在此建立了先进的维修与医疗设施.

column1: Originally a Star League staging ground, Yuris has a long and bloody history of urban conflict with various resistance groups. Despite this, in the lush rural regions, many industries prosper.
column2: 尤里斯最初是星际联盟的跳板，各种抵抗组织的巷战写就了一部漫长的血泪史. 尽管如此，在郁郁葱葱的乡下，许多工厂依然兴旺着.

column1: The Zacatecoluca system was colonised in the Star League era, but was abandoned during the First Succession War after heavy fighting.
column2: Zacatecoluca星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间经过激烈战斗后被废弃.

column1: The Zalaf system was settled or annexed by the Draconis Combine at some point during the Reunification War. Majesty Metals have a small Aerotech construction facility on the planet.
column2: Zalaf星系在统一战争期间的某个时候被天龙联合体殖民或吞并. Majesty Metals在该行星上拥有一座小型的航空航天建造设施.

column1: The Zalt system was colonised in the Star League era, but was abandoned during the Second Succession War after heavy bombardment.
column2: Zalt星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间因遭到猛烈轰炸而被废弃.

column1: The Zalzangor system was colonised in the Star League era, but was abandoned during the First Succession War after heavy fighting.
column2: Zalzangor星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间经过激烈战斗后被废弃.

column1: The Zambezi system was colonised in the Star League era, but was wiped out during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zambezi星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被毁灭.

column1: The Zanbasa system was colonised in the Star League era, but was wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Zanbasa星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间被彻底毁灭.

column1: The Zanderij system was colonized by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The medical research undertaken here is enhanced by the hallucinogenic fruit found growing across the planet.
column2: Zanderij星系在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被天琴共同体殖民. 这里进行的医学研究因遍布整个星球生长的致幻果实而得到提升.

column1: Zangul is a cold water-world with chains of rocky islands and sprawling archipelagos. Most of the population lives on a single island, which is entirely covered with the slowly-decaying hulk of the original Capellan spaceport.
column2: 赞古尔气候寒冷，表面覆水，不仅有着岩质岛链，也有着绵延不绝的群岛. 大多数人口居住在一座岛上，在岛上盖满了缓缓朽烂的卡佩拉太空港残骸.

column1: Though Zaniah has some light commercial industry and is known for its exported civilian vehicles, it is best known for the Mechwarrior sanctuary named St. Marinus House, which is located deep in one of its deserts.
column2: 尽管Zaniah拥有一些轻商业产业，并以其出口的民用车辆而闻名，但它最出名的是名为St. Marinus House的机甲战士庇护所，该庇护所位于其一片沙漠深处.

column1: Zanzibar was originally settled by the Taurian Concordat, but was absorbed during a Liao expansion centuries ago. It has a strong black market where almost anything can be traded.
column2: 桑给巴尔最初是由金牛协约国建立的，但几个世纪前在廖氏的扩张过程中被吞并. 这里有着强大的黑市，几乎能交易任何东西.

column1: The Zaprudy system was colonized by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Known for its massive tar and mudflats, many scavengers often comb them for Lostech or other remains.
column2: Zaprudy星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被天琴共同体殖民. 该星系以其广袤的焦油地和泥滩而闻名，许多拾荒者常常在这些地方搜寻失落科技或其他遗存.

column1: The Zara system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zara星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The planet is noted for its rich mineral deposits and slight heavy gravity. Massive water processing plants dominate the landscape, to support cities and their agricultural settlements on the planet due to the toxic taint in the water.
column2: 这颗行星以丰富的矿藏和略高的重力而闻名. 由于水中含有有毒污染物，庞大的水处理厂遍布大地，以维持行星上的城市及其农业定居点.

column1: Zathras was a Magistracy system that broke away and declared its independence. The new state styles itself an 'Empire', and has made aggressive moves towards the newly-independent Aquagea.
column2: 扎特拉斯曾是卡诺帕斯行政区的一个星系，后来脱离并宣布独立。这个新国家自称“帝国”，并对新独立的阿夸盖亚采取了侵略性举动。

column1: A relatively small world with one major city, Zaurak is known for its agricultural prowess in the face of extensive massive planetary weather shifts.
column2: Zaurak是一个相对较小的世界，只有一座主要城市，以其在面对大范围、剧烈的行星天气变化时仍具备强大的农业实力而闻名.

column1: The Zavijava system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra. Extensive volcanism began in the early 26th Century which caused a major climate shift as temperatures cooled.
column2: Zavijava星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民. 26世纪初，大规模的火山活动开始，随着气温下降，引发了重大的气候变化.

column1: The Zawiercie system was colonised in the Star League era, but was abandoned during the First Succession War due to utter devastation.
column2: Zawiercie星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间因彻底毁灭而被废弃.

column1: Settled in the early years of the Star League, Zdice is known for its prestigious universities. Beautiful rings encircle the planet, providing a boost to tourism.
column2: Zdice在星际联盟早期便有人定居，以其久负盛名的大学而闻名. 美丽的星环环绕着这颗行星，促进了当地旅游业的发展.

column1: Deposits of silicon and precious gemstones ensure Zebebelgenubi has a bright future as a major manufacturer and research complex. Rumours abound of Lostech caches hidden in the mountains, but few have been found.
column2: 硅矿和珍贵宝石矿藏确保了Zebebelgenubi作为主要制造与科研综合体的光明未来. 有关山脉中藏有失落科技秘藏的谣言四起，但已发现的寥寥无几.

column1: The mountainous icy terrain of Zebenescamali houses billions of citizens, who enjoy the security offered by the wealth from the mining resources of the planet.  The low gravity also makes winter sports particularly favourable for tourism.
column2: Zebenescamali的多山冰封地形居住着数十亿公民，他们享受着该行星矿产资源财富所带来的安全保障. 低重力也使得冬季运动对旅游业尤为有利.

column1: The Zebrenaski system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zebrenaski星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The Zebuluraskai system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Second Succession War.
column2: Zebuluraskai星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The Zelmag system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned shortly thereafter due to plague.
column2: Zelmag星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但此后不久因瘟疫而被废弃.

column1: The Zelmag system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zelmag星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The Zelski system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zelski星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The Zempoatlepetl system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zempoatlepetl星系于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The Zertarum system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zertarum星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃了.

column1: The Zetang system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Zetang星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: Colonised during the Star League, Zhongshan hosted a Star League Defense Force garrison for many years. Treasure hunters often search the highlands in search of rumours of hidden caches.
column2: 于星际联盟时期被殖民，Zhongshan曾多年作为星际联盟防卫军的一处驻地. 寻宝者经常在高地搜寻，追查有关隐藏秘藏的传闻.

column1: A harsh Capellan world, Ziliang had two industries: Mining and prisons. The mining facilities were run by prisoners, who often died in the dangerous environment. After the Federated Suns took over, labour was a much more hospitable affair.
column2: 作为一个严酷的卡佩拉世界，Ziliang有两项产业: 采矿和监狱. 采矿设施由囚犯运营，他们常常在危险环境中丧生. 恒星联邦接管后，劳动条件变得宜人得多.

column1: Zinal was founded during the Star League era, but cataclysmic earthquakes destroyed the colony and swallowed it whole. It has been abandoned since.
column2: Zinal建立于星际联盟时代，但灾难性的地震摧毁了殖民地，并将其整个吞没. 此后它便一直被废弃.

column1: Zindao was destroyed during the Second Succession War, and is home to very few settlers ekeing out a miserable existence.
column2: Zindao在第二次继承战争中被摧毁，如今只有极少数定居者在此勉强度日，过着悲惨的生活.

column1: An oft fought over border world, Zion is known for its arid climates and Star League ruins.
column2: Zion是一个常遭争夺的边境世界，以其干旱的气候和星际联盟遗迹而闻名.

column1: The Zlatousi system joined the Outworlds Alliance at some point during the Age of War. It's volcanic past provides extremely fertile soils for agricultural needs.
column2: 兹拉图西星系在战火时代期间某个时候加入了外域联盟。它火山活动的过往为农业需求提供了极其肥沃的土壤。

column1: Colonised at some point after the Reunification Era, Zoetermeer II is the second planet in the Zolfo system and has a single moon named Zegwaard.
column2: 在统一时代之后的某个时候被殖民，Zoetermeer II是Zolfo星系中的第二颗行星，并拥有一颗名为Zegwaard的卫星.

column1: Originally a dry dusty world barely able to feed itself, recent discoveries by BP Interstellar of massive deposits of petroleum, coal and other minerals have reinvigorated investment in the entire planet.
column2: 这颗星球原本干旱多尘，几乎难以自给自足；BP Interstellar最近发现了大量石油、煤炭和其他矿藏，这重新激起了对整个星球的投资.

column1: Zollikofen is the first planet of eleven in the Zollikofen system. The surface of Zollikofen is home to at least one industrial manufacturer, Acme Widgets, and a host of mining concerns.
column2: Zollikofen是Zollikofen星系中十一颗行星中的第一颗. Zollikofen的表面至少有一家工业制造商Acme Widgets，以及众多采矿企业.

column1: The Zorn's Keep system was settled during the Succession Wars and became significant enough for Inner Sphere nations to record its position. It is unremarkable, except for a small mining presence.
column2: 佐恩要塞星系在继承战争期间被殖民，并发展到足以让内天体诸国记录其位置的程度。它并无特别之处，只是有小规模的采矿存在。

column1: The Zortman system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra, and subsequently joined the Free Worlds League. The Center for Technology Research is renown across many systems.
column2: Zortman星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，随后加入了自由世界联盟. 技术研究中心在许多星系中享有盛誉.

column1: Zosma is a rocky, arid world with a thin atmosphere; subject to brutal levels of year-round heat from the system primary star and possessing nutrient poor soil, there are few species of native flora on the planet.
column2: Zosma是一颗岩石质、干旱的行星，大气稀薄；常年承受来自星系主星的严酷高温，且土壤贫瘠，因此行星上原生植物物种稀少.

column1: Zuhbehr was devastated during the Third Succession War and abandoned shortly thereafter.
column2: Zuhbehr在第三次继承战争中遭到严重破坏，随后不久被废弃.

column1: Zumbo was devastated during the Third Succession War and abandoned shortly thereafter.
column2: Zumbo在第三次继承战争中遭到严重破坏，此后不久即被废弃.

column1: Zurich was one of Maximilian Liao's favorite worlds, receiving favourable trade agreements and tax breaks. Though it lacks economic resources and position, the presence of Star League era BattleMechs increased the tourist trade to the world.
column2: 苏黎世是马克西米利安·廖喜爱的行星之一，享有优惠的贸易协定和税收减免。虽然它缺乏经济资源与位置优势，星盟时代战斗机甲的存在却增加了该世界的旅游业。

column1: The Zvolen system was settled at some point before the mid-twenty-fourth century and joined the Lyran Commonwealth during the Age of War. During the final years of the Star League, Zvolen was the site of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: Zvolen星系在二十四世纪中叶之前的某个时候被殖民，并在战争时代加入了天琴共同体. 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Zvolen是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Fighting on Zwenkau was part of the initial skirmishes that resulted in the commencement of the Second Succession War. It's factories still produce a substantial amount of armaments.
column2: 在兹温考的战斗是引发第二次继承战争的最初几场小规模冲突之一。其工厂至今仍生产大量武器。

column1: Settled during the Star League, the fourth planet in the Zwipadze system is known for its pharmaceutical and narcotics trade.
column2: Zwipadze星系中的第四颗行星于星际联盟时期被殖民定居，以药品和麻醉品贸易闻名.

column2: -6% 热量产生，+20% 移动速度. 部署时 +2 固定点数收益(仅限RT Online). +45% 机师维护费用.

column1: Pilots dubbed \"assassins\" are masters of Offensive Push. They gain a significant bonus to Offensive Push accuracy, in addition to an increased chance to hit the called location.
column2: 被称作"刺客"的飞行员是攻势推进的大师。除了击中指定部位的几率更高之外，他们在攻势推进的精度上还获得显著加成。

column1: Pilot Quirk: Assassin
column2: 机师特质: 刺客

column1: Athletic pilots can take more of a beating than their peers, boasting a small increase to maximum HP and recovery speed.
column2: 体魄强健的机师比同僚更耐打，最大生命值和恢复速度都有小幅提升.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Athletic
column2: 机师特质: 健壮

column1: Bookish pilots have increased sight and sensor range.
column2: 喜爱阅读的机师拥有更远的视野和传感器范围.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Bookish
column2: 机师特质: 喜爱阅读

column1: Brave pilots generate more Resolve and are less likely to panic.
column2: 勇敢的机师会生成更多决心值，并且不容易陷入恐慌.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Brave
column2: 机师特质: 勇敢

column1: Pilots with command experience are able to inspire and coordinate their allies. While a commander is on the field, nearby allies gain a small bonus to Initiative and Tactics, generate additional Resolve per round, and are less likely to panic.
column2: 拥有指挥经验的机师能够激励并协调友军. 当指挥官在场上时，附近的友军会获得先攻权与战术技能的小幅加成，每回合获得额外的决心值，并且更不容易陷入恐慌.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Commander
column2: 机师特质: 指挥官

column1: Criminal pilots haven't quite left that life behind. Their illicit dealings sometimes bring in some additional spending money, but deals gone south can be a drain on the company funds.
column2: 有犯罪背景的飞行员并没有完全抛下那种生活。他们的非法交易有时会带来一些额外的零花钱，但交易告吹也会成为公司资金的流失。

column1: Pilot Quirk: Criminal
column2: 机师特质: 罪犯

column1: Dependable pilots are less likely to panic in the heat of battle. They also take reduced stability damage.
column2: 可靠的机师在激烈的战斗中更不容易陷入恐慌，同时受到的稳定性伤害也会降低.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Dependable
column2: 机师特质: 可靠

column1: Disgraced pilots reflect poorly on their company, but they are skilled at keeping a low profile - even in combat.
column2: 身败名裂的机师会损害连队的声誉，但他们精于保持低调——即便身处战斗之中也是如此.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Disgraced
column2: 机师特质: 身败名裂

column1: Dishonest pilots are, unsurprisingly, not to be trusted. On top of the hot water they often find themselves in, the company coffers have a funny way of going up and down when they're around. Curious.
column2: 不诚实的飞行员不可信任，这一点毫不意外。除了他们常给自己招来的麻烦之外，只要他们在场，公司的账目总会以一种有趣的方式忽上忽下。真奇怪。

column1: Pilot Quirk: Dishonest
column2: 机师特质: 不诚实

column1: Drunkard pilots take additional stability damage, but have higher Offensive Push accuracy. Their blurred perception also makes it impossible for them to find the eject button in a panic.
column2: 醉鬼机师会承受额外的稳定性伤害，但“进攻推进”的命中率更高. 此外，由于感知模糊，他们在恐慌时根本找不到弹射按钮.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Drunk
column2: 机师特质: 酗酒

column1: Gladiator pilots deal more damage and stability damage with their melee attacks.
column2: 角斗士机师在使用近战攻击时，能造成更高的伤害与稳定性伤害.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Gladiator
column2: 机师特质: 角斗士

column1: Honest pilots lift the spirits of the crew and provide a small increase to Morale.
column2: 诚实的机师能提振全体成员的精神，并提供少量的士气加成.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Honest
column2: 机师特质: 诚实

column1: Pilots with horrendous unlucky streaks. Allies and enemies deployed alongside a jinxed pilot have a chance for things to go wrong at the worst possible times.
column2: 厄运缠身的机师运气背到极点. 与这类机师一同出战的友军和敌军，都有可能在最糟糕的时机碰上倒霉事.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Jinxed
column2: 机师特质: 倒霉蛋

column1: Pilots experienced with LosTech can lessen the strain on the 'Mech Bay. In addition, they reduce the operating costs of the Argo's Drive Systems.
column2: 熟悉失落科技的飞行员能减轻机甲库的压力。此外，他们还能降低阿尔戈驱动系统的运营成本。

column1: Pilot Quirk: LosTech Experience
column2: 机师特质: 失落科技经验

column1: Lucky pilots find their weapons jamming less frequently and their shots grouping more tightly.
column2: 鸿运当头的机师会发现自己的武器卡壳频率更低，弹着点也更加密集.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Lucky
column2: 机师特质: 幸运

column1: Veteran MechWarriors have fast reactions and gain a small bonus to Initiative.
column2: 资深机甲战士反应迅速，先攻值获得少量加成.

column1: Pilot Quirk: MechWarrior
column2: 机师特质: 机甲战士

column1: Pilots with mercantile experience continue to ply their side hustles on the Argo. They have a small chance to generate additional income, and know how to optimise bookkeeping to cut down on DropShip costs.
column2: 拥有商业经验的机师会在阿尔戈号上继续经营自己的副业. 他们有较小的几率能创造额外收入，并且懂得如何优化账目以削减空投艇的相关开销.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Merchant
column2: 机师特质: 商人

column1: Pilots with formal military experience are tough as nails. They gain a small bonus to maximum HP and Offensive Push accuracy, and can manage high-recoil weapons.
column2: 拥有正规军经历的机师坚毅如铁. 他们的最大生命值有小幅提升，“进攻推进”命中率也有加成，并且能够驾驭高后坐力武器.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Ex-Military
column2: 机师特质: 退伍军人

column1: Pilots with neural implants are able to interface more directly with their 'Mech. Implants are required to gain the benefits of an active Enhanced Imaging or DNI-style cockpit, although the passive benefits of those cockpits will still apply to pilots without them. Cockpit Interface cockpits, however, require a pilot to possess neural implants to use at all.
column2: 带有神经植入体的飞行员能更直接地与机甲对接。要获得主动式增强成像或DNI式座舱的加成，需要植入体，不过那些座舱的被动加成对没有植入体的飞行员仍然适用。但座舱接口式座舱要求飞行员必须拥有神经植入体才能使用。

column1: Pilot Quirk: Neural Implants
column2: 机师特质: 神经植入物

column1: Noble pilots are shrewd negotiators, and know how to use their connections to supplement the upkeep of the Argo's entertainment and medical facilities.
column2: 贵族飞行员是精明的谈判者，懂得利用人脉来补贴阿尔戈娱乐与医疗设施的维护费用。

column1: Pilot Quirk: Noble
column2: 机师特质: 贵族

column1: Pilots with officer training increase the sight and sensor radius of their allies.
column2: 受过军官训练的机师能够增加友军的视野与传感器探测范围.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Officer
column2: 机师特质: 军官

column1: Pilots with pain shunts ignore injuries from overheating, ammo explosions, and feedback caused by taking structure damage while using DNI cockpits. However, it does not protect against the small chance of injury from DNI failure.
column2: 配备痛觉屏蔽的机师会忽略因过热、弹药爆炸以及使用DNI驾驶舱时因结构受损产生的反馈所造成的伤害. 然而，它无法抵御DNI故障所造成的小概率伤害.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Pain Shunt
column2: 机师特质: 痛觉屏蔽

column1: Reckless pilots have an easier time hitting fast-moving enemies with high evasion. Conversely, the maximum amount of evasion they themselves generate is reduced.
column2: 鲁莽的机师更容易命中高速移动且具有高闪避值的敌人. 相反，他们自身能够产生的最大闪避值会降低.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Reckless
column2: 机师特质: 鲁莽

column1: Spacer pilots know a thing or two about spacecraft operations and can pitch in to keep costs down.
column2: 太空人机师对航天器操作略知一二，能够帮忙搭把手以降低相关成本.

column1: Pilot Quirk: Spacer
column2: 机师特质: 太空人

column1: Technically-minded pilots can provide additional hands in the 'Mech Bay. Additionally, they reduce upkeep costs on the Argo's 'Mech Bay upgrades.
column2: 有技术头脑的飞行员能在机甲库中提供额外人手。此外，他们还能降低阿戈号机甲库升级的维护成本。

column1: Pilot Quirk: Technician
column2: 机师特质: 技师

column1: Things are never simple are they. Let's get it done.
column2: 事情从来都不简单，对吧。我们把它办完。

column1: A number of mercenary commands have gotten together to have a bit of a free-for-all fight with some cash and salvage on the line for the winner. However, it's gonna be a wild ride as everyone's IFFs are going to be switching between ally and enemy mode constantly, just to keep it interesting, as the flow of battle changes. Our employer is paying us to win this thing for them, so get in there and make us look good, Commander.
column2: 若干雇佣兵部队聚到一起打一场近战，赢家可得现金和战利品。不过这会是一场狂野之旅，因为所有人的敌我识别都会随着战局变化不断在友军和敌军模式之间切换，纯粹为了增加趣味。我们的雇主付钱让我们替他赢下这场，所以进去大干一场，让我们脸上有光吧，指挥官。

column1: Witness-in-protection? Lost contact? I think we all know how this might turn out. Let's go in with our eyes open, Commander.
column2: 证人保护？失联？我想我们都清楚这可能是什么结果。睁大眼睛进去，指挥官。

column1: I'm not at liberty to give you many details on this sensitive matter. What I can tell you is as of last night we lost contact with a site housing a very valuable witness-in-protection in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. If this has anything to do with the reason for protection I'd expect {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} groups to be involved. Get there and figure out what's going on.
column2: 关于这件敏感事务，我不便告诉你太多细节。我能告诉你的是，到昨晚为止，我们与{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系中一处安置着一位极重要受保护证人的地点失去了联系。如果这事与保护她的原因有关，我预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}团体牵涉其中。去那里查清楚发生了什么。

column2: 摧毁入侵小队

column1: Multiple contacts. Incoming hostiles. Engage at will, Commander.
column2: 多个接触信号. 敌军正在来袭. 自由开火，指挥官.

column1: Nice to make a difference. Especially when we get paid.
column2: 能有所作为真好. 尤其是我们还能拿到报酬的时候.

column1: No doubt that party was thrown for our witness. We better hurry to the other settlement. They might need more help.
column2: 毫无疑问，那场派对是为我们的证人举办的. 我们最好赶紧去另一个定居点. 他们可能需要更多帮助.

column1: There are two main settlements in this area. You know how this goes. Let's do a sweep and get more info, Commander. And let's hope this is just a case of some bad comms systems... the alternative won't be pretty.
column2: 这一带有两处主要定居点。你知道事情会怎么走。让我们扫一遍获取更多信息，指挥官。但愿这只是通讯系统故障……另一种可能可不好看。

column1: Typical hire-a-merc baby sitting job. A royal going silent is unusual though. Usually we'd hope for them to shut up. Let's hope it's just some faulty communications but expect trouble.
column2: 典型的雇雇佣兵当保姆的活。不过一位皇族失联就很不寻常了。通常我们还巴不得他们闭嘴。但愿只是通讯故障，但要预期有麻烦。

column1: Commander, we need you in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system immediately. We lost contact with one of the minor royals of the region - Henriette Bosh. They frequently bombard us with a constant stream of requests yet, since some time, we haven't heard from them.\n\nPlease check on them and report back to us.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你立刻前往{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系。我们与该区域一位小贵族失去了联系——享丽埃特·博什。他们一向用源源不断的请求轰炸我们，可已经有段时间没听到他们的消息了。\n\n请去看看他们的状况并向我们回报。

column1: Establish contact with the Royal
column2: 与那位贵族建立联系

column1: We've been provided a possible location the Royal is staying at. We've had no replies on our attempted comms though, which is unusual to say the least. Let's head to the nearest location and move on from there, Team.
column2: 我们已获知那位"皇家"可能落脚的一处位置。不过我们尝试通讯都没有得到回复，至少可以说是很不寻常。队伍，我们先前往最近的位置，再从那里继续推进。

column1: Survive the turrets in alpha base
column2: 在阿尔法基地的炮塔下存活

column1: Interrupted mid-stream? Not much does that, Commander. We better be ready for anything down there.
column2: 数据传了一半中断? 这事可不常见，指挥官. 咱们最好做好万全准备.

column1: Last week, radio coms with a strategic outpost was interrupted mid datastream to one of the remote relays and we've been unable to reestablish contact. Our other units are all tied up, so we need you to make contact and get a sitrep.
column2: 上周，与一处战略前哨的无线电通讯在一个远程中继的数据流中途被切断，我们一直无法重建联系。我们其他单位都被牵制住了，所以需要你去接触并取得情况报告。

column1: Landing site secure. Let's do what we agreed, Commander. Scout out that data relay and take it from there. Good luck.
column2: 着陆点已稳固。指挥官，按我们说好的做。侦察那座数据中继站，再从那里着手。祝好运。

column1: Forward base is a little misleading, Commander. I've heard rumours it's more a spy station. Let's go find out what's going on.
column2: 说前沿基地有点误导人，指挥官。我听说它更像一处间谍站。我们去看看是怎么回事。

column1: We recently lost contact with one of our forward bases in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. We've heard rumours of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near here so it might be related. We need you to go in and investigate for us.
column2: 我们最近与{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系的一处前沿基地失去了联系。我们听说这一带有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}活动的传言，所以可能与之有关。我们需要你去调查一下。

column1: Follow the Trail
column2: 沿着踪迹前进

column1: Commander! Are we glad to see you! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forward base {TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Alpha.
column2: 指挥官! 见到你真是太好了! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}前沿基地{TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Alpha.

column1: We've received very little intel on this situation. We just know they went dark and we assume jamming is involved. Careful out there, Commander.
column2: 关于这一情况我们收到的情报极少。我们只知道他们失联了，并推测涉及信号干扰。小心行事，指挥官。

column1: Destroy the lance that is occupying the supply cache
column2: 消灭占领补给藏匿点的小队

column1: Head to the second supply cache
column2: 前往第二个补给藏匿点

column1: Oh sure, dropping in a merc 'Mech company to check your secret supply cache is the very definition of discretion. Commander, if this doesn't go sideways I may die of shock.
column2: 哦当然，投放一支雇佣兵机甲连去检查你的秘密补给藏点，这简直是"谨慎"的定义。指挥官，要是这事没出岔子，我可能会惊讶死。

column1: Commander, we need you to confirm the status of a supply cache in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system that we established in case we need to execute local operations. Your company will run a patrol through the region, passing by the dumps and establishing communications by tightbeam only.\n\nDo not attempt to contact the cache by radio and maintain a low profile, discretion is paramount on this operation.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你确认{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系一处补给藏点的状态——那是我们为需要执行本地行动而设的。你的连队将在该区域进行巡逻，经过那些储藏点，且仅通过窄波束建立通讯。\n\n不要试图用无线电联系藏点，保持低调，本次行动中谨慎最为重要。

column1: Head to second supply cache
column2: 前往第二个补给藏匿点

column1: Investigate the supply cache
column2: 调查补给藏匿点

column1: About time. Now to show {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} what happens when someone decides to fuck with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}.
column2: 总算来了. 现在该让{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}知道，惹到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}会是什么下场.

column1: Ambush! Take them out!
column2: 埋伏! 干掉他们!

column1: As {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} didn't want to put all their eggs in one basket, they've split the cache over two locations within a quick march of each other. When you close in to each location, we can make contact with the garrison and get a sitrep.
column2: 由于{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不想把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里，他们把储藏点分散在两个相隔一次快速行军距离的地点。当你接近每个地点时，我们可以与守军取得联系并获取战况。

column1: Great work Commander. Secure the caches, Sumire is inbound with the Leopard to collect you and the remaining supplies.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 保护好藏匿点，苏米尔正驾驶豹式空投艇前来接应你和剩余的补给.

column1: Inbound Leopard!
column2: 豹式正在抵达!

column1: Losing these supply caches is going to significantly hinder {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} efforts in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, Commander... and our reputation.
column2: 失去这些补给藏匿点将严重阻碍{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在 {TGT_SYSTEM.name}的行动，指挥官……也会损害我们的声誉.

column2: 脉冲信号已发送……已确认. Alpha站点——

column1: Ping sent... confirmed. Alpha site transferring logs now. Reporting no issues.
column2: 脉冲信号已发送……已确认. Alpha站点正在传输日志. 报告称没有异常.

column1: Ping sent... confirmed. Alpha si-Wait-
column2: 脉冲信号已发送……已确认. Alpha站点——等等——

column1: Ping sent... Mech powerups detected!
column2: 脉冲信号已发送……检测到机甲启动!

column1: So much for secrecy. Powering up base turrets to assist you, Commander.
column2: 看来秘密已经保不住了. 启动基地炮台来支援你，指挥官.

column1: Thanks for the assist, Commander. Preparing to evac the supplies.
column2: 感谢支援，指挥官. 正在准备撤离补给.

column1: Turrets going live!
column2: 炮台激活!

column1: Turrets powering up!
column2: 炮台正在启动!

column1: What a generous gift {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} left for us. Please, allow us to express our thanks personally.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}给我们留下了多么慷慨的礼物啊. 请允许我们当面表示感谢.

column1: Head to the biolab in the next base
column2: 前往下一个基地的生物实验室

column1: Survive the bioscan in alpha base
column2: 在Alpha基地的生物扫描中存活下来

column1: Bio research station? We better be careful here, Commander. I don't fancy catching a new type of cold, if you know what I mean?
column2: 生物研究站？我们最好小心点，指挥官。我可不想染上一种新型感冒，你懂我的意思吧？

column1: One of our bio research stations has gone dark in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. We've not sure why but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} affiliated groups have been asking about purchasing some specific supplies we also use in that system. Investigate and find out what's going on.
column2: 我们的一座生物研究站在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系失联了。我们不清楚原因，但{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}关联团体一直在询问购买某些我们也在这个星系使用的特定物资。去调查，搞清楚发生了什么。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} radio operator. You have illegally taken over this {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base. Leave or be forced out.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}电台操作员. 你们非法占领了这个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地. 立即离开，否则将被强制驱逐.

column1: Commander! Are we glad to see you! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Biolab {TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Delta.
column2: 指挥官! 见到你我们太高兴了! {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}生物实验室{TGT_SYSTEM.name}-Delta.

column1: Unidentified BattleMech lance. This base has been put under quarantine by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Leave this area now.
column2: 不明战斗机甲小队. 该基地已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}隔离. 请立即离开该区域.

column1: Virus? Commander, incoming hostiles!
column2: 病毒? 指挥官，有敌人来袭!

column1: Watch out, Commander! Base defenses are coming online!
column2: 小心，指挥官! 基地的防御系统正在启动!

column1: Watch out, Commander! Turrets coming online!
column2: 小心，指挥官! 炮台正在启动!

column1: We've been informed there's two main bases for the Biolab. Let's head to the first one and scout it out. And... try not to take any deep breaths out there, Commander.
column2: 我们被告知生物实验室有两处主要基地。我们去第一处侦察一下。还有……在外面尽量别深呼吸，指挥官。

column1: You leave us no choice. Contain and control those Mercs!
column2: 你们让我们别无选择. 控制和压制那些雇佣兵!

column1: This is being set in the per-contract override. Huzzah!
column2: 这是在每份合约的覆盖设置中设定的。呼哈！

column1: Sometimes the best strategy is to stretch, bounce, and hope you don't snap.
column2: 有时候最好的策略就是拉伸、弹跳，然后祈祷别绷断。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s incursions have been escalating, and a massive force is gathering to deliver a decisive strike and destroy all of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}'s fortifications in the area.  We've been hired to slow them down, taking the brunt of the attack upfront.\n
\nThe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s second-string units have been deployed to support us.\n
\n Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的侵犯不断升级，一支庞大部队正在集结，准备发动决定性打击、摧毁{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在该地区的所有工事。我们受雇拖慢他们，正面承受攻击的主力。 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的二线部队已被派来支援我们。 < 纵深防御可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column2: 保卫 Bravo 基地

column2: 执行一次成功的弹性防御
