column2: 更多敌人正在进入防线!

column1: Defend Bravo base until the next base is online.
column2: 保卫Bravo基地直到下一个基地启动.

column1: Hostiles heading towards Charlie base!
column2: 敌对单位正在向Charlie基地进发!

column1: More hostiles incoming, Commander.
column2: 更多敌人正在来袭，指挥官.

column1: Hold the Ground, Until You Can't
column2: 守住地面，直到你守不住

column1: Maintain the defense and do whatever it takes to get us out of this in one piece.
column2: 守住防线，不惜一切代价让我们完好无损地脱离此地.

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has been pulling back their forces in large numbers after taking heavy casualties.  The last remaining bases are being kept online as a decoy, so the bulk of their troops are retreating without being attacked.  Our task is to create a diversion, with no reinforcements coming from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s.\n
\nBe advised that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} are sending a massive force, we're on our own here; save for some stationary turrets.\n
{MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThan.33%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.Intro_1}We are the {COMPANY.CompanyName}!  We'll push through this and stand firm against anything they throw at us!
column2: {MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThan.33%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.Intro_1}我们是{COMPANY.CompanyName}！我们要冲破这一切，坚定地顶住他们扔来的一切！

column1: Last Stand
column2: 最后一搏

column1: It might be someone's last stand, but it's not ours, Commander.
column2: 这也许是某人的最后一战，但不是我们的，指挥官。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s is forcing our employer back, so this is where they're making their stand. Our job is to hold the line and stall the enemy's advance until reinforcements arrive. Our employers say they've got some static defenses set up and even a volunteer militia backing us up.\n
\nStay alert and hold this position as long as possible.\n
Make a Stand
column2: 坚守阵地

column1: A few working units were activated to help defend the area.
column2: 一些可正常运作的单位已被启动，以协助防守该区域.

column1: Charlie Base is up.  Hold this position at all costs until reinforcements take over.
column2: Charlie基地已上线. 不惜一切代价守住这个阵地，直到援军接防.

column1: Defend Bravo base until Alpha base is online.
column2: 保卫Bravo基地，直到Alpha基地启动.

column1: I hate to be bearer of bad news, but new hostiles are detected moving towards you.
column2: 我不想带来坏消息，但探测到有新的敌对单位正在向你们移动.

column1: More enemies dispatched!
column2: 又消灭了一批敌人!

column1: Scopes are pinging bogies moving towards Alpha Base, Commander
column2: 测距仪显示有目标正在向Alpha基地移动，指挥官.

column1: Leapfrogging is the Way
column2: 蛙跳才是王道

column1: As someone wise said, \"we tactically leapfrog in a different direction.\"
column2: 正如某位智者所说，"我们朝另一个方向战术性地交替跃进。"

column1: Recent clashes between the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s and the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s respective forces have drained our employer's resources, forcing them into a retreat.  The remaining bases are serving as final holdouts, intended to inflict as much damage as possible on {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} before pulling out of the area.\n
\nThe employer doesn't expect us to wipe out all attacking forces, but they do want to send a clear message: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will return stronger and reclaim the territory they've lost.\n
Defend the bases
column2: 保卫那些基地

column1: Alpha Base is about to be hit --- another wave of hostiles incoming.
column2: Alpha基地即将受到攻击——另一波敌人正在来袭.

column1: Charlie Base is about to come under threat --- enemy forces are already on the move toward it.  We need to act now!
column2: Charlie基地即将受到威胁——敌军已经在向它移动了. 我们需要立刻行动!

column1: Commander, heads-up: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s forces have fully retreated.  We're the decoy team, so we'll be taking the heat alone.  We need to drag this out, deal as much damage as we can, and avoid unnecessary losses.
column2: 指挥官，提醒一下：{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队已完全撤退。我们是诱饵队，所以只能独自承受压力。我们需要把这场战斗拖长，尽可能多造成伤害，同时避免不必要的损失。

column1: Fresh hostile contacts detected en route to Alpha Base.
column2: 检测到新的敌对目标正在前往Alpha基地的途中.

column1: Great, looks like the bait worked a little too well.  I hate being the one out front like this.
column2: 太好了，看来诱饵的效果有点太好了. 我讨厌像这样当出头鸟.

column1: The participants are going weapons-hot for this one, and hopefully we'll have a better outcome than the battle they're reenacting.
column2: 这一场的参赛者要动真格了，但愿我们的结果比他们重演的那场战斗更好。

column1: During a local battle reenactment, a large force wearing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} colors unexpectedly landed and disrupted the event. We've now been tasked with defending the settlement using the fully immersive --- and actually functional --- bases.\n
\nFortunately, the actors are equipped with real working units instead of props...which might explain why this reenactment is so realistic and attracts such a big crowd.\n
Hostiles en route to Charlie base, intercept them, Commander!
column2: 敌对单位正在前往Charlie基地的途中，拦截他们，指挥官!

column1: More trouble on the way!
column2: 更多麻烦正在路上!

column1: New wave of hostiles inside the perimeter --- lock it down!
column2: 新一波敌人已进入防线内部——封锁他们!

column1: The bases and military units in the reenactment aren't just props --- they're equipped with real, functional armaments.  This will enable us to defend the position while we wait for the next base to go online.
column2: 重演中的基地与军事单位不只是道具——它们装备着真实可用的武器。这让我们能在等待下一个基地上线时守住阵地。

column1: The units in Alpha are loaded with live rounds, safeties off.
column2: Alpha基地的单位已装填实弹，保险解除.

column1: A rearguard fight isn't exactly what we wanted, but we'll make it work
column2: 后卫生作战并不是我们想要的，但我们会把它办好

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence reports a massive {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force advancing on several recently captured bases following their successful occupation.  They'll almost certainly attempt to reclaim --- or even destroy --- the sites.  The main {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have already reached the neutral zone and are doubling back, but they won't make it in time to stop the initial assault.\n
\nWe've been hired to engage the enemy and delay their attack long enough for the main forces to return.\n
\n Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!\n

{MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThanOrIs.50%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.dialogue_fancy}Their task was to give the main host time to return and strike anew. Upon the few strongholds that yet stood, they held fast, guarding walls and towers against the foe.
column2: {MC.If.RandomPercentage.IsLessThanOrIs.50%}{MC.Modification.AddTo.EncounterTags.dialogue_fancy}他们的任务是为大军争取回返并再度出击的时间。在尚存的少数堡垒上，他们坚守不退，为敌人守着墙垣与塔楼。

column1: At High Noon
column2: 正午时分

column1: Straight out of the holovids, Commander. A showdown at high noon... or whatever time it will be on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.
column2: 简直就像全息影剧里的情节，指挥官. 一场正午时分的决斗……或者说，在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上不管是什么时候吧.

column1: Our bases in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been plagued by the local Jarman brothers. With support from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} they continually raid our supplies and we've had enough. Using their overconfidence against them we've baited them into accepting a duel with us. Can you help us out?
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的基地一直遭当地贾曼兄弟骚扰。在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的支持下，他们不断劫掠我们的补给，我们受够了。我们利用他们的过度自信，诱使他们接受与我们的决斗。你能帮我们一把吗？

column1: Win the festive duel
column2: 赢下节庆决斗

column1: These guys aren't inexperienced so watch out and good luck, Commander.
column2: 这些人并非新手，所以小心点，祝你好运，指挥官。

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} seems so insignificant. Why are there so many fighting over it?
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}看起来如此不起眼. 为什么会有这么多人争夺它?

column1: Our bases in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been plagued by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We have challenged them to a Trial of Refusal, hopefully driving them for the system once and for all.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的基地一直受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的侵扰. 我们已向他们发起拒绝审判 (Trial of Refusal)，希望能一劳永逸地将他们赶出这个星系.

column1: We have engaged the enemies.
column2: 我们已与敌人交战。

column1: Double Trouble
column2: 双重麻烦

column1: Bar Guard
column2: 栏卫

column1: Commander, looks like those two guys that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} crew ticked off last night were actually {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} guards. Looks like we've got ourselves a duel.
column2: 指挥官，看来昨晚被{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}船员惹毛的那两个家伙其实是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}卫兵。看来我们摊上一场决斗了。

column1: Last night a few of our crew members took some much needed R&R at the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} bar. Words were said and now it looks like we're stuck in a duel with two apparent {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} guards. Our crew aren't fighters so maybe you can help us out?
column2: 昨晚我们几名船员在当地{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}酒吧享受了急需的休息。话说得不太客气，现在看起来我们陷入了一场与两名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}警卫的决斗。我们的船员不是战斗人员，也许你能帮我们一把？

column1: Defeat Guards
column2: 击败守卫

column1: Defeat the Guards in a Duel
column2: 在决斗中击败守卫

column1: Glad you did it, Commander but time to run! Reports of this duel are reaching the airwaves.
column2: 很高兴你成功了，指挥官，但现在该撤了! 这场决斗的消息已经传到各个通讯频道了.

column1: Ready up, Commander.
column2: 准备就绪，指挥官.

column1: Commander, Those guys we ran into from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} are pretty hot headed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warriors. Looks like we've got ourselves a duel.
column2: 指挥官，我们在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}那边碰到的那帮人都是些火爆脾气的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士。看来我们要打一场决斗了。

column1: Last night a few of your crew members took some Liberties at the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} bar. Words were said and now you are to duel with the offended warriors of{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}.
column2: 昨晚，你的几名船员在当地一家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}酒吧里行为有些出格. 口角发生后，现在你必须与受冒犯的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士们进行决斗.

column1: Festive Couple
column2: 喜庆一对

column1: This actually sounds like fun! I'll have you both on coms the entire time but the rest of the crew will be cheering you on from the crowd. Let's do this, Commander.
column2: 这听起来其实挺有意思的！我会让你们俩全程连在通讯上，其余船员会在人群里为你们加油。动手吧，指挥官。

column1: As with every year at this festive time on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} we host an arena fight for the people. This year we'd like you to be our representative. Your duo duel is against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We're placing our trust in you so please don't let us down.
column2: 每年在这个节庆时刻前后，我们都会在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}为民众举办一场竞技场比赛。今年我们希望由你代表我们出战。你的双人对决对手是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}。我们信任你，请别让我们失望。

column1: Defeat the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的队伍

column1: The crowd is cheering for you two, Commander.
column2: 人群正在为你们俩欢呼，指挥官。

column1: Heh, sounds like we are to be the opening act, Commander.
column2: 嘿，听起来我们是开胃菜，指挥官.

column1: Every year around this time on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, we host an Trial of Position for the Sibkos. This year, we would like you to be the opening match. Your duo duel is against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Don't let our young warriors defeat you to badly.
column2: 每年这个时候前后，我们会在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}为同巢举办一场定位试炼。今年，我们希望你来打揭幕战。你的双人对决对手是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}。别让我们年轻的战士把你们打得太惨。

column1: BattleMech Trial of Position. Ready! GO!
column2: 战斗机甲定位试炼. 准备! 开始!

column1: Hah! Showed those warriors our abilites, Commander. Great job!
column2: 哈! 向那些战士展示了我们的能力，指挥官. 干得漂亮!

column1: The crowd is not cheering for us, Commander.
column2: 观众不是在为我们欢呼，指挥官.

column1: Last Minute Replacements
column2: 最后时刻的替补

column1: So, pick up the mess AND give away the credit. What a raw situation. At least the MRB knows the deal.
column2: 所以，既要收拾烂摊子，还得把功劳让给别人. 真是亏大了. 至少雇佣兵审查委员会知道内情.

column1: We're in a bit of trouble. Two of our pilots challenged two long standing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} duelists to a fight. Only now our pilots are nowhere to be found. Can you step in and take their spots please? Of course, you'd have to pretend to be our pilots.
column2: 我们有点麻烦了。我们两名飞行员向两位长期驻场的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}决斗者发起了挑战。只是现在我们的飞行员哪儿都找不着。你能替上他们的位置吗？当然，你得假装是我们的飞行员。

column1: Defeat the duelists
column2: 击败决斗者

column1: Looks like those expert duelists are waiting for you. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 看来那些老练的决斗者正等着你。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: So, clean up the mess AND give away the credit. What a raw situation. At least the MRB knows the deal.
column2: 所以，既要收拾烂摊子，还要把功劳让出去. 真是糟糕的局面. 至少雇佣兵审查委员会了解内情.

column1: Two of our sibko warriors have challenged two long-standing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} warriors to a fight. As they haven't had their Trial of Position, we can not allow them to fight this match. We would like you to particpate as their proxies instead, saving {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s honor, while also showing our sibko what it means to be a Warrior.
column2: 我们两名同巢战士向两名长期驻场的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士发起了挑战。由于他们尚未完成定位试炼，我们不能让他们参加这场对决。我们希望你们代他们出战，既保住{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的荣誉，也让我们的同巢看看什么叫做战士。

column1: And down they go!
column2: 他们倒下了!

column1: Looks like those expert warriors are waiting for you. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 看来那些资深战士正在等着你. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Words Hurt
column2: 言语伤人

column1: I just don't know, Commander. When people say they want to 'fight' allegations it's not meant to be a real fight. This {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor is crazy. Let's uphold the truth... for a price.
column2: 我真的不懂，指挥官。人们说想“以战斗对抗”指控时，并不是指真的打一场。这位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督疯了。让我们维护真相……只要给钱。

column1: We've been informed by one of the largest news networks that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor has taken issue with a recently released report on military fund spending irregularities. She's demanded a duel to fight those allegations. We'd like to hire you to represent and uphold that worthy news report, Commander.
column2: 一家最大的新闻网络通知我们，一位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督对最近一篇关于军费开支违规的报道提出异议，并要求以决斗来对抗这些指控。指挥官，我们想雇你去代表并维护那篇值得尊敬的新闻报道。

column1: Defend the Truth
column2: 捍卫真相

column1: The duelists are out there on the other side of the arena. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 决斗者就在竞技场的另一边. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: There we go. Issue settled. Back to the dropship, Commander.
column2: 搞定了. 问题解决了. 返回登陆舰，指挥官.

column1: You will retract that report. Right. Now.
column2: 你必须撤回那份报告. 就. 在. 现. 在.

column1: I just don't know, Commander. When people say they want to 'fight' allegations, it's not meant to be a real fight. These {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Clanners are crazy. Everything is a fight for them.
column2: 我真不明白，指挥官。当人们说他们想"打"官司应对指控时，那并不是要真的打一场架。这些{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}氏族人是疯子。对他们来说什么都是打架。

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Trinary Leader has taken issue with a recently released report on military inefficencies. She has demanded a duel to fight those allegations. We would like to hire you to represent our allegations, Commander.
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}三元编队指挥官对最近发布的一份关于军队效率低下的报告颇有异议. 她要求通过决斗来与报告中的指控作斗争. 指挥官，我们希望雇佣您代表我们，为这些指控据理力争.

column1: You can retract that report now, or when your mechs are flaming scrapheaps.
column2: 你现在可以撤回那份报告，否则就等着你的机甲变成一堆冒着火的废铁吧.

column1: Yearly Tussle
column2: 年度角力

column1: What do you think? Maybe we can get some of this good food and fine wine as part of the deal!
column2: 你觉得怎么样? 也许我们可以把这些美食和佳酿也作为协议的一部分!

column1: Every year we {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}s in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} continue a historic procedure with the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}s. We both field mercenaries and whoever wins claims a years worth of good food and fine wines. Our usual mercenaries who help us were recently and unexpectedly wiped out by a failed jumpship jump, so we've come to you for help.
column2: 每年我们这些{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}都会与当地的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}延续一项古老程序。双方各派雇佣兵，胜者赢得一整年的好食物与美酒。通常帮我们的雇佣兵最近因一次失败的跃迁舰跳跃意外全灭，所以我们来找你帮忙。

column1: Win the yearly duel
column2: 赢下年度决斗

column1: Our employers have won this every year for the past four years. No pressure, Commander.
column2: 我们的雇主在过去四年里每年都赢下这个。别有压力，指挥官。

column1: Every year {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} continues a historic tradition with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}. We both field mercenaries in a Trial of Possession, and whoever wins claims a year's worth of good food and fine wines. Our usual mercenaries who help us were recently and unexpectedly wiped out by a misjump, so we have come to you for help.
column2: 每年{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}都会与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}延续一项历史传统。我们双方都派出雇佣兵进行一场占有试炼，赢家获得足以享用一年的好食美酒。通常帮我们的雇佣兵最近因一次误跳意外全灭，所以我们来找你帮忙。

column1: This is just a normal day of political and military maneuvering in the Inner Sphere, meaning it's a good payday for us.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s manufacturing facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} is being challenged by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s forces as they alledge it is a cover for military personnel and units. Diplomatic efforts have failed and a military strike is on their way as we speak. The site will be abandoned but all personnel must evacuate safely. Your mission is to ensure their secure extraction.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的制造设施正受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的置疑，后者声称它是军事人员与单位的掩护。外交努力已告失败，而就在我们说话时，一场军事打击正在赶来。该地点将被放弃，但所有人员必须安全撤离。你的任务是确保他们安全撤离。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces contact confirmed.  Stall them until evac is prepped
column2: 确认发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队. 拖住他们，直到撤离准备就绪.

column2: 车队 04 已脱离危险区

column1: Flankers!!!  Protect the retreating evacuees.
column2: 侧翼部队！！！保护正在撤离的人员.

column1: Hostiles sending another team to harass the convoy.
column2: 敌方又派了一支部队来骚扰运输车队.

column1: Initial batch of convoys ready to depart.
column2: 第一批运输车队已准备出发.

column1: Second wave, incoming...
column2: 第二波，来了……

column1: Stay put, picking you up.
column2: 原地待命，我们来接你.

column1: We've marked your evac zone.  Reach it as soon as possible.
column2: 我们已标出你的撤离区。尽快抵达。

column1: Taking fire for them isn't desirable, but it's how we earn our keep.
column2: 替他们挨枪子并不理想，但这就是我们挣饭钱的方式。

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s agents are using this installation as their forward base.  They were discovered by the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s intelligence and has deployed a substantial force to eliminate them. Lacking military power to mount a defense, the agents are falling back. Assist them in conducting a safe evacuation.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的特工正以这处设施作为他们的前沿基地。他们被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的情报部门发现，后者已派出一支可观的部队来消灭他们。由于缺乏军力组织防御，这些特工正在后撤。协助他们安全撤离。

column1: Hold the installation during evac prep and cover the convoys during their escape
column2: 在撤离准备期间坚守设施，并在车队撤离时提供掩护.

column1: Protect the base structures
column2: 保护基地建筑结构

column1: All remaining evacuees are aboard; ensure their safe extraction.
column2: 所有剩余撤离人员均已登船; 请确保他们安全撤离.

column1: Convoy evacuation point is here.
column2: 车队撤离点在此处.

column1: First group of convoys is ready to roll.
column2: 第一批车队已准备出发.

column1: Onsite intelligence reports that enemy forces have breached our garrison perimeter.  We are under contract to defend the facilities while evacuation preparations are in progress.
column2: 现场情报报告称敌军已突破我方驻军防线. 我们按照合约规定，在撤离准备进行期间负责保卫设施.

column1: Second group of flankers on position!  Ensure the evacuees remain safe!
column2: 第二组侧翼包抄部队已就位! 确保撤离人员的安全!

column1: Second wave inbound --- hold positions and defend at all costs!
column2: 第二波敌军正在逼近——坚守阵地，不惜一切代价防御!

column1: Well done, Commander.  Enemy units in the area have been eliminated.  Evacuation can proceed before further reinforcements arrive.
column2: 干得好，指挥官. 该区域的敌方单位已被消灭. 在下一批增援抵达之前继续执行撤离.

column1: You heard them, boss.  Do your thing.
column2: 你听到他们的话了，老大. 按你的意思办吧.

column1: Hopefully they keep that stuff to themselves, so we don't get involved.
column2: 但愿他们把那些东西留给自己，别把我们卷进去。

column1: Our employer has been cooking up some extremely questionable science. Unfortunately, they forgot one tiny detail: they don't actually have permission to do any of it here.\n
\nDespite repeated calls by the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities, they kept right on bubbling their beakers and poking their mysterious gizmos. Now, they're being evicted forcefully.\n
\nOur mission? Give them a little breathing room to grab all their scientific doohickeys, pack up their suspiciously dubious supplies, and evacuate the place.
column2: 我们的雇主一直在鼓捣一些极其可疑的科学。遗憾的是，他们忘了关键的一点：他们其实没有在这里做这些事的许可。 尽管{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局多次要求，他们仍继续冒着烧瓶气泡、捅着神秘小装置。如今，他们正被强制驱逐。 我们的任务？给他们一点喘息空间，让他们收拾好那些科学玩意儿、打包好那些可疑得可疑的物资，然后撤离此地。

column1: Detecting enemy hostiles en route to the convoy.
column2: 探测到敌方部队正在前往车队途中.

column1: First convoy is ready to roll.
column2: 第一批车队已准备好出发.

column1: More hostiles trying to intercept the retreating vechiles.
column2: 更多敌军试图拦截正在撤退的车辆.

column1: The scientists are busy packing and loading the vehicles with their gear. The lab structures must be protected until all of them and their gear and supplies are on their way.
column2: 那些科学家正忙着把装备打包装上车辆。实验室建筑必须得到保护，直到他们所有人连同装备与补给都上路。

column1: Guess this facility is shutting down. Good news for us though.
column2: 看来这处设施要关停了。不过这对我们是好消息。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have identified the location of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s forward operating base. Friendly elements are preparing to withdraw, but enemy units are rapidly closing in. We are tasked with providing support to delay the enemy's advance. They'll need escorting out while under fire, so be prepared to split our forces.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已定位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}前进作战基地的位置。友军单位正准备撤退，但敌军部队正迅速逼近。我们的任务是提供支援以拖延敌军推进。他们需要在火力下被护送撤离，所以要做好分兵准备。

column1: Defend and evacuate essentials
column2: 防守并撤离要员

column1: Defend the base while personnel are evacuating, Commander.\n
\nThe convoy will head out as soon as it's ready and make sure they're protected no matter what.
column2: 指挥官，在人员撤离期间守住基地。\n\n车队一准备好就会出发，无论如何都要确保它们受到保护。

column1: Boots on the ground...that's us.
column2: 实地人员……就是我们。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been hitting {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} bases the past few days. All signs point to this base being next. We've been asked to defend the base long enough to evacuate its occupants.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队近几天一直在袭击{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地。种种迹象都表明下一处就是这里。我们被要求守住该基地足够久，以便撤离其人员。

column1: We underestimated the enemy numbers heading our way.  Evacuations are in progress, but it'll take time.  We need you to stall the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces while we get people onto the transport line.
column2: 我们低估了朝我们而来的敌军数量。撤离正在进行，但需要时间。我们需要你在我们把人送上运输线的同时拖住{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。

column1: We just need to buy them enough time to do the purge and then get them out safely.
column2: 我们只需要为他们争取足够的时间来完成数据清除，然后安全地将他们撤离.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s intelligence-gathering facility has been compromised. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units are mobilizing a significant strike element to neutralize the site and its occupants. Our employer is initiating a full data purge to mitigate liability and prevent sensitive material from being captured. Our mission is to delay the enemy advance long enough to ensure the purge is completed, then guard the withdrawal of personnel from the installation.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的情报搜集设施已被攻破。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位正调动一支可观的打击力量，要摧毁该地点及其人员。我们的雇主正在启动全面数据清除，以减轻责任并防止敏感材料被缴获。我们的任务是尽可能久地拖延敌军推进，确保清除完成，然后掩护人员从设施撤离。

column1: Are those the last batch?
column2: 那是最后一批吗?

column1: Commander, buy us some time to rid of the stuff then we'll extract.
column2: 指挥官，给我们争取点时间把这些东西清理掉，然后我们就撤离。

column1: They seem intent not to let anyone escape.
column2: 他们似乎决意不让任何人逃脱.

column1: You heard them, Commander.  Delay the enemies then guard the convoy.  Good luck.
column2: 你听到他们的话了，指挥官. 先拖延敌军，然后护卫车队. 祝你好运.

column1: Beefed Up Security
column2: 加强安保

column1: Commander, be careful: if there *is* a second attack, the raiders will go all out.
column2: 指挥官，小心点: 如果*有*第二轮攻击，那些袭击者会全力以赴.

column1: There is a small {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that has been attacked by raiders.  Their latest attack was far better organized and equipped than the previous ones, suggesting the raiders are receiving logistical and tactical support from a hostile power.  We might not be able to withstand a second attack of that scale.\n
\nWe'd like to hire you to provide additional defensive support.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上有一处小型{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，一直遭到劫掠者袭击。他们最近一次袭击的组织与装备远比之前几次精良，说明劫掠者正在从某个敌对势力获得后勤与战术支援。我们可能承受不住再一次那种规模的袭击。\n\n我们想雇你提供额外的防御支援。

column1: Defend {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Base
column2: 保卫 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Additional Forces
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 额外部队

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Auxiliaries
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 辅助部队
A FEW MINUTES AGO...\n

column1: \nLooks like {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}'s intel was right.  We're picking up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} comm chatter from this area.  Guessing they're the ones backing these raiders.\n
\nThis could get ugly. Commander, priority one is to keep them away from the base.  We've set your drop point coordinates, Oliveira out.
column3: 几分钟前…… 看来{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}的情报没错。我们正在该区域接收到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}通讯。我猜他们就是这些袭掠者的后台。 这可能会很难看。指挥官，首要任务是别让他们靠近基地。我们已经设好你的投放坐标，奥利维拉完毕。

column1: Good shooting, but don't celebrate yet.
column2: 射得好，但先别庆祝。

column1: Whoo hoo!
column2: 呼哈！

column1: Breakthrough on the Brink
column2: 濒临突破

column1: Commander, if they're hiring mercs to babysit when their forces are less than a day away they expect trouble.  Rumors say {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are in the area, they could present a threat.
column2: 指挥官，如果他们的部队不到一天就能抵达，却还要雇雇佣兵来看守，那他们就是在预期有麻烦。有传言说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队就在这一带，他们可能构成威胁。

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} industrial lab is at a critical juncture in its R&D program.  Any disruption would set us back a decade. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has discovered this, and they've already interdicted the first lance of 'Mechs that were sent to defend the facility.  We need mercenaries to step in and buy the time necessary for further reinforcements to arrive.
column2: 一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工业实验室正处于其研发计划的关键节点。任何中断都会让我们倒退十年。{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}发现了这一点，他们已经拦截了第一批被派去防守该设施的机甲。我们需要雇佣兵介入，为更多增援抵达争取必要的时间。

column1: Defend a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} R&D Facility
column2: 守卫一座{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}研发设施

column1: Defend Industrial Laboratory
column2: 守卫工业实验室

column1: Hot drop went bad, you've scattered forces.  Regroup if able, but priority is unchanged: defend the facility.
column2: 热投放出了问题，你的部队被打散。若有可能就重新集结，但优先事项不变：守住设施。

column1: Expect sustained attacks from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}
column2: 预期{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}会持续进攻

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has contracted us to defend their fort, a munitions depot and BattleMech refit yard positioned in a strategically vital but undisclosed theater.  The installation serves as a critical logistics hub for its' operations, stockpiling advanced weapon systems and replacement parts for frontline units.\n

\nIntelligence confirms that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned  strike force is en route, intent on seizing or destroying the facility before a major {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} offensive can be launched.\n
\nYour orders are to hold the installation, repel all enemy forces in open combat, and ensure the fort remains fully operational.
column2:
{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}签约雇我们防守他们的堡垒，那是一处位于战略要地但未公开战区的弹药库与战斗机甲改装场。该设施是其行动的关键后勤枢纽，为前线部队储备先进武器系统与替换部件。

情报确认，一支亲{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的打击部队正在赶来，意图在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}发动大规模攻势之前夺取或摧毁该设施。

你的命令是守住设施，在公开战斗中击退所有敌军，并确保堡垒保持完全可用。

column1: Defend a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} the Fort
column2: 保卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的堡垒

column1: All units, confirm status after drop insertion.  Report in.
column2: 所有单位，确认投放后状态。回报。

column1: Hold the Line
column2: 守住战线

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility must be running on incredibly narrow margins if they can't afford to protect it themselves.  Anyway, Commander, this should be very straightforward.
column2: 如果{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的设施连自己保护都负担不起，那它的运营余量一定极窄。总之，指挥官，这应该非常直接。

column1: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous.  We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site.  Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
column2: 敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直向我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处加工设施发动袭击，袭击越来越肆无忌惮. 这座设施对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说是一笔巨额资金投入，其被摧毁将带来政治和经济上的双重灾难. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵部队来防御该地点. 在击退了所有敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位后，我们就会把报酬汇给你.

column1: Defend Base from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Attackers
column2: 从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}攻击者手里保卫基地

column1: Defend Processing Facility
column2: 守卫处理设施

column1: All right, Commander, we've been tasked with defending this installation.\n
\nWe have reports of incoming hostiles from multiple directions.  They'll be targeting the structures; intercept them before they bring any down.  Good luck.
column2: 好，指挥官，我们的任务是守卫这处设施。\n我们接到报告，多个方向有敌人来袭。他们会把目标对准建筑；在他们弄倒任何一栋之前拦截他们。祝好运。

column1: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors.  Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
column2: 警告，指挥官，传感器显示多个接触信号正从多个方向接近. 看来攻击部队呼叫了援军.

column1: Maintenance Base
column2: 维护基地

column1: You don't hire mercenaries on a whim. They know there's an attack incoming, and we're going to absorb it. Thankfully, all we need to do is hold out.
column2: 没人会一时兴起雇佣兵。他们知道有袭击要来，而我们要承受它。所幸我们只需坚守。

column1: We operate a repair and maintenance facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  This base is critical to our operations in the system, and we suspect that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are going to assault the facility.  We'd like you to garrison the base, and if an attack comes, hold off the assault until our forces can arrive and relieve you.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}运营着一处维修与保养设施。这座基地对我们在该星系的行动至关重要，而我们怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队将进攻该设施。我们希望你去驻防该基地，若有进攻来临，拖住攻势，直到我们的部队赶到接替你。

column1: Defend {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Maintenance Base
column2: 守卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}维护基地

column1: Defend Maintenance Base
column2: 守卫维护基地

column1: \n{COMPANY.CompanyName}, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Control.  You are cleared for hot drop.  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signatures inbound fast.\n
\nBrace for atmospheric interference: trajectory deviation detected, correcting...
column2: 预部署…… {COMPANY.CompanyName}，这里是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}控制中心。你已获准热投放。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号正快速接近。 准备应对大气干扰：探测到弹道偏移，正在修正……

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements have secured the site, Commander.  Good work.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}援军已经拿下了该地点，指挥官. 干得好.

column1: Commander, if they're hiring mercs to babysit when their forces are less than a day away they expect trouble. Rumors say {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are in the area, they could present a threat.
column2: 指挥官，如果他们的部队不到一天就能赶到，却还要雇雇佣兵来当保姆，那说明他们预料有麻烦。有传言说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队就在这一带，他们可能构成威胁。

column1: We have a small, disused base in a remote part of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.  We need it and are preparing to reactivate it.\n
\nWe'd like to hire you to recon the facility and defend it until our forces can move in.  We'll have a lance with you in half a day and a logistics team within 24 hours.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}一处偏远地区有一座闲置的小型基地。我们需要它，正准备重新启用。\n我们想雇你侦察该设施并防守它，直到我们的部队能进驻。半天内我们会有一支分队与你同去，24小时内会有一支后勤队抵达。

column1: Commander, you are go for hot drop.  Objective is a disused {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} forward base at this grid.  Secure and hold until relief arrives.
column2: 指挥官，你可以执行热投放了。目标是这个网格上一处废弃的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}前沿基地。夺取并坚守，直到援军抵达。

column1: Extra Employer reputation for completing a specific objective
column2: 完成特定目标获得的额外雇主声望

column1: Objective Bonus Reputation Reward
column2: 目标额外声望奖励

column1: Extra payment for completing a specific objective
column2: 完成特定目标的额外报酬

column1: Extra Target team reputation penalty for completing a specific objective
column2: 完成特定目标时对目标阵营声望造成的额外惩罚

column1: Objective Bonus Reputation Penalty
column2: 目标额外声望惩罚

column1: All Eyes On
column2: 万众瞩目

column1: There's worse ways to make money than influencing a whole new generation of pilot's fighting styles. Sounds fun!
column2: 影响整整一代飞行员的近战风格来赚钱，比很多赚钱方式都好。听起来挺有意思！

column1: Commander, you've been very active. Active and successful. We're developing a new type of BattleMech simulator and we need new and improved data. Sound interesting? Good, because we want to analyse how you fight {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. We've arranged for an ex-{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} pilot to fight you for a data gathering exercise. What do you say? You'll be well rewarded.
column2: 指挥官，你一直非常活跃。活跃且成功。我们正在研发一种新型战斗机甲模拟器，需要新的、更好的数据。听起来有意思吗？很好，因为我们想分析你如何与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队作战。我们已安排一名前{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}飞行员与你对战，作为一次数据收集演习。你怎么说？报酬会很丰厚。

column1: Overcome the test subject
column2: 击败测试对象

column1: And there we go. I expect to see a lot more of those moves in the future. Guess we should be ready for that ourselves.
column2: 就这样了. 我预计未来会看到更多这样的战术动作. 看来我们自己也得为此做好准备.

column1: Here we go, Commander.
column2: 开始了，指挥官.

column1: It's going to be a Circle of Equals. I hope they bring their own supply, because I don't know if we have enough sugar packets onboard.
column2: 这会是一场平等之环。我希望他们自带补给，因为我不知道船上够不够糖包。

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have always been a bother, always claiming to be superior to ours. So we arranged for a Trial of Grievance against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}, and bargined for you to fight on our behalf as a slight to them. They're enraged at the implications of this, and we're more than happy to exploit it for ourselves. For the Glory of the Clan, show {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} that even our hired mercenaries are stronger than they are.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队一向令人厌烦，总自称比我们优越。所以我们安排了一场针对{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的控诉考验，并谈妥由你代表我们出战，以此羞辱他们。他们对这其中的暗示暴怒不已，而我们也乐于为己所用。为了氏族的荣耀，向{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}证明，就连我们雇来的雇佣兵都比他们强。

column1: A Taste For War
column2: 嗜战之味

column1: Commander, this seems like a straight up duel. It's based in an established arena so I guess it's as good as we'll get to 'safe'.
column2: 指挥官，这看起来是一场纯粹的决斗。它设在既有的竞技场里，所以我想这已经是我们能接近“安全”的极限了。

column1: A prized {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Gladiator has challenged you to solo combat, Commander. The holovid rights have already been sold to the highest bidder and we've already been wired a cut. We can't turn this chance down so we hope you can't too! We'll throw in the holo-vid footage for {COMPANY.CompanyName}'s promotional vids.
column2: 一位受器重的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}角斗士向你发起单挑挑战，指挥官。全息影像版权已经卖给了出价最高者，我们已经收到了一笔分成。我们不能拒绝这个机会，所以希望你也别拒绝！我们还会把全息影像素材送给{COMPANY.CompanyName}用于宣传片。

column1: I wonder what we did to get this grievance? Was it that stuff I did on Tuesday?
column2: 我想知道我们到底做了什么才招来这场争议? 难道是我星期二干的那件事?

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warrior has issued you a Trial of Grievance through us, Commander. It's a good opportunity to show our Sibkos how mercenaries fight, so we'll pay you if you win. Now, will {COMPANY.CompanyName} be remembered for their glorious fight, or forgotten?
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士通过我们向你发出了控诉考验，指挥官。这是向我们的同巢展示雇佣兵如何作战的好机会，所以如果你赢了我们就会付钱。那么，{COMPANY.CompanyName}会因光荣的战斗被铭记，还是被遗忘？

column1: Win the Trial of Grievance
column2: 赢得申诉试炼

column1: Challenge Accepted
column2: 接受挑战

column1: No ammo left? What kind of idiot set up their supply lines. Let's clean this duel up and cash in, Commander.
column2: 没弹药了？是哪个白痴安排的补给线。我们把这场决斗收拾干净去换钱吧，指挥官。

column1: Over the past few weeks we've been engaged in small stage skirmishes with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} in and around {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. The company commander must feel they can't continue their campaign because they've requested a duel to claim this local forward base. Little do they know that we've recently run out of supplies so we've very much taken them up on their offer. This is where you come in. We need you to win this for us, Commander.
column2: 过去几周，我们一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}内外与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}进行小规模前哨战。对方连长想必觉得无法继续他们的战役，因为他们请求以决斗来决定这处当地前沿基地的归属。他们不知道我们最近补给耗尽，所以我们非常乐意接下他们的提议。这就是需要你的地方。我们需要你为我们赢下这场，指挥官。

column1: Destroy Duelist Commander
column2: 摧毁决斗者指挥官

column1: Save the forward base
column2: 拯救前沿基地

column1: I know they said they were going to send a proxy but, a lowly Merc? What a waste of a perfectly good duel.
column2: 我知道他们说要派个代表来，但就派个低贱的雇佣兵? 真是浪费了一场绝佳的决斗.

column1: That's the one, Commander. Take him out.
column2: 就是那个，指挥官。干掉他。

column1: Much less waste when its only two mechs facing off in the field, even less if they pay us to fight for them.
column2: 当战场上只有两台机甲对决时，浪费就少得多了; 如果他们付钱让我们替他们打，那就更少了.

column1: Our battles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} in and around {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been a waste of resources. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has issued us a Trial of Possession for this small area of the conflict. It will be a one-on-one battle in a Circle of Equals with you taking our place, ostensibly to save our own resources.
column2: 我们与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}及其周边的战斗一直是在浪费资源. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}已向我们发出所有权试炼，以争夺冲突中的这一小片区域. 这将是一场在平等者之环中进行的一对一战斗，由你代表我们出战，表面上是为节省我们自身的资源.

column1: Assert dominance of base
column2: 确立对基地的控制权

column1: Destroy Duelist Warrior
column2: 摧毁决斗者战士

column1: I know they said they were going to send a proxy but, a lowly Dezgra Merc? What a waste of a perfectly good Circle of Equals.
column2: 我知道他们说会派个代表来，但就派个低贱的叛节雇佣兵? 真是浪费了一场完美的平等者之环对决.

column1: That is the warrior, Commander. Take them out.
column2: 那就是那个战士，指挥官. 干掉他们.

column1: We are coming in to pick you up fast, Commander. Hold on. We will sort the fallout from this later.
column2: 我们正在快速赶来接应你，指挥官. 坚持住. 后续的善后事宜我们之后再处理.

column1: Cornered Revenge
column2: 困兽之报

column1: 'Killbox'? Haven't heard that name for a long time. Do you think she's still upset after all these years?
column2: '杀戮区'？这名字很久没听过了。你觉得过了这么多年她还生气吗？

column1: We have a BattleMech causing us trouble in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} who refuses to back down until you, Commander, show up and fight them in a duel. They call themselves Killbox. I don't know what their problem is with you but we'll pay you to get here and just deal with them. It's causing us a headache.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一台战斗机甲给我们找麻烦，除非你——指挥官——露面与他们决斗，否则他们拒绝退让。他们自称"杀戮区"。我不知道他们跟你有什么过节，但我们会付钱让你过来，把这事处理掉。这让我们很头疼。

column1: Defeat Killbox
column2: 击败“杀戮箱”

column1: Defeat the Killbox
column2: 击败“杀戮箱”

column1: Last time we saw Killbox she was stuck on that moon, Commander. Not sure how they got off it. Guess it doesn't matter now. Good luck!
column2: 上次我们见到杀戮区时，他们被困在那颗卫星上，指挥官。不知道他们是怎么脱身的。我想现在也无所谓了。祝好运！

column1: Sounds like someone you may have run into before Commander. I wonder, do they write the name in blood on themselves? We should ask before the battle starts.
column2: 听起来像是你以前可能遇到过的人，指挥官. 我很好奇，他们会在自己身上用血写下名字吗? 我们应该在战斗开始前问问.

column1: There is a Warrior in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} who refuses to back down until you, Commander, show up and fight them in a Circle of Equals. As they are Bloodnamed, we feel that you cannot brush them off as easily as some drunk in a bar. It would bring great honor to our Clan if you would arrive and show them your might.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一位战士，除非你，指挥官，亲自到场在平等者之环中与之战斗，否则绝不退让. 由于他们拥有血脉名号，我们认为你无法像打发酒吧里的醉汉那样轻易敷衍过去. 如果你能到场并向他们展示你的实力，将为我们氏族带来巨大的荣誉.

column1: Defeat the Bloodnamed Warrior
column2: 击败那名拥有血脉名号的战士

column1: Defeat Warrior
column2: 击败那名战士

column1: Good work commander. Maybe that taught them a lesson
column2: 干得好，指挥官. 也许这给他们上了一课.

column1: Oh I remember this guy now, we completely humiliated them!
column2: 哦，我现在想起这家伙了，我们当时让他丢尽了脸!

column1: Well he got his revenge, and we proved that we are only the Dezgra mercenaries he though we were.
column2: 好吧，他报了仇，而我们也证明了自己不过是他所认为的那种叛节雇佣.

column1: Life Lesson
column2: 人生教训

column1: I have to hand it to this guy. At least he cares enough about his son to teach him a thing or two. Even if that means a knock on the head... or two.
column2: 我不得不佩服这家伙. 至少他对儿子上心到愿意教他点东西. 哪怕这意味着要吃一记……或者几记当头棒喝.

column1: A rich {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} business man has requested that we show his arrogant step-son what real fighting feels like. We thought {COMPANY.CompanyName} could help us here. Don't hold back. This father wants to teach a real life lesson - especially for his {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} side of the family.
column2: 一位富有的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}商人请求我们让他那傲慢的继子见识一下真正的战斗是什么滋味。我们认为{COMPANY.CompanyName}能帮上这个忙。不必留手。这位父亲想教一堂真实的人生课——尤其是给他{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}那一系的亲戚看。

column1: Teach a life lesson
column2: 教一堂人生课

column1: There he is, Commander.
column2: 他在那儿，指挥官。

column1: Some training work sounds nice about now. It's someone still learning, so how hard can it be?
column2: 现在来点训练工作听起来不错。对方还在学习，能有多难？

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has requested we field test a new pilot from their Alpha Sibko. {COMPANY.CompanyName} has been a valuable ally and we would like our new generation to pick up some skills. Don't hold back, the pilot is going to be putting everything they learned into this fight. The Clan wants to teach some real life lessons to them, and their Sibko.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}请求我们实战测试一名来自阿尔法育婴所的新飞行员。{COMPANY.CompanyName}一直是宝贵的盟友，我们希望我们新一代能学到些本领。别留手，这名飞行员会把学到的一切都投入这场战斗。部族想给他们和他们的育婴所上一堂现实课。

column1: 'Don't want to risk anything here?' I think they forget that we're putting our necks on the line. I suppose if the pay is good that's what we do.
column2: 不想在这儿冒任何风险？我想他们忘了我们是在拿命冒险。我想只要报酬够好，这就是我们要做的事。

column1: The Governor of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been challenged to a proxy war duel by a rival {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor. We'd like you to be his proxy in this fight. If you lose, we'll just deny it was ever agreed to. We don't want to actually risk anything here.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}的总督被一位对立的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督挑战进行代理战争决斗。我们希望你去当他在这一战中的代理人。如果你输了，我们就干脆否认曾经同意过。我们并不想在这里真正冒任何风险。

column1: Defeat the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} duelist
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的决斗者

column1: At least we're keeping casualties down to a minimum here. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 至少我们把这里的伤亡控制到了最低。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Solving the lack of available experienced units by hiring the best? Well, they at least know who to turn to!
column2: 通过雇佣最优秀的人才来解决缺少有经验部队的问题? 好吧，他们至少知道该找谁!

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been challenged to a Trial of Possession by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}. We would like you to represent us in this Trial, as all our troops are involved elsewhere. If you lose, we will just deny it was ever agreed to, or that you weren't representing us.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}挑战进行占有试炼。我们希望由你代表我们参加这场试炼，因为我们所有部队都在别处。如果你输了，我们就干脆否认曾经同意过，或者否认你代表我们。

column1: Defeat the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warrior
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的战士

column1: At least we are keeping casualties down to a minimum here. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 至少我们在这里能把伤亡降到最低. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Job done and we have given the Clan a chance to resupply. Time to get some rest, Commander.
column2: 任务完成，我们也给了氏族一个补充物资的机会. 该休息了，指挥官.

column1: Well, they did say they would not acknowledge a loss. Let us see how that works out. Let us get you back to the dropship, Commander.
column2: 他们确实说过不会承认失败. 那就让我们看看最终会是什么结果吧. 我们先送你回空投舰，指挥官.

column1: Failure to preserve both facilities will be recorded as a failed contract regardless of enemy losses.
column2: 未能保住两处设施将被记录为合约失败，无论敌方损失如何。

column1: A soon-to-be-operational planetary sensor array and a missile defense battery will form the backbone of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regional defense operations.  The two facilities are linked through a common targeting network, and the destruction of either asset will compromise the effectiveness of the entire system, once operational.\n

\n{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} units are expected to probe defenses before committing heavier assault forces against whichever site appears weakest.  The governor's office has declared both installations mission-critical.
column2: 一套即将投入运作的行星传感器阵列和一座导弹防御炮组将构成{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}区域防御行动的骨干。两处设施通过一张共同的瞄准网络相连，一旦投入运作，摧毁任一资产都会削弱整个系统的效能。\n\n预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队会先试探防御，然后对看起来较薄弱的那处设施投入更重的突击部队。总督府已宣布两处设施均为任务关键。

column1: Defend Sensor Array and Missile Defense Battery
column2: 保卫传感器阵列与导弹防御炮组

column1: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} Regional Defense Liason:</color> {COMPANY.CompanyName}, this is Firebreak Control.  Although still no operational, the sensor array and the missile defense battery are linked to the regional defense grid...if either facility is destroyed, the entire network becomes ineffective.\n
\nBoth sites must survive.
column2: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}区域防御联络官：</color>{COMPANY.CompanyName}，这里是防火墙控制中心。虽然尚未投入运行，但传感器阵列与导弹防御炮组都已接入区域防御网……若其中任何一处设施被毁，整个网络都会失效。\n两处站点都必须存活。

column1: Drive a Wedge, Secondary Line, Attacking the Hammer, Strenghtening Anvil Response are classic military tactics to break this kind of engagement; choose or adapt what you require, Commander.
column2: 楔入突击、二线部署、攻击铁砧、加固应对是打破这类交战的经典军事战术；指挥官，按需选择或调整吧。

column1: An ordnance plant and its associated munitions depot have come under threat from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces seeking to cripple local {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} military production.  While each facility can function independently, the loss of either would halt wartime manufacturing efforts across the region.\n

\n{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} intelligence suggests coordinated attacks intended to split defending forces between the two objectives.  Your company must maintain defensive control over both locations simultaneously throughout the operation.
column2: 一处军械厂及其附属弹药库正受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队的威胁，后者意图瘫痪当地{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的军工生产。虽然两处设施都能独立运作，但失去任何一处都会使整个地区的战时制造陷入停顿。\n\n{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}情报显示，敌方意图协调进攻，把守军分散在两个目标之间。你的连队必须在整个行动期间同时保持对两处地点的防御控制。

column1: Defend Ordnance plant and Munitions Depot
column2: 保卫军械厂与弹药库

column1: Commander, there are two critical facilities under threat: the ordnance plant and the munitions depot.  Our employers reports that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}s intend to strike both simultaneously.
column2: 指挥官，有两处关键设施正受到威胁：军械厂和弹药库。我们的雇主报告说，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}人打算同时打击这两处。

column1: Defending two assets at the same time, fun times.
column2: 同时防守两处资产，真有意思。

column1: Two cargo terminals are being operated by the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} in the system.  Cargo operations have been divided between both terminals, if either terminal is destroyed, precious supply and logisticical assets would be lost.  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders are exepcted to launch repeated attacks intended to disable loading infrastructure and fuel depots.\n
\nBoth facilities must reamin operational until reinforcements arrive.
column2: 该星系有两个货运终端由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}运营。货运作业分散在两个终端，若任一终端被摧毁，宝贵的补给与后勤资产都将丧失。预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者会反复发动袭击，意图瘫痪装卸基础设施与燃料库。\n\n两处设施在援军抵达前都必须保持运作。

column1: Defend Both Cargo Terminals from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders
column2: 抵御{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者，保卫两个货运终端

column1: Commander, the cargo terminals, designated as Alpha and Bravo, are currently handling critical supply shipments for the front.  If either terminal falls, the entire logistics chain for this sector is compromised.
column2: 指挥官，那两个被指定为阿尔法和布拉沃的货运终端目前正处理前线的关键补给运输。若任一终端失守，整个区域的物流链都将受损。

column1: The destruction of either plant would trigger a humanitarian crisis affecting thousands of civilians.  No pressure, Commander.
column2: 摧毁任一座工厂都会引发一场影响数千平民的人道主义危机。别紧张，指挥官。

column1: Two water purification plants supply separate population centers and are considered vital to planetary stability.  {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} intelligence indicates {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders intends to overwhelm both facilities, forcing defenders to spread thin.\n
\nYour contract is explicit: both facilities must remain operational until relief forces arrive.
column2: 两座净水厂为不同的人口中心供水，被视为行星稳定的关键。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}情报显示{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者意图压垮两处设施，迫使守军分散。\n\n你的合约说得很明确：两处设施必须在援军抵达前保持运作。

column1: Defend Water Purification Plant from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders
column2: 抵御{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者，保卫净水厂

column1: Commander, both facilities are critical.  We need to keep Alpha and Bravo operational until relief forces arrive.  Lose either plant and the mission is a failure.\n
\nExpect multiple attack waves and stay flexible.
column2: 指挥官，两处设施都至关重要。我们需要让阿尔法与布拉沃保持运转，直到救援部队抵达。失去任何一处，任务即告失败。\n预期会有多波攻击，保持灵活。

column1: If either relay station is rendered inoperable, mission will be considered as a failure.
column2: 若任一继电站失效，任务将被视为失败。

column1: Your company is tasked with protecting two communications relay support stations.  These installations form a single communications network; if either station is destroyed, the entire regional communications grid will collapse.\n
\n{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are expected to sabotage teams and strike exploiting weak points of the defenses.\n
\n{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} has designated both sites as irreplaceable strategic assets.The contract will be considered failed if either relay station is rendered inoperable.
column2:
你的连队受命保护两处通讯中继支援站。这些设施构成一张单一通讯网络；若任一站点被摧毁，整个地区通讯网都将崩溃。

预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会派出破坏小组，并打击防御的弱点。

{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}已指定两处站点为不可替代的战略资产。若任一继电站失效，合约将被视为失败。

column1: Defend Communications Relay Support Stations from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strikers
column2: 抵御{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}突击部队，保卫通讯中继支援站

column1: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} Relay Control Officer:</color> {COMPANY.CompanyName}, this is Relay Control.  You are defending two communications relay support stations on named Alpha and Bravo.\n
\nThese facilities function as a single network --- lose one, and the entire communications grid goes dark.
column2: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}中继控制官：</color>{COMPANY.CompanyName}，这里是中继控制。你要防守分别名为阿尔法与布拉沃的两座通讯中继支持站。\n\n这两处设施作为单一网络运作——失去其一，整个通讯网格就会陷入黑暗。

column1: The contract is void if either station falls to enemy action.
column2: 如果任一发电站被敌方攻陷，合约即告无效.

column1: Two power stations provide the energy required to sustain a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} civilian complex.  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces have launched a campaign to seize or destroy the installations, knowing the loss of either station would destabilize the entire power grid.\n
\nYour orders are straightforward: both power stations must survive the engagement intact.
column2: 两座电站为一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}民用建筑群提供所需能源。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队已发起战役，要夺取或摧毁这些设施——他们知道失去任一座电站都会让整个电网失稳。\n\n你的命令很直接：两座电站在交战中都必须完好存活。

column1: Defend Both Power Stations
column2: 防守两座发电站

column2: 防守发电站 - Alpha

column2: 防守发电站 - Bravo

column1: Attacker lance neutralized.
column2: 攻击小队已消灭.

column1: Bravo station reporting fresh hostiles, another attack wave is moving in.
column2: Bravo发电站报告出现新的敌军，又一轮攻击正在逼近.

column1: Confirmed kill.  Good shooting.
column2: 确认击杀. 打得好.

column1: Defend those stations at all costs.
column2: 不惜一切代价守住那些发电站.

column1: Enemy lance has been destroyed.
column2: 敌方小队已被摧毁.

column1: Enemy reinforcements around Alpha have been wiped out.  Excellent work.
column2: Alpha周边的敌方增援已被全歼. 干得漂亮.

column1: Hostile lance destroyed near Bravo.  Keep those guns hot.
column2: Bravo附近敌方小队已摧毁. 保持火力全开.

column1: Looks like the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}s picked the wrong contract to interfere with.
column2: 看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}选错了要干涉的合约.

column1: Two power stations, designated Alpha and Bravo, are feeding an entire civilian district.  Intelligence reports multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} strike forces moving into the area.
column2: 两座发电站，代号Alpha和Bravo，正在为整个民用区供电. 情报显示多支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}打击部队正在进入该区域.

column1: Warning!  Alpha Station has lost all defensive turrets. Your company is the only thing standing between the enemy and that reactor.
column2: 警告! Alpha发电站已失去所有防御炮台. 你的连队是阻挡敌人摧毁那座反应堆的最后一道防线.

column1: NPC Defector
column2: NPC 叛逃者

column1: Commander, we need an immediate deployment.  We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet.  They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface.  This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again.  There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要立即部署。我们追缉一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已有数月，终于追踪到这颗行星。他们已转入地下，但今天早些时候我们一个轨道单位发现他们在地表活动。这是我们首次确认目击目标，我们希望你能立即将其拿下，别让他们再次溜走。时间不够对行动区域做完整勘测，所以你会盲飞进去。

column1: Eliminate Roving Enemy Forces
column2: 消灭游荡敌军

column1: We've failed...
column2: 我们失败了……

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that the leader of an insurgent cell backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to take out one of the primary enemies of the legitimate {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regime in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Additionally, we'll include a bonus payment if you're able to destroy all of the target's escorting units.
column2: 我们已从多个渠道得到确认，由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}支持的叛乱小组头目正在公开活动。这是铲除{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的合法{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政权的主要敌人之一的难得机会。此外，如果你能摧毁目标的全部护卫单位，我们还会有额外奖金。

column1: Destroy Insurgent Escorts
column2: 摧毁叛乱分子护卫队

column1: Destroy Target Unit
column2: 摧毁目标单位

column1: Insurrection Interception
column2: 叛乱拦截

column1: I've negotiated a major bump if we DO end up finding the propagandist and eliminating her, as well as a danger-pay bonus if she has any escorts and we eliminate them as well.
column2: 如果真能找到那名宣传员并除掉她，我已经谈妥了一笔可观的加价；如果她有护卫，而我们也一并清除，还有危险津贴奖金。

column1: For months, we've had trouble with people here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} being riled up by talk of insurrection, rebellion, independence.  Based on top {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts' reports, we believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist in the area, stirring up discontent.  We've set up a security net to capture her.  But we can't cover every possible exit from our net and could use an extra Lance of 'Mechs.  If she tries to slip through your assigned territory, turn her unit to slag.
column2: 数月来，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的人一直被叛乱、起义、独立的言论煽动，令我们头疼。根据{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}顶尖分析师们的报告，我们相信这一带有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员在煽动不满情绪。我们已布下一张安全网来抓她。但我们无法覆盖网中每一个可能的出口，所以需要一支额外的机甲分队。如果她试图从你的辖区溜过，就把她的单位熔成矿渣。

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Propagandist
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员

column1: Destroy the Propagandist and Escape
column2: 消灭宣传员并摆脱敌人

column1: Commander, this is the region we've been asked to patrol as part of the net.
column2: 指挥官，这就是我们作为警戒网一部分负责巡逻的区域。

column1: Middle Management
column2: 中层管理者

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager.  The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units as well.  Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要去干掉一名中层管理者。目标不会独自一人，指挥官，如果我们把护卫单位也清理掉另有奖金。不过如果局面太热，我们随时可以打了就跑。

column1: Our intelligence operatives believe that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader is present and vulnerable on the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  Eliminating them will leave their organization in shambles and clear the field for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations.  The target will be relatively unguarded, and we'd like you to strike during this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们的情报人员相信，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领袖正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表上且防备薄弱。除掉他们将使他们的组织陷入混乱，为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}行动清出场地。目标身旁不会有太多护卫，我们希望你在这一时机窗口内发动打击。

column1: Commander, our intel was right; the target is in the AO and only lightly guarded.
column2: 指挥官，我们的情报是对的; 目标就在行动区域而且只有少量护卫.

column1: Take them out, get to the evac zone, and then we get paid.
column2: 干掉他们，到达撤离区域，之后我们就可以拿到报酬了.

column1: The General
column2: 将军号

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that a high ranking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} officer is moving in the open.  This is a rare opportunity to disrupt their command structure on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  We'll pay a 33% bonus per lance if you can also destroy his personal guard and any other {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in the AO.
column2: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}高级军官正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上打乱他们指挥结构的难得机会。如果你还能摧毁他的私人卫队以及行动区域内其他{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，我们将按每支分队额外支付33%的奖金。

column1: Engage as you see fit, Commander.
column2: 自行决定是否交战，指挥官.

column1: These are the coordinates that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} provided, so the target officer should be in the area.
column2: 这是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}提供的坐标，所以目标军官应该就在这片区域.

column1: War Machine
column2: 战争机器

column1: Buckle up, Commander.  This sounds like an extremely tough fight.  You know something this valuable is going to be escorted.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 听起来这像是一场极其艰苦的战斗. 你知道有些珍贵的东西要护送.

column1: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them.  This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence.  We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited.  If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.
column2: 我们定期勘察"空"行星，只为确认上面没有意外活动。这次我们运气不错。一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小队从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}表面接收到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，对应一台正在跑试射流程的极重型机甲。我们怀疑敌人是把这台机甲带出来做验证试验，以为该行星无人居住。如果我们能定位并拦截这台机甲，就能让一件强力硬件不落入敌手。

column1: Destroy Enemy Escort
column2: 消灭敌方护卫

column1: Destroy the 'Mech and Escape
column2: 摧毁机甲并撤离

column1: We're picking up live fire from the surface, Commander.
column2: 我们探测到地表传来的实弹射击，指挥官。

column1: Someone's in serious trouble --- and they need our help now.
column2: 有人惹上大麻烦了——而他们现在就需要我们的帮助。

column1: Fierce fighting has erupted in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and our defenses won't hold without immediate support. We're contracting anyone who can get boots on the ground now.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}爆发了激烈战斗，若不立即支援，我们的防线撑不住。我们正在签约任何能立刻派兵落地的人。\n< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column2: 前往集结点

column1: Allied reinforcements are just about here --- let them handle the stragglers.  Nice work, Commander.
column2: 友军增援马上就到---让他们去对付残兵吧. 干得好，指挥官.

column1: Recon has spotted additional bogies coming your way.
column2: 侦察发现另有多个目标正朝你而来。

column1: The allies have dispatched a vanguard lance and they'll be arriving soon.  Hold the enemy off as long as you can.
column2: 盟友已派出一支前卫分队，他们很快就会抵达。尽可能久地拖住敌人。

column1: We failed.
column2: 我们失败了。

column1: Being Attacked Means the Enemy Believes in You
column2: 遭受攻击意味着敌人相信你的实力

column1: Hold the line for as long as you can!
column2: 尽可能久地守住阵线!

column1: Even though we've had some wins in other parts of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} region, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s stepping up their game. Right now, several units have arrived at {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and it's looking like it might fall into their hands. Your job is to back up the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}'s lance and hold the line for as long as you can. Reinforcements are on the way, but we need to buy some time.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 尽管我们在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}区域的其他地方取得了一些胜利，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在加大力度。眼下，若干单位已抵达{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}，看来它可能会落入他们手中。你的任务是支援{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}的分队，尽可能久地守住阵地。增援正在赶来，但我们需要争取一些时间。\n< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: Defeat Enemies (Wave 2)
column2: 击败敌人（第 2 波）

column1: Defeat Enemies (Wave 3)
column2: 击败敌人（第 3 波）

column2: 让1个单位抵达集结点

column1: Hold the line until reinforcements arrive
column2: 坚守阵地直至增援抵达

column1: Ally reinforcements are arriving any moment.  Let them deal with the stragglers.
column2: 友军增援随时抵达. 让他们去对付残兵吧.

column1: This is the fabled 'bug swarm', Commander, come prepared for an endurance battle.
column2: 这就是传说中的"虫群"，指挥官，做好打持久战的准备。

column1: There is an old Kuritan theory of warfare that says that numbers matter more than skill. Our enemies here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} have decided to put that theory to the test and have lined up a swarm of BattleMechs to attack us. We need a few elite pilots to hold off the swarm as best we can. We'll send you what help we can manage. Prove the theory wrong and be on the right side of history, Commander.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 库瑞塔人有一套古老的战争理论：数量比技巧更重要。我们在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 的敌人决定检验这套理论，已排出一大群战斗机甲向我们发起进攻。我们需要几位精英飞行员尽量抵挡这股洪流。我们会尽可能为你提供支援。指挥官，用事实证明这套理论是错的，站到历史正确的一边。\n\n 战区战斗可能极为漫长，请做好持久作战的准备！

column1: We took down the swarm, well done Commander.
column2: 我们解决了那群蜂拥之敌，干得好指挥官。

column1: This is a straight-up brawl and we're on our own for this one. Stay frosty, Commander.
column2: 这是一场纯粹的白刃战，这一仗只能靠我们自己。保持冷静，指挥官。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have been pushing into this region, so there are big bounties out on them. Take out as many as you can --- the more you drop, the bigger your payout.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在推进这一地区，所以对他们开出的赏金很高。尽可能多干掉一些——你打掉的越多，拿到的钱越多。\n< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: No backup is coming.  Employ all necessary measures to achieve the objectives: neutralize hostiles.
column2: 没有援军会来. 采取一切必要措施达成目标: 消灭敌对单位.

column1: Being paid to get chased and shot at? Not ideal.  Fingers crossed for some extra bonuses
column2: 被雇来让别人追着打还要挨枪子? 这可不算理想. 希望能拿到一些额外奖金吧.

column1: Commander, a battalion sporting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s colors are operating covertly in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Your mission: draw their focus, hold them in place while we close their escape. Disrupt, disable, and buy us time --- extraction to follow. We will send an allied force to support your evac as soon as you draw enough enemy attention.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 指挥官，一个打着{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}旗帜的营正在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}秘密活动。你的任务：吸引他们的注意力，把他们钉在原地，而我们封住他们的退路。扰乱、瘫痪、为我们争取时间——随后撤离。一旦你吸引到足够的敌军注意，我们会派一支友军来支援你的撤离。\n< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: The employer is fumbling the deployment of their vanguard units.  Hold the line --- whether they show up or not.
column2: 雇主把他们前卫单位的部署搞砸了。守住防线——不管他们到底来不来。

column1: Front lines, Commander --- and there's serious cash on the table for taking these guys down.  Just remember: don't get dead before you collect.
column2: 前线，指挥官——而且干掉这些人有一大笔现金。记住：别在收钱之前死掉。

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under attack --- invaders are here to take everything. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are holding but starting to break. We need every able hand on the frontline now. Any help you can offer will mean the world to us.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}正在遭到攻击——入侵者来此夺走一切。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队仍在坚守，但已开始崩溃。我们现在需要所有能动的人上前线。你能提供的任何帮助对我们都意义重大。\n\n 战区可能极为漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: Neutralize hostiles
column2: 消灭敌对单位

column1: Allies have communicated the rally point, they need you to be there to confirm extraction.
column2: 友军已传达集结点位置，他们需要你到达那里以确认撤离.

column1: Done and done, Commander.  Let's head on out.
column2: 办妥了，指挥官。我们出发吧。

column1: Hopefully we'll not be surprised as our employers.
column2: 但愿我们不会像我们的雇主一样被打个措手不及。

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s area in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} just got hit with a surprise attack, and right now, the only thing standing in the way is a single lance. Our main forces are too far out to help in time, so we're calling on anyone willing to step up and lend a hand.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}中{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的区域刚遭到突袭，而眼下挡在路上的只有一支分队。我们的主力部队太远，来不及救援，所以我们在号召任何愿意挺身相助的人。\n< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: You were born and raised in the Federation. MechWarriors who hail from the Federated Suns tend to possess more finely honed skills and better equipment than their counterparts from other regions of space. They often see themselves as righteous warriors and champions of liberty - sometimes to a fault.
You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],Federated Suns]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],联邦太阳]]。

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],Federated Suns]] tend to possess more finely honed skills and better equipment than their counterparts from other regions of space. They often see themselves as righteous warriors and champions of liberty - sometimes to a fault.

\nThough nearly extinguished by the [[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],Draconis Combine]] in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFirstSuccessionWar],First Succession War]], the Federated Suns - a constitutional monarchy ruled by the renowned [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseDavion],House Davion]] - has become arguably the most powerful of the five great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],Successor States]]. Through skillful military campaigns and subtle diplomacy, House Davion has significantly increased the number of star systems under its control in the last two centuries.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],联邦太阳]]的机师往往比太空中其他区域的同行拥有更精湛的技能和更好的装备。他们常把自己视为正义的战士与自由的捍卫者——有时过于如此。\n\n尽管在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFirstSuccessionWar],第一次继承战争]]中几乎被[[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],龙尼斯联合体]]灭国，这个由著名的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseDavion],达维昂家族]]统治的君主立宪国如今可以说是五大[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],继承国]]中最强大的。凭借高超的军事行动与巧妙的外交，达维昂家族在过去两个世纪里大幅增加了其控制的星系数量。

column1: The Federated Suns (Davion)
column2: 恒星联邦（戴维恩）

column1: You were born and raised in the Deep Periphery. MechWarriors that hail from the Deep Periphery are rare, but even rarer is the MechWarrior who will admit to such an origin. Beyond the outermost edges of the Periphery lie depths of space that remain uncharted and unknown to most of human civilization, littered with abandoned colonies and small outposts.
You were born and raised in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],Deep Periphery]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],深远外缘]]。

column1: MechWarriors that hail from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],Deep Periphery]] are rare, but even rarer is the MechWarrior who will admit to such an origin.

\nBeyond the outermost edges of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Periphery]] lie depths of space that remain uncharted and unknown to most of human civilization. Little is known about these regions, but they are far from uninhabited. The Deep Periphery is littered with abandoned colonies and small outposts, isolated from the rest of humanity. After the fall of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],Star League]], General [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky],Aleksandr Kerensky]] led the remnants of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSLDF],Star League Defense Force]] into the Deep Periphery, disappearing from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]] and from recorded history.
column2: 来自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],深远外缘]]的机师很罕见，但更罕见的是愿意承认这种出身的机师。\n\n在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],外缘]]最外侧的边缘之外，是大部人类文明都未曾测绘、未知的深空。人们对这些区域知之甚少，但它们远非无人居住。深远外缘散落着与人类其余部分隔绝的废弃殖民地与小前哨。在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],星盟]]覆灭之后，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky],亚历山大·克伦斯基]]将军率领[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSLDF],星盟防卫部队]]的残部进入深远外缘，从此从[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]和成文史中消失。

column1: The Deep Periphery
column2: 深空外围

column1: Born by natural means within the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],Clans]], your status has always been second class. However, this has done nothing to curb your ambition to become more than just a footnote in the known universe, let alone just the Clans.
column2: 你以自然方式生于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],氏族]]之中，身份一直是二等。然而这丝毫没有遏制你的野心——你要成为远比已知宇宙中一个脚注更重要的人物，更不用说只在氏族之内了。

column1: You were born a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFreeborn],freeborn]] [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],Clan]] member.
column2: 你生为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],氏族]]的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFreeborn],自由出生者]]成员。

column2: 氏族领地(自由生者)
