column1: Originally from the Duchy of Andurien in the Free Worlds League, James Pato grew up tinkering with anything he could get his hands on. He was drawn to an apprenticeship as a MechTech, starting with AgroMechs and moving on to BattleMechs after helping the local garrison with a broken 'Mech crossing his family's property.

\nWorking for the militia, he quickly rose through the ranks and became the local subject matter expert on the coding for 'Mech's Targeting and Tracking Systems (TTS) and internal diagnostic computers. More than once his custom adjustments have led to his MechWarriors nearly dying in the field, almost costing him his position. He found himself putting in countless hours behind the command couch of BattleMechs in order to understand what his pilots experience, eventually earning his own title as MechWarrior.

His ability to find work as either MechTech or MechWarrior has granted him freedom to travel around the Rimward Periphery, searching for LosTech such as Star League era TTS. He's heard rumors there was once a totally autonomous BattleMech drone project run in secret but has yet to find any real evidence. If he were to find such a LosTech cache, it would allow him to establish his own brand of TTS that rival the best the Inner Sphere has to offer.
column2:
詹姆斯·帕托来自自由世界联盟的安杜里恩公国，从小摆弄一切能拿到手的东西。他被吸引去当机甲技师学徒，从农业机甲起步，后来因帮当地驻军处理一台横穿他家土地的故障机甲而转向战斗机甲。

在为民兵工作期间，他迅速晋升，成为当地在机甲瞄准追踪系统（TTS）与内部诊断计算机编码方面的专家。他的定制调整不止一次让他的机甲战士在战场上险些丧命，也差点让他丢职。为了理解飞行员的体验，他不得不在机甲指挥座椅后面投入无数小时，最终为自己赢得机甲战士的头衔。

既能当机甲技师又能当机甲战士的能力，让他得以自由往返于边缘方向外围，搜寻星际联盟时期TTS这类失落科技。他听说曾有一个完全自主的战斗机甲无人机秘密项目，但至今未找到任何真实证据。若他能找到这样一处失落科技储藏点，就能建立自己的TTS品牌，与内层星域最好的产品一争高下。

column1: Dragon 66

Dragon 66 was born Zin Ala in the Federated Suns, the child of a family of military bureaucrats. His stable, safe childhood left him craving more excitement than bureaucracy could provide, so when he was old enough, he enrolled in the planetary guards.

\nAfter boot camp, his aptitude tests placed him in logistical support roles — not that different from what his family did, but at least he was on the more exciting front lines. Through dedicated service and commitment, Zin worked his way up from driving supply vehicles to planning their routes to overseeing entire logistical operations.

\nAll that changed when an operation he was involved with collapsed, leaving him one of the few able-bodied soldiers able to defend a key location. He did a hero's job, but when reinforcements won through, they came with military lawyers and wagging fingers over breaches of protocol.

As a result, he ended up on Solaris VII, where he stayed just long enough to establish a reputation. But knowing he had no future there, he moved on to the Periphery, looking for a chance to once again start at the bottom and work his way up.
column2:
龙66原名辛·阿拉，出生在联邦太阳一个军事官僚家庭。他那安稳无忧的童年让他渴望比官僚工作更多的刺激，所以年龄一到，他就报名加入了行星卫队。

新兵训练之后，他的能力测试把他分到了后勤支援岗位——和他家人做的事差别不大，但至少他更靠近激动人心的前线。凭着尽职与投入，辛从驾驶补给车一路做到规划补给路线，再到统管整个后勤运作。

这一切在他参与的一次行动崩溃时全都改变了，那次让他成为少数还能行动、可以守卫一处关键地点的士兵之一。他干出了英雄般的成绩，但当增援突破进来时，他们带来的是军法律师和就违反规程摇动的手指。

结果他最终去了索拉里斯VII，在那里只待了足够建立名声的时间。但他知道自己在那儿没有未来，于是前往外缘，寻找再次从底层从头做起、一路往上爬的机会。

column1: Reginald von Kaas was born and bred on Terra, the only child of ComStar Demi-Precentors. He grew up schooled in all the traditions and when he was of age, he joined the local defense force.

\nAfter some formal training, he was assigned to supervise BattleMech restoration, where he fell in love with the machines. Using his family connections, he had himself reassigned as a 'Mech pilot. He then proceeded to show such dedication to the use and care of 'Mechs that he was quickly promoted to the top of his local defense cadre despite the lack of combat opportunities.

\nAfter that, there's a blank spot in his record, the sort typical of those who have engaged in covert operations. He dropped out of sight for over five years. His next official record is in the Periphery on the MRB register, using the callsign VonKobra, and with several impressive shooting certifications under his belt.

According to those records, at one time he led a small mercenary unit of his own, but that unit dissolved without any recorded contracts. He now considers himself a freelance operative, although his personal intensity suggests the 'freelance' descriptor may be deceptive.
column2:
雷金纳德·冯·卡斯生于地球、长于地球，是通讯之星半执事夫妇的独子。他从小接受全套传统教育，成年后加入了当地防御部队。

经过一段正式训练，他被分配到战斗机甲修复监管岗位，并在那里爱上了这些机器。借助家族人脉，他把自己调任为机甲飞行员，随后表现出对机甲使用与保养的极高投入，尽管缺乏实战机会，仍在当地防御教导队中迅速晋升到顶层。

在那之后，他的档案出现了一段空白——那种从事隐蔽行动者常见的空白。他消失于公众视野五年多。他的下一份官方记录出现在外围地区的雇佣兵登记局名册上，呼号VonKobra，名下还有几项令人印象深刻的射击认证。

据这些记录，他曾一度自领一支小型雇佣兵部队，但该部队没有任何记录在案的合同就解散了。如今他自视为自由特工，不过他个人的紧绷气质让“自由”这个说法可能具有欺骗性。

column1: James Bixby was born on Arc-Royal in the Lyran Commonwealth to a wealthy family that, as new money, lacked many of the advantages of the titled aristocracy, most notably land and a family BattleMech. Because of his wealthy background, James was easily able to enter the Somerset Military Academy, where he scored in the top 15% of his class and won a coveted position in a Cadet Trade with House Davion's Albion Military Academy.

\nAfter graduation, he earned his callsign 'Arbiter' evaluating recently dispossessed MechWarriors to see if they were worthy of a replacement machine. This was just a stepping stone to getting his own BattleMech, however. He earned assignment to a Griffin after several years of writing up reports on other pilots and attending off-hours training sessions. He was assigned to the Storm Company in the Lyran Guard, where he served faithfully for a five year tour.

However, when he was overlooked for a promotion due to his lack of family connections, he realized he had no interest in spending the rest of his life as nothing more than a 'Mech pilot for the military. He cashed out his savings and war salvage and headed to the Periphery to see what he could do about acquiring a BattleMech of his own, and bringing his family the prestige it had always lacked.
column2:
詹姆斯·比克斯比出生在莱兰联邦的弧王家，家境富裕，但作为新贵缺乏有爵位贵族拥有的许多优势，尤其是土地和家族战斗机甲。由于出身富裕，詹姆斯轻松进入萨默塞特军事学院，成绩位列全班前15%，并赢得与戴维恩家族阿尔比恩军事学院进行学员交换的宝贵名额。

毕业后，他因评估刚失去机甲的机甲战士是否值得获得替换机体而获得“仲裁者”呼号。但这只是他获得自己战斗机甲的踏脚石。在为其他飞行员写了数年报告并参加业余训练课程后，他赢得了驾驶一台狮鹫的资格，被分配到莱兰卫队的暴风连，忠实服役一个五年任期。

然而，当他因缺乏家族人脉而被忽视晋升时，他意识到自己毫无兴趣把余生只当一名军中机甲飞行员。他兑现积蓄与战场战利品，前往外围地区，看看能否为自己弄到一台战斗机甲，为家族带来它一直缺少的声望。

column1: Tony Bono has no memory of his parents, who were a gladiatorial duo on Solaris VII, and who died particularly memorable deaths that are still occasionally referenced today. He was raised by the techs and other gladiators in the stable, growing up on stories of the valor and celebrity of his parents and other famous arena champions.

\nWhen he was eighteen, despite the wishes of his favorite auntie, he decided to officially join the stable as a gladiator instead of a tech. He was an excellent duelist, able to make any fight not just entertaining but actually exciting, but his temperament was too serious. He found he was unable to showboat in a way that garnered more than passing media attention, despite his family background.

Unable to convince himself to move from piloting a 'Mech to repairing them, no matter what his stable aunties hoped, he eventually withdrew entirely from gladiatorial life. After traveling a while on the farewell gift of his adopted family, he headed to the Periphery, where his grim focus on winning small-scale battles has served him well as a MechWarrior-for-hire.
column2:
托尼·博诺对父母毫无记忆，他们曾是索拉里斯VII的一对竞技场搭档，死得特别令人难忘，至今偶尔还被人提起。他在马疚的技师和其他角斗士抚养下长大，听着关于他父母以及其他著名竞技场冠军的英勇与名声的故事长大。

十八岁那年，尽管他最爱的阿姨反对，他还是决定正式以角斗士而非技师的身份加入马疚。他是个出色的决斗者，能让任何一场战斗不仅好看而且真正刺激，但他的性情过于严肃。他发现，尽管有家族背景，他也没法以一种能引来超过一时媒体关注的方式作秀。

无论马疚里的阿姨们怎么期望，他都无法说服自己从驾驶机甲转而修理机甲，最终彻底退出了角斗生涯。靠着养父母送给他的告别礼物旅行了一段时间后，他前往外缘，在那里他对小规模战斗胜利的冷峻专注，让他在当受雇机师时如鱼得水。

column1: Brett Finnegan Bozeman was born to minor nobility on Gulkana in the Federated Suns, but moved early with his family to Maldive near the Taurian Concordat as part of a business consolidation. There he received a comprehensive education in physical and intellectual pursuits from personal tutors.

\nAs he grew, he witnessed the tumultuous handling of the planetary government by the local governing corporation, and resisted family pressure to take his place in the family business; he wanted no part of such an undisciplined and untrustworthy environment. Instead, he enlisted in the AFFS as soon as he was of age.

\nShortly after his enlistment, his record was blanked. His family lost contact with him, except for the occasional update from his superior offices reassuring them he was still alive. When peace loomed in the 3020s, he finally resurfaced, a hardened MechWarrior unwilling - or unable - to talk about what he'd been doing for so many years.

After a year of peace with his family on New Avalon, he could no longer take the quiet life. While he was not allowed to return to active duty in the AFFS, they couldn't stop him from seeking out mercenary work on the Periphery. This time, though, he promised to keep his family updated on his movements
column2:
布雷特·芬尼根·博兹曼出生在联邦太阳古尔卡纳的底层贵族家庭，但年幼时随家人迁往靠近陶里安协约国的马尔代夫，作为一次业务整合的一部分。在那里，他接受私人教师全方位的体力与智力教育。

成长过程中，他目睹当地执政公司对行星政府的混乱处理，并抗拒家人要他进入家族生意的压力；他一点也不想涉足那样一个缺乏纪律、不可信赖的环境。相反，他一到年龄就入伍加入了AFFS。

入伍后不久，他的档案就被清空。他的家人与他失去联系，只有上级军官偶尔发来消息，向他们保证他还活着。当3020年代和平降临时，他终于重新露面，成为一名饱经磨砺的机师，不愿——或者无法——谈论这些年他都在做什么。

在新阿瓦隆与家人共度一年太平日子后，他再也受不了平静的生活。虽然他不被允许重回AFFS现役，但他们无法阻止他去外缘找雇佣兵的活干。不过这一次，他答应会让家人知道他的一举一动。

column1: Coming from a sleepy agricultural world of no strategic value in the Free Worlds League, Astraeus Veisi was the first member of his family in 75 years to express any interest in getting off-planet. Astraeus decided young, staring up at the sky, that he was going to the stars. It wasn't so much that life was hard on the farm, but that nothing he did there would ever really matter.

\n When he was old enough, he enrolled in a local tech school, specializing in military equipment, because maintaining tractors wasn't that different from maintaining tanks. 'Mechs were more challenging, but the principles were the same, and repairing 'Mechs was his ticket off the farm.

\nHe signed on with a small mercenary company as a tech, but took advantage of the informal setting and his personal relationship with the commander to get some cockpit time. When one too many of the regular pilots was benched, he had his opportunity to show what he could do as a pilot.

Once the status quo returned, he knew he couldn't return to being just a MechTech. He said a fond farewell to the company that had lifted him to the stars and set out on a career as a freelance agent. He drifted from one temporary company to another, looking for someplace where he'd fit as well as he did in his first company - and still be able to pilot a 'Mech of his own.
column2:
阿斯特赖俄斯·维西来自自由世界联盟一个毫无战略价值的沉睡农业世界，是家族 75 年来第一个表现出想离开行星的人。他年幼时仰望天空便下定决心要去星辰之间。倒不是农场生活艰苦，而是他在那里做的一切都无足轻重。

到年龄后，他进入当地技术学校，专攻军用装备——因为维修拖拉机和维修坦克差别不大。机甲更具挑战，但原理相同，而修机甲就是他离开农场的门票。

他以技师身份加入一家小型佣兵公司，却利用其不拘束的氛围以及与指挥官私交，争取到一些驾驶舱时间。当正式飞行员"坐板凳"的人太多时，他终于有机会展示自己作为飞行员的能力。

一旦恢复常态，他就知道自己再也回不去只当机甲技师。他向那家把他送上星辰的公司深情告别，走上自由代理人的职业道路。他在一家家临时公司间漂泊，寻找一个既能像第一家那样让他如鱼得水、又能让他驾驶自己的机甲的地方。

column1: Andaelas was born on Meacham in the Lyran Commonwealth, to parents who died in the endless conflict with the Draconis Combine before he could even be named. One of the many orphanages of Meacham took him in and he was given the house name 'Alistair' for his own. Growing up, he was taught to be proud of his parents' sacrifice, and expected to follow in their footsteps when he came of age.

\nWhen that day came, they conscripted him before he could volunteer. With poor equipment and very little training, he was sent to the Draconis Front, a meat grinder where his dedication to the Commonwealth was tested time and again. Mostly, it held.

\nEverybody who survived was promoted, so as to inspire next batch of conscripts. But promotion just meant more challenges. Finally, his squadron of foot soldiers was thrown against a lance of BattleMechs without backup. When Andaelas climbed into a nearly crippled Catapult and turned its missiles on the enemy DropShip delivering yet more troops, he knew he could never go back to being a groundpounder again.

His loyalty to the Lyran Commonwealth had become ambivalent as well. He couldn't shake his pride for his planet and his people, but he was too aware of the pointlessness of the endless war and sacrifice. At last, with the full support of his troubled commanders, he left the LCAF and went to the Periphery, looking for a cause he could once again believe in.
column2:
安达埃拉斯生于莱兰联邦的米查姆，父母在与德拉科尼斯联合体无休止的冲突中阵亡，那时他还没来得及取名。米查姆众多孤儿院中的一家收留了他，并给了他"阿利斯泰尔"这个家名。在成长中，他被教导要为父母的牺牲感到骄傲，并被期待成年后追随他们的脚步。

那一天到来时，他们在他主动报名之前就把他征召了。装备低劣、训练极少，他被送到达维昂前线——一座绞肉机，他对联邦的忠诚在那里被反复考验。大多数时候，它撑住了。

所有活下来的人都获得晋升，以激励下一批新兵。但晋升只意味着更多挑战。最终，他的步兵中队在没有支援的情况下被扔去对抗一支机甲小队。当安达埃拉斯爬进一台几乎报废的弹射器、把它的导弹对准正在投送更多兵力的敌方空投舰时，他知道自己再也回不去当步兵了。

他对莱兰联邦的忠诚也变得矛盾。他无法摆脱对母星与同胞的自豪，却又太清楚这场无休止的战争与牺牲毫无意义。最终，在心事重重却全力支持他的指挥官们的默许下，他离开 LCAF 前往外围区，寻找一个他能再次相信的事业。

column1: Peter Chang was born on Old Kentucky, in the Capellan Confederation, to an established family of skilled metalworkers. He preferred books to metallurgy, and his supportive family encouraged him to work hard and attend a local vocational school after his militia training. When he graduated at the top of his class and was accepted into Sian University, they couldn't have been prouder.

\nThey were less pleased when they realized he intended to study literature and philosophy rather than something useful, but Peter didn't care. Having achieved a place in academia, he fully intended to stay there. He underestimated the viciousness of the tenure track, though. Soon, via maneuverings only sketchily recorded, he was strongly encouraged to travel, and travel far.

\nRelying on a small stipend provided in exchange for his silence, he explored the Inner Sphere and discovered that adventure was more to his taste than academia anyhow. On one journey, he found himself piloting a Marauder — and found that he was good at it. When he received word that his benefactor had died and his stipend would no longer be provided, he knew exactly what to do next: mercenary work, out in the Periphery.

He's something of a curiosity among MechWarriors, with his academic background and extensive civilian travels. But that very background makes him useful in a lance with more traditional MechWarriors, so he's found plenty of work since he first sat in that Marauder.
column2:
彼得·张出生在卡佩兰联邦的老肯塔基，家里是世代相传的熟练金属工匠。比起冶金，他更喜欢书，而他支持他的家人鼓励他努力用功，并在民兵训练之后去上当地一所职业学校。当他以全班第一毕业并被罗罗大学录取时，他们再骄傲不过了。

当他们意识到他打算学文学与哲学而非什么有用的东西时，就没那么高兴了，但彼得不在乎。既已在学术界占得一席之地，他打算就待在那里。不过，他低估了终身教职之路的凶险。很快，经过一些只有粗略记载的运作，他被强烈建议去旅行，而且要走得远远的。

靠着以沉默换来的微薄津贴，他游历内天体，发现冒险比学术界更合他的口味。在一次旅程中，他发现自己驾驶着一台掠夺者——还发现自己很擅长这个。当他收到消息说他的资助人已死、津贴不再发放时，他清楚下一步该做什么：去外缘做雇佣兵。

凭借学术背景与丰富的平民旅行经历，他在机师中算是个奇特的存在。但正是这种背景使他在由更传统的机师组成的分队中很有用，所以自从他第一次坐进那台掠夺者以来，他找到了不少工作。

column1: Paradox — only his father calls him Edward — grew up on Tharkad in the Lyran Commonwealth, in the very heart of civilization. From an early age, he was fascinated by history, especially epic BattleMech battles and legends of LosTech.

\nHe drifted through school and eventually settled into concentrating on history and political science, focusing on the motivations and impacts of the Succession Wars. A student broadcasting project became a launching point for a moderately successful series of historical programs he co-hosted.

\nAfter an extended tour of the Inner Sphere, he was tapped as one of a team of hosts on a new historical program about BattleMechs and LosTech: his childhood dream come back again — and this time he was able to get up close and personal with 'Mechs.

Paradox then leveraged the hands-on experience from his second show into a third documentary show set on Solaris VII. This one was not a success, which was unfortunate for all the sponsors, and for Paradox's own savings. After he burned his bridges with one too many inflammatory remarks about his colleagues, he vanished from the public eye and eventually turned up in the Periphery, working as a mercenary pilot.
column2:
帕拉多克斯——只有他父亲叫他爱德华——在莱兰联邦的萨卡德长大，那里正处于文明的核心。他自幼痴迷历史，尤其是史诗般的战斗机甲战斗与失落科技传说。

他在学校里漫无目的，最终专注历史与政治学，重点研究继承战争的动机与影响。一个学生广播项目成为他联合主持的一系列颇受欢迎的历史节目的起点。

在内层星域游历一段时间后，他被选中成为一档关于战斗机甲与失落科技的新历史节目的主持团队成员之一：他童年的梦想又回来了——而这次他得以近距离接触机甲。

帕拉多克斯随后利用第二档节目获得的实操经验，做出第三档以索拉里斯VII为背景的纪录片。这档并未成功，对所有赞助者和帕拉多克斯自己的积蓄都是不幸。在关于同事说过太多煽动性言论、把桥彻底烧断之后，他从公众视野中消失，最终出现在外围地区，成为一名雇佣兵飞行员。

column1: For many, being born into the nobility of the Capellan Confederation means limitless possibilities, but for Abe Chung, it was only a burden. One of far, far too many cousins, his entire life was ordered for him and he was only ever looked at to be corrected.

\nHe bore up patiently, barely meeting expectations, all the way through college, where he graduated at the bottom of his class with degrees in biology and engineering. Disgusted by his failure to excel, his family sent him far away, to a medical outpost on the edge of civilization, there to supervise doctors with far more passion than himself.

\nBut away from the overbearing scrutiny of his lineage, in a place where even a useless, over-educated petty noble sometimes had to drive a supply truck in a crisis, Abe blossomed. When a local conflict spilled into the hospital grounds and three BattleMechs stood pilotless, Abe did what had to be done.

His keen observational skills and strong sense of tactics carried that day, along with his borrowed 'Mech, but the conflict didn't stop there. Soon the entire medical outpost was shut down and its staff transferred elsewhere. Abe's family called him home, ready to take another look at what their disappointing young man had grown into. He didn't answer, instead choosing to vanish into the Periphery to make his own way as a mercenary 'Mech pilot.
column2:
对许多人而言，生于卡佩兰联邦的贵族意味着无限可能，但对阿贝·钟来说，这只是一副重担。作为多得令人发指的堂表亲之一，他的一生都被安排好了，而他被注视时只是为了被纠正。

他耐心忍受，勉强达到期望，一路读到大学毕业，以生物与工程学位、全班垫底的成绩毕业。家族对他未能出类拔萃感到厌恶，把他远远送走，送到文明边缘的一处医疗前哨，去监督那些比他热情得多的医生。

但远离了家族那令人窒息的目光，在一个连无用、教育过度的低级贵族有时也得在危机中驾驶补给车的地方，阿贝绽放了。当一场当地冲突波及医院院区、三台战斗机甲无人驾驶时，阿贝做了必须做的事。

他敏锐的观察力与强烈的战术感，再加上那台借来的机甲，撑过了那一天，但冲突并未就此结束。很快整个医疗前哨被关闭，人员被调到别处。阿贝的家族叫他回家，准备好再评估一下他们那个令人失望的年轻人长成了什么样。他没有回应，而是选择消失在外缘，以雇佣兵机师的身份自力更生。

column1: Kenrik was born on Bellevue in the Federated Suns, to parents who were executed promptly after his birth for failing to keep oaths made to a local crime lord. Kenrik himself was adopted into the crime lord's extensive 'family', and from his earliest years was employed doing 'errands' for the family matriarch.

\nAs he grew, so did his 'family'. By the time he was an adult, they were a 'syndicate', and he was running smuggling operations between cities, escorting the convoys in a BattleMech that had been 'adopted' just like him. Eventually, a long-term investigation fingered him, and the family matriarch shipped him off-planet to Solaris VII, to protect him as well as herself.

\nOn Solaris VII, under instructions to create a new identity for himself, he settled into training to join a gladiatorial stable. While there, he dueled and defeated a spunky younger pilot who quickly decided he was her new mentor. When he received word from Bellevue that it was time for him to move on from Solaris VII, the kid followed him all the way out to the Periphery.

Intermittently, they work together now. When they aren't on the same contracts, he answers her mail. Occasionally. Sometimes. But the letters from Bellevue telling him he can come home again, those, he ignores.
column2:
肯里克出生在联邦太阳的贝尔维尤，他的父母在他出生后不久就因未能履行对当地一名犯罪头目的誓约而被处决。肯里克本人被领养进这位犯罪头目庞大的"家族"，从很小的时候起就为家族的女族长跑"差事"。

随着他长大，他的"家族"也在成长。到他成年时，他们已经是一个"辛迪加"，而他负责在城市之间经营走私，用一台像他一样被"领养"的战斗机甲护送车队。最终，一场长期调查把他揪了出来，家族女族长把他送出行星前往索拉里斯VII，既是为了保护他，也是为了保护自己。

在索拉里斯VII，按照为自己创造新身份的命令，他安顿下来接受训练，准备加入一家角斗马疚。在那里，他与一名胆大的年轻飞行员决斗并将其击败，而那姑娘很快就认定他是自己的新导师。当他收到贝尔维尤的消息，说他该离开索拉里斯VII时，那孩子一路跟着他来到了外缘。

如今他们时断时续地一起干活。不同处一份合约时，他会回她的信。偶尔。有时候。但那些从贝尔维尤寄来、告诉他可以回家的信，他置之不理。

column1: El Duce
column2: 埃尔·杜塞

column1: Adam Doochin has only a few fragmented memories of a glittering childhood spent in a Lyran Commonwealth palace, all overshadowed by a nightmarish memory of the night his family fell. He was rescued from his nursery by a roguish 'old friend' of his mother's, who fled with him to the Periphery.

\nHis new guardian, while committed to keeping him alive, wasn't above teaching him how to pick pockets and con the gullible. As he got older, they moved into smuggling operations, working as a team until one job went horribly wrong and his guardian sacrificed himself to cover Adam's escape.

\nAlone for the first time in his life, Adam drifted away from the criminal lifestyle, wandering the Periphery and re-evaluating his life from an adult's perspective. Almost accidentally, he was pulled into a criminal investigation where his childhood skills could be used for the good of others, an opportunity he welcomed.

Soon he was doing regular work as an investigator. It kept food in his mouth and a roof over his head, but after a few years in one location, restlessness once again threatened his security. When he found himself working with a MechWarrior on a case, and invited afterward to join their mercenary company as a rookie pilot, he jumped at the chance.
column2:
亚当·杜钦对在一座莱兰联邦宫殿中度过的闪耀童年只有零星碎片般的记忆，而这一切都被他家族陨落那一夜的噩梦记忆所笼罩。他被母亲一位狡黠的“老朋友”从育婴室救出，此后带着他逃往外围地区。

他的新监护人一方面致力于让他活下去，另一方面也不介意教他掏口袋和骗轻信之人。随着他长大，他们转向走私生意，组成搭档合作，直到一次行动惨败，监护人为掩护亚当逃脱而牺牲。

人生中第一次孤身一人，亚当远离了犯罪生活，在外围地区漂泊，以成年人的视角重新审视自己的人生。几乎是在偶然间，他被卷入一桩刑事调查，而他的童年技能可以为他人利益所用——他欣然接受这个机会。

不久他便开始定期做调查工作，足以糊口栖身。但在一个地方待上几年后，不安分又一次威胁到他的安稳。当他在一桩案子里与一名机甲战士合作、随后受邀以新手机甲飞行员身份加入其雇佣兵公司时，他立刻答应。

column1: Bullet Trap
column2: 弹头捕阱

column1: Josh Durand started life in a rural town attached to a Federated Suns military base, the son of an enlisted man who'd mustered out early to settle down and raise a family. Josh was something of a problem child for his teachers, although he loved spending time with his family. While he achieved an adequate technical education, his heart was elsewhere, and he spent hours watching maneuvers at the military base.

\nAs soon as he was eligible, he enlisted. While school discipline had riled him, military discipline suited him. He immediately started on a Special Forces track as a communications officer, before eventually transitioning to ops and intelligence work.

Then, as the needs of the military shifted, he underwent training to pilot BattleMechs. He served as a 'Mech pilot for the Federated Suns for five years, picking up the callsign 'Bullet Trap' for his preference for the front lines. The end of the Third Succession War saw him mustered out with all honors. While he welcomed a more peaceful era for his people and his family, he knew he could never adapt to such a life, so he headed to the Periphery to continue the work he enjoyed as a mercenary.
column2:
乔什·杜兰德的童年在联邦太阳国一处军事基地旁的乡村小镇开始，父亲是一名早早退役安家养家的士兵。乔什在老师眼里是个问题孩子，尽管他很喜欢与家人相处。他虽然接受了足够的技术教育，心却在别处——他会花数小时观看军事基地的机动演练。

一到符合条件，他就入伍了。学校的纪律让他烦躁，军纪却很适合他。他立刻走上特种部队的通讯军官路线，后来转向作战与情报工作。

随后，随着军方需求变化，他接受了战斗机甲驾驶训练。他为联邦太阳国担任机甲飞行员五年，因偏好前线而得到“子弹磁铁”的呼号。第三次继承战争结束时，他带着全部荣誉退役。虽然他为自己的人民与家人迎来了更和平的时代而高兴，他知道自己永远无法适应那样的生活，于是前往外围地区，以雇佣兵身份继续他热爱的工作。

column1: Born to engineers on Victoria in the Capellan Confederation, Chris Eck was marked early as a particularly gifted child. Matching early performance was rewarded with the patronage required for him to attend the Sian Center for Martial Disciplines. He graduated in the top fifth percentile and was immediately recommended for the Sian University Officer Candidate Program.

\nAfter he passed the strenuous final examination process, he was assigned to a BattleMech unit in a lieutenant position. He served in that position for several years, but when he was due for promotion, he was instead invited back to the SCMD for advanced courses in the specialized field of BattleMech covert operations. After some time engaged in \"boring activities nobody would want to hear about\", he was sent to Solaris VII for the traditional MechWarrior background cleansing. There, he made an unexpected splash by going undefeated in his first tournament, despite joining late and without the backing of a stable.

Now in the Periphery, he tells his story easily over a couple of beers, with every indication of perfect honesty. When awed rookies ask how he ended up working out in the Periphery as a mercenary, his only answer is, "I could tell you, but then I'd have to kill you." He isn't lying.
column2:
克里斯·埃克在卡佩兰邦联的维多利亚星由工程师父母所生，很早便被认定为天赋异禀。与早期表现相称的回报，是足以让他进入思安军事纪律中心的资助。他以前百分之五的成绩毕业，随即被推荐进入思安大学军官候补计划。

通过艰苦的最终考核后，他被派往一支战斗机甲部队任中尉。他在该职位上服役数年，但到了该晋升的时候，却被召回 SCMD 进修战斗机甲秘密行动这一专门领域的高级课程。在从事了一段时间"没人想听的乏味工作"后，他被派往索拉里斯 VII 进行机甲战士传统的背景清洗。在那里他出人意料地一鸣惊人：尽管入行晚、又没有马疚支持，他却在首次锦标赛中保持不败。

如今在外围区，他喝着几杯啤酒就能轻松讲起自己的故事，处处显得无比坦诚。当敬畏的新人问起他怎么会跑到外围区当佣兵时，他唯一的回答是："我可以告诉你，但那样我就得杀了你。"他没有说谎。

column1: Mummy Bear
column2: 熊妈妈

column1: Alioth is a scion of a deposed Outworld Alliance noble house, or possibly the youngest son of a Periphery crime lord, or a war orphan created by a border skirmish. The story changes each time he tells it. Some digging reveals a surname of Liadar, but he never uses it. Nor will he say the name of the planet his noble family ruled, for he vowed to forget in exchange for his freedom.

He is broadly educated, with several general tech certifications that promise he's unlikely to break things. He can pilot small shuttles and aircraft as well as a 'Mech. He's comfortable in low gravity. He has dozens of stories about his time as an assassin for varying Periphery powers. And he has an uncanny knack for showing up unexpectedly, usually right behind somebody talking about him. It's just possible that everything he claims is true. But is it likely?
column2: 阿利奥斯是被废黜的外域联盟贵族之后，也可能是某个外围区犯罪头目的幼子，或者是边境冲突造成的战争孤儿。他每次讲的版本都不一样。深挖之下能查出姓氏利亚达尔，但他从不用它。他也不肯说出家族统治的星球之名，因为他曾发誓以遗忘换取自由。\n\n他受过广泛教育，持有数项通用技术认证，保证他不太会把东西弄坏。他既能驾驶小型穿梭机与飞行器，也能驾驶机甲，在低重力下行动自如。他关于自己为外围区各方当刺客的经历有几十个故事。他还拥有一种诡异的能耐：总能在意想不到的时刻出现，通常就在谈论他的人背后。他所说的一切也许都是真的。但可能吗？

column1: Marcus Dubroski grew up on the streets of Cluff's Stand. While he didn't always get enough to eat, he managed to find ways to make himself useful to local tradesmen who wanted him to have a future. They clubbed together to send him to the best technical school in the system.

\nHe graduated with honors but even that can't create opportunities out of thin air. Without any other options, he enlisted in the planetary military. Unfortunately, he enlisted approximately one year before the entire military organization collapsed due to lack of payroll. Markus stole a truck full of hardware, sold it via a friend on the streets, and headed off-planet to Solaris VII. There he signed up for an apprenticeship at a stable with openings, went through comprehensive training with other rookies, and survived his first public bout.

He soon realized that he wasn't a fan of people cheering when he lost. As soon as he paid off his training debt, he moved on from Solaris VII to the Periphery, where he now makes a living as a mercenary. He makes friends easily and finally seems content with the life he's made for himself.
column2:
马库斯·杜布罗斯基在克拉夫据点的街头长大。虽然他不总能吃饱，但他设法让自己对那些希望他有个未来的当地商人有用。他们凑钱把他送进该星系最好的技术学校。

他以优异成绩毕业，但那也无法凭空创造机会。别无选择之下，他入伍加入行星军队。不幸的是，他入伍大约一年后，整个军事组织就因为发不出薪饷而崩溃。马库斯偷了一卡车硬件，通过街上的朋友卖掉，然后离开行星前往索拉里斯VII。在那里他报名加入了一家有空缺的马疚做学徒，与其他新人一起接受全面训练，并在自己的首场公开比赛中活了下来。

他很快意识到自己并不喜欢人们在他输掉比赛时欢呼。一还清训练债务，他就离开索拉里斯VII前往外缘，如今以雇佣兵为生。他很容易交到朋友，看来终于对自己所过的生活感到满足。

column1: Todd Stevenson grew up in his father's shipping fleet on the edge of the Free Worlds League, learning how to shine up old tech so it looked — and hopefully worked — like new. He also learned the importance of making sure you always got something out of every deal. When a government crackdown confiscated his father's fleet in lieu of back taxes, and his father simply accepted it, Todd rebelled.

\nStealing one of his father's ships, he continued trading, now doing smuggling for the black market. Fearless and boastful, he accepted all the riskiest runs — and on one of them, he struck gold. On a moon well off established trade routes, he found a derelict military DropShip, with several trashed BattleMechs in the bay. He spent several years piecing together the equipment and learning how to use it. A number of ill-advised decisions during that time meant that eventually a coalition of dissatisfied customers tracked him down — and he was only able to buy his life with his makeshift 'Mech. And the way he tells it, it almost certainly fell apart the first time somebody other than him tried to fire its weapons.

His reputation as a black market trader in shreds, he made his way to the Periphery, to look for whatever work he could get. He now gets work as a junior MechTech or a 'Mech pilot, whichever his employers need. His equipment is always very, very shiny.
column2: 托德·史蒂文森在自由世界联盟边缘他父亲的运输船队中长大，学会了如何把旧技术擦得锃亮，让它看起来——但愿也能运作得——像新的。他还学会了确保自己从每笔交易中都能捞到好处的重要性。当政府以追缴欠税为由查没了他父亲的船队，而他父亲就这么认了时，托德选择了反抗。 他偷走父亲的一艘船，继续做生意，如今是为黑市走私。他无所畏惧又爱吹嘘，接下了所有最危险的航线——而在其中一次，他撞上了金矿。在一颗远离既定贸易航线的卫星上，他发现了一艘废弃的军用空投艇，舱里躺着几台报废的战斗机甲。他花了数年时间把装备拼凑起来，并学会如何使用。那段时间里一连串不明智的决定，最终导致一群不满的客户联手找上门——他只能靠那台拼凑的机甲买下自己的命。而据他自己讲述，那东西几乎肯定在除他以外的人第一次开火时就散架了。 他作为黑市商人的名声尽毁，于是他前往外缘，看能接到什么活。如今他做初级机修技师或机甲飞行员，哪个雇主需要就做哪个。他的装备总是非常、非常闪亮。

column1: Whitney was born into a Taurian military family with roots stretching back to the Reunification War. The tradition of serving as a MechWarrior was long a part of Whitney's family, but although traditions lingered, the family had since drifted into poverty and obscurity. Perhaps because of this, Whitney chose a military life out of family loyalty, not her duty as a Concordat citizen.

\nShe enrolled in the Taurian École Militaire on Taurus and, despite some challenges related to her small size and bookishness, she immediately gravitated toward 'Mech combat. While examinations showed deficiencies in CQC, she displayed an aptitude for long-range and hit-and-run engagements. These earned her the moniker of 'Whisper' for her knack of striking from unexpected directions.

Upon graduation and being commissioned at 20, she served in a regular line regiment as a Cornet for three years. Despite seeing action in repelling Canopian raiders and pirates, her term of service was less eventful than she had hoped - and news from home was growing more concerning. Desiring something more for her family's sake, she left her post with one goal in mind - a career as a mercenary.
column2:
惠特尼出生于一个根基可追溯到统一战争的陶里安军人家庭。作为机师服役这一传统早已是惠特尼家族的一部分，但尽管传统仍在，家族此后已陷入贫困与默默无闻。也许正因为如此，惠特尼出于对家族的忠诚而非作为协约国公民的义务，选择了军旅生涯。

她入读了陶鲁斯上的陶里安军事学校，尽管因身材矮小和书呆气遇到一些挑战，她立刻被机甲战斗吸引。虽然考核显示她在近距离近战上有所欠缺，她却展现出远程与打了就跑交战的才能。这为她赢得了"低语"的绰号，因为她擅长从意想不到的方向发起打击。

毕业并在20岁获得委任后，她以少尉身份在一个正规线列团服役三年。尽管在击退卡诺帕劫掠者与海盗中参战，她的服役期却不如她期望的那样有事迹——而来自老家的消息越来越令人担忧。为了家族谋求更多，她带着一个目标离开了岗位——成为雇佣兵。

column1: The Godfrey family was once originally a cadet branch of a ruling Federated Suns family, but before Joshua Godfrey's birth, they emigrated to the Capellan Confederation and purchased citizenship and Sheng titles there. Joshua, as the pampered youngest son of a large family, was gently guided through all childhood challenges, and encouraged to find something he enjoyed that would support the rest of the family in their political and business affairs.

\nWhile he was at Sian University, though, tragedy struck. A decades-old grudge had resurfaced to punish his family for their defection from the Federated Suns. While the culprit was an old business rival and the ultimate motivation financial gain, the damage was the same. Joshua's parents and eldest siblings were all assassinated in a single horrifying week - and the Liao would make no response except polite sounds of commiseration.

Against the advice - and pleadings - of his remaining brother and sister, Joshua left the university before graduation. Recalling a childhood fascination with BattleMechs, he traveled to the Periphery to find an apprenticeship as a MechWarrior. He fully intends on learning the ins and outs of the mercenary trade, and then leading a command of his own home again, there to defend what remains of his family.
column2:
戈弗雷家族原本是联邦太阳一个执政家族的支系，但在约书亚·戈弗雷出生之前，他们移居卡佩兰联邦，并在那里购得了公民身份与生氏头衔。约书亚作为大家族中受宠的幼子，在童年的一切挑战中都被温柔引导，并被鼓励去寻找一样他喜爱、又能支持家族其余成员政治与生意事务的东西。

然而他在罗罗大学期间，悲剧降临。一桩数十年前的旧怨重新浮出水面，为惩罚他们叛离联邦太阳。虽然肇事者是一个旧日商业对手、最终动机是金钱，损伤却是一样的。约书亚的父母与最年长的兄姐都在一个恐怖的星期内被刺杀——而廖氏除了礼貌的哀悼之辞之外，不作任何回应。

不顾剩下的兄姐的劝告与恳求，约书亚在毕业前离开了大学。他回忆起童年对战斗机甲的迷恋，于是前往外缘，寻找一名机师的学徒身份。他完全打算学会雇佣兵行当的里里外外，然后再次带领一支属于自己的队伍回家，守卫他家族剩下的一切。

column1: Thomas Hayes, the son of teachers, was raised on the Vagabond School the Sorbonne, in the Federated Suns. Far better educated than the school's students, he was pressed into service early as a tutor, sometimes to children notably older than him. He was good at it, and initially had no higher ambition than following in his parents footsteps. But they wanted him off the poorly maintained JumpShip and as soon as he was old enough, they used all the credit they'd earned serving on the Sorbonne to get him into a military academy.

\nHe couldn't not do well at the academic part of the curriculum, and he was found adequate at the less intellectual parts of the training as well. After he graduated, he was offered a commission as a navigator, but turned it down to return to academia. He spent several years earning an advanced degree in military history, which gave him an uncomfortable familiarity with the slow decline of civilization in the face of constant warfare.

When a round of conscriptions started, he was ordered back to service, and placed in a BattleMech. He did his duty, but he was a little too aware of the big picture for his superiors' comfort. As soon as a potential peace loomed on the horizon, he was mustered out. To avoid a repeat conscription when war inevitably began again, he headed out to the Periphery, where he found work as a mercenary pilot to pay the bills while he worked on a book about the Third Succession War.
column2: 托马斯·海耶斯是教师的儿子，在联邦太阳国的流浪学校索邦号上长大。他的学识远胜于该校学生，因此很早便被拉去当辅导老师，有时教的孩子明显比他年长。他做得很出色，起初并无超越父母足迹的野心。但他们希望他离开那艘维护不良的跃迁舰；等他年龄一到，他们就用自己在索邦号上服役挣到的全部信用点把他送进了军事学院。 他在课程中偏学术的部分不可能不优秀，在训练中不那么费脑的部分也被认为足够合格。毕业后，他被授予导航员委任状，但拒绝并回到学术界。他花了几年取得军事史高级学位，这让他对文明在持续战火中缓慢衰落的图景熟悉得令人不适。 当一轮征召开始时，他被勒令重返服役，并被编入一台战斗机甲。他尽了职责，但他对大局的认知有点过于清醒，令上级不安。一有和平的苗头出现，他就被退役。为避免战火不可避免再起时再次被征召，他前往外围地区，在那里当雇佣兵飞行员付账单，同时写一本关于第三次继承战争的书。

column1: Dust Raker
column2: 清道夫

column1: The son of a renowned Davion diplomat, Phaelon Halder spent his early childhood traveling with his mother as she went on the many missions created by the Third Succession War. He grew up steeped in intrigue and court drama, and learned early to confound those who were willing use children to get an edge in their negotiations.

\nWhen he was old enough, he was sent to the New Avalon Institute of Science, where he was enrolled in both the College of Military Science and the elite College of Finance. Once he graduated, he went onto the position waiting for him at the Ministry of Ways and Means.

\nHowever, five years into his ten year contract, he realized that if he spent any more time at a desk job there would be 'an unhappy Incident even Mother couldn't smooth over'. To forestall this, he manipulated his supervisor into terminating his contract. Then he promptly bought his way into a Davion-aligned mercenary company, where he enjoyed himself thoroughly until the Third Succession War ended.

When his unit was disbanded, he was still unready to settle down. He headed out to the Periphery where there was still plenty of mercenary work to be found. He stays in regular contact with his family, and will certainly return home again if there is ever a real need for him. Meanwhile, he continues to pursue the adventurous lifestyle.
column2:
作为著名达维昂外交官的儿子，费隆·哈尔德幼年时随母亲四处奔波，参与第三次继承战争催生的众多使命。他在阴谋与宫廷戏码中长大，很早就学会了如何去迷惑那些乐意利用孩子来在谈判中占便宜的人。

等到年龄够大，他被送进新阿瓦隆科学院，同时注册于军事科学学院与精英的金融学院。一毕业，他就走上了在筹算部等着他的位置。

然而，在十年合约进行到第五年时，他意识到如果继续坐办公桌，就会出现"连母亲都无法抹平的不愉快事件"。为防患于未然，他操纵上司终止了他的合约。随后他立刻买通关系进了一家亲达维昂的雇佣兵公司，在那里尽兴地玩到第三次继承战争结束。

当他的部队被解散时，他仍不准备安定下来。他前往外缘，那里仍有大量雇佣兵的活可接。他与家人保持定期联系，若真有一天需要他，他一定会回家。同时，他继续追求这种冒险式的生活。

column1: The Steiner-affiliated mercenary unit that raised Aaron Morrow told him his parents had died heroes. It wasn't until he was older that he learned they wouldn't have had to die heroes if House Steiner had sent the reinforcements they'd promised. It was at the same time he learned about the elaborate, long-term revenge ploy his commander had been pursuing.

\nYoung Aaron had already been on half a dozen missions at this point. He was involved romantically with an LCAF regular. When he learned that the Steiner had betrayed his unit and his family, and that in return, years later, his unit was about to betray House Steiner — well, some young men might have chosen revenge. Others might have chosen love. Aaron Morrow, torn between his heart and his history, chose neither. He warned his lover what was planned, explained why, and walked away.

In the Periphery, he continues performing the only trade he knows. He travels light, his only valuable possession a wrecked SLDF neurohelmet his lover gave him right before he left. He keeps it, he says, to remember the past.
column2:
那支与斯坦纳有关联、把亚伦·莫罗养大的雇佣兵部队告诉他，他的父母死于英雄之举。直到他长大后，他才得知如果斯坦纳家族派出了承诺的增援，他们本不必成为英雄。也是在那时，他得知了他的指挥官一直在筹划一场精心而长期的复仇。

此时年轻的亚伦已经执行过六次任务。他与一名LCAF现役军人有恋爱关系。当他得知斯坦纳背叛了他的部队和他的家人，而作为回报、多年之后，他的部队即将背叛斯坦纳家族时——嗯，有些年轻人可能会选择复仇。另一些人可能会选择爱情。亚伦·莫罗在内心与经历之间撕扯，两者都没选。他警告了他的恋人有什么计划，解释了原因，然后离开了。

在外缘，他继续从事他唯一掌握的行当。他轻装上路，唯一的贵重物品是一只损毁的SLDF神经头盔——他的恋人临别时给他的。他说，留着它是为了记住过去。

column1: Aidan McRae was the only child of the commander of a Davion mercenary unit assigned to monitor Mendham Electronics after it was liberated from the Capellan Confederation. His mother was only a minor noble, but during the time her company was under contract to House Davion, they were one of the wealthiest families on Mendham. Aidan received every advantage in education and training, including attending a prestigious military academy, before returning to his mother's house to take his place in the BattleMech that had been reserved for him since birth.

\nUnfortunately, that BattleMech belonged to House Davion, just like much of the company equipment. And unfortunately, Aidan's mother had no income stream other than her mercenary contract, and a decided taste for living in the style of her noble childhood. All would have been well if the Mendham contract had continued past the company's probationary period. It might still have been well if House Davion hadn't formed an alliance with House Steiner. But alas, Mendham Electronics was deemed trustworthy, and peace broke out, and so the McRae mercenary company that was to be Aidan's inheritance was scattered.

But peace never lasts forever. There's always somebody, somewhere, looking for mercenaries. While Aidan's mother remains in her new, much smaller home in the Federated Suns, Aidan travels the Periphery, working, networking, and saving money, so that one day the Sons of Grace might rise again.
column2:
艾丹·麦克雷是某支达维昂雇佣兵部队指挥官唯一的孩子，该部队被派去监视门德姆电子——后者刚从卡佩兰联邦手中解放。他母亲只是个低级贵族，但在她的连队受雇于达维昂家族期间，他们是门德姆上最富有的家族之一。艾丹在教育与训练上享受了一切优势，包括就读一所名牌军事学院，之后回到母亲的宅邸，坐进那台自他出生起就为他预留的战斗机甲。

不幸的是，那台战斗机甲属于达维昂家族，就像公司的大部分装备一样。同样不幸的是，艾丹的母亲除了雇佣兵合约之外没有任何收入来源，而她又下定决心要过贵族童年时那种生活。如果门德姆合约能在连队的试用期之后继续，一切本会顺利。如果达维昂家族没有与施泰纳家族结盟，也许仍然会顺利。但可惜，门德姆电子被认定值得信任，和平降临了，于是本应作为艾丹遗产的麦克雷雇佣兵公司就此四散。

但和平从不长久。总有人在某个地方寻找雇佣兵。当艾丹的母亲仍住在联邦太阳境内她那座小得多的新居时，艾丹游历外缘，接活、拓展人脉、攒钱，只盼有朝一日"恩典之子"能再度崛起。

column1: War Boar
column2: 战猪

column1: Siegfried Krauss, born to a noble Lyran lineage, educated at the best Lyran school, and appointed to the most prestigious and safest of positions, has a nemesis.

\nIt's his only explanation for how he could go from that most prestigious of positions, to enlisting in a BattleMech corps. It's his explanation for how he went from a ranking position in the BattleMech corps to wandering the Inner Sphere. It's even his explanation for how, once he settled on Solaris VII and built up his own stable, he threw it all away to become a mercenary in the Periphery.

Siegfried Krauss doesn't deal with breakups very well at all. But he can't seem to help falling in love. And, of course, who can resist falling in love with him? If only they'd stay in love. If only all sparkling-eyed brunettes would just... stay away. If only, once the relationship ended, he could stand to stay where once he'd had so many happy memories. But he can't. It simply hurts too much.
column2: 西格弗里德·克劳斯出身莱兰贵族世家，就读于最好的莱兰学校，被委任到最显赫也最安全的职位——而他有一个宿敌。 这是他对自己如何从那个最显赫的职位转到战斗机甲部队的唯一解释。这是他对自己如何从机甲部队的军官之位沦落到在内天体四处漂泊的解释。这甚至是他对自己为何在索拉里斯VII安顿下来、建起自己的马疚之后，又抛下一切去外缘当雇佣兵的解释。 西格弗里德·克劳斯完全不擅长处理分手。可他似乎总是忍不住坠入爱河。当然，又有谁能抗拒爱上他呢？只盼他们能一直爱下去。只盼所有眼眸闪亮的褐发女子都能……离他远点。只盼每当一段关系结束，他能忍受留在那些曾满是美好回忆的地方。但他做不到。那实在太痛了。

column1: Victoria Samson was born on Thule, in the Draconis Combine. The only daughter of a long line of infantry officers, she had a number of brothers, all of whom adored her. While her parents pushed her toward the traditional occupations of a Draconian girl, her brothers encouraged her in both mischief and combat training.

\nIt was inevitable that as soon as she was of age, she enlisted. While she quickly proved her worth as an exceptional 'Mech pilot, her taste for mischief could not be satisfied so easily. She began dabbling in the barracks black market. During her first tour of duty, she piloted her Jenner with distinction - and ran the odd illegal substance along the way.

\nOn her next tour, without any combat action, she started cozying up to the Yakuza. This, however, was not as much fun as she'd hoped, and she soon found herself looking for an escape from water that had gotten much too hot. With the aid of some Davion connections she'd made, she fled the Combine and headed straight to the Periphery. Now she hires herself out as a mercenary - and if she makes a little on the side moving things from here to there, well, it makes people happy. And isn't that what counts?
column2:
维多利亚·萨姆森出生在龙尼斯联合体的图勒。作为世代步兵军官家族中唯一的女儿，她有众多兄弟，全都宠爱她。她的父母把她往龙尼斯女孩的传统职业上推，而她的兄弟们则鼓励她既淘气又练近战。

年龄一到她就入伍，这无可避免。虽然她很快证明自己是出色的机甲飞行员，她对恶作剧的喜好却不是那么容易满足的。她开始涉足兵营黑市。第一次服役期间，她驾驶詹纳表现卓越——沿途也顺带运过一些违禁物品。

下一次服役时没有战斗任务，她开始与黑帮套近乎。然而这并不像她期望的那么有趣，她很快发现自己想从已经变得太烫的水里脱身。靠着结识的一些达维昂关系，她逃离联合体，直奔外缘。如今她以雇佣兵身份受雇——如果她顺便从这儿往那儿搬点东西赚点小钱，嗯，那让大家开心。这不才是最重要的吗？

column1: Lorenzo Raldoron grew up in a working class family of mechanics in the Federated Suns. While his parents and aunts worked on urban vehicles and passenger aircraft, they had a family love of BattleMechs, watching holovids of the Solaris games together and once enjoying a family trip to the legendary planet. In their spare time, they'd construct models together.

\nBy the time Lorenzo was old enough to attend technical school, work as a MechTech was no longer an elite position for mechanics. Decades of war did that. When he graduated, he had his pick of positions, and chose to work on a DropShip so he could see other systems. After his first tour of duty was up, he realized that he could enjoy more freedom working for a mercenary company rather than the AFFS, and moved Rimward. This allowed him more time to continue working on the models that had been a lifetime interest. He enjoyed trying to recreate the look of LosTech designs even if the technology itself was beyond him.

Becoming a pilot was never a driving interest of his, but when his current employer ended up in a situation where pilots were needed more than techs, he stepped up and discovered how easy it was for him to maneuver BattleMechs. Now he accepts work in either position, but has found, on average, he has more time to pursue his hobby if he works as a pilot.
column2:
洛伦佐·拉尔多隆在联邦太阳一个工人阶级技工家庭长大。他的父母和姑姨都从事城市车辆与客运飞行器的维修，而全家都热爱战斗机甲，一起观看索拉里斯赛事的全息影像，还曾全家去那颗传奇行星旅行。闲暇时他们会一起拼装模型。

到洛伦佐年龄够大可以上技术学校时，机修技师已不再是技工中的精英岗位。数十年的战争造成了这种局面。毕业时他有很多职位可选，他选择在一艘空投艇上工作，好去看看其他星系。第一轮服役期满后，他意识到为雇佣兵公司工作比在AFFS能有更多自由，于是前往核心方向。这让他有更多时间继续制作那些他一生热爱的模型。他喜欢试着重现失传科技设计的外观，即便那技术本身远超他的能力。

成为飞行员从来不是他的主要兴趣，但当他当时的雇主遇到需要飞行员多过需要技师的局面时，他挺身而出，发现自己操作战斗机甲竟如此轻松。如今两种岗位的活他都接，但他发现平均而言，做飞行员能有更多时间追求自己的爱好。

column1: Sabrewolf - he never uses 'Zebak Koga' - was born to explorers of the Periphery who simply didn't return one day from one of their expeditions. At least that's the story he was told. Perhaps they died, or perhaps they decided a child was an unwanted burden. He was passed around the small community his parents had been using as a base until he was old enough to be sent off to school, at which point he was promptly given to a passing mercenary company. 'Apprenticed', they called it. He does not say the name of the company, except to observe, with dark glee, that they no longer exist.

After escaping his original company as a young man, he continued to seek employment as a mercenary, first as ground support for BattleMech lances, and then as a BattleMech pilots. He has had many commanders, and does not always leave with good reports. Insubordination is a common complaint. It's not that he's rude. It's just that if he disapproves of a mission, or how it's being carried out, he will instead enact his own plan. But somehow, he stays alive and brings his 'Mech back, which is valuable enough in a pilot.
column2:
萨布雷沃夫——他从不用"泽巴克·科加"这个名字——出生于外缘的探险者，而他们某天出外探险就再也没回来。至少他是这么听说的。也许他们死了，也许他们觉得孩子是个不受欢迎的负担。他在父母曾作为据点的那个小社区里被辗转寄养，直到年龄够大被送去上学，随即又被直接交给一支路过的雇佣兵公司。"学徒"，他们这么称呼。他不肯说出那家公司的名字，只是带着阴沉的快意指出，他们已经不复存在了。

年轻时从原公司逃出后，他继续以雇佣兵身份求职，先是为战斗机甲分队做地面支援，后来成为战斗机甲飞行员。他有过许多指挥官，离职时得到的评价并不总是好的。不服从命令是常见的抱怨。倒不是他粗鲁，只是如果他不认可某项任务或任务的执行方式，他就会改而实施自己的计划。但不知怎么的，他总能活下来并把机甲带回来，这对一名飞行员来说已足够宝贵。

column1: Viona Heinrici was born on Hesperus II in the Lyran Commonwealth to a family with a long history of working in and around the famous Defiance Industries BattleMech factory. While her father and brothers worked in the factory itself, her mother and aunts were pilots serving in defense of the factory, so naturally, Viona followed in their footsteps.

\nHowever, while she was still in training, there was a particularly brutal attack on Hesperus II by the Free Worlds League. While the LCAF successfully defended Defiance Industries, a large portion of Viona's family were casualties of the assault. As a result, out of respect for her family's long service, Viona was allowed to finish her training but refused a combat assignment.

Disappointed at not having a chance to put her training to the test, Viona chose to go to Solaris VII, where she found work in a stable and survived her first bout. Later, while training, she was defeated by a rough-edged older pilot from the Federated Suns. Fascinated by his gruff attitude, she immediately adopted him as her mentor. When he abruptly left Solaris VII, she tracked him down and then followed him out to the Periphery, which turned out to be an even more interesting place than Solaris VII. Now she works as a mercenary, staying in contact with both her mentor and her remaining family on Hesperus II, and thoroughly enjoying life.
column2:
维奥娜·海因里希出生在莱兰联邦的赫斯佩鲁斯II，家族世代都在著名的反抗工业战斗机甲工厂内外工作。她的父亲和兄弟们都在工厂里干活，而她的母亲和姑姨们则是为保卫工厂服役的飞行员，所以维奥娜自然而然地追随了她们的脚步。

然而，她还在受训期间，自由世界联盟对赫斯佩鲁斯II发动了一次特别残酷的进攻。虽然LCAF成功守住了反抗工业，但维奥娜家族中有很大一部分人成了那次进攻的伤亡者。因此，出于对她家族长期服役的敬意，维奥娜被允许完成训练，但被拒绝分配战斗岗位。

由于没能有机会检验自己的训练而失望，维奥娜选择前往索拉里斯VII，在那里她在一家马疚找到了工作，并在首场比赛中存活下来。后来，在训练中，她被一位来自联邦太阳的粗犷老飞行员击败。她被他那股生硬的作风吸引，立刻把他认作自己的导师。当他突然离开索拉里斯VII时，她追踪到他，并跟着他来到了外缘——结果那里比索拉里斯VII还有意思。如今她做雇佣兵，一边与导师和赫斯佩鲁斯II上余下的家人保持联系，一边尽情享受生活。

column1: Jason Castro is the firstborn son of the Duke of Rio in the Draconis March of the Federated Suns, and as such he received all the best training available, and was taught to know his own value. He was one of the first graduates from the newly rebuilt Robinson Battle Academy, and was assigned a position of responsibility early.

\nUnfortunately, despite his lineage, his training and his confidence, he lacked the wisdom to lead his command well. Too soon after receiving his commission, he bungled an attack on a superior Draconis Combine force along the border. His entire unit was wiped out, and he barely escaped with his life.

Horrified, his father pulled strings to have him sent home to relative safety. While Jason accepted the opportunity to resign his commission, he refused to return to Rio, and instead headed out to the Periphery to pick up work as a mercenary. While he is still too arrogant to admit it, he is hoping to acquire the experience and wisdom he needs to somehow make up for the disaster of his first command. Meanwhile, he affects a hard-bitten cynicism beyond his years.
column2:
杰森·卡斯特罗是联邦太阳龙尼斯边区里奥公爵的长子，因此他受尽了最好的训练，也被教导要认清自己的价值。他是新近重建的罗宾逊战斗学院的首批毕业生之一，并很早便被委以重任。

不幸的是，尽管出身、训练与自信俱在，他却缺乏带好部队所需的智慧。获得委任后不久，他就在边境对一支强大的龙尼斯联合体部队发起进攻时搞砸了。他的整个单位被全歼，他自己也仅以身免。

惊恐之下，他的父亲动用关系把他调回相对安全的后方。杰森虽然接受了解除委任的机会，却拒绝回里奥，转而出走外缘当雇佣兵。他至今仍太傲慢，不肯承认，但他盼着积累所需的经验与智慧，以某种方式弥补自己第一次指挥的灾难。同时，他装出一副远超年龄的饱经沧桑的玩世不恭。

column1: Chris Winzar's mother cleaned the houses of the rich on Chara III while Chris played in the back streets nearby. Richer children went to private schools, while he struggled to keep his place in a rundown two-room public schoolhouse. And eventually, they went off to lucrative jobs, while he stayed at home to take care of an increasingly ill mother, reading her books. After she died in their leaking apartment, he enlisted the next day. It was the only way off Chara III for him, and the only way he could make sure his future children would have a better childhood than he did.

\nAfter basic training, he served a five-year tour at Hesperus II, where almost anybody could get cockpit experience in a BattleMech. After his tour was over, he left the LCAF and headed to Solaris VII, hoping, as so many hoped, to do well enough that he could build up a nest egg for a brighter future.

He landed on his feet on Solaris with Lion City Stables. They treated him well, but while his skills were adequate to keep him alive, he didn't have the personality to shine. After several years, his manager advised him to give up on Solaris while he still could. He was advised to head out to the Periphery where he would do well as a mercenary. His manager even provided him with a list of companies to try to join, and a letter of recommendation that spoke highly of his even temperament and marksman skills.
column2:
克里斯·温扎的母亲在查拉 III 为富人打扫宅邸，克里斯则在附近的后街玩耍。有钱人家的孩子上私立学校，他则在破旧的两间教室公立学校里苦苦保住自己的位置。后来他们去做赚钱的工作，他却留在家里照患病的母亲，给她读书。母亲在他们漏水的公寓里去世后，他第二天就入伍了。这是他离开查拉 III 的唯一途径，也是他确保自己未来的孩子能比他过得更好的唯一办法。

基础训练后，他在赫斯佩鲁斯 II 服役五年——在那里几乎任何人都能在战斗机甲里取得驾驶舱经验。服役期满后，他离开 LCAF 前往索拉里斯 VII，像许多人一样希望自己表现足够好，能攒下一笔钱换取更光明的未来。

他在索拉里斯的"狮城马疚"站稳了脚跟。他们待他不错，但他的技艺虽足以保命，性格却不足以耀眼。几年后，经理建议他趁还来得及就放弃索拉里斯，去外围区当佣兵会过得不错。经理甚至给了他一份可以尝试加入的公司名单，以及一封极力称赞他性情平和与射击技艺的推荐信。

column1: Big Sly
column2: 大滑头

column1: The pilot called Christoph Nick came from... somewhere. Everybody comes from somewhere, after all. And the people he spent most of his time working with were particularly notorious for not giving a damn about somebody's past. He showed up one day on Tortuga Prime, and he knew his way around, and that was all that mattered.

\nFor years, he worked in various pirate bands out of Tortuga, raiding and stealing, but refusing to enslave anybody. For him, being a pirate was about freedom, not power, and he had the skills to back up his point of view. As a result he had an antagonistic relationship with the ruler of Tortuga. He managed to avoid her intermittent assassination attempts and never came in direct conflict with her until he at last decided that life under Dame Trevaline no longer fit his ideals. In one very busy night, he freed two hundred slaves, stole three ships, and burned down four of Dame Trevaline's stashes... possibly all by himself.

He doesn't tell this story himself, of course. But the dregs of society in every port city recognize his name, and whispers surround him when he goes out for a drink. As for Christoph himself? He likes to stay on the move, and only works with mercenary companies without a fixed contract.
column2:
这位名叫克里斯托夫·尼克的飞行员来自……某个地方。毕竟每个人都来自某个地方。而他长期共事的人特别以不在乎别人的过去而著称。他某天出现在托尔图加主星，而且熟悉门路，这就够了。

多年来他在托尔图加的各路海盗团里干活，袭掠与偷盗，却拒绝奴役任何人。对他而言，当海盗关乎自由而非权力，而他有本事支撑自己的观点。因此他与托尔图加的统治者关系对立。他躲过了她断断续续的暗杀企图，也从未与她正面冲突，直到他最终认定在特雷瓦琳夫人手下生活不再符合他的理想。在一个极其忙碌的夜晚，他释放了两百名奴隶、偷走三艘飞船、烧毁特雷瓦琳夫人的四座藏货点……很可能全是他一个人干的。

当然，这故事不是他自己讲的。但每个港口城市的社会渣滓都认得他的名字，他出门喝酒时四周总有窃窃私语。至于克里斯托夫本人？他喜欢保持流动，只与没有固定合同的雇佣兵公司合作。

column1: Garrat Dardai was born on Erod's Escape in the Periphery years before its official colonization by Jacob Erod. His family was part of group of slaves from a pirate planet who had escaped on a stolen ship and stumbled onto the Escape's verdant lushness. Unfortunately his own parents had both died from disease by the time he was ten years old, and he was taken in by a local orphanage run by a man who had picked up his moral code from pirates.

Young Garrat spent his teenage and young adult years picking pockets, casing houses, and fleecing the occasional visitors to the Escape who stopped to resupply. It wasn't his preferred life and he often dreamed of escape, but could never work out a way out of his situation... until one day he messed with the wrong mercenary company. Or, from a long-term perspective, the right one. After being caught red-handed stealing from the company, the commander had him thrown into their DropShip's brig and, once he was off planet, demanded he repay what he stole through hard labor. He did so, and so cheerfully that he was soon simply one of the crew. When his term with that company was up, he was free to make his own way in the Periphery, with plenty of legitimate skills to keep himself fed.
column2:
加拉特·达尔代在雅各布·埃罗德正式殖民之前数年，出生在外缘的埃罗德的逃脱上。他的家人属于一群从某海盗行星逃离的奴隶，他们乘着一艘偷来的船，偶然发现了这座退隐之地的葱郁。不幸的是，到他十岁时他的父母都已病死，他被当地一家孤儿院收留，而经营它的人是从海盗那里学来道德准则的。

年轻的加拉特在青少年与青年时期靠扒窃、踩点、以及从偶尔停下补给的路人身上行骗度日。这不是他想要的生活，他常梦想逃离，却总想不出办法摆脱处境……直到有一天他惹错了雇佣兵公司。或者从长远来看，是惹对了。在被当场抓获盗窃该公司财物之后，指挥官把他关进空投艇的禁闭室，等他离行星之后，要求他以苦力偿还所窃之物。他照做了，而且做得如此愉快，很快他就干脆成了船员之一。当他与那家公司的期限满了之后，他已能凭自己的正当技能在外缘谋生、养活自己。

column1: Michael Dark was born on Coventry in the Lyran Commonwealth, the son of an overseer of Coventry Metal Works. He worked hard in school and graduated from the Coventry Military Academy near the top of his class. He was then assigned to the LCAD Sixth Guards on Hesperus II, where he saw combat against Wolf's Dragoons.

After his tour with LCAF was up, he chose to become a mercenary. Early in his mercenary career, he met Cecilia Bowens, who was serving as a MechTech and general support staff for the second company he worked for. They fell in love and married, but as they both enjoyed the mercenary lifestyle they decided to stay in the business. Now they have two children, Hugh and Julie, and Michael Dark often pitches his family to prospective employers as a package deal. Although children are unusual on a mercenary DropShip, his are well-trained and manage to make themselves useful. They're cute, too. It tends to be a good bargain.
column2:
迈克尔·达克出生在莱兰联邦的考文垂，是考文垂金属厂一位监工的儿子。他在学校刻苦用功，以接近班级顶尖的成绩毕业于考文垂军事学院。随后他被派往赫斯佩鲁斯II上的LCAD第六卫队，在那里与狼族龙骑兵交战。

在LCAF的服役期满后，他选择成为雇佣兵。雇佣兵生涯初期，他遇到了塞西莉亚·鲍恩斯，她在他效力的第二家公司担任机修技师和一般支援人员。他们相爱并结了婚，但由于两人都喜爱雇佣兵的生活方式，便决定继续留在这行。如今他们有两个孩子，休和朱莉，而迈克尔·达克常常向潜在雇主推销说他一家是个打包方案。虽说孩子出现在雇佣兵空投艇上并不寻常，但他的孩子训练有素，还能帮上忙。而且他们很可爱。这往往是一笔划算的买卖。

column1: Lars was born on Arcturus, the original capital of the Lyran Commonwealth, in one of the metropolises reclaimed by the ecosystem after the capital moved to Tharkad. As a result, his childhood an odd mix of the urban and the rural. But like many other Arcturans, Lars was raised with near fanatical devotion to the Commonwealth. When he was old enough, he enlisted in the LCAF.

\nOn his first tour in the LCAF, he was assigned to the infantry, trained in anti-'Mech operations. He spent most of his tour living in harsh environments, avoiding being stomped on or shot by enemy 'Mechs. After his first tour ended, Lars used his earnings from his enlistment to attend the Blackjack School of Conflict, training to become a MechWarrior.

\nThe unconventional methods taught at the Blackjack School of Conflict made Lars a perfect fit for the 6th Lyran Guards. But after surviving the 13th Battle of Hesperus II, Lars decided his life and skills were worth more than a government paycheck and left the LCAF to find wealth through his trade as a Solaris VII gladiator.

He had a promising start on Solaris, but an embarrassing defeat found Lars relegated to fighting small-time matches in The Reaches. After racking up some serious debt through gambling and expensive living, Lars decided to sell his skills as a mercenary to pay off his debts... before someone comes collecting.
column2:
拉尔斯出生在阿克图鲁斯——莱兰联邦最初的首都——首都迁往塔卡德之后被生态系统重新收复的众多大都市之一。因此他的童年是都市与乡野的奇特混合。但像许多阿克图鲁斯人一样，拉尔斯从小被灌输对联邦近乎狂热的忠诚。年龄够大后，他入伍加入了LCAF。

在LCAF的第一次服役中，他被分配到步兵，接受反机甲作战训练。他的大部分服役期都在恶劣环境中度过，躲避被敌方机甲踩死或射杀。第一次服役结束后，拉尔斯用入伍所得去上黑杰克冲突学校，受训成为机师。

黑杰克冲突学校教授的非正统方法让拉尔斯完美契合莱兰第六卫队。但在赫斯佩鲁斯II第十三次战役中幸存之后，拉尔斯认定自己的性命与技能比一份政府薪水更值钱，于是离开LCAF，以索拉里斯VII角斗士的身份靠手艺求财。

他在索拉里斯开局不错，但一次难堪的失利使拉尔斯沦落到"边远区"打小场比赛。在赌博与奢靡生活欠下可观债务之后，拉尔斯决定以雇佣兵身份出售自己的技能来还债……趁还没人上门讨债。

column1: Death Krusade
column2: 死神十字军

column1: Karina Spenthia Yvonne Marsin, scion of the First Families of the Federated Suns, had the most ancient and noble of lineages. And, oh, she had a very fine education, the best of weapons, the shiniest of buttons. She had the wisest of older sisters and the kindest of younger brothers. And yet she was so, so bored.

\nThere was so much she could get away without anybody noticing. So much that nobody needed, so much that would hardly even be noticed if it went missing. So much others were forced to do without. Not that she particularly valued giving away her scores to the poor. Except... it did make her laugh to see her least favorite cousin's dress on a grubby nine year old.

\nOne day, though, somebody did notice. Perhaps, perhaps because she'd wanted them to. Perhaps she'd gotten more and more brazen, more and more taunting, until they couldn't help but catch her, red-handed, black-suited. Oh, the looks on their faces!

\nBut though she was a humiliation, though she was a scandal, still she was a Marsin. She skipped, singing, into her exile in the Periphery. There she did quite, quite well turning her hobby into a career. Until one day, she opened a vault that was much larger than expected and found her first BattleMech.
She may have lost it since: to a thief, a thief, a thief she'll find someday and... In any case, being a MechWarrior-for-hire is a nice change from the boredom of burglary. For now.
column2: 卡琳娜·斯彭西娅·伊冯娜·马辛，联邦太阳第一家族的后裔，拥有最古老高贵的血统。哦，她受过非常好的教育，用最好的武器，戴最亮的纽扣。她有最聪慧的姐姐和最善良的弟弟。然而她实在太、太无聊了。 有太多东西是她可以在无人注意的情况下拿走的。太多没人需要的东西，太多即便失踪也几乎不会被注意到的东西。太多别人被迫没有的东西。倒不是她特别热衷于把自己的战利品送给穷人。只是……看到自己最讨厌的堂妹的裙子穿在一个脏兮兮的九岁孩子身上，确实让她发笑。 然而有一天，真的有人注意到了。也许，也许，是因为她希望他们注意到。也许她变得越来越放肆、越来越挑衅，直到他们忍不住当场抓住她——人赃并获，一身黑衣。哦，他们脸上的表情！ 但尽管她是个耻辱，尽管她是个丑闻，她终究是马辛家的人。她唱着歌、蹦跳着走进了在外缘的流放生活。在那里，她把自己的爱好变成了职业，干得相当、相当不错。直到有一天，她打开一个比预期大得多的金库，发现了她的第一台战斗机甲。 她后来可能把它弄丢了：落在一个贼手里，一个贼，一个她总有一天要找到的贼，然后……无论如何，当受雇的机师总比无聊的闯空门强些。至少现在是。

column1: Live Fire
column2: 实弹

column1: One of the many children orphaned by the Third Succession War, Jeffrey Scott was lucky enough to be adopted by the noble Scott family of the Free Worlds League, and raised as a cherished member of their large family.

\nAfter being educated at a local military academy, his family arranged for him to work at a military testing range instead of on the front lines. Not an uncommon act at the time, he still welcomed the opportunity to broaden the MechWarrior skills he'd acquired during school sports.

\nWhat could have been a splendid career was severely curtailed when he discovered that one of his siblings had been using him as a catspaw in a criminal endeavor with the potential to destabilize a Duchy. Rather than be indicted and betray his foolish brother, he abandoned his position.

Now he travels the Periphery, taking work as a mercenary. Perhaps he'll make it home again. Perhaps not. Most of his stories of old days are of the Shadow Hawk he piloted on the test range, and if he'll ever see it again.
column2:
作为第三次继承战争造成的众多孤儿之一，杰弗里·斯科特幸运地被自由世界联盟的斯科特贵族家族收养，在这个大家庭中作为受疼爱的成员长大。

在当地一所军事学院接受教育后，家族安排他去一处军事试验场工作，而不是上前线。这在当时并不罕见，他倒也欢迎这个机会，去拓展自己在上学期间运动队里学到的机师技能。

本可辉煌的职业生涯却严重受挫——他发现自己的一个兄弟一直在利用他充当犯罪勾当的爪牙，而此事有可能动摇一个公国。他不愿被起诉、也不愿出卖自己愚蠢的兄弟，于是放弃了自己的职位。

如今他游历外缘，靠当雇佣兵谋生。也许他还能再回家。也许不能。他关于往日的故事大多是他在试验场上驾驶的那台影子鹰，以及他是否还能再见到它。

column1: There's only one path for a war orphan raised in a group home in a nation where the same war yet rages. Bjorn Hummel, of the Lyran Commonwealth, joined the LCAF as soon as he was of age, alongside many of his foster siblings.

\nTheir group home had been a good one, and he and his foster siblings kept in close contact after their different assignments. Until his promotion to special ops, he shared almost everything with them. After, his letters closed down, and he saw the same slow withdrawal from them as the war pulled them away from each other. Eventually, for too many of them, he'd get one final letter about them, from the person who'd raised them, informing him of their death. And once, through shady means, he received a letter full of secrets, sent by a foster brother who subsequently died.

\nThese weren't secrets to shake a nation, or destroy a company. Not in a galaxy at war. But they were secrets to shatter a soul, and they came too close to some of Bjorn's own experiences for him to lock away. A year of poor sleep rendered him unfit for duty, and he was discharged from the LCAF.

The nightmares eased a little, then. But he soon found the only way he could really sleep at night was if he was engaged in a cause he could really believe in. He's picky about his contracts, now. He's going to make things better.
column2:
对于一个在战时孤儿院长大、所在国家仍深陷同一场战争的战争孤儿来说，只有一条路可走。莱兰联邦的比约恩·胡梅尔一到年龄就加入了LCAF，与他许多同为孤儿的兄弟姐妹一同入伍。

他们的孤儿院是家好孤儿院，他和他的养兄弟姐妹在不同分配后仍保持密切联系。直到他被提升到特种作战部门之前，他几乎与他们分享一切。之后，他的信越来越少，他也看到他们同样缓慢地抽离，因为战争把他们彼此拉远。最终，对太多人而言，他会收到关于他们的最后一封信——来自那位把他们养大的人，告知他们的死讯。还有一次，通过不正当的渠道，他收到了一封满是秘密的信，寄信的一位养兄弟随后也死了。

那些并非足以撼动一个国家、或摧毁一家公司的秘密。在一个战火中的银河里算不上。但它们是足以击碎灵魂的秘密，而且它们离比约恩自身的某些经历太近，让他无法把它们锁起来。一年的失眠使他不再适合服役，他被LCAF开除了。

那时噩梦稍稍缓解。但他很快发现，唯一能让他夜里真正入睡的办法，是投身于一个他真正相信的事业。如今他对合约很挑剔。他要把事情变得更好。

column1: Soren Holmgren's family on Rasalhague was not historically involved in the ongoing resistance against the principality's Kuritan conquerors. His father was an office worker, while his mother painted landscapes. But then the Coordinator of the Draconis Combine was assassinated in 3004 by a Rasalhague nationalist, and as punishment, random executions were ordered. Soren's father was one of those so punished, destining Soren for a lifetime dedicated to striking back at House Kurita.

\nAs soon as he finished technical school, he volunteered for the Rasalhague liberation guerrillas. They further trained him in covert operations focused on repositioning military hardware. Stealing BattleMechs is far more technical than merely piloting them, requiring both skills and specialized hardware. Soren excelled at it, substantially reinforcing the armories of the liberation guerrillas while maintaining a cover as a quiet vehicle mechanic.

But these things never last forever. Eventually, you get discovered. The Rasalhague resistance force was grateful enough to get Soren and his remaining family off-planet. Now, his family resettled on a Periphery world, he works as a mercenary pilot, preferentially seeking out contracts against House Kurita, so he can continue his vendetta.
column2:
索伦·霍尔姆格伦在拉萨尔哈格的家族历史上并未参与对抗该公国栗田征服者的持续抵抗。他的父亲是个办公室职员，母亲则画风景画。但后来龙尼斯联合体的协调官在3004年被一名拉萨尔哈格民族主义者刺杀，作为惩罚，随之而来的是随机处决。索伦的父亲就是被如此惩处的人之一，这注定索伦此生都要致力于打击栗田家族。

技术学校一毕业，他就志愿加入了拉萨尔哈格解放游击队。他们进一步训练他从事以转移军用硬件为重点的秘密行动。偷战斗机甲远比驾驶它们更具技术性，既需要技巧也需要专用硬件。索伦在这方面极为出色，大幅充实了解放游击队的军械库，同时以一名沉默寡言的车辆技工身份作掩护。

但这种事从来不会长久。最终，你会被发现。拉萨尔哈格抵抗力量感激地帮索伦和他余下的家人离开了行星。如今家人已在外缘世界重新安顿，他作为雇佣兵机师工作，优先寻找针对栗田家族的合约，好继续他的复仇。

column1: The son of military reservists in the Federated Suns, Aidan Slipais decided to step up the family commitment to military action by attending one of the military academies. Aptitude testing there declared him to be a good fit for special ops, so when he graduated from the Academy, he gave it a try.

\nHis superior officers found very little to complain about, but in the old fairytale parlance, Aidan himself found it 'too hot'. So on his next tour, he opted to join a regular unit, to see if he enjoyed the more relaxing pace of overt warfare more.

\nHe found his special ops experience quite useful in commanding his unit, and once again, his commanding officers had nothing but praise for his performance. Alas, for the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns, he found it 'too cold'.

\nSo, in search of something that would get his blood pumping but not make his hair stand on end, he retired from military service and traveled to Solaris VII. He joined a stable, participated in some bouts, and found a new chapter in an old story: 'too expensive'.

Now, he works as a mercenary in the Periphery. It isn't the military career he dreamed of as a child, but for now, it's 'just right': the perfect mix of excitement and downtime in an all-expenses-paid environment.
column2:
作为联邦太阳预备役军人的儿子，艾丹·斯利派斯决定把家族对军事行动的投入更进一步，去上一所军事学院。那里的能力测试判定他非常适合特种作战，所以从学院毕业时他试了一试。

他的上级军官几乎挑不出什么毛病，但用老童话的说法，艾丹自己觉得那"太热"。于是下一次服役时，他选择加入一支常规部队，想看看自己是否更喜欢公开战争那种更放松的节奏。

他发现自己的特种作战经验在指挥部队时相当有用，而他的指挥官再次对他的表现只有称赞。唉，对联邦太阳武装部队而言，他觉得那"太冷"。

于是，为了寻找能让他热血沸腾又不至于汗毛倒竖的东西，他从军职退役，前往索拉里斯VII。他加入一家马疚，参加了一些比赛，并在一个老故事里找到了新的篇章："太贵了"。

如今，他在外缘做雇佣兵。这不是他童年梦想的军旅生涯，但就目前而言，它"刚刚好"：在一个全程报销的环境里，刺激与闲暇的完美混合。

column1: Auri Tilson grew up in the backwaters of the Outworld Alliance, craving the excitement his ancestors had eschewed. There was a war out there, and he was far too young to appreciate how it had barely touched his home. When he was old enough, he enlisted and opted for off-planet service.

By the end of his first tour, he'd realized that while he enjoyed working in a BattleMech unit, he disliked the discipline of military life. He mustered out and went to Solaris VII, where he spent ten years working his way up through a stable, starting out as a pilot and eventually becoming a coach and manager. But he spent many seasons falling short of his tournament ambitions. Noting the exodus of several up-and-coming young stars from Solaris VII, he came up with a plan to travel the Periphery, recruiting from among the mercenaries there for a new stable that could could at last win the Grand Tournament.
column2: 奥里·蒂尔森在外域联盟的偏远地区长大，渴望着祖先们避开的刺激。外面有战争，而他太年轻，不懂那场战争几乎没触及他的家乡。一到年龄，他就入伍并选择了离星服役。\n\n第一个服役期结束时，他意识到自己虽然喜欢在战斗机甲部队工作，却讨厌军旅生活的纪律。他退役去了索拉里斯 VII，在那里花了十年在一家马疚里往上爬，从飞行员做起，最终成为教练与经理。但多个赛季里他始终未能达到自己的锦标赛目标。注意到几位崭露头角的年轻明星离开索拉里斯 VII，他想出一个计划：游历外围区，从当地佣兵中招募人手，组建一家终能赢下大赛的马疚。

column1: Despite being a war orphan, Sven Toraldson grew up pretty much the same as any other kid in the Capellan Confederation, courtesy of the foster parents the government assigned to him. He battled with toy 'Mechs, watched heroic holovids and dreamt of adventure. When he was old enough, his parents sent him off to enlist.

\nBoot camp was quite the knock to his daydreams, but he was determined to stick it out. His drill seargeant, watching his early efforts, said disparagingly, \"You're no Ajax\", and for a long time the nickname clung to him. But while many of Sven's contemporaries found glory, or death, or other careers, he stubbornly continued to 'stick it out'. There was a pension waiting for him eventually and he was too set in his ways to learn a new trade. Eventually, when he was older than almost everybody in his battalion, he picked up a new callsign: Ulysses.

\nAt the end of twenty years, he mustered out with the pension he'd been waiting for, with a nice - if not very significant - medal in a box and a timepiece everybody'd chipped in to give him. He was now free to live a life of leisure, enjoying his later middle years... and it turned out to be exactly as boring as he was afraid it would be.
So he headed out to the Periphery to find work in a mercenary company, letting his pension pile up in his bank account, waiting for another go at retirement. Maybe in another twenty years.
column2:
尽管是战争孤儿，斯文·托拉尔德森的成长与卡佩兰联邦其他孩子几乎没什么不同，多亏政府给他指派的养父母。他用玩具机甲对战，看英雄全息影像，梦想冒险。等他年龄够大，父母便送他去入伍。

新兵训练营对他的白日梦是一记不小的打击，但他决心撑下去。他的教官看着他早期的表现，轻蔑地说："你可不是阿贾克斯"，这个绰号缠了他很久。虽然斯文的许多同龄人获得了荣耀、死亡或别的职业，他却固执地继续"撑下去"。终究会有一份养老金在等着他，而他也太固守成规，学不了新行当。最终，当他比全营几乎所有人都年长时，他得了个新代号：尤利西斯。

二十年后，他带着等来的养老金退伍，盒子里有一枚不错——虽然不算特别重要——的勋章，还有大家凑钱送他的一块表。他如今可以自由地过闲适生活、享受中晚年……结果这生活正如他所担心的那样无聊透顶。

于是他前往外缘，在一家雇佣兵公司找活干，任由养老金在银行账户里堆积，等着下一次退休。也许是再二十年后。

column1: Test9 grew up on New Syrtis, raised by a scholar who idolized the iconic era of the early Star League. He grew up steeped in the honor and values of legends that may have never happened, learning to model his behavior after knights, and his techniques after the Star League gunslingers. When he was grown, he naturally went out questing to discover and nurture what remained of that lost civilization. Although he trained at the Warrior's Hall, and earned some distinction serving in the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns, he realized that the conflicts of the Inner Sphere would never let him really extend himself and work toward building a new golden age. So he went to the Periphery, where he found plenty of opportunities to hone his skills while evaluating the noble potential of the nations there. He's a valued MechWarrior wherever he goes, as his honor and clear thinking combine to make him a natural leader in crisis situations - but he rarely stays with any company for more than a year or so before another adventure pulls him away.\n\n
column2: Test9在新锡尔提斯长大，由一位崇拜星际联盟早期时代的学者抚养。他在那些或许从未发生过的传奇的荣誉与价值观中浸染成长，学着以骑士为榜样塑造行为，以星际联盟枪手为师学习技艺。成年后，他自然出发去探索并培育那失落文明留下的残迹。虽然他在战士殿堂受训，并在联邦太阳国武装部队中赢得过一些功绩，他意识到内层星域的冲突永远不会让他真正施展自己、去建设一个新的黄金时代。于是他前往外围地区，在那里他找到了大量磨炼技艺的机会，同时评估那些国家的贵族潜能。无论走到哪里，他都是受重视的机甲战士——他的荣誉与清晰思维结合，使他在危机中天生就是领袖——但他很少在任一家公司待超过一年左右，因为新的冒险总会把他拉走。\n

column1: Daksis Rand grew up with information technology as his playground. He was raised on Hachiman in the Draconis Combine, the child of IT executives, and he got an early start dabbling in the digital world. He was a rising star at the technology academy he attended, until certain extracurricular activities related to an illegal information brokerage came to light. While nothing was ever proven against him, he left the academy under a cloud of suspicion.

\nUsing his skills, he managed to hide his dubious record and get a job at Victory Industries, where he worked hard to keep his record clean. If information on a salvage breakthrough leaked, well, there was no evidence it was his fault. Except when that record he'd cleaned up came to the attention to the Internal Security Force and they considered that evidence enough.

Once again, Daksis had to forge a new identity for himself, and this time, he had to burn through quite a few connections just to survive. Once he made it to the Periphery, the pressure eased and he was able to relax a little once again. He decided, for his own health, that he ought to retire from information brokering. So now he's working as a mercenary because, as he says, it keeps him out of worse trouble.
column2:
达克西斯·兰德是在信息技术的环境中长大的。他在龙尼斯联合体的八幡长大，父母都是IT高管，他很早就开始涉足数字世界。他在就读的技术学院里是颗冉冉升起的新星，直到某些与非法情报经纪有关的课外活动被揭发。虽然从未有证据能坐实对他的指控，他还是在疑云笼罩下离开了学院。

凭借自己的技术，他设法隐藏了这段可疑记录，在胜利工业找到了一份工作，并努力保持履历清白。如果有关于某项回收技术突破的情报泄露出去，那也没有任何证据表明是他的责任。直到那份被他洗白的记录落到了内部安全局的眼里，而他们认为这足以作为证据。

达克西斯不得不再次伪造身份，而这一次，为了活命他不得不烧掉相当多的人脉。等他抵达外缘，压力总算缓解，他又能稍微放松一些了。为了自己的健康着想，他决定该从情报经纪这行退休了。所以现在他做雇佣兵，因为——用他的话说——这能让他避开更糟的麻烦。

column1: The son of a Free Worlds League blue-collar family with ambitions, Griffin Voyls was an easy-going child who nonetheless always knew his own mind. Although his family encouraged him to enlist or attend a military academy, he chose to go to a technical school because he was pretty sure the discipline of a military enlistment wouldn't suit him.

\nHowever, in his last year of school, the military made a serious attempt to recruit him, promising him a position to suit his tastes. He decided to give it a try and accepted a position as a crew member on a military DropShip. Unfortunately, while the discipline and work suited his tastes, DropShip life turned out to be far too close to the front lines for his low-key personality.

He returned to civilian work, doing technical work on industrial 'Mechs. But the war found him again. As he looked at the battlefield his work site had turned into, he realized the only way to manage in the world now was to stay moving, and his preferred way to do that was in a mercenary company. If ever he serves as a pilot, well, at least there's a whole bunch of armor between him and the enemies trying to kill him.
column2:
格里芬·沃伊尔斯出身自由世界联盟一个怀抱雄心的蓝领家庭，是个随和的孩子，却始终清楚自己的想法。尽管家人鼓励他入伍或上军事学院，他选择去技术学校，因为他相当确定军旅的纪律不适合他。

然而在学校的最后一年，军方认真地试图招募他，许诺一个合他口味的职位。他决定试一试，接受了军用空投艇乘员的职位。不幸的是，虽然纪律与工作合他口味，空投艇的生活却离前线太近，不适合他低调的个性。

他回到民用工作，为工业机甲做技术活。但战争又找到了他。当他看着自己工地变成的战场时，他意识到如今在这世上唯一的应对之道就是保持移动，而他偏好的方式就是在雇佣兵公司里。如果他真要当飞行员，嗯，至少在他和想杀他的敌人之间还有一大堆装甲。

column1: Ice Trey
column2: 冷面特雷

column1: Once an up-and-coming medium 'Mech pilot in the arenas of Solaris VII, Duncan Fisher quickly found he had a face for radio, not for tri-vid. After a decent but short stint in the arenas, Duncan fell into the life of a professional S7 caster, where he found much acclaim. He cast multiple Championship bouts in his time behind the mic and was widely beloved by the fans for his bombastic personality. Now, he's found his way into a cockpit again for a little up close and personal match analysis. Better keep the bar well-stocked with whiskey and cigars.\n\n
column2: 邓肯·费舍尔曾是索拉里斯VII竞技场上一名冉冉升起的中型机师，但他很快发现自己的脸适合电台而非全息影像。在竞技场度过了体面而短暂的一段生涯之后，邓肯投身职业S7解说员的生活，在那里大受赞誉。他在麦克风后解说过多场冠军赛，因其夸张张扬的个性深受粉丝喜爱。如今他又找回了座舱里的位置，来做一些近距离、面对面的比赛分析。最好让威士忌和雪茄的储备保持充足。\n\n

column1: Born on Solaris VII, Chris \"Harmony\" Johnson was an aspiring MechWarrior as well as a match commentator. Getting his start in the more niche arenas that were not officially sanctioned by the Solaris VII board, Harmony grew in popularity among the crowds in the brutal sport of 'Mech combat both as a fighter and as a commentator.

However, once he had gotten enough experience to make it to the big leagues, his dreams were crushed when he was told that 'there's only enough room for one snarky sarcastic 'Mech jock in the business' by his agent. Disillusioned with the glimmer and glam of life in the city of gladiators, Harmony struck out into the Inner Sphere, determined to find the best match of all on a real battlefield.
column2: 克里斯·"和谐"·约翰逊生于索拉里斯 VII，既是抱负远大的机甲战士，也是赛事解说员。他从索拉里斯 VII 董事会未正式认可的偏门竞技场起步，在这项残酷的机甲近战运动中，作为战士与解说员同时赢得了观众的喜爱。\n\n然而当他积累了足够经验、即将齐身大联盟时，经纪人告诉他"这行只容得下一个尖酸刻薄的机甲佬"，他的梦想就此破灭。对这座角斗士之城的浮华幻灭后，"和谐"闯向内天体，决心在真正的战场上找到最好的那一场对决。

column1: Although Klyst hasn't seen much real battlefield action, she has a solid experience of 'Mech warfare from her time in the Solaris Games, where she fought as a renowned lone gladiator through multiple seasons. A relentless warrior with a lone wolf mind, whose out-of-the-box thinking surprised more than one gladiator team, she favors mobility and firepower over protection - medium and heavy 'Mechs packing a punch and jump jets are her thing, although she won't give the cold shoulder to assault-class 'Mechs... as long as they are fitted with jump jets.\n\n
column2: 虽然克里斯特没怎么经历过真正的战场，但她在索拉里斯竞技大赛中作为知名独狼角斗士征战多个赛季，积累了扎实的机甲战斗经验。她是个不屈的战士，心思如独狼，其跳出框框的思路让不止一支角斗士队伍吃惊。她偏爱机动性与火力而非防护——能打出重击并装有跳跃推进器的中重型机甲是她的最爱；不过她也不会冷落突击级机甲……只要装上了跳跃推进器。

column1: Dan got his start, like most enigmatic anti-heroes, on some forgotten Deep Periphery world, where the only education was the School of Hard Knocks. Realizing life on Planet Noir was not going to end well, regardless of what some woman in red claimed, Dan found passage off the planet with some space whalers who hailed from the Jarnfolk region. What he didn't know then was, they weren't just sea-shanty singing lunatics hunting hallucinations of space whales, but a top secret black-ops group hunting Killer Whale missile systems from the old SLDF. After a few years, and significant training to correct Dan's issue of calling every moving piece of metal an Atlas, the group found a cache of SLDF 'Mechs instead of the promised Killer Whales. Dan, inquisitive as ever, jumped into one and turned it on, triggering the cache's self-destruct and killing his compatriots, while he walked out unscathed in a pristine SLDF 'Mech. His last words to the group were \"This will be a whale of a good time!\".\n\n
column2: 丹的起点，像大多数神秘的反英雄一样，是在某个被遗忘的深远外缘世界，那里唯一的教育就是"社会大学"。意识到无论某个红衣女人怎么说，在黑色行星上的生活都不会有好结局，丹搭上了一些来自雅恩福克地区的太空捕鲸人的船离开了行星。他当时不知道的是，他们不只是唱着船歌、猎捕太空鲸幻影的疯子，而是一个绝密黑色行动小组，专门追猎旧SLDF的杀人鲸导弹系统。几年之后，在大量训练纠正了丹把所有会动的金属都叫阿特拉斯的毛病之后，这群人发现了一处SLDF机甲库存，而不是承诺中的杀人鲸。丹一如既往地好奇，跳进一台并启动它，触发了库存的自毁，杀死了他的同伴，而他自己毫发无伤地走出来，坐在一台崭新的SLDF机甲里。他对这群人说的最后一句话是："这会是一段鲸喜连连的好时光！"\n\n
