column1: If this cargo is valuable enough to pay us to steal it, it's going to be extremely well-defended. Be prepared, Commander.
column2: 如果这批货值钱到能雇我们来偷，那它的防守一定极其严密。做好准备，指挥官。

column1: A team of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} agents has obtained the schedule and manifest of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy. This convoy's cargo is extremely valuable technological components. We want you to steal them for us. Stage an ambush of the convoy, destroy the vehicles, and we'll send in a recovery team to gather the cargo. There's a bonus if you secure the area and eliminate all the convoy guards.
column2: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}特工小队已获取了一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}运输队的行程与货单。这支运输队的货物是极其珍贵的技术部件。我们要你替我们把它偷回来。设伏袭击运输队，摧毁车辆，我们会派回收小组去收取货物。如果你能控制该区域并消灭所有运输队护卫，还有额外奖金。

column1: Looks like the intel our employers provided was accurate. We're tracking multiple vehicles in the area.
column2: 看来雇主提供的情报是准确的。我们在这个区域跟踪到多台车辆。

column1: Stolen Goods
column2: 赃物

column1: Rolling Metal
column2: 轧制金属

column1: Don't underestimate the Schrek, Commander. It's tough as hell and carries three PPCs, and has the heat capacity to fire them non-stop.
column2: 别低估士莱克，指挥官。它硬得不像话，装有三门粒子炮，并有足够的散热能力持续开火。

column1: Our sources on the planet have alerted us to a convoy of vehicles being transferred to an otherwise undefended military base. If we act quickly, we can destroy that convoy before it has a chance to reinforce the base. Normally we wouldn't be concerned about a simple vehicle convoy, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence operatives report that one of the vehicles is a fully operational Schrek PPC carrier. That's not a threat we can afford to ignore. We need you to eliminate that convoy before they make it to their base.
column2: 我们在行星上的情报来源提醒我们，一支车辆车队正被转移到一处原本无人防守的军事基地。若我们行动迅速，就能在车队有机会增援基地之前将其摧毁。通常我们不会在意一支简单的车辆车队，但{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报人员报告说，其中一辆是完全可用的施雷克PPC车辆。那是我们不能忽视的威胁。我们需要你在他们抵达基地之前消灭那支车队。

column1: Destroy the Armored Convoy and Escape
column2: 消灭装甲车队并摆脱敌人

column1: This is the area, Commander. The armored column should be just ahead.
column2: 就是这片地区，指挥官. 装甲纵队应该就在前面.

column1: Terrorist Convoy
column2: 恐怖分子车队

column1: Commander, this smells political, and that makes me nervous. I suggest we go in, take care of the convoy, and get out again, without too many questions. There's a bonus from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} if we clean up all the enemy forces, but that's up to you.
column2: 指挥官，这事有政治味道，而让我紧张。我建议我们进去，处理掉车队，然后撤出来，别问太多问题。如果我们把敌军全清掉，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会额外付奖金，但那由你决定。

column1: Terrorist strikes against our facilities have increased, and our intel says {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is bankrolling the terrorists and providing logistical support in the form of small arms, explosives, and medical supplies. We need you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoy and destroy it before it reaches the terrorists.
column2: 恐怖分子针对我们设施的袭击越来越多了，根据我们的情报来看，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在资助恐怖分子，以轻武器、炸药和医疗用品的形式提供后勤支援. 我们需要你拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给车队，并且在它抵达恐怖分子之前就消灭它.

column1: Destroy the Terrorist Convoy and Escape
column2: 消灭恐怖分子车队并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the Terrorist Supply Convoy
column2: 消灭恐怖分子的补给车队

column1: Thorny Problem
column2: 棘手的问题

column1: It's a solid plan, Commander, as long as they're right about the light defenses.
column2: 这是个稳妥的计划，指挥官，只要他们关于防御薄弱的情报没错。

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} control of this world is nearly absolute. We've identified a point of vulnerability, however: they move supplies and weapons by convoy, and those convoys are lightly defended by a single lance of 'Mechs. If we destroy enough of their supply convoys, their other operations will be weakened enough for our forces to move in and take advantage of their fragility. We don't want to tip our hand, however, so we'd like you to engage in a little guerilla warfare on our behalf.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}对这颗星球的控制几乎固若金汤。不过，我们找到了一个可乘之机：他们的补给与武器都靠运输车队运送，而护卫车队的只有一支机甲小队，防御薄弱。只要摧毁足够多的补给车队，他们的其他行动就会被削弱到足以让我方部队趁虚而入、利用其脆弱局面的程度。不过，我们不想过早暴露意图，所以希望你能替我们打一场小小的游击战。

column1: Straightforward and successful: my favorite kind of mission.
column2: 简单明了就能成功: 这就是我喜欢的任务类型.

column1: That bonus is ours, assuming we take out the convoy.
column2: 那个额外奖励归我们了，假如我们干掉车队的话.

column1: This is as close as I can get you without tripping every early warning system in the area. If you move up to here, you should be able to see the targets.
column2: 不触发这一地区的预警系统的话，我最多可以带你们到这儿. 如果你前进到这儿，应该就能看到目标了.

column1: It's a solid plan, Commander, as long as they're right about the defenses being light.
column2: 这是个稳妥的计划，指挥官，只要他们关于防御薄弱的情报没错。

column1: Affirmative, Meyer. Commander, be warned; there may be additional enemy forces in the field. Dammit.
column2: 明白，梅耶尔. 指挥官，请注意; 战场上可能会有其它敌军. 该死的.

column1: Well, despite the unexpected second lance, that was straightforward and successful.
column2: 好吧，尽管出现了意外的第二支小队，这次行动仍然简单明了且成功.

column1: Obviously, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would prefer to salvage the lostech themselves, requiring us to clear out any defending forces. Thus, they're paying more if we clear out the defenders.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}显然更愿意亲自回收这些失传科技，因此需要我们清除任何防守部队。所以，如果我们清掉守军，他们会付更多钱。

column1: We need to make a deniable strike on a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy. Intel shows the convoy is a shipment of weapons, including at least one intact Star League era weapon system. That level of technology could shift the balance of power in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} - something {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership isn't willing to tolerate.
column2: 我们需要对一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队进行一次可否认的打击。情报显示该车队运的是武器，其中至少有一套完好的星盟时代武器系统。那种技术水平可能改变{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的力量平衡——这是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层不愿容忍的。

column1: Inferno Rack
column2: 炼狱发射架

column1: Not Set
column2: 未设置

column1: Yang Artillery
column2: 杨氏火炮

column1: The Argo's drive is only operating at a fraction of its potential, Commander. With some time and materials, I believe I can boost the output of the secondary fusion reactors - to put it simply, I'll make the Argo go faster.
column2: 阿戈号的推进器只发挥了其潜力的一小部分，指挥官。给我一些时间和材料，我相信我能提升次级聚变反应堆的输出——简单说，我会让阿戈号跑得更快。

column1: The Argo's drive was enough to get it off the surface of a low-gravity moon, but much of the supporting infrastructure was damaged in the escape, and running the drive at full power requires extensive repairs. Once the repairs are complete, the drive can generate 1.5 g of thrust.
column2: 阿戈号的推进器足以让它脱离一颗低重力卫星的地表，但逃生时大量配套基础设施受损，要以全功率运转推进器需要大规模维修。维修完成后，推进器能产生1.5G推力。

column1: Drive Repairs
column2: 修复驱动器

column1: The Argo's drive is far more powerful than I suspected. We may not ever bring it completely back online, but for now I can increase our thrust. While 2 g is not comfortable and the crew will complain, we'll cut our travel times significantly.
column2: 阿戈号的推进器远比我猜想的强大。我们或许永远无法让它完全重新上线，但目前我可以提高我们的推力。虽然2G并不舒适，船员也会有怨言，但我们的航行时间将大幅缩短。

column1: The Argo can, in a pinch, generate quite a bit more thrust than it first seemed. By repairing a number of drive subsystems meant to increase thrust efficiency, it’s possible to get the Argo up to an uncomfortable 2 g of sustained thrust.
column2: 阿尔戈在紧急情况下能产生的推力比最初看起来要多不少。通过修复若干旨在提升推力效率的驱动子系统，可以让阿尔戈维持一段难受的2G持续推力。

column1: Drive Upgrades
column2: 升级驱动器

column1: The Argo's drive is far more powerful than I suspected. We may not ever bring it completely back online, but for now I can increase our thrust. While 3 g is not comfortable and the crew will complain, we'll cut our travel times significantly.
column2: 阿戈号的推进器远比我猜想的强大。我们或许永远无法让它完全重新上线，但目前我可以提高我们的推力。虽然3G并不舒适，船员也会有怨言，但我们的航行时间将大幅缩短。

column1: The Argo's drive can be upgraded to allow for a severe High-G burn, but it's gonna be a strain on the System and Structure, and your budget.
column2: 阿尔戈的驱动器可升级以支持剧烈的高G燃烧，但这会对系统与结构造成负担，也会给你的预算造成压力。

column1: High-G Burn Drive Upgrade
column2: 高G过载驱动升级

column1: Finally I would be able see where to land in advance! No more accidentally landing in a swamp because Darius sent us to the wrong area.
column2: 我终于能提前看清着陆地点了！再也不会因为达吕斯把咱们派错了地方，而意外降落在沼泽里了.

column1: The current sensor systems have lacked the capabilities to properly map the terrain in our mission drop zones. With some simple rewiring and adding the proper software to the Argo computers, we can adapt the general sensor array to support terrain scans.
column2: 目前的传感器系统一直缺乏对任务空降区地形进行精确测绘的能力. 通过一些简单的线路改造，并为阿尔戈号的计算机加装合适的软件，我们就能将通用传感器阵列改造为可支持地形扫描的配置.

column1: Terrain Mapping Sensors
column2: 传感器-地形测绘

column1: With this upgrade, my intel will be a lot more accurate of the battle conditions. I hope.
column2: 希望有了这次升级，我的情报对战场状况的把握会精准得多. 但愿吧.

column1: By further upgrading our sensor systems and connect them to a series of autonomous satellites it would be possible to monitor weather systems and unusual geological characteristics in the whole star system.
column2: 通过进一步升级我们的传感器系统，并将其与一系列自主卫星相连，就有可能监测整个恒星系的气象系统及异常地质特征.

column1: Weather Monitoring Systems
column2: 气象监测系统

column1: With this we can support dropping an additional Mech onto the battlefield.
column2: 有了这个，我们就能额外向战场空降一台机甲.

column1: So it turns out the docking cradles were salvaged for parts and scrap, but the mounting points are still intact. I can get my techs to work fabricating new 'Mech cradles, Commander, but it's gonna take a while to get everything rebuilt. I think there's enough pieces left behind to get one assembled quickly, though.
column2: 结果发现那些对接架已被拆解成零件与废料，但安装点还完好。指挥官，我可以让技师们去制造新的机甲托架，但把所有东西重建起来要花些时间。不过我觉得留下的零件足够快装出一台来。

column1: Leopard: Drop Bay 1
column2: 豹式: 1号空降舱

column1: This will use up the last of the parts that weren't salvaged, but at least we were able to keep the costs down, right?
column2: 这会用掉最后一批没被回收的部件，但至少我们把成本压下来了，对吧？

column1: The first cradle turned out alright, Boss. There's enough scrap left lying around we should be able to construct the bones of a gantry for the next, but we're also gonna need to buy several complex components to get the next cradle ready for use.
column2: 第一个机架做出来还不错，老大。周围剩下的废料应该够我们搭出下个机架的龙门骨架，但我们还需要买几个复杂部件才能让下一个机架准备就绪。

column1: Leopard: Drop Bay 2
column2: 豹式: 2号空降舱

column1: The cradles can be completed, but Sumire has some concerns. You should talk to her before trying to field a full extra lance, Boss.
column2: 托架可以完成，但苏米尔有些顾虑. 头儿，在尝试投入一整支额外小队前，您应该先和她谈谈.

column1: Half-done now, Boss. It's really starting to look like a proper dropship. I can get started on fabricating parts to assemble the final two cradles from scratch. Producing both sets of parts at the same time should save us a little time and money.
column2: 现在完成一半了，老大。它真的开始看起来像一艘像样的空投艇了。我可以开始从头制造部件，来组装最后两个机架。同时生产两套部件应该能帮我们省一点时间和钱。

column1: Leopard: Drop Bay 3
column2: 豹式: 3号空降舱

column1: Making sure our people can make it to the mission is the first real step to victory.
column2: 确保我们的人能顺利抵达任务地点，是迈向胜利的真正第一步.

column1: There's more to dropping a lance of BattleMechs from orbit than strapping them to a wall, Commander. Several of the gyros and handling sensors around the ship are damaged or downright missing. If we try to insert the ship from orbit with all four 'Mech cradles occupied, using anything less than an absolutely perfectly balanced load could lead to a very real chance of losing the shuttle and all aboard. We'll need to replace and recalibrate those systems through some test drops before we can make full use of the new Leopard, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，把一支机甲分队从轨道上投下去，可不只是把它们捆在墙上那么简单。舰上好几具陀螺仪和操纵传感器已经损坏，甚至干脆不见了。如果我们载满四个机甲机架从轨道投放飞船，只要载荷不是绝对完美的平衡，就极有可能连穿梭机带机上所有人一起损失。指挥官，我们得先通过几次试投放来更换并重新校准这些系统，才能充分发挥这艘新豹式的能力。

column1: Leopard: Drop Bay 4
column2: 豹式: 4号空降舱

column1: If we get this up and running, our tactical flexibility will take a big step up, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，如果我们能让这东西投入运作，我们的战术灵活性将向前迈进一大步.

column1: We managed to find someone selling a junked Leopard, Commander. The seller says it 'ran when parked'. If we can get it fully operational again, we'd be able to drop some Heavy Metal!
column2: 我们设法找到有人在卖一艘报废的豹式，指挥官。卖家说它"停车时还能跑"。如果我们能让它重新完全运作，我们就能投送一些重金属了！

column1: Junkyard Leopard
column2: 废弃豹式

column1: Processors that can handle this kind of raw data-bandwidth are LosTech these days, Commander. I'm sorry, but this won't be cheap.
column2: 指挥官，如今能处理这种原始数据带宽的处理器已属失落科技。抱歉，这不会便宜。

column1: Further Repairs on the Leopard's Mechbays allows more efficient storage of units and equipment.
column2: 对豹式机甲舱的进一步修复能更高效地储存单位与装备。

column1: Leopard: Utilize Storage Areas
column2: 豹式: 利用存储区域

column1: At this point, I think only ComStar can claim to have better communication infrastructure in a single place.
column2: 事到如今，我想只有通讯之星敢说能在一个地方拥有比我们更好的通讯基础设施了.

column1: Freed space on the Leopard allows to store munitions and replacement Parts easier.
column2: 豹式空投艇上腾出的空间使得弹药与替换零件的存储更加便捷.

column1: Leopard: Munition Dump
column2: 豹式: 弹药库

column1: This stuff can't do the work for me, but it comes awfully close. You want to speed things up around here, give me the resources to get these machines back online.
column2: 这些材料没法替我把活干了，但已经很接近了。你想让这里的事快点推进，就给我资源让这些机器重新上线。

column1: Many of the Argo's Mech Bay systems were only meant to be used with sophisticated Star League–era automation. Bringing that automation even partially back online is a substantial force multiplier to Yang's skills. Enables second Repair bay to work at 100% efficiency.
column2: 阿戈号机甲库的许多系统原本只应与精密的星盟时代自动化配合使用。让那种自动化哪怕部分重新上线，都是对杨技能的大幅加成。使第二个维修舱能以100%效率工作。

column1: There's machines hidden in the walls, under the floor panels — I don't even know what half of it does. But I turned one on and it built a 'Mech leg before I was able to shut it off. We make these work, we'll be moving 'Mechs out of repair in record time.
column2: 墙里、地板下都藏着机器——我连一半是干什么用的都不知道。但我启动了一台，在我能关掉它之前它就造出了一条机甲腿。要是我们把它们弄好，我们就能以创纪录的速度让机甲出维修线。

column1: Repairs to the Mech Bay have unearthed a much more extensive system of 'Mech maintenance automation than Yang previously suspected. Once it's back online, many common tasks will become trivial. Enables third Repair bay to work at 100% efficiency.
column2: 机甲库的维修发掘出了比杨先前所料广泛得多的机甲维护自动化系统。一旦它重新上线，许多常见工作都会变得轻而易举。使第三个维修舱能以100%效率工作。

column1: Improved Automation
column2: 改良的自动化系统

column1: Okay, what we've got here is a fully outfitted machine shop, and a whole lot of data on 'Mech specifications. Get this back online, and we'll be machining our own parts, probably better than the ones coming out of the Taurian factories. Faster, too.
column2: 好，我们这里有一间装备齐全的机加工车间，以及一大堆关于机甲规格的数据。让这里重新上线，我们就能自己加工零件，大概比陶里安工厂出产的更好。也更快。

column1: Maintaining 'Mechs in the Succession War era is complicated by the relative rarity of precision-manufactured parts. The Argo's machine shop, once repaired and brought online, can help address this lack.
column2: 在继承战争时代维护机甲之所以复杂，正是因为精密制造的部件相对稀少。阿戈号的机加工车间一旦修好并上线，就能帮助缓解这种短缺。

column1: Machine Shop
column2: 机甲车间

column1: You always see cables and stuff hanging down from the ceiling and think, 'What the hell are those for?' Right? Lifting and turning entire 'Mechs. We get them back online, and we can lift a whole 'Mech. I mean, honestly? I just want to see that happen.
column2: 你总是看见天花板上垂着线缆之类的东西，心里想"这些到底是干嘛用的？"对吧？那是用来吊起并翻转整台机甲的。我们让它们重新运转，就能吊起一整台机甲。老实说？我就是想亲眼看到那一幕。

column1: 'Mechs were not really meant to bear their own weight while being refitted with new equipment. The Argo's Mech Bay includes harnesses meant to hoist the 'Mech up for easier access while refitting.
column2: 机甲本来并不是为了在换装新装备时承受自身的重量而设计的。阿戈号的机甲库配有吊具，用于把机甲吊起，方便改装时接近。

column1: Refit Harness
column2: 改造吊具

column1: The platforms around here are meant to move automatically when they detect the size of the 'Mech we're working on, adjusting to be at just the right height. They're all off-line, and we've been working around that, but… let's get them fixed and speed this up.
column2: 这附近的平台本该在检测到我们正在作业的机甲尺寸时自动移动，调整到刚好合适的高度。它们全都离线了，我们一直绕着这个干活，不过……让我们把它们修好，加快进度。

column1: The Argo's 'Mech cubicles used to have a complex system of movable walkways and scaffolds for accessing any part of a damaged 'Mech. Those walkways, once brought online, make the job of repairing 'Mechs much simpler.
column2: 阿戈号的机甲隔间过去有一套复杂的可移动走道与脚手架系统，用来接近受损机甲的任意部位。一旦让那些走道重新上线，维修机甲的工作就会简单得多。

column1: Repair Scaffolding
column2: 维修脚手架

column1: The Argo's Mech Bay is vast, spacious, and meant to be entirely managed by complex automation. Currently, 6 of the 18 total 'Mech cubicles are powered and in working order, and almost none of the automation.
column2: 阿戈号的机甲库广阔、宽敞，本应完全由复杂的自动化系统管理。目前，18个机甲隔间中有6个已通电并处于可用状态，而自动化几乎一点也没有。

column1: Mech Bay 1
column2: 1号机甲舱

column1: We've got a lot of extra space in here, Commander. It's just full of junk and pirate garbage, and half of the walls are missing. I could pull my engineers off 'Mech duties and we could probably get another six 'Mech cubicles online. Just say the word.
column2: 我们这里多出了不少空间，指挥官。只是里面堆满了垃圾和海盗的破烂，一半的墙还不见了。我可以把我的工程师从机甲维护岗上调走，大概能让另外六个机甲机库上线。你一句话就行。

column1: The repaired power conduits allow six more 'Mech cubicles to be powered up and made available. This also brings more of the Mech Bay's automated systems online, making Yang's job easier. \n\n Enables second Repair bay, allows work on a second 'Mech's at 50% efficiency.
column2: 修复后的电力导管让另外6个机甲隔间得以通电启用，也让机甲库更多自动化系统上线，减轻杨的工作负担。\n\n 启用第二个维修舱，可同时以50%效率维修第二台机甲。

column1: Mech Bay 2
column2: 2号机甲舱

column1: The power's back on to the rest of the Mech Bay, and we can start repairs on the last 6 cubicles. Even if you don't want to fill them with 'Mechs, believe me, I can put the extra space to good use. It's gonna take a shitload of work, though.
column2: 机甲库其余部分的电力已经恢复，我们可以开始修复最后6个隔间了。就算你不打算用机甲把它们填满，相信我，我也能让多出来的空间派上大用场。不过这可是个大工程。

column1: With the Argo's power systems fully online, and enough reinforcement to keep the active Bays from damaging the ship's spine, the final 6 'Mech cubicles can be powered up and put to work. \n\n Enables third Repair bay, allows work on a third 'Mech at 33% efficiency..
column2: 随着阿戈号动力系统完全上线，加上足够的加固使已启用的舱室不会损伤舰体脊骨，最后6个机甲隔间可以通电并投入使用了。\n< 启用第三个维修舱，允许以33%效率对第三台机甲作业。。

column1: Mech Bay 3
column2: 3号机甲舱

column1: We've found a way to get the whole secondary Mech hangar online, but the cost will be high. But it will be worth it in my opinion, not only does it let us have more Mechs ready, it also gives us more space to work on them.
column2: 我们找到办法让整个第二机甲库上线了，但代价会很高。不过我认为值得：它不仅让我们能备妥更多机甲，还给我们更多维修空间。

column1:
<color=#0033FF>Unlocked through Events.</color>

The secondary Mech Hangar allows for having another 18 mechs readied at any time.

<color=#FF0000>Note: There is no way to move Mechs between the two hangars.</color>
column2:
<color=#0033FF>通过事件解锁。</color>

次级机甲机库允许随时另外备妥18台机甲。

<color=#FF0000>注意：无法在两个机库之间移动机甲。</color>

column1: Mech Hangar 2
column2: 机甲舱2

column1: Commander, the medics are talking about all the advanced facilities, and we now have sufficient power to operate it all. We'd need to do a major overhaul of all our Med Bays, but we'd substantially increase our ability to treat severe injuries.
column2: 指挥官，医护兵们一直在谈论那些先进设施，而我们现在有足够的电力让它们全部运转。我们需要对所有医疗舱做大改造，但我们的重伤救治能力将大幅提升。

column1: The original Argo specifications had room and infrastructure for actual hospital facilities, rather than just simple Med Bays. With a full hospital's worth of equipment and connections to the ship's library and databases, the MedTechs are able to perform near-miracles of healing. All Med Bays will be converted into Hospital Bays.
column2: 阿戈号原本的设计规格中，就有容纳真正医院设施的空间与基础设施，而不只是简单的医疗舱。有了完整的医院级设备，以及与舰上图书馆和数据库的连接，医疗技师们能够创造出近乎奇迹的疗愈效果。所有医疗舱都将改建为医院舱。

column1: Hospital Bay
column2: 医院室

column1: This field hospital has a small number of beds, surgical equipment, and medical supplies. The cost includes the salary of a skilled MedTech to treat your injured MechWarriors.
column2: 这处野战医院只有少量的床位、手术设备和医疗用品. 相关费用包含一名熟练的医疗技师的工资，用于治疗受伤的机甲战士.

column1: Med Bay 1
column2: 1号医务室

column1: Commander, the existing Med Bay is able to keep up, but just barely. Nobody's dying for lack of treatment, but our medics are overworked. Beta Pod has an entire additional medical bay, unused and waiting to be renovated and powered back up.
column2: 指挥官，现有的医疗舱勉强跟得上，但也只是勉强。没人因为得不到治疗而死，但我们的医护兵超负荷了。贝塔舱有一间完整的额外医疗舱，闲置未用，等着翻新并重新通电。

column1: This expanded field hospital allows for two MedTechs to work side by side, meaning more capacity to treat patients. The cost includes the salary of an additional skilled MedTech to treat your injured MechWarriors.
column2: 这处扩建的野战医院允许两名医疗技师一起工作，意味着能治疗更多病人. 相关费用包含一名额外的熟练医疗技师的薪水，用于治疗受伤的机甲战士.

column1: Med Bay 2
column2: 2号医务室

column1: We're taking enough injuries to keep our current medical staff fully tasked, Commander, and that makes me worry about our future capacity. These battles aren't getting any easier. We have the space for another Med Bay, and I'm sure we'd find it useful.
column2: 我们受的伤已经足够让我们当前的医务人员满负荷了，指挥官，这让我担心我们未来的容量。这些战斗不会变得更容易。我们有空间再设一间医疗舱，我相信它会派上用场。

column1: The fully upgraded field hospital has enough bed space, diagnostic equipment, and surgeries to allow fully half the company to be treated at once. The cost includes the salary of an additional skilled MedTech to treat your injured MechWarriors.
column2: 全面升级后的野战医院有着充足的床位、诊断设备以及手术室，足够同时治疗公司的一半人马. 相关费用包括含一名额外的熟练医疗技师的薪水，用于治疗受伤的机甲战士.

column1: Med Bay 3
column2: 3号医务室

column1: Basic MRB Contract Console that allows bidding on all standard contracts and flashpoints.
column2: 基础型佣兵审核委员会合约控制台，可竞标所有标准合约及冲突点任务.

column1: MRB Contract Console
column2: MRB合约控制台

column1: Each of the three pods is meant to be a mostly self-sufficient habitation space. Alpha Pod, as its interior labeling designates it, is the only one of the three to have retained its pressure seal, making its interior (mostly) habitable.
column2: 三个舱室中的每一个都意味着一处基本自给自足的居住空间. 阿尔法舱就如同内部标签上标示的那样，是三个舱室中唯一保持气密性的一个，从而使其内部(基本)宜居.

column1: Alpha Pod
column2: 阿尔法舱

column1: The crew has seen the Beta Pod rec facilities on the ship's floor plans, Commander, and it's all they can talk about. More practically, we'd be able to bring the Beta Pod medical facilities back online.
column2: 船员们在舰上平面图里看到了贝塔舱的娱乐设施，指挥官，他们满嘴都是这个。更实际地说，我们还能让贝塔舱的医疗设施重新上线。

column1: Beta Pod, once repaired, includes what was clearly once a hydroponics facility near the spine of the Argo, and a low-g gymnasium just above that. Neither survived exposure to hard vacuum and stellar radiation, but they're tantalizing indications of the luxuries the Argo once included. \n\n +10 Days before Affinities Decay.
column2: 贝塔吊舱一经修复，其中显然曾有一处在阿尔戈脊柱附近的水培设施，其上方还有一间低重力健身房。两者都没能挺过硬真空与恒星辐射，但它们令人遐想地暗示着阿尔戈曾经拥有的奢侈配置。\n\n 偏好力衰减前+10天。

column1: Beta Pod
column2: 贝塔舱

column1: Commander, there are already a half dozen requests for new facilities for Gamma Pod, ranging from a swimming pool to a DropShip-sized bouncy castle. On a more practical note, we could also begin using the Gamma Pod medical facilities.
column2: 指挥官，关于伽玛舱的新设施已经有6份请求了，从游泳池到空投艇大小的充气城堡. 有份实际一点的记录是，我们可以开始利用伽玛舱的医疗设施.

column1: Gamma Pod is very much a blank slate, as only its internal support structures survived intact. Rebuilding the habitation decks of the pod still leaves plenty of space for other facilities. \n\n +10 Days before Affinities Decay.
column2: 伽马舱基本是一张白纸，只有其内部支撑结构完好幸存。重建该舱的居住甲板之后，仍会剩下充足空间用于其他设施。\n< 契合度衰减前+10天。

column1: Gamma Pod
column2: 伽玛舱

column1: I'm terrified of the current state of the power system, Commander. Repairing it should be a top priority. We cannot bring most of the Argo's other systems online until the power is stable. Also… I'd avoid touching any exposed deck plating. Just in case.
column2: 我对电力系统的现状感到恐惧，指挥官。修好它应当是最高优先事项。在电力稳定之前，我们无法让阿戈号的大部分其他系统上线。另外……我会避免触碰任何裸露的甲板板。以防万一。

column1: The Argo's power system is a wreck, and getting a minimal level of power to the ship's systems without constant tripped breakers and brownouts is a minor miracle.
column2: 阿戈号的动力系统一团糟，能让舰上系统获得最低水平的电力、又不会不断跳闸和电压不足，已经算是个小小的奇迹。

column1: Repaired Power Conduits
column2: 修复后的电力管道

column1: Notably, upgrading the power system will allow us to provide power to all three habitation pods, which means more room and more Argo systems operational.
column2: 值得注意的是，升级动力系统将使我们能向全部三个居住舱供电，这意味着更多空间，也能让更多阿戈号系统投入运转。

column1: Running power through patched-together conduits isn’t reliable or safe. Upgrading all the conduits throughout the Argo is a monumental task, but necessary for anything that places a significant load on the system.
column2: 通过临时拼凑的导管输电既不可靠也不安全。升级阿戈号全舰的所有导管是一项浩大工程，但对任何会给系统带来显著负荷的东西都是必需的。

column1: Improved Power Conduits
column2: 改良的电力管道

column1: This is a remarkable ship. I continue to be astonished at how advanced portions of the Argo's infrastructure are. We're not even running the drive at half the power it can handle. More power means more thrust, Commander.
column2: 这是一艘了不起的船。我不断惊讶于阿戈号基础设施的某些部分有多么先进。我们连它推进器能承受的一半功率都没用到。更多功率意味着更大推力，指挥官。

column1: The Argo was intended to operate at a much higher total power throughput than the jury-rigged conduits can manage. With this upgrade we can bring some weapons online that should help us stave of some attackers.
column2: 阿尔戈原本设计的总功率传递量远高于这些临时拼凑的导管所能承受。有了这次升级，我们就能让一些武器上线，帮我们挡下一些袭击者。

column1: High-Capacity Power Conduits
column2: 大容量电力管道

column1: There's this game, Commander. No, hear me out, I'm serious! It's called DropShip Commander, and you pilot a Leopard in a bunch of battle scenarios. Now, I'm not saying this game will make me a better pilot. But I'm not saying it won't, either.
column2: 有这么个游戏，指挥官。不，听我说完，我是认真的！它叫《空投艇指挥官》，你在里面驾驶一艘豹式打一堆战斗剧本。我不是说这游戏能让我成为更好的飞行员。但我也不说它不能。

column1: That empty storage space in Gamma Pod, with some additional power conduits, could easily support a handful of 2-D and 3-D game systems. It's no replacement for the training units, but it's more fun.
column2: 伽马舱里那块闲置的存储空间，加上一些额外电力导管，能轻松支持几套2D和3D游戏系统。它替代不了训练单元，但更好玩。

column1: Just look at this, a Candy Machine and deluxe set of AeroTech, you got to learn how Flyboys think, Boss!.
column2: 快瞧这个，一台糖果机和豪华版空战技术套装，头儿，你得学学那些飞行员是怎么想的！

column1: With some more refurbishment the Arcade can be easily upgraded to give more opportunities to relax and unwind.
column2: 只要再稍加整修，娱乐厅就能轻松升级，提供更多放松和消遣的机会.

column1: Upgraded Arcade
column2: 升级版娱乐厅

column1: Manipulating of our people is surprisingly easy. I am not sure if this is worrisome or not.
column2: 操纵咱们的人真是出奇的容易. 我都不确定这算不算值得担忧的事了.

column1: Introduce an award for the Employee of the week, which involves putting their picture on the wall with a golden frame and a small monetary gift. It's the perfect way to boost egos, just don't tell them it's a fake award that everyone will get it over time.
column2: 设立“每周最佳员工”奖项：把他们的照片配上金色相框挂到墙上，再给一份小额奖金。这是激发自尊心的绝佳方式，只是别告诉他们这其实是个假奖项，人人迟早都会得。

column1: Employee of the Week
column2: 本周最佳员工

column1: I suspect a solid majority of the complaints I've received from the MechWarriors are simple idleness. With fitness facilities, I could solve that idleness for them, Commander. If you take my meaning.
column2: 我怀疑我收到的机甲战士投诉中有相当一部分只是闲得慌。指挥官，如果有机身训练设施，我就能替他们解决这份闲情。你懂我的意思。

column1: MechWarriors have to maintain their physical condition, and doing so in their own quarters is claustrophobic and distracting. Luckily, the Argo has a full gymnasium, needing only repair and power.
column2: 机甲战士必须保持体能，而在自己舱室里锻炼既幽闭又分心。所幸阿尔戈有完整的健身房，只需修理并通电。

column1: Now that we got the Argo gymnasium working, we can add some better Equipment and Showers.
column2: 既然我们让阿戈号的健身房运作起来了，我们可以加一些更好的设备和淋浴间。

column1: Upgraded Gymnasium
column2: 升级版健身房

column1: I've looked over Gamma Pod, Commander, and most of the original plumbing is intact. With a small amount of effort, we could repair the hydroponics and have fresh herbs and vegetables instead of reconstituted paste in the galley. Just a thought.
column2: 我看过伽马舱了，指挥官，大部分原有管道都还完好。只需花点小力气，我们就能修好水培系统，让厨房里有新鲜香草和蔬菜，而不是复原糊。只是个想法。

column1: Near the spine, the spin of the pods isn't sufficient to generate any real apparent gravity. This makes those areas bad for living in, but excellent for growing hydroponic crops. They freshen the air and add variety to mealtimes.
column2: 在脊柱附近，吊舱的旋转不足以产生任何真正可感知的重力。这使那些区域不适合居住，却非常适合种植水培作物——它们能清新空气，也让餐桌多些花样。

column1: Hydroponic Garden
column2: 无土栽培室

column1: I've looked over the Hydroponic Gardens in Gamma Pod, Commander, and there's several key areas we could greatly improve and expand upon.
column2: 我看过伽马舱的水培花园了，指挥官，有几处关键区域我们可以大幅改进和扩展。

column1: More hydroponic crops means not only even fresher air, along with an greater variety to our mealtimes, but it would also reduce our monthly costs even further!
column2: 更多的水培作物不仅意味着更清新的空气和用餐时更丰富的种类，还能进一步降低我们的月度开销！

column1: Enhanced Hydroponic Gardens
column2: 升级版水培花园

column1: I swear to the gods, trying to read a technical readout in that lounge is impossible. Commander, I need to keep up with the latest tech to do my job, and I can't do it while the MechWarriors are playing beer pong over my head.
column2: 我向诸神发誓，在那间休息室里读技术资料根本不可能。指挥官，我需要跟上最新技术才能干好我的活，而机师们在我头顶上玩啤酒乒乓时我做不到。

column1: A library is more than just a database and a stack of e-readers. It requires a dedicated space for quiet study and learning, as far from the raucous lounge as possible.
column2: 一座图书馆不止是一座数据库和一排电子阅读器. 它需要远离喧嚣休息区的专用空间，供人静心学习.

column1: A JumpShip pilot told me there's an off-the-books digital distribution service. They get tri-vid and books from DropShips and sell them under the table. It would be more interesting than the decade-old 'Mech magazines Yang keeps putting in the library, anyway.
column2: 一名跃迁舰飞行员告诉我，有个不记账的数字分发服务。他们从空投艇上弄到全息影像和书籍，私下出售。不管怎么说，总比杨老往图书室里放的那些十年前的机甲杂志有意思。

column1: Active subscriptions to a variety of e-book services, periodicals, and tri-vid channels make the library even more appealing to everyone.
column2: 对各种电子书服务、期刊和三维影像频道的有效订阅，让图书馆变得对每个人都更有吸引力.

column1: Improved Library
column2: 改良的图书馆

column1: I've just had to chase another card game out of the mess hall so the staff could clean up, Commander. The crew needs somewhere to relax that isn't also where we're trying to serve meals.
column2: 指挥官，我刚又不得不把一局牌局从食堂赶出去，好让员工打扫。船员需要一个既能放松、又不是我们努力上菜的地方。

column1: A shared social space outside the barracks allows the MechWarriors to bond as a team.
column2: 营房之外的共用社交空间能将机甲战士们拧成一支团队.

column1: The, uh, the engineers were wondering if they could schedule a regular tri-vid event. There's this show, about mercenaries during the civil war, and their 'Mechs are supposed to be historically accurate. I'd— uh, they'd like a space to watch stuff like that.
column2: 那个，呃，工程师们想知道能不能安排一个定期的三录节目。有个剧，讲内战时期的雇佣兵，里面的机甲据说是历史准确的。我想——呃，他们想找个地方看这类东西。

column1: A few couches and a table don't make for much of a social space. Drinks, 2-D video screens, and a sound system, on the other hand…
column2: 几张沙发和一张桌子算不上什么社交空间。而饮料、二维视频屏和一套音响系统就是另一回事了……

column1: Upgraded Lounge
column2: 升级后的休息室

column1: Yeah, Boss, with all the Rustgut some of the Boys keep trying to make i thought we should maybe add some less toxic choices for everyone.
column2: 是啊，头儿，看着弟兄们老试着酿那锈肠子私酒，我就琢磨着咱该给大家弄点毒性没那么大的选择.

column1: A nice Bar and choice selection of drinks for the Lounge.
column2: 休息室里有个不错的吧台，还有精选的各种饮品.

column1: Commander. Come on. LOW-GRAVITY SWIMMING POOL. I don't know what there even is to discuss here.
column2: 指挥官。拜托。低重力游泳池。我不明白这里有什么可讨论的。

column1: When you have a large space with nothing critical in it, where the gravity is too low for living quarters, the obvious choice is to fill it with chlorinated water.
column2: 当你拥有一个很大的空间，里面没什么重要东西，而且重力又不足以建造居住舱时，显而易见的选择是用氯处理过的水(自来水)填满它.

column1: Low-G Pool
column2: 低重力泳池

column1: Upgraded Low-G Pool with better opportunities for swimming, training and leisure activities.
column2: 升级版的低重力泳池，提供了更好的游泳、训练和休闲活动条件.

column1: Upgraded Low-G Pool
column2: 升级版低重力泳池

column1: Our internal storage is having enough roadblocks as is, Commander. I can't make it from Engineering to the Mech Bay without tripping over our loose ends and spares. We're managing so much poorly placed inventory right now that crews are losing productivity just trying to find the tools and resources they need.
column2: 我们的内部仓储已经够多阻碍了，指挥官。我从工程部走到机甲库，一路上都会被散落的零碎和备件绊倒。眼下我们管理着这么多摆放不当的库存，光是找工具和材料，各班组的生产力就在流失。

column1: The Argo's internal storage is just enough for day-to-day survival, but we'll need to develop an inventory system optimized for the Argo and not just a standard DropShip. This ship's layout and functions are so different from standard that a new unified inventory system needs to be developed from scratch.
column2: 阿戈号的内部仓储只够日常生存，但我们需要开发一套专为阿戈号优化、而非标准空投艇的库存系统。这艘船的布局与功能与标准型号差异太大，所以必须从零开始开发一套新的统一库存系统。

column1: Storage Space
column2: 存储空间

column1: 'Mechs assembling 'Mechs so that our 'Mechs can go to battle properly equipped. It might sound silly, but the Argo is a big ship and every bit of efficiency helps us.
column2: 让机甲来组装机甲，这样我们的机甲才能装备齐全地上战场。这听起来也许傻，但阿戈号是艘大船，每一点效率都对我们有帮助。

column1: An optimized inventory system for the Argo is an excellent start, but we can cut storage costs further. If you're willing to front the cost for a few, rugged WorkMechs, we'd save a ton of labour and time managing our storage. This will translate into cheaper storage costs in the long run.
column2: 为阿尔戈优化库存系统是个极好的开始，但我们还能进一步削减仓储成本。如果你愿意先出钱买几台坚固的工作机甲，我们就能在管理仓储上省下大量人力与时间。长远看这会转化为更低的仓储成本。

column1: Mechanized Storage Space
column2: 机械化存储空间

column1: I'm not suggesting that we have robots take everyone's jobs, but it's a fact that machines don't sleep, breathe, eat or complain. Some of our guys could strive to be a little more like that every now and again.
column2: 我不是建议让机器人接管所有人的工作，但事实是机器不睡觉、不呼吸、不吃饭、也不抱怨。我们有些人可以时不时努力更像那样一点。

column1: Automating the Argo's internal storage is the future. One last upgrade to the storage cells would let us move to an automated drone inventory system with a few pressurized WorkMechs for special work. Depressurizing some of our inventory and making robots do the work will save us a lot of upkeep by letting us assign the labour and resources elsewhere
column2: 自动化阿戈号的内部仓储就是未来。对储存舱做最后一次升级，就能让我们转向自动化无人机库存系统，配几台增压作业机甲做特殊工作。给部分库存降压、让机器人干活，能让我们把人力与资源调配到别处，省下大量维护费用

column1: Automated Storage Space
column2: 自动化存储空间

column1: Commander, have you seen these simulator pods? They're fantastic! I take back everything bad I've ever said about the Argo. We gotta get these things running ASAP.
column2: 指挥官，你见过这些模拟器舱了吗？它们太棒了！我收回我说过关于阿戈号的一切坏话。我们得尽快让这些东西运转起来。

column1: This set of networked Battle Pods allow MechWarriors to compete against one another in simulated 'Mech battles, generating experience for participating MechWarriors. Each MechWarrior with less than 200,000 total experience will gain 30 experience points per day. Affinity decays to minimum 5 points
column2: 这套联网战斗舱让机甲战士能在模拟机甲战斗中对战，为参战者生成经验。 总经验不足20万的机甲战士每天获得30点经验。 偏好力最低衰减至5点

column1: Training Module 1
column2: 1号训练模块

column1: Farah just told me that the simulators in Beta Pod can network with the others. You know what that means? It means ship-wide tournaments. It means MechWarriors getting stomped in simulated battle by yours truly. We need these simulators, Commander.
column2: 法拉刚告诉我，贝塔舱的模拟器可以与其他舱的联网。你知道这意味着什么吗？意味着全舰锦标赛。意味着机师们会在模拟战里被我本人痛揍。我们需要这些模拟器，指挥官。

column1: Adding more Battle Pods allows for full-lance training simulations, as well as raucous ship-wide tournaments. This increases the amount of experience gained by MechWarriors aboard the ship. Each MechWarrior with less than 500,000 total experience will gain 50 experience points per day. Affinity decays to minimum 10 points
column2: 增加更多战斗吊舱可以实现全分队训练模拟，以及热闹的全舰锦标赛。这会提升船上机师获得的经验量。\n< 每名总经验低于500,000的机师每天将获得50点经验。 \n< 契合度最低衰减至10点

column1: Training Module 2
column2: 2号训练模块

column1: I've got a design for my simulator team's insignia ready to go, Commander. We're gonna get shirts made—and maybe even warm-up jackets.
column2: 我给模拟器小队设计的徽章图案已经准备好了，指挥官。我们要做T恤——也许还做热身夹克。

column1: With a training space completely packed with Battle Pods, MechWarriors can engage in lance-versus-lance competition, and that inevitably means teams, logos, and pennants. Large-scale competition means even more experience for participating MechWarriors. Each MechWarrior with less than 800,000 total experience will gain 80 experience points per day. Affinity decays to minimum 40 points
column2: 训练空间被战斗吊舱完全塞满后，机师们可以进行分队对分队的竞赛，而这必然意味着队伍、标志和锦旗。大规模竞赛意味着参赛机师获得更多经验。\n< 每名总经验低于800,000的机师每天将获得80点经验。 \n< 契合度最低衰减至40点

column1: Training Module 3
column2: 3号训练模块

column1: Improving the network linkages between our C&C systems should ease some of the burden.
column2: 改善我们指挥与控制系统之间的网络连接，应该能减轻一部分负担.

column1: The Command and Control systems were never really intended to support a Light Company's worth of 'Mechs, Commander. If we want to maintain communications with our pilots, we'll need to upgrade our communication networks to deal with the additional bandwidth.
column2: 指挥官，指挥控制系统原本并非为支持一支轻型连规模的机甲而设计。若要维持与飞行员的通讯，我们就得升级通讯网络以应对额外的带宽需求。

column1: Leopard: Upgraded Communication Networks
column2: 豹式: 升级通讯网络

column1: The next step will be to standardize the communication hardware between our 'Mechs and the Argo's systems so I can remove an abstraction layer from our ship-side software.
column2: 下一步是统一我们的机甲与阿戈号系统之间的通讯硬件，这样我就能从舰载软件里去掉一层抽象层。

column1: The upgrades continue, Commander. Interfacing this Star League technology with our own Command & Control systems is proving challenging, but there's no problem more money and time can't fix, right?
column2: 升级继续推进，指挥官。把这套星际联盟技术与我们自己的指挥控制系统的对接被证明颇有挑战，但没有更多金钱与时间解决不了的问题，对吧？

column1: Leopard: Command and Control System Integrations
column2: 豹式: 指挥与控制系统整合

column1: There's a lot of work to do on this baby, but we can manage it.
column2: 这小家伙有很多活要干，但我们应付得来。

column1: The shuttle was allowed to go to rust sitting in the junkyard, Commander. Most parts of the Leopard's basic structure consist of little more than rust and hope. My 'techs can get to work repairing the worst of the damage, but I warn you now, to complete all of the work will be a long process.
column2: 指挥官，那艘穿梭机被扔在废品场里任由生锈。豹式基础结构的大部分，除了锈迹和希望之外几乎什么都不剩。我的技师可以开工修掉最严重的损伤，但我现在就警告你，要完成全部工作将是一个漫长的过程。

column1: Leopard: Critical Repairs
column2: 豹式: 关键维修

column1: After this she might look like there weren't a family of squatters throwing parties in her every night.
column2: 这之后她看起来就不会像每晚都有一家子擅自占住者在里面开派对。

column1: The good news is that the 'Mechs probably won't fall out of their cradles when the Leopard launches, so now we can get started on making sure they won't fall through the floor.
column2: 好消息是，豹式发射时那些机甲大概不会从机架里掉出来，所以我们现在可以着手确保它们不会漏穿地板了。

column1: Leopard: Floor Reinforcements
column2: 豹式: 甲板加固

column1: The interior is now fit to sleep in. Not that I have been... Anyways, now we can start work on all the problems we can't see.
column2: 内部现在可以住人了。倒不是说我一直住在里面……总之，现在我们能开始处理那些我们看不见的问题了。

column1: The interior of the ship is now more or less serviceable, but the underlying structure still needs a lot of work.
column2: 飞船内部现在大致可用了，但基础结构仍有大量工作需要完成.

column1: Leopard: Basic Structural Repairs
column2: 豹式: 基础结构修复

column1: Frankly I'm surprised there's been no disasters already, Boss. No one reported this to me. If you happen to notice any of my 'techs on septic tank duty over the coming weeks, I promise it's completely unrelated.
column2: 说实话，我很惊讶到现在都还没出事，老板。没人向我报告这件事。如果你接下来几周碰巧看到我的哪位技师被派去清理化粪池，我保证这完全无关。

column1: Turns out the engine mounts are almost completely rusted away Commander. We're gonna need to rebuild them before we can start fixing the engines, otherwise they'll rip themselves out under too much stress.
column2: 指挥官，结果引擎支架几乎完全锈穿了。我们得先重建它们，才能开始修引擎，否则在过大应力下它们会把自己扯出来。

column1: Leopard: Engine Mounts Replacement
column2: 豹式: 引擎支架更换

column1: We've reached the limit of weight these engines can handle, Commander. It'll take some time to get them back up to spec.
column2: 我们已达到这些引擎能承受的重量极限，指挥官。把它们恢复到规格需要一些时间。

column1: The Leopard has lost a lot of engine power over the years rusting away. As it stands, getting down to the planet won't be a problem but it'd be a one way trip with the engines in their current state. I'll help Yang get started on repairing the worst of the damage.
column2: 豹式在多年锈蚀中损失了大量引擎功率。就现状而言，降到行星上不是问题，但以引擎当前状态那将是有去无回的单程之旅。我会帮杨开始修复最严重的损伤。

column1: Leopard: Engine Overhaul
column2: 豹式: 引擎大修

column1: Tune the Engine and drop them hot, Boss.
column2: 调校好引擎，直接让它们热机空降，头儿.

column1: The engine work continues, Commander. We've almost got those engines back up to their rated output. A little more tweaking should do it.
column2: 引擎的工作还在继续，指挥官。我们几乎把那些引擎恢复到额定输出了。再微调一下就行。

column1: Leopard: Improved Engine Tuning
column2: 豹式: 改进引擎调校

column1: Almost at the home stretch, Commander. We've turned this ship from a home for rats into something I'd feel safe flying myself. Almost.
column2: 快到家了，指挥官。我们把这艘船从老鼠窝变成了我自己都敢开的东西。差一点。

column1: Now that the engines and structure are back up to snuff, the next step is to recalibrate the control systems to correctly handle the balance and performance changes that our repairs have caused. We'll need to do a series of orbital drops to accurately gauge the handling characteristics and then punch them into the onboard flight systems.
column2: 既然引擎与结构已恢复到位，下一步是重新校准控制系统，以正确处理我们维修所带来的平衡与性能变化。我们需要做一系列轨道投放，以准确测出操控特性，再把它们写进舰载飞行系统。

column1: Leopard: Recalibrate Control Systems
column2: 豹式: 重新校准控制系统

column1: I wish I'd known you'd see this through before we started, Boss. I could have saved us some time and money if we'd just done this from the start.
column2: 我真希望在我们开始之前就知道你会把它做完，老大。要是我们一开始就这么干，本可以省下不少时间和钱。

column1: The good news is we're almost at the finish line. Frankly, I never thought we'd get this far, Boss. I've been putting this off so far because of the necessary time and money, but the spine of the ship was bent either during it's past service or while it was rotting away in the junkyard. We're going to have to completely tear down the ship to expose the structural skeleton to complete the work, but after this it will be as good as new!
column2: 好消息是我们快到终点线了。老实说，老大，我从没想过我们能走到这一步。我一直在拖延，因为需要的时间与金钱，但舰船的脊骨要么是在它过去服役期间，要么是在废品场里腐烂时被弄弯了。我们得把整艘船拆开，露出结构骨架才能完成这项工作，但做完之后它会像新的一样！

column1: Leopard: Strengthened Structural Frame
column2: 豹式: 加固结构框架

column1: This is it, after this there really isn't anything else we can improve. Well, except buying something bigger than a Leopard.
column2: 就是这一下了，这之后真的没什么可改进的了。嗯，除了买比豹式更大的东西。

column1: A full reconstruction of the Leopard, adding several new compartments by expanding its hull. Includes modifying the internal frame, improving the internal wiring and upgrading the engines. The reconstruction will take considerable time and has a very high cost, but once done allows bringing almost anything to away missions.
column2: 豹式空投艇的全面重建，通过扩大船体来新增数个隔舱. 包括修改内部框架、改进内部布线以及升级引擎. 重建将耗费相当长的时间和极高的成本，但一旦完成，几乎可以将任何东西带往外勤任务.

column1: Leopard: Hull Expansion
column2: 豹式: 船体扩容

column1: We've been having troubles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} for months now, and our negotiations with them have been stalled by a stubborn {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} diplomat. If he were removed from the equation, through a random attack by \"bandits\" for instance, we might be able to make some headway.
column2: 我们和{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}已经纠缠数月，而与他们谈判一直卡在一位固执的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}外交官身上。如果他从等式里消失——比如遭到“匪盗”的随机袭击——我们也许就能取得一些进展。

column1: Commander, we need an immediate deployment. We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet. They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface. This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again. There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要立即部署。我们追踪一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已有数月，终于把他逼到了这颗星球。他已经藏匿起来，但今天早些时候我们的一个轨道单位发现他在地表活动。这是我们首次确认目击到目标，我们希望你能立刻把他拿下，别让他再次溜走。我们没时间对行动区域做完整勘察，所以你会是盲入。

column1: That extra lance of enemy forces is why I hate going in without intel. In any case, the terrorist is dead.
column2: 敌军多出来的那支小队就是我讨厌没有情报时进场的原因. 总之，恐怖分子死了.

column1: Dead or Alive
column2: 生或死

column1: War Criminal
column2: 战犯

column1: These days 'war criminal' basically means anyone on the other side of the battlefield. I wouldn't worry about that 'trial' comment. There won't be one.
column2: 如今"战争罪犯"基本上就是指站在战场另一边的人。我不会为那句"审判"的说法担心。根本不会有什么审判。

column1: A wanted war criminal has been spotted on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Unfortunately, he appears to have integrated himself into a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned mercenary company. We need you to track him down and destroy his 'Mech. If he ejects, we'll take him into custody to be tried before a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} court. If not, no harm done - you'll be paid the same either way.
column2: 一名被通缉的战犯在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}被发现。不幸的是，他似乎已经混进了一支亲{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的雇佣兵公司。我们需要你把他揪出来并摧毁他的机甲。如果他弹射逃生，我们会把他收押，交由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}法庭审判。如果没有，也没什么损失——两种情况下你的报酬都一样。

column1: Destroy Supporting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
column2: 消灭支援的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column1: Eliminate Wanted MechWarrior
column2: 消灭被通缉的机甲战士

column1: Kill confirmed, Commander - the target is down and you are cleared for extraction. Get to the rendezvous with the Leopard, and Sumire will bring you home.
column2: 击杀确认，指挥官--目标完蛋了，你们可以前往撤离点. 去和豹式会合，苏米尔会带你们回家.

column1: We're only contracted for a single target here, but we both know it won't be that easy.
column2: 我们在这里只签约打一个目标，但我们都知道事情不会这么简单。

column1: Escaping Spy
column2: 逃跑的间谍

column1: Covert Agent
column2: 秘密特工

column1: Commander, we'll get paid whether or not we find anything, so this could be a very profitable trip.
column2: 指挥官，不管我们找不找得到东西都会拿到报酬，所以这可能是一趟非常赚钱的差事。

column1: We've been scouring the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system for weeks, looking for a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} spy who took something that didn't belong to them. Recent intelligence has revealed a possible location, but we can't possibly chase every lead with our thin resources. We need you to look into this long shot. If you find the spy, destroy them.
column2: 我们已经在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系搜寻了数周，寻找一名拿走了不属于他们东西的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}间谍。最近的情报揭示了一个可能的位置，但以我们薄弱的人手不可能追查每一条线索。我们需要你去查一下这条希望渺茫的线索。如果你找到那名间谍，就消灭他们。

column1: Eliminate the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Spy
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}间谍

column1: Stop the Spy from Escaping
column2: 阻止间谍逃走

column1: Commander, you're near the coordinates provided to us by {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intel.
column2: 指挥官，你已经接近{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报部门提供给我们的坐标。

column1: If we find him, take him out, then evac.
column2: 如果我们找到他，就消灭他，然后撤离.

column1: We believe the target may be in this general region.
column2: 我们相信目标可能在这个大区.

column1: False Security
column2: 虚假的安全感

column1: I'm not excited about taking on someone with The Professional's reputation with an under-strength lance, but at least we'll have the element of surprise.
column2: 我并不乐意带着一支兵力不足的分队去对付一个有"专家"那种名声的人，但至少我们握有奇袭之利。

column1: The target we'd like your people to eliminate is a notorious killer-for-hire who goes by the name 'The Professional'. They're currently under contract with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, and they've been spotted here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, which is extremely concerning for our interests. This mercenary is cagey and cautious and will attempt escape at any indication that they're overmatched. We'd like you to land a low-tonnage lance to engage them, to give them a false sense of security, and then eliminate them before they can escape. We're prepared to offer very generous salvage terms.
column2: 我们希望你们的人消灭的目标是一名臭名昭著的雇佣杀手，代号"专家"。他们目前受雇于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}，并已在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里被发现，这对我们的利益极为不利。这名雇佣兵谨慎多疑，一有任何处于劣势的迹象就会试图逃跑。我们希望你们投放一支低吨位分队去交战，给他们一种虚假的安全感，然后在它们逃脱之前将其消灭。我们准备提供非常优厚的打捞条款。

column1: Destroy The Professional
column2: 消灭专家

column1: Prevent The Professional from Escaping
column2: 阻止“专家”逃走

column1: Did you really just drop into my backyard with that lance? I'm offended. This won't even be a challenge.
column2: 你真的就带着那支分队降落到了我的后院？我被冒犯了。这甚至算不上挑战。

column1: Target destroyed, Commander.
column2: 目标被摧毁了，指挥官.

column1: A hit-and-run operation sounds straightforward enough, Commander. Just remember that if you get bogged down in fighting the escorts, escape is always an option.
column2: 一次打了就跑的行动，听起来够简单明了的了，指挥官. 只是记住如果你陷入了和护卫队的苦斗，撤退始终是一个选择.

column1: Commander, this mission should be simple. A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} noble is participating in a patrol, as a show of support for the troops. She's insisted on using her ancestral family 'Mech, which is a Cicada CDA-2A. This should make eliminating her quite easy. Recognizing the danger, her handlers have sent along an extremely heavy supporting lance. If you're quick, and aggressive, you should be able to destroy her little Cicada before her escorts can react.
column2: 指挥官，这次任务应该很简单。一位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族正在参加巡逻，以示对部队的支持。她坚持驾驶家族祖传的机甲，那是一台蝉 CDA-2A。这让除掉她变得相当容易。她的幕僚察觉到了危险，随行派出了一支极重型的支援小队。只要你动作够快、够凶狠，就能在她的护卫做出反应之前摧毁那台小小的蝉。

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Noble
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族

column1: Keep the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Noble from Escaping
column2: 阻止{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族逃走

column1: Do you have anything helpful to offer, Yang?
column2: 你有什么有用的建议吗，杨?

column1: Good luck and good hunting.
column2: 祝你好运，狩猎顺利.

column1: If you ask me, boss, anyone who sends their VIPs out in a CDA-2A is asking to be shot.
column2: 要是你问我的话，头，任何一个把自己的VIP塞进一部CDA-2A派出去的人都该被枪毙.

column1: These little bastards are fast, so watch for the VIP to make a run for it.
column2: 这些小混蛋跑得很快，所以注意VIP可能会试图逃跑.

column1: A hit-and-run operation should be straightforward enough, Commander. Just remember that if you get bogged down in fighting the escorts, escape is always an option.
column2: 一次打了就跑的行动，听起来够简单明了的了，指挥官. 只是记住如果你陷入了和护卫队的苦斗，撤退始终是一个选择.

column1: Frontier Justice
column2: 边地的正义

column1: Rogue MechWarrior
column2: 恶棍机甲战士

column1: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional enemies, and escape
column2: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌人，然后撤离

column1: If I had to guess, Commander, I'd say the 'outlaw' part of this is just propaganda. Outlaw or not, though, the payout's the same for us.
column2: 如果要我猜，指挥官，我会说这其中"不法"那部分只是宣传。不过不管合法与否，对我们来说报酬都一样。

column1: We are offering a sizeable bounty for the head of a local outlaw. The target is a rogue {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior who has attacked {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel and facilities in this system. We need a mercenary company to find her and take her down before she takes out her aggressions on any more of our settlements.
column2: 我们要出一大笔赏金缉拿当地一名不法分子的首级. 目标是一名在这个星系中攻击了{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员和设施的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恶棍机甲战士. 我们需要一家佣兵公司找到她，在她继续攻击我们的定居点之前把她干掉.

column1: Destroy the Enemy Forces
column2: 消灭敌方部队

column1: Destroy the Outlaw MechWarrior
column2: 消灭不法分子机甲战士

column1: Stop the Outlaw from Escaping
column2: 阻止不法分子逃走

column1: Excellent work as always, Commander. When you get back, drinks are on me.
column2: 工作一如既往的漂亮，指挥官. 你回来时，我请你喝一杯.

column1: Find the target, take her out, and proceed to the LZ for evac. Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 找到目标，干掉她，然后前往着陆区撤离. 狩猎顺利，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: There's only one target that matters on this drop, Commander.
column2: 这次投放只有一个目标要紧，指挥官。

column1: Hard Target
column2: 硬目标

column1: Elite MechWarrior
column2: 精锐机甲战士

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior is headed to a major military compound on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, where they'll take command of a company-sized 'Mech force, and become untouchable. They're en route to the encampment, but until they arrive, they're vulnerable.
column2: 那名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师正前往{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处大型军事营地，在那里他们将接管一支连级机甲部队，从此不可触及。他们正在前往营地的路上，但在抵达之前，他们是脆弱的。

column1: An elite MechWarrior has been deployed to take command of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in this system. We need a skilled mercenary force to remove this MechWarrior before they reach their command, while they're only lightly escorted. Every downed 'Mech will help our cause, so there will be a bonus for complete destruction of the target's supporting forces. Additionally, the MechWarrior's command may send out an escort unit to meet them; expect enemy reinforcements once you engage.
column2: 一名精英机甲战士被派来接管该星系{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的指挥权。我们需要一支技术娴熟的雇佣兵力量，在这名机甲战士抵达其指挥部之前、且只有轻装护卫时将其除掉。每击毁一台机甲都有助于我们的事业，因此彻底摧毁目标的护航部队还有奖金。此外，该机甲战士的指挥部可能会派出一支护航单位前来会合；一旦交战，预期会有敌方增援。

column1: Defeat the Elite MechWarrior and Escape
column2: 击败精锐机甲战士后摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy Elite {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}精锐机甲战士

column1: Commander, intel says the target and their escorts will be moving through this area.
column2: 指挥官，情报显示目标和他们的护卫将通过这一地区.

column1: Take them out, and then head for the evac zone.
column2: 干掉他们，然后前往撤离区域.

column1: The bigger they are.... Well done, Commander.
column2: 他们越是庞大....做得不错，指挥官.

column1: Heart of Darkness
column2: 黑暗之心

column1: Enemy Commander
column2: 敌方指挥官

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} needs this cleaned up quietly. Our intel shows the former commander has more loyal units than our employers will admit. This fight could escalate quickly, so stay alert.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}希望这件事能悄悄解决. 我们的情报显示，这位前任指挥官掌握的忠诚部队比雇主所承认的要多得多. 这场战斗可能会迅速升级，请保持警惕.

column1: A former {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} commander, backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, has set up his own government. To avoid any unwanted personnel conflicts, and to save our people the stress of fighting their former comrades, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} requires a Merc unit to remove this traitor and keep him from destroying his own people.
column2: 一名前{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥官，在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队的支持下，建立了自己的政权. 为了避免不必要的人员冲突，并减轻我方人员与昔日同袍作战的压力，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}需要一支雇佣兵部队去除掉这个叛徒，防止他继续伤害自己的人民.

column1: Defeat {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column1: Defeat {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}援军

column1: Defeat the Traitorous Commander
column2: 击败叛国的指挥官

column1: Destroy the Commander and Escape
column2: 消灭指挥官并摆脱敌人

column1: Keep your eyes open and be ready for a counterattack.
column2: 睁大眼睛，准备应对反击.

column1: Nice, clean, and quiet. Perfect. Good work, Commander.
column2: 美妙，干净，同时还隐秘. 完美. 干得漂亮，指挥官.

column1: The target was far better prepared for us than our employers led us to believe. Time to dust off and call it even.
column2: 目标所做的准备比我们雇主所说的还要充分. 是时候拍拍屁股到此为止了.

column1: With the backing of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, this 'king' could prove to be a tough opponent.
column2: 有了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的支持，这位“国王”可能会是个难对付的对手。

column1: He Does His Own Stunts
column2: 他亲自上阵

column1: Brock Armstrong
column2: 布罗克·阿姆斯特朗

column1: Have you seen the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} holo-vid show \"Mercenaries\"? Yes, we're being asked to kill its star, Brock Armstrong. He knows his way around a 'Mech and will have two full lances as escorts.
column2: 你看过{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的全息剧集《雇佣兵》吗？没错，我们被要求杀掉它的主演，布洛克·阿姆斯特朗。他对机甲很在行，而且会有整整两支分队作为护卫。

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has arranged for a holo-vid celebrity to visit {TGT_SYSTEM.name} in the hopes of rallying the morale of the local citizens. This is an opportunity for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} psy-ops to instead make them understand how dangerous the region really is. Deploy your lance, find the target, eliminate him. Destroy his bodyguards if you feel so inclined.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已经安排一位全息影视明星前往{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，以提升当地民众的士气. 这正是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}心理战部队发挥作用的好机会，让他们真正明白这片区域有多危险. 派出你的小队，找到目标，消灭他. 如果你想的话，也可以一并消灭他的护卫.

column1: Destroy Enemy Escorts
column2: 消灭敌方护卫

column1: Commander, from here on out, we're expecting to encounter enemy forces.
column2: 指挥官，从现在起，我们预计会遇到敌军。

column1: Take him out, and get to the evac zone.
column2: 除掉他，再到撤离区域去.

column1: For months, we've had trouble with people here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} being riled up by talk of insurrection, rebellion, independence. Based on top {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts' reports, we believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist in the area, stirring up discontent. We've set up a security net to capture her. But we can't cover every possible exit from our net and could use an extra Lance of 'Mechs. If she tries to slip through your assigned territory, turn her unit to slag.
column2: 数月来，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的人一直被叛乱、起义、独立的言论煽动，令我们头疼。根据{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}顶尖分析师们的报告，我们相信这一带有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员在煽动不满情绪。我们已布下一张安全网来抓她。但我们无法覆盖网中每一个可能的出口，所以需要一支额外的机甲分队。如果她试图从你的辖区溜过，就把她的单位熔成矿渣。

column1: Mission accomplished. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist is dead.
column2: 任务完成. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员死了.

column1: Our employers need us to keep an eye out for the propaganda agent, as this is one possible escape route she might take.
column2: 我们的雇主需要我们密切注意宣传员，因为这是她可能采用的一条逃跑路线.

column1: Target eliminated. We can clean up any remaining hostiles, or head for the evac zone.
column2: 目标已消灭. 我们可以清理所有剩余的敌人，或前往撤离区.

column1: Key Personnel
column2: 关键人员

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager. Not much glory, but it pays. The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units. Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要去干掉一名中层管理者。没什么荣耀，但有报酬。目标不会独自一人，指挥官，如果我们把护卫单位也清理掉另有奖金。不过如果局面太热，我们随时可以打了就跑。

column1: We have an opportunity to eliminate a key figure in the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hierarchy in this system, which will leave their organization in chaos and ensure safety for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. The target will be relatively unguarded and vulnerable, and we'd like you to strike in this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们有机会除掉该星系{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}层级中的一名关键人物，这会让他们的组织陷入混乱，并确保{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}行动的安全。目标身旁不会有太多护卫、防备薄弱，我们希望你在这一时机窗口内发动打击。

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager. The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units as well. Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要去干掉一名中层管理者。目标不会独自一人，指挥官，如果我们把护卫单位也清理掉另有奖金。不过如果局面太热，我们随时可以打了就跑。

column1: Our intelligence operatives believe that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader is present and vulnerable on the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Eliminating them will leave their organization in shambles and clear the field for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. The target will be relatively unguarded, and we'd like you to strike during this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们的情报人员相信，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领袖正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表上且防备薄弱。除掉他们将使他们的组织陷入混乱，为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}行动清出场地。目标身旁不会有太多护卫，我们希望你在这一时机窗口内发动打击。

column1: Destroy Ambushers
column2: 摧毁伏击部队

column1: The target is down, Commander. Well done.
column2: 目标完蛋了，指挥官. 做得不错.

column1: Code of Silence
column2: 沉默法则

column1: Target MechWarrior
column2: 目标机甲战士

column1: I suppose the target probably should have known what he was getting into. Lay down with dogs...
column2: 我想目标已经知道他接下来会发生什么. 近墨者黑......

column1: We had a deal with a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. He helped out with some of our operations, and in turn we kept him supplied with things he couldn't get on the open market, if you know what I mean. But he's decided he's too good to work with us anymore. That's not okay. We want you to go down there and show him that it's not okay. He's probably gonna try to make a break for it. Don't let him escape.
column2: 我们跟{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师有过约定。他帮过我们一些行动的忙，作为交换，我们一直供应他一些他在公开市场上弄不到的东西，你懂我的意思。但他现在觉得自己不值得我们合作了。那可不行。我们要你下去让他明白这不行。他大概会试图跑路。别让他逃掉。

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲战士

column1: From here, you should be able to get eyes on him.
column2: 从这里，你应该可以看到他.

column1: This is where the target should be patrolling, Commander.
column2: 这里应该就是目标巡逻的地方，指挥官.

column1: There's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, involved in keeping the peace. He helped out with some of our operations, and in turn we kept him supplied with things he couldn't get on the open market, if you know what I mean. But he's started talking to the authorities, and making threats about exposing our business. We want you to put a stop to that. He's probably gonna try to make a break for it. Don't let him escape.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师，参与维持治安。他帮过我们一些行动的忙，作为交换，我们一直供应他一些他在公开市场上弄不到的东西，你懂我的意思。但他开始与当局接触，还威胁要揭露我们的生意。我们要你把这事掐断。他大概会试图跑路。别让他逃掉。

column1: An Eye For An Eye
column2: 以眼还眼

column1: If this MechWarrior is singlehandedly making a dent in pirate activity in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, he's going to be a tough enemy.
column2: 如果这名机甲战士能凭一己之力削减 {TGT_SYSTEM.name} 的海盗活动，他会是个强敌。

column1: We've lost three hidden supply bases on this ball of rock, Commander, and all three losses were thanks to one man, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior tasked with tracking down our activities in this region. We're tired of letting him pick the time and place of battle, so we'd like you to give him a little surprise visit while he's on patrol. He'll be lightly defended but given his paranoia he'll probably have backup waiting nearby, so watch for an ambush.
column2: 我们在这块石头球上丢了三处隐蔽补给基地，指挥官，而三次损失都归功于一个人——一名被派来追查我们在此区域活动的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师。我们受够了他来选定战斗的时间与地点，所以我们希望在他巡逻时给他一次小小的惊喜拜访。他的护卫很少，但鉴于他的多疑，附近大概会有后援等着，所以当心伏击。

column1: From here, you should be able to get eyes on him, Commander.
column2: 从这里，你应该可以看到他，指挥官.

column1: This is where our employers said to look for the target.
column2: 这里就是我们雇主说要寻找目标的地方.

column1: The Price of Freedom
column2: 自由的代价

column1: It's reached a point where we can no longer operate in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, Commander, and it's all thanks to a particular {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior tasked with tracking down our activities in this region. We're tired of letting him pick the time and place of battle, so we'd like you to give him a little surprise visit while he's on patrol. He'll be defended and given his paranoia he'll probably have backup waiting nearby, so watch for an ambush.
column2: 已经到了我们无法再在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}行动的地步，指挥官，这全拜一名被派来追查我们在此区域活动的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师所赐。我们受够了他来选定战斗的时间与地点，所以我们希望在他巡逻时给他一次小小的惊喜拜访。他会有护卫，而鉴于他的多疑，附近大概会有后援等着，所以当心伏击。

column1: Recruitment Drive
column2: 征兵行动

column1: Veteran MechWarrior
column2: 机甲战士老兵

column1: His 'Mech may be heavy, Commander, but I don't see a lot of 'Mech repair facilities out here, so this might not be as difficult as it looks.
column2: 他的机甲可能很重，指挥官，但我在这一带看不到多少机甲维修设施，所以这也许不像看上去那么难。

column1: Our spies report that a veteran {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior from the Succession Wars retired to this system, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would very much like to keep him retired. Permanently if possible. We've been monitoring a DropShip in orbit around the planet, and believe that they're preparing for a pickup. We need you to drop and intercept this MechWarrior before he can be reactivated. He's likely in a fairly heavy 'Mech, so be careful when you engage him.
column2: 我们的间谍报告，一名继承战争时期的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}老兵机师退役定居在这个星系，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}非常希望让他保持退役状态。如果可能的话是永久性的。我们一直在监视轨道上的一艘空投艇，相信他们正准备接人。我们需要你降下去，在这名机师被重新启用之前拦截他。他大概驾驶着一台相当重的机甲，所以交战时小心。

column1: Destroy the Veteran MechWarrior and Escape
column2: 消灭机甲战士老兵并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy Veteran MechWarrior
column2: 消灭机甲战士老兵

column1: Engage and destroy the target, then proceed to the evac zone.
column2: 交战并摧毁目标，之后前往撤离区域.

column1: This is where the last transmission from the surface originated from.
column2: 这里就是地面最后发送讯息的位置.

column1: We've arrived at the coordinates provided by our employers.
column2: 我们已抵达雇主提供的坐标。

column1: I have a bad feeling about this, Commander. If they want that 'Mech torched, I'm guessing it's relatively powerful. Be careful.
column2: 我有不好的预感，指挥官。如果他们想烧掉那台机甲，我猜它相当强大。小心点。

column1: One of our covert facilities was breached, Commander, in what appears to have been an inside job. A MechWarrior stationed there murdered the rest of the staff and is defecting to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, taking a valuable {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech with her. The facility is a total loss, but we don't want that 'Mech falling into enemy hands. Track down the renegade and destroy her 'Mech. We believe she's being escorted by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and there's a bonus if you destroy them as well.
column2: 指挥官，我们的一处秘密设施被突破了，看样子是内部人员所为。驻守在那里的一名机甲战士杀害了其余工作人员，并叛逃到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，还带走了一台宝贵的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲。设施已彻底损毁，但我们绝不能让那台机甲落入敌手。找到这名叛徒并摧毁她的机甲。我们认为她正由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队护送，若你将其一并摧毁，还有额外奖励。

column1: Destroy Renegade
column2: 消灭叛徒

column1: Destroy the Renegade and Escape
column2: 消灭叛徒并摆脱敌人

column1: Stop the Renegade from Escaping
column2: 阻止叛徒逃走

column1: That 'Mech is leaving a trail anyone could follow. Our target is not subtle.
column2: 那台机甲留下的痕迹谁都跟得上。我们的目标一点也不隐蔽。

column1: Commander, we should expect heavy resistance. We might get a shot at the officer alone but his guard and support units won't be far off. You'll have to either strike hard and fast then bug out, or bring enough firepower for everyone.
column2: 指挥官，我们应预期会遇到顽抗。我们也许有机会单独袭击那名军官，但他的卫兵与支援单位不会离得太远。你要么快打快撤，要么带上足以应付所有人的火力。

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that a high ranking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} officer is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to disrupt their command structure on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We'll pay a 20% bonus per lance if you can also destroy his personal guard.
column2: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}高级军官正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上打乱他们指挥结构的难得机会。如果你还能摧毁他的私人卫队，我们将按每支分队额外支付20%的奖金。

column1: Target eliminated. Mop up the remaining enemies, or come on home.
column2: 目标已消灭. 清剿剩余敌人，或者直接回家.

column1: Thorn In The Side
column2: 芒刺在背

column1: Commander, this is a bold move by the smugglers so we have to assume they have more than just a simple token force there. Be prepared for anything.
column2: 指挥官，这伙走私者敢采取如此大胆的行动，我们最好假设他们不止有一支象征性部队在那儿. 准备好应付任何情况.

column1: Smugglers funded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} have set up just outside our borders, causing an ongoing problem for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. We'd like to cut the head off this particular snake with a targeted, limited, and deniable strike on their leader. Ideally, this will shut them down permanently.
column2: 受{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}资助的走私者在我们的边界外扎了营，持续给{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动制造麻烦。我们想对这条毒蛇来个斩首行动：一次精准、有限且可否认的打击，直取他们的头目。若能如愿，这将永久终结他们。

column1: Destroy All Smuggler Forces
column2: 消灭所有走私者部队

column1: Destroy Smuggler Reinforcements
column2: 消灭走私者的援军

column1: Destroy the Smuggler Leader and Escape
column2: 消灭走私者的首领并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the Smuggler Leader
column2: 消灭走私者首领

column1: Intel suggests hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Be alert.
column2: 情报指出敌对{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位出现在了这一地区. 请警惕.

column1: Once the target is down, head for the extraction point for a pickup.
column2: 一旦目标完蛋了，就前往撤离点接受接应.

column1: The target is down. Head for the extraction point.
column2: 目标完蛋了. 前往撤离点.

column1: This is the area where the smugglers reportedly set up shop.
column2: 据报这里是走私者开展业务的地方.

column1: Well done, Commander. Our employer will be very happy to hear the news.
column2: 做得不错，指挥官. 我们的雇主听到这个消息会非常高兴的.

column1: We get paid only for a confirmed kill, although there's a bonus for clearing out any additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. Still, it may be best to approach this as a hit-and-run operation.
column2: 我们只有确认击杀才能拿到报酬，不过清除任何额外的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队另有奖金。尽管如此，把这当成一次打了就跑的行动也许最好。

column1: Our intelligence has identified an infamous war criminal in the service of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We do not care about the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, but the criminal must be brought to justice. And by 'justice' we mean 'dead'.
column2: 我们的情报确认了一名在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上为{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}效力的臭名昭著战犯。我们不在乎{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，但这名罪犯必须被绳之以法。而我们说的"法"是指"死"。

column1: Destroy the War Criminal and Escape
column2: 消灭战犯并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the War Criminal
column2: 消灭战犯

column1: Commander, the criminal we're after should be nearby.
column2: 指挥官，我们要抓的那名罪犯应该就在附近。

column1: Mission accomplished. The target is dead.
column2: 任务完成. 目标死亡.

column1: The target will be supported by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, but we have no contractual obligation to engage them.
column2: 目标将会有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的支援，但我们没有合约义务去和他们交战.

column1: This is a hit and run. If you prefer, just kill the target and get out. Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 这是一场打了就跑的任务. 如果你喜欢，只要击杀目标就脱离. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

column1: Buckle up, Commander. This sounds like an extremely tough fight. You know something this valuable is going to be escorted.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 听起来这像是一场极其艰苦的战斗. 你知道有些珍贵的东西要护送.

column1: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them. This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence. We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited. If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.
column2: 我们定期勘察“空置”星球，只为确认那里没有意外活动。这次我们运气不错。一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小队从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}地表接收到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，对应一台正在跑试射序列的超重型机甲。我们怀疑敌人认为该星球无人居住，正把这台机甲开出来做验证试车。如果我们能定位并拦截这台机甲，就能让一件强力硬件不落入敌手。

column1: We were outgunned and outnumbered. Not a good showing, Commander.
column2: 我们在火力和人数上都被超越了. 情况不妙，指挥官.

column1: Well done, Commander. You made that look easy.
column2: 做得不错，指挥官. 你让它看起来很简单.

column1: Weakest Link
column2: 最弱的一环

column1: The target seems to be just a low-level officer in the overall {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} scheme of things - just a link in the chain. We just need to dive in, take out the target and get out.
column2: 目标似乎只是整个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}体系中的一名低级官员——只是链条上的一环. 我们只需要潜入进去，消灭目标，然后撤离.

column1: A member of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} chain of command in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been troubling us. We need this irksome operative eliminated. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence operatives have located the target's position planetside.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}中{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥链的一名成员一直在烦扰我们。我们需要除掉这名恼人的干员。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报人员已定位目标在行星上的位置。

column1: Eliminate {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leader
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导人

column1: Eliminate the Target and Escape
column2: 消灭目标并摆脱敌人

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} target is believed to be here.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}目标据信就在这儿.

column1: The target is down. Head for the evac zone.
column2: 目标完蛋了. 前往撤离区域.

column1: These are the coordinates that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence provided, Commander.
column2: 这些就是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报人员提供的坐标，指挥官.

column1: You mean I can just type anything here and Darius will say it?
column2: 你是说我在这里随便打什么，达里乌斯就会照说？

column1: Only marginally effective for a light tank, the Scorpion has proven effective in mass numbers. Swarms of Scorpions, easily procured due to their low cost, are an often-encountered danger on poorer worlds.
column2: 对轻型坦克来说它只能算勉强有效，但蝎式以数量证明了威力。由于采购成本低廉，成群结队的蝎式在贫困星球上屡见不鲜，是常见的威胁。

column1: Argo, we've taken control of the facility. You need to keep it intact and neutralize the attackers.
column2: 阿戈号，我们已控制该设施。你需要让它保持完好并消灭进攻者。

column1: The second contender has arrived!
column2: 第二位挑战者已抵达!

column1: Entering the arena is contender number 3!
column2: 进入竞技场的是3号挑战者!

column1: Contender number 4 is joining the rumble!
column2: 4号挑战者正在加入近战!

column1: Contender number 5 has entered the fray!
column2: 5号挑战者已加入战局!

column1: Contender number 6 has arrived, marking the last to join the fight!
column2: 6号挑战者已抵达，标志着最后一位参战者已加入战斗!

column1: Friendly forces are engaging hostile units.  The survival of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} isn't our main concern, but in a combat zone, strength in numbers matters.  We'll offer support where we can --- keeping them in the fight longer gives us a better shot at earning a bonus.
column2: 友军正在与敌方单位交战。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的存亡并非我们主要关心的事，但在战区里，人多势众自有其道理。我们会在力所能及处提供支援——让他们撑得越久，我们拿到奖金的机会就越大。

column1: Looks like the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} are dead set on taking over {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s territory.  A small group of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned troops is holding down a key spot, and it's our job to back them up.  Link up with them and push back any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces that come your way.
column2: 看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}铁了心要夺取{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的领地。一小股{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}阵营部队正守住一处关键地点，我们的任务是为他们提供后援。与他们建立联系，并击退任何朝你们逼来的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。

column1: Friendly units are moving in to hit the enemy.  Link up with them and try to stall the enemy advance as long as you can.  Just don't push too far out there, Commander --- stay sharp.  Good luck.
column2: 友军单位正在推进打击敌人。与他们建立联系，尽可能久地拖延敌军推进。只是别推得太靠前，指挥官——保持警觉。祝好运。

column1: We're heading straight into the thick of it, Commander.  Watch each other's backs, hold off the enemy as long as you can, then get the hell out.  We'll be standing by for your extraction.  Good hunting out there.
column2: 我们正一头扎进最激烈的中心，指挥官。互相照应，尽可能久地拖住敌人，然后就赶紧撤。我们会待命接应你们。祝狩猎顺利。

column1: <color=#FAD02C>MEGA KILL!!!</color>\n
Heads up, Commander.  Ally command says enemy forces could hit your location any moment now.
column2: 注意，指挥官. 友军指挥部说敌军随时可能袭击你们的位置.

column1: More {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hostiles coming your way.
column2: 更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌军正在向你处移动.

column1: Enemies are closing in --- better brace yourself, Commander.
column2: 敌人正在逼近——最好做好准备，指挥官.

column1: They've made you, Commander.  Multiple tangos converging on your location.
column2: 你被发现了，指挥官。多个目标正向你的位置汇聚。

column1: Looks like you stirred things up, Commander.  More hostiles are on the way!
column2: 看来你捅了马蜂窝了，指挥官. 更多敌军正在赶来!

column1: Well, you sure got their attention.  I'm showing multiple hostiles incoming on your position.
column2: 好吧，你确实引起了他们的注意。我这边显示多个敌人正向你的位置逼近。

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forward intel have spotted more bogeys heading your way.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的前沿情报发现更多目标正在向你处移动.

column1: You've definitely riled them up, Commander.  Incoming hostiles!
column2: 你确实把他们激怒了，指挥官。敌人来了！

column1: We've got more bogeys locking in on your location.
column2: 又有更多不明目标锁定你的位置。

column1: Heads up!  More {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hostiles are on the move.  They're en route to your position!
column2: 注意！更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌人正在移动。他们正朝你的位置来！

column1: Additional contacts near the perimeter, Commander.  Brace for contact.
column2: 防线附近有更多接触信号，指挥官. 准备接敌.

column1: We've got enemies operating in the area.  Keep your eyes open.
column2: 我们有敌人在这一带活动。睁大眼睛。

column1: Enemy reinforcements detected nearby.  They're moving toward your position.
column2: 探测到附近有敌方增援。他们正向你的位置移动。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are advancing --- prepare for engagement.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正在推进——准备接战.

column1: Your resistance is pulling in additional hostiles around you.
column2: 你的抵抗正在吸引周围更多的敌人.

column1: Contact!  Multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hostiles inbound on your position.  Get ready for contact.
column2: 接敌! 多个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌军正在向你的位置移动. 准备交战.

column1: Scopes are picking up more bogies, Commander.
column2: 测距仪捕捉到更多目标，指挥官.

column2: 高爆穿甲弹: 以降低总伤害和范围伤害为代价，可造成大量穿甲伤害.

column2: 惰性弹药; 不会因过热而殉爆或爆炸.
