column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol detected unexpected signals here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and we'd like you to investigate. Analysis suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an abandoned factory on the planet's surface. We don't know what this particular facility was used for, but given the effort they're sinking into this, it must be valuable. We want it.
column2: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}这里探测到意外信号，我们希望你去调查。分析表明{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}重新启用了行星表面一座废弃工厂。我们不知道这处特定设施原来是干什么用的，但鉴于他们投入的力气，它一定很有价值。我们想要它。

column1: Trade negotiations between {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have broken down. We believe that if we capture and hold a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system, we will be able to force them back to the negotiating table. Your job is to take the base and hold it until our forces can occupy it.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}之间的贸易谈判破裂了. 我们相信，如果我们夺取一座位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地，就能迫使他们重返谈判桌. 你的任务是拿下基地，并坚守直到我们的部队能够进驻.

column1: Dropship arriving! Prepare to head out.
column2: 空投艇来了! 准备出发.

column1: Contested Will
column2: 有争议的法令

column1: I don't buy the 'ancestral fortress' part of this, but the legal maneuverings check out. Commander, a merc company coming in could resolve this quickly and prevent a large-scale conflict.
column2: 我不买"祖传要塞"那部分的说法，但法律上的运作倒是查得通。指挥官，来一家雇佣兵公司就能快速解决此事，避免一场大规模冲突。

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} family lost a large area of land on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, thanks to dubious legal maneuvering by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents. This land includes an important ancestral military base. We need this base taken back from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} and held until this can be sorted out.
column2: 由于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}代理人可疑的法律操作，一个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}家族在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}失去了大片土地. 这片土地上有一座重要的祖传军事基地. 我们需要从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}手中夺回这座基地，并坚守到问题解决为止.

column1: Capture and Hold the fortress
column2: 夺取并守住要塞

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Units
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位

column1: Occupy the Fortress
column2: 占领要塞

column1: Scout the Fortress
column2: 侦察要塞

column1: Take back the ancestral fortress
column2: 夺回祖传堡垒

column1: Commander, a word of warning, we have reports this base may have gun emplacements for point defense.
column2: 指挥官，一句提醒：有报告称这座基地可能配有近距离防御炮位。

column1: Then move up, clear out any defenders, and hold the area until {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces arrive to relieve you.
column2: 继续推进，肃清所有守军，并坚守这一地区直到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队来接替你们.

column1: This is the ancestral fortress? This looks like a modern, operational military base to me.
column2: 这就是“祖传堡垒”? 对我来说，这看起来像是一座现代化，可以运作的军事基地.

column1: This is where the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 'ancestral' fortress is located.
column2: 这就是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}“祖传”堡垒的所在地。

column1: Turrets, boss. Just keep an eye out in case they are online.
column2: 炮塔，老板。留神点，以防它们已经通电。

column1: Well done, Commander; the fortress is ours. There are {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces inbound to take possession.
column2: 做得不错，指挥官; 这座要塞是我们的了. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会来接手控制.

column1: We've been monitoring communications traffic on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and discerned a pattern. There's a well-defended {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we suspect of being a secure data storage facility. We'd like your team to land, capture the base, and take a complete image of the contents of their databases. Once the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces realize what we're doing, they'll launch a counteroffensive, so we'll need you to stay in the field until the download is complete.
column2: 我们一直在监视{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的通讯流量，并辨认出一种规律。那里有一处防御严密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，我们怀疑它是安全数据存储设施。我们希望你的团队降落、夺取该基地，并完整拍摄其数据库内容。一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队意识到我们在做什么，他们就会发起反攻，因此我们需要你留在战场直到下载完成。

column1: Oh hey, just like I said. Turrets. Watch yourself, Commander.
column2: 噢嘿，就像我说过的. 炮台. 小心，指挥官.

column1: This shouldn't be all that difficult, but we'll need Dr. Murad on the ground to do the actual data hacking. She's already agreed to go in with your team.
column2: 这应该不会太难，但我们需要穆拉德博士到地面上来实际进行数据入侵。她已经同意跟你的小队一起进去。

column1: Sounds like our employers have their own data security problems.
column2: 听起来我们的雇主有他们自己的数据安全问题.

column1: Stealing is a Form of Flattery
column2: 偷窃是种“恭维”

column1: Commander, plausible deniability is our specialty.
column2: 指挥官，合理否认可是我们的拿手好戏.

column1: We have long suspected that there is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research station hidden in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, and we've finally gotten wind of its possible location. We need a few brave, and plausibly deniable, mercenaries to secure the location for a dropship extraction of any valuable scientific personnel.
column2: 我们长期怀疑{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系内藏有一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究站，如今终于探得它可能的位置。我们需要几位勇敢且可矢口否认的雇佣兵，去控制该地点，以便空投艇撤离任何有价值的科研人员。

column1: Capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Research Station
column2: 夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究站

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column1: Hold the Station while Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 援军抵达时守住站点

column1: Occupy the Research Station
column2: 占领研究站

column1: Pacify the Area Around the Research Station
column2: 平定研究站周边地区

column1: Scout the Research Station
column2: 侦察研究站

column1: Alright, you should have good view of the research facility now.
column2: 好了，你们现在应该可以清楚地看到研究设施了.

column1: Be careful of additional forces. Reports are they have additional units in the area that are rallying back at the base. Expect contact.
column2: 小心增援部队. 报告说他们在该区域还有额外单位，正在基地集结. 预计会发生接触.

column1: Commander, a word of warning: we have reports this base may have gun emplacements for point defense.
column2: 指挥官，提醒一下: 我们收到报告称这个基地可能部署了防御炮台.

column1: Eliminate opposition and take control of the territory, Commander.
column2: 消灭敌对势力并控制该区域，指挥官.

column1: Sit tight, Commander. I think {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will be pleased with the results.
column2: 原地别动，指挥官. 我想{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会满意这次的结果.

column1: The research station is under our control, Commander.
column2: 研究站在我们控制之下了，指挥官.

column1: We're here to capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research station.
column2: 我们来夺取 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 的研究站。

column1: Clandestine Research
column2: 秘密研究

column1: We're going to land in a hot AO, with no idea where we are, capture a well-defended military facility, and hold it against a counter-attack. What could go wrong?
column2: 我们即将降落在一片热区，完全不知道自己在哪儿，夺取一处防御严密的军事设施，然后顶住反攻守住它。还能出什么岔子？

column1: Commander, we're preparing a series of operations on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. However, before we can begin, we need a secure lodgement to bring military units and supplies down to the surface. We've identified a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military facility that will be ideal for our purposes. We need you to land a strike force, capture the facility, and hold it until we can bring down our people to secure the location. Because this operation is covert and on an extremely tight schedule, you'll be inserting with no topographical intel.
column2: 指挥官，我们正准备在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上开展一系列行动。但在开始之前，我们需要一处安全的落脚点，把军事单位与补给送上地表。我们已确定一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事设施，对我们的目的而言堪称理想。我们需要你投下一支打击部队，夺取该设施并守住它，直到我们能把人手送下来确保该地点安全。由于这次行动是隐蔽的且时间极紧，你将在没有地形情报的情况下投放进去。

column1: Capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military facility
column2: 夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军用设施

column1: I don't like dropping dark like this. Meyer, we need some eyes on the target. Any thoughts?
column2: 我不喜欢这样摸黑投放。迈耶，我们需要有人盯着目标。有什么想法吗？

column1: Um, let me look... Okay, this location seems like a good vantage point. You should be able to see the facility from there.
column2: 嗯，我来看看...好吧，这个位置似乎是最佳视点. 从那儿你应该可以看到设施.

column1: Logistical Base Capture
column2: 夺取后勤基地

column1: This should be straightforward. Move up, recon the depot, and then occupy it. Once we secure the area, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will send in their people to loot the place.
column2: 这应该很简单明了. 前进，侦察仓库，然后占领它. 一旦我们拿下了这块地方，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}就会派他们的人洗劫这里.

column1: We've been tracking the movement of several {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoys, and that's allowed us to pinpoint their destinations: a hidden, well-defended logistics depot. This facility is a key supplier for  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in this region, and taking it from them will significantly damage their efforts against us. We'd like you to drop in, take the depot, and hold out against any enemy reinforcements.
column2: 我们一直在追踪几支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队的动向，这让我们精确定位了它们的目的地：一处隐蔽、防守严密的后勤库。该设施是该地区{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的关键供应方，从他们手里夺下将严重打击他们对我们的行动。我们希望你能降落进去，拿下后勤库，并顶住任何敌方增援。

column1: Capture & Hold Depot
column2: 夺取并守住仓库

column1: Capture the Logistics Depot
column2: 夺取后勤仓库

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Garrison
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}守备部队

column1: Occupy the Depot
column2: 占领补给站

column1: Scout the Depot
column2: 侦察补给站

column1: Commander, I'm not picking up any active hostiles, anywhere. The place looks deserted.
column2: 指挥官，我在任何地方都没探测到活动的敌人。这地方看起来空无一人。

column1: I suspect {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will be very pleased with this haul.
column2: 我猜{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会对这批缴获非常满意.

column1: The depot is ours, Commander.
column2: 这座补给站是我们的了，指挥官.

column1: Manufacturing Facility
column2: 制造设施

column1: They haven't told us what, precisely, the facility is producing, but given the strength of enemy forces on the ground, it's something worth protecting.
column2: 他们没告诉我们那座设施究竟在生产什么，但看地面上敌军兵力的规模，这东西值得保护。

column1: We've discovered that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an old manufacturing facility in this system. To maintain the balance of power in this system, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} needs to capture this facility. You'll make a surgical strike, occupy the base, and hold it until {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces can arrive to take control.
column2: 我们发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已重新启用了本星系内的一处旧制造设施。为维持本星系的势力平衡，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}需要夺取该设施。你要实施一次精准打击，占领基地，并坚守到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队抵达接管为止。

column1: Capture the Manufacturing Facility
column2: 夺取制造设施

column1: Hold the Facility Until Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 守住设施直到援军抵达

column1: Occupy the Facility
column2: 占领设施

column1: The manufacturing facility is just ahead, Commander.
column2: 那座生产设施就在前方，指挥官.

column1: Capturing Production
column2: 夺取生产设施

column1: Mech Factory
column2: 机甲工厂

column1: Embarrassing to have an enemy stealing data right out from under your nose. I'm guessing the opfor won't have had time to get any of the facility defenses online, so at least there won't be turrets.
column2: 敌人从你眼皮底下偷走数据，真是丢脸。我猜敌方来不及让该设施的任何防御上线，所以至少不会有炮塔。

column1: We picked up a coded transmission from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scouts report a previously unknown manufacturing plant has been activated by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and they're broadcasting what we believe might be pre-war blueprints to an unknown recipient somewhere in the system. We need you to move in and capture that facility, intact, and protect it while we mobilize a garrison.
column2: 我们从{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表截获一段加密传输：{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}侦察兵报告，一处此前未知的制造厂已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队启动，而他们正向该星系中某个未知收件人广播我们认为是战前蓝图的东西。我们需要你推进并完好地夺取该设施，并在我们动员驻军期间保护它。

column1: Capture the BattleMech Factory
column2: 夺取战斗机甲工厂

column1: Destroy the Occupying Enemy Force
column2: 消灭正在占领的敌方部队

column1: Hold Factory While Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 援军抵达时守住工厂

column1: Occupy the Factory
column2: 占领工厂

column1: Scout the BattleMech Factory
column2: 侦察战斗机甲工厂

column1: Sure enough, Commander, there's a lot of comm chatter coming from that factory.
column2: 果然如此，指挥官，那座工厂传来大量通讯杂音。

column1: The factory is under control, Commander, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are setting up defenses. Good work.
column2: 我们已经控制了工厂，指挥官，同时{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正在建立防御. 干得好.

column1: Nine-Tenths of the Law
column2: 占有即所有

column1: The legal justification here sounds sketchy, Commander, but we're mercenaries, not lawyers. As long as they're happy, we get paid.
column2: 这里的法律依据听起来很可疑，指挥官，但我们自己是雇佣兵，不是律师。只要他们满意，我们就能拿到钱。

column1: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have constructed a forward base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, ignoring the express wishes of the local government. Naturally, the planetary governor is furious, but he can't make a stand against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs without assistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has offered that assistance. You are to seize control of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base and hold it until we gain a legal claim to the facility. We will then sell it back to the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} government at a considerable discount.
column2: 我们得知{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队无视当地政府的明确意愿，在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上建起了一处前进基地。行星总督自然震怒，但没有援助他无法对抗{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲；{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}已提出提供这一援助。你要夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地的控制权并守住它，直到我们获得该设施的合法所有权。届时我们将以相当大的折扣把它卖回给{TGT_SYSTEM.name}政府。

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Force
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column1: Hold for enemy contact
column2: 等待敌方接触

column1: Occupy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Base
column2: 占领{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地

column1: Scout the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Base
column2: 侦察{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地

column1: Before we go for the base, we should get eyes on the enemy - the positioning of their garrison, and ideally the layout of the base itself.
column2: 在我们前往基地之前，我们应该先看看敌人--守备部队的位置，最好还有基地本身的布局.

column1: Remember, that base is our payday, and our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} employers want it intact. Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 记住，那座基地就是我们的发薪日，同时我们的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}雇主要求它完好无损. 狩猎顺利，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Sit tight, the employer will be very pleased with this haul.
column2: 原地别动，雇主会非常满意这次押运的.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility that we're here to capture should be just ahead, Commander.
column2: 我们要夺取的那处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施应该就在前方，指挥官。

column1: The base is ours, Commander.
column2: 这座基地是我们的了，指挥官.

column1: Word of warning, Commander: this base is likely to be defended by point defense turrets.
column2: 提醒一句，指挥官: 这座基地好像被一些防御炮台守卫着.

column1: You should have a clear view of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility now, Commander.
column2: 你现在应该可以清楚地看到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施了，指挥官.

column1: Ordnance Depot Capture
column2: 军火补给站夺取行动

column1: We've been tracking the movement of several {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoys, and that's allowed us to pinpoint their destinations: a hidden, well-defended ordnance depot. This facility is a key supplier for local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and taking it from them will significantly damage their efforts against us. We'd like you to drop in, take the depot, and hold out against any enemy reinforcements.
column2: 我们一直在追踪几支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队的动向，这让我们精确定位了它们的目的地：一处隐蔽、防守严密的军械库。该设施是当地{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的关键供应方，从他们手里夺下将严重打击他们对我们的行动。我们希望你能降落进去，拿下军械库，并顶住任何敌方增援。

column1: Capture the Ordnance Depot
column2: 夺取军火补给站

column1: Spazz is a nasty, nasty drug, Commander, but not really recreational in any way. If some MechWarrior wants to burn themself out on the stuff, that's on them.
column2: 疯狂是一种非常、非常凶险的药物，指挥官，根本算不上什么娱乐品。如果某个机师想把自己烧在这玩意儿上，那是他自己的事。

column1: We've been following this shipment of Spazz that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} intercepted. You'd think that, given all the things they say about Spazz, they'd have torched the stuff already. But instead they've locked it up in a secure depot. I'm sure they won't mind if we take that stuff off their hands. We have much better uses for it than just blowing it all up.
column2: 我们一直在追查这批被{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局截获的斯帕兹。你会以为，既然他们那样说斯帕兹，早该把东西烧了。但他们却把它锁进了安全仓库。我相信他们不会介意我们把东西从他们手里接走。比起一把火烧掉，我们对它有大得多的用处。

column1: Capture the Secure Depot.
column2: 夺取安全仓库.

column1: Eliminate Depot Turrets
column2: 消灭补给站的炮台

column1: Pacify the Area around the Depot
column2: 平定补给站周边地区

column1: From here, we should be able to get eyes on the depot and a look at its defenses.
column2: 从这儿，我们应该可以看到补给站和它的防御力量.

column1: Looks like our friends will have to find someone else to steal the cargo for them.
column2: 看来我们的朋友只能找其他人来帮他们窃取那个货仓了.

column1: The facility where the drugs are being kept is just ahead, commander.
column2: 保存有药物的设施就在前方，指挥官.

column1: Ripe for the Picking
column2: 下手的好机会

column1: I don't like the unspecified 'some cargo', Commander, but whatever it is, it's probably just as bad if left in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hands.
column2: 我不喜欢那句含糊的"一些货物"，指挥官，但不管它是什么，留在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}手里大概同样糟糕。

column1: I'm having a great day, Commander. You know why? I just got the latest logistics data from our friends down on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Turns out that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base where they keep all the stuff they're planning to ship off planet? It's going to be full of some extremely valuable cargo. Things we'd like to get our hands on. You capture the base, we'll loot it, and we'll both get paid.
column2: 我今天过得很愉快，指挥官。你知道为什么吗？我刚从{TGT_SYSTEM.name}下面那些朋友那里拿到最新的物流数据。原来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}存放他们打算运出行星的所有东西的那座基地？里面会装满一些极其贵重的货物。是我们想弄到手的东西。你夺取基地，我们去洗劫，我们双方都拿到钱。

column1: Capture the Logistics Base.
column2: 夺取后勤基地.

column1: From here, we should be able to get eyes on the base and a look at its defenses.
column2: 从这儿，我们应该可以看到基地和它的防御力量.

column1: The facility our friends want us to capture is just ahead, commander.
column2: 我们朋友要我们夺取的设施就在前面，指挥官.

column1: Professional Facility Management
column2: 专业设施管理

column1: Turrets always make things more complicated, but this seems like a pretty routine operation, Commander.
column2: 炮台总是让事情变得更加复杂，可这似乎是个相当常规的行动，指挥官.

column1: Fifteen years ago we lost track of a facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence believed it had been permanently shut down. A month ago, an orbiting spy satellite picked up signs that the facility had been brought back online. Our current guess is that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was dispatched to bring the base back up to operational capacity. We'd rather not have sensitive radar backed by armed turrets and flak batteries aimed at the skies of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We'd like you to clear their team out and hold the facility while our own people land to scour it for useful intel.
column2: 十五年前我们失去了{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里一处设施的踪迹，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报部门相信它已被永久关停。一个月前，一颗轨道间谍卫星捕捉到该设施被重新上线的迹象。我们目前的猜测是，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}派出一支小队来让基地恢复运作能力。我们并不希望有敏感雷达配着武装炮塔和高射炮组瞄准{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的天空。我们希望你去清掉他们的小队并守住该设施，直到我们自己的人降落来搜寻有用情报。

column1: Capture the Reactivated Facility.
column2: 夺取重新激活的设施.

column1: Commander, we're in the AO. I'm seeing those turrets we were promised, but no sign of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team that's supposed to be here.
column2: 指挥官，我们进入行动区域了。我看到了承诺的那些炮塔，但没见到本该在这里的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队。

column1: Ha! You must be the janitor they sent to turn the lights back on.
column2: 哈! 你一定就是他们派来重新点灯的看门人.

column1: Heads up, Commander; dropship inbound.
column2: 小心，指挥官; 空投艇来了.

column1: I could do without the giant ego that mercenary seems to carry around everywhere.
column2: 我可以不带着佣兵形影不离的强烈自我意识去做.

column1: I prefer to think of myself as a facility management professional.
column2: 我更喜欢把自己设想为一座设施的管理专家.

column1: Well, that was a lot more exciting than we bargained for.
column2: 嗯，那比我们预想的更令人兴奋.

column1: Pulling Linchpins
column2: 拔掉关键支点

column1: Commander, the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} plan is sound, as long as we're okay with intentionally setting up an ambush on ourselves.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的计划是稳妥的，只要我们能接受故意给自己设下伏击。

column1: We've recently discovered a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military outpost in an extremely inconvenient location, strangling trade and movement for our personnel in the area. Your mission: eliminate enemy defenses, then capture and hold the base long enough for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces to take possession. We'll support your action by drawing off some of the defenders ahead of time, so if these units retreat to the base, they'll already be weakened by our troops.
column2: 我们最近在一个极其不便的位置发现了一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事前哨，扼住了我们人员在该地区的贸易与通行。你的任务：清除敌军防御，然后夺取并守住该基地，直到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队能够接管。我们会通过提前引开部分守军来支援你的行动，所以如果这些部队撤回基地，他们已经被我们的部队削弱了。

column1: Capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} Military Outpost
column2: 夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}军用哨所

column1: Hold the Outpost while Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 援军抵达时守住哨所

column1: Occupy the Military Outpost
column2: 占领军用哨所

column1: Scout the Military Outpost
column2: 侦察军用哨所

column1: Alright, you should have good view of the Outpost now.
column2: 好了，你现在应该可以清楚地看到哨所了.

column1: Dropship inbound for landing!
column2: 空投艇抵达准备降落!

column1: Sit tight. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} should be pleased with the results.
column2: 耐心等待. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}应该会满意这些结果.

column1: The Outpost is under our control, Commander.
column2: 哨所在我们控制之下了，指挥官.

column1: We're here to capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military Outpost.
column2: 我们来这里是为了夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事前哨。

column1: Steal the Prototype
column2: 窃取原型

column1: Commander, I expect the defenses on the facility to be substantial. But if we were bothered by the odds, we wouldn't be mercenaries.
column2: 指挥官，我预计那座设施的防御相当可观。但要是我们会为胜算发愁，我们就不会当雇佣兵了。

column1: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been busy working on a new water filtration technology, which is both extremely valuable and likely to shift the balance of power in the region by opening up more worlds for colonization. We've discovered where they're working on the latest prototype. We know that they are monitoring the location of our own 'Mechs in the area, so we need a mercenary lance to make the vanguard assault and catch them by surprise. We'll then take over the facility with {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
column2: 我们得知{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在忙于研发一种新的水过滤技术，它既极其宝贵，又可能通过开辟更多可殖民世界来改变该地区的力量平衡。我们已经查清他们在哪里研发最新原型。我们知道他们正在监视我方机甲在该地区的动向，所以需要一支雇佣兵分队打头阵突击，杀他们一个措手不及。随后我们将以{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队接管该设施。

column1: Capture the Research Facility
column2: 夺取研究设施

column1: Destroy the Defending Forces
column2: 消灭守卫部队

column1: Hold the Facility While Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 援军抵达时守住设施

column1: Scout the Research Facility
column2: 侦察研究设施

column1: All right, you should have good view of the Research Facility now.
column2: 好了，你现在应该能清楚地看到研究设施了.

column1: Commander, this is the location provided by our employers.
column2: 指挥官，这儿就是雇主提供给我们的位置.

column1: Once we have a better picture of the situation, eliminate any defending forces and move into the base.
column2: 一旦我们更好地了解局面后，消灭任何防卫部队并进入基地.

column1: The Research Facility is ours, Commander; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will be pleased to have this prototype in their hands.
column2: 这座研究设施是我们的了，指挥官; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会对获得原型机满意的.

column1: Surveillance Outpost
column2: 监视哨所

column1: How relevant can intel from the ass end of nowhere really be? We're still being paid, so I suppose it doesn't matter, honestly.
column2: 从天涯海角弄来的情报能有多大用处？反正我们照样拿钱，说实话我觉得无所谓。

column1: Unremarkable, empty systems like this one are the perfect location for covert intelligence gathering operations. We believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} doing exactly that. Monitoring the pattern of DropShips making landings on the planet has led {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts to a remote, apparently empty facility. Until just a few days ago, when we picked up the unmasked signature of a 'Mech's fusion engine powering up. That facility isn't empty, and we want the data stored there.
column2: 像这样不起眼、空置的星系，正是秘密情报搜集行动的绝佳地点。我们相信{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上有一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施正在做这件事。通过监视在该星球降落的空投艇规律，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的分析人员锁定了一处偏远、看似空置的设施。直到几天前，我们捕捉到一台机甲的聚变引擎启动时未加掩蔽的信号特征。那处设施并非空置，而我们要拿到储存在那里的数据。

column1: Capture the Surveillance Outpost
column2: 夺取监视哨所

column1: Occupy the Outpost
column2: 占领哨所

column1: Pacify the Area Around the Outpost
column2: 平定哨所周边地区

column1: Scout the Outpost
column2: 侦察哨所

column1: Remember there may be more enemy units in the field, so stay alert.
column2: 记住战场上可能有更多的敌人，所以保持警惕.

column1: The outpost is ours, Commander. Our employer has agents inbound to take possession of the data archives.
column2: 这个哨所是我们的了，指挥官. 我们的雇主派特工过来接手数据档案了.

column1: These are the coordinates we received from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence.
column2: 这些就是我们从{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报中收到的坐标.

column1: Covert Surveillance
column2: 秘密监视

column1: Swift Reclamation
column2: 火速回收

column1: Commander, if these are just mercantile goods, as they say, I wouldn't expect very aggressive defenses.
column2: 指挥官，如果这些真如他们所说只是商用货物，我不会指望有多么猛烈的防御。

column1: Apparently {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} controls a network of transports and warehouses in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, moving mostly mundane merchandise but also a very few highly valuable goods. Our clandestine research efforts have acquired the latest shipping manifests and identified an opportunity for a swift, profitable strike at a key shipping hub. If timed properly, your Mechs can attack quickly and pave the way for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} extraction team to empty the warehouse of its contents.
column2: 显然，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}控制着{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系的一张运输和仓储网络，运送的大部分是普通货物，但也有少数高价值货物. 我们的秘密调查获取了最新的运输清单，并发现了对一个关键运输枢纽进行快速且高收益打击的机会. 如果时机掌握得当，你的机甲就能迅速发起攻击，为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的回收小队搬空仓库里的物资铺平道路.

column1: Hold the Warehouses while Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 援军抵达时守住仓库

column1: Occupy the Warehouses
column2: 占领仓库

column1: Plunder the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} warehouse complex
column2: 洗劫{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的仓库群

column1: Scout the Warehouses
column2: 侦察仓库

column1: Alright, you should have good view of the warehouse complex now.
column2: 好了，你们现在应该可以清楚地看到仓库群了.

column1: Sit tight. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will be pleased with these results.
column2: 耐心等待. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会满意这些结果的.

column1: The warehouse complex is under our control, Commander.
column2: 仓库群已在我们控制之下，指挥官.

column1: We're here to capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} warehouse complex.
column2: 我们来这里是为了夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的仓库群。

column1: Synthetic Plague
column2: 人造瘟疫

column1: I'll ask the obvious question: how do we know they won't just keep the bioweapons for themselves? Then again, if we second guessed every job, we'd be broke.
column2: 我要问那个显而易见的问题：我们怎么知道他们不会把生物武器留给自己？话又说回来，如果我们每份活都这么疑神疑鬼，早就饿死了。

column1: We've got a developing situation, Commander, and we need immediate aid from a reliable mercenary company. A covert {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was investigating reports of a cache of bioweapons on an otherwise abandoned world. We've tracked down four of these caches in the Periphery over the last 20 years, and disposed of them safely. The team was about to signal for an extraction when their signal went dead. We have reason to believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have taken control of the cache site, and eliminated our covert team. We need you to take that site and signal our disposal team.
column2: 指挥官，情况正在发展，我们需要一家可靠雇佣兵公司的立即援助。一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}秘密小队正在调查一处据称存放生物武器储藏点的废弃世界。过去二十年里我们在外围地区追查到四处这类储藏点并安全销毁。小队正准备发出撤离信号时失联了。我们有理由相信{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已控制了储藏点现场并消灭了我们的秘密小队。我们需要你夺取该现场并向我们的处置小组发信号。

column1: Capture the Bioweapon Storage Site
column2: 夺取生物武器储存场

column1: Destroy the Enemy Defenders
column2: 消灭敌方守卫

column1: Occupy the Bioweapon Storage Site
column2: 占领生物武器储存场

column1: Pacify the Area Around the Bioweapon Storage Site
column2: 平定生物武器储存场周边地区

column1: Scout the Bioweapon Storage Site
column2: 侦察生物武器储存场

column1: We're in the AO, Commander. My skin is crawling just thinking about what's out here.
column2: 我们进入行动区域了，指挥官。光是想想外面有什么，我就浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

column1: The B Team
column2: B队

column1: This seems like the kind of setup where afterwards we'll say 'It was supposed to be undefended!', Commander. Be prepared.
column2: 这看起来像是那种布局——完事之后我们会说'它本该是无人防守的！'，指挥官。做好准备。

column1: We're training a group of MechWarriors to act as a local defense force, and we'd like you to assist in their training. There's a decommissioned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we need to take ownership of. As it's undefended, this is a perfect opportunity for our trainees to practice operating as a team in a low-risk environment. We need you to send along a single experienced MechWarrior to keep an eye on them and model good behavior for them.
column2: 我们正在训练一批机甲战士，让他们担任本地防御部队，希望你能协助他们的训练。有一处已退役的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地需要我们接手。由于该基地没有防御，这正是我们的受训人员练习团队协作的绝佳低风险机会。我们需要你派出一名经验丰富的机甲战士随行，照看他们并为他们树立良好的榜样。

column1: Capture the Decommissioned Base.
column2: 夺取已退役的基地.

column1: Can we blow up some of the buildings?
column2: 我们能炸掉一些建筑吗?

column1: Get your lance into that base, Commander, and hold out till our employer can get some more people on the ground.
column2: 派你的小队进入那座基地，指挥官，在我们雇主派更多人到地面之前守住.

column1: I think these kids could use some more time on the practice range.
column2: 我想这些孩子本可以在靶场花上更多时间的.

column1: So all we gotta do is just walk in there and stand around? This job sounds like bullshit to me. I wanna learn how to shoot, not stand around!
column2: 所以我们只要走进去站着不动就行? 这活听起来像胡扯. 我想学怎么开枪，不是站着发呆!

column1: Stow it, Meyer. It all worked out fine, and we get paid.
column2: 别说啦，梅耶尔. 结局不错，我们也拿到了钱.

column1: That sucks. Can I shoot some of the buildings anyway?
column2: 真无聊. 无论如何我能不能朝些建筑打几枪?

column1: Well... that certainly was an experience. Darius, I think we should get hazard pay for this kind of mission.
column2: 好吧...这真是一次难忘的经历. 达吕斯，我觉得这种任务我们该收取危险津贴.

column1: This seems like a mission where afterwards we'll say 'It was supposed to be undefended!', Commander. Be prepared.
column2: 这看起来像是那种任务——完事之后我们会说'它本该是无人防守的！'，指挥官。做好准备。

column1: Aww, really? Come on, I want more targets!
column2: 噢，真的吗? 来吧，我要更多目标!

column1: Yes. Why, do you have something?
column2: 是的. 怎么了，你发现什么了吗?

column1: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.
column2: 这个星系是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}扩张计划的目标之一。不幸的是，殖民计划落空了，我们现在必须在殖民者被敌对势力拦截之前，把他们从行星表面撤出来。由于对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}存在互相矛盾且可疑的主权声索，而该殖民地本是秘密，我们不能公开进行一次大规模救援行动。我们需要一个可否认的中间人。

column1: Ammunition Convoy
column2: 弹药车队

column1: Not much to say, Commander. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} made a tactical fumble, and we're going to bail them out. The convoy lead is privately offering to make sure a few crates of ammo 'fall off the truck' if we get them home.
column2: 没什么好说的，指挥官。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}在战术上搞砸了，而我们要去把他们捞出来。车队领队私下表示，如果我们把他们送回家，他可以保证让几箱弹药“从车上掉下来”。

column1: We've had reports of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near one of our outlying bases. Unfortunately, we already have a military supply convoy in the field, and it will be easy prey for a force of 'Mechs. We need you to rendezvous with the convoy and protect it while it's being evacuated.
column2: 我们收到报告称在我们一处边远基地附近有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}活动。不幸的是，我们已有一支军用补给车队在外，它会很容易成为一支机甲部队的猎物。我们需要你与车队会合，并在它撤离期间提供保护。

column1: Commander, the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy is right on schedule, and as predicted, we're picking up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的车队时间表完全正常，而正如预测，我们正在该区域发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位。

column1: Move to intercept the convoy and provide cover and support while they escape.
column2: 前去拦截车队，在他们撤离时提供掩护和支援.

column1: You heard those scare quotes didn't you boss? Civilian Liaison means Spec Ops. They're in a rush so I got them to promise a few crates of ammo would 'fall off the truck' as a bonus.
column2: 你听到那些意味深长的引号了吧老板？“平民联络官”就是特种作战。他们很急，所以我让他们承诺让几箱弹药“从车上掉下来”作为额外报酬。

column1: One of our Civilian Liaison Teams has acquired a recently former {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} ammunition depot following the sudden death of much of the staff in an unfortunate incident. We removing the ammunition to a secure location lest if fall into the wrong hands. Your company is to provide security during the extraction.
column2: 我们的一支平民联络队接管了一座不久前还属于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的弹药库，此前库内大部分人员在一起不幸的事故中突然丧生. 我们正在将弹药转移至安全地点，以免落入不法之徒手中. 你们佣兵连的任务是在转移期间提供安保.

column1: The ammunition depot is just up ahead, Commander.
column2: 弹药库就在前方，指挥官。

column1: Rumor has it that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} have been smuggling restricted munitions in among their medical supplies. On the surface, at least, we're being tasked with a humanitarian escort mission.
column2: 传言说{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}一直在把受管制弹药藏在他们的医疗物资里偷运。至少表面上，我们接到的任务是执行一次人道主义护送任务。

column1: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}违反一切战场底线与可接受行为，一直在攻击我们的医院与医疗物资。我们正设法把补给重新分配到更安全的地点，但有一支车队仍缺乏适当的护航。这就轮到你了。虽然{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会疲于拦截我们各批分散的货运，但你可以预料到这一批不会被忽视。

column1: Get them to safety, keep them intact, and get out there when it's done.
column2: 把他们送到安全处，保证他们完好，事后就撤出来。

column1: We have friendly units ahead.
column2: 前方有友军单位。

column1: Secure the Assets
column2: 确保资产安全

column1: Commander, the carriers they're talking about are slow and fragile. On the other hand they could certainly provide fire support if things go south.
column2: 指挥官，他们说的那些车辆又慢又脆。但另一方面，如果情况恶化，它们确实能提供火力支援。

column1: The position of one of our lances of fire support vehicles has become untenable due to the proximity of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces. We'd like you to provide security while we relocate them.
column2: 由于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队逼近，我们一支火力支援车辆分队的阵地已无法坚守。希望你能在我们转移它们时提供掩护。

column1: Blown Operation
column2: 破坏行动

column1: When I hear 'rapid' and 'immediate', I'm thinking 'no intel' and 'expect nasty surprises', Commander.
column2: 听到“迅速”和“立即”，我就想到“没有情报”和“准备好迎接可怕意外”，指挥官。

column1: Less than an hour ago, we lost contact with a covert team tasked with infiltrating a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility. The only reason for them not to respond is if their operation was blown, by discovery or counterintelligence. The research materials they were meant to collect are extremely important, and we can't afford to lose them. We need you to make a rapid and immediate deployment to the the facility, and get our people and their cargo to safety.
column2: 不到一小时前，我们与一支奉命潜入 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 设施的秘密小队失去了联系。他们不回应的唯一可能，就是行动已经暴露——无论是被察觉，还是被反间谍部门识破。他们原本要取回的研究资料极其重要，我们绝不能失去它们。我们需要你立即快速部署到该设施，把我们的人和货物安全撤出。

column1: Capture Facility, Protect Covert Team, and Extract Safely
column2: 夺取设施，保护秘密小队，安全撤离

column1: Mercenary force, you are entering a restricted {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} area. Withdraw or you will be fired on.
column2: 雇佣兵部队，你们正进入{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的限制区域. 立刻撤离，否则将对你们开火.

column1: The covert team and the research materials are safe. Well done, Commander.
column2: 秘密小组和研究材料都安全了. 做得不错，指挥官.

column1: Try not to get any of them shot or stepped on. Good luck.
column2: 设法别让他们中的任何一个挨枪或被踩踏. 祝你好运.

column1: We have an LZ marked for you. Is your team ready to move?
column2: 我们已经为你们标记了着陆区. 你们的队伍准备好出发了吗?

column1: When I hear 'rapid' and 'immediate', it makes me think 'no intel' and 'expect nasty surprises', Commander.
column2: 指挥官，一听到“迅速”和“立即”，我就想到“没有情报”和“等着挨闷棍”。

column1: Civilian Extraction
column2: 撤出平民

column1: There is probably more to this than {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} are saying, but our role would be limited to escorting a convoy of personnel carriers to an evac point. The remainder of this situation is someone else's problem.
column2: 这事可能比{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}说的要复杂，但我们的任务仅限于护送一支运兵车队到撤离点。剩下的情况是别人的问题。

column1: Our research facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been under constant attack from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces for some time. Rather than continue to risk their lives, we are evacuating the noncombatants. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will pay handsomely for a mercenary unit to protect them from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} aggression.
column2: 一段时间以来，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的研究设施一直受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}势力的攻击. 我们不愿意让非战斗人员继续冒着生命危险，我们决定撤离他们. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}将为雇佣兵部队提供丰厚报酬，以保护他们免受{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的攻击.

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The convoy safely reached extraction, and I have Sumire moments away from your position for a pick up. Be ready.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 车队安全抵达了撤离点，我让苏米尔马上到你们的位置接应. 请做好准备.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} researchers are en route in APCs, Commander. I'm sending you coordinates for the rendezvous point. Secure the site.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的研究人员正乘装甲运兵车赶来，指挥官。我把会合点的坐标发给你。确保该地点安全。

column1: The scientists are approaching the rendezvous point now. Watch over them, Commander. Those APCs are fragile.
column2: 现在那些科学家正在接近会合点. 保护好他们，指挥官. 那些装甲运兵车可不牢靠.

column1: Grand Theft Auto
column2: 侠盗猎车手

column1: Commander, if that Demolisher has ammo on board, this could be a short and simple mission. Those things are terrifying.
column2: 指挥官，如果那辆“破坏者”载有弹药，这就可能是个简短利落的任务. 那些东西太可怕了.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have recently taken a shipment of military vehicles, including an operational Demolisher. This represents an unacceptable buildup of force on this world, but also presents us with an opportunity. We have people in place prepared to steal those vehicles, but without 'Mechs providing an escort, they'll be attacked as soon as {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} command notices they're leaving without orders. Get the vehicles to an extraction point, and keep them intact.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局最近接收了一批军用车辆，其中包括一辆可作战的破坏者。这代表该星球上不可接受的军力集结，但也给了我们机会。我们已有人手准备偷走那些车辆，但若没有机甲护航，一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥部发现它们未经命令离营，就会立刻遭到攻击。把这些车辆送到撤离点，并保持完好。

column1: Reach Motor Pool, Escort Vehicles, and Extract Safely
column2: 到达车辆调配场，护送车辆，安全撤离

column1: Secure the Motor Pool
column2: 拿下车辆调配场

column1: Bravo squad, this is Argo actual. Are you ready to move?
column2: Bravo小队，这里是阿尔戈号指挥官. 你们准备好出发了吗?

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The vehicles are safely away.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 车辆安全离开了.

column1: Ha! I like these guys, Darius.
column2: 哈! 我喜欢这些家伙，达吕斯.

column1: Keep radio silence, people. And expect more company.
column2: 保持无线电静默，诸位. 预计更多敌军将至.

column1: Not seeing any 'Mech engine signatures. It doesn't seem like they're alerted to our presence yet, XO.
column2: 没看到任何机甲引擎信号。他们似乎还没察觉我们来了，副官。

column1: Once they power those vehicles up, all hell is going to break loose, so be ready.
column2: 一旦他们启动了那些车辆，局面将彻底失控，做好应战准备.

column1: Commander, if that Demolisher has ammo on board, this mission might be short and simple. Those things are terrifying.
column2: 指挥官，如果那辆“破坏者”载有弹药，任务可能会简短利落. 那些东西太可怕了.

column1: Roger, Argo. The good news is that the Demolisher is armed. The bad news is that it needs some serious maintenance, and its armor is garbage.
column2: 收到，阿尔戈号. 好消息是“破坏者”已武装完毕. 坏消息是它需要大修，而且装甲形同虚设.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
column2: 一艘{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇坠毁在这块空荡的岩石上，此后不久我们探测到来自地表的求救信号。我们赶到时，船员已被一支装备精良的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获。我们在该星系内没有足够大的军事存在来执行人质营救行动，所以我们在找一家称职的雇佣兵公司来做。我们需要你抵达关押船员的那处设施，摧毁看守他们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，并护送他们到安全地带。

column1: Hostile Acquisition
column2: 敌意收购

column1: I'm sure that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep thinks they're very clever, but this kind of headhunting is serious. We should expect the enemy to shoot to kill.
column2: 我相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的那位代表觉得自己很聪明，但这种猎首行动是严肃的事。我们应该料到敌人会下死手。

column1: Our intelligence analysts located a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We've already pacified the base, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} made very firm job offers to the scientists at the facility. Almost all of them have accepted. We need to evacuate those scientists before their previous employers hear about their new positions.
column2: 我们的情报分析员在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 上发现了一处藏得极深的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 研究基地。我们已肃清该基地，而 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 向设施内的科学家们开出了十分坚决的聘请条件。他们几乎全都接受了。我们必须在这些科学家的旧雇主得知他们的新职位之前，把他们撤出来。

column1: The research base is just up ahead, Commander.
column2: 研究基地就在前面，指挥官.

column1: The scientists are in custody, Commander. Well done.
column2: 科学家被收押了，指挥官. 做得不错.

column1: Job Offer
column2: 工作邀约

column1: Desperation is good for business. I'd guess a broken cease-fire means we're likely to encounter military units on our way to the pickup; stay alert, Commander.
column2: 绝望对生意有利。我猜停火协议被破坏意味着我们前往接应点的路上很可能遇到军事单位；保持警觉，指挥官。

column1: A convoy of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} doctors ministering to those recovering from the recent conflicts here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have become caught behind enemy lines when the cease fire collapsed. A lance of mechs tasked with the rescue have gone missing, so we are desperate for assistance from anyone.
column2: 在停火协议破裂后，一支由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}医护人员组成的车队被困在敌后，他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上为最近冲突中受伤的人提供医疗援助. 一队负责救援的机甲已经失踪了，因此我们迫切需要任何人的援助.

column1: Move to their position and provide support as needed.
column2: 前往他们的位置并提供所需的支援.

column1: The convoy is just up ahead, awaiting our arrival.
column2: 车队就在前方，等候我们的抵达.

column1: Insurrection Protection
column2: 叛乱保护

column1: Commander, I've done some research, and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} really wants this particular rebel eliminated. Stay alert and expect the worst. That's usually a good approach.
column2: 指挥官，我做了些调查，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}非常想除掉这名特定的叛军。保持警觉，做好最坏的打算。这通常是个好办法。

column1: Here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been an oppressive presence for some time, which has led to a number of revolutionary leaders rising up from the common people to strike at the status quo. One such leader has been targeted by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} for elimination. It's in the interest of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership that this rabble rouser survives.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系这里，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}长期以来是一股压迫性的存在，这导致许多革命领袖从平民中崛起，打击现状。其中一位领袖已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}列为清除目标。让这名煽动者活下来符合{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层的利益。

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The convoy safely reached extraction, and we are moments away from your position for a pick up.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 车队安全抵达了撤离点，我们马上就到你的位置来接你.

column1: The Convoy pickup point is up ahead.
column2: 车队接应点就在前方。

column1: Man of the People
column2: 人民之子

column1: Commander, I've chatted with this politician briefly, and he is certainly a piece of work. I suspect that his enemies may not wait until the ballot box to remove him from power.
column2: 指挥官，我跟这位政客简短聊过，他确实是个极品。我怀疑他的敌人可能不会等到投票箱才把他赶下台。

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} politician is looking for an armed escort to guide him safely to a diplomatic summit. We can assure you that any accusations of bribery and corruption are completely unfounded. His {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} enemies are simply stirring up the common people against him.
column2: 一名{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政客正在寻求一队武装护卫，以确保他安全前往一次外交峰会. 我们可以向你保证，任何关于贿赂和腐败的指控都是莫须有的. 他的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌人只是在煽动民众反对他.

column1: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. Looks like {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is sending in additional units, bound for your position.
column2: 传感器上出现了更多接触，指挥官. 看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}派遣了另外的部队，正在接近你的位置.

column1: The politician's convoy is already under fire!
column2: 那位政客的车队已经遭到攻击！

column1: Penitent Justice
column2: 忏悔的正义

column1: Commander, I've read a bit about this criminal and the things that she's accused of. I suspect {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will do anything to eliminate her. If we take this job, we should expect trouble.
column2: 指挥官，我读过一些关于这名罪犯以及她被指控之事的内容。我猜{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}会不惜一切除掉她。如果我们接下这份活，就该预期有麻烦。

column1: A long-time enemy of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has unexpectedly turned herself into local authorities, and will now be extradited to another system for trial. However, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} does not want to see her testify, and will try to stop her from leaving the planet. We've secured a convoy of armored vehicles to transport the criminal, but we need the extra fire-power of your 'Mechs to guarantee a safe path to the evacuation zone.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}的一个长期敌人出人意料地向当地当局自首，如今将被引渡到另一星系受审。然而，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}不希望看到她作证，会试图阻止她离开这颗行星。我们已备好一支装甲车辆车队来押送这名罪犯，但我们需要你机甲的额外火力，以确保通往撤离区的道路安全。

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Convoy safely reached extraction, and I have Sumire moments away from your position for a pick up. Be ready.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}车队安全抵达了撤离点，我让苏米尔马上到你们的位置接应. 请准备好.

column1: The convoy is waiting for us.
column2: 车队正等着我们.

column1: Weapons technicians, huh? Well, I suppose a rescue op is a rescue op, no matter who we're rescuing.
column2: 武器技师，是吗？好吧，我想救援行动就是救援行动，不管救的是谁。

column1: We've got a little problem, Commander, and you're just the people to help us out. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities raided one of our warehouses. The guns and drugs, they can keep, but they also captured some of our best technicians. We need those people back to continue our work here. They're being transported to the detention center for interrogation, which would not be good for our business at all. We need you to rescue them.
column2: 我们碰上点小麻烦，指挥官，而你们正是能帮我们的人。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局突袭了我们的一处仓库。枪械和毒品，他们留着也行，可他们还抓走了我们最好的几名技师。我们需要那些人回来，好继续在这里干活。他们正被押往拘留中心接受审讯，这对我们的生意可大大不妙。我们想请你把他们救出来。

column1: The convoy has stopped at a nearby facility, Commander.
column2: 车队已经停靠在附近的一处设施了，指挥官.

column1: Unexpected Guests
column2: 不速之客

column1: There's got to be more to this story than just a simple kidnapping, Commander.
column2: 这故事背后肯定不只是一次简单的绑架，指挥官。

column1: I can't imagine why our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends didn't let us know they'd invited a bunch of wealthy merchants to visit. We'd have prepared a welcoming party for them at the spaceport. Instead, it looks like we're going to have to meet up with them out in the field. Luckily, we know where they are; the drivers of their little convoy were pretty happy with the payoff we gave them. We want you to go down there and escort our new friends to safety.
column2: 我想不通为什么我们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}朋友没告诉我们，他们邀请了一群富商来访。不然我们本可以在太空港给他们准备一场欢迎会。结果看来我们得在野外和他们碰面。幸运的是，我们知道他们在哪儿；他们那支小车队的司机对我们给的报酬相当满意。我们要你下去护送我们的新朋友到安全地带。

column1: More contacts, Commander. These folks are shooting to kill. Who the hell is on these transports, anyway?
column2: 更多接触，指挥官. 这些家伙是抱着必杀的态度在开火. 在这些运输车里的到底是什么人?

column1: The Price of Discretion
column2: 谨慎的代价

column1: Commander, I suspect that our employers' reluctance to commit their own forces has less to do with any extreme danger of the task, but some distaste with their merchant friend.
column2: 指挥官，我怀疑我们的雇主不愿投入自己的部队，与其说是任务极度危险，不如说是对他们那位商人朋友有些不满。

column1: We're looking for a mercenary company with a reputation for discretion. A personal friend of our leadership here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has requested protection for a convoy of his, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} can't commit our own forces to this task. While his convoy is armed and armored, he suspects that his enemies have hired mercenaries of their own to interdict this shipment.
column2: 我们在找一家以谨慎保密闻名的雇佣兵公司。我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}领导层的一位私人朋友请求为他的车队提供保护，但{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}无法把自家部队投入这项任务。虽然他的车队有武装有装甲，但他怀疑他的敌人也雇了雇佣兵来阻截这批货。

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy safely reached extraction, and I have Sumire moments away from your position for a pick up. Be ready.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}车队安全抵达了撤离点，我让苏米尔马上到你们的位置接应. 请准备好.

column1: The convoy is waiting for you.
column2: 车队正在等你.

column1: Professional Lifestyle
column2: 职场生活方式

column1: The truth is, I hate fighting other mercenaries. It seems like such a waste of perfectly good armor and myomer.
column2: 真相是，我讨厌和其他佣兵战斗. 这似乎是对优质装甲和麦约摩尔的一种浪费.

column1: We've become aware of a target of opportunity. There's a convoy of military supplies moving through unpatrolled regions on the planet below, and we'd like to seize it for ourselves. The problem is that we have credible reports that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are also moving to intercept, and they've hired a skilled mercenary to lead their efforts. We'd like you to capture that convoy instead, and take it to a designated evac zone for pickup.
column2: 我们得知有一处可乘之机的目标。有一支军用补给车队正穿过下面行星上无人巡逻的区域，我们想把它据为己有。问题在于，我们有可靠报告称{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队也在前往拦截，而且他们雇了一名技艺娴熟的雇佣兵来指挥。我们希望你去夺取那支车队，把它带到指定撤离区等待接收。

column1: Destroy Enemy Blocking Force
column2: 消灭敌方阻截部队

column1: Ensure All Convoy units survive during Extraction
column2: 确保撤离期间车队全部单位存活

column1: Escort Convoy units to their evac zone
column2: 护送车队单位前往撤离区域

column1: Enemy mercenary, be advised that we will not allow you to capture this convoy.
column2: 敌方佣兵，注意我们是不会允许你们夺走这支车队的.

column1: Looks like I got us here first, boss. You're welcome.
column2: 看来是我先到这儿了，老大。不用谢。

column1: Polite hostages? Huh. I could get used to that.
column2: 有礼貌的人质? 嗯. 我可以习惯的.

column1: Witness Protection
column2: 证人保护

column1: Commander, if the convoy has been attacked once, we can just about guarantee that it's going to be attacked again. Somehow, I doubt {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will give up so easily.
column2: 指挥官，如果车队已经被袭击过一次，我们几乎可以保证它还会再被袭击。不知怎么的，我怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}不会这么轻易放弃。

column1: An ally of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} stands accused of a long list of illegal, unethical and deplorable activities. Proof of her guilt was being transported to a spaceport, for safe-keeping off-planet, when it was attacked by unidentified mercenary forces. The convoy narrowly escaped and we need you to protect it while we arrange for a dropship pickup.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}盟友被指控涉及一系列非法、不道德及令人发指的活动. 她的罪证正被运送至太空港以便转移到星球之外保管，但途中遭到不明雇佣兵部队的袭击. 车队勉强摆脱了敌人，我们需要你保护车队，直到我们安排空投艇接应.

column1: Move to intercept them and provide support.
column2: 前去拦截他们并提供支援.

column1: We have friendly units in danger, Commander.
column2: 一个友方单位正处于危险之中，指挥官.

column1: Commander, while I imagine they will fire at targets of opportunity you shouldn't rely on support from our employer's lance. They'll be making a bee line for their extraction point.
column2: 指挥官，虽然我想他们会朝可乘之机的目标开火，但你不该指望雇主那支分队的支援。他们会直扑撤离点。

column1: A lance of our heaviest mechs is in poor repair after a long patrol. We have credible intelligence suggesting that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will attempt to exploit this vulnerability. We have no other significant units available in the area so we need you to drop and run interference while we extract our mechs to a repair facility.
column2: 我们一队重型机甲在执行了长时间巡逻后状况不佳. 我们有可靠情报表明，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}将试图利用这一弱点. 我们在该地区没有其他主力部队可用，因此需要你们空降，在我们把机甲撤往维修设施的过程中进行掩护.

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The convoy has been extracted, and Sumire is on her way to get you.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 车队已经撤出来了，苏米尔正飞过去接你们.

column1: More contacts on the sensors, Commander! Looks like a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} assault team - stop them before they can destroy the convoy!
column2: 传感器上出现了更多接触，指挥官! 看来是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的突击小队--赶在他们消灭车队前阻止他们!

column1: We have friendly units about to come under fire.
column2: 我们的一个友方单位就快受到攻击了.

column1: As soon as {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership realizes what we're doing, Commander, they're going to try to destroy the convoy themselves. Expect enemy reinforcements to target the vehicles.
column2: 一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层意识到我们在做什么，指挥官，他们就会试图亲自摧毁这支车队。预期敌方增援会把目标对准车辆。

column1: We've received intel that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is reinforcing one of their key fortifications on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. If we allow them to do so, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} destabilization operations here will be set back by months, possibly years. We need you to intercept the supply convoy and redirect it to a waiting dropship, which will carry the supplies to our insurgent forces on the planet.
column2: 我们收到情报，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在加固他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处关键要塞。若任由他们得逞，我们在这里的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}颠覆行动将倒退数月、甚至数年。我们需要你拦截补给车队，并把它改道送往一艘待命的空投艇，由后者把补给运给该星球上的我方叛乱部队。

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The convoy safely reached extraction, and I have Sumire moments away from your position for a pick up.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 车队安全抵达了撤离点，我让苏米尔马上到你们的位置接应.

column1: Get them to the extraction LZ, keep them intact, and then get to the evac point. Oliveira out.
column2: 带他们到撤离用着陆区，保证他们安然无恙，然后前往撤离点. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Pack it in, Commander. This has turned into a real shit-show.
column2: 结束吧，指挥官. 这里的情况已经变成了真正的狗屎表演.

column1: The supply convoy is right where our employers said it would be.
column2: 那支补给车队就在我们雇主所说的位置.

column1: Save the Prototype
column2: 挽救原型

column1: Commander, this is definitely a contract where speed is of the essence. I expect that if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces locate the asset, they'll rally reinforcements from the captured research facility.
column2: 指挥官，这绝对是一份讲究速度的合同。我预计一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队找到那个资产，他们就会从被占领的研究设施调集增援。

column1: A surprise attack by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} resulted in the capture of our research facility here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. At the last moment, when all was lost, a convoy managed to escape with an extremely valuable prototype. With the facility in enemy hands, we need this prototype to reconstruct the work of our scientists. Intercept the convoy before the enemy does, and escort our researchers to safety.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的一次突袭导致我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的研究设施被夺走了. 在最后关头，几乎失去一切的时候，一支车队设法带走了一件极其珍贵的原型. 由于设施已落入敌手，我们需要这件原型来重建科学家的研究成果. 在敌人之前找到这支车队，并护送我们的研究人员安全撤离.

column1: Scientific Emergency
column2: 科学突发事件

column1: Show of Force
column2: 武力展示

column1: It's always a good time to shoot pirates, Commander.
column2: 射海盗永远都是好时候，指挥官。

column1: Theft and banditry on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have become a tremendous problem of late, to the point that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} corporate interests can't safely move goods overland. We need a mercenary company capable of defending our convoy and deterring any hostile force that may want what it's carrying. Payment will be remitted upon our receipt of the convoy and the successful evac of your lance.
column2: 近来{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的盗窃与匪患成了大问题，严重到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的企业利益无法安全地经陆路运送货物。我们需要一支能守住我们车队、并震慑任何觊觎其所载货物的敌对势力的雇佣兵公司。报酬将在我们收到车队、且你的分队成功撤离后支付。

column1: The rendezvous point is here, designated Zone Alpha.
column2: 会合点在这里，就指定为A区.

column1: This is a convoy escort mission. We need to take a predetermined position, rendezvous with the convoy, and get it to its destination in one piece.
column2: 这是一次车队护航任务。我们需要占据预定位置、与车队会合，并把它完好无损地送到目的地。

column1: Supply Convoy
column2: 补给车队

column1: Not much to say, Commander. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} made a tactical fumble, and we're going to bail them out.
column2: 没什么好说的，指挥官。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}在战术上搞砸了，而我们要去把他们捞出来。

column1: We've had reports of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near one of our outlying bases. Unfortunately, we already have a supply convoy in the field, and it will be easy prey for a force of 'Mechs. We need you to rendezvous with the convoy and protect it while it's being evacuated.
column2: 我们有报告称，在我们一处偏远基地附近发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的活动。不幸的是，我们已有一支补给车队在外，面对一队机甲很容易成为猎物。我们需要你与车队会合，并在其撤离过程中提供保护。

column1: Get to your Evac Point
column2: 到达你的撤离点

column1: The Prisoner
column2: 囚犯

column1: This is a hot one, Commander. It's going to be a crap shoot which one {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will decide to make their main assault. You need to prepare as if it's going to be this one.
column2: 这一票很热，指挥官。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}会决定对哪一处发动主攻，纯属赌运气。你需要按这里会成为主攻来准备。

column1: We need to transfer a prisoner from {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} to another system. This prisoner has allies in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} that will stop at nothing to set their ally free. To make it harder for them to target the prisoner, we are doing our best to send out mixed signals on the prisoner and when the transfer will be. We are also sending {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces out as 'dummy' convoys, and sending multiple vehicles in each convoy. However, your convoy will be the real one.
column2: 我们需要把一名囚犯从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}转移到另一个星系。这名囚犯在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}有盟友，他们会不惜一切释放他们的同伙。为让他们更难锁定这名囚犯，我们尽力在囚犯本人以及转移时间上放出混杂信号。我们还会派出{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队作为"诱饵"车队，并在每支车队中派出多辆车辆。然而，你的车队才是真的那支。

column1: Commander, we have word the prisoner is safely under lock and key; good work.
column2: 指挥官，我们收到消息，犯人已经安全收押; 干得好.

column1: Keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} units alive and get them to the extraction point. Oliveira out.
column2: 保证{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}单位活着，带他们前往撤离点. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Looks like {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} got here before us. Guess the deception didn't work.
column2: 看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}比我们先到了。看来这套欺骗没奏效。

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.\n\nDrop Cost Multiplier: 1.02.
column2: Centurion 是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也善于打人。CN9-A 型可在任何距离上交战，但越接近目标，其伤害输出曲线越高。\n\n投放费用倍率：1.02。

column1: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect.\n\nDrop Cost Multiplier: 0.98.
column2: 黑豹9R是扎实的全能机甲，只是速度稍慢。它们用跳跃推进器、可观的装甲以及标志性粒子炮的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于肉搏缠斗并取得不错效果。\n\n投放费用倍率：0.98。

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 暗影鹰 2H 是"样样通吃"的完美范例。它具备适用于所有射程的武器，速度与跳跃能力可观，装甲也相当不错。代价是它在任何方面都不特别出众。 特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.\n\nDrop Cost Multiplier: 0.97.
column2: 别被矮墩墩的"城市仔"骗了，它看着像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装上重型装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它们的射程内，它们就非常有用。\n\n投放成本倍率：0.97。
