column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility must be running on incredibly narrow margins if they can't afford to protect it themselves. Anyway, Commander, this should be very straightforward.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 的设施若是连自我防护都负担不起，那经营利润一定薄得可怜。总之，指挥官，这次任务应该非常简单直接。

column1: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous. We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site. Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
column2: 敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直向我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处加工设施发动袭击，袭击越来越肆无忌惮. 这座设施对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说是一笔巨额资金投入，其被摧毁将带来政治和经济上的双重灾难. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵部队来防御该地点. 在击退了所有敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位后，我们就会把报酬汇给你.

column1: All right, Commander, we've been tasked with defending this installation.
column2: 好的指挥官，我们奉命防守这座设施。

column1: Excellent work, Commander - the hostiles are clear and our facility is secure.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官--所有敌人已经被清除，我们的设施安全了.

column1: We have scattered reports of incoming hostiles from multiple directions.
column2: 我们从多个方向上收到零星报告说有敌人来袭.

column1: We're in position! All engineers have disembarked from the Personal carriers. The APCs will scatter and support you, keep the Turrets online and we'll keep firing.
column2: 我们到位了！所有工兵都已从人员运输车下车。装甲运兵车会散开支援你，让炮塔保持在线，我们就会持续开火。

column1: This job doesn't seem all that difficult, but... Turrets? Please. Never send a machine to do a MechWarrior's job.
column2: 这活看起来没那么难，可是……炮塔？拜托。永远别派机器去做机师的活。

column1: We have an urgent problem that needs an immediate military response, Commander. We've just detected multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShips en route to one of our supply bases. Logistics bases are generally protected by automated turret systems, but this attack force is much larger than the turret systems were meant for. We want you to provide additional firepower in case the turrets aren't enough.
column2: 指挥官，我们有个紧急问题需要立即的军事响应。我们刚探测到多艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇正前往我们的一处补给基地。后勤基地一般由自动炮塔系统保护，但这支进攻力量远大于炮塔系统所能应对的规模。我们希望你在炮塔不够用时提供额外火力。

column1: Defend Logistics Base
column2: 守卫后勤基地

column1: Hey, Darius. Are there supposed to be turrets guarding this place?
column2: 嘿，达吕斯. 这个地方该有炮台守卫吗?

column1: There should be. Why?
column2: 应该是. 怎么了?

column1: There is a small {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that has been attacked by raiders. Their latest attack was far better organized and equipped than the previous ones, suggesting the raiders are receiving logistical and tactical support from a hostile power. We might not be able to withstand a second attack of that scale. We'd like to hire you to provide additional defensive support.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上有一处小型{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，一直遭到劫掠者袭击。他们最近一次袭击的组织与装备远比之前几次精良，说明劫掠者正在从某个敌对势力获得后勤与战术支援。我们可能承受不住再一次那种规模的袭击。我们想雇你提供额外的防御支援。

column1: Destroy Enemy Vanguard
column2: 消灭敌方先锋

column1: Looks like {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}'s intel was right.
column2: 看来{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}的情报没错。

column1: This could get ugly. Commander, priority one is to keep them away from the base. Oliveira out.
column2: 情况要变得糟糕起来了. 指挥官，首要目标就是让他们远离基地. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Cover the returning patrol until it gets inside the base.
column2: 掩护返程巡逻队直到其进入基地.

column1: There are no static weapon emplacements on this facility and I couldn't pin their negotiator down on whether any of the VTOL assets on site are going to be of any use.
column2: 这处设施上没有固定武器阵位，而我也没法从他们的谈判代表嘴里问出，现场那些VTOL资产是否有任何用处。

column1: Our VTOL factory on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under threat because of rumors that we are developing a new military airframe. This gossip has reached certain parties who may send spies and saboteurs. We have arranged for a garrison force to be moved into place, but we need mercenaries to protect the factory until our forces arrive.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的VTOL(垂直起降飞行器)工厂正面临威胁，因为有传言称我们正在研发一款新的军用机身. 这些流言蜚语已传到某些可能派出间谍和破坏者的势力耳中. 我们已经安排了一支驻防部队前往该地，但在我们的部队抵达前，需要雇佣兵来保护工厂.

column1: Cover Returning Patrol
column2: 掩护返程巡逻队

column1: Defend VTOL Facility
column2: 保护VTOL设施

column1: Hold Out for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements
column2: 坚守到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}援军到来

column1: Apparently spies come in mechs these days.
column2: 看来现在的间谍都开机甲了.

column1: Commander, our contracted mission is to defend this factory.
column2: 指挥官，我们签约的任务是守卫这座工厂.

column1: Various VTOL assets are conducting test flights in the AO.
column2: 各种垂直起降车辆正在作战区域进行测试飞行.

column1: We have a VIP at a base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just received a garbled transmission from a local agent that the base will be attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They're striking at the VIP, and they know our forces are not in position to come to his aid. We need a team of competent mercenaries to protect the facility and our personnel.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处基地有一位要人，而我们刚收到当地特工发来的一段错乱传输：该基地将遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的攻击。他们的打击目标是那位要人，而且他们知道我方部队无法及时救援。我们需要一支称职的雇佣兵队伍来保护该设施与我们的人员。

column1: I'm guessing our employers know that a hammer blow is coming, so we'll expected to take the brunt of the attack until their reinforcements arrive on the field.
column2: 我猜我们的雇主知道一次重锤即将落下，所以我们要承受攻击的主力，直到他们的增援抵达战场。

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} industrial lab is at a critical juncture in its R&D program. Any disruption would set us back a decade. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has discovered this, and they've already interdicted the first lance of 'Mechs that were sent to defend the facility. We need mercenaries to step in and buy the time necessary for further reinforcements to arrive.
column2: 一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工业实验室正处于研发计划的关键节点。任何干扰都会让我们倒退十年。{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}发现了这一点，并已拦截了首批派去防卫该设施的机甲小队。我们需要雇佣兵介入，为后续增援抵达争取必要时间。

column1: All we have to do is hold out until the cavalry arrives. Good luck.
column2: 我们要做的就是守住，直到骑兵赶到. 祝你好运.

column1: Commander, if we lose another building we lose the whole lab. You have to hold on.
column2: 指挥官，如果我们再失去另外一座建筑物，就会失去整个实验室. 你得守住.

column1: Escort them safely to the generators and we can bring some additional firepower to this fight.
column2: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们能给战斗带来一些额外的火力.

column1: They have point defense turrets set up around the base. They were taken offline in the last assault, however.
column2: 他们在基地周围设置了几处防御炮台. 不过，它们在上一轮袭击中离线了.

column1: This isn't the first assault on this facility, Commander. Expect significant enemy forces.
column2: 这不是第一次进攻这处设施，指挥官。预期会遇到可观的敌军。

column1: We have a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy of engineers who can bring them back online.
column2: 我们这里有一车队的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工程师能让它们重新上线.

column1: This all seems extremely straightforward, Commander. There will likely be significant opposition, but nothing we haven't handled in the past.
column2: 这一切看起来都极其直接，指挥官。很可能会有可观的抵抗，但不是我们过去没处理过的东西。

column1: Our covert operatives on the planet have located a secret {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility that's been abandoned. We have a team inbound to this planet to strip the facility of everything valuable, but our people on the surface tripped some sort of alarm, which means the original owners are probably on their way to level the place and ensure we can't salvage anything. We need you and your people to occupy that base and keep it intact until our team arrives.
column2: 我们在这颗星球上的秘密特工发现了一处已被废弃的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。我们已派出一支小队前往该星球，要把设施里所有值钱的东西都拆运一空，但我们在地表的人触发了某种警报，这意味着原来的主人很可能正在赶来，打算把那里夷为平地，确保我们什么也捞不到。我们需要你和你的人占领那座基地，并在我们的小队抵达之前保持其完好无损。

column1: I hope whatever they found in there was worth it.
column2: 我希望他们在里面找到的东西是值得的.

column1: There's something I still don't get, XO. Why did they abandon this place if it's full of stuff valuable enough that they're willing to flatten the place to keep it out of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} hands?
column2: 还有一点我不明白，副官。如果这地方的东西宝贵到他们宁愿把它夷平也不让{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}拿到，那他们为什么放弃这里？

column1: This all seems straightforward enough, Commander. There will likely be significant opposition, but nothing we haven't handled in the past.
column2: 这一切看起来都够直接，指挥官。很可能会有可观的抵抗，但不是我们过去没处理过的东西。

column1: Frontal Assault
column2: 正面强攻

column1: It may or may not be that easy, Commander. We may be a bit behind the front lines, but a FOB is an attractive target for our prospective employer's enemies.
column2: 可能那么简单，也可能不，指挥官。我们也许稍微落后于前线，但前进作战基地对我们潜在雇主的敌人来说是个诱人的目标。

column1: We've established a forward operations base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We need a competent lance to watch it while our regular forces are on maneuver. You should expect intermittent enemy contact from probing attacks and skirmishers.
column2: 我们已在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}建立了一处前沿作战基地。我们需要一支称职的分队在我们正规部队机动期间看守它。你应当预料会遭到试探性攻击与散兵袭扰带来的间歇性敌军接触。

column1: We have a centralized supply depot here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, located to support multiple fronts of hostile action. With so many troops elsewhere, we're looking for a lance of Mercs to babysit our outpost. We have no intel that suggests a specific threat, but better to be certain.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里有一个集中补给站，用来支援多个敌对战线的行动。由于兵力大多调往他处，我们想找一支雇佣兵分队来看守我们的前哨。没有任何情报显示存在特定威胁，但还是稳妥为上。

column1: Holo-Vid Propaganda
column2: 全息影像宣传

column1: Even though {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} supposedly believes the facility is 'undefended', I'm still expecting a stand-up fight, Commander.
column2: 尽管{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}号称认为该设施"无人防守"，我仍然预期会有一场正面硬仗，指挥官。

column1: As part of a propaganda effort, we've been operating a secret holo-vid broadcasting facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. The clearest sign that our efforts are working is that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents have spent months searching for the facility. Unfortunately, they've succeeded, and are launching an assault on what they believe to be an undefended installation. While our personnel prepare for evacuation and destroy all the files and documents, we need a team of mercenaries to hold off {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
column2: 作为宣传工作的一部分，我们一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上运营一处秘密全息影像广播设施。我们努力见效的最明显迹象，就是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}特工花了数月搜寻这处设施。不幸的是，他们成功了，正在对他们认为无人防守的设施发动进攻。在我们的人员准备撤离并销毁所有文件文档时，我们需要一队雇佣兵去拖住{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。

column1: Defend Holo-Vid Facility
column2: 守卫全息影视设施

column1: Commander, if we lose any more structures, we lose the entire base and all its personnel.
column2: 指挥官，如果我们再失去建筑物，就会失去整座基地和全体人员.

column1: Commander, we're tasked with defending a propaganda facility.
column2: 指挥官，我们的任务是防守一处宣传设施。

column1: Hold the facility, keep the buildings upright, and destroy the attackers. Good luck.
column2: 守住这处设施，保持建筑物屹立不倒，消灭进攻者. 祝你好运.

column1: We have scattered reports of possible hostiles in the area. Looks like the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} mean to shut down this operation.
column2: 我们收到零星报告称该区域可能存在敌对势力. 看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}打算终止这次行动.

column1: We operate a repair and maintenance facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This base is critical to our operations in the system, and we suspect that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are going to assault the facility. We'd like you to garrison the base, and if an attack comes, hold off the assault until our forces can arrive and relieve you.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}运营着一处维修与保养设施。这座基地对我们在该星系的行动至关重要，而我们怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队将进攻该设施。我们希望你去驻防该基地，若有进攻来临，拖住攻势，直到我们的部队赶到接替你。

column1: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets.
column2: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们就能用那些炮台加强自己的防御能力.

column1: Hang on tight, Commander. This could get ugly.
column2: 抓紧了，指挥官. 情况可能会很糟.

column1: Just as I predicted, Commander; this isn't going to be boring guard duty.
column2: 正如我所料，指挥官；这不会是什么无聊的守卫任务。

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements have secured the site, Commander. Good work.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}援军已经拿下了该地点，指挥官. 干得好.

column1: They have point defenses set up around the base, but they are offline.
column2: 他们在基地周围设置了几处点防御设施，但它们离线了.

column1: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to bring them online.
column2: 我们有一支友方车队带着工程师，他们急切地想要让它们重新上线.

column1: BattleMech Repair Base
column2: 战斗机甲维修基地

column1: They're putting us between the hammer and the anvil, Commander. A 'Mech repair facility is a juicy target.
column2: 他们把我们夹在锤与砧之间，指挥官。一处机甲维修设施可是块肥肉。

column1: We operate a BattleMech repair facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This base is critical to our 'Mech operations in the system, and we believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are planning an assault. We'd like you to protect the facility, and if an attack comes, hold off the assault until our forces can arrive and relieve you.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}运营着一处战斗机甲维修设施。这座基地对我们在该星系的机甲行动至关重要，而我们相信{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正计划进攻。我们希望你去保护该设施，若有进攻来临，拖住攻势，直到我们的部队赶到接替你。

column1: Defend {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech Repair Base
column2: 保卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲维修基地

column1: As expected, Commander, it looks like this 'security duty' is about to get hot.
column2: 如我们所料，指挥官，这次"安保任务"看起来要变热了。

column1: Hold the base, keep the buildings upright, and then we get paid. Oliveira out.
column2: 守住基地，保持建筑物屹立不倒，之后我们就可以收钱了. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Caught In The Act
column2: 被抓现行

column1: Pirates aren't known for competent planning, Commander. Still, their screw-up is our payday.
column2: 海盗并不以擅长谋划而闻名，指挥官。不过，他们的失误就是我们的进账。

column1: A few hours ago, some enterprising lads from our organization planetside were able to seize control of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. They maybe hadn't thought their entire plan through, so right now there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force on the way to level the base before our boys can download any valuable data. We need you to cover them while they finish up and escape.
column2: 几小时前，我们组织在地表上几个机灵的家伙成功夺取了一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究设施。他们可能没把整个计划想周全，所以现在有一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}打击部队正在赶来，准备在我们的弟兄下载到任何有价值数据之前把基地荡平。我们需要你在他们完成下载并撤离期间掩护他们。

column1: Defend Seized Facility
column2: 守卫夺来的设施

column1: Leave immediately or you will be destroyed.
column2: 立即离开不然你会被消灭.

column1: Only one structure left, people. Focus all fire on that building!
column2: 只剩下一个建筑物了，伙计们. 把所有火力都集中在那栋建筑上!

column1: Unknown mercenary force: you are trespassing on {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} property.
column2: 不明佣兵部队: 你正在侵犯{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}财产.

column1: I can't imagine any use for those guns in this system that isn't bad, but I suppose that's to be expected.
column2: 我想不出这些火炮在这个星系里有什么不算糟糕的用途，不过我想这也是意料之中。

column1: Somehow, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities have discovered one of our storehouses. If it were just drugs or stolen goods, we'd let them seize it and write it off as a loss. But it's a weapons stockpile, and those damn things are hard to move from one system to another. We'd like you to protect our guns while our people load them onto transports and we evacuate them.
column2: 不知怎么的，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局发现了我们的一处货栈。如果里面只是毒品或赃物，我们就让他们没收，当作损失注销了。但那是一批武器库存，而那些鬼东西从一星系运到另一星系可不容易。我们想请你在我们的人把枪装上传送车辆并撤离时保护它们。

column1: Defend Pirate Stockpile
column2: 守卫海盗囤积的物资

column1: Attention, pirate scum: you are in violation of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} regulations on the sale and possession of deadly weaponry.
column2: 注意，海盗渣滓们: 你们已经触犯了{TGT_SYSTEM.name}法律中有关出售和持有致命武器的条例.

column1: Military force has been authorized against your facility. Withdraw immediately or be destroyed.
column2: 军队已经得到授权攻击你的设施. 立即撤离，否则将被摧毁.

column1: Make A Stash
column2: 秘密储备点

column1: I'm assuming that 'hardware' means 'weapons', Commander. This should be a fairly standard base defense.
column2: 我猜"硬件"指的是"武器"，指挥官。这应该是一场相当标准的基地防御战。

column1: We've got a facility down on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} where we store valuable hardware before loading it aboard our DropShips for transport out of the system. Unfortunately, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities have discovered our facility, and they're not interested in making any kind of accommodation that lets us get our goods off-planet. We need you to defend the place while we load our valuables up for evacuation.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}下面有一处设施，用来在把贵重硬件装上空投艇运出星系之前存放它们。不幸的是，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局发现了我们的设施，而他们无意做任何让我们把货物运出行星的妥协。我们需要你在我们装载贵重物资准备撤离时防守那个地方。

column1: Defend Pirate Storehouse
column2: 守卫海盗仓库

column1: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, \"professional ethics.\" We have no idea what that means.
column2: 我们有一个极其古怪的任务给你。我们在下面那颗行星上有一处制造设施，我们一直知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队在附近侦察。我们预计他们会有所动作，但没料到他们会……事先给我们发警告？显然他们雇了一名雇佣兵，那人联系我们告知攻击将在何时进行，因为——我引用原话——"职业操守"。我们完全不明白那是什么意思。

column1: Titan Attack
column2: 泰坦攻击

column1: We're going to try to keep an assault 'Mech from destroying a facility, without any ground intel. This seems like a really terrible idea, Commander.
column2: 我们要在没有地面情报的情况下，阻止一台突击机甲摧毁一处设施。这看起来真是个糟糕透顶的主意，指挥官。

column1: We have an urgent assignment that we'd like your assistance with, Commander. We have a secret listening post here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents have discovered the base's location. We need time to transmit all the data we've gathered to a DropShip in orbit, but they're already advancing on the facility. Worse, we're detecting an engine signature from an assault-class 'Mech closing on the base's location. We need you to drop immediately and protect that base until we can get the data transmitted.
column2: 指挥官，我们有一项紧急任务需要你的协助。我们在 {TGT_SYSTEM.name} 设有一处秘密监听哨站，刚刚得知 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 的特工已经发现了基地的位置。我们需要时间把收集到的全部数据发送给轨道上的一艘降落舰，但他们已经在向这处设施推进了。更糟的是，我们探测到一台突击级机甲正朝基地位置逼近的引擎信号。我们需要你立即投放，保护那座基地，直到我们把数据发送完毕。

column1: Defend Listening Post
column2: 守卫监听站

column1: Engage it and keep it firing at our people, instead of the buildings.
column2: 和它交战，让它把火力对准我们的人，而不是建筑物.

column1: Meyer, are you picking up that assault 'Mech they said would be here?
column2: 迈耶，你探测到他们说会在这里的那台突击机甲了吗？

column1: Noted, Yang.
column2: 记下来了，杨.

column1: Yang, you do realize that getting shot at is... kinda part of the job description?
column2: 杨，你明白被人打枪是...工作描述中的一部分吧?

column1: We're going to keep an assault 'Mech from destroying a facility, without any ground intel. This seems like a really terrible idea, Commander.
column2: 我们要在没有地面情报的情况下阻止一台突击机甲摧毁一处设施。这看起来真是个糟糕透顶的主意，指挥官。

column1: Engage it and keep it--
column2: 交战并让它--

column1: It worked out in the end. Somehow.
column2: 最后还是解决了. 不知为什么.

column1: You gotta be kidding me.
column2: 你一定是在逗我.

column1: We have a small disused base in a remote part of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We need it and are preparing to reactivate it. We'd like to hire you to recon the facility and defend it until our forces can move in. We'll have a lance with you in half a day and a logistics team within 24 hours.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的一处偏远地区有一座废弃的小型基地。我们需要它，并正准备将其重新启用。我们想请你侦察该设施并防守它，直到我军能够进驻。半天之内我们会有一个小队与你会合，24小时内后勤小组也会抵达。

column1: Commander it looks like this babysitting job may be heating up.
column2: 指挥官，看来这份保姆差事要升级了.

column1: I suggest you power up your mechs and get ready.
column2: 建议你们启动机甲，做好准备.

column1: You must ensure that the survivors reach the facility.
column2: 你必须确保幸存者抵达设施.

column1: Setting aside the rumors of LosTech, this contract is an excellent opportunity to take payment in 'Mech parts and salvage rights, as {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} MechTechs are on-site for recovery.
column2: 撇开那些关于失传科技的传言不谈，这份合约是一个以机甲部件和打捞权作为报酬的绝佳机会，因为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机修技师就在现场进行回收。

column1: Our munitions factory on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under threat because of a rumor about a cache of Star League equipment at the site. This malicious gossip about LosTech has brought hungry wolves to our door. We have arranged for a garrison force to be moved into place, but we need mercenary units to protect the factory until our forces arrive.
column2: 我们位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的军工厂正面临威胁，原因是一则关于工厂所在地藏有星际联盟设备的传言. 这条涉及失落科技的恶意流言，已经把一群饥饿的“豺狼”引到了我们门口. 我们已经安排了一支驻军部队前往，但在他们抵达之前，我们需要佣兵部队来保护工厂.

column1: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capabilities.
column2: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们就能加强自己的防御能力.

column1: They have point defenses set up around the base. They are, however, offline.
column2: 他们在基地周围设置了几处点防御设施. 不过，它们，离线了.

column1: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses and get them firing.
column2: 我们有一支友方车队带着工程师，他们急切地想要前往那些防御设施并让它们开火.

column1: This is an ecological disaster, shame on you. Reduces Movement and Stability
column2: 这真是一场生态浩劫，你应当感到羞愧. 降低移动力与稳定性

column1: This unit moved through rough terrain. It will take 50% stability damage from all attacks until its next activation.
column2: 该单位穿越了崎岖地形. 在其下次行动前，受到的所有攻击将造成 50% 的稳定性伤害.

column1: ROUGH TERRAIN
column2: 崎岖地形

column1: Burning Forests generate Heat. Thick smoke makes it harder to see and be seen.
column2: 燃烧的森林产生热量，浓烟使得观察与被观察都更加困难.

column1: The mech, the mech, the mech is on fire. Generate 6 More Heat.
column2: 机甲，机甲，机甲着火了. 额外产生 6 点热量.

column1: MECH IS ON FIRE
column2: 机甲着火

column1: This unit moved through Chemical Fire. Heatsinking impaired by 10%
column2: 该单位穿越了化学火焰. 散热能力削弱 10%.

column1: Units on standing on and moving across burning terrain sink less heat.
column2: 站立在燃烧地形上或在上面移动的单位，散热能力会降低.

column1: Chemical Fire
column2: 化学火焰

column1: Coolant Pools increase heat venting for units standing in within (-25 Heat). Units passing through Coolant Pools gain the Coolant Splash Effect (-15 Heat per turn for 2 turns).
column2: 对任何站在其中的单位，冷却液池将增加其排热量(-25点热量). 穿过冷却液池的单位会获得冷却液溅洒的效果(每回合-15点热量，持续2回合).

column1: This unit moved through a coolant pool. Coolant Residue will remove an additional 15 heat on its next activation.
column2: 该单位穿过了一个冷却液池. 残留的冷却液将在该单位下一轮行动时另外消除15点热量.

column1: COOLANT POOL
column2: 冷却液池

column1: COOLANT SPLASH
column2: 冷却液溅洒

column1: These mineral deposits interfere with targeting systems. +3 Difficulty to hit units within a Mineral Field. +2 Difficulty for attacks made by units within a Mineral Field.
column2: 这些矿物沉积物干扰了瞄准系统. 攻击矿田内的单位 +3 命中难度，矿田内的单位发动攻击 +2 命中难度.

column1: MINERAL FIELD
column2: 矿田

column1: This is a dangerous location. Stand here at your own risk.
column2: 这是一片危险地区. 站在这儿的话，风险自负.

column1: DANGEROUS LOCATION
column2: 危险地区

column1: Destroyed Buildings reduce movement and make you harder to detect, but they provide COVER.
column2: 毁坏的建筑会降低移动速度，让单位更难被侦测到，但它们能提供掩护.

column1: DESTROYED BUILDING
column2: 被摧毁的建筑物

column1: A DropPod might land here. Don't be standing here when it does.
column2: 一个空投舱可能会落在这里。别在它落地时站在这里。

column1: DROPPOD LANDING ZONE
column2: 空投舱降落区域

column1: A DropShip might land here. Don't be standing here when it does.
column2: 一艘空投艇可能会落在这里。别在它落地时站在这里。

column1: DROPSHIP LANDING ZONE
column2: 空投艇着陆区

column1: The exposed conduits' electromagnetic discharge interferes with targeting systems. +4 Difficulty to hit units within an Electrical Field. +4 Difficulty for attacks made by units within an Electrical Field.
column2: 外露导管的电磁放电会干扰瞄准系统。对处于电场内的单位命中难度+4。处于电场内的单位发起的攻击难度+4。

column1: ELECTRICAL FIELD
column2: 电场

column1: Localized radioactivity interferes with targeting systems, but adds Heat to units passing through. +4 Difficulty to hit units standing in a Radiation Field. +10 Heat for two activations to units passing through a Radiation Field. Makes units harder to detect.
column2: 局部放射性会干扰瞄准系统，但会使穿越其中的单位增加热量. 攻击站在辐射场中的单位 +4 命中难度. 穿越辐射场的单位在两个行动回合内 +10 热量. 使单位更难被侦测到.

column1: This unit moved through intense radiation. It will sink 10 less heat on its next activation.
column2: 该单位穿越了强辐射区. 下次行动时散热能力将减少 10 点.

column1: RADIATION FIELD
column2: 辐射场

column1: Illumination Flares Dramatically Increase Visibility.
column2: 照明弹极大提升了可见度.

column1: Forest reduces movement and spotting distance, and provides COVER; +1 to fire out of and +2 to fire Into Woods. +10% Stability damage taken in Woods. Reduces enemy Visibility by 20%.
column2: 森林降低移动力与观测距离，并提供“掩护”效果; 从森林中向外开火难度 +1，向森林中开火难度 +2. 在森林中承受的稳定性伤害 +10%. 敌方可见度降低 20%.

column1: This unit moved through geothermal terrain. It will only sink 50% of its normal heat until the end of its next activation.
column2: 该单位穿过了地热地形. 直到下一轮行动结束前，它的散热能力都只有正常的50%.

column1: Units on Geothermal terrain gain 5 heat per turn and only sink 75% of their normal heat.
column2: 位于地热地形上的单位每回合获得 5 点热量，且只能散发正常散热量的 75%.

column1: Units on lava terrain gain 15 heat per turn and only sink 75% of their normal Heat.
column2: 位于熔岩地形上的单位每回合增加 15 点热量，且只能散发正常散热量的 75%.

column1: Ice reduces movement speed and increases stability damage taken by 30%, but it improves a unit's Heat-sinking ability by 10%.
column2: 冰面会降低移动速度，并使承受的稳定度伤害增加30%，但它能提升单位10%的散热能力。

column1: Units cannot move through Impassable terrain.
column2: 单位无法穿过不可通行地形.

column1: Units within Marsh gain 50% stability damage reduction from all attacks.
column2: 沼泽中的单位可减少50%所有攻击带来的稳定性伤害.

column1: This design mask has no effect. It is the default Biome design mask.
column2: 这种设计遮罩没有特殊效果. 这是默认环境的设计遮罩.

column1: NO EFFECT
column2: 没有效果

column1: A nearby nuclear detonation has scrambled sensors and electronics.
column2: 附近的核爆炸干扰了传感器和电子设备.

column1: Units near a nuclear detonation suffer -2 accuracy for the rest of combat.
column2: 位于核爆炸附近的单位在战斗剩余时间内承受 -2 命中精度惩罚.

column1: Secondary Effect Zone
column2: 次级效果区域

column1: Units travel faster along Roads, especially wheeled vehicles.
column2: 单位沿道路移动更快，尤其是轮式车辆.

column1: Rough Terrain reduces movement speed and causes units to take +50% stability damage from all attacks. +4 Difficulty to hit units within Rough Terrain with Melee attacks.
column2: 崎岖地形会降低移动速度，并导致单位承受的所有攻击造成的稳定性伤害增加 50%. 在崎岖地形中对单位进行近战攻击的命中难度 +4.

column1: This unit moved through rough terrain. It will take +50% stability damage from all attacks until its next activation.
column2: 该单位穿越了崎岖地形. 在其下次行动前，受到的所有攻击将造成 +50% 的稳定性伤害.

column1: This unit moved through urban debris. It will take 150% stability damage from all attacks until its next activation.
column2: 该单位穿过了一片城市废墟. 直到下一轮行动前，它在所有攻击下都会承受150%的稳定性伤害.

column1: Urban Debris reduces movement speed and causes units to take +50% stability damage from all attacks. +4 Difficulty to hit units within Rough Terrain with Melee attacks.
column2: 城市废墟会降低移动速度，并导致单位承受的所有攻击造成的稳定性伤害增加 50%. 在崎岖地形中对单位进行近战攻击的命中难度 +4.

column1: URBAN DEBRIS
column2: 城市废墟

column1: Smoke Drastically reduces Sight and Visibility.
column2: 烟雾极大降低了视野和能见度.

column1: SMOKE SCREEN
column2: 烟幕

column1: Spore Fields slow all units moving through them. Units standing in Spore Fields suffer an additional 20% damage when hit due to the spores' corrosive effects. +4 Difficulty to hit units passing through Spore Clouds.
column2: 孢子场会减缓所有穿过它的单位。站在孢子场中的单位被命中时，由于孢子的腐蚀作用会额外承受20%伤害。穿过孢子云的单位被命中难度+4。

column1: This unit moved through a Spore Cloud. Spores stick to units and interfere with targeting systems. +4 Difficulty to hit this unit.
column2: 该单位穿过一片孢子云. 孢子附着在单位上干扰了瞄准系统. 攻击该单位命中难度+4.

column1: SPORE CLOUD
column2: 孢子云

column1: SPORE FIELD
column2: 孢子地

column1: Water reduces movement speed, provides COVER and increases a unit's Heat-sinking ability by 50%.
column2: 水域会降低移动速度，提供掩护，并使单位的散热能力提升50%。

column1: Units cannot move through Deep Water.
column2: 单位无法通过深水.

column1: DEEP WATER
column2: 深水

column1: Whirlwinds reduce movement and spotting distance as well as increasing Stability Damage taken, but they provide COVER (10% damage reduction against ranged attacks to the front and side; does not stack with BRACE).
column2: 旋风会降低移动与视野距离，并增加承受的稳定度伤害，但它们提供掩护（对来自正面与侧面的远程攻击减免10%伤害；不与"稳固"叠加）。

column1: Broken Chain
column2: 断链

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't kidding about this being an ambitious target. Expect serious, well-armed resistance. This will not be easy.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}说这是个大胆的目标，绝不是开玩笑。预期会遇到顽强且装备精良的抵抗。这不会轻松。

column1: We have a very ambitious target in mind for you: a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical base. Thousands of tons of armor, ammunition, 'Mech parts, and personnel pass through this facility every day, all on its way to front-line fighting units. A strike at this base will seriously hinder the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, possibly even turning the tide of battle completely against them. It will be well-defended, and as soon as the assault begins the enemy will scramble reinforcements.
column2: 我们为你定下了一个极为大胆的目标：一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}后勤基地。每天有数千吨装甲、弹药、机甲部件与人员经此设施转运，全部运往前线作战单位。打击该基地将严重削弱{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，甚至可能彻底扭转战局。它会有重兵防守，而一旦袭击开始，敌人就会紧急调集增援。

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Base Garrison
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地守备部队

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Logistical Base and Escape
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}后勤基地并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Logistical Base
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}后勤基地

column1: Damn. We need to abort, Commander, before we suffer any more losses.
column2: 该死. 我们需要放弃行动，指挥官，在我们遭受更大的损失之前.

column1: Move up to engage the target buildings. Looks like the base has its own defenses.
column2: 行动起来向目标建筑物开火. 看来这座基地有自己的防御力量.

column1: To interrupt the supply chain, we'll need to take out several key structures.
column2: 要打断补给链，我们需要摧毁若干关键建筑。

column1: Cease and Desist
column2: 停止并终止

column1: The contract does not specify any retrieval, Commander. We are to bring the base down and destroy the tech with it.
column2: 合约没有指定任何回收项目，指挥官. 我们要把基地毁掉，连同技术一起摧毁.

column1: We have reliable information that a remote {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} laboratory is attempting to reverse-engineer sensitive {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} technology in violation of the usage license. They have failed to respond to our communications that they cease and desist these unlawful operations. Therefore, we authorize you to execute the license termination clause upon that facility.
column2: 我们有可靠的信息表明，一处偏远的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}实验室正违反使用许可试图对敏感的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}技术进行逆向工程. 他们未对我们要求其停止这些非法操作的通知作出回应. 因此，我们授权你对该设施执行许可终止条款.

column1: Approach the base and destroy the designated buildings.
column2: 接近基地，摧毁指定建筑.

column1: Be wary of the base defenders, and watch for any additional patrols in the area. Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 小心基地的守卫，并注意这一地区是否有额外的巡逻队. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

column1: Commander, we're here to shut down a research base.
column2: 指挥官，我们是来关停一处研究基地的。

column1: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.
column2: 我们刚与一处设施失去联系，指挥官，我们需要你的帮助。今天早些时候，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的设施收到了一段他们以为是常规数据的传输。它严重错乱，他们要求重发后却毫无回应。此后不久，基地系统开始故障，然后我们同时失去了与该基地和覆盖该区域的同步卫星的联系。我们希望你去调查那处设施。

column1: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.
column2: 我们在找一家愿意为我们做一些秘密工作的雇佣兵公司。我们丢了一处基地给{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，并且相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的人员此刻正在被审讯。我们不能容许那些人泄露秘密，但如果被人看到我们摧毁自己的基地，那会很难看。我们需要可否认性。我们需要你把那座基地夷平，尤其是仓储与通讯设施。如果你能确保没有活口，我们会很感激，并会在你清掉所有对手后额外支付奖金。

column1: We should expect heavy resistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't saying what's in that facility, but whatever it is has them riled up.
column2: 我们得做好遭遇强抵抗的准备；{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 不肯说那座设施里有什么，但无论是什么都让他们很激动。

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} is an illegal intrusion into our territory, and a cover for military personnel and units. Our efforts to resolve this through diplomatic channels have been rebuffed, so we are now turning to a military solution. The facility must be destroyed.
column2: 位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造设施是对我方领土的非法入侵，并且还是军事人员和部队的掩护点. 我们试图通过外交途径解决此事，但遭到了拒绝，因此现在只能诉诸军事手段. 这处设施必须被摧毁.

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Structures and Escape
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}建筑物并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Facility
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施

column1: Assault the base and destroy enough of it to force {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} to abandon the location.
column2: 突袭这座基地并摧毁足够多的东西，迫使{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}放弃这一地区.

column1: We should expect strong opposition on this one. Be wary, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 这次行动预计会遇到强烈抵抗. 小心点，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Your target is the nearby {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
column2: 你的目标是附近的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地.

column1: Territorial Claims
column2: 领土主张

column1: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.
column2: 对行星表面的一次例行扫描发现了意料之外的情况：一处废弃设施的位置传出了能量信号。从我们读到的数据来看，可能是某座机甲工厂正在启动。在战略上，我们并不处于能夺取这座工厂的位置，所以需要你们找到它并将其摧毁。如果我们行动够快，就能在任何机甲被生产出来之前解决此事。当然，如果你们确实遇到任何新生产的机甲，也应当把它们打成废铁。

column1: Depending on what's being produced there, this could be simple, or it could be terrifying. I wish I could be more specific, but our employers don't even know who we're fighting.
column2: 取决于那里在生产什么，这事可能很简单，也可能很可怕。我希望我能说得更具体，但我们的雇主连我们在跟谁打都不知道。

column1: Destroy Enemy Orions
column2: 摧毁敌方的“猎户座”

column1: We have to assume they are. Things just got more complicated.
column2: 我们得假设他们就是如此. 事情刚刚变得更复杂了.

column1: Turn The Tables
column2: 扭转局势

column1: Destroy enemy structures, deal with defending forces as needed.
column2: 摧毁敌方建筑，按需处理防守部队。

column1: Commander, in my experience, merchants will defend their profits with extreme prejudice. Expect a hostile response as soon as you kick down the door.
column2: 指挥官，根据我的经验，商人们会用极端的偏见来捍卫他们的利润. 当你把门踢开时，就该预料到有充满敌意的反应.

column1: A consortium of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturers has been losing ground to a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} competitor every fiscal quarter for years. It's time to turn the tables with one well-timed strike at the primary {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing plant here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system.
column2: 一个由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}制造商组成的财团多年来每个财季都在输给一家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}竞争对手。是时候用一次时机恰到好处的打击扭转局面了——目标就是{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系里那家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}主要制造厂。

column1: Destroy Defending Forces
column2: 摧毁守卫部队

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Manufacturing Plant and Escape
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造厂并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the Manufacturing Plant
column2: 摧毁制造工厂

column1: Be wary of the security forces, but the buildings should take priority. Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 小心安保部队，但建筑物应该优先考虑. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

column1: Move to the facility and start wrecking the buildings.
column2: 前往设施并开始摧毁建筑物.

column1: That was disappointing, commander. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will not be pleased.
column2: 那真是令人失望，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}不会满意的.

column1: We're tasked with destroying several manufacturing structures in the target facility.
column2: 我们的任务是摧毁目标设施内的若干制造建筑。

column1: Incomplete Intelligence
column2: 不完整的情报

column1: This could be {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} using the supplies as cover, but it could also be {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} looking for plausible deniability. We'll probably never learn which.
column2: 这可能是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}拿补给做掩护，也可能是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}在寻求可推诿的说辞。我们大概永远不会知道是哪种。

column1: Our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} enemies are hiding restricted munitions in a series of warehouses used to distribute medical supplies. We would make a public accusation that they're hiding munitions in medical supplies, but that would reveal the source of our intel. Instead, we need you to go in and do what we cannot: destroy the warehouses.
column2: 我们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌人正把受管制弹药藏在一系列用于配送医疗物资的仓库里。我们本可以公开指控他们把弹药藏在医疗物资中，但那会暴露我们情报的来源。所以，我们需要你进去做我们不能做的事：摧毁那些仓库。

column1: Destroy the Target Warehouses
column2: 摧毁目标仓库

column1: Destroy The Warehouses and Escape
column2: 摧毁仓库并摆脱敌人

column1: Be wary of any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defenders, and additional patrols in the area. Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 小心任何{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的防御部队，以及该区域的额外巡逻队. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

column1: Move to the base and start wrecking the buildings.
column2: 前往基地并开始拆毁建筑物.

column1: We're tasked with destroying several structures in the target medical warehouse facility.
column2: 我们的任务是摧毁目标医疗仓库设施内的若干建筑。

column1: Leave A Mark
column2: 留下标记

column1: This seems straightforward, Commander. If things get out of hand, remember you can just blow up the buildings and make a run for it.
column2: 看起来很简单明了，指挥官. 如果局势失控，记住你可以直接炸掉建筑物然后撤离.

column1: There's a minor {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base in this region, and we'd like to remind them that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is aware of their base and they should not become complacent. Destroying a handful of the facility's structures should send the proper message. The base is likely to be guarded; destroy the units guarding it and there's a bonus in it for you.
column2: 这一带有一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小型基地，我们想提醒他们，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}知道他们基地的存在，他们不该自满。摧毁该设施的一小部分建筑应该就能传达恰当的信息。基地很可能有守卫；摧毁守卫部队另有奖金给你。

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Garrison
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}守备部队

column1: Destroy Structures in the Base
column2: 摧毁基地里的建筑物

column1: Take them out, and start doing some damage.
column2: 干掉他们，制造一点破坏.

column1: There will be a garrison, so keep your eyes open for it. Oliveira out.
column2: 那里会有一支守备部队，所以你的眼睛要睁大些. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: We're seeing fixed defenses powering up, Commander. Turrets are such a pain in the ass.
column2: 指挥官，我们看到固定防御正在启动。炮塔真是麻烦透顶。

column1: If there are enough pirates there to present a problem for local authorities, we should be prepared for a tough fight, Commander.
column2: 如果那儿的海盗已经足以成为当局的问题，那我们该准备好打一场硬仗，指挥官.

column1: A heavily armed pirate band has taken control of a facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and are using it as a base of operations for raiding and terrorizing nearby settlements. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities do not have the local military resources to assault the base, given how extensively they've entrenched. We need you to destroy the base so that they can no longer use it as a staging area for their criminal acts.
column2: 一伙武装精良的海盗控制了{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处设施，并把它当作基地，对附近定居点进行袭掠与恐吓。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}当局没有足够的当地军事资源去强攻该基地，因为他们构筑的工事极为完备。我们需要你摧毁该基地，使他们再也无法把它当作犯罪行动的集结地。

column1: Destroy Facility Structures
column2: 摧毁设施建筑物

column1: Destroy Pirate Facility Structures and Escape
column2: 摧毁海盗设施的建筑物并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy Pirate Garrison
column2: 消灭海盗守备部队

column1: Destroy Pirate Reinforcements
column2: 消灭海盗的援军

column1: Commander, our target is just ahead. You need to knock down enough structures to cripple the facility.
column2: 指挥官，我们的目标就在前方. 你需要摧毁足够多的建筑物来瘫痪这座设施.

column1: There may be additional enemy units deployed away from the base, so keep your eyes open. Oliveira out.
column2: 可能会有额外的敌方单位部署在远离基地的地方，所以眼睛请睁大些. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Well done, Commander. Any remaining pirate forces will have nowhere to hide.
column2: 做得不错，指挥官. 剩下的海盗部队将会无处可藏.

column1: Blood Feud
column2: 血仇

column1: Two wrongs don't make a right, Commander, but they do make a payday.
column2: 指挥官，两个错误加不出一个正确，但它们确实能带来一笔进账。

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have just finished a very ambitious operation. They rounded up two dozen members of a rival criminal organization and they're holding them in a secure detention facility. We're not happy with the idea that those scumbags get to live out their lives in comfort and safety behind bars. We want you to give them a bit more severe sentencing.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局刚刚完成一次极为大手笔的行动。他们围捕了一个敌对犯罪组织的两打成员，把他们关在一处安全拘留设施里。我们可不乐意看到那些渣滓在铁窗后舒适安全地过完余生。我们想让你给他们一个更严厉点的判决。

column1: Destroy the Detention Facility
column2: 摧毁拘禁设施

column1: Another successful criminal operation in the can, Commander.
column2: 又一场杀青的成功犯罪行动，指挥官.

column1: Enough, Sumire. Commander, your target is just ahead. Good luck.
column2: 好了，苏米尔. 指挥官，你的目标就在前面. 祝你好运.

column1: Unknown BattleMech lance, this is a secure facility. Halt and identify yourselves.
column2: 不明身份的战斗机甲小队，这是一座安全设施. 站住并表明你的身份.

column1: Hide the Evidence
column2: 掩盖证据

column1: No honor among thieves, I suppose.
column2: 盗贼之中没有任何荣誉可言，我认为.

column1: We had a few associates go missing recently, and where should they happen to turn up but a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} black site? We have to assume they're being interrogated right now. Normally, we'd be extremely concerned for their welfare and we'd try to rescue them, but in this case it seems likely they're beyond rescue. We need you to level that black site, to ensure any secrets they've spilled are erased.
column2: 我们最近有几名同伙失踪了，而他们偏偏出现在一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}黑牢里。我们必须假设他们此刻正在被审讯。通常我们会极为担心他们的安危并设法营救，但这次他们似乎已经救不回来了。我们需要你把那处黑牢夷平，确保他们泄露的任何秘密都被抹除。

column1: Anybody still inside that facility is not going to be doing much talking anytime soon, Commander.
column2: 还留在那座设施里面的人很快就再也开不了口了，指挥官.

column1: THIS IS AN AUTOMATED WARNING. YOU ARE ENTERING A RESTRICTED AREA. WITHDRAW OR YOU WILL BE FIRED ON.
column2: 这是自动警告. 你正在进入限制区域. 请立即撤离，否则将遭到攻击.

column1: Leave No Trace
column2: 不留痕迹

column1: One of our sources inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} law enforcement facility just reported some alarming news. Somehow, the authorities have gotten their filthy hands on one of our accountants, and they're interrogating him for all our business secrets right now. column1: In the morning briefing, Darius pulls up an inventory spreadsheet on the Leopard's viewscreen. \"We're running a little low on medical supplies. Medipatches, trauma packs, a few other things. It isn't critical yet, but I feel better when we're well-stocked.\"

\nSumire frowns. \"Why do we keep patching our supplies in dribs and drabs? Can't we get some kind of 'bulk discount' and get ahead of this problem? Gods know we'll end up using them, and maybe the doctors can speed up our recovery times for a while.\"
column2: 晨间简报时，达里乌斯在豹式空投艇的屏幕上调出一份库存表。“我们的医疗物资有点紧张了。医疗贴片、创伤包，还有几样别的。还不算危急，但库存充足时我心里踏实。”\n\n澄美皱眉。“为什么我们的补给总是一点一点地凑？就不能来点什么‘批量折扣’，一次性解决这问题吗？天知道我们最后肯定会用完，说不定医生们还能借机让我们恢复得快些。”

column1: At the sound of the door sliding open, Darius and Yang turn in unison to face you.
\n\"Commander,\" Darius intones, his voice tinged with exasperation. \"The colony on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} has requested our help--\"

\nYang cuts in—he's practically giddy with excitement. \"Boss, they have [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAgroMech],AgroMechs]]! Herders, Farmhands… even a CattleMaster! These are some of the wonkiest machines ever to walk on two legs. You've gotta let me work on them.\"
\nDarius' frown deepens. \"This is not the best use of our time or resources.\"
\n\"Come on, Boss.\" Yang clasps his hands, pleading. \"AgroMechs!\"
column2:
门滑开的声音响起，达里乌斯和杨同时转身面对你。

"指挥官，"达里乌斯开口，语气里带着恼意。"{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的殖民地请求我们帮忙——"

杨插话——他简直兴奋得发抖。"老大，他们有[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAgroMech],农用机甲]]！牧人型、农夫型……甚至还有一台牧牛大师！这些是有史以来用两条腿走过的最古怪的机器。你得让我摆弄摆弄它们。"

达里乌斯的眉头皱得更深。"这不是我们时间或资源的最佳用法。"

"来吧，老大。"杨双手合十，恳求道。"农用机甲啊！"

column1: As you enter the garden, Darius greets you, holding a basket of strawberries. \"Commander, I've been monitoring the Hydroponics productivity and we're growing more than we're using. So I did a little research on market opportunities.\"

\n\"I've heard back from two potential customers in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} orbit. One would pay cash for the fresh food. I think I can get ¢75,000, give or take. The other is offering machine tools in trade, which the Mech Bay could use to boost productivity.\"
\nDarius looks longingly at his basket. \"All offers require a minimum supply of produce, though, and it'll take more than our surplus to fill them. The crew won't like limits on their salad bar.\"

column1: As you arrive at the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Market]] rendezvous, you realize, too late, that something isn't right. There's a burst of lights and sirens as the local authorities surround your group.

\nA senior officer steps forward. \"This can be easy or hard, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Turn over the access codes, secret handshakes, and whatever other tradecraft you use to gain access to the Market, and you'll walk away scot-free, with ¢100,000 C-Bills in your pocket.\"
\nShe crosses her arms in smug determination. \"Or you can pretend you don't know anything and pay a frankly staggering fine for wasting our time.\"

她得意地抱臂。“或者你可以装作什么都不知道，然后为我们浪费时间支付一笔数额惊人的罚款。”

column1: Darius demands the first agenda item in the morning briefing. \"Commander, I've secured an invitation to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]] here in the Periphery.\"

\nYang claps Darius on the back. \"About time! You've been haggling and calling in favors for months. It was kinda like you enjoyed it.\" Darius smirks. \"Who, me? Well... persuading that cabal of crooks, merchants and politicians wasn't boring.\"
\nSumire cuts through the joviality. \"Don't forget the pirates. Your cabal may vote us in, but our history with their primary customers is setting our membership fee.\"
\nDr. Murad frowns. \"Improvements to the Argo aren't getting any cheaper. Surely we can just continue looting what we need?\"
column2: 达里乌斯要求把晨间简报的第一项议程交给他。"指挥官，我已经拿到了外缘[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]]的邀请。" 杨拍拍达里乌斯的背。"总算成了！你讨价还价、到处找人帮忙都几个月了。看着你还挺享受的。"达里乌斯得意一笑。"谁，我？嗯……说服那个由骗子、商人和政客组成的秘会可不无聊。" 苏米蕾打断这份欢快。"别忘了那些海盗。你的秘会可以投票接纳我们，但我们与他们主要客户的历史决定了我们的会员费。" 穆拉德博士皱眉。"阿戈号的改进可越来越贵了。我们难道不能继续靠劫掠来获得所需？"

column1: Darius opens the morning briefing with a familiar refrain. \"Commander, I've persuaded the cabal that controls access to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]] to consider, again, our possible membership.\"
\nSumire laughs. \"They don't usually make that offer more than once. Times must be desperate.\" Yang gasps in feigned insult. \"Or Darius is just that good of a negotiator!\"

\n\"Our reputation with the pirates in the Periphery is still a gating factor.\" Dr. Murad points out. \"The Black Market isn't going to offend their best customers. What is their asking price this time?\"

column1: In the morning briefing, Darius is unusually excited. \"Commander, our pirate friends have vouched for us with the cabal that controls access to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]] in the Periphery. They'll even waive the usual membership fee!\"
\nSumire chuckles darkly. \"We keep such sterling company. Considering our reputation with the Great Houses, though, it's hard to find welcoming ports these days.\"
\nDr. Murard reluctantly agrees. \"The Black Markets are almost our only option for new supplies. It's got to be worth the extra scrutiny we'll receive from the system authorities.\"
column2:
晨间简报时，达里乌斯异常兴奋。"指挥官，我们的海盗朋友已经向外缘控制[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]]入口的那个秘会为我们担保。他们甚至愿意免除通常的会员费！"

苏米蕾阴沉地轻笑。"我们交的真是些高贵的朋友。不过考虑到我们在大贵族家族中的名声，如今要找个欢迎我们的港口也真难。"

穆拉德博士勉强同意。"黑市几乎是我们获得新补给的唯一选择。这肯定值得我们因此受到星系当局的额外审查。"

They'll cover the cost and an extra ¢50,000 for our trouble. We just need to do the footwork.\"
\nDarius scowls. \"The Black Markets aren't risk-free for us. The authorities could intervene and cause problems. Or this could all be a set up.\"

column1: In the morning briefing, Sumire had laid out her plans to tour the archeological ruins of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. \"I've only seen them in Holovids,\" followed by the fateful invitation: \"Commander, you should join me!\"

\nBut now Sumire's splendid views are being ruined by a rabid band of relic hunters, standing between the two of you and the Leopard. Sumire groans. \"This doesn't always happen, Commander, I swear...\"

\nA voice echoes unexpectedly through the broken buildings. \"These odds aren't very fair. I hope you don't mind if I even them up.\" A man steps out from the shadows on the far side of the smugglers, dressed outlandishly in the style of a Star League era movie star, but brandishing two gleaming pistols.

\nTwo smugglers spin in the gunslinger's direction, then immediately crumple to the dirt, with a spray of blood and an echo of gunshots. After a fusillade of bullets from your and Sumire's sidearms, a third enemy crumples lifelessly. The remaining smugglers flee toward their vehicles.
\nThe gunslinger holsters his pistols in a dextrous flourish. \"You look out of place without your Mech, Commander.\"
\n\"Uh, have we met?\" asks Sumire.
\nThe man laughs. \"No. I just have a good eye for warriors who have forgotten their swords.\"
column2:

但现在苏米蕾的壮丽景色被一帮狂热的遗物猎人毁了，他们挡在你们两人与豹式之间。苏米蕾呻吟了一声。"指挥官，这可不是每次都这样，我发誓……"

一个声音出乎意料地在破败的建筑间回荡。"这赔率不太公平。希望你不介意我把它们拉平。"一个男人从走私者另一侧的阴影中走出来，衣着奇特地模仿星盟时代电影明星的风格，双手却握着两把闪亮的枪。

两名走私者朝枪手的方向转身，随即立刻倒在尘土中，血花飞溅，枪声回荡。在你和苏米蕾的随身武器一阵齐射之后，第三名敌人无声地倒下。剩下的走私者朝他们的车辆逃去。

枪手以灵巧的姿态把双枪插回枪套。"没有机甲的你看起来不太对劲，指挥官。"

"呃，我们见过吗？"苏米蕾问。

那人大笑。"没有。我只是很擅长看出哪些战士忘了带剑。"

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang's voice comes over the comm from the cargo bay, breathless.</color> "Commander, get down here."

<color=#BFBFBF>By the time you arrive, the salvaged transport's cargo container is already cracked open, its contents spilled across the deck plating. Yang crouches beside a stack of dense metal ingots, running a scanner over one.</color>

"Whatever this thing was hauling cargo for, they packed it right. This is naval-grade Ferro-Aluminum, same stuff Farah's been hunting for the hangar job." <color=#BFBFBF>He hefts one of the ingots, testing its weight.</color> "Can't tell you what it was meant to be used for, they stripped the ID plates clean off the container before it ever left port. Doesn't matter much either way. What matters is we've got it now."

<color=#BFBFBF>He does a rough count of the stacked ingots.</color> "Looks close to a full ton, near as I can eyeball it. Worth having it weighed properly before anybody starts celebrating."
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>杨的声音从货舱的通讯器里传来，气喘吁吁。</color>“指挥官，下来一趟。”

<color=#BFBFBF>等你赶到时，那艘被打捞上来的运输船货柜已被撬开，里面的东西散落在甲板上。杨蹲在一堆致密的金属锭旁，用扫描仪扫着其中一块。</color>

“不管这东西是给什么运货的，他们打包得很讲究。这是舰用级铁铝合金，正是法拉为机库那活儿一直在找的材料。”<color=#BFBFBF>他掂起一块金属锭，试了试分量。</color>“我没法告诉你它本来打算用来做什么，货柜还没离港，识别牌就被他们拆得一干二净了。反正也不重要。重要的是它现在在我们手上。”

<color=#BFBFBF>他粗略清点了一下堆放的金属锭。</color>“凭我肉眼估摸，差不多有一整吨。在有人开香宾庆祝之前，最好还是正经称一称。”

column1: Yang bends down, loosening the screws on the venting unit in your private quarters. \"I've got bad news, Boss.\" He pries the grate free, coughing because of the floating particles.
\n\"Let me guess…\" Darius leans in the doorway. \"Killer dust bunnies?\"

\nYang ignores the XO. \"You know the MechTechs are always griping. It's nearly an official pastime in the Mech Bay, but what I'm catching a whiff of sounds like real trouble. They're overworked and underpaid. They want a serious end-of-year bonus. Can't say I blame 'em.\"

\n\"Aren't we all?\" Darius's grin slips as he pulls up the budget on his compad. \"They know we gotta keep costs down. How about we replace the 'Techs that are complaining? It's risky, but new expenses are popping up every day. What do you say, Commander?\"
column2:
杨弯腰松开你私人舱室里通风单元的螺丝。“坏消息，老板。”他撬开格栅，被飘起的灰尘呛得咳嗽。

“让我猜猜……”达里乌斯倚在门口。“灰尘怪兽？”

杨没理这位副官。“你知道机甲技师一直在抱怨。这几乎成了机甲库里的官方消遣。但我闻到的那点味道听起来是真麻烦：他们又累又没拿到该拿的钱，想要一笔正经的年终奖金。我倒不怪他们。”

“我们不都这样吗？”达里乌斯在掌机上翻出预算，笑容淡了。“他们知道我们得压低成本。要不把抱怨的技师换掉？虽然冒险，但新开支天天冒出来。你说呢，指挥官？”

column1: In the morning briefing, Sumire asks something unexpected: \"So, what's the story with those MechWarriors bowling in the barracks hallways?\"

\nDarius crosses his arms over his chest. \"I've already put an end to that. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] were calling it 'corridor bocce'… I shut it down as a matter of discipline.\"
\nYou turn to Darius. \"How much trouble have their games caused?\"
\n\"They're playing in unused corridors, so not much. But it was only a matter of time before something… or someone… got damaged. We should really repair the gym in Beta Pod instead.\"

column1: In an unused corridor near Gamma Pod, Darius shows you a strange chart written on the wall in chalk. Each row lists a MechWarrior callsign, and in the columns next to each name: a percentage and a number in C-Bills.

\nAs you compare the C-Bill values and the relative experience of the MechWarriors listed, you realize that this is a perverse betting pool. The percentages must represent the survival odds for each MechWarrior.
\nJust then [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] rounds the corner and stops short. A stick of chalk falls from {TGT_MW.DET} fingers and snaps on the floor.
column2:
在伽马舱附近一条闲置的走廊里，达里乌斯给你看墙上用粉笔画的一张古怪图表。每一行列着一个机师代号，旁边各栏里分别是：一个百分比和一个C币金额。

column1: As the morning briefing draws to a close, Darius raises a final point of discussion. \"The crew's been wound a little tight lately, and the lounge is empty too often. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] brought it to my attention, along with a suggestion that we 'do something' about it. I'm thinking that some kind of celebration is in order… anyone have any ideas?\"
\nSumire raises her hand. \"My family used to observe the Festival of Lights around this time of year. We'd light candles for the dead, then throw a wild party in their honor.\"
\nYang snorts. \"C'mon, Sumire. That sounds a little highbrow for people who go skinny dipping in coolant tanks. How 'bout we give {TGT_MW.Callsign} permission to throw a keg party instead?\"

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] hops off {TGT_MW.DET} bed as you enter the MedBay. \"Commander, it's a miracle! I'm good as new thanks to a little-known natural remedy. Got it for a steal on shore leave.\"
\nA MedTech pulls up an x-ray on a viewscreen. \"I hate to admit this, but somehow {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s hairline fracture has regenerated in record time. It's perplexing.\"

\n\"I think you mean amazing. Don't worry, Commander—it's a completely natural supplement. The restorative power is derived from the horn of a Stratford narwhal and refined into a powder. It's pretty tasty in coffee.\"

\nThe MedTech's eyes widen with alarm. \"It would be best if we continued to monitor {TGT_MW.Callsign}. Even though {TGT_MW.DET} fracture has healed, there's no telling what sort of unexpected side effects might be caused by this unapproved treatment.\"

\n\"Oh, come on,\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} grumbles. \"It's my week to lead the daily exercises! I don't want to miss that. I've got a killer routine planned. What if the MedTechs analyze this supplement and prove it's safe, Commander?\"
column2: 你走进医疗舱时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]从{TGT_MW.DET}床上跳下来。"指挥官，真是奇迹！多亏一种鲜为人知的天然疗法，我完好如初。休假时我白菜价淘到的。" 一名医疗技师在显示屏上调出一张X光片。"我不想承认，但不知怎么的，{TGT_MW.Callsign}的骨裂以创纪录的速度愈合了。令人费解。" "我想你的意思是惊人。别担心，指挥官——这完全是天然补充剂。其修复力取自斯特拉特福独角鲸的角，精制成粉末。放咖啡里挺好喝的。" 医疗技师的眼睛惊恐地睁大。"最好继续观察{TGT_MW.Callsign}。虽然{TGT_MW.DET}的骨裂已经愈合，但这种未经批准的疗法会造成什么意外副作用，谁也说不准。" "哦，得了吧，"{TGT_MW.Callsign}嘟囔。"这周轮到我带日常训练！我不想错过。我安排了一套超狠的流程。要是医疗技师们分析一下这个补充剂、证明它安全呢，指挥官？"

I know a guy who can get us an [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAlrakisTigerfalcon],Alrakis Tigerfalcon]], but it ain't cheap. This is an exotic, highly sought-after animal. I'm gonna need a million C-bills.\"

You'll be getting a hell of a deal on a practically pristine Mech.\"

column1: Thanks to the modern-day miracle of the Hyperpulse Generator, it's mail day aboard the Argo. Crew members filter into and out of the communications room to receive messages from home.

\nLater that evening, there's a knock at the door of your personal quarters. Upon opening the door, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] slips inside and hands you a datapad.  \"Commander, I'd already read half of this message before I realized it wasn't mine. It's addressed to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], from a long-distance lover back home. It's a breakup letter.\"
\nA torn expression creases {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s face. \"I just don't know what to do. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} would be devastated… do I pass the letter on to {SCN_MW.OBJ}, or do I keep it to myself?\"

column1: Strolling down the hall, you collide with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who seems to be in a hurry. \"Oh, Commander! I was looking for Darius but you'll do… [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is on the verge of a brawl with [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]. We need someone in authority to break this up.\"
\nYou raise your eyebrows. \"You have command experience, don't you, {TGT_MW.Callsign}?\"
\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} blinks. \"Well, yeah. But on board your ship, I'm just a pilot. I don't want to overstep my rank.\"
column2:
你沿走廊漫步，撞上似乎正赶路的[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。"哦，指挥官！我在找达里乌斯，不过你也行……[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]和[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]快要打起来了。我们需要有权威的人去制止。"

你挑起眉毛。"你不是有指挥经验吗，{TGT_MW.Callsign}？"

{TGT_MW.Callsign}眨了眨眼。"呃，是有。但在你的船上，我只是个飞行员。我不想越级。"

column1: During the daily briefing, Dr. Murad raises a hand. \"There will be a rare meteor shower on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. I thought it would boost everyone's spirits if we viewed the phenomenon from up close on the observation deck.\"
\n\"Sounds risky.\" Darius shakes his head. \"It's not like the Argo has brakes.\"
\n\"Well, how about we install a telescopic camera on the hull?\" Dr. Murad persists. \"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] volunteered to mount it.\"
\n\"Maybe it'd be safer to take the Leopard down to {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}'s surface and view the pretty lights from a safe distance?\" Yang beams. \"Hell, I'll even cook. What do you say, Commander?\"

He pulls you aside and puts his communicator on speaker, so both of you can hear [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

\n\"Commander, I'm in a bit of a situation. I went on an expedition to some nearby ruins, and I, uh, I think I'm being hunted by some of the native wildlife. column1: Late in the evening, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] ducks into your quarters. Dark circles rim {TGT_MW.DET} bloodshot eyes. \"Hey, Commander… I, uh, know you're busy, but I don't know where to turn.\"
\n\"What's wrong, MechWarrior?\"

\n{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s voice trembles. \"I haven't slept for days. I keep thinking why me? Why am I alive? I've seen ejections fail, ammo explosions, and impossible headshots. Rookies, veterans, it doesn't matter. How long until my picture is added to the Memorial Wall?\"
column2: 深夜，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]溜进你的舱室。{TGT_MW.DET}布满血丝的眼睛周围挂着黑眼圈。"嘿，指挥官……我，呃，知道你很忙，但我不知道该找谁。" "怎么了，机师？" {TGT_MW.Callsign}的声音发颤。"我已经好几天没睡了。我一直在想为什么是我？为什么我还活着？我见过弹射失败、弹药爆炸，还有不可能完成的爆头。新兵、老兵，都一样。还要多久我的照片就会被挂上纪念墙？"

column1: \"It's not like I'm the only noble-born person on the ship,\" says [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], slumping low in your guest chair. \"I mean, there's you. Why can't [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] harass you about their stupid idea?\" Apparently when {TGT_MW.Callsign} asked to speak to you privately about something 'Darius wouldn't understand', it was about the trials and tribulations of being nobility.
\n\"Well, what is {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s idea?\" you ask.

\n\"I don't know. Something about cooling systems. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} me to use my 'connections' to get the idea to people who can implement it. And {SCN_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} believe me when I say that my birth doesn't automatically open doors like that. And even if it did, I can't waste it on bullshit.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} gives you a plaintive look, clearly hoping for advice, or at least sympathy.
column2:
“船上又不是只有我一个贵族出身，”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]说，在你客座椅子里萎靡地瘫着。“我是说，还有你呢。为什么[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]不去拿他们那蠢主意烦你？”看来{TGT_MW.Callsign}所谓想私下谈“达里乌斯不会理解”的事，指的就是当贵族有多么苦多么难。

“那么，{SCN_MW.Callsign}的主意是什么？”你问。

“我不知道。好像是散热系统之类的。{SCN_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:想|Default:想}让我用我的‘人脉’把主意传给能实现它的人。而{SCN_MW.Subj}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:不|Default:不}信我说的：我的出身并不会自动打开那种门。就算会，我也不能把它浪费在胡扯上。”{TGT_MW.Callsign}可怜巴巴地看着你，显然在期待建议，或者至少是同情。

column1: Raised voices echo down the mess deck hallway and you arrive to find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] nose-to-nose with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].
\n\"I don't care about your noble family! You. Don't. Give. Me. Orders!\" {SCN_MW.Callsign} snarls, poking the other MechWarrior in the chest with each word.
\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} lifts {TGT_MW.DET} chin. \"Even out here in the Periphery, you should know enough to listen to your betters.\"
\n{SCN_MW.Callsign}'s fist flashes out before anyone can intervene, sending {TGT_MW.Callsign} staggering, blood erupting from a broken nose.
\nIn the dangerous silence that follows, the room finally notices that you've arrived. A single fork clatters to the floor.

食堂走廊里传来高声叫嚷，你赶到时看见[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]正与[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]贴脸对峙。

"我才不管你什么贵族家世！你。别。对。我。发号施令！"{SCN_MW.Callsign}咆哮着，每说一个词就戳一下对方的胸口。

{TGT_MW.Callsign}抬起{TGT_MW.DET}下巴。"就算在外缘这种地方，你也该懂得听比你强的人的话。"

还没等任何人上前阻拦，{SCN_MW.Callsign}的拳头已经挥出，打得{TGT_MW.Callsign}踉跄后退，血从被打断的鼻子里喷涌而出。

在随之而来的危险沉默中，房间里的人终于注意到你来了。一把叉子哐当一声掉在地上。

column1: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] stomps into your quarters, dragging [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] behind {SCN_MW.OBJ}. \"{TGT_MW.Callsign} mistook my bunk for a latrine… AGAIN!\" {SCN_MW.Callsign} wrinkles {SCN_MW.DET} nose. \"Third time this month.\"

\n{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stumble|Default:stumbles} forward. \"I… I can explain… \" {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slur|Default:slurs}. {TGT_MW.DET_C} breath stinks like gasoline fumes and paint thinner, making your eyes water.

\n\"It's not even noon!\" {SCN_MW.Callsign} narrows {SCN_MW.DET} eyes at {TGT_MW.OBJ}. \"There's having a good time and then there's this. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}'d get us killed if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} deployed in this state, Commander.\"
column2: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]跺着脚冲进你的舱室，把[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]一路拖在{SCN_MW.OBJ}身后。“{TGT_MW.Callsign}又把我的铺位当成厕所了……又一次！”{SCN_MW.Callsign}皱起{SCN_MW.DET}鼻子。“这个月第三次了。” {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:踉跄|Default:踉跄}上前。“我……我可以解释……”{TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:含糊地说|Default:含糊地说}。{TGT_MW.DET_C}呼吸里满是汽油味与油漆稀释剂的味道，呛得你眼睛发酸。 “现在连中午都还没到！”{SCN_MW.Callsign}眯起{SCN_MW.DET}眼睛盯着{TGT_MW.OBJ}。“偶尔放松是一回事，这就是另一回事了。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}要是以这种状态出战，会把我们全害死，指挥官。”

column1: After receiving a troubling message from Yang, you rush down to the Mech Bay. Yang pushes between a mob of MechWarriors and MechTechs entangled in a shoving match at the [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]'s feet. A message welded into the {SCN_Unit.Name}'s torso reads: \"No 'Techs, no 'Mechs!\"
\n\"You. Depend. On. Us.\" A scrawny MechTech with a black eye shoves a wrench at the 'Mech jockeys to emphasize every word. \"We deserve respect, and that means a raise.\"

\n\"I'll give you what you deserve.\" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes forward, but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and Yang pull {SCN_MW.OBJ} back from the 'Tech. \"We're the ones risking our necks!\"
\nYang raises his voice before anyone else can comment. \"Shut your traps! All of you. How do you want to handle this, Boss?\"
column2:
收到杨发来的令人不安的消息后，你冲到机甲库。杨从一群纠缠在[[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]脚下的机师与机修技师之间挤过来。{SCN_Unit.Name}的躯干上焊着一句话："没有技师，就没有机甲！"

"你们。依赖。我们。"一名眼圈发黑、身材瘦削的机修技师把扳手朝那些机甲骑手挥去，每个字都加重语气。"我们值得尊重，而那就意味着加薪。"

"我会给你该得的。"[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]冲上前，但[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]和杨把{SCN_MW.OBJ}从技师身边拉回来。"冒风险的是我们！"

在其他人开口之前，杨提高了嗓门。"都闭嘴！你们所有人。你想怎么处理这事，老大？"

column1: Annoyed, Darius calls you on the comms. \"Commander, I'm going to need you over in the corridor between the barracks and the mess. I caught [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] painting my likeness on the bulkheads and I'm not amused.\"

\nIn the corridor, {TGT_MW.Callsign} stands next to the mural, clutching an airbrush. Behind {TGT_MW.OBJ}, the XO is depicted flexing his shirtless, rippling biceps and abs, while flames erupt behind him.
\n\"What's going on here, {TGT_MW.Callsign}?\" you ask.
\n\"Everyone hates this stretch. It's cold and grey. So, I decided to turn up the heat.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} grins. \"You know, some members of this crew really, really like it.\"

column1: Passing by the MedBay, you spot [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] wrestling a medical monitor from a MedTech. \"You need to take a second look!\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} presses a hand against {TGT_MW.DET} stomach and winces. \"I know something is wrong. I feel like I'm dying.\"
\nYou pause in the doorway. \"What is going on here?\"

\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} relinquishes the monitor, and the MedTech clears her throat. \"{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s complaints of abdominal pain are purely neurological. Phantom pain, Commander. There's nothing to treat. We've checked.\"
\n\"Please, Commander, I'm not making this up.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} takes a deep breath. \"If you authorize an exploratory surgery or another examination, I know the MedTechs will find something.\"
column2: 路过医疗舱时，你看见[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]正从一名医疗技师手里争抢一台医疗监护仪。"你得再看一遍！"{TGT_MW.Callsign}用手按住{TGT_MW.DET}腹部，皱了皱眉。"我知道有什么不对劲。我感觉自己快死了。" 你在门口停下。"这里怎么回事？" {TGT_MW.Callsign}放开监护仪，那位医疗技师清了清嗓子。"{TGT_MW.Callsign}主诉的腹痛纯粹是神经性的。幻痛，指挥官。没什么可治的。我们检查过了。" "求你了，指挥官，我没在编。"{TGT_MW.Callsign}深吸一口气。"如果你批准做一次探查性手术或再做一次检查，我知道医疗技师们会发现些什么。"

He gave me some ancient components in exchange for information on how they functioned. I've determined that they could dramatically speed up our treatment speeds, but they'll burn out after a couple weeks. Would you like me to activate them in this emergency?\"

column1: Sumire turns to you. \"Commander, that Periphery seminar I took mentioned this system. It's famous for some ancient ruins on the primary planet. I've seen breathtaking pictures.\"

\nShe's clearly leading up to something. \"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] have been moping around a lot lately, and it's starting to get on my nerves. Banishing them to these ruins for a week would give them something new to think about.\"
\nA smile flickers across her face. \"Of course. I'd fly them down there, supervise them, and get them home on time, because I think those ruins will be even more amazing in person.\"

澄美转向你。“指挥官，我参加那次外围地区研讨会时提到过这个星系。它以主星球上的古老遗迹闻名。我看过令人屏息的照片。”

她显然在铺垫什么。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]和[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]最近一直闷闷不乐，已经开始让我心烦了。把他们打发去那些遗迹待一周，能让他们有点新东西可想。”

她脸上闪过笑意。“当然，我会送他们下去、监督他们，并按时带他们回来，因为我觉得亲眼看到那些遗迹会更惊人。”

\nAs you prepare for a brawl, Behemoth says, \"Hey, Commander, let me handle this.\" She's grinning. \"You can keep shopping if you want.\"
\nYou step out of her way, but linger a moment.

\nBehemoth takes a wide stance, raises her fists in the air, and roars back at the berserker down the street. His eyes bulge out and he changes position, leaning forward like he's about to charge, and roars again. In response, Behemoth drops low and roars at the heavens.
\nWhatever is going on, she seems to have it well in hand.

你正准备开打，巨兽说：“嘿，指挥官，这个交给我。”她在笑。“你想继续逛街也行。”

巨兽岔开腿、双拳举向空中，朝街那头的狂战士吼了回去。那人眼睛鼓起，改变姿势前倾，仿佛要冲锋，又吼了一声。作为回应，巨兽压低身形，朝天空咆哮。

column1: Darius jabs a finger at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who sits sulking in a makeshift brig. \"Yang caught this one sneaking through the Argo's ventral airlock last night. From the outside.\"
\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} averts {TGT_MW.DET} gaze.

\n\"Apparently, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} managed to jimmy the door open without alerting anyone.\" The XO's lip curls into an angry frown. \"How about it, MechWarrior? Care to explain why you took an unauthorized [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]?\"

\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} sighs. \"I just had to, Commander.\" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:search|Default:searches} your face for a reaction. \"It's so peaceful out there—floating free, just me and the stars. No explosions, no sweltering cockpit. Just calm and quiet.\"

\nDarius shoots you a sidelong glance. \"This little stunt could've gone wrong in a hundred different ways. Chuckles here is lucky {TGT_MW.SUBJ} didn't get anyone killed. How do you think we should handle it?\"
column2: 达里乌斯用手指戳着[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，后者闷闷不乐地坐在临时禁闭室里。“昨晚杨抓到这家伙从阿尔戈的腹部气闸偷偷进来。是从外面。” {TGT_MW.Callsign}移开{TGT_MW.DET}目光。 “看样子，{TGT_MW.SUBJ}撬开了舱门而没惊动任何人。”副官气得嘴角绷紧。“怎么样，机甲战士？愿意解释一下你为什么未经许可进行[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],舱外活动]]吗？” {TGT_MW.Callsign}叹了口气。“我非去不可，指挥官。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:端详|Default:端详}着你的脸，看你的反应。“外面太宁静了——自由漂浮，只有我和星星。没有爆炸，没有闷热的座舱。只有安静与平和。” 达里乌斯斜眼瞥你。“这出小把戏有一百种出事的方式。这位笑匠运气好，{TGT_MW.SUBJ}没害死任何人。你觉得我们该怎么处理？”

column1: The Alyina Mercantile League is an independent state formed in the wake of Clan Jade Falcon's collapse during the mid-32nd century. Centered on the planet Alyina, the League emerged as a coalition of mercantile interests and planetary governments seeking to establish stability and economic independence in a region long ravaged by Clan conflict. Blending pragmatic governance with a strong focus on commerce, the League fosters cooperation among its member worlds while actively defending its sovereignty through a combination of mercenaries and local forces. Positioned at a crossroads of trade and strategy, the Alyina Mercantile League has become a beacon of order and prosperity in a fractious era.
column2: 阿莉娜商业联盟是翡翠猎鹰氏族在三十二世纪中叶崩溃之后形成的一个独立国家。联盟以阿莉娜行星为中心，由商业利益方与行星政府结成的同盟组成，力求在一个长期被氏族冲突揉躏的地区建立稳定与经济独立。联盟把务实治理与对商业的强烈关注相结合，在成员世界之间促进合作，同时通过雇佣兵与本地部队的组合积极捍卫自身主权。地处贸易与战略的十字路口，阿莉娜商业联盟已成为这个纷乱时代里秩序与繁荣的灯塔。

column1: The Amaris Empire was the realization of Stefan's great ambitions. Viewing all the Inner Sphere, and specifically the Star League, as oppressor states who were crushing the Periphery states, Stefan planned a military coup to overthrow the League leadership and take the power. The death of First Lord Simon Cameron in 2751 was his opportunity. The First Lord's death, apparently an accident, later was discovered to be a murder, but it remains unknown if it was the work of Stefan or not. In any case, Stefan approached Richard Cameron, the young successor of Simon, winning his trust, murdering him, all his family and anyone loyal to the Camerons. The Amaris Coup was a great initial success, conquering all worlds of the Terran Hegemony.
column2: 阿马里斯帝国是斯特凡宏大野心的实现。斯特凡把所有内层星域势力、尤其是星际联盟视为压迫外围国家的压迫者，因而策划了一场军事政变以推翻联盟领导层并夺取权力。2751年第一领主西蒙·卡梅隆之死成了他的机会。这位第一领主的死表面上是意外，后来被发现是谋杀，但是否出自斯特凡之手仍不清楚。无论如何，斯特凡接近了西蒙的年轻继承人理查德·卡梅隆，赢得他的信任，随后谋杀了他、他全家以及一切忠于卡梅隆的人。阿马里斯政变初期大获成功，征服了地球霸权的所有世界。

column2: 阿马里斯帝国

column1: The Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition (ARLC) is a breakaway state formed in the mid-32nd century after the collapse of the Wolf Empire and Clan Wolf's occupation of the Lyran Commonwealth's Arc-Royal region. Centered on the planet Arc-Royal, the ARLC was established under the leadership of Clan Wolf-in-Exile. It represents an alliance of local systems seeking autonomy, rejecting external domination while embracing both the Clan and Inner Sphere traditions. Known for its strong military capability, the Coalition is characterized by its hybrid culture and pragmatic governance, embodying a unique blend of freedom and security within a turbulent Inner Sphere.
column2: 弧王自由联盟（ARLC）是一个分离国家，于三十二世纪中叶在狼帝国崩溃、狼族占领莱兰联邦弧王地区之后成立。它以弧王行星为中心，在流亡狼族氏族的领导下建立。它代表着寻求自治的地方星系联盟，拒绝外部支配，同时拥抱氏族与内天体两种传统。联盟以强大的军事能力著称，其特征是混合文化与务实治理，在动荡的内天体中体现了自由与安全的独特融合。

column1: The Arano Restoration is the remnant of the former Aurigan Coalition, driven from power by the treachery of Santiago Espinosa. Many noble houses of the Aurigan Directorate harbor sympathies for the Restoration and its cause: returning the Arano monarchy to power.

His rule is oppressive and militaristic, with individual liberties sacrificed to the cause of security and stability.
