column1: Untouched by attacks from the Word of Blake, the Protectorate actively worked to improve the fledgling nation's industrial base and used the developing manufacturing resources to help boost the economy through exports. The improved manufacturing base also gave the CPM local sources of supply, and military recruitment picked up both as a result of the more enthusiastic amongst the energized citizens of the protectorate and the swarms of immigrants from the Concordat who fled to the Protectorate to escape the ruling military junta.  The Protectorate further improved its economic base by establishing trade ties with the nearby Filtvelt Coalition and Fronc Reaches, as well as the more distant Raven Alliance - and these ties also helped to secure the Protectorate's borders.  Eighty-one years after the Calderon Protectorate was formed, on 29 August 3147, Protector Sam Calderon and Kaff Doru announced that Doru's twelve-year-old daughter Reva and Calderon's eight-year-old son Bryant would marry once Bryant turned eighteen. Until then, the two nations would expand their trade relations and engage in mutual defense operations, with additional safeguards to prevent events like the Bromhead Massacre of 3067.
column2: 由于未遭布雷克之言的攻击，保护国积极致力于改善这个初生国家的工业基础，并利用发展中的制造资源，通过出口提振经济。改进后的制造基础也为CPM提供了本地供应来源，军事招募也随之上扬——既有保护国公民中更热心者的踊跃，也有大批为逃避执政军政府而从协约国逃往保护国的移民。保护国还通过与附近的菲尔特地联盟和弗朗克边疆，以及更遥远的渡鸦联盟建立贸易关系，进一步夯实其经济基础——这些纽带也有助于保障保护国的边界安全。卡尔德隆保护国成立八十一年后，3147年8月29日，保护者萨姆·卡尔德隆与卡夫·多鲁宣布，多鲁十二岁的女儿雷瓦与卡尔德隆八岁的儿子布莱恩特将在布莱恩特满十八岁后成婚。在此之前，两国将扩大贸易往来并开展共同防御行动，并附加额外保障措施，以防止再出现像3067年布罗姆黑德惨案那样的事件。

column1: Nueva Castile isn't actually a faction per se, but more a typical outer periphery area in flux.  It is lacking in HPG stations, and so far out of touch with the rest of the inner sphere that hardly anyone knows what's really going on there.
column2: 新卡斯蒂利亚其实不算一个严格意义上的势力，更像是外围地区一个处于变动中的典型边远区域。它缺少HPG站，与内层星域其余部分脱节得几乎没人知道那里到底在发生什么。

column1: Nueva Castile
column2: 新卡斯蒂利亚

column1: The Chainelane Isles is not a unified realm, but rather a collection of waring planet-states and minor principalities fighting with mostly pre-mech tech.
column2: 钱莱恩群岛并非一个统一的国度，而是由众多相互征战的星球国家和次要公国组成的集合体，其战争手段主要依靠前机甲时代的科技.

column1: Chainelane Isles
column2: 钱莱恩群岛

column1: The Circinus Federation are effectively a highly organized pirate group that operates under the guise of being the legitimate armed forces of a democratically elected government.
column2: 切尔西努斯联邦实质上是一个组织严密的匪盗集团，以民选政府的合法武装力量为伪装活动。

column1: Circinus Federation
column2: 圆规座联合会

column1: Blood Spirit
column2: 血灵

column1: Named for the esprit-de-corps that bound the original 800 Clan warriors, Clan Blood Spirit ironically became the most isolationist and bitter of the Clans. They believed that the other Clans had abandoned the way set down by Nicholas Kerensky.
column2: 血灵氏族的名称源于团结最初800名氏族战士的团队精神。然而讽刺的是，血灵氏族最终成为了所有氏族中最孤立、最苦涩的一个。他们认为其他氏族已经背弃了尼古拉斯·克伦斯基所制定的道路。

column1: Clan Blood Spirit
column2: 血灵氏族

column1: Clan Burrock is one of the original 20 Clans founded by Nicholas Kerensky, and is regarded as one of the more enlightened of the Crusader Clans as far as their treatment of commoners and freeborn.
column2: 岩蜍氏族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基创立的原始20个氏族之一，在对待平民与自由出生者的方式上，被视为十字军氏族中较为开明的一支。

column1: Clan Burrock
column2: 伯洛克氏族

column1: Cloud Cobra
column2: 云眼镜蛇

column1: The only Clan defined by its incorporation of organized religions, Clan Cloud Cobra's warrior-priests are organized into Cloisters and dedicated themselves to an overarching concept known as The Way.  Clan Cloud Cobra are one of the Warden Clans, who seek to preserve the inner sphere.
column2: 作为唯一以纳入组织化宗教为特征的部族，云眼镜蛇的战士祭司按“隐修院”编制，献身于一个被称为“道”的总体理念。云眼镜蛇是守护者部族之一，致力于保存内层星域。

column1: Clan Cloud Cobra
column2: 云蛇氏族

column1: The Coyote Clan was responsible for the invention of the OmniMech and is one of the strongest of the Warden Clans. The Coyotes were also known for their mystical beliefs, based on native American religious practices.
column2: 郊狼氏族是万能机甲的发明者，也是守望者氏族中最强大的氏族之一. 郊狼氏族还以其基于美洲原住民宗教习俗的神秘信仰而闻名.

column1: Diamond Shark
column2: 钻石鲨

column1: Originally known as Clan Sea Fox, and often referred to as the Merchant Clan, the Diamond Sharks were among the most powerful and progressive of the Warden Clans.
column2: 钻石鲨最初被称为海狐氏族，常被称作商人氏族，是守护者氏族中最强大、最进步的一支。

column1: Fire Mandrill
column2: 火沸沸

column1: Probably the most fractious of the Clans, the Fire Mandrill are as likely to fight each other as they are an enemy.
column2: 可能是各部族中最易内斗的，火沸沸彼此开战的可能性不亚于与外敌开战。

column1: Ghost Bear
column2: 鬼熊

column1: Among the most powerful of the Clans, the Ghost Bears were defined by their conservative 'wait and see nature' and their deep familial relationship with each other.
column2: 身为氏族中最强大的几支之一，幽灵熊的特征是其保守的"观望"天性以及彼此间深厚的家族式纽带。

column1: The Goliath Scorpion Clan was obsessed with recovering any and all lost artifacts of the fallen Star League, sending Seekers fueled by necrosa visions far and wide to recover them.
column2: 蝎狮氏族痴迷于寻回覆灭星盟的一切失落造物，派出由死灵幻象驱动的探寻者远赴四方将其收回。

column1: Known for their prominent use of combat vehicles in front-line forces, the Hell's Horses lived by the motto that man came before machine and all members were valued as being part of a greater whole, including freebirths.
column2: 以在前线部队中大量使用战斗车辆而闻名，地狱马的座右铭是人先于机器，所有成员——包括自由出生者——都被视为更大整体的一部分而受到重视。

column1: Clan Hell's Horses
column2: 氏族地狱马

column1: Ice Hellion
column2: 冰恶棍

column1: A fierce, quick-handed Clan bordering on reckless, the Ice Hellion Clan often grasped for prizes beyond their reach and could be their own worst enemy. Ice Hellion warriors prized the ability to strike first above other considerations.
column2: 冰地狱狮是一个凶猛、出手迅速的部族，几近鲁莽，常伸手去抓超出自身能力的东西，可能是自己最大的敌人。冰地狱狮战士把先手打击的能力看得比什么都重。

column1: Jade Falcon
column2: 玉鹰

column1: Staunch traditionalists and aggressive fighters, the Jade Falcons were central in the creation of the Crusader philosophy. They live by the mantra 'might makes right'
column2: 作为坚定的传统主义者与好斗的战士，玉猫部族在十字军哲学的创立中处于核心地位。他们奉行“强者即正义”的信条。

column1: Clan Jade Falcon
column2: 玉鹰氏族

column1: Gutted in the fight for Terra and the proceeding ilKhan Trial, with 98% percent of their forces on Terra perishing in the struggles, Clan Jade Falcon's survivors numbered roughly 120, with many of those severely injured. Clan Jade Falcon then began serving as a bodyguard Clan vowing to protect the ilKhan and the reborn Star League under new leadership after abandoning the Mongol Doctrine and choosing a new Khan.  The most intact part of the Falcon's Touman was their Warfleet, which helped Clan Wolf units to keep watch over the other Clans invited to the IlClan's founding ceremony.  The remaining forces in the Occupation Zone were either conquered by Inner Sphere factions or splintered into newer incarnations of the Clan. One maintains the Clan Jade Falcon identity and is led by Khan Jiyi Chistu, the other, composed by the bulk of the Falcon's Merchant Caste, is the Alyina Mercantile League, led by Merchant caste Syndic Marena.
column2: 在争夺地球的战斗及随后的伊尔汗大考验中被彻底打残，驻地球部队有98%在战火中覆灭，翡翠猎鹰氏族的幸存者仅约120人，其中许多人身负重伤。此后翡翠猎鹰放弃蒙古教义、选出新可汗，转而充当护卫氏族，誓言保护伊尔汗与重生星盟的新领导层。猎鹰图曼中最完整的一部分是其战舰队，它协助狼族部队看管受邀参加伊尔汗建国典礼的其他氏族。占领区内的残余部队要么被内天体势力征服，要么分裂成该氏族的新化身。其中一支保持翡翠猎鹰氏族的身份，由可汗吉伊·奇斯图统领；另一支由猎鹰商人种姓的主体组成，即阿莉娜商业联盟，由商人种姓理事玛蕾娜领导。

column1: Clan Mongoose was one of the original twenty Clans founded by Nicholas Kerensky, named for the creature on Shadow that preyed upon the dangerous venom worms and thus endeared itself to Shadow's colonists. While the Clan did well enough for itself during the first half of the twenty-ninth century, its heavy reliance upon politics over honorable combat alienated other Clans and eventually sealed its fate when Clan Smoke Jaguar won the right to Absorb them in 2868. After a brutal campaign the Jaguars prevailed and, save for some aerospace pilot heritages taken by Clan Cloud Cobra, Clan Mongoose's legacies ceased to exist.
column2: 獴氏族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基创立的原始二十个氏族之一，得名于影星上一种捕食危险毒虫的生物，因此深受影星殖民者的喜爱。虽然该氏族在二十九世纪前半段发展得相当不错，但它过度依赖政治而非荣誉战斗，使其他氏族疏远，最终在2868年烟虎氏族赢得吸收它的权利时注定了它的命运。经过一场残酷的战役，烟虎胜出，除了一些被云眼镜蛇氏族收走的航空飞行员血脉之外，獴氏族的传承不复存在。

column1: A Clan marked by their own unique brand of mysticism, the Nova Cats are guided by visions and portents, and even its Khans first consulted with the Oathmaster before undertaking any action which could affect the Clan.
column2: 新星猫是一个以独特神秘主义风格著称的部族，他们受幻象与预兆指引，就连可汗在采取任何可能影响部族的行动之前，也要先咨询誓约长。

column1: The Clan Protectorate is a unique province within the Free Worlds League, formed under the leadership of Clan Sea Fox and inspired by the vision of Lady Julletta Marik. Recognizing the strategic and economic advantages of partnering with Clans rather than opposing them, Lady Julletta facilitated the Protectorate's creation as a semi-autonomous region blending Clan efficiency with Free Worlds League governance. The Protectorate is centered around worlds granted to Clan Sea Fox in exchange for their mercantile prowess, fostering stability and prosperity through trade and mutual cooperation. It represents an ambitious experiment in hybrid governance, uniting Clan and Inner Sphere ideals within the Marik realm.
column2: 氏族保护国是自由世界联盟中一个独特的省，在海狐氏族领导下建立，灵感来自朱莱塔·马里克女士的构想。朱莱塔女士认识到与氏族合作、而非对抗它们的战略与经济优势，促成保护国作为一个半自治区域建立，把氏族效率与自由世界联盟的治理融为一体。保护国以那些为换取海狐氏族的商业才能而授予他们的世界为中心，通过贸易与相互合作促进稳定与繁荣。它代表着一次雄心勃勃的混合治理实验，在马里克领域内把氏族与内天体的理想结合起来。

column1: Clan Protectorate
column2: 氏族保护领

column1: Clan Sea Fox is the original name of Clan Diamond Shark. Clan Sea Fox and Clan Snow Raven had a falling out, and in response Clan Snow Raven created the Diamond Shark, a predator designed solely to hunt and kill the Sea Foxes who lived in Strana Mechty's oceans. After most of the Sea Foxes had been killed, Clan Sea Fox petitioned the Grand Council to change its name to Clan Diamond Shark. Several sea foxes were preserved by the Clan and placed on other worlds, where they flourished. As a result, Clan Diamond Shark changed its name back to Clan Sea Fox by 3100. The Diamond Shark/Sea Fox Clan has relied heavily on its Merchant Caste since its inception, giving them more power and freedom than most Clans. Though many believe them to be weak because of their democratic attitudes toward their lower castes, the Diamond Sharks maintained one of the largest and most elite toumans among the Clans.
column2: 海狐氏族是钻石鲨氏族的原名。海狐氏族与雪鸦氏族发生争执，作为回应，雪鸦氏族创造了钻石鲨——一种专为猎杀斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂海洋中海狐而设计的掠食者。在大部分海狐被杀之后，海狐氏族向大议会请愿，要求改名为钻石鲨氏族。该氏族保存了几只海狐并安置到其他行星上，它们在那里繁衍兴旺。因此，钻石鲨氏族在3100年前又把名字改回了海狐氏族。钻石鲨/海狐氏族自创立起就严重依赖其商人种姓，给予他们的权力与自由远超大多数氏族。尽管许多人因其对低等种姓的民主态度而认为他们软弱，钻石鲨仍保有着氏族中规模最大、最精锐的图曼之一。

column1: Clan Sea Fox
column2: 海狐氏族

column1: 50 years after Clan Diamond Shark officially changes its name back to Clan Sea Fox, they proceed to buy all of the Free Worlds League's ComStar assets and absorbs all Wolf Empire's working and nonworking HPGs. They also supplied Clan Wolf for their campaign to Terra.  Clan Sea Fox, after the rise of the IlClan, began bonding mercenary contracts across Federated Suns and Draconis Combine space, quickly replacing the MRBC.
column2: 在钻石鲨部族正式改回海狐部族之名50年后，他们着手买下自由世界联盟的全部通讯之星资产，并吸收狼帝国所有可运行与不可运行的HPG。他们还为狼部族的远征地球行动提供补给。在伊尔克兰崛起之后，海狐部族开始在联邦太阳国与龙脉联合体空间内串联雇佣兵合同，迅速取代了MRBC。

column1: Smoke Jaguar
column2: 烟虎

column1: Clan Smoke Jaguar was among the most aggressive and warlike of the Clans, even at the expense of more peaceful endeavors, and were early supporters of the Crusader philosophy.  They are noted for repressing anyone but their own Warrior Caste.
column2: 烟虎氏族是氏族中最具侵略性和最好战的成员之一，即便以牺牲更为和平的事业为代价，并且是十字军哲学的早期支持者。他们以压制除自身武士阶层以外的所有人而为人所知。

column1: Clan Smoke Jaguar
column2: 烟虎氏族

column1: Masters of compromise and manipulation, Clan Snow Raven were opportunists of the highest order, possessing an almost un-Clanlike sense of self-preservation and a willingness to sell their services to the highest bidder.
column2: 作为妥协与操纵的大师，雪鸦氏族是最高级别的机会主义者，拥有近乎不像氏族人的自保意识，以及把服务卖给出价最高者的意愿。

column1: Clan Snow Raven
column2: 雪鸦氏族

column1: Star Adder
column2: 星蝰蛇

column1: A conservative Clan, the Star Adders are known for their pragmatism and their strategic (rather than tactical) view towards battle, as well as treating freeborn that proved themselves as equals.
column2: 星蝰氏族是一个保守的氏族，以实用主义和注重战略（而非战术）层面的作战观念而闻名，同时也以平等对待那些证明了自己价值的自由生而著称.

column1: Clan Star Adder
column2: 星蝰氏族

column1: Steel Viper
column2: 钢蝰

column1: The Steel Vipers had the toughest training regime of any Clan save the Blood Spirits, graduating fewer but more elite warriors, and were more discriminating against freebirths than other Clans.
column2: 钢蛇氏族拥有除血灵氏族外所有氏族中最严苛的训练制度，培养出的战士数量更少但更为精锐，并且比其他氏族更歧视自由生者.

column1: Clan Steel Viper
column2: 钢蛇氏族

column1: Stone Lion
column2: 石狮

column1: Named from the feline inhabiting the northern mountains of Tokasha, Clan Stone Lion was created from the remaining Homeworld members of Clan Hell's Horses after the Abjuration of their Inner Sphere portion in 3075
column2: 以栖息在托卡沙北部山脉的猫科动物命名，石狮氏族是在其内天体分支于3075年被弃绝之后，由地狱马氏族余下的本土星系成员创建的

column1: Clan Stone Lion
column2: 石狮氏族

column1: Clan Widowmaker was one of the original twenty Clans. Their homeworld was Roche, settled in 2812. Known as an extremely aggressive Clan, they had a relatively short history before their Absorption by Clan Wolf.
column2: 寡妇制造者氏族是原始二十个氏族之一。他们的母星是罗什，于2812年殖民。作为一个以极度好斗著称的氏族，他们在被狼族吸收之前历史相对短暂。

column1: The chosen Clan of Nicholas Kerensky, the Wolves have dominated Clan society since their inception. Less formal and more flexible than others, Clan Wolf emulated its namesake by blending caution with decisiveness.
column2: 作为尼古拉斯·克伦斯基选中的部族，狼族自创立以来一直主导着部族社会。狼部族比其他部族更少形式、更为灵活，以其同名者（狼）为榜样，把谨慎与果断融为一体。

column1: Clan Wolf-in-Exile is a splinter faction of the original Clan Wolf, one of the twenty Clans created by Nicholas Kerensky. Born from the destruction of the original Clan Wolf in the Refusal War, the Wolves-in-Exile continued to uphold the Warden traditions of their forebears under the leadership of Khan Phelan Kell by siding with the Inner Sphere
column2: 狼族流亡者是原狼部族的分裂派系，而狼部族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基所创二十个部族之一。流亡之狼诞生于原狼部族在拒绝战争中的覆灭，他们在可汗费伦·凯尔的领导下站在内层星域一边，继续坚守先辈的守护者传统。

column1: One of the original twenty Clans, Clan Wolverine was Annihilated in the years after Operation KLONDIKE, officially for having detonated nuclear devices to destroy a genetic repository of Clan Snow Raven and for opposing Nicholas Kerensky and the Clans as a whole.

\nThe Clans subsequently went to great lengths to purge Clan Wolverine from their history. They refer to the former Clan Wolverine only as the \"Not-Named Clan\". Instead of properly referring the \"IIC\"-style evolution of the Wolverine BattleMech as the Wolverine IIC, it was renamed the Conjurer (Hellhound). More than two hundred years after Clan Wolverine's annihilation, the mere comparison of a Clan warrior to an animal identified as wolverine, in a completely unrelated situation and by a person not accustomed to Clan society, was still considered a shocking insult that might elicit a violent response.
column2: 作为原始二十个氏族之一，狼獾氏族在克朗代克行动之后的岁月里被灭绝，官方理由是它引爆核装置摧毁了雪鸦氏族的一处基因库，并反对尼古拉斯·克伦斯基与整个氏族体制。\n\n此后氏族们不遗余力地把狼獾氏族从历史中抹除。他们只把前狼獾氏族称作"无名氏族"。狼獾战斗机甲那种"IIC"式演化本应称为狼獾IIC，却被改名为咒术师（地狱犬）。在狼獾氏族被灭绝两百多年后，仅仅把一名氏族战士比作一种被认作狼獾的动物——在完全无关的场合，由不熟悉氏族社会的人做出——仍被视为可能招致暴力回应的惊人侮辱。

column1: Clan Wolverine
column2: 狼獾氏族

column1: Far be it from a simple organization like ComStar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, butâ€¦ your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
column2: 像通讯之星这样简单的组织本不该在作战事务上斥责你，指挥官，但……你在那次行动中的表现实在糟糕透顶。我们对你的无能予以严正谴责。

column1: ComStar, the institution and religion, grew out of the Star League Department of Communications, as reenvisioned by Jerome Blake, Minister of Communications. ComStar is transnational, beholden to none of the Successor States, and its priesthood exclusively controls access to the only means of faster-than-light communications, the HyperPulse Generators. ComStar facilities and personnel are sacrosanct, a status enforced aggressively by the institution; offending statesâ€”even entire Successor Statesâ€”can find themselves cut off from the rest of the Inner Sphere, unable to communicate or trade. The current head of ComStar is Primus Julian Tiepolo.
column2: 通讯之星(ComStar)，作为一个机构与宗教，脱胎于星际联盟通讯部，由时任通讯部长杰罗姆·布雷克重新构想而创立. 通讯之星是跨国组织，不对任何继承国效忠，其教士阶层独掌着唯一超光速通讯手段——超脉冲发生器的使用权. 通讯之星的设施与人员神圣不可侵犯，这一地位由该机构极力维护; 冒犯它的国家——甚至是整个继承国——都可能发现自己被内天体其余部分隔绝，无法通讯与贸易. 通讯之星目前的领袖是首席主教朱利安·蒂耶波洛.

column1: It seems apparent that while you failed to achieve our goals, you engaged the enemy for as long as you were able. Better luck next time, Commander. May the Spirit of Blake be with you.
column2: 这看起来似乎很显然，虽然你没有达成我们的目标，但已经尽你所能来和敌人交战了. 希望你下次能走运一些，指挥官. 希望布雷克的精神与你同在.

column1: ComStar congratulates you on your successful mission, mercenary. We are pleased you've been able to assist us so thoroughly.
column2: 康星祝贺你任务成功，佣兵。我们很高兴你能如此彻底地协助我们。

column1: Dark Caste
column2: 黑暗种姓

column1: The Dark Caste is largely a mystery. Equipped with ancient Clan mechs from their Golden Century as well as old mothballed SLDF mechs, the Dark Caste appear to be little more than Clan renegades and bandits, raiding Deep Periphery states with impunity and marauding at will. They have no leadership or goals, they exist only to survive at any cost.
column2: 黑暗种姓大体是个谜。他们装备着来自黄金世纪的古老氏族机甲以及旧封存的SLDF机甲，看起来不过是氏族的叛徒与匪徒，肆无忌惮地劫掠深远外缘国家，任意横行。他们没有领袖或目标，只为了不惜一切代价生存。

column1: Come now, mercenary—did you even try to complete the contract, or did you believe we'd pay you for your own inadequacies? Such a dismal performance cannot be rewarded, only reprimanded.
column2: 得了吧，雇佣兵——你到底有没有尽力去履行合同，还是以为我们会为你自己的无能付钱？如此糟糕的表现得不到奖赏，只能受到训斥。

column1: The Federated Suns is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward and spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Davion, the Federation is the most powerful of the five, and the people of the Federation pride themselves on their self-proclaimed role as defenders of justice and liberty. The Federation is quite capable of ruthless, decisive action, though, and its idealism readily gives way to pragmatism when called for. The current ruler of the Federation, Prince Hanse Davion, is an experienced and unconventional military commander. The Federation's alliance with the Lyran Commonwealth effectively ended the Third Succession War.
column2: 联邦太阳国是星际联盟的五个继承国之一，位于地球的外缘方向与顺旋方向。它由达维昂家族统治，是五国中最强大的一个，其人民也以自封的正义与自由捍卫者自居而自豪。不过，这个联邦同样能采取无情而果断的行动，必要时其理想主义也会让位于务实。联邦现任统治者汉斯·达维昂亲王是一位经验丰富、不循常规的军事指挥官。联邦与莱兰联邦的结盟实质上终结了第三次继承战争。

column1: Well, let it never be said House Davion does not believe in charity. Obviously, your skills could not be equivalent to our own regular armies—so we do not blame you for your inability to complete the contract.
column2: 嗯，可别让人说戴维恩家族不信慈善。显然，你的本领无法与我们正规军相提并论——所以我们不怪你没能完成合同。

column1: Excellent performance, Commander. The Federated Suns are pleased with what you have accomplished and the skill you've evidenced. Expect our payment in full!
column2: 表现出色，指挥官。联邦太阳国对您的成就与展现出的技艺十分满意。报酬将足额奉上！

column1: the Federated Suns
column2: 恒星联邦

column1: Little is known about the New Delphi Compact, apart from the capital being New Delphi.  This area will probably be quickly absorbed into a nearby faction anyway, so it's almost certainly not worth your trouble.
column2: 关于新德尔菲共同体知道的很少，除了首都是新德尔菲。这一地区大概很快就会被附近某个派系吸收，所以几乎肯定不值得你费心。

column1: New Delphi Compact
column2: 新德尔斐盟约国

column1: We are deeply disappointed in your performance, Commander. Your efforts on the battlefield were those of a raw cadet, not the leader of a mercenary company.
column2: 我们对你的表现深感失望，指挥官。你在战场上的作为像个新兵，而不是一名佣兵团的领袖。

column1: The Duchy of Andurien was a member province of House Marik's Free Worlds League throughout most of its history before becoming an independent nation in 3079. The water-rich Andurien worlds were disputed between the Free Worlds League and House Liao's Capellan Confederation from early in the Age of War until the First Succession War when the region was finally secured by the League.
column2: 安杜里恩公国在其历史的大部分时间里都是马里克家族自由世界联盟的成员省，直到3079年成为一个独立国家。这些水资源丰富的安杜里恩世界从战火时代早期起就在自由世界联盟与廖氏卡佩兰联邦之间争夺，直到第一次继承战争才最终被联盟稳固掌控。

column1: The Duchy Of Andurien understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 安杜里恩公国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Humphreys is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——汉弗莱斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: Duchy Of Andurien
column2: 安杜瑞恩公国

column1: During the mid-thirty-second century the Duchy of Andurien strengthened its ties with the Canopians and Capellan Confederation while staunchly refusing to join the resurrected Free Worlds League.  Attempts to annex eleven unaligned world between them and the Regulan Fiefs would cease after the FWLM invades the Regulan Fiefs.
column2: 在32世纪中叶，安杜瑞恩公国加强了与船底人及卡佩拉联邦的联系，同时坚决拒绝加入重生的自由世界联盟。在自由世界联盟军队入侵雷古兰领地后，其试图吞并位于本国与雷古兰领地之间11个中立世界的行动遂告终止。

column1: The Elysian worlds are all planets maintained in their pristine wilderness state. The people supported themselves mainly as hunters and gatherers, and almost universally follow the One Star faith.
column2: 极乐世界诸星球都保持着原始荒野状态。其居民主要以狩猎与采集为生，并几乎普遍信仰“一星”教。

column1: Escorpion Imperio
column2: 天蝎帝国

column1: The Escorpion Imperio was formed in 3080 after Clan Goliath Scorpion was Abjured by the Grand Council. They left Clan Space and conquered the Deep Periphery states known as Nueva Castile and the Umayyad Caliphate
column2: 蝎帝国成立于3080年，此前歌利亚蝎部族被大议会放逐。他们离开部族空间，征服了被称为新卡斯蒂利亚与倭马亚哈里发的纵深外围国家

column1: The Federated Commonwealth was the union of the Lyran Commonwealth and Federated Suns. The accession of Archon-Prince Victor Steiner-Davion in 3055 formally brought the nation into being, though in practice it had existed as the Federated Commonwealth Alliance since 3028. Katherine Steiner-Davion seceded the Lyran half of the nation in 3057, creating the Lyran Alliance, which would lead to the FedCom Civil War in 3062. Victor abdicated the throne in 3067 and his successor, Prince-Regent Yvonne Steiner-Davion, reverted to the \"Federated Suns\". In 3084 the Lyran Alliance reverted to the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: 联邦共同体是莱兰联邦与联邦太阳的联合体。3055年大公-亲王维克托·施泰纳-达维昂继位，正式使这一国家成立，尽管实际上它自3028年起就以联邦共同体联盟的形式存在。凯瑟琳·施泰纳-达维昂在3057年让国家的莱兰半边退出，建立了莱兰联盟，这最终导致3062年的联邦共同体内战。维克托于3067年退位，其继任者、摄政亲王伊冯娜·施泰纳-达维昂又恢复为"联邦太阳"。3084年，莱兰联盟恢复为莱兰联邦。

column1: The Ferris Collective is a small independent state located between the Rasalhague Dominion and the Republic of the Barrens. Established in the chaos following the collapse of the Hegemony, the Collective is governed by a self-appointed 'Emperor,' who oversees a patchwork of settlements and factories. Known for its pragmatic reliance on mercenary forces to secure its interests, the Ferris Collective is both a trading hub and a fiercely defended enclave, using its manufacturing capabilities and mercenary contracts to maintain independence in the turbulent 32nd century Inner Sphere.
column2: 费里斯集体是一个位于拉萨尔哈格自治领与荒原共和国之间的小型独立国家。它建立于霸权崩溃后的混乱之中，由一个自封的"皇帝"统治，管辖着一片拼凑起来的定居点与工厂。费里斯集体以务实地依赖雇佣兵部队来保障自身利益而闻名，既是贸易枢纽，又是防御严密的飞地，凭借其制造能力与雇佣兵合约，在动荡的三十二世纪内天体中维持独立。

column1: Ferris Collective
column2: 费里斯集合体

column1: The Filtvelt Coalition is a Periphery realm that formed on February 20, 3072 from worlds that seceded from the Federated Suns
column2: 菲尔特地联盟是一个外缘政权，于3072年2月20日由从联邦太阳分离的各行星建立

column1: Filtvelt Coalition
column2: 菲尔特维尔特联盟

column1: The Filtvelt Coalition is a Periphery realm that formed on February 20, 3072 from worlds that seceded from the Federated Suns.  When Sherwood was conquered by Tortugan pirates, the Coalition aided the Periphery March to counter the invasion.
column2: 菲尔特维尔特联盟是一个外围国度，于3072年2月20日由脱离恒星联邦的诸世界组建而成。当舍伍德星被托尔图加海盗攻占时，该联盟曾协助外围边疆区抵御入侵。

column1: Finmark Free Republic
column2: 芬马克自由共和国

column1: The Finmark Free Republic was a rising periphery power that became another casualty of the First Succession War.

\nBetween 2779 and 2782 Finmark created a government modeled on the early Rim Worlds system and managed to pull together a defense force comprised largely of fresh recruits and orphaned elements of the SLDF and the former Rim Worlds Army; these forces mustered a strength of almost two BattleMech regiments, a similar number of aerospace fighters, and enough armor and infantry units for each world in the Republic to have approximately two regiments of mixed armor and infantry each.

\nFinmark's influence continued to grow, with systems as far away as Inner Surge and Port Vail receiving some form of defensive support from Finmark by the late 2780s as the government worked on rebuilding as much of the former Finmark Province as possible; the government also worked to restore the orbital shipyards above Finmark, with the shipyards nearing fully operational status by the late 2780s. Unfortunately for the nascent interstellar state - and particularly the inhabitants of Finmark - the increasing savagery of the First Succession War combined with Finmark's growing strength attracted predatory attention from the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2:
芬马克自由共和国曾是一个崛起中的外缘势力，后来成为第一次继承战争的又一牺牲品。

在2779至2782年间，芬马克建立了一个仿效早期边缘世界体制的政府，并设法拼凑起一支国防力量，主要由新兵以及SLDF和前边缘世界陆军的孤儿部队组成；这些部队集结起将近两个战斗机甲团的兵力、数量相当的航空战机，以及足以让共和国每颗行星各拥有约两个混编装甲与步兵团规模的装甲与步兵单位。

芬马克的影响力持续增长：到2780年代末，连内浪和维尔港这样遥远的星系也在接受芬马克某种形式的防御支援，政府则致力于尽可能重建前芬马克省的版图；政府还着手修复芬马克上方的轨道船坞，到2780年代末这些船坞已接近全面运转状态。对这位初生的星际国家——尤其是芬马克的居民——而言不幸的是，第一次继承战争日益加剧的残酷加上芬马克不断增强的实力，招来了莱兰联邦的掠食性关注。

column1: The Fronc Reaches is a small Periphery state located in the Capellan Marches rimward of the Capellan Confederation, spinward of the Magistracy of Canopus, and anti-spinward of the Taurian Concordat. The Fronc Reaches formed from worlds jointly colonized by the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat, formerly known as the New Colony Region.
column2: 弗朗克边疆是卡佩兰边疆区里的一个小型外缘国家，位于卡佩兰联邦的核心方向、卡诺帕治安官辖区的旋臂方向、陶里安协约国的反旋臂方向。弗朗克边疆由卡诺帕治安官辖区与陶里安协约国共同殖民的世界组成，此前被称为新殖民地地区。

column1: Fronc Reaches
column2: 弗朗克边域

column1: The Fronc Reaches is a small Periphery state located in the Capellan Marches rimward of the Capellan Confederation, spinward of the Magistracy of Canopus, and anti-spinward of the Taurian Concordat. The Fronc Reaches formed from worlds jointly colonized by the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat, formerly known as the New Colony Region. From 3135, trade negotiations were opened with both the Capellan Confederation and the Magistracy of Canopus, with both markets eager for military equipment manufactured by the Reaches.
column2: 弗朗克边域是一个小型外围国家，位于卡佩拉边疆区，地处卡佩拉联邦的缘向方向、船底自治区的自旋方向，以及金牛协约国的逆自旋方向。弗朗克边域由船底自治区与金牛协约国共同殖民的星球组建而成，这些星球前称为新殖民地星区。自3135年起，弗朗克边域与卡佩拉联邦及船底自治区开启了贸易谈判，这两个市场都对其制造的军事装备翘首以待。

column1: Galatean League
column2: 加拉蒂亚联盟

column1: The Galatean League emerged as a formal entity on December 24, 3144, following the successful defense of Galatea against an invasion by Clan Jade Falcon. Originally a loose coalition of mercenary commands led by Hansen's Roughriders, the League was established to safeguard Galatea and its neighboring worlds from future Clan advances. Envoys from the League extended invitations to Menkent, Mizar, and Syrma, securing the allegiance of Syrma and Mizar in 3145, though Menkent chose to align with the Jade Falcons. Alcor later joined the League as well. Despite Mizar's withdrawal in 3149, the League maintained a protective presence there, highlighting its commitment to regional stability. The Galatean League represents a bastion of independence and mercenary cooperation in the fractured Inner Sphere of the 32nd century.
column2: 加拉提亚联盟于3144年12月24日正式成立，此前加拉提亚成功抵御了玉猫部族的入侵。该联盟最初是由汉森猛骑兵领导的雇佣兵部队松散联盟，成立目的是保护加拉提亚及其邻近世界免受部族未来的推进。联盟使节向门肯特、米扎尔与西尔玛发出邀请，并在3145年获得西尔玛与米扎尔的效忠，但门肯特选择与玉猫结盟。阿尔科尔后来也加入了联盟。尽管米扎尔于3149年退出，联盟仍在那里维持保护性存在，体现出其对区域稳定的承诺。在32世纪四分五裂的内层星域中，加拉提亚联盟代表着独立与雇佣兵合作的堡垒。

column1: An amalgamation of the Free Rasalhague Republic and Clan Ghost Bear, the Rasalhague Dominion is a blend of the political, military and cultural styles of Inner Sphere and Clan societies. Founded in 3060 as the Ghost Bear Dominion the new state was isolationist by inclination, only waging war against the Draconis Combine and Word of Blake due to external factors
column2: 拉萨尔哈格自治领是自由拉萨尔哈格共和国与幽灵熊氏族的融合体，混合了内天体与氏族社会的政治、军事与文化风格。它于3060年作为幽灵熊自治领建立，这个新国家在倾向上是孤立主义的，只因外部因素才对龙尼斯联合体与布雷克之言发动战争

column1: Ghost Bear Dominion
column2: 鬼熊 Dominion

column1: Green Ghosts
column2: 绿幽灵

column1: The so-called Green Ghosts are an enigmatic and highly unusual warband. They began raiding the Lyran (coreward and anti-spinward) periphery border, i.e. the general area of the former Rim Worlds Republic, in 3060 and continued their operations at least through 3089.
column2: 所谓绿幽灵是一支神秘而极不寻常的作战团体。他们于3060年开始劫掠莱兰（核心方向与反旋臂方向）外缘边界，即前边缘世界共和国的大致区域，其行动至少持续到3089年。

column1: The Hanseatic League is a mercantile faction located in the Deep Periphery.  Mercenaries are welcome, and the overall technological level of their defence forces is equal to any faction in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 汉萨同盟是一个位于深远外缘的商业派系。雇佣兵在此受欢迎，其防御部队的整体技术水平与内天体任何派系相当。

column1: The Havens
column2: 庇护之地

column1: The Havens is a proto-state in the BattleTech universe, comprising systems such as Porthos and Santander.  Emerging after the Ferris Rebellion when the Ghost Bears opted to return Santander and Porthos to the inheritors, The Havens is known for its strategic positioning and the unique challenges it presents to neighboring factions.
column2: 庇护之地是BattleTech宇宙中的一个原型国家，辖有波托斯和桑坦德等星系。在费里斯叛乱之后，幽灵熊氏族选择将桑坦德和波托斯归还其继承者，庇护之地便由此兴起，以其战略位置及对邻近势力构成的独特挑战而闻名。

column1: The Illyrian Palatinate was founded in the mid 24th century by groups of Scandinavian colonists, however it currently faces pressure from both the Circinus Federation and the Marian Hegemony.
column2: 伊利里亚帕拉丁领由斯堪的纳维亚殖民者群体于24世纪中期建立，但如今它同时面临切尔西努斯联邦与马里亚纳霸权的压力。

column1: Illyrian Palatinate
column2: 伊利里亚边区

column1: The St. Ives Compact was a minor Inner Sphere nation that existed from 3029 to 3063.
column2: 圣艾夫斯共同体是一个存在于 3029 至 3063 年的内天体小国。

column1: St. Ives Compact
column2: 圣艾夫斯 Compact

column1: The JarnFolk (literally 'Iron People') are a society of deep Periphery denizens residing approximately 250 light years spinward of Columbus.  They live a primarily agrarian lifestyle.
column2: 雅恩福克人（字面意为"铁人"）是一个深远外缘居民社会，居住在哥伦布旋臂方向约250光年处。他们主要过着农耕生活。

column1: In 3071, Devlin Stone escaped from a Word of Blake reeducation camp on Kittery - RBMU 105 - in the company of Professor David Lear. Together, they organized a local resistance against Word of Blake forces that was finally able to destroy the Blakist organization on Kittery by the end of that year. By 3072, Stone led a force that liberated a number of nearby worlds from the grip of the Jihad. These worlds eventually joined to form Kittery Prefecture.

\nWhen word started spreading about this group of planets that were being liberated from the control of the Blakists, Victor Steiner-Davion believed that this idea of a prefecture was the work of a bandit-king looking to create their own power within the Inner Sphere. In October of 3073, Victor and Stone met on of Tukayyid, where Devlin told him what he was doing and how he was going to do it. Victor had to decide whether he was going to stop Stone or get out of his way. Victor decided to get out of his way, to let Stone restructure the Inner Sphere to allow for peace. Victor knew that society was going to collapse because of the Word of Blake attacks, and restructuring the way society had worked for hundreds of years was the only way to bring peace to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 3071年，德夫林·斯通在教授大卫·李尔的陪同下，从基特里（RBMU 105）的布莱克之词再教育营逃脱。两人共同组织当地抵抗力量对抗布莱克之词部队，最终在那年年底摧毁了基特里的布莱克派组织。到3072年，斯通率领一支部队从圣战魔掌中解放了附近若干星球，这些星球最终联合成立基特里辖区。\n\n当关于这批被解放星球的传言开始扩散时，维克多·施泰纳-戴维恩认为“辖区”这一构想是某个匪盗之王想在内层星域内建立自己势力的产物。3073年10月，维克多与斯通在图卡伊迪会面，德夫林向他说明自己在做什么、以及打算怎么做。维克多必须决定是阻止斯通，还是给他让路。维克多决定让路，让斯通重塑内层星域以谋求和平。维克多明白，布莱克之词的攻击将导致社会崩溃，而重塑这套运行了数百年的社会方式，是给内层星域带来和平的唯一途径。

column1: Your performance was an embarrassment, Commander. The Draconis Combine expects more of their mercenaries. Keep this up, and we may not offer you any contracts at all!
column2: 指挥官，你的表现令人难堪. 天龙联合体对他们的佣兵期待更大. 如果你继续保持这种状态，那我们可能根本不会给你任何合约!

column1: The Draconis Combine is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located coreward and spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Kurita, the Combine has always been aggressively expansionist—the head of the Combine was the first of the Council Lords to declare himself the new ruler of the collapsing Star League. Regularly in conflicts along its borders with all its neighbors, the Combine is a highly structured, militaristic society, with rulership in the hands of the Coordinator, the commander-in-chief of the Draconis military. The Combine's culture is heavily influenced by the Japanese roots of the ruling family—despite the minority status of those with Japanese ancestry—as this cultural heritage is imposed from above by the predominantly Japanese ruling class. The current leader of the Combine is Coordinator Takashi Kurita.
column2: 龙脉联合体是星际联盟五个继承国之一，位于地球朝核心与朝旋臂方向的一侧。它由 Kurita 家族统治，历来极具扩张性——联合体的首领是议会领主中第一个自立为崩溃中的星际联盟新统治者的人。联合体与其所有邻国的边境上冲突不断，是一个高度结构化、军事化的社会，统治权掌握在协调官手中，他同时也是龙脉军队的总司令。联合体的文化深受统治家族日本血统的影响——尽管具日本血统者实为少数——因为这一文化传统是由以日本人为主的统治阶层自上而下强加的。联合体现任领袖是协调官 Takashi Kurita。

column1: While your retreat would be grounds for censure in one of our soldiers, we understand that a mercenary life is more… complicated. We hope it will not become a habit, however.
column2: 虽然你的撤退若发生在我们自己的士兵身上会招致谴责，但我们理解雇佣兵的生活更为……复杂。不过我们希望这不会成为习惯。

column1: The Draconis Combine is pleased with your fervor, Commander. Your skills in battle are precisely the sort that young cadets could learn from.
column2: 天龙联合体对你的热忱表示赞赏，指挥官. 你的作战技艺正是年轻的军校生可以学习的典范.

column1: the Draconis Combine
column2: 天龙联合体

column1: The Draconis Combine is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located coreward and spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Kurita, the Combine has always been aggressively expansionist—the head of the Combine was the first of the Council Lords to declare himself the new ruler of the collapsing Star League. Regularly in conflicts along its borders with all its neighbors, the Combine is a highly structured, militaristic society, with rulership in the hands of the Coordinator, the commander-in-chief of the Draconis military. The Combine's culture is heavily influenced by the Japanese roots of the ruling family—despite the minority status of those with Japanese ancestry—as this cultural heritage is imposed from above by the predominantly Japanese ruling class. The current leader of the Combine is Coordinator Takashi Kurita.  By 3152, the Combine would have numerous Heavy Aerospace and Major Defense industries under it's control.
column2: 龙尼斯联合体是星盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的核心方向与旋臂方向。由栗田家族统治的联合体一直极具扩张主义色彩——联合体首脑是议会领主中第一个自封为崩塌中的星盟新统治者的人。联合体与其所有邻国的边界上经常发生冲突，是一个高度结构化、军事化的社会，统治权掌握在协调官手中——他是龙尼斯军队的总司令。联合体的文化深受统治家族日本根源的影响——尽管有日本血统者只占少数——因为这一文化遗产是由以日本人为主的统治阶级自上而下强加的。联合体现任领袖是协调官栗田隆。到3152年，联合体将拥有众多重型航空与主要国防工业归其掌控。

column1: If you cannot accomplish the missions we lay before you, Commander, we will find another mercenary who can! Consider this a warning to perform better—or be replaced.
column2: 指挥官，如果你无法完成我们交给你的任务，我们会另找一位能完成的雇佣兵！把这当作一次警告：要么干得更好，要么被替换。

column1: The Capellan Confederation is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward of Terra. Ruled by House Liao, the Confederation is the smallest and newest of the Successor States and often the loser in conflicts against the other powers of the Inner Sphere. It is an authoritarian police state, with philosophical origins in a text known as the Korvin Doctrine, which argues for total subservience of the individual to the state. Citizens of the Confederation must earn their position and the benefits of citizenship through service to their community. The current ruler of the Confederation is Chancellor Maximilian Liao, a shrewd planner and master manipulator.
column2: 卡佩拉联邦是星际联盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的(银河)缘向(即南方). 廖氏家族统治的卡佩拉联邦是继承国中最小和最年轻的国家，在与内天体其它强国的冲突中常常处于不利地位. 这是个专制的警察国家，其哲学基础源于名为《科尔文主义》的理论，该理论主张个体应完全服从国家. 联邦公民必须通过为社区服务来赢得地位和公民权的福利. 联邦现任统治者总理大臣马克西米利安·廖是一位精明的策划者和操纵大师.

column1: Loss on the battlefield is not always failure. Losses teach us to improve and better ourselves. You fought well, Commander, even if you did not prevail. Learn from this lesson and do better next time.
column2: 在战场上失利并不完全意味着失败. 失利教会我们改善和提升自己. 你打得不错，指挥官，即使你没有取得胜利. 引以为戒，在下次任务中做得更好.

column1: House Liao has always believed in one thing, Commander: victory at any cost. It seems you also understand this vital lesson. We are pleased you've performed so well.
column2: 指挥官，廖家始终信奉一件事：不惜一切代价取胜。看来你也深谙这一要义。我们对你的出色表现很满意。

column1: the Capellan Confederation
column2: 卡佩拉联邦

column1: The Capellan Confederation is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward of Terra. Ruled by House Liao, the Confederation is the smallest and newest of the Successor States and often the loser in conflicts against the other powers of the Inner Sphere. It is an authoritarian police state, with philosophical origins in a text known as the Korvin Doctrine, which argues for total subservience of the individual to the state. Citizens of the Confederation must earn their position and the benefits of citizenship through service to their community. The current ruler of the Confederation is Chancellor Daoshen (Centrella-) Liao.  By 3152, the Capellan Confederation would control numerous Major Defense Industries.
column2: 卡佩拉联邦是星际联盟的五大继承国之一，位于地球的缘向方向。由廖氏家族统治的联邦是继承国中面积最小、建立最晚的一个，在与内天体其他势力的冲突中常常处于不利地位。这是个专制的警察国家，其哲学根源可追溯至一部名为《科尔文主义》的理论，该理论主张个人对国家的绝对服从。联邦公民必须通过为社群服务来赢得自身地位和公民权益。联邦当前的统治者是总理大臣达奥申·（琴特雷拉-）廖。到3152年，卡佩拉联邦已控制了众多大型国防工业。

column1: For somebody who came so highly recommended, you let us down pretty hard. Thanks for nothing, I guess.
column2: 对于一个被强烈推荐的人来说，你却让我们很失望. 算我自讨没趣，我猜.

column1: Local Government
column2: 当地政府

column1: This world is independently ruled by a planetary government, unaffiliated with any of the interstellar states of the Inner Sphere or the Periphery.
column2: 这个星球由当地政府独立统治，不属于内天体或外围的任何跨星际国家.

column1: You win some, you lose some. Sometimes it's in between. I'm disappointed you couldn't complete the contract, but at least you gave it your best shot.
column2: 有输有赢。有时介于两者之间。我很失望你没能完成合同，但至少你尽力了。

column1: Well done, Commander. We obviously placed our faith in the right mercenary company. We'll let you know if we have any other work for you.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我们显然把信任交给了正确的佣兵团。如果还有活我们通知你。

column1: Lothian League

column1: The Lothian League was a small Periphery realm composed by six ice-and-snow planets located beyond the outer reaches of the Free Worlds League near the Marian Hegemony.  After decades of conflict and unrest with the Marian Hegemony, the Lothian League officially gained its independence in 3128 and resembled little of the free state that existed a century before.  The League is currently ruled by Grand Mistress Clarissa Logan.
column2: 洛锡安联盟是一个小型外围国度，由六颗冰雪星球组成，位于自由世界联盟外缘之外，靠近马里安霸权。在与马里安霸权经历了数十年的冲突与动荡后，洛锡安联盟于3128年正式获得独立，但此时它已与一个世纪前那个自由国家的样貌相去甚远。该联盟目前由大女宗主克拉丽莎·洛根统治。

column1: Understand that we hired you with an expectation of - if not success - at least decent effort. You've shown neither, and I'm going to ensure my superiors hear about it, Commander.
column2: 希望你能明白，我们雇你时，期待的是——就算不能成功——至少也得有像样的努力。你两者都没做到，而我会确保我的上级知道这件事，指挥官。

column1: Lady Centrella represents The Magistracy of Canopus, a large Periphery state, located rimwards and anti-spinwards of Terra, just beyond the Free Worlds League. Founded explicitly as a matriarchy, the Magistracy is ruled by a Magestrix, a position open only to women, and usually held by a member of the founding Centrella family. Independent since the fall of the Star League, the Magistracy has remained mostly untouched by the Succession Wars, except by the overall collapse of trade and travel. The Magistracy is famed for its social and cultural freedom, with no consensual behavior forbidden by law or custom. The current ruler of the Magistracy is the Magestrix Kyalla Centrella, who harbors a deep grudge against the Inner Sphere, and the Free Worlds League in particular.
column2: 琴特雷拉女士代表了船底自治区，这是个较大的外围国家，位于地球的银河缘向(南方)和反旋向(西方)，就在自由世界联盟下方. 船底自治区明确作为母系社会创立，由女导师统治，这一职位仅向女性开放，通常由创始家族琴特雷拉家族成员把持. 自治区在星际联盟消亡后独立，除了贸易和航行的全面崩溃外，自治区大体上并未受到继承战争的波及. 自治区以其社会与文化上的自由，自愿行为不受法律或习俗禁止而闻名，自治区现任统治者女导师基娅拉·琴特雷拉，对内天体，特别是自由世界联盟报以极深的敌意.

column1: Despite your failure, I'll ensure that high command understands that you fought as hard as you were able. There's always next time, Commander.
column2: 尽管你失败了，我会确保最高指挥部明白你已经竭尽全力作战。总还有下一次，指挥官。

column1: Your performance was exemplary, Commander. I'll be certain to ensure the upper echelons of Magistracy high command hear about your skills.
column2: 你的表现堪称典范，指挥官。我一定会确保治安官辖区最高指挥部的上层听到你的本领。

Founded explicitly as a matriarchy, the Magistracy is ruled by a Magestrix, a position open only to women, and usually held by a member of the founding Centrella family. Independent since the fall of the Star League, the Magistracy has remained mostly untouched by the Succession Wars, except by the overall collapse of trade and travel. The Magistracy is famed for its social and cultural freedom, with no consensual behavior forbidden by law or custom. The current ruler of the Magistracy is the Magestrix Kyalla Centrella, who harbors a deep grudge against the Inner Sphere, and the Free Worlds League in particular.
column2: 船底自治区是个大型外围国家，位于地球的(银河)缘向(即南方)和反旋向(即西方)，紧邻自由世界联盟. 船底自治区明确建立为母系社会，由女导师统治，这一职位仅向女性开放，通常由创始家族琴特雷拉家族的成员把持. 自治区在星际联盟消亡后保持了相对独立，虽然受到贸易和航行全面衰退的影响，但几乎未被继承战争波及. 自治区以其社会和文化自由而闻名，法律与习俗不禁止任何自愿行为. 自治区现任统治者为女导师凯亚拉·琴特雷拉，她对内天体，尤其是自由世界联盟怀有极深的怨恨.

column1: Despite your failure, I'll make sure that high command understands you fought as hard as you were able. There's always next time, Commander.
column2: 尽管你失败了，我会确保最高指挥部明白你已尽全力作战。总还有下次，指挥官。

column1: Your performance was exemplary, Commander. I'll ensure that the Magistracy high command hears about your skills.
column2: 你的表现堪称典范，指挥官。我会确保法域最高指挥部知道你的本事。

column2: 威严金属与制造公司

column1: The Marian Hegemony is an expansionist periphery faction who's government and military are based on the ancient Terran Roman Empire.
column2: 马里安霸权是一个扩张主义外围区势力，其政府与军队以古代泰拉罗马帝国为蓝本。

column1: Marian Hegemony
column2: 马里安霸权

column1: the Hegemony
column2: 霸权

column1: The Marian Hegemony is a major Periphery state rimward and anti-spinward of Terra, beyond the Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey and Rim Commonality. The monarchist republican nation bears resemblance to the ancient Roman Empire with its national symbol being the bust of an armored Roman warrior against a tan banner that bears the name 'Marian Hegemony' in English at its center and the Latin words 'Pax' (Peace) and 'Mortis' (of Death) on its opposite ends.
column2: 马里安霸权是地球核心方向、反旋臂方向的一个主要外缘国家，位于塔马林德-阿比公国与边缘共同体的更远处。这个君主共和制国家与古罗马帝国相似，其国徽是一名装甲罗马战士的胸像，衬以浅褐色旗帜，旗帜中央用英文写着"马里安霸权"，两端则是拉丁文"Pax"（和平）与"Mortis"（死亡）。

column1: The Free Worlds League is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward and anti-spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Marik, the League was, with the Capellan Confederation, one of the original signatories of the treaties that would eventually form the Star League. After the fall of the Star League, the Free Worlds League granted broad control over its economy and government to the commander of its military, the Captain-General. The League is known for being a powerful mercantile state, but the Succession Wars have nearly destroyed its economy. The current ruler of the League is Captain-General Janos Marik.
column2: 自由世界联盟是星际联盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的(银河)缘向(即南方)和反旋向(即西方). 马里克家族统治的联盟和卡佩拉联邦一样，都是最早签署建立星际联盟条约的成员国之一. 在星际联盟崩溃后，自由世界联盟将经济和政府的广泛控制权交给了军队的最高指挥官——总司令. 联盟以强大的商业实力著称，但继承战争几乎摧毁了它的经济. 联盟现任统治者是总司令亚诺斯·马里克.

column1: The Free Worlds League understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 自由世界联盟明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了可贵的努力，即便最终失败。这不过是下一场战斗的又一课。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Marik is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 顶级表现，指挥官——马里克家族对你的成绩非常满意。继续保持，我会确保更多活找上你。

column1: the Free Worlds League
column2: 自由世界联盟

column1: The Free Worlds League is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward and anti-spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Marik, the League was, with the Capellan Confederation, one of the original signatories of the treaties that would eventually form the Star League. After the fall of the Star League, the Free Worlds League granted broad control over its economy and government to the commander of its military, the Captain-General. The League is known for being a powerful mercantile state, but the Succession Wars have nearly destroyed its economy. In 3148, the reborn League faced invasions from the Marian Hegemony, Regulan Fiefs, and Duchy of Andurien, managing to defeat them all and invade the Regulan Fiefs. The state surrendered to the Free Worlds League following an invasion that was sparked by the assassination of Jessica Marik. The Regulan Fiefs were granted provisional status within the League for a period of ten years, after which they would be allowed to request full membership.  The current ruler of the League is Captain-General Nikol Marik.
column2: 自由世界联盟是星际联盟的五大继承国之一，位于地球的缘向与逆自旋方向。由马里克家族统治的联盟，曾与卡佩拉联邦一道，是最终促成星际联盟成立条约的最初签署方。星际联盟崩溃后，自由世界联盟将其经济与政府的广泛控制权授予了其军队统帅，即总司令。联盟素以强大的商业国家著称，但继承战争几乎摧毁了其经济。3148年，重生的联盟面临来自马里安霸权、雷古兰领地和安杜瑞恩公国的入侵，并成功将其全部击败，随后入侵了雷古兰领地。在杰西卡·马里克遇刺所引发的入侵之后，该国向自由世界联盟投降。雷古兰领地获准在联盟内享有为期十年的临时地位，期满后可申请成为正式成员。联盟当前的统治者是总司令妮可·马里克。

column1: The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth was one of the successor states to the late Free Worlds League. The nation constitutes the core of what was once the League, including the capital of Atreus.
column2: 马里克-斯图尔特联邦是已故自由世界联盟的继承国之一。这个国家构成了昔日联盟的核心，包括首都阿特柔斯。

column1: The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 马里克-斯图尔特联邦明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——马里克-斯图尔特联邦对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Mercenary Review Board was founded by ComStar to allow ComStar agents to serve as brokers for mercenary companies seeking work.
column2: 雇佣兵评审委员会是由通讯之星创办的，目的是让通讯之星的代理人为寻求工作的雇佣兵公司充当经纪人.

column2: 雇佣兵评审委员会

column1: the MRB
column2: 佣兵评委会

column1: Minnesota Tribe
column2: 明尼苏达部落

column1: Far be it for a simple organization like Comstar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, but… Your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
column2: 像康星这样简单的组织本不该在战争事务上责备你，指挥官，但是……你在那次行动中的表现简直糟糕透顶。我们严厉谴责你的无能。

column1: The Star League Defense Force (SLDF) was the largest military force in human history, with over 100 million soldiers serving in 486 divisions at its peak. The SLDF suffered horrific losses opposing Stefan Amaris in the Amaris Civil War.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军(SLDF)是人类历史上规模最大的军队，在鼎盛时期有超过1亿的士兵在486个师服役. 在阿玛里斯内战中，SLDF因对抗斯蒂芬·阿玛里斯而蒙受了惨重的损失.

column1: Nautilus Base Defenses
column2: 鹦鹉螺基地防御力量

column1: The New Oberon Confederation emerged in 3086 following the withdrawal of Clan Hell's Horses from the Periphery. Centered on Oberon VI, the Confederation reestablished its independence under local administrators who took control after the Clan's departure. With assistance from Clan Ghost Bear technicians, they refurbished Grimfort — a fortress originally built by Hendrik Grimm — transforming it into a modern Castle Brian to bolster their defenses.
column2: 新奥伯龙邦联在3086年地狱马氏族撤出外缘之后出现。它以奥伯龙VI为中心，在该氏族离开后由接管的当地管理者重建独立。在幽灵熊氏族技师的协助下，他们翻新了格林堡——一座最初由享德里克·格林建造的堡垒——把它改造成现代化的布莱恩堡以加强防御。

column1: New Oberon Confederation
column2: 新奥伯龙邦联

column1: This world has been abandoned, and only a remnant population exists here, with no real government.
column2: 这颗星球已经被遗弃，在这里只有少量的剩余人口，也没有一个真正意义上的政府.

column1: The Oberon Confederation is quite simply a bandit state, veiled in a thin veneer of legitimacy.  Piracy and slavery is still rampant, although Hendrick Grimm III has made steps to push such things out of the public eye.
column2: 奥伯龙邦联简直就是一个匪盗国家，只是披着一层薄薄的合法性外衣。海盗与奴役依然猖决，尽管享德里克·格林三世已采取一些措施把这类勾当从公众视野中推开。

column1: Oberon Confederation
column2: 奥伯龙邦联

column1: The Oriente Protectorate was founded in 3086, after the dissolution of the Free Worlds League. Descended from one of the original founding states of the League, the Oriente Protectorate is a fusion of the Grand Duchy of Oriente, the Protectorate, and the Duchy of Orloff. Oriente is theoretically a representative government, but it operates under military rule, much like the Free Worlds League after the fall of the Star League.
column2: 奥连特保护国成立于3086年，即自由世界联盟解体之后。作为联盟最初创始国之一的后裔，奥连特保护国是奥连特大公国、保护国与奥洛夫公国的融合体。奥连特理论上是代议制政府，却依军事管制运作，很像星际联盟崩溃后的自由世界联盟。

column1: The Oriente Protectorate understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 奥连特保护国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Since the beginning of the 31st century, the situation in the Outworlds Alliance has become particularly grim. With the general loss of technology, Alliance worlds have suffered from declining population and literacy levels.
column2: 自 31 世纪初以来，外域联盟的处境变得格外严峻。随着技术的普遍流失，联盟各世界的人口与识字率不断下滑。

column1: Outworld Alliance
column2: 外域联盟

column1: The Ragnarök Union is a microstate in the Barrens region, established in July 3084. It comprises three worlds—Götterdämmerung, Botany Bay, and Last Chance—which were formerly part of the Greater Valkyrate. Under the leadership of Hu Xiao Lin, who maintained her position since before the Clan Invasion, the Union achieved self-sufficiency by leveraging historical ties with Lackhove and Erewhon to access advanced technology. By 3095, the Union operated a cluster of tanks acquired from Clan Jade Falcon; however, efforts to secure training at the Falcon's military academy on Somerset had not yet succeeded.
column2: 诸神黄昏联盟是荒原地区的一个微型国家，建立于3084年7月。它由三颗行星组成——诸神黄昏、植物学湾和最后机会——它们原本是大瓦尔基里特的一部分。在胡晓琳的领导下（她在氏族入侵之前就一直保持这一地位），该联盟通过利用与拉克霍夫和埃瑞黄的历史纽带获取先进技术，实现了自给自足。到3095年，联盟拥有一批从翡翠猎鹰氏族获得的坦克；不过，在萨默塞特的猎鹰军事学院争取训练的努力尚未成功。

column1: Ragnarök Union
column2: 诸神黄昏联盟

column1: The Free Rasalhague Republic was a nation born in the wake of the Fourth Succession War, which enjoyed less than two decades of independence before finding themselves directly in the path of the Clan invasion.
column2: 自由蛇夫座共和国是在第四次继承战争之后诞生的国家，享有独立不到二十年，便发现自己正处在氏族入侵的必经之路上.

column1: Free Rasalhague Republic
column2: 自由蛇夫座共和国

column1: The Rasalhague Dominion is a unique hybrid political entity that emerged in the late 31st century from the unification of Clan Ghost Bear and the Free Rasalhague Republic. Combining the rigid structure and traditions of the Clans with the democratic ideals of the Republic, the Dominion has created a balanced and innovative society. Centered around Skandia and Alshain, it maintains strong military capabilities under the tenets of Clan Ghost Bear's warrior caste, while fostering economic growth and civilian governance through the influence of its Rasalhagian citizens. The Dominion is defined by its emphasis on cooperation and unity, ensuring its people thrive within a structure that respects both cultural heritage and martial strength.
column2: 拉萨尔哈格自治领是一个独特的混合政治实体，于三十一世纪末由幽灵熊氏族与自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的统一而形成。自治领把氏族严整的结构与传统同共和国的民主理想结合起来，创造出一个平衡而创新的社会。它以斯坎迪亚和阿尔沙因为中心，在幽灵熊氏族战士种姓的信条下维持强大的军事能力，同时通过其拉萨尔哈格公民的影响促进经济增长与文官治理。自治领的特征在于强调合作与团结，确保其人民在一个既尊重文化遗产又尊重军事实力的结构中繁荣。

column1: Rasalhague Dominion
column2: 蛇夫座自治领

column1: Raven Alliance
column2: 渡鸦同盟

column1: After Clan Snow Raven lost their holdings and was abjured from Clan Space during the Wars of Reaving, they would seek refuge with their allies in the Outworlds Alliance. Seeing the similarities and benefits between both factions, they would bore a fruitful relationship that would result in the merging of the Raven Alliance after the Jihad ended.
column2: 雪鸦部族在“掠夺战争”中失去领地并被逐出部族空间后，前往外域联盟寻求盟友庇护。看到双方之间的相似与互利之处，他们建立起富有成果的关系，最终在圣战结束后合并为鸦联盟。

column1: After Clan Snow Raven lost their holdings and was abjured from Clan Space during the Wars of Reaving, they would seek refuge with their allies in the Outworlds Alliance. Seeing the similarities and benefits between both factions, they would bore a fruitful relationship that would result in the merging of the Raven Alliance after the Jihad ended. The Alliance's Khans, as members of the Council of Six, were invited to Terra in the aftermath of the ilClan Trial. The Ravens affirmed Alaric Ward as ilKhan, subordinating the Alliance to the new Star League.
column2: 在收割战争期间失去领地并被逐出氏族空间后，雪鸦氏族向他们在外域联盟的盟友寻求庇护。看到两个派系之间的相似性与共同利益，他们建立起富有成果的关系，最终在圣战结束后合并为渡鸦联盟。联盟的可汗们作为六人议会的成员，在伊尔氏族试炼之后受邀前往地球。渡鸦们确认阿拉里克·沃德为伊尔汗，使联盟从属于新星盟。

column1: The Principality of Regulus is one of the founding nations of the Free Worlds League. Following the dissolution of that confederation, the Regulan Fiefs was founded as the union of the Principality of Regulus, Regulan Free States, and the Principality of Gibson. It is led by the Cameron-Jones family from the city of Tunis on Regulus.
column2: 雷古鲁斯公国是自由世界联盟的创始国之一。该邦联解体后，雷古鲁斯封地作为雷古鲁斯公国、雷古鲁斯自由邦与吉布森公国的联合体而成立，由卡梅隆-琼斯家族从雷古鲁斯上的突尼斯城统治。

column1: The Regulan Fiefs understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 雷古兰封地明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Cameron-Jones is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——卡梅伦-琼斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Republic of the Sphere is the buffer state created in the wake of the Word of Blake Jihad. Keeping the peace in the heart of the Inner Sphere is no small task.
column2: 天球共和国是布雷克之言圣战之后创造的缓冲国。在内天体腹地维持和平绝非易事。

column1: Republic of the Sphere
column2: 球体共和国

column1: The Republic of the Barrens is a nascent proto-state formed in the aftermath of the Clan invasions, situated in the desolate and chaotic region known as the Barrens. Founded on principles of survival and resilience, it emerged as a loose confederation of worlds united by necessity rather than shared ideology. Its population, composed of scattered settlements and independent factions, relies heavily on resourcefulness and adaptability to thrive in the harsh and lawless environment. The Republic maintains a tenuous existence, balancing its efforts to establish governance with the constant threats of piracy, clan raiding parties, and internal dissent. While small and often overlooked by larger powers, the Republic symbolizes human perseverance in one of the Inner Sphere's most unforgiving territories.
column2: 荒原共和国是氏族入侵后形成的一个初生原始国家，坐落于被称为荒原的荒凉混乱地带。它以生存与坚韧为立国原则，是各行星出于必要而非共同意识形态结成的松散邦联。其人口由零散定居点与独立派系组成，高度依赖机智与适应力在这片严酷且无法无天的环境中求生。共和国维持着岌岌可危的存续，在建立治理的努力与海盗、氏族劫掠队和内部异议的持续威胁之间苦苦平衡。尽管弱小且常被更大的势力忽视，共和国象征着人类在内天体最不宽容的疆域之一的顽强。

column1: Republic of the Barrens
column2: 荒原共和国

column1: The Rim Collection is a minor nationstate founded by six planets that remembered the old Rim Worlds Republic, pre-Amaris, and wanted to recreate that dream. They are small, democratic, and pretty much harmless. Their military is composed of the mercenary group Able's Aces who have become national heroes for the Collection.
column2: 边缘集团是一个由六颗行星建立的小国，这些行星记得阿马里斯之前那个旧的边缘世界共和国，想要重现那个梦想。他们规模小、实行民主，基本无害。其军队由雇佣兵团体"艾布尔王牌"组成，后者已成为边缘集团的民族英雄。

column1: Rim Commonality
column2: 边缘共同圈

column1: During the Jihad, the Rim Commonality declared independence from the League on the 13th of April 3075 The Rim Commonality cited the historic Camlann versus Free Worlds ruling as precedent, barring entry to all high-ranking Free Worlds League representatives and breaking away from the League.
column2: 在圣战期间，边缘共同体于3075年4月13日宣布脱离联盟独立。边缘共同体援引卡姆兰诉自由世界案的裁决为先例，禁止所有自由世界联盟高级代表入境，并脱离联盟。

column1: The Rim Commonality understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 边缘共同体明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Commonality is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——共同体对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Rim Territories is a proto-state officially presented as a mutual defense and trade pact. In truth, it operates as a loose collective of pirate groups, with each world functioning as a criminal fiefdom under the control of its dominant gang or raiding clan. Governed from the capital world of Pain, the Rim Territories thrives on illicit trade, plunder, and under-the-table alliances, while maintaining a thin veneer of legitimacy to negotiate with other factions. This pragmatic and ruthless structure allows the Rim Territories to survive and even profit amidst the chaos of the Inner Sphere.
column2: 边缘领是一个对外宣称为共同防御与贸易协定的原型国家。实际上，它是一个由海盗团体组成的松散集合体，每个星球都在其主宰帮派或劫掠氏族的控制下，如同一个个犯罪领地。边缘领以苦痛星为首都进行统治，其经济建立在非法贸易、劫掠和地下联盟之上，同时为了与其他势力交涉，它又维持着一层薄弱的合法性外衣。这种务实而冷酷的统治结构，使得边缘领得以在内天体的混乱中生存，甚至从中牟利。

column1: Rim Territories
column2: 边缘领

column1: The Rim Worlds Republic, 2250-2769, was born of Hector Worthington Rowe and his five-hundred-strong Theban Legion at the end of their own Second Exodus. Journeying for six years through the Dark Nebula, the men who would create the Republic were anti-Alliance veterans on the run aboard blackmailed JumpShips, plunder from slain garrisons, and a limited number of provisions and women they'd taken as slaves. Simply put - pirates.
column2: 边缘世界共和国（2250-2769）诞生于赫克托·沃辛顿·罗及其五百人底比斯军团在他们自己的第二次出走结束时。在暗星云中跋涉六年，这些将创建共和国的人是一群在逃的反联盟老兵，靠着被胁迫的跃迁舰、从被屠驻军缴获的战利品，以及数量有限的给养和他们掳为奴隶的女人。简单说——海盗。

column1: Rim Worlds Republic
column2: 边缘世界共和国

column1: Scorpion Empire
column2: 天蝎帝国

column1: The Scorpion Empire emerged from the remnants of Clan Goliath Scorpion and absorbed the assets of the shattered Clan Ice Hellion, establishing a new realm built on their shared histories and philosophies. Guided by the Scorpion Imperio, a unique governing body blending Clan traditions with the cultural influences of the Nueva Castile region, the Scorpion Empire seeks a balance between strength and cultural enrichment. Known for their esoteric outlook, the Empire reveres the mythical vision quests central to their Scorpion heritage while extending dominion across systems in the deep periphery.
column2: 天蝎帝国由残存的巨蝎氏族脱胎而来，并吸收了分崩离析的冰狱氏族遗产，在它们共同的历史与哲学基础上建立了一个新的国度。在天蝎皇廷——一个融合了氏族传统与新卡斯蒂利亚地区文化影响的独特治理机构——的指引下，天蝎帝国致力于在武力与文化积淀之间寻求平衡。该帝国以其深奥的世界观而闻名，尊崇其天蝎传承中核心的神圣幻视之旅，同时将统治权扩展至深空外围中的各个星系。

column1: The Enigmatic Shadow Divisions constituted some of the most fanatical military units in the Protectorate forces. By the end of the Jihad some of these units were still unaccounted for, are you sure you should be looking into this?
column2: 神秘的暗影师是保护国部队中最狂热的军事单位之一。圣战结束时，其中一些单位仍下落不明。你确定要查这件事吗？

column1: Star League
column2: 星际联盟

column1: The Star League Defense Force (SLDF) was the principal military force defending the Star League, a conglomeration of star systems within roughly 500 light years of Terra. At its height the SLDF was the largest military force known to man, composed of over 100 million soldiers organized into 486 divisions. The Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere after fighting the Amaris Civil War, when Stefan Amaris overthrew the ruling First Lord of the Star League, Richard Cameron. After a long series of bloody battles throughout the Star League, Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky ended the coup with the liberation of Terra and the execution of Amaris. However when no new First Lord could be agreed upon by the Great Houses the Star League was dissolved. Kerensky then led the surviving 113 divisions out beyond the Inner Sphere in Operation EXODUS, hoping to save the essence of the League from the internecine violence that was to come. The SLDF would return 300 years later as the Clans, a technologically superior military that invaded the Inner Sphere in 3049.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军（SLDF）是保卫星际联盟的主要军事力量，星际联盟是由泰拉周围约500光年内的星系组成的联合体. 在其鼎盛时期，SLDF是人类已知最庞大的军事力量，由超过1亿名士兵组成，编为486个师. 星际联盟防卫军在阿玛里斯内战之后离开了内天体——当时斯蒂芬·阿玛里斯推翻了星际联盟在任的第一领主理查德·卡梅伦. 在星际联盟全境经历了一系列漫长的血腥战斗后，总司令亚历山大·克伦斯基解放了泰拉并处决了阿玛里斯，从而终结了政变. 然而，由于各大国未能就新任第一领主达成一致，星际联盟随之解体. 克伦斯基随后带领剩余的113个师通过“大迁徙行动”离开内天体，希望将星际联盟的精髓从即将到来的内部冲突中拯救出来. 300年后，SLDF以氏族的身份归来——一支技术优势明显的军事力量，于3049年入侵了内天体.

column1: Star League Defense Force
column2: 星际联盟防卫军

column1: Alternately known as the Exodus Planetary Council, the so-called Star League-in Exile was a provisional government that oversaw the Pentagon and Kerensky Cluster worlds settled by the Exodus Fleet. The collapse of the Star League-in-Exile following the death of General Aleksandr Kerensky and the resulting Pentagon Civil War would trigger the formation of the Clans.

\nOn 24 August 2786, the Exodus Fleet arrived in the Pentagon Worlds. Five systems were found in close proximity to one another: Arcadia, Babylon, Circe, Dagda, and Eden. Landing began on each of the worlds by 17 September that year, and colonies began to take shape. Each world was either marginally habitable or had some dangerous pathogen native to it.

\nOf six million people, two million were SLDF personnel, a military far beyond what they would need or support. General Kerensky and General Aaron DeChavilier demobilized noncombat specialties and, for any combatants who wished to remain in uniform, held testing at every rank, reducing the SLDF to a half-million strong.

\nExploration of the nearby Kerensky Cluster began, and more habitable worlds were found. Strana Mechty and six other worlds were colonized in the Cluster, though the bulk of the population remained in the Pentagon Worlds. The infrastructure and manufacturing to support the new nation were established.  New Moscva on Eden was established as the new capital.
column2:
它也被称为出走行星议会，这个所谓的星盟流亡政权是一个临时政府，管辖着由出走舰队殖民的五角星系与克伦斯基星团诸世界。在亚历山大·克伦斯基将军去世后，星盟流亡政权的崩溃以及随之而来的五角内战，将触发氏族的形成。

2786年8月24日，出走舰队抵达五角星系。人们发现五个彼此邻近的星系：阿卡迪亚、巴比伦、喀耳刻、达格达和伊甸。当年9月17日起，各世界陆续开始着陆，殖民地开始成形。每颗行星要么勉强可居，要么有某种原生危险病原体。

在六百万人中，有两百万是SLDF人员——这支军队远超他们所需或所能供养。克伦斯基将军与亚伦·德沙维利耶将军复员了非战斗专业，而对任何希望继续穿军装的战斗人员，则在每个军衔层级进行测试，把SLDF削减到五十万人。

对附近克伦斯基星团的探索开始了，并发现了更多宜居世界。星团中殖民了斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂及其他六个世界，不过大部分人口仍留在五角星系。支撑这个新国家的基础设施与制造业建立起来。伊甸上的新莫斯科瓦被定为新首都。

column1: SLDF in Exile
column2: 流亡星盟防卫军

column1: The Society is a secret cabal of Clan Scientists spread across most of the homeworld clans; they are not pleased with the Warrior caste being in control.
column2: 协会是一个由氏族科学家组成的秘密结社，遍布大部分本土星系氏族；他们对战士种姓掌权感到不满。

column1: House Steiner has no place for cowards or failures, Commander. Ensure your future efforts are more robust, or the Lyran Commonwealth will be no friend to you.
column2: 指挥官，施泰纳家族没有胆小鬼或失败者的位置. 确保你未来的成绩更加强劲，不然天琴共同体不会同你交好.

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located coreward and anti-spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Steiner, the Commonwealth is the wealthiest of the five, with an entrenched and powerful noble class. The focus on pedigree and prestige among the nobility has often resulted in less-than-brilliant officers being elevated to high command, to the detriment of the Commonwealth's military strength. Much of the Commonwealth's success comes from the vast resources located within its borders. The current ruler of the Commonwealth is Archon Katrina Steiner, notable for her peace proposal that, in allying the Commonwealth with the Federated Suns, effectively ended the Third Succession War.
column2: 莱兰联邦是星盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的核心方向与反旋臂方向。由斯坦纳家族统治的莱兰联邦是五国中最富有的，拥有根深蒂固而强大的贵族阶层。贵族间对血统与声望的重视，常导致才具平庸的军官被提拔至高位，损害了联邦的军事实力。联邦的诸多成就大多来自其疆域内的庞大资源。联邦现任统治者是大公卡特里娜·斯坦纳，她以那份和平提案闻名——该提案使联邦与联邦太阳结盟，实际上终结了第三次继承战争。

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth didn't get where it is by accepting victory or defeat as inevitable, but by continuing to fight after a loss. I hope you'll do the same, Commander. While you were defeated, you acquitted yourself well.
column2: 莱兰联邦不是靠把胜利或失败视为必然才有今天的地位，而是靠在失败之后继续战斗。我希望你也能如此，指挥官。你虽然战败，但表现可圈可点。

column1: Large coffers pay for larger victories—and you have been instrumental in ensuring that our winning streak is intact. Excellent work, mercenary. House Steiner is pleased.
column2: 更大的金库换来更大的胜利——而你在确保我们连胜不败上起到了关键作用。干得漂亮，雇佣兵。施泰纳家族很满意。

column1: the Lyran Commonwealth
column2: 天琴共同体

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located coreward and anti-spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Steiner, the Commonwealth is the wealthiest of the five, with an entrenched and powerful noble class. The focus on pedigree and prestige among the nobility has often resulted in less-than-brilliant officers being elevated to high command, to the detriment of the Commonwealth's military strength. Much of the Commonwealth's success comes from the vast resources located within its borders.
column2: 莱兰联邦是星盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的核心方向与反旋臂方向。由斯坦纳家族统治的联邦是五国中最富有的，拥有根深蒂固而强大的贵族阶层。贵族间对血统与声望的重视，常导致才具平庸的军官被提拔至高位，损害了联邦的军事实力。联邦的诸多成就大多来自其疆域内的庞大资源。

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind was originally a province of the Free Worlds League. It seceded from the League during the Word of Blake Jihad, and would later combine with the Abbey District to form the Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey, an independent state.
column2: 塔马林德公国原本是自由世界联盟的一个省。它在布雷克之言圣战期间脱离联盟，后来与阿比区合并，成为独立国家塔马林德-阿比公国。

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 塔马林德-阿比公国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Duchy is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——公国对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: In 3151, Hauptmann-General Sarah Regis led the resurrection of the Tamar Pact, following the collapse of the Republic of the Sphere and the Lyran Commonwealth. Acting independently, she freed her homeworld, Arcturus, from Falcon rule and began a campaign to reclaim abandoned systems like Kelenfold, Borghese, and Blue Diamond. On August 13, 3151, she declared the rebirth of the Tamar Pact, renounced her LCAF rank, and appointed herself Governor-General. Despite internal dissent, Regis reorganized her forces into the Armed Forces of Tamar, bolstering them with loyalists, mercenaries, and advanced supplies from Clan Sea Fox and the Alyina Mercantile League. Early successes, including the capture of Kerensky's Vision, established the Pact's position, and with her family's wealth, strategic alliances, and a growing military, Regis transformed the Tamar Pact into a powerful and independent nation determined to restore its former territories and industrial might.
column2: 3151年，大统领将军莎拉·雷吉斯在天球共和国与莱兰联邦崩溃之后，领导了塔马条约的重生。她独立行动，从猎鹰的统治下解放了她的母星阿克图鲁斯，并开始一场收复凯伦福尔德、博尔盖塞和蓝钻等被废弃星系的战役。3151年8月13日，她宣布塔马条约重生，放弃LCAF的军衔，自任总督将军。尽管内部有异议，雷吉斯仍把她的部队重组为塔马武装力量，用效忠者、雇佣兵以及来自海狐氏族和阿莉娜商业联盟的先进补给加以充实。早期的成功——包括夺取克伦斯基之见——确立了条约的地位，凭借家族财富、战略同盟与不断壮大的军力，雷吉斯把塔马条约转变为一个强大而独立的国家，决心恢复其昔日的领土与工业实力。

column1: Tamar Pact
column2: 塔玛尔条约国

column1: The Taurian Concordat is one of the largest Periphery states, located rimward of Terra, beyond the Federated Suns. Founded and ruled by House Calderon, the Concordat prides itself on its independence, freedom, and stability. The Concordat is wealthy, well educated, and well armed for a Periphery state. The Taurians defend their independence fiercely against Inner Sphere aggression, particularly by the Federated Suns; they perceive House Davion's reputation as a protector of liberties as unwarranted and even hypocritical, and they have a long history of conflict with the much larger Successor State. The current ruler of the Concordat is Protector Thomas Calderon.
column2: 陶里安协约国是最大的外围地区国家之一，位于地球朝外围方向的一侧、联邦太阳国之外。协约国由卡尔德隆家族创建并统治，以其独立、自由与稳定为傲。就外围地区国家而言，协约国富庶、教育水平高且军备精良。陶里安人顽强捍卫自身独立，抵御内层星域的侵略，尤其是联邦太阳国的侵犯；他们认为戴维恩家族“自由守护者”的名声毫无根据，甚至虚伪，并且与这个强大得多的继承国有着悠久的冲突历史。协约国现任统治者是护国公托马斯·卡尔德隆。

column1: Good job, Commander. The Taurian Concordat thanks you for your service. It's always refreshing to deal with a true professional when one hires mercenaries.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。金牛座协约感谢你的效力。雇雇佣兵时能碰上真正的专业人士，总是让人耳目一新。

column1: The Taurian Concordat is one of the largest Periphery states, located rimward of Terra, beyond the Federated Suns. Founded and ruled by House Calderon, the Concordat prides itself on its independence, freedom, and stability. The Concordat is wealthy, well educated, and well armed for a Periphery state. The Taurians defend their independence fiercely against Inner Sphere aggression, particularly by the Federated Suns; they perceive House Davion's reputation as a protector of liberties as unwarranted and even hypocritical, and they have a long history of conflict with the much larger Successor State. 3147 would see the proposed marriage of Kaff Doru's son and Sam Calderon's daughter in 3157, which would reunify them as one nation again.  Until then, the two nations would expand their trade relations and engage in mutual defense operations.  The current ruler of the Concordat is Protector Kaff Doru.
column2: 金牛座协约是最大的外围国家之一，位于地球边缘方向、联邦太阳国之外。它由卡尔德隆家族创建并统治，以独立、自由与稳定为傲。作为外围国家，协约富裕、教育良好、武装精良。金牛座人激烈捍卫自身独立以对抗内层星域的侵略，尤其是联邦太阳国；他们认为戴维恩家族“自由捍卫者”的名声毫无根据甚至虚伪，并且与这个庞大得多的继承国有长期冲突史。3147年，卡夫·多鲁之子与萨姆·卡尔德隆之女的婚约被提出，将在3157年使两国重新统一为一国。在那之前，两国将扩大贸易关系并开展共同防御行动。协约现任统治者是保护者卡夫·多鲁。

column1: The Terran Hegemony was an interstellar state located at the center of the Inner Sphere. Established after a military coup led by James McKenna overthrew the dictatorial and decaying Terran Alliance, the Hegemony quickly rose to dominating positions in the realms of technology, military innovation, and diplomacy, and remained the most influential of all interstellar powers for the rest of its existence. The Hegemony's early expansionist period contributed to the formation of the Great Houses, its era of aggressive diplomacy eventually led to the creation of the Star League, and its destruction in the Amaris Civil War led to the Succession Wars.
column2: 地球霸权是位于内层星域中心的星际国家。它由詹姆斯·麦肯纳领导的军事政变推翻独裁且衰朽的地球联盟后建立，随后迅速在技术、军事创新与外交领域攀升至主导地位，并在其存续的余下时间里始终是所有星际势力中最具影响力者。霸权早期的扩张时期促成了各大家族的形成，其激进外交时代最终催生了星际联盟，而它在阿马里斯内战中的毁灭则导致了继承战争。

column1: Terran Hegemony
column2: 泰拉霸权

column1: The Tikonov Free Republic was a short-lived state formed during the Fourth Succession War. Following his defection to the Federated Suns in early 3029, Capellan Confederation Colonel Pavel Ridzik established his own fiefdom from Tikonov Commonality worlds as yet unconquered by the Suns. After his death the statelet voted to merge with the Lyran Commonwealth's Sarna March in 3031
column2: 提科诺夫自由共和国是第四次继承战争期间成立的一个短命国家。卡佩兰联邦上校帕维尔·里兹克在3029年初叛逃到联邦太阳之后，以尚未被联邦太阳征服的提科诺夫共同体各行星建立了自己的领地。他死后，这个小国于3031年投票决定与莱兰联邦的萨尔纳边区合并

column1: Tikonov Free Republic
column2: 提科诺夫自由共和国

column1: The Timbuktu Collective is a protective alliance formed in June 3148 through the merger of the Rim Collection and five worlds from the Lyran Commonwealth's Timbuktu Theater. This union was driven by secessionist sentiments and a desire for greater autonomy amid perceived neglect by the Commonwealth. The Collective's capital is Timbuktu II, and as of 3151, it controlled 17 systems. Its military, the Collective Armed Guards (CAG), was initially formed from defected units and has since expanded through local enlistment and the hiring of mercenaries. The Collective has steadily expanded its borders, incorporating additional worlds such as Pocologan, Viborg, and Sapienza. Despite economic challenges due to reduced interstellar trade, the Timbuktu Collective remains determined to restore its former territories and industrial might.
column2: 廷巴克图集体是一个防御性联盟，于3148年6月由边缘集团与来自莱兰联邦廷巴克图战区的五颗行星合并而成。这一联合源于分离主义情绪，以及在感受到联邦的忽视之下对更大自治的渴望。集体的首都是廷巴克图II，截至3151年它控制着17个星系。其军队"集体武装卫队"（CAG）最初由叛变部队组成，此后通过本地征募与雇佣雇佣兵而扩充。集体稳步扩张边界，吸纳了波科洛根、维堡和萨皮恩扎等更多世界。尽管因星际贸易减少而面临经济挑战，廷巴克图集体仍决心恢复其昔日领土与工业实力。

column1: Timbuktu Collective
column2: 廷巴克图集合体

column1: Tortuga Dominions
column2: 托尔图加自治领

column1: The Umayyad Caliphate is a small state residing within the Deep Periphery. The Umayyads are in a region of space roughly seventy-five light years in diameter, situated 150 light years coreward from the Hanseatic League and 200 light years anti-spinward from the Clan Jade Falcon colony of St. Jean. Originally separate entities, more than 200 years of continuous warfare and shared history has inextricably bound the Umayyads to Nueva Castile, even resulting in the intermingling of some bloodlines.
column2: 乌玛雅王朝是位于深空外围的一个小国。乌玛雅人占据的星域直径约75光年，距离汉萨同盟向内核方向约150光年，并位于玉鹰氏族殖民地St.Jean反旋向约200光年之外。乌玛雅人最初是一个独立的实体，但超过200年的持续战争和共同历史，将他们与新卡斯蒂利亚密不可分地联系在一起，甚至导致了一些血脉的融合.

column1: Umayyad Caliphate
column2: 乌玛雅王朝

column1: The union of two breakaway factions from the Oberon Confederation, namely Butte Hold and Morgraine's Valkyrate in 3028 created the Greater Valkyrate, a Pirate Kingdom that kept the Oberon Confederation in check as their strong antagonist. It was notable for emphasizing the dominance of women over men.
column2: 3028年，奥伯龙邦联中两个分离派系——比特霍尔德与莫格雷恩的女武神领——合并，创建了“大女武神领”。这个海盗王国作为其强势对手，牵制着奥伯龙邦联。它因强调女性对男性的主导而引人注目。

column1: Greater Valkyrate
column2: 大女武神国度

column1: The Vesper Marches is a nation established in March 3151 within the former Clan Jade Falcon Occupation Zone. Founded by Duke Vedet Brewer, the Marches emerged following Brewer's departure from the Lyran Commonwealth and his subsequent takeover of Melissia, which became the capital of his new realm. Initially, its military strength centered around the First Hesperus Guards, with later expansions incorporating noble personal armies. Politically, the Vesper Marches function as Brewer's personal domain, maintained through alliances with Melissia's noble families. Economically, the nation benefits from corporate support on Medellin and trade relations with the Free Guilds of the Malthus Confederation.
column2: 维斯珀边区是一个于3151年3月在原翡翠猎鹰氏族占领区内建立的国家。它由维德特·布鲁尔公爵建立，出现于布鲁尔离开莱兰联邦、随后接管梅利西亚之后，后者成为他新领域的首都。起初其军力以第一赫斯佩鲁斯卫队为中心，后来扩张时吸纳了贵族私人军队。政治上，维斯珀边区充当布鲁尔的私人领地，通过与梅利西亚贵族家族的联盟维系。经济上，该国受益于梅德林的企业支持以及与马尔萨斯邦联自由行会的贸易关系。

column1: The Wolf Empire, established on January 1, 3142, emerged from Clan Wolf's strategic expansion into the Inner Sphere during the tumultuous Blackout period. Under the leadership of Khan Alaric Ward, Clan Wolf seized over sixty worlds from the Free Worlds League and the Lyran Commonwealth, culminating in the proclamation of the Wolf Empire. With its capital on Gienah, the Empire continued its aggressive campaigns, ultimately breaching the Republic of the Sphere's defenses to capture Terra in 3151, thereby becoming the ilClan of the reborn Star League.
column2: 狼帝国建立于3142年1月1日，诞生于动荡的大停电时期狼族向内天体的战略扩张。在可汗阿拉里克·沃德的领导下，狼族从自由世界联盟和莱兰联邦手中夺取了六十多个星系，最终宣告狼帝国的成立。帝国以吉拿为首都，继续其侵略性战役，最终突破天球共和国的防线，于3151年夺取地球，从而成为重生星盟的伊尔氏族。

column1: In the morning briefing, Yang jumps right in. \"Commander, the Leopard is too small! My MechTechs keep tripping over everything.\"
\n\"Chief, we've talked about this,\" Darius says in exasperation. \"We can't exactly knock down any walls.\"
\nSumire inserts herself. \"What if we moved some supplies into other parts of the Leopard? The bunks, the kitchen, hell, I'll even store some boxes in the cockpit if it'll help.\"
\nYang rubs his chin. \"Yeah, if I had some breathing room for a week, I could re-organize and make room for everything to move back.\"
column2:
晨间简报时，杨直接切入正题。"指挥官，豹式太小了！我的机修技师们老是被东西绊倒。"

"总工，我们谈过这个了，"达里乌斯无奈地说。"我们又不能把墙拆了。"

苏米蕾插话。"要是我们把一些补给搬到豹式的其他部分呢？铺位、厨房，见鬼，要是有用我甚至愿意在座舱里堆几个箱子。"

杨摩挲着下巴。"行，要是能有一周喘息的余地，我就能重新归整，腾出空间把所有东西搬回来。"

column1: We need you to recover our operatives from inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. They will be carrying highly sensitive scientific materials which must be returned to us. These materials are of a biological nature, and must not be tampered with. Opening or tampering with the materials will be considered a breach of contract.
column2: 我们需要你从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的研究设施中救出我们的特工. 他们携带的都是高度敏感的科学材料，必须完好无损地回到我们这里. 这些材料具有生化性质，禁止擅自处理. 打开或擅自处理这些材料将被视为违反合约.
